However, when he ate this cultivation fruit, Shi Yu couldn’t remain calm at all. He felt that his will was instantly impacted.
It was mainly because what he ate was indeed not an ordinary item.
It was a divine-level resource.
It was a divine skill prototype cultivation fruit developed by Baby Ginseng after it learned the cultivation method. It studied it for half a month and consumed fertilizer almost equivalent to super divine resources.
The initial level of the cultivation fruit cultivated by Baby Ginseng was a quasi-divine skill. It could be said to be the best among divine-level resources. With sufficient energy, it would take days to condense one. It was no wonder that Shi Yu directly fainted.
Not only did it make one’s sense of smell and taste feel smelly, but it also made one’s mind, heart, and soul feel smelly. There were no blind spots in all aspects. Perhaps even the perception of the spiritual element couldn’t stop this thing.
“Mi!!”
“Ning!!”
After discovering that Shi Yu had fainted from the stench, every pet panicked and rushed over to watch the commotion.
The Vermillion Bird clone with the main body in its mouth and the Star Sea Sprite Susu rushed over immediately.
Qi carried Little Zi and immediately rushed to the scene with the younger siblings of the clueless team.
In the ranking battle of the ten thousand races, Buggy and the patient, Eleven, who was tied up with worm silk, were also shocked. They thought that something had happened to Shi Yu and accelerated toward home.
At the scene, Susu covered its nose and looked at the cultivation fruit that had been bitten, as well as glared at Baby Ginseng.
This thing could be eaten???
“Yi. (The greater the price to use something, the better the effect.)” Baby Ginseng argued reasonably. This meant that it was a huge success.
“Ning!! (Can it be cleansed?)” Susu quickly asked.
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng fell into deep thought. It didn’t know what the consequences of cleansing the stink of the cultivation fruit would be or if it would change the nature of the cultivation fruit, but it wasn’t a problem to cleanse and awaken Shi Yu.
“Ning.” Upon hearing that, Susu immediately cleansed and called for help, cleansing Shi Yu’s negative state. Then, Shi Yu slowly crawled up with twitching hands and feet.
“I say…”
“Baby Ginseng!!! Can’t this thing be optimized anymore!!” Shi Yu’s mentality exploded.
He originally thought that no matter how bad it was, how bad could it be?
However, Shi Yu had forgotten that he was a man who couldn’t even accept stinky tofu and snail powder!
“Yi!! (Probably, but it’s only entry-level proficiency now. Perhaps after reaching expert+11, it can change its taste.)” Baby Ginseng said.
Of course, it wasn’t sure either.
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “Alright, I’ll give you some points later…”
“However, the effect of this thing seems to be pretty good. Although I only slept for less than a minute just now, I feel that the efficiency of cultivation is almost twice that of my normal cultivation…”
Baby Ginseng: Yi!
To be honest, according to its speculation, this was the nature of this fruit. The higher the level and Effect, the more smelly it might be… However, Baby Ginseng didn’t dare to tell Shi Yu.
Sigh, it should work hard…
It felt that even if it could modify the mutation, the consumption would probably not be small. It would, at most, modify it for Shi Yu. If it was sold, it definitely wouldn’t spend the effort to modify it.
“Sigh.” Shi Yu sighed. Little Ji, Duckie, and the others beside him advised Shi Yu to suffer in order to be superior.
Shi Yu didn’t feel comforted at all. He only wanted to train them more.
Soon, Eleven and Buggy rushed over without stopping. At this moment, Shi Yu had already dispersed his pets and was still conflicted about whether he should eat the remaining cultivation fruits. He had already taken a bite of this thing. If he didn’t eat it as soon as possible, as time passed, the nutrition would disappear.
“Wuu…”
“Ji!!” On the way back, Eleven and Buggy had already confirmed that Shi Yu had revived and was fine. However, after returning, they still looked at the cultivation fruit curiously and sighed with emotion. The power of this thing was actually greater than adding points?
“Do you want to try it…” Shi Yu handed it over.
Eleven and Buggy shook their heads repeatedly and took a step back.
“Wu wu wu. (Shame to waste.)” Eleven said.
This cultivation fruit was only effective for humans, so they wouldn’t eat it.
“Tsk, isn’t the opponent very strong? I sensed that it seemed very difficult for you guys to fight. I almost lost.” Shi Yu temporarily didn’t think about the fruit and asked Eleven.
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven, who was wrapped into a white bear by Buggy’s pile of worm silk bandages, shook its head. No, no. The opponent was very weak, and it won very easily.
“Ji!! (It’s clearly very difficult to win. If this is the God Sealing Battle, that green dragon and the Beast Tamer will attack together. You will definitely lose miserably.)” Buggy curled its lips.
Of course… if it didn’t use the power of faith, it would probably be even worse than Eleven.

chapters.title: Chapter 1353 - 1353 Battle God Bear Eleven (2)
chapters.content:
1353 Battle God Bear Eleven (2)
Eleven was speechless and looked at Shi Yu eagerly.
“Looks like a cosmic life form from a first-level domain is indeed not easy to deal with… Eleven, don’t worry. You only have two quasi-divine skills, one entry-level and the other proficient level. Your battle power is all supported by the combination of super skills. It’s normal for it to be difficult to fight these guys.”
“Even if you don’t fuse new skills, when I add more than ten points to your Yin Yang Millstone and Light Control, your battle power will definitely double. Don’t worry.”
“Wuu!!” Eleven was immediately full of energy. It accidentally broke the bandage tied by Buggy and immediately gritted its teeth. Every black and white hair stood up like needles.
“Hurry up and find Baby Ginseng.” Shi Yu was speechless.
“Then, Buggy, hypnotize me immediately and let me enter a deep sleep state. Try your best to block my perception. Then, use your psychic power to show off this leftover fruit in my mouth and teleport it into my stomach!”
Shi Yu turned to Buggy and issued an order, trying to bug it.
“Ji. (Alright.)” Seeing that it was such a simple order, Buggy immediately followed it and hypnotized Shi Yu. Then, it stuffed the cultivation fruit into Shi Yu’s mouth and fed it to Shi Yu.
However, after doing all of this, Buggy still discovered that Shi Yu, who should have been dreaming, began to toss and turn with a frozen expression…
…
At the same time, at the Blue Wave Branch of the Myriad Races Committee.
The Myriad Races Committee was an organization that was born for the ranking battle of all races.
The positions of the core higher-ups here were basically monopolized by the strong races of the various realms.
Apart from being in charge of the matters related to the ranking battle of the ten thousand races, the most common thing the higher-ups of the Myriad Races Committee did was to discover some grassroots geniuses immediately through their internal authority.
There were too many cosmic life forms who had come to register for the ranking battle of the ten thousand races. Although most of them were here to give points and didn’t recognize their strength, it was also common for a few grassroots geniuses who didn’t belong to the powerful divine race to evolve very quickly due to coincidence.
As soon as such contestants were discovered, it was the focus of the Myriad Races Committee. The higher-ups of the Myriad Races Committee would use the convenience of their authority to find an opportunity to rope them in and let them join their faction.
Bringing in marriages and breeding was an excellent choice…
Although the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race, Gorka, was only at the quasi-divine level at the moment, it had always been the focus of the Myriad Races Committee, the Blue Wave Branch. Firstly, it was because its race was ranked in the top 10,000 of the Myriad Races in the Starry Sky and was one of the true Myriad Races in the Starry Sky. In the entire World King Planet, it was a famous divine race. In the entire Blue Wave World, it was even more powerful.
The Blue Wave Green Dragon Race lived in the Blue Wave World. The rise and fall of this race’s ranking concerned the strength of the Blue Wave World, so they naturally had to pay special attention.
The second clueless was because Gorka had signed a contract with the genius of the Blue Wave Human Family, Sen Nian. Sen Nian was a super genius. He had once partnered with Gorka and entered the top 500 of the God Sealing Battle together. His highest result was 486. He was regarded by the Blue Wave World as a genius combination with the hope of charging into the top 100 in the future.
They were training in the ranking battle of all races. Victory and defeat were basically paid attention to at all times.
Just as Eleven and the others finished fighting Gorka and the information on the backstage system of the Myriad Races Committee was updated, the staff in charge of the review was immediately stunned.
“The Blue Wave Green Dragon Race lost to a newbie who had just participated in the ranking?” The staff member exclaimed. Then, another group of staff surrounded him.
A group of staff surrounded the video and looked at the battle video recorded by the judge robot in disbelief. Iron-eating Beast Race’s Eleven erupted infinitely and defeated the Blue Wave Green Dragon Gorka, suppressing the other party without the ability to counterattack the whole time!
In just a few minutes of battle, it directly defeated the Blue Wave Green Dragon. In the end, it was suspected to have used the prototype of a top-notch divine skill!
“Iron-eating Beast??? What race is this?? It’s actually even fiercer than all races in the starry sky of the same level…”
“I pulled up the information. This Iron-eating Beast Race that calls itself Eleven is from the Floating Realm… Wait, age, four years old?”
“He’s f*cking four years old???”
“What a joke.” A cry of surprise came from the entire workshop. After all, the Blue Wave Green Dragon, Gorka, had started to become a little famous 40 years ago. It produced results and stepped into the quasi-divine realm.
It was considered a young dragon among the dragons, but… being beaten up by a four-year-old bear was ridiculous!
“Director Sen is Sen Nian’s elder, right? Should… we inform Director Sen??” The staff looked at each other.
Soon, Director Sen, one of the managers of the Blue Wave Branch of the Myriad Race Committee, arrived at the scene. He also finished watching the competition video in shock and fell into deep thought.
“In the next two battles, arrange for a more powerful opponent for it. Don’t worry about the rest.” After seeing Eleven’s domain, he gave the order.
The Floating Realm… had cultivated a top-notch divine race… This Iron-eating Beast Race came from the Floating Realm and wasn’t something they could afford to provoke.
The number one expert and number two expert in the Floating Realm had the battle record of joining forces to hunt super divine beings and were on good terms with a few super divine lives. A large race like the Sen family still knew some inside information, so they just had to divert some energy to pay attention to this Iron-eating Beast, Eleven. There was no need to get too involved.
“What does the Floating Realm want…” Director Sen muttered in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1354 - 1354 Battle God Bear Eleven (3)
chapters.content:
1354 Battle God Bear Eleven (3)
Previously, the Floating Realm was only a top-notch expert, but from the looks of it… Director Sen felt that this second-level realm seemed to have to work hard in the younger generation.
On the other side, after an unknown period of time, Shi Yu was still sleeping.
It had been a long time since Shi Yu had slept so soundly.
In Shi Yu’s sleeping state, his second Beast Taming Space suddenly changed with a boom and upgraded.
Little Ji, Duckie, the cat, the turtle, and Little Quas, who had contracted the second Beast Taming Space, were all shocked. They felt the changes in their bodies due to the upgrade of the Beast Taming Space.
“Roar!!!”
“Quack!!” Little Ji and Duckie roared at the sky, very surprised.
After Shi Yu successfully leveled up in his sleep, Little Ji and Duckie immediately spread the news and ran to the towering emperor to thank him crazily.
It hadn’t been a day or two since Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to cultivate the second Beast Taming Space. At this moment, when they saw Shi Yu eat the fruit created by the towering emperor and successfully upgrade the second Beast Taming Space, Little Ji and Duckie immediately cried.
They… could finally live in a luxurious Beast Taming Space of the same scale as Team One!
Soon, the pets gathered by Shi Yu’s window and surrounded him. They looked at Shi Yu, who was lying on the bed, and whispered to each other.
“I keep feeling that it’s strange,” Ling said.
Why did it look like they were watching a funeral?
Now, Shi Yu had already slept for a week. During this period, Ling had almost completed its research and modification, but he was still sleeping.
However, seeing that Shi Yu was sleeping soundly and that no pet came to disturb Shi Yu, it kept letting him level up in peace.
However, now that Shi Yu had reached Level 9 and his physique had improved greatly, Eleven and the other pets looked at each other and felt that they couldn’t let Shi Yu sleep anymore.
Now, Shi Yu, who was at Level 9, had entered his best state. Next, Eleven and Buggy felt that it was time to pull Shi Yu up and add points to them.
“Wu wu wu!! (Buggy, go.)” Under Eleven’s call, Buggy immediately nodded and entered Shi Yu’s dream. It realized that in the dream, Shi Yu was eating stinky tofu, snail powder, durian, and herring canned food excitedly…
It endured its sympathy and pulled Shi Yu back to the real world from the dream.
“Ugh…” Although Shi Yu had some intermittent dreams, he had rested pretty well. At this moment, he had vaguely recovered his restoration consciousness. After gradually waking up, he felt energetic and slept very well.
“Wu wu wu!! (Almost seven days.)”
Damn, he didn’t even feel anything. He had really fallen asleep!
This worked?
“Roar!!!” “Quack!!” Little Ji and Duckie celebrated happily, indicating that it was true.
Shi Yu immediately got up and looked at Ling. “Ling, did something happen while I was sleeping?”
Ling said, “It’s nothing big. Apart from me, everyone is staying at home obediently. I downloaded a lot of information about the Starry Sky Storm from the Disaster Research Institute and bought a lot of mechanical parts through the channels of the Disaster Research Institute. At the moment, the interior of the mechanical space is undergoing modification. In a few days, the comprehensive modification should be successful and it can evolve into a cosmic life form.”
Shi Yu grabbed the bedsheet and said, “Well done. I originally wanted to help you, but from the looks of it, you’re almost done yourself.”
Ling : “…”
Did it mean that it could increase its own research speed by adding points?
“Didn’t Eleven participate in the ranking battle anymore?” Shi Yu asked Little Eleven. Little Eleven shook its head repeatedly. It didn’t want to fight anymore!!
In this state, it was indeed a little difficult.
It wanted to fight after adding points!!
Eleven clenched its fists with shining eyes.
“Looks like it’s nothing…” Shi Yu sighed and said, “Double Level 9…”
Shi Yu clenched his fists and felt that his physical control talent had also been brought to Level 9. Now, he seemed to be able to control any energy in his Crowd Control body at will.
Including soul power.
It seemed like he could already use his mental strength to form psychic power and use his soul power to attack the soul.
Apart from that, his control over his life form had also reached an unbelievable level. Under Shi Yu’s Crowd Control, he didn’t use Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit at all. He immediately shrank, and his clothes began to become larger…
In the blink of an eye, Shi Yu turned into a seven or eight-year-old boy through physical control.
“Although its body has become smaller, its appearance is still handsome…” Shi Yu said.
The pets: “?”
“Are Turtle, Little Quas, and Cat around?” Shi Yu dragged his large pajamas and looked around.
“Hu!!! (Lord, I’m here!!)”
The Winter Water Snake also stuck its head out.
“Not bad. You should be able to adapt to the environment of the World King Planet now, right?” Shi Yu said.
The three pets nodded repeatedly.
“Master, do you plan to start nurturing them?” Ling asked.
“Yeah, now that I’m at Level 9, my cultivation speed is faster than I expected at the start. With the cultivation fruit, I should be able to save a lot of time in cultivation next.”
“Also, because Susu has learned the origin wave, the difficulty of adding points is also smaller than before. In 10 months, it should be more than enough to equip you perfectly.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1355 - 1355 Battle God Bear Eleven (4)
chapters.content:
1355 Battle God Bear Eleven (4)
“In that case, why don’t we find an opportunity to nurture them too? Everyone can participate in the God Sealing Battle together. Also, Little Zi, I’ve already found a way to make you a battle planet.”
Little Zi, who was in Qi’s arms, was stunned before being pleasantly surprised. There was still room for it!
Shi Yu smiled and nodded. He had indeed found a way long ago.
That was… to become a world overlord!
After becoming a world overlord of a domain on the World King Planet, one could obtain the Star Attack skill.
If one wanted to become a world overlord of the World King Star, even if it was a third-level world overlord, the threshold wasn’t low. For example, it wasn’t easy to have a low-level planet of one’s own and obtain first place in the God Sealing Battle.
However, after really becoming a world overlord, there were also many benefits. For example, he could obtain his own fiefdom or the Star Attack skill. At that time, after having his own fiefdom, Shi Yu could let Little Zi move the Star Continent in its body to the World King Planet and establish his City of Incense Faith to provide the power of faith to Buggy and the others.
Right on the heels of that, if it taught Little Zi attack skills, it would be able to fight as it pleased.
Having his own fief on the World King Planet and accumulating the power of faith of the four Saints was part of Shi Yu’s plan. However, Shi Yu felt that just this wasn’t enough. This bit of power of faith wasn’t enough to nurture the four holy beasts. More power of faith was still monopolized by the four saints, who had evolved deeper.
Therefore, Shi Yu was still conceptualizing a skill.
[Name]: Faith Overdraft
[Effect]: As long as it makes up for the power of faith in the future, it can overdraw the power of faith that it never had to strengthen its faith skill!
[Deduction success rate]: Extremely low
As long as they learned this move, the combination of Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others was equivalent to having unlimited power of faith. They could mobilize the power of faith at any time.
Compared to other gods of faith, it would be much more carefree. It was commonly known as exceeding consumption.
In short, at least, there would be stronger power to use at the critical moment. As long as he knew when to use this move and when not to use it, this move could definitely become the strongest sure-kill move in Shi Yu’s team.
If he mobilized the power of faith to the limit, perhaps he could fight a super divine at the divine level?
Then, after defeating the gains of the super divine level, he could also use it to buy a large number of precious items of the Four Saints’ faith from the ruins of the era, perfectly forming a closed ring…
Of course, Shi Yu’s most important task at the moment was to strengthen Eleven.
Eleven should be the last to be strengthened. At the moment, only its skills were in the team. There were still more than ten, and they had yet to be fused.
…
Next, Shi Yu began to let unrelated pets move freely. As for Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Susu, and the others, they stayed behind and prepared to assist in adding points.
In Little Zi’s body, Star Continent.
“Alright, I’m almost done resting. My current state isn’t bad. Eleven, I’ll fuse it for you now!” Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng, Susu, Chi Tong, Ling, Buggy, and the others. “How are your states? Do you need to prepare?”
All the pets shook their heads, indicating that they could do it now!!
“Alright.” Shi Yu looked at Eleven. This was the last fusion of the first team!
After completing this, he could easily add more points.
[Eleven]
[Race Skill]
“Super Level”: Inner Power, Space Quake, Impregnable, Demon God Body, Leaving Gold Battle Body, Thunder God Armor, Nine Li Army, Indestructible Golden Body, Killing Wind, Mirror Reflection, Turning Stone into Gold, Molten Gold
“Quasi Divine-level”: Yin Yang Millstone, Control of Light
[Taught Skill]
“Super Level”: Superalloy
Eleven’s skills were a little complicated, but under Shi Yu’s multiple permutations, he had indeed found a few optimal permutations.
“Wuu!!!” As Eleven roared in anticipation, the pets were already prepared!!
Buggy first activated the Creation Domain. In the Creation Domain, Buggy was the Creation God. It could also recover Shi Yu’s state to a certain extent and increase the ability to enhance Baby Ginseng.
Another layer of inner worlds overlapped in Little Zi’s body, which was originally a small world.
“Mi!!!” Chi Tong entered Shi Yu’s body and underwent a possession state. At the same time that it increased Shi Yu’s strength, it replaced Shi Yu to withstand some of the losses.
“Ning!!” Susu, on the other hand, was accumulating origin fluctuations to cleanse Shi Yu and Eleven’s consumption and affliction. If necessary, it would use the Star Sea Contract. Although this violated the contract rules, as long as it didn’t come often, there wouldn’t be a problem with the contract as long as it only came a few times.
“The last step.” Ling passed. The nine-colored divine light gently strengthened Shi Yu, Eleven’s will, and various states. At the same time, it used the wind of blessings to entangle and bless Shi Yu and Eleven.
Under such a configuration, Shi Yu could withstand even the greatest consumption. The advantage of Shi Yu contracting a bunch of pets appeared to be vivid at this moment.
When Baby Ginseng also placed its palm on Shi Yu and Little Zi also used the World Blessing, Shi Yu took a deep breath and entered a mental resonance state with Eleven to activate the Taiji Domain. In an instant, Eleven also sensed this heavy power.
If the previous additional points were only the result of an activity between Shi Yu and a single pet, then the current additional points were the result of the entire team’s hard work.
Gathering the strength of the entire team to help a pet become stronger.
“Wuu!!” After sensing this heavy power again, Eleven was still very touched. It made up its mind to persist and master a stronger power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1356 - 1356 Battle God Bear Eleven (5)
chapters.content:
1356 Battle God Bear Eleven (5)
Compared to other teammates, Eleven didn’t have any support skills. Its support function for other pets wasn’t big. It was just a natural battle beast, so Eleven had always wanted to help his teammates in other aspects.
Therefore, it had to become stronger.
Skill: Inner Power, Impregnable, Leaving Gold Battle Body, Indestructible Golden Body
[Fusion success rate]: Extremely low
[Fusion Risk]: Very high
“Eleven, charge!”
“Wu!” “Yi!” “Mi!” “Ning!” “All the best!”
Under the cheers of the entire team, the skill furnace directly activated!!
Countless skill EXP shattered and fused. The huge will impact made Eleven roar at the sky!!
“Roar!!!!!!”
At the same time, a shocking warpath potential erupted from Eleven’s body!!
“Boom boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!!!”
Under Shi Yu and the others’ perception, the current Eleven had all its energy restrained. Only its warpath turned into an unstoppable sharpness that shot into the sky, shaking Buggy’s Creation Domain continuously.
Even Little Zi’s entire inner world was shaken by the shocking fighting spirit.
This commotion…
As Shi Yu consumed his energy quickly, he was extremely happy. There was a high chance that this commotion would fuse into a very powerful skill!!
However, what surprised Ling and the others the most was that during the skill fusion, they didn’t feel many terrifying changes in Eleven’s energy. Instead, Eleven’s physical life force began to shine like the sun.
Could it be… a physique skill?
At this moment, Eleven indeed felt this way. It felt that no matter what energy it was, it was crazily impacting and flowing in its body, strengthening its body, and making its already very terrifying physique even stronger.
It made Eleven feel that even if it stood and let the green dragon attack previously, the other party couldn’t break through its defense. Standing and letting Baby Ginseng self-destruct continuously couldn’t shake its fundamental powerful confidence.
“Roar!!!” Eleven’s body unknowingly enlarged to a hundred meters, a thousand meters, ten thousand meters, and 100,000 meters. Its physique was constantly strengthening, and its strength was constantly condensing. In an instant, Buggy, the god of creation here, was almost absent-minded. It was as if it had predicted a scene in front of its eyes.
When Buggy woke up, it realized that it was all an illusion. However, its Creation Domain had really shattered at this moment. It began to let Little Zi, a low-level planet, withstand this terrifying physical power that was enough to crush the world.
When all the pets were shocked by how ridiculous a skill Eleven wanted to fuse into, Eleven’s huge transformation finally stopped and began to shrink towards the cub state as if it was leaking air.
At the same time.
[Fusion successful]
[Inner Power, Impregnable, Leaving Gold Battle Body, Indestructible Golden Body] had already fused into the [Battle God Body].
Skill: Battle God Body
< Introduction > It’s a top-notch battle physique. It can double any energy in the body into physique strength and unleash the strongest physical strength with the smallest consumption.
It could transform the enemy’s damage into physique strength and life force. The heavier the injury, the stronger the battle power.
When one died in battle, the battlepath obsession would transform into an endless life form and revive. As long as the battle will didn’t disappear, the body wouldn’t die.
Boom!!!
After the fusion was successful, Eleven had already recovered to the size of a meter tall. It closed its eyes and floated in the air, slowly descending. At this moment, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Ling, and the others couldn’t feel any energy fluctuations or stats fluctuations on Eleven.
However, when they saw Eleven’s small body, they could sense the aura of a primeval ferocious beast. That was a top-notch divine body that could kill demigods with an ordinary punch and crush divine skills.
No one expected that the fusion of these skills would actually fuse a pure physique skill for Eleven.
“Cough… Cough…” The weak Shi Yu looked at Eleven, who had landed on the ground and slowly opened its dark star-like eyes, in surprise. At this moment, he completely sensed Eleven’s power. This power… was undoubtedly the power of a small star that could explode with a punch alone after stepping into the God Realm!
“Wuu…” Eleven opened its eyes, which were filled with confidence. It simply clenched its fists and let out a boom, causing Little Zi’s entire world to tremble. Rain fell from the sky. That was Little Zi crying.
“Wu wu wu…” Eleven was so scared that it hurriedly apologized. It had good control over its physical strength. It felt that this skill was better than the Yin Yang Millstone in combat. Its consumption was smaller than the Yin Yang Millstone, and its strength was greater than the Yin Yang Millstone. Apart from the special effect of obliterating everything, everything was very perfect.
Eleven immediately bowed and thanked the silent crowd, while Shi Yu maintained his smile.
“It’s not over. Give me the divine crystal. Everyone, quickly replenish your strength.”
“Adjust your state and let’s continue!!”
….
[Skill]: Nine Li Army, Killing Wind, Mirror Reflection, Turning Stone into Gold, Molten Gold, Space Quake, Superalloy
[Fusion success rate]: Extremely low
[Fusion Risk]: Very high

chapters.title: Chapter 1357 - 1357 Battle God Bear Eleven (6)
chapters.content:
1357 Battle God Bear Eleven (6)
Previously, he had used Eleven’s explosive skill and restoration skills to fuse, forming a battle divine body with an invincible body. Now, Shi Yu was using the Nine Li Army’s clone skill as the core to fuse with the skills of wind, water, earth, exort, and space.
To be honest, he still didn’t know what skills he could bet, but these skills happened to have a success rate. This made Shi Yu choose to give it a try.
It was still an incomparably difficult process. During this period, Eleven stood in the Taiji Domain. Eight panda clones about Eleven’s size slowly formed under the spinning of the Taiji Painting.
At first, they only looked like black and white pandas, but soon, as the black and white power circled, metal armor of different colors appeared on their bodies. There was white armor, red armor, brown armor, green armor, and blue armor. They were of different styles!!
Every panda clone was filled with a powerful aura that wasn’t inferior to a demigod.
“Roar!!!” As Eleven’s main body in the center of the Taiji Painting roared, the eight Bean Bear clones suddenly opened their corresponding armor and different colored eyes.
[Fusion successful]
[Nine Li Army, Killing Wind, Mirror Reflection, Turning Stone into Gold, Molten Gold, Space Quake, Super Alloy] had already fused into [Eight Trigrams Clone].
[Skill]: Eight Trigrams Clone
< Introduction > Taiji gives birth to Two Elements, Two Elements give birth to Four Symbols, Four Symbols give birth to Eight Trigrams…
It could create eight battle clones that controlled the power of laws in Heaven, Earth, Thunder, Wind, Water, Fire, Mountain, and Swamp!!
“Taiji Domain, what exactly are you…”
At this moment, Shi Yu couldn’t help but say. He realized that the skills that were assisted in fusion through the mind domain, the Taiji Domain, were all top-notch divine skills. They were top-notch and powerful.
Sensing that the eight Bean Bears beside Eleven also contained terrifying physical power and had powerful auras flowing with laws on their bodies, Buggy and the other pets were shocked.
What a joke. Why did they feel that Eleven’s eight clones could sweep through demigods without its main body attacking?
“Wu wu wu!!!”
At this moment, Eleven didn’t care so much. It was extremely excited. Its warpath was high, and it commanded the Armored Bean Bears to carry divine crystals to recover everyone’s restoration.
Continue, continue. It still had skills to fuse!!!
“Come, rest for two days. Continue.” Shi Yu sensed the Taiji Domain beside him and fell into deep thought.
According to the theory that Taiji gave birth to two elements, two elements gave birth to four symbols, and the four symbols gave birth to eight trigrams, since the four symbols were cosmic life forms from the last era, what did the power of Taiji represent??
When he fused the Yin Yang Millstone, Shi Yu had already sensed the power of the Taiji Domain. However, he now felt that he had still underestimated the potential power of this domain that contained divine power.
Earth…
If there was a chance, he had to go back and take a look.
…
[Skill]: Demon God Body, Thunder God Armor
[Fusion success rate]: Extremely low
[Fusion Risk]: Very high
Next, Shi Yu only had two super skills that had yet to be fused. One was mainly dark, and the other was mainly light thunder. There was a slight conflict, so the compatibility wasn’t high, but it contained the Dao of Yin Yang. Shi Yu felt that with the support of the Taiji Domain, he could still try to fuse it.
In the past few days, just giving Eleven the fusion skill and the consumption of the entire team’s divine crystals made Shi Yu feel very pained. However, when he thought of Eleven’s current strength, Shi Yu felt that everything was worth it.
Before this, he was still worried that even if he obtained first place in the God Sealing Battle, he couldn’t defeat the cosmic divine beast guarding the prize. But now, he wasn’t worried at all.
Because Eleven alone was enough to fight ordinary initial-level gods above his level without any external help, at that time, it shouldn’t be a big problem for the entire team to defeat an intermediate-level god.
With endless expectations, Shi Yu and the others underwent the final fusion with Eleven.
“This time… it can’t be very ridiculous, right?” Shi Yu was almost afraid.
Buggy and the other pets were also afraid. They felt that Eleven was getting closer and closer to invincibility.
“Roar!!!”
This time, during the fusion process, Eleven seemed to have recovered to the initial state of the Chaos Panda, as if it had fallen into the chaos of lightning and its figure couldn’t be seen clearly. Its body was yin and yang, light and dark, filled with two-colored lightning that fused, converted, and collided.
Under the influence of Eleven’s will, the thunder, both light and dark, on its body freely transformed. At times, Eleven was clad in white Thunder God armor, while at other moments, it turned into the body of a black Demon God, exuding an extraordinary aura.
[Fusion successful]
[Demon God Body and Thunder God Armor] had already fused into [One Thought of God and Demon].
[Skill]: One Thought of God and Demon
< Introduction > It can become a god with a thought and a demon with a thought. In the divine state, it can control the power of light thunder. In the demon state, it can control the power of dark thunder.
After entering the Divine Demon Thought, one could break through the restrictions of the brain under the stimulation of the power of light, darkness, and lightning and obtain extremely strong attacks, defense, speed, injury avoidance, and thought reaction power that exceeded time.
Note: The simultaneous thoughts of a demon and a god are extremely dangerous. After using it, you will lose the ability to fight!! The stronger the physique, the smaller the negative effect!!
“What the hell is this?” Shi Yu and the others were already speechless.
Buggy and the other pets completely collapsed. They felt that unless they obtained the faith overdraft Shi Yu mentioned and overdrafted their future desperately, they definitely couldn’t defeat Eleven.
“Wuu!!!” Indeed, this was a very dangerous skill. The moment it mastered it, Eleven sensed that even if it obtained the Battle God Body, it would lose its ability to fight after being dazzling. However, at the same time, during the period of the Demon God’s Thought, even if it encountered an opponent who mastered the divine skill that could create a Time Stop domain, and the opponent trapped it in the Time Stop domain, its thoughts could also exceed time. With a thought, it could control the Crowd Control Divine Punishment, and destroy the opponent.
For example, Zavay, who had mastered Time Slow and Time Stop in the first place of the God Sealing Battle. At this moment, Eleven only felt that the other party was something!!
The Yin Yang Millstone obliterated the other party’s Time Mark, and the Demon God’s Thought countered the other party’s time skill. Eleven no longer knew how to lose when the Battle God Body instantly defeated the other party.
“Wu wu wu!!!” After all the skills were fused, Eleven shouted happily, thanking Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others crazily.
The ranking battle of all races… It was going to participate in the ranking battle of all races again!!
“Wu!! (Calm down!!)”
“Yiya!!! (Calm down, the opponent will be killed by you!!)” Baby Ginseng and the other pets advised.
What was going on? They felt uncomfortable and looked at Shi Yu.
Wu wu wu wu, why were the skills Eleven fused so strong? It was unfair!!!
“If you ask me, I also want to know why its skills are so ridiculous when fused.” Shi Yu also said excitedly, “As expected of Eleven. As expected, you’re still good at being a gambler!”
“Wuu!!!” Eleven was happy. So be it. As long as it had powerful skills, it didn’t matter if it turned from a panda into a bear.

chapters.title: Chapter 1358 - 1358 Crushing Stars (1)
chapters.content:
1358 Crushing Stars (1)
After Eleven finished fusing, Shi Yu fell asleep again.
In just a month, Shi Yu completed the skill fusion of Little Ji, Duckie, Baby Ginseng, Susu, Chi Tong, and Eleven, giving it a complete transformation.
As for Buggy and Ling, they had almost fused on Blue Planet.
Buggy fused into the Creation Domain, and Ling fused into a mechanical spirit.
If he wanted to strengthen them, he could only rely on replication, points, and skill deduction.
Fortunately, Shi Yu already had plans for the Starry Sky Storm and overdrafted faith in their strengthening plan, so he slept very soundly without any quests pressing down on him.
After eating the cultivation fruit and sleeping to rest, Shi Yu no longer meditated this time. Instead, he developed his Beast Taming Talent.
At the moment, Shi Yu had mastered six abilities: Telepathy, Skill Index, Body Control, Time Strengthening, Space Strengthening, and Fusion.
Among them, Telepathy, Skill Index, and Body Control increased with the Beast Taming level. At the moment, they were all considered Level 9. Among them, due to the special power of the Telepathy Taiji Domain, it could be called a divine-level talent.
As for the Time Strengthening, Space Strengthening, and Fusion talents, they temporarily couldn’t keep up with Shi Yu’s level. The highest Space Strengthening was only at Level 8, and they needed to be strictly developed.
Time strengthening and Space Strengthening determined the success rate of Shi Yu exploring ruins in the future. The Fusion Talent determined the difficulty of Shi Yu replicating skills in the future.
As for the cleansing enhancement talent and the cleansing hand talent sent by the Environmental Protection Association, Shi Yu temporarily ignored them and didn’t treat them as his primary cultivation goal.
For him, he could still tell which talent was more important first.
Shi Yu’s requirements weren’t high either. As long as he could cultivate time, space, and Fusion Talent to Level 9, it was enough. As for the divine level, it required additional resources and opportunities. It was very difficult to master at Level 9. It was an ability that only divine-level Beast Tamers could master. He didn’t have any extravagant hopes.
While Shi Yu was sleeping and cultivating, Eleven, who had recovered first, was already gesturing with new abilities excitedly.
After experiencing it, Eleven felt that it was very strong.
Battle God Body, Eight Trigrams Clone, One Thought of God and Demon!
Each of them could be said to be a top-notch divine skill.
Among them, every clone of the Eight Trigrams Clone could condense in advance like the previous Bean Bear.
Most importantly, the functionality of each clone was also different. For example, the Clone of Ze also mastered the ability to heal and be kind. Not only could it heal the main body’s injuries, but it could also use the power of kindness to accelerate the growth of plant resources and develop the potential for pets of the same race.
Although every clone’s battle power wasn’t weak, being a fighter wasn’t the only way to use it.
It could be said that their existence could allow Eleven to fight more peacefully and without thinking about other things.
Of course, the skill that surprised Eleven the most was still the Battle God Body. With this top-notch battle physique, it didn’t have to think about messy battles in the future. Directly resisting the enemy’s attack and attacking in a normal manner was its best strategy in the future.
This way, the consumption was the smallest, the attack power was the highest, and the overall cost-effective ratio was the highest. It was easy to control light, and the consumption of the Yin Yang Millstone was too high.
Eleven had a lot of battle experience, so it quickly concluded the most suitable battle process for itself.
When it encountered an opponent, it wouldn’t attack first. It would casually send a clone suitable for battle to fight the other party.
If the clone could defeat it, there was no need for it to attack at all. If the clone couldn’t defeat it, it wasn’t too late for it to attack.
This could avoid consuming too much physical strength. It was alright now, but after reaching the divine level, divine power was an even rarer and harder energy to replenish. There was no harm in considering this in advance.
After it attacked, it only used pure physical strength to fight first. Probably not many opponents could withstand this level. No matter how serious the injuries were and how long it took, the consumption of its body wasn’t very high. It could support the longest battle process. Even if it fought for a month, it wouldn’t collapse from exhaustion.
As long as it didn’t encounter an enemy like Susu that could cleanse everything or master a skill like the Yin Yang Millstone that could obliterate warpath, just this move alone was invincible at the same level.
After feeling that it couldn’t defeat its opponent in this state, it could use One Thought of God and Demon. With control over the light thunder in the form of a god, it could enter Thunder God Armor Mode. It was faster, and control of the dark thunder in the form of a demon could let him enter the Demon God Body Mode. Its attack power was stronger, but its speed was inferior to the former. It could choose different forms to fight according to the enemy’s differences.
The burden would be slightly greater after activating the single form of the One Thought of God and Demon. Not only for the body but also for the mind. However, it was still within the acceptable range. This state, together with the invincible physique, could defeat more powerful enemies.
If this still couldn’t defeat the enemy, gods and devils would have the same thought. At the same time, activating the states of gods and devils would be the final choice. Using the Yin Yang collision law to break through the restriction of the brain to enter an extreme explosive state, would have a huge mental burden. During use, the mind could be fast enough to exceed time and see future battle scenes, commanding the body to complete miraculous actions.
After using it, one would definitely overdraft their mind. Their body would be broken, and even their will would be worn down, causing the effect of the Battle God Body to decrease greatly. It could be said to be a trump card that could be used at the end.
As for the Yin Yang Millstone, compared to these skills, the cost-effective ratio wasn’t the highest if it was directly used in attacks. It would have a special effect when facing attacks like the Abyss Race and the Yun Race, or it would master Time Mark. The enemy of the Battle God Body would have a more miraculous effect. Now, it had retreated to support skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 1359 - 1359 Crushing Stars (2)
chapters.content:
1359 Crushing Stars (2)
Weaker enemies, countered by clones, ordinary enemies, physical battles, stronger enemies, gods, and devils with a thought. Enemies stronger than them had the same thought. As for the control of light, it was mercilessly abandoned by Eleven. It was regarded as the skill with the lowest cost-effective ratio. It planned to wait for Shi Yu to fuse it with other skills in the future.
“Wuu!!!” In Little Zi’s body, Buggy and Eleven fought. After Buggy’s Green Dragon Indestructible Body was crushed by the Battle God Body again, Buggy cried. Eleven let out the umpteenth triumphant roar.
As for the other pets, they didn’t play with Eleven at all.
Baby Ginseng worked hard to improve the cultivation fruit. Ling went to the research institute to study. Susu cleansed the pollution source daily to support the family, while Chi Tong brought the second team out to watch movies and shop.
Initially, Qi also wanted to go, but for safety’s sake, she still carried Little Zi and stayed behind to “protect Shi Yu”.
In fact, when he really encountered danger, Shi Yu’s greatest reliance wasn’t the six spatial divine stones given by the Space Emperor. The stones had long been assigned to other pets with poor life-saving abilities. His greatest reliance was actually on the Time Sprite, Qi.
Although Qi was only at the demigod level and had yet to reach the divine level, according to Qi’s experience, below the super divine level, even top-notch gods who were expert spatial gods couldn’t catch it. With it protecting Shi Yu, Shi Yu could definitely be foolproof!
When it reached the divine level and recovered its peak strength, even a super divine level expert wouldn’t be able to catch it.
It was also because of Qi that Shi Yu’s other pets could go out in peace and leave Shi Yu’s side.
Now that every pet had grown up, and the World King Planet was such a place where all races in the starry sky were everywhere, it wouldn’t be very strange for them to go out and play themselves.
In short, Shi Yu felt that his pets were already old enough to go out. He couldn’t care less and felt that it was above his pay grade. There was no need for him to watch over them like a guardian.
“Wu wu wu.”
“Ji…”
In Little Zi’s body, Eleven and Buggy discussed continuing to go to the ranking battle!!
After the two of them instructed Baby Ginseng and Susu, who had stayed beside Shi Yu, they immediately crawled out of the mystic realm villa and ran towards the location of the ranking battle.
“Wu…” While searching for the teleportation array, Buggy still saw a familiar figure on the bustling street.
Chi Tong, a girl in black holding a sword with a Vermillion Bird clone on her shoulder, was walking around with the shrunken Little Ji, Duckie, Shorty, Turtle, and Little Quas, buying various street snacks.
The reason Chi Tong brought them out was because Little Ji and Duckie were too noisy. Little Zi despised them. These two guys didn’t hold back when they were anxious, unlike Buggy and Eleven, whose mentalities were maxed out.
As for the other three newbies, they were purely brought along in passing to let them go out and broaden their horizons.
“Eleven!! Buggy!!” Chi Tong and the others also discovered Eleven and Buggy.
“We’ll leave first!!” After Eleven and Buggy greeted Chi Tong and the others, they left in the public teleportation array.
“Roar!!”
“Big Sister, Eleven, and the others seem to be going to fight. Do you want to take a look!!” Little Ji and Duckie were curious. They wanted to see the panda beat up all the races in the starry sky!
Although Little Ji’s big sister was Ling and Duckie’s big sister was Susu, Chi Tong, who was also their best friend and had the highest ranking in the team’s internal competition previously, was clearly the eldest big sister.
Chi Tong looked conflicted and looked at the Turtle, Shorty, and Little Quas, who were also looking forward to it. “No, although I also want to see it, I’ve already bought the movie tickets. Moreover, I can’t refund the tickets. I’ve also bought yours. You have to watch it with me.”
“QAQ…” The pets were silent.
“Hu hu!! (Watching a movie isn’t bad either…)” The turtle moved closer to the little Quas Snake. This was considered a sweet date…
Little Quas moved and looked up at the sky slightly. Therefore, the first time their second team went out, they ate, drank, and played. Moreover, it was public funds. When Shi Yu woke up, would he really not criticize them?
Senior Ling… seemed to have said that the team’s expenses these days were very high. Half of the 200 divine-level energy crystals had already been squandered. If this continued, forget about a few months, in another two months, the team’s finances would be in trouble.
“Meow~~” Shorty thought the least. It looked at the Vermillion Bird clone enviously and also wanted to stick to Big Sister Chi Tong.
…
Blue Wave City, Myriad Region, Myriad Race Ranking Battle Battle Facility.
Eleven and Buggy came for the second time.
This time, there were much fewer things to do than the first time. After Buggy took out Eleven’s battle card from its portable space, Eleven ran to the registration machines everywhere to match.
Match in progress…
At the same time, the Myriad Race Committee, the Blue Wave Branch, immediately received the news.
Ever since Eleven’s last battle, they had been watching Eleven closely, wanting to see the outcome of its next battle.
However, no one expected that after so long, Iron-eating Beast Eleven didn’t come to challenge again. It only came half a month later.
“I knew it. Back then, when it defeated Gorka, it didn’t seem as easy as it looked in the video. It was very difficult to fight, and it definitely suffered very serious injuries. It’s only natural for it to recover for so long.” In a room, the green dragon and its Beast Tamer, Sen Nian, who had been defeated by Eleven, were sitting in Director Sen’s office.
“Uncle, if you want to see its limit, you might as well let Gorka do it again. We were careless last time. It will definitely be different this time,” Sen Nian said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1360 - 1360 Crushing Stars (3)
chapters.content:
1360 Crushing Stars (3)
“For you, Eleven is indeed a very good opponent, but according to the rules of the ranking competition, you can’t repeat the battle. Moreover, facing a four-year-old opponent, even if you win a second time, what’s there to be proud of…” Director Sen said.
During this period of time, Sen Nian had been crazily training and strengthening the Green Dragon Gorka. He hoped that he could win the next time, but unfortunately, it would have to wait.
Eleven was about to welcome its second opponent in the positioning competition, the Star Refining Race, Fanba.
“If it’s matched with this monster, won’t it not even have room to showcase its abilities?” Sen Nian was speechless.
“I’ll go take a look at the scene.” After Sen Nian and the green dragon spoke, they left. When they arrived at the battlefield, the Star Refining Race, Fanba, had already arrived.
It was a humanoid life form with purple skin and circular holes of various sizes on its body. It didn’t have eyes, and the areas of its eyes were also sunken holes, looking very terrifying.
“Cough, cough, God Fanba.” Even the extremely proud Sen Nian and the Blue Wave Green Dragon, who had once been proud of their ranking in the top 400 of the God Sealing Battle, obediently called this guy God.
“It’s you.” The Star Refining Race’s Fanba glanced at Sen Nian and the green dragon and frowned. “Are you my next opponents?”
The Star Refining Race was ranked 202nd among the cosmic races, and the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race was ranked more than 9,000… They were on completely different levels.
Moreover, Fanba had already defeated this green dragon a long time ago. There was no point in fighting anymore.
“No, no, it’s just that your opponent happened to have defeated Gorka previously in this battle, so we came to take a look,” Sen Nian said.
“Then it looks like your strength isn’t bad. I can look forward to it,” Fanba said.
Sen Nian said, “There’s no need to look forward to it too much. When the other party fought us, it was very difficult for him to win. He’s definitely not your match, Big Boss Fanba.”
He was telling the truth. His best result in the God Sealing Battle was 486, but Fanba was in the early 100s, almost in the top 100.
Moreover, it was only ranked 486 because of the combination of him and the green dragon, but the other party didn’t have the enhancement of a human contractor. It purely fought its way up by itself, and its strength was very strong.
The strength of the Star Refining Race, which was ranked 202nd among the races in the starry sky, was completely out of the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race’s league. Fanba was a rare monster in the Blue Wave World that even Sen Nian and Gorka had to lower their heads to.
Just like their racial names… Their ability was to forge stars!
It could refine a non-living planet into a suitable weapon.
Every attack with the weapon represented the power of a star. There was no way to fight.
The strongest super divine ancestor of the Star Refining Race even refined the star into arms.
But even so, it was terrifyingly strong.
In short, after matching this guy, Sen Nian and the green dragon couldn’t imagine how that Iron-eating Beast Eleven could win…
This wasn’t bullying a child.
As the two of them conversed, Eleven also came over with Buggy.
“Eh???” As soon as he arrived, Eleven was very surprised to discover that the green dragon he defeated last time was also here.
“Are you still the opponent?” Eleven quickly asked in the common language of the starry sky, the mind language. It rubbed its fists. This time, it was confident that it could blow up the green dragon with a punch.
“Obviously not!” Buggy looked at the Star Refining Race’s Fanba with an even more terrifying aura.
Star Refining Race!!!
It was actually the Star Refining Race.
Eleven and Buggy were very surprised after observing Fanba for a moment.
The ability of the Star Smelting Race was a skill that Shi Yu and the others thought they had to replicate when they flipped through the information of the myriad races in the starry sky.
The ability to refine a planet into arms was simply too heaven-defying. Even Eleven, who didn’t like arms, hoped to have a bamboo refined from a metal stats star as a weapon.
“We’re just here to take a look.” The corners of Sen Nian and the green dragon’s mouths twitched when they saw Eleven and Buggy.
Who would have thought that one of these two guys was four years old, and the other was three?
When he and the green dragon learned about it later, their mentalities almost collapsed.
At this moment, the judge robot, similar to last time, flew out again.
“I detected that the two parties have arrived. Please head to the arena. I’ll be the judge next.”
“This is a positioning competition. Eleven, a newbie, is representatives of the Iron-eating Beast Race.”
“Ranked 202nd among the cosmic races, Fanba is representative of the Star Refining Race.”
“Why is it a positioning competition?” At this moment, Fanba didn’t care about Eleven and Buggy, who entered. Even if they defeated the Green Dragon Gorka, they were concerned about why the guy who defeated the genius of the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race was an unknown race.
It looked at Eleven. At this moment, Eleven also looked at the Star Refining Race with a regretful expression.
Wu wu wu, it was a pity that Shi Yu was sleeping. It was a pity that Shi Yu couldn’t participate in the Myriad Race Battle. Otherwise, he could have copied the Star Refinement Skill and obtained it.
Its Venus Bamboo Rod…
“Hello…” Eleven greeted the Star Refining Race, planning to make a friend after the battle. It would be easier to pull it to Shi Yu’s side later and let Shi Yu replicate the skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1361 - 1361 Crushing Stars (4)
chapters.content:
1361 Crushing Stars (4)
“Let’s go.” The Star Refining Race’s Fanba nodded and walked to the battlefield. He had already determined that this battle was most likely deliberately arranged by the Myriad Races Committee.
That was indeed the case…
Not only were Sen Nian and the green dragon present in this battle, but behind them, with Director Sen as the lead, many staff members of the Myriad Races Committee of the Blue Wave Branch were paying attention behind the screen.
“Even if this Eleven defeats the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race, isn’t it too difficult to fight the Star Refining Race…”
“It can’t be helped. At the moment, only the Star Refining Race is here.”
“…”
Many staff members looked at the screen in silence. Soon, under the command of the judge robot, the battle began.
The battle style of the Star Refining Race was that no matter what battle it was, it had to use the weapon it had refined to fight. This was because the victory of the battle could bring about the upgrade of the weapon and complete the tempering of the weapon. Therefore, at the scene, the Star Refining Race’s Fanba directly stretched out its hand and summoned a weapon similar to a black mace.
On it was filled with thick dark fluctuations. There were actually dark law ripples lingering, making Eleven’s eyes widen!!
Dark Star? Wait, this purple-skinned cave person didn’t still have dark control at the quasi-divine skill level, right??
At the thought of this, Eleven was even more excited.
Star Refining Divine Skill and Dark Control Divine Skill. If these skills were both replicated and learned, wouldn’t it be invincible?
Its light control could also fuse with its dark control!
“Ji!!!” Even Buggy thought of this possibility and couldn’t help but show a collapsed expression beside Sen Nian and the green dragon. No way.
The leader couldn’t be so lucky, right? It encountered a skill the moment it came up?
“What’s wrong?” Sen Nian and Green Dragon looked at the shocked Green Silkworm.
At this moment, because he was too excited, Eleven completely didn’t notice that the judge had already announced the start, but the opponent’s movements were very fast.
Buzz!!!
Space fluctuations blinked. The Star Refining Race, who was holding the Dark Star Mace, directly teleported in front of Eleven.
Boom!!!
It held the mace in both hands and suddenly smashed it the moment it appeared. During the process of waving the mace, black light made space tremble and let out a violent boom.
In an instant, Sen Nian and the green dragon were attracted by this terrifying attack. It was this that had once knocked them out with a swing and even lost the strength to activate the Law of Life.
This terrifying attack was only on World King Planet. If it was on a low-level planet, it completely had the ability to destroy the world.
An attack was equivalent to a super meteorite hitting another star. It could cause very terrifying destructive power.
Boom!!
The sound of the attack continued.
“Wuu!!” However, in this world-destroying attack, Sen Nian and the green dragon suddenly discovered that with a discordant cry, the body of the Star Refining Race’s Fanba suddenly stopped in midair. The battle scene seemed to have frozen!
The huge dark mace was directly caught by the Iron-eating Beast Eleven’s outstretched palm.
No energy fluctuations leaked out. Iron-eating Beast Eleven simply stretched out its palm and relied on its physical strength to receive this attack. This scene was unbelievable, making the Star Refining Race’s Fanba clench his arms in disbelief.
Because it felt that if it didn’t use a little more strength, its arms would be snatched away by its opponent!!
Wait a minute…
Fanba looked at Eleven in disbelief, its body trembling with the mace. It saw the harmless little Iron-eating Beast opposite it looking at it excitedly.
“Your strength isn’t bad. Do you want to be friends?” After Eleven finished speaking, it squeezed hard. With a crack, a crack appeared in the weapon refined from a small dark star.
Star Refining Race’s Fanba: ???
Sen Nian and the Green Dragon: “?”
“How is this possible!!!” The staff of the Myriad Race Committee, who were observing in the dark, watched this scene with their mouths agape.
The attack of the Star Refining Race, a race ranked 200+ among the races in the starry sky, whose personal strength was almost in the top 100 of the God Sealing Battle, was actually stumped by the opponent with only physical strength??
Just as everyone was in disbelief, Eleven swung hard. The sailbar holding the mace immediately seemed to have encountered an extremely powerful impact, and its body was immediately sent flying like an afterimage.
Boom!!!
It suddenly hit the reinforced wall of the battlefield, and spiderweb-like cracks appeared.
Fanba was embedded in the wall. It spat out a mouthful of saliva in pain and coughed dryly.
Then, it immediately opened its eyes in shock and looked at the newbie of the Myriad Race Ranking Battle that it had helped set.
It, who resonated with the small dark star, was like a star life form encountering a cosmic behemoth that ate planets. Fear involuntarily appeared in its heart.
“Iron-eating Beast Race??” It looked at Eleven for the first time. Was it sure this was the Iron-eating Beast Race and not a cosmic behemoth?
It even turned its head stiffly and looked at Sen Nian and the green dragon, who had just said that their opponents weren’t very strong. Was this the guy they were talking about? The guy who barely won against them?
From the moment it was born until now, it had never encountered a monster that relied on its physical strength to defend against its attack and almost crushed a star, sending it flying in strength!!
It thought for a moment. Probably only a cosmic behemoth with the strongest body in the universe could reach this level!
At this moment, Sen Nian and Green Dragon Gorka, who were swept by Fanba’s gaze, were also very stunned. They also looked at Eleven, who was twisting its wrist, in confusion.
How was this possible… When fighting them, this Iron-eating Beast wasn’t like this!!
How was this power possible…
“Ji…” At this moment, Buggy quickly patched Eleven and said, “The last time it fought you, it hadn’t eaten for a month. It was extremely weak. This is its true strength!”
Sen Nian and the green dragon looked at the three-year-old worm: ???
As if they would believe him. Who didn’t eat when they went out to fight!

chapters.title: Chapter 1362 - 1362 Demigod vs True God
chapters.content:
1362 Demigod vs True God
Sen Nian and the Blue Wave Green Dragon couldn’t believe what they had seen and heard because this was too strange. Green Dragon, who had fought Eleven personally, believed in what it had experienced personally.
However, in the past 10 years, the Star Refining Race’s Fanba was considered a top-notch monster in the entire World King Planet with non-divine battle power. If it weren’t for the fact that it had only debuted for a short period of time and didn’t have any human contractors, it wasn’t impossible for it to enter the top 50 and top 10 one day.
There was definitely a qualitative difference between Fanba’s strengths and theirs. However, such a monster that was enough to crush them had now made them fall into a disadvantageous position after defeating an incomplete guy half a month ago…
This…
“Are you suspecting me?”
Seeing the young man and the green dragon’s disbelief, Buggy said, “Otherwise, why do you think it could last so long last time? Otherwise, why do you think it has the strength to stand up every time? This is all because its body is invincible to begin with. It’s really because it didn’t eat last time and didn’t perform well!”
Buggy almost believed it. The other party didn’t believe it.
It could even create the world. What was wrong with creating a lie now?
“…” The human Beast Tamer, Sen Nian, and the green dragon, Gorka, looked at the battlefield in silence. The power of Eleven’s attack was indeed powerful. Although the materials of the battlefield here weren’t built according to the standard of divine-level battles, it was definitely not something ordinary demigods could destroy.
Looking at the Star Refining Race’s Fanba that was smashed into the crack in the wall, they swallowed their saliva together. However, Fanba was indeed worthy of its strength. After being hit so warmly by Eleven, they quickly adjusted their mentality and landed back on the arena.
“How can you make friends like this?” Fanba looked at the dark mace that had cracks like the wall and recalled Eleven’s words just now. Ridiculous…
“Wuu!!!” Eleven didn’t care so much. It was definitely going to make this friend.
Bang!!!
Eleven ran and sprinted out, and its figure instantly disappeared. Although its speed wasn’t as fast as the Lightspeed Fist, with just physical skills, although Eleven’s attack was a little slow, it consumed almost no energy.
The moment a crack appeared on the ground, Eleven’s attack triggered the gust, making Fanba, who was opposite it, feel extremely strong pressure. Its expression changed.
It understood that if it didn’t use its full strength, it was impossible to defeat this monster… However, even if it used its full strength, it couldn’t guarantee that it could defeat this Iron-eating Beast Race…
He would give it his all…
The gaze of the Star Refining Race’s Fanba turned cold, and it waved the mace in its hand again. During this process, the cracked mace gradually recovered. At the same time, compared to the almost normal attack last time, Fanba directly stacked all the buffs that could be stacked!
Dark Control, Dark Devour Law!
Space Control, Space Quake Law!
This time, Eleven immediately felt that its strength had been swallowed a lot. At the same time, the other party’s strength was even greater. It kept trembling, from its fist to its entire body, and its internal organs were injured!!
The moment the two parties collided, wisps of strong wind shot out like bullets. Cracks appeared on the ground and the surrounding walls. The entire battle facility swayed, as if it was about to collapse at any time.
“Roar!!” Eleven sensed the change in the other party. It was still ferocious and its strength didn’t decrease.
“You…” Seeing that although its opponent’s strength had been swallowed a lot, it could still resist the attack enhanced by the spatial power and receive the damage without changing its expression, the Star Refining Race’s Fanba revealed an unhappy expression.
This guy was still using its physical strength to fight the enemy!
The reason why Fanba felt that it didn’t have the confidence to win even if it went all out was because Eleven’s physical strength alone made it feel huge pressure. And now that it went all out, Eleven still didn’t use other methods. This kind of battle where it couldn’t see the depth of the enemy made it feel a lot of pressure.
Boom!!!
In an instant, the two parties were evenly matched. Fanba first wanted to hide and dodge, but it sensed that the other party’s terrifying strength was focused on a point that was enough to distort space. It turned and teleported into the distance, but Eleven’s movement speed was also extremely fast. The two parties immediately collided a second time in another place!!
Another shocking aftermath swept across, making the venue a mess. A storm swept the battlefield!
In the next second, light flashed, and they collided again with a bang.
In the next second, the light flashed again. With a boom, the collision occurred in different places every time.
Both parties kept moving, attacking and defending. In the blink of an eye, it was already difficult to see their figures clearly on the arena. Only the aftermath of bangs kept spreading all over the arena, sweeping up a storm.
During this period, Fanba used almost all the methods it could use. However, in its despair, it discovered that this Iron-eating Beast Race was a freak. It kept using its physical strength to collide with its Star Arms, as if it didn’t care about its injuries at all. Moreover, its condition wouldn’t fall at all. Instead, as the battle went deeper, it also felt that the other party’s strength was increasing!
“What’s this…”
In the audience, Sen Nian and Green Dragon opened their mouths wide and watched the battle that gradually couldn’t keep up with the tempo. They swallowed crazily. Fanba was still so strong, but that Iron-eating Beast was indeed using its physical strength to deal with it the whole time. The spatial power, high-temperature fire, light control, and many other skills from the last time weren’t used at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1363 - 1363 Demigod vs True God (2)
chapters.content:
1363 Demigod vs True God (2)
Even so, from the looks of it, it was still suppressing the Star Refining Race’s Fanba!!
This made Sen Nian and the green dragon almost go crazy. So last time… what exactly happened?
“Ji…” At this moment, seeing that Eleven had finally released the power of the Battle God Body to its heart’s content, Buggy was also quite excited. As expected of a top-notch battle physique. No, it was better to say that it was as expected of a leader. Just one Battle God Body wasn’t enough to make Eleven so strong. Its powerful foundation was also the key to letting the Battle God Body display such a strong effect. With five top-notch divine skills on its body, it was difficult for its foundation to be poor.
Boom!!!
After a few minutes of collision, two figures appeared in the center of the arena at the same time. Then, they appeared and slid back. A long crack appeared under their feet before they stabilized their bodies with friction.
As far as the eye could see, Fanba’s Star Mace was already extremely broken and lacking a corner. As for Eleven, who was on the other side, it was also covered in injuries. However, the most infuriating thing was that Fanba felt its strength gradually decrease, but it didn’t feel the other party’s strength decrease. Not only did it maintain this one-meter-long cute form, but its strength was also continuing to increase. It really couldn’t understand.
“Who exactly are you?” Fanba of the Star Refining Race asked. “You’re so strong, it’s impossible for you to be unknown.”
“Wuu!!!” The mace of the Star Refining Race’s Fanba recovered again. The injuries on Eleven’s body also began to heal at a high speed. Eleven looked at it and said, “Panda King Eleven!!! The strongest expert of the Iron-eating Beast Race!!”
“Are you making friends or not?” Eleven asked again.
The Star Refining Race’s Fanba gritted its teeth. So, what Iron-eating Beast? Panda? It had never heard of it!!
Which realm had mutated this monster race? To be able to suppress it at the same level, it felt that it was no problem to rank in the top 100 of the cosmic races.
“As long as you can withstand my attack, I’ll make you a friend,” the Star Refining Race’s Fanba said.
As soon as it finished speaking, black mist began to spread from the Star Arms. Under the entanglement of the black mist, its appearance changed a little, becoming thicker, larger, and darker than before!
The size of the purple-skinned holey person in Eleven’s eyes also began to increase exponentially. A black light spot began to condense in every hole on its body and gradually expanded into small stars that floated on Fanba’s body one by one!
In particular, two dark star-like eyes condensed in its empty eyes.
Boom!!!
The dark aura that was several times stronger than before was directly revealed. The overwhelming aura made the expressions of Sen Nian and the green dragon in the audience change drastically again, and also surprised Buggy.
“The weapons of the Star Refining Race are usually stronger than their main bodies. It consumes a lot of energy to control arms, so usually, the arms are in a sealed state. Only when they encounter a strong enemy will they break the seal. The high consumption also brings stronger destructive power.” As Sen Nian muttered, the Star Refining Race’s Fanba had already raised the mace high. At the tip of the mace, a black energy ball that had been compressed to the extreme and kept spinning began to be born!!
An incomparably deep terrifying power that was like a star exploding spread on it. Seeing this, Eleven, who was opposite him, revealed a cautious expression for the first time.
“Dark… Destruction…!!” The Star Refining Race’s Fanba roared. The terrifying black ball sealed the space and slid over like a dark star, gradually enlarging as it smashed towards Eleven!!
Seeing this, just as Buggy thought that Eleven was going to use the thought of a god to activate a single berserk form, it didn’t expect that the leader was even wilder than it. Its warpath directly erupted, and the monstrous power of the warpath instantly broke through the spatial seal. However, Eleven had no intention of dodging, nor did it want to rely on its stronger state to crush it. It still punched at the dark star!!
“Wuu!!!” Eleven punched in the air and instantly compressed the air to the limit, forming a violent air cannon. It surprisingly still wanted to rely on its physical strength to resist this attack. For Eleven, victory and defeat weren’t the most important now. Through the pressure of the outside world, training its Battle God Body could make its physique stronger. This opportunity was rare.
Boom!!!
The Dark Star Charge and Eleven seriously punched each other. First, the Dark Star Charge caved in like a balloon being pressed. Then, with a roar from the Star Refining Race’s Fanba opposite, it erupted with stronger power and even erupted with overload to increase its power!
Buzz!!!
The impact of the dark star increased again, and it swallowed Eleven’s fist wind. Then, with a bang, the fist wind was swallowed. The black light and Eleven hit the opposite wall together. Under the eruption of the endless dark power, the black ball star continued to crush the wall, already crushing a huge hole. Eleven was in the center of the crush and experienced crazy friction!
Such a spectacular scene stunned Sen Nian and the green dragon. It also made Fanba, who was weakly using the mace to support its body on the arena, pant as it stared intently at the opposite side…
“Ji…” At this moment, Buggy let out a regretful voice. Battle God Body… The heavier the injury, the stronger the strength. The leader was clearly using the pressure of the other party’s attack to train its body…
Boom!!!
Just as Buggy’s thought fell, the dark star that kept spinning and rubbing on the wall exploded with a bang. A huge hole appeared in the middle of the entire ball, as if a hole had been blasted open. It was extremely shocking. On the other side of the hole, a black and white bear with a broken body no different from the wall swung its arm, and the remaining star power dissipated with a bang!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1364 - 1364 Demigod vs True God (3)
chapters.content:
1364 Demigod vs True God (3)
Buzz!!
“Sob…” At this moment, Eleven also panted. It saw that its opponent seemed to be even weaker than it and walked back to the arena step by step.
It was over…
It, Panda King Eleven… was indeed the strongest!
“I…” It was difficult for the Star Refining Race’s Fanba to accept, but then, the huge pain in its abdomen still made it lose consciousness. Before it lost consciousness, it saw the monster called Eleven in the corner of its eye and punched its stomach.
Bang!!!
The mace left its hand, and Fanba was sent flying. It shattered the wall and completely lost consciousness!!
Scenes were clearly transmitted to the working room of the Myriad Races Committee by the judge robot.
At this moment, the group of Myriad Race Committee staff led by Director Sen had already fallen completely silent amidst continuous surprise.
“How can this be…”
“The whole time, the whole time, it defeated the Star Refining Race with its physical strength!”
“Its body endured the unsealed Star Arms head-on, and in the end, its strength was even better. It doesn’t look unscientific no matter how I look at it.”
“The body resists the power of the stars. Is this an Iron-eating Beast or a Star Beast!!”
As the battle ended, waves of discussion immediately came from the extremely silent office hall. Obviously, everyone was rather confused about the process of this battle.
“The Light Control it used to fight Green Dragon is a top-notch divine skill. This battle… is useless.”
“If it’s used, how strong will its battle power be? Is there any hope of fighting a true god above its level?”
Amidst everyone’s surprise, Director Sen also swallowed his saliva and thought of a possibility.
“Could it be that this guy is using its opponent as a sparring partner according to the opponent’s difference? If it used a skill, it would definitely be able to win this battle more easily, but why does it have to win in such a miserable state?”
“It’s the same this time, and the last time too. Did it not use its full strength in every battle and only train itself…”
Everyone felt that this guess was ridiculous. Using a genius of the Star Refining Race who had a chance of being in the top 100 of the God Sealing Battle as a battle sparring partner with just his physique? What a joke. Even those monstrous geniuses in the top 10 of the God Sealing Battle who could suppress primary-level gods, could they do it?
Bang, bang!
In the arena, Eleven looked at the unconscious opponent and hurriedly called Buggy.
“Buggy, Buggy, give it some medicine.”
“Roger!” Under the ridiculous expressions of Sen Nian and the green dragon next door, Green Silkworm teleported to the position where Fanba was and opened the dimensional space. Strange green liquid kept flowing out of it and dripped into Fanba’s body.
“Cough, cough.” A moment later, Fanba recovered consciousness. The moment it recovered its consciousness, it suddenly got up and looked around cautiously. Then, it saw Eleven holding the spoils of war.
It… it lost.
Fanba wasn’t unfamiliar with losing. When it participated in the God Sealing Battle, it had lost to stronger opponents.
However, this was the first time it had lost so ridiculously and aggrievedly. It still couldn’t believe that it would one day be defeated by its opponent with only physical strength!
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven picked up the mace and weighed it curiously. It walked forward with small steps and handed it to the purple-skinned holey person.
“Don’t be depressed. Its skills are all physique skills. Physical strength is its strongest point. You’re already very strong. Let’s be friends for now and fight next time.” Buggy encouraged from the side.
“…” After a moment of silence, the purple-skinned caveman was still silent. Really?
Was there really a monster that only cultivated the body in this universe?
Even the cosmic behemoth race, which had the strongest physical body in the entire universe, cultivated other stats power, right?
“I lost…” A moment later, it sighed. It had to admit that it was right to come to the various major worlds to train because its skills were inferior. There was really no limit to the sky. Apart from the monsters who often participated in the God Sealing Battle, there were actually so many unknown freaks in the other competitions.
“Alright, let’s be friends,” it said. “Let’s fight again next time.”
Next time, it definitely wouldn’t lose.
At this moment, it seemed to have seen Eleven’s limit.
Apart from that, it also looked at the stunned Sen Nian and the green dragon beside it with an unfriendly expression.
These two guys were scamming it, right?
It didn’t believe that with Eleven’s battle power, it could barely defeat a Blue Wave Green Dragon!
That punch that was enough to blow up a small planet could crush the green dragon with a single punch.
“Well, well, well…” At this moment, Sen Nian swallowed his saliva crazily and said, “Can you… count us in…”
To be honest, he also wanted to make a friend.
Strong, too strong. Be it the Star Refining Race’s Fanba or this Iron-eating Beast Eleven, they were as strong as monsters. He and Gorka had to make friends with such monsters. Only in this way could they improve faster!!
Sen Nian and Green Dragon: “Ruthless…”
“No,” Eleven also rejected. It didn’t fancy any of Green Dragon’s skills and didn’t have any compatibility with it.
Unlike this purple-skinned caveman, who liked to refine star skills and control darkness very much.

chapters.title: Chapter 1365 - 1365 Demigod vs True God (4)
chapters.content:
1365 Demigod vs True God (4)
