Sen Nian and the green dragon shouted in their hearts: Heartless!!!
“Ji!! (Don’t be discouraged, come again after you become stronger!)” Buggy lay on Eleven’s shoulder and shook its head. Work hard and train a top-notch wood-element divine skill. Perhaps Baby Ginseng would make friends with you!
Sen Nian and the green dragon’s mentalities completely collapsed. They felt ostracized. This was even more uncomfortable than losing the battle.
“Big brother with the mace, leave your contact information. We’ll call you to eat together another day and spar again!!” Eleven waved its hand, anxious to establish a good relationship with Fanba of the Star Refining Race.
Shi Yu was still sleeping. They could only work hard first.
If it let this guy go, the universe was so big, so who knew where the next Star Refining Race would be?
“Uh…” The corners of Fanba’s mouth twitched. Big Brother? It was still young! It was only in its thirties. It was sure that this Iron-eating Beast, Eleven, was definitely an old monster much older than it. Why was it pretending to be young?
Not only in appearance, but also in voice…
At this moment, another voice sounded.
“Wait, contestant Eleven, sorry to disturb you.”
Director Sen, a divine-level Beast Tamer in a formal suit, rushed over from outside. He heaved a sigh of relief when he saw that Eleven and the others were still around.
“Uncle…?” Sen Nian looked at the person with a headache. Just now, in the office, he even said that Gorka didn’t defeat Eleven last time because he was careless, but after this battle ended, even if he and Green Dragon added up, what right did they have to fight this Iron-eating Beast?
The last time… it really didn’t eat?
He began to doubt himself.
“Fanba, you’re also here.” Director Sen also smiled at Fanba and introduced himself. “Hello, everyone. I’m Director Sen from the seventh office of the Blue Wave Branch of the Myriad Races Committee. I also saw the battle just now. Excuse me, contestant Eleven, are you interested in participating in a battle above your level?”
Fanba’s expression changed slightly.
“Fight above my level?” Eleven was curious.
Director Sen said, “Yeah, a battle above your level. You’ve already carried out two ranking competitions, but you didn’t use your full strength at all. There’s no longer an opponent suitable for you among the quasi-divine levels in the Blue Wave World.”
“If you want to see where the limit of your potential is, you can apply to the Myriad Race Committee to fight above your level. You can enter the Myriad Race Battlefield of the ‘second world’ at the level of a quasi-divine and match divine-level opponents to fight above your level. You don’t have to wait until the divine level to have the authority to enter.”
“If we can win a battle above your level, there will be a higher increase in the ranking of your race.”
“At the same time, as long as you can win a battle, your battle results will also be learned by the headquarters of the Myriad Races Committee. The benefits you obtain will be even more unimaginable. Perhaps many cosmic races will throw you an invitation.”
“The Myriad Races Committee has a fund that specializes in nurturing new and powerful racial groups. We can fight for them.”
“Not only can you benefit, but the entire Iron-eating Beast Race can also benefit from your perfect performance.”
Director Sen felt that the Sen family was definitely not qualified to rope in this monster, Iron-eating Beast Race. Then, why not treat it as a performance? If he could push a quasi-divine who could defeat a divine-level expert to the headquarters, he would also obtain a lot of benefits.
“Contestant Eleven, you don’t have to worry. A battle above your level won’t be given to a divine level who’s too powerful. It’s basically a low-level god with an extremely low race ranking. With your powerful body, together with your previous Light Control and that mysterious top-notch millstone divine skill, the chances of victory are very high!” Director Sen said crazily.
However, when he heard that there was a top-notch divine skill, Fanba, who was beside him, was suddenly stunned and looked at Buggy.
Then, it looked at Eleven.
What? The purple-skinned holey person was stunned. Why was there a top-notch millstone divine skill? What was that?
“Moreover, if you can win, you should be the youngest winner of a battle above your level, right? At the age of four, you can fight a true god above your level!!” Director Sen said. “After obtaining the recognition of the headquarters, there will be a larger stage to improve yourself!!”
Four years old!
After hearing that, Fanba of the Star Refining Race was stunned again. After thinking about it carefully, its chest suddenly felt stuffy, and its brain rumbled.
“Wu wu wu!!!” Eleven was already eager to try fighting above its level when it heard Director Sen’s words!!
Higher ranking!!
It looked at Buggy with shining eyes and asked how it was.
“Ji!!” Buggy also felt that it could give it a try. With the leader’s current strength, it was definitely not a problem to fight a junior god.
The divine beast that the first place in the God Sealing Battle wanted to challenge was an intermediate god, and it wasn’t a weak intermediate god.
If it couldn’t even defeat weaker primary-level gods, how could it fight it?
“Let’s go back and prepare. We’ll challenge when we’re ready~” Eleven said.
It was mainly because he had to tell its guardian, Shi Yu, and obtain Shi Yu’s permission.
Moreover, Eleven felt that it still needed to strengthen itself. These top-notch divine skills were still at a proficient level. If it could be raised to expert level, it would definitely be more stable to fight junior gods.
“Alright, alright, no problem.” Seeing that Eleven had agreed, Director Sen burst with joy.
However, at this moment, a discordant voice came from Fanba. It pointed at Eleven with a broken expression and said, “It just… just now, there were still top-notch divine skills that it didn’t use?”
“Moreover… it’s only… four years old??”
It seemed that it had suffered a greater blow than losing the battle just now.
Sen Nian, the Green Dragon, Director Sen, and Green Silkworm looked at it, wanting to say something but stopping themselves…
Yes.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1366 - 1366 Demigod vs True God (5)
chapters.content:
1366 Demigod vs True God (5)
Soon, Eleven and Buggy returned happily.
However, it was true. It was too difficult to find a demigod stronger than the purple-skinned hole person in the Blue Wave World.
After Eleven and Buggy returned, Chi Tong, who had finished watching the movie, returned one after another with the second team’s cubs.
Right on the heels of that, Eleven was considering whether to awaken Shi Yu first and discuss the big matter of replicating skills and fighting above its level!
“Ji!! (Let the Beast Tamer sleep a little longer.)”
“Wuu!!” Eleven nodded. Alright then.
However, if Eleven and Buggy wanted the Beast Tamer to sleep more, Shi Yu’s heartless little secretary couldn’t care less.
As soon as something happened, it would directly shake Shi Yu awake through telepathy from several regions.
“Wu ah ah ah, what are you doing?” Shi Yu said a little angrily after being woken up.
Didn’t he say not to wake him unless it was something important? He felt that he didn’t sleep for long this time.
Disaster Research Institute.
Ling flew out of the research institute and said, “Master, there’s a message. It’s Senior Lin Feng.”
“Oh??” Shi Yu was immediately not sleepy. “The Kirin Race confirmed the Wind Blessing and prepared a thank-you gift??”
Ling said, “Unfortunately, no, Master, stop dreaming.”
“But it’s still pretty good news.”
“The Four Saints Meeting that happens every 10 years in the first-level domain, the Heavenly Spirit Domain, is about to begin. Senior Lin Feng was also invited. He asked if you wanted to participate together. There will be participants from the Blue Planet Dragon Race and the Blue Planet Phoenix Race.”
“Four Saints Meeting… What’s that?” Shi Yu asked in a daze.
Ling said, “It’s a conference organized by many individuals and cosmic races who are evolving towards the four holy beasts. At the conference, many items of the faith of the four holy beasts will be sold. According to tradition, there might even be items of faith of the era appearing as the final treasure. Of course, these are all secondary.”
“In the Heavenly Spirit Domain, there’s an era ruin in a half-cracked state. It’s filled with a large amount of the power of faith of the four holy beasts. It’s a very good opportunity to freeload the power of faith. During the conference, this era ruin will be temporarily opened. Many evolution individuals of the four holy beasts will compete and kill here just to obtain the power of faith.”
“I’m thinking that if we want to learn that skill, there might be the materials needed at this meeting.” Ling analyzed. “We can choose not to go to the dangerous ruins, but there’s no harm in going to the meeting.”
“When is it?”
“Alright, let’s go.”
“Well… I can take advantage of this period of time to increase the levels of Little Quas, Turtle, and Cat before going over there to find their evolution materials and skill materials… By the way, Ling, remember to supervise me when we get there. You’re not allowed to let me approach the ruins. Before I reach the divine level, I don’t plan to touch the ruins in the universe…”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1367 - 1367 Baby Team Takes Off (1)
chapters.content:
1367 Baby Team Takes Off (1)
Space Disaster Research Institute.
After speaking to Shi Yu, Ling sighed.
Master… wanted him to supervise and not touch the ruins?
It could do it, but would Shi Yu listen?
If the ruins were really in danger, it wasn’t worried that Shi Yu would take the initiative to court death.
It was just worried that danger would come knocking on its door…
“Teacher Ling, the storm trajectory has changed. Come and take a look.”
Ling turned around. A girl in a research suit with white and red hair was running towards it with a nervous expression.
“Alright, I’ll go take a look now.” The Rubik’s Cube Ling nodded and flew into the research institute.
This girl’s name was Jin. She was the granddaughter of Dr. Lei Nuo and was currently Ling’s assistant.
At first, Jin was very unhappy to be assigned by Dr. Lei Nuo, but soon, she was convinced by Ling’s ability and was willing to assist Ling in his research.
“You come too,” Ling said as it left.
“Yes!” Jin followed behind with a look of worship. She felt that Ling was much more powerful than her grandfather. Ever since she studied with Ling, her luck had improved a lot. She could encounter a bunch of good things every day.
Originally, things that needed 10 tries to succeed only needed one try now!
Even if she bought a nutritional drink, she could buy another bottle ten times in a row.
Dr. Ling was forever a god!!!
Unfortunately, she had yet to see the legendary creator of Dr. Ling, the genius mechanic from the Floating Realm…
…
After Shi Yu woke up, the team was much more lively.
Apart from Ling, the pets reported the situation to Shi Yu in the past two days.
“Wuuu!”
Just as it ended the long-range mental communication with Ling, Eleven ran over.
It waved its arm up and down and explained to Shi Yu the great injustice it and Buggy had encountered in the ranking battle of all races.
It could roughly be simplified to: purple-skinned, holey person, has skills, can replicate, and can fight above its level. Interesting. After hearing about this, he was interested in participating.
“You encountered the Star Refining Race?”
Shi Yu asked curiously as he opened the thermos beside the bed and gulped down the nutritious food inside.
“Wuu!!” Eleven nodded heavily.
“Ji!!” Buggy crawled over at this moment. It felt that Eleven might not necessarily have compatibility, but it might be able to learn it.
However, Buggy really couldn’t imagine what arms it needed as Green Dragon.
Could it be that it had to learn from Chi Tong and become Sword Dragon?
“How do you feel the opponent’s strength?” Shi Yu asked.
Eleven said, “Wuu.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled. Then he would invite the other party over when he was free and treat it to a meal. He could also replicate its skills.
To be honest, Shi Yu didn’t know if his pets could learn it. However, he felt that this should be a universal skill similar to multiplication. Everyone hoped for it.
At that time, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, Little Ji, Duckie… It didn’t seem bad for everyone to have a Star Arms?
This arms skill was equivalent to carrying a legal backup energy source and using a planet as a backup power. It still made sense for the Star Refining Race to be ranked 202.
“As for a battle above your level, if you’re willing to participate, so be it. However, don’t force it. Don’t force it if you can’t defeat it. Just admit defeat immediately,” Shi Yu said.
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven patted its chest to indicate that there was no problem.
At this moment, after obtaining Shi Yu’s permission, Eleven was immediately happy. At the same time, Shi Yu turned around and told the good news of the Four Saints Meeting to Buggy, who was inseparable from Eleven.
“In the Four Saints Meeting, there are evolved individuals of the Green Dragon everywhere. Perhaps we can replicate some skills suitable for you over there and buy some items of the Four Saints’ faith to increase your foundation.”
“What do you think?”
“Roar!!!” Buggy excitedly recovered to become a dragon. Great!!
After arriving at the World King Planet, it didn’t dare to use its power of faith at all.
Now, the power of faith stored in Buggy’s body was probably only enough for it to maintain the Creation Domain and fight with all its might for eight hours. Every minute and second was extremely precious.
They were all collected and stored in its body on Blue Planet before it left. This was only the consumption of the Creation Domain. If it used the power of faith to strengthen the Green Dragon Indestructible Body in battle and used the Dragon Star Group, it might not even be able to last half of eight hours.
Poor, poor. If it had sufficient power of faith, no matter how strong Eleven was now, would it be tortured by the leader?
At the moment, the strongest skill in the team, in terms of potential, was actually Buggy’s Creation Domain. Unfortunately, because it was too strong and the restrictions were too great, it needed to be strengthened with the power of faith to display its full strength.
If it had unlimited power of faith, Buggy’s Green Dragon Indestructible Body would also be far stronger than the Battle God Body. After all, this was equivalent to thousands of believers using their strength to strengthen Buggy together.
“Alright, tell Chi Tong, Little Zi, and the others about the news,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Roar!!” Buggy listened and immediately ran to announce the good news. On the way… it glanced at Susu.
“Ji… (Susu, work hard. When the time comes, how many Green Dragon faith tools you can buy will depend on you.)”
Susu: “?”
…
That night, Ling also returned home.
During dinner, Shi Yu and his family gathered and chatted.
“Ling, you should have completed the modification, right? Isn’t it time to learn Starry Sky Storm next?” Shi Yu asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1368 - 1368 Baby Team Takes Off (2)
chapters.content:
1368 Baby Team Takes Off (2)
“Yes.” As Ling charged, it said, “Master, have you forgotten something?”
“The way to learn the Starry Sky Storm is to let me withstand the Starry Sky Storm head-on. I need to use the Turning Misfortune into Luck and the Wind Spirit Bead, so shouldn’t you raise my skills to the current maximum level before letting me learn them?”
“This way, the success rate will be higher…”
“Ah…” Shi Yu said, “I think so too, but I’m not free yet.”
“Before you go and resist the Starry Sky Storm, I’ll definitely maximize your skills.”
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven also held the bamboo pole with both hands and said, “Wuu!”
It was about to participate in a battle above its level in the ranking of all races. In order to win, shouldn’t it also add points to its current quasi-divine skill to the expert level? It didn’t have to be maxed out. It just had to be at the expert level!
“Ji!!!” “Mi!!” Buggy and Chi Tong, who were eating fruits, also fought for it. If they wanted to participate in the Four Saints Meeting, should they maximize their faith skills?
“Yi… (Cultivation Fruit…)” Baby Ginseng said.
“Ning…” Susu originally wanted to say something, but considering its position as the sister, it sighed. It should obediently cleanse the pollutants and raise its entire family.
At this moment, Little Ji and Duckie couldn’t say a word. Shi Yu couldn’t help but feel a headache. After the skill fusion, adding points was indeed a big problem.
They were all quasi-divine skills, and they were high-level and top-notch quasi-divine skills. It wasn’t that easy to add points once. He felt that the remaining 100-plus divine-level crystals would be used up soon.
“That makes sense, but let me rest for two days first. I’ll add points to Little Quas, Turtle, and Cat these two days.”
“It’s relatively easy to add points to their skills… It’s good for their health,” Shi Yu said.
Occasionally, he should also slack off for two days.
At the same time, Little Quas, Turtle, and Cat were stunned. Additional points… What was that?
From just now, they didn’t understand much.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven threatened them fiercely.
“That’s special training that’s enough to destroy and defeat your will. It’s very scary.”
Little Quas, Turtle, and Cat trembled. Even Eleven, who was the strongest, felt that the special training was terrifying.
…
Even Shi Yu had forgotten how long ago it had been since he added points to low, intermediate, and high-level skills.
At the moment, the monarch-level Turtle, Little Quas, and Cat really had a bunch of low-level skills to add.
After dinner, Shi Yu pulled Turtle, Little Quas, and Cat to the side and started a small meeting.
“A meeting!”
At the moment, the configuration of the three pets was like this…
Turtle, high-level monarch race, monarch level, medium will. Skills were Water Spear, Spin Impact, Spirit Water, Water Shield Wall, Guardian Water, and Water of Life.
Little Quas, low-level overlord race, monarch level, medium will. Its skills were Quas Gravel, Water Spear, Quas Tail, Frozen Water, Blizzard, Praying Rain, Absolute Zero, and Vortex Strangulation.
Shorty, high-level monarch race, monarch level, medium will. Its skills were Gem Eye, Deterrence, and Metal Control, and it belonged to a mutated species.
Shi Yu felt that their skill configurations were pretty good. After the Turtle and Little Quas’ skills were maxed out, they could directly fuse into Water Elemental Control and Quas Elemental Control and become Black Tortoises.
As for the three skills of Shorty, the Metal Control was an evolution skill. It could be upgraded to a metal control divine skill in the future. Moreover, this metal control could also be taught to Eleven and Chi Tong in the future. It was very useful.
“My lord, my lord.”
“Minister.”
“God!!”
After being pulled over by Shi Yu, the three babies each called Shi Yu the way they liked.
Turtle used ‘My lord’, Little Quas used ‘Minister’, and Shorty encouraged Shi Yu to establish the Shi Yu Divine Sect. It was the sect master, so Shi Yu was naturally a god!
“Do you want to participate in the God Sealing Battle?” Shi Yu asked in a meeting.
“If you want to participate, which rank do you want to reach?” Shi Yu came up and asked a very explosive topic, stumping the three little ones.
“Ah, this…” Turtle fell into deep thought. It looked at Little Quas and asked, “Little Quas, what about you?”
“…I can’t tell,” Little Quas said.
The turtle rubbed its hands and smiled. “If my ranking can be higher than yours, Little Quas, can the two of us go to the movies alone and not go with Big Sister Chi Tong and the others…”
Little Quas: “?”
This was all it had?
Shorty: “Meow!!”
“Hey, hey, hey, can the two of you pay attention? There are still underage kittens here.” Shorty was angry. These two guys were too annoying.
If it established Shi Yu’s sect in the starry sky, it would definitely set up rules and not allow the sect to fall in love. It felt that this would only be a bad thing.
Obviously, Shorty worshiped Shi Yu’s entire team selectively. It only worshiped the first six members of the team, Little Ji, and Duckie.
After all, it had grown up watching their battle videos.
“Alright, looks like you don’t have a specific idea either…” Shi Yu said. Was this question that difficult?
Turtle, Little Quas, and Cat were silent. Of course, they had no idea!!!
The seniors of the first team were so strong, but they weren’t confident of obtaining good results in the God Sealing Battle.
They reflected the difference between… the overlord level… the totem level… and the two major levels.
They didn’t even have the qualifications to participate, so how could they determine the specific results of the God Sealing Battle, in which tens of millions of demigods participated?
“It’s alright. Although it’s only ten months, you might have a chance to participate. The three of you, come here,” Shi Yu called out. The three baby pets immediately walked in front of Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1369 - 1369 Baby Team Takes Off (3)
chapters.content:
1369 Baby Team Takes Off (3)
Shi Yu’s hand first pressed on the turtle’s… head.
Increase points… Spin impact!
It was the Turtle Ramming Attack!
Buzz!
White light flickered. Shi Yu wasn’t affected at all before pressing his hand on Little Quas’s head.
He was now at Level 9 with two demigod battle power configurations. It was simply extremely easy to add some low-level skills.
If this could be tiring, then this cheat had to exist.
In the second round, he increased points for Water Spear!
Shi Yu added some water guns to Little Quas. Then, with a blue flash, he pressed his hand on the cat’s head.
This time, Shi Yu had a high-level skill, Deterrence Stats!
Buzz!
Platinum light flickered.
“Meow!!!” Shorty was arrogant.
At this moment, the three babies didn’t feel anything.
It felt extremely comfortable.
Because they only added points once, the individual nutritional supplements they ate every day could also allow their skill level to increase quickly, so their senses weren’t very strong.
However, Shi Yu’s hand didn’t stop at all!
One second at a time!
Clap, clap, clap.
Just like fighting a ground rat, his hand kept pressing on the heads of Turtle, Little Quas, and Cat. +1+1+1+1+1+1 continuously…
Consecutive +1s appeared on the heads of Turtle, Little Quas, and Cat, making their expressions gradually stunned.
“Hu hu hu!!!” Turtle was shocked. What happened to it?
“Wu~~” Little Quas was also shocked, and the temperature of its body plummeted.
“Meow!!!” Apart from being shocked, the cat’s gem eyes lit up as it looked at Shi Yu in admiration.
Divine… miracle!!
There was no need for Baby Ginseng’s support at all. There was no need for any pet support at all. Shi Yu increased his points crazily.
Soon, apart from super skills, all the low, intermediate, and high-level skills of the Turtle, Little Quas, and Gem Cat had reached above-perfect proficiency, close to transcendent!!
As for Shi Yu, he was only a little tired. It wasn’t the kind of tiredness, but like a sage mode that had been playing games for a long time.
Ah, it was so tiring to add points. Couldn’t the trash index have a low-level skill, ten consecutive hits, a hundred consecutive hits, and a full-level function?
It was so troublesome to circulate and add points every time.
“How is it?”
However, Shi Yu looked at Turtle, Little Quas, and Cat. From their expressions, the effect seemed to be pretty good.
“Of course, super skills can’t be added like this. Although it doesn’t affect me much, it’s a destruction to your willpower. This is also why I trained your willpower previously.”
“Those training are all preparations to increase points. As long as you can last 10 months, it’s not a big problem to reach the demigod level. However, what rank you can reach depends on your own hard work during this period of time.”
“If I can train my overlord will, I will definitely have relatively good results. If it’s still mid-level will, the efficiency of adding points might not be very high.”
“How is it? Can you withstand it?”
“Hu hu hu!!”
“Wu~~”
“Meow!!!” The three pets had serious expressions. What a joke. There was such a good thing?
Could this be the special training that Senior Eleven mentioned to destroy one’s will and heart?
Why not let them do more? Otherwise, this point wouldn’t feel right…
If they had known that training could allow them to enjoy adding points… They would definitely have been able to withstand 10 times the training previously.
“Alright, collective transformation, right?” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “I won’t be cheeky with you anymore, Eleven. Continue adding points. After adding points, I’ll continue sleeping. By the way, I still have a divine skill here. Turtle, Little Quas, it’s prepared for you. Do you want to learn it?”
“Huh?”
“Wu??” Turtle and Little Quas were stunned.
Shi Yu said, “This skill is called the Black Tortoise Fusion Technique. It’s a skill developed by Dong Huang’s second Legendary Beast Tamer, Emperor Wu. It can allow the Turtle Race and the Snake Race, who are telepathically connected, to fuse and evolve into the Four Holy Beasts, the Black Tortoise.”
“Of course, you can separate later.” Shi Yu smiled.
Turtle: !!!
Little Quas: !!!
Fusion?!
Cat: “?”
“Mi…!” Wait, this wasn’t a car to the God Sealing Battle!
“How do you know everything?” Shi Yu looked at the celebrity-chasing cat with a dark expression. Was this a celebrity-chasing girl? This cat probably didn’t create a random couple for him, right?
“Don’t think too much. It’s just that it fused and evolved into a Black Tortoise, obtaining stronger power at the last minute. You two little guys, be more pure-minded. Don’t tell me that your race doesn’t have any records of Black Tortoises. Even if you don’t understand it in the race, you should have attended cultural classes with Ling after coming to me, right?” Shi Yu said weakly.
…
That night, Shi Yu relied on himself to upgrade the low, intermediate, and high-level skills of Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty to transcendent.
As for consumption, it only drank a large cup of nourishing beauty water. It didn’t delay the team of pets from doing their own thing at all.
As for Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty, they felt that this night had improved more than their bitter cultivation in the past few months.
For a moment, their feelings were complicated. They were suddenly filled with hope for the future…
If this could continue, the God Sealing Battle…
“Top 10…” Little Quas silently set a small goal in its residence with its tail. Apart from the nine seniors who were participating in the first team, there were also Turtle and Shorty who could participate. In other words, there might be 12 members on the team.

chapters.title: Chapter 1370 - 1370 Baby Team Takes Off (4)
chapters.content:
1370 Baby Team Takes Off (4)
Little Quas, who had always wanted to be strong in its life, didn’t have any expectations for the top nine, but it definitely had to get tenth place.
Even Lord Dragon God of Dragon Palace City… couldn’t achieve such good results in the God Sealing Battle, right?
The more Little Quas thought about it, the more excited it became. It remembered that the Dragon God seemed to have also come to the World King Planet. If it performed well in the God Sealing Battle, could the Dragon God see it?
“Hu!!” Turtle also set a small goal for the top 10.
It was the same for Shorty. The target was in the top 10.
The three babies began to place their ambitions in the top 10 of the God Sealing Battle. It would be embarrassing if they weren’t in the top 10.
The next day, Shi Yu woke up energetically.
On this day, Shi Yu began to arrange for Eleven to contact the purple-skinned holey person, planning to get Eleven to trick it into replicating the skill.
Early in the morning, the purple-skinned holey person received a call from Eleven.
“Wu wu wu, wu wu wu.”
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven invited the purple-skinned holey person, God Fanba, to come to their house for dinner.
It meant that the chef at home had already prepared a big meal.
At the same time, Fanba, who was still in Blue Wave City, listened to the crying and barking on the phone and kept feeling that this trip was a “surprising ambush plot”.
Moreover, there was actually a chef at home… The Iron-eating Beast Race… was indeed not simple.
“It doesn’t come with good intentions, right…” It had already promised Eleven previously… Moreover, Fanba was really curious. What kind of race could nurture such a monster?
After careful consideration, Fanba still headed to the designated location and arrived at the environmental area of Blue Wave City.
Blue Wave City had a total of 92 city districts. Among them, the Myriad Race Committee’s territory was the Myriad Domain District. The Environmental Protection District was naturally the territory of the Environmental Protection Association. Facilities like the Disaster Research Institute were all in different areas, and they were the symbolic landmarks of the local area.
“It actually lives in the Environmental Protection District…” After Fanba arrived, it completely didn’t expect that this area wasn’t the residential area of a large family or the rental area of an external faction. Most of the facilities were managed by the Environmental Protection Association…
“Moreover, this area is…” Fanba was slightly stunned when it arrived at the luxurious mystic realm villa area.
The map showed that this was the high-level residential area of the Environmental Protection Association.
It was usually assigned to the residences of cleansing masters above two stars in the Environmental Protection Association.
No matter how it thought about it, it also felt that this place didn’t match Eleven… Physical cleansing?
With confusion, it began to go deeper. When it approached, Buggy and the other pets had already sensed it. Buggy even came out to welcome it directly.
“Welcome, welcome, purple-skinned holey person, you’re here.” Buggy chirped and teleported over.
“My name isn’t purple-skinned holey person. My name is Fanba, Star Refining Race’s Fanba,” Fanba repeated. Damn it, if it weren’t for the fact that it couldn’t defeat that Iron-eating Beast, it would definitely teach this worm a lesson.
“Alright, Star Refining Race’s holey person, come quickly. We’ve prepared a big meal for you. It’s all our favorites.”
“…” Fanba fell into deep thought and entered. “I also have a goal in coming this time. I want to fight it again. This time… can you let me see its full strength?”
“Even if I lose very badly, I want to see how big the difference between us is.”
Buggy nodded and felt that it wasn’t a big problem. Full strength…
Then, under Buggy’s lead, Fanba arrived at the villa garden. At this moment, Eleven also came out and followed Shi Yu to welcome the guest.
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven waved its hand. A friend came from afar! Its skills could be stolen!
“Star Refining Race’s Fanba, I’ve heard so much about you. Welcome,” Shi Yu also said.
“Uh.” Fanba saw the human standing beside Eleven, and the skin around its eyes swayed slightly.
This person…
“I’m Eleven’s Beast Tamer. I’ve already heard about it running out to participate in the ranking battle of all races. Thank you for fighting Eleven. It has a very high evaluation of you,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Fanba was silent, rather shocked, but also felt that it was only natural… As expected, Eleven of the Iron-eating Beast Race still had a contracted partner?
Eleven was already so strong. How strong would it be if it obtained the support of the Beast Tamer?
Fanba couldn’t imagine it.
“So you have a Beast Tamer,” Fanba said.
“Wuu!! (It’s all thanks to the Beast Tamer’s Cultivation that I can have today),” Eleven said proudly.
Fanba: “?”
What was it so proud of? Wouldn’t it be more worth bragging about its own hard work!
“Ji!! (It’s also my Beast Tamer.)” Buggy also revealed its identity.
This time, Fanba finally knew why the super expert of the Iron-eating Beast Race was with a worm. It turned out that both parties had been contracted by the same human…
Therefore, to be able to be contracted with Iron-eating Beast Eleven, who was this worm? It looked at Buggy and only remembered that it had drunk a strange medicinal liquid previously and could teleport.
“In short, welcome,” Shi Yu said.
“Thank you…” Fanba muttered.
“Shi Yu, Fanba still wants to fight Eleven again. It wants to see Eleven’s full strength!!!”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “No problem. Since it’s the guest’s request… However, according to the rules of the God Sealing Battle, its full strength is carried out with my support. Quasi-mythical Fanba, do you want to give it a try?”
“Looks like Quasi-mythical Fanba is very interested. No problem. In that case, let’s spar after dinner.”
Fanba wanted to say something but hesitated. It kept feeling that something was wrong. It… had yet to say anything!
…
Next, Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy treated Fanba to the food made by Baby Ginseng. As for the other pets, they were still doing their own thing and didn’t appear.
Shi Yu and the others were still quite generous. Even Fanba, who came from a large-sized race, ate very well and enjoyed it very much. Fanba, who originally felt that there was something wrong with Shi Yu and the others, suddenly felt that it had wronged them.
Until… the two parties started sparring.
There was naturally a battlefield in the vice president’s residential area. Because it was prepared for purifiers above the two-star level, it was basically equivalent to a divine level. It was even stronger than the battle facilities of the ranking battle of all races. When fighting, it was naturally free to go all out.
Boom…
Bang!!!
“Ah…” Fanba of the Star Refining Race let out a shocking scream.
[Copy successful]
[Skill Name]: Star Refinement
< Introduction > It has the ability to refine non-living stars into weapons and equipment.
After successfully refining it, it could control the Star Arms as it pleased.
Note: The success rate of refining the Star Arms depends on the skill proficiency, the strength of the star, and the compatibility of the Star Refiner’s Stats with the star attribute.

chapters.title: Chapter 1371 - 1371 Buggy’s Star Arms (1)
chapters.content:
1371 Buggy’s Star Arms (1)
Star Refinement, replication successful!
Shi Yu copied two top-notch divine skills from the Star Refining Race’s Fanba in a row.
The comfortable feeling made the current Panda God of War, Shi Yu, so high that he couldn’t stop.
Star Refinement was actually a spatial skill.
Most of the pets had a basic level of compatibility with learning, even lower than the compatibility required for Space Control over the pets!
The dream of pets having a Star Arms didn’t seem far away.
However, while Shi Yu was high, the purple-skinned holey person was extremely tormented.
It looked at the panda person who had fused with the Iron-eating Beast in front of it and the flash of light on Shi Yu’s fingertip. It hurt, it hurt too much.
“Have you ever been kicked at the speed of light?” Until now, the demonic words of Panda Man Shi Yu still echoed in its mind.
With such a powerful body and a light-speed kick, the mace was directly shattered, and its ribs were shattered. What was the point of fighting?
Monster…
This pair of guys were definitely monsters that could compete with the top 10, top five, and top three of the God Sealing Battle!!
“No more fighting…”
Fanba looked at the mace that would take god knows how long to repair. It directly sat on the ground and smashed it.
“Uh, there’s still a top-notch divine skill I haven’t shown you,” Shi Yu said.
The Eight Trigrams clone and the One Thought of God and Demon couldn’t be shown to it, but the control of light and the Yin Yang Millstone revealed by Director Sen had to be shown to the guest.
This was just Fusion+Battle Divine Body+Light Control!
“No, there’s nothing bad about not looking,” Fanba of the Star Refining Race said as it sat.
This was enough for it to realize the real difference. Before it had new arms, it no longer had any extravagant hopes of defeating Eleven.
“…” Shi Yu was stunned. Forget it.
So be it.
The Starry Sky Race was really good.
One day, he would definitely make friends with the top 10,000 races in the starry sky.
What could he do…
Yes… As long as Eleven passed the Myriad Race Ranking Battle and let the Iron-eating Beast Race rank at the top, the Iron-eating Beast Race would become a high-level race of the Myriad Race Committee…
That would be much more convenient!
Be it touching powerful races or obtaining information about new rare races immediately, it was quite convenient!
Eleven howled and removed its fusion state with Shi Yu.
Only then was Fanba willing to get up.
In its own race, it was the most talented, but after arriving at the World King Planet, it took part in first the God Sealing Battle, then the ranking battle of all races. It encountered obstacles everywhere that had already made its mentality collapse a little. Of course, the most important reason for its mental imbalance was that its opponent was too young.
If it were defeated by an old guy who had lived for hundreds or thousands of years and was stuck below the God Realm, it wouldn’t feel so uncomfortable.
“Will you participate in this year’s God Sealing Battle?” It looked at Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy.
Shi Yu said, “I think so?”
“Alright, I’ve decided. I want to return to the race and refine the stars again. See you in the God Sealing Battle,” Fanba said.
“Uh.” Buggy sighed. If it couldn’t defeat it now, it was even more impossible to defeat it in the God Sealing Battle.
At that time, all the strong talents and skills that their race had… would each belong to them!
…
“Hahahaha!”
After sending the purple-skinned holey person away, Shi Yu compared the compatibility of the pets according to the contract connection and laughed like a goose. He was as happy as a 200-kilogram child.
Eleven and Buggy, who knew why Shi Yu was smiling so happily, were also infected and laughed together.
“Hahahaha.” Eleven and Buggy laughed.
“Do you know why I’m smiling so happily?”
Eleven and Buggy: !!!
“Next, you’re in luck! Apart from Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty who can’t learn Star Refinement Skills, everyone else can learn them.”
“Wuuu.”
“Ji!!” Eleven and Buggy didn’t expect the compatibility requirement for the refinement skill to be so low.
It was really a talent skill of the Star Refining Race that had become a common skill.
The purple-skinner holey person might become an eternal sinner in the race.
However…
Eleven and Buggy smiled, and their expressions suddenly changed. They sensed that something was wrong and looked at Shi Yu.
“Huh?” “Wu?”
Wait a minute, it was fine if other pets could learn it.
Even the Son of the Stars, Little Purple… and even the Time Sprite, Qi?!
Heavens!!!
“Yeah…” Shi Yu also completely didn’t expect it. He said, “Ridiculous. A skill with compatibility has finally appeared.”
“The most ridiculous thing is that the Time Sprite, known for finding it impossible to learn other attack skills, also has a skill now.”
“It’s a complete surprise… Perhaps it’s because this skill is only an arms skill? Moreover, it’s a weapon skill to refine external resources. It has less impact on oneself, so the Time Sprite can learn it?”
Eleven and Buggy looked at each other. It seemed like that was indeed a possibility!
“Starry sky…” Shi Yu was delighted. There were indeed more good skills in the universe.
Little Zi and Qi should be very happy.
In an instant, Shi Yu sent the good news he had obtained to every pet in the group, apart from Little Quas, Turtle, and Shorty.
He wouldn’t agitate those three guys first.
“Yi!!” “Mi!!!” “Wa~”
Immediately, happy shouts came from various places in the Beast Taming Space and Little Zi’s body. Its feeling was indescribable. The joy it felt couldn’t compare to the New Year celebration, it was simply like winning the lottery!

chapters.title: Chapter 1372 - 1372 Buggy’s Star Arms (2)
chapters.content:
1372 Buggy’s Star Arms (2)
And it was super big.
After it arrived in the universe, it was influenced by Shi Yu and liked history.
The contract between humans and transcendent lives would affect each other, and it was vividly displayed here.
The history of Blue Planet had no secrets for Qi, but the universe was different. Even if it was a Time Sprite, it was like a child in the face of the huge universe.
Moreover, there were countless cosmic eras before this one.
Could it also transmigrate the era in the future?
With various expectations, Qi also began her journey as an “archeologist”. Under Shi Yu’s careful education, she embarked on the archeological path of the celestial pit.
If a Time Sprite knew archeology, even the cosmic emperors would cry.
“Star Arms…” Qi’s eyes were shining. No matter how good the Time Umbrella of Eleven and the others created for it was, it wasn’t Qi’s after all.
However, Star Refinement and Star Arms were real. As long as it learned them, it could rely on its own abilities to repair and upgrade them. This made Qi even more tempted.
Great!!!
It had already thought about it. It still wanted an umbrella for its new arms!
The various pets began to think of what arms they wanted.
Little Zi was also very surprised. However, it looked down at its round body and the nebula gas that looked like clothes and fell into deep thought.
Why not add Star Ring Arms?
Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, Little Ji, Duckie… All of them thought about their arms.
After all, it was also an opportunity to strengthen himself. Moreover, it was a huge strengthening.
This was equivalent to every pet contracting a planet. How could this not be strong?
Although it was a dead planet…
A planet with consciousness and life inside couldn’t be refined.
But even so, it was very strong.
Could it be that it wanted to find a renewable weapon to eat…
“You guys think very well.” At this moment, Shi Yu also affirmed.
“But it seems a little early to be happy.”
“Where can I find stars for you to refine…”
“The planets around the World King Planet are all life planets with owners. If you want to find a non-life planet, and it’s a top-notch non-life planet, there’s plenty to find in the vast Cosmic Sea.”
“Besides, we have to find more than ten…” Shi Yu had just thought of this problem.
If only one pet could learn to refine star skills, it could guarantee that it would find a convenient weapon for that pet.
However, all his pets were to refine star skills. Where could he find these dozen or so top-notch planets…
Wasn’t this taking his life?
Of course, it was easy to find a star, but the problem was that there was definitely no one in the team who could control a star weapon now… Even if they reached the divine level, it would be difficult.
Moreover, the power of the sun didn’t match every pet…
Ling requested to open the call. “Master, if there’s really no other way, the World King Planet seems to have a universe overlord army stationed here. We can buy a planet from them… It’s too dangerous and time-consuming to look for it ourselves…”
Shi Yu was speechless.
The cosmic overlord army was the only foreign faction on the World King Planet that could legally sell the planet. This was mainly because the World King had to give the cosmic overlord respect.
The position of the cosmic overlord army was to earn money. As long as they were paid, they could go to the battlefield to be mercenaries to fight the army of the World King Planet, the army of the insect race, the army of the Dark King, or hunt the cosmic behemoth. In short, whoever paid was the boss.
Logically speaking, such a faction should die the fastest, but unfortunately, the universe overlord was currently recognized as the strongest expert in the universe. Its army naturally ran rampant. Apart from its territory, there were also factions of the other four universe emperors doing business.
Among them, the planet trade was one of them… Not to mention a planet without consciousness, even if there were life habitats and conscious planets, they would dare to attack and sell them.
“That’s a path…” Shi Yu said, “Although they destroy stars and races at every turn, it’s said that they’re still very honest in doing business.”
This was Yun An’s old enemy. The Yun clan planet that Yun An belonged to seemed to have been destroyed by others who hired the universe overlord army.
Sigh, he couldn’t afford to offend them.
“Since there are no planetary resources, I won’t teach you now,” Shi Yu said. “We’ll talk about it when we have the chance to find a suitable star.”
He would teach them other skills first.
Skills like Dark Control, Metal Control, and Space Control… could be learned from each other.
“Ji!! (You can teach me first!!! My Dragon Star Group is also considered a Dragon Star. I can refine a one-time Dragon Star Group into permanent Star Arms through Star Refinement.)”
“Ji!! (If the Dragon Star Group could fuse with the Refining Star, how cool would that be~)”
Shi Yu and Eleven looked at Buggy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1373 - 1373 Buggy’s Star Arms (3)
chapters.content:
1373 Buggy’s Star Arms (3)
Buggy was serious. This was a decision it had thought about for a long time. It would be a huge loss to let it consume the power of faith and use the one-time Dragon Star Group.
However, apart from being able to refine planets, the Star Refinement Skill also seemed to be able to repair, strengthen, and derive arms skills. In short, there were many benefits.
Wasn’t Refining Stars a perfect combination skill with the Dragon Star Group?
If it could modify the Dragon Star Group through Star Refinement… At that time, it would be surrounded by several Dragon Star meteorite arms that could be repaired themselves even if they were smashed. This could reduce the need for the power of faith a lot.
It didn’t have to spend much effort to find a suitable star, right? It had mastered the laws of creation and the skill to create the Dragon Star. Couldn’t it build it itself!!
Then, by refining stars, it would maximize their potential!
Of course, if it could encounter more suitable Star Arms in the future, it wouldn’t mind changing. But now, Buggy only wanted to learn Star Refinement before the God Sealing Battle and strengthen itself. This way, it would see vast improvements!
“Are you sure?” Shi Yu said. “The Dragon Star Group… can also be refined?”
Buggy: “Try, try!!”
Buggy had already thought about it. At the Four Saints Meeting, it would buy a pile of faith items and spend a huge price to condense an Eternal Dragon Ball Arms. At that time, whoever wasn’t convinced would directly turn a Dragon Ball into a dragon star and smash it. It was simple and crude!
Buggy still felt that it was very cool. Meteorite Destruction! Unfortunately, the price to use it wasn’t small.
On Blue Planet, Buggy still had seven dragon stars hanging above Blue Planet to protect Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang, but here, it didn’t have a single dragon star.
This time… was a good opportunity to condense dragon stars again!
“Alright,” Shi Yu said. “I’ll teach you when I’m free~”
Buggy: “Wuu!!!”
Eleven was stunned. Wu wu wu.
It was clearly it who…
…
Next, Shi Yu continued to add points. Although he had promised Buggy, Buggy’s weapon wasn’t in a hurry. It wasn’t the highest priority.
He first added points to Ling. What he added were the three super skills, Wind Element Control (transcendent), Turning Misfortune into Luck (transcendent), and Wind Spirit Bead (transcendent). Because it was a super skill, it was definitely easier to add points than quasi-divine skills.
In addition, these three skills determined the success rate of Ling learning the Starry Sky Storm in the future. Naturally, he had to take priority.
Next were the three babies of the clueless team. Shi Yu smoothly added their low, intermediate, and high-level skills to Dao Proficiency, but super skills were only added slowly.
Because it was added too quickly, when it reached the perfect level, they would break through to the overlord. Now that they only had intermediate will, it was better to wait to train their overlord will before breaking through.
During the process of Shi Yu adding some super skills to them, he didn’t let Susu cleanse their affliction. For them, this was a rare opportunity to train their willpower.
If they couldn’t take it now, what would happen to their quasi-divine skills in the future?
After enjoying the leap in the level of low-level skills… The additional points of super skills finally made Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty experience the danger of adding points.
It hurt them, but they were happy.
In short, Shi Yu planned to let them slowly train for more than a month before undergoing [Evolution Breakthrough].
In less than two days, the additional points Shi Yu added to Ling were completed. When Ling went to optimize the three super skills of Dao Proficiency to quasi-divine skills, Shi Yu finally began to return to teach Buggy the Star Refinement Skill!!
“Roar!!!!” Buggy had just learned it in pain when it eagerly asked Shi Yu if there was a success rate of fusion between the Dragon Star Group and the Star Refinement.
“No, the success rate is 0.”
“Roar…” Buggy was depressed, but it still turned around and excitedly took the World Tree Fruit created by Baby Ginseng to increase comprehension before running to try to refine the dragon star.
Compared to real Star Arms, the arms refined by the dragon star were definitely weak at the current stage, but they were at least a powerful combination skill. It was definitely stronger than the individual Dragon Star Group. Buggy believed that when Shi Yu added points to the Dragon Star Group to a divine skill and when it learned to overdraft its faith, the Dragon Ball Arms might not be inferior to other Star Arms.
After all, it was his, so it was more convenient. Moreover, it was easier to upgrade than other Star Arms. The Star Arms of the Star Refining Race could only be upgraded by increasing the Star Refining skill, but its Dragon Ball was different. It could also be upgraded by upgrading the Dragon Star Group skill and injecting the power of faith… This was an advantage that Eleven and the others didn’t have.
“Wu wu wu…” Buggy ran to refine the Dragon Ball. Eleven was also eager to try, wanting to learn the Dark Control that was replicated at the same time.
Shi Yu naturally taught it without any problems.
“Wuu!!!” However, it was also a pity that the fusion rate of Light Control and Dark Control was currently 0… Eleven was shocked when it heard that.
Why couldn’t it learn Light and Dark Control even though it already knew Yin Yang Millstone?
“These two skills are both divine skills that are close to top-notch quality. After fusion, it might not be as simple as Light and Dark Control, and has an undoubtedly higher difficulty, like the ‘Yin Yang Law’.” Shi Yu guessed blindly, trying his best to guess better.
That was really a possibility. After all, even if the chances of directly fusing weren’t high, they still had the invincible Yin Yang Taiji Domain!
Eleven nodded and felt that it made sense. Then, it looked forward to it even more!
“Don’t worry, there’s still time in the future. The existing skills are enough for you to practice.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Speaking of which, when are you going to participate in the battle above your level? Do you want to increase the proficiency of these skills again?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1374 - 1374 Buggy’s Star Arms (4)
chapters.content:
1374 Buggy’s Star Arms (4)
“Wu wu wu!!!” Eleven nodded crazily. It wanted to be an expert in quasi-divine skills!!
In order to have better results in Eleven’s battle above its level, Shi Yu naturally pulled the entire team and continued to support Eleven.
It was undoubtedly the most difficult to add points to Eleven, because its quasi-divine skills were too high-quality.
When adding points at the quasi-divine skill stage, the consumption of each skill began to be different. The more powerful the divine skill, the harder it was to add points. Therefore, when adding points to Eleven, the little resources of the entire team could be said to be consumed at a visible speed.
Susu’s work speed couldn’t compare to the consumption of points at all.
If the Environmental Protection Association knew that even the cleansing star spirit couldn’t afford to raise a team of pets, they would definitely be very shocked.
About half a month later, Shi Yu completed the additional points for Eleven.
Apart from Light and Dark Control, the Yin Yang Millstone, the Eight Trigrams Clone, the Battle God Body, and the Thought of God and Demon had all gained points to the expert level for Eleven.
“Wuu!!!!” At this moment, Eleven already had sufficient confidence to fight a true god above its level.
“Ji~” Buggy saw that the leader’s strength had increased greatly and was envious. It lowered its head and refined the thing that looked like a glass bead in front of it again. This was surprisingly the “Dragon Ball Arms” formed by Buggy through the Star Refinement and Dragon Star Group.
The dragon ball was like a green glass bead with a golden symbol inside. Although it only looked the size of a glass bead now, Buggy knew that this bead was impressive.
It was ever-changing! The size and weight could be controlled at will! The weight of the Dragon Ball was still increasing under its refinement. In the future, even if it was as heavy as Blue Planet, it wasn’t impossible.
At that time, it would be too cruel to smash a bead down. Its power was basically no different from the dragon star summoned from the starry sky. Most importantly, the current Dragon Ball could still be constantly repaired through the power of spatial star refinement. It was no longer a one-time use.
It probably saved a lot of power of faith.
Therefore, as long as Buggy kept upgrading the Dragon Ball through the stronger power of the starry sky and the power of faith, it might be the first pet in the team to have a finished star weapon. Because faith skills were generally stronger than ordinary skills after strengthening with external forces, when the time came, it would be like the impact of a divine-level star. It wouldn’t be a dream to destroy gods above its level.
This made Chi Tong extremely envious.
Since the Dragon Star could be refined into arms, could the Vermillion Bird clone that could transform into the sun?? Could it strengthen the Vermillion Bird clone through the Star Refinement Skill…
It could be said that when it came to Shi Yu, the racial skills of the Star Refining Race directly let Buggy and the others play tricks.
As Eleven and Buggy leveled up, Baby Ginseng was the most anxious.
“Your divine-level first clear is going to be snatched away,” Chi Tong said.
“Yi!!! Yiya!!” Baby Ginseng waved its arms around. Nonsense!!!
How could defeat and kill be the same?
“Ning…” Susu considerately cleansed Baby Ginseng’s anxiety.
Baby Ginseng: “Wu wu wu wu wu.”
It had been cleansed, but not completely.
…
Shi Yu still didn’t plan to follow when all races fought above their level. It was mainly because he couldn’t follow either. A racial PK was still a battle for Eleven alone.
Of course, according to tradition, Buggy still accompanied Eleven to the Myriad Region this time.
As soon as they arrived, Director Sen immediately ran over to welcome them warmly. After waiting for more than half a month, he finally saw this Battle God Iron-eating Beast again.
It looked like Eleven was already prepared to fight above its level.
“Contestant Eleven, I’ve long applied for the right to fight above your level for you. After you’re ready, you can use the teleportation array here to enter the ‘second world’.”
“That thing is similar to the Teleportation Key Stones. You should have experienced it, right?”
“Yes!” Eleven nodded and was already looking forward to it. What kind of race would the opponent be?
Eh! If only it was the Yun Race!
The happiest battle it carried out was still with Yun An.
Unfortunately, Eleven also felt that it was dreaming. How could there be a Yun Race on the World King Planet?
Director Sen seemed to have seen Eleven’s anticipation and couldn’t help but smile. “What race will it be…”
“Wu!!” Buggy made Eleven feel at ease. Don’t worry, you’re so strong now. No matter what race you are, it’ll become a stepping stone for you and the Iron-eating Beast race!!
Eleven could be invincible at the same level with its physical body alone. With the One Thought of God and Demon, Buggy estimated that this guy could instantly kill a junior god.
He really didn’t know which race was so unlucky to encounter Eleven and participate in a battle above its level…
At the same time.
First-level world, Dong Xuan Realm.
This was a realm jointly managed by the three divine races.
The three divine races were respectively Dragon, Phoenix, and Kirin!
At this moment, in the main city of the Kirin in the Dong Xuan Region, a Kirin Race hummed a tune and flew towards the battle facilities of the Myriad Race Ranking Battle… They planned to enter the second world and fight rankings…

chapters.title: Chapter 1375 - 1375 Unlucky Race Kirin (1)
chapters.content:
1375 Unlucky Race Kirin (1)
“As usual, I’ll make a cup of Cold Crystal Spring.”
“I’ll drink it after I come out.”
In the Ranking Battle of All Races facility for all races in the main city of the Kirin, a completely ice-blue Kirin walked past a building and said to the waiter at the door.
“Yes.” The waiter watched as the Ice Kirin walked in.
In the surroundings, there were also humans and other Kirins coming and going, but most of them were Kirin subspecies that contained the Kirin bloodline. There were sheep, wolves, deer, and dragons in various forms.
“Hello, Senior.”
“Is it the advancement battle of the Ice Kirin Race this time?”
Some people greeted the Ice Kirin respectfully when they saw it and received its response.
“That’s right. If you win this battle, you can advance,” it said in a good mood.
“Whether the Ice Kirin Race can advance to the top 1 million depends on this.”
“Senior, all the best. We’ll wait for your good news,” many juniors said.
“Brother Bobo, you’re here,” a divine-level Fire Kirin with an aura not inferior to the Ice Kirin passed by and said to it.
“In the end, your family still chose you.”
The Ice Kirin laughed and said, “It’s only my luck was good.”
“Hurry up and go. I’ll wait for your good news.” The Fire Kirin gave its blessings.
Among the ten thousand races, the ranking of the Blue Planet’s Kirin Race was actually not low.
As they didn’t have the habit of participating in war, the few god races on Blue Planet often stayed in the ranking battles of all races.
It was mainly because it was relatively safe and could be trained!
Even if they relied on time to survive, they still managed to get the ranking.
However, because they were too free, the Kirin Race was later not satisfied with only fighting for the ranking of large races.
Many branch races would also rank on behalf of the branch race they belonged to when they were free.
The ranking of the branch races was much lower than that of the large races.
For example, the Ice Kirin in front of him represented the Ice Kirin Race, a branch race of the Blue Planet’s Kirin Race. It wanted to raise the Ice Kirin’s ranking to the top 1 million.
In this critical battle, a few Kirin Gods who were passionate about ranking in the Ice Kirin Race chose the candidate to fight by drawing lots and handed over this difficult mission.
“It’s quite stressful…” When the Ice Kirin arrived, a group of juniors followed behind. Although they couldn’t watch the battle, they could at least obtain the results immediately…
Soon, they arrived at a huge building. There was a teleportation device here that could input various data. The staff followed the Ice Kirin’s instructions and inputted it before carrying out the teleportation.
…
In the second world, the Myriad Race Battlefield.
In an instant, the Ice Kirin appeared on an icy plain.
At the same time, several voices appeared in its mind.
[Teleportation completed.]
[You have arrived at the second world, the Myriad Race Battlefield.]
[The venue has been randomly confirmed to be the primary venue, Icefield.]
[Triggered! This battle is confirmed to be a ‘challenge above your level’.]
[Your opponent is: Ranked Race, Iron-eating Beast Race, Quasi Divine, Eleven.]
[Battle, begin!]
Ice Kirin Bobo: ???
The Ice Kirin’s mood was completely filled with twists and turns.
After hearing that the venue was randomly chosen to the icefield, it was first happy because it had the home advantage.
But then, to its surprise, it actually randomly triggered a battle above its level!!
In the ranking battle of all races, the matched ones were basically of the same level. Unless they applied to fight above their level, there was a 100% chance of them not encountering a higher level.
The battle mechanism above their level made many battle parties hate it deeply. This was because even if they won, the points obtained were far inferior to defeating someone of the same level. However, if they lost, a large amount of points would be deducted…
“Sigh, forget it. Perhaps the points can barely be…” The Ice Kirin looked at its opponent in the distance.
It actually successfully applied for the qualifications to fight above its level in the Race Ranking Battle. It was definitely a super expert among demigods. However, the difference between a demigod and a true god… It, the Ice Kirin, would tell this Iron-eating Beast Race well.
At the same time, on the other side.
Many similar voices appeared in Eleven’s mind after it was teleported over from the Blue Wave World.
[Your opponent is: 1,001,024th place, Ice Kirin Race, Junior God, Bobo.]
[Battle, begin!]
“Wuu!!!” As its voice fell, Eleven instantly looked at its opponent and was puzzled.
Kirin… Kirin Race?
Was it the Kirin Race on Blue Planet?
Eleven wasn’t sure either.
It didn’t know if there were other Kirin Races in the starry sky of the universe, but it knew that there were other dragons in the universe. Then, it couldn’t say for sure where the Kirin in front of it came from.
Forget it, just fight.
…
In the Myriad Race Battlefield, after the Ice Kirin, Bobo, and the Iron-eating Beast, Eleven, matched, information about this battle also appeared on the huge monitor in the Teleportation room that connected the battlefield in the Blue Wave Domain and the Dong Xuan Realm.
[Ranked Race, Iron-eating Beast Race, Quasi Divine, Eleven] vs [1,001,024th place, Ice Kirin Race, Junior God, Bobo]
[Battle…]
A battle above its level!!!
On the Dong Xuan Realm’s side, a bunch of juniors who had come to see the ranking of the ice-element Kirin God were stunned. They didn’t expect that Senior Bobo would actually be matched with a demigod who applied to fight above its level… Moreover, it wasn’t those geniuses of the big starry sky races, but a race that had yet to be ranked.
“Even if we win, it won’t reach the top 1 million, right…” Many demigods with the Kirin bloodline muttered.
“It’s also a good thing. Even if the increase isn’t big, we can at least confirm that we’ll win this battle. If we win the next battle, our ranking after advancing will definitely be higher,” someone analyzed.
Compared to the Dong Xuan Region, at the scene of the Blue Wave Region, Buggy looked at the opponent it matched with with with a much strange expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 1376 - 1376 Unlucky Race Kirin (2)
chapters.content:
1376 Unlucky Race Kirin (2)
Wait, Kirin???
Ahhh, unfortunately, it couldn’t see the battle process. It wanted to see it so much.
“Oh no, the match is so close to the front. Eleven’s luck isn’t very good.” Seeing the 1 million ranking, Director Sen fell into deep thought.
Icefield.
The Ice Kirin looked at Eleven opposite it and said, “Forget it, I’ll play with you.”
With that said, a hundred Ice Swords appeared in the air behind it!!
Every Ice Sword had the power of a demigod to use a quasi-divine skill!
Facing a demigod, Bobo didn’t use his divine power, wanting to preserve it for the next battle.
Apart from divine power, it didn’t even have any intention of using the ordinary energy in its body for the time being.
It only used its method of mobilizing the natural energy of the world to condense the ice-element natural power of the icefield to form an attack.
This way, the consumption could be reduced to the minimum. Moreover… this attack couldn’t be said to be weak for demigods. Every one of the thousand attacks was enough to be called a serious attack of a demigod.
And now, there were a total of 1,000!!
Swoosh!!!
1,000 Ice Swords spun and attacked Eleven.
Seeing this, Eleven was stunned. It looked at the Ice Kirin and let the 1,000 Ice Swords land on its body. With bangs, icy mist filled the air in the blink of an eye.
“Wuu!!!” Then, Eleven walked out of the icy mist. Apart from some icy slag on its body, it was unscathed.
“What?” The Ice Kirin was stunned. Uninjured?
What a joke. This was a demigod?
When it was stunned, Eleven was already running with all its might on the icefield. Its simple physical skills turned it into an afterimage and instantly arrived beside the Ice Kirin.
Seeing this, the Ice Kirin couldn’t believe it. This guy’s physique seemed to be stronger than ordinary divine-levels. It subconsciously condensed an ice wall. Eleven hit the ice wall, and the ice wall shattered with a crack. Fortunately, it successfully blocked Eleven.
As soon as it finished speaking, the ice wall that blocked Eleven exploded. The strong ice impact first stiffened Eleven’s body and thoughts. Then, it bounced Eleven away and froze it into a huge ice cube in midair.
The extreme cold current attacked Eleven’s body crazily. In an instant, it froze Eleven’s body inside and out.
Bang!
The ice landed on the ground. The Ice Kirin understood that this was the end. However, in the next moment, with a roar and a huge power eruption, the frozen Eleven broke free from the ice.
“Wu wu wu!! (Divine level, indeed very strong.)” Eleven swung its frozen body and said seriously.
“What a joke…” At this moment, the Ice Kirin’s impression of Eleven completely changed.
This guy shattered the ice with its physical strength alone??
Could it be a cosmic behemoth!
Iron-eating Beast, what race was this?
The Ice Kirin had the same question as the person who fought Eleven previously.
Its expression froze. This guy was indeed an existence that could threaten ordinary primary-level gods. It was just unlucky to have encountered it. Otherwise, even if other true gods could win, they would have to put in a lot of effort.
“Your name is Eleven, right? Which realm are you from?” The Ice Kirin stopped attacking and started chatting.
“Can I say this?” Eleven asked.
It seemed like they often taught on television not to let children answer strangers questions.
Ice Kirin: “…”
Why was this guy like a child? What was there not to say? However, one way or another, Eleven, who was more than a meter tall, indeed didn’t look very old.
“Uncle, which realm are you from?” Eleven asked.
Since the other party started first, it also wanted to confirm its guess.
The Ice Kirin said, “I’m from the Dong Xuan Realm! You don’t even know which realm the Kirin Race is from?”
It was a frog at the bottom of the well!
“Also, I’m not an uncle!”
Eleven looked shocked.
Dong Xuan Realm… It seemed to know this!
Wasn’t this the realm managed by the three races of Blue Planet, Dragon, Phoenix, and Kirin?
Eleven was overjoyed. It didn’t expect its luck to be so good that it could actually encounter someone from the same hometown!
What was this called? Meeting someone from the same hometown brought tears to its eyes.
“What kind of expression is that?” The Ice Kirin was puzzled.
“Wu wu wu!! (Uncle, what a coincidence. I’m from the Floating Realm, and we’re even in the Realm Alliance!!)” Eleven immediately replied.
“Uh.” The Ice Kirin was stunned.
From the Floating Realm?!
What a coincidence?
When did such a powerful race appear in the Floating Realm!
Bobo was only a junior god and its level was insufficient. It didn’t know about Shi Yu, but it knew that the Floating Realm and the Dong Xuan Realm were indeed a very good alliance.
The Realm Lord of the Floating Realm was a peak divine-level expert who could talk to their Kirin Race’s super divine ancestor.
“So… you’re a junior genius of the Floating Realm?” The Ice Kirin also fell silent.
“But even if you’re an alliance, I won’t give in to you. Little brat, let’s talk when we have the chance. Let’s continue fighting!”
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven hurriedly shook its head.
It didn’t have to give in!
“Uncle, can you not hold back anymore? I want to see your divine skill. I’ve never fought a real divine skill,” Eleven said in anticipation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1377 - 1377 Unlucky Kirin Race (3)
chapters.content:
1377 Unlucky Kirin Race (3)
The Ice Kirin gritted its teeth. This brat wanted it to waste divine power?
If the opponent was anyone else, it wouldn’t care. However, it had just finished speaking, so it didn’t seem good to refuse.
“You’re pretty shameless… Forget it, I’ll guide you.” The Ice Kirin sighed.
“Be careful. The divine skill I master is the ‘Frozen Divine Realm’. In the Frozen Space, the spatial barrier, mental consciousness, physical activity, energy flow… will all be frozen.”
“In an instant, you’ll lose your mobility. Seeing that you’ve indeed never seen a divine skill, I’ll let you see it.”
“Wuu!!!” Eleven completely focused, indicating that it would also resist and counterattack with all its might.
However, the divine skill to freeze consciousness… Would it really be unable to counter it? Eleven was puzzled.
Of course, the Ice Kirin only smiled at Eleven’s response.
“In that case, attack first and use your full strength. Otherwise, I’m afraid you won’t have a chance.”
“Wuu!!” Eleven felt that it was good.
Although it was confident that it could react in any situation, it wasn’t a big problem to activate its strength in advance.
Facing the first divine-level creature it encountered, Eleven knew very well that it was impossible to defeat it with physical strength alone.
That was definitely an opponent that had to go all out to have a chance to defeat.
After thinking it through, two violent powers separated from Eleven’s body. They were no longer gentle, but completely erupted!!
Boom!!
Accompanied by a thunderclap, white lightning flashed in Eleven’s black eyes, turning into a white Thunder Armor wrapped around its entire body!
“This power…”
Thunder God Armor Mode!!
Sensing that Eleven was using the power of lightning to stimulate its body even stronger, it fell into a state that was almost self-mutilating. Even its reaction consciousness began to circulate at a high frequency. The Ice Kirin grinned.
Not bad!
That physical strength was indeed not the limit. If this guy represented the Floating Realm to participate in the God Sealing Battle, the Floating Realm would easily enter the top 100!
“Roar!!!!” Under the Ice Kirin’s gaze, Eleven continued to erupt with stronger and stronger lightning power. It didn’t hesitate to destroy its body in exchange for extreme eruption!
The monstrous warpath made the Ice Kirin nod.
“Eleven, right? You’re indeed…”
Before the Ice Kirin could finish speaking, with another boom, black lightning erupted from Eleven’s body.
On the icy plain, Eleven clenched its fists. Under two loud bangs, white lightning wrapped around its body, and black lightning flowed. Under the interweaving impact of the power of lightning, one light and one dark, a powerful and mysterious power that wasn’t inferior to the power of a god appeared like a miracle!!
“Roar!!!!!”
Eleven roared, and the shocking roar made the Ice Kirin widen its eyes and reveal an incredulous expression.
It wasn’t a simple Thunder God Armor.
It wasn’t just a Demon God Body.
It was One Thought of God and Demon after light and darkness collided!
It was a complete version of the One Thought of God and Demon.
If it was just the Thunder God Armor, although it could also increase Eleven’s speed and reaction speed greatly, it would always be in a state that Eleven could withstand.
As for the Demon God Body, it only allowed Eleven to obtain the huge power enhanced by the power of Dark Thunder.
Perhaps it could temporarily resist a true god, but it was still very unlikely to win.
Therefore, the only way to win was to think of gods and demons together!
After entering the Divine Demon Thought, one could break through the restrictions of the brain under the stimulation of the power of light, darkness, and lightning and obtain extremely strong attacks, defense, speed, injury avoidance, and thought reaction power that exceeded time.
Battle God Body+Demon God Cognitive!
No…
There was even the Yin Yang Millstone!
At this moment, the black and white electric arcs that filled the sky seemed to have become Eleven’s hair. They kept floating like a blurry Yin Yang lightning sea.
Eleven was like a thunder god walking out of the chaotic lightning sea. At this moment, a god-like aura completely erupted from its body, shaking the sky and earth. A vast universe swept through the entire icy plain.
The expert-level Yin Yang Millstone was now conceptualized. Every two interweaving black and white electric currents on Eleven’s body seemed to have formed the form of a millstone, obliterating everything.
In the Ice Kirin’s perception, Eleven didn’t seem to be a demigod at this moment, but a true god!
In the next moment, its expression turned cold. A divine power that could suppress all energy and perfectly match the power of laws bloomed from its body!!
The blue divine power formed a huge wave on the Ice Kirin’s body.
“Frozen Divine Domain!” The Ice Kirin roared. Divine power instantly combined with the dazzling power of laws to describe a divine skill.
The greatest difference between a divine level and a non-divine level was that a divine level had already converted most of its energy into divine power. The power of a quasi-divine skill condensed from divine power was at least several times that of a quasi-divine skill.
The divine skill condensed even contained unbelievable power.
Originally, such a divine skill was definitely fatal to non-divine life forms. However, sensing Eleven’s current state, the Ice Kirin panicked.
Was this a f*cking demigod? The terrifying power erupting from Eleven’s body made even it, who had divine power, feel a huge pressure.
Boom!!
The white ice sealing power instantly froze the entire Icefield Battlefield. The world and the ground were frozen, and space was gray. Originally, everything in this Divine Realm should have been frozen. Even the flow of time would be much slower.
However, under the shocked discovery of the Ice Kirin, Eleven was almost unaffected at this moment. All the cold air that filled its body was instantly disintegrated. In this extremely cold state, its thoughts were even clearer. It punched in the air!

chapters.title: Chapter 1378 - 1378 Unlucky Kirin Race (4)
chapters.content:
1378 Unlucky Kirin Race (4)
Bang!!!
The terrifying black and white lightning storm directly flipped over the icy plain, obliterating all snow and wind. The frost that swept over to protect the Ice Kirin was also instantly devoured. The powerful move arrived in front of the Ice Kirin in the blink of an eye. Under its roar, it devoured it and flipped it over…
Boom!!!
The lightning storm pushed the Ice Kirin’s body and opened a huge crack in the icy plain, hitting it more than a thousand meters away. When the power of lightning dissipated, cracks of various sizes had already appeared on the Ice Kirin’s sturdy ice body.
At this moment, the Ice Kirin was in disbelief. It didn’t understand why Eleven suddenly had such powerful strength.
Why was it difficult to resist even its divine skill?
“Boom!!!” In the divine domain that froze its thoughts, the Ice Kirin’s own thoughts almost froze. It was difficult to understand, but Eleven, whose thinking reaction was enough to exceed time, couldn’t stop at this moment. Another bolt of lightning exploded under its feet.
The burden on the body in the state of the Demon God’s Thought was huge. Moreover, the prototype of the three top-notch divine skills, the Battle God Body+Yin Yang Millstone+One Thought of God and Demon, was erupting with all its might!!
It couldn’t last long, and it could only attack continuously.
“What?” In an instant, the Ice Kirin only saw a black-and-white afterimage appear in the sky above it. Then, it spat out ice shards and its body caved in. Accompanied by a huge impact, its body smashed down the icy plain!!
Boom!!
A deep pit appeared. In midair, Eleven raised its arms high, and the power of light, darkness, and lightning surged on its body. One, two, three, four… Many small Yin Yang Millstones condensed. As its arm landed, the Yin Yang Millstones that filled the sky smashed into the huge pit crazily!
At the same time, during the fall, it destroyed the Frozen Divine Domain above its level, making the entire Divine Realm sway!!
Boom boom boom boom!!!
A terrifying boom bloomed on the Icefield Battlefield.
“Uh…” At this moment, the Ice Kirin, which was being attacked crazily, only had one thought.
It suspected that Eleven was also a Kirin.
“I don’t believe it…” It roared with difficulty in the huge pit, but in the next second, it was suppressed by a Yin Yang Millstone.
At the same time, an extremely ridiculous emotion was born in Bobo’s heart. Monster, monster. It regretted letting the other party attack first. No, it regretted coming to the ranking battle today!!
This guy wasn’t as simple as being able to skip levels. Instead, it was torturing a beginner!
“No…”
Little brat, stop!!
“Wuu!!!” How could Eleven stop? If it stopped, it would lose!
…
At this moment, in the teleportation rooms of the Dong Xuan Region and the Blue Wave Region, two groups of people were waiting for the outcome of the battle.
The juniors of the Kirin Race were puzzled why their divine level had yet to defeat the demigod opposite.
Logically speaking, there shouldn’t be a need to be so slow. Could it be that Senior Bobo became playful and started entertaining the other party?
“It changed, it changed, it’s over!” Just as everyone was puzzled, the information on the screen suddenly updated.
[Battle…] became [Battle Over].
Accompanied by a teleportation light, the Ice Kirin’s figure was teleported back to the Dong Xuan Region. Many people looked in the direction of the teleportation array. The Ice Kirin had yet to appear, so they said, “Congratulations…”
However, before they could finish speaking, they saw the Ice Kirin, covered in injuries, fall from the teleportation array.
Bang!
The Ice Kirin landed.
All the members of the Kirin Race looked at this scene in disbelief and then looked at the screen.
[Winner: Ranked Race, Iron-eating Beast Race, Quasi-Divine Eleven]
They clearly knew every word, but when combined, it stunned everyone present.
“How is this possible!!!” They exclaimed in unison.
As for the Ice Kirin on the ground, it gradually recovered a trace of consciousness. However, its rationality told it that it was best to continue fainting. It directly entered a deep sleep.
At the same time.
Blue Wave World.
The group of staff from the Blue Wave Myriad Race Committee, led by Director Sen, also waited nervously for the results of the battle.
As the information here changed, it displayed the winner’s information. On the teleportation array, a black and white bear that swayed as if it had drunk fake wine appeared. Director Sen’s expression was suddenly overjoyed!!
