“Won??? It really won?!!”
He had already picked up his cell phone excitedly and was waiting for contact from the headquarters of the Myriad Races Committee!
“Ji!” At the side, Buggy saw his ecstatic appearance and shook its head. Of course, how could the leader lose?
It immediately asked Eleven about the information it was most concerned about.
“Leader, could that Kirin Race be…”
“Sob…” Eleven was weak. It was exactly as they thought.
“…” Buggy’s expression stiffened. It was true.
Then it was over. The Beast Tamers were still hoping for the Kirin Race to return the favor… If they fought now, they wouldn’t bear a grudge, right?
Eleven was also shocked. There was such a thing? Oh no, it forgot.
The two pets instantly contacted Shi Yu from afar with worried expressions.
In the environmental area, Shi Yu fell into deep thought when he heard that. Tsk, the two of you… are unlucky children!! Why did you compete against the Kirin Race?
…
At that moment, as the Ice Kirin was defeated by someone who fought above its level, the ranking battle facilities of the myriad races in the Dong Xuan Region directly changed!!
The divine-level managers present, including the Fire Kirin that had just greeted the Ice Kirin, rushed to the scene one after another. They looked at the Ice Kirin, who was lying down, with incredulous expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1379 - 1379 Unlucky Kirin Race (5)
chapters.content:
1379 Unlucky Kirin Race (5)
In the Ice Kirin Race, many members of the Ice Kirin Race instantly had a heart attack, and their lungs exploded when they heard that Bobo had lost in a ranking battle to a demigod.
“F*ck, what’s going on?” A pile of Ice Kirins immediately rushed to the battlefield with the medicine, wanting to understand.
In a battle above their level, the chances of a demigod winning were actually very low. Therefore, every time they successfully crossed their level, the headquarters of the Myriad Races Committee would take it very seriously. The factions that successfully crossed their level would naturally be overjoyed, and the races that had been surpassed would lose face.
Upon hearing that the divine level had been surpassed, even the president of the Myriad Race Committee in the Kirin main city, a top-notch Divine Realm Holy Kirin, couldn’t help but come to the scene to take a look at the situation. It wanted to personally ask this kid from the Ice Kirin Race what was going on.
“President…” When the top-notch Holy Kirin arrived, the medical staff and spectators present greeted it.
“Which big race’s quasi-divine did it lose to?” The top-notch Holy Kirin asked the staff at the scene.
The female staff in charge of matching the Ice Kirin said timidly, “President… I don’t think it’s a big race in the starry sky. It’s a new race that has never participated in the ranking competition… It’s the Iron-eating Beast Race, Eleven. We’ve never heard of this race and this quasi-divine…”
“President, have you heard of this race? We know Bobo’s strength. Even if it’s not considered an expert among primary-level gods, it’s definitely not weak,” the divine-level Fire Kirin said at this moment.
“…” The corners of the Holy Kirin President’s mouth twitched, but suddenly, it remembered something and said, “What did you just say?”
“Iron-eating Beast Race??”
“President, you know??” Fire Kirin asked.
President Holy Kirin opened its mouth slightly and said, “I have some impression, but that’s impossible.”
“According to what I know, the Iron-eating Beast Race is a race on our mother planet, Blue Planet. On World King Planet, there’s only one person who has an Iron-eating Beast…”
“One of the geniuses brought over from Blue Planet in the Floating Realm, Shi Yu. But the problem is that the Iron-eating Beast is only one of its many pets. They’ve only been on World King Planet for a month. How can they defeat a divine-level expert above their level!!”
Most importantly… the only Wind Kirin was on Shi Yu! It was contracted by it!
The Holy Kirin President didn’t say anything.
As soon as the Holy Kirin President finished speaking, the Kirin Race present was stunned. Wait?
It wasn’t some cosmic race, but a hidden strong race… But… a race walked out of their origin mother planet, the Blue Planet that had been smashed and fallen to a low-level planet??
The races of the future would defeat the five god races of Blue Planet above their level?
President Holy Kirin couldn’t believe it either. It glanced at the unconscious Ice Kirin and directly contacted Lin Feng.
At this moment, Lin Feng, who was far away in the Heavenly Spirit World, received the call from the Kirin Race and immediately said happily, “Why, have you confirmed the evolution path of the Wind Kirin and the Wind of Blessing?”
President Holy Kirin said, “Old Lin, does Shi Yu have an Iron-eating Beast called Eleven?”
“Yeah, what’s wrong? Wait, aren’t you guys thinking about the Wind Kirin? Why are you mentioning the Iron-eating Beast?” Lin Feng was confused.
“Just now, Eleven defeated a junior god of the Ice Kirin Race above its level in the ranking battle of all races… What’s wrong with this kid!”
Lin Feng was stunned. “Huh?? What did you say???”
“Hahahahahahaha, I’m dying of laughter. Why is your race so unlucky? Look, I told you to drag out the return gift and not give it. You’ve suffered retribution, right! Hurry up and hand over the resources.”
President Holy Kirin: “?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1380 - 1380 The Cat is Back (1)
chapters.content:
1380 The Cat is Back (1)
In the central world, World King City, the headquarters of the Myriad Races Committee.
As another battle above its level succeeded, this place received the news immediately.
“Minister, a new challenger has succeeded above its level.”
In a luxurious office, a strange life form with a human body but a planet on its head looked at the person.
“Tell me about it,” the planet head said. Then, it turned to look at the documents on the table again.
The secretary said, “The challenger is from the Floating Realm. He logged into the Myriad Race Battlefield in the Blue Wave Realm. For the third time, he participated in the Myriad Race Ranking Battle and just completed the ranking.”
“It calls itself the king of the Iron-eating Beast Race, Eleven. In the first battle, it defeated the quasi-divine of the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race, ranked 9212. The second time, it defeated the quasi-divine of the Star Refining Race, ranked 202… This time, it defeated someone above its level. It’s the junior god of the Ice Kirin Race, ranked 1001,024!”
“Most importantly, Eleven is only four years old.”
The minister of the New Star Race Resources Management Department, Di Yin, didn’t react when he heard the pile of information in front.
In this position, he had received too much information about successful battles above his level. There were countless from large races and new top-notch divine races.
If he wanted him to take a look, this person who succeeded above its level definitely had to have something even more outstanding. For example, defeating a strong race in the top 10,000 above its level and not a weak race at the bottom.
Or age.
“Four years old?” Di Yin said.
“Do you have any information on the divine power value of that junior god?”
“About 40.”
Di Yin fell into deep thought. “Interesting, but we still need to observe more and activate the ‘New Star Plan’ on it. Encourage it and more Iron-eating Beasts to continue participating in the ranking battle of all races and even fight above its level.”
“We’ll arrange its opponent next.”
…
Blue Wave World.
Eleven and Buggy from the Blue Wave Branch of the Myriad Races Committee received a warm welcome. The Blue Wave Branch bore the consumption of Eleven’s battle and treated it to a big meal.
“Contestant Eleven, there’s news from the headquarters.” Director Sen excitedly found Eleven and Buggy, who were still eating and drinking.
“How much, how much?” Eleven looked up.
“Congratulations, the Iron-eating Beast Race has successfully leveled up. The initial ranking is out. It’s 11,111,111!”
“A total of six 1s. How auspicious,” Director Sen said.
However, as soon as it finished speaking, Eleven was like a bolt from the blue. The food in its hand fell with a look of disbelief.
What!!
It actually ranked in the 10 million?
Why was it so low?
Didn’t it successfully fight above its level?
Buggy: Leader is awesome~
“Was there a mistake?!” Eleven was unconvinced.
“Contestant Eleven, this initial ranking is already not low. You have to know that this doesn’t represent your personal racial strength, but the ‘average racial strength’ of the Iron-eating Beast Race. Although your personal racial strength can compete with the same level as the top 100 cosmic races, it can’t be helped that the other clansmen don’t have a participation record…”
“Under normal circumstances, if you want to have a good ranking in the ranking battle of all races, be it family or race, you have to have at least ‘5’ participating representatives.”
“In the ranking battle of all races, the number of participating races is calculated in the form of ‘hundreds of millions’. This ranking is really not low.”
Eleven was stunned and still a little sad.
10 million… 10 million… It had worked very hard to fight a Kirin above its level, not even caring about their friendship…
Director Sen was caught between laughter and tears. “But the problem isn’t very big. As long as you advance all the way to the divine level and all the way to the super divine level, even if you’re the only one from the Iron-eating Beast Race who can fight, you might be able to enter the top 10,000 or even the top 1,000 in the future…”
“Wuu!!” Eleven felt it was time to bring Blue Planet’s Iron-eating Beast over to play ranking together.
“Ji~” Buggy was amused. 10 million was so low. Although it didn’t participate, it should be considered a member of the Green Dragon Race. At the moment, the Green Dragon Race’s ranking was in the top 100.
Just like Susu, it didn’t participate in the competition at all. It was far ahead of Eleven and stood on the shoulders of its predecessor.
“The ranking isn’t the most important thing. Contestant Eleven, the headquarters has already confirmed to launch a new star race cultivation plan for the ‘Iron-eating Beast Race’. Next, as long as you continue to participate in the battle above your level and win, as long as the other Iron-eating Beast Races also participate in the ranking battle and obtain good results, they will constantly accumulate wealth in the Iron-eating Beast Cultivation Fund and can be used to withdraw money.”
“This is your greatest gain after working hard to win this victory.”
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven sighed and expressed that it wasn’t bad. This was also good. In the future, ranking was no longer a pure waste of food. There were still benefits!
Director Sen chuckled. As long as Eleven was happy. He was also quite happy. Unearthing a new star race wouldn’t be lacking in personal results. However, he looked at the messy table in silence. The two of them were too gluttonous, right? Why did he feel that they were even more gluttonous than divine-level beasts?
Damn, no wonder they were so strong!
…
“Yes, yes.” At home, Shi Yu listened to Eleven and Buggy’s report and nodded. “Not bad. Unfortunately…”
Unfortunately… battles above its level matched opponents from all over the world. Even if it encountered good skills, it couldn’t replicate them!
Letting Eleven pull customers was too slow.
Sigh.
“Then you can play by yourself next,” Shi Yu said. “In two months, we’re going to participate in the Four Saints Meeting. During this period, I’ll take care of Buggy, Chi Tong, and the three guys first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1381 - 1381 The Cat is Back (2)
chapters.content:
1381 The Cat is Back (2)
“Wu wu wu!” Eleven expressed its understanding. Shi Yu had helped it increase its points in the past half a month. It was time for the other teammates.
However, Eleven didn’t plan to continue fighting. It realized that it was still too difficult for it to fight a divine-level expert. It was very easy to fail. If it weren’t for the accelerated thinking and physical activation of the One Thought of God and Demon that happened to counter the restrictions of the Ice Kirin’s Frozen Divine Domain on reaction, body, and energy, it would be very dangerous.
Eleven’s goal in participating in the ranking battle of all races was to increase the ranking of the Iron-eating Beast Race, not defeat the enemy itself. Therefore, it suddenly had a bold idea.
The independence of the eight trigrams clone seemed to be very strong. Compared to the clones, bean soldiers, and the Nine Li Army, it was more like an independent individual. Therefore, it planned to find a day to try and see if it could jam a bug and let the eight clones disguise as Iron-eating Beast clansmen participate in the ranking competition and fight the ranking with it…
Eleven intended to plan this with Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others. It was afraid of being seen through if it planned it by itself.
If it could succeed, at that time, it wouldn’t have to carry everything of the Iron-eating Beast Race itself. It would just have to command its clone to fight and improve its ranking every day. When the Iron-eating Beast army on Blue Planet came, it could also throw it to its clone to train. Perfect!
“Shocking! The eight different armored Iron-eating Beasts that swept through the big races of the starry sky are actually the clones of the Panda King!” Just thinking about it made Eleven drool. It felt like it was the same thing as “Shocking! The powerful contestants in the top 10 of the God Sealing Battle are actually the contracted pets of the same person!”
It looked at Shi Yu and patted the Beast Tamer. As expected of them!
Shi Yu: “?”
…
On the day Eleven finished getting the ice cream, Shi Yu didn’t think too much about this, but Lin Feng still called personally.
“Shi Yu, I still underestimated you,” Lin Feng muttered after calling.
“Eleven actually fought its way to the Kirin Race’s house, and it’s a battle above its level.”
Damn, what was going on? At that time, he was at the legendary level. Many of his pets had to attack together to succeed.
“Ah…” Shi Yu immediately realized what it was.
“Thanks to the Environmental Protection Association, I obtained a lot of resources to strengthen my pets,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“…” The corners of Lin Feng’s mouth twitched. He had clearly been informed that Shi Yu had cultivated a cleansing star spirit and become the vice president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association. The Space Emperor expressed that he couldn’t lose his mind alone.
If it was said that, as a world overlord, the official status of the Space Emperor could still be compared to Shi Yu, then Lin Feng, an idler hanging in the Floating Realm, was clearly completely defeated by Shi Yu.
“Then do you still have any resources? We gave you so many resources. Don’t tell me you’ve spent them all??” Lin Feng asked.
Although it was satisfying to consume and strengthen in a short period of time, the cost-effective ratio of lengthening the timeline was higher!
“I still have some.”
Lin Feng was silent. Some?
“At the Four Saints Meeting, if nothing goes wrong, there will be a large number of transactions of faith items. At that time, you should exchange items and take what you need. If you want to nurture the Green Dragon in depth, you have to collect more faith items. It’s best to buy an era faith item to strengthen the Green Dragon. The power of faith on the faith items left from the last era is purer and contains extremely strong time power. It’s better for the enhancement effect of the Four Holy Beasts.”
“Don’t forget the Four Saints Meeting…”
“This… I’ll prepare it.” Shi Yu nodded. If he wanted resources, he would have to go. Although he still had some now, it would probably be gone soon.
He also planned to use the remaining pile of divine-level crystals in the past two months to strengthen his pets.
At that time, he would probably have to find another way to earn a living.
As for how to obtain a large number of faith items at the Four Holy Beast Meet, Shi Yu could only place his hopes on Baby Ginseng, hoping to sell its cultivation fruit and Reincarnation Fruit for a good price.
Well, there was also Susu’s inheritance water droplet. This was also a top-notch skill. It could even be taught law comprehension… Huh? Wait.
“Senior Lin Feng, since the Kirin Race is looking for you, don’t they really have anything to say about the Wind Blessing learning method I gave them? Are they not going to return the favor at all…” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say. Why didn’t these guys repay his kindness?
At the mention of this, Lin Feng also said helplessly, “They should still be researching. You know the difficulty of learning your Wind Blessing yourself… Now, their super divine ancestor brings a batch of geniuses to study it every day, but they haven’t succeeded.”
“If there are no results, I’m afraid it won’t show anything.”
Ah, this… Shi Yu muttered. If he had known earlier, he would have used it to sell and not give it away.
Speaking of which, could he use Susu’s inheritance water droplet to combine it with Ling’s Wind Blessing to create a Wind Blessing Teaching Crystal? This time, he had to completely win the Kirin Race.
“Senior Lin Feng, are you familiar with the Demon Race?” Shi Yu thought of something.
“What’s wrong? I’m pretty familiar with it,” Lin Feng said.
Shi Yu pondered.
Could it be that Senior Lin Feng still had a demon concubine?
Shi Yu remembered that when Senior Lin Feng was born, Dong Huang had already implemented monogamy.
It was fine if it was the Space Emperor. After all, he was born in ancient times and was an emperor. It was understandable for him to have many wives and concubines. Having more children was also to strengthen the royal family to resist external enemies, but for Lin Feng, it was obvious that Senior Divine Source’s ideological education didn’t pass.
“On Blue Planet, I obtained a divine stone that sealed the cubs of the Demon Race in the Mythical Era. The cubs of the Demon Race inside shouldn’t have hatched yet. Do you think the Demon Race will be interested? If you’re interested, you can let this little demon return to the race to avoid suffering on Blue Planet…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1382 The Cat is Back (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1382 The Cat is Back (3)
"If they don't want it, I can also raise it for them. As long as they give me alimony, I promise to nurture the little demons to a top-notch divine level, not inferior to that Iron-eating Beast."
Lin Feng: "…"
Lin Feng: "?"
This kid wanted to sell a demon cub, right?
This kid was extorting, right?
"The Demon Race will definitely be interested. Do you have the divine stone with you?"
"No, it's still on Blue Planet. Senior Lin Feng, you can send someone to call a demigod named Teacher Ying from Blue Planet's Dong Huang to World King Planet. All my assets on Blue Planet are saved with her. Tell her to bring all the resources over."
"I've already established myself on the World King Planet and joined the World King Planet's large faction. My status is enough to be compared to Senior Space Emperor and Senior Lin Feng. In this way, she dares to come over."
Lin Feng: "?"
Why did he bring him along? Also, why did he feel that this kid was tricking that Teacher Ying?
His status was high, but it was clearly still "in the cub state". His own hard strength wasn't enough to support it.
Lin Feng said, "Alright, I'll get Qi Mu to return to Blue Planet when I'm free."
Next, Shi Yu and Lin Feng chatted for a while before ending the call. At this moment, Shi Yu had already started to think of a way to get money. He felt that the most important thing now was to trick Teacher Cat over.
Teacher Cat's Wish Divine Skill was still awesome and exciting. He had investigated. It seemed to be the intrinsic skill of a Starry Sky Race, the Star Prayer Race. It was very ferocious. The origin of the extraterrestrial gem that Teacher Cat picked up might not be simple.
He could even make a wish for a resource like the Teleportation Key Stone. With her as the cat military advisor beside him, he might be able to earn money faster.
…
Next, Shi Yu counted the more than 100 divine-level crystals in his hand. He already planned to consume them all in two months.
He formulated a points plan for himself.
Firstly, the Star Sea Contract and origin fluctuations, the Life Divine Body, and the Wood Control had to be added first. These skills were all related to earning money. With the enhancement effect, it could also increase the efficiency of adding points. It was the foundation.
Baby Ginseng's Reincarnation Fruit, Cultivation Fruit, and Susu's inheritance water droplet were the key to earning money next. They had to be maxed out. They were the results of the foundation.
Apart from that, Buggy's Green Dragon Indestructible Body, Creation Domain, Dragon Star Group, Chi Tong's Vermillion Bird clone, and the Four Holy Transformations of Little Quas, Turtle, and Shorty also needed to be completed in two months. There would be many activities of the Four Holy Evolvers in the Four Saints Meeting, so it was never a bad thing to let their faith skills be stronger.
Finally, there was the Wind Control, Wind Spirit Bead, Turning Misfortune into Luck, and the Mechanical Spirit that Ling had already advanced to a quasi-divine skill. These four skills also had to be maxed out, deciding if it could successfully learn the Starry Sky Storm next.
These skills were all added points that Shi Yu planned to complete in the next two months. The workload was very, very huge. After all, it involved several top-notch divine skills and high-level divine skills. It was very difficult to add points to these skills. Therefore, Shi Yu felt that the funds Blue Planet and the Space Emperor had given him would be exhausted immediately.
However, all of this was worth it. As long as he endured these two months and added the skills of his pets, with the resources brought by their skills, Shi Yu's funds could be circulated. Although he couldn't add points as fiercely as now, as long as he obtained some investment from various places to maintain his daily livelihood, it shouldn't be a problem…
"Add more points!"
That day, Shi Yu began to cruelly continue to add points. Coupled with the charming cultivation fruit, he ate, slept, and added points after sleeping… During this period, apart from the skill proficiency of the pets, Shi Yu's own Space Strengthening talent and Time Strengthening talent were also quickly leveling up.
Although Shi Yu didn't want to stir up any era ruins, in order to not cause any accidents, he still worked hard to increase the level of his Passage of Time.
…
Blue Planet…
Phoenix Man was entrusted by Lin Feng to spend another cosmic crystal to come to Dong Huang. He planned to bring back a batch of information first and invite a native of Blue Planet to the World King Planet.
Ancient Capital University.
"Excuse me, is Teacher Ying around?" The Phoenix man descended into Ancient Capital University and used telepathy to cover the entire school. He sent a voice transmission to life forms above the totem level.
A moment later, a slightly lazy cat girl in a cheongsam appeared and looked at the familiar Phoenix man.
"Eh, it's you. The one who was defeated by Shi Yu."
The Phoenix Man: "?"
What was this cat saying?
"Teacher Ying, right? Well, Shi Yu asked me to come over. He's doing very well on World King Planet and joined a large organization. His status is already comparable to the Space Emperor, and his future is limitless. He wants to invite you to World King Planet to plot with him. Then, he wants you to bring all the resources and move…"
Gem Cat: Alert.jpg
Who was this kid kidding? He had only left for two months, how could he be comparable to the Space Emperor who had defeated a super divine above his level?
Although Shi Yu was indeed very monstrous, this speed was clearly even more unscientific. She didn't believe it.
"Do you believe it yourself??" the gem cat asked.
"I…" The Phoenix man was immediately stunned. Lord Lin Feng had told him this. He didn't want to believe it either, but…
"No, no," the gem cat said.
"Really! Shi Yu said that with his current status, when you reach there, not only can you eat well, your level can also quickly reach the divine level."
"In fact, even if it's a super divine level and a cosmic emperor, it's not impossible to look forward to it." This was added by Phoenix Man himself to complete the mission.
"I won't go even if it's real. Only a fool would believe you." The gem cat girl was extremely Buddhist. Now, she was the strongest on Blue Planet. Was she so free that she would go to World King Planet to find trouble?
The next day, the gem cat packed its assets and stepped onto the teleportation to World King Planet with the cosmic crystal sent by Phoenix Man. Its goal was super divine level!

chapters.title: Chapter 1383 As Long As the Starry Sky Storm Has Hands (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1383 As Long As the Starry Sky Storm Has Hands (1)
Blue Wave City, environmental area, mystic realm villa, beside the Cleansing Lake.
Eleven was training the eight trigrams clone.
Qian, Kun, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Li, Gen, and Dui's eight clones. Each clone contained different powers.
Eleven had yet to completely master their abilities.
The eight trigrams clone was very magical, but the main body couldn't master the ability mastered by the clone.
Unlike the Bean Bears, whose abilities were all inherited from Eleven, their clones had left Eleven and had abilities that even their main bodies didn't have.
Although it was still led by Eleven's consciousness, it was equivalent to Eleven having to redevelop many new abilities. It was very troublesome.
Perhaps, when the proficiency of this skill was high, many abilities could really be fused into the main body.
Shi Yu said that in the cosmic view: Qian was the sky, Kun was the ground, Zhen was thunder, Xun was wind, Kanw as water, Li was fire, Gen was the mountain, and Dui was the lake.
However, in terms of body, Qian was the head. Kun was the abdomen, Zhen was the feet, Kan was the ear, Li was the eye, Gen was the hand, and Dui was the mouth. Therefore, Eleven believed that when the eight trigrams clone was trained to a high level, it could fuse the eight trigrams clone itself.
"Wuu!" Under Eleven's reprimand, the eight clones endured the pressure with sweat all over their faces.
Buggy was basking in the sun on the pavilion, watching its clone suffer and refining the Dragon Ball daily.
Baby Ginseng, on the other hand, was constantly creating Cultivation Fruits and Reincarnation Fruits, preparing to sell them.
Susu was still cleansing sources of pollution and worked hard to earn money.
As for Chi Tong, Little Ji, and Duckie, they held the inheritance water droplet created by Susu and inputted their experience in "death power", "destruction power", and "abyss power" respectively. It was equivalent to recording Internet lessons.
These… were also to be sold.
However, although the memory water droplet had been upgraded to the inheritance water droplet, because the power of laws was more profound, even if someone used it, he couldn't inherit 100% of the EXP. Considering the level of the inheritance water droplet and the incomplete prototype power of laws EXP of Chi Tong and the others, if he wanted to learn it, he probably had to rely on talent and comprehension. It would be a blessing to have a 5% chance.
But even so, Shi Yu still felt that it could be sold for a good price. After all, powers like the Death Destruction Abyss were rare and powerful. Even a 1% chance was enough for many divine-levels to take a gamble.
Qi and Little Zi, who were bored and had nothing to do, were naturally called by Shi Yu to train Little Quas, Turtle, and Shorty. Under the occasional additional points of unassisted super skills, the level of the baby team's will steadily increase. It was already close to the overlord's will. Perhaps in a few days, it could become a little overlord.
"Wu." After a long time, Shi Yu woke up from his sleep. He first tested his strength progress. Through this sleep, his Space Strengthening talent had finally been developed to level nine. His Time Strengthening talent had also been developed to Level 7. It was really not easy.
As expected of him, he still slept so hard.
"Is Ling around? Ling, this is the last time to add points." After waking up, Shi Yu called out to Ling.
"I'm here!" Ling, who was hiding in its territory and researching, immediately came over when it received Shi Yu's call with slight anticipation.
A month passed.
Baby Ginseng's Wood Control, Life Divine Body, World Tree Fruit, and Susu's origin fluctuations took more than half a month to increase to the stage (expert+11), which was the perfect state of a quasi-divine skill. If it took another step, it could be upgraded to a divine skill.
With the support of these functional divine skills, Shi Yu's efficiency in adding points increased again. Ling's few skills were also efficiently strengthened.
< Name > Ling
[Race Skill]
[Quasi-Divine Level]: Wind Blessing (expert+11), Mechanical Spirit (expert+11), Wind Control (expert+10), Turning Misfortune into Luck (expert+11), Wind Spirit Bead (expert+11)
[Taught Skill]
[Super level]: Mythical Revival (transcendent), Nine-Colored Divine Light (transcendent)
It had almost reached a very peak state, with four quasi-divine skills perfected!
However, although it looked powerful, Shi Yu knew that although Ling's results in the God Sealing Battle in this state wouldn't be bad, it was impossible for it to be at the top or even the top 100.
He still lacked an absolute trump card.
As long as he had that, Ling would have the capital to compete for the top 10.
This skill was naturally one of the cosmic disasters, the Starry Sky Storm.
Even in the entire World King Planet, there weren't many super disaster skills mastered at the divine level.
After coming to the Blue Wave World for nearly two months, Ling was finally fully prepared to try learning the Starry Sky Storm.
Shi Yu completed the last additional point for Ling. After adding Wind Control to (expert+11), Ling was eager to give it a try. It had long self-studied all the information about the Starry Sky Storm in the Blue Wave Disaster Research Institute.
At the same time, it also observed the cosmic storm simulated by this disaster research institute several times.
Even the simulated Starry Sky Storm's power was comparable to a divine-level attack.
Therefore, it would also be very dangerous for Ling to come into contact with this. However, it was precisely because of this that they made so many preparations. Their goal was to be able to find the pattern of the operation of the Starry Sky Storm to dodge the damage and absorb power to complete their learning.
"I hope Lady Luck will stand on our side and let you succeed in one go," Shi Yu said.
"Then let's go~!" Ling said.
"There's no hurry. There's still a key support that hasn't arrived," Shi Yu said. Soon, a familiar figure arrived outside the villa garden.
"The place you live in is pretty luxurious!!!" The gem cat girl looked here and was furious.

chapters.title: Chapter 1384 As Long As the Starry Sky Storm Has Hands (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1384 As Long As the Starry Sky Storm Has Hands (2)
After Shi Yu tricked her into coming to the World King Planet, she arrived at the Floating Realm and realized that she couldn't find Shi Yu at all.
With the help of Senior Dragon God, after she contacted Shi Yu, not only did Shi Yu not bring her to eat and drink well, but he also directly threw her into the Floating City and let her adapt to the environment of the World King Planet first.
When he was done, he would call her…
Although the environment of the World King Planet was indeed beyond the gem cat's expectations, and she liked it very much, the power of the starry sky was so rich that her Wish Divine Skill improved at lightning speed. She felt that it wasn't difficult to really reach the divine level, she still felt that she had been deceived by Shi Yu.
Fortunately, a month later, Shi Yu finally called her over.
"Are you done?" The gem cat acted as if it had returned to its home. After arriving at the villa, it leisurely took the coconut Shi Yu picked from the coconut tree beside the Lake of Purification and drank the coconut juice.
"Wuuu!!"
Seeing that Teacher Cat had come, Eleven and the others stopped what they were doing and came to welcome him with happy expressions.
Teacher Cat was here too!
"I'm half done!" Shi Yu smiled and said, "As I miss Teacher Ying too much, I called you over in advance. I got Baby Ginseng to prepare a big meal for you. The fruits it creates now are very delicious."
"You still have a conscience!" the gem cat girl said.
Ling understood. Shi Yu wanted to call Teacher Ying over and make a wish that it could successfully learn the Starry Sky Storm and increase its safety. The poor Teacher Ying still didn't know why she had been called over…
She could already imagine Teacher Ying's expression after knowing the truth.
…
"I'm so full!!!" After a beautiful meal, the gem cat girl rubbed her stomach and said with a satisfied expression, "If there's such food every day, I didn't come for nothing."
"Erm, Teacher Ying…" Shi Yu said, "Do me a favor…"
The gem cat girl looked at Shi Yu and Ling's sincere expressions, and a huge question mark appeared on her head.
The Gem Cat: "?"
"What!!"
"Help me make a wish," Shi Yu said with a chuckle.
The corners of the gem cat's mouth twitched. "Alright, alright, alright. I knew you definitely had a pit waiting for me. Tell me, as long as it's within my ability."
Teacher Ying's Wish Divine Skill consumed energy according to the difficulty of the wish.
The more ridiculous the wish, the greater the consumption.
For example, obtaining a beautiful little dress might not consume much energy for her.
But if she made a wish to revive a Beast Tamer who had just died, the consumption might be very huge.
Of course, if it was too big and exceeded the limit of the body's endurance, the wish would malfunction and the body wouldn't be injured.
Perhaps in the future, the Wish Divine Skill could reach the level of making a wish at the cost of death, but now, Teacher Cat had yet to master it.
In addition, there was an interesting mechanism. Although the wish was very ridiculous, if one was very lucky and was very close to this wish, it wouldn't consume much energy.
For example, if one made a wish and picked up a super divine level resource, if in reality, there were super divine level resources not far away and very close, the consumption would be much lower. However, if one didn't have super divine level resources beside them and forcefully made a wish, the success rate would be slim.
Therefore, the combination of the Wish Divine Skill and the Luck Divine Skill would be a very perfect combination skill.
However, luck was impossible to measure in the absence of Ling. Therefore, unless it daydreamed and drank fake wine, the gem cat basically had relatively normal wishes. This way, it wouldn't enter any terrifying enfeeble state.
"It's a small matter," Shi Yu said. "It's just that Ling is going to take a look at the Starry Sky Storm later. Just make a wish that it doesn't encounter danger."
Gem Cat: "?"
"It's a simulation, an artificial simulation, not the one that killed the Kirin Race envoy."
"I plan to let it enter the Starry Sky Storm to experience the Starry Sky Storm and learn it. Please make another wish for it to successfully learn it."
The Gem Cat: "?"
"I, is this something that ordinary Beast Tamers and ordinary pets can do?!" The gem cat said angrily, "Don't think I don't know what the Starry Sky Storm is. A cosmic disaster that top-notch gods are afraid of!!"
"It's not that I can't help you, but can you not do dangerous things and place your hopes on me… The pressure is very high, alright!"
Shi Yu said, "Don't worry, I'm not counting on you. I just think that having another layer of insurance is better than nothing. We've already done enough preparations."
The Gem Cat: "?"
Damn it, that was even more ridiculous!
…
Blue Wave City, Space Disaster Research Institute.
Shi Yu had informed Dr. Lei Nuo in advance of his arrival.
In the research institute, Dr. Lei Nuo and his granddaughter, Ling's assistant, Jin, immediately welcomed Shi Yu personally.
After all, Shi Yu was a rare guest. It was so rare that, apart from the first time he came with the Space Emperor, Ling came over to learn the rest of the time.
This made Dr. Lei Nuo extremely puzzled. Did Shi Yu really have a dream?
"Mr. Shi Yu?" Jin stood beside Dr. Lei Nuo and greeted Shi Yu softly. This was the first time she had seen Dr. Ling's mechanic. She observed Shi Yu carefully, wanting to see what was different about Shi Yu from other mechanics to be able to nurture a perfect researcher like Dr. Ling.
"Hello." Shi Yu smiled and said to Dr. Lei Nuo, "Dr. Lei Nuo, I came this time to use the 'Starry Sky Storm Simulation Space'."

chapters.title: Chapter 1385 As Long As the Starry Sky Storm Has Hands (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1385 As Long As the Starry Sky Storm Has Hands (3)
Dr. Lei Nuo smiled and said, "No problem, but it shouldn't be that simple, right?"
The simulation of the Starry Sky Storm was extremely dangerous, but Ling had also seen it a few times. It was always he who brought Ling to observe. This time, Shi Yu suddenly came over. He felt that it shouldn't be as simple as just watching the Starry Sky Storm again.
"Well… I plan to let Ling enter the Starry Sky Storm and personally experience the power of the Starry Sky Storm," Shi Yu said.
"Oh, so it's like… Pfft!!!" Dr. Lei Nuo widened his eyes.
Jin, who was beside him, also widened her eyes.
"What?" the two of them said in unison.
Shi Yu smiled and said, "I'll also go in with Ling…"
"Dr. Lei Nuo, don't worry. It'll be fine. Ling's learning of the theory of the Starry Sky Storm has already reached the extreme. If there's no practice, it's very difficult to improve anymore."
"So this is your plan…" After pondering for a moment, Dr. Lei Nuo hesitated and said, "Alright, since Ling has analyzed it itself and there's no problem, I'll open it to you. However, although it's only a simulated cosmic storm, it's also extremely dangerous. It's not something ordinary demigods can withstand. You have to think about the risks."
Shi Yu said, "Yes."
"It's only been two months, and you're actually going to try…" Dr. Lei Nuo shook his head.
Young people were really impatient.
After confirming the plan, Dr. Lei Nuo brought Shi Yu and the others outside the alternate space that simulated the cosmic storm.
It was very technological. In the hall with a screen filled with flashing data, a teleportation door that connected to another space was established.
The other space of the door was the simulation area of the Starry Sky Storm.
"Mr. Shi Yu, Dr. Ling, do you really want to try…" Jin said, "In the Blue Wave Research Institute, trying to come into contact with the Starry Sky Storm… Among the researchers, only Grandpa can maintain a 100% success rate. The best outcome for the other researchers who tried is to return with serious injuries."
"You're only at the demigod level. Perhaps it'll be safer if you go to the divine level."
"It's already been decided," Shi Yu said. "Ling has already made sufficient preparations for this day."
"Forget it, let them go. I can understand the feeling that this kind of research progress is at a bottleneck and needs to be broken through with practice." Dr. Lei Nuo kept setting the parameters and said, "Ling's research on the Starry Sky Storm has indeed exceeded this research institute. With me controlling all the researchers except me, there won't be any danger."
"Only through practice can there be improvements."
As he spoke, on the huge screen of the control room, in the scene connected to another space, a white wind ball had already slowly condensed at one end. That was the prototype of the Starry Sky Storm, the young body of the Starry Sky Storm that hadn't been infected by the power of the stars!
"Shi Yu, after you enter, I'll let the Starry Sky Storm grow. Be prepared. In 10 minutes, you'll meet and continue to collide. If you can pass through the Starry Sky Storm in the end, your level will be considered to have graduated."
"Even if you join the various cosmic fleets, you can obtain a 'navigator' position," Dr. Lei Nuo said.
"Alright." Shi Yu took a deep breath.
This was basically simulating the situation after encountering a cosmic storm in the starry sky!
It was also the qualification test for researchers who studied the Starry Sky Storm. Only by being able to encounter the Starry Sky Storm and successfully dodge the core disaster could they graduate!
After confirming it, Shi Yu and Ling directly entered the simulation space.
Under the gaze of Dr. Lei Nuo and Jin, Shi Yu, and Ling arrived at the safe area. At this moment, Ling had already changed into a new form, a small silver-white cosmic battleship!!
This was the final form after Ling modified itself into a cosmic life form, and it was the most suitable form to sail in the universe.
The current appearance of this battleship, together with the main body of the mechanical spirit inside, was all Ling had.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already disappeared and entered the battleship. He fused with Ling and became the pilot.
"Grandpa, be careful. If there's danger, save them in time."
"I understand. I'm not blind from old age." Dr. Lei Nuo looked at the screen and said, "Jin, watch carefully. Watch how they sail normally when they encounter a cosmic storm."
"It shouldn't be a problem for this Ling to successfully avoid the danger of the Starry Sky Storm. Otherwise, I wouldn't be at ease letting them use the simulation space. Study well…"
"Yes…"
As the two of them conversed, in the simulation space, the Starry Sky Storm was growing quickly. The originally white eye of the storm began to be dyed in various colors such as red, green, blue, and yellow. The interior was no longer purely gas flow, but a form change produced by the interweaving of the Starry Sky energy.
Air, electricity, heat, light… The moving and chaotic starry sky energy storm made the storm produced in the area where the vortex gas interacted with the starry sky radiation look very much like a surging sea, moving violently in a direction.
The vast cosmic storm contained shocking power. When it encountered a planet, it was enough to instantly completely destroy the natural environment and civilization facilities inside. The level of disaster far exceeded the local earthquake, the local typhoon, and even the descent of a meteorite.
In the universe, such a disaster was undoubtedly the scythe of the Death God. However, when Shi Yu rode the cosmic battleship and was ready, he still bravely walked forward and chose to fight the simulated cosmic storm head-on.

chapters.title: Chapter 1386 As Long As the Starry Sky Storm Has Hands (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1386 As Long As the Starry Sky Storm Has Hands (4)
In the scene outside, the small silver-white battleship was getting closer and closer to the Starry Sky Storm. Dr. Lei Nuo and Jin couldn't take their eyes off it. Dr. Lei Nuo said, "Very good! The position you entered was chosen very well. As expected of Ling. Although the power of the storm in this position isn't the weakest, it has the least impact on them."
Boom!
Shi Yu and Ling plunged into the cosmic storm. In an instant, Ling felt that its life form was greatly affected. The entire battleship began to sway. It instantly lost its vision and direction, and its state weakened by 30%.
"Cough." Upon encountering the cosmic storm, Shi Yu also instantly felt dizzy. He felt that it was even more disgusting than teleporting to the World King Planet. This was even the result of Ling perfectly resisting the first wave of impact.
"Ling, how's the situation?"
"It's recovering various functions. It's currently in a controllable range," Ling said.
The outside relied on the "Turning Misfortune into Luck" to absorb the power of the Starry Sky Storm as a defense. Then, it injected energy into the "Wind Spirit Bead" inside to deconstruct and analyze the power of the Starry Sky Storm. In the end, it activated the power of the World Tree Fruit to increase enhancement comprehension and relied on high-level calculations and deduction rules to practice repeatedly. This was the method Shi Yu deduced for Ling to learn the Starry Sky Storm through the skill Index.
Because it was distracted from learning the Starry Sky Storm, Ling couldn't spare too much energy to resist the Starry Sky Storm and control its body. It could only follow the waves. Of course, although it could be said to be following the waves, it didn't completely give up resisting.
"The storm form has changed!" Under Dr. Lei Nuo and Jin's observation, Shi Yu and the others had only entered the storm for a few seconds before the storm's form changed. This required Shi Yu and the others to immediately find a new strategy to deal with it and change their route. Otherwise, it was very likely that they would be swept into the core of the storm and encounter an even stronger conflict.
"Watch how they deal with it carefully!" Dr. Lei Nuo instructed his granddaughter.
However, a scene that made Dr. Lei Nuo's balls hurt appeared. In the face of the sudden change in the form of the storm, the battleship Shi Yu rode responded to the changes with immutability. It didn't move at all. The chaotic storm seemed to have brushed past him. He dodged the battleship and let the battleship perfectly dodge the impact in the gap.
Jin: "No positioning… is the best positioning??"
Dr. Lei Nuo was silent. He thought of something and said, "Nonsense! In the future, if you encounter such a situation, you mustn't pilot a battleship like this. The mortality rate is definitely 99%!! I forgot that Dr. Ling has the Luck Divine Skill. This… is this alright?"
He relied on luck to let the strong impact area of the Starry Sky Storm circle around him!!
"Again!" Jin suddenly said, "Two storms fused…"
The cosmic storm was unpredictable, and one had to be careful at all times. Seeing this, Dr. Lei Nuo said, "This situation is the most difficult to deal with. If one doesn't have rich driving experience and a powerful foundation, they will definitely be heavily injured…"
Just as he finished speaking, the fused strong storm impact once again circled around Ling, who was learning to comprehend the cosmic storm as it drove.
Dr. Lei Nuo: "?"
Jin: "Wow, Old Master, I want to learn this!"
He felt that driving a battleship through a cosmic storm like this was good as long as he had hands.
"I can't learn it!!!"
In the environmental area, in the mystic realm villa, the gem cat girl lay on the sofa weakly. "I'll make a wish…"
In fact, it was just that ridiculous. Shi Yu and Ling relied on various unscientific methods to fight for the best and most comfortable learning space. In this model, they drove for three minutes but still didn't encounter any danger.
Of course, if it really encountered danger that couldn't be avoided with luck, Ling would also quickly react. Its computing ability could calculate what was real danger and what looked dangerous. However, if it dealt with the Starry Sky Storm with all its might, there wouldn't be such a perfect learning environment as today.
Letting oneself learn in the cosmic storm was undoubtedly the boldest but most efficient learning experience.
"The mysteries of the Starry Sky Storm are quite deep," Ling said. "Master, the simulated Starry Sky Storm should still be inferior to the real starry sky. It's not easy to see through the origin when comprehending it…"
Shi Yu's scalp went numb. "Speak in human language!"
He was under a lot of pressure now, alright? In order to let Ling study in peace, he was the one piloting the battleship now!
Shi Yu sat in the driver's seat and looked at the blurry storm area in his vision. He sighed.
Of course, today, Shi Yu also learned a very profound experience of piloting a battleship through the cosmic storm from Ling through the memory water droplet. Although he was facing ten thousand changes by remaining unchanged, he still needed to do some operations.
It consumed energy.
"It's a little difficult to learn human language. It still requires time," Ling said. "But according to the deduction results, the success rate is as high as 95%."
"As expected of the learning method deduced by Master."
Shi Yu said, "Don't be distracted. Learn well."
Ling said, "You made a mistake just now. I'll save it."
Shi Yu was speechless.
Time passed minute by minute.
Dr. Lei Nuo saw it. It was the most ridiculous way to face the cosmic storm in history. It was to sail in a straight line! He would bet that he wouldn't encounter the most dangerous area head-on! Wasn't this a living gambler?
It really relied on its luck to do whatever it wanted.
He looked at his adoring granddaughter and felt that something was wrong.
This wasn't a proper driving guide.
"The most dangerous is here!" Suddenly, Dr. Lei Nuo looked at the screen again. According to the simulation results, the Starry Sky Storm encountered a star. Under the influence of the star, it was divided into many solar storms. The violent Starry Sky Storm upgraded again. A strong storm wave swept out and covered the entire area!
"This time, they can't rely on luck. On such a scale, even in the area with the weakest energy, they have to deal with it with all their might at the demigod level. It's already at the stage of testing the defense facilities and will."
"If I pass this, their level will be close to mine…"
After Dr. Lei Nuo finished speaking, he was stunned.
Jin was also stunned.
This was because the cosmic storm that should have gone berserk directly opened a huge hole, like a king sending them off respectfully, creating an extremely safe passage for Shi Yu's battleship to pass through.
"This!!" Dr. Lei Nuo was stunned.
Jin said in a daze, "Grandpa, what did you just say…"
"Impossible, definitely impossible!!!" Dr. Lei Nuo said in shock, "Heavens, they control the Starry Sky Storm?!!"
"How is this possible? This doesn't make sense!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1387 Lucky Cat (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1387 Lucky Cat (1)
If it was said that luck could still be explained by Shi Yu and the others dodging the storm disaster area previously, then now, luck could no longer explain it.
The Starry Sky Storm opened a huge hole and sent the people who accidentally entered away. Wasn't this nonsense?
In fact, this wasn't the first time Dr. Lei Nuo had seen this situation. When he had studied in other realms, he had also seen a big shot complete such a magnificent feat.
In the simulated high-intensity starry sky storm environment, like the Lord of the Storm, it controlled the starry sky storm to avoid damage.
The reason why he could do it was because that doctor had mastered the Starry Sky Storm skill himself. He could already turn a cosmic disaster into an ability.
And now, Dr. Lei Nuo was certain that Ling and Shi Yu in front of him seemed to have done the same thing…
"Dr. Lei Nuo, thank you." After Ling came out of the simulation space, Shi Yu also came out of the battleship with a light. Then, he thanked Dr. Lei Nuo.
Shi Yu was very happy now. Ling had indeed learned the Starry Sky Storm. Be it luck, power of faith, or the powerful teaching method of the skill Index, in short, he hadn't prepared for the past two months for nothing!
This was a powerful disaster skill that could be used at the demigod level to attack divine-levels. From today onwards, Ling could be considered to have completely taken off.
"You… You guys…" At this moment, Dr. Lei Nuo looked at Shi Yu and Ling who came out in silence. Jin had already swallowed her saliva crazily.
"You guys really mastered the Starry Sky Storm?!" Dr. Lei Nuo still couldn't believe it. After all, even he had yet to comprehend the true meaning of the Starry Sky Storm.
"Sort of, but it's not completely mastered. After all, it's only a simulated storm that I've comprehended. It's still at the entry stage. I still have to continue learning. Perhaps when I see the real Starry Sky Storm, Ling can completely control this disaster."
Ling said, "Master is right, but this is still a very good start."
Putting everything else aside, at least he could increase the level of the Starry Sky Storm by adding points…
"I, this… You… This…" Dr. Lei Nuo was incoherent. Didn't they agree to only enter the simulation space and come into contact with the Starry Sky Storm? Why did he suddenly master it!!
He had a heart attack. He had transmigrated to simulate storms so many times, but he had yet to master it!!
Was this a genius? So he had completely underestimated Shi Yu and Ling previously? Wang Kong, what kind of monster had he brought?
Not only him, but the Space Disaster Research Institutes everywhere would probably be stunned. Another disaster mechanic was born!
"How exactly did you guys do it…" Dr. Lei Nuo raised his hands shakily with a yearning expression.
At the side, Dr. Lei Nuo's granddaughter panicked.
Wait, Grandpa, I should be Dr. Ling's student. Go away!
"My method… is only suitable for my own race, but I can share some superficial experience," Ling said.
"Enough, enough. Thank you, Dr. Ling," Lei Nuo said excitedly. Then, he still looked at Shi Yu and Ling in disbelief.
"Aren't you excited? Do you know what this means?"
Shi Yu was stunned. "Of course I'm excited. Didn't you previously say that mastering a 'disaster' can obtain an extremely high status even in the headquarters of the Disaster Research Institute?"
"That's right!!!"
Dr. Lei Nuo laughed crazily and said, "You have to know that there are very few researchers who really master disasters in the disaster research institute. Hahahaha, Brother Shi Yu, Sister Ling, tell me, I haven't mistreated you these two months, right?"
Shi Yu and Ling suddenly felt their seniority increase. They had once again upgraded to the level of the Space Emperor.
"Well, it's all thanks to Dr. Lei Nuo's teaching that Ling and I were able to learn the Starry Sky Storm so quickly," Shi Yu said. Apart from adding points, the knowledge theories Ling had learned in the research institute were also especially important.
"Then why don't you guys be deputy directors of the Blue Wave Disaster Research Institute!"
"Next, I'll recommend you to the headquarters. If nothing goes wrong, you'll be able to obtain a large amount of research funding. These research funds will be divided into individuals and groups. If you join a certain research institute, you can apply for more research funds. Of course, I don't want this money at all. I just want a name," Dr. Lei Nuo rubbed his hands and discussed.
"Ling, just be a deputy director. After I retire, the Blue Wave Research Institute will be yours. Next, you can decide where the research funds of the Blue Wave Research Institute are arranged every year."
The construction of the disaster research institutes in the various first-level domains had been heavily invested. They were personally managed by the headquarters and didn't belong to individuals. The fortification was a rotation system, and the capable should occupy it. Therefore, Dr. Lei Nuo said that as long as he held a position, the future Blue Wave Research Institute would belong to Ling. It was completely possible.
Shi Yu and Ling fell into deep thought. Alright, this day had indeed come again. Apart from the Environmental Protection Association, it was the second official position.
"Dr. Lei Nuo, you're too polite…" Shi Yu said, "We'll listen to your arrangements, but… if there are new funds, is there a chance to upgrade the facilities that simulate other cosmic disasters to the level of the Starry Sky Storm? "
Dr. Lei Nuo said, "Completely. You still don't understand the status of mastering the cosmic disaster skill at the disaster research institute. Let me put it this way. As long as you reach a top-notch god and can perfectly control the disaster skill, you will have the support of a certain faction. You even have the qualifications to compete for the position of chief researcher of the research institute headquarters."

chapters.title: Chapter 1388 Lucky Cat (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1388 Lucky Cat (2)
"If you reach the super divine level, as long as the previous chief retires and dies without any competitors of the same level, the next chief will be you. This is already a position that stands at the peak of the World King Planet."
Shi Yu gulped. That was indeed what Dr. Lei Nuo had said the last time. However, this was still too far away. Now, he only wanted to flirt with the other doctors who had mastered disasters in the research institute and replicate other disaster skills…
Don't worry, it was fine as long as he obtained the prerequisite for the upper domain.
"Well… Can you demonstrate the Starry Sky Storm skill once?" Dr. Lei Nuo said. "I want to see what the effect will be when I use it outside."
"No problem." Shi Yu nodded.
The wind of the Starry Sky Storm wasn't the wind in the traditional meaning of Blue Planet, but the cosmic wind produced by the special force fields between the various planets. The entire Starry Sky Storm skill was like an upgraded Wind Spirit Bead.
Not only could it absorb various cosmic powers to perfect the storm, but it could also borrow various cosmic powers to expand the range of the disaster, like the power of nature.
Boom.
In an experimental building, looking at the divine-level venue ravaged by the Starry Sky Storm, Dr. Lei Nuo and Jin swallowed their saliva. They felt that if junior gods encountered it, they would be heavily injured.
After Ling finished experimenting with Dr. Lei Nuo, Dr. Lei Nuo was extremely happy. "This is it."
"In the next period of time, Shi Yu, Ling, use the facilities of the Blue Wave Research Institute to complete a specific research result report paper. This will be the key to your advancement. I'll directly recommend the paper to the headquarters. If everything goes smoothly, you can quickly become cosmic disaster doctors certified by the Disaster Research Institute."
"We disaster researchers are different from other professions. Our goal is to study disasters thoroughly and increase the survival rate of people after encountering disasters in the universe. It's a great cause to benefit the entire universe. Therefore, mastering the Starry Sky Storm isn't the key. The key is how to use this talent to benefit the World King Planet. Therefore, the next thesis will mainly involve your understanding of this."
"Be it military or interstellar travel, it's fine."
"Since you've already mastered the Starry Sky Storm, your understanding in this aspect definitely far exceeds that of ordinary people. There's no problem."
"Alright," Shi Yu said with a nod.
It was indeed different from other professions. For example, the Environmental Protection Association directly tested one's cleansing ability. As for the Disaster Research Institute, the greater value derived from one's personal ability seemed to be the most important.
He still had to write a thesis…
Sigh, that made sense. If everyone knew how to deal with the cosmic storm, then the unlucky Kirin Race that ran to Blue Planet to deliver the message wouldn't have to die.
It was too unfair to die in a traffic accident.
"Then, Dr. Lei Nuo, we're a little tired today. We'll go back first. After resting, we'll start work." Shi Yu suddenly had a headache. He was too tired from piloting the battleship just now.
Ling used a Starry Sky Storm and consumed a lot of energy.
"Then go quickly and rest well," Dr. Lei Nuo said.
After Shi Yu and the others left, Dr. Lei Nuo suddenly recalled something and thought of a bad thing.
"Grandpa, what's wrong? Are you unhappy??" Jin looked at her grandfather and asked.
"It's nothing…" Dr. Lei Nuo suddenly recalled that Old Wang seemed to have told him that Shi Yu was also a three-star purifier, the vice president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association!
Although the Space Emperor didn't say directly why he became a three-star purifier and the vice president, Dr. Lei Nuo kept feeling that something was wrong.
This shouldn't be considered snatching people from the Environmental Protection Association, right? No, definitely not. With such good research and learning ability, it was obvious that his future as a researcher was greater.
"I have to prepare some gifts. I wonder if Shi Yu has learned the divine-level mechanical talent to increase his enhancement calculation and deduction ability… Wait, if Shi Yu is a three-star purifier, he must also be learning the exclusive talent of the Environmental Protection Association… Is this the energy competition Old Wang mentioned?"
…
Environmental Protection District, mystic realm villa.
Shi Yu and Ling returned tiredly, but after they entered the villa, they realized that there was a cat girl lying on the sofa. She seemed to be even more tired than them.
"Teacher Ying?" Shi Yu called out tentatively.
"I'll make a wish…" On the sofa, a weak voice came. Shi Yu silently summoned Baby Ginseng and soon healed the gem cat girl.
"I'm so tired…" The gem cat girl pushed herself up from the sofa and rubbed her eyes. She looked at Shi Yu and the others unhappily and said, "What exactly did you guys do? Why did I consume so much energy?"
"Ah, I didn't do anything. I just barged around in the Starry Sky Storm and bet that the Starry Sky Storm wouldn't attack us," Shi Yu said. "Teacher Ying, you actually suffered such a serious backlash… Looks like we underestimated you. Your skill is indeed very awesome."
The gem cat: "?"
How overboard.
Shi Yu smiled and waved his hand. "In short, thank you, Teacher Ying. I'll let Baby Ginseng make a big meal for you today."
"Hurry up, hurry up, wu wu wu." The gem cat indeed felt hungry.
"Hurry up." Shi Yu also commanded the dark-eyed ginseng.
"Yi…" Baby Ginseng cried. Another mouth to feed appeared in the team. It was so annoying.
"No, wait." The gem cat girl suddenly reacted and said, "You… mastered the Starry Sky Storm??"

chapters.title: Chapter 1389 Lucky Cat (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1389 Lucky Cat (3)
Shi Yu blew his hair and said calmly, "That's true. Don't you know who we are? If nothing goes wrong, we can get the title of a doctorate in cosmic disaster science in a while."
"Not only am I the vice president of the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association and a three-star purifier, but I'll also be the deputy director of the Space Disaster Research Institute and have a doctorate in cosmic disaster science. Teacher Cat, don't worry, you'll eat better from now on."
The gem cat was more and more pleasantly surprised. Although she didn't understand, she felt that Shi Yu was impressive. She knew that she wasn't wrong about this kid. As expected, this guy was a monster no matter where he went.
"Then when are you going to make me a cosmic emperor?" she asked.
Shi Yu: "?"
"What cosmic emperor?"
"? Didn't you promise it? That Phoenix man said that you found a way to let me become the cosmic emperor, so I came."
Shi Yu: "?"
"I didn't. I don't know about it. Go find Phoenix Man."
The gem cat was angry. She knew that it was a scam. "What about the super divine level?"
Shi Yu: "I don't know."
The gem cat: "?"
"At most, divine-level. Baby Ginseng, take out the cultivation fruit. Teacher Ying, this is a modified cultivation fruit. As long as you eat it, you can automatically level up by sleeping. I specially prepared one for you. Do you want to try it?"
"Yi!" Baby Ginseng took out the cultivation fruit.
The taste wasn't successfully modified, but it modified one that could be eaten by other life forms other than humans.
"There's such a good thing?" The gem cat's anger dissipated immediately. She took the cultivation fruit from Baby Ginseng and took a bite.
In the next second, her face turned green and purple. She fainted and was immediately knocked out.
When Shi Yu, Ling, and Baby Ginseng saw this, they fell into deep thought. "Ling, think about how to write the thesis. I reckon that Teacher Cat can sleep for half a month. Don't disturb her."
"Yi! (Sacrifice a cultivation fruit and save a few meals.)" Baby Ginseng felt that it wasn't a loss.
This fruit was indeed powerful. It was named: Anti-Cat Fruit!
"Alright…" Ling said. She had already thought about it. She planned to write this paper from the perspective of cosmic disaster materials science and research mechanical materials suitable for the mechanic class that could more perfectly resist the disaster of the cosmic storm.
Although it might not be able to upgrade the various battleships and definitely couldn't compare to the existing intelligence crystals, opening up a new idea should be able to prove their abilities.
…
Next, after completing the most important thing, Shi Yu continued to prepare for the Four Saints Meeting and added points to Buggy, Chi Tong, Little Quas, Turtle, and Shorty.
A week later, as the points were added, Shi Yu also began to deduce an important skill: [Faith Overdraft].
[Learning Pet]: Buggy
[Name]: Faith Overdraft
[Effect]: As long as it makes up for the power of faith in the future, it can overdraw the power of faith that it never had to strengthen its faith skill!
[Deduction success rate]: Extremely low
Shi Yu chose to deduce it on Buggy. As long as Buggy learned it, it should be no problem to directly replicate it and teach it to the Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger.
…
A long time later.
Shi Yu lay weakly in front of Buggy.
At the same time.
[Deduction successful]
[Exclusive Learning Method]: The first step is to at least master the prototype of the spiritual law. The second step is to condense a spiritual body and successfully establish a spiritual contract with the corresponding faith item that contains strong traces of time. The third step is to consume the Pledge Flower, the Wish Power Crystal, and the Curse Star to establish an oath and restrictions.
The stronger the control over the corresponding power of faith, the higher the success rate.
"Is this the condition to learn Faith Overdraft… Looks like… it's not very troublesome…" After Shi Yu and Buggy received it, Buggy was quite satisfied. At least, it didn't have to go to the male department to remove his genitals.
However, it looked like it was going to put in a lot of effort again. A faith item that contained strong traces of time… What was strong traces of time? Did hundreds of years count? Or millions of years? Or billions of years? Or would it be from the last era?
He couldn't be sure now. He could only try when the time came and prepare some.
Apart from that, Buggy didn't master the spiritual law either… It had to find a place to replicate it. Although it was also quite rare, this shouldn't be a difficult law to replicate.
"Great…!!!" Just as Shi Yu and Buggy were in deep thought, a happy voice suddenly came from the villa outside.
Teacher Ying, who had slept for a week, finally woke up. At the same time, her body emitted a powerful aura, and weak law ripples lingered.
Shi Yu and Buggy were stunned. They immediately appeared and asked, "Teacher Ying, what's going on? You…"
The gem cat girl was extremely excited. "Although that cultivation fruit is extremely disgusting, the effect is really good!!"
"For your sake, I spent a lot of money to buy an inheritance resource for a 'mental control' divine skill from a revival divine beast on Blue Planet. I've originally been stuck at a bottleneck, but I didn't expect to master it after sleeping."
"From today onwards, I'm also a person with two quasi-divine skills!! I'm so strong! So strong!"
"Quasi-divine skill of mental control?" Shi Yu and Buggy found it unbelievable as they looked at the gem cat girl with green eyes.
"Teacher Ying…"
"Do you want us to experiment on your skills with you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1390 Dragon and Butterfly (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1390 Dragon and Butterfly (1)
After Shi Yu invited her, the gem cat excitedly pulled Shi Yu away to PK.
It would end with Shi Yu being beaten up.
As the gem cat didn't let Shi Yu send his pet, Shi Yu could only fight it himself.
Although he had battle power comparable to a demigod, he was only close to a demigod at the lower limit of a demigod like Blue Planet. It was impossible for him to defeat the space-element gem cat.
Buggy and the other pets looked at Shi Yu, who was being beaten up. They covered their faces and couldn't bear to look.
Beast Tamer, you've worked hard.
However, so be it. In any case, Shi Yu was already satisfied that the skill had been replicated.
"Teacher Ying, what do you think of the cultivation fruit?" After being tortured, Shi Yu said with a swollen face.
"How did you create such… a thing?" the gem cat said.
This was the most disgusting thing she had ever eaten. It was simply ruining her stomach. However, when she thought of the effect of the cultivation fruit, which could even help her level up while sleeping, she couldn't help but hesitate again.
If she could eat enough cultivation fruits and sleep for more than ten thousand years, wouldn't she directly reach the maximum level?
Thinking about it this way, it wasn't unacceptable.
"What do you think?" Shi Yu asked.
The gem cat understood. It was most likely that Shi Yu was also a lazy dog, so he squeezed the research ginseng dry to create such a divine fruit.
Sigh, a good ginseng baby was actually being used by a lazy person.
"This thing… is it filling?" the gem cat asked.
She now felt that this thing was like stinky tofu. Stinky tofu tasted good despite smelling bad, while this cultivation fruit was useful despite tasting bad. It was difficult to refuse.
"Of course not!" Shi Yu said. "I gave you one… I'm already very generous. It's not easy to create that. I have to use divine-level energy crystals to quickly replenish the consumption. The flowers that rely on natural regeneration have withered."
"However, I can sell it to you at 10% of the cost price."
The gem cat was stunned. "Are you treating me like an outsider?"
"Then I'll sell it to you according to the market price!"
The gem cat: Did I mean that???
"But the market price of this fruit… how much can it be sold for?" the gem cat asked.
Shi Yu shook his head and said, "I'm not very sure either, but if it can't increase sharpness, it's better not to sell it. As for the specifics, we have to go to the plant association to appraise it. I'll bring Baby Ginseng over another day."
Be it the Cultivation Fruit or the Reincarnation Fruit, they were both new things developed by Shi Yu. Shi Yu needed an Effect Appraisal Certificate. This way, it would be easier for him to sell them in the future.
Just like Ling's paper, this was also something that needed to be done before going out.
"I'll go!" The gem cat girl volunteered.
"Uh…" Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Then go. With this time, he could sleep more.
…
Next, Shi Yu entrusted Ling to buy things like the Pledge Flower, the Wish Power Crystal, and the Curse Star. Then, he obtained good news and bad news.
The good news was that he could still buy them. This was the good thing about big places. There were all kinds of rare things. There were no Blue Wave Domains, but there were nearly 200 other first-level domains. There were still more second and third-level domains.
Even if the World King Planet didn't have it, the World King Planet still maintained a trade relationship with countless planets in the Cosmic Sea. Any rare specialty could be found. In this situation, it was too difficult to lack goods.
The bad news was that not only did Susu not save up the work salary for more than a month with the Star Sea Contract and the origin wave, but it might also not be enough. Shi Yu and the others still had to pay a little…
It was another three extremely expensive divine-level resources, the kind whose quality was close to Level 11. Susu cried under the bed.
As the name suggested, the Pledge Flower could help the user establish an oath goal. The more determined the user's will was, the greater the potential that could be erupted.
The Wish Power Crystal was a crystal condensed from the powerful power of wish. It had the function of making a wish, similar to the wish stone obtained by Emperor Wu.
The Curse Star was a resource that exchanged for stronger power through self-curse… Shi Yu understood that the mechanism of over-drafting faith was very simple. After the user borrowed the power of faith that they didn't have, if they didn't repay it in a certain period of time, they would probably become a liar and enter a cursed state.
"We can choose not to buy the Wish Power Crystal for the time being and see if the cat can condense it. If it can, this is worth a lot. We can let the cat work to support us," Shi Yu said as he looked at the resource price on the Internet.
Ling: "Teacher Ying has the experience of establishing a financial group that spans the world on Blue Planet. When we become world overlords later and have our own territory, we can throw everything to Teacher Ying to manage and establish a business-oriented domain."
"Hehe…" Shi Yu chuckled. That was what he thought, too.
…
In another area of the Blue Wave World, the Plant Association.
"Yi!!" The gem cat girl in a suit and Baby Ginseng, who was wearing a doctorate hat, a leaf scarf, a white coat, and a bark book, came here together.
"The Reincarnation Fruit and the Cultivation Fruit are so powerful. Don't tell me you also want to be the vice president of the plant association?" The gem cat girl muttered to Baby Ginseng.
"Yiya!" Baby Ginseng felt that it was a good idea.
Although the vice president of the Environmental Protection Association said that it was Shi Yu's, to put it bluntly, the Environmental Protection Association valued Susu and it was Susu's.
It was the same for the Disaster Research Institute. To put it bluntly, it was Ling's.
Baby Ginseng felt that since two of the three sisters had successfully risen on the World King Planet and cozied up to a large faction, how could it, the towering emperor, fall behind?

chapters.title: Chapter 1391 Dragon and Butterfly (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1391 Dragon and Butterfly (2)
Among the three brothers, Eleven seemed to have relied on its racial potential to obtain the support of some new star racial plan from the Myriad Race Committee. It felt that it was nowhere near as powerful as Susu and Ling…
In that case, it would rely on it to make a comeback!
The gem cat and Baby Ginseng stepped forward.
However, after a while, they came out with stunned expressions.
Today, the plant association suspended all business for special reasons.
"Yi??" Their plan had failed before they even executed it?
The gem cat and Baby Ginseng asked when they would start the business again, but they couldn't say for sure.
"To think I'm dressed so beautifully today." The resentment came from the gem cat and Baby Ginseng.
Both parties came out of the plant association angrily. Right on the heels of that, Baby Ginseng was stunned and saw a familiar face nearby.
"Yi!" Baby Ginseng and the gem cat girl greeted them and ran to someone they knew.
It was a young man in a dark green trench coat and a green dragon. Both parties seemed to have just come out of the plant association.
"Yi!! Yi!!" Baby Ginseng ran to their side.
"Sen Nian, Gorka!"
Sen Nian and Gorka turned around and looked at the strangely dressed Baby Ginseng…
In the Blue Wave World, there were as many plant races as hairs on a cow, so apart from dressing a little strangely, Baby Ginseng didn't attract any additional attention.
In addition, the Blue Wave Domain had special laws that took very good care of the plant lives of various races, especially the plant lives of supplement races.
No race was allowed to illegally harm the supplement plant race that nurtured life. Otherwise, it would be against the law and would be punished. The other realms might not necessarily have this law, but in the Blue Wave World, this was the highest command. There was no other reason. After all, the World Lord of the Blue Wave World was a plant life form at the super divine level. It was normal for it to favor plants.
This was also the reason why Baby Ginseng dared to swagger out. Of course, the most important reason was that, with its current control ability combined with Shi Yu's physical control talent, it could keep itself very low-profile. It couldn't be seen at all that it was a super support supplement with countless quasi-divine skills.
Moreover, Baby Ginseng had also prepared a copy of the spatial divine stone given by the Space Emperor. It was foolproof.
"You are…" Sen Nian asked.
"I'm the towering ginseng emperor," Baby Ginseng said. "I heard Eleven mention you guys. I'm its good friend. You guys are Eleven's friends, so we're also friends."
Sen Nian and the Green Dragon: "?"
Towering ginseng emperor? What kind of strange name was this? Judging from the style, it didn't seem to be from this realm, right?
But wait a minute… Eleven's friend?
Sen Nian and the green dragon widened their eyes. They had heard from Director Sen that Eleven had successfully fought above its level and had already become the focus of the Myriad Races Committee headquarters.
Eleven would definitely have a seat in the top 50 of the God Sealing Battle. In the entire Blue Wave World, it was the strongest genius.
Facing such a genius, Sen Nian and the Green Dragon also understood why Eleven and Buggy didn't want to make friends with them previously. They weren't worthy.
However, at this moment, in the face of Baby Ginseng's words, Sen Nian and the green dragon were stunned. Could it be that Eleven had already regarded them as friends behind their backs?
Wu wu wu… Eleven had them in its heart… Bullsh*t!
Sen Nian and the green dragon's faces darkened. They felt that the Iron-eating Beast must have used the battle results of defeating them to talk nonsense. It definitely wasn't introducing them like introducing friends.
However, one shouldn't hit a smiling person. Facing Baby Ginseng, Gorka still asked in a friendly manner, "So you're Eleven's friend. What's the matter?"
"Do you know what happened to the plant association and why all business was suspended?" Baby Ginseng asked.
The green dragon said, "You don't know?"
Baby Ginseng shook its head.
Sen Nian read, "The Blue Wave Plant Association organized a group of plant-element geniuses to train in the Demon Region. In the end, there was sudden danger. An ancient, super divine ruin suddenly descended. Although the final ruin was cracked, the process caused these geniuses, who had yet to reach the divine level, to suffer heavy casualties. Even those who were lucky enough to survive were saved by emergency reincarnation and became near-death seeds again."
"Now, the higher-ups of the plant association should be thinking of a way to save them. However, even if they save them, they will probably have to start from scratch. Moreover, they might not necessarily be able to recover the memories of their previous lives. For the new generation of the Blue Wave World, it can be said to be a huge blow. After all, these guys are the hearts of those large families."
He shrugged, feeling really unlucky. Thinking about it carefully, it was safer to fight in the ranking battle of all races…
"Yi…" Baby Ginseng was also stunned. It was so miserable.
"Perhaps they need a large number of Reincarnation Fruits. This might be able to reduce their losses to the minimum." At this moment, the gem cat girl slowly walked over.
