The gem cat looked happy. Hey, what did she hear?
Wasn't this a business opportunity!
Seeing the gem cat girl, Sen Nian was stunned and his heart raced. Wait, who was this beautiful cat girl?
"You are??"
"I'm its teacher," the gem cat placed its hand on Dr. Baby Ginseng's hat and said.
Baby Ginseng: Wu wu wu, sort of.
After Baby Ginseng heard the gem cat's words, it seemed to have been reminded of something. Yes, the genius plants of the Plant Association were forced to transform into seeds. From scratch, the faction that cultivated them would definitely be extremely heartbroken. At this moment, would the Reincarnation Fruit that could awaken the memories and strength of its previous life be popular?
The Cultivation Fruit could also play an important role in this process, even after this process, helping them increase their strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 1392 Dragon and Butterfly (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1392  Dragon and Butterfly (3)
Could he directly open the Blue Wave World Market through this step and advance to the peak of the ginseng life?
"Reincarnation Fruit? Teacher? Student?" Sen Nian and the green dragon looked at the strange combination of teacher and student in confusion.
Why was a plant-type life form's teacher a cat that was evolving towards a human form?
"Yi!! (Don't worry about it. Do you have a relative who's a higher-up in the plant association? I have something good to sell here. Can you contact the higher-ups of the plant association?)" Baby Ginseng took out a fruit and shook it.
Sen Nian and Gorka: ???
…
In the mystic realm villa.
After Shi Yu replicated the quasi-divine skill of mental control, he began to teach Buggy first.
In the past few days, he had also taught other quasi-divine skills randomly. For example, he had successfully taught Eleven and Chi Tong the Metal Control skill of Shorty.
For example, Dark Control wasn't only taught to Eleven, but also to Duckie.
Apart from installing Buggy, quasi-divine-level spatial control also gave Chi Tong and Ling with pretty good compatibility.
After Ling modified itself into a cosmic life battleship, its main new attributes were spatial Stats. This was more convenient for it to sail in the starry sky of the universe. Apart from Space Control, it also had to teach Light Control.
Although they were all entry-level, after teaching them, their configurations immediately underwent a tremendous change.
Even if there was a difference in the number of quasi-divine skills from the first place in the God Sealing Battle, a small monster like Zavay with 15 quasi-divine skills, the difference in quality was definitely negligible.
Shi Yu optimized the skill configuration while adding faith skills to Buggy and Chi Tong. The efficiency was very high.
"Alright!" Although Baby Ginseng wasn't around, the supplements it left behind also added points. After Shi Yu finished adding points to Buggy, both parties immediately thanked Teacher Cat for her gift.
"We'll think of a way to figure out the faith item at the Four Saints Meeting. You just have to condense your spiritual body first," Shi Yu said. "You have to use the spiritual laws to condense your spiritual body."
"If you have any difficulties, tell me again. I'll continue to increase points."
"Wu!!!" Buggy asked what was so difficult about this? Although it didn't know mental control previously, its previous skills included high-end usage of mental strength. Its attainments in mental strength weren't low, it just lacked an opportunity.
Buggy immediately performed condensing a spiritual body for Shi Yu on the spot. The spiritual body condensed from spiritual laws was like a Nascent Soul in the cultivation system, like a miniaturized pet.
Soon, a Green Silkworm embryo slowly formed. Then, it turned into a cocoon and turned into a butterfly, turning into a beautiful spiritual butterfly. It felt very similar to the Butterfly of Imagination.
Then, it slowly planned to grow into the current Green Dragon form, but… at this moment, it was stuck.
Buggy was covered in sweat. The Butterfly of Imagination's spiritual body just didn't grow anymore and couldn't transform into a dragon.
"Ji…" Buggy, who wanted to know what was going on, immediately entered the spiritual sea with the incarnation of the Dragon of Imagination and found the Butterfly of Imagination. The two parties fused together. Soon, Buggy knew what was going on.
At this point, although it had already evolved into a Green Dragon, in its heart, Buggy still thought that it was an insect type and acknowledged its identity as a Green Silkworm. Therefore, it wasn't easy to create a nomological spiritual body.
As the saying went, the body and mind weren't united.
Buggy didn't expect that it would actually be stuck in such a place. No… The Green Silkworm was it, the Butterfly of Imagination was it, and the Green Dragon was also it. In order to successfully shape it, the Dragon of Imagination it turned into immediately worked hard to fuse with the Butterfly of Imagination, trying to assimilate…
"Work hard first. If you can't take it anymore, I'll help you. I'm going to sleep." Shi Yu yawned. He felt that Buggy condensing a nomological spiritual body wasn't something that could be done overnight. He should sleep first.
This time, Shi Yu had a dream. He dreamed of the Prediction Owl on Blue Planet. He dreamed that it would laugh crazily and shout in relief, "As expected of you, Buggy." Then, it would complete the upgrade…

chapters.title: Chapter 1393 Produced By the Ginseng Emperor (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1393  Produced By the Ginseng Emperor (1)
At this moment, the interior of the Blue Wave Plant Association was like a hospital delivery room.
Under the "delivery" of a pile of highly skilled plant gods, the life divine seed that had been infected by various powers turned into young plants waiting to be fed again.
They had lost the power of their previous lives and the memories of their previous lives. They could only start growing again in their young bodies. However, for these young plants, it was already the best outcome. If not for this, they might have disappeared forever, leaving no traces.
"Daughter…" The plant queen, who had the figure of a beautiful adult woman, had green leaf wings, and her arms were wrapped in thorn vines. Her rose-like hair covered her eyes and nose. When she saw her daughter become a green onion with eyes, she cried silently.
This was the young form of their race… Could it be that they were going to start raising children again?
Only by taking care of a child would one know the pain.
"Unfortunately, Madam Manka, it couldn't recover its memories. It's already doing its best to preserve its Race Talent," a Green Dragon said.
Gani, a divine-level member of the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race and a higher-up of the Plant Association, became a medical member of the Plant Association's training accident because he had mastered the laws of life and wood.
"I understand." The plant queen nodded silently. She was already mentally prepared.
Green Dragon Gani shook his head. There were still some Reincarnation Seeds to be saved in the nutritional room. Now wasn't the time to rest.
However, just as it was about to return to the work area, telepathy sounded in its heart from afar.
"Dad, I'm Gorka. Someone wants to meet you and the president of the plant association."
"?" When Green Dragon Gani heard this voice, it looked into the distance. What was this brat doing again?
"The other party said that it can help the plant lives that are forced to reincarnate quickly recover the power and memories of their previous lives."
"What?" Green Dragon Gani directly flew away from the spot and searched for its son's location through telepathy. Soon, it flew outside the plant association and landed in front of Baby Ginseng and the others.
Its gaze swept past Sen Nian and Gorka and looked at the gem cat girl and Baby Ginseng. "Gorka, what's going on? If you're lying, I'll break your wings!"
The green dragon, Gorka, said with a bitter expression, "What has it got to do with me? I'm just passing the message in place of them."
Baby Ginseng looked at the stronger green dragon flying over and took a deep breath. Good lord, they also had people in the plant association? As expected, it was the same everywhere. All industries were infiltrated by powerful families.
"Who are you?" Gani asked Baby Ginseng and the gem cat.
Sen Nian said, "Godfather, they claim to have mastered an ability called the 'Reincarnation Fruit' that can awaken the power and memories of their previous life."
"Are you sure?" Green Dragon Gani asked solemnly. There was such an ability? At least, the various races in the current Blue Wave World didn't have such a method.
Perhaps the World King could rely on the power of a super divine to help the plant-element demigod who had just reincarnated awaken the power and memories of its previous life, but the World King was far on the battlefield. It was impossible for it to return for such a small matter…
For a world overlord, it was a small matter, but for the plant association, it was a major accident. If it wasn't handled well, the loss would be small, but the good impression of the family that was deeply cooperating with the plant association would be big.
Therefore, at the moment, the president of the plant association had already gone to seek help and planned to find a way to find other realms. However, before he could find a way to find the plant association, someone actually said that he could solve it himself and took the initiative to come knocking on his door.
"Yes." Baby Ginseng pressed its doctorate hat. Of course.
"What exactly are your origins, and what are your intentions? Do you know the price of lying?" Green Dragon Gani said.
"It's just that we happen to have the resources you need and want to help others. Of course, we won't pay without reason. Just give us a reward," the gem cat girl said.
Money!! Money!! Money!!
Only when Shi Yu was rich could she eat.
"Yi! (We're from the Floating Realm!)" Baby Ginseng said.
Green Dragon Gani's expression changed. Why was the Floating Realm so familiar?
"Godfather, they said they were friends of the Iron-eating Beast Race's Eleven, who defeated Gorka…" Sen Nian explained.
"Tsk," the Green Dragon Gani said. It knew it. Why was it so familiar? It turned out that it was also from the Floating Realm, like the Iron-eating Beast, whom Old Sen mentioned. What was wrong with this Floating Realm? Its presence had been so strong recently.
"If what you say is true, it's a big help. Follow me, I'll bring you to see the president," it said.
Baby Ginseng and the gem cat looked at each other. It worked!
…
At this moment, in a conference room of the plant association, a human with the appearance of an old granny had a worried expression.
Around her, two vice presidents of the plant association, who had already sent their pets to work, were discussing countermeasures with her.
"President Feng, how is it?"
"In the current situation, two resources have been found to solve it," the old granny president said. "One is the Level-11 resource, Three World Soil, and the other is the Level-11 resource, Forgotten Star River Water."
"Both resources are extremely expensive. There are 212 plant-type demigods who were forced to reincarnate this time. The plant association can't afford to bear the loss this time."
It was so expensive that it was even more expensive than pulling their reincarnations to demigod level again.
"Moreover, these resources are extremely rare. Even if we connect and provide us with a purchase channel, it's impossible to collect so many in a short period of time." The old granny president shook her head.

chapters.title: Chapter 1394 Produced by the Ginseng Emperor (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1394 Produced by the Ginseng Emperor (2)
"From the perspective of the plant association, it looks like I can only symbolically give them some human compensation."
Upon hearing that, the higher-ups present were silent. Although this wasn't the best way to deal with it, this was the only way.
"President!" Just as the president of the Plant Association was at a loss, Green Dragon Gani brought Baby Ginseng and the others outside the conference room and called the president from outside.
"Gani? Come here." The old granny president didn't understand why Gani wasn't helping over there and came here. Following her summoning, Gani immediately brought Baby Ginseng and the others in.
"President, I encountered them outside. They said that they can provide a large amount of resources called the 'Reincarnation Fruit' that can awaken the power and memories of the previous life." After Gani entered, he went straight to the point to the president.
Upon hearing that, the higher-ups of the plant association were stunned and suddenly looked at Baby Ginseng and the gem cat.
"Reincarnation Fruit? What did you say?" The old granny president looked at Baby Ginseng.
"It's the Reincarnation Fruit," Baby Ginseng said. "If you need it, I can provide it in large quantities, but it's not easy to create one. It's not free."
In the face of many wolf-like and tiger-like gazes, Baby Ginseng suddenly trembled. After saying that, why did it feel that everyone present was looking at it with green eyes?
"You're saying that you can create resources with this effect?" The old granny president of the plant association looked at Baby Ginseng.
"Do you have anything real? Let me see."
When Baby Ginseng heard that, it directly took out a Reincarnation Fruit that it had created previously and gave it to the president of the plant association. After obtaining the Reincarnation Fruit, the president of the plant association immediately sensed a special time power from it and was stunned.
It was a time-element fruit resource!
After deeply exploring the powerful essence of the Reincarnation Fruit, President Feng gradually believed it. However, at this moment, she was even more curious about where this time-element plant life form came from.
Apart from in the Blue Wave World, such a guy wouldn't be able to live long in other worlds.
"Yi! (Helping demigods awaken the power and memories of their previous lives should be easy, but the divine level is a little difficult.)" Baby Ginseng nodded and said.
"Are you sure this thing is effective?" President Feng asked again.
"Of course," the gem cat girl said firmly. She had recovered the power of her previous life through the Reincarnation Fruit. How could it be fake?
"Gani, there were some orphans with no backgrounds among the geniuses who were forced to reincarnate, right? Bring one here," President Feng said to Gani.
When Gani heard that, it understood that President Feng wanted to test the effect, so it immediately turned and left.
"President, this is Gourmand Flower, a genius unearthed at the border. It was also forced to reincarnate this time."
In less than a minute, a young plant-type creature that looked like a tender sprout was brought over by the green dragon. It looked confused and was placed on the conference table. President Feng walked to its side and held the Reincarnation Fruit. "Little guy, come, have a bite."
Upon hearing that, the young Gourmand Flower took a bite of the Reincarnation Fruit. The higher-ups of the plant association present couldn't take their eyes off it. A moment later, the young Gourmand Flower was stunned, and white light spread from its body.
Boom!
Under everyone's gaze, its aura rose unbelievably. Soon, it rose from transcendent to commander rank, monarch rank, and overlord rank…
Multiple law ripples spread on its body. As the white light dissipated, a Gourmand Flower that looked like a flower figure with several huge abyssal mouths on its arms and body appeared.
"Uh…" At this moment, the Gourmand Flower's expression was chaotic. It made a sound and felt a headache. The Reincarnation Fruit in front of it seemed to have a fatal temptation to it. It ate two to three more bites before recovering slightly.
"Aren't I… already dead?" It let out a voice with a headache. It opened its eyes and looked around. After seeing President Feng and the others, it had an incredulous expression.
"President Feng? You saved me?"
At this moment, President Feng and the others also sighed slightly. It was actually really so useful. On World King Planet, it wasn't that there weren't resources to awaken the power and memories of their previous lives, but they were all extremely expensive and rare, such as the Forgotten Star River Water and the Three Worlds Soil…
And this plant-type ginseng life form in front of them could actually manually create such a resource??
"It's not us, it's…" At this moment, President Feng was just about to say something when the Gourmand Flower changed again. The power of the Reincarnation Fruit didn't seem to have been completely activated, and time light appeared on its body again.
Its aura began to climb to quasi-divine, approaching the divine level.
"Ah…" A huge cry came from the Gourmand Flower, as if its spiritual consciousness had been attacked.
Seeing this, Green Dragon Gani immediately asked, "What's going on?"
"Don't worry, it should be that the Reincarnation Fruit awakened the power and memories of its previous life. Not only did this big flower reincarnate this time, but its strongest stage should be at the divine level." After Baby Ginseng finished speaking, as expected, just as it said, the Gourmand Flower began to evolve again.
Its originally bright red body, that was filled with huge mouths, was gradually dyed with white stripes. Strong spatial fluctuations spread from its body. President Feng and the others directly revealed their incredulous expressions.
"Spatial law…" Green Dragon Gani said, "This guy has mastered spatial law??"
Although the Gourmand Flower was a genius cultivated by the plant association, it had never mastered a powerful divine skill like the spatial law. But now, after eating a Reincarnation Fruit, not only did it return from the form of a reincarnated cub to when it was alive, but it also awakened a spatial law divine skill, immediately making the gazes of the higher-ups of the plant association present turn cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 1395 Produced by the Ginseng Emperor (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1395 Produced by the Ginseng Emperor (3)
Then, he looked at the honest Baby Ginseng and the eager gem cat beside him in disbelief.
At this moment, the cat was a little excited. It felt like Baby Ginseng's Reincarnation Fruit seemed to have leveled up a lot more. Then, apart from her previous life as a demigod, could she also inherit the power of her previous life or even her previous, previous life?
Perhaps she was a big boss in the starry sky of the universe in her past, past, past life.
"I…" The Gourmand Flower tried its best to recall something, but unfortunately, it never did. Its strength was also slowly decreasing, returning to the state of the Gourmand Flower, panting.
The level of the fruit Baby Ginseng gave wasn't high and wasn't enough to support it. It completely awakened the power and memories of its previous life.
At this moment, President Feng and the others completely believed that the Reincarnation Fruit created by the ginseng in front of them could help those geniuses who were forced to reincarnate recover their strength and memories.
"Sir, who exactly are you…" At this moment, President Feng spoke respectfully. Just this move from Baby Ginseng could already win their respect.
Not only could this Reincarnation Fruit help the Blue Wave Plant Association survive the current difficulties, but it was also a resource with extremely strategic value. It could also make a faction become a very rich money tree.
"Floating Realm, ginseng emperor," Baby Ginseng said. "Do you believe me this time?"
"I believe you, I believe you," President Feng said. "Can you really provide a large number of Reincarnation Fruits? What's the price?"
Baby Ginseng fell into deep thought and said, "How much can you give?"
Ignoring the time cost, after creating the divine-level Reincarnation Fruit with all its might through the Wood Control, the Life Divine Body, and the storage power of the Sun and Moon, it probably needed one-third of the clueless divine-level elemental energy crystal, or one-third of the power of the wood-element divine-level energy crystal, to replenish its physical fitness.
President Feng said, "How about two wood-element divine-level energy crystals?"
Baby Ginseng took a deep breath. How rich!
Although it was already very satisfied, Baby Ginseng still made a difficult expression. The gem cat beside it heaved a sigh of relief when it saw this. Fortunately, Baby Ginseng controlled itself! No one would bid a high price for the first time.
President Feng smiled bitterly and said, "Sir ginseng emperor, to be honest, we really need a large number of Reincarnation Fruits. At least 200. If the price is too high, it will cause problems in the operation of the plant association."
"And from the looks of it, just one Reincarnation Fruit might not be enough for them to recover all their strength."
At this moment, the Gourmand Flower had only recovered to the overlord level through the Reincarnation Fruit. It was still a certain distance from the demigod level before reincarnation.
At this moment, the higher-ups of the plant association present knew that the price was too low. There was no way two divine-level energy crystals could buy the Three World Soil and the Forgotten Star River Water. Perhaps the level of the Reincarnation Fruit was inferior to those resources, but in terms of effect, there was almost no difference in this matter.
President Feng was silent. No matter how high it was, it wasn't impossible. The price she offered was to let the plant association buy it all themselves. If it was any higher, she could only let those genius families pay a portion.
"Why don't you discuss it again?" the gem cat girl said.
"It still has accompanying resources here," the gem cat said. "It can also create Cultivation Fruits. It's a fruit that the user can level up on their own after sleeping without doing anything. When used with the Reincarnation Fruit, it won't be long before they can return to their peak and even become stronger."
The higher-ups of the plant association were slightly stunned. Huh?
"It's a sample," the gem cat said.
"This is a sample. Making two together consumes too much energy. It can only be supported by a large number of supplements." Baby Ginseng took out another cultivation fruit and placed it on the table.
Then, there was also a "business card".
"Our contact information is on this. If you've considered it, you can contact us!"
"Then, thank you, everyone… Help me appraise the effects of the 'Reincarnation Fruit' and 'Cultivation Fruit'. I want an Effect Appraisal Certificate." Baby Ginseng didn't expect that the president of the plant association could personally help it appraise the effect.
"Let's go." The gem cat poked the ginseng emperor and gave them some time to communicate.
"Alright… Alright." Upon hearing that, President Feng also knew that they indeed needed time to consider many things.
After chatting, Baby Ginseng and the gem cat left. Such a big deal couldn't be negotiated immediately. They had to give the other party some time. Even if the other party could pay, Baby Ginseng didn't have that much stock at this moment.
After Baby Ginseng and the gem cat left, the conference room fell silent.
"So… was it that senior ginseng emperor who saved me?" On the table, the Gourmand Flower was blurry.
"You, eat this and take a look. Perhaps it can help you recover more strength." President Feng threw the cultivation fruit left behind by Baby Ginseng to the Gourmand Flower.
She had already confirmed the current state of the Gourmand Flower. She wanted to see what abilities this cultivation fruit had.
"Alright." The Gourmand Flower didn't dare to disobey the president's command and directly ate the cultivation fruit again. Then, its entire body emitted a mixed stench, making the higher-ups of the plant association almost have a heart attack.
They suddenly covered their noses and saw that the Gourmand Flower had fallen asleep with white eyes.
"President… You guys… harmed me," Gourmand Flower said.
President Feng: "?"
"This… Ugh." Green Dragon Gani was shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1396 Produced by the Ginseng Emperor (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1396 Produced by the Ginseng Emperor (4)
"Why is it so smelly!!" President Feng almost thought that Baby Ginseng and the others had left behind some smelly bomb. She immediately checked the situation of the Gourmand Flower and confirmed that the smell was emitted because of the Cultivation Fruit just now.
However, during the inspection, President Feng also discovered that the plant body of the Gourmand Flower had indeed started to grow automatically at this moment, and its speed was very fast. It had just slept for a few seconds, and it might be comparable to a few days of bitter cultivation. Everything else was fine.
This was partly because of the effect of the Cultivation Fruit, and also because the Gourmand Flower had already activated its original potential through the Reincarnation Fruit and could be considered to have recovered its strength.
"President…" After everyone cleaned up the smell haggardly, a higher-up said, "President, we have to take the Reincarnation Fruit. Even without this, the Reincarnation Fruit is very important to the Blue Wave Plant Association."
"Resources that contain the power of time and awaken the power and memories of your previous life have always been high-end and very expensive. Now that a low-level substitute has finally appeared, maybe we can open a huge market."
"Yeah, the other party just asked us to appraise the effect of the Reincarnation Fruit and the Cultivation Fruit. Doesn't that mean that the other party isn't a member of other plant associations? This is an opportunity. We have to rope that ginseng emperor into the Blue Wave Plant Association."
"If it joins other branches, we'll suffer a huge loss."
"Do I need you to say this?" President Feng said. "It's just… easier said than done."
A green-haired middle-aged man said, "In the first transaction, we can join forces with the families of those geniuses and spend a lot of money to give this ginseng emperor enough benefits. Then, with this, we can invite him to become the honorary vice president of the plant association."
"It'll save so many geniuses at once. The factions behind those geniuses should support them wholeheartedly. There's a reason for assigning the ginseng emperor as vice president. It won't attract criticism."
"And after the ginseng emperor becomes the honorary vice president of the Blue Wave Plant Association, as long as we can persuade it and obtain the proxy sales rights of the 'Reincarnation Fruit' and even the cultivation method, all the losses can be made up for as time passes."
"Isn't it a little rude to give an honorary vice president to a stranger of unknown origin?" Another purple-haired higher-up said. She had been around for so many years before she got to the position of vice president.
"Let me consider it." After the old granny president closed her eyes tightly, she said, "It's too difficult to obtain this resource with the funds of the plant association alone, but to let those families cooperate to invest, we have to let them confirm the effect of the Reincarnation Fruit first…"
"We can buy a few Reincarnation Fruits at a high price from that ginseng emperor first and let them experiment…"
As she spoke, the Gourmand Flower that was sealed by everyone beside her suddenly broke through the seal. Its aura reached the quasi-divine level. It actually completed the breakthrough while sleeping and returned to its peak…
Everyone was silent.
President Feng said, "You can also… buy a few of this stinky fruit."
…
After Baby Ginseng and the gem cat returned, Shi Yu woke up from his sleep and said, "Looks like your gains aren't bad?"
"Yiya!!!" Baby Ginseng explained the current situation of the plant association to Shi Yu and was very happy.
This money-making speed wasn't inferior to that of Susu, right!
"I didn't expect this thing to be so rare on the World King Planet. It can actually be sold for such a high price." At this moment, the gem cat girl also felt that she had eaten an impressive thing and felt the pinch of needing to share.
"Yi!!" Just as everyone finished chatting, Baby Ginseng received a message. The plant association wanted to buy a small batch of resources first at a very high price. After Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng saw it, they were very tempted.
Shi Yu licked his lips and said, "Make it for them. In the next few days, you should create the Reincarnation Fruit and the Cultivation Fruit first."
"Yi!!" Baby Ginseng expressed its agreement.
In a few days, the plant association received the first batch of resources they wanted from Baby Ginseng and the gem cat. They called a batch of reincarnated cubs to experiment with their elders.
After eating the Reincarnation Fruit, this batch of young sprouts immediately awakened the power and memories of their previous lives, surprising the faction behind it.
Although the Reincarnation Fruit was expensive, it was much cheaper than resources like the Three World Soil. Apart from that, in addition to the fact that the plant association was willing to pay a portion of the money, even small divine-level families could easily bear it.
"Everyone, this is the resource provided by that ginseng emperor, the Reincarnation Fruit."
President Feng looked at the recovered geniuses of the plant association and was gratified.
"I… revived?"
"Dad… Mom…"
"Teacher…" After the plant demigods recovered from their reincarnation state, they were also extremely excited.
"President Feng… Who exactly is this ginseng emperor?" The rulers of the families also looked at their children with surging emotions and asked.
Great, this ginseng emperor was simply a huge help.
"Did this senior ginseng emperor save us?" The geniuses who were saved also had grateful expressions.
President Feng nodded and said, "That's right. Apart from the Reincarnation Fruit, it also prepared a 'Cultivation Fruit' for you. It's a fruit that can efficiently increase strength by combining work and rest. When used with the Reincarnation Fruit, I believe it won't be long before you can recover to the peak or even break through to the peak."
"President, I wonder where the Cultivation Fruit is. We'll buy it too," a divine-level parent said. They had already seen the effect of the Reincarnation Fruit, so the Cultivation Fruit produced by the ginseng emperor shouldn't be too bad.
President Feng had a strange expression and said, "Wait a minute."
Soon, a few Cultivation Fruits were served. The revived geniuses of the plant association only felt that the feeling of being alive was really good. They picked up the Cultivation Fruits one by one, but in a moment, their expressions turned purple and black.
In order to not deceive them, Baby Ginseng specially displayed the smell of the Cultivation Fruit in order to give the buyers mental preparation and let them decide if they wanted to buy it or not. It could be said to be a kind merchant.
This was the gem cat's suggestion. Business was about integrity. The sold goods should be represented accurately.
Therefore, there was the scene in front of them. After a bunch of geniuses from the plant association obtained the Cultivation Fruit, they almost fainted just by smelling it.
"Ugh…" Retch sounds came from the association one after another. Many geniuses' faces were pale. They… really had to eat this?
"Eat, there's no problem. Your elders have already paid to help you buy it. Don't waste it." President Feng had already seen very good effects on the Gourmand Flower. Although the value of this Cultivation Fruit was inferior to the Reincarnation Fruit, it wasn't bad. If it was popularized in the future, it would be very helpful to the strengthening of the plant association.
Under her command, this group of plant geniuses still didn't make up their minds. They looked like they were about to cry. Why did this thing smell even more disgusting than those divine beast feces fertilizer?
They didn't want to eat…
If they had to eat this thing, it was better not to recover… They would rather be cubs again.
"Eat…" Beside him, the genius elders also covered their noses and forcefully ordered.
Could President Feng lie to them?
In any case, they weren't the ones eating fruits. If eating it could really make their descendants stronger, they would also be happy to see it. They couldn't let other people's children eat it and their own children not eat it because of the taste, right? Wouldn't they fall behind a lot… and get swept up?

chapters.title: Chapter 1397 The Universe Overlord Army is Here (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1397 The Universe Overlord Army is Here (1)
A few days later.
It was time for Shi Yu and Lin Feng to head to the Heavenly Spirit Domain to participate in the Four Saints Meeting.
During this period, Shi Yu and his pets worked overtime and lived very happily.
The transaction between Baby Ginseng and the Plant Association was also carried out in an orderly manner.
Although Baby Ginseng had yet to create enough Reincarnation and Cultivation Fruits needed by the plant association due to time problems, Shi Yu and the others had already earned a lot because of this.
Soon, his assets returned to their peak, more than the resources given by a one-star will and the master of a domain.
Moreover, during this period of time, the effects of the Reincarnation Fruit and the Cultivation Fruit had also spread in the Blue Wave World.
Everyone knew that the accident that caused many plant-element geniuses to be forced to reincarnate had already been saved by the Reincarnation Fruit created by a plant-element big boss called the ginseng emperor.
At the same time, an automatic cultivation resource called the Cultivation Fruit also became popular in the Blue Wave World.
If the Cultivation Fruit only had the effect of efficient cultivation, it might not necessarily be as popular as it was now. It suddenly exploded in popularity because it was a stinky gimmick.
Those geniuses who had eaten the Cultivation Fruit couldn't accept it. They only ate such disgusting food themselves, so they recommended it to their relatives and friends. This caused the number of Cultivation Fruits made by the plant association to increase…
This made Shi Yu realize that Teacher Cat indeed had a business mind. At some point, as long as the quality was passable, certain strange attributes could often be used as top-notch marketing methods. It was far easier to spread than normal stats.
"Are you really not going?" Before Shi Yu walked to the Heavenly Spirit Domain, he finally asked the gem cat girl, who was lying lazily on the sofa.
"No." The gem cat opened the fridge with its psychic power and took out a bottle of fresh milk.
"Then don't say that we didn't bring you out to play in the end." Shi Yu remembered that when she was on Blue Planet, she was unhappy for a long time because he didn't bring her along on a few trips.
"How could that be?" The gem cat girl yawned. What was so fun about the Four Saints Meeting? Now that she had the Cultivation Fruit, although it was a little unpalatable, she only wanted to cultivate here.
Moreover, she hadn't even finished exploring the interesting places of the Floating Realm and the Blue Wave Realm. She wasn't very interested in going to the Heavenly Spirit Realm.
"Then we'll leave." Shi Yu shrugged. So be it. Shi Yu packed his luggage and called his pets.
The Four Saints Meeting would last for a month. Shi Yu and the others wouldn't return in the short term, and other things had been arranged.
The transaction between Baby Ginseng and the plant association would be suspended for a period of time. Susu's cleansing quests had always exceeded the standard. It had long completed the mission number of a three-star purifier for decades. As for Ling's research paper, it had already been written and recently uploaded to the headquarters of the Disaster Research Institute.
"Senior Lin Feng, I'm leaving…" After finishing his work, Shi Yu contacted Senior Lin Feng and planned to leave.
…
First-level domain, Heavenly Spirit Domain, Four Holy Ancient City.
Shi Yu and the others circled around and finally arrived. In an ancient city, under a huge Green Dragon Fountain, Shi Yu directly said,
"Senior Lin Feng, this place is so remote. I searched for a long time before I found it."
Lin Feng smiled and said, "Haha, indeed. Such a big ruin is actually not in the main city."
"Let's go first. I've already helped you find a place to stay. The event won't begin in two days. During this period, you can walk around first. There will be some shops or auctions selling faith items in the ancient city. You can participate yourself."
"Uh, Senior Lin Feng, what about you?" Shi Yu still wanted to walk around with Lin Feng. When the time came, he would lack money. This senior couldn't "stand by and do nothing", right?
"I've arranged with Xiao Bai to meet an old friend, so I won't be with you. But if you have anything, you can look for me," Lin Feng said.
Shi Yu: "?"
Xiao Bai… Shi Yu knew that Senior Lin Feng had cultivated a white tiger on Blue Planet. To be precise, it was a white tiger mother. It wasn't a white tiger mother like when a white tiger fused with a human Beast Tamer, but a white tiger mother evolving into a human form.
Its name was Xiao Bai.
It was precisely because of this relationship that Senior Lin Feng obtained the initial qualifications to participate in the Four Saints Meeting.
However, to Shi Yu's surprise, the other party had really called him over casually and not because he wanted to personally guide him.
"I miscalculated…" Shi Yu looked like he had miscalculated. Yes, guiding juniors wasn't as fun as going to a gathering with the white tiger mother.
It was already very kind of Senior Lin Feng to bring him here…
"You're already so old. Don't tell me you still want me to take care of you by your side," Lin Feng said.
"No, Senior Lin Feng, just go do your own thing." The corners of Shi Yu's mouth twitched.
"Then I'm relieved." Lin Feng smiled and said, "Buy more faith items to prepare for the God Sealing Battle. Then, you can also participate in the battle of the Four Saint Ruins."
"You don't have to worry too much. This is according to level. Overlords compete with overlords, demigods compete with demigods, and true gods compete with true gods. Your Green Dragon has that skill. Coupled with enough faith power, it's almost invincible at the demigod level…"
"Well… Let me see when the time comes," Shi Yu said.
As the two of them chatted, the sky suddenly seemed to darken.
A huge super cosmic battleship descended from the starry sky with a spatial ripple.

chapters.title: Chapter 1398 Universe Overlord Army is Here (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1398 Universe Overlord Army is Here (2)
The appearance of the battleship attracted the gazes of everyone in the Four Holy Ancient City, making the expressions of the humans and the cosmic creatures that were evolving towards the four saints solemn.
Boom.
The battleship landed, and the shocking commotion disturbed many people. The way it arrived was extremely arrogant, but no one dared to show a dissatisfied expression.
"Ah, this." Lin Feng's expression also became serious. "Why are they here this time?"
"This is…" Shi Yu saw the symbol on the huge cosmic battleship.
It was a black bullhead symbol with a pair of demonic bull horns. It was very oppressive.
It was the cosmic army of a universe overlord…
"It's the universe overlord army," Lin Feng said. "I wonder which super divine general under the universe overlord led the army…"
"What are they doing here?" Shi Yu said.
Lin Feng said, "It's possible that it's also for the transaction. Of course, the most likely is to crack the Four Saints Ruins. The cosmic overlord army has always been very interested in the Era Ruins…"
"The Four Holy Ruins are very ancient Elder Gu and have appeared long ago. It shouldn't be their first time here, but in the past, cracking the Four Holy Ruins should have ended in failure. They might have new methods this time."
"Don't worry about them. As long as you don't take the initiative to provoke them, they won't dare to act recklessly on World King Planet," Lin Feng said.
Shi Yu nodded. If only they were here to trade. He happened to want to buy a few planets from the cosmic overlord army…
And if they were here for the Four Holy Ruins… Shi Yu could only say that it was fine as long as they were happy.
In any case, he had no intention of coveting this Four Saints Ruins…
Cough, not at all. That was impossible. However, Shi Yu knew that the chances of him cracking this ruin weren't high.
According to Senior Lin Feng, this ruin came from the previous cosmic era. It was the Four Saints Ancient Battlefield established by the subordinates of four cosmic gods.
The Green Dragon, the White Tiger, the Vermillion Bird, and the Black Tortoise were the four Cosmos Gods of the previous cosmic era. In terms of strength, they were believed to be comparable to the Dark King, the Worm Queen, the World King, and the Beastmaster of the current era. They gathered the faith of the entire universe.
However, it wasn't because the entire universe believed in them that they were powerful, but because they were strong enough, so they obtained the faith of the entire universe.
Therefore, with such a huge amount of power of faith, the four Cosmos Gods themselves were actually not very useful. Regardless of whether they had it or not, they were also invincible. They had long stood at the peak of the universe.
However, the power of faith was indeed a pretty good power system. According to the archeological discoveries of archeologists in this era, the four holy beasts liked to turn these useless powers of faith into rewards for their followers.
Among them, the Four Saints Battlefield was established by the subordinates of the four holy beasts in this context. It was a battlefield facing the four factions of the Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise.
On the battlefield, the people who entered could represent the Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise to fight. The winner could split the power of faith stored in the Four Saint Ruins.
This was an inherent mechanism left behind in the ruins of the era.
As for the other mechanisms, no one knew. Apart from understanding this mechanism, no one could crack the other functions of this era's ruins, nor could anyone become the owner of this era's ruins.
Slowly, the Four Saints Ruins were jointly occupied by the archeological association of the World King Planet and some evolvers of the Four Saints, becoming the current event model.
Any evolver of the Four Holy Ruins could come here to compete for the power of faith at a certain price during the opening of the Four Holy Ruins.
In the Four Saints Ruins, the power of faith of the Four Saints was very huge. Until now, one couldn't see the depth. This was also normal. After all, the Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise were universe gods from the last era and had obtained the faith of all the creatures in the universe. Even if the power of faith condensed in such a context was only an insignificant small portion, it could still stuff a divine level to death.
Because of this, the World King Planet archeological association, including the army of a universe overlord, and some four holy families had always wanted to crack this ruin. Whoever could become the owner of this ruin could obtain a huge amount of power of faith and be invincible.
If the master of the ruins was a believer in the Four Saints and could still mobilize this power of faith, then even if the master of the ruins was only at the divine level, it was enough to fight at a super divine level with such a huge power of faith, making super divine lives tremble in fear.
If a super divine level became the master of the ruins, he would probably instantly become the first-tier expert below the Cosmos God level.
How could Shi Yu, who was in urgent need of the power of faith, not covet such a ruin? If he could become the owner of this ruin, he would probably not lack the power of faith for the rest of his life.
The power of faith that was passed down to the highest era was much purer and stronger than the power of faith condensed in this era.
At that time, even if he was still a demigod, he should be able to become an expert in the first tier below the super divine level. His strength wouldn't be inferior to the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the others.
Of course, Shi Yu was only thinking about it. After all, if he wanted to become the owner of the ruins of the Four Holy Ruins, he would probably offend a large number of people, making all the evolvers of the Four Holy Ruins want to skin him, Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others.
It was really hard to say if it could resist these covetous eyes with the increase in strength brought by becoming the owner of the ruins.
"Let's go, let's go," Lin Feng said to Shi Yu as the cosmic battleship landed in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1399 The Universe Overlord Army is Here (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1399 The Universe Overlord Army is Here (3)
"Alright." Shi Yu nodded.
Then, Lin Feng brought Shi Yu to an ancient residence with the Green Dragon and the White Tiger on the left in front of the door. Then, he directly slipped away, leaving Shi Yu in deep thought.
Senior Lin Feng really didn't want to stay with him for another minute.
He was such a genius and outstanding. Shouldn't he be liked by the seniors?
"Senior Lin Feng is indeed unreliable. No wonder Senior Divine Source doesn't like him," Shi Yu muttered.
Ling: "It's already very good that Senior Lin Feng can give you a chance to participate in the Four Saints Meeting…"
"Cough, cough, I know."
"Forget about him. Let's hurry up and buy the evolution resources of Little Quas, Turtle, and Shorty," Ling said.
"Alright, alright." Shi Yu shrugged.
He would go buy evolution resources for Little Quas, Turtle, and Shorty.
At the moment, the cultivation of Little Quas, Turtle, and Shorty had already reached the extreme of the monarch level.
Even the overlord's will had already been obtained under the training of points. It could be considered to have the initial foundation of evolution.
When Buggy evolved into the Green Dragon, it only had one more Green Dragon Domain than them.
Shi Yu originally wanted to let them complete the evolution of the Black Tortoise and the White Tiger before coming here.
However, after asking around a little, he discovered that there would be many accompanying evolution resources in the Four Saints Meeting that were specially targeted at the Four Holy Beasts.
In that case, Shi Yu gave up on the thought of blindly letting them evolve. He planned to come here to purchase some before helping them evolve.
…
In the ancient residence Lin Feng had found, Shi Yu yawned and summoned all his pets except Qi, Baby Ginseng, and Susu.
Qi appeared because it wasn't suitable to appear. If it was captured by the universe overlord army, who could Shi Yu reason with?
As for Baby Ginseng and Susu, they still had to work to support their entire family, so they stayed obediently in the Beast Taming Space.
"You guys walk around."
"Ling, you're in charge of buying the evolution resources of Little Quas, Turtle, and Duckie. Prepare the evolution plan."
"Yes, Master," Ling said. "What about you?"
"Rest?"
"Of course." Shi Yu chuckled and said, "I'm so tired from teleportation in several realms. I'm going to lie down for a while. Just call me if you need anything. In any case, the Four Holy Ancient City isn't very big. My telepathy can cover the entire range."
"This is basically equivalent to going with you."
"Alright." Ling nodded helplessly and looked at Little Quas, Turtle, and Shorty. "The three of you, come with me to buy evolution resources."
"Buggy, Chi Tong, you guys come too."
"I also have to find epoch faith items to learn 'Faith Overdraft' for Buggy and prepare some faith items for Chi Tong to use in battle."
"Alright~" Buggy and Chi Tong expressed their understanding. They liked shopping.
"Wuu." Eleven felt that it had nothing to do. It looked at Shi Yu and asked if he needed a health massage.
"What's that?" Shi Yu asked.
"Wu wu wu." Eleven raised its arms, and eight Armored Bean Bears appeared behind it.
It had just developed a way to nourish a fixed target through the eight trigrams clone massage.
"Emmm…" Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
Taiji and gossip… did seem to have the ability to nourish one's health?
"Uh, let's give it a try," Shi Yu said.
"Quack!!" "Roar!!"
"Mi~"
Duckie, Little Ji, and Little Zi thought for a moment and didn't join in the fun. They also chose to stay and planned to accompany Qi to play in the Beast Taming Space.
At this point, the allocation of the team's quests was completed. Ling and the others brought all their assets and ran to buy faith items and evolution resources. Eleven massaged the Beast Tamer at home, and Baby Ginseng and Susu continued to earn money. As for Qi, Little Ji, Duckie, and Little Zi, they played mahjong in the Beast Taming Space.
"Let's go." The sword spirit Chi Tong turned into the form of the big sister in black, the Death Sword Maiden. The Vermillion Bird clone landed on its shoulder, and the excited Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty followed behind.
Buggy maintained the form of a Green Silkworm and mixed in with the second team. As for Ling, it maintained the form of a "battleship figurine" and a "mini battleship" and floated beside them like a toy.
A team of people started to go out to shop, leaving nine pandas behind to massage Shi Yu, who was lying down.
"Ah, ah, be gentle…" A moment later, Shi Yu let out a painful wail. Fire, water, lightning, and various powers surged towards his body, making Shi Yu curse.
Was this a health massage? This was obviously training his body!
…
On the other side of the Four Holy Ancient City, after the battleship of the cosmic overlord army landed, the stairs that connected the battleship to the ground also descended.
A team of 20 humanoid cosmic life forms made of divine levels with different forms and wearing white standard battle suits immediately walked out of two rows and stood to welcome the big shots behind.
A moment later, a purple-haired girl in the same battle suit with a purple pattern slowly walked down from the cosmic battleship under the protection of the two top-notch gods.
At this moment, a large number of cosmic life forms from various realms and planets were gathered around. There were overlords, demigods, and divine-levels. There was a sea of people, but when they encountered the descent of the cosmic overlord army, no matter where they came from, even the descendants of super divines dodged the guys who came out of the battleship like they were dodging the plague.
In the universe, the cosmic overlord army was the endorsement of hooligans. No one dared to provoke it.
"Lord Zijian, it's not time for the Four Saint Ruins to open yet. Where are we going next?" The two top-notch gods asked the girl respectfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 1400 The Universe Overlord Army is Here (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1400 The Universe Overlord Army is Here (4)
"Let's take a look around first." The purple-haired girl, who looked to be no more than fifteen or sixteen years old, looked around and said, "Before entering the ruins, I want to familiarize myself with the environment."
"Yes." The two top-notch divine subordinates nodded and listened to the girl.
They had thin, red humanoid bodies and long antennae. Everyone present recognized their race.
"Darekians" were one of the lackey races of the cosmic overlords, with incredibly formidable combat prowess.
Then, they directly entered the Four Holy Ancient City. After they left, the surrounding people panted and communicated softly.
"What's wrong with that human girl? Is she some big shot? She can actually let a top-notch god be her sidekick. Unbelievable."
"Look at her clothes. It's a purple pattern. Of course she's a big shot."
From the battlesuit of the cosmic overlord army, one could see the level of each member inside. According to red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, red was the lowest, and purple was the highest. Generally speaking, the purple-striped battle suit basically represented… super divine level!
Even the two aliens who revealed their top-notch divine aura were only wearing green battle suits. Who was that girl? It immediately triggered a serious discussion among everyone present.
Obviously, that girl didn't match any super divine-level big boss that many people knew. Then, there was only one possibility. She didn't obtain an extremely high status in the universe overlord army through battle, but through other fields, she made her value comparable to a super divine level in the universe overlord army.
"I've heard of it." In the crowd, an old man in the form of a Green Dragonman pondered and said, "That girl should have come to World King Planet in the past two years. She's one of the top archeologists in the cosmic overlord army. 200 years ago, she explored various era ruins for the cosmic overlords outside the Cosmic Sea. She's very active and has the results of cracking many era's ruins…"
"I heard that her arrival made the World King Planet archeological association extremely serious and nervous. I didn't expect that her first stop when she came to the World King Planet was to come to the Four Holy Ruins…"
"What?" Upon hearing the Green Dragonman elder's words, the surrounding people were slightly shocked. He had such a powerful background?
"The archeologists of the cosmic overlord army stationed on World King Planet have been suppressed by the World King Planet's archeological association for many years in cracking the ruins. Looks like they invited a great god over this time…" Someone analyzed.
"In that case, big shots will also come to the World King Planet archeological association to restrict the archeologists of this cosmic overlord army, right?"
"It's hard to say, it's hard to say… The Four Saint Ruins can't be cracked just because we want to, nor can we stop others from cracking it with restrictions. The information we understand about this ruin isn't enough at all."
Zi Jian, a human, 207 years old, a top-notch archeologist of the universe overlord army. She had the battle record of cracking four era ruins and obtained a source of transcendence, adding a new super divine general to the universe overlord army.
She had an extremely high status in the cosmic overlord army.
It could be said that her archeological talent was already at the top of the starry sky. However, the moment Zi Jian stepped into the Four Holy Ancient City, a surprised expression appeared on her beautiful face, and her footsteps subconsciously stopped.
"What's wrong, Lord Zijian?" asked the surrounding guards when they saw this.
"It's nothing. I just didn't expect that there was an expert in this city who was quite powerful. No wonder your people encountered obstacles everywhere on World King Planet and couldn't even take a few era ruins," Zi Jian said.
"This…" The two top-notch divine star people were speechless.
"Then will there be any accidents when cracking the Four Saints Ruins this time… Do we need to do anything?"
Zi Jian shook her head and said, "No need. To you, he's an expert, but in my opinion, he's just a newbie who has just entered the sect. Don't worry about him. Let's go."
At the same time.
Shi Yu, whose eyes were half-closed as he enjoyed the massage, suddenly opened his eyes. He suddenly felt a little uneasy. He felt that the ruins detection function in the Passage of Time skill taught by Emperor Shi seemed to be suppressed, making it difficult for him to breathe.
"What's going on?" Shi Yu looked outside solemnly. The nine pandas also stopped the massage in their hands and watched eagerly.
"Damn, there's a monster," Shi Yu said. "My ruins detection ability is blocked."
"Wu wu wu." Eleven was surprised. Wasn't that taught by Senior Emperor Shi? Senior Emperor Shi was so weak!
Shi Yu looked at Eleven. Very good, he actually didn't say that his Beast Tamer was very lousy. This kid was worth teaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 1401 Birth of the Black Tortoise (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1401 Birth of the Black Tortoise (1)
Four Holy Ancient City.
On the transaction street, Chi Tong and the others, who were shopping, went pretty smoothly.
What they needed were ordinary faith items from the Four Holy Beasts that contained the power of faith. The evolution resources of the four holy beasts were everything here.
With Shi Yu's current wealth, buying these wasn't a problem.
The only thing that might make things a little difficult for Shi Yu and the others was the faith item of the era.
This thing was really expensive. However, Shi Yu and the others had proven through experiments that Buggy couldn't avoid this if it wanted to learn Faith Overdraft.
"Black Tortoise evolution resource, purchase completed."
"White Tiger evolution resource, purchase completed."
"Vermillion Bird faith item, purchase completed."
"Alright, we're just short of the faith item of the Epoch Green Dragon."
After spending a sum of money relatively easily, Ling, Chi Tong, and the others were stumped by Buggy's resources.
The remaining energy crystals were definitely not enough to buy an era faith item.
They could only try to barter.
But the problem was that there was no chance to barter for them. The faith items of the era weren't sold in ordinary places at all.
Such a scarce resource might only be seen in the next large-scale auction.
At that time, it would be impossible to use a bunch of messy resources to bid.
Therefore, they could only throw the goods they had prepared to sell into the auction in advance or sell them to others in advance in exchange for universal currency.
At the thought of this, they went straight to the largest auction in the Four Holy Ancient City.
However, during the process of heading there, they were suddenly attracted by the exchange of passers-by.
"The merchant group of the cosmic overlord army… has also started the transaction?"
In the room, Shi Yu, who was still enjoying Eleven's massage, fell into deep thought when he heard the pets' report.
After the cosmic overlord army descended, the accompanying merchant group immediately occupied a place in the Four Holy Ancient City and started trading.
They were buying rare treasures at a price that far exceeded the market price. At the same time, they were also selling some goods unique to the universe overlord army.
A large number of Beast Tamers and cosmic life forms had already swarmed over. Although the cosmic overlord army was terrifying, its reputation was pretty good in transactions.
Chi Tong and the others meant to go there and see if they could sell the Reincarnation Fruit and the Cultivation Fruit to the merchant group of the cosmic overlord army. Then, they could see if there were any planets to buy.
"Well… Let's go take a look," Shi Yu said.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Chi Tong, Ling, Buggy, and the others immediately headed in the direction of the merchant group of the cosmic overlord army.
At this moment, a town in a city had already been instantly built around the huge cosmic battleship. There were dozens of shops, allowing the merchant group of the cosmic overlord army to do business here in peace.
Just as they arrived, the worries in Chi Tong and the others were dispelled. This was because there was an endless stream of people coming here. Many Beast Tamers and evolvers of the Four Holy Beasts rushed in.
A moment later, Chi Tong and the others brought a group of babies to a relatively small store. After queuing for a while, they successfully entered.
The businessman inside was a standing starry sky octopus with eyes. Chi Tong, Ling, and the others called him the Octopus Star Man for the time being.
"What do you want to buy and sell?" The Octopus Star Man looked at the mini battleship beside him and the pile of babies in the Death Sword Maiden, Chi Tong's hand.
"Are you selling planets here? What about the Epoch Green Dragon's faith items," Ling asked.
"Oh, you want to buy a planet? The faith item of the Epoch Green Dragon?" The Octopus Star person revealed a surprised expression and looked at Ling.
"These are all rare goods. Even we didn't bring much this time."
Chi Tong and Ling were delighted. There were really both.
"We want to take a look."
"Sure." The Octopus Star person chuckled and took out a virtual mechanical life form. The screen turned and aimed at Chi Tong and the others.
"We only sell top-notch planets. There are only four planet goods this time. It's first come, first served. It's now or never."
"As for the faith items of the Epoch Green Dragon, the Vermillion Bird, the Black Tortoise, and the White Tiger, it's also now or never."
"Take a look yourselves."
With that said, the screen displayed the pictures and small text introduction of the 12 goods.
Four planets, one red, one white, one blue, and one green.
The eight faith items had strange forms. There were complete statues and scattered materials, such as dragon scales, sparrow feathers, and turtle shells…
"Daylight robbery!" Buggy also climbed onto Chi Tong's shoulder and looked at the epoch faith item priced at 9,999 divine-level energy crystals. It was stunned.
Even if 10 idiots fought for the epoch faith item at the Four Holy Ancient City Auction, it was impossible for it to be so expensive.
The Octopus Star Man said, "This can be ignored. Our army doesn't lack energy crystals. Such rare goods only accept bartering, so you just have to take out treasures we think are equivalent."
"Including buying a planet."
"After you take it out, I'll appraise the rarity of the treasure. Then, I'll report to my superiors if you want to trade."
"Of course, if you're willing to trade with priced energy crystals, we also accept…"
Chi Tong and the others were silent. They looked at the 12 goods with ridiculous prices and fell into deep thought.
Putting aside the items of faith, there were four planets, a fire planet, a space planet, a water planet, and a wood planet.
Among them, the space planet was the largest, and its interior was the most stable. The spatial power was strong.
Although the other planets were smaller, they also had their own uses. For example, that wood-element planet used its power as a farm. It was enough to nurture super divine-level plant resources.

chapters.title: Chapter 1402 Birth of the Black Tortoise (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1402 Birth of the Black Tortoise (2)
Ling fell into deep thought. Then, it took out the inheritance crystal made of the Reincarnation Fruit, the Cultivation Fruit, and the inheritance water droplet.
"Let me see." The Octopus Star person first looked at the inheritance crystal that it could determine at a glance and said, "Oh? An inheritance tool that contains the prototype of the Destruction Law?"
It was slightly surprised and said, "It's indeed a good thing, but this thing isn't very useful to us. It's not very rare."
"We have many inheritance crystals, including blank inheritance crystal balls," Ling said.
The Octopus Star person was also silent for a moment. Then, it nodded and said, "Alright, let's look at other things first."
It looked at the Cultivation Fruit and the Reincarnation Fruit and said, "What are these? I can't tell."
"This is the Effect Appraisal Certificate of the plant association." Chi Tong took out the Effect Appraisal Certificate of the Reincarnation Fruit and the Cultivation Fruit. The originally indifferent Octopus Star Man's gaze finally changed after seeing the effect of the Reincarnation Fruit.
The power of the Time Fruit and the power of reincarnation awakened the multiple effects of the power of its previous life, making it think of the three-lifetime soil of the super divine resource.
The three-lifetime soil was said to be a super divine resource that could allow the user to obtain the power of their previous life, the peak power of the present, and the power of future reincarnation. Moreover, it was permanent. Although this Reincarnation Fruit was temporary, it was enough to be called a low-level three lifetimes soil. In its opinion, the rarity was much higher than the inheritance crystal ball.
They were part of Lord Zijian's archeological army and often explored dangerous ruins. This Reincarnation Fruit that was enough to protect their lives was more meaningful. Secondly, in some ancient ruins, they often excavated some ancient creatures that used their sleeping and reincarnation abilities to maintain their lives. With this fruit, the efficiency of researching them would be higher.
"How many of these do you have?" the Octopus Star person asked.
"Not much. This is very rare. We also accidentally obtained some," Ling said. "10 Reincarnation Fruits, 10 Cultivation Fruits, and a pile of inheritance crystals in exchange for an era faith item and a planet."
The Octopus Star Man said, "In your dreams!"
Ling, Chi Tong, Buggy: "…"
Damn it.
Ling said, "We can still add some divine-level energy crystals. Why don't you ask your superiors? What if they agree?"
The Octopus Star person also knew that it had to ask for instructions to discover rare resources. It looked at the divine-level Cultivation Fruit again and realized that it could actually be used by humans. It was slightly tempted.
Lord Zijian had less cultivation time. It was either on the archeological path or sleeping in the nutritional cabin on the trip. Although this mainly had an obvious effect at Level 9, it wasn't entirely ineffective at Level 10. If the amount was large enough, perhaps Lord Zijian would like it.
"Wait a minute." The octopus turned around and returned to the room.
At the same time.
On a tall building not far from the entrance of the unopened Four Holy Ruins, the archeologist of the cosmic overlord army, Zi Jian, was sitting on it, shaking her legs and looking at the empty sky with a burning gaze.
In the eyes of outsiders, there was nothing. However, in her eyes, it was as if she could see an alternate space connected by countless spatial threads, or as if she could see a cosmic chessboard. The aftermath was difficult to solve.
Her hand touched the sky and kept changing like a net. The surrounding spatial ripples flickered. In the end, she sighed and said, "No wonder no one has been able to crack it for so long. It's indeed a little difficult. Before the ruins opened, I couldn't find the loophole in this ruin either."
"Lord Zijian, two rare divine-level resources that we've never seen before were discovered by the merchant group. The other party wants to use these to exchange for planets and epoch faith items. You need to decide," a Darekian said.
"What resource?" the purple-haired girl asked. In the next moment, she obtained information about Reincarnation Fruit and the Cultivation Fruit from the guard. When she heard the effect of the Reincarnation Fruit, she only nodded slightly. However, after hearing the effect of the Cultivation Fruit, her eyes lit up.
The Cultivation Fruit could allow a Level 10 user to automatically meditate and cultivate during the sleeping process to develop their Beast Taming Ability and Beast Taming Space. The cultivation speed, depending on the user's level and talent, was 1 to 100 times faster than normal sober cultivation. There were no side effects, and the effect was best when used in a weak state. The fruit was a little strange.
"There's such a resource?" The purple-haired girl was surprised. In the eyes of ordinary people, this resource might be very useless. Who didn't know how to meditate, cultivate, and develop talent? Spending a lot of money to buy the automatic Cultivation Fruit was simply wasteful behavior.
However, for geniuses who were nervous for some time and wanted to become stronger quickly and grasp every minute and second, this fruit that could automatically cultivate while sleeping could ensure that they could cultivate without rest and maximize their cultivation efficiency.
Of course, she found this fruit interesting purely because she was busy with work and didn't have much time to meditate and cultivate to develop additional abilities other than cracking ruins.
As cracking the ruins consumed a lot of energy, when the battleship traversed the universe, she basically slept in the nutritional cabin to recover her state. She basically wasted her time.
It could be said that she was in her 200s and had spent at least 180 years sleeping on interstellar travel.
This Cultivation Fruit was simply tailor-made for her. The effect of the weak state was actually better. Amazing!
"It doesn't matter. Exchange it for them," Zi Jian said. She wanted to try the effect of this Cultivation Fruit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1403 Birth of the Black Tortoise (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1403 Birth of the Black Tortoise (3)
If the effect was good, she could take one to the plant-type super divine life form in the army and help the other party nurture more and modify and upgrade it.
As for a planet and an epoch faith item? It was indeed a very rare thing for ordinary divine-levels.
But to her, it was no different from trash. As long as she was happy, she could give it away.
"Yes." The Darekians nodded.
In the store, after the Octopus Star person came out, he conveyed his superior's intention.
"It can be traded," the Octopus Star Man said.
As soon as it finished speaking, Ling, Chi Tong, Buggy, and the others immediately found it unbelievable. Was this the universe overlord army? So heroic, much more generous than the plant association.
If they had known earlier that the universe overlord army would come, why would they have sold the items to the plant association? It would have been better to use them all to trade with the universe overlord army.
The plant association was so poor!
…
Next, Chi Tong and the others could be said to have returned with a load. Apart from an era faith item that looked like a green dragon scale, there was also a huge space planet.
This planet was stored in an equipment called Planet Stone. Layers of nesting dolls were equipment unique to the universe overlord army to store planets.
Planets were bought for Qi.
Qi was a Space-time Sprite and basically didn't have much battle power. With this space planet, after refining it into arms, it could have initial self-protection abilities.
This star's quality wasn't low. If it could nurture life, it would at least be an intermediate star, and it was a rare space planet. Ling and the others also firmly locked onto this and didn't let go.
As it was something his superior had specifically asked for, the Octopus Star people could only carry out the transaction.
In the ancient residence, Shi Yu and the others were extremely happy after bringing back a pile of gains.
After defeating Little Ji, Duckie, and Little Zi several times at cards, it was also extremely surprised. It didn't expect that everyone could buy it a planet when they went out to shop.
"Qi, there's no hurry to teach you the Star Refinement skill. This planet can't be released here."
"Let's evolve Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty first," Shi Yu said.
Apart from buying planets and epoch faith items, he had also bought evolution resources.
"Yes!!" Qi wasn't in a hurry. It also knew that it would take a long time to add points to the maximum level of the Star Refinement skill.
In Little Zi's body, the world of stars.
Shi Yu prepared to complete the evolution of Turtle and Little Quas first.
At this moment, Turtle and Little Quas' stats were as follows.
[Turtle]
Stats: Water
Race: Longevity Turtle
Race Level: High-level Monarch
Growth Level: Monarch Level
[Race Skill]
"Low Level": Spin Impact (Dao Proficiency)
"Super Level": Water of Life (expert+11), Water Element Control (expert+11)
[Taught Skill]
"Advanced Level": Deterrence (Dao Proficiency)
"Super Level": Black Tortoise Fusion Technique (transcendent)
…
[Little Quas]
Stats: Water, Quas
Race: Winter Water Snake
Race Level: Low-level overlord
Growth Level: Monarch Level
[Race Skill]
"Super Level": Water/Quasi Elemental Control (expert+11), Absolute Zero (expert+11), Vortex Strangulation (expert+11)
[Taught Skill]
"Advanced Level": Deterrence (Dao Proficiency)
"Super Level": Black Tortoise Fusion Technique (transcendent)
Shi Yu had basically fused all their skills, leaving only the temporary fusion evolution skill, Water/Quasi Elemental Control, and the Turtle Snake Fusion Technique he had obtained from Emperor Wu.
Oh, the turtle even retained the elemental skill, Turtle Ramming.
Of course, although they had learned the transcendent Black Tortoise Fusion Technique, Turtle and Little Quas had never used it…
But today, driven by the evolution trend, they were finally going to make their first attempt.
"Wu…" Shorty stared intently, afraid that it would miss any details. The other pets also ran over to help, wanting to see what potential the little guys of the second team had after evolution.
"In theory, this is only your first evolution. There's no need to be nervous," Shi Yu said. "This is only a fusion evolution completed on the foundation of the Longevity Turtle and the Winter Water Snake. In the future, you can still complete the evolution alone on the foundation of the Longevity Turtle and the Winter Water Snake. Then, right on the heels of that, you can fuse and evolve. At that time, the evolution state will be stronger."
"Lord!!" The turtle had a serious expression.
It would never forget today's kindness!
Not only could it become stronger, but it could also… It looked at Little Quas and could also stick to it.
This was simply like a dream.
"Minister, I'm ready." Little Quas was also in a strange mood and was already mentally prepared.
"Alright." Shi Yu took a deep breath and directly activated the Taiji Domain.
The Black Tortoise Fusion Technique created by Emperor Wu secretly matched the Yin Yang Great Dao.
The Taiji Domain that contained the Yin Yang laws could clearly increase their evolution to a certain extent.
In the Yin Yang Taiji Domain, Turtle and Little Quas looked at each other.
"Resources!" Ling threw out the purchased evolution resources.
Divine-level resources, the Longevity Bead, such as the Eternal Flower that Shi Yu had consumed, could strengthen Enhancement life forms. They came from the Undying Shell of the Star God Race.
Divine-level resources, the Water Calming Divine Stone, could control the power of divine water. It contained the law of suppression and was mainly the power of suppression.
Divine-level resources, the Imperial Star Soul, contained the power of the stars. The Imperial Law came from a low-level life star. It was mainly defensive power and was one of the few water-element stars with the strongest defense.
In addition, the Turtle Snake Fusion Technique from Emperor Wu, the pile of Black Tortoise faith items brought from Blue Planet, as well as the divine-level fruits and divine-level energy crystals created by Baby Ginseng and Susu…

chapters.title: Chapter 1404 Birth of the Black Tortoise (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1404 Birth of the Black Tortoise (4)
It was almost all the evolution resources of Little Quas and Turtle.
It wasn't that Shi Yu couldn't afford more resources, but they were still too weak. This was only their first evolution. Even if they were given super divine-level resources, they wouldn't be able to withstand it.
This was already the limit of their potential transformation capacity, based on what Ling had deduced.
In the next moment, Little Quas swallowed the Longevity Bead. Turtle swallowed the Water Stabilization Divine Stone. At the same time, the Imperial Star Soul attached to its body. Right on the heels of that, as the will of the world, Little Zi mobilized the power of faith of the Black Tortoise to bless Little Quas and the turtle.
On Blue Planet, Shi Yu used the power of faith of the Green Dragon and the Vermillion Bird more. For example, he basically didn't touch the faith items of the Black Tortoise and the White Tiger. At the moment, it was just nice to leave it for Turtle and the others to evolve.
Boom!!
After devouring divine-level resources, Turtle and Little Quas directly activated the Black Tortoise Fusion Technique and fused. Both parties instantly turned into a white and blue light, and an ice-blue light shot into the air with a whoosh and fused.
At the same time, two Yin Yang fish, one black and one white, appeared in the Taiji Domain and wrapped around them, instantly dyeing the blue light with a layer of black.
"Gulp." Shorty sensed the huge aura of Turtle and Little Quas after fusing and looked forward to its evolution. It was very looking forward to it. After all, Eleven had helped it build a set of battle armor for its evolution!
"Roar!!!" During the evolution of Little Quas and Turtle, Buggy couldn't help but roar. The new generation surpassed the old. It knew that the later evolution was beneficial. Look, a pile of divine-level resources and almost all the faith items had been used. After this evolution, its strength definitely couldn't be bad.
Eleven and the other pets also watched their unscientific evolution eagerly.
As for why it was unscientific…
[Little Quas, from today onwards, I'll protect you. Whoever wants to hurt the lord and you will have to shatter my shell first!]
[Speaking of which, should I go down there?]
During evolution, Turtle confessed deeply.
[You're the Turtle Prime Minister. You're standing on two legs. Why are you going down?] Little Quas couldn't help but teach it a lesson.
Indeed, at this moment, as the evolution progressed, Shi Yu realized that although he had already worked very hard to pursue a traditional appearance, there were still some deviations from the evolution. The Turtle Prime Minister Race was a standing turtle. This caused the evolved Black Tortoise to still have a standing appearance.
Boom!!!
Energy Points: 811 million!
Under Ling's detection, they had just fused and evolved to the overlord level, and their energy levels were comparable to top-notch totems. They were far stronger than Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others at the overlord level.
"Holy shit!!" Although the appearance outlined in the light was a little strange, after sensing that the life fluctuations of Turtle and Little Quas had fused into one and erupted with super potential, Shi Yu knew that the evolution was successful.
So be it if its appearance was strange, as long as it was strong!
A moment later, accompanied by a wave roar, a divine beast with a Taiji Painting-like back wrapped around and fused with a white snake. The snake head and the huge turtle's head stood side by side, and the huge black shell turtle was born.
Boom!!
The huge turtle smashed its fists, and waves splashed in all directions with a domineering expression.
"Lord! I'm invincible!" Turtle's appearance looked much fiercer, and it was no longer that silly blue turtle.
At the same time, because of the fusion and evolution, new skills were born in the new Black Tortoise.
This time, they added three new skills.
What made Shi Yu feel like shit was that these three skills were actually all quasi-divine faith skills. This… was simply the first time.
Even when the first team evolved, they weren't as fierce as them. Was this the charm of fusion evolution?
On average, 1.5 per person seemed to be alright.
"Ling, record the skill," Shi Yu said.
"Yes!"
