First, [Name]: Black Tortoise Divine Power
[Stats]: Water
< Introduction > It's a quasi-divine-level faith skill. It can reverse Yin and Yang and be born from death. It can transform negative damage into its own life force or condense into a source of life for the believer.
This was a skill similar to the Undying Golden Body, but this skill was stronger. The Black Tortoise could share the life force it obtained with others. This was definitely another powerful healer after Baby Ginseng. Shi Yu was very satisfied.
Second, [Name]: Dark North Shield
[Attributes]: Water, Space
< Introduction > It's a quasi-divine-level faith skill. It's the strongest defense. It can condense the Dark North Shield to help oneself or the target of protection avoid injuries. The highest it can achieve is absolute defense.
This skill also made Shi Yu involuntarily praise it. This was an extreme defense skill. As long as there was enough power of faith, even at the demigod level, it could defend against a super divine attack. If it was combined with Faith Overdraft, it could be considered the strongest defense in Shi Yu's team.
Third, [Name]: Seal of Sea Suppression
[Stats]: Water, Ice, Spirit
< Introduction > It's a quasi-divine-level faith skill. It can condense a huge snake-striped shell mark. The divine seal doesn't have any attack ability, but it can suppress all violent phenomena and calm them down.
The last skill exceeded Shi Yu's expectations. To Shi Yu's surprise, his Black Tortoise looked extremely ferocious, but the three skills were all support-type faith skills.
However, the Sea Suppressing Seal didn't look like it had the ability to attack, but in the face of ferocious moves, it seemed to be more useful than any attack move. It was also the use of the power of laws. Was the power of the abyss violent? It could still be suppressed. Was Baby Ginseng's self-destruction violent? If it calmed down, it might not necessarily have much power.
The power of a cosmic disaster was undoubtedly more violent, but perhaps this skill could also suppress it. This skill had extraordinary meaning. This seemed to be a skill that had reached the extreme in a certain direction.
In Shi Yu's opinion, the three skills were all very fierce. However, if he wanted the Black Tortoise to have stronger battle power, it looked like he still had to go to the Four Saints Meeting to replicate a few attack skills.
"Master, Master." At this moment, the turtle was still waiting for Shi Yu's praise.
"Be quiet." Little Quas wrapped itself around the turtle and sensed its current strength. It took a deep breath and felt that it was unbelievable. However, it also looked at Shi Yu in anticipation, waiting for Shi Yu to praise their strength after evolution.
"It's indeed not bad. I look forward to your performance in the God Sealing Battle," Shi Yu said with a smile.
Now, he was certain that the second team could also be qualified to fight in the God Sealing Battle! As long as its skills were maxed out!
"Roar!!!" Little Ji and the other pets also nodded crazily. They also shared the Black Tortoise's skill through Shi Yu.
Not bad, not bad.
"When you train in the future, you can train Duckie to death. There's no need to be afraid of killing you," Duckie said. It felt a threat from the Black Tortoise.
Turtle, Little Quas:???
Shorty trembled at the side. Fortunately, its evolved skills were definitely not defensive. White Tiger, God of War, God of Slaughter, mainly killed and fought!! It was definitely not the target to be beaten up.
…
On the other side, in the battleship of the cosmic overlord army.
Zi Jian looked at the cultivation fruits served by his subordinate and took one. "This is the Cultivation Fruit."
"Yes, Lord Zijian, we've already verified it through the channels of the plant association. The effect of this fruit has indeed been appraised by the plant association, and the internal evaluation is quite high. You can eat it without worry."
"But the verification says that the fruit has a strong strange smell and requires extremely strong willpower to withstand it," an alien in a research suit said.
"It's alright."
The one Zi Jian was holding was created by Baby Ginseng early on and was kept to sell at the Four Saints Meeting. It was just that the taste was poor, but the smell didn't show. After Zi Jian held it in her hand, she wanted to immediately verify the effect of the Cultivation Fruit, so she simply took a big bite.
In the next moment.
"Ugh…" She leaned forward, her face turning white and purple, and she was instantly covered in sweat.
The stench that went deep into her soul made it a little difficult for her, a divine-level, to resist. She almost lost her composure.
"Lord Zijian, Lord Zijian… You… Are you alright…" The white-robed researcher was shocked.
"Damn it, is this for humans to eat???" said the purple-haired girl angrily.

chapters.title: Chapter 1405 Crooked Evolution (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1405 Crooked Evolution (1)
On Shi Yu's side, after evolving Turtle and Little Quas, Shi Yu discovered many unbelievable changes.
"Speaking of which, the two of you only seem to occupy one contract slot now. What's going on?"
Shi Yu felt that not only were the life forms of the current fused Little Quas and the Turtle completely a life individual, but even the contract slot requirement for the Beast Taming Space had only become one.
Even the skill index regarded the Black Tortoise as an individual at this moment. This made Shi Yu fall into deep thought. Then, did adding some skills now mean that adding it once was equivalent to upgrading the skills of both pets at the same time?
"Eh?" When Shi Yu said that, the other pets also discovered this strange phenomenon. They sized up Turtle and Little Quas.
After being observed by so many seniors, Turtle and Little Quas immediately felt embarrassed. They scratched their heads and said, "Perhaps this means that our evolution is more successful?"
"But their minds are still two independent individuals," Little Quas said.
"You guys split up and take a look," Shi Yu said. "Remove the fusion."
"Yes, my lord/minister."
After Shi Yu gave the order, Turtle and Little Quas directly separated. The originally fused Black Tortoise immediately divided into two. Both parties used the Black Tortoise Fusion Technique in reverse and immediately returned to the blue and white silly turtle and the blue and white queen snake form.
"Ah…" Turtle shouted. It felt that its strength had fallen very seriously, and it was weak.
"Wu…" Little Quas also felt its strength decrease. At the same time, it felt its connection with the turtle decrease.
Not only did they sense it, but Shi Yu also realized that after dispelling the fusion, the strength of both parties immediately became that of ordinary overlords. Although they still had the battle power of invincible overlords and had more than 100 million energy points, it was definitely impossible for them to have the battle power to suppress ordinary totems above their level like before.
"Faith skills… can't be used anymore, right?" Shi Yu said. He realized that Turtle and Little Quas had already recovered into a situation where two contract slots were needed.
Turtle and Little Quas nodded…
"Fusion evolution can be done this way…" He didn't know if he could use this bug to contract another pet.
After the contract was completed, what would the outcome be if they separated?
Shi Yu felt that the Beast Taming Space would be destroyed.
"Looks like those three powerful faith skills indeed have a price." Shi Yu nodded. The Black Tortoise divine power with the effect of reviving the dead, the strongest defense of the Dark North Shield, and the Sea Suppression Seal that could calm violent disasters… To be honest, Shi Yu felt that it was a little broken. Even if he used a lot of evolution resources, it was a little ridiculous for it to evolve to this extent.
But if it was the combination of two pets that could display such power, it was understandable.
"Then in the future, the two of you have to partner more. Of course, I'll also nurture your normal state next," Shi Yu said. The normal Turtle and Little Quas were the monarch races and overlord races. If they cultivated their normal states into top-notch god races before fusing, how strong would the Black Tortoise be?
This made Shi Yu feel that among the four holy beasts, the Black Tortoise was the one with the strongest battle power. However, among the various myths and legends he studied, there were also those who said that the Green Dragon was the strongest, those who said that the White Tiger was the strongest, and those who said that the Vermillion Bird was the strongest… Everyone was right.
Perhaps… the era ruins of the archeological Four Holy Beasts could one day let him find the answer to this question. Who had the strongest battle power among the Four Holy Beasts?
As Turtle and Little Quas nodded, Shi Yu also looked at Shorty and said, "Alright, it's your turn to evolve."
"Meow!!!" Shorty was eager to give it a try and couldn't wait anymore.
A faint "king" character was reflected in its sapphire-like dazzling eyes.
According to the normal trajectory, Shorty could only evolve with the levelless gem eye. At most, it would evolve into battle power like Teacher Ying. Shi Yu wasn't very satisfied.
Therefore, on Shorty, Shi Yu also practiced the dog gambling theory and fused its skills.
[Shorty]
Stats: Metal
Race: Treasure Hunting, Gem Cat (Treasure Hunting Cat and Gem Cat hybrid)
Race Level: High-level Monarch
Growth Level: Monarch Level
[Race Skill]
"Super Level": Metal Control (expert+11), Gem King Eye (expert+11)
This guy originally had the gem eye and the skill of deterrence, but under Shi Yu's fusion, it directly became Gem King Eye.
The Gem King Eye, a super deterrence and evolution skill, could vividly display the deterrence of a king through its eyes. At the same time, it could also absorb various gems to grow and evolve.
Compared to the levelless gem eye, the upper limit of the Gem King Eye was clearly higher. Even Eleven was a little envious of this skill. The word "king" could flicker in its eyes. So cool!
Unfortunately, it was a panda, not a gem cat. It couldn't learn this skill.
Shi Yu and the others bought an evolution resource outside for Shorty.
The growth-type divine-level resource, the Eye of the White Tiger, was actually a metal-element star core with a special nature. It could absorb the power of faith of the White Tiger and use it as a carrier to condense into a universal evolution resource suitable for tiger-type creatures to evolve into the White Tiger. It was very popular on the World King Planet. It was a research result discovered and obtained by a famous feeder on the World King Planet.
As long as it absorbed enough power of faith from the White Tiger, it could grow into a divine-level resource at most.
With this more suitable carrier to carry the power of faith, there was no need for Little Zi and Buggy to control the White Tiger power of faith on the faith items to directly bless Shorty. It could directly choose the evolution method that Shorty was most familiar with and most suitable for.

chapters.title: Chapter 1406 Crooked Evolution (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1406 Crooked Evolution (2)
Of course, apart from that, Shi Yu also had a platinum gem. This divine-level platinum gem came from Blue Planet and was obtained from Ancient God Golden Bull. It was born in a metal-element mineral vein under a battlefield and contained strong murderous power.
It was also brought over by Shi Yu, preparing to give it to Shorty as an evolution resource for the White Tiger. Apart from that, Shi Yu also got Eleven to create a battle armor for the Shorty that contained strong battle will and could increase the battle will.
It was forged with Metal Control, Superalloy, and many other methods to imitate the Battle God Body. Shi Yu's concept was that during the evolution process, Shorty could use Metal Control to fuse with this Battle God Armor with Eleven's cooperation and achieve an all-round increase. Not only did its eyes evolve, but its body also had to evolve.
Then, it was time for some general resources. These resources were definitely not as much as what Little Quas and Turtle had. After all, Shorty was only an individual. If there were too many resources, it wouldn't be good either. After all, evolution wasn't a one-time thing, but a long-term job.
"Meow!!!" Shorty put on the white-gold armor that Eleven had created. It was very malleable. This armor also had a pair of platinum wings and was very cool. If it weren't for the fact that Shorty was too small and short, it would definitely look majestic.
Right on the heels of that, Shorty looked at the White Tiger Eye that had condensed the core power of all the White Tiger faith items on Blue Planet and a platinum gem born under the battlefield of gods.
In ancient times, the Guardian Teacher of Ancient Capital University, Ying, had relied on the gem eye to absorb more than ten rare gemstones to complete the strongest evolution. Now, it, Shorty, had relied on the Gem King Eye to absorb two divine-level gemstones to evolve… It wasn't a problem.
If it was used to improve its strength, Shorty's body definitely wouldn't be able to withstand it. But now, it was basically no problem to only use it as an evolution resource to strengthen the potential of its race with the support of Shi Yu and the entire team.
"Gem King Eye, Metal Control, increase points!"
Shi Yu and Shorty entered a mental resonance state and began to add points.
Buzz!!!
At the same time, under the Metal Control of Shorty, the two gemstones slowly fused into its left and right eyes. In the next moment, an extremely strong deterrence erupted from its body. The powerful deterrence wave swept up killing intent and warpath, as if it was enough to deter totems!!
Boom!!
A dazzling platinum light completely enveloped Shorty.
Ling and the others watched intently. The White Tiger was a war god and also a god of killing. Eleven's battle armor provided the strengthening of battle will. The Platinum Pearl increased the strengthening of the killing power, and the White Tiger Eye, which had absorbed the power of faith, ensured that Shorty could successfully evolve into a White Tiger.
This was an evolution path that basically matched science. Under the light of evolution, Shorty was indeed as Shi Yu and the others had imagined. Its aura suddenly increased, and its body kept enlarging. Soon, it went from a shorty that was far from knee-high to a short tiger that was still not as tall as Shi Yu.
"Roar!!!" The roar of the hundred gods king surged out of the white light. The substantialized deterrence killing intent turned into a storm of light. Turtle and Little Quas swallowed their saliva. Only the two of them clearly felt deep fear.
The deterrence of Shorty was definitely extremely intimidating to those of the same level!
"This…" During the evolution process of Shorty, Shi Yu's expression changed again and again.
He was first happy, then puzzled.
He was happy that Shorty seemed to have succeeded in successfully fusing with the battle armor Eleven had given him. Although the thought didn't seem to be control, but to treasure the leader's gift well, it was good that it succeeded.
However, what made Shi Yu speechless was the skill that the short cat had awakened!
There were a total of four! Just like Turtle, Little Quas, and the others, they were all support skills!
Three super, two ordinary super, and one faith super.
The last was a quasi-divine-level faith skill.
The first ordinary super level, Killing Wind!
This was a dual-element skill of metal and wind. Eleven had once mastered it, but it was later fused. Perhaps it was because it had inherited Eleven's battle armor or because of the Platinum Pearl, but this skill was passed down to Shorty again.
Although this matched Shorty, it didn't receive Shi Yu's attention. It wasn't the powerful skill he was looking forward to.
The second skill, [Name]: White Tiger Demon
[Attributes]: Metal, Spirit
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > Every time you kill/defeat an enemy, your battle power, vitality, and spiritual power will receive a temporary increase without side effects. The stronger the enemy you kill/defeat, the greater the increase.
Shi Yu was quite satisfied with this ability. As expected of the White Tiger, it was a battle god and a killing god. This skill was too suitable for the battlefield.
Third Skill, [Name]: White Tiger Armor
[Attributes]: Metal
[Level]: Super faith skill
< Introduction > It can condense the White Tiger Armor that increases the enhancement attribute in all aspects through the power of faith. The stronger the power of faith, the stronger the increase!
Upon receiving this, Shi Yu could still accept it. Although there were no clear attack skills, it was still a system.
Deterrence and murderous wind reduced the enemy state. The White Tiger Evil killed weak enemies and strengthened itself. The White Tiger Armor strengthened itself to the limit. At this moment, it was a big move in a normal battle. It was enough to have the Metal Control to mainly kill.
However, what made Shi Yu's balls hurt the most was that the quasi-divine-level faith skill he looked forward to the most was completely an unexpected skill.
Fourth Skill, [Name]: Treasure Hunting White Tiger

chapters.title: Chapter 1407 Crooked Evolution (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1407 Crooked Evolution (3)
[Attributes]: Metal, Space
[Level]: Quasi Divine-level faith skill
< Introduction > It contains the mutated law of metal that has fused with the White Tiger's power of faith. It has the ability to sense rare treasures and can make one rich.
"This…" Shi Yu was at a loss. As the evolution light dissipated, a short White Tiger in platinum armor appeared. Although it looked impressive, it still looked like a fangirl when facing the seniors and the Beast Tamer.
"Meow!!!" Shorty wore majestic armor and flapped the platinum wings attached to the armor.
"This skill is good. In any case, no matter how hard I work, I can't surpass my seniors. Why don't I use this skill to help everyone earn money!" Shorty was very happy—even happier than when it awakened battle skills.
Shi Yu was speechless.
It made sense.
The cat brought in money indeed… Turtle, Little Quas, and the other pets had just seen Shorty's majestic evolution, but in the blink of an eye, they were also stunned. They didn't expect Shorty to actually evolve into a Treasure Hunting White Tiger.
Ridiculous…
Although Shorty was a hybrid of the Treasure Hunting Cat and the Gem Cat, the entire team didn't expect it to evolve into the Treasure Hunting White Tiger.
"As expected of the cat brought out by Teacher Ying…"
A team of pets pointed at it.
"White Tiger is the God of War and the God of Killing. It has many divine powers, such as Evil Avoidance, Disaster, Praying Abundance, Punishment, Promoting Good, Getting Rich, and Marriage." At this moment, Ling said, "Actually, it's already very perfect. At least, it didn't awaken any attack-type divine power."
"Becoming rich is what we lack."
"Yes." Shi Yu smiled. That made sense. If Shorty awakened any powerful battle abilities, it would really not be very useful. Even if it was to avoid evil, avoid disaster, and become rich, it wasn't as important as becoming rich to the current Shi Yu and the others.
Even a universe overlord was so passionate about doing business. Money was definitely a good thing.
Without money, it was too uncomfortable.
Attack skills were easy to replicate, but Shi Yu had rarely heard of skills like Treasure Hunting White Tiger.
In short, he was lucky.
F*ck, Teacher Gem Cat's Wish Star, Shorty's Treasure Hunting White Tiger, and Ling's Wind of Luck. Shi Yu felt that this configuration was invincible. At the moment, Ling was also undergoing its own modification. If it wanted to learn Future Prediction, Shi Yu had replicated this skill from the owl. However, if Baby Ginseng couldn't learn it, it would be very bad. He still had to rely on Ling, who had stronger learning abilities. At that time, with the full configuration, no one could defeat it.
Shorty's evolution was crooked, but not completely.
"Come!" Shi Yu smiled. The short white tiger immediately put away its armor and turned into a big cat. It pounced into Shi Yu's arms and rubbed against him coquettishly.
"By the way, I feel that there's something wrong with the Four Holy Beasts in our team…"
"The Green Dragon didn't evolve from a dragon, but from a Green Silkworm…"
Buggy looked proud.
"The Vermillion Bird is just a clone… not its main body…"
Chi Tong pinched the spare ingredient, the Vermillion Bird clone, from its shoulder with one hand and examined it. The Vermillion Bird clone cried.
"The Black Tortoise is standing…"
Under Little Quas's gaze, the turtle tried to lie down in silence, but it was awkward no matter what.
"The White Tiger is wearing armor and is so short. The Killing God of War is clearly the main stats, but in the end, the Moneymaker Stats have the upper hand…"
Shorty roared softly. Was it its fault that it was short? If it wanted to become taller, it could optimize its race at any time, but wasn't it because it was used to walking in this body ratio…
The turtle nodded. It was the same. Standing… was purely out of habit!
"Forget it, in short, it's done. The Four Holy Beasts have gathered. I'm going to sleep and rest," Shi Yu shouted.
…
Two days later, Shi Yu woke up because today was the day the Four Holy Ruins opened. Although he had yet to think of whether to let Buggy and Chi Tong register, the rare era ruin had descended. After rubbing his eyes, he still planned to take a look.

chapters.title: Chapter 1408 I Really Don't Want to Crack the Ruins (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1408 I Really Don't Want to Crack the Ruins (1)
The Four Holy Ruins was finally about to open. Shi Yu had awakened and was full of energy. After the Four Holy Beasts gathered, he received the stats feedback again and felt that he was strong. He was the one in the middle of the Four Holy Beasts, Shi Yu.
According to what he knew, although the humans of the starry sky weren't good at cultivation, it didn't mean that they didn't cultivate. There were all kinds of cultivation civilizations, technological modifications, mixed-blood warriors, and various factions in the cultivation world. However, when Shi Yu heard that, he felt that it was extremely difficult. Why should he suffer?
In his opinion, the Beast Tamer path was still more suitable for him. As long as his pet leveled up and he contracted more new pets, his own strength could also increase along with it. It was extremely comfortable.
"Master, this universe overlord army that came to the Four Holy Ancient City is called the Purple Sword Special Force. The leader seems to be an archeologist who specially came for the Four Holy Ruins." After Shi Yu woke up, Ling reported the situation of the Four Holy Ancient City over the past two days to Shi Yu.
Among them, the information about the top archeologist under the universe overlord, Zi Jian, was the most popular in the ancient city. Ling said, "However, apart from the first day, passers-by have never seen this Captain Zi Jian. Someone saw her appear outside the Four Holy Ruins. She might be researching the Four Holy Ruins."
"It's within my expectations," Shi Yu said. "The Cultivation Fruit is indeed a good thing. It completely suppresses my desire to explore the ruins. Otherwise, I would definitely have been hanging outside the ruins two days ago."
After packing up, Shi Yu retracted his pets. Not everyone could enter the Four Holy Ruins. Tickets were needed. Senior Lin Feng had gotten one for Shi Yu, and it was still an advantage for Beast Tamers. With this one, Shi Yu could bring all his contracted pets in.
Shi Yu flew with his psychic power and left the ancient residence to rush to the Four Holy Ruins. At this moment, in the outside world, a sea of people surged. This rare event broadened Shi Yu's horizons. Green Dragon, Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger evolvers appeared in the Four Holy Ancient City like they were common. There were countless of them, and the number of divine-levels might be more than ten thousand.
There were actually so many evolvers of the Four Saints. No wonder the faith items of the Four Saints were so expensive and rare here.
Shi Yu realized that compared to the traditional image of the Four Holy Beasts, Buggy and the others weren't very special in the entire Four Holy Ancient City. Here, the humanoid Four Holy Evolvers, like Dragonmen, and the mutated Four Holy Evolvers, like the two-headed White Tiger, were also very strange.
Among them, some of the Four Holy Evolvers were alone, and some of the Four Holy Beasts had human contractors. However, no matter what, their auras weren't weak. This made Shi Yu feel even more excited. How many faith skills did this take?
"The Four Holy Ruins are about to open…" The location of the Four Holy Ruins was a huge square. On the battlefield and in the martial arena, four broken Four Holy Statues that couldn't be seen clearly stood in all directions of the square. This was a half-fused ruin. Most of the time, it was in a closed state. Every once in a while, it would automatically open, connecting to the era space to complete the incomplete ruin.
At this moment, the lives in the square would feel as if they were in an alternate world. They could see many battle facilities. In the battle alms, a large amount of the power of faith of the Four Saints was spread. The evolvers of the Four Saints could directly mobilize the power of faith here to fight. If they won the battle, they could further obtain a purer reward of the power of faith from the ruins.
It was no wonder that so many evolvers of the Four Saints gathered at the Four Saints Meeting.
"Enter." The square of the Four Holy Ruins was wrapped in an absolute power. Shi Yu approached and only successfully entered after his tickets turned into ashes.
"Shi Yu, over here!" When Shi Yu arrived at the square of the Four Holy Ruins, he heard a mental shout. After searching for a target, Shi Yu discovered Senior Lin Feng. He was walking side by side with a beautiful woman in a white tiger hide shirt.
"Senior Lin Feng, Senior White…" After Shi Yu came over, he greeted Lin Feng and his contracted White Tiger.
"You're Shi Yu. You indeed look talented." This was the first time White Tiger Mother had seen Shi Yu. She had heard of Shi Yu's deeds from Lin Feng, but this was the first time she had seen him.
"Senior, you flatter me." Shi Yu smiled. At this moment, Lin Feng said, "A certain branch of the Blue Planet Dragon and Phoenix Race is also here. They're also evolving towards the Green Dragon and the Vermillion Bird. After entering the ruins, I'll bring you to meet them."
"Alright." Shi Yu nodded, but what concerned him more at this moment was the two groups of people who suddenly flew into the ruins from a higher altitude. There were many unwritten rules in many cities on the World King Planet. Flying in some towns was fine, but flying higher depended on one's identity. Many hot-tempered big shots weren't very willing to have someone flying above them.
"It's the cosmic overlord army… and people from the archeological association…" The white tiger girl said at the side. In the sky, a batch of aliens in standard battle suits flew to the ruins with a purple-haired girl as the lead. The other batch was an old man standing on the white-bearded Green Dragon. His followers were all wearing the brown archeological suit of the archeological association and flying together.
"It's indeed her…" At this moment, Shi Yu's heart sank the moment he saw the purple-haired girl. After hearing from Ling that an archeologist from the cosmic overlord army had come, Shi Yu immediately judged that the person who suppressed her power of the Passage of Time might be the other party.
At this moment, the two parties were close. Shi Yu could finally confirm that the other party had definitely mastered archeological skills similar to the Passage of Time, and she had cultivated it much deeper than he had.

chapters.title: Chapter 1409 I Really Don't Want to Crack the Ruins (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1409 I Really Don't Want to Crack the Ruins (2)
"That's the president of the Heavenly Spirit Domain Archeological Association, Zong Jie, but his more important identity is that of a member of the Green Dragon family. The arrival of Zi Jian indeed attracted the other party out." Lin Feng clicked his tongue in wonder.
Both parties were important figures. Let alone the cosmic overlord army; the other was a bottomless expert of the Green Dragon family. The Green Dragon family was naturally extraordinary since it could be named after the Green Dragon. Their patriarch was the only Green Dragon evolver who had survived to the super divine level. The branch of the Green Dragon family was also spread across hundreds of realms and spread faith. In the entire World King Planet, it was a large family.
"Captain Zi Jian, I didn't expect your first stop when you came to the World King Planet to be my Heavenly Spirit Domain," the old man immediately said bluntly after meeting Zi Jian. How could the World King Planet archeological association not know the goal of the cosmic overlord army?
The goal was to crack the Four Holy Ruins and plunder all the faith resources.
At the moment, although no one could crack the Four Holy Ruins and obtain the right to manage it, it was jointly monopolized by several large families and archeological associations to continue sucking blood. It was no different from becoming the owner of the ruins according to the rules of the ruins. Naturally, they were unwilling for outsiders to really take away the ruins.
"Who are you? You're blocking my way." Zi Jian yawned and looked at the old man in front of her in disdain.
"Hehe, you're indeed as the rumors say…" Zong Jie was the president of the Heavenly Spirit Domain Archeological Association and the branch head of the Green Dragon family's Heavenly Spirit Domain. When had he been ignored by a little girl? However, he also admitted that the other party was indeed qualified.
"I'm Zong Jie, the president of the Heavenly Spirit Domain Archeological Association, one of the caretakers of the Four Holy Ruins. Captain Zi Jian, I advise you not to waste time in this ruin. Why don't you go to other places to take a look in case you return in disappointment?" President Zong Jie said.
"You're the most powerful archeologist in this place?" Zi Jian asked perfunctorily. She still felt a little sleepy. Although that Cultivation Fruit was disgusting, the effect really surprised her. She used the Cultivation Fruit to cultivate a Beast Taming ability from scratch. In just two days, she reached Level 8. It was unbelievable. If it weren't for the fact that the Four Holy Ruins were about to open, she would have wanted to sleep a little longer.
After cracking the ruins… She had to go to the plant association and find the guy who created the Cultivation Fruit to let him serve her.
At the same time, she wanted to ask the other party why it made such a good Cultivation Fruit with such a bad taste.
Was there something wrong with his mind or something?
"You flatter me." President Zong Jie's expression was calm. However, he, who could listen to the sound of the ruins the moment he was born, was famous for his archeological ability in the Heavenly Spirit World. Indeed, no one dared claim to be first if he said he was second. Unfortunately, he had yet to crack an era ruin. Facing the monster in front of him, who had cracked four era ruins, his little attainments were nothing.
"That's right," Zi Jian said. "When I first came to this city, the archeologist I sensed with pretty good abilities didn't seem to be you."
"What?" President Zong Jie was stunned.
The conversation between Zi Jian and Zong Jie was paid attention to by many Four Saints Evolvers present the whole time. Although they were mainly here to compete for the power of faith, they still took the competition between archeological big shots very seriously.
If the cosmic overlord army monster really took away the ruins, where would they obtain the power of faith in the future?
From various sources, Zi Jian's talent completely crushed the archeologists on the World King Planet!
However, what surprised them the most at this moment was that even President Zong Jie couldn't enter the eyes of a woman from this cosmic overlord army, but there was someone else who could make her acknowledge him? Did the other party mean that there was an archeologist stronger than President Zong Jie in the Four Holy Ancient City?
"Hello." In the sky, Zi Jian's gaze looked down and followed her perception, locking onto a target.
"Kid, from the looks of it, you don't seem to be from the World King Planet's archeological association, but a wild archeologist," she said to a confused young man in a panda outfit below.
"Two days ago, you were the one I sensed who didn't hide your powers, right? Do you want to follow me?"
"Or are you here to compete with me?"
When Zi Jian saw that, everyone was stunned. President Zong Jie was stunned again. Lin Feng also looked at Shi Yu beside him in confusion and subconsciously moved away from Shi Yu.
"Holy shit." Lin Feng was shocked. She was talking about Shi Yu?
When…
It seemed… normal. Even on the World King Planet, there weren't many archeologists who could crack the ruins of the era. As for Shi Yu, he seemed to have already obtained benefits from an era ruin. As the number one archeologist on Blue Planet, it was natural for him to be highly evaluated.
Shi Yu looked at Lin Feng in confusion.
Was he serious about taking a step back?
Shi Yu didn't expect that the other party could still lock onto him even after he had already turned off the Passage of Time. At this moment, under thousands of gazes, Shi Yu couldn't help but fall silent.
"Tsk, what's going on?"
He was invited by the universe overlord army!
Many evolvers of the Four Saints looked at Shi Yu with burning gazes. They looked at this unfamiliar young man. Who was this guy?
Under countless gazes, what else could Shi Yu do?
He could be said to have a crying expression as he replied with his scalp numb, "Captain Zi Jian… I… don't have any thoughts about the Four Saints Ruins."

chapters.title: Chapter 1410 I Really Don't Want to Crack the Ruins (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1410 I Really Don't Want to Crack the Ruins (3)
"There must be a misunderstanding!"
According to Ling's information, there were dozens of divine-level and a few top-notch gods in Zi Jian's special force. The strength of Zi Jian's special force was even more unfathomable. Even the Space Emperor and Lin Feng would probably be afraid if they came. Considering the background, the Blue Planet bloodline was nothing. Snatching ruins from this bad woman? No, Shi Yu still wanted to live for a few more days.
Moreover, the Four Holy Ruin was monopolized by several large factions. Without strength and background, daring to crack it blindly was also courting death…
As for being invited to join the universe overlord army, Shi Yu really didn't expect it. If he had just arrived at the World King Planet alone, he would definitely have agreed without a word. However, the problem was that, according to the Space Emperor, he seemed to have been chosen by a super divine level figure from the Environmental Protection Association. It wasn't easy for him to deal with the two factions!
The cosmic overlord army was no longer an official faction on World King Planet, but it wandered outside the system.
"Captain Zi Jian, what do you mean?" At this moment, President Zong Jie's eyes also flashed. Although he couldn't tell what was special about this young man, Zi Jian was too much to poach someone on the World King Planet in front of him.
"It's nothing. I just feel that it's a waste for an archeological genius to stay on the World King Planet. How many ruins can there be on a small World King Planet?" Captain Zi Jian revealed her canine teeth and had a very arrogant attitude.
A mere cosmic life form…
She really dared to say it.
Below, many Four Saints Evolvers were shocked.
"Oh my god." Lin Feng was speechless.
The White Tiger Mother looked at Lin Feng in silence. Her gaze seemed to be saying, "Look at your junior. He seems to have been admired by a big shot. If he cozy up to this captain, he can be said to have soared."
Lin Feng shrugged, but the problem was, was the current Shi Yu touched? Would he dare to move?
Boom.
At this moment, a loud bang broke this awkward situation. A bright sound of laws sounded from the nothingness. The entire Four Saints Ruins began to transform. Space fragments flew and recombined, and a new world gradually formed.
The Four Holy Ruins finally opened.
"Steady your body!! Close your eyes!! Otherwise, you'll faint." At this moment, some divine-level experts who had brought their juniors over reminded again. As soon as they finished speaking, endless light transmigrated, as if it was pulling everyone into an alternate space-time light path and letting everyone head to a new world.
Shi Yu also entered the passage, but he felt that his condition was good. At this moment, everything around him seemed to have disappeared, leaving him alone. This short, peaceful process made Shi Yu heave a sigh of relief, thinking about how to politely refuse Captain Zi Jian.
He thought for a moment. The cosmic overlord army was still too dangerous. They did high-risk jobs and often had to go to various places in the starry sky to carry out missions. It was more comfortable on the World King Planet.
"F*ck." However, what made Shi Yu feel ridiculous was that another accident seemed to have happened. He had clearly turned off the messy archeological abilities such as time and space. He didn't even listen to the ruins. In the end, something seemed to have happened!
Shi Yu felt that he heard a dragon roar. Then, in the depths of his heart, the source of power of the Green Dragon Domain suddenly trembled. The two seemed to have resonated, making Shi Yu immediately panic.
"Damn, what's going on?" Shi Yu said.
"Roar!!" Buggy was also a little stunned.
"Master, it's the Green Dragon Domain that resonated with the Four Saint Ruins," Ling said. "Master, I knew it. I definitely won't be able to control you when the time comes."
"Is this my fault?" Shi Yu was confused. No way, could the Green Dragon divine power he obtained from the Green Dragon Ruins on Earth still react to this Four Holy Ruin?
According to his speculation, Earth was Blue Planet from the last era, a certain planet from the last era. Moreover, it had the divine power left behind by the cosmic Green Dragon God and was accidentally obtained by him. Then, what did the reaction of the Green Dragon divine power with the Four Holy Ruins mean?
Soon, Shi Yu understood, and his perspective instantly rose. In the blink of an eye, it was as if his consciousness had transformed into a god. The light in front of him dissipated, and he looked down at a new world.
This world seemed to be the true interior of the Four Holy Ruins. This place was filled with a large amount of power of faith. Shi Yu felt that at this moment, he could even rely on his thoughts to control a portion of the power of faith in the world and the environmental changes inside. It was like becoming the master of the ruins and having the right to control them.
Shi Yu found it unbelievable. In the next moment, a voice sounded in Shi Yu's ears.
He seemed to have entered a special state when exploring ruins and saw a historical image at this moment.
It was the shadow of history that crossed an era!
Boom!!
It was still the world Shi Yu had seen just now. At this moment, the sky collapsed and the ground caved in. Space shattered, and a gray, destructive aura circulated violently. A human old man stood in the center of the Four Holy Statues and looked up at the starry sky.
"A latecomer."
"This era is about to end. I wonder if this place can be lucky enough to survive until the next era."
"Since you see me, it means that it hasn't been completely destroyed. You should have inherited part of the inheritance of the four saints or cultivated the power of faith of the four saints to the extreme to be able to obtain the authority of this small world. No matter which it is, spread the name of the four saints well."
The human old man continued, "Of course, if you feel that controlling this world is somewhat beyond your abilities, it's normal… After all, the long passage of time has taken its toll, and it's also in a state of disrepair."
"There's only one thing you need to do… In this world, according to the inherent rules of the ruins, defeat as many opponents as possible. Then, you will slowly match this world… and increase your authority."
The old man's voice was buried in the collapsed world. Shi Yu opened his eyes again. It was still that world, but this time, it was indeed broken and filled with traces of vicissitudes.
"What a joke…" Shi Yu was stunned. He really didn't want to crack the secret of this ruin. He did it just like that?
Maintaining the perspective of the owner of the ruins, Shi Yu realized that it was really the shadow of history left behind by the old man. Although he had some control over the ruins, that wasn't all!
Right now, he could only guarantee the absolute control of the power of faith drifting in the ruins of the Four Saints and the right to expel those who entered. However, the power of faith essence buried in the depths of the ruins couldn't be mobilized. Apart from that, he couldn't directly turn this ruin into a tool of the ruins, pack it up, and take it away.
This situation made Shi Yu feel that it was extremely scammy. What was going on…
"What's going on???"
"The opening failed??"
A moment later, in the Four Saints Square, many Four Saints Evolvers opened their eyes and realized that they hadn't entered the real Four Saints Ruins. Instead, they were stunned to still be left behind the square of the Four Saints Ancient City.
Not only them, but President Zong Jie of the Heavenly Spirit Archeological Association was also stunned. This was the first time he had encountered such a failure.
"Strange." Captain Zi Jian also sensed her surroundings in confusion. She didn't successfully enter?
"What happened…" Beside Shi Yu, Senior Lin Feng and the beautiful White Tiger Mother were also confused. This wasn't the first time they had come to the Four Saints Meeting, but they had never heard of such a situation.
The Four Saints Square rumbled. No one paid attention to the lousy matter between Captain Zi Jian, President Zong Jie, and Shi Yu just now. The attention of Captain Zi Jian and President Zong Jie also shifted away from Shi Yu. At the moment, everyone was only concerned about what had happened in the Four Saints Ruins and why they had failed to enter this time.
"Yeah, what's going on…" At this moment, the corners of Shi Yu's mouth twitched. What else could be going on… Because he was forced to obtain a portion of the authority of the Four Holy Ruins, the ruins automatically kicked out the other people who entered.
Why not… he pull everyone in again?
However, the ruins didn't belong to him previously, and he didn't feel anything. Now that the ruins had become his, if others went in to split the power of faith, he would feel like he had suffered a huge loss.
"Not good!! The statues of the Four Holy Beasts cracked!!" At this moment, someone suddenly discovered that many more cracks had appeared on the already broken statues of the Four Holy Beasts that had experienced the destruction of the era.
"The ruins have changed…" The eyes of many archeologists were solemn.
Shi Yu's expression darkened. This guy was talkative! He immediately reopened the Four Holy Ruins and planned to carry it out as usual. Just this once. This was the last time. In any case, there was still a lot of power of faith here. If he somehow succeeded this time, this ruin would belong to him!
Although it was a little troublesome, as long as he obtained this ruin, with the Four Holy Beasts, he should be invincible below the super divine level. Shi Yu really couldn't bear to miss it.
"The bold will die from overeating, and the timid will starve to death." He hoped that the Environmental Protection Association and the Disaster Research Institute he had joined previously could protect him after he obtained the ruins!

chapters.title: Chapter 1411 Mastermind Shi Yu's Scam (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1411 Mastermind Shi Yu's Scam (1)
The sound of space and time vibrated, and space changed. The Four Saint Ruins opened again. Many Four Saints Evolvers looked at each other. Facing the passage of the ruins, when they didn't know if they should enter, it actually opened again?
The ruins had changed! From the looks of it, it was really changeable.
Just now, the archeologists of the archeological association had already indicated that there was a situation. Then, what exactly had changed? Before figuring it out, many Four Saints Evolvers hesitated and were a little afraid.
After all, the ruins of the era represented danger and the unknown. Originally, the Four Saints Ruins weren't dangerous, but no one could be sure if the changed Four Saints Ruins were dangerous.
Of course, only a small number of people hesitated. Most people still entered immediately when they saw the ruins and reacted, such as archeologist Zi Jian, Zong Jie, and the others.
"Shi Yu, do you want to enter or not?" At this moment, Lin Feng, the senior, couldn't help but consult Shi Yu's opinion beside him.
Shi Yu was the strongest archeologist on Blue Planet.
"Let's enter!" Shi Yu said. "Opportunities and risks coexist!"
With that said, he entered the passage first. Lin Feng took a deep breath and followed.
In the passage, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
"If we follow the original rules of the ruins, it feels a little a loss for so many people to split the power of faith."
"However, in order to obtain the authority of the world, we have no choice but to fight. At the same time, if we want to replicate more faith skills, we have to fight. This batch of people is the best choice."
"Why don't…" Shi Yu suddenly smiled.
Sensing Shi Yu's excitement, the contracted pets quickly knew that someone was going to be dealt with again.
"Since so many archeologists think that there are changes in the ruins, let's change it. Let's get a middle ground. Not only will we not disappoint these people, but we can also achieve our goal." When Shi Yu opened the ruins, he used the authority of the master of some of the ruins to mess around.
…
[Buggy, Chi Tong, Little Quas, Turtle, Shorty, listen up.]
In an instant, with a thought, Shi Yu pulled up an online meeting through telepathy.
In the Beast Taming Space, the Green Dragon, the Vermillion Bird, the Black Tortoise, and the White Tiger looked up.
In the next moment, they felt dizzy. They were summoned by Shi Yu and teleported to an unfamiliar place…
[I combined the authority of the ruins and teleported you to a certain ruins space. Next, I'll assist you in pretending to be the 'guardian of the ruins'.]
[I'll teleport the opponents you want to defeat to you one by one. Your mission is to be in charge of defeating the other party!]
[However, I can't directly defeat it cleanly. At least, I have to wait for the other party to display a portion of its strength. If the opponent's skill isn't bad, I will directly possess you through the authority.]
[Well, in order to maintain fairness, Buggy, Chi Tong, you guys suppress it to the overlord level, to the same level as Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty.]
[Don't worry, with my help, the power of faith in this ruin is all yours. As long as you don't face a divine-level expert, you guys with endless faith energy can theoretically kill indiscriminately.]
[In the beginning, I'll only let demigods in. Slowly, after the battle, I'll increase the authority to control the ruins. You guys will increase your strength, and I'll continue to let divine-levels in to fight for you.]
[Use this training opportunity well!]
[Let's accompany these people and put on a good show.] After Shi Yu finished speaking, the Four Holy Beasts understood. Shi Yu really treated himself as the master of the ruins and started the job of the master of the ruins. He was in charge of testing the people who entered…
"Mi!!!" Chi Tong was the first to agree. Alright, performing? She liked it!
Turtle and Little Quas, who had fused into Black Tortoises again, also revealed serious expressions. This was the first time Shi Yu had let them come out to fight…
Were the opponents the Four Holy Evolvers of the World King Planet? The pressure was huge…
"Meow." Shorty was the same. Its gaze was serious. It definitely couldn't disappoint the expectations of a god!
Only Buggy was calm and composed. Small scene, small scene! It was an old actor who had cooperated with Shi Yu to cosplay the Iron-eating Beast Knight and the Sword Immortal to simulate sword aura during the real Green Silkworm era.
…
A moment later, many people entered the Four Saint Ruins again and carefully observed the changes in the ruins.
Soon, someone discovered that the Duel Arena and battlefield of the Four Saint Ruins were all closed. They couldn't enter at all to fight for the power of faith. This situation couldn't help but make the expressions of the people who entered change.
"President Zong Jie, what's going on!" Someone asked President Zong Jie, one of the guardians of the Four Holy Ruins, but at this moment, the old man also had a confused expression.
"I don't know. It might be related to the changes just now. Everyone, calm down. Look carefully for any other changes," he said.
"Is this ruin specially welcoming me?" Zi Jian of the cosmic overlord army was also slightly interested in the changes in the ruins. Before coming, she had investigated the Four Saints Ruins deeply enough.
The mechanism of this ruin had never changed since it was discovered. This time, something unexpected happened?
However, she still liked to explore the reason for this unknown change.
"Shi Yu, do you know what's going on?" Senior Lin Feng, who had sensed that something was wrong and took a small step away from Shi Yu, came back. Shi Yu was also an archeologist, so he might know the reason for this situation.
"I don't know," Shi Yu said as he looked around. Now wasn't the time to talk freely. At least, he had to wait until he obtained all the authority of the ruins before he could lay his cards on the table. He was nothing now. After all, he couldn't even take the ruins away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1412 Mastermind Shi Yu's Scam (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1412 Mastermind Shi Yu's Scam (2)
"I discovered the change!" There were many people present. Soon, someone discovered what changes had happened to the current ruins compared to the former Four Saints Ruins. Although the Duel Arena and the battlefield that were fighting for the power of faith no longer reacted, four huge stone tablets of different colors appeared around the ruins!!
"What's this…" Many Four Saints Evolvers looked at the green, white, red, and black stone tablets and fell into deep thought.
On the four huge stone tablets, ancient words from the previous era were carved: Green Dragon Leaderboard, White Tiger Leaderboard, Vermillion Bird Leaderboard, and Black Tortoise Leaderboard. This made everyone confused.
Before figuring out what the stone tablet was, no one dared to approach it rashly.
"This is… a spatial door?!" Soon, someone determined the characteristics of the stone tablet. Zi Jian stood in front of the Green Dragon Leaderboard stone tablet and reached out to touch the stone tablet under everyone's gaze.
In the next moment, spatial ripples shot out of the stone tablet. Zi Jian wanted to reach her hand in and enter with her entire body, but she was stopped by a spatial power. This made Zi Jian reveal a dissatisfied expression.
"What I hate the most in my life are ruins that restrict levels," she said angrily.
"Captain, what did you discover?" the two Darekians asked.
"Try and see if you can enter," Zi Jian said. The universe overlord army was talented and bold. The others didn't dare to approach the stone tablet, but under Zi Jian's orders, her subordinates had no choice but to come into contact.
In the end, without exception, they were all blocked outside by the stone tablet.
"This should be a spatial door, but it restricts entry levels. I'm afraid you can't enter if you're above the divine level…" She said, "No, even if it's not the divine level, as long as it doesn't meet the 'rules', it doesn't seem to be possible."
Under her gaze, a human soldier from the cosmic overlord army below the divine level also touched the stone tablet, but he was still blocked outside.
"Then, there's only one truth. You, continue to try. To be precise, let your Green Dragon pet go." Zi Jian pointed at the soldier who was stopped just now. The soldier was stunned and immediately said, "Yes, Captain!"
With that said, he directly condensed a golden summoning array. In the array, with a dragon roar, a green-colored dragon shot into the sky. It was also a dragon life form that was evolving towards the Green Dragon.
Under the Beast Tamer's command, this dragon directly came into contact with the stone tablet. Right on the heels of that, it successfully passed through the stone tablet, causing an uproar.
…
Sca was a Green Dragon evolver and a quasi god of Zi Jian's special forces. With its strength, it was all thanks to it being a Green Dragon evolver that it could enter such a team. Otherwise, it wouldn't be qualified at all.
This time, under the command of Captain Zi Jian, after successfully passing through the ruins stone tablet, it made Sca feel that a huge opportunity was waiting for it.
After it entered, its vision was first engulfed in darkness, then slowly regained brightness. It found itself transported to a place resembling an ancient arena, surrounded by ruins. However, what surprised it the most was the colossal presence before its eyes.
"Roar!!!" In front of the Green Dragon Sca, there was also a Green Divine Dragon. Its body was a hundred meters long and occupied the sky. It had two golden horns on its head and was covered in green scales. Golden flames of spiritual faith burned in its eyes and tail, looking majestic.
Although its image was a little different from its own, the Green Dragon Sca was certain that this was also a Green Dragon Evolver. Moreover, the other party's aura gave it a very strange feeling. It felt very strong one moment, and only so-so the next.
What was going on!
Wasn't he the only dragon who entered the stone tablet just now?
Who was this guy?
"Roar!!!" It also roared.
"Who are you!!!" Just as it finished speaking, voices seemed to appear in the surrounding ruins, taking the initiative to let those who entered hear the voices of the ruins.
[This is the guardian phantom of the Green Dragon Leaderboard. Fight it and you can ascend the Green Dragon List. If you rank at the top, you will obtain a large amount of power of faith as a reward!]
[The one at the top will even…]
"What??" The sudden sound of the ruins made the Green Dragon Sca pause. It found it unbelievable. What mechanism was this?
The Duel Arena and the battlefield for the power of faith in the Four Saints Ruins closed, and another Green Dragon Leaderboard level that relied on rankings to obtain the power of faith was updated?
The one at the top will even… even what? Finish talking!
The Green Dragon Sca cursed. Why was it lagging?
This ruin must be very old!
"Challenger, tell me your name." In the Green Dragon Leaderboard level, Buggy, who had been called over by Shi Yu to work, let out a deep, empty, and silent voice, as if it was saying that it was really a guardian phantom.
"You're a guardian phantom… Do you know what the reward for first place is? You survived from the last era until now? Who created this ruin?" The Green Dragon Sca asked continuously.
"Challenger, tell me your name."
"Challenger, tell me your name," Buggy ignored the other party and repeated.
"Green Dragon, Sca!" Zi Jian's special force's Sca let out a low roar. Damn it, didn't the other party have intelligence? Just as its thought fell, it saw the Green Dragon Guardian directly slap at it in the air.
It was as if answering the name had triggered a mechanism and started the battle.
"Then let's fight!" The Green Dragon Sca sensed that the other party's strength wasn't strong. It directly mobilized the power of faith here, wanting to strengthen its body and resist it. It discovered that this place was the same as the legendary Four Saints Duel Arena and the Four Saints Battlefield. A large amount of power of faith wandered and could be directly used. This was too comfortable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1413 Mastermind Shi Yu's Scam (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1413 Mastermind Shi Yu's Scam (3)
With the principle of not being wasteful, it directly activated its faith skill. However, to Sca's surprise, with a huge roar, under the suppression of the bloodline of the Green Dragon opposite, it directly lost its right to control the free power of faith. If it wanted to mobilize 100 portions of the power of faith just now, it had only successfully mobilized 0.1 portions now.
This guardian! His control over the power of faith was very high!
All the power of faith swam towards Buggy.
Green-gold light filled the sky and bloomed around Buggy.
Even the power of faith stored in Sca's body was almost lost.
When Sca reacted, although Buggy didn't move on the spot, its dragon claws directly crossed space and hit the skar, smashing it from the sky to the ground.
"Roar…" Sca let out a cry of pain.
This…
This attack hurt in its heart. It was certain that the other party's growth level was only at the overlord level. However, because the other party had the absolute right to control the power of faith, its battle power had reached a very exaggerated level under the enhancement of the power of faith. Even as a quasi-divine, it was a little difficult to withstand this attack.
It was over!
Sca's heart turned cold. The faith skill seemed to be countered in the Green Dragon Leaderboard's challenge level.
It made it feel like it was showing off in front of an expert, as if the dragon in front of it was the real Green Dragon. Wanting to mobilize the power of faith in front of it was no different from a joke.
"Roar!!" As Sca analyzed, Buggy slapped over again.
At this moment, Buggy felt extremely good. This was the first time it had squandered the power of faith like this while in combat. A normal attack could sweep up a pile of power of faith!! If it summoned the Dragon Star Group, wouldn't it be able to smash even a divine level expert to death?
It wondered if there was a chance to snatch Baby Ginseng's first clear to the divine level!
Baby Ginseng, who was busy preparing to be a healer for the Four Holy Beasts: "?"
…
In the outside world, as the Green Dragon Sca entered, the successful cases here were also seen by the Four Saints Evolvers on the other stone tablets. However, many Four Saints Evolvers still didn't try it easily. They wanted to see the information brought back by Sca, who had entered first.
In just two minutes, the Green Dragon Sca was teleported out. Everyone's expressions changed. They saw that the Green Dragon Sca was covered in injuries and was in a tragic state. When it entered, it was still majestic. After coming out, it was already a crippled dragon.
"Roar…" As it fell to the ground, the Green Dragon Sca let out a weak cry. So… so strong…
"What's going on? What happened?" Zi Jian immediately asked.
Before the extremely weak Sca could say anything, another row of ancient words from the last era appeared on the huge Green Dragon Leaderboard stone tablet.
Sca, 0.1 Guardian Green Dragon power. Low level!
Everyone looked at this row of words and was stunned again. What was this?
"Uh wu…" The Green Dragon Sca let out a sorrowful cry. Under the healing ability and self-healing of its companions, it opened its eyes. After seeing Zi Jian, it immediately cowered and said, "Captain Zi Jian, I'm sorry to disappoint you. I couldn't break through the level."
"So, what level is it and what's going on inside?" Zi Jian asked.
Sca immediately said, "The level inside… is mainly targeted at this Green Dragon Leaderboard. The person who enters can fight the Guardian Green Dragon inside and use this to judge their strength… If they perform well, they should be ranked at the top of the Green Dragon Leaderboard and obtain rewards such as the power of faith. Just now, wait… 0.1 Guardian Green Dragon power, what's this?" It looked at the change in the stone tablet and its expression suddenly changed.
Although it didn't know what the evaluation criteria were, it felt deeply insulted! It protested!
This sounded weak.
"Is the Guardian Green Dragon very strong?" Zi Jian said.
Sca stuttered, "The other party… It's not a matter of strength. It looks like it's only at the overlord level, but it has an extremely high right to control the power of faith. Under the enhancement of the power of faith, it's no longer like an overlord. Under the suppression of faith, the power of my faith skill is completely ineffective…"
"Come back, useless thing." A moment later, Sca's Beast Tamer summoned it back.
With only 0.1 Guardian Green Dragon's power, Sca, who looked like it had been beaten very badly by the Guardian Green Dragon, quickly lost its value. And the information brought back through it made many Four Saints Evolvers look at each other. The changes in the Four Saints Ruins… were actually like this!
Originally, evolvers dueled each other to compete for the power of faith, but now, they challenged the Four Saints Leaderboard to obtain the power of faith. Because this change had just appeared, no one could say if it was good or bad. However, as long as there were no problems with the ruins, it was best.
"But why aren't divine-level challenges allowed?" There was joy and worry among the evolves. Many divine-level evolvers were rather dissatisfied with this new mechanism.
"There might be other changes in the ruins. There's no hurry." President Zong Jie invested all his energy in the ruins. The ruins actually underwent such a change. He had to study what was going on.
Perhaps this was an opportunity to crack the Four Saints Ruins!
"Go, invite the geniuses of the families outside who aren't even at the divine level and the geniuses of the families located in other realms. As long as they aren't here today, invite them over," he said to a family member.
"Looks like there's going to be fun this time." Captain Zi Jian also looked at the Green Dragon Leaderboard with a burning gaze. She didn't nurture any Four Holy Beasts. In the beginning, she didn't plan to compete for the power of faith. She had her own way to crack the ruins. However, in order to understand more information, she also called her subordinates to gather more Four Saints Evolvers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1414 Mastermind Shi Yu's Scam (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1414 Mastermind Shi Yu's Scam (4)
There were Four Saints Evolvers on the World King Planet, and there were also many under the cosmic overlord army. Moreover, they didn't all follow this time.
"Jiu…"
"Roar!!!"
"Uh!!"
At this moment, demigod-level Four Saints Evolvers also entered the Vermillion Bird Leaderboard, White Tiger Leaderboard, and Black Tortoise Leaderboard. For a moment, the situation in the Four Saints Ruins changed. There were discussions everywhere, and they paid attention to the four major leaderboards!
At the moment, the Green Dragon Sca with the power of 0.1 monopolized the rankings, immediately stimulating the competitiveness of many Four Saints Evolvers.
Many demigod-level Green Dragon evolvers were eager to give it a try outside. As for them, they definitely had 1.5 or 2 Guardian Green Dragon powers no matter what. This 0.1 still looked too lousy.
"Shi Yu, what do you think?" Lin Feng and the White Tiger Mother were beside Shi Yu with serious expressions.
"We might not be able to enter this ruins stone tablet. You can give it a try."
"Perhaps there's a huge opportunity."
Shi Yu stood on the spot with a serious expression.
He… How else could he look? He could just stand and watch.
His Green Dragon had already run in to be the guardian. There was no need for him to challenge himself…
In addition, the huge opportunity wasn't a huge opportunity. It was just a pure scam by Shi Yu…
The only use of these challengers was to upgrade Buggy and the others! To upgrade themselves!
However, there were so many challengers, and they even had to receive guests at the divine level later. In short, Baby Ginseng would be tired. Of course, he had to quickly nurture the White Tiger and the Black Tortoise. Buggy and the Vermillion Bird had been suppressed to the overlord level, and the two of them were now at the true overlord level. He didn't know how far they could reach through this training.
If one didn't have a demigod level, it was very difficult to fight a true god above their level, even if they had almost unlimited faith power.
"Senior Lin Feng, I'm really not interested in this ruin…" Shi Yu made it clear again.
"Uh." Lin Feng suspected that it was true.
From the information he had obtained from Blue Planet, Shi Yu shouldn't be someone who would be calm over his possession.
Wasn't he tempted to see the ruins?
Shi Yu sighed. Right now, he only wanted to be a quiet… mastermind!
He didn't know… how long he could hide it for and how long it would take to obtain complete authority over the ruins.
As Buggy used the power of faith here to defeat an opponent, Shi Yu indeed felt that his authority over the Four Saint Ruins had increased a little. The main opponent was still too weak, causing the training effect to be less than desired.
That Sca had two faith skills, a physique skill, and a farming skill. It was too lousy. Shi Yu didn't have any desire to replicate it. After all, it was perfectly covered by the Green Dragon Indestructible Body and the Creation Domain.
No wonder Zi Lan and the others were very shocked to see Buggy master the Creation Domain. Buggy's evolution speed was really not low. He only hoped that he wouldn't be disappointed after they went in and hopefully evolved some more outstanding Four Holy Beasts.
…
At the same time.
"Challenger, tell me your name." x3!!
The other batch of challengers who entered the Vermillion Bird, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise Ruins looked at the Guardian Holy Beast in front of them and fell into deep thought.
A huge Vermillion Bird with a sword in its mouth, a Flying White Tiger in armor, and a Black Tortoise with a snake tail wrapped around it. They didn't look right.
Wasn't this the Four Holy Ruins of the previous era? The image of the Guardian Holy Beasts should have been created with reference to the four universe gods, right?
Could it be that the true forms of the four universal gods from the previous cosmic era looked like this?
Was this for real? Why did it feel like a low-quality counterfeit?
As if sensing that the Four Saints Evolvers inside had some misunderstanding about the image of the real Four Saints, the Four Saints Ruins cracked again… After Shi Yu succeeded in becoming the owner of the ruins, the reputation of the Four Ancient Saints was harmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1415 One Person Raising the Four Saints, Four Saints Raising One Person (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1415 One Person Raising the Four Saints, Four Saints Raising One Person (1)
After Shi Yu began to set up his scam, the Four Holy Beasts in the team received guests one after another.
White Tiger Leaderboard Ruins.
Shorty looked at the first challenger to enter, a tigress. Its expression was calm, and it was excited.
This was its first real opponent in the few months of training!
Although it was only at the overlord level and its opponent was at the demigod level, with Shi Yu silently supporting it from behind, Shorty felt that victory was in its grasp! It could do it!
Shorty's opponent was a relatively traditional White Tiger. Its entire body was as white as snow and had no stray hair. In comparison, the short Shorty in armor was still relatively strange.
"Quasi-divine of the White Tiger Family, Pei Qi!!!" The female White Tiger said its name and began to mobilize the power of faith of the White Tiger.
But soon, its expression changed. This was because, like the Green Dragon Sca from before, it had also encountered a very troublesome problem!
"Meow!!!" Under the roar of the short-legged armored White Tiger opposite, the female White Tiger, Pei Qi, felt that the wandering power of faith wasn't mobilized by her at all and ran to the Guardian White Tiger.
It was like two people fighting over something. One was weak, while the other was strong, and by many times. The Guardian White Tiger directly snatched everything away.
"This level of control over the power of faith…" Pei Qi was depressed. She roughly knew how the previous Green Dragon lost. The feeling this Guardian White Tiger gave it was that it was only at the overlord level.
However, the other party's control over the power of faith had completely exceeded this level. It felt that it wasn't inferior to a divine-level White Tiger.
As everyone knew, once the creatures who cultivated the power of faith had enough numbers and quality of the power of faith, their strength would multiply, and after losing the power of faith, their strength would plummet by several times.
"Meow!!!" Because Shorty was Shi Yu's pet and had a contract with Shi Yu, the master of the ruins, it also received a portion of the authority of the ruins. In the Four Holy Ruins, it could naturally easily mobilize the power of faith.
If he didn't have this ability, Shi Yu couldn't let Shorty and the others fight these Four Saints Evolvers above their level. Buggy and Chi Tong were still alright. Even without the enhancement of the authority of the ruins, their control over the power of faith was still outstanding among their peers. Putting aside the power of faith, their strength was also top-notch.
However, the White Tiger and Black Tortoise that had just been cultivated still had to rely on their authority. This wasn't a bad thing. During the battle process with the power of faith, they would be nourished by the power of faith and accelerate their growth. At the same time, it was also an opportunity to train the control of the power of faith. Even if they didn't add points, the proficiency of the faith skill would increase.
At this moment, under the enhancement of the power of faith, Shorty's platinum armor shone brightly. It directly spread its golden wings and slapped at the challenger with the platinum tiger palm.
"White Tiger Light Killing Wave!" In the face of the attacking White Tiger, although she could only mobilize a trace of power of faith, Pei Qi still used her faith skill with all her might. A golden light of faith wrapped in killing intent shot over and collided with Shorty's tiger palm.
Boom!!!
Although there was a major level difference, under the situation of squandering the power of faith without limit, the strength of Shorty's body had at least been strengthened to 6.5 points. If it hadn't become the master of the ruins, Shi Yu definitely wouldn't have dared to squander like this. After all, the power of faith consumed by Shorty to maintain the White Tiger Armor for a second was comparable to the time when Buggy threw a few meteorites from the starry sky on Blue Planet.
"Roar!!!" After tearing apart the light wave, Shorty only had many scratches on its armor. Its main body wasn't injured at all, and it continued to attack.
Bang!!!
Pei Qi was sent flying. However, what Pei Qi couldn't understand was that the other party's slap actually took out all the money and treasures in its inner space. The food and metal-element energy crystals she had stored fell out of the spatial crack and onto the ground.
Apart from that, the few sharp golden tiger teeth that Pei Qi had nurtured with the law of metal and countless resources for decades, the golden teeth that were comparable to divine-level resources, were also slapped away by this palm with a crack.
"It hurts!!!" The tigress, Pei Qi, felt that the other party's attack wasn't as simple as it looked, and it even contained an even more mysterious power.
Even Shorty was stunned.
But in the next moment, it couldn't care less. It chased after the tigress.
It shouted in its heart: Hurry up and show off your powerful faith skill! This way, Shi Yu can possess it!
…
On Turtle and Little Quas' side, they were also welcoming the challenger. Their opponents' evolution was relatively ordinary. They only had the image of huge turtles. There wasn't even a shadow of a snake, and the turtles were all lying on their stomachs.
"The real Black Tortoise looks like it's indeed the combination of a turtle and a snake…" After the other party saw the Black Tortoise formed by Turtle and Little Quas, it fell into deep thought. Although it didn't understand why it was standing, the black and white Black Tortoise in front of it indeed let it experience a different Black Tortoise charm.
In Shi Yu's team, the evolution level of the Four Holy Beasts was divided according to perfection. In fact, the Green Dragon was greater than the Black Tortoise and the Vermillion Bird was greater than the White Tiger. Among them, Shorty's evolution was the most incomplete. As for Buggy, because it had the support of the Green Dragon Domain, its evolution level was the highest. As for the Black Tortoise, because it had the Taiji Domain, the Turtle Snake Fusion, and Dark Yin Yang Dao were also more perfect than the Vermillion Bird.
Therefore, at the moment, the combination battle power of Turtle and Little Quas, together with the power of faith, could only be described as absolute strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 1416 One Person Raising the Four Saints, Four Saints Raising One Person (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1416 One Person Raising the Four Saints, Four Saints Raising One Person (2)
"Challenger, Ku Wu!!" The Black Tortoise was strong and powerful. After reporting its name, it first tried to mobilize the power of faith here. It realized that the power of faith was all controlled by the Guardian Tortoise. It could only mobilize a weak portion and attack crazily!!
"Super Destructive Black Tortoise Spiral Star Attack!" It roared, almost stunning Turtle and Little Quas on the spot.
In the next moment, weak power of faith, powerful will, and starlight gathered on the shell, and black water lingered. Ku Wu's head and limbs contracted, and the shell spun at a high speed. In an instant, it vaguely fell like a black star spiral and attacked Turtle and Little Quas!
"Oh." Turtle's heart skipped a beat. Wasn't this its Turtle Ramming Attack… No, it was the Spin Impact!
Did it think that with more special effects and a longer name, it couldn't recognize it??
In the face of this attack, Turtle and Little Quas directly activated the "Dark North Shield". The standing turtle's arms interacted, and the black water shield condensed from the rich power of faith directly blocked the spinning attack.
At the same time, Turtle shouted in its heart: Master, copy this. I should learn this!
…
"Learn my ass. There are so many challengers. There's no time to learn it all. I'll only choose faith skills comparable to the 'Creation Domain' and 'Seal of Sea Suppression' to replicate," Shi Yu thought to himself in the outside world.
Although it could be fused after learning a bunch of useless things, it was too tiring. This way, he would devote all his energy to the cultivation of the Four Holy Beasts and not have time to train other pets.
At the same time, if he replicated all the hundreds of thousands of Four Saints Evolvers, although he didn't lack skill slots now and could delete them as long as he fused them, he definitely wouldn't be able to withstand it. He probably wouldn't have the time to be idle anymore.
Compared to the focused battle of Shorty, Turtle, and Little Quas, Chi Tong's side was as easy. Although it had been suppressed to the overlord level, with the infinite power of faith, it didn't know how to lose at all.
"Jiu!!!" In the ruins of the Vermillion Bird Leaderboard, the Vermillion Bird with the divine sword in its beak only swung its head, and the sword light slashed out by the divine sword easily cut off half of the Vermillion Bird's hair in front of it!
0.2 Guardian White Tiger power, 0.1 Guardian Black Tortoise power, 0.1 Guardian Vermillion Bird power… Various results were displayed on the Four Saints Leaderboard, making the entire Four Saints Ruins a little chaotic.
"Tsk tsk, from the looks of it, these Guardian Holy Beasts are pretty strong. Unfortunately, divine-levels can't enter," Lin Feng said regretfully beside Shi Yu.
"Yeah." His White Tiger Mother also felt that it was a pity.
"Senior Lin Feng, who are the strongest Green Dragon, Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger Evolvers below the divine level?" Shi Yu asked.
He felt that the evolution level of the batch of Four Saints Evolvers that entered just now wasn't high, let alone Buggy. Why wasn't it as tall as Shorty?
Shi Yu thought for a moment and could only attribute it to the fact that he had indeed invested a lot of faith resources and evolution resources. Although the World King Planet was huge and the Four Saints system was more perfect, there were just too many Four Saints Evolvers. Every evolver wanted to have a share of the pie. Ordinary people couldn't get many faith resources when they evolved, but he directly plundered a few faith items from the parallel Blue Planet as evolution resources. Then, the power of the world in Little Zi's body was also cultivated towards the Four Saints system. Under the world blessings of many faith resources and a low-level star, it seemed normal for his Four Holy Beasts to evolve to this extent, stronger than 99% of the Four Saints Evolvers.
However, it was stronger than ordinary Four Saints Evolvers, but Shi Yu didn't believe that every Four Saints Evolver on the huge World King Planet was at this level.
Where were the geniuses??
They might have some rare skills that Shi Yu wanted to replicate.
"This is naturally the strongest expert of the younger generation of the Four Saints Family," Lin Feng said.
"The Green Dragon Family, the White Tiger Family, the Vermillion Bird Family, the Black Tortoise Family… They're all experts whose family factions span hundreds of realms. The strongest experts in the younger generation of their families are basically the strongest Four Saints Evolvers below the divine level."
"This time… they shouldn't have come. The number one genius of every stage of the Four Saints Family doesn't lack the power of faith at all. It's basically provided by the family. There's no need to come here to compete at all."
"I didn't pay attention to anything else, but I remember that the Green Dragon Family is the same family as President Zong Jie. There's a quasi-divine Green Dragon. It's very powerful. It once ranked eighth in the best result of the God Sealing Battle and entered the top 10 to master the top-notch faith skill, Green Dragon Creation." He looked deeply at Shi Yu.
"That's a faith divine skill that contains the laws of creation."
Similar to his Green Dragon's Creation Domain…
