There was a reason why the Space Emperor and Lin Feng thought highly of Shi Yu and thought that Shi Yu could one day take first place in the God Sealing Battle. It was mainly because the potential displayed by Eleven and Buggy at that time was too powerful.
The strongest expert of the younger generation of the Green Dragon Family had relied on the Green Dragon Creation to obtain the top 10 of the God Sealing Battle. Then, Shi Yu's Green Dragon Buggy had obtained some nurturing and accumulated some faith power. Why couldn't it rely on the Creation Domain to obtain the top 10?
In addition, Shi Yu not only had Buggy as a pet. With all the members participating, it might not be impossible for him to get first place in the God Sealing Battle.
"However, with the changes in the Four Saint Ruins this time, they should be called by their families to challenge and explore, right?"
"This…" At this moment, when he heard Senior Lin Feng's words, Shi Yu was stunned. The Green Dragon Creation sounded strong, but it conflicted with Buggy's Creation Domain. He felt that it was the same ability with a different name. Was it useful to replicate it?

chapters.title: Chapter 1417 One Person Raising the Four Saints, Four Saints Raising One Person (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1417 One Person Raising the Four Saints, Four Saints Raising One Person (3)
"That guy from the Green Dragon Family is indeed very terrifying. In comparison, the strength of the other three families is slightly inferior to it." At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded. An old man with a sparrow head and a terrifying divine power aura slowly walked over. Behind him were two Vermillion Birds, and behind them were a middle-aged man and a young man.
"That genius of the Vermillion Bird Family has mastered the faith skill, World Destruction Flame, that contains the prototype of the World Destruction Law, but his best result is only lingering in the top 30, far inferior to the genius of the Green Dragon Family."
"Of course, it's much stronger than the useless people behind me."
The young people and the Phoenix Vermillion Bird behind the old man had dissatisfied expressions.
Shi Yu and Lin Feng looked at the Vermillion Bird old man.
World Destruction Flame… This was good!
"Old Wan, you're here. Shi Yu, this is a senior of the Blue Planet's Phoenix Race. Old Wan is one of the best in the Phoenix Race, having evolved towards the Vermillion Bird. Their family evolved towards the Vermillion Bird," Lin Feng introduced.
"Senior Wan." Shi Yu greeted the Vermillion Bird old man, who had a human body and a sparrow head. At the same time, he looked at the three generations of descendants. The oldest seemed to have fused with the Vermillion Bird, like a hybrid. As for the other two, one was a divine-level Beast Tamer, one was an intermediate-level Phoenix Vermillion Bird, one was a Level 9 Beast Tamer, and the other was a demigod Phoenix Vermillion Bird… From the looks of it, they were mainly Phoenix Vermillion Birds. The two humans were similar subordinates.
"You're Sir Shi Yu from your mother planet, right?" Old Vermillion Bird smiled at Shi Yu. He had also heard the evaluation of Shi Yu from the cosmic overlord army just now. As expected, the rumors were true. Shi Yu was definitely a super genius.
"Sir Shi Yu, what do you think of this ruin?" he asked.
"I'm not sure yet. I plan to stay and observe for a period of time," Shi Yu said.
"Eh, Old Green is here too," Lin Feng suddenly said. He looked in a certain direction. An old Green Dragon was flying over. Behind it were a few divine dragons of different levels. Some of the Green Dragons had humans sitting on them.
"Lord Lin Feng, Old Ghost Wan Que!" When the old Green Dragon arrived, its gaze immediately stopped on Shi Yu.
"Old Dragon Qing Bin, Sir Shi Yu, I didn't expect your archeological talent to actually be recognized by the universe overlord army…"
Everyone from the Blue Planet Dragon Race and the Phoenix Race was very shocked. Shi Yu's information on Blue Planet was strictly kept secret by the Space Emperor and the others. Apart from the super divine level ancestors of the five major divine races, the divine-level generations of the five major divine races really didn't know Shi Yu's background. They only knew what was on the surface.
At the moment, in the Blue Planet Alliance, the status of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng together was comparable to that of the five super divine ancestors of Blue Planet. Lin Feng alone could be said to be a top-notch god below the five super divine ancestors. These Blue Planet big races were very respectful to him. After all, he was a fierce person who had killed super divine ancestors.
"I don't know what's going on either." Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, "Perhaps Captain Zi Jian made a mistake. Senior Lin Feng, what should we do next? I plan to walk around this ruin carefully. If there's a chance, I'll enter and challenge it. What about you guys?"
Lin Feng said in distress, "Just like you. In this situation, what else can we do…"
Shi Yu chuckled… They could do whatever they wanted. He was going to nurture the Guardian Holy Beast.
In addition, the strongest expert of the younger generation of the Four Saints Family… He felt that it was four guys who had mastered the prototype of a top-notch faith divine skill. He had to pay extra attention!
…
Next, Shi Yu used the authority of the owner of the ruins to add points from afar. Soon, he upgraded all the super skills of Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty to transcendent.
The growth levels of the three of them had finally reached the totem level. Their battle power was at the demigod level. Of course, this was according to the standards of Blue Planet. On World King Planet, they were at the quasi-divine level.
At that moment, after becoming the owner of the ruins, Shi Yu also obtained another benefit, which was that he could spend money again!
He didn't lack money anymore!
There was too much power of faith in the Four Holy Ruins. What did this mean? It meant that Buggy could use the Creation Domain to the greatest extent. In the Creation Domain, Buggy was a god and could do anything, including healing people and accelerating the ripening of plants.
In such a situation, with Baby Ginseng, Susu, and Shi Yu's increase in points, was there a need to think?
Apart from Buggy, the Black Tortoise and the Black Tortoise's Black Tortoise Divine Power faith skill could also transfer vitality and heal Shi Yu. Later, he would replicate a support-type faith skill for the Vermillion Bird and the White Tiger. Shi Yu had already thought of how fast it would be to add points to the Four Saint Ruins.
Apart from that, Buggy used the law of spring to assist Baby Ginseng in creating the Cultivation Fruit and the Reincarnation Fruit in the Four Saint Ruins. It could basically be said to be divine speed.
Shi Yu could imagine that it wouldn't take long for him to add all the skills of his pets. Then, he could use the remaining time to accumulate a large amount of resources and save them to sell for other resources.
As expected, if he wanted to become rich, he still had to crack the ruins.
Although this would consume a lot of faith power, Shi Yu, who had just become rich, had no intention of saving money. He planned to enjoy it first.
With the help of this Four Holy Ruins, he could quickly nurture the Four Holy Beasts. Then, the Four Holy Beasts could immediately rely on his support faith skills to feedback to him and nurture other pets!
Sigh, if he had known that he could become so rich, he wouldn't have been in a hurry to overextend his Faith Overdraft. It was so annoying that he didn't lack the power of faith.
"These two really haven't given up." When Shi Yu pretended to walk around the ruins, he also discovered that President Zong Jie of the Heavenly Spirit Archeological Association was focused on studying the ruins. It was the same for the archeologist, Zi Jian.
As the owner of the ruins, he could clearly determine the abilities of the two people. That President Zong Jie and him when he was a newbie on Blue Planet relied on chatting, luck, and mental conversations with the ruins' consciousness. They didn't have much skills.
As for Zi Jian, she was very skillful. She used a special method to find the loopholes in the ruins and wanted to obtain the authority of the ruins. If the ruins didn't have a master, this method might really succeed. Unfortunately, the authority over the ruins had already been claimed by Shi Yu, who acted swiftly. In addition, as Buggy and the others kept fusing the power of faith, Shi Yu and the others' control over the ruins increased quickly. It was already impossible for Zi Jian to obtain authority over the ruins.
Unfortunately, why didn't Teacher Ying follow?
If she followed, apart from the Cultivation Fruit, she would definitely be able to eat all kinds of gem divine fruits.

chapters.title: Chapter 1418 Lu Qingyi's Counterattack (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1418 Lu Qingyi's Counterattack (1)
That day, many people withdrew from the Four Saints Ruins, because, apart from the Four Saints Leaderboard, they didn't discover any other changes in the ruins.
Divine-level experts couldn't do anything inside. Even if they were demigods, many of them had retreated. This was because the challenge of this Four Saints Leaderboard was too unintelligent. Every time, they could only challenge it alone at the same time. Every challenge had to be separated for a period of time.
With so many Four Saints Evolvers, if everyone wanted to fight once, they had to wait a long, long time.
In the ruins, some people had even fought to challenge the rankings in order to prioritize entering, causing conflict.
"Let's go, we're not staying anymore."
A day later, because it was too boring, Lin Feng helplessly called the White Tiger Mother. He didn't plan to stay in the ruins anymore and was prepared to leave.
Before leaving, he found Shi Yu, who was patting a pillar like he was picking a watermelon. His face darkened.
"Shi Yu, you didn't queue."
"No, there were too many people," Shi Yu said. "Senior Lin Feng, are you… leaving?"
"Yeah, let's go. Why don't you come along? I don't think there's anything fun here. Didn't you say you weren't interested in the Four Saints Ruins?" Lin Feng said.
"Wu, so boring." The White Tiger Mother was bored.
"I might not be able to leave yet," Shi Yu said with an embarrassed smile.
"What do you mean?" Lin Feng was stunned. Shi Yu saw that Lin Feng was already planning to leave and couldn't help but say, "Let's talk outside."
Seeing that Shi Yu was acting strange, Lin Feng couldn't help but shake his head. The three of them left the ruins together.
However, unlike what Lin Feng imagined, after they stepped into the ruins passage that left the ruins, they didn't appear in the outside world. Instead, they appeared in an extremely special, independent space.
As soon as he realized that something was wrong, Lin Feng's expression immediately froze. "This is…?"
The White Tiger Mother also immediately observed her surroundings.
"This is the deep space of the Four Holy Ruins," Shi Yu said as he looked at Lin Feng and the White Tiger Mother in front of him.
Lin Feng and White Tiger: "?"
Both parties fell into deep thought and were a little confused.
"I originally wanted to wait a while, but the speed at which I obtained authority over the ruins is faster than I imagined. Perhaps in less than a month, I can obtain the complete authority of the Four Holy Ruins."
"Senior Lin Feng, Senior White Tiger, why don't you come after I completely become the owner of the ruins? At that time, the premium power of faith sealed inside the ruins can be shared with you," Shi Yu said.
At the moment, the ordinary power of faith floating around wasn't very useful to the divine-level White Tiger Mother. Shi Yu didn't let Senior Lin Feng snatch it from him.
When the time came, he would directly give them premium items to repay them for the ticket.
Lin Feng and White Tiger: "?"
Both parties looked at Shi Yu in confusion. Shi Yu… What was he saying?
"You…" Lin Feng was stunned.
"Well… The initial changes in the ruins were caused by me. I accidentally cracked the Four Holy Ruins and obtained the authority of a portion of the Four Holy Ruins. At the moment, I'm working hard to obtain the remaining portion."
"What!!!" Lin Feng was shocked. What a joke.
The White Tiger Mother also opened her mouth slightly with an incredulous expression.
"What about the Four Saints Leaderboard?" she asked.
"I also created it. The Four Holy Beasts inside are a few pets I contracted and cultivated. I used the authority of the ruins to let them obtain the highest right to mobilize the power of faith… It's not a problem to fight ordinary demigods… If I want to obtain the authority of the complete ruins, I have to fight continuously like this…" Shi Yu said helplessly.
Lin Feng and the White Tiger Mother were stunned on the spot.
Lin Feng was immediately stunned. Holy sh*t, Shi Yu cracked the era ruins that the Four Holy Families, despite joining forces with the archeological association and even the archeologists of the cosmic overlord army, couldn't crack? He just got a ticket for Shi Yu along the way, and Shi Yu cracked it??
This, this, this…
"I was just lucky… Didn't I crack an era ruin on Blue Planet? Both parties happened to have a chain reaction." Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, "Senior Lin Feng, say something."
"F*ck!!!" Lin Feng shouted. "Is this reasonable? The ruins of the Four Saints, inside… How much power of faith is inside…"
"In any case, it's probably enough for the super divine level," Shi Yu muttered. He had the Faith Overdraft, which he could use after the super divine level.
Beside Lin Feng, the White Tiger Mother bit her handkerchief with her canine teeth. Her eyes flickered as she looked at Shi Yu with envy and jealousy before looking at her Beast Tamer. Why didn't her Beast Tamer know how to crack the ruins?
It was so boring to evolve it into the Four Holy Beasts but not have the money to buy the faith item of the era.
Lin Feng: "?"
"In that case, the Four Holy Ruins… will be yours in a month??" Lin Feng asked.
Shi Yu said, "You can say that. I remember that the rules of the World King Planet's archeological association regarding the unearthed ruins seem to be like this."
"No matter what state the ruins are in, if the ordinary ruins are clearly attributable, they will belong to the descendants of the master of the ruins. If they don't clearly belong, they will belong to the world overlord of the earth realm."
"And the ruins of the era from the last cosmic era belong to the person who cracked the ruin. There are no clear geographical restrictions."
"That's indeed the case, but this person has to have the identity of the official world overlord of the World King Planet. Only world overlords can control the ruins of the era," Lin Feng said.
This was also the control method of the World King Planet against the era ruins that had been unearthed. The era ruins contained the special power of the last era. If there was a owner, it naturally had to be one of their own people. And for the World King Planet, one of their own was the official world overlord of the World King Planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1419 Lu Qingyi's Counterattack (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1419 Lu Qingyi's Counterattack (2)
Of course, there was a special label at the end of this law… except for the universe overlord army.
According to the treaty between the World King and the universe overlord, if the archeologists of the universe overlord army cracked the unsolved era ruins of the World King Planet, they could directly take it away without the restrictions of their identity as world overlords.
"Therefore, even if you completely crack the Four Saint Ruins, it's not perfect. Only by becoming a world overlord or joining the universe overlord army can you really have the right to own the era ruins," Lin Feng said.
Shi Yu nodded and said, "I know. It's not difficult to become a world overlord. I've already cultivated the Son of the Stars left on Blue Planet by the Space Emperor to the demigod level and become a low-level star. I can participate in the world overlord assessment at any time and become the master of a third-level domain."
"Or, after participating in the God Sealing Battle and obtaining first place, you can also directly become the master of a third-level realm."
Lin Feng shook his head and said, "Even if you become a world overlord, even if I, the Space Emperor, and the five super divine experts of the five major god races on Blue Planet support you together, the benefits related to the Four Saint Ruins are still too great."
"The Four Holy Family had been eyeing this ruin for a long time. After you obtain the ruin, they definitely won't let the matter rest."
"It's not just the Four Saints Family… They might also be affected by the rules of the World King Planet, so it won't be too obvious. In the starry sky of the universe, the Four Saints Evolvers aren't just from the World King Planet."
"On the contrary, if you join the cosmic overlord army, you can make them retreat in the face of difficulties…" The names of the five super divines on Blue Planet weren't as famous as the cosmic overlord army.
After all, a universe overlord was a universe supreme master. More than 200 super divine level beings served in the army. No matter how strong the Four Saints Family was, they were still weak chickens compared to the universe overlord army.
Even if the Four Holy Beasts of the last era were reborn, whether they could defeat the cosmic overlord army was another matter, let alone the heir of an era.
"Of course, there are also many factions in the cosmic overlord army. Without any strength or backing, you went in. The possibility of your Four Saints Ruins being divided by the Four Saints Evolvers inside is even higher than the possibility of it being divided on World King Planet… Captain Zi Jian is only an archeologist. Although her status is high, her strength hasn't reached the super divine level, so she might not necessarily be able to protect you."
"No matter what, we can't give up on the ruins of the era. I still plan to let the four guys in the ruins fight the God Sealing Battle. When the time comes, we should be exposed." Shi Yu smiled and said, "Let's take it one step at a time. Moreover, the problem shouldn't be very big."
"I'm now the vice president of the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association, the vice president of the World King Planet Planet Plant Association, and the vice president of the Space Disaster Research Institute. If I can still obtain the identity of a world overlord in the future and then break through to the divine level, coupled with the faith power of the era ruins, I'm not necessarily weaker than you and the Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng. An era ruin can definitely be preserved."
"The super divine lives of the Four Holy Family can't come to find trouble with me, right… They're bullying the weak. If that's the case, the few of us can directly hunt them back into the source of transcendence. Wouldn't that be wonderful? We would make a name for ourselves."
He liked this method of baiting people.
It would be pretty good if he could bait a super divine enemy in the Four Holy Ruins.
The era ruin and the divine-level Four Holy Beasts were definitely invincible below super divine. Coupled with the divine-level Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others, Shi Yu felt that after he reached the divine level, he should have the ability to fight against super divines.
Even if he couldn't defeat it, with Qi around, he could definitely run. There was nothing to be afraid of.
Lin Feng and White Tiger Mother: ???
He hasn't even f*cking reached the divine level, and he was already thinking about how to kill a super divine and explode the source of transcendence?
"I wonder if I can hold a position in the cosmic overlord army along with the world overlord of the World King Planet…" Shi Yu thought.
"Wait…" Lin Feng suddenly sensed a blind spot and said, "I know the Environmental Protection Association. I heard from Senior Space Emperor that the Environmental Protection Association's God Bing Ling specifically wants you and Susu, but what the hell is the Plant Association and the Space Disaster Research Institute? "
"When did this happen?"
He suspected that there was something wrong with his hearing.
"Ah, just now, the plant association headquarters wanted to let my Baby Ginseng be the vice president of the Blue Wave Plant Association. I agreed."
"My Baby Ginseng should have developed a fruit with pretty good effects," Shi Yu said.
In order to find and recruit the ginseng emperor who had developed the Cultivation Fruit and the Reincarnation Fruit, Zi Jian directly asked the plant association headquarters for information about the ginseng emperor. After the plant association headquarters saw the information about the ginseng emperor, they had no intention of letting the cosmic overlord army succeed. Therefore, they planned to strike first and give Baby Ginseng extremely high treatment, letting him become the vice president of the Blue Wave Plant Association. Moreover, the salary treatment wasn't inferior to that of the president.
Lin Feng was silent.
"What's with the Space Disaster Research Institute?"
Shi Yu said, "Ling learned the 'Disaster Skill, Starry Sky Storm' through the disaster simulation at the Blue Wave Research Institute. Then, according to its learning EXP, it wrote a paper on modifying battleships and uploaded it to the headquarters of the Disaster Research Institute."
"Recently, there's news from the research institute that Ling's paper is very valued. Several disaster science big shots want to have an academic exchange with us. Of course, there's no time at the moment. We'll first hold a position in the Blue Wave Research Institute and have a higher title. As it's issued on the same date, we might have to wait a while."
At this moment, Lin Feng was confused.
"Give me a minute…" Lin Feng said.
Lin Feng left very peacefully. He wanted to discuss this with the Space Emperor. The last time, the Space Emperor used the Environmental Protection Association to stimulate him. This time, he wanted to use the Plant Association, the Disaster Research Institute, and the era ruin to stimulate the Space Emperor!

chapters.title: Chapter 1420 Lu Qingyi's Counterattack (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1420 Lu Qingyi's Counterattack (3)
If Shi Yu was about to become the master of the Four Holy Ruins, the Blue Planet indeed had to make some preparations in advance.
After Lin Feng left, Shi Yu still stayed at the Four Holy Ruins. He was very calm, and he wasn't afraid of encountering any danger. As long as he didn't leave the Four Holy Ruins, even if a super divine level came, they couldn't do anything to him, the master of the ruins.
Now, Shi Yu was constantly increasing the authority of the ruins and adding points to his pets, waiting for the Four Holy Family to call over the geniuses who had mastered the prototype of top-notch faith divine skills.
About two days later, Shi Yu upgraded all the pets' super race skills to Dao Proficiency. The pets upgraded the super race skill to the quasi-divine skill stage.
At this point, Eleven had 7 quasi-divine skills, Buggy had 7, Baby Ginseng had 9, Chi Tong had 7, Susu had 6, Ling had 8, Little Ji had 7, Duckie had 7, and Little Zi had 3. Qi still only had 1, which was the Space-time Travel. He had yet to teach them the Star Refinement skill.
The Fusion Black Tortoises had a total of eight, while Shorty had five. Apart from that, although the four most talented evolvers of the Four Holy Family had yet to enter the top 50 quasi-divine evolvers before the God Sealing Battle, Shi Yu had also replicated two pretty good faith divine skills and prepared to leave them for the Black Tortoise and the White Tiger.
Next, Shi Yu only needed to add some quasi-divine skills wholeheartedly.
With nearly 100 quasi-divine skills, even if he could spend money, it would probably not be a small project. Fortunately, Shi Yu wasn't a normal person and was confident that he could maximize everyone's potential before the God Sealing Battle.
…
While Shi Yu was working overtime on World King Planet, on Blue Planet.
Under normal circumstances, after the last World Tournament ended, it would take at least seven years for Blue Planet to complete the Mythical Revival and allow demigods to become gods.
This time, because Blue Planet created the cosmic crystal, it was slightly delayed for a while. However, as a large amount of resources were teleported back through the cosmic crystal, along with the World King Planet, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and even the Blue Planet's lineage, this time began to shrink to the limit!
After the gem cat was picked up, it didn't take long for Blue Planet to complete the first round of repairs and completely start the Mythical Revival Era.
The laws of the planet gradually became complete. Countless demigods living on Blue Planet obtained the favor and ascended to the divine level as if they were ascending in the day.
Dong Huang's Divine Source Legendary, Shen Feng's Legendary Z, the Seven Islands Valkyrie, the Snowfield Battle God, the Rongguang Hero King, and the Ming Hua Death God… These Level 9 Beast Tamers in the world also successfully advanced to the divine level.
The Ancient God Golden Bull, the other seven gods of the World Tournament, and many Awakening Gods also recovered all their strength and restored them to their peak states.
Blue Planet welcomed the largest version update.
It wasn't just these experts who were stuck at the Level 9 bottleneck. The low-level experts also advanced one after another. For example, President Lin Xiao of Dong Huang, the legend of the Tyrannical Sea, and the Level 8 presidents of the various countries easily stepped into the legendary level.
In an instant, legendary Beast Tamers, who were rarely more than five in the same era, were born frequently on Blue Planet. Soon, the number of Legendary-level Beast Tamers reached dozens.
Among them, most were old experts, but there were also young Legendary-level Beast Tamers of the new generation.
For example, Dong Huang's Lu Qingyi, who had originally stepped into the Legendary-level not long ago, broke through two levels in an extremely short period of time. As Blue Planet's version were updated, she also reached the Legendary-level.
"We're finally here." In a certain ruin, Lu Qingyi took a deep breath and revealed a happy expression. Now that she was at the Legendary-level, she could also go to World King Planet, right?
Reaching the Legendary-level was something that Lu Qingyi hadn't expected This was all thanks to the skills taught by Emperor Shi before Shi Yu left. He locked onto, found, and drew a map of almost all the Mythical Ruins and Legendary Ruins on Blue Planet and handed it to her.
After Lu Qingyi, who was the president of the Dong Huang Archeological Association and the new director of Bureau 11, obtained the map, she began to crack the ruins almost every day and night. With the help of various parties, the strongest record was to break nine Mythical Ruins in a month.
The opportunities in the ruins were unimaginable. As Lu Qingyi cracked continuously, her and Dong Huang's strength were quickly increasing. However, the gain that surprised Lu Qingyi the most wasn't the opportunities that strengthened her Beast Taming Space to the limit in a certain Mythical Ruins, nor was it a certain divine beast cub.
Instead…
She had received an inheritance in a legendary ruin and obtained a very powerful Beast Taming Talent.
The Beast Tamer who gave her the inheritance was called "Yue Maiden". She was a legendary expert from the totem era.
Her Beast Taming Talent was called "Plunder".
The Plunder talent could plunder the skills of transcendent life forms and create tools. It could also plunder the Beast Taming Talent of humans and create tools. The Awakening Mirror and Talent Bead Shi Yu had once obtained were toys created by the Yue Maiden.
Yue Maiden was thought to be the most terrifying female Beast Tamer among the humans in the totem era before the Beast Taming Era.
In any historical record, there was no record of her later years. It was only when she accidentally entered the inheritance ruins left behind by the Yue Maiden that Lu Qingyi knew that in her later years, the Yue Maiden had been developing her already very abnormal Beast Taming Talent.
The original Plunder talent was only to plunder the Beast Taming Talent and create it as a tool. However, after development, the Yue Maiden successfully did it before she died. She developed the plundering talent into a divine-level talent that could plunder the abilities and talents of other lives and transform them into her own abilities and talents.
Moreover, her research on the divine-level Plunder ability had also allowed her to develop it and let others learn the Plunder talent. Although she knew that this ability was extremely unholy and dangerous, Yue Maiden still chose to pass it down and pair it with cultivation resources. She then hid it in the ruins formed by her Beast Taming Space.
After Lu Qingyi cracked the ruins, she successfully received Yue Maiden's inheritance and learned the divine-level Plunder talent.
Initially, Lu Qingyi felt that the generations of Legendary-level Beast Tamers of Dong Huang who could establish and rebuild the great unification of the human dynasty in the Cultivationless Era were the most impressive batch. But now, she realized that before the Beast Taming Era, there were also many capable people. Although the legendaries of the totem era had no intention of establishing a human dynasty, and there were very few records, it didn't mean that they were weak.
The history of the totem era was much longer than the Beast Taming Era in 2000, and capable people appeared in large numbers during this period.
After cracking many human Legendary Ruins from the totem era, Lu Qingyi gained a lot. Yue Maiden's inheritance was her greatest gain. It was a treasure more suitable for humans than the inheritances left behind by those Mythical Races.
In the Mythical Era, the Totem Era, and the Beast Taming Era, Shi Yu had almost explored the secrets of the Mythical Era and the Beast Taming Era, allowing him to gain a lot. The inheritance of the Totem Era allowed Lu Qingyi to gain a lot.
In Lu Qingyi's opinion, out of the legends of Dong Huang, probably only Emperor Shi could suppress her. Unfortunately… she couldn't live until the Mythical Revival and couldn't enter the starry sky. Otherwise, she would definitely become an existence that made all races in the starry sky tremble in fear.
"This divine-level Plunder ability can't be exposed after arriving at the World King Planet. Apart from Shi Yu, Teacher Ying, and the others, no one can be told." Lu Qingyi stood up and looked at the starry sky outside. Although she had found the Yue Maiden Ruins thanks to Shi Yu, she didn't know if she could surpass Shi Yu with this ability. Lu Qingyi waved her fist excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1421 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1421 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (1)
Although two days had passed in the Four Saints Ruins, this place was still extraordinarily lively. Many Four Saints Evolvers kept challenging the Four Saints Ruins. Many names had already appeared densely on the Four Saints Leaderboard, but until now, no challenger could defeat the Guardian Holy Beast and reach 1 battle power unit.
The difficulty of clearing the ruins made everyone's teeth hurt. Shi Yu, on the other hand, never tired of it. He fused skills for Little Quas, Turtle, and Shorty.
He had to fuse it. The reason why Shi Yu didn't replicate it on a large scale was firstly because it was a waste of energy, and secondly, there would be a bottleneck in the skill index. At the moment, the skill index only had 70 skill slots, and it was almost full. The way to delete skills was first to maximize them and then, secondly, to fuse them into new skills.
Apart from teaching skills, all the racial skills were quasi-divine skills. It was impossible to maximize them, so there was only one way to delete the fusion skill. However, although fusion could delete skills, the problem was that as more and more skills were fused, a situation would quickly appear. The two skills didn't have fusion compatibility, so they couldn't be fused.
At that time, the skill index would really be full, and he couldn't delete it even if he wanted to. Of course, it wasn't very difficult for Shi Yu to increase the page count of the skill index. At the moment, he had contracted 13 pets. The rule of the skill index was to increase the number of skill pages by five for every pet he contracted. However, the current upper limit of the pet Shi Yu could contract was 18. Therefore, as long as he wanted, he could contract five more pets and increase the skill page by 25. This way, he didn't have to worry about the skill page for the time being.
However, Shi Yu wasn't very willing to do this just to replicate more skills and contract new pets. This was because when new pets arrived, they had to be cultivated too. At that time, the new pets would also need a pile of skill pages. In the end, it was still not enough.
Moreover, he still had to spend more energy to add points. Shi Yu had a headache. This was also the reason why Shi Yu didn't awaken the demon cub after the gem cat brought it to the World King Planet. He didn't plan to contract it, as he no longer wanted to nurture pets from scratch.
It was also for this reason that the demon cub brought by the gem cat from Blue Planet had been neglected. Shi Yu originally wanted to sell the demon cub to the Demon Race at a cheap price, but the Demon Race didn't recognize this "ancestor" at all and wasn't interested in the demon cub. Shi Yu couldn't help but sigh. His options were limited!
Therefore, Shi Yu's treatment of the demon cub was to directly give it to the gem cat. If the gem cat was unwilling to become a healer, he would let the gem cat choose a Beast Tamer from Dong Huang and send it over. An orphan cub of the divine race would still be very popular with Beast Tamers. After all, it was a pet with quasi-divine skills. Once it contracted, it directly exceeded 99% of Beast Tamers.
Of course, not wanting to nurture a new pet didn't mean that Shi Yu didn't plan to contract a new pet. Be it the skill page or the stats feedback, they were what Shi Yu needed. However, in terms of choosing, he definitely had to be careful next.
There weren't many pets that could move his heart now. Even if they couldn't reach the level of Qi, they had to at least be like the cosmic behemoth. Shi Yu was still quite interested in the racial talent of the cosmic behemoth race. Apart from being invincible and being able to cross the starry sky, the cosmic behemoth race could also open the "cosmic hole", planetary teleportation array, interstellar teleportation array… They were created by imitating the cosmic hole skills of the cosmic behemoth race. It could be said that the cosmic behemoth race was the easiest race to cross the universe.
If he had a cosmic behemoth as a mount, why would he need the Green Dragon or the Space Battleship Ling?
Unfortunately, the cosmic behemoth race was also the most difficult race to contract… The strongest individual was a cosmic-level race, and none of them were easy to deal with.
"The White King is here…"
Just as Shi Yu was in a daze, the Four Holy Ruins suddenly became noisy. A strong white tigerman in armor with the word "king" on its forehead walked towards the White Tiger Leaderboard step by step.
His arrival attracted the attention of many people. Zong Jie and Zi Jian, who were investigating the ruins, looked over.
"Who is this?" Zi Jian asked casually.
"He's just a small figure. He's the strongest quasi-divine of the White Tiger Family and has mastered the prototype of a top-notch faith divine skill," a member of Zi Jian's special force said.
"I didn't expect him to come first." President Zong Jie of the Green Dragon Family frowned. Among the strongest quasi-divines of the Four Holy Family, the strongest of the Green Dragon Family was followed by the White Tiger Family, the Black Tortoise Family, and the Vermillion Bird Family.
This tigerman named White King had mastered the Power of Retribution. This skill could cause intense damage to everything that had ill intentions towards him.
The super divine family head of the White Tiger Family also mastered this skill. It was said that once, when the White Tiger family head went to the Starry Sky Battlefield, the enemy super divine general learned that the White Tiger family head had arrived and became hostile to him. At this moment, both parties were still separated by a star domain. However, the White Tiger family head directly relied on the other party's hostility to cross a star domain and heavily injure the enemy, the Yun Race's super divine general.
The super divine general of the Yun Race was immediately shocked when he didn't see his opponent heavily injured. He immediately retreated. The World King Planet's bloodline successfully took down this area's resources.
This legend had also warned countless lives on World King Planet that it was best not to have hostility towards the White Tiger Race. Otherwise, they wouldn't even know how they died.
Of course, from the looks of it, it was indeed a little exaggerated. In fact, this Power of Retribution was a faith skill. It needed the support of a huge amount of power of faith to maximize its power. Back then, the White Tiger family head also consumed incomparable power of faith to successfully lock down the enemy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1422 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1422 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (2)
It could be said that as long as they were willing to expend the power of faith, even if the distance was far, enemies who harbored ill intentions towards themselves could be sensed. They could administer punishment across great distances. However, generally speaking, unless they encountered special circumstances, the White Tigers with this skill wouldn't use it casually, as the consumption of the power of faith was indeed enormous.
In proximate combat, the Power of Retribution was much easier to use. After attacking the opponent, it could activate the opponent's malice and awaken the enemy's negative emotions. Then, it would cause a critical hit and release the power of faith needed. It was also much smaller than attacking an unknown enemy.
This was also why the White King could be ranked as the second genius of the Four Holy Family.
"There's finally a strong one." Shi Yu was also gratified when he heard everyone's conversation.
White Tiger Retribution! He had long reserved this skill. With this, as long as there was enough power of faith to support it, he could largely avoid any conspiracy or assassination. Shi Yu felt that someone like him, who could cause trouble, could have half a life more with the White Tiger's retribution skill.
"White King, you're finally here." In a camp around the White Tiger Leaderboard, a top-notch Divine White Tiger looked at the tigerman and said.
"Uncle!" The White King greeted the top-notch White Tiger God. "What's the status now?"
"At the moment, there's still no one who can overcome that Guardian White Tiger. The best result is 0.9 Guardian White Tiger power. It was fought by your big brother, approximately comparable to 90% of the Guardian White Tiger's strength?" The top-notch White Tiger God deduced. "Your strength is several times stronger than that of your big brother. It shouldn't be a problem for you to defeat the Guardian White Tiger!"
"Alright!" The White King nodded and looked at the White Tiger Leaderboard. "Uncle, do you have any other instructions? If not, I'll try challenging it."
"Yes! Remember to… remember to leave all the treasures on you outside," the top-notch White Tiger God said with a strange expression. "The other three Guardian Holy Beasts are alright, but this one is a little strange. Its attack can easily knock away the treasures carried by the challenger. At worst, it can cause a strong blow to the challenger's precious organs. Many challengers lack teeth, claws, and beards after coming out. It's very ferocious."
The White King fell into deep thought and nodded heavily.
Before coming here, what he had heard the most was that the Guardian Holy Beast of the Four Holy Ruins had very high control over the power of faith. However, he wasn't very worried about this. Even if he didn't use the power of faith, he was still the first tier below the Divine Realm.
Although the Power of Retribution could only display the strongest effect with the enhancement of the power of faith, it wasn't impossible to use it without the power of faith. Even half the effect was enough.
His best result in the God Sealing Battle was ranked 20th, so he had the right to be arrogant.
Although the rules in this ruin didn't allow human contractors to assist him, he alone was confident enough to say that he was the strongest White Tiger Evolver below the God Realm.
At this moment, the White King was only worried that the Guardian Holy Beast was an inanimate object and a program. It wouldn't be mobilized by the Power of Retribution. In that case, it would have the greatest headache.
"I wonder if the White King can clear it." As the White King arrived, many White Tiger Evolvers made way. There was no need for it to queue. Everyone wanted to see if the strongest White Tiger Evolver in the quasi-divine stage could pass the White Tiger Leaderboard Ruins.
A moment later, the White King entered the challenge level.
Inside the White Tiger Ruins, the armored Shorty looked at the White King in front of it with a burning gaze.
"Challenger, tell me your name."
"The strongest quasi-divine of the White Tiger Family, White King." White King directly condensed a golden ax and made a battle posture, looking at the short-legged White Tiger in front of him.
Faith skill, White Tiger Warrior!
Weapons forged by the power of faith could be tempered with the power of faith.
"Meow!!!" Both parties instantly attacked together. The White King leaped up. He listened to the other party's cry and fell into deep thought.
Why did it sound like a cat?
However…
Just as the White King had heard, the White Tiger's control over the power of faith was indeed very strong. It only had a trace of the power of faith that it could use. Even if it used the power of faith stored in its body, most of its strength would be deprived by the other party.
Fortunately, the other party couldn't snatch away the faith arms that had condensed into a combat weapon.
Boom!!!
The golden ax was filled with purple light, and the laws of retribution lingered, turning into a purple-gold battle axe. The ax hit the tiger palm of Shorty.
At this moment, to the White King's joy, the Power of Retribution could even activate the malice of the Guardian Holy Beast. This attack directly caused critical hit damage, instantly sending Shorty flying!!
Bang!!!
Giant cracks appeared on the armor, condensed from the strong power of faith in Shorty's body. It was only a step away from shattering. It was also smashed a hundred meters away by the other party and hammered into the wall.
"Hehe." The White King let out a triumphant roar and continued to charge.
Even his trashy big brother obtained 0.9 Guardian White Tiger power. His strength exceeded that of the other party several times. It was reasonable for him to have Guardian White Tiger power several times stronger.
However, just as the White King thought that victory was in its grasp and it could quickly suppress the Guardian White Tiger to win, the overlord-level fluctuations on the Guardian White Tiger suddenly loosened, and its growth level increased to the quasi-divine level. In an instant, its strength increased greatly.
"Possession." At the same time, a voice that only Shorty could hear resounded in its heart. In Shorty's delight, Shi Yu's spirit and soul, with the high-level use of the Fusion Talent and the form of the ruins spirit, possessed Shorty's heart and resonated with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1423 - 1423 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1423 - 1423 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (3)
At this moment, the strength of Shorty, who had removed the level suppression, increased again. In addition, its control over the power of faith exceeded the challenger’s, making the White King’s expression change drastically.
Damn, why did this guardian white tiger level up?
As it was confused, the short-legged White Tiger flew up from the ruins. The White Tiger Armor was instantly repaired, and its roar emitted shocking killing intent. The White Tiger Demon, with every opponent it defeated, could temporarily increase its strength. Shorty, who had been fighting for two days and two nights, had already defeated countless opponents. It, who had been suppressing the White Tiger Demon previously, had also completely activated the White Tiger Demon at this moment.
Boom!!
The blue baleful aura turned into flames and clouds that wrapped around Shorty.
Coupled with the biting, cold, murderous wind, the White King instantly felt like he had fallen into an ice cave. A cold sword was pressed against his neck, and it was difficult to breathe. When he reacted, the tiger’s palm wrapped in battle armor slapped over again. This time, the Faith Battle Soldier was directly shattered. Under the huge, incomparable power, the killing intent devoured the Power of Retribution. Then, right on the heels of that, it hit his chest. With a boom, the White King felt his entire body fall apart, and he flew backward instantly.
“Alright.” In the outside world, Shi Yu’s main body revealed a look of joy. He had obtained the other party’s faith skill!
This time, Shorty may become the greatest winner.
At the same time, Shi Yu roughly knew what level the God Sealing Battle was at. Although the other party didn’t have the power of faith to use at this moment and no contractor could assist in adding buffs, it wasn’t a problem to roughly guess.
“Roar!!!” Soon, the White King, who had been chased out of the ruins, appeared in the outside world covered in injuries, stunning everyone.
Then, they quickly looked at the White Tiger Leaderboard. The White King’s name directly appeared at the top of the ranking, with the power of the Guardian White Tiger at 6.6.
This was still the first time a number above 1 appeared on the four rankings. However, when everyone looked at the White King’s miserable appearance, he didn’t look happy to have obtained victory no matter how they looked at him.
“White King, what’s wrong? Did you win?” The top-notch White Tiger God of the White Tiger Family immediately flew to the side and asked.
“I lost,” the White King said.
“This… This, then what’s wrong with this ranking?” The top-notch White Tiger God was stunned. How could he still lose with 6.6 Guardian White Tiger power?
“1 Guardian White Tiger power should be referring to the strength unit of the Guardian White Tiger when it was maintained at the overlord level. After I defeated it, it directly broke through in the next moment,” the White King said. “After the Guardian Holy Beast broke through, I was completely no match for it.”
“What??” What the hell? The Guardian Holy Beast could break through?
In an instant, many evolvers who challenged the Four Holy Ruins were stunned.
“Then did you receive the reward and trigger anything?” the top-notch White Tiger God immediately asked.
The White King shook his head and said, “There’s nothing.”
Apart from being beaten up, nothing happened.
It was momentarily at a loss.
He didn’t know how he had come all the way from an extraterrestrial planet outside the World King Planet.
Perhaps… he had to defeat the quasi-divine-level Guardian Holy Beast to obtain the reward? The White King looked at the rankings.
Upon hearing that, countless Four Saints Evolvers fell into deep thought. They also looked at the Four Saints Leaderboard and felt that this was a ridiculous pit.
“Boring. I thought there would be some new gains, but I still failed.” Zi Jian of the cosmic overlord troops was wearing an archeological coat. When she heard the White King’s words, she looked bored.
“Wuu…” The White King originally wanted to say that if she could do it, she should go ahead. However, after seeing the other party’s identity, he gave up attacking.
Instead, it said indignantly, “It’s impossible for quasi-divine-level faith creatures to pass this level. If the Guardian Green Dragon is as strong as this Guardian White Tiger, even if Tian Yu comes, he definitely won’t be able to defeat it. This ruin is unsolvable,” the White King said.
…
After the White Tiger Family’s strongest quasi-divine, the White King, triggered the “Guardian Holy Beasts’ breakthrough mechanism”, many Four Saints Evolvers slipped away. They couldn’t even defeat the White King, so how would they waste time?
However, after the weak slipped away, the experts came one after another. After the White King, the strongest quasi-divine Vermillion Bird of the Vermillion Bird Family, Hong Ji, who had mastered the World Destruction Flame, came to the Four Saint Ruins.
However, although he obtained a good result of 4.1 Vermillion Bird power, Chi Tong, who was possessed by Shi Yu, was still insta-killed and replicated the World Destruction Flame.
Shi Yu estimated that he could upgrade the Vermillion Bird clone to the World Destruction Vermillion Bird clone through fusion.
“Sister Hong Ji, you lost too.”
“Get lost.” Hong Ji, who was slashed by Chi Tong, had a sullen expression when she saw the White King running over.
Why did the Vermillion Birds here play with swords?
It didn’t expect that it would actually be chased and slashed. It thought it would win.
There was also the strongest quasi-divine Ming Wu of the Black Tortoise Family.
“Roar!!!” After the muscular turtle was beaten out, it was incredibly furious.
Although it was a Black Tortoise, it mainly cultivated attack skills. However, after fighting for a long time, not a single skill could break through the other party’s defense. The Black Tortoise was really aggrieved.
“Turtle, looks like you lost too.” The White King and Hong Ji paid attention to the entire process of it entering the ruins and coming out.
“Isn’t this very normal?” Ming Wu cursed. “If it could be cleared so easily, it wouldn’t be the era ruin.”
The White King chuckled and said, “I knew it. This ruin is unsolvable.”
Then, the strongest quasi-divine of the Green Dragon Family, Tian Yu, and the genius in the top 10 of the God Sealing Battle also came at the Four Saint Ruins.
If it had faced Shorty, Turtle, and the others, it may have been alright. Unfortunately, it encountered the strongest of Shi Yu’s four beasts, Buggy. The Green Dragon Creation Skill was entirely suppressed by the Creation Domain and crushed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1424 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1424 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (4)
"You lost too." The White King, Hong Ji, and Ming Wu rushed over to congratulate Tian Yu.
"This Guardian Green Dragon also mastered the power of creation…" Tian Yu's face darkened. "I can't use the power of faith, but it can."
"But what do the three of you mean? You seem very happy that I lost?"
White King, Hong Ji, and Ming Wu couldn't deny it. Of course, that was an extraordinary joy.
"Are these guys here to be a joke?" When Captain Zi Jian of the special battle team, who was patiently cracking the ruins, saw the four geniuses of the Four Holy Family being sent flying out of the challenge ruins one after another, she couldn't help but mock.
The four geniuses of the Four Saints Family didn't look very smart.
At this moment, Captain Zi Jian surprisingly saw a figure. That figure, like her, had a smile aimed at the geniuses of the Four Holy Families. Moreover, he smiled as if he was even happier than her. He hid behind the stone pillars of the ruins and smiled.
Zi Jian: "?"
When Zi Jian saw this figure, she recalled something. This guy… wasn't he…
"Shi Yu." Zi Jian activated telepathy with Shi Yu from afar and shouted his name. As for Shi Yu, who had had a huge harvest, he was also stunned when he heard someone call him. Then, he looked at Captain Zi Jian.
"So you didn't leave. You're smiling so happily. Could it be that you made some progress in cracking the ruins? You stayed behind to study this Four Holy Ruins too, right?" She looked at Shi Yu from afar and walked over step by step. She quickly arrived in front of Shi Yu. Although she had the appearance of a young girl, she was even taller than Shi Yu and looked down at him.
"Uh, Captain Zi Jian…" Shi Yu was too happy and didn't notice the other party. He thought that the other party had already forgotten him. In the past few days, he had seen that Zi Jian and President Zong Jie were very fixated with the ruins and didn't care about anything else.
"What can I gain… I just feel that it's a little interesting to see the geniuses of the Four Holy Families suffer," Shi Yu said with an awkward smile.
"Have you considered my previous words? Are you interested in joining the cosmic overlord army and serving me?" she said. "The archeological association of the World King Planet can't even see your talent. You should know what's more suitable for you, right?"
"Thank you for your good intentions, Captain Zi Jian. I'll consider it," Shi Yu immediately said.
"I hope you'll consider it seriously."
Seeing that Shi Yu was really boring, Zi Jian snorted and turned to leave. As for Shi Yu, he looked at the sky and continued to summarize his gains.
…
After a few days since the opening of the Four Holy Ruins of the Heavenly Spirit Realm, in the Floating Realm, the Space Emperor kept hearing the news from the Heavenly Spirit Realm and was completely convinced.
What did he say? An archeologist was definitely not a down-to-earth profession. After hearing from Lin Feng that Shi Yu had cracked the Four Holy Ruins, the Space Emperor was shocked and delighted.
But soon, he understood that Shi Yu was playing more and more over there. He had even messed with the younger generation of the Four Holy Families over and over again. He had already expected how much resistance Shi Yu would face when he moved the ruins…
The era ruins had a very strong speciality, unlike ordinary ruins that could transform into ruins props and be casually taken away. They were like a small world. If they wanted to move away, it was worse than a planet wandering in the universe, and the commotion was even greater than the explosion of the sun. At that time, it was impossible to hide it. The entire Heavenly Spirit Domain would be shocked.
"Old Wang, you're still worried?" In the Sky City temple, Lin Feng flew over and held a bottle of wine. "Shi Yu said that if he wants to obtain the authority of the ruins, he has to keep fighting. This can't be helped."
"Aren't you surprised? I originally said that it would take Shi Yu a few years to achieve good results in the God Sealing Battle, but from the looks of it, in just a few months, his Blue Sea Sprite has evolved into a cleansing star spirit. His Iron-eating Beast defeated the junior god of the Kirin Race, and its mechanical phantom beast learned disaster skills. The Four Holy Beasts he cultivated also quickly grew up because they cracked the ruins of the era and acquired a huge amount of faith resources…"
"That Green Dragon even defeated the strongest quasi-divine Tian Yu of the Green Dragon Family, who's eighth in the God Sealing Battle, right? Why do I feel that this beast, Shi Yu, can obtain pretty good results in the God Sealing Battle this year?"
"As long as he can use those Four Holy Beasts… Perhaps he can really vie with the top few monsters who took first place… We just need to resolve his mess."
"Yes…" The corners of the Space Emperor's mouth also twitched. He didn't expect Shi Yu to improve so quickly. The Dragon God who came to the World King Planet with Shi Yu had cultivated three quasi-divine skills in a short period of time. It was already shocking enough, but Shi Yu was even more ridiculous.
"Let's not talk about him first. How's the situation on Blue Planet?" Lin Feng asked.
Emperor Kong said, "At this time, it should have completely revived. The latest news hasn't come yet."
As soon as the Space Emperor finished speaking, in the teleportation area, Zi Lan, the disciple of the Space Emperor who used the Teleportation Key Stones to travel to Blue Planet and World King Planet, flew in the direction of the Sky City Temple with an anxious expression.
The Space Emperor frowned and looked in a certain direction. He muttered, "What a coincidence. Our communication ambassador is here, but from the looks of it, what she brought back doesn't seem to be good news…"
"Huh?" Lin Feng also looked in the direction Zi Lan flew in.
"Zi Lan, what happened?" The Space Emperor teleported the flying Zi Lan to the temple from afar. At this moment, Zi Lan was panting. She looked at the Space Emperor and Lin Feng and said, "Teacher, Lord Lin Feng, bad news."

chapters.title: Chapter 1425 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1425 Shearing the Four Holy Family's Wool (5)
"Something happened on Blue Planet."
"Blue Planet's revival failed?" Lin Feng asked.
"No, it succeeded. A month ago, Blue Planet was successfully revived. In a month, it steadily completed its restoration. Those demigods who were stuck at the demigod-level bottleneck for hundreds or thousands of years were able to break through. Those gods of the Blue Planet's Mythical Era also recovered their peak strength."
"Isn't that good?" Lin Feng said.
"However, apart from allowing the current legendary demigod to break through and allow the gods of the Mythical Era to recover to the peak, the revival of Blue Planet has also awakened some invaders who have yet to be completely eliminated since the Mythical Era!"
"In the past half a month, several divine-levels have mysteriously disappeared. In the end, it's completely confirmed that they were swallowed by a remaining Space Worm!"
"There's a Space Worm. I don't know what method it used to dodge the cleansing at the end of the Blue Planet War and survive until now. This Space Worm is very strong, and its strength has reached the realm of an intermediate god. Apart from the abilities of the Space Worm Race, it also mastered the power of the abyss. It might have devoured the abyss invaders in its early years."
"The current junior gods on Blue Planet aren't its match at all."
"Most importantly, this Space Worm is very careful. It has been hiding in the dark and only ambushes divine-level creatures. It doesn't do any other damage and is still evolving quickly. At this rate, when it grows to the level of a high-level god, Blue Planet will be in danger."
At this moment, when they heard Zi Lan's report, Emperor Kong and Lin Feng revealed serious expressions.
There was actually a Space Worm left on Blue Planet?
"Where's the Blue Planet's Will and the World Tree? Those junior gods left behind aren't their match. It should have a way, right?" Lin Feng said.
"Even if it hasn't recovered to its peak, it shouldn't be a problem to deal with an intermediate god."
Zi Lan said, "The Blue Planet's will can't confirm its position either. It said that the other party's ability is very strange and is similar to a cosmic behemoth. It said that not only might this Space Worm have devoured the flesh and blood of the Abyss Race, but it might also have devoured the blood of the cosmic behemoth that was killed back then and then learned its divine power. It's very difficult to find."
"Moreover, the planet's laws have just been perfected. If the Blue Planet's will uses the power of the world to fight an intermediate deity now, the recovered planet will probably immediately fall back to its original state."
"What the hell? It devoured the cosmic behemoth and the Abyss Race again. The three races have fused," Lin Feng couldn't help but say.
"So now, we can only come to Teacher and the others to ask for help. The present Blue Planet almost doesn't have any way to fight back this guy," Zi Lan said.
The Space Emperor and Lin Feng looked at each other and were serious. The key was that they didn't lose for the time being. Although the present Blue Planet could accommodate divine-levels, they couldn't pass at all.
At the moment, on the World King Planet, only Zi Lan, the Phoenix Man, the Angel Race, the Demon Race, the geniuses they brought, Shi Yu, the Dragon God, and the gem cat could head to Blue Planet.
"Wait, you just said that the Space Worm nurtures the power of the abyss?" the Space Emperor suddenly said.
"Yes, Teacher."
"Lin Feng, go find Shi Yu and let Shi Yu return to Blue Planet. He should be able to settle this matter," the Space Emperor said. "Let's prepare some tools that can be used by him."
"Uh." Lin Feng was stunned before quickly reacting. Yes, if it was a simple intermediate-level god, Shi Yu definitely couldn't do anything. At the divine level, the strength of each stage would undergo a qualitative change. Even the number one in the past God Sealing Battles, who had challenged for hundreds of years, had never been able to defeat an intermediate-level deity two levels higher.
However, if this intermediate deity was an abyssal life form, it would be a different story. Shi Yu had contracted the cleansing star spirit. To handle the Abyss Race, the battle power of the cleansing star spirit had to increase by at least one level. This was restraint. In addition, Shi Yu's cleansing star spirit's cleansing skill was a top-notch law that contained attack stats. It had to increase by at least two levels. In addition to their preparations, a cosmic abyss worm shouldn't be able to cause any waves.
"I'll go find Shi Yu," Lin Feng said.
"Wait, wait?!" Zi Lan was stunned. She looked at the two lords. The opponent was an intermediate god, but was he letting Shi Yu go?

chapters.title: Chapter 1426 Blue Planet's Number One Person (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1426 Blue Planet's Number One Person (1)
Shi Yu was addicted to pulling wool.
The arrival of the geniuses of the Four Holy Family began to give Shi Yu relatively good gains.
Then, a month later, through continuous battles, Shi Yu finally obtained complete authority over the ruins!
For the past month, the Four Holy Beasts in Shi Yu's team had been fighting every day and at all times.
The huge EXP bar was simply a leap in their battle power.
Especially Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty. Their strength directly changed from the little transparency of the second team to the monster level that wasn't inferior to the first team.
Under the enhancement of the power of faith, it could also completely fight head-on with a junior god.
Unfortunately, due to the specialty of the era ruins, it couldn't be turned into a ruin tool at all. Although he had completely become the owner of the ruins, Shi Yu couldn't easily move them away.
If he moved away, the commotion would be too big. At the moment, he had yet to legally obtain the identity of the ruins. He needed to consider it in the future.
It was also because of this that Shi Yu was still cultivating in the ruins and didn't leave immediately.
Although he had already taken the greatest advantage, the one Shi Yu had let in to challenge was only at the demigod level.
After that, he was also prepared to let the divine level in. At that time, he could start a new round of cutting grass.
"It's about time. From tomorrow onwards, I'll start to give the junior god the right to challenge." Standing in the ruins, Shi Yu thought to himself.
For the past two days, he had done nothing.
It was to mobilize the essence of the power of faith in the ruins to temper the Four Holy Beasts in the team.
This process could optimize their Four Holy Beasts bloodlines and increase their bloodline levels.
It allowed their physical strength, energy value, life force, spiritual power, and soul strength to increase greatly.
In addition to the new faith skills that had been replicated and fused, their current bloodline levels should have already exceeded most divine-level Four Holy Beasts. They could even suppress divine-level Four Saints Evolvers with their bloodlines.
"Huh?" Shi Yu, who was in deep thought, was suddenly stunned. He suddenly realized that Senior Lin Feng, who had left to return to the Floating Realm a long time ago, had come to the ruins again.
"Senior Lin Feng, have you calculated it?"
"I was just about done here when you came."
Just as Lin Feng entered, Shi Yu teleported near him and said with a smile.
He remembered that he had previously said that after obtaining the complete authority of the ruins, he would give Lin Feng a pile of the power of faith of the White Tiger.
Two days ago, he had just obtained the complete authority of the ruins, and now Lin Feng was here. It really didn't take a while.
"Shi Yu!" After Lin Feng arrived, he was slightly stunned when he heard Shi Yu's words. "You succeeded?"
He naturally knew what Shi Yu meant by "finished". Lin Feng couldn't help but be delighted.
Good kid!
With the Four Holy Ruins, Shi Yu himself cultivated the Four Holy Beasts. After Shi Yu stepped into the divine level, even if Shi Yu was a pig, he could lead his pets to be almost invincible below the super divine.
The Dong Huang bloodline on Blue Planet still had a very strong sense of belonging to the name Dong Huang.
But soon, Lin Feng's expression changed. "That's not the most important thing now… Let's talk somewhere else! I have other things to talk to you about."
"Huh?" Shi Yu saw Lin Feng's expression change and said, "Alright."
"Did something happen to Teacher Ying in the Blue Wave World… I dreamed last night that she went berserk during cultivation and evolved from a cat into a golden leopard."
"No, no…" Lin Feng was speechless. What kind of dream was this?
Shi Yu brought Lin Feng to an independent space. In space, Lin Feng said solemnly, "Something happened to Blue Planet."
Lin Feng told Shi Yu about Zi Lan's reports to the Space Emperor one by one.
During this period, Shi Yu's expression kept changing. In the end, when Lin Feng finished speaking, he said, "Why are there still remaining invaders on Blue Planet…"
"The other party's methods are indeed shocking. Back then, among the three invaders of Blue Planet, this worm was one of them and swallowed the other two. Its talent now should be only inferior to the Worm Empress at that time." The corners of Lin Feng's mouth twitched.
It was alright to devour the Abyss Race and successfully digest it, but this guy was actually suspected to have even swallowed a portion of the flesh and blood of a super divine-level cosmic behemoth and survived. This was very terrifying.
"So it means that you want me to bring Susu back to kill, right?" Shi Yu said.
Lin Feng nodded and said, "None of the experts above the intermediate god level on the floating planet have the teleportation point of Blue Planet. We can't go over. Even if we can go over, the resources needed to reach the divine level are too expensive. We can't afford it. As for relying on interstellar navigation from World King Planet to Blue Planet now, even if it's very smooth, it will take several years."
"At the moment, you're the only one who can go back and deal with that guy. Susu can pose a threat to that intermediate god with the specialty of the cleansing star spirit."
"Moreover, you've also successfully forged the Four Holy Ruins and accumulated enough faith power. The Four Holy Beasts should be able to pose a certain threat to intermediate-level, right?"
"In addition, Senior Space Emperor and I will also prepare some equipment and assets to temporarily boost your strength."
"What we mean is that you should go back and take a look first. If you can't resolve it, I'll try to go to Blue Planet from here! Although it will take a long time, this is the only way."
"Alright, I understand. I'll prepare and go back immediately," Shi Yu said seriously.
Lin Feng said, "I heard that that guy is fairly wretched. It clearly has the strongest strength on Blue Planet and has been preying in the dark. It conceals for a long time every time it hunts. After you reach there, you might not necessarily be able to locate it immediately."

chapters.title: Chapter 1427 Blue Planet's Number One Person (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1427 Blue Planet's Number One Person (2)
"Therefore, the situation on Blue Planet shouldn't be that bad. Set off after you've prepared adequately."
"I see. Then I'll accumulate more power of faith…" Shi Yu said.
As for the opponent being very sneaky? That wasn't a problem.
Back then, Yun An was also like this. However, through the owl's premonition, he still found it.
Even if the Prediction Owl couldn't predict the divine-level location, there was still Shorty.
Now, Shorty had also learned the Retribution White Tiger skill.
At that time, it could shout and curse that worm.
As long as it developed a trace of hostility…
In that case, Shi Yu could squander the power of faith to find its location.
"Senior Lin Feng, help inform Teacher Ying of the Blue Wave World and let her go back with me. I might need her help."
Teacher Gem Cat's Wish Star skill…
The opponent was an intermediate-level god. Even if Shi Yu had a bunch of advantages, he didn't dare be sloppy. He had never fought an intermediate-level god. It was already so difficult for Eleven to fight a weak initial-level god of the Kirin Race. One could imagine the strength of an intermediate-level god.
The opponent was a monster of the Space Worm Race that suppressed all the gods on Blue Planet. They had to be fully prepared.
In terms of strength, it might be close to a high-level god.
Although the cat wasn't strong, it was always good to have more support.
Shi Yu had also copied the Wish Star skill, but unfortunately, his pets didn't learn compatibility. It was a huge loss.
A moment later, Senior Lin Feng left. Shi Yu shouted at Buggy, Chi Tong, Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty at the same time.
"That's what happened. Next, we might have to return to Blue Planet to deal with the unexpected situation."
"We can't take away the Four Holy Ruins, but we can take away some faith power. I'll give you a day. Try your best to absorb the power of faith and store it in your bodies until the limit."
"I will also condense the power of faith into a faith crystal through authority and store it away."
"Roar!!" Buggy and the others replied in their territory.
Intermediate god?
This wasn't easy to fight.
"Yi!" Only Baby Ginseng was slightly excited. Was its divine-level first clear finally here?
Lin Feng, the Space Emperor, and the others placed their hopes on Susu and the Four Holy Beasts, but Baby Ginseng was also very impressive.
So what if Eleven defeated a primary-level god! It was going to blow up an intermediate-level god now!
"Baby Ginseng, assist well and don't think too much."
"Blue Planet has just recovered and is still in a weak stage. It's not for you to blow up."
Baby Ginseng: "…Wu wu wu wu."
Shi Yu shook his head and began to condense the faith crystal, preparing to take it away as a resource. This also required time.
At the same time, he also began to summarize his profits during this period of time and formulate tactics.
On Buggy's side, the skills didn't change much. Shi Yu also copied a few Green Dragon faith skills, including the Green Dragon Creation of the strongest quasi-divine feather of the Green Dragon Family.
However, these skills were all included by Buggy's skills.
The success rate of the fusion of the Green Dragon Creation Domain and the Creation Domain was actually extremely high.
After fusing, Shi Yu realized that the abilities of these two skills were 99% similar. It was almost as if the same skill had changed its name. Fortunately, it didn't occupy the skill slot.
Apart from that, the other faith skills that Shi Yu took a fancy to were also perfectly included by the Creation Domain and the Green Dragon Indestructible Body. They had all fused.
The current Green Dragon Indestructible Body could be said to be a very perfect physique. As long as there was the power of faith, one could achieve immortality and could recover from injuries in seconds. It enabled one to unleash bursts of energy, allowing Buggy and the others to fight for a month without resting. It was all thanks to their abnormal physique skills that they could use the power of faith to recover from injuries, vitality, and energy without any burden.
Just like Buggy, the changes on Chi Tong's side were also relatively small. The compatibility between the Vermillion Bird clone and other faith skills was very high. The few faith skills copied had also been fused into the Vermillion Bird clone. Among them, the greatest gain was the "World Destruction Flame".
This was a true divine skill that contained the prototype of a world-destroying law. It was stronger than the Destruction law mastered by Little Ji. Of course, according to the Creation Domain, it was still a little inferior. After all, creation was much harder than destruction.
If Buggy and Chi Tong's improvement was just icing on the cake, then the enhancement of the Fusion Black Tortoise and the Armored White Tiger was a qualitative change.
< Name > Shorty
[Race Skill]
"Quasi Divine-level": Metal Control (expert), Gem King Eye (expert), Killing Wind (expert), White Tiger Fiend (expert), faith skill, White Tiger Divine Armor (expert), faith skill, Retribution White Tiger (expert), faith skill, Treasure Hunting White Tiger (expert)
Apart from the most special Retribution White Tiger, the other copied faith skills were fused by Shi Yu into the White Tiger Armor skill. The White Tiger Armor evolved into the White Tiger Divine Armor. The difference of one word was like the difference between heaven and earth.
The current White Tiger Divine Armor had almost become the normal state like Buggy's Green Dragon Indestructible Body. It had various effects, including healing, strengthening, defense, eruption, attack, support, and many other abilities.
It could be said that compared to the real body of Shorty, the White Tiger Divine Armor was more like its main body. As long as the enemy didn't completely blast the White Tiger Divine Armor into nothingness, all the damage Shorty suffered would be transferred to the armor.
Even if its main body was blasted into pieces, there was still a fragment of the armor outside. It could also rely on the power of faith to be reborn with this armor fragment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1428 Blue Planet's Number One Person (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1428 Blue Planet's Number One Person (3)
At the same time, Shorty could also condense the White Tiger Divine Armor and let other people wear it, such as Shi Yu.
Moreover, the White Tiger Divine Armor could also resonate and strengthen, forming an army skill effect. It wasn't a big problem to create a White Tiger Army wearing the White Tiger Divine Armor.
< Name > Fusion Black Tortoise
[Race Skill]: "Quasi Divine-level": Quas Control (expert), Water Control (expert), Absolute Zero (expert), Faith skill, Dark North Shield (expert), Faith skill, Sea Suppression Seal (expert), Respect Skill, Holy Black Tortoise Body (expert), Faith skill, Turtle Divination (expert), Faith skill, Black Tortoise Fist (expert)
It was the same for Turtle and the others. First, a pile of messy faith skills fused into a perfect physique skill. This time, with the Black Tortoise Divine Power as the core, it fused into the Holy Black Tortoise Body.
Apart from that, Turtle's Water of Life also fused in and was absorbed by the higher power. Little Quas's Vortex Strangulation fused into the Water Control.
The nature of the Green Dragon Indestructible Body, the Vermillion Bird clone, the Holy Black Tortoise Body, and the White Tiger Divine Armor were similar. Their abilities were very comprehensive, but in some directions, their specialization was a little different.
The Green Dragon Indestructible Body focused on strength and speed, mainly battle power. This might not be the true physique of the Four Holy Green Dragons, but it was Buggy's own wish.
Their evolutionary directions were all according to their own ideas.
For example, Buggy wanted to be first on the team and compete with Eleven. Its Green Dragon Indestructible Body mainly focused on battle power, and all other abilities were in service of battle.
For example, Chi Tong's wish was to protect Shi Yu.
The Vermillion Bird clone could make one's soul indestructible, complete evolution, and become a real life form, reviving from the dead.
It could be said that Baby Ginseng's Undying Fruit, together with the blessings of the Vermillion Bird, was equivalent to Shi Yu having an immortal body.
Even if its body and soul were destroyed, as long as Chi Tong didn't die, it could save Shi Yu through the traces of the contract.
On the other hand, the Holy Black Tortoise Body had unlimited life and endless energy. It could share its life with others and let people live a long time. It was probably not a problem for Shi Yu, who had contracted it, to live for as long as he wanted.
As the Turtle Prime Minister, it was its wish to allow Shi Yu live for a long time, while Little Quas wanted to have more energy to serve Shi Yu.
From this, it could be seen that their skills had very strong preferences. Although they were all blended and evolved, they were more or less affected by their preferences. This was also a characteristic that Shi Yu only discovered later.
[The skills evolved and blended are related to the experience, personality, and wishes of the pet. It's a manifestation of the heart.]
As for the greatest trait of the White Tiger Divine Armor, it could naturally share the armor with others and let others increase in all aspects, forming an army skill.
Shi Yu calculated that this cat really wanted to establish some Shi Yu Divine Sect. It had even prepared the team uniform for its believers. It was the White Tiger Divine Armor.
Of course, this wasn't the most important thing. The most important thing were the two new skills obtained by the Black Tortoise.
Faith skill, Turtle Divination.
Faith skill, Black Tortoise Fist.
Although Turtle Divination wasn't a battle skill, Shi Yu replicated it almost immediately after discovering it.
He was even more pleasantly surprised than seeing any skill. He was almost knocked out by joy.
In Shi Yu's opinion, this skill was simply too impressive.
With the help of Turtle Divination, the Black Tortoise could sign a temporary contract with other lives.
Then, it could form an alternate space. This alternate space was called the Netherworld.
In the Netherworld, it could consume the power of faith and summon this person's ancestor soul.
It wasn't really awakening the undead, but finding traces of its history in the universe.
Just like how the shadow of history in the ruins would be recorded by time, traces of life forms actually could too, but it was even harder to see, and this skill could do it.
In the Netherworld, the Black Tortoise could consume the power of faith to ask some questions to the awakened undead. Then, it could bring back the answers and show them to the world in the shape of a prophecy.
Wasn't this an awesome archeological skill?
