The one who knew this skill was a divine-level old turtle. The other party was quite famous in the entire World King Planet. With this ability, it also earned a lot of faith power.
The condition it gave for divination was that it had to double the price of the power of faith needed.
Shi Yu didn't replicate this skill while in combat, but this old turtle set up a stall in the ruins. Shi Yu found other opportunities to replicate it.
In Shi Yu's opinion, this skill was his greatest gain this time…
Turtle was forever a god.
The other was the Black Tortoise Fist. It was a skill with a very simple name. Shi Yu had replicated it on the strongest quasi-divine of the Black Tortoise Family. This skill sounded ordinary, but the effect was extraordinary.
Just like the Dragon Star Group, the Black Tortoise Fist could be condensed in advance! It could store the fist intent that had blended with the power of faith in its body.
However, unlike the Dragon Star Group, as long as the Black Tortoise Fist blended a trace of power of faith, it could increase the power of faith itself endlessly, thereby strengthening its strength. It could be said to be a faith skill that saved a lot of power of faith.
Moreover, the increase in speed wasn't slow. Coupled with the terrifying lifespan of the Black Tortoise, one could imagine how terrifying the strength of the Black Tortoise that knew this skill could erupt if it seriously prepared for battle and endured for millions of years before fighting.
If the Faith Overdraft that Shi Yu wanted to learn was a loan, then this Black Tortoise Fist could actually be saved and even generate interest. This opened a new path of thinking for Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1429 Blue Planet's Number One Person (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1429 Blue Planet's Number One Person (4)
It could be said that if it weren't for the fact that in this ruin, Turtle and the others had the absolute right to control the power of faith, in addition to the fact that the genius of the Black Tortoise Family was young, this battle wouldn't have been easy.
"Ruins… Why are the ruins closed?!"
A few days later, something unexpected happened in the Four Holy Ruins.
Under everyone's stunned expressions, the Four Saints Leaderboard emitted a violent light. A "large amount" of essence power of faith spewed out of the Four Saints Stone Tablet.
Seeing this, many of the Four Saints Evolvers' eyes turned red, but the power of faith of the Four Saints seemed to have a master as it lingered around the four lives, not giving others a chance to fight.
These four lives were surprisingly the strongest quasi-divines of the four major families.
During this period of time, they had maintained first place on the Four Saints Leaderboard and were the challengers with the best battle results.
Seeing the appearance of the Four Holy Ruins and rewarding them, everyone also felt that it was only natural.
However, for these four people…
"That's it?" The genius quasi divine of the Four Saints Family sensed the power of faith lingering and fell into deep thought.
The power of faith was too weak!
For the other Four Saints Evolvers, this might be a lot, but who were they? The Four Saints Family was the strongest below the Divine Realm. Every year, the power of faith distributed by the family was more than this!
This wasn't why they wasted a month in the Four Saints Ruins!
Soon, everyone was teleported out.
"Damn it!" Captain Zi Jian looked at the closed ruins and was very dissatisfied. She felt that… it was such a shame.
The ruins closed at this moment, making her suspect that the ruins were targeting her.
"Be content. Usually, the Four Saint Ruins only open for 10 days. This time, it's only shut after a month," someone said.
"How can I be satisfied? In the past, even if it only opened for a day, I could still obtain some power of faith, but this month… It seems like no one has obtained the power of faith. This time, it's a huge pit!"
"No, no, no. Those geniuses from the Four Saints Family still obtained it."
"It's still a scam!"
Many Four Saints Evolvers cursed.
When Shi Yu heard that, he felt extremely guilty. He retreated slightly behind the crowd and prepared to leave.
It wasn't that he was stingy.
Instead, it was because he couldn't bear to give too much. It didn't matter if he was extravagant with his pets. However, giving the force of faith to people he didn't know was even more uncomfortable than killing him. Shi Yu only gave some to the four leaderboards on account of the fact that they had provided four top-notch skills.
Otherwise, he wouldn't give a single bit of force of faith.
"Four Holy Ruins… See you in a few months." Shi Yu left the Four Holy Ancient City dejectedly. Although he couldn't take away the Four Holy Ruins, he had taken away a large number of faith crystals this time.
This amount was enough for four little holy beasts to dissipate their support points every day and fight above their level for a few years.
It was enough for a long time.
…
Floating Realm.
Soon after, Shi Yu returned. Just as Shi Yu arrived at the Sky Temple, he discovered that the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, the Dragon God, and the gem cat were all here.
"Senior Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng, Senior Dragon God, Teacher Ying," Shi Yu immediately said after landing.
"Yes." Everyone nodded.
"You're here." The Space Emperor said, "Did the preparations go smoothly?"
"Yes," Shi Yu said.
"Then I'll leave Blue Planet to you to take a look, but don't force it. If you're not an opponent, retreat immediately. Then, let Lin Feng slowly rush to Blue Planet," the Space Emperor said.
"Wu." Lin Feng looked bitter. To be honest, he didn't want to undergo a few years of starry sky navigation. It was too boring and too dangerous.
"I'll do my best," Shi Yu said. "Is Senior Dragon God going back too?"
The Dragon God shook her head and said, "Forget it. I can't help you even if I go. I'll leave it to you."
The Dragon God was naturally informed that something had happened to Blue Planet, but she was helpless. Even if she returned to Blue Planet to break through, she wasn't a match for an intermediate god.
Lin Feng said, "Only you this time. Teacher Ying will go."
"Sigh." Teacher Ying had a bitter expression. What was going on? Previously, she didn't want to come to the World King Planet because she was worried that the World King Planet would be in danger. In the end, now that she had come to the World King Planet, Blue Planet was the one in danger first. Moreover, it was pulled to a perilous place by Shi Yu to commit a sin!
Of course, Teacher Ying only complained on the surface. If the danger involved Dong Huang, she would definitely attack with all her might. A hundred years ago, an undead disaster happened in the Ancient Capital. The gem cat could have escaped, but in order to save the students at that time, it still exceeded the limit and completed its evolution, leading the teachers and students to counterattack.
Unfortunately, this story was only living in legends. After entering a peaceful era, Teacher Ying seemed to have its will corroded by corruption and became more and more corrupt.
If it weren't for Shi Yu's admission, she might still be counting money at Ancient Capital University.
"There's no time to lose. Teacher Ying, let's go," Shi Yu said to Teacher Ying after obtaining the backing equipment and resources from the Space Emperor and the others.
"Alright."
Both parties took out the Teleportation Key Stones and the cosmic crystals prepared by the Space Emperor.
"Have a safe trip," the Space Emperor and the others said.
"Wait for our good news," Shi Yu said.
As the cosmic crystal fused into the Teleportation Key Stones, Shi Yu and the gem cat's bodies were wrapped in strong white light. Then, they disappeared from the World King Planet.
After they left, the Dragon God looked worried.
Emperor Kong said, "Senior Dragon God, don't worry. Believe in Shi Yu. When Lin Feng and I were legendaries back then, we were already mixed in the battlefield with top-notch gods and were chased all day. What he's facing now isn't an impossible challenge. To him, it shouldn't be a crisis. Young people have to experience some training."

chapters.title: Chapter 1430 Blue Planet's Number One Person (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1430 Blue Planet's Number One Person (5)
Lin Feng said bitterly, "Stop talking, or I'll start crying."
At the thought of Shi Yu's comfortable life after coming to the World King Planet for the past few months and how this vice president had even cracked an era ruin, he felt that he had suffered too much at that time.
"That's true." The Dragon God nodded. Although she felt that it was a little difficult for Shi Yu to face an intermediate god after coming to World King Planet to cultivate for a few months, she was relieved when she thought of the miracle Shi Yu had created previously.
…
Blue Planet, Inatella.
After a few months, Shi Yu and Teacher Ying returned.
"I didn't expect to return after leaving for so long."
"The current Blue Planet… is much more comfortable than before." Shi Yu sensed Blue Planet's current situation and smiled.
"Yes." The gem cat looked around in its cat form. Although it was much inferior to the Blue Wave World, it was already much better than the previous Blue Planet.
"Teacher Ying, have you thought of how to deal with that Demon Divine Stone? Why don't you give it to Senior Lu and the others?" Shi Yu said.
"I won't send you off anymore!" The gem cat muttered. "I'll raise it myself. On World King Planet, I want to do something big. I can't always rely on clones… I have to have other underlings."
"Moreover, this little demon is too pitiful. First, it was despised by you, then by the Demon God Race. It can be said to be a divine-level orphan. I feel that it's definitely a protagonist. Its future is immeasurable."
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, "Alright… Then you can do it. Don't cripple it."
"What do you mean, what do you mean!"
As the two parties conversed, a green tree worm crawled over from somewhere. When it saw Shi Yu and the gem cat, it was extremely surprised.
"Shi Yu???"
"Why are you guys back??"
The World Tree clone frowned and realized that things weren't simple.
The Space Emperor's disciple, Zi Lan, left and ran to the World King Planet to find a way to solve the hidden danger of Blue Planet. In the end, Shi Yu and that cat returned?
"Didn't something happen to Blue Planet? I came back to settle it." Shi Yu stretched out his hand and greeted the World Tree clone. "Yo, long time no see."
"Long time no see," the gem cat also uttered lazily. After seeing the world, it sensed different when it came back to its poor hometown. It looked at Blue Planet's World Tree as if it was looking at the village chief.
The World Tree clone: "…"
"Wait?!" The World Tree clone was slightly shocked. Something was wrong, right? The hidden danger was an intermediate god, and it wasn't a weak intermediate god. Shi Yu would solve it?
Shi Yu's previous strongest legendary status, the strongest identity below the divine level, was no longer useful on the current version of Blue Planet.
"Don't underestimate me," Shi Yu said.
"Yes, don't underestimate this kid. Eleven can defeat a junior god on World King Planet alone without the enhancement of a Beast Tamer," the cat said. "Now that their entire team is back and they have the support equipment of the Space Emperor and the others, an intermediate god can't cause any trouble."
"Uh." The World Tree clone was bitter. Beginner gods were different from intermediate gods!
However, since the Space Emperor and the others had sent Shi Yu back, Shi Yu should have a way.
"The greatest issue now is how to find it," the World Tree clone said. "After finding it, I'll attack with you. We have to destroy this guy."
Although there might be a risk of falling to the world level if he used the power of the world now, the internal hidden danger still had to be eliminated.
"I already have a way."
"What way?" the World Tree clone said.
Shi Yu said, "Baiting law enforcement."
World Tree: ???
"With that Baby Ginseng??" The World Tree said, "That guy is cunning. Your Baby Ginseng is only at the demigod level. Even if it's very nourishing, it's definitely more nourishing at the divine level with divine power. It might not fall for it."
"No, I mean baiting all the divine-levels on Blue Planet at the moment."
"Moreover, this is only one of the methods. I'll find the other methods. Lord World Tree, can you help me connect to the divine level of the entire Blue Planet?" Shi Yu said.
Although the World Tree was confused, it still nodded and helped Shi Yu connect to the native gods of Blue Planet.
In the next moment, the divine-level Beast Tamers of the seven countries, such as Dong Huang Divine Source, the Seven Islands Valkyrie, the Elven Empress in Tingxiang, the revived gods, such as Ancient God Golden Bull, who was a guest in Dong Huang, and the new gods on Blue Planet, all received the notice of the World Tree.
During this period of time, because of the devour assassin hidden in the darkness, everyone at the Blue Planet divine level felt threatened. The mentality of an old god like Ancient God Golden Bull was relatively stable, but some new gods of the totem empire were too panicked.
They had just advanced to the divine level, but their lives were in danger. Now, they really hoped that Lord World Tree could quickly find a way to deal with this worm in the darkness.
"Hello, everyone." However, to the surprise of these gods, the voice of the World Tree didn't come from the telepathy that connected the world's divine levels.
It was another familiar and unfamiliar voice.
The new divine-level Beast Tamers of the seven countries were immediately stunned when they heard this voice.
"Shi Yu?" The Divine Source Legendary in Dong Huang was very shocked. Wasn't this Shi Yu's voice?
Shi Yu was back?
"Everyone, I'm Shi Yu. I was entrusted by the World Tree to address the invaders of Blue Planet. I've temporarily came back from World King Planet."
"Please remember what I'm saying now in your hearts. If anyone accidentally encounters that monster next, please mention my name to it and say that I'll penalize it."
After Shi Yu finished speaking, many divine-levels were shocked. What??
Before the Mythical Revival, the number one person on Blue Planet, Shi Yu, had returned?
The goal of returning was to destroy this intermediate god?
Many divine-levels sensed that it was ridiculous.
"No way." The Ancient God Golden Bull didn't believe it.
However, through telepathy, Shi Yu's attitude wasn't to be doubted.
Although this method was simple, it was practical.
As long as the other party was hostile to him, Shorty could consume faith power perception and lock onto the other party through the Retribution White Tiger skill.
At that time, those who chanted his name would be protected!

chapters.title: Chapter 1431 The Owl's Past Life (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1431 The Owl's Past Life (1)
Dong Huang.
As Shi Yu broadcasted to the global divine levels, they immediately knew of Shi Yu's return.o
"Sigh, what does this kid mean?"
In the Ancient God Nursing Home in the capital, Ancient God Golden Bull was wearing a black suit and had an evil expression. He sat on the sofa and muttered.
"Could it be that he broke through to the divine level?"
"Oh no, I've finally recovered to the divine level and still want to fight him one day with the level advantage. If he also breaks through to the divine level, it's a little dangerous! No, very dangerous!"
"Old Bull, hurry up. Let's go to the Dong Huang Association. Shi Yu will probably return to Dong Huang later," the Tiger God, Lie Shanjun, said as he walked out of a room.
"Let's go, let's go." Ancient God Golden Bull stood up and took a look!
Inatella, Shi Yu also left. As he couldn't find that worm in the short term, Shi Yu informed the World Tree and returned to Dong Huang first.
Shi Yu first arrived at the headquarters of the Dong Huang Association. The former president Divine Source and President Lin Xiao were both here. After returning, he naturally had to report.
"Everyone's here." However, Shi Yu didn't expect that there were really many people here. After he teleported over, he realized that not only were President Divine Source and President Lin Xiao present, but the Seven Gods of Inatella and even the Prediction Owl were also present!
It was fine if President Lin Xiao mixed in among the eight divine levels, but why was the owl, who wasn't even a demigod, also here? Was it a dog-headed military advisor?
"Shi Yu!" President Divine Source saw Shi Yu and the gem cat and said, "Did Senior Space Emperor and Lin Feng let you come back?"
"Yes. They asked me to give it a try first. If I can't solve it, they'll think of a way." When Shi Yu finished speaking, Divine Source and the other gods looked at each other. Since the Space Emperor and the others had said so…
"But what's with the method you just mentioned?" President Lin said.
"It's a perception skill, one of the ways to find that monster. However, there's only one way that's not safe. I might have to ask Teacher Owl to predict it." Shi Yu looked at the owl.
He had temporarily prepared five ways to find that monster and planned to use them together. He didn't believe that he couldn't find the other party.
"Me??" The Prediction Owl had a bitter expression and said, "Sigh, I really predicted it. Otherwise, why do you think I'm here? However, I can't do it. I can't predict it."
Shi Yu chuckled and said, "After all, it's a premonition above your level. It's normal that you can't predict it. I brought back a modified Reincarnation Fruit that can allow your strength to temporarily reach the divine level for an instant."
"Moreover, didn't I bring Ling and Teacher Ying back? If they assist you together, the success rate will definitely increase greatly."
"Hmph." The gem cat girl nodded. She just had to make a wish!
"Wu…" The Prediction Owl sighed. Prediction above its level… It had already expected that it would be like how it predicted Yun An at that time, losing half its life.
"Shi Yu, did you break through to the divine level?" At this moment, Ancient God Golden Bull asked.
"Huh?" Shi Yu said, "No."
Ancient God Golden Bull was stunned. "No?? You want to rely on the demigod level to find that monster? It already has the strength of an intermediate god!"
"If you say that you can defeat it above your level after breaking through to the divine level, I'll believe you. You still want to skip two levels?"
"I know, but I can't break through yet," Shi Yu said helplessly. "Firstly, I just reached Level 9 not long ago. I'm still a distance away from the divine level. Secondly, if I break through to the divine level, I won't be able to participate in the God Sealing Battle of the World King Star."
"This competition is especially important. It determines whether Blue Planet can quickly become a super divine planet."
"Demigod… It should be enough!"
"Why, Senior Bull God, you don't trust my strength?" Shi Yu smiled kindly and said, "I didn't work for nothing on World King Planet these few months. Why don't you spar with Eleven again?"
"That's not what I mean!" Ancient God Golden Bull said in all seriousness, "But you can spar if you want."
Everyone was speechless. Why were they going to spar as soon as they met? The Bull God really didn't give up.
"Eleven!"
"Wuu!!!"
Under Shi Yu's summoning, Eleven opened its starry eyes and appeared in the outside world. It looked around and then at Ancient God Golden Bull.
"Hehe, come and let me test your progress." Ancient God Golden Bull took a step forward and pushed Eleven out with one hand.
Ancient God Golden Bull didn't believe it. It had already recovered to its peak restoration, but it still didn't believe that it would be defeated by a demigod.
Seeing this, everyone followed, also wanting to see Shi Yu's so-called enhancement during this period.
However, when they arrived at the Duel Arena below the association, President Lin suddenly recalled something and said with a bitter expression, "Wait, wait, this place can't withstand your battle!"
Although they had already upgraded again and again, enduring a demigod-level battle was already the limit.
"Don't worry," Ancient God Golden Bull said. "My control over divine strength has already reached the microscopic level, and my power won't leak out at all. If you don't believe me, you can ask them."
"However, this little guy's battle fluctuations are indeed not small." The Bull God looked at Eleven and fell into deep thought.
In its opinion, Eleven was a huge baby with power!
The previous time they fought, Inatella almost sank… It was too much.
"Wu wu wu!!" Eleven also expressed that it was fine!
Its quasi-divine skill proficiency had been included to the expert level by Shi Yu. It was no longer a issue to control. It was no longer at the stage where it had just acquired a quasi-divine skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1432 The Owl's Past Life (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1432 The Owl's Past Life (2)
"Don't worry, Eleven can also control Crowd Control well," Shi Yu said. "A simple spar."
"Teacher Owl, stop looking. I'll give you the Reincarnation Fruit. I'll eat it to adapt to my strength first," Shi Yu said.
"I'll do it! I have it here!" The gem cat took out a Reincarnation Fruit and handed it to the owl first.
"Uh…" Shi Yu said.
"Aiyo! Good lord!" The owl took the fruit and sensed the rich time power on it. Its eyes lit up.
"Hehe, quickly give it a try."
The gem cat came to the owl's side and said, "This fruit has already been upgraded. Previously, when you ate it, it didn't have any effect. Perhaps your previous life wasn't just a demigod, but a divine level! Now, it can definitely be traced back to the past."
"Really?" the Prediction Owl pondered.
The gem cat revealed a sharp gaze. It was real and fake!
The fruit's effect was real, but it didn't believe that the owl had a divine-level past life.
The reason why it was looking forward to the owl eating it so much now was that it had asked Baby Ginseng to create this fruit.
A hybrid version of the effect of the Reincarnation Fruit and the taste of the Cultivation Fruit!
It had specially kept it for the owl to eat at such a time. It couldn't be the only cat to experience the taste of the Cultivation Fruit.
"Come on!!" In the Duel Arena, Ancient God Golden Bull and Eleven faced each other.
The owl, who was just about to eat the fruit, couldn't help but look over.
At the same time, President Divine Source and President Lin Xiao were also watching seriously. Their gazes were solemn and serious. Although Divine Source had broken through to the divine level, it had never engaged in a divine-level battle and was still modifying machinery.
As for President Lin Xiao, after reaching the legendary level, he also wanted to know the true meaning of the divine level more.
This battle might be a very good lesson.
Apart from that, the other six Inatella gods were also quite serious. They also wanted to know if Golden Bull's body was rusted.
Bang!
In the form of a bullman, the corners of Ancient God Golden Bull's mouth curled up. It first disappeared and instantly arrived beside Eleven like a golden light.
"Huh??" Eleven, who didn't activate One Thought of God and Demon, was also shocked. It didn't expect Ancient God Golden Bull's full-strength state to be so strong. Its speed was actually much faster than melting ice cream on World King Planet.
If the Ice Kirin was a mage, then the Ancient God Golden Bull was a warrior!
"I can't see clearly!" Divine Source Legendary observed with his mechanical eye and couldn't discover Ancient God Golden Bull's movements at all. President Lin Xiao also had a serious expression.
Boom!
Accompanied by a loud bang, everyone present saw that Ancient God Golden Bull's uppercut had already hit Eleven's stomach. At the same time, under the huge force, the ground of the entire arena shattered!!
The atmosphere trembled, and a hole appeared in the sky!
With a bang, Eleven was directly smashed into the sky like a flying meteor by Ancient God Golden Bull and passed through the hole!
The commotion of this punch was definitely not big for divine-level power. Just as Ancient God Golden Bull had said, its power was controlled very well and was all focused on Eleven.
However, although the commotion wasn't big, President Divine Source and President Lin Xiao's mouths were wide open. President Divine Source's mechanical eye locked onto Eleven, who was sent flying, with a shocked expression.
Boom boom boom boom!!!
Because under the impact of the shocking power, sounds of tearing through the air kept coming from Eleven's body. It was still flying backward, passing through the clouds and the ozone layer. The power on its body had yet to disappear until the starry sky!!
"Wuu…" A moment later, Eleven was sent flying into the universe by Ancient God Golden Bull's punch. Its body shattered a small planet before stopping.
Eleven floated in the universe in confusion and opened its eyes. It touched its stomach and indeed felt some pain.
"What a joke. What power is this?" President Divine Source said. "It… was beaten into the starry sky??"
President Lin suddenly turned around. What?
Was there really a fist that could blast an opponent into the starry sky?
This was a divine-level battle?
He looked at the muscular Ancient God Golden Bull and sensed the power of its physique. With such a physique, it would probably be unscathed even if forbidden arms bombarded it.
"Holy shit, awesome." The Prediction Owl's gaze also lingered on the sky and Ancient God Golden Bull, and it subconsciously took a bite of the Reincarnation Fruit.
"Haha, my Golden Mountain Divine Body is in perfect condition!" Ancient God Golden Bull looked at the starry sky and said excitedly!!
In the surroundings, when the six Inatella gods saw this, they sighed with emotion that Ancient God Golden Bull's divine body was still so strong.
Now that Ancient God Golden Bull had recovered his divine power, he finally didn't have to be as aggrieved as in the World Tournament.
"This attack is strong, but the damage won't be high. I held back! Speaking of which, have you completed the evolution of the cosmic life form? Can it return on its own? If not, I'll go seize it," Ancient God Golden Bull said. However, before it could finish speaking, a light flashed in the starry sky.
"Wu wu wu." As a voice sounded, Ancient God Golden Bull revealed an incredulous expression. He suddenly turned around and looked behind him.
"What a joke." The Boar God, the Eternal Tree, the Holy Divine Deer, and the other gods looked at Eleven, who was clearly propelled into the starry heavens by Ancient God Golden Bull's attack and returned in the blink of an eye. Moreover, there were almost no wounds on its body. They couldn't understand.
"Wuu!!" Eleven shook off the dust on its body. Although the Golden Mountain Divine Body was strong, it was indeed impossible to injure it!
Buzz!
Black and white lightning sparks shot out of Eleven's body, and electric arcs flowed out of its eyes. With a step forward, its figure instantly disappeared and it arrived in front of Ancient God Golden Bull.
"Bang!"
Everyone only heard a bang and saw Ancient God Golden Bull's figure suddenly bend like a shrimp. Eleven's lightning fist directly and gently strike Ancient God Golden Bull's abdomen. Ancient God Golden Bull's stomach quickly caved in, and his eyes were about to pop out, as if he had suffered a huge impact. However, his body wasn't propelled but directly leaned forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 1433 The Owl's Past Life (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1433 The Owl's Past Life (3)
Buzz!!
Eleven took a step back. Electric arcs came out of Ancient God Golden Bull's body. He couldn't control the passiveness of his paralyzed body and took a few steps forward. He hugged his stomach and said with a distorted expression, "No, impossible!!"
"Hehe," Shi Yu said. "Bull God, you'll believe me now, right?"
"Eleven didn't use its full strength either. This attack shouldn't have injured it…"
Before Shi Yu could finish speaking, Ancient God Golden Bull fell to the ground with a bang and fainted.
Shi Yu and Eleven: ???
"Huh?" Shi Yu was stunned. How could he fall like this? Although Eleven had used the Divine Demon Thought, Ancient God Golden Bull's defense was definitely stronger than ice cream. He was unable to be so brittle, right?
At this moment, the other six Inatella Gods were also quite shocked. They didn't expect that the Iron-eating Beast in the World Tournament was already so strong. It was unable to rely on Beast Tamers to suppress the true god level at the demigod level.
What a joke. They looked at Shi Yu uniformly. Was this guy really the son of fate on Blue Planet? The increase in strength was really incomprehensible.
"Shi Yu! Eleven!"
Divine Source Legendary and President Lin, a new god and a new legendary, compared their strength to Shi Yu and felt suffocated.
Shi Yu wasn't lying. He was really ridiculously strong now.
"Don't worry about Old Bull," Lie Shanjun said. "It might not have fainted from its injuries. It fainted from embarrassment."
"Ah!!! Smelly!!!" In addition, Ancient God Golden Bull wasn't the only one who fainted. Prediction Owl was watching the battle as an onlooker when it suddenly smelled the Reincarnation Fruits it had eaten. The stench rose and Prediction Owl was about to faint.
Its feathers had turned green, and its gaze was hazy as it shouted, "Stupid cat, what did you feed me!!"
"Reincarnation Divine Fruit!!" the gem cat said. "This is the taste after this thing upgraded. Don't worry, it's not poisonous!"
The Prediction Owl directly fainted and entered a dream.
"What's going on?" President Lin was numb. Before Shi Yu returned, the Dong Huang Association had never been so noisy.
"It's alright, it's a good thing." The gem cat turned into a fun cat, but soon, its expression stiffened.
Because the sleeping owl suddenly got up like it was sleepwalking. Some memories flowed through its mind and it muttered, "I… the Astrologer Race…"
Gem Cat: "?"
Damn!
What was the Astrologer Race?
What was this owl saying?
The gem cat suddenly had a bad feeling.
The surrounding people and gods were also confused. In the next moment, with a boom, nomological ripples appeared on the Prediction Owl's body, and its aura suddenly increased. When it opened its eyes, the time hexagram on its chest flickered, and its demigod aura was undoubtedly revealed.
This scene directly made everyone present reveal shocked expressions. The toes of the fallen Ancient God Golden Bull also twitched, feeling rather surprised.
"There really is?" Shi Yu muttered. He was also very surprised. Damn, so the owl really had a previous life.
Previously, eating the Reincarnation Fruit was ineffective because the level of the previous Reincarnation Fruit was too low.
It looked like it worked this time…
Initially, he only wanted to use it as a Time Fruit for Teacher Owl. From the looks of it, it was an unexpected surprise that directly sent it to the demigod level.
This guy's breakthrough speed was only inferior to Shi Yu, the gem cat, and the others in Dong Huang's batch of nearly a hundred years.
"Hahahaha." After the owl broke through, it opened its eyes and laughed.
However, as it laughed, it started to sob.
"I remember everything."
"I… am a super genius girl of the Astrologer Race. In nearly ten thousand years, I'm the youngest peak divine level expert of the Astrologer Race!! Since I was born, the success rate of the prophecy was 100%. I've never made a mistake!"
"Wu wu wu."
"Old witch, why are you crying!!" The gem cat was confused. It was the one who wanted to cry. Why was it only a demigod in its previous life? The owl was a top-notch god.
Moreover, the identity introduction this old witch mentioned was ridiculous. A super prophecy master at the peak of the divine level?
It wasn't convinced.
It had only picked up the treasure of the Star Prayer Race in its previous life, but this owl was directly an astrologer in its previous life?
Although the gem cat didn't know what the Astrologer Race was, it could sense that it should also be a big race in the starry sky.
"Wu wu wu." The Prediction Owl cried very sadly. It said, "In my previous life, I reached the peak of the divine level very early. Then, I began to go out to train. Through the premonition method, I foretold the opportunity for myself to break through to the super divine level."
"During my travels in the universe, I successfully foretold that there were era ruins on Blue Planet! In era ruins, there were more than one sources of transcendence. Therefore, I went to Blue Planet excitedly. In the end, because I was too excited, I didn't predict the disaster of the universe during the process and directly failed, becoming on the verge of death…"
"Then, in order to protect my life, I was forced to reincarnate. I didn't expect to be reborn to Blue Planet…"
"Moreover, after reincarnation, I was so miserable. My prophecy power was greatly reduced… Most importantly, I actually became a cat."
The gem cat said, "Please face your identity. You're a bird, I'm a cat."
Inatella and the other gods were stunned.
Listening to the owl's self-report, they felt that it was ridiculous.
This unreliable owl in Dong Huang was at the peak of the divine level in its previous life? It was a big boss of the same level as the Ancestral Dragon and the Origin Phoenix??
What a joke.
President Divine Source and President Lin also felt that it was extremely ridiculous. What did Teacher Ying feed Teacher Owl just now? It was really some Reincarnation Fruit and not some hallucinatory poison?
"Astrology Race." At the scene, Shi Yu might be the only one who trusted Teacher Owl the most.
He believed in the effect of Baby Ginseng's Reincarnation Fruit. In addition, Teacher Owl's prophecy was indeed very impressive. At the overlord level, it could predict demigod-level things, and it was several times in a row…
This situation was already extremely abnormal. Only special talent could explain it.
Just like the Star Prayer Race, if the talent of the Star Prayer Race was to make a wish, then the talent of the Astrologer Race was to predict.
Of course, there were many races that could predict the future, but there were really not many whose premonition abilities were stronger than the Astrologer Race. Shi Yu had seen the introduction of this race on World King Planet.
It could be said that even if Ling learned Future Prediction and had the strengthening of the Wind of Blessing, it might not necessarily be more accurate than the Astrologer Race's Prediction at the same level. This was a matter of racial talent and skill compatibility.
It was equivalent to saying that a dog and a fish could swim, but no matter how superb a dog's swimming skills were, it was very difficult to surpass a fish.
"Teacher Owl, congratulations!!" Shi Yu said.
In short, it was a good thing. When he brought Teacher Owl back to the World King Planet later, wouldn't he directly get intimate with the Astrologer Race? It was a super genius of the Astrologer Race and a candidate for the next patriarch.
"So I'm so strong." Teacher Owl wiped its tears. "Hahaha, moreover, it's not too late to reach the super divine level. As long as I recover the power of my previous life, I'll…"
"Although I congratulate you on recovering your strength and I'll help you, I still have something sad to tell you," Shi Yu said.
"Hm?"
Divine Source Legendary and President Lin were also stunned and thought of something.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, "The era ruins you foretold in your previous life with the source of transcendence should have been cracked by someone. The source of transcendence has also been used. What a pity."
Why did he feel that the ruin that Teacher Owl had foretold was the ruin that Emperor Shi had entered?
Why don't Teacher Owl fight Senior Emperor Shi?
"???" The Prediction Owl was stunned. It widened its eyes and directly had a heart attack. Its body fell backward and fell to the ground in a daze…

chapters.title: Chapter 1434 Half a Year Later (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1434 Half a Year Later (1)
Shi Yu was still impressed. The owl was very strong. It could actually predict where the source of transcendence was.
At this level, no matter which cosmic-level faction it joined, it would definitely become an expert.
However, it was indeed too unlucky. When it came to find the source of transcendence, it actually died on the way. Moreover, after waking up from its reincarnation, the source of transcendence was already in this process and was taken away by others…
It was a huge injustice. Its unlucky level was comparable to the Kirin Race.
Shi Yu and the gem cat looked at each other. Shi Yu said, "Teacher owl might be too tired. Let it rest first."
"Shi Yu, what exactly is that Reincarnation Fruit you gave it just now?" The chef, the Boar God, couldn't help but ask.
It looked so impressive and awesome.
Shi Yu smiled and said, "A asset condensed from a time-element divine skill."
Right on the heels of that, Shi Yu explained the impact of the Resurrection Berry to everyone. After hearing it, many gods found it unbelievable.
"How about this? I'll give everyone one." Shi Yu took out nine Reincarnation Fruits and gave them to the Seven Gods of Inatella, Divine Source, and President Lin Xiao.
In the Four Holy Ruins, they used the power of faith to create a large number of Cultivation Fruits, Reincarnation Fruits, and other fruits. It could be said that they had completely escaped poverty.
"For us?" Lord Lie Shan and the other gods smiled and chased him away. "Alright, good kid, I didn't misjudge you!! In the World Tournament, I could tell that you were a dragon among men!"
The gods were moved. They felt that this thing was even more precious than the divine-level resources they had passed down to Shi Yu. Shi Yu had actually given it to them.
"President Lin, I'll prepare another 50 Cultivation Fruits for Dong Huang later. This fruit can increase the cultivation efficiency of the user and has the highest compatibility with human Beast Tamers. If we use these 50 fruits reasonably, Dong Huang should be able to have a few more powerful legends," Shi Yu added.
Since he had returned, Shi Yu also planned to help Dong Huang again.
"Cultivation Fruit?" Divine Source Legendary's eyes lit up. "What good thing is this?"
"The effect on Level 10 isn't that obvious. The lower the user's level, the better the effect. Of course, you can eat one if you want to experience it." Shi Yu chuckled.
"Probably. It allows the user to automatically meditate and develop Beast Taming abilities when sleeping. Moreover, the efficiency is quite high. Now, the Beast Tamers on Blue Planet have all started to cultivate their second and third Beast Taming Talents again. With the support of this Cultivation Fruit, it can double the impact and half the effort."
"I understand. It's indeed a good thing," President Lin Xiao said. "I'll choose a suitable nominee and distribute the Cultivation Fruit."
"Alright," Shi Yu said with a smile. Beside him, the gem cat had a strange expression. Shi Yu was going to drug Dong Huang collectively. Hahaha.
It wondered if Shi Yu would let Qingyi and the others eat this thing. The gem cat had already started to look forward to them fainting from the stench!
The painful expressions of the second-generation heirs in the Blue Wave World were still vivid in her mind.
"Well, seniors, time is tight. I'll bring Teacher Owl to prepare first. I also have to prepare the other battle plans, so I won't stay long," Shi Yu said.
"If there's anything, we'll contact you."
"No problem." Everyone nodded. They would listen to Shi Yu's arrangements.
…
The owl, whose heart ached so much that it fainted, was pulled away by Shi Yu and the gem cat.
After leaving, Ling was summoned by Shi Yu and turned into a cosmic battleship that flew into the starry sky.
It wanted to build a technological product in the universe, the Eye of the Universe, to monitor the changes in Blue Planet's space.
The Eye of the Universe was an indispensable facility for the battle between two planets in the Space War. If a certain group took a fancy to a planet, they would often create the Eye of the Universe in the outside world first and occupy the right to information to prevent the enemy from escaping the planet and seeking help from the outside world.
This was also one of the ways Shi Yu found that monster. The Space Emperor and the others had already prepared the blueprint and materials. However, everyone wasn't sure if the Eye of the Universe created by Ling could capture the other party, but it was never wrong to be more prepared.
Apart from that, the Time Sprite Qi was also summoned and entered Blue Planet space and time.
Its hiding ability was also top-notch, and its ability to find people wasn't bad.
"Shi Yu, you're back?"
"I heard you're back to deal with that intermediate god, right?"
Shi Yu had just arranged the mission for Qi and Ling when Senior Lu suddenly called.
"Yeah, Senior Lu, you're pretty well-informed." Shi Yu smiled.
"It's alright. No matter what, I'm one of the few Legendary Beast Tamers in Dong Huang now." Lu Qingyi smiled.
"What?" Shi Yu was stunned. "You've reached the legendary level? When did this happen?"
He looked at the gem cat girl who was flying in the air, dragging the falcon and giving it a wake-up slap.
"So fast?" The gem cat was also very surprised. What? When she left, Lu Qingyi had just broken through to Level 8.
"Teacher Ying is also here… Not long after, it's mainly because the information about the ruins you left behind is very valuable. I gained a lot from it. In addition, when the Mythical Revival happened, the World Tree gave the world the Blessing of Life, so it happened," Lu Qingyi said.
"Is this how it's used…" Shi Yu was helpless. "I previously said that I would wait until you reached the legendary level to find the Teleportation Key Stones for you. I didn't expect it to be so fast…"
"Wait for me for more than half a year. At that time, no matter who it is on Blue Planet, they can freely head to World King Planet!" Shi Yu said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1435 - 1435 Half a Year Later (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1435 - 1435 Half a Year Later (2)
“We’ll talk about this later. I have something to tell you in person. Are you free now? Let’s talk about the gains in a certain ruin.”
“Alright, where are you? I’ll look for you,” Shi Yu said. It looked like Senior Lu had obtained some impressive gains and wanted to split them with him.
…
Ancient Capital.
Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi arranged to meet here. In a courtyard with lush plants and fragrant flowers, Lu Qingyi, who was wearing a white casual suit, saw Shi Yu and said, “Where’s Teacher Ying?”
“I’m busy,” Shi Yu said. To be precise, he was taking care of the owl. The owl looked like it had fainted from the stench and its mentality had collapsed, but it was more because the power of the astrologers in its previous life was too huge and it had to sleep and digest.
Therefore, the gem cat pulled it to find a place to rest.
“Senior, what’s so urgent that you have to say it in person?” Shi Yu asked.
Both parties found a small table and sat down. Lu Qingyi said, “In the information about the ruins you left behind, there’s a legendary ruin left behind by Yue Maiden. I obtained her inheritance inside.”
“Oh,” Shi Yu said. “Wait??”
Shi Yu didn’t care much about the inheritance of a Legendary Beast Tamer. However, suddenly, he was slightly shocked. “It’s worth your attention. In other words, not only did you obtain some resources, but… you even inherited that person’s talent?”
“Plunder talent??”
Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “That’s right.”
Then, she told Shi Yu about Yue Maiden developing the Plunder skill in her later years and handing down the talent.
After Shi Yu heard it clearly, he directly took a deep breath and said, “Senior Yue Maiden is also a super genius born in the wrong era.”
Shi Yu was really quite cowardly in the early stages of this ability. What if the skill index could also be plundered?
“Is there such a talent in the universe?” Lu Qingyi asked.
“I’ve never heard of it on the World King Planet. Even if there is, it should be the exclusive ability of some special races. Humans don’t have a clear cultivation method,” Shi Yu said. “It’s also possible that it’s too taboo and the records will be erased.”
“This talent… is very good. However, after plundering the opponent’s ability, the other party will die. Senior, don’t expose it easily. Blue Planet is alright, but when we reach the World King Planet, there will definitely be problems. In the universe, many races with rare abilities were captured and extinct,” Shi Yu said. For example, the Time Sprite, or the source of inheritance obtained by Teacher Cat, the Star Prayer Race, had also encountered the danger of extinction many times.
On Blue Planet, there were also examples. The Wind Kirin Race was the first to be targeted because their abilities were very strange.
This Plunder talent would definitely become a thorn in some people’s side or they would want to snatch it and use it.
In addition, the activation condition of the Plunder talent was that the target of the pillaging had to be at the border of life and death and couldn’t resist. Then, after the ability was plundered, it would immediately die. It was much more ferocious than the skill index. With this ability, if Senior Lu made a friend, the friend would probably not be able to sleep in the middle of the night, afraid of being assassinated.
In short, it was very strong.
Of course, as the skill index was updated, Shi Yu was very certain that it was the strongest ability. Evolution talent and Plunder talent had to be pulled aside, unless the Plunder talent could plunder the index…
“I know,” Lu Qingyi said. “After obtaining this ability, I haven’t started using it yet. This should be a path of no return… After starting, I couldn’t stop.”
Shi Yu also picked up the tea and took a small sip. He nodded. Indeed, although there was no good or evil ability, this Plunder talent could easily lead people astray.
“However, why not use it if you have the ability? You can specially choose those convicted felons who have committed vile offenses first. Dong Huang, Dragon Palace City, and the alliance, don’t they all have various ferocious sins? Those who can be specially imprisoned can’t be weak. Senior, you’re suitable to be a executor.”
“I’ve thought of that too.” Lu Qingyi smiled bitterly and said, “After all, I can’t really hunt other Beast Tamers.”
“I’ve also thought about baiting like you…”
Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment. As expected, his heart was also black after being cut open.
“I understand. When I encounter a life-and-death strong enemy in the future, I’ll spare the other party’s life and let you kill it,” Shi Yu said. “In addition, can’t the Plunder talent also create special ability tools? If you don’t need them, you can also create them for me to use.”
The Awakening Mirror and the Body Control Talent Bead were both implements created by Yue Maiden.
This was something that the skill index couldn’t do. The skill index could only target transcendent lives, but the Plunder talent could even target humans.
“You’re pretty open-minded. Unfortunately, I don’t know how to give you the talent. Otherwise, you would definitely be able to use it,” Lu Qingyi said.
“Don’t think too much,” Shi Yu said with a smile. Talent didn’t matter. A skill index was enough for him to use at the moment. Even with the Cultivation Fruit, his current talent couldn’t be developed at all.
“Well, since you say so, I’ll start to use the Plunder talent. With this, do I have a chance to surpass you in strength?” Lu Qingyi smiled.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Senior, don’t even think about it. I just cracked an era ruin on World King Planet and acquired a huge amount of resources. After I break through to the divine level, my strength should be able to quickly surpass the Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng, and the others. You can’t catch up.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1436 Half a Year Later (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1436 Half a Year Later (3)
"There's still some hope if you run to the World King Planet and plunder all the talents of those human geniuses from super divine families."
Lu Qingyi: "?"
"What era ruins?"
"A small ruin of the Four Holy Beasts, a small ruin…"
…
Shi Yu didn't expect to receive so much good news on his return to Blue Planet.
First, the owl successfully activated the effect of the Reincarnation Fruit, and then Senior Lu obtained Yue Maiden's inheritance.
Their abilities were the same as Teacher Ying's. They were both top-notch skills with support effects.
At a certain moment, it could reverse the situation and increase the benefits hundreds of times.
After chatting with Lu Qingyi about the World King Planet, Shi Yu received a call from the gem cat.
"Shi Yu, the old witch is awake."
"When do we start predicting?"
Shi Yu glanced at Senior Lu in front of him and said, "Senior, I'll deal with that monster first. Let's talk when we're free."
"Be careful," Lu Qingyi said. She didn't have a deep understanding of intermediate gods. She felt that since Shi Yu could return to deal with it, there was no problem, unlike the World Tree and the others who were conflicted.
"Alright." Shi Yu nodded.
A moment later, he appeared at the top of a tall building and saw the Prediction Owl sitting on the roof.
"Sigh…" The Prediction Owl sighed. It had just made a prediction only to discover that the era ruins and source of transcendence were really f*cking gone.
Reincarnation was a mistake!!
"An owl that has lost its dream." The cat girl introduced it to Shi Yu.
"It doesn't matter. It's just a source of transcendence. Since I can predict it once, I can do it a second time," the owl muttered.
"Kid, I'll help you predict it this time, but after settling the matter here, think of a way to bring me to the World King Planet too."
"No problem," Shi Yu said. "Then, Teacher Owl, when do we start?"
"Let's go to the starry sky. It's better to use the power of the stars to predict the effect," the Prediction Owl said.
When Shi Yu and the others heard that, there was no problem. They directly headed to the starry sky.
Through telepathy, Shi Yu got Ling in the starry sky to prepare a foothold. Soon, Shi Yu and the others appeared on the deck of the battleship Ling.
"I'm starting??" the Prediction Owl said.
"Let's begin." The gem cat and Ling were already familiar with it. The combination of the three parties made the owl sigh at how good this combo was.
Buzz!!
Under the lingering starlight and wind of blessing, the Prediction Owl activated the Time Hexagram and entered the prediction state.
"It'll be very difficult this time…" it began.
Firstly, it was because the premonition target was stronger than it now, even if it used the power of the Reincarnation Fruit. Secondly, apart from the other party's existence information, there was no effective information about the other party at all.
"All the best, Teacher Owl," Shi Yu said.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was already on standby. It appeared on Shi Yu's shoulder and prepared to be a healer at any time.
Boom!!
Soon, the owl's state quickly decreased, and its life force and energy began to disappear quickly. Seeing this, Baby Ginseng's nourishing power immediately followed, allowing the owl to continue its premonition without any distractions.
"This…"
Soon, the Prediction Owl predicted a dark space. It was trying to predict the other party's location, but apart from the dark space, it couldn't see anything.
The owl was covered in sweat, and the feathers on its body began to fall off. The hexagram flashed like a weak Ultraman.
Was the old witch alright? At this moment, the gem cat beside him also looked weak. As a wish owl, it could predict success, but the backlash of the wish seemed to be very big this time.
Of course, compared to the main owl, its consumption was still bearable.
A moment later, the owl's body was filled with a death aura as it sat on the deck.
"I'll try my best."
"Turtle, Little Quas, Buggy, Chi Tong." Shi Yu immediately summoned Little Quas, Turtle, Chi Tong, and the others in the fusion Black Tortoise state.
He could tell that apart from its life force flowing away greatly, its soul had also suffered a backlash, and its condition was extremely poor.
This made Shi Yu involuntarily summon the few pets that could heal people to collaborate with Baby Ginseng.
"Yiya!" Baby Ginseng cheered for everyone. Everyone, work harder!
"Wu…" Sensing the nourishing treatment of the entire team that Shi Yu could only enjoy when he added points, the owl heaved a sigh of relief.
"No, I can't predict the location of the other party's next appearance."
"Ah, this." Although Shi Yu had already expected it, his heart still turned cold. Wu wu, what happened to the strong alliance?
One of the search plans failed?
"However, don't underestimate me." The Prediction Owl tried its best to stand up and say, "Although I didn't predict its location, I changed the course of my premonition."
"I predicted when it would appear next."
"If there aren't too many changes during this period, the probability of it appearing at that time is the highest!"
"Really?" Shi Yu was delighted. The jewel feline beside him, which was being nursed by Baby Ginseng and the other pets, also revealed a surprised expression. This night bird was good.
"When?" Shi Yu asked.
The Prediction Owl said, "About half a year later, around here."
"At this time, try to monitor the various locations on Blue Planet with all your might."
"Huh?" Shi Yu was stunned. "Really? Half a year??"
Wait a minute, the Deity Sealing Conflict was held in seven months. Shi Yu yet wanted to quickly complete his opponent and come back to get ready for battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1437 Half a Year Later (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1437 Half a Year Later (4)
This guy appeared at the right time for the God Sealing Battle?
"Probably," the owl said.
"Didn't they say that that guy appeared every few days in nearly half a month? Why is it taking so long this time?" the gem cat said.
"Fighting and eating in succession also requires time to rest and digest. Perhaps it has already started to recuperate. When it appears again, it might be stronger than the last time," the owl said.
Shi Yu said, "In half a year…"
His expression kept changing, and he finally sighed.
"Then let's wait for it."
In any case, he had brought enough resources from the World King Planet. Blue Planet had already revived, so it was the same to add points here to prepare for the God Sealing Battle.
If he couldn't make it in time for this God Sealing Battle, he would participate in the next one. In any case, the interval between each batch wasn't long.
Of course, during this period, Shi Yu wouldn't wait for death. He would also use other methods to find the monster worm.
"Wu, I'm so tired. I'll leave the rest to you," the owl said tiredly. "Shi Yu, be careful. The other party's strength isn't weak."
"Don't worry!" Shi Yu said. "Blue Planet is our home ground, Susu's home ground."
After returning to Blue Planet, apart from the power of the starry sky, Susu could also mobilize the power of the sea. It was definitely invincible.
"Teacher Owl, I'll look for you if there's a problem."
"Alright, I'm going to digest the power of my previous life," the owl said. "The next time we meet, I won't be like this."
"You can look forward to it!"
Shi Yu and the gem cat were stunned. From the looks of it, this guy wanted to optimize its race and return to the posture of the Astrologer Race. The Astrologer Race… seemed to also be in human form.
The gem cat snorted. How could the owl be prettier than it?
"Teacher Ying, what do you plan to do next?" Shi Yu turned to look at the gem cat.
"I'll hatch that demon cub and take care of the Chamber of Commerce on Blue Planet," the gem feline said lazily.
"Remember not to run around. We're in a dangerous moment now," Shi Yu said.
The gem cat: "Of course I know."
After the three parties confirmed it, Shi Yu got Buggy to send them back, while he was still standing in the starry sky.
"Shi Yu…"
Qi flashed around Shi Yu and said with a dejected expression, "I didn't locate it."
Qi originally felt that it wasn't difficult to find a hidden worm, but the other party hid deeper than it imagined.
As expected of a worm that had swallowed the flesh of a cosmic behemoth.
Qi knew that… the damage the Abyss Race and the Worm Race caused to Blue Planet back then wasn't even a tenth of the damage caused by the cosmic behemoth.
After all, the first two races only targeted life forms on Blue Planet at the start, but the cosmic behemoth directly targeted Blue Planet itself.
"It's alright," Shi Yu encouraged. "After all, your strength hasn't recovered yet. After you become stronger, look for it again. I'll teach you the Star Refinement skill now. Let's find a suitable place to release the spatial stars we carry. During this period of time, you have to hurry up and refine them."
"After refining them into arms, your strength will definitely increase. When the time comes, you might be able to locate it."
"Huh??" Qi was very surprised, her cherry eyes shining.
She could finally learn how to refine stars into arms!
Great!
This was the first step for her Time Sprite to become stronger!
…
The volume of the spatial star was about ten moons. Shi Yu and the others brought Qi far away from Blue Planet before finding a suitable place to release the white star.
After releasing it, it couldn't be taken back. The star stone used by the cosmic overlord army to store stars was a one-time use item. Therefore, Qi could only take it away after refining this into arms.
"Star Refinement, increase points."
Qi stood on the back of Shi Yu's hand, her heart surging. This was the second skill she could learn after the Mythical Revival.
A moment later, gentle starlight wrapped around Qi. Under the lingering light of the additional points, she immediately felt some changes in her body.
"Wu…" Qi Qiang endured the pain. A moment later, Qi learned the Star Refinement skill.
She sensed the spatial star very happily, but in the following moment, she wilted again.
"Refining… will take about 100 years," she said in despair.
"??" Shi Yu.
"Hundred years??"
"Continue to increase points."
In order to increase the efficiency of the Star Refinement, he had to at least maximize the Star Refinement points and upgrade it to (expert+11).
Shi Yu had also thought about the process of adding points to Qi. For the following period of time, he would work hard to add points and sleep.
Be it preparing for the God Sealing Battle or hunting monster bugs, he needed greater strength to support them.
After a long time, Qi finally completed the 15 additional points of the Star Refinement and began to touch the spatial star again.
"How long will it take to refine it into arms?" Shi Yu asked.
After Qi sensed it, she still had a long face and said, "Why do I feel that it still needs a few years?"
This was even if it was very compatible with the spatial star as a Time Sprite.
"Ji!!" At the side, Buggy sighed. Fortunately, it chose to refine its dragon star and succeeded in a few days.
After all, the dragon star was created by Buggy itself. The compatibility was 1,000%. Even if it wasn't refined, it could be directly controlled.
"Isn't there any way to accelerate?" Shi Yu was worried. It'll be too long to await a few more years.
"Wait, the time spent refining the star is too long. This must be related to the high level of the star. Buggy, in a few days, bring Baby Ginseng and draw some of the energy resources of this planet together to make it 'weak'. Perhaps the refining time can be shortened."

chapters.title: Chapter 1438 Half a Year Later (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1438 Half a Year Later (5)
"It's like subduing a magical treasure. You definitely have to hit until there's barely any health left."
"But this way, the weapon you obtained might be weak at the start…"
"Ji!"
Qi: Ah…
She looked at this beautiful white star aggrievedly. It was going to be wasted by Buggy and Baby Ginseng before it could be refined into arms? However, this seemed to be the only way. A few years was too long, and it couldn't wait.
…
Next, Shi Yu prepared for battle in all aspects.
Without lacking additional resources and the Cultivation Fruit, Shi Yu's efficiency in adding points and cultivation increased.
On Dong Huang's side, after obtaining the resources provided by Shi Yu, Senior Lu, Tyrannical Sea Legend, President Lin, and the others' cultivation speed also increased.
Among them, Senior Panda's treatment was the best. Eleven specially sent his eight trigram clone over to be Senior Panda and the mentor of the Iron-eating Beast Corps.
It wasn't easy for him to return to Blue Planet. Eleven decided to strengthen the panda army here first. At least, it had to nurture a batch of overlords.
At that time, he could bring these guys to the ranking battle of all races.
Just like that, a month later.
Just as the owl had predicted, the monster worm didn't appear at all for the past month.
Ling successfully built the Eye of the Universe, but unfortunately, the Eye of the Universe couldn't find the hiding place of the monster worm, Meld.
However, Ling was certain that if that worm left the hidden place and fought other gods, it would definitely be able to sense it immediately.
At this moment, Qi was refining the stars.
In the second month, Ling successfully modified itself and finally accomplished the teaching conditions of Future Prediction. Shi Yu successfully taught it the Future Prediction skill.
Moreover, he added points to the perfect stage of the quasi-divine skill.
At this moment, after two months of development and cultivation, Shi Yu's time strengthening talent had also reached Level 8.
Shi Yu called the gem cat over and let Ling predict the location of the monster worm.
However, what was extremely displeased was that Ling couldn't predict it at all, just like the owl. Moreover, Ling couldn't even successfully predict the "half a year" that the owl predicted.
This made Shi Yu understand that even with the same proficiency, the postnatural instruction premonition cast by Ling was still a little lesser to the racial intrinsic ability branded in the depths of the soul by the astrologers.
At this moment, Qi was still refining the star.
In the third and fourth months, Shi Yu's additional points and cultivation were still carried out in an orderly manner.
During this period, Shi Yu was still very annoyed. He didn't find the worm, but his Fusion Talent had been successfully cultivated to Level 9.
As for Qi, she was still refining the stars.
In the fifth month, Shi Yu's Time Strengthening Talent was finally developed to Level 9. He assisted Ling and foretold it again. At least he had gained something.
It was confirmed that the prophecy of the owl was basically right.
According to the owl's premonition, Ling also confirmed the time node where the worm might appear.
During this period, Shi Yu's quests basically came to an end.
All the quasi-divine skills of the 13 pets had been added to the perfect state (expert+11). If they were one step closer, they could become gods.
At this point, Shi Yu's preparation for the God Sealing Battle was considered to have been completed. Shi Yu began to turn around and invest the energy of adding points and developing talent in meditation to increase the level of the Beast Taming Space.
After participating in the God Sealing Battle, he wanted to break through to the divine level immediately.
At that time, he could also be considered an expert on the World King Planet, which basically didn't appear in the super divine level. It would be easier for him to do anything.
As expected, Qi was still refining the star.
Until… six months after Shi Yu returned to Blue Planet, half a year later!
"Wu wu wu." An aggrieved voice sounded. Shi Yu also opened his eyes helplessly and gazed at the little elf in front of him.
It was a little girl with light pink hair and cherry-colored eyes. She had beautiful looks, but she was only the size of a palm. She leaned a pink and white mini umbrella on her shoulder and said, "Shi Yu, I finally… finally…"
"I finally succeeded in the refinement!"
"It wasn't easy…" Shi Yu also cried to death. Although they had tortured the white star to its weakest state, Qi still refined it for half a year before successfully refining the white star.
The pink and white umbrella in front of him was what it looked like after the transformation of the star Qi had refined.
She didn't choose the arms that she had practiced the most when she was young. Instead, she chose the Umbrella of Time Shi Yu had given her as a prototype to build the arms.
"I've already tried my best. It's not too late now!" Qi spun in midair with the umbrella. Her pink short skirt and the ribbon on her body also fluttered, and her cherry-like beautiful eyes revealed a divine color that had never been seen before.
As a Time Sprite that couldn't have battle power, Qi was very happy to have such powerful arms that could be seen as a skill.
Moreover, this arms was definitely not weak.
After all, its predecessor was an intermediate-level star. Just its volume was equivalent to ten moons, and there was a deep space.
Even if he didn't care about anything and directly pulled the umbrella on the enemy, he could smash a bunch of totem demigods.
To Shi Yu, every pet's improvement speed was undoubtedly very fast. Even the gem cat teacher gazed at the short cat that was born and felt that its strength probably surpassed that of her, a teacher.
"Not late!" Shi Yu said.
"I'm going to fly around the world to take a look now~ At the same time, I want to go back to Tingxiang and see Grandma Ge Lin," Qi said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1439 Half a Year Later (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1439 Half a Year Later (6)
"Sure, sure. Go." Shi Yu smiled.
"Cough!" Qi said in embarrassment, "I'll go find Buggy to apply an illusion to me. Otherwise, with my current size, I'll definitely scare Grandma Ge Lin and the others…"
"That's true." Shi Yu was amused. The Time Sprite was really strange!
It was no longer important if Qi could find the monster worm. During this period, they tried various methods but couldn't find it. Shi Yu had already given up and planned to wait for the worm to run out on its own.
The due date for the owl's premonition was getting closer and closer…
The other party's arrival should be in the next few days.
It had to come out quickly! After settling it now, he could still return to World King Planet and catch up to the God Sealing Battle.
…
Qi flew eagerly in the direction of Tingxiang.
After leaving Tingxiang, she hadn't seen Grandma Ge Lin for a long time.
Now, Ge Lin had already become a legendary blacksmith. Because she had a good relationship with Qi and Qi had been contracted by the former number one person on Blue Planet, Shi Yu, Ge Lin's current status in Tingxiang was very high.
Boom!
Boom!
In the palace of Tingxiang, Master Ge Lin was leisurely forging weapons for the younger generation of the royal family with various high-level materials. Suddenly, this bearded dwarf seemed to have heard a familiar voice.
"Grandma Ge Lin!"
In the crafting room, as a spatial ripple appeared, Ge Lin looked at the recognizable figure that appeared and was stunned!
"Qi…?!"
She put down the hammer and looked at the even more beautiful and delicate Qi. She exclaimed, "Qi, you're back??"
"Yes!" Qi chuckled.
"Grandma Ge Lin, long time no see."
"Yeah, long time no see. How are you doing at Shi Yu's place? Did he bully you?" Grandma Ge Lin asked worriedly.
"Why are you still the same height? You don't look like you've grown at all. Did you eat badly?"
The old woman looked at Qi, who was still more than a meter tall, and fell into deep thought.
After Shi Yu's World Tournament, his reputation on Blue Planet became greater and greater. At the start, Ge Lin was very gratified that Qi had been taken away by Shi Yu.
However, later on, Shi Yu and his group of pets had their own performance. Even Little Ji and Duckie of the second team were active in the Alliance Meeting. However, during this period, only Qi had no news at all.
This made Ge Lin very worried about Qi's situation. She thought that Qi wasn't liked by Shi Yu and was neglected.
"No, I'm very good," Qi said.
The reason why she didn't appear much was because her identity was a little sensitive after awakening the power of the Time Sprite's previous life.
This identity destined that Qi couldn't help Shi Yu fight as a main battle member.
As for height, Qi was helpless. This was still Buggy's disguise! If it was her real height, the problem would be even greater.
Not only did it not grow taller, but it also shrank severely.
"That's true, that's true. The ability you came over with just now was Instant Transmission, right?" Grandma Ge Lin said excitedly. "Looks like you've learned an impressive ability."
"Let's go. The environment here isn't good. Let's change places to drink! Ah, wait, you can't drink." Grandma Ge Lin was worried.
However, she still pulled Qi out of the crafting room.
However, just as both parties came out, there was suddenly a boom. The sky above Tingxiang trembled like a thunderclap!!
The sky instantly darkened.
A terrifying shadow appeared in the sky above Tingxiang Palace.
At the same time, Qi, who came out with Grandma Ge Lin, immediately sensed two very powerful auras.
Divine level!!
In the sky, two divine-level fluctuations!!!
One of them was very recognizable to Qi. It was the Elven Empress of Tingxiang.
However, the other one gave Qi a very unfamiliar feeling. Her expression changed slightly as she suddenly realized something.
"What happened?"
Grandma Ge Lin protected Qi behind her and looked at the sky in shock.
"Your Majesty!!"
At the same time, above the palace, the Elven Empress was facing a centipede with an abnormally huge body. Even if it circled, it was several streets long. Its shell looked very hard.
Seeing this centipede monster that was even larger than a dragon, the elves in the palace had frightened expressions.
"Space Worm!!" However, the ordinary elves didn't know what was going on, but President Auland and the other Legendary Beast Tamers in the city knew some inside information.
This guy was probably the Space Worm that had caused an uproar previously and hunted divine-level beings!!
"Everyone, evacuate and seek help from the Blue Planet Alliance!! Those above the legendary level stay behind and protect the capital." In the sky, the Elven Empress was also extremely nervous. She was a new divine-level Beast Tamer. Her contracted sprite had yet to reach the divine level. The Elven Empress felt that she was powerless to fight the centipede monster in front of her.
Legend had it that this monster only attacked lone gods in sparsely populated places.
Boom!!
Just as she finished speaking, the centipede monster that covered the sky attacked the Elven Empress. It opened its huge abyss-like mouth and devoured her.
In the capital of Tingxiang, many people watched this terrifying scene.
What exactly was this monster? It actually dared to attack the Elven Empress of their Tingxiang!!
After all, their Elven Empress had already advanced to the divine level.
However, they had indeed heard the words that the Elven Empress had spread throughout the city just now.
The Elven Empress wanted them to run and ask for help from Blue Planet. This meant that… this monster had the ability to threaten the god of Tingxiang and Tingxiang itself. It was very dangerous!!
"Run!!!" Many people heard the order and fled in all directions.
There were also some elite Elven Warriors who stayed on the spot, not wanting to give up on the Elven Empress and leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1440 Half a Year Later (7)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1440 Half a Year Later (7)
Lil, Annie, Luo Yi, Hillia, and the other elves who had been recommended by the Elven Empress to try and see if they could contract Shi Yu, as well as some experts from Tingxiang and the contestants of the World Tournament, were basically in the capital. They were all gathered here.
"Those under the legendary level, retreat." The president of the association in Tingxiang, President Auland, who had advanced to the Legendary level, summoned her pet and already planned to help the empress.
However, at this moment, no one expected that during the centipede monster's attack, a figure would arrive between the centipede monster and the Elven Empress at an extremely fast teleportation speed.
It was a pink-haired little girl holding an umbrella.
"Qi!!!" Grandma Ge Lin was immediately shocked when she saw Qi teleport and disappear, running into the sky.
"Make way!!" In the sky, Qi suddenly appeared. She held the retracted Star Umbrella and swung it at the huge centipede with a confident expression!!
Crack!!
In the next moment, dense spiderweb-like patterns appeared in the sky. Space directly shattered, and the centipede monster's attack stopped. Right on the heels of that, the centipede monster's huge body began to shatter into pieces. It was sliced into pieces by spatial cracks.
Boom!!
The huge centipede monster's entire body directly shattered and floated in the sky!!
Seeing this, everyone below opened their mouths wide and looked at the little girl who suddenly appeared in the sky in confusion. Behind Qi, the Elven Empress also looked shocked and a little stunned.
"Aunt Empress, don't worry. This guy isn't that intermediate god." Qi held the Star Umbrella and floated in the air. With a confident smile, she said, "However, it's still a little dangerous for you. Leave this guy to me to settle!"
"Leave it to me to settle!"
As soon as Qi finished speaking, the shattered body of the centipede monster began to stick together again. The injuries were healing at a shocking speed.
Many people were astonished by the centipede monster's restoration, but some people were also shocked by the little girl's words just now.
Qi!!!
Upon hearing this name, Lil, Annie, Luo Yi, Hillia, and the others were stunned.
Qi??
"You're Qi." At this moment, the Elven Empress completely confirmed that the little girl who had split the centipede that had definitely reached the divine level into pieces in one hit was the naturally weak sprite Shi Yu had taken away, Qi.
Under Shi Yu's cultivation, she was actually so strong??
The Elven Empress felt that Qi's strength had probably already exceeded her.
She couldn't help but feel suffocated.
"Yes." Qi nodded and looked at the monster in front of her solemnly.
The centipede monster in front of her should only be at the level of a primary-level god. It definitely couldn't be an intermediate-level god.
Qi quickly reached out to Shi Yu through telepathy and realized that she could call him.
"Qi, did you also encounter a big worm?" In the starry sky, Shi Yu and Ling also sensed the changes on Blue Planet through the Eye of the Universe. They said with a serious expression, "Your perception was right."
"Isn't this that intermediate god? Now, such bugs have materialized all over the world."
"Among them, there are Bee Beasts, Ant Beasts, Mosquito Beasts… There are several of them. Fortunately, their strength is only at the primary-level god."
"It's just one of them in Tingxiang."
Was it a clone…
"But you don't have to worry. We'll settle it immediately!"
Buzz!!!
In the starry sky, the stars flickered. A green divine dragon circled in the universe. Behind it, several huge dragon stars floated, ready to attack!!
This was the real Dragon Star Group!!
"Roar!!!" Accompanied by Buggy's huge roar, every terrifying dragon star that had integrated the power of faith of the era fell to Blue Planet at lightning speed!!
At this moment, just like Tingxiang, the Seven Islands, Rongguang, Xue Yuan, Ming Hua, and many other countries were also attacked by strange bugs.
Seven Islands Valkyrie, Rongguang Hero King, Snowfield Battle God, Ming Hua Death God…
These new divine-levels looked at the strange worm in front of them solemnly like the Elven Empress of Tingxiang.
"Oh no." Their moods were also very heavy.
"Little worm, you actually dare to attack me. Shi Yu won't let you off!! When Shi Yu comes, he'll definitely cut you into pieces!" Shen Feng's Legendary Z was the only one who took Shi Yu's words to heart.
The targets of these strange bugs were all locked onto the lone divine-level.
As for Dong Huang, perhaps because the divine-level groups in the capital were serious, it wasn't within the attack range.
"Die."
At this moment, in order to prevent the situation from expanding, Shi Yu directly got Buggy to spend money and launch the strongest attack!
In various parts of the world, the experts facing the divine-level strange worm raised their heads slightly and saw a light descend from the sky.
It was a dragon-shaped meteorite.
They recognized this move in an instant because Shi Yu's Green Dragon using this move to kill totems above its level in the World Tournament was really too spectacular.
"Dragon Star Group!" they said.
"Wait, wait, Tingxiang…" Far away in Tingxiang, Qi was like an angry kitten, waving an umbrella.
However, the speed at which the Dragon Star Group descended was very fast. It was already close in less than 1s.
The green-gold light that was like a meteor was like a divine dragon that had descended from the starry sky. It bared its fangs and brandished its claws, coming from the starry sky with an incomparably terrifying pressure!!
The so-called dragon form was just flames produced by its friction with the atmosphere, and its main body was a small planet.
"This!!!" The descent of the asteroid shocked many people. Meteorite impact!! They felt that even if the divine-level worm didn't cause damage, this huge meteorite could still smash a country!!
However, these people's worries were completely unnecessary.
Boom!!
The meteorite descended with incomparable might, directly suppressing the centipede monster's body and suppressing it to the ground from the sky. An earth-shattering air wave rumbled and trembled. As the clouds disturbed, the dragon star crushed the centipede monster. Before it could approach the ground, the centipede monster's body turned into black charcoal under the burning of the dragon-shaped fire. "Squeak!!!" The centipede monster also let out a miserable cry.
As for the huge meteorite that continued to descend and covered the entire city in darkness, when it approached the ground and tall buildings, scaring a group of people, it actually unbelievably didn't cause any damage. The entire meteorite directly fell apart into light spots that filled the sky, and it was blown away by the wind with the centipede monster that turned into black ashes.
On the ground, the hearts of a group of people thumped and they swallowed their saliva crazily. This situation happened everywhere. Every insect monster was smashed and burned by the huge dragon star meteorite that descended from the sky, and it didn't cause any damage to the surroundings.
This meteorite that was like a divine punishment immediately stunned everyone. The divine-level experts who were facing the attack of the worm monsters also looked at the unknown starry sky with twitching eyes.
Shi Yu? Green Dragon?
Was this guy a monster?
A divine-level worm was instantly killed just like that?
Moreover, Shi Yu wasn't at the scene at all. He had attacked from an unknown distance.
At this moment, in the capital of Tingxiang, everyone, including the Elven Empress, was in shock. They were first astonished by Qi's appearance and her shocking strength.
