Then, they were shocked by Shi Yu's attack. The Elven Empress realized that she had still underestimated Shi Yu. After returning from the World King Planet, Shi Yu's strength had actually reached such a ridiculous level?
"I, I really am." At this moment, seeing Buggy's decisive attack and transcendent strength, Qi wasn't surprised at all. This was because that worm was indeed not strong. Even she was confident of killing, hunting, and protecting Tingxiang.
It was precisely because of this that Qi, who thought that she could snatch the first clear of the team, immediately had a heart attack when she saw her prey being shot.
Wu wu wu, it was too much.
"Yi!!!" Of course, beside Buggy, Baby Ginseng was shaking its head, extremely denying that the first clear of the divine-level in the team was Buggy's. No matter how one looked at it, those bugs only looked like the clone of that intermediate god. They couldn't be considered a complete individual, but they could bully a new weak god.
"Roar!!" Buggy said. Then the first clear of the main body should also be Susu's. Didn't it say not to explode it?
Baby Ginseng also had a heart attack. Wu wu wu, it was too much.
"Stop arguing." Shi Yu gritted his teeth and smiled. "This guy finally appeared."
"Come on, give it to me. Let me see where's your main body!!"
…
At the same time, a black shadow dormant in the hole of the universe opened its angry eyes. The clones it created to hunt were actually hunted?? It was too much!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1441 The Worst God and Return (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1441 The Worst God and Return (1)
"You're not coming out, right?"
"It doesn't matter. Then I'll force you out."
"Cat, do you sense it?"
"Meow!" The huge White Tiger in platinum armor stood beside Shi Yu, its Gem King Eye extremely dignified.
It almost sensed it!
This Space Worm was too sneaky.
Shi Yu didn't expect that after half a year, the other party actually didn't come out itself, but sent a bunch of clones.
Moreover, after the clone was destroyed, there was still no movement at all, afraid that there would be strong enemies in the outside world.
However, even if one thought a thousand times, one would definitely make a mistake. This Space Worm was still too young.
Shorty consumed the power of faith and activated the Power of Retribution. Those who were hostile to Shi Yu and the others were instantly locked onto by Shorty like lights in the night.
Amidst the dense hostility waves, Shorty quickly locked onto one of them.
After so many clones were destroyed, no matter how stealthy this Space Worm was, it was impossible for it not to have any hostility.
"Meow!!!" It looked at Shi Yu, indicating that it had already found the main body of the Space Worm.
However, Shorty blinked. Wasn't there a little too many people who were antagonistic to it? Why wasn't the Space Worm the only one?
"It's normal, it's normal," Shi Yu said. "Your Beast Tamer is so outstanding and has charmed countless girls. The hostility produced by suitors of those girls is naturally huge."
"Besides, there's a bunch of messy foreign races."
"Brilliant." Shorty came to a realization. That made sense.
If he was too outstanding, it was inevitable that others would be jealous of him.
Shi Yu chuckled. There was more trouble when people were popular. Who didn't have a dark side in their hearts? However, they were all small characters. At Shi Yu's height, there was no need to argue with children.
"As long as it's not that ridiculous, don't worry. Let's deal with this little worm first," Shi Yu said.
…
The hole of the universe was a spatial tunnel that required special abilities to open. Not only could the user travel through the hole of the universe, but they could also live in it.
At this moment, a monster with purple armor skin and the appearance of a standing worm was panting slightly.
Its shell armor looked very hard. It had two human-like arms with sharp claws. The worm's purple eyes flickered. Then, it used endurance.
It gave up on the idea of going out itself.
The clone was defeated so easily, which meant that there was a strong enemy in the outside world. It was better to continue recuperating for a period of time.
When it created a stronger clone, it would let the other party investigate.
This was what the Space Worm thought. However, in the next moment, its soul and mind suddenly felt a sharp pain. The intense pain made the Space Worm involuntarily scream.
"Ah…" An ear-piercing scream echoed in the hole of the universe.
A moment later, the pain stopped. The Space Worm took a deep breath. In fact, it didn't suffer much damage. Compared to the damage, the sudden pain shocked it even more.
"Ah…" The armored worm was shocked. Could it be that its location had been discovered?
"Ah…" In the next moment, the armored worm suffered intense mental damage again, making it cry out.
A strong anger rose in the heart of the armored worm. Who was it, who exactly was it?
Forget it…
This method was unprecedented.
It gave up on the idea of going out to handle the other party.
It planned to endure it for a while and take a step back. It would be alright after a while.
It didn't believe that the other party could repeatedly cause it damage.
The armored worm forcefully sealed its perception and fell asleep, but just as it fell asleep, a violent pain woke it up.
Its teeth swayed, and its stomach churned. It continued to close its eyes and try to sleep…
Bang!
Again.
Just like that, it repeated dozens of times.
"Ah!!!"
The armored worm angrily searched for the source of the attack, its body constantly shuttling through the hole of the universe.
"I'll hit you every time you move…" In the starry sky, in the Eye of the Universe, the armored Shorty was enhanced by the nine-colored divine light. It depleted the power of faith and constantly crossed a long distance to punish the Space Worm.
Unfortunately, because the other party was very strong and hid too deeply, it wasn't this space that could cause lethal damage.
Shorty felt the pinch. Its consumption just now was much greater than Buggy using the strengthened Dragon Star Group to smash a bunch of worm clones to death.
A moment later.
The armored worm, which had endured the harassment of Shorty all the way, found the source of the attack and opened the ultimate cave. It floated out of the cave and looked at Shorty, Shi Yu, and the others standing on the Eye of the Universe facility.
"You guys… have a death wish!!!" A huge abyssal divine power aura spread, making the people on Blue Planet in some areas look up and see a purple river of stars. There was no blue sky. That was the vast aura of the abyssal divine power of the Space Worm.
The entire Blue Planet seemed to be enveloped in dark clouds.
"Has the battle started?" The descent of the Dragon Star Group naturally attracted a lot of attention. Be it the gods who weren't attacked or not, they could immediately feel the tense atmosphere in the starry sky.
"Shi Yu…" The World Tree immediately understood Shi Yu's good intentions when it saw that Shi Yu had lured the worm into the universe and didn't fight on Blue Planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1442 The Worst God and Return (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1442 The Worst God and Return (2)
Was the World Tree afraid of lowering the Blue Planet's world level?
"None of you should come."
On Blue Planet, when some divine-level experts wanted to fly to the starry sky to support Shi Yu, like Divine Source Legendary, they heard Shi Yu's telepathy spread through the sky.
The Space Worm could evolve, grow, and treat injuries by devouring everything. Shi Yu could take care of his team, but he might not necessarily be able to take care of others.
If a bunch of people came, they might all become nutrients for the worms.
"This kid…" Divine Source guessed Shi Yu's meaning and couldn't help but curse.
When did he become a burden, and after becoming a god?
Shi Yu wanted to face the Space Worm alone.
"Yo, you're finally here." Shi Yu looked at the worm with a smile.
"Master, the other party's divine power is very strong," Ling reminded. "But fortunately, it hasn't reached the level of a high-level god. It can be used to test the strength of the current team."
"If you defeat it, you can defeat the intermediate divine examiner of the God Sealing Battle."
At this moment, all the pets behind Shi Yu appeared and stared at the Space Worm.
"Die!!!" As Ling and Shi Yu communicated, Shorty stimulated the other party again, making the Space Worm charge over in anger.
It was extremely fast.
Boom!
In an instant, the Cosmic Eye was sliced into two by the other party's sharp claws and exploded in the universe. As for Shi Yu and the others, who had just stood on the Eye of the Universe, they had already scattered and flown in the starry sky.
"Wuu!" Photons lingered on Eleven's body as it used the light to control its flight. It looked at the armored bug with strong battle intent.
As cosmic life forms, the Green Dragon, Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger Four Holy Beasts naturally didn't need any other methods to fly freely in the starry sky.
Among them, the Vermillion Bird was a clone, while Chi Tong's main body had already possessed Shi Yu, turning Shi Yu into a sword god in a black trench coat and holding a black sword with fire patterns.
The other pets also displayed their abilities. Even the overlord of the earth, Little Ji, knew that it couldn't lose face at this time and flew with anti-gravity.
It could be said that apart from Little Zi, who was light, soft, and not suitable for fighting, Shi Yu's entire group had joined the battlefield. Even Qi rushed over from Tingxiang to support Shi Yu.
"What's that…"
On Blue Planet, in everyone's vision, the starry sky seemed to have exploded, spreading an extremely dazzling light. It was the armored bug attacking Shorty.
It knew that the one who tortured it just now was this guy. At this moment, its first hunting target was Shorty.
The armored worm's sharp claws that could tear apart stars slashed fiercely at Shorty. At this moment, a Shadow Northern Guard appeared on Shorty's body. That was the support of Little Quas and Turtle, the strongest defense.
Under the blockage of the Dark North Shield, this attack didn't cause much damage to Shorty. It only tore its armor apart. However, the aftermath of the attack and the shield's collision still caused a violent energy explosion, blowing Shorty away and smashing it into the moon, creating a huge hole on the moon with a bang.
The armored worm ignored the other pets and locked onto Shorty, flying towards the moon.
Weak, it was too weak.
The worm that was still a little worried before attacking no longer cared.
It wanted to devour the other party!
But just as it flew halfway, the white eye of the storm that appeared unexpectedly made the worm's pupils shrink.
In an instant, a storm formed. The originally white eye of the storm began to be dyed in red, green, blue, gold, purple, various colors. Air, electricity, heat, light… A moving and chaotic starry sky energy storm swept up, looking very much like a surging sea, directly devouring the worm!
"Ah!!!" In the storm, under the miserable cry of the worm, it seemed to have suffered damage stronger than the Retribution White Tiger. As the energy in the storm vibrated, a broken body pushed open the storm and walked out.
"Unfortunately." Seeing this, the mini battleship Ling in the starry sky felt a pity. The effect of the cosmic storm that used up nearly half its energy on the worm wasn't very satisfactory.
Beside Ling, the corners of the other teammates' mouths twitched. It was a pity to beat an intermediate god into such a miserable state in one move.
"Ah!!!"
After struggling to break free from the storm, the worm suddenly looked at Ling and panicked.
Strong, it was too strong.
The worm, which had no consideration before attacking, was worried.
The other party could hurt him!
Forget it, why not leave?
The wounds on its body healed, and it turned and flew away.
Shi Yu: "?"
"Roar!!!" However, when it flew away, under Buggy's roar, the surrounding Origin Domain activated.
In an instant, the armored worm was covered in it, causing it to be stunned. It wanted to tear open its domain, but it realized that this small world was very strong and it very difficult to do.
It wanted to open the hole of the universe and leave first, but it realized that it couldn't do it at all. This made the armored worm's heart skip a beat. It looked around and realized that it was already surrounded.
"Boom!" The Fusion Black Tortoise's Black Tortoise Fist directly smashed towards the armored worm. The fist shadow of the serpent's roar raised waves of booms.
"Roar!!" Under the hot sun, Little Ji also swung a Sun Meteorite Sword. Because it saw the miserable state of the cat being sent flying just now, it didn't dare attack directly and only released sword light from behind.
"Quack!!" Duckie, who had opened its mind, observed the abyssal power surging in the enemy's body and immediately reminded everyone to be careful. At the same time, it imitated Little Ji and threw out a Vajra Demon Subduing Staff, not daring to approach.

chapters.title: Chapter 1443 The Worst God and Return (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1443 The Worst God and Return (3)
Seeing this, Qi simply attacked with the umbrella. The four of them attacked the armored worm from four directions. Sensing the threat, the Space Worm suddenly erupted with stronger divine power fluctuations. Purple abyss divine power flames spread in all directions. The strength of the Space Worm increased by another level under the explosive aura.
"Uh ah!!! (This is too much!!)" Under the eruption of the armored worm's roar, the entire Creation Domain was immediately infected with a layer of black and purple where the aura affected. Little Ji, Duckie, and the others' attacks were also instantly devoured and blown away by the divine power eruption.
The Creation Domain that had been enhanced by the power of faith began to sway.
Shi Yu and the others had cold expressions.
It was indeed a worm that had swallowed an abyssal life form!
At this moment, the pets who had yet to attack were eager to try.
Among the Space Worm Race, there were three that they didn't devour. One was a planetary life form, one was a cosmic behemoth, and the other was a life race with powerful pollution power like the Abyss Race.
It was very likely that devouring the Abyss Race wouldn't help it evolve by devouring their power, but by being anti-polluted. The survival rate of the worms devouring Abyss Races of the same level was less than 10%.
As for the cosmic behemoth race, because their race was too strong and not suitable to devour, the survival rate of monsters one level lower than the cosmic behemoth race was less than 1%.
Was this Space Worm lucky? Not only did it devour and digest the Abyss Race, but it also swallowed the flesh and blood of a higher-level cosmic behemoth and didn't die. It even successfully mastered one of the other party's talent skills.
"Go…" Shi Yu waved his hand.
"Roar!!!" At this moment, the first team also began to show its might. With a roar, a "cosmic behemoth" 100,000 meters tall appeared in the Creation Domain. After Panda King Eleven enlarged to its peak, black and white lightning lingered around its body. A palm that was enough to destroy the world lingered with destructive power and slapped the worm on the ground from top to bottom.
Zi. Zi. Zi.
Although the abyssal godly energy couldn't be obliterated, at least it didn't corrode Eleven's body. This palm carried endless power and directly pressed the worm that looked up at the black shadow underground.
Boom.
As the huge pit formed, Buggy felt the Creation Domain tremble with a bang and almost collapsed.
"Roar!!" Buggy was also shocked. Crowd Control!!
Baby Ginseng curled its lips at the side. If it wanted to explode, it would definitely collapse. Unfortunately, Shi Yu didn't allow it. Moreover, it couldn't explode. The God Sealing Battle was about to begin. Now that it had wasted the time mark, it didn't have time to condense it.
Baby Ginseng understood that it was the healer in this battle.
It sighed.
Eleven's palm was world-shaking.
"Ya!!!" Unfortunately, this palm still couldn't punish the Space Worm. Eleven's huge palm, which was enough to destroy a country, began to slowly move from the huge pit with Eleven's eyes wide open. In the huge pit of destruction, a small worm figure directly propped up Eleven's huge palm and slowly floated into the sky.
Boom!!
As soon as it released its strength, the reinforced iron bones in Eleven's palm seemed to have been interrupted. Eleven's entire body began to fall back under the huge force. During this process, Eleven began to shrink and return to its normal state, flying in the sky.
"Roar!!!" The worm shouted crazily, revealing a panicked expression.
What were these guys doing?
Why did it feel that they were even stronger than the primary-level god it had swallowed previously?
With so many potent opponents, the worm panicked.
"You're so strong, can you not be so cowardly?" The worm felt another attack.
"My two cat teachers aren't as cowardly as you."
At this moment, Shi Yu finally attacked. The Vermillion Bird clone let out a cry and turned into a black sword enchanted with the World Destruction Vermillion Bird's flames, activating the fire patterns on it. A white armor automatically appeared on Shi Yu's body. Shorty returned to the team and flew into the Creation Domain to strengthen Shi Yu.
There was also a mysterious dark shield mark on the armor. In addition to Buggy's Creation Domain, Buggy had transferred the authority of the world to Shi Yu. At this moment, Shi Yu's attack was enough to reach the divine level.
"Profoundity Sword Skill, Holy Beast Slash." The sword that had fused the power of the Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise made Shi Yu's body flicker with light, turning into a meteor that pierced towards the worm.
Sensing the terrifying power on Shi Yu's body, the worm panicked even more. Its stare kept flickering.
Don't come over!!
"Ya!!" Under the worm's roar, the spreading divine power compressed into its sharp claws and waved a light that was like the flowing of a galaxy.
Boom!!!
With the light, Shi Yu's sword slash dissipated the other party's unique skill and collided with the worm's main body. When the beautiful halo lingered into a storm, with a crack, the Creation Domain shattered under the huge impact. After the destruction of the small world, the two figures flew backward together and floated in the starry sky. Shi Yu panted, and the worm also panted. Purple blood flowed down the gaps of its armor.
As for Shi Yu's body, apart from injuries of various sizes, the power of the abyss also infected him, making Shi Yu slightly serious. This guy…
"Susu, cleanse."
"Everyone, assault together, except Susu."
Under Shi Yu's call, the abyss corrosion on his body was immediately cleansed. At the same time, a combination ability of the Creation Domain and the Taiji Domain was born.
The black and white world restarted, making the worm's expression change again as it felt the suppression.
With a roar, it entered the Taiji World. Eleven's pupils revealed a violent gaze, and its battle power increased greatly. It directly entered the Divine Demon Thought state. Before the worm could react, a Thunder Palm cracked its armor, causing it to fly backward with a puff. It spat out blood crazily and endured serious injuries.

chapters.title: Chapter 1444 The Worst God and Return (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1444 The Worst God and Return (4)
"Yiya (Jupiter!)…" During the process of the worm flying backward, although Baby Ginseng couldn't use self-destruction, it still had other attack methods. It pointed at the abyss worm flying backward. Under the nourishment of the light that filled the sky, a huge wood-element star condensed and wrapped around the worm.
Then…
"Boom!!" Jupiter seemed to have been ignited as it emitted a huge flame, devouring the worm that Eleven sent flying again.
Boom.
The aftermath was endless, and the starry sky was incomparably dazzling and beautiful. On Blue Planet, the gods who had indeed sensed the fluctuations of the starry sky battle felt their hearts skip a beat. They didn't even dare to breathe loudly, as if the end of the world would come at any time.
"Shi Yu…" The World Tree clone, which was the only one who flew out of Blue Planet to pay attention to the battle, saw the Space Worm being suppressed by Shi Yu and the others and felt that it was unbelievable. An intermediate god being suppressed by a group of demigods was also unimaginable in the Mythical War.
"Ah!!!" However, this armored worm was much more tenacious than he imagined. In the light, its entire body turned into a black and purple vortex that kept devouring the aftermath of Jupiter's explosion and slowly walked out of the explosion.
Seeing this, Baby Ginseng was stunned. Beside it, Buggy told Baby Ginseng not to cause trouble and just wait to be a healer after the battle.
Baby Ginseng: "?"
"How did I antagonize you?" After the worm came out this time, it couldn't help but say.
Shi Yu and the others were stunned. They didn't expect the worm to ask this.
"What do you think? Didn't you consume life on Blue Planet?"
The worm cried out crazily. It just wanted to eat its fill. What was wrong with that?
Didn't they eat meat too? It felt that it had been wronged.
"It's true that you want to fill your stomach, but this is a matter of position. If we allow you to do as you wish, the ecology of Blue Planet will be destroyed by you. If you mess around like this, how can I freeload on Blue Planet's world power in the future? Moreover, you'll devour someone I know sooner or later. If you want to eat your fill on other planets, I can't be bothered with you." Shi Yu smiled kindly.
"Tell me, do you merit to die?"
The worm delayed Shi Yu for half a year, yet it still dared feel wronged?
World Tree, Worm: "?"
Baby Ginseng:!!
Shi Yu said, "Finish it."
The Space Worm was shocked.
Everyone's attack continued.
Buggy touched the back of the Space Worm and directly took out the intrinsic Dragon Ball that had been refined for a long time.
"Meow!" Buggy gave the short cat a secret signal. The short cat immediately stunned the worm through the Retribution White Tiger.
Right on the heels of that, Buggy directly smashed the Dragon Ball at the worm with a bang.
"Pfft!!" The worm felt its body being flattened and it fell towards a certain asteroid.
Seeing that Buggy's Dragon Ball was so fierce, Qi looked at the Star Umbrella that had just been blown apart and her heart twitched.
"Profoundity Sword Skill, Vermillion Bird Chant." When Shi Yu saw the worm smashing towards him, divine power lingered in his red eyes. The sword aura in the form of the Holy Beast Vermillion Bird lingered on his body, instantly turning into a fiery red light that waved and slashed at the worm.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!
Shi Yu passed through like a Vermillion Bird phantom. Explosions occurred consecutively on the worm's body, and World Destruction Flame lingered around its body.
"This, this, this, this."
The battle was very intense. As the river of stars trembled, the World Tree was stunned.
It actually had the illusion that the worm that was two levels higher than Shi Yu and the others was very miserable.
"Uh ah!!!" In the fire body, the armored worm roared. Its body turned into the Devour Space again and absorbed the fire.
"Stop, stop…"
To be honest, the Space Worm no longer wanted to fight. Its heart was in a mess, and it felt that its consumption was increasing. If this continued, everything it had eaten previously would be for nothing.
If this continued, the outcome was hard to say.
"It's still alright?"
Of course, apart from the worm being frightened, the World Tree clone was also rather nervous. Seeing that although Shi Yu could suppress the worm, he couldn't take it down for a long time and his skills were frequently devoured, it was very worried that something would happen.
If the other party swallowed and evolved, it would be bad.
"Shi Yu, let me help you," the World Tree clone said.
Although consuming the power of the world in a battle would cause Blue Planet's level to decrease again, the most important thing was to solve the hidden danger!
"There's no need. Don't waste the upgrade resources. Senior Space Emperor and the others will cry." Shi Yu floated in the starry sky and said, "We can settle this guy."
"Forget it, I won't fight anymore," Shi Yu said. "As long as I know the difference."
Shi Yu didn't want to fight anymore. He had already replicated the two most important skills, so he said, "Susu, deal with it."
The World Tree clone was shocked and looked at the Starry Sky Slime that revealed a bitter expression!
This guy was the Blue Sea Sprite.
Although its appearance had changed, its form hadn't changed. The World Tree clone could recognize it.
At this moment, the World Tree clone suddenly discovered a blind spot. Just now, the Blue Sea Sprite had only been assisting in purging and didn't directly attack this Abyss Worm.
Logically speaking, the effect of the Sea Cleansing Spirit's attack on the Abyss Worm shouldn't be inferior to the various unique skills released by Shi Yu previously.
Why…
"Ya!!!" At this moment, seeing the little life form that had been hiding behind to cleanse its abyssal power appear, the Abyss Worm revealed an hostile expression. After fighting for a long time, it really wanted to consume some nutritious food first.
This water-element life form wasn't bad.
However, suddenly, the sneaky feeling in its heart made it sense a trace of danger. It gave up on the thought of fighting. The moment the battle calmed down, it turned and flew away, wanting to leave the troubled place of Blue Planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1445 The Worst God and Return (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1445 The Worst God and Return (5)
"Ning!" However, it was already too late. As Susu decided to attack, it activated the Reincarnation Fruit in the Infinite Devour Space and temporarily advanced to the divine level. Its stare wavered with a cleansing light, and a wave that swept through the starry sky instantly swallowed the entire territory.
Star Sea Contract, Origin Wave!
It believed that all the power on this abyss creature was impurities!
It should be cleansed.
Buzz!!
The starry sky fluctuations swept past, and the body of the armored worm that flew away suddenly froze on the spot. With a terrified expression, it felt that the power on its body was slowly disappearing and slowly returning to zero.
In an instant, it even lost the ability to float and fly in the universe. Its level quickly fell from intermediate god to primary god, then to demigod, overlord, monarch, commander, transcendent, awakening, and even…
Mortal body.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the others widened their eyes and looked at Susu, who had displayed its divine might. They felt that it was extremely ridiculous, extremely ridiculous. Was this the lethality of cleansing star spirits to the Abyss Race?
Although they had already exhausted more than 60% of the worm's stamina, Susu was still too terrifying.
At this moment, seeing this scene, the World Tree clone beside him was also suddenly stunned. It looked at the Space Worm floating helplessly in the universe like trash in shock and felt that it was unbelievable.
"This, this, this…" It looked at Susu in shock and at the Blue Sea Sprite that had turned from blue jelly to seven-colored jelly. It didn't understand what exactly was going on with it just now and what skill it had used.
"If you could tolerate it a little more and hide in the hole of the universe without coming out, I really wouldn't be able to do anything to you. Your cultivation isn't good enough." Shi Yu happily pulled the struggling Space Worm and walked in front of the World Tree clone. "Mission completed."
"You… you… you… completed it just like that?" The World Tree clone was stunned. Didn't they agree that the Space Emperor and the others would give a bunch of equipment to assist in battle? Why didn't Shi Yu use it?
It was clearly still fighting just now, so why did the Blue Sea Sprite instantly kill its opponent with a glance??
The World Tree clone couldn't understand the scene just now.
This was a method that was associated with the first place in the universe, the Abyss Race.
"It won't be that easy if it's someone who doesn't have the power of the abyss," Shi Yu said. "Fortunately, there should still be time. There's still a period of time until the God Sealing Battle."
"Lord World Tree, I'll pack up and prepare to leave. There shouldn't be anything else here, right?"
"I submit… I submit… Don't kill me!!"
"I was wrong. I'm not eating anymore, I'm not eating anymore, alright?" The armored worm kept struggling in Shi Yu's hand.
But now, its mortal body was completely controlled by Shi Yu.
Shi Yu couldn't help but look at this coward… His will level… was low.
This was the guy who made the Blue Planet gods nervous.
Was his talent too good? He had grown to this extent without suffering much?
In fact, Shi Yu also discovered that the pets of the divine-level races beside humans on World King Planet generally didn't have high will levels, inferior to those on Blue Planet.
This might be a pet with strong willpower?
"By the way, I don't plan to kill this guy."
The worm was delighted. "I…"
Shi Yu looked at the Space Worm and said, "This guy's talent isn't bad. I'll send it to reincarnate later and let it start over on Blue Planet. When the time comes, guide it well. It might be able to become the guardian of Blue Planet in the future."
"Ah…" The armored worm was shocked and struggled with all its might.
Wait, it didn't want to reincarnate!! No!!!
"No…"
"Alright." The World Tree clone nodded. Then, it recalled something and connected the divine-level lives on the entire Blue Planet through telepathy.
At this moment, on Blue Planet, in the seven countries and the totem country, in the divine mystic realms, every divine-level listened to the World Tree's voice solemnly.
"I'm the World Tree."
"The previous divine-level invader has already been dealt with by Shi Yu."
"By the way, shouldn't I collect some protection fee?" There were other voices mixed in the World Tree's voice.
There was also a heart-wrenching scream.
The scream sounded as soon as the World Tree finished speaking.
The divine-level experts were rather moved. For example, the corners of Ancient God Golden Bull's mouth twitched crazily. He felt that challenging Shi Yu previously was a stupid cow's behavior.
What a joke… That Shi Yu… really did it? He dealt with an intermediate god…
Moreover, from the sound of it, it was captured alive???
Had an hour even passed during this period?
In the Origin Land, the Genesis Tree God and the other new gods who had some conflict with Shi Yu's expressions stiffened. They felt that it was getting more and more ridiculous. The Genesis Tree God looked at its spatial warehouse and closed its eyes tightly, feeling the pinch. Shi Yu was giving it a warning, right? It had to be.
…
< Name > Infinite Devour
[Level]: Divine
< Introduction > It's a special skill. It can open up the Devour Space and rely on devouring to digest everything to increase the race level and growth level, completing endless evolution and growth.
< Name > Hole of the Universe
[Level]: Quasi Divine-level
< Introduction > It can open the Hole of the Universe to perform a spatial jump.
In the battle with the Space Worm, Shi Yu had only replicated two skills. Firstly, it looked like a high-level skill, Infinite Devour. Susu's Infinite Devour level had been stuck at the transcendental level for a long time. During this period, it had engulfed many divine-level resources and even super divine-level resources, but it didn't increase its level.
This time, he finally replicated the divine-level devour skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1446 The Worst God and Return (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1446 The Worst God and Return (6)
This was the foundation of the power of the Space Worm.
As for the second one, Shi Yu replicated the other party's Hole of the Universe skill. Although this Space Worm had inherited the cosmic behemoth's Hole of the Universe, it was obvious that it had yet to be trained to the level of a divine skill. Therefore, the one Shi Yu replicated was also a quasi-divine skill.
Fortunately, the other party's training level wasn't high. Otherwise, it probably wouldn't be so easy for Buggy to use the Creation Domain to isolate the other party from opening the Hole of the Universe.
However, it was a pity that be it the Infinite Devour or the Hole of the Universe, Shi Yu's group of pets didn't have much compatibility. The former was because its level was too high and it couldn't be taught. The latter, as the exclusive skill of the cosmic behemoth race, was also quite difficult to learn. There was really no compatibility.
Therefore, after the battle, Shi Yu scratched his head. He felt that apart from obtaining a pile of support equipment from the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, he had gained nothing.
He didn't know when he could use these skills.
"Umbrella, my umbrella, wu wu wu." As Shi Yu concluded his gains, the other pets were also chatting about the battle just now.
Qi held the broken Star Umbrella and felt a little aggrieved. The umbrella had first been lowered by Buggy and Baby Ginseng before it was refined, and now it was beaten up by the Space Worm. It was so sad.
"We can just repair it again," Shi Yu comforted Qi.
"It's mainly because your umbrella doesn't look as hard as a dragon ball or anything. Why don't you change it to a mace? The Mace Loli is pretty impressive."
"No!"
"Yiya," Baby Ginseng said. The Space Worm wasn't killed by Susu, but sent to reincarnate by its Reincarnation Fruit. Therefore, shouldn't the divine-level first clear belong to Baby Ginseng?
"Ji!!" Buggy wanted Baby Ginseng to have some shame. The one it sent away wasn't even at the transcendent level.
"Hmph." Baby Ginseng expressed that it didn't care anymore.
"Baby Ginseng, you've done very well. At least you can last for so long without self-destructing." Shi Yu smiled and said, "During the God Sealing Battle, you can explode to your heart's content. No one will stop you."
Baby Ginseng was filled with fighting spirit. It wanted to fight that Cosmic Crow Zavay!
After dealing with the Space Worm, it was time for Shi Yu to leave Blue Planet. Afraid of wasting time, Shi Yu, who was in a hurry to return, informed President Lin and the others before rushing back to World King Planet.
In any case, if it went smoothly, everyone would see each other soon.
The gem cat still had to pack up, so Shi Yu didn't wait for her.
World King Planet.
Floating Realm, Sky City.
At this moment, this place was extraordinarily lively, because the annual God Sealing Battle was about to begin. At the moment, the geniuses and second-generation heirs of the Floating Planet and the Floating Realm had all come to Sky City, planning to use the teleportation facilities of Sky City to go to the nearby first-level realm to participate and register.
Generally speaking, the people of the Floating Realm went to the Dong Xuan Realm and the Heavenly Demon Realm beside them to register. After all, this place and the Floating Realm were in a realm alliance.
The Dong Xuan Realm was controlled by the three races, the Dragon, Phoenix, and Kirin, while the Heavenly Demon Realm was controlled by the Angels and Demons.
Of course, because the God Sealing Battle was held very frequently, many people didn't go to the same place every year and use the God Sealing Battle to travel to other worlds, such as the Blue Wave World and even the central world. It was also common, but the further away they were, the more rich they needed.
At this moment, in a venue in Sky City, the young geniuses were gathered and listening to Lord Lin Feng's passionate speech.
In order to encourage the geniuses of the Floating Realm, before the annual God Sealing Battle, Lin Feng and the Space Emperor would choose one person to mobilize these geniuses, hoping that they could achieve better results.
This year, it was Lin Feng's turn.
"Hello, Sister Zilan, isn't Shi Yu back yet?" The Phoenix man sat beside Zi Lan and asked, "Looks like he doesn't intend to participate in this year's God Sealing Battle."
"With his strength, even if he participates this year, I think he can achieve pretty good results."
He had also learned from Zi Lan that Shi Yu had gone to Blue Planet to deal with an intermediate god. However, like Zi Lan, although he felt that Shi Yu's strength wasn't weak, wasn't it too strange for a Level 9 Beast Tamer to deal with an intermediate god?
Intermediate gods were considered famous experts in the Floating Realm.
"I don't know either. If that intermediate god is the same as in the prophecy, it should appear recently, but whether Shi Yu can kill it… and whether he can return in a complete state… I can't determine," Zi Lan said.
In the past half a year, she had also been instructed by the Space Emperor to travel to Blue Planet to exchange information. Sky City also knew that the worms were hiding and might not appear for half a year.
"That's all I have to say. I hope your ranking this year can improve from last year." Lin Feng stood in front and smiled at the more than a hundred genius Beast Tamers of the Floating Realm and their contracted pets below.
"Grandpa." At this moment, among the geniuses, a young man stood up and said, "Are we the only ones representing the Floating Realm this year?"
"Isn't Shi Yu from Blue Planet participating?? He's … also very strong, right?"
After Lin Feng's grandson, Lin Rui, finished speaking, many geniuses present discussed softly. The genius of the Lu family, Lu Ran, and the daughter of the Space Emperor, Wang Qingqing, these second-generation heirs who had once been beaten up by Shi Yu in the Sky Arena were all attracted by Lin Rui's question.
Yes, why didn't Shi Yu, who had appeared for a while in Sky City, appear for so long? Would he participate?
These young geniuses had no idea that Shi Yu had gone to the Blue Wave World. Their memories of Shi Yu still lingered on Shi Yu using the dragon that had inherited the power of the Ancestral Dragon to sweep through the geniuses in the Sky Arena.
"Shi Yu…" Lin Feng had a slight headache. "He was dispatched to the mother planet by me and the Realm Master to carry out a special quest. I'm not sure if he can rush back…"
"Huh?" Just as Lin Feng finished speaking, he suddenly looked outside the venue and said in surprise, "What a coincidence. He's back. This way, your team still has to add another person."
"If nothing goes wrong, he will also participate in the God Sealing Battle with you."
"Alright, the meeting is over! I wish everyone good results. It's still the same rules as in the past years. I'll deduce the evolution path for you!"
After Lin Feng finished speaking, the other geniuses were alright, but Zi Lan and the Phoenix Man, the two geniuses who were ambassadors of Blue Planet and World King Planet, looked at each other with slightly changed expressions.
Shi Yu… was back?
Don't tell them… Shi Yu really killed that intermediate god… This… If he really did it, wouldn't such a guy participate in the God Sealing Battle… be killing indiscriminately?
…
Sky City, on the temple.
When Shi Yu returned, Lin Feng and the Space Emperor were the first to know. They put down what they were doing and came to the temple to wait for Shi Yu.
"Fortunately, I didn't disappoint." Just as Shi Yu landed, he smiled and said to Lin Feng and the Space Emperor.
Upon hearing that, Lin Feng and the Space Emperor also had happy expressions. The Space Emperor laughed and said, "Well done. Moreover, the time happened to be in time for the God Sealing Battle. With you this time, the Floating Realm is stable."
"Yeah, you brat, you have to let our Senior Space Emperor hold his head high for once. Among the three major realms of the Blue Planet lineage, the Floating Realm has the worst results in the past years," Lin Feng said with a chuckle.
"I will," Shi Yu said. "By the way, Senior Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng, I plan to let every companion enroll for the competition alone. It shouldn't be a problem, right… They've always wanted to see their limits alone. I want to satisfy them."
"If I'm lucky, I might be able to get more placements for our Floating Realm."
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng: ???
Huh? What did this kid say?
"You're f*cking arrogant," Lin Feng couldn't help but say, but then he was amused. His expression was very arrogant. "However, I like it. Hahahaha."
At the side, the Space Emperor's face darkened. Could the two of you save him some trouble? The Space Emperor didn't understand why his subsequent Dong Huang legendaries were so unstable.
However, the Space Emperor displayed a faint smile. Forget it, Shi Yu could do whatever he wanted. He was still young anyway.
In this year's God Sealing Battle, the various realms… were going to be stunned. He, World King Wang, could finally rise up in front of that group of World King friends. As a new realm, the Floating Realm's basis was still weak. It was normal for the juniors to not be able to compare to those old realms, but this year… an even more terrifying one came to their Floating Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 1447 Beginning of the God Sealing Battle (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1447 Beginning of the God Sealing Battle (1)
"There's still half a month until the God Sealing Battle. During this period, you can prepare well."
"If you have any needs, you can tell me and Lin Feng," the Space Emperor said.
Lin Feng looked at Shi Yu and said, "By the way, which realm do you plan to register for the competition?"
"Central realm," Shi Yu said.
"I've never been there. I want to go to a big place to take a look."
"Moreover, isn't the additional challenge after obtaining first place in the God Sealing Battle that you can't fight online and have to go to the central realm to do it?"
"Let's go over there directly to save ourselves the trouble."
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng were silent. Look, was this human language?
Even if two to nine people worked together in the God Sealing Battle, they wouldn't be as arrogant as this kid.
"If you can't get first place, after this God Sealing Battle ends, I'll personally give you 'hell special training'." The Space Emperor made a decision. It was mainly because Shi Yu's words were too arrogant and he couldn't stand it.
"Hehe." Shi Yu smiled and said, "I'll work hard."
…
After returning to the World King Planet, there was still half a month until the God Sealing Battle began. In other words, Shi Yu could still prepare for battle for about ten days.
It was just ten days. Shi Yu originally wanted to spend it quietly, but Zi Lan, Phoenix Man, and the others immediately came looking for him after Shi Yu returned.
"Shi Yu, you really succeeded in killing that intermediate god?"
The two of them ran over in disbelief to verify this question. They wanted to know very much.
"You definitely won't believe me if I say it." Shi Yu saw the two's curious gazes and grinned. "But that's indeed the case."
The two of them opened their mouths wide, not very understanding. Shi Yu said, "What's with the suspense? I'll also participate in the God Sealing Battle. You'll know after the God Sealing Battle. I just returned from the battle. Let me rest first."
"Alright… We'll definitely watch your every battle live broadcast," the Phoenix man said through gritted teeth.
He didn't believe that there was really someone who could walk out of a remote place in less than a year and become the strongest demigod in the entire universe.
"Which realm are you going to participate in?" Zi Lan asked.
"Do you want to go to the central realm together?" Shi Yu asked.
Zi Lan was stunned, then said, "Forget it, forget it. We have to go to the Dong Xuan Realm. We have to go to the family of the contracted target."
A moment later, Shi Yu sent the two of them away and heaved a sigh of relief.
Sigh, he had already imagined how the various associations his pet had joined would annoy him if he really got first place in the God Sealing Battle.
Shi Yu then paid attention to his pets and planned to mobilize them before the competition.
In the past half a year, the one who had improved the most was definitely Qi.
From nothing to having battle power was a huge improvement.
However, Qi definitely wouldn't participate in the God Sealing Battle.
"Ahhh~" In the room, when Shi Yu called his pets out to mobilize, Qi's heart itched. She had obtained battle power, but she couldn't fight. It was so annoying to participate in the team internal competition.
"It's just the God Sealing Battle. There's nothing to participate in. It's just a baby game," Shi Yu said. "When you transmigrate us to the ancient universe to take risks one day, we'll engage in combat to our heart's content."
"Well, that's true…" Qi thought and said, "I'm actually more inquisitive now. Who's the sixth cosmic life form?"
"If there's a chance, I have to return and take a look."
The corners of Shi Yu's mouth twitched. "There's no hurry. Let's deal with the super divine level first. The cosmic level isn't that fast."
Eleven, Buggy, and the other pets nodded repeatedly in the room.
Qi wasn't very bold. After being led onto the archeological path by Shi Yu, she was quite curious.
Just like on Blue Planet, there were many historical gaps. In the universe, there were even more historical gaps.
Not to mention the last era, just this era had lost or erased a lot of history.
One of them was that there were rumors that a total of six cosmic-level experts had been born in this era since ancient times.
Apart from the current five cosmic-level experts, there was still one more.
However, the data of this cosmic life form seemed to have been erased. There were no records at all.
It was normal for Qi to be inquisitive about it. Shi Yu was also curious. However, being curious about a cosmic life form wasn't something they could afford to do at their current level.
"My lord, my lord."
At this moment, Turtle and Little Quas suddenly walked over.
"We've thought about it. We're going to join in the form of a fusion this time."
"Have you thought about it? Sure." Shi Yu looked at the Fusion Black Tortoise.
At this moment, the appearance of the Fusion Black Tortoise changed drastically.
In this half a year, Turtle and Little Quas finished their evolution again.
It wasn't through any special evolution method, but relying on the totem stage to optimize its racial abilities.
In the past, Turtle was only the Longevity Turtle, and Little Quas was only the Winter Water Snake. Now, their normal state before they fused had also evolved into different appearances and evolved into a divine-level race.
Turtle had evolved to become stronger. Its current body was very suitable for combat, so it called itself "Battle Turtle".
A black tortoise shell, a white abdomen, a fierce face, strong muscles, and a standing figure. When it waved its fist, it looked like a Battle Turtle.
In the words of the turtle, the Turtle Prime Minister, who couldn't engage in combat and couldn't conquer the country for his lord, wasn't a good prime minister.
As for Little Quas, it had newly evolved into two heads and evolved into a three-headed snake. The reason why it evolved like this was because they realized that the stronger its mental strength, the stronger the power of faith it could trigger. Therefore, Little Quas optimized itself in the direction of enhancing its mental strength.
Therefore, after Turtle and Little Quas fused, they looked like a standing Battle Turtle. Above, on the left, and on the right, a white sea snake appeared. They were very fierce.

chapters.title: Chapter 1448 - 1447 Beginning of the God Sealing Battle (1)
chapters.content:
1448  Beginning of the God Sealing Battle (2)
It gave Shi Yu the feeling that it was a Mega Water Arrow Turtle. The cannon barrel had been changed to a sea snake.
"In that case, our ranking will be higher. With our strength, it might be difficult for us to enter the top 50," Little Quas's three heads said together, and there was an echo.
In fact… it was mainly because… the two of them were afraid that they would be at the bottom if they participated in the battle alone.
If they participated in the battle together now, no matter how lousy they were, they wouldn't be weaker than Shorty.
"Achoo." The short-legged white tiger playing with the furball sensed malice.
Shi Yu said in amusement, "The top 50 is already a very terrifying result."
"However, it shouldn't be a problem to participate as a fused body. Your fusion state should be able to be seen as an individual."
"By the way, if those Four Saints Evolvers in the Four Saints Ruins knew that you guys changed so quickly, I wonder if they would cry."
When Buggy and the others were guardians of the Four Holy Ruins, because they displayed too much strength, they inevitably encountered follow-ups.
In that month, Shi Yu had already seen no less than 100 Four Saints Evolvers evolving their images towards the forms of Buggy, Chi Tong, Turtle Little Quas, and Shorty, making Shi Yu extremely speechless.
During that period, no less than ten Turtle Snake Black Tortoises appeared.
This was just like plastic surgery on Earth. They all went for a attractive template.
Perhaps this could indeed increase the confidence of some of the Four Saints Evolvers and increase their manage over the power of faith.
"Come, come, come. Let's discuss your registration names next."
"Forget about Eleven, Chi Tong, and Ling."
"Buggy, isn't it a little unsuitable for you to directly use Buggy to register for the God Sealing Battle? When the time comes, it'll be a little embarrassing to announce your name as the top 10 winner of the God Sealing Battle."
"Turtle, Little Quas, you have to have a new name in your fusion state, right?"
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the pets revealed speechless expressions. So their Beast Tamer still knew that the moniker he gave them was a little embarrassing.
Buggy cried.
Shorty also cried. Although it liked Shi Yu to call it Shorty, it was indeed ridiculous to use this moniker to compete. It didn't want to be called 'contestant Shorty'.
"Yi…" Only Baby Ginseng heaved a sigh of relief. Fortunately, it had long given itself a new name.
Now, everyone in the plant association knew its well-known name, the ginseng emperor. This was called intelligence.
Ling: "Sure, I wonder if 10 days is enough to think of a name."
…
After a while.
On the Floating Realm's side, Vice Realm Master Lin Feng personally brought Shi Yu to the central realm and acted as a bodyguard.
Lin Feng's direct descendants didn't even enjoy this treatment.
In the central realm.
It could be seen as the center capital of the World King Planet. Many official institution headquarters that crossed hundreds of realms were located here.
Although the God Sealing Battle could be registered in the various first-level realms and then entered the "second world" to fight through the teleportation array, which was similar to the ranking fight of all races, there was no doubt that the number of contestants gathered in the central realm every year was the most. This was a pursuit.
"We're finally here." Lin Feng and Shi Yu had finally arrived at the largest teleportation point on World King Planet.
At this time, there was an endless stream of tourists coming to the central realm. The entire teleportation point was filled with people. Shi Yu and Lin Feng were completely inconspicuous.
"Heh, Shi Yu." Lin Feng poked Shi Yu and said, "Look at that."
He pointed at a sexy beauty with ice-blue skin.
"Oh?" Shi Yu was still looking for the exit when he heard Senior Lin Feng call him. He immediately looked over.
"What?"
"It's the Frost Star People, the planet that produces attractive women. They're incredibly beautiful. Look," Lin Feng said. "Damn it, she left. Did you see her?"
Shi Yu's face darkened. F*ck, he thought that the other party wanted him to see something important.
"Senior Lin Feng, you already have many descendants. Can you calm down?"
Lin Feng chuckled and said, "I just admire different beauties. Shi Yu, you brat, I already had several wives at your age. What about you?"
Shi Yu: "???"
"I just devoted all my energy to cultivation, so I'm stronger than you, Senior Lin Feng, than when you were at the same age."
Lin Feng: "?"
"Kid, are you itching for a beating? If you can't get first place in the God Sealing Battle, Senior Space Emperor and I will give you special training in hell for a year."
Shi Yu said, "There's such a good thing? I even want to deliberately go easy on you guys and let you give me special training…"
Lin Feng's face darkened.
He, who often caused others to choke on their words, finally experienced the sensation of being choked.
At the same time, some passers-by saw Shi Yu and Lin Feng discussing the first place in the God Sealing Battle. They shook their heads and walked over with doubtful expressions.
Where did this country bumpkin come from? How could the first place in the God Sealing Battle be so easy to get?
Lin Feng and Shi Yu: "…"
Next, Shi Yu and Lin Feng separated.
Lin Feng went to find a place to stay, while Shi Yu found a place to register first.
Now, there were more than hundreds of registration points for the God Sealing Battle in the central realm, so there was basically no long line.
In the registration hall of a certain God Sealing Battle, a staff member with an outstanding aura looked at the strange long line that suddenly entered and fell into deep thought.
It was a young man in a panda casual suit and a panda.
Behind it was a Green Silkworm.
After that was a sword maiden in a black dress.
Baby Ginseng in a research suit.
Starry Sky Slime… mini battleship… dragon and a blind duck…

chapters.title: Chapter 1449 Beginning of the God Sealing Battle (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1449 Beginning of the God Sealing Battle (3)
"Everyone, are you together?" The staff looked at the long line and asked Shi Yu, who was at the front.
"No, I don't know them," Shi Yu said.
"Uh, alright," the staff said.
A moment later, Shi Yu and the others left. They each took their contestant cards and left the staff in confusion.
Bullsh*t.
They were all from the Floating Realm and even entered together. How could they not know each other?
The staff would never have thought that this pile of strange creatures that had signed up separately was all one person's contracted pet.
At most, he thought that they knew each other. After all, in the Floating Realm, it was rare for a Level 9 Beast Tamer to contract multiple pets, let alone 10!
This was actually a bug. Every life individual could register independently, but if this life individual had a contracted target, the contracted target was also included in this individual.
And if this contracted target was a human Beast Tamer, and this human Beast Tamer had other contracted pets, it would still be considered an individual.
Everything only recognized the contract connection.
Shi Yu wasn't the first to play like this, but none of the contestants who played like this had obtained good results. There were very few in the top 100.
After all, on the World King Planet, there had never been anyone who could contract multiple pets and train multiple pets to the top of the God Sealing Battle.
This might also be the reason why the officials of the God Sealing Battle had never paid much attention to this bug.
Shi Yu didn't know if the officials of the God Sealing Battle would repair this loophole if his pet could really occupy the top rankings this time…
…
After registering, Shi Yu retracted his pets and sat in the teleportation array to find Senior Lin Feng according to the coordinates sent by Senior Lin Feng.
In fact, it wasn't a big problem for Shi Yu, Lin Feng, and the others to find a random wilderness and stay in the ruins space. However, this would be too miserable. It was no different from camping.
It was rare for him to come to the central realm, so he naturally had to stay in a luxurious place that included three meals.
At this time, there was a luxurious mystic realm residential area specially prepared for the contestants of the God Sealing Battle. Divine chefs used various divine-level ingredients to cook three meals a day. It was a nutritional meal specially prepared for the contestants of the God Sealing Battle.
With Shi Yu participating, as a senior, Lin Feng naturally couldn't let Shi Yu suffer.
"Shi Yu, come quickly."
When Shi Yu arrived at the mystic realm residential area, he saw Lin Feng standing outside the villa, chatting with a bearded middle-aged man in sunglasses and a cigarette in his mouth.
Next to the other party was a cool girl in sunglasses.
"Old Lin, so he's the junior you brought to participate?" The smoking man looked at Shi Yu and said, "He doesn't look very old."
"Don't tell me he's your illegitimate son. You don't even value your descendants so much, right? You even brought him up personally."
Lin Feng was amused. "If I could have such an outstanding, illegitimate son, I would die of joy."
"Shi Yu, this guy is an old friend of Wang Kong and me in the Void Battlefield. We've possessed a life-and-death relationship. Just call him Old Sun."
"This is his daughter, also here to participate in the God Sealing Battle. You're about the same age, you can get to know each other."
"Senior Sun." Shi Yu understood. Lin Feng possessed encountered someone he knew. The world was very big, but it was very small.
"Haha, hello," Senior Sun said. "This is the first time I've seen Lin Feng value a junior so much. I'm waiting to see your performance. Your name is Shi Yu, right?"
Shi Yu smiled and said, "Yes."
"Ah Lin, let's have a meal together?" Senior Sun invited. "We haven't seen each other for so many years. At least let's drink until we're drunk."
"Alright," Lin Feng said. "Shi Yu, let's go together."
Shi Yu was helpless. Forget it, so be it. He was also hungry. He wanted to see how delicious the delicacies made by the chef of the central realm were. He was tired of eating Baby Ginseng's fruits.
Meat! Meat! Meat!
At the dining table.
Lin Feng and Senior Sun drank happily. Shi Yu didn't drink and ate meat silently at the side.
"Why aren't the two of you talking?" Senior Sun and Lin Feng, who were chatting, couldn't help but ask when they observed that the two juniors didn't communicate the whole time.
"Qiujing, communicate with your peers," Senior Sun said.
"What's there to talk about?" Sun Qiujing said silently. She looked at Shi Yu and felt that there was nothing to communicate about.
Shi Yu took another bite of meat. He didn't expect her to be an introverted girl. She had to broaden her horizons!
"Look at you. You cultivate all day and don't even know how to chat anymore?" Senior Sun smiled and said, "You both have to participate in this God Sealing Battle. You can talk about this."
Sun Qiujing gazed at Shi Yu and nodded. "Do you want to compete?"
"Cough." Shi Yu almost choked. Did she know how to chat?
Senior Sun also gazed awkward, but beside him, Lin Feng was interested and said, "Old Wang, this is your daughter's first time participating."
"Yeah, but she's very strong. She was only released after she received sufficient training from her mother. I think it shouldn't be a problem to fight for the top 10,000," Senior Sun said confidently.
"Do you want to compete?" Lin Feng asked. "Let's see who has a higher ranking between her and Shi Yu. Let's bet on something."
The corners of Senior Sun's mouth twitched. "What are you thinking about taking from me?"
"Cough, with the super divine resource you obtained on the battlefield, you shouldn't have used it yet, right?" Lin Feng said.
Senior Sun said, "Get lost…"
"If I lose, I'll give up my life to help you deduce an evolution path of a top-notch god race. I'll pay all the evolution materials. You specify the target."

chapters.title: Chapter 1450 Beginning of the God Sealing Battle (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1450 Beginning of the God Sealing Battle (4)
Senior Sun suddenly fell silent and said, "Really?"
He was suddenly tempted. He knew Lin Feng's ability. Although that super divine resource was precious, he couldn't use it. On the contrary, Lin Feng's evolution deduction was very useful to his daughter.
Just now, he was actually very humble. Not to mention the top 10,000, even if it was the top 1,000, his daughter could easily reach the top 100. Perhaps Lin Feng didn't know what contracted divine beast he had found for his daughter.
"Yeah." Lin Feng nodded.
"Well…" When Shi Yu saw that Lin Feng was betting on him, the corners of his mouth couldn't help but twitch. If there was no share, he wouldn't do it. What super divine resource could make Senior Lin Feng so concerned… Was he betting on it for him?
"Good daughter, are you confident?" Senior Sun looked at his daughter. This… was a very big bet!!
"Yes." The girl nodded expressionlessly.
"Hahaha, drink," Lin Feng laughed heartily and said.
"Drink, drink, drink. Speaking of which, kid, what's your background? Lin Feng dared to place such a big bet on you and deduce a top-notch divine race evolution path. Wouldn't we drain him dry and make him weak for decades?" Senior Sun looked at Shi Yu deeply.
"What background can he have? He's just a little guy from Wang Kong's mother planet. He's not worth mentioning." At this moment, Lin Feng didn't dare let Senior Sun ask blindly, afraid that he wouldn't bet anymore.
Shi Yu just had to shut up now.
Shi Yu was speechless.
That night, Shi Yu ate very well. One way or another, the meat was better than the Cultivation Fruit.
…
A storm brewed in the central realm.
Many geniuses of various realms had come here and didn't choose to participate in the God Sealing Battle in their hometowns.
Because just the atmosphere of participation was completely different.
Time quickly passed and it was soon the night before the God Sealing Battle began.
The spectators from the various realms of the World King Planet who were paying attention to the God Sealing Battle began to pay attention to the official website of the God Sealing Battle.
As of the end of the registration, a total of 83,886,09 people had signed up for this year's God Sealing Battle.
It was considered one of the few batches of applicants in recent years.
The reason why the God Sealing Battle received so much attention was that every subsequent God Sealing Battle would be broadcast live on the official website of the God Sealing Battle in the form of different live-streams.
Tonight, more than four million battle lists would be randomly matched.
The rules of the God Sealing Battle were a very simple elimination battle. In a two-on-one battle, the loser would be eliminated, and the winner would advance.
In the initial four million live-streams, it was naturally impossible for passers-by to pay attention to every battle.
What the audience wanted to see was basically the battle process of relatives and friends they knew, or experts who had obtained outstanding results in the previous batch.
"The number of registrations is singular. Perhaps Shi Yu will be the lucky one to advance without a battle."
In the Floating Realm, the gem cat girl had also returned to the World King Planet. At this moment, she was paying attention to the God Sealing Battle with Senior Dragon God.
The Dragon God didn't choose to register for this God Sealing Battle. She felt that with her current strength, she wouldn't have good results and planned to cultivate for a few more years.
Even if she knew that a bunch of demigods on Blue Planet had already successfully upgraded, she wasn't in a hurry to break through.
"I hope so." The Dragon God smiled. Wind of Blessing? Could it be that this skill could really make Shi Yu so lucky?
Not only the gem cat and the Dragon God, but many people were also curious about who would be so lucky to advance without a battle.
Soon, it was time for the battle list to be announced!
Swoosh!
The official website interface refreshed, and a dense list of countless pages directly refreshed. The quality of the server was super strong.
At this time, naturally, no one would look at them one by one. They were all good at using the search function.
"F*ck." In the Floating Realm, the gem cat, who was paying attention to the candidates, was directly stunned.
"Ling???"
The lucky one who advanced without a battle was surprisingly Ling from the Floating Realm. For a moment, the Dragon God was also slightly silent. This little cat was really right?
Out of more than eight million contestants, it was the lucky one who advanced directly without competing. What kind of luck was this?
"I knew it!" the gem cat said.
"Wait, why isn't it Shi Yu, but Ling??" The gem cat was puzzled. "Wait a minute, why did Ling register alone?? What's going on?"
In the central realm.
In a luxurious room.
"Holy shit, Ling advanced." Shi Yu and the others also surrounded him and looked at the situation of the randomly matched opponents.
The matching of the God Sealing Battle depended on luck.
As long as single was unlucky, the initial and second places of the previous batch might be matched in the first round and one would be eliminated.
It wasn't like this had never happened before.
Therefore, every pet took the next opponent very seriously.
After all, the frequency of the early stages of the competition was quite high. If they encountered a strong enemy correct from the start, even if they won, it wasn't easy for them to recover their state, and they might lose the next round.
Of course, in order to avoid this situation, Shi Yu and the others had prepared a lot of supplements in advance. The Space Emperor and Lin Feng too provided a lot.
"I actually advanced without a fight. Boring. I still want to fight." Seeing this, the image of the ship girl on the mini battleship, Ling, revealed a dissatisfied expression.
Chi Tong, Susu, and the others looked at Ling and curled their lips.
Shouldn't Ling be happy that it was the lucky one?
"Forget about Ling. Hurry up and investigate who your opponents are and if there are any strong enemies," Shi Yu said.
If they matched the contestants who had participated in the God Sealing Battle previously, they could see the other party's historical results.
"Ji."
"Yi!!"
"Ning!"
Soon, the pets shouted and complained.
Weak, too weak.
The opponents they matched had historical battle results, but none of them were high.
They were all above the 1 millionth rank.
Without thinking, they might be able to insta-kill the other party with a casual move.
Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Duckie, Little Ji, Turtle, Little Quas, Shorty, and the others had bored expressions.
"It's normal. It's only the first battle," Shi Yu said. "Where's Eleven?"
At this moment, only Eleven didn't say anything.
At that moment, Eleven hugged his laptop with a complicated expression and couldn't help but smile.
"Wu wu wu."
Seeing Eleven's strange expression, everyone leaned over.
Some too took their computers and searched for Eleven's opponent.
This seek directly made Shi Yu's entire team fall silent.
Even when it was revealed that Ling was the lucky single to advance, the entire team had never been so silent. This was because Ling's good luck was obvious to everyone.
But Eleven… wasn't it a little too f*cking ridiculous?
Battle Number: 2022, Battle List: [Zavay] vs [Eleven]!
Eleven's initial opponent… was Zavay of the Cosmic Crow Race, who held the first place title of the God Sealing Battle for 79 consecutive times! Right from the start, Eleven encountered the previous reigning champion!

chapters.title: Chapter 1451 First Battle (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1451 First Battle (1)
After Shi Yu and the others arrived at the World King Planet and paid attention to the God Sealing Battle, the first name they knew was Zavay.
Because its battle results were too dazzling.
Before Zavay participated in the God Sealing Battle, there was a monster combination that won the God Sealing Battle 101 time in a row. No one could defeat it.
Until this Zavay of the Cosmic Crow Race participated and the 101st streak ended!
Then, it was the era of Zavay's rule over the God Sealing Battle for 79 consecutive years.
The previous champion participated again and could only stay in second place.
People gave a description for this genius from the Cosmic Crow Race, who was ranked 30th among the myriad of races in the starry sky.
[The strongest below the divine level in a century.]
A monster with 15 quasi-divine skills, including five time-element quasi-divine skills, was indeed worthy of this title.
It was said that Zavay could have broken through to the divine level a century ago. The reason he suppressed his level and didn't break through was to defeat that intermediate god at the demigod level and take away the reward.
Of course, monsters like Zavay, after obtaining first place in so many God Sealing Battles, still couldn't pass the additional challenge after winning the God Sealing Battle and defeating the intermediate god guarding the reward. It was obvious how difficult it was to obtain the final reward.
Eleven's first opponent was actually it.
Out of more than eight million demigod contestants, Eleven was matched with this guy at once…
"Oh my God…" Shi Yu couldn't help but hold his forehead. What kind of luck was this?
"Wu wu wu, wu wu wu!!" However, Eleven was very excited.
The other pets were shocked, not because they sympathized with Eleven, but because they were green with envy!
"Yi!!!" Baby Ginseng was extremely dissatisfied. Why, why did Eleven match Zavay?
Zavay was clearly the opponent it wanted to defeat.
"Ji!!" Buggy and the others had uncomfortable expressions. How glorious would it be to defeat the previous first place? Why weren't they the ones matched with Zavay?
Why Eleven…
"This luck… If it were other contestants, they would be considered very unlucky. Fortunately, we have the strength. Otherwise, I would really suspect that Ling sucked away Eleven's luck." Shi Yu looked at the battle list and couldn't help but smile.
Alright, so be it.
Eleven's current quasi-divine skills were inferior to the other party, but their quality had all exceeded that of Zavay's. Moreover, Shi Yu had seen Zavay's battle video. Although he wasn't too sure, he felt that Eleven shouldn't lose.
Moreover, its skills countered the other party in a certain way.
Even if he didn't support Eleven, the chances of winning were very high.
…
At this moment.
Shi Yu and the others weren't the only ones who discovered [Eleven] vs [Zavay].
Lin Feng and the Space Emperor, who were more concerned about Shi Yu, also found the details of the battle on their side. The corners of their mouths couldn't help but twitch.
They knew Shi Yu's registration mode. Eleven and the others' identification and strength certificates were even issued by the Space Emperor, so the two of them went straight to the point and searched for the names of Shi Yu's pets. This search…
"This unlucky child," they couldn't help but say. It was unknown if they were talking about Eleven or Zavay.
Not only them, but many people also paid attention to Shi Yu and Eleven.
For example, in the Blue Wave World, Director Sen of the Myriad Races Committee hadn't seen Eleven participate in the Myriad Race Ranking Battle for a long time. Apart from paying attention to the God Sealing Battle, he couldn't help but search for Eleven to see if it participated.
After searching, Director Sen was also stunned.
"Zavay?"
At the same time, Fanba of the Star Refining Race, who had been beaten up by Eleven in the ranking battle of all races, was also stunned. It also knew that Eleven would participate in the God Sealing Battle. After this search, it was directly silenced by Eleven's unlucky state.
"I've finally refined a new arms. I originally wanted to compete with you to see whose ranking in the God Sealing Battle is higher, but…" The purple-skinned holey person shook its head.
No matter how strong Eleven was, it didn't think that Eleven could defeat a monster like Zavay.
Not to mention the 10 five-element divine skills that could be combined, just the five time quasi-divine skills, Time Acceleration, Time Deceleration, Time Stop, Time Reversal, and Time Mark… could play a bunch of opponents to death.
Eleven was going to be given away for nothing.
Perhaps not many people knew Eleven, but as the champion of 79 consecutive championships, the attention on Zavay was undoubtedly off the charts.
A bunch of spectators started searching to see who was so fortunate to have faced Zavay in the first round.
"Eleven? I've never heard of it."
"There's no participation record. It's a pure newbie."
"How unlucky. The first time it participated in the God Sealing Battle, it encountered Zavay. How is it supposed to play this? Haha."
Dong Xuan Region.
"Why can't I find Shi Yu?" The Ice Kirin Race's Bobo, who had been defeated by Eleven above its level, later learned that Eleven was the pet of Blue Planet's genius, Shi Yu.
It felt that Shi Yu would definitely participate in this God Sealing Battle, so it searched. However, it couldn't find Shi Yu's name. It took a step back and searched for Shi Yu's pet, Eleven. Then…
It also looked at the words [Eleven] vs [Zavay] in silence.
"Who's this Eleven? Why is it so fortunate to have encountered Zavay?" Zi Lan, Phoenix Man, and the others, who had come to the Dong Xuan Region to register for the God Sealing Battle, didn't pay much interest to Shi Yu at first. They were all paying attention to the opponents they matched.
However, when the others on the discussion board discussed how the fortunate guy had faced Zavay in the first round, they were slightly stunned when they saw the recognizable name "Eleven". Their faces darkened.
Why was it so familiar? Was Shi Yu's Iron-eating Beast called Eleven…

chapters.title: Chapter 1452 The First Battle (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1452 The First Battle (2)
At the same time.
In the same central realm, Zavay itself, who was at the core of the discussion, was a cosmic life form with a human body, crow head, and crow wings. It didn't even pay attention to who its opponent was. Its entire body emitted an invincible aura as it meditated calmly and waited for tomorrow's competition.
It didn't care who the opponent was.
Because it was the strongest.
…
After the name list of the God Sealing Battle was out, the various major realms were lively. The level of attention to such a global battle was naturally extremely high.
Soon, countless people successfully welcomed the arrival of the next day with anticipation.
The next morning.
"How is it?"
"Do you really not need me to attack with you?" Shi Yu asked again.
"Wu wu wu!" Eleven nodded. It could do it, it would definitely win.
"Alright." Shi Yu smiled. He originally wanted to go up and fuse and replicate the skill, but forget it, it was the same to find an opportunity to replicate it after the competition.
His skill slots were limited now. With Zavay's pile of top-notch skills, his skill slots weren't enough at all.
If he replicated Zavay's skills, he couldn't replicate others.
Shi Yu planned to let his pets go up and fight, while he himself would be below. He would pay attention to who had top-notch skills in all aspects and compare the goods. Then, he would visit them one by one after the God Sealing Battle ended.
"Shi Yu… How's your preparations?" On the day of the competition, when Shi Yu and the others planned to go out to the God Sealing Battle competition area, Lin Feng was already guarding the door.
He had already rushed over to look for Shi Yu last night, but seeing that Shi Yu was confidently massaging Eleven's body and adjusting its state, he didn't stay long…
"Today is Eleven's God Sealing Battle!" Shi Yu's words had two meanings.
"Wuu!!" Eleven was wearing a victory scarf and was full of fighting intent.
"Roar~" In Shi Yu's group, Buggy and the others also congratulated this panda.
Seeing this, Lin Feng smiled. Alright, alright, then it would depend on Eleven's performance.
…
There were battle facilities in the 251 districts of World King City that could be used as teleportation points for the God Sealing Battle.
Eleven and the others were pretty lucky. Because they registered consecutively, they were all assigned to a battle facility. They all logged into the second world from the teleportation point of the battle facility 203 to participate in the God Sealing Battle.
"Wuu~" Eleven was like a big brother as it walked at the front. When it looked up, it could see the silver battle symbol of the battle facility shining under the sun.
The panda led the way, the worm crawled on the ground, the Starry Sky Slime jumped about,and the mini warship followed behind. The ginseng baby wore a researcher suit, and the beautiful sword maiden was dressed in black. The ferocious dragon, the blindfolded duck, the four-headed turtle snake, and the short-legged cat were all present. All of them were full of evil fighting intent.
Shi Yu held his cell phone and walked at the end like a passer-by who didn't know them. Due to time problems, he intended to only pay attention to Eleven's combat live broadcast.
"I must enter the top 500,000 of this year's God Sealing Battle!!!"
Outside the combat facility, a young man riding a dragon landed and made a great wish.
"If you can withstand one round, you'll be considered to have succeeded!" A cat-headed person also walked into the battle facility resolutely. It looked like it was the only one without a contracted partner.
"If you can't enter the top 1 million this year, don't come back! I don't have such a useless son!" There were even divine-level experts who sent their descendants over the whole time and gave them a strict warning.
"Dad… Don't worry, at least the first round is stable. I matched with a strange-colored slime. It's a newbie."
…
"How lively," Shi Yu muttered to himself after following Eleven and the others in.
At this moment, the combat facilities were filled with contestants and staff. The God Sealing Battle wasn't a traditional competition. It was held online the whole time and there were no audience seats. The contestants came from various realms and could only watch through the online live-stream.
However, as long as one was willing to spend money, they could buy a relatively high-level spectator device. During the live broadcast, they could enter the God Sealing Battlefield of the second world with their consciousness and watch the battle with their own eyes.
This made Shi Yu unable to help but sigh. Big places really knew how to play.
"Roar!! (I'll go prepare first.)"
"Quack!! (Me too.)" After entering the battle facility, Little Ji and Duckie asked for instructions and hurried to a teleportation venue with the contestant card.
The competitions of different contestants were carried out at different times. For example, Little Ji and Duckie started the tournament at 7:00, Eleven started the competition at 7:10, and Shi Yu's other pets' time was even later.
In order to not delay watching Eleven's competition, Little Ji and Duckie ran to the battle at lightning speed, wanting to defeat the opponent in 10 minutes and come out.
Shi Yu didn't pay attention to their battle. It wasn't that he didn't care about Little Ji and Duckie, but the historical ranking of their opponents in the God Sealing Battle was in the millions.
