Not long after arriving at the World King Planet, after Little Ji first merged with the World Annihilation Dragon Pearl, its strength was enough to suppress the top 10,000 contestants of the God Sealing Battle. And now, after comprehensive fusion, additional points, and cultivation, facing an opponent in the millionth place, to be honest, it only needed one deterrence!
A deterrence that merged with the Destruction Will was enough to crush the other party's spirit and make the other party submit to the power of an overlord.
Duckie was about the same. After fusing with the Eye of the Evil God, it only needed a deterrence that swept up its terrifying and deep abyssal evil thoughts to scare weak opponents into peeing their pants.
There was really no need to pay attention to such battles. Shi Yu believed in his pets!
Therefore, after letting Little Ji and Duckie go, Shi Yu and the others followed Eleven to the venue where it had to teleport.
The venue was very large. There were a total of 10 teleportation arrays, each guarded by a staff member who had reached the divine level. Although they were all junior gods, if any conflict was discovered at the scene, so many divine-level staff members were enough to suppress it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1453 The First Battle (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1453 The First Battle (3)
In the venue, hundreds of contestants had already arrived early in the morning. They stayed in different places in the venue. They were either sitting or leaning against the wall to rest with their eyes closed. The atmosphere was solemn.
Most people didn't care much when Eleven and the other pets entered. A small number of contestants looked over and observed…
"Hey, that black and white bear." In the arena, a hairy-faced monkey in a battle suit leaning against the wall suddenly grinned and said, "Why does it look so familiar?"
"Are you Eleven? Your opponent in the first battle is Zavay from the Cosmic Crow Race?"
On the battle list, there was the profile picture of the identity certificate used by every contestant to register. Eleven's profile picture was naturally on it.
"Huh? Yes." Eleven looked over and spoke in the cute universal language. This was a skill where telepathy materialized into language through the mouth. The pets in Shi Yu's team were already expert-level.
"Hehe, it's true. You actually dare join after knowing who your opponent is??" The hairy-faced monkey grinned in disbelief.
After knowing that its opponent was Zavay, it actually came to participate. Wasn't it afraid of being beaten to the verge of death? Healing cost money.
Wasn't it better to give up the competition directly?
At this moment, as the fur-faced monkey spoke, the gazes of the entire venue concentrated on Eleven. A smile appeared on their faces. This unlucky guy.
The originally solemn atmosphere of the venue actually had a little joy for a moment. Although the subsequent competition schedule was tense, at least… they weren't as unlucky as Eleven to come across the previous champion right from the start.
So be it, but it actually came to participate…
Interesting.
Buggy and the others, who entered with Eleven, also smiled. However, they were smiling because this group of people didn't know Eleven's strength.
This was the number one Panda King in the universe. How could it be defeated by some Cosmic Crow Race!
"Roar!!"
"Quack!!"
Soon, Little Ji and Duckie rushed over. Just as Shi Yu thought, they insta-killed their opponent with a deterrence. Seeing that Eleven had yet to leave, they heaved a sigh of relief.
…
Time passed little by little.
A group of people had long entered live-stream 2022, waiting to see the battle of Zavay.
After all, it was the strongest below the divine level in a hundred years. Its popularity was undoubtedly the highest.
Before long, the battle room 2022 opened.
The screen flashed, and a rock arena appeared. On the arena, the figures of the two parties slowly appeared.
On the left was a two-meter-tall Zavay in red, black wings, and a crow head and human body.
On the other side was Eleven, who was more than a meter tall and wasn't wearing anything. It had a victory headband tied to its head.
"So strong." Many people could sense Zavay's bottomless and rich power after entering the second battlefield to watch the battle through the virtual glasses.
"I can feel that it has improved again. Its strength is increasing a little every year." The human who had once won the championship 101 consecutive times and his contracted partner looked at Zavay solemnly.
His name was Ming Gu, and he was recognized as the strongest below Zavay.
In the past dozens of years, his goal had long changed from completing the champion challenge to defeating Zavay. It could be said that he was very concerned about Zavay's every move.
Whoosh!
Countless people surged into the live-stream. Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, Dragon God, Gem Cat, Zi Lan, Phoenix Man, Director Sen, Star Refining Race's Fanba, Green Dragon Gorka, Ice Kirin Bobo…
"As everyone can see, contestant Zavay and contestant Eleven have already logged onto the arena."
Under the attention of countless people, a virtual little elf appeared in everyone's vision. Everyone looked at the scene from its perspective.
This was a battle elf, a virtual mechanical intelligence life form. When the attention of a certain live-stream reached a certain standard, they would appear and explain the battle to everyone like a commentator to increase its popularity. Of course, if one didn't want to see it, they could also choose to block it and watch the battle wholeheartedly.
However, after all, they were watching the battle from a space. Even if it was a divine-level expert, they couldn't guarantee that they could see every detail of the battle clearly. The battle elf's explanations could reduce a lot of doubts.
In this battle, everyone felt that the battle elf was dispensable. This was because no matter how they looked at it, just one move was needed to end the battle. The only ones who could make Zavay feel that it was a little troublesome were probably the monsters in the top five.
"Contestant Zavay has already won first place in the God Sealing Battle for 79 consecutive times. I believe its goal this year is the same as usual. As for its opponent, Eleven, it seems to be participating in the God Sealing Battle for the first time. I wonder what kind of sparks can be produced from the battle between them."
"Please… look forward to it." After the battle elf finished speaking, it floated to the side and zoomed in. Zavay and Eleven had already looked at each other.
Zavay stood on the spot indifferently, its eyes not caring about Eleven, its opponent.
It didn't take Eleven seriously at all.
After entering the arena, a powerful mental intimidation began to spread from Zavay's body…
Boom!
A terrifying mental deterrence… swept towards Eleven like a tsunami.
The ground cracked.
The sky cracked.
Wherever the intimidation swept, space and time seemed to have stopped!
On the other side, Eleven also looked at Zavay very calmly.
It could also sense Zavay's powerful aura and couldn't help but be satisfied from the bottom of its heart.
This was how it should be. The first place in the God Sealing Battle indeed lived up to its reputation. The opponent was very strong, and Eleven was very satisfied. However, Eleven didn't like the opponent's disdainful attitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 1454 The First Battle (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1454 The First Battle (4)
Today… it would teach this guy how to be a crow!
"The battle has started!"
"Before encountering an opponent really worth attacking, contestant Zavay has always used his deterrence to instantly kill the other party!"
"If you're not strong enough, you'll fall in front of contestant Zavay in an instant!!" the battle elf said.
It was over…
As Zavay erupted with incomparable deterrence, many spectators knew that the competition was over.
However…
Boom!
In the next moment, the deterrence wave swept across Eleven's entire body, but Eleven stood on the spot without any effect. At the same time, its body erupted with a thunderous bang.
"Wait, it's unharmed?"
The audience, who originally thought that this unknown black and white bear would be insta-killed by deterrence, was stunned when they saw how calm Eleven was under this terrifying deterrence.
On the other side, Zavay's eyes also flashed before it was suddenly stunned.
Because it discovered that the opponent… didn't do any protective measures and received the deterrence!
Under its gaze, Eleven took a step back with its right foot and made a punching posture with its right fist!!
"This is…"
The battle elf said, "Contestant Eleven relied on its physical strength to withstand Zavay's deterrence… Then… it chose to punch directly in the air!"
Eleven directly punched out in the air with its physical strength.
Buzz!!
The air compressed and space distorted. Eleven's punch, with its physical strength, directly formed a storm-like counterattack in the air, instantly scattering all the deterrence. With a crack, the deterrence shattered. The fist wind swept up a terrifying impact, directly lifting up the cracked rock ground at the speed of light, sweeping up gravel that filled the sky!!
"What skill is this!" Countless spectators exclaimed.
The conflict elf said, "A punch that hits the air with muscle power alone, this… isn't a skill!"
Boom!!!
When the little elf's voice sounded, the fist wind blew Zavay away from the spot in an instant. Its wings protected its body as it moved back dozens of meters. Its entire body seemed to have suffered a thousand cuts. Even the wind blade domain of the wind law didn't feel so powerful…
The battlefield rumbled.
Zavay drew a deep crack on the ground before stopping.
When the storm dissipated, dense injuries had already appeared on Zavay's body. Its entire wing was trembling. At this moment, the sky was instantly cloudless. Everyone was shocked by this scene.
"Who is this Eleven? What race is it from? Where did it come from!"
Eleven didn't shock the audience after enduring Zavay's deterrence, but seeing Eleven send Zavay flying with a punch in the air without even touching it, this had already exceeded everyone's understanding.
"This… This power, how is this possible? Its physique is even more terrifying." Fanba of the Star Refining Race, Ice Kirin Bobo, and these lives who had fought Eleven were also shocked when they saw this scene.
From proficiency to expert+11, the 13 additional points added to the Battle God Body undoubtedly brought a qualitative leap to Eleven!
At the same time, when multiple top-notch quasi-divine skills were maxed out, the energy increase brought by them also turned into an increase in physique due to the nature of the Battle God Body.
This was already an extremely heaven-defying physique.
Even a cosmic behemoth was only so-so.
However, many people were only slightly shocked. They didn't feel that the scales of victory would tilt because of this.
Because Zavay didn't even use one-tenth of his strength. Countless people only felt that the first conflict contestant Zavay encountered might not be as weak as they imagined.
"You, not bad." At this moment, Zavay spread its wings, and its red crow eyes flickered, as if it valued Eleven a little.
"Can you be more serious? I don't want you to lose for no reason." After Eleven punched out, it recovered its image as a good baby and looked at Zavay seriously.
Boom!
As Eleven finished speaking, in an instant, it triggered a vibration even stronger than its punch in the various realms. Countless onlookers widened their eyes and wondered if they had heard wrongly.
What was this guy saying?
Was it crazy?
It said… it didn't want Zavay to lose for no reason?
Not to mention an unknown figure saying this, even that guy that had won 101 consecutive championships didn't dare say such big words in front of Zavay.
"This guy is too arrogant," Ming Gu said with gritted teeth.
Didn't it hear of Zavay?
Underestimating Zavay was underestimating him, Ming Gu!
"Is that so?" But at this moment, in the face of Eleven's words, Zavay didn't react. It was still calm. Its body slowly floated up, and its arm was raised high above its head. In its palm, a five-colored light ball of gold, green, blue, red, and brown began to condense, compress, and spin… It was like a five-colored star.
Every light flowed with nomological ripples. It was unbelievable.
Every time they saw this scene, many spectators still felt that it was ridiculous.
"Zavay has mastered the prototype of the five major laws of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, and can freely fuse them. Not to mention the quasi-divine skill stage, even at the divine skill stage, there are very few who can fuse the five stats laws. Is the talent of the Cosmic Crow Race really so powerful?"
"In the past, when this move was used, it was a sure-kill. The frightening destructive power of the fusion of the five elements will even immediately defeat primary-level gods!"
"And the most frightening thing is that Zavay's skills will never be wasted."
"In the face of Zavay, who controls the power of time, any opponent is a doll that can be controlled by it. Eleven hasn't realized how frightening its opponent is at all."

chapters.title: Chapter 1455 The First Battle (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1455 The First Battle (5)
"Eleven is in danger… However, if its physical strength is really that strong, perhaps there's still a chance of survival. It won't die. It can only blame itself for saying such big words just now."
In the Floating Realm, the gem cat also revealed a serious expression. The other party's talent for controlling multi-element energy was simply unique. Although she could control nine-element energy balls, she only controlled combinations separately. And this guy actually fused five nomological energies together…
As countless people muttered in their hearts, Zavay's arm landed, and the five-element light balls also landed. Under the powerful energy pressure, the entire venue instantly collapsed.
Boom!
Just as Eleven stepped on the arena and was about to leap up, a gray domain directly enveloped the entire place. In everyone's vision, time seemed to have stopped. Apart from Zavay and the five-element light balls still moving, Eleven's figure seemed to have been fixed there.
Time Stop Domain!
Under everyone's focused gaze, the five-element light ball instantly fell. The light that pierced through space enlarged infinitely in everyone's vision, almost destroying everything and blasting out a bottomless abyss thousands of meters in diameter!!
Boom!!!
In the abyss, light pollution continued to spread, forming a five-colored energy storm that spread in all directions in a shocking manner.
In the sky, Zavay looked at the destroyed arena with a calm expression.
But soon, its expression froze. For the first time, its expression changed. Zavay wasn't the only one. The expressions of these spectators, who had yet to recover from their shock, also changed.
"Ying…" This was because, in the huge abyss hole, a small figure slowly flew up. Although the injuries on its body looked extremely miserable, there was no ripple in its eyes. Soon, it flew to the same height as Zavay.
At this moment, countless spectators opened their mouths wide. This was because in the dozens of God Sealing Battles, there were very few contestants who could resist Zavay's attack head-on and still move normally.
Even the intermediate god of the champion challenge would be injured if it took this attack head-on.
Eleven actually took it!!
"It took it, it took it!" The battle elf was also very surprised.
What was wrong with this guy?
"What's wrong with this guy!!" With Ming Gu as the lead, many spectators voiced their shock and found it unbelievable.
"Wuu! (Again!)" Eleven looked at Zavay with high battle intent. When its Battle God Body was injured, it would transform into physique and life force. The more heavily injured it was, the stronger its battle power.
At the moment, it wasn't the peak state Eleven was looking forward to.
"You should have fallen directly."
Zavay's expression was unfriendly, feeling that it had been underestimated.
It spread its wings, and a white domain enveloped its entire body, accelerating the release of its skills. In an instant, a five-element energy ball emerged behind it, two, three, four, five… There were a total of five such energy balls.
With a flap of its wings, the attack instantly arrived. Eleven flew in the sky like that, ignoring whether the other party had triggered any Time Stop Domain.
Right on the heels of that, an attack that shocked many people struck on Eleven. After a world-destroying boom, countless people's hearts thumped as they opened their eyes in disbelief. They looked at the figure that was still flying in midair like a battle god and couldn't imagine it.
Eleven… hadn't fallen yet!
"Wuu!!!" Eleven roared happily. Its shocking battle intent materialized into lightning, making Zavay, who was opposite it, reveal a shocked expression.
"What's wrong with this guy's physique?" Zavay had once fought a real cosmic behemoth. It felt that Eleven's physique was already comparable to a cosmic behemoth!!
"Yi… (Next, it's my turn to counterattack.)" Eleven felt that its physique had been strengthened to the point where it could erupt with full power with One Thought of God and Demon and clenched its fists.
Bang!!
Accompanied by a thunderclap, a white lightning flashed in Eleven's black eyes, turning into a white Thunder Armor wrapped around its entire body!
One Thought of God and Demon, Thunder God Armor!
Using the power of the lightning law to stimulate his body even stronger, it descended into a state that was almost self-mutilating. Even its reaction consciousness began to circulate at a high frequency!!
"Roar!!!" Under Eleven's roar, the audience, who was already shocked, was stunned again. They saw that the current Eleven's aura agitated the sky and earth, erupting to the point where even gods had to retreat when they saw it. With a boom, the sky seemed to have sensed Eleven's power. White lightning arcs began to appear in the entire world and dispersed in nature.
Originally…
Eleven's physique had already reached an extremely unbelievable level.
And now, the cover of the Thunder God Armor made its physical strength enter an even more brutal, explosive state.
"Time… Reversal!"
After its opponent entered an explosive state, Zavay's expression changed slightly. It sensed a threat that wasn't inferior to Ming Gu.
It let out a low cry, and the power of time in its body dispersed again. Apart from using Time Reversal, all the consumption produced just now… was completely recovered!
The state of its body almost went back to when it had just entered the battlefield and started the battle.
After all, the consumption of using Time Reversal was far smaller than the combo just now.
Seeing this scene, the audience once again felt that the time element was ridiculously powerful. They felt that it was impossible for Zavay to lose.

chapters.title: Chapter 1456 The First Battle (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1456 The First Battle (6)
Time Reversal could allow Zavay to return to his peak state at any time.
Time Mark had the chance to revive Zavay twice and return him to his peak state.
It was impossible for Zavay to be defeated by someone of the same level!
However…
"Is it that simple?" In the Dong Xuan Realm, the Ice Kirin muttered. It felt like Eleven was extremely ridiculous. It had seen Eleven erupt with all its might, but the feeling Eleven gave it just now was that it wasn't inferior to the full-strength state when fighting it just now.
How long had it been? It had actually progressed so much?
If the current Eleven erupted with all its might, how powerful would it be?
The Ice Kirin couldn't imagine it.
There was no need to imagine it, because immediately, under everyone's gaze, Eleven's eruption continued without stopping!
The eruption that made Zavay come back to its peak state as if it was facing a great enemy was only Eleven's initial eruption!
The eruption wasn't over!
With another bang, black lightning erupted from Eleven's body.
In the sky, Eleven clenched its fists. With two loud bangs, white lightning wrapped around its body, and black lightning flowed. Under the interweaving impact of the power of lightning, a powerful and mysterious power that wasn't inferior to the power of a god appeared like a miracle!!
"Roar!!!!!"
Eleven roared again. The shocking roar made everyone widen their eyes and reveal astonished expressions.
One Thought of God and Demon, Demon God Body!
It was a move that increased the strength of the body to the limit through the power of Dark Thunder.
The Thunder God Armor combined with the power of Light Thunder was a complete version of the Demon God's Thought!
Unlike the initial Demon God's Thought, Eleven still mastered the Light Control and Dark Control quasi-divine skills in a perfect state, making the power that its Demon God's Thought could erupt with even more terrifying.
In an instant, the black and white electric arcs that filled the sky seemed to have become Eleven's hair. They kept floating, making Eleven look like a thunder god walking out of the chaos of the lightning sea. At this moment, a god-like power completely surged from its body, shaking the sky and earth, reversing the universe, and sweeping across. It even made the wings of the Cosmic Crow Zavay, who had just recovered to its peak state, tremble.
"Wuu… (Come on…)" As Eleven called out, its body showed signs of attacking, making Zavay quickly activate the Time Stop Domain and the Time Deceleration Domain… The two time domains spread and enveloped Eleven!!
However, in the gray domain, Eleven, who was opposite him, seemed to be unaffected. Black and white lightning flashed on its body, and it still maintained a high speed as it instantly arrived in front of Zavay.
Bang, bang, bang, bang!!
During this process, the time domain trembled. The time that was exceeded seemed to wail and enter the Demon God's Thought. However, under the stimulation of the power of light, darkness, and lightning, it could break through the restrictions of the brain and obtain extremely strong attacks, defense, speed, immunity to injuries, and the power of thought and reaction that exceeded time. In other words, the current Eleven was almost not restricted by Zavay's time domain. In the domain, all living beings were equal.
"Roar!!!" Eleven's arrival made Zavay incredulous. A five-colored muslin quickly spread from its body. That was another combination of profundity in Zavay. If the five-element light ball just now focused on attacking, the current five-element battle suit was focused on defense.
However, this combination skill, which could be said to be the strongest defense, like the strongest attack, instantly fractured like glass when it smashed the light, darkness, and lightning fist heavily into Zavay's abdomen under the impact of the eleven consecutive punches. Zavay let out a puff and widened its eyes. It sensed that this attack was even more frightening than its strongest attack power. It was very unbelievable.
Was the opponent… really only a quasi divine?
Before its thoughts fell, its body seemed to have fallen apart. It flew backward infinitely and was sent flying, turning into a beam of light!!
The booming sound of air being torn apart showed how frightening the force Zavay had encountered so far was.
All the spectators instantly saw it from the perspective of the battle sprite. Its abdomen was almost penetrated, and countless drops of blood flowed down its body and spewed out of its mouth.
In an instant, even the battle sprite fell silent. The huge difference between the two parties reversed, making the information it stored a little unable to react.
If it was like this, the various spectators undoubtedly revealed shocked expressions.
"Zavay, what are you doing!!!" Seeing this scene, Ming Gu, who regarded Zavay as its strongest opponent, revealed an expression as if it had seen a ghost. Where did Eleven come from? It could actually make Zavay…
"What a joke. That Zavay… was suppressed?"
"What's the hurry… Zavay won't lose. Don't forget, it can reverse time at any time, and it has two chances of revival!"
Online and offline, the audience members who were paying attention to this battle fell into a discussion. The number of people in the live-stream was still rising crazily.
It was nothing. Zavay had yet to lose…
However, if Zavay handed over the Time Mark even once in the first battle, it would be a loss for it.
This was because even if it used the Time Mark twice, it might not necessarily be able to defeat the intermediate god challenged by the champion. If it lost once or two times in the God Sealing Battle, the challenge this year would undoubtedly end in failure again.
At this moment, countless people were paying attention to the battle, wanting to see how the subsequent development would go.
"Reversal…" Zavay, who was sent flying, used Time Reversal with difficulty. As the power of time was consumed, its body returned to its nearly peak state. At the same time, its expression was even more ferocious, no longer as calm as before.

chapters.title: Chapter 1457 The First Battle (7)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1457 The First Battle (7)
At this moment, it felt a huge pressure, just like facing that intermediate god. This gave it the illusion that it couldn't defeat its opponent without using the Time Mark.
However… for the sake of the champion challenge, it definitely couldn't use it.
The other party's eruption couldn't last long. It only wanted…
Boom!!!
Zavay, who had just returned to a relatively intact state, didn't even see Eleven's figure. It didn't even have time to activate its time domain before it felt a palm that descended from the sky and pinched its head.
"Roar…" Eleven descended at lightning speed and was sent flying above Zavay. The Thunder Palm pinched its head, and its body turned into a bolt of lightning that fell to the other intact ground!!
Thunderlight flashed, drawing a beautiful straight line in midair.
With a bang, the power of bolt corroded its body and caused a massive impact. When another huge pit appeared on the ground, Zavay, who had its head smashed, felt like it was about to faint. Apart from vomiting blood, it felt that its consciousness couldn't even control Time Reversal.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Eleven grabbed the other party's head with one hand and threw a heavy punch with the other. Without giving the other party a chance to reverse time, it attacked crazily and punched crazily. The attack seemed to have exceeded time. Looking at Zavay, who was crushed and vomiting blood, the audience was afraid.
The audience who originally thought that Zavay could rely on Time Reversal to fight Eleven was stunned.
"This…"
This… What kind of monster was this!!!
Where did this monster come from!
It actually… actually ravaged Zavay to this extent! Zavay didn't even have a chance to use Time Reversal!
"Test completed…"
"Contestant Eleven's state is an overload state. It's estimated to last less than a minute…"
At this moment, seeing Zavay's miserable appearance, the spectators of the various realms swallowed their saliva crazily. Only when they heard the analysis conclusion of the battle sprite did they return to their senses.
Yes, how could such a powerful state be maintained for a long time?
The audience who had the ridiculous thought that Zavay would lose suddenly shook their heads. Zavay wouldn't lose…
Although it might waste a Time Mark, Zavay would still win!!
However, Eleven's existence seemed to be born to break this naive thought.
Eleven sighed and threw Zavay's body… into the sky!
In the next moment.
Boom!
An unprecedented massive millstone appeared in midair under Eleven's feet.
A circular metal millstone formed, showing black and white clueless colors, one yin and one yang, one light and one dark. It was filled with two-colored bolt that fused, converted, and collided. It was extremely mysterious. Everything around it seemed to have turned into chaos, disintegrating and being obliterated.
After condensing a millstone, Eleven stood on the millstone and watched as Zavay, who had been thrown into the sky, slowly fell.
Rip.
When Zavay descended into the sky above the millstone, its body was fixed in midair by the Yin Yang lightning. A strong destructive power swept up!!
"Ah!!!!!" Accompanied by Zavay's shocking roar, everyone looked at the two marks that contained strong traces of time spreading out from Zavay's body in disbelief.
Time Mark!
The key to Zavay's revival.
However, at this moment, Time Mark was actually pulled out of its body. As the Yin Yang Millstone under Eleven's feet spun crazily, it was crazily disintegrated and obliterated by an unbelievable mysterious power!!
In the blink of an eye, the two Time Marks were corroded by the black and white power and collapsed into nothingness.
On the millstone, the power of time in Zavay's body also disintegrated crazily and disappeared. The floating Zavay seemed to have gone from a high and mighty invincible king to a prisoner whose life was controlled by others in an extremely short period of time.
"Roar!!"
Eleven emitted a monstrous deterrence and announced its victory!!!
Universe, do you see it!
This was the Iron-eating Beast!
When the deterrence trembled, all the spectators were also shocked, their gazes exploding.
"The Time Mark too…"
"Impossible!!!" The second place, Ming Gu, couldn't accept this scene and was extremely shocked.
"Holy shit, holy shit, holy shit." Lin Feng, who was also watching the battle, was extremely excited. Seeing Eleven really win, he also experienced that it was ridiculous. Although Shi Yu was full of confidence, it was another feeling to really see the outcome.
"This…" In the Floating Realm, the Space Emperor also descended into incomparable thought. Wait a minute, what was going on?
Shi Yu used only one pet, a pet without the support of a Beast Tamer, to overcome the previous champion, the Cosmic Crow Zavay, who was ranked in the top 30 of the myriad races in the starry sky?
Although he had very high expectations for Shi Yu, Shi Yu's initial answer scroll was too ridiculous.
Fanba, Green Dragon Gorka, Director Sen, Zi Lan, Phoenix Man, and the others didn't think highly of Eleven at the start and experienced that Eleven was really unlucky. At this moment, they even lost their ability to think.
"What's wrong with this world?"
"Hehe!!" The gem cat wasn't surprised to see the results of the competition. What was wrong with the universe? It was actually not surprised that Shi Yu had created such a miracle in the universe. She looked at the silent Dragon God and patted this senior.
"Calm down, Senior Dragon God, all the best. You've already been exceeded by Shi Yu too much."
"This Cultivation Fruit is for you…"
In the battle venue of the second world.
"Yi…" Eleven looked at the battle elf and asked if it had won.

chapters.title: Chapter 1458 The First Battle (8)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1458 The First Battle (8)
The time mark had already been obliterated. He couldn't really kill this guy, right?
It looked at Zavay, who had completely lost the ability to resist and had fallen into the huge pit.
One way or another, this friend was still worth making.
The battle elf was also a little stunned at this moment. It couldn't believe that the previous champion, Zavay, who had won 79 championships in a row, was eliminated in the first battle… Its ranking was now in the millionth!!
It suddenly looked at Eleven, the harmless Panda Eleven, on behalf of all the spectators.
Who exactly was this guy? Who exactly was he?
At this moment, all the spectators' curiosity about Eleven reached the extreme. This guy was too terrifying.
[Ground 2022, winner: Eleven!]
Before everyone could react, a light figure popped up in front of their vision. Then, right on the heels of that, the live broadcast ended.
At this moment, countless people suddenly pulled off the spectator device and revealed shocked gazes. The championship of Zavay for 79 consecutive years was broken??
Moreover, it was broken in the first round??
Be it first-level realms, second-level realms, or third-level realms, as long as they could pay attention to the God Sealing Battle, they were all shocked. Those who didn't pay much attention to the God Sealing Battle were also instantly informed of this news.
Even if Zavay obtained first place again, it wouldn't cause such a huge commotion. However, Zavay was defeated by a nobody. This was simply… unbelievable!
It was completely worthy of today's headlines on World King Planet.
…
In the Heavenly Demon Domain, the Fallen Angel Prince, who was also from Blue Planet like Shi Yu, had actually been paying attention to the God Sealing Battle. It didn't participate, but it noticed the traces of Shi Yu's participation.
Initially, it was gloating when it saw Eleven facing Zavay. Now that it saw Zavay being crushed by Eleven the whole time, for a moment, it couldn't accept this ridiculous situation at all. It couldn't believe that this was a guy who had come to World King Planet from Blue Planet like it.
No matter how terrifying this guy's talent was, it actually beat up the current number one quasi-divine in the universe without the strengthening of a Beast Tamer?? What a joke!!
It was fine if it was the Blue Planet World Tournament, but why was it also so impressive in the cosmic God Sealing Battle…
The Fallen Angel Prince, who originally thought that it had improved greatly, revealed a crazy expression. It had never returned to Blue Planet and didn't know that Blue Planet had been wreaked by the worms and then resolved by Shi Yu. Otherwise, it would be even crazier now…
In the time realm, at the headquarters of the Cosmic Crow Race.
The Cosmic Crow Race was a race with very few people. Zavay was the greatest hope of this generation.
On the Cosmic Crow Race's side, no one from the real Cosmic Crow Race paid attention to Zavay's performance in the God Sealing Battle at all. They felt that there was no need to pay attention. With Zavay's strength, it wouldn't lose at all.
"Master, Master…" The clansmen didn't pay attention, but there was still a servant in charge of recording the battle situation who paid attention. At this moment, this servant ran over to the master in shock, which was the location of the father of Zavay.
"What happened? You're so panicked."
Zavay's father frowned when he saw the servant in such a sorry state.
"Master, bad news. Young Master Zavay… was defeated in the first round of the God Sealing Battle!"
"The one who defeated it was a newbie who had just participated in the battle. Its ranking of all races isn't even in the top 100!"
The head of the Cosmic Crow Race was stunned before revealing an disbelieving expression.
"Bullshit!!"
…
Shocking news of the God Sealing Battle!!
Zavay, the winner of the 79th consecutive championship, was knocked out in the first battle!!
In the central realm, after Eleven came out of the teleportation point covered in injuries, it saw a strange scene.
In this battle hall, the staff and contestants who were preparing for battle widened their lantern-sized eyes and gazed at it in shock.
"Congratulations." Of course, there were also people who congratulated it relatively calmly. Who else could it be but Shi Yu? Shi Yu smiled in relief. Well done.
"It was so slow. As expected, it still used a millstone. I thought it would revive twice and you would kill it twice," Buggy said.
"So convenient… If it were me, I would probably only be able to defeat it by killing it twice." Chi Tong gazed at the fire-patterned black sword in front of it and said emotionlessly, its body filled with death aura.
Baby Ginseng felt hostility and felt a chill.
"That's too violent. Just let its power of time and Time Mark disappear peacefully," Susu said. As a clean freak, it couldn't bear to see such a bloody battle.
The people in this arena were originally just short of kneeling to watch the live broadcast and Eleven. At this moment, when they heard the conversation coming from all directions, they were directly stunned and felt that their brains weren't enough.
Wait a minute, what was going on? Were they stunned by the fight just now?
Why did it feel like they couldn't comprehend what was going on in this world? What were these guys talking about just now??
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1459 Reaction of All Parties (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1459 Reaction of All Parties (1)
After fighting Zavay, Shi Yu and Eleven went home.
Eleven was heavily injured and had consumed a lot of energy. It definitely had to go back with Shi Yu to nourish itself.
As for the other pets, they continued to wait for the competition.
In any case, the opponent wasn't strong, so there was no need for additional attention.
They were no longer children and could take care of themselves.
Of course, Shi Yu and Eleven returned, but the commotion after Eleven's battle didn't stop.
"Who exactly is Eleven, who defeated Zavay?"
"Which realm is it from?"
"What race is it?"
"Why haven't I heard of it before?"
Around this topic, regardless of level, the various realms joined in the discussion.
Zavay of the Cosmic Crow Race, the strongest quasi-divine in a hundred years.
If the timeline was stretched, there would definitely be a quasi-divine stronger than it. After all, the race ranking of the Cosmic Crow Race was only 30th among the myriad races in the starry sky.
The quasi-divines born in the top 30 and even the top 10 were definitely even more monstrous.
But the problem was that the top races of the cosmic races were all familiar races. There were no such black and white bears.
"I… I know it!"
Even if Eleven was unknown previously, with such popularity, there would always be people who had seen it and knew it.
The first person to stand out was called Fang Qin. She came from the Blue Wave World and was an ordinary staff member of the Myriad Race Ranking Battle facility. She was in charge of the registration of the Myriad Race Ranking Battle.
Fang Qin said, "It… Its race is the Iron-eating Beast, a new registered race. It should be five years old this year. It came from the Floating Realm and participated in the ranking battle of all races. I even helped it register its initial information."
Soon, her words were pushed to the trending list.
It wasn't because this was Eleven's real information, but because this information was too ridiculous. It was splashed on the trending list of the God Sealing Battle forum.
"Bullshit!!!" The second place, Ming Gu of the God Sealing Battle, cursed when he saw this rumor.
All kinds of bullshit really emerged just to get attention. Five years old? Why didn't they say Eleven came from heaven?
Fang Qin quickly deleted this "rumor". She felt a sense of regret for being rash. This had already violated the rules and regulations.
However, as an employee of the Myriad Races Committee, many nosy people still verified the information she released from the Myriad Races Committee.
The president of the Blue Wave Myriad Race Committee found Fang Qin and criticized her fiercely.
At the headquarters of the Myriad Races Committee, the minister of the resource management department of the new star race, Di Yin of the Star Race, a cosmic life form with a human body and the head of a planet was working calmly.
At this moment, an assistant rushed in and said, "Minister Di Yin, our phone has exploded…"
"There's news on the Internet that the first place in the God Sealing Battle, the Cosmic Crow Zavay, was defeated by a five-year-old Iron-eating Beast Race. Moreover, this Iron-eating Beast Race was registered with the Myriad Race Committee."
"Now, many people are calling the customer service to ask if this race and age are real…"
Minister Di Yin frowned and said, "Why are all the ridiculous rumors looking for us… You have to report this to me?"
The assistant said, "Minister, this might not be a rumor… Zavay was really defeated in the first round. You'll know when you see the news. Moreover, I just investigated. The one who defeated it was really the five-year-old Iron-eating Beast Race. We have a record of it!"
"Have you forgotten? A few months ago, a four-year-old contestant completed a battle above his level. You even named it to participate in the New Star Race Support Plan, but later on, it didn't continue to participate, so we didn't pay much attention."
"It's it, it's it, it's it. It's the one who defeated Zavay, so… shouldn't we reply to these calls?"
Minister Di Yin: "?"
"Huh??" Minister Di Yin suddenly got up and was stunned. What did he say?
He still didn't believe it and turned to control the computer to verify it. Then… he was stunned.
Minister Di Yin opened his mouth wide and said, "What are you dawdling for! Hurry up and go!!! A race that participated in the New Star Support Plan defeated the Cosmic Crow Race. Isn't this a free performance!! Although… we haven't supported the other party in anything, don't care about these details."
"Resources later! Promote it fiercely first!!"
Soon, some information about Eleven, who had defeated Zavay, spread.
[Myriad Race Committee Official]: Not long ago, regarding contestant Eleven defeating contestant Zavay in the God Sealing Battle, a widely regarded rumor appeared on the Internet. It was said that contestant Eleven had registered for the Myriad Race Ranking Battle and was only five years old. His race is the Iron-eating Beast Race. Here, our Myriad Race Committee solemnly refutes the rumor. This isn't a rumor. The Iron-eating Beast Race that contestant Eleven belongs to is a member of the New Star Support Plan of the Myriad Race Committee. It's a target we're concentrated on nurturing… The announcement is true.
"Pfft…"
At the headquarters of the Cosmic Crow Race.
After Zavay's father confirmed that Zavay was fine, it had been asking about who this Eleven was until the officials of the Myriad Races Committee came out to speak.
Apart from a group of nonsense, people could roughly summarize some useful information from it… Name, Eleven, age, five years old, race, Iron-eating Beast…
"Five years old! This guy is f*cking five years old?!!!" Zavay's father had already seen the battle video and seen its son being beaten up and its 79 consecutive championships ended. Now, the Myriad Races Committee was telling it that Eleven, who had tormented its son who was more than 100 years old, was only five years old??
Haha!
What a joke!
"I don't believe it, I don't believe it…" The second place, Ming Gu of the God Sealing Battle, was directly shocked when he saw the announcement of refutation again. Like him, there was also a cluster of competitors of the God Sealing Battle who were stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1460 Reaction of All Parties (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1460 Reaction of All Parties (2)
Five years old? Five years old? What a joke!
As soon as this information spread, many people's first thought was that they didn't believe it.
However, even if someone wanted to question this extremely unscientific information, they had to see where the information came from.
This was no longer a personal statement, but the official media of the Starry Sky Myriad Races Committee.
It wasn't that there was no chance of rumors spreading on such an official account, but it was minimal. After this information was hung up for a long time and hadn't been taken down, everyone was numb.
The reaction here was the strongest in the Floating Realm, because the "rumors" also said that Eleven came from the Floating Realm. Was that for real??
What right did a monster like them, a mere second-level domain, have to defeat the Cosmic Crow Zavay?
Of course, ordinary realm citizens didn't know, but the Space Emperor could confirm that Eleven was indeed from his Floating Realm.
In the face of a group of familiar friends sending a message to confirm, the Space Emperor replied calmly.
Dong Xuan Region and Heavenly Demon Region.
As the headquarters of the Blue Planet Divine Race, the five super divine ancestors usually cultivated in seclusion in the super divine mystic realm.
Very few people could contact them and find out where they were.
Only on important matters was the clan qualified to disturb them. For example, the most recent awakening of the Kirin Race's ancestor was the return of the Wind Kirin inheritance.
And today, the super divine ancestors of the five divine races received greetings from the top divine patriarchs of the various races at the same time.
"Ancestor!"
"The genius Shi Yu brought his contracted pets from his mother planet to the Floating Realm. His contracted pet defeated the 79th consecutive champion of the God Sealing Battle, the Cosmic Crow Zavay. With the strength they displayed, they have a chance of completing the champion challenge."
"If the Floating Realm obtains a permanent teleportation array, our race will be very passive in terms of the ownership of Blue Planet's resources," the various divine patriarchs said in shock. They didn't expect the genius brought back by the Floating Realm to be so monstrous.
In the various super divine mystic realms, the super divine ancestors of the five divine races woke up together.
Although they didn't have any impression or concept of Zavay, they knew the value of first place in the God Sealing Battle. The value of the champion challenge was an honor that was difficult for even the top 100 races in the starry sky to fight for.
The genius Wang Kong brought from Blue Planet could actually have such an achievement?
"Where's the genius we brought back from our mother planet?" the super divine ancestor of the Demon Race asked the people behind him.
The current patriarch of the Demon Race said bitterly, "Although his talent is strong, his strength isn't enough to participate in the God Sealing Battle. At the moment, he's only in the millionth place…"
"Trash!! If he can't enter the top 1,000 next year, don't cultivate him!" the Demon Race forefather said. He walked out of the super divine mysterious realm and looked in the direction of the Floating Realm.
The super divine ancestors of the various divine races walked out of the mysterious realm and headed to the Floating Realm together to discuss the permanent translocation formation with the Space Emperor.
The super divine forefather of the Kirin Race was even more silent. That little brat who brought back the Wind Kirin inheritance actually had such terrifying talent potential?
…
"Aha, hahaha."
Before Shi Yu arrived home, Lin Feng welcomed Shi Yu midway. His smile made his face look like a chrysanthemum.
"Haha…"
Shi Yu: "?"
"Senior Lin Feng, say something."
"Hahaha…"
Lin Feng couldn't close his mouth. "You guys actually really won. That was the 79th consecutive champion."
"Doesn't this mean that the first place is stable? A pet defeated Zavay. Zavay can fight that intermediate god. At that time, you can undergo the champion challenge with all the other pets. I feel that it can work."
"It really works… A permanent translocation array." Lin Feng was overjoyed.
If Shi Yu could really complete the champion challenge, it wouldn't be long before he could return to Blue Planet.
On Blue Planet, there was still his second team's pet and his family.
The feeling of homesickness was heavy for Lin Feng.
After Lin Feng disappeared, Blue Planet didn't give up searching for Lin Feng, including his parents and soulmates.
Among them, a portion of them firmly believed that Lin Feng was fine, but they were worried that after finding Lin Feng, a long time would have passed. Hence, they entered the cryochamber under the Divine Source's suggestion and sealed themselves to enter a sleeping state.
This way, even if Lin Feng returned hundreds of years later, they could still maintain their young lives.
Lin Feng felt very apologetic towards these people. Although he had married and had children on World King Planet again… Lin Feng's heart was still on Blue Planet.
In comparison, because the Space Emperor was ancient, his longing for his family wasn't that serious. He had too many children. Just his heirs alone were dozens, and he had a harem of 3,000 beauties. He couldn't think of them at all.
Moreover, the Space Emperor had left too long ago. Even if he returned, there would basically be no familiar traces. After another totem war, things would probably have changed. What he valued more now was Blue Planet's possibility and the value Blue Planet could bring after upgrading to a high-level planet.
These investments were mainly to make his super divine path smoother.
Now, the main goal of the Space Emperor was to achieve a super divine. Of course, as Dong Huang's former emperor, his sense of affiliation to Dong Huang was also very strong.
After all, the Space Emperor, who was born in the totem era, had been instilled since he was young to expel foreign races and restore Dong Huang's thoughts. Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, Empress, and Dragon Emperor were all idols unified by the human Beast Tamers under the ideological education of that era.
His previous idea was to turn Dong Huang into a first-rate faction in the entire universe with Lin Feng and the Divine Source Legendary on Blue Planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1461 Reaction of All Parties (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1461 Reaction of All Parties (3)
Now, with Shi Yu, the founding emperor of Dong Huang, and the addition of Emperor Shi, the Space Emperor felt that his wish might be easier to achieve.
And all of this was established on the premise that Blue Planet could connect to a cosmic civilization.
Now, Shi Yu might be able to help Blue Planet complete this goal very quickly.
"By the way, how are its injuries? That explosive skill looks like it's under a lot of pressure." Lin Feng suddenly thought of something and inquired nervously.
"Eleven… is resting in the Beast Taming Space," Shi Yu said. "It shouldn't be a big problem. We've prepared a lot of restoration items in advance. When Baby Ginseng returns, we'll let Baby Ginseng take a look. If it really doesn't work, there's still Susu's cleansing."
"Sigh, what are you waiting for!" Lin Feng said. "Let my pet take a look at Eleven's injuries first."
"Alright." Shi Yu nodded. Lin Feng had once contracted a Moo Cow of a transcendent race.
The milk squeezed out by the Moo Cow was a top-notch restoration item and supplement. However, Shi Yu didn't like milk very much, so he didn't buy it at that time.
Presumably, this was the healer on Lin Feng's team.
His goal of contracting this pet was probably similar to Shi Yu contracting the ginseng baby.
…
That day, apart from Eleven's opponent being a little troublesome, the battles of the other pets were very smooth.
Buggy maintained an energy-efficient state and instantly killed its opponent with a dragon's might.
Chi Tong and the others were similar. Unsurprisingly, they insta-killed their opponents with deterrence. Because their opponents' rankings were low, they didn't receive much attention in the battle.
Apart from their opponents collapsing a little and not knowing why the newbies this year were so strange, everything was very calm.
When they all went home, they saw Eleven holding a big bottle and drinking moo milk.
As for Shi Yu, he was sitting on the sofa with his laptop.
"They're all back. Has the next opponent refreshed? Eleven's has already refreshed," Shi Yu said.
The opponent Eleven encountered in the first round was relatively terrifying. The opponent it matched in the second round was relatively lousy. It should be able to end the battle with a deterrence.
After Shi Yu finished asking, the pets started chattering.
They looked at Ling in dissatisfaction.
Ling shrugged and showed an innocent expression.
"Ling was the lucky one to advance again. I know," Shi Yu said. "Where are the others?"
Buggy and the others articulated that their next opponents were still very lousy.
Regarding this, Shi Yu nodded and said without any surprise, "I'm looking at the trending topics now. Good lord, it hasn't been long, but most of Eleven's information has already been exposed. This Myriad Race Committee really doesn't have any ethics."
To be honest, Shi Yu felt that it was meaningless after watching the trending topic for a long time.
It was mainly because he was too familiar with Eleven.
On the other hand, Shi Yu watched the second trending topic with interest.
"You guys come and take a look too." Under Shi Yu's call, the pets gathered.
Shi Yu was replaying a video. In the video, there was an alien with dark blue skin that looked like armor. Its posture was no different from that of an ordinary person. It had blood-red eyes, purple-black lips, and two lines that looked like blood tears under the eyes on its face.
"This is the strongest quasi divine a thousand years ago, Kai Te. He won first place in the 19 God Sealing Battle. It's said that he originally wanted to continue participating in the God Sealing Battle until he completed the champion challenge. However, because of a life-and-death crisis, he was forced to break through to the divine level and no longer suppressed his level."
"Then, he quickly grew to the level of a top-notch god and immersed himself in this realm for hundreds of years until now…"
"He issued a challenge to the super divine-level Demon Emperor…"
In the scene, he was flying above a city, and his pressure enveloped the entire city.
In the next moment, a saber light seemed to have descended across countless spaces. Kai Te's body was directly divided into two, and his soul and spirit were instantly killed, turning into a blood mist that scattered throughout the city.
The dazzling saber light was permanently frozen in the sky.
"It's said that the life-and-death crisis this guy encountered in his early years is related to the Demon Emperor faction. His contracted partner even died because of this. This time, it should be for revenge. At the same time, let's see if we can kill this super divine and expose the source of transcendence to take another step forward."
"Unfortunately, it was insta-killed in one move." Shi Yu shook his head. Logically speaking, Kai Te's strength wasn't necessarily inferior to the Space Emperor and Senior Lin Feng, but facing this Demon Emperor, he was still unable to fight back. It was so miserable.
It didn't look like it was that easy to explode the source of transcendence.
However, it was also possible that this Demon Emperor was too strong. It was said that he was a hybrid of a human and a demon. Not only was his bloodline powerful, but he also mastered the contract ability of a human and contracted a divine saber forged with 81 super divine resources. His strength was unbelievable and he could destroy a planet with a slash.
"Ji…" Buggy swallowed its saliva and inquired Shi Yu why he was paying attention to this. Why would this video appear on the trending list of the God Sealing Battle Forum?
"Uh, because the son of this Demon Emperor is also making big news like Eleven. The third son of the Demon Emperor only appeared this year. The first time he participated in the God Sealing Battle, he also encountered an impressive guy in the first round. His opponent was 21st in the last God Sealing Battle, and then… he was insta-killed by the third son of the Demon Emperor."
"Although it's not as brutal as Eleven, due to the special identity of the son of the Demon Emperor, it can also be said to have received a lot of attention." Shi Yu opened the video of the son of the Demon Emperor instantly killing the 21st place in the previous God Sealing Battle.
"There are also people who say that it and Eleven are the two greatest dark horses in this year's God Sealing Battle…"
In the video, it was a noble young master with silver hair, golden eyes, beast ears, and beast tail. It held a demon saber and had an oppressive aura.
It looked like it was also a hybrid like its father and walked the path of the contract blade.
"Eh…" At this moment, when it saw this face, Chi Tong suddenly exclaimed.
She fell into deep thought. Looking at the other party's profile picture, why did it feel so familiar?
Wait a minute…
"Well, well… My next opponent seems to be him. Because he doesn't have any participation record, I thought he was a rookie. So he's very strong??" Chi Tong suddenly said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1462 What's Wrong With the Newcomers This Year (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1462 What's Wrong With the Newcomers This Year (1)
"…"
After Chi Tong finished speaking, Shi Yu and the others looked at Chi Tong.
The long silence made Chi Tong feel embarrassed.
"Well…" Shi Yu pondered for a long time and said," What a coincidence. Forget it, it's not a big problem. "
Chi Tong said, "That means… we can defeat it, right?"
"Don't worry about its Demon Emperor father, right?"
"You can defeat it. Of course, don't kill it. Don't sound so excited," Shi Yu said. "A super divine expert is so bored that he would care about the outcome of a newbie competition for his descendants."
"Isn't Zavay's forefather also a super divine expert? Eleven trounced Zavay up too."
Shi Yu thought that everyone would be able to relax in the next round, but from the looks of it, Chi Tong might be a little tired.
"Alright~" Of course, Chi Tong didn't feel tired. As long as it didn't encounter Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Susu, and Ling in advance and confronted some other strong enemies, Chi Tong was still very happy. It would treat it as a warm-up.
"In addition, although the strength exhibited in its video is very weak, don't be careless."
"It's a hybrid Beast Tamer. What if it contracted something else other than that demon saber?"
"It's the son of a super divine… You have to take it seriously!"
"Alright~" Chi Tong said.
Of course, Shi Yu also knew that the chances of Chi Tong losing weren't high…
After all, just her clone was already at the level of the top few of the God Sealing Battle…
"Alright, alright, disperse. Rest well and wait for the next round," Shi Yu said.
"Oh~" The pets dispersed and ran to use the computer.
They also wanted to see the trending topic!
Especially Chi Tong. Eleven was first on the trending list today. She was thinking about how to win tomorrow and suppress Eleven in popularity.
…
Floating Realm.
Five terrifying existences descended into the Sky Temple one by one.
Their figures were blurry, and their true bodies was unable to be seen, as if they were in a fog that didn't belong to this world.
"Seniors, you've come. It's really surprising."
The Space Emperor walked out of the divine hall and chuckled. "You're here because of the God Sealing Battle, right?"
"Wang Kong," the super divine of the Demon Race said in the mist. "You've picked up a good seedling from Blue Planet."
"I came here to ask you how confident you are in its achieving first place in the God Sealing Battle and obtaining that permanent teleportation array."
"I'm naturally confident, but who can say for sure about this kind of thing?" the Space Emperor said.
The super divine of the Demon Race said, "If one time doesn't work, then two, then three. Then, from the looks of it, it won't be long before our mother planet can connect to the World King Planet. Not bad. At that time, our race will do our best to help our mother planet advance to a high-level planet."
"Wang Kong, you did well in this matter." The angel super divine was a woman. She uttered in a faint voice, "We'll remember your contribution."
"Seniors." The Space Emperor smiled and said, "In exploring our mother planet and helping our mother planet recover its Restoration, our Floating Realm has always been the main force. Now, it's also the permanent teleportation array obtained by the Beast Tamers of my Dong Huang's bloodline."
"I think we should also redistribute the resource planning of Blue Planet in the future?"
The peak Blue Planet was one of the best on intermediate planets. It could be uttered to be a half-step super divine planet, which was why it could nurture so many top-notch gods with unrivaled talent.
It could be uttered that back then, Blue Planet was only a step away from becoming a high-level planet and a super divine planet.
If not for that, it wouldn't have attracted so many invaders to split the resources.
The five god races on Blue Planet had taken a fancy to the potential of their mother planet. The current mother planet, the mother planet at its peak, might not be a big deal, but if their mother planet advanced to a super divine planet, they could even abandon the Dong Xuan Realm and the Heavenly Demon Realm. At that time, Blue Planet would be a better habitat.
The environment of the super divine planet was far greater than a first-level realm. It was the same in all aspects.
Especially when a divine-level planet had just advanced to the super divine level, a large number of pseudo source of transcendence would be born. This was useless to planetary life forms themselves, but it was very useful to other lives. Although it was unable to let a divine-level planet advance to the super divine level, it was a strange object that could save super divine experts countless years of bitter cultivation.
Generally speaking, super divine lives with super divine planets as their territories were very strong, far stronger than super divine world overlords in first-level realms.
"Wang Kong, what do you mean?" the demon super divine said. "Can your Floating Realm alone raise your mother planet to a high-level planet?"
"Moreover, after the mother planet advances to a high-level, it also needs us to protect it."
"Wang Kong is right. They've indeed made a huge contribution this time. They can save at least a hundred years and bring many benefits in the future," the Kirin Race super divine said. "We'll bear all the resources for the advancement of the mother planet. There's no need for the Floating Realm to share them."
"Sure." "Agreed."
The super divines of the Dragon Race and the Phoenix Race expressed that they could accept it. In the past, they only cared about the resources after Blue Planet advanced, but now, if a permanent teleportation array could be established on Blue Planet, it would be a more suitable home for the five god races to live in. At that time, the entire race could strengthen again because of this.
"Thank you for your understanding, seniors," the Space Emperor said. "But I still have a small request. Although we all have the same mother planet and should be harmonious, in the initial plan, our Floating Realm indeed accounted for too little."
"Therefore, I think, why don't we do this? After our mother planet advances to super divine, the six of us will compete."
"The Dragon Race, the Phoenix Race, the Kirin Race, the Angel Race, the Demon Race, and the Human Race are considered the strongest six races on Blue Planet. At that time, we'll use the competition method to divide resources and territories under the witness of the will of our mother planet. I wonder what you think, seniors?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1463 What's Wrong With the Newcomers This Year (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1463 What's Wrong With the Newcomers This Year (2)
"Competition?" The super divine of the Demon Race said, "Wang Kong, tell me, what's the competition?"
Emperor Kong said, "According to the strength of the various races at that time."
"Set a strong and weak order."
"This way, it'll save us the trouble of causing conflict in the future. Of course, as for the resources for Blue Planet's advancement, we still have to rely on you, seniors."
The super divines of the five divine races were stunned. What did Wang Kong mean?
Was he stupid?
There wasn't a single super divine in the Floating Realm. What was the meaning of this unnecessary action?
In essence, the strength of the various races still competed with the top experts!
Or did Wang Kong think that he and Lin Feng could really defeat super divines above their level?
These two guys were just lucky to have worked together to assassinate a weak super divine. Did they really think that they had the ability to resist a super divine?
"This is all I want."
"Sure," the super divine of the Dragon Race said. "It's reasonable. If you're stronger, you can get more resources. That's how it should be."
The super divine of the Dragon Race felt that the strength of the Dragon Race wasn't weaker than the other four divine races. A long, long time ago, it was even the strongest among the five super divines.
The Space Emperor's suggestion was advantageous to the Dragon Race.
"This…" Although the other four super divine races had concerns, considering that the greatest initiative to connect to the mother planet was in the hands of the Space Emperor, they said, "We can discuss in detail."
"Alright," the Space Emperor said in satisfaction.
To be honest, with the current financial resources of the Floating Realm, it couldn't support helping its mother planet become a super divine at all. It could only rely on the five major divine races.
However, letting the five god races occupy Blue Planet again and occupy all the benefits caused the human race to decline. The Space Emperor was unwilling to see it. After all, Shi Yu had also put in a lot of effort in the Floating Realm.
Compared to the distribution rules that were disadvantageous to the Floating Realm at the start, he chose to propose the rule of "distribution with the strength of the various races" again.
On the surface, humans were worlds apart from the five god races. Their top battle power was inferior, and their average battle power was even inferior to the five divine races that had developed for hundreds of millions of years.
However… the Space Emperor had a trump card that the five divine races still didn't know about.
Super divine level, Emperor Shi!
With Shi Yu's description of Emperor Shi, Emperor Shi shouldn't be weak.
At the super divine level, sometimes with the emperor presiding over it, there was no lack of top-notch battle power.
In the divine-level area, with him and Lin Feng, they were confident that they wouldn't lose to any divine-level. With the two of them working together, they might even be able to deal with a super divine for a moment.
There was also Shi Yu, the strongest quasi divine.
When Shi Yu broke through to the divine level, with the Four Holy Ruins, it shouldn't be a problem for him to fight a top-notch god. In that case, not only were the humans on Blue Planet not weak, but they were also terrifyingly strong. They would definitely crush a single god race.
First, he would set the rules. At that time, it would be better to split Blue Planet with strength than to have conflicts later on. The development of the human race was still too short. It needed to develop slowly. When he, Lin Feng, and Shi Yu were born with new super divine powers, Dong Huang would be able to dominate Blue Planet.
…
"Shi Yu!!!"
"I'm meeting Old Sun for dinner again. You and Eleven will go with me later."
"Although the God Sealing Battle hasn't ended, with Eleven's battle results, it shouldn't be a problem for us to win the bet, right?"
"Old Sun can't still be making a final struggle, right? Ha."
On Shi Yu and the others' side, Lin Feng returned a long time after leaving, and he was very happy.
He immediately remembered the bet between him and Senior Sun at the dining table last night.
Between Shi Yu and Sun Qiujing, whose ranking was higher…
If Shi Yu's was higher, Senior Sun would give Lin Feng a super divine resource.
"Senior Lin Feng, is this appropriate…" Shi Yu said, "What's that super divine resource you're talking about?"
Lin Feng said, "What's inappropriate about that? I've even saved his life. Moreover, that super divine resource is useless to him…"
"Have you learned of the super divine stone?"
"Uh…" Shi Yu was stunned. "What's that?"
"To think you're an archeologist. Looks like you didn't do your homework seriously after arriving at the World King Planet," Lin Feng uttered with a smile.
"The super divine stone is from the ruins of the last era! It's from the era."
"You know about stone gambling, right? Although people don't know who created the super divine stone, in essence, opening it isn't much different from stone gambling."
"It's sealed inside with strange things. Most of the super divine level resources from the previous eras, so it's also called the super divine stone."
"In addition, there's another reason why it's called the super divine stone. If you want to unlock it, you need the cooperation of at least four super divine experts to do it."
"This condition… is undoubtedly very harsh, so even if Old Sun was lucky enough to obtain this thing on the battlefield, he hasn't been able to open it until now."
"However, it's different in my hands. After you acquire first place in the God Sealing Battle, the super divine ancestors of the five divine races will definitely come out of seclusion. At that time, I'll just ask them to help open it. I'm just more curious about what can be obtained inside. I'm not really lacking a super divine resource," Lin Feng said with a chuckle.
"Senior Sun is also giving such a valuable thing??" Shi Yu said.
Lin Feng said, "It's a bet. Moreover, he can't use the super divine stone anyway, and he can't tolerate to trade it. It's better to bet. It's all a bet."
"If there's really something good, at most, I'll help his daughter infer the evolution for free. If nothing beneficial comes out, then…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1464 What's Wrong With the Newcomers This Year (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1464 What's Wrong With the Newcomers This Year (3)
"Not everything good can be obtained here. There's really nothing too precious here."
"90% of it is just ordinary, super divine resources from the last era. The advantage is that it's rare. However, I've also heard that someone opened a creature from the last era!! A sealed era creature."
"It seems to have been opened by the archeological association after spending a lot of strive to invite a few super divines."
"Of course, they're all corpses. They no longer have a life force. After an era, it's impossible for them to live anymore, but they're also quite worth researching."
"No matter what it is, aren't you curious as an archeologist?" Lin Feng said.
After a instant of silence, Shi Yu said, "Alright, Senior Lin Feng, you've aroused my curiosity. If I like the thing in the super divine stone, I'll take it away first."
Lin Feng chuckled and said, "Sure, but you have to give me more of the power of belief of the White Tiger in the Four Saint Ruins…"
"No problem. This was agreed upon previously," Shi Yu said.
…
"Yo, Old Sun." That day, Lin Feng pulled Shi Yu along to find Senior Sun to drink and eat. There was no delay at all.
"You're here." Senior Sun quite welcomed Lin Feng and Shi Yu. After all, only he and his daughter had come to the central world this time. It was a little cold.
It wasn't boring to have an old comrade come to catch up and drink.
At this moment, the girl, Sun Qiujing, was seriously farming the God Sealing Battle forum to watch the trending topics.
"Senior Lin." However, when Lin Feng arrived, she still got up and greeted him.
"Did Little Qiu's God Sealing Battle go smoothly today? How was the battle? Was the opponent strong?" Lin Feng asked.
Senior Sun chuckled and said, "She was relatively unlucky and encountered a contestant ranked more than 7,000 in the previous batch. However, she was lucky enough to win."
With that said, he chuckled at Lin Feng, as if he was asking Lin Feng if he was panicked.
Lin Feng said, "That's not bad."
Senior Sun said, "Where's Shi Yu?"
Sun Qiujing said, "I've searched before, but I didn't find any information about him…"
"So, you signed up with your contracted partner as the main body?" She looked at Shi Yu and spoke more than usual.
For combinations with contracts, they usually only choose one to register as the main body. Generally speaking, whoever was mightier would use their name. Human Beast Tamers were stronger and dominated, so they would register with the identification of a human Beast Tamer. If a certain human contracted a big race in the starry sky and the contracted creature was stronger, they would register with the name of the contracted beast and be an accessory.
Sun Qiujing couldn't find Shi Yu's name. She subconsciously judged that Shi Yu was just an accessory.
"Huh?" Senior Sun said. "Is that so?"
He, the Space Emperor, and Lin Feng were all humans. He remembered that these two old comrades were both humanists. The juniors they thought highly of shouldn't be living off his pets, right?
"I indeed let my pet register by itself… It's mainly because I'm relatively lazy. If the opponent isn't strong, I'll let my pet participate by itself while I wait for the results at home." Shi Yu smiled and scratched his head.
"Is that so?" Senior Sun said, "Good kid, looks like you acknowledge the strength of your pet. Then what was the outcome of its first battle?"
"Hehe, Old Sun, why don't you admit defeat directly in the bet? Didn't you see the news?"
"What news??" Senior Sun was stunned.
Seeing that the other party really didn't know, Lin Feng said to Sun Qiujing, who was holding a laptop, "Little Qiu, tell your father what the greatest hot topic of the God Sealing Battle today is."
"The previous champion, Zavay, was eliminated in the first round?" Sun Qiujing was stunned, not understanding what he meant.
"I just heard this from Little Qiu," Senior Sun said.
"Have you seen it yet? Look at the news. See which realm the guy who eliminated the first place, Zavay, came from," Lin Feng said.
"Floating Realm…" Sun Qiujing still didn't react after watching.
On the other hand, Senior Sun, who was beside him, suddenly widened his eyes and looked at Sun Qiujing. "What did you say??"
"Which realm did the guy who defeated Zavay come from??"
"The Floating Realm…" Sun Qiujing said, "That's what the Internet says, but it's not proven…"
She didn't know that Uncle Lin in front of her was the deputy lord of the Floating Realm. It was a second-level realm and wasn't that famous. She only knew that Lin Feng was her father's comrade…
However, Senior Sun himself knew that the Floating Realm was the territory of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng. He couldn't help but be stunned and suddenly look at Shi Yu.
"Wu wu wu…" At this moment, Eleven, who was clearly very tired but was still pulled by Shi Yu to eat forcefully, also crawled out of Shi Yu's pocket. Then, it slowly enlarged and climbed onto Shi Yu's shoulder.
Its big eyes looked at Senior Sun and the girl.
The two of them: …
After seeing Iron-eating Beast Eleven appear beside Shi Yu, Senior Sun, and the girl's expressions gradually changed. "This, this, this…"
"Let me introduce you. My initial pet, Eleven," Shi Yu said. "The results of its first battle… are pretty smooth…"
When Shi Yu finished speaking, Senior Sun and Sun Qiujing were stunned.
What the hell?!
The beast that defeated the previous champion in the first round… was Shi Yu's pet??
Shi Yu's words echoed in their ears.
[I did let my pet register itself… It's mainly because I'm relatively lazy. If the opponent isn't strong, I'll let my pet participate alone while I wait for the results at home.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1465 What's Wrong With the Newcomers This Year (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1465 What's Wrong With the Newcomers This Year (4)
What a joke.
So, the opponent they thought wasn't strong was the Cosmic Crow Zavay?!
"I don't believe it," Senior Sun said after losing his ability to think. Beside him, Sun Qiujing's expression darkened. This was the first time she had come out to see the world and participated in a bet. She only felt that something was wrong.
Lin Feng snorted and said, "There's no point in a final struggle. Come, come, come, let me introduce you again. The geniuses from our mother planet, Shi Yu and Eleven…"
"A mere Zavay is easy to control!"
"Did you bring the super divine stone?"
…
Shi Yu spent the night in a daze. Soon, it was the next day. The second round of the God Sealing Tournament was about to begin.
The focus of today's competition was on the two most hot topics. They were Iron-eating Beast Eleven and the third son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang.
Among them, Iron-eating Beast Eleven's competition was the first to be carried out. After Eleven, who was covered in armor, arrived at the teleportation point and logged onto the battlefield, it realized that its opponent was a coward and had already given up.
Victory without a fight.
This made the audience watching Eleven's live-stream extremely regretful.
Because of the heat the day before, after Eleven appeared today, it was immediately followed by the various paparazzi. Fortunately, Eleven was prepared. When it came, it had armor disguise, and when it left, it had the Teleportation Stone. If it wasn't a super divine, it couldn't be caught.
Eleven didn't pay attention to any interesting battles. The other dark horse, the third son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, naturally received attention.
To a certain extent, Tian Shang's identity was even more noble than Zavay's.
Zavay only had a super divine ancestor, but Tian Shang was directly the biological son of a super divine expert!!
The third son of the Demon Emperor.
However, because the third son of the Demon Emperor was too young, less than 30 years old, according to Zavay's decades of training, it was hard to say which was stronger, him or Zavay.
Moreover, the Demon Emperor didn't come from a big race. He was just a human hybrid. His son had natural talent and potential, but not as superior as the Starry Sky Race.
Of course… Some people believed that even the five-year-old Eleven could defeat Zavay. It wasn't impossible for the third son of the Demon Emperor in his twenties to be comparable to Zavay…
Unfortunately, Zavay had already been eliminated in the first round. There were more than four million people, and it was the worst batch. The two of them were destined to not meet.
"17173 battle room, Tian Shang vs Chi Tong!!!"
"Eh, the opponent should know that Tian Shang insta-killed the 21st place in the previous batch!! It actually didn't forfeit??"
When it was time for the battle of the third son of the Demon Emperor, a large number of people instantly surged into the live-stream. After seeing that Tian Shang's opponent actually didn't directly forfeit and even entered the battlefield, they immediately felt that it was unbelievable.
Because yesterday, as the opponent of the Demon Emperor's third son in the next round, Chi Tong's information was exposed.
It was also a newbie. Although it had won a battle, there was no hope of winning upon encountering the third son of the Demon Emperor…
"But one way or another, Chi Tong is so beautiful. What race is it? Human? It doesn't seem to be. It seems to be a hybrid too!?"
On the plain arena, on one side was a noble young master in a feather coat, silver hair, and golden eyes. His demon saber had yet to be summoned.
If it were on Blue Planet, he would also be considered a Beast Tamer. However, he would be controlling an arms-type pet.
Opposite him was a girl in a black dress that fluttered in the wind. She held a fire-patterned black sword at her waist, and her red eyes were filled with disdain for all life fluctuations.
"A sword battle?!!" After discovering Chi Tong's clothes, many spectators were stunned.
At the scene, Tian Shang's expression was calm. He originally thought that he could defeat his opponent without even using his sword in this battle. However, after sensing the faint aura of an expert emanating from Chi Tong, he stretched out his hand and summoned a white demon saber that emitted terrifying demonic power.
