The two of them were both very quiet types. Their auras kept condensing, and a huge amount of demonic power gathered around Tian Shang and the Demon Blade. A terrifying sword intent also filled Chi Tong's body.
Apart from the battle sprite beside them who was still pushing it, the gazes of all the spectators focused on the swords they each swung in the next moment!!
"Heavenly Demon Slash…" Tian Shang said calmly. The saber that gathered terrifying demonic power turned into a soaring sword light that shattered everything and suppressed Chi Tong!!
It was like a cruel Heavenly Wolf tearing at its opponent.
"It's actually the move that insta-killed Ling Yu. Even the 21st place in the God Sealing Battle couldn't withstand it. It was on the verge of death, and Tian Shang actually used this move again."
Everyone held their breaths. Seeing Tian Shang use such a killer move to deal with this opponent, they couldn't help but be stunned.
How much hatred was there?
"Not enough…" Chi Tong casually swung her sword.
In the next moment, fire patterns spread on the black sword. That was the power of fire mastered by the Vermillion Bird clone. In addition to the spatial power, sharp metal power, and death power mastered by Chi Tong herself, the four powers condensed on the sword body and intertwined. Countless sword shadows and sword lights overlapped on the sword, and the ten thousand swords became one.
Immortal Slaying Sword Intent!!
Buzz!!
With Chi Tong as the center, the sword intent that could destroy the stars erupted with a bang. It was filled with a red light that could destroy everything. The concept was dim to deathly silence, turning into a long rainbow that flew towards the Heavenly Demon Slash!
This was Chi Tong's current strongest killer move, the simplified version of the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation… She, who could easily defeat the genius of the Vermillion Bird Family ranked in the top 50 of the God Sealing Battle with just a clone, when her main body and clone fused and used the move most suitable for her, had unstoppable power. She was confident that she could kill Cosmic Crow Zavay twice.
The Immortal Slaying Sword Intent didn't stop at all and directly came into contact with the Heavenly Demon Slash. Almost instantly, the Heavenly Demon Slash was destroyed with a bang and collapsed into countless lights. What was even more terrifying was that the Immortal Slaying Sword Intent still swept with a terrifying power and attacked the third son of the Demon Emperor.
"This is…" The pupils of the third son of the Demon Emperor constricted. He originally thought that he had already thought very highly of his opponent, but when Chi Tong attacked, his face still instantly turned pale. His mind warned crazily, and he sensed the threat of death.
Boom!!
Looking at this blade intent, although it had yet to arrive, he immediately felt that he had been destroyed ten million times…
The third son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, had a ferocious expression. He raised the Demon Blade again and condensed all the strength in his body, erupting with his strongest profundity to resist with all his might.
Boom!
Under the dazzling light, the third son of the Demon Emperor was enveloped in powerful light. It was as if time had passed. With a puff, he spat out a mouthful of blood. The Demon Blade was sent flying, and his entire body was filled with injuries from the invasion of blade intent. His face was pale as he flew out, unable to resist at all.
Chi Tong sighed and slowly put away its sword, looking at the combat elf.
It was as if it was also looking at the countless spectators who had entered the live-stream early, waiting for the third son of the Demon Emperor to show off his might…
"I'm overthinking… The adversary isn't strong…" Chi Tong muttered.
"Im… Impossible!!!" At this moment, as the combat ended, shocked voices erupted like a tide from various realms again. Many people opened their mouths wide and were stunned. They looked at the victory results that popped up in the live-stream in disbelief…
[Ground 17173, winner: Chi Tong!]
The third son of the Demon Emperor… was… insta-killed??
"I don't understand!!!" The second place of the God Sealing Battle, Ming Gu, who had once won 101 consecutive championships, was first sad that his opponent, Zavay, had left. Then, he paid attention to other experts, such as Eleven, and the third son of the Demon Emperor…
This third son of the Demon Emperor was also very strong. He felt that there was a trace of a threat to him.
Then… he saw that the third son of the monster newbie, the Demon Emperor, who had only appeared this year and participated in the God Sealing Battle was insta-killed by another newbie, Sword Maiden… The pressure Chi Tong's blade gave him was incomparably powerful, much stronger than Zavay's five combination profundities!!
This confused the forever second place.
"What's amiss with the newbies this year!! Huh??"

chapters.title: Chapter 1466 The Ten Supernovas (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1466 The Ten Supernovas (1)
"As expected, I can't open it."
In the room, Shi Yu looked at the huge rock in front of him with a headache.
This was the super divine stone.
Last night, Lin Feng still managed to get the super divine stone.
The outcome of the bet was decided in advance before the competition ended.
It was mainly because Senior Sun didn't think that his daughter could compare to Shi Yu.
In the first round, Shi Yu's pet shattered Zavay, the 79th consecutive champion. What was there to compete?
In order to make Senior Sun "willingly" take out the super divine stone, Lin Feng promised that if he obtained something good, he definitely wouldn't hide it!
At that time, they would all be old comrades. Who could let anyone suffer?
After gulping down a mouthful of wine, the super divine stone ran to Lin Feng's pocket.
After returning, Lin Feng gave the super divine stone to Shi Yu first.
He planned to let Shi Yu ask the five super divines of Blue Planet to open the stone.
It was said that the super divine stone could only be opened with the combined efforts of at least four super divines. However, Shi Yu didn't believe it.
This was an ancient item no matter what, so he wanted to see if he could crack the other party through archeological skills like cracking ruins and chatting.
However, after trying for the whole night, it didn't succeed. There were no ripples at all.
This made Shi Yu very disappointed…
…
"Shi Yu, hahahaha, Chi Tong won!!"
Lin Feng ran over to Shi Yu again in a good mood and said, "Speaking of which, between Chi Tong and Eleven, who's stronger?"
"He actually insta-killed the son of a super divine with a sword. Why do I feel that Chi Tong is also quite strong?"
"Of course she's strong. In the last team internal competition, she was in first place," Shi Yu said with a smile as he welcomed Senior Lin Feng.
"At that time, she didn't have so much power of faith to use."
The corners of Lin Feng's mouth twitched. Alright, Eleven wasn't the strongest, right?
"Of course, that's the old version. Now, I only have a rough guess which is stronger. As for the real ranking, we still have to fight and see."
After all… even Shi Yu didn't ask what trump cards they had prepared for their teammates.
However, this time, Shi Yu vaguely felt that although Eleven, Chi Tong, and the others performed fiercely, they might not necessarily be able to firmly take first place…
"Good news." Lin Feng looked at the super divine stone Shi Yu placed in the living room and said, "Do you want to hear it?"
"What good news?" Shi Yu said. "Who did you bet with again? What is it this time?"
Lin Feng said, "It's not that I bet with someone, but Senior Space Emperor bet with someone…"
Shi Yu: "…"
Lin Feng smiled and briefly told Shi Yu about the descent of the super divines of the five major divine races on the Blue Planet into the Floating Realm.
When he learned that at that time, the Blue Planet bloodline would split the resources of Blue Planet according to the strength of their race, Shi Yu had a strange expression.
The Space Emperor was setting a trap for the five divine races.
At that time, when Emperor Shi came out, what would the five divine races do?
Although Emperor Shi had just advanced to the super divine level not long ago, as a time-element big boss, he couldn't be weaker than the super divines of the five major divine races on Blue Planet, right? It was said that the five major divine races on Blue Planet were only at the bottom of the super divine level.
As for Emperor Shi… According to the owl's prophecy, there might be more than one source of transcendence in the ruins of the era.
Therefore, when Emperor Shi himself became a super divine Beast Tamer, he might even have at least one time-element pet at the super divine level.
This was very impressive.
It was already very impressive for a large faction to have one super divine expert. To have two super divine experts, it was a faction with two super divine experts. In the entire universe, it was a large faction!
And the combination of a super divine Beast Tamer and a super divine pet was very rare in the entire World King Planet.
For example, the previous Demon Emperor was a super divine Beast Tamer himself, but the Demon Blade in his hand wasn't a super divine.
But even so, it could still instantly kill super geniuses among divine-levels…
The combination of a super divine Beast Tamer and a super divine creature that Shi Yu was familiar with seemed to only be the vice president of the Environmental Protection Association, God Bing Ling.
God Bing Ling was a super godly Beast Tamer. Her contracted target was the strongest expert of the cleansing star spirit race, the super divine level cleansing star spirit, and the current president of the Environmental Protection Association.
Therefore, if Emperor Shi could have two super godly powers in one body, he would undoubtedly be very strong. And if he had three super divine powers in one body… That would be even more unimaginable. At that time, as long as Dong Huang's bloodline didn't provoke the five cosmic-level factions, they could almost do whatever they wanted in the universe.
At the thought of having a super big boss protecting him after releasing Emperor Shi, Shi Yu felt anticipation.
"Senior Space Emperor is fighting for benefits for Dong Huang," Shi Yu said. "The good news is that."
"Of course not," Lin Feng said. "It's the five super divines. They were afraid that I couldn't protect you alone and wanted to come over and be your bodyguard…"
"Pfft!" Shi Yu almost spat out his saliva. Five super divines were his bodyguards??
Damn, did the son of a universe overlord have such treatment?
Although they were all the worst super divines, it was too exciting.
"It shouldn't be as simple as being a bodyguard, right?" Shi Yu said.
"Almost. He's probably afraid that you'll win the championship and run away with the teleportation array. He'll sell it and also have the intention of monitoring you." Lin Feng smiled.
"If you really obtain the permanent legendary formation, seeing that you're only from a small spot like the Floating Realm, there will probably be a lot of threats and sharpness from the various races."
"Of course, although we know that you have the protection of God Bing Ling, the five godly races on Blue Planet will definitely be worried."
"It's also a good thing that they're here. At least…" Lin Feng said, "At least, your super godly rock will probably be unlocked soon. There's no need to wait until the contest ends."
"You probably studied it for a long time. You didn't even watch your pet's competition."

chapters.title: Chapter 1467 The Ten Supernovas (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1467 The Ten Supernovas (2)
Shi Yu laughed and said, "I'm still paying attention to Chi Tong. The opponents of the other pets were insta-killed in one move. There's nothing to see."
The corners of Lin Feng's mouth twitched. It was as if Chi Tong's opponent wasn't insta-killed in one move.
"Senior Space Emperor just sent me a message… It probably won't be long before they rush to the central realm."
"By the way, at this time, the Newcomer Rankings should be out, right?" Lin Feng said.
"Your pets should be able to get on the rankings… Take a look."
"Uh, let me see. It shouldn't be time yet, right?"
…
At this moment, many people who were paying attention to the God Sealing Battle felt that this year was quite sudden.
The newbies were all too sick.
In fact, it was understandable that only the third son of the Demon Emperor had appeared.
After all, it was the son of a super divine.
In the end, this super divine son was insta-killed by a sword and eliminated in the second round. Who would have thought?
Chi Tong's name immediately became a trending topic, second only to Eleven.
Because of Eleven and Chi Tong's outstanding performances, in addition to Tian Shang's "outstanding performance", the Newcomer Rankings this year were paid attention to.
When the time came, many spectators guarded the specific segment of the God Sealing Battle.
Soon, a white light flickered in a pitch-black video. The light gathered into a few big words!
[The ten strongest newbies this year!]
When the words appeared, many spectators were excited. They had been looking forward to it for a long time.
After the words dissipated, a table appeared. On the table was a huge box. In the box was a furball-like creature.
The audience was extremely familiar with it. Every year, it was this box god who came to take note of the most powerful newbies.
No one knew its race or strength. They only knew that its status in the God Sealing Battle Committee wasn't low.
"Hello, everyone. It's time for fixed Newcomer Rankings again!" The box god said, "As everyone knows, most of the participants of the God Sealing Battle are old people who participated repeatedly."
"However, in every batch, countless new contestants will also surge in."
"Among these new faces, shocking dark horses often appear. In the end, they display absolute strength and defeat those old contestants who are already famous."
"Now, according to tradition, I'll take stock of the strength data of the contestants according to the super divine computer in charge of the second world. I'll count the ten strongest newbies and the ten supernovas among the contestants this year!!"
"As many newbie contestants have yet to display their full strength, this ranking is only for reference."
When the show arrived, everyone was excited.
This supernova ranking was the most interesting segment during the God Sealing Battle.
It was basically equivalent to the officials of the God Sealing Battle telling the audience which ten contestants were the strongest among the new contestants who signed up for the God Sealing Battle.
Although the box god had said that the strength data of the contestants detected by the super divine computer was only for reference, according to the results of the previous years, the ranking given by the officials basically wouldn't have too much deviation. At most, there would be a few fluctuations.
After all, even if there were just one or two competitions referenced, it was still a super divine computer. It wouldn't be difficult to look the strength of a quasi-divine level. Even if the other party hid something, it wouldn't be difficult.
After the annual supernova ranking, apart from the veteran contestants, the audience would also focus their gazes on these newbies.
But this year…
In fact, before the box god could start the ranking, the audience had already determined who the top three supernovas were.
First, it must be that Iron-eating Beast Eleven.
Having directly killed the Cosmic Crow Zavay, it would be intolerable if Eleven didn't rank first.
As for second place, it was definitely Chi Tong.
After instantly killing the son of a super divine, her strength might not be inferior to the Iron-eating Beast Eleven. Perhaps she would be first.
As for third place, although the third son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, had already been eliminated, people estimated that it was only him. After all, although he was miseraby, insta-killed by another contestant, it was still ranked 21st.
The third son of the Demon Emperor definitely had the strength of the top 10 in the entire God Sealing Battle, but what could he do? His opponent was too abnormal and strange. Nobody knew where his opponent arrived from.
The audience also knew that there were a few newbies from large factions participating, but no one could say for sure the exact ranking. None of them were as dazzling as these three newbies.
Under the gazes of countless people, on the screen, the box god said, "Then now, let's announce the ten newbies of this year one after another…"
[Tenth place: Tian Shang!]
[Reason for entering the rankings: Demonic power is strong, comparable to the divine level. A saber that is fused with the essence, qi, and spirit law of the contracted Demon Blade can kill a true god!]
On the screen, when the words and profile picture appeared, the audience was stunned.
"What?"
"Wait a minute, the third son of the Demon Emperor can just rank tenth among the newbies this year?? Is there a mistake?"
"Could it be that because Tian Shang was eliminated in the second round, its ranking decreased?"
"No, this ranking doesn't rely on battle results. It's just based on the test results of the second world's core and that super divine computer. Tian Shang is ranked tenth. In other words, the super divine computer thinks that there are still nine newbies stronger than him…"
"How is this possible…"
"Not to mention the newbies, even if all of them the old individuals are included, there might not be nine people stronger than Tian Shang."
Facing this tenth place, majority of the audience was stunned. Although the third son of the Demon Emperor was insta-killed in the second round, his strength couldn't be ranked tenth among the newbies, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 1468 The Ten Supernovas (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1468 The Ten Supernovas (3)
The box god said, "As everyone can see, the tenth place among the ten supernovas this year is contestant Tian Shang."
"Contestant Tian Shang is very powerful. In the first round, he joined forces with his contracted Demon Blade and defeated contestant Ling Yu, who was 21st in the previous God Sealing Battle, in one hit. He's ranked among the top ten supernovas. He's fully deserving!"
In the video, the scene of Tian Shang instantly killing his opponent appeared.
The audience naturally knew that Tian Shang deserved to be ranked among the top ten newbies, but they didn't understand why the third son of the Demon Emperor was only ranked tenth!
"Actually, when I saw the list given by the super divine computer, I was also very curious, because in my prediction, contestant Tian Shang should be in the top three no matter what…" the box god said, "But there seem to be a lot of monster newbies this year."
"There are a total of nine contestants. They were evaluated by the system to be stronger than contestant Tian Shang. Although a portion of them have yet to display outstanding battle results and expose all their strength, the shocking power contained in their bodies was detected."
In a hospital in a duel hall, the third son of the Demon Emperor was lying on the bed, undergoing treatment. He was recuperating, and his expression was as if he had lost his dream. Outside the door, the medical staff in charge of guarding Tian Shang looked at the ranking and looked at each other.
In order to avoid this super divine young master from breaking down and being unable to withstand the stimulation, it was better not to tell him about the ranking.
[Ninth place: World Destruction Dragon!]
[Reason for entering the rankings: A mechanical dragon with a special life form. Its body contains a powerful destructive power. The destructive dragon's might can shock a true god!]
On the screen, the audience was stunned again when the words and profile picture appeared.
Who was this?
They had never heard of it.
The name was so arrogant. It didn't look like a name, but a racial name. However, they had never heard of any dragon daring to be arrogant enough to call itself a World Destruction Dragon.
In the video, it showed a terrifying huge dragon, a dragon's might that looked down on the world, as well as the scene of destruction and the defeated opponent. After the audience saw it, they were shocked.
Some geniuses who had fought Little Ji in the Floating Realm, Zi Lan, Phoenix Man, Lin Rui, Wang Qingqing, and the others who were paying attention to the rookie ranking, swallowed their saliva.
Wasn't this Shi Yu's mechanical phantom beast that had absorbed the power of the Ancestral Dragon?
Some Mechanic Masters of the Mechanical Family were also puzzled when they saw this. "Which Mechanical Family is this? Why haven't I known of it? It's actually ranked higher than the son of the Demon Emperor… Unbelievable."
Ninth place, the World Destruction Dragon. Its name was immediately discussed widely, and it instantly became third on the popular list. The ranking had just begun.
[Eighth place: Ginseng Emperor!]
[Reason for entering the rankings: A rare time-element plant, a quasi divine. Its energy level is the highest among the ten newbies!]
It was another unheard-of newbie!
Most people had never heard of this ginseng emperor.
However, in the video, the gentle-looking ginseng emperor in a white research suit raised his hand and released a terrifying ordinary deterrence. It was simply comparable to a divine deterrence. It instantly insta-killed the opponent, forming a sharp contrast.
That was the absolute deterrence shown by Baby Ginseng when it temporarily stepped into the divine level with the power of the Reincarnation Fruit.
In the Blue Wave World, a bunch of geniuses from the Plant Association were stunned when they saw the ginseng emperor on the rankings. This, this, this, this… Wasn't this the ginseng emperor who created the Cultivation Fruit??
It was actually only at the quasi-divine level? Moreover… it also participated in the God Sealing Battle? It was ranked among the ten strongest newbies?
Many people who were familiar with Baby Ginseng discovered it unbelievable.
Outside the World King Planet, on a battleship, an intelligence officer hurriedly reported to the captain.
"Captain Zi Jian, we finally have information on the ginseng emperor, the creator of the Cultivation Fruit you're looking for. The other party participated in the God Sealing Battle!"
In the cultivation room, Captain Zi Jian of the cosmic overlord army, who was wearing a battle suit, walked out and said, "God Sealing Battle?"
"Let's go and find it," Captain Zi Jian said.
Cultivation Fruit… She had long used it up, and the plant association didn't have any stock either. It was quite urgent for her to find this ginseng emperor.
[Seventh place: Susu!]
[Reason for entering the rankings: A Cleansing Star Spirit Race that has mastered deterrence that can affect space and time. The cleansing fluctuations in its body are potent and deep!]
The branches of the various regional Environmental Protection Associations were astonished as Susu entered the rankings.
A new cleansing star spirit was born?
In the scene, Susu had fused with the deterrence wave of the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy. It had indeed distorted space and time and instantly defeated the enemy. This was power outside the power system of the cleansing star spirit. It was actually so powerful.
"Susu is a new member of the Environmental Protection Association."
Only when the headquarters of the Environmental Protection Association stepped forward to explain that Susu was a member of the Environmental Protection Association did all understand.
Many factions sighed that the Environmental Protection Association was going to strengthen again.
If the cleansing star spirit was ranked seventh, they would admit it!
However, among them, there was also a large batch of spies from the Dark King faction. When they saw that a new cleansing star spirit had been born in the Environmental Protection Association, their hearts thumped, and they revealed dark expressions.
But soon, the emotions of the spies of the Environmental Protection Association and the Dark King faction reversed.
[Sixth place: World Cleansing Demon Duck!]
[Reason for entering the rankings: The abyss believes in a god and has fused with a super divine level pollution source. The power of the abyss can corrode a true god!]
In the scene, Duckie's terrifying abyssal power also instantly killed its opponent.
"How can there be an abyssal creature stronger than the cleansing star spirit!!"
Everyone in the Environmental Protection Association was stunned.
"Wait, who is this guy? Without the identity registration of the Environmental Protection Association, it's impossible for the Abyss Race to participate."
"No matter who it is, we have to rope it into the Dark King's camp!" The spies of the Dark King faction felt that it was incredible that an Abyss Race could actually suppress the cleansing star spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1469 The Ten Supernovas (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1469 The Ten Supernovas (4)
Right on the heels of that…
[Fifth place: Time Sect Master!]
A white Shorty appeared.
…
"Damn, what kind of messy ranking is this? If Little Ji, Susu, and Baby Ginseng return, they'll explode in anger."
Halfway through the inventory, Shi Yu muttered.
The super divine computer of this second world was impressive, but after lining Little Ji up behind Duckie, were they sure that Little Ji wouldn't go berserk?
It was fine if it ranked Little Ji behind Duckie, but it actually ranked Susu behind Duckie. If Susu didn't go berserk, Duckie would have to kneel down and beg for mercy when it returned to show its loyalty.
And Baby Ginseng… As the general of the first team and the most knowledgeable of the three brothers, it was actually ranked behind a bunch of second team underlings. Baby Ginseng would probably self-destruct from anger.
Shi Yu estimated that his pets were almost all in the top ten supernovas, apart from Ling, who might not be included because it had yet to appear in a battle and hadn't had its strength detected.
"F*ck…" In Shi Yu's room, Lin Feng continued to swallow his saliva. He knew that Shi Yu was very impressive, but when he saw Shi Yu's pet being checked as one of the ten supernovas, he still felt that it was ridiculous.
How many monster pets had Shi Yu cultivated?
He felt that compared to Shi Yu, he was like a furball.
"Oh? Shi Yu, stop looking first." Suddenly, Lin Feng said, "So fast, Senior Space Emperor and the others… are here."
"They're here?" Shi Yu was shocked. "Where?"
Just as Shi Yu finished speaking, six figures appeared outside the door. The Space Emperor led the way. Behind him were five figures. Among them, three men and two women looked like humans.
The luxuriously dressed dragon man, the beautiful woman in the Phoenix Feather Robe, the muscular man in scales, the angel goddess who retracted the Holy Wings, the dark blue demon, and the super divine of the five major divine races on Blue Planet had all shapeshifted into humanoid forms suitable for appearance. They traveled quietly and arrived at the central realm.
They were all very low-profile, afraid of being challenged by the powerful divine level in the central world.
Along the way, no one could imagine that there were actually five super divine-level experts in this group of six.
Although they weren't afraid of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, there were still many existences even more terrifying than Lin Feng and the Space Emperor among the divine levels who could attack super divines at their peak head-on.
"Seniors, you're here." Lin Feng quickly brought Shi Yu out to welcome them.
"Greetings, seniors," Shi Yu said.
"Are you Shi Yu?" The five superdivines looked at Shi Yu and smiled. This was because they were still hoping that Shi Yu would take down the permanent teleportation array. They looked at Shi Yu with pleasant expressions.
"As expected of a talented person," the Kirin Race's super divine said. "Kid, bringing back the Wind Kirin inheritance from your mother planet is very important to our Kirin Race. Do you have anything you want in return?"
Shi Yu muttered in his heart that Lin Feng had long asked for repayment. Didn't they still refuse to give it to him?
Now that he was about to obtain the permanent teleportation array, he mentioned the reward. What a scam.
"The Kirin Race made heavy sacrifices to protect Blue Planet back then. Without the sacrifice of the Kirin Race, there wouldn't be me later. It's my duty to bring back the Wind Kirin inheritance," Shi Yu said politely.
"Don't say that. You're still working hard for your mother planet. As seniors, it's only right for us to reward the juniors who work hard," the dragon super divine said. "I heard that you cultivated a Green Dragon. Why don't I send the strongest Green Dragon evolver in the Dragon Race to guide it?"
Shi Yu was speechless.
The corners of Lin Feng's mouth twitched. Shi Yu had already cracked the Four Saint Ruins, and he still needed their guidance?
These superdivines were here to talk bullsh*t, right?
Sigh, he should hurry up and let them finish their business before chasing them away!
"Seniors, Shi Yu has a shy personality and has social phobia. He's embarrassed to ask for rewards from you. Why don't you let me ask for them on his behalf?" Lin Feng laughed and said, "He just obtained a super divine stone. Seniors, how about you spend some super divine power to help him open it??"
The five super divines were slightly stunned.
"It's just opening a stone. It's no big deal. Where is it?" the demon super divine said.
…
In the hall.
The Space Emperor was also puzzled. Where did Lin Feng and Shi Yu get a super divine stone?
However, the five super divines were still very happy to leave a good impression on Shi Yu through this method. At this moment, they were already thinking about how to rope Shi Yu in.
It was a pity for a genius like Shi Yu to stay in the Floating Realm.
It was better to send it to their race and nurture juniors so as to tie him to their race.
Especially the super divine of the Kirin Race, who was already thinking about how to bring Shi Yu and the Wind Kirin back to the race.
They believed that, compared to Wang Kong and Lin Feng, the two ordinary divine-levels, Shi Yu would definitely choose to follow super divine professionals similar to them.
"Is it this stone?"
"Yes, seniors, I'll leave it to you."
The five super divines naturally knew what the super divine stone was. The five of them nodded at each other and stretched out their palms at the same time, aiming at the super divine stone.
In the next moment, a mysterious power that Shi Yu couldn't understand no matter how he observed it lingered in the five super divine palms before slowly surging towards the divine stone.
"Good lord." Lin Feng was looking forward to it. He didn't expect that the stone he had just gotten last night could be opened today.
What good thing could it be?
Five streams of super divine power flowed towards the super divine stone. In the next moment, dense cracks appeared on the outside of the super divine stone.
Right on the heels of that, it all shattered. Shi Yu took a deep breath and stared intently.
"Huh?" The five super divines exclaimed softly. When the shell of the super divine stone shattered, the full appearance of the things inside was revealed. The Space Emperor, Lin Feng, Shi Yu, and the five super divines were stunned.
Because 90% of the resources inside the super divine stone were super divine, yet no super divine resources were obtained this time.
Inside the super divine stone was an additional stone, a biological fossil, and an amber-like thing. And inside the amber was a person!
It was a man who was completely naked. His private parts were covered by holy light, revealing only his powerful body and handsome face.
"An ancient man from the last era??" The five super divine beings were surprised. It was rare for a super divine stone to open such an ancient creature.
"The life aura of this ancient man has already disappeared, but his physical strength should be comparable to a super divine. If he's sold to the archeological association, its value should be even more expensive than super divine resources. It's not bad," the dragon super divine said.
At this moment, Lin Feng seemed to be a little disappointed to see that the person was a man and not a goddess. He looked at Shi Yu and saw that Shi Yu was looking at this man with an extremely serious expression.
"You're interested in men?" Lin Feng asked.
"No, I'm merely interested in the ancients of the era," Shi Yu said with a deep breath.
In particular, this ancient of the era indeed gazed very alike to his previous life on Earth. Shi Yu's heart trembled similar to a tsunami as he forcefully controlled the changes in his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1470 Archeology Examination of His Previous Life Body (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1470 Archeology Examination of His Previous Life Body (1)
After seeing his previous life's body appear in the super divine stone, Shi Yu was completely stunned.
In broad daylight, he only felt his head buzzing.
He felt his hair stand on end.
Therefore, Earth was really Blue Planet from the last era. His soul had really transmigrated into a cosmic era and arrived at the future after the reboot.
However, even so, why was his body still preserved and sealed until now?
What confused Shi Yu even more was that in his previous life, he was only an ordinary person. Although he wandered around and had a good physique and wasn't weak, he couldn't compare to a super divine physique.
Why was it at the super divine level in his previous life?
"Continue opening the amber to take a look," the angel super divine said. After saying that, she wanted to unveil the holy light…
"Senior, wait a minute." Shi Yu hurriedly stopped her and said, "That's it. This is good."
"Now that they're one, if we break deeper, it might affect the ancient items."
If his arm and leg were broken, Shi Yu would have nowhere to cry.
The angel super divine stopped and looked at Shi Yu.
"I remember. You're an archeologist, right?" Before coming, she had obtained some information about Shi Yu.
"Yes," Shi Yu said. "Opening an ancient man of an era is considered very important research value to me…"
"Super divine from the previous era…" The dragon super divine and the others looked at their sealed bodies and sighed.
Even super-divines couldn't withstand the birth and destruction of a universe.
"Perhaps this super divine expert tried to avoid the destruction of the universe by sealing himself with a divine stone. Unfortunately, it didn't work," the Phoenix Race super divine said.
"But it's already extremely difficult to preserve the body completely," the Kirin Race super divine said. "There aren't more than ten such era creatures in the entire universe, right?"
"It's not as valuable as a super divine resource." The demon super divine shook its head.
Shi Yu was very silent when he heard the discussions of the various super divines. At this moment, his mind was in a mess.
"I think it's better not to study such a dangerous thing," the dragon super divine said.
"Even the archeological association didn't develop anything. Instead, they paid a heavy price. You're quasi-divine. It won't be good if you play with fire."
"I remember that at least three of the five cosmic-level factions have once opened era creatures. Among them, on the World King Planet, the archeological association even carried out research for 800 years on the beings that were opened."
"They wanted to revive the beings of the era, but they used various methods and failed. During this period, they invited capable people to study it together, and there was no lack of super divine lives who were experts in various fields."
"There are also people who want to occupy the bodies of beings of the era through soul possession, but once they come into contact with the bodies, all their souls will be obliterated. The compatibility is 0, and there's no room for recovery."
"Even if I want to purely create the cadaver of an era creature into a puppet, I have no idea where to start. It's impossible to achieve precise control. I can only use psychic power to control the body and guide the body of the era creature to make movements."
"Therefore, this thing isn't something you can investigate alone. The best choice is still to sell it to the archeological association at a high price in exchange for a certain amount of resources," the dragon super divine gave a suggestion.
He was worried that Shi Yu would play with fire and kill himself.
At that time, if the God Sealing Battle didn't end, the permanent teleportation array would be gone.
Eh? Wait a minute, it didn't seem to affect Shi Yu's death. It was fine as long as his pet didn't die.
Shi Yu's pets seemed to have displayed the potential to get first place without relying on the Beast Tamer.
"Thank you for the reminder, Senior," Shi Yu said. "I'll be careful."
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng were silent. Shi Yu probably only uttered that he would pay attention to the surface.
But at that time, who knew what would happen?
An ancient corpse of the era… The Space Emperor never expected that this super divine stone would open such a thing.
Beside him, Lin Feng also shook his head secretly. Seeing that Shi Yu was interested, he planned to throw it to Shi Yu to deal with.
As long as other era beings appeared, even if it was a wild beast, Lin Feng could be interested.
But now, he was really not interested.
Lin Feng himself wasn't willing to bring the corpse of an ancient man around every day.
At this moment, chattering sounds came from outside the door.
It was Eleven, Chi Tong, and the others who had formed a party to compete. They had formed a team again.
From afar, everyone heard their argument.
"Roar!!! (Why, why?)"
Perhaps it already knew the ranking of the newbies, Little Ji shouted indignantly.
"Yi! (How can I reason?)" Baby Ginseng was unconvinced, but it was indeed a little guilty.
Sun and Moon Glory+Soul Fruit+Time Mark. With multiple self-destructions, it was indeed not afraid of any opponent on the team.
However, the problem was that this strategy couldn't be used repeatedly.
If it was used on Eleven, it couldn't be used on Chi Tong. If it was used on Chi Tong, it couldn't be used on Buggy…
Baby Ginseng had a headache. As expected, there were too few Time Marks. There were only two of them!
"Quack, duck, duck…" Duckie followed behind Susu and kept explaining. It didn't have time to care about Little Ji. In its opinion, it was only natural that it was positioned higher than Little Ji.
However, what kind of lousy ranking was this? It positioned higher than its big sister, Susu. Duckie instantly broke out in cold sweat, and its heart trembled… It felt that there were always disorderly people who wanted to harm it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1471 Archeology Examination of His Previous Life Body (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1471 Archeology Examination of His Previous Life Body (2)
[The five super divines of Blue Planet are also here.] After sensing the return of his pets, Shi Yu told them about the situation at home.
Upon hearing that, Eleven and the other pets were immediately stunned.
What???
When they completely entered, they saw a group of people surrounding a biological amber.
Lin Feng and the Space Emperor were here… Apart from them, there were also five guys whose strength couldn't be seen clearly. They were like ordinary people, but they felt that they weren't to be trifled with.
The pets entered and looked at the five super divines.
The gazes of the five super divines directly passed all the pets and landed on Eleven.
Eleven blinked. The five super divines… were attracted because of its battle results…
Then, Buggy, the Dragon Race's super divine, Chi Tong, the Phoenix Race's super divine, and Ling faced each other one by one. The Angel Race's super divine and the Demon Race's super divine were silent.
What did Shi Yu mean?
They had cultivated the descendants of dragons, phoenixes, and kirins, but they ignored the descendants of angels and demons.
Were they looking down on angels and demons?
The angels and super divine demons felt that if they wanted to rope Shi Yu in, they first had to let Shi Yu sign a contract with the geniuses of their race.
In any case, from the looks of it, Shi Yu had already contracted so many pets. He shouldn't mind having one more.
"Hello, seniors," Eleven and the others greeted obediently.
"You guys… aren't bad," the Kirin Race's super divine said, especially to Ling. This battleship was a mechanical phantom beast with the Wind Kirin Race's inheritance, right?
Although it wasn't an orthodox Kirin, it could be considered half a Kirin after accepting the Wind Kirin inheritance.
He just didn't know if it was willing to join the Kirin Race with Shi Yu in the future.
"Seniors, Shi Yu's pet has just returned from the competition and needs to rest and prepare for the next competition. Why don't we leave first to discuss the changes in the rules?" Emperor Kong said. "While Lin Feng is also here."
"Alright." At the moment, this was the most important thing. The five super divines nodded.
A moment later, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the five super divines left. Only Shi Yu, Eleven, and the others were left in the room.
Eleven and the others gazed at the biological amber and the broken super divine stone in silence and at Shi Yu.
"Master, did the super divine stone… only open such a thing?" Ling said.
"This isn't just a thing!" Shi Yu said. "This might be the most outstanding life form in the last cosmic era."
Ling: What?
Eleven and the other pets: What???
They had never noticed Shi Yu praise others so generously. Did he receive some stimulation today?
"Ling, collect all the information about the super divine stone and the ancient creatures of the era first," Shi Yu said.
Shi Yu looked at his previous life and felt that he was getting closer and closer to solving the mystery of transmigration.
"By the way, you guys have seen the Newcomer Rankings, right?" Shi Yu suddenly rubbed his nose in it.
"Meow!!!" Shorty told Shi Yu happily that it was fifth!!
[Fifth place: Time Sect Master!]
[Reason for entering the rankings: The physique is a pure body of faith that controls a huge amount of power of faith!]
"I saw it…" Shi Yu smiled. "You can actually get fifth place. Not bad."
In a certain magnificent chamber in the Floating Realm, under the recommendation of the gem cat, the Dragon God, who had eaten the Cultivation Fruit, also uttered after seeing this ranking, "Little cat, Shi Yu's short cat seems to be your junior, right?"
"Your junior's power has already exceeded that of a super divine son. How are you feeling?"
The Dragon God stabbed the gem cat several times, making the gem cat's heart ache to the extreme. It still remembered Shorty's stupid appearance when it recommended it to Shi Yu. Although it was quite stupid now, why… Why…
Why was its rank higher than that of Baby Ginseng, Susu, and the others? Why!!
"I…" The gem cat felt a huge blow. No, this wouldn't do. The gem cat had already decided that after Shi Yu finished the competition, it would bring Shorty and the owl to search for treasures.
After so long of investigation, the cat more or less knew where the gem it had picked up came from.
In the universe, the Star Prayer Race was considered a race with weak battle power but very cheat-like abilities.
Their wishing ability was omnipotent at a sufficient price.
The most valiant record was that several Star Prayer Races helped a top-notch god make a wish to break through. The other party actually encountered the ruins of the era when it went out and picked up the source of transcendence.
Therefore, this also caused the Star Prayer Race to be coveted very seriously. Many Space Races yearned to raise a Star Prayer Race as a pet.
It could even treat the entire Star Prayer Race as its exclusive property.
Because of this, the Star Prayer Race encountered many calamities and was on the verge of extinction a few times. There were originally hundreds of clansmen, but now, there were probably very few of them left. They were hidden in various places in the universe. This might also be the backlash of making many wishes.
It was uttered that when the Star Prayer Race was in danger of extinction, the Star Prayer Race had once divided the treasure in the race into seven and thrown it into the spatial crack. They had also made a wish that a creature that could inherit the will of the Star Prayer Race could inherit the power of the Star Prayer Race and prevent the Star Prayer Race from being completely destroyed. Then, they would help the Star Prayer Race take revenge.
The gem cat didn't know if this allusion was real or fake, but it had indeed been hit by a meteor from outer space and picked up the Star Prayer Race inheritance. Therefore, the gem cat was thinking that if this allusion was real, was it possible for it to find the other six inheritances?
With it as the source, the Prediction Owl and Shorty could help it find it through the Prediction and Treasure Hunting Skill. The gem cat felt that there was a high chance!

chapters.title: Chapter 1472 Archeology Examining His Previous Life Body (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1472 Archeology Examining His Previous Life Body (3)
At that time, it would be the strongest god of the Star Prayer Race!
"Senior Dragon God, just you wait. Let's see who's stronger when the time comes," the gem cat muttered. Its current wish was to see if it could fuse its nine-element energy bullets like Zavay.
If it could do it, its power would definitely be even cooler. It wouldn't be a problem to cripple Eleven in one hit.
"You want to compete with me…" The Dragon God pondered. Was this cat serious? What bad idea was it up to?
…
On Shi Yu and the others' side, Baby Ginseng was rather depressed.
Shorty was actually ranked fifth.
However, Buggy was even more depressed than Baby Ginseng.
Because it was the fourth.
[Fourth place: Worm of Imagination!]
[Reason for entering the rankings: The physique is a pure body of faith that controls a huge amount of power of faith!]
It was ranked fourth, but Buggy didn't expect that the super divine computer in the second world would be so perfunctory. Even its reason for being on the rankings was the same as that of Shorty's.
It had finally thought of its battle name, but in the end, this treatment made Buggy very uncomfortable. The consequences were very serious.
Even [Third place: Super Holy Beast!]
[Reason for entering the rankings: One body with two souls, physique as a pure body of faith, and control a huge amount of power of faith!] At least the description of Turtle and Little Quas included their two souls in one body.
The ranking of the Four Holy Beasts in the team was higher than Shi Yu imagined, but this was most likely because they still stored a large amount of power of faith in their bodies.
As for [Second Place] and [First Place], there was no suspense.
The second place was given to Chi Tong. The reason for going on the rankings was to control powerful sword laws, while the first place was given to Eleven. The reason for going on the rankings was that they had the strongest body and at least three top-notch divine skills…
As soon as the complete top 10 rankings were out, it could be said to have caused a huge commotion.
90% of the ten strongest newbies had never heard of it before. This year's God Sealing Battle was really magical.
Of course, it was just a Newcomer Ranking. It wasn't something Shi Yu paid attention to. All his current thoughts were on the archeological test. This was because the first place in the God Sealing Battle was a little boring and unattractive.
"Has your opponent for the next battle come out?" Shi Yu asked when he saw that Ling was still investigating.
"Wuu!!!" Eleven and the others replied.
They had come out. They were all opponents above 100,000 rankings and weren't worth mentioning.
"Quack!!" Only Duckie was caught between laughter and tears.
It was different. It matched the previous batch's 99th place.
That was fine. The key was that the 99th place in the previous batch was a genius from the Environmental Protection Association who was an expert in cleansing abilities.
Duckie had paired with its "family".
"Ning. (Don't lose.)" Susu said.
It didn't allow this fat duck to rank higher than it and be defeated by other cleansing creatures.
"Quack!!" Duckie patted its chest and promised that it wouldn't lose.
Shi Yu also smiled and said, "The abyssal creatures have paired with the super genius of the Environmental Protection Association. Alright, I reckon the other party will be traumatized after this battle…"
If the other party had the same personality as Susu…
Just thinking about it, if Susu encountered an abyssal creature that it couldn't defeat or cleanse no matter what, and then this abyssal creature displayed a cleansing strength stronger than Susu, how devastated would Susu be?
"Did Ling advance again?" Shi Yu said.
"No." Ling looked over and replied, "Today, I specially removed the Wind of Blessing on my body. Then, a group of contestants perished together. The singular contestants became even numbers. Without the free advance option, I also matched my rival in the next round."
"Ah, this," Shi Yu said. "Why did you remove the Wind of Blessing? I thought you could happily advance freely until the finals."
Ling snorted and said, "That would be too shameless. Moreover, I'm not interested in first place. I just want to move around."
"However, I feel that my luck should have been too good previously. There was a backlash this time. I paired with that contestant Ming Gu who won 101 consecutive championships and later became second."
Shi Yu: "Huh?? Your luck backlash is too powerful. From passing twice to matching the 101-time consecutive champion… Why do I feel that the unlucky guy from the Kirin Race came to Blue Planet because you used a large amount of the Kirin Race's luck backlash on Blue Planet and died…"
Ling unveiled its virtual image and puffed up its face. "Don't talk nonsense."
"I'm merely kidding…" Shi Yu said, "The backlash isn't too strong. It's just that you were paired to the previous second place. At least, you didn't match with Eleven and the others… If you guys encounter each other in advance, that's called bad luck."
Ling said, "In order to prevent them from encountering each other in the early stages, I applied a weak wind of luck to them. I hope it works."
Eleven and the others bowed at Ling, but at the same time, they were afraid of it.
Ling was so scary.
As long as Ling wanted to, it seemed like it could completely cheat. It could reverse the wind of luck and make them all unlucky. In the first few rounds, they encountered each other and were eliminated. Then, Ling itself advanced to the finals by rotation…
At the thought of this, they felt that Ling's ability was too buggy. It could completely use the rules of the God Sealing Battle to win without fighting.
"Eh…" Shi Yu couldn't help but sigh. Why didn't Eleven and the others react when they heard that Ling had paired the 101-time consecutive champion? It was as if Ling had matched a cameo. They looked down on people too much.
Ming Gu wasn't much weaker than Zavay. He had successfully destroyed the other party's Time Mark several times.
"Master, I've summarized all the information I can investigate within my authority." At this moment, Ling said, "I'll share my memories with you through telepathy."

chapters.title: Chapter 1473 Archeology Examining His Previous Life Body (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1473 Archeology Examining His Previous Life Body (4)
"Alright." Shi Yu nodded. With Ling around, he could relax.
…
Next, Shi Yu studied the information Ling had given him.
At the moment, he only dared study information.
He really didn't dare to let Shi Yu open the amber.
However, when he saw his previous life, Shi Yu indeed had a few thoughts.
If this was really him, if it was really him in his previous life, was there any way he could control him?
What the dragon super divine said and the information Ling had investigated showed that no one could control the creatures of the era accurately, even if they were only puppets. The greatest obstacle was compatibility.
But he was different. His soul might have transmigrated from the body of the last era to this cosmic era.
In other words, his soul might have a nearly 100% compatibility with his previous body.
If he could directly control this super divine body, Shi Yu felt that he could take off on the spot. However, although that was the case, Shi Yu didn't dare to guarantee 100% that this body was his.
After all, he was only an ordinary person. How could he have a super divine body, and who sealed his body?
His transmigration didn't feel like an accident. It felt more like a carefully planned thing to let the lives of the last era successfully live to the next era.
Even cosmic-level creatures couldn't exist for two eras, but he did it. This was simply unbelievable.
"Sigh…" Shi Yu was worried. He instantly seemed to have aged by a second.
…
Time passed quickly and it was soon the next round of the God Sealing Battle. During this period, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng didn't let the five super divines disturb Shi Yu. Shi Yu studied his previous life in peace.
As for Eleven and the others, they still ran to the competition. If nothing went wrong, their contest today would receive more attention.
As soon as the top 10 Newcomer Rankings appeared, it was difficult for them, the monster newbies ranked in front of the son of the Demon Emperor, not to be paid attention to.
The opponents who paired them also trembled and felt uneasy.
Of course, apart from the battles of Eleven and the others being paid attention to, there was another battle that was paid attention to.
That was [Ling] vs [Ming Gu].
As soon as this match list was out, the forum exploded. This newbie Ling, the Ling who had advanced twice without a battle, was so lucky that a group of failed contestants were envious, jealous, and spiteful. They felt that it was ridiculous.
However, as the third round of the name list appeared, Ling, who was extremely lucky, encountered the 101-time consecutive champion, Ming Gu. The group of failed contestants was immediately overjoyed.
When the time comes, fortune turns!
Ling was extremely lucky in the second two rounds. It must have suffered a backlash this time.
Apart from this battle, the audience was most concerned about the battle between the [World Cleansing Demon Duck] and the [Wind Mirror].
The reason why the audience paid attention to the sixth place, the World Cleansing Demon Duck, was that among the ten newbies, only the opponent it encountered had pretty good strength.
For example, the contestants Eleven and the others matched, who were ranked hundreds of thousands, there was no need to pay attention at all. They would definitely be insta-killed again.
A monster newcomer who had mastered the power of the abyss matched a super genius of the Environmental Protection Association. This was clearly even more of a gimmick.
Coincidentally, the World Cleansing Demon Duck's contest was in front of "Lucky Ling". As the competition time approached, the audience gradually entered the World Cleansing Demon Duck vs Wind Mirror's live-stream.
Including contestants like Ming Gu, who had won the championship 101 times, and most of the contestants who were in the 100s before the God Sealing Battle, they also joined with grave expressions.
It was mainly because when they thought of how there were nine monster newbies stronger than the son of the Demon Emperor, they felt a sense of danger.
Until now, there were still people who were unwilling to believe that nine newbies were stronger than the son of the Demon Emperor. This battle might be a very good battle to witness the strength of other monster newbies.
On an island arena floating in the sky, two figures appeared.
On one side was the blinded World Cleansing Demon Duck.
On one side was a female Beast Tamer with black hair. She had a baby face and looked like a child. Although she didn't have any obvious characteristics, looking at her directly, she gave off a very pure feeling.
"Let's deduce… Wind Mirror was ranked 99th last year."
"The son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, insta-killed the previous batch's 21st place with a single slash. His strength is far greater than the 99th place. There's no problem, right?"
"And this World Cleansing Demon Duck is several times higher than the son of the Demon Emperor. It's not a problem for it to be far greater than Tian Shang, right?"
"Therefore, the normal development of this battle… is the World Cleansing Demon Duck instantly killing the Wind Mirror…"
"That's not necessarily true. Wind Mirror is a perfect god of the Environmental Protection Association who's an expert in the power of cleansing. She has rich experience dealing with the Abyss Race. Perhaps she can rely on her restraint relationship to reverse the situation. It's also very common for one thing to counter another thing in the God Sealing Battle."
"But the problem is… this Abyss Race is ranked above the cleansing star spirit!! The cleansing star spirit is the strongest cleansing race ranked 77th among the myriad of races in the starry sky with just the cleansing ability."
"Although the contracted pet of the Wind Mirror, the 'Wind Dancer', is also a strong race of cleansing, its ranking among the myriad races in the starry sky is already in the hundreds…"
As the audience discussed, Wind Mirror had already summoned its contracted partner, ranked 512th among the myriad of races in the starry sky, the Cleansing Race, Wind Dancer.
An elemental creature floated in the sky. Its elegant figure when flying was like a dancer. The Wind Dancer often appeared in the various major realms. As it flew, it cleansed the dirt and was widely praised.
Apart from the Wind Dancer who appeared beside Wind Mirror, a tool-type pet that looked like a circular mirror appeared in Wind Mirror's hand. As a weapon, a white cloak appeared behind her, emitting a faint light that isolated all filth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1474 Archeology Examining His Previous Life Body (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1474 Archeology Examining His Previous Life Body (5)
A guardian-type equipment life form, a mirror life form, and a Wind Dancer were the complete contract configurations of this Wind Mirror.
"I know. You're very strong." Wind Mirror's light voice sounded as she looked at Duckie.
"Quack. (Attack.)" Duckie was extremely calm. Otherwise, there would be no chance. However, this venue, the island in the sky, was interesting. It should let Little Ji suffer.
As soon as she finished speaking, the Wind Dancer let out a soft cry and directly summoned the storm formed by the super cleansing divine skills of the spiritual, wind, and undead elements to blow at Duckie!!
Light Wind!
The strongest cleansing skill of the Wind Dancer Race could cleanse all filth. Even after reincarnation, even if it reincarnated 100 times, it would become a good person for 100 lifetimes. Its body would definitely reject the source of pollution.
Of course, apart from this abnormal ability to cleanse the enemy's battle intent, it was just a basic skill. This was a cleansing skill stronger than a simple Sea Cleansing Spirit.
"Cleansing Light." On the foundation of such a cleansing skill, Wind Mirror's cloak fluttered as it held the "Wind Mirror" in hand and aimed it at the Wind Dancer. Using the cleansing enhancement talent, which had been cultivated to the divine level, it was strengthened a second time by the "Wind Mirror Weapon", forming an extremely strong strengthening ability that bloomed all over the Wind Dancer's body.
At this moment, the Wind Dancer seemed to dance under a holy halo, dancing with the light wind to cleanse the filthy duck.
"This isn't a blood counter." Seeing this, the audience swallowed their saliva. The abilities cultivated by the Beast Tamers of the Environmental Protection Association had always countered races like the abyss. It wasn't a big problem to skip a level, right?
Perhaps this duck was also considered unlucky? It clearly had strength that far exceeded contestant Wind Mirror, but because it was restrained and outnumbered, it was at a disadvantage.
This duck didn't seem to have a contractor. It was alone. On the other hand, Wind Mirror was completely armed.
Boom!
In the next moment, a light wind enveloped and covered Duckie's entire body. Duckie stood on the spot, and the bandage on its eye fluttered in the wind.
The abyssal aura spreading from its body was like a flame encountering water. White mist rose crazily and was completely cleansed. However, the duck was calm, as if a dead duck wasn't afraid of boiling water.
It often drank the cleansing water as if it was water, indicating that it could still withstand it.
On the other side, Wind Mirror took a deep breath. In the next moment, the bandage on the World Cleansing Demon Duck's eye was blown away by the wind…
This was the first time Duckie had untied the bandage in the God Sealing Battle.
"It's over." In the Blue Wave World, Master Adolf and his disciple, Little Chun, the combination of the Environmental Protection Association that had once given Duckie an assessment, and President Xing Nan, who was watching the battle, were extremely regretful when they saw this scene.
Sigh, Wind Mirror, Wind Mirror… Be more careful.
Why was she blowing away the duck's bandage for no reason?
As the bandage was blown away, Duckie opened its closed eyes, revealing its dark red eyes. A terrifying aura gradually spread on Duckie's body. Bang, bang, bang, bang, bang. Duckie's abyss heart also began to beat strongly.
Boom!!!
In the next moment, the strange, unholy, huge, and deep power of abyssal pollution instantly spread to the Wind Mirror through the light wind, air, and wind. The Wind Mirror's pupils constricted, and it felt its brain instantly tremble and dizzy. When she recovered, the entire floating island turned into a terrifying abyss filled with filthy fluctuations.
"Wind Mirror…" In mid-air, the Wind Dancer shouted in panic. Its originally light wind elemental body was also directly dyed black at this moment. The power of the abyss slowly corroded its entire body, and it couldn't cleanse itself at all.
"Hand of Purification!" Wind Mirror wanted to use her other divine-level cleansing ability to assist the Wind Dancer in cleansing, but she suddenly realized that the cleansing cloak she was wearing also quickly filled with the power of the abyss. It couldn't provide any protection at all.
Her will was instantly corroded.
Wind Mirror's expression was filled with despair as she felt darkness in front of her. She instantly knew why this Demon Duck was ranked before the third son of the Demon Emperor. Even if it was a junior Abyss God, it was impossible for it to have such a terrifying abyssal power.
Was this the so-called abyssal power that had fused with the super divine level pollution source?
At this moment, the audience saw the whole time that Duckie was only spreading the power of the abyss outside. The entire island, the sky, and even the ground below had become a place like an abyss purgatory. The terrifying pollution ability, in addition to the scene of Wind Mirror hugging her head and struggling in pain, crying, and the Wind Dancer almost turning into an abyss creature… In an instant, countless spectators were afraid.
This…
Even Ming Gu revealed a wary expression. What was this? Even the geniuses of the Environmental Protection Association who were expert cleansing couldn't withstand the corrosion power… It felt so dangerous.
"Sigh…" Just as all the spectators were afraid of Wind Mirror's encounter, this so-called World Cleansing Demon Duck sighed and slowly turned around. It picked up the bandage and tied it around its eyes again.
"This world is filthy again…"
With that said, it pressed its two duck palms together, and a blue-gold holy light spread from its body. In an instant, the light enveloped the entire domain. The deep abyssal power seemed to have encountered a frightening existence and quickly disappeared…
Light also enveloped its opponents, and the abyssal power on their bodies quickly faded. However, the corrosion of their will just now had already made them completely unable to withstand it, causing them to faint.
Duckie turned its back to everyone and slowly left the venue…
Only the words [Winner: World Cleansing Demon Duck] were left.
"This…"
World Cleansing… At this moment, the expressions of many people changed. For the first time, they understood the meaning of its name.
"World Cleansing Demon Duck, no wonder it's ranked before the cleansing star spirit. It does have some abilities." In the headquarters of the Environmental Protection Association, a figure smiled and spoke. It was Great God Bing Ling. As a super divine level purifier, she also paid attention to this battle.
"This batch is really scammy!!!"
As the World Cleansing Demon Duck displayed the power of the abyss that was enough to ignore the super genius of the Environmental Protection Association and the cleansing power that far crushed the other party, displaying the frightening talent of cultivating both good and evil. In an instant, many old contestants felt their balls hurt and felt the cruelty of this year's God Sealing Battle.
That Newcomer Ranking… didn't seem to be a problem. These guys were really ridiculous.
"It's alright, it's alright." In a room, Ming Gu said to his silent contracted partner, "Fortunately, our luck is pretty good. We haven't encountered these monster newbies. If we encounter these guys too early, we might be a little tired. Although our next adversary is also a newbie, it didn't enter the rankings. It shouldn't be strong."
"Our adversary seems to have freely advanced two rounds…" said a ghost-like creature beside Ming Gu.
"Well, its luck is pretty good, but unfortunately, it encountered us in the third round. I wonder if its luck is good or bad." Ming Gu shook his head and didn't think too much about it. Did the lcuky contestant have a chance to be tested by the super divine computer in the second world? Did it have a chance to enter the rankings?
....
"Damn it!!" At the same time, in Shi Yu's room, Shi Yu looked at the amber that was gradually melting on its own and fell into deep thought. He took a few steps back.
Damn, could this thing still transform itself? Was it because it was too hot today?
Shi Yu looked at his naked physique lying on the ground. For a moment, he quickly found garb and planned to put clothes on this body first. Even if he wanted to study it, he couldn't keep studying his naked body, right? It affected his thoughts too much.
He flipped through his garb cabinet. Panda outfits, ancient clothes for disguise, old man clothes, child clothes, White Tiger Divine Armor, archeological clothes, and a pile of equipment with strange uses. For a moment, he had difficulty choosing. He didn't know what to adorn for this super divine physique and his previous life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1475 Luck is Also a Part of Strength (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1475 Luck is Also a Part of Strength (1)
After the competition between the World Cleansing Demon Duck and the Wind Mirror, the audience began to believe in the strength of the ten newbies. Perhaps the son of the Demon Emperor was really only ranked tenth out of the newbies this year.
No one knew what special day this year was. So many monster newbies had actually appeared in one go. The feeling these ten newbies gave people this year was that their strength wasn't inferior to those ranked in the old top ten rankings. This was ridiculous.
On this point, not only did passers-by feel it, but the top 10 of the last God Sealing Battle also felt the pressure. Some people were worried that they would be squeezed out of the top 10 this year.
"Eleven's opponent forfeited again."
"Chi Tong's opponent too…"
Today's God Sealing Battle was still the same as before. When the weaker contestants encountered too strong an opponent, they directly forfeited. There was no need to carry out such a battle at all. It couldn't even have the effect of training themselves.
Just as the audience had predicted, apart from the battle of the World Cleansing Demon Duck that was a little interesting, the battles of the other ten newbies were either forfeited or insta-killed.
"Ming Gu." In a certain battle facility, Ming Gu was meditating with his eyes closed, waiting for the next battle. Suddenly, a voice sounded, making the eternal second place, Ming Gu, open his eyes.
"Zavay…" Seeing his old opponent, Zavay, Ming Gu said, "What are you doing here? You're still home after suffering such a serious injury."
Zavay said with an unfriendly expression, "Are you very happy that I was eliminated?"
Ming Gu chuckled and said, "Of course, I'm happy. I still have to thank Eleven for eliminating you. Perhaps I can bask in its glory this time and get first place again."
"I hope so," Zavay said. "We're considered old friends. I know you need a permanent teleportation array, so I'll give you a chance."
With that said, he took out a memory crystal ball and threw it to Ming Gu. "After activating this crystal ball, you can personally experience the battle with that Eleven with my perspective."
"My ability counters yours, but your ability isn't countered by Eleven… All the best," Zavay said.
"You…" Ming Gu took the crystal ball and was stunned. Then, he smiled and said, "Consider it compensation for suppressing me for 79 years? Then I'll accept your kindness."
He indeed needed a permanent teleportation array very much. On the other hand, Zavay participated in the God Sealing Battle to challenge himself and for honor. The Cosmic Crow Race had long had a permanent teleportation array. Although the more the better, it wasn't that urgent.
Otherwise, with Zavay's strength and a few contract pendants, he could definitely clear the level.
"Take first place." With that said, Zavay turned and left, leaving Ming Gu alone.
"Don't worry, Zavay. I'll take your share and take first place." Ming Gu didn't expect Zavay to send such a big gift. When he watched the battle between Zavay and Eleven, he was indeed very confused, but with this, he could probably understand Eleven better.
Before that, he would deal with that lucky Ling first.
…
"That's it!" On the other side, Shi Yu chose a set of panda pajamas for his previous life after choosing for a long time. It was easy to wear and it was very loose, making it more convenient to study his previous life form.
It would probably be very difficult to wear the other messy clothes.
Unfortunately, Buggy wasn't around. Otherwise, Buggy could directly imagine a set of clothes to wear.
"Mi!!" At this moment, Little Zi flew over from the room and told Shi Yu that the battle between Shi Yu Ling and Ming Gu was about to begin.
It and Qi in its body were already waiting to watch the battle and asked Shi Yu if he wanted to watch it together.
"No…" Shi Yu glanced at his previous life form on the sofa and said, "I won't watch. In any case, the winner will be Ling."
Little Zi: "…"
Little Zi and Qi watched it themselves. They felt that this battle was quite interesting because Ling had already stated that although it could overcome its opponent, the consumption would probably not be small…
…
Battlefield 71717 opened not long after.
The protagonist of this battle was Ming Gu vs Ling.
The attention of this battle could at least be ranked in the top five of all the battles currently underway.
The reason was very simple. The 79th consecutive champion, Zavay, had already been eliminated. Among the old generals, only the 101-time consecutive champion, Ming Gu, was left.
The two of them had almost taken first place in the past 200 years. The other old contestants had always been able to wander behind the third place. There was clearly a certain difference in power between them.
Now that Zavay had lost, it depended on how far Ming Gu could go. Would he continue to be second place, or could he finally overcome Eleven, an opponent that Zavay didn't defeat?
Apart from that, there was another thing. It was Ming Gu's opponent. It was very intriguing and lucky to have advanced freely twice. This kind of luck seemed to be the first in ten thousand years.
However, after good luck, it was unlucky enough to encounter the 101-time consecutive champion, Ming Gu. This difference in luck was also a complete gimmick. It reached the top of the trending list and attracted a large amount of traffic.
On the starry sky arena, two figures slowly appeared.
The venue of every combat of the God Sealing Battle was random. Any environment might appear. This battle was the venue of the starry sky of the universe, a huge arena floating in the starry sky of the universe!
"We actually drew such a rare venue." After Ming Gu entered, he sighed slightly. The starry sky venue had the lowest opportunity of being drawn out of all the maps. It was only 1%.
However, it actually didn't matter what venue it was. He didn't have much require for venues, and no venue could weaken their combat power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1476 Luck is Also a Part of Strength (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1476 Luck is Also a Part of Strength (2)
When Ming Gu came out, he also summoned his contracted Ghost God.
This was a strange life form with a black and purple armor body. Its feet and shoulder armor were filled with blue and white flames. It didn't belong to any large race in the starry sky. It was purely a battle monster cultivated by Ming Gu.
"Huh?" Ming Gu suddenly looked at his opponent. He realized that his opponent was actually a model-like white mini battleship. It was actually a mechanical life form!!
Not only Ming Gu, but most of the audience was also slightly stunned.
They looked at Ling, who had appeared opposite Ming Gu, and fell into deep thought. That Ling who had freely advanced two rounds was a mechanical life form?
As Ling's profile picture was a white-haired virtual human image on the official website, the audience thought that Ling was also a human.
Just as the audience was puzzled, the image of a virtual mechanical spirit appeared above the cosmic battleship. It was the Lucky Ling in people's impression.
"It's really a mechanical life form. Where's your mechanic?" Ming Gu said calmly. Generally speaking, other races might not have contractors, but mechanical races basically had a mechanic.
Because in the universe, mechanical races were originally races created by humans at the start. Although in other places in the starry sky, some mechanical races might leave humans after becoming stronger and take over, on the World King Planet, mechanics were still firmly in the hands of humans.
"I'm enough alone," Ling said.
"Master is watching the battle."
"Then your mechanic is quite strange." Letting the mechanical pet register for the competition itself while he watched the battle from the back…
Even if he wanted to test the mechanical performance, he should have come to the scene personally.
"What special machine are you? You can actually freely advance twice under such a large base number," Ming Gu asked again.
Ling said, "Sort of, so you have to be careful. Please do your best."
Ming Gu was stunned. He had said a few more words to Ling because of Ling's good luck twice, but he didn't expect to receive such an answer from Ling.
As for Ling, the reason why it chatted more with Ming Gu was because the other party had a certain replication value like Zavay.
However, the replication value of Ming Gu's contracted Ghost God was much smaller than Zavay's. This was because Ming Gu could win 101 championships not because his pet was impression, but because Ming Gu himself was very strong!
Ling naturally investigated Ming Gu. The other party's talent was very high, and the "divine contract" ability was very abnormal.
The "divine contract" was a special contract method developed by the Beast Tamer in the starry sky of the universe. It was equivalent to the ultimate development of the Beast Taming Space.
It was a "contract" that could only be completed by a Beast Tamer with a certain level of talent.
Ordinary Beast Tamers and pets only signed contracts with "servant contracts" and "equal contracts". In the "servant contracts", the master's side had stronger control over the servant's side, and it could even decide the other party's life and death with a thought.
As for the "equal contracts", it was a relatively normal contract method.
These two contract methods were very popular on Blue Planet.
Apart from these two contracts, there was actually another contract model called the "divine contract". It was the mainstream contract method on World King Planet.
Beast Tamers with strong talent potential could achieve some unbelievable modifications to themselves and their pets through the contract method of "equivalent exchange" when signing a "divine contract" with their pets.
For example, when a Beast Tamer with outstanding talent signed a contract with a pet, they could issue rules to themselves. After the two parties signed the contract, the growth speed of the companion in the Beast Taming Space was a hundred times faster than in the ordinary Beast Taming Space. And the price he had to pay was that he could only ink a contract with this pet in his life.
Depending on the talent of the Beast Tamer, the form of the divine agreement was also different. 99% of the Space Beast Tamers chose to contract only one pet in exchange for their own strengthening and several times the growth speed of their pets.
There were also a small number of Beast Tamers who could complete a stronger "divine contract" because their talent potential was stronger.
Ming Gu was such a genius. The divine agreement he completed was "The effect of the beast-taming ability can reach ten times the normal state."
As for the price, no one knew. He could probably only contract one pet.
However, this also made Ming Gu not need to rely on any powerful divine beast at all. Even if it was just an ordinary pet, under the enhancement of his Beast Taming Talent Enhancement Effect, it could defy the heavens and kill gods.
This ability was also the reason why Ming Gu from a second-level domain and not some super divine faction could reach this stage.
Even if the pet didn't come from a large race, it could still occasionally kill Zavay under his strengthening. If it weren't for the fact that Zavay could revive twice, Zavay really wouldn't have been able to defeat Ming Gu with just one life.
"What's that Lucky Ling saying…"
"Let Ming Gu do his best?" At this moment, the audience discussed, as if they had heard something fun.
"Let me do my best…" Ming Gu also chuckled.
If Zavay, Eleven, and Chi Tong remarked this, he might have been more serious.
However, this little device in front of him, which didn't even have a mechanic beside it, remarked such a thing…
What rights did it have to do that?
"Could it be… luck?" Ming Gu remarked with a smile.
"Didn't you hear… that luck is also a part of strength?" Ling also smiled.
"Look, something seems to have changed in the starry sky."

chapters.title: Chapter 1477 Luck is Also a Part of Strength (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1477 Luck is Also a Part of Strength (3)
As soon as Ling finished speaking, the expressions of Ming Gu and his contracted Ghost God changed. They suddenly felt that something was wrong with this Starry Sky Battlefield.
