White waves slowly spread in all directions on this Starry Sky Battlefield. A huge circular storm eye seemed to have surrounded the entire arena.
This change stunned the audience and also made the battle elf observing the battle situation quickly analyze, "Unbelievable!"
"The prototype of a Starry Sky Storm has appeared on the battlefield of 71717!"
"As everyone knows, the competition venue of the second world is a perfect simulation of various natural environments. The weather and disaster changes in natural environments, such as rainstorms, snowstorms, heavenly lightning, volcanic eruptions, tsunamis, earthquakes, and typhoons, will also appear randomly, increasing the chances of battle."
"Among them, there might be disasters in the Starry Sky Arena. The Starry Sky Storm is one of them. However, the chances should be very small. Contestant Ming Gu and contestant Ling actually encountered the Starry Sky Storm!"
"Under the Starry Sky Storm, it's very likely that the battle will be very difficult to continue. Just resisting the Starry Sky Storm will probably take all their strength. There might even be a situation where both parties die from the disaster…"
"Next… if both parties still want to fight, it'll be dangerous."
"The best choice is to end the battle quickly before the Starry Sky Storm takes shape, or one of them chooses to admit defeat. Otherwise, after accidentally entering the storm, the battle situation will be extremely uncontrollable."
After speaking to the battle sprite, the spectators from the various realms who were paying attention to this God Sealing Battle were stunned.
"Starry Sky Storm?"
"Holy shit, a Starry Sky Storm actually appeared."
"Damn, is this Ling a machine created by Lady Luck? A cosmic disaster actually came to cause trouble in a battle that originally had no suspense."
"It's completely up to luck to be swept into the Starry Sky Storm. If they're lucky, they might be swept into the weak area. If they're unlucky, they'll directly be swept into the disaster area."
"This Ling can't be lucky enough to win this battle with an accidental cosmic disaster, right?"
The second place in the God Sealing Battle, Ming Gu, encountered the Starry Sky Storm in the battle. In an instant, this hot topic became a trending topic.
It made Zavay and the other contestants, who originally didn't pay attention to this battle, have no choice but to pay attention.
"The Starry Sky Storm isn't a big problem either. The power of the Starry Sky Storm in the second world is far inferior to the real universe."
"Moreover, as long as Ming Gu insta-kills Ling, there won't be a problem. There's no need to bet on luck with it."
"I'm now certain that this mechanical life form is definitely a mechanical race created to mainly cultivate luck. Its luck is too heaven-defying."
The battle that was already very popular increased again with the appearance of the cosmic disaster, the Starry Sky Storm.
In the starry sky arena, the corners of Ming Gu's mouth also twitched. If he had known earlier, he wouldn't have stated so much nonsense to Ling. Damn, the other party's luck was really good!!
This time, he believed it.
"But do you think you can win like this?" Ming Gu asked. At the same time, he activated a strengthening talent, and light lingered in his eyes.
Beside him, the contracted Ghost God immediately stretched out its palm and slapped in the air. Space ripples rippled above Ling, and this space seemed to be connected. A huge palm a hundred meters long was directly slapped out of the dimension.
Although the palm wasn't big, it swept up monstrous dark spatial power, as if it contained the power to cover a planet, and slapped at the small battleship!!
"Ming Gu attacked. It looks like he wants to end the combat quickly and instantly kill his opponent!"
The audience witnessed it and felt that the combat was about to end.
However, at this moment, the mini battleship seemed to have also started to counterattack. The scale gradually increased under the nine-colored light. As the battleship increased in size, the nine-colored divine light kept shooting out, making Ling look like an angry hedgehog.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom!!
As the palm landed, light stabbed out. In the next moment, the two parties caused contact. The dark palm was pierced by the nine-colored light until it was riddled with holes. The palm instantly disintegrated, and the space behind collapsed under the light. The battleship also enlarged to nearly a thousand meters in length at this moment.
"This…" The audience was shocked when they saw this. Ling actually blocked this attack.
"You missed the best opportunity to attack." In the huge extraterrestrial battleship, the mechanical spirit, Ling, sat in the driver's seat and looked at everything outside before saying calmly.
On the other side, Ming Gu also frowned. He didn't expect this guy's strength to not be weak either. He in fact couldn't hurt the other party with a normal strengthening range.
"I admit that you have some abilities, but this is the end." Ming Gu felt that he couldn't save energy anymore. With a wave of his hand, a monstrous light erupted from his body. The aura of the contracted Ghost God beside him also rose steadily. Soon, like Baby Ginseng activating the Time Fruit, it obtained power comparable to the divine level or even exceeded that of a primary god.
However, just as Ming Gu was about to attack again, just as Ling said, he missed the best opportunity to attack. The Starry Sky Storm in the distance suddenly increased in speed. In an instant, the storm formed.
The originally white storm wave began to be dyed in red, green, blue, gold, purple, various colors. Air, electricity, heat, light… The moving and chaotic extraterrestrial energy storm swept up, looking very much like a surging sea, directly devouring the cosmic battleship opposite, making Ming Gu and the others lose their target.
Moreover, it devoured Ming Gu and the contracted Ghost God from all directions!!
"Too late!" Seeing this, Ming Gu instantly fused with the contracted Ghost God and activated the tenfold fusion enhancement state. But even so, the instant devour of the Starry Sky Storm still caused Ming Gu and the others feel great damage.

chapters.title: Chapter 1478 Luck is Also a Part of Strength (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1478 Luck is Also a Part of Strength (4)
"Ah!!!!" Under the sweep of the Starry Sky Storm, the Ghost God and Ming Gu let out a miserable cry. Apart from fusing, it activated its defense-strengthening talent and life-strengthening talent. Only then could the Ghost God and Ming Gu catch their breaths in the Starry Sky Storm.
Hu hu hu hu…
Ming Gu forcefully stood in the corrosion of the Starry Sky Storm. Its body quickly flew towards the cosmic battleship Ling and said, "Even in the Starry Sky Storm, I, Ming Gu, am still invincible. However, I have to say that you're really a lunatic. Aren't you afraid of dying in this chaotic storm?"
Ming Gu directly moved in the Starry Sky Storm!
Seeing this scene, the audience was shocked.
"As expected of Ming Gu."
"Even the Starry Sky Storm can't trap it."
"Ling is finished. Although mechanics have more experience in resisting cosmic disasters, in this disaster, they still have to face a strong enemy. I'm afraid they'll be shattered. There's no way out."
The audience locked onto the cosmic warship Ling again, wanting to see what method Ling had used to resist the Starry Sky Storm. Even if mechanics were more experienced in resisting cosmic disasters, it was definitely filled with danger in this environment.
However, what stunned the audience was that Ling, who was in the Starry Sky Storm at this moment, floated quietly in the storm as if nothing had happened. There wasn't a trace of it on the ship. These storms seemed to have consciously missed it.
"I found you!!" Finally, Ming Gu, who was traveling through the Starry Sky Storm with his strength, tore open a storm and found Ling's true body. His gaze was unfriendly. Just as he was about to attack, a violent storm directly swept towards Ming Gu and blew him away.
What was going on?
Ming Gu roared. This damn storm. He shuttled over again, but a storm devoured him again!
The audience looked at Ming Gu, who was targeted by the Starry Sky Storm everywhere, and then at the completely unaffected Ling. For a moment, they couldn't understand.
"When you can't hold on anymore, surrender."
"Do you really think I'm just lucky?"
"I created this Starry Sky Storm, it wasn't naturally formed. As I said, luck is also a part of strength, and I have the absolute strength to defeat all opponents." A calm voice came from the battleship. In the next moment, under the astonished gazes of Ming Gu, who was blown away, and under the incomprehensible gazes of the audience, a passage slowly formed in the Starry Sky Storm. The warship Ling calmly turned around and sailed out.
"Impossible!" At this moment, it wasn't just Ming Gu in the storm. A large number of mechanics and cosmic disaster researchers in the audience were astonished by Ling's words and the changes after the Starry Sky Storm encountered Ling.
At this moment, the battle elf was also a little stunned. She quickly investigated and traced the venue data. Then, she was stunned.
"Starry Sky Storm… Starry Sky Storm…"
"It doesn't seem to be born naturally… It's really artificial!"
"This… contestant Ling created the Starry Sky Storm and trapped contestant Ming Gu inside!"
After saying that, countless cosmic life forms who had a headache from the cosmic disaster looked at the battle scene in confusion.
At this moment, the warship had already left the Starry Sky Storm area. A beautiful mechanical spirit figure also stood on the battleship and looked at this beautiful storm scene.
"Devour!!!" In the Starry Sky Storm, Ming Gu lost his ability to think and couldn't understand. In the face of the terrifying pressure from all directions, he activated the devour ability. His body was like a black hole, devouring the energy that caused them damage.
In the face of Ming Gu's struggle, the mechanical spirit, Ling, only stretched out its slender hand and gently pointed at the interior of the Starry Sky Storm. A spiritual bead immediately materialized on its fingertip. Then, slowly, this spiritual bead was dyed with orange-red light, emitting hot fluctuations. It was like a mini star as it floated towards the Starry Sky Storm!!
Boom!!!!
When the Wind Spirit Bead touched the Starry Sky Storm, it directly spent many solar storms. The violent storm increased in chaos again. At the same time, it swept out and swept towards Ming Gu.
A huge amount of energy surged over, instantly exploding Ming Gu's body. With a bang, they produced an explosion and were blown away by the storm with serious injuries.
Until this moment, all the spectators were completely stunned. They had entered early. Seeing Ming Gu being crazily tortured, Zavay, who had entrusted the "hope of first place" to Ming Gu, also fell into deep thought, his body trembling slightly.
[Ming Gu… What are you doing!!]
"What… what a joke…" The audience spoke hoarsely. This, this, what was going on?
That Lucky Ling, who had passed twice, could actually casually control the Starry Sky Storm?? This Starry Sky Storm looked like it was really created by her??
The 101-time champion, Ming Gu… was being beaten up by her?
The audience, who originally thought that Ling was unlucky this time, was stunned.
"Am I still f*cking awake?" In the central realm, outside a certain venue, a contestant from the God Sealing Battle wore spectator glasses and muttered.
"What's wrong with Ling? Isn't she a newbie? Didn't she not get ranked in the top 10? How… How can she have such strength?"
"Wait a minute, could it be that because she freely advanced twice, her strength wasn't detected? In that case, the son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, can't even rank in the top 10 of the newbies??"
The son of the Demon Emperor, who had just walked out of the hospital and was about to leave the central realm and go home to cultivate bitterly, stopped on the spot when he heard the shocked voices of passers-by. He clenched his fists in anger, feeling that his noble son's bearing was completely gone.
…
Super cool!
Another super cooldown!
The monster rookie, Ling, who had yet to be recorded, directly stepped on the head of the hundred-year-old second place, Ming Gu, and ascended to the top of the trending list.
The name of the genius mechanical girl who controlled the Starry Sky Storm instantly swept across the World King Planet.
But at this moment, everyone wanted to know even more who the master Ling mentioned was!!
Ling… was actually a forbidden machine that had mastered a disaster skill. This completely astonished the various large factions.
At this moment, in the sky above the central domain, in the warship of the cosmic overlord army, a top-notch god ran back in panic.
"Captain Zi Jian…"
Captain Zi Jian, who was sitting in his seat, reading an ancient book and eating ice cream, looked at his subordinate and said, "Why, you found that ginseng emperor?"
They came from the camp outside the World King Planet to find the ginseng emperor who could create the Cultivation Fruit. For this, Zi Jian even sent top-notch divine subordinates to find it.
However, this top-notch god's expression didn't seem right?
"Captain Zi Jian… I've found traces of that ginseng emperor. However, just as I followed it for a while, I was instantly locked onto by the will of at least five super divine levels… The faction behind this ginseng emperor is too terrifying," the top-notch god stated with lingering fears.
"We can't afford to offend them."
"What???" Captain Zi Jian was astonished and instantly felt extremely afraid. Five super divine levels?? What a joke.
"Wait, we're going to make a deal, not assassinate. What are you afraid of!"
"Captain, five super divines!"
…
In the central realm, in World King City, the five super divines of Blue Planet gathered and asked the Space Emperor and Lin Feng.
"What's going on? Why is Shi Yu's pet targeted by the top god of the universe overlord army?"
The five super divines on Blue Planet were very nervous and afraid. They couldn't afford to offend the cosmic overlord army.
"Seniors, I don't remember Shi Yu offending the universe overlord army… But he's only a top-notch god. Don't worry," the Space Emperor said.
The Kirin Race super divine said, "This isn't a matter of level. That's a universe overlord army."

chapters.title: Chapter 1479 An Inescapable Name (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1479 An Inescapable Name (1)
At Shi Yu's residence.
Lin Feng returned and saw that the ancient corpse was thrown on the sofa in panda pajamas. He fell into deep thought and looked at Shi Yu, who was typing on his laptop.
"What are you doing?" Lin Feng said. "Where's the amber?"
"It melted by itself. I'm just checking some information," Shi Yu replied. "Senior Lin Feng, what's wrong?"
"It's not a big deal. It's just that not long ago, your pet ginseng baby was followed by the people of the universe overlord army," Lin Feng said. "But the other party has already been scared away by us."
Shi Yu stopped what he was doing and looked at Senior Lin Feng. "Baby Ginseng?"
Lin Feng nodded and said, "Do you have any judgment?"
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, "In my interaction with the cosmic overlord army, I only have a few encounters with Captain Zi Jian, an archeologist from Zi Jian's special forces. She admires my talent very much. As you know, she has invited me to join them many times."
"However, I don't think it's because of this. My pet sold the 'Cultivation Fruit' and the 'Reincarnation Fruit' to the people from Zi Jian's special forces. If they only followed Baby Ginseng, it's probably because of this. Given the number of fruits they bought with that little bit of money… they have probably been used up."
Lin Feng said, "So, it's for the transaction? Then why are they running?"
"Who knows," Shi Yu said. "Wait, Senior Lin Feng, didn't you say that they were scared away by you guys… Why are they so scared?"
Lin Feng fell into deep thought. "It's probably those five super divine seniors. When they saw that someone was following Baby Ginseng, they locked onto the other party with their thoughts and warned it."
Shi Yu was speechless.
The corners of Shi Yu's mouth twitched. "Anyone who's locked onto by five super divine levels will run, right? Can you confirm which army they are from?"
There were too many armies of the cosmic overlord army. Even those stationed on the World King Star were divided into several armies with different goals.
Lin Feng shrugged and said, "I haven't confirmed it yet. The factions here are too complicated, but if it's Zi Jian's special forces, it might really be for the transaction."
"These five seniors are much more reliable than I imagined…" Shi Yu said, "In any case, they're all here. When I'm free, let them accompany me to the Heavenly Spirit World. Let's move the Four Holy Ruins away."
"It's good to have a big boss protecting you."
"We definitely have to do this. In addition, they're not as reliable as you think." The corners of Lin Feng's mouth also twitched. "You don't know how nervous they were when they saw the universe overlord army following your pet."
"They even discussed it. The five of them will give the warning together. They were afraid that the warning alone wouldn't be taken seriously."
Shi Yu was speechless.
"Of course, they're not afraid of the top-notch god who followed Baby Ginseng, but they care about the reputation of the universe overlord army."
"I understand." Shi Yu nodded.
"However, for people like them, if they know that you want to take away the Four Saint Ruins, they'll probably be serious for a long time. They might be worried about provoking the Four Saints family."
"But it's not a big problem. As long as the permanent teleportation array is in your hands, they will definitely listen to you."
Shi Yu was speechless. "These seniors…"
Lin Feng chuckled and said, "I can understand them. They reached super divine levels because they were completely lucky. Moreover, there's actually a story behind their behavior."
"What story?" Shi Yu was curious.
Lin Feng said, "It happened not long after these five seniors reached the super divine level. At that time, they were also high-spirited and determined to do something big together. After all, they were the five most talented geniuses of the five major divine races. However, something big happened during that period of time."
"On World King Star, an especially impressive and awesome divine-level appeared. He killed seven first-level world overlords alone, which is seven super divine levels. Moreover, one of the seven super divine levels even had a good relationship with the five super divine levels. We just discussed cooperation not long ago. Tell me, when we encountered such a thing, how could the ancestors of the five great divine races on Blue Planet not be traumatized?"
"What?" Shi Yu was stunned. "A divine level slain seven super divine levels alone?"
Lin Feng nodded and said, "This kind of event is also a legend from a long, long time ago. It's said that at that time, the entire World King Planet was in turmoil. After that, not many people dared to mention it."
"It was likely the first time I knew that the five super divines of Blue Planet could also be so impressive. I immediately kept a low profile, afraid that others would also treat them as bosses that dropped resources."
Shi Yu said, "This person… who is he? Doesn't the World King care if he kills seven realm lords on World King Star?"
Lin Feng said, "The other party challenged according to the rules and is also a member of the World King Planet. Lord World King can't be bothered. As the saying goes, even if all the super divine levels in the universe die, it won't affect the status of these cosmic-level experts."
"This sentence was said by a universe overlord. At that time, he slain a few disobedient super divine level subordinates, and it was circulated as a famous saying."
"Anyway, the divine-level beings can challenge the super divines regardless of rank, it's an unwritten rule, nothing much to say about it. But the other side chose to kill the realm lord instead of going to the battlefield to kill enemy troops. We don't understand the details, and we dare not inquire casually. All I know is that this divine-level being is now one of the three strongest super divines on the World King Planet," Lin Feng said.
"It's a peerless, fearless man," Shi Yu said. "He slain seven and frightened at least five. He's too fierce."

chapters.title: Chapter 1480 An Inescapable Name (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1480 An Inescapable Name (2)
"Hehe, it's indeed fierce," Lin Feng said. "I feel that you also have this potential after reaching the divine level. However, in the end, it's also related to some super divine beings being too weak."
"Senior Lin Feng, how strong are your and Senior Space Emperor's battle powers now?" Shi Yu asked.
Lin Feng shook his head and said, "It's been a long time since we've improved much. Our current goal is to nurture a perfect god. At that time, the two of us should have a high chance of winning against a super divine level like the five major divine races on Blue Planet."
"Compared to the monster I told you about just now, there's still a huge difference. I guess he might have broken the perfect limit!"
"The perfect limit can be broken?" Shi Yu asked.
He still remembered that when he first arrived at the World King Planet, Lin Feng and the Space Emperor had told him.
The divine level was the process of condensing the Heart of God, cultivating the level of a divine skill, and increasing one's divine power.
Those who had just stepped onto the divine level were junior gods and low-level gods. As the divine power in the Heart of God increased, they would be promoted to intermediate-level gods, high-level gods, and top-notch gods. At every stage, after breaking through a threshold, they would be tempered by divine power and reborn, allowing their strength to take a qualitative leap.
Among them, the highest level of cultivation of divine skills at the divine level was the perfect level. After reaching it, there would be a bottleneck, and one would be unable to cultivate divine skills to transcendence.
Generally speaking, there were two types of top-notch gods. One was a god who relied on various strengthening resources and cultivated a large number of ordinary and trash divine skills to slowly accumulate divine power and raise his divine power level to the level of a top-notch god.
This kind of top-notch god had a huge amount of divine power, but he might not necessarily have mastered a perfect-level divine skill and cultivated it to perfection. On World King Planet, most top-notch gods were like this. They relied on the advantage of increased resources.
There was also a top-notch god whose divine power had reached the standard and mastered a perfect-level divine skill. This top-notch god was stronger and was called a perfect god. Apart from having rich resources, it also had to have a certain amount of talent.
Most of Lin Feng and the Space Emperor's ten pets had reached the top-notch Divine Realm. However, they were both the first top-notch gods and weren't perfect gods yet. However, this didn't mean that their talent was weak. Hundreds of years of cultivation were only the beginning for divine-levels. They still had a long time to improve.
In addition, with the huge battle power advantage of a Beast Tamer forming an army alone, it wasn't a problem for them to defeat ordinary, perfect gods. Otherwise, they wouldn't be qualified to assassinate the super divine level that was heavily injured.
And if they could nurture a top-notch divine pet that had mastered a perfect-level divine skill, their strength would increase further.
It could be said that a perfect god was the peak battle power of a divine-level, because it was impossible for divine skills to be cultivated to the transcendent level. This stage was the limit. If one wanted to advance to the super divine level, they could only rely on the source of transcendence.
However, at this moment, Senior Lin Feng also said that he suspected that the divine-level who killed seven super divines seemed to have broken the limit of a perfect divine skill and cultivated a transcendent-level divine skill. That was why he could be so fierce. This undoubtedly broke the common sense that was passed down in the starry sky of the universe.
"I don't know either, but I only know that the other party is so fierce. There must be something different about him from ordinary people." Lin Feng shrugged and said, "Do you know how to call such a person in the divine-level circle?"
"Epoch god! It means that there aren't many peerless, ruthless people who can appear in a cosmic era. Divine-level ones can resist super divines like dogs. Tsk tsk," Lin Feng said. "I originally didn't want to tell you this. After all, you're only at the quasi-divine level. However, looking at your performance, the perfect gods definitely can't stop you. I look forward to you nurturing a bunch of perfect gods and even epoch gods."
"In short, Senior Space Emperor and I don't know much either. When you see a senior like God Bing Ling in the future, you can ask for more guidance."
"I'll fight for it." Shi Yu smiled bitterly. "Then when the super divine ancestors of the five major divine races on Blue Planet advanced to the super divine level, they shouldn't have reached the level of a perfect god, right?"
Lin Feng said, "Probably. As long as one has the divine power of a top-notch god, they're qualified to process the source of transcendence. However, it's stated that top-notch gods only have the initial qualifications to refine the source of superiority and can't perfectly absorb the power of the source of transcendence. The stronger their divine power during refining, the stronger they become after breaking through to the super divine level. Therefore, after those five super divine seniors broke through, they're only the weakest super divine level."
"If it's a perfect god, after refining the source of transcendence, its strength will be stronger. Therefore, at the divine level, every enhance in divine power matters."
"He wasn't even a flawless god, but he was lucky enough to pick up the source of transcendence. Even if he becomes a super divine, it would be strange if he could be strong."
"As for those epoch gods who live in legends and can kill super divines above their grade at the heavenly level, even if they don't become super divines, they're not much weaker. And after becoming super divines, they're even stronger. So you know why the five super divines from the five major divine races on Blue Planet are so afraid of trouble, right?"
"In short, although his talent isn't bad, it's not enough to reach that realm. It was purely raised by luck. Well… I reckon that Senior Emperor Shi is in a similar situation. However, Senior Emperor Shi has experienced so much before becoming a god. His temperament should be stronger than that of these geniuses from big clans who have had smooth sailing in the deity race." Lin Feng touched his chin.
"That's for sure," Shi Yu said.
"Alright, I'm just here to remind you to pay attention to the cosmic overlord army. Well, there are also some other factions, such as spies of the Abyss Race. However, there's the headquarters of the Environmental Protection Association here. Those guys shouldn't dare to approach. At least in World King City, even the cosmic overlord army doesn't dare cause trouble easily. Everything has to follow the proper procedures."

chapters.title: Chapter 1481 An Inescapable Name (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1481 An Inescapable Name (3)
"Alright, I'll be careful. I'll remind Eleven and the others later." Shi Yu nodded.
After Senior Lin Feng left, Shi Yu looked at his previous life and fell into deep thought.
Primary-level god, intermediate-level god, high-level god, top-notch god… A top-notch god who cultivated a perfect divine skill was called a perfect god. A top-notch god suspected to have broken through the perfect limit was called an epoch god. A perfect god could slightly threaten the weakest super divine level, while an epoch god seemed to be able to kill weaker super divine levels…
Shi Yu was very curious. He wondered if the skill index could break this perfect limit.
…
In the central realm, the World King City, at the God Sealing Battle Committee.
The God Sealing Battle had just started, and they were forced to hold a meeting.
In a glorious conference room, there was a long conference table. Eight perfect gods from various races in charge of the God Sealing Battle sat on both sides and looked at the goateed old man who walked into the room.
"Hahaha, have you all had a headache recently?" As soon as the goateed old man entered, he took out ten photos and slapped them on the conference wall.
The ten photos were surprisingly of Eleven, Buggy, and the others.
"That's right, President Saatchi," one of the headless people said. "From Eleven defeating Zavay, to Chi Tong defeating Tian Shang, to Ling defeating Ming Gu, this group of guys listed as the ten strongest newbies has already turned this God Sealing Battle upside down."
"This is the first time it's so lively since we started working."
"Hehe, that's right," a furball in a box said. "The various departments under us are about to explode from the annoyance. At the moment, there are more than 100,000 media, family factions, and special institutions here to ask about them."
"If their information spreads like this, it will cause a huge commotion, right?" A seven-colored planet floated on the seat.
"I see." President Saatchi looked at the photo and said, "Who would have thought that these ten monster-like newbies all came from the same realm?"
"Moreover, it's a second-level realm."
"The one who recommended the God Sealing Battle to them is the realm lord of the Floating Realm, Wang Kong."
"However, this isn't the most important thing. Most importantly, there's an inescapable name behind most of them."
President Saatchi took out another photo and slapped it in the middle of the ten strongest newbies. It was surprisingly a photo of a human.
"Him, Shi Yu."
Many members below discussed. If it weren't for the fact that they were members of the God Sealing Battle Committee and could directly transfer the registration information of the contestants, they definitely wouldn't believe that these ten newbies with ridiculous monsters actually came from the same realm.
Moreover, the strangest person was Shi Yu.
It was as if it was a clue that connected everything, making them have a bold guess.
"If nothing goes wrong, the champion of this year's God Sealing Battle will be one of them," President Saatchi said. "Let's see what they want to show us later."
"Will the Floating Realm, this second-level realm, rise because of this?"
"But before that…" President Saatchi pasted another photo. In the photo, it was a huge humanoid skeleton in a wide mage robe. White flames spread from its eyes, deep and cold.
"Luster is the leader of the cosmic overlord army's 177th Army and is a transcendent-level undead. Just yesterday, the cosmic overlord army's 177th Army and Zi Jian's special forces both applied to enter the World King Planet. Among them, Zi Jian's special forces haven't shown significant activity, but the 177th Army's intentions are clear. Luster brought a group of Level 9 Beast Tamers and quasi-divine beings from the cosmic overlord army, aiming to have a discussion with the quasi-divine beings of the World King Planet."
"Obviously, they're here to bring about trouble," President Saatchi said. "Moreover, they're targeting our God Sealing Battle."
"These guys really know how to cause trouble," the box god remarked unkindly.
"Is this bastard military using our quasi-divine as a training tool?" The headless person said angrily, "Wasn't it enough to abduct so many people last time?"
"I remember it was 300 years ago. This 177th Army came once."
"Yes." President Saatchi affirmed and said, "Our authority is insufficient and can't be stopped. However, considering public opinion, since they're here, we definitely can't let them return successfully. We can't let it be like 300 years ago."
"Don't disturb the normal contestants first. Box, you have a good rapport with Zavay in private, right? Just ask Zavay to accept their invitation to battle," President Saatchi said.
"Yes." The box fur ball affirmed and sighed in its heart. This cosmic overlord military had really come to bring about trouble at the wrong time. In the past 200 years, they had won 79 and 101 titles in the God Sealing Battle. They had just been eliminated and probably had nowhere to vent their anger… This year, it was also the batch with the most monsters. They definitely can't be as arrogant as last time.
…
"In the end, I still have to do it myself." On the other side, the archeological girl, Captain Zi Jian, who looked to be about 15 or 16 years old, personally found the ginseng emperor.
She was wearing daily casual clothes. When she saw the ginseng emperor in a research suit walking out of the fight facility smugly, she was just about to walk over, but suddenly, the ginseng emperor took out a Teleportation Stone and disappeared, making Captain Zi Jian a little speechless.
It left pretty quickly.
She closed her eyes slightly and flashed, teleporting to a street. At this moment, Captain Zi Jian suddenly sensed a divine-level consciousness locking onto her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1482 An Inescapable Name (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1482 An Inescapable Name (4)
She looked up and chased after him fearlessly.
"Just divine-level? Didn't they say it was five super divines?" she said.
"Little Wang, this person…" During this period, Blue Planet's Five super divines, who had been in charge of protecting Shi Yu and Shi Yu's various pets, were immediately shocked when they saw Zi Jian's appearance.
"Yes, she's the top archeologist of the cosmic overlord army, Captain Zi Jian… Her status in the cosmic overlord army is comparable to a super divine. As expected, she came to find Baby Ginseng."
"The other party shouldn't be an enemy. Leave this matter to Shi Yu to deal with himself," the Space Emperor said.
"Yi…" At this moment, Baby Ginseng also walked out of the other wall and looked at Zi Jian with a serious expression.
Seeing that the ginseng emperor was finally willing to appear, Captain Zi Jian smiled and said, "Teacher Ginseng, it's really not easy to see you. The Cultivation Fruit… is your masterpiece, right?"
"Yi!" Baby Ginseng nodded. Captain Zi Jian must like it too!
Zi Jian didn't care how many super divine levels there were behind Baby Ginseng. She went straight to the point and said, "Then I'll get to the point. I want to carry out a long-term transaction with you. I need you to provide me with a batch of the highest-level Cultivation Fruits you can create every year. Are you interested?"
At this moment, after realizing the powerful faction behind this ginseng emperor, Zi Jian also gave up on the idea of directly inviting the ginseng emperor to work for him. Now, he only wanted to reach a cooperation.
"Yi! (This, I can't make the decision. You talk to my boss. Follow me.)" Baby Ginseng said.
"Alright," Zi Jian said. "Teacher Ginseng, please lead the way."
At this moment, Shi Yu had already known what was going on through telepathy with Baby Ginseng. He quietly waited for Captain Zi Jian's arrival in his residence.
Soon, there was a knock on the door. Shi Yu personally opened the door. Outside the door, Captain Zi Jian, who had followed Baby Ginseng, was stunned when she saw Shi Yu.
"Captain Zi Jian, long time no see." Shi Yu grinned and said, "It's been more than half a year since we last separated in the Four Holy Ruins, right?"
"Yi! (It's my boss.)" Baby Ginseng said.
After being stunned, Captain Zi Jian grinned and said, "So you're the one selling the Cultivation Fruits and the Reincarnation Fruits behind the scenes."
"I recall your name is… Shi… Shi… Shi Yu, right? Wow, it hasn't been long. I still remember your name."
She smiled and observed Shi Yu. She never expected to see him in this way.
Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, "Captain Zi Jian is really forgetful. I thought that Captain Zi Jian would recall me, the 'archeological genius' you personally acknowledged, for the rest of yout life."
Zi Jian straightaway walked into the house and said, "I'm busy with work every day, so I don't have time to recall you. But if the next cooperation goes smoothly, I might be able to remember you."
Shi Yu invited Captain Zi Jian into the living room and said, "I already know why Captain Zi Jian is here. We can cooperate, but I want to trade through a designated resource."
"What?" Captain Zi Jian asked.
Shi Yu made a cup of tea and said, "Super divine stone, I want the super divine stone. Of course, the price of the super divine stone is even more expensive than the Cultivation Fruit. How many Cultivation Fruits can a super divine stone be exchanged for? Captain Zi Jian, tell me the number."
Captain Zi Jian looked at him and said, "Super divine stone? You know how to want it. I also like this thing very much. If I give it to you, I'll have much fewer toys."
Shi Yu said, "Isn't the Cultivation Fruit good? Stone gambling is so boring."
Zi Jian: "?"
"Do you have some special hobby?" Zi Jian suddenly thought of the disgusting taste of the Cultivation Fruit and couldn't help but say with a dark expression.
"Cough, cough, cough. That's the nature of the Cultivation Fruit. I mean, its effect."
"Captain Zi Jian, I don't know if you've noticed, but the baby ginseng is merely quasi-divine-level. It hasn't reached the divine level yet. But even so, the effect of its Cultivation Fruit is already so obvious. I guarantee that it can advance to the divine level in less than three years."
"At that time, the effect of the Cultivation Fruit will be even more perfect. Therefore, you won't lose out by exchanging the super divine stone. I'll make up for your losses in numbers."
Captain Zi Jian looked at Baby Ginseng, who was resting its face beside him, and suddenly realized that yes, this ginseng emperor was merely at the quasi-divine level at the moment. The Cultivation Fruit was created by a quasi-divine-level life form!
If Baby Ginseng reached the divine level, the effect of the Cultivation Fruit would be even more helpful to her.
"If the taste of the Cultivation Fruit can be improved, the transaction can continue," Captain Zi Jian said.
"This can be done slowly," Shi Yu said.
He knew that as a top-notch archeologist of the universe overlord army, Captain Zi Jian definitely had many channels to obtain the super divine stone. Shi Yu, who had opened the stone once and obtained his previous life, had already fallen in love with this feeling.
What skill fusion and evolution? It was already outdated.
Coupled with the gem cat's wish and Ling's good luck, opening the stone made Shi Yu feel even more fun.
This was also considered… archeology!
At this moment, Captain Zi Jian's communication device suddenly rang. Zi Jian took it out and took a look. She originally wanted to hang up, but when she saw Luster's name on it, she picked it up with an unfriendly expression. At the same time, she remarked to Shi Yu apologetically, "Sorry, I have some bones to pick."
Shi Yu: "?"
"Luster, what's the matter?" Zi Jian picked up the communication device and asked directly.
"Girl, I heard from my subordinates that your special battle team is also in World King City. Are you interested in watching our new recruit performance together?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1483 An Inescapable Name (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1483 An Inescapable Name (5)
"Is that all? I'm not interested." Zi Jian hung up and looked at Shi Yu again. "Let's continue."
"If you want the super divine stone, I don't have it in my hands now… Huh?" Captain Zi Jian was suddenly stunned. He thought of something and said, "Wait, there seems to be something in the 177th Army."
"177th Army? Super divine stone?"
Zi Jian smiled and said, "That's right. The 177th Army seems to have obtained a super divine stone not long ago, but my relationship with them isn't very good. If I can successfully get it, we'll do one trade first."
…
After Shi Yu sent Captain Zi Jian away, he leaned against the sofa and sighed deeply. He didn't comprehend if it was correct to deal with the cosmic overlord army, but Captain Zi Jian was indeed generous. There were many methods to deal with things, like super divine stones.
"Master." At this moment, Ling and the others appeared one after another. Just now, Shi Yu was discussing business, so they chose to avoid him.
"Master, did you see my battle today?" Ling said. "Ming Gu's contracted Ghost God's Dark Devour skill appears to be pretty good. It's very suitable for Eleven. It's a low-level replacement for the Black Hole divine skill. Unfortunately, it encountered my Starry Sky Storm and exploded them."
"I took a look."
"Very good," Ling said.
"In addition, I heard your transaction conversation just now. The chances of Captain Zi Jian coming for the super divine stone of the 177th Army of the cosmic overlord army aren't high."
"Why?" Shi Yu was stunned. "You still know about the 177th Army?"
Ling said, "The cosmic overlord army, the 177th Army, is one of the ten armies of the cosmic overlord armies stationed in the Cosmic Sea. The in-charge is a super divine level undead expert. Lust, who is also the person with whom Captain Zi Jian just hung up on… Yesterday night, the 177th Army arrived at the World King City and decided to let the new army communicate with the geniuses of World King Planet. The super divine stone is the prize they announced."
"The arrival of the 177th Army has already caused an uproar on the Internet today. It's mentioned that the Cosmic Crow Zavay is about to fight."
Shi Yu was stunned. "What's this?"
Ling said, "Master, you can roughly understand that the cosmic overlord army came to the World King Planet to contest us, just like how you once represented Ancient Capital University to challenge Imperial Capital University."
"During the God Sealing Battle, many geniuses from the World King Planet gathered in the central realm. The 177th Army brought their geniuses to invite these geniuses to battle. Among them, the super divine stone is one of the prizes they took out. Perhaps they can take away resources from the cosmic overlord army if they reach any conditions."
"Huh??" Shi Yu and the surrounding pets were stunned.
"Is this 177th Army here to do charity on the World King Planet? Do you mean that we can get the super divine stone just by defeating them?"
Ling said, "That's roughly what it means, but it's definitely not doing charity. The new recruits of the cosmic overlord army are also outstanding among demigods. They're very strong, not inferior to the top 10 of the God Sealing Battle. There are also people comparable to first place. They're all super geniuses they recruited from the entire universe."
"Don't forget, the cosmic overlord army is the strongest faction in the entire universe."
"And they won't do any losing deals. Usually, this kind of contest is their 'conscription method'. I've investigated. 300 years ago, this 177th Army came to cause trouble during the God Sealing Battle. After that, the 177th Army, which displayed powerful strength and financial resources, acquired a lot of new blood the next year. Many geniuses from the World King Planet joined the cosmic overlord army and became army recruits."
"Master, you can understand that they're here to advertise with resources."
"Of course, considering our strength, you can also understand that they're here to send resources. Master, if you're tempted, quickly take action. Don't let Zavay and the others, who have nothing to do after we eliminate them, take advantage of the opportunity."

chapters.title: Chapter 1484 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1484 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (1)
The matter of the cosmic overlord army's 177th Army descending in World King City to carry out the recruit trial and invite the contestants of this God Sealing Battle quickly fermented on the Internet.
Eleven defeated Zavay, Chi Tong killed the son of the Demon Emperor, and Ling's Starry Sky Storm crushed Ming Gu. These news stories came and went quickly. On the planet in the center of the Cosmic Sea, no topic could consistently occupy the absolute mainstream.
World King City, Epoch Square. A huge super battleship group surrounded the square. At this moment, this place had already become the training venue for the new recruits of the 177th Army. On the throne in the sky, an incomparably terrifying skeleton god was sitting upright in the sky.
Next to it sat two people. One of them, due to his unique profession, was only a divine-level Beast Tamer, but his expertise in archaeology gave him a status within the army comparable to Captain Zi Jian of the special forces, who was equivalent to a demigod.
The other was the president of the World King Planet's God Sealing Battle Committee, Sa Qi. Although President Sa Qi was also at the divine level, his pets were several top perfect gods. He had the battle record of joining forces with his pets to hunt foreign super divines on the battlefield. His battle record was even fiercer than that of Lin Feng and the Space Emperor.
Lin Feng and the Space Emperor cooperated with 20 pets to hunt a weak super divine that had just fought other super divines.
As for him, he was a super divine at his peak who had killed a few pets head-on. He was also a Legendary-level figure on World King Planet.
Although it was said that after that battle, President Saatchi was also seriously injured and only one pet died, paying a huge price, no one dared underestimate this old man. Now that he had retired and taken over the idle position of the God Sealing Battle Committee, no one thought that he wasn't qualified to sit with a super divine.
"President Saatchi, Zavay is pretty strong." The skeleton super divine, Luster, said in a deep voice, "Captain Zi Jian, what do you think?"
"Yes, yes, yes," Zi Jian said perfunctorily. She came here to ask Luster for the super divine stone, even if it was a transaction. However, who knew that Luster would make use of this and show off.
However, Luster also expressed that as long as no one could take away this super divine stone at the end of the recruit trial, there was no harm in giving it to Captain Zi Jian.
The premise was that Captain Zi Jian would give it face and visit the new recruit trial with it. Moreover, she had to help their 177th Army crack a super divine ruin.
Because Zi Jian wanted the super divine stone, she agreed. As for President Saatchi, he was here to supervise Luster. If there were no big shots presiding over the World King Planet, he believed that the cosmic overlord army would dare poach people on the spot, and with him presiding over here, Luster would undoubtedly restrain himself a lot.
At this moment, Epoch Square was surrounded by soldiers of the cosmic overlord army's 177th Army and members of the various factions in World King City. The major media outlets were allowed to broadcast the situation here passionately.
Because of this matter, the attention of the God Sealing Battle decreased a lot. Countless spectators were watching the "exchange" here.
Outside Epoch Square, Shi Yu, Lin Feng, the Space Emperor, and the others finally arrived at the scene. After entering, they found an audience seat around the arena in the center of the square and sat up.
After learning that Shi Yu wanted to fleece the cosmic overlord army, the five super divines on Blue Planet immediately lowered their faces. They didn't doubt Shi Yu's ability, but it was precisely because Shi Yu had this ability that their stomachs hurt with anxiety.
They kept feeling that Shi Yu was in a little danger. He was not stable and cautious enough. He was too reckless.
However, Emperor Kong and Lin Feng chuckled out loud and felt that it was not a big problem.
"This 177th Army is quite rich," Lin Feng said as he looked at the arena.
"That's right." The Space Emperor nodded and said, "Why didn't I encounter such a good thing before?"
This new recruit trial of the cosmic overlord army was in the form of an arena!
The newly recruited elites of the cosmic overlord army would defend the arena. The Level 9 rookies of the World King Planet could challenge them.
After winning one match, he could obtain a shocking reward. If he successfully challenged the arena consecutively, the reward would increase.
At the moment, the announced prize was that defeating a new recruit of the 177th Army could obtain 20 divine-level cosmic crystals.
Just the first level reward alone made many demigods and even divine-levels envious. After all, the worth of cosmic crystals was much higher than divine-level resources of the same level, and the cosmic overlord army took out 20 at once.
It could roughly support Shi Yu to travel to Blue Planet and World King Planet 10 times.
And this was only the beginning. After defeating two new recruits in a row, apart from the 20 cosmic crystals, he could also obtain three meditation jades.
If it was uttered that 20 stellar gemstones were nothing to a second-level realm lord like the Space Emperor, then the meditation jade began to be a good thing.
"Shi Yu, these three meditation jades should be able to allow you to reach the third level of the divine level in a short period of time," the Space Emperor said. "Work hard to get them back!"
"You're still a distance away from the divine level, right?"
"Yes." Shi Yu was also extremely tempted. The meditation jade was a cultivation resource targeted at human Beast Tamers! The effect was actually no different from those low-level cultivation resources. It could accelerate the effectiveness of meditation and increase the level of the Beast Tamer.
Although the effect was simple, the increase was really huge.
It was uttered that a new Level 9 Beast Tamer with normal talent could break through to the divine level in a year as long as he used a meditation jade to assist in his cultivation.
As for Shi Yu, he had the enhancement of the Cultivation Fruit, the Planet Blessing, and so on. If he had another meditation jade, after the God Sealing Battle ended, it was definitely stable for him to immediately break through to the divine level. Moreover, both Beast Taming Spaces could reach the divine level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1485 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1485 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (2)
As for the two additional pieces, they could allow Shi Yu to take another step forward at the divine level.
For Beast Tamers, after the divine level, it was divided into ten stages. Those who had just stepped into the divine level were at the first level of the divine level. If they broke through again, it would be the second level of the divine level. It meant that every time they broke through, the Beast Taming Space would undergo a tremendous change.
For the growth speed of pets, the Beast Tamer's own stats would have a greater increase in effect. Apart from that, this level change also determined the enhancement effect of the Beast Tamer's Beast Taming Talent and the strength of the Beast Taming Space.
A Beast Tamer at the peak of the divine level could basically casually increase the battle power of a junior god with ordinary strengthening talent to a high-level god. He could also turn the Beast Taming Space into spatial arms to suppress weak gods. A Beast Tamer at the peak of the divine level, even without additional battle power like pets, could forcefully sign a master-servant contract with a junior god and firmly control them with the Beast Taming Space.
At the moment, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng were both at the tenth level of the divine level. At the peak of the divine level, their levels were very fierce. However, it was also because the two of them had invested the focus of their cultivation and resources in themselves that their pets didn't have a perfect god.
In addition to the feedback of the pet's breakthrough, the Space Emperor estimated that these three meditation jades could allow Shi Yu to cultivate to the third level of the divine level in a few months. This was already a very shocking improvement speed.
Even the Floating Realm didn't have any reserves for such resources. They were even more precious than divine-level cosmic crystals. The Space Emperor and Lin Feng couldn't even bear to give their sons such resources. It was too wasteful. Their speed had increased, but it burned money. Basically, only geniuses heavily nurtured by super divine factions had the confidence.
Even among the resources that the Environmental Protection Association could exchange, there was no such thing. It had probably been divided internally.
As for defeating the three new recruits of the universe overlord army in a row, apart from the two resources mentioned above, it was time for the highlight. He could obtain the "super divine stone" and the "A-level Quests Token".
Although the mechanism of the super divine stone was relatively scammy, its value and rarity were indeed above ordinary super divine level resources. An unopened stone could be exchanged for many other super divine resources. It was also a very valuable resource.
This was also Shi Yu's goal.
As for the A-level Quests Token, it could allow the 177th Army to give it to the user for free to carry out an A-level Quest. The nature of the cosmic overlord army was similar to that of a mercenary. As long as they were given enough money, they would do almost anything. As for the mission token issued by the cosmic overlord army, they could freeload labor.
Three consecutive wins were the highest reward. The rewards after four consecutive wins were gone. It seemed that the cosmic overlord army didn't think that anyone could defeat their four new recruits in a row.
This wasn't arrogance, but the universe overlord army… really had this strength. The new recruits they could send weren't as simple as new recruits in name. They were all carefully selected kings of new recruits from countless demigods in the universe, from various races.
"Roar!!!" For example, the new recruit fighting Zavay now was a Yun Race Dragon, one with very terrifying strength. Under the roar of the Yun Race Dragon, Zavay's condition was extremely poor, and it looked tired.
Countless media outlets were following the situation in this battle. Until now, no one had been able to defeat this Yun Race Dragon guarding the first level. The other party's terrifying strength made everyone feel that it was close to the top five of the God Sealing Battle.
Initially, that was what everyone thought. However, as Zavay fought, the strength the other party displayed wasn't as simple as the top five. Even Zavay seemed to have fallen into a disadvantage.
In the dark land, the power of pollution spread and constantly corroded Zavay. Zavay also kept using time to slow down to prevent the Yun Race's radiation from worsening on his body. He even used Time Reversal to cleanse the pollution on his body.
This was difficult to stop. The powerful radiation pollution made Zavay consume a lot of energy. Even its five-element defense combination skill couldn't withstand it. As for its five-element attack combination skill, although it could heavily injure the Yun Race Dragon every time, it couldn't withstand it. As an elemental life form, it wasn't so easy to completely destroy this Yun Race Dragon.
At this moment, President Saatchi's expression was calm, but he was burning with anxiety. He could tell that the current Zavay couldn't let go at all. If there were still two Time Marks, this Yun Race Dragon was definitely not Zavay's match.
Unfortunately, Eleven had already removed Zavay's Time Mark. If it wanted to condense the Time Mark that recorded its current realm again, it would take a year even if it used a large number of time-element resources.
"This Zavay is quite disadvantaged toward this moment," the Space Emperor said.
"Well, although the pollution power of that Yun Race Dragon isn't because strong as Duckie's full battle power, it's not bad. Moreover, its physique is even stronger than Duckie," Shi Yu said rather seriously.
The cosmic overlord army genuinely didn't refuse anyone. As expected of a "neutral" faction in the universe. There were probably many races unpopular on World King Planet under them. Perhaps there were yet cosmic behemoths.
If the new recruits of the cosmic overlord army were all at this level, it was genuinely not easy to defeat three consecutively. Even first place, like Zavay, and second place, like Ming Gu, in the God Sealing Battle weren't easy.
"What a pity. The 'Yun Mo' of the cosmic overlord army has recovered again. Although its body has already shrunk to more than pair meters tall after it recovered this time, contestant Zavay's condition is additionally extremely poor. After contestant Zavay was polluted, it didn't choose to reverse time again, nor did it slow down the spreading speed of the radiation on its body. Is it weak?" A reporter appeared toward the battle scene and was extremely nervous.

chapters.title: Chapter 1486 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1486 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (3)
"Zavay…" In a certain hospital, Ming Gu, who was recuperating, was lying on a hospital bed. He looked at the current situation of the live broadcast on the wall screen and frowned. Damn it, what exactly was going on this year?
Back then, he and Zavay were so high-spirited.
But now, why could anyone step on them?
"Crow, I advise you to admit defeat. Otherwise, when the radiation power goes deep into your life source, it won't be that easy for you to obtain cleansing." Yun Mo laughed and mocked Zavay.
This was the first place in the God Sealing Battle?
Before it could laugh again, Yun Mo's expression stopped upon seeing Zavay's figure instantly disappear. At the same time, a huge hole appeared in Yun Mo's stomach. After Zavay appeared in the distance again, Yun Mo's elemental core was directly pinched by Zavay's hand which was shining with five-colored light.
"You're very long-winded. If it weren't for the fact that I'm not at my peak now, you would have long been unable to make a sound." After Zavay finished speaking, it crushed the elemental core, causing a crack to appear. Then, it looked up.
"Huh?" Above, out of the three important figures, Captain Zi Jian said in surprise, "Zavay is pretty ruthless to itself. It actually ignored the pollution and used the last bit of strength to accelerate time for itself. Its timing isn't bad. It's when Yun Mo is at its weakest."
"Huh?" Luster was also quite surprised. Time Deceleration and Time Reversal to deal with the Yun Race were indeed not bad skills, but Time Acceleration was undoubtedly a self-mutilating skill. Once Time Acceleration was accelerated, the pollution speed would also increase. Zavay actually chose this move in order to win.
"Great God Zavay won!!!" As Zavay threw the elemental core to the ground and the meteor dragon on the arena fell, the reporter and audience were overjoyed. However, in the next moment, Zavay itself, trembling and partially kneeling, reached the end of its strength.
"Damn it." Zavay was indignant. If it weren't for Eleven… Eleven forcefully sealed its mind, causing it to faint with a blurry consciousness and hand its cleansing quests to the God Sealing Battle Committee.
The scene fell silent again.
Seeing that Zavay and Yun Mo had fallen, for a moment, everyone looked at the platform. At this moment, the super divine expert, Luster, said, "Although both parties have lost their ability to fight, let's consider contestant Zavay the winner."
"To be able to defeat Yun Mo, who's ranked third among the new recruits of our 177th Army, its strength isn't bad. It's worth commending."
"Under the nurturing of our army, Yun Mo eats pollution sources that contain top-notch divine power as food every day and even successfully refines a wisp of super divine level pollution sources. It's not easy for Zavay to fight to this extent under pressure."
Upon hearing Luster's words, President Saatchi said unkindly, "Zavay consumed a lot of energy in the God Sealing Battle. Otherwise, it wouldn't have fallen after dealing with Yun Mo."
"Is that so?" Luster chuckled and said, "Then, is there anyone stronger than him? Our new recruits are still waiting."
Luster's words stumped President Saatchi. Apart from Zavay, the God Sealing Battle Committee indeed didn't inform anyone else in order to not affect the other contestants participating.
"It's alright, we can wait," Luster said. "Next, until the end of the God Sealing Battle, our army will carry out the recruit trial here. We also welcome this contestant Zavay. After Zavay recovers its state, it can challenge again."
After Luster finished speaking, the contestants and spectators of the God Sealing Battle of the various realms gritted their teeth.
Be it the Yun Race or the cosmic overlord army, most of the people on World King Planet were naturally unanimously xenophobic.
However, everyone also understood that the cosmic overlord army was incomparably terrifying. Just a new recruit of the 177th Army was actually so strong. Although Zavay didn't have two Time Marks, it could actually combat a life-and-death Zavay to a draw. This dragon definitely had the might of the top three of the God Sealing Battle, which was close to the strength of Zavay and Ming Gu.
In the end, in Luster's words, Yun Mo was only the third-ranked recruit of the cosmic overlord army's 177th Army?
What a joke…
"This is also normal… After all, that's the Yun Race… I wonder which is stronger, it or that World Cleansing Demon Duck," a Beast Tamer who had been to the battlefield said with his scalp numb.
The Yun Race, the Qi Race, the Abyss Race, the Flame Race, the Disaster Race, and more than ten other polluted races were all center races under the Dark King. Their racial strength wasn't necessarily inferior to the large races ranked at the top of the myriad races in the starry sky!
Although they didn't have the chance to participate in the ranking war of all races organized by the World King Planet because their faction camps were different, to be able to rely on more than ten races to combat the cosmic races of the World King Planet, the races under the Dark King couldn't be simple to deal with.
The Yun Race, Insect Race, and the Space Behemoth Race… Although these races were unknown among the myriad of races in the starry sky, no one dared say that they were weak.
"Where's God Eleven…" At this moment, the audience watching the recruit trial of the cosmic overlord military thought of Eleven, who had defeated Zavay. At this moment, only God Eleven could defeat the arena set up by the cosmic overlord army.
"Hurry up and invite God Eleven!! The opponents who matched God Eleven in the God Sealing Battle, if you know your place, admit defeat. Let God Eleven take time to choose this arena!"
"And God Ling!" The contestants of the God Sealing Battle and the audience were noisy.
Some people also felt that it was difficult for Eleven. After all, Eleven could defeat Zavay by self-mutilating. It was alright to win one war in this state, but it was probably very difficult to win three consecutive battles.

chapters.title: Chapter 1487 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1487 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (4)
As for Epoch Square, once Zavay lost and was carried down, no one dared challenge it again. It wasn't that they didn't have the courage, but they knew very well that it was impossible for them to win if they went up.
"Next, it's still the one who continues to defend the arena." At this moment, Luster super divine raised his bone finger under his mage robe and pointed at Yun Mo, who already had some of its elemental core crushed on the arena.
In the next moment, Yun Mo's elemental core restored itself. Its collapsed body also gathered on the elemental core again. In just a few seconds, this Yun Race Dragon returned to its peak state of five to six meters when it first appeared. Its condition instantly recovered to full restoration.
"Thank you, Lord Luster." It half-knelt towards the super divine Luster and bowed. Then, it got up and looked at the various God Sealing Battle contestants hidden in the audience.
"That guy still has some skills. However, I can only be ranked third among the new recruits of the 177th Army. Defeating me doesn't mean anything. Who else is there!!" The Yun Race Dragon shouted.
It was rather dissatisfied with Zavay's actions of forcefully defeating it without caring about its body being polluted.
"I'll do it." At this moment, a laugh came from somewhere in the audience. Shi Yu smiled and looked at the arena of Epoch Square.
Under the gazes of everyone, Shi Yu's psychic power flew onto the arena and looked at the meteor dragon opposite him.
"I'm Shi Yu."
Shi Yu appeared. In an instant, all the cameras locked onto him. Then, the audience was stunned.
Who was this?
Very few people knew Shi Yu.
"It's him!" However, there were also some people who knew Shi Yu, such as Captain Zi Jian and President Saatchi on the platform. They were stunned and had incredulous expressions.
"Eleven's… Beast Tamer!" In a certain realm, the purple-skinned holey person of the Star Refining Race was one of the few contestants who knew that God Eleven had Beast Tamers and contractors. However, it didn't expose the information about its "friend". At this moment, seeing Eleven's Beast Tamer appear, the purple-skinned holey person knew that this dragon was going to be finished.
"You… all know him??" Luster saw that President Saatchi and Captain Zi Jian were rather surprised by Shi Yu's appearance and immediately asked curiously.
Captain Zi Jian didn't even know the previous number one in the God Sealing Battle, Zavay. However, she actually knew this human?
Moreover, President Saatchi seemed to be very surprised.
However, Luster could sense that most of the people present weren't very familiar with Shi Yu. They looked very unfamiliar.
"Of course… I know him! He's a good archeologist." Zi Jian gritted her teeth. What did Shi Yu mean by appearing here? Could it be that Shi Yu wanted to take away the super divine stone himself?
Zi Jian's expression was unfriendly. If Shi Yu wanted to take away the super divine stone, what would she use to trade with Shi Yu?
However… she quickly heaved a sigh of relief.
Shi Yu was a youth who didn't know fear. The new recruits of the 177th Army were all at the top of the new recruits of the various armies of the cosmic overlord army. It was impossible for Shi Yu to defeat them.
Wanting to freeload? No way.
"Well… His pet performed pretty well in the God Sealing Battle. It's considered a newbie with potential this year," President Saatchi also said vaguely.
"I see." Luster continued to look at the arena quietly.
At this moment, under Yun Mo's gaze, Shi Yu also smiled and summoned his pets. In the Beast Taming Space, pets raised their hands crazily to register.
There was naturally no need to fight all of these opponents. They could win in a one-on-one battle, not to mention that Shi Yu had enhanced them. That was even more stable.
At this moment, Shi Yu actually didn't bring all his pets. He only brought a few that weren't competing for the time being. For example, Eleven and Susu had gone out.
Otherwise, Eleven and Susu would definitely fight to go on stage with the opponent of the Yun Race. The former would definitely want to taste the other party and see how it was compared to Yun An, while the latter would definitely want to cleanse this dirty dragon.
"Quack!!" In the Beast Taming Space, Duckie attempted its best to register, indicating that it desired to take over Big Sister Susu's mission. It still had rich experience with fighting dragons.
"Roar!!" Little Ji also tried its best to register, indicating that it had rich anti-pollution experience. Little Ji also questioned Buggy to teach Duckie a lesson.
"Alright, Little Ji it is. Duckie, you still have a competition in the afternoon. Little Ji is done battling in the morning. Let Little Ji do it." Shi Yu considered it for a moment and pulled Little Ji out. A terrifying dragon might immediately emitted from the summoning array. Accompanied by a substantial deterrence, a roar resounded through the entire venue!!
"Roar!!!" An extremely domineering world-destroying dragon ascended the arena and glanced at the Yun Race Dragon with the gaze of a dragon that looked down on the world.
At this moment, the two dragons appeared. Everyone was shocked.
"Holy shit, holy shit, isn't this the World Destruction Dragon positioned tenth on the Newcomer Ranking? I remember now. When the box god counted, it said that the World Destruction Dragon was a mechanical life form. Then there must be a mechanic. This person is the mechanic of the World Destruction Dragon?"
"Wait, isn't it ninth? Why is it tenth?"
"God Ling can definitely enter the top 10. I'll kick out the son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang. The status of the World Destruction Dragon will automatically decrease."
"Shh, be careful of Tian Shang arriving to kill you. However, tenth place for newbies… Can it be done? Even if it's positioned in front of Tian Shang, this Yun Race Dragon clearly has the level of the top three of the God Sealing Battle."
"No, I don't know. The state of the World Destruction Dragon that the box god estimated shouldn't have the enhancement of a mechanic. If it fights alongside a mechanic now, it might be stronger??"
Initially, people who didn't know who Shi Yu was instantly gave Shi Yu an identity when they saw Little Ji summoned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1488 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1488 Hurry Up and Invite God Eleven (5)
A mechanic of the World Destruction Dragon!
So he wasn't a nobody.
"Come on." However, the Yun Race Dragon didn't care who its opponent was. Its pitch-black eyes stared at Little Ji. In an instant, the arena was filled with black radiation fluctuations that spread in all directions.
In the face of this scene, Shi Yu floated up, as if he had no intention of interfering in the battle. In the next moment, Little Ji walked towards the Yun Race Dragon step by step.
"Huh?" When the Yun Race Dragon saw this hot dragon ignore the pollution radiation and walk over directly, its gaze couldn't help but turn cold. It strengthened the power of the pollution radiation and spread crazily!!
Boom!!!
Black light that filled the sky enveloped the World Destruction Dragon Little Ji. Seeing this, the contestants watching the battle trembled. Wait, why was this World Annihilation Dragon in a daze? It didn't dodge or block.
Even Zavay was careful not to touch this pollution radiation. After touching it, it immediately used moves to prevent the pollution from worsening and used skills to cleanse it. Why did this World Destruction Dragon directly step on it!
"Roar!!!" A large amount of pollution radiation attacked. Little Ji indeed didn't dodge or block, mainly because its movements were slow. The venue was so small, so it couldn't dodge even if it wanted to.
The reason why it was so confident was that during the battle with Duckie, it had long figured out a way to counter pollution.
Buzz!!!
The source of pollution attacked. In an instant, Little Ji's entire body was corroded. Black electric arcs appeared on its body, and the color of its skin began to change. Its eyes gradually became irritable.
This scene shocked the audience. They didn't know what Little Ji was thinking. After being polluted, the problem was huge.
Firstly, it would lose its mind, disregard its relatives, and even attack the Beast Tamer. Then, according to the contract, the Beast Tamer would also be mentally infested until both parties were assimilated and polluted into the Yun Race such that they could be controlled by the enemy. It could be said to be a relatively difficult power…
But in the next moment, Little Ji's roar made all the spectators, including the super divine Luster, unable to hold it in anymore.
"Roar!!! (As long as I don't have intelligence and don't have rationality, I won't be affected by the pollution source!!)" Little Ji resisted the pollution and directly entered the reverse scale berserk state with red eyes. The destructive power rushed to its brain and it entered a state where it didn't recognize anyone in exchange for an increase in strength.
Sacrificing its intelligence a step in advance and using its more familiar method to resist the radiation power of the Yun Race and fight poison with poison was its way of dealing with Duckie.
Apart from that.
"Roar!!! (Such a weak pollution power, even the anti-poison system installed by the Mechanic can't break through it!)" Little Ji roared. In the next moment, some of the radiation that entered its body was instantly expelled, shocking the audience.
Yun Mo ate top-notch pollution sources as food and had even swallowed super divine pollution sources. What anti-poison system could stop this pollution?
They looked at Shi Yu. Could it be that this was a mechanic who specialized in detecting and killing viruses?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and felt the gaze. However, he felt rather ashamed that this mechanic wasn't him, but Ling.
At this moment, Yun Mo couldn't believe that there was actually a life form that could withstand its contamination and charge at it without any effect. After all, even the previous Zavay couldn't do it.
"I am the overlord of the earth!!!" Under Yun Mo's stunned expression, Little Ji rushed towards it. A Sun Meteorite Sword that was filled with sun magma condensed in its hand and hit Yun Mo's physique with a boom, splitting its body into two.
"Roar!!!" Yun Mo let out a miserable cry. Its body quickly recovered and increased the pollution, but the World Destruction Dragon opposite still didn't seem to be affected. This affected Yun Mo's mentality very much.
"Impossible!!" Its dragon claws smashed towards Little Ji. Little Ji slashed at it with its sword, and Yun Mo was instantly sent flying again. In terms of brute force, how could it compare to the crazy Little Ji?
This didn't mean that Little Ji was stronger than Zavay. It was purely because it had encountered restraint again and encountered Little Ji, who had rich anti-pollution experience. The foe was relatively unlucky.
In the blink of an eye, the audience saw a crazy dragon chasing after another dragon that was releasing poison. In an instant, the audience fell into deep thought. Why did they feel that this World Destruction Dragon was even fiercer than Zavay?
Zi Jian, Luster, President Saatchi, and the others' eyelids twitched.
Ten minutes later, Little Ji was still crazy and panting. It, who didn't have a chance to perform in the God Sealing Battle, directly slashed the Yun Race genius into pieces this time. On the other side, Yun Mo's physique had already shattered. The elemental core was directly sent flying, and cracks appeared again.
The whole time, Shi Yu floated opposite. He was wearing a protective suit and crossed his arms as he watched the battle quietly.
"This…" At this moment, Captain Zi Jian was stunned.
President Saatchi also fell into deep thought. He knew that Shi Yu was a mysterious guy and was very fierce. He was related to Eleven and the others, but this battle completely exceeded his expectations.
Was this World Destruction Dragon also so fierce??
In a certain ward, Ming Gu and Zavay, who had been sent in, also looked at the battle scene on the screen on the wall in a daze.
"Zavay, is that guy's contamination force really very strong? Why do I feel that this World Destruction Dragon isn't afraid at all? And why were you so afraid at that time?" Ming Gu looked at Zavay.
"Why do I feel that if it were me this year, I could even defeat you?"
"Do you think your battle results are that good?" Zavay, who had just been cleansed, looked at the ceiling and was no longer willing to think about anything. It felt like this year's God Sealing Battle was targeting it everywhere. In the blink of an eye, why were a tenth place rookie's battle results even fiercer than its…

chapters.title: Chapter 1489 The World Where Only Zi Jian is Injured (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1489 The World Where Only Zi Jian is Injured (1)
"Thank you for the fight!"
The Yun Race Dragon fell, and the World Destruction Dragon won. Shi Yu didn't increase Little Ji's stats nor interfere the whole time.
The new recruit of the cosmic overlord army, Yun Mo, was suppressed by the World Destruction Dragon until it couldn't breathe. It was either collapsing or recovering.
This guy's vitality was indeed vigorous and very difficult to fight. Even the ferocious Little Ji took a long time to fight.
"Roar!!!" On the arena, Little Ji gradually recovered and roared, crushing the ground.
The audience looked at the World Destruction Dragon in fear. Its ferociousness just now made the audience like the Yun Race Dragon, unable to breathe. They could only concentrate on its brutal attack.
"This mechanical phantom beast… isn't simple. It can actually ignore the Yun Race's radiation and will for such a long time… Shi Yu really dares to play. There were several times when I thought that the World Destruction Dragon was going to turn around and beat him up…" Lin Feng said, "It's ranked at the end of Shi Yu's team. I thought it was very weak. Why is it also so heaven-defying?"
The Space Emperor said, "How can it be simple to successfully fuse the dark side of the Ancestral Dragon at the demigod level? As the saying goes, mechanics are the crystallization of all the intelligence of mechanics. There are so many monsters in Shi Yu's team. As long as this World Destruction Dragon inherits a little talent from every teammate, it won't be weak."
"Moreover, Shi Yu isn't bold. He should have enough confidence to deal with the enraged Little Ji."
Lin Feng chuckled and said, "That's true… His main talent is telepathy. His connection with pets is deeper than ordinary Beast Tamers. He might be able to awaken pets at any time. Even if he can't awaken them, Shi Yu still has a bunch of powerful pets. Even if he fights, he should be able to wake up this berserk World Destruction Dragon."
"He can play with this strategy as he wishes. There's indeed no need to worry about the pet's backlash."
Susu's cleansing…
The two of them looked at the super divine skeleton, Luster, wanting to see this super divine-level expert's current expression.
At this moment, the super divine expert, Luster, was very surprised. He didn't expect Yun Mo to lose so badly. He had spent a lot of effort to snatch this Yun Race genius from other armies.
Despite his new recruit being defeated again, Luster didn't say anything. From the perspective of World King Planet, President Saatchi wanted to defeat the 177th Army forcefully and let them leave dejectedly.
However, from Luster's perspective, it didn't matter if his three new recruits won or lost. A huge victory and displaying the strength of the cosmic overlord army would attract more geniuses. Losing also meant that there were even more monstrous geniuses on the World King Planet.
At that time, through the A-level Quests Token, the two parties would have a connection. In the future, there would be many opportunities to recruit them.
