If they could successfully recruit them, the 177th Army would still not lose out. Therefore, this exchange was an open plan. They wouldn't lose out either way.
"You're not bad," Luster said. "However, can it still fight? Do you want to continue challenging?"
At this moment, Luster directly asked. Seeing that Shi Yu didn't attack the whole time, it didn't know if Shi Yu had any way to recover his state.
"I'll continue challenging," Shi Yu said.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the scene was instantly in an uproar. Countless contestants and spectators of the God Sealing Battle felt that Shi Yu, who had suddenly appeared, was so fierce and awesome. Moreover, the World Destruction Dragon, which was ranked tenth, was so awesome. It was completely unexpected.
In that case, the top 10 of the Newcomer Ranking had the strength to take Zavay's life??
"Little Ji, come back." Just as the audience thought that Shi Yu was going to use some Beast Taming Talent to recover Little Ji's state, Shi Yu made another move.
He indeed retracted Little Ji, who was growling on the arena, and put it back into the Beast Taming Space. Instead, he seemed to have summoned a new pet.
"I'll leave the next opponent to you." This time, a short cat that gazed like a white Munchkin cat appeared on the arena.
"Wuu." As soon as Shorty appeared, it gazed around fiercely and watched as the members of the cosmic overlord army dragged the dragon away.
Little Ji, Duckie, and the others were pets with poor continuous battle abilities in the team. After Little Ji finished fighting, Shi Yu judged that unless he assisted, it might be a little unrealistic for it to fight two opponents of this level in a row, so he recalled it to the cleansing lake in the Beast Taming Space to soak in it.
As Little Ji's battle power was too reckless and its body was dirty, Shi Yu didn't really want to support it…
Instead, he recalled the equally eager Shorty to carry out the next round of battle.
The power of Shorty was alright. It wasn't as good as Little Ji and Duckie without the power of faith, but under the paywall state enhanced by the power of faith of the era in the Four Holy Ruins, Little Ji and Duckie definitely couldn't defeat it. When the newbies counted, the fact that the White Tiger and the Black Tortoise could directly rank in the top five basically showed how terrifying Shorty and the others were who could mobilize the power of faith of the era without any pressure.
"Meow~"
In Shi Yu's opinion, Shi Yu's small action of summoning Shorty was nothing. However, in the eyes of most people who were paying attention to this recruit trial, they were shocked.
Everyone gazed at the summoned Shorty and collapsed into deep thought.
"This, this, this, this." In the scene, someone raised his arm shakily and pointed at Shorty. "This, this cat, why does it look so similar? It's the 'Time Sect Master' ranked fifth among the 10 supernovas!!!"
"How is this similar? It's clearly the same cat, alright?" Someone compared it and exclaimed.
"Wait, the Time Sect Master… Shi Yu… Damn, it's definitely not wrong. Its name is all related to Shi Yu. Wait a minute, the World Destruction Dragon that ranked tenth among the supernovas and the Time Sect Master that ranked fifth are indeed both Shi Yu's pets?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1490 The World Where Only Zi Jian is Injured (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1490 The World Where Only Zi Jian is Injured (2)
"What's the background of Shi Yu? Who exactly is he? Do any of you know? His pets are so strong, and he actually has more than one pet. He actually contracted two super pets."
"Why didn't he summon them together just now instead of summoning one alone? Could it be that he issued some strange divine contract rule to himself? He can only summon one pet every time, but he can increase the strength of the pet? Otherwise, why would he let the pets register separately?"
"I still don't understand. Isn't Shi Yu a mechanic? But I remember that the Time Sect Master mainly cultivates the power of faith. It doesn't belong to the same cultivation system!"
As the crowd discussed, a noble young man passed by and almost couldn't control his surging mood. This was the son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang. He originally wanted to leave World King City, but when he heard that the cosmic overlord army was here, he planned to stay a few more days.
However, he didn't expect that he had already been completely expelled from the ten supernovas today. He, who was originally in tenth place, was directly squeezed out in the eyes of passers-by with Ling's rise.
"Who is this person? Could it be that he's also the son of a super divine? But I've never heard of someone with the surname Shi." Tian Shang stared at Shi Yu and Shorty. It was also very unbelievable. After Zavay lost just now, he had given up on the idea of challenging the cosmic overlord army. However, he didn't expect that Shi Yu, who appeared out of nowhere, was actually so strong and easily did what he thought was impossible.
Luster heard the audience's exclamation and said, "Du Zhe, you do it."
As soon as Luster finished speaking, a fiery red antman walked out of the soldiers of the 177th Corps. Apart from its humanoid body, its entire body was covered in the characteristics of ants. Its shell was like red armor. Compared to Yun Mo just now, it looked very ordinary. However, after careful observation, some old, divine-level experts immediately felt their hair stand on end.
"Red Ant!! It's actually a Red Ant!!"
"Apart from the Yun Race, the cosmic overlord army didn't even let go of the Space Worm!!"
After seeing this antman, countless divine-levels couldn't sit still anymore.
"Senior, what's the Red Ant?" A newbie with insufficient experience asked the veteran divine-levels. Those veteran gods who knew about the Space Worm explained it solemnly.
"There are a total of 13 mutants in the super race of the Space Worm!"
"These 13 mutants aren't like those ordinary worms that devour everything. They only devour specific lives. These specific lives are more in line with their evolutionary needs and can make them stronger."
"For the Space Worms, sometimes, it doesn't mean that the more they eat, the more powerful their evolution will be. The 'evolution recipe' that's suitable for them is the most important. The ancestors of these 13 mutants have all reached the peak of the super divine level and left behind the best evolution recipe. Therefore, they can be said to be nobles among the Space Worms. The Red Ant is one of these 13 Space Worm nobles."
"By the way, I forgot to tell you. The recipe for the Red Ant… is a human Beast Tamer, and a human Beast Tamer who signed a contract with it. A Red Ant basically has to eat 10 divine-level Beast Tamers who have signed a contract with it, or 1,000 Level 9 Beast Tamers, to break through to the divine level. Once it breaks through, the weakest is at least high-level divine battle power," the senior said to the junior.
"This is… a race that likes to eat humans. Moreover, they're very strong. Apart from their intrinsic racial skills, they also master two top-notch law divine skills!"
"The Law of Strength, the Law of Control, and the top-notch quality strength and protection laws have almost tempered the body to the extreme. It's close to a cosmic behemoth and is the strongest warrior of the insect race. Speaking of which, it's strange. Using people as a recipe, it actually boosts strength and defense, not intelligence. This recipe is really strange."
In a short instant, the horror of the Red Ant that ate contractors spread on the Internet.
At the scene, President Saatchi naturally recognized the Red Ant and couldn't help but say, "Captain Luster, don't tell me your 177th Army went to the Filthy Land and the Worm Race Mother Nest to take a look before returning to World King Planet. Don't tell me that your last new recruit is a cosmic behemoth."
The Filthy Land, Worm Race Mother Nest was the title given by the humans on the World King Planet to the territories of the cosmic emperor, the Dark King, and the cosmic emperor, the Worm Queen. It had the same meaning as the Cosmic Sea.
"Our 177th Army can't afford to raise a cosmic behemoth yet," Captain Luster said calmly, denying it.
"Is this little ant the second strongest among the new recruits recruited by the 177th Army?" President Saatchi narrowed his eyes and asked.
"That's right. It depends on whether Shi Yu can defeat it again!" Luster said.
As soon as Luster finished speaking, the Red Ant, Du Zhe, had already walked towards the short cat in front of it, step by step.
Its mouth squirmed. It felt that Shi Yu's aura behind the short cat was very fragrant. It wanted to contract Shi Yu very much, but before that, it had to deal with this cat first…
"Wait a minute, this red ant's gaze… Don't tell me it wants to devour Shi Yu."
"I think so!"
"Damn, why are these new recruits of the 177th Army each additional terrifying than the other? They're all as terrifying as monsters."
"However… it shouldn't be a problem, right? The Time Sect Master is ranked in front of the World Destruction Dragon. Even if this red ant is very strong, the Time Sect Master is definitely stronger."
When the audience paid attention to the battle, they realized that the Red Ant's gaze was becoming additional and more terrifying. That was the gaze that couldn't help but look at its prey. Just this gaze crossed the live broadcast, making a group of people and even new divine-level Beast Tamers feel their hearts skip a beat.

chapters.title: Chapter 1491 The World Where Only Zi Jian is Injured (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1491 The World Where Only Zi Jian is Injured (3)
"Meow…" However, suddenly, a voice quickly attracted everyone's attention from the ant.
The short Time Sect Master stood on the arena and stared at the red ant with greedy eyes. Endless killing intent spread. Its white hair had already stood on end, and the substantial killing intent turned into waves that spread on the short cat.
Ant, you're courting death!
After sensing that the Red Ant had very strong ill intentions towards Shi Yu, Shorty's mood was extremely bad. Killing intent involuntarily spread. The other party's hostility of treating Shi Yu as food had already exceeded the limit that Shorty could accept.
On the other side, the Red Ant also instantly sensed the killing intent of this short cat and couldn't help but feel its heart skip a beat.
"The aura isn't bad… But…"
"No buts. Little ant, you made my cat angry. The consequences are serious." Shi Yu sensed the short cat's anger and couldn't help but smile.
He crossed his arms again and looked at the arena playfully. As Shorty's mental fluctuations were too strong, Shi Yu's mental fluctuations also resonated.
Boom!!!
A terrifying killing intent also bloomed from Shi Yu's body. Shi Yu's pupils almost suddenly turned into the violent eyes of a wild beast, emitting a terrifying aura, shocking the Red Ant.
In the next moment, the white-gold aura on the arena spread. A strong power of faith erupted from Shorty's body. An incomparably huge metal statue materialized outside the Shorty's body. It was a humanoid statue in armor. It was extremely dignified, and one could tell that it had the outline of Shi Yu's appearance.
This was the peak skill that Shorty could display by combining its faith, Metal Control, White Tiger Divine Armor, Retribution White Tiger, and other skills. It was also a move to respond to its mental request.
Under the Red Ant's gaze, the palms of this huge Shi Yu statue directly slapped at the Red Ant like it was slapping a mosquito, as if it wanted to hold it in its palm and hear it beg for mercy.
The Red Ant's heart skipped a beat again. Its legs erupted with strength, wanting to dodge this move, but the Power of Retribution that exploded in its intellect and detonated its evil thoughts directly made the Red Ant's mind suffer intense pain and miss the best opportunity to escape.
"Boom!!!" With a bang, the statue crushed the red ant in its palm. A violent sound that was like a planet exploding immediately came from its palm, spreading in all directions.
"Alright, I'll just let it think about it and spare its life," Shi Yu said.
"Meow~" With a cat's cry, the statue's palms separated. The ant-man had been flattened, and its form didn't form again. Instead, blood flowed from its seven apertures as it fell from the sky with empty eyes…
With a bang, it hit the ground.
Shi Yu sighed slightly. The cat was getting fiercer and fiercer. Shi Yu instantly regretted summoning the cat. It, the turtle, and the others were really burning money!
Compared to the prize, the value of the burned power of faith was actually difficult for Shi Yu to determine for a moment. Well, the other party's prize should still be more expensive, but in the next round, as expected, he still couldn't use the cat. He was here to earn money, not to lose money.
Crack. The metal statue collapsed, and Shorty's figure appeared again. It glanced at the flattened antman and ran back to rub against Shi Yu's pants.
"Meow!" Those who dared to be hostile to Shi Yu would die!
Another battle ended.
The end was so fast that almost everyone present was stunned.
"That… was that Beast Taming Talent?" Everyone understood that Shi Yu and Shorty had entered a special state just now, greatly increasing Shorty's strength.
Just now, when Little Ji fought Yun Mo, Shi Yu didn't attack. Everyone was curious about Shi Yu's Beast Taming Ability, and now, Shi Yu seemed to have increased it by a small amount… Just a small amount directly stunned countless spectators in front of the screen.
"Ming Gu, what was that just now…" In the ward, Zavay was originally looking forward to the battle, but when he saw the Red Ant instantly insta-killed, he was immediately stunned. What a joke. Wasn't Shi Yu's strength a little ridiculous? It was fine if his pet was so strong, but the strength that erupted after he enhanced his pet was also so terrifying?
"It should be a mutation of the telepathy talent. Shi Yu's development of the telepathy talent is very high!" Ming Gu said. "The boost is almost several times that of a strengthening talent of the same level."
He was also extremely shocked. Damn, what was going on with this year's God Sealing Battle?
Initially, he thought that he, Ming Gu, Eleven, Chi Tong, and the others were the strongest competitors for the championship. Later on, he thought that it was Ling. In the end, where the f*ck did this Shi Yu pop out from? He actually contracted two of the ten supernovas and was also so fierce himself.
At the recruit trial venue, the crushing defeat of the Red Ant made the eyelids of a mixed-blood human Beast Tamer in the army twitch. He was the number one recruit of the 177th Army this year. Although his force was a little stronger than Yun Mo and Du Zhe, it didn't exceed the absurd level of insta-kill. He relied on the cooperation of himself and his pet… In the end, what was wrong with Shi Yu!
He only felt that even if he went up, he would be crushed by Shi Yu.
On the platform, the corners of President Saatchi's mouth also twitched. Just now, he also shuddered. When he reacted, the Red Ant was gone.
Shi Yu… This Shi Yu… Well done!!
President Saatchi was overjoyed. This time, the cosmic overlord army should concede defeat.
At the side, Captain Zi Jian had yet to recover from her shock. Wait? What was going on? Shi Yu… defeated two opponents just like that? He was only a step away from the super divine stone?

chapters.title: Chapter 1492 The World Where Only Zi Jian is Injured (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1492 The World Where Only Zi Jian is Injured (4)
Something was wrong… Why was Shi Yu so strong?
She originally thought that it was impossible for Shi Yu to defeat the new recruits of the 177th Army, so she panicked a little.
"Such pure power of faith in the era… Is this… a White Tiger Evolver?!" Luster was also surprised. Only then did he remember that Shi Yu was an archeologist who was even praised by Zi Jian.
If the mechanic class matched another mechanic class, then the new age faith class naturally matched the archeologist class.
Shi Yu was actually a dual genius.
"You won again," said Luster, the super divine. His words made the corners of the audience's mouths involuntarily twitch. What kind of monster was Shi Yu?
"Yes, I still want to continue challenging. Next should be the strongest new recruit," Shi Yu said.
"There's no need," Luster said. "He's not your match. Shi Yu, right? You're very outstanding. You can take away the three rewards for breaking through the arena."
Shi Yu was shocked and looked at the kind-looking skeleton. Was this for real?
President Saatchi was also stunned. He suddenly realized that Luster had already started to express goodwill toward Shi Yu.
At the side, Zi Jian was stunned. What? He gave it to Shi Yu just like that?
Wait a minute, were they all so lousy as the first-place recruits? Give it a try!! How could they give it to Shi Yu directly?
"This is against the rules, right?" Zi Jian said.
"Shi Yu… He and his pets are worth this treatment."
Luster said calmly. He suddenly recalled that Shi Yu was an archeologist who was even praised by Zi Jian. Their 177th Army lacked notable archeologists. Wasn't this readily available?
If Shi Yu was really that outstanding, with Shi Yu, there was no need to care about Zi Jian in the future.
Zi Jian: "?"
At this moment, everyone was shocked. They didn't expect the super divine of the cosmic overlord army to directly admit defeat generously and admit that their new recruits were inferior to Shi Yu.
Among the new recruits of the 177th Army, the Human Beast Tamer didn't know what to say. This was because he admitted that he definitely couldn't withstand Shi Yu's attack with Shorty just now.
"Why…" This strongest recruit gritted his teeth. He didn't expect such a monster to exist on World King Planet.
"Then we'll accept it respectfully. Indeed, no one below the God Realm is my match," Shi Yu said with a smile. He didn't feel that he was in the wrong.
"Heh… Heh… Heh…" Luster looked at the arrogant Shi Yu and smiled bitterly. He liked such a genius.
"The test will end here." Luster got up and left without caring about President Saatchi and Captain Zi Jian.
Luster was already very satisfied to discover a genius at Shi Yu's level. He felt that this trip was not in vain. It wasn't a loss this time.
As for whether they could poach Shi Yu, Luster didn't believe that he would fail. Their cosmic overlord army had never failed in what they wanted to do.
President Saatchi also stood up. No matter what, Shi Yu had made World King Planet proud. Although Shi Yu had enticed the 177th Army to poach him, and they would definitely believe of a way to poach him, this wasn't a loss. Next, he just had to ensure that Shi Yu wasn't poached by the cosmic overlord army.
"Shi Yu… This Shi Yu is so strong. I believe that Eleven, Ling, and Chi Tong can't defeat this guy who contracted two new stars and is even so mighty himself."
"The champion of this year's God Sealing Battle might be him." A spectator trembled as he looked at Shi Yu, who had defeated a powerful fleet of the cosmic overlord army, and directly became Shi Yu's supporter and fan.
Both Luster and President Saatchi were happy. The audience was also happy to see the cosmic overlord army being chased away and Shi Yu about to obtain a pile of resources.
Only Captain Zi Jian, who was still sitting on the platform, looked at Shi Yu below and fell into deep thought. She clenched her fists… What was going on? Where was her super divine stone? Where was her Cultivation Fruit?

chapters.title: Chapter 1493 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1493 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (1)
"Mr. Shi Yu, this is your reward for breaking through the arena."
In the hall of the 177th Army's fleet, Shi Yu took a piece of spatial equipment from a tall undead with unknown strength.
"The most valuable reward here is the A-level Quests Token. It can specify our 177th Fleet to serve you on a mission that doesn't exceed A-level difficulty."
"What's this A-level standard?" Shi Yu asked.
The tall undead smiled kindly and said, "The standard of the A-level Quests can roughly be seen as deciding the direction of a war without super divine level battle power."
"Or, Sir Shi Yu, which intermediate planet do you want to become the overlord of? Our 177th Fleet can help Sir Shi Yu conquer this planet."
"The lives on the planet will become your slaves. Everything on the planet will become your treasure. You will be the owner of this planet."
"Of course, the premise is that it doesn't involve super divine existences…"
"I understand." Shi Yu immediately realized that although the value of this A-level Quests token sounded very cool, it was quite terrifying.
For example, Blue Planet.
Blue Planet was an intermediate planet.
With this token, Shi Yu could completely ask the 177th Army to occupy Blue Planet in the Mythical Era.
After all, there were no super divine beings on Blue Planet in the Mythical Era.
Of course, Shi Yu analyzed that the 177th Army shouldn't be able to take this mission.
After their inspection, they should refuse and think that this exceeded the A-level difficulty.
Although Blue Planet was also an intermediate planet, the Space Emperor and the others regarded it as a quasi high-level planet. It couldn't be compared to other intermediate planets.
For example, the Floating Planet of the Space Emperor was also an intermediate-level planet, but up until now, the Floating Planet hadn't even produced a top-notch divine native.
However, there were many top-notch gods born on the Blue Planet. Even the Dragon and Phoenix Races on Blue Planet, such as the Ancestral Dragon and the Origin Phoenix, should have perfect divine battle power at their peak. They were outstanding among top-notch gods and had the strength to temporarily resist super divines.
Otherwise, if they didn't have this strength, why would Blue Planet win when the three super divines invaded Blue Planet back then? Although the three super divines also fought each other and consumed each other, if Blue Planet's peak battle power was only that of ordinary top-notch gods, it was definitely impossible for it to last that long. At least five perfect gods should have it.
The three super divines had all died on Blue Planet. It was really hard to say if the 177th Army and the super divine fleet could take Blue Planet alone.
"When it's useful, I'll ask for help from the 177th Fleet." However, Shi Yu still felt that this token should be very useful in the future.
"Alright," the tall undead said.
There was no rope in or poaching, as Shi Yu imagined. After the 177th Fleet rewarded him with the resources, they directly let Shi Yu leave on his own. It gave Shi Yu a pretty good feeling.
However, when Shi Yu came out, Zi Jian stood outside the hall and looked at him faintly.
"Cough… Captain Zi Jian…" Shi Yu said, "You're here too… What a coincidence."
Shi Yu put away the spatial equipment and smiled. "I'll receive this super divine stone myself. There's no need to trouble Captain Zi Jian…"
"By the way, it's alright if you don't have the super divine stone in your hand now. I can prepare the Cultivation Fruit for you first. You can pay me the money in the future."
"Huh?" Zi Jian was stunned. "Are you sure?"
"Of course," Shi Yu said. "I still confide you, Captain Zi Jian!"
"Alright." Captain Zi Jian's mood instantly improved. She found Shi Yu more pleasing to the eye and said, "I'll find a few super divine stones for you as soon as possible."
"In addition, if that big skeleton wants you to join the 177th Army, don't go. I'll give you double what they can give! You might as well come to me."
"Although the Zi Jian's special forces don't have any super divine experts, in terms of treatment, it's equivalent to a formal super divine fleet. Moreover, there are even fewer people, so you can be assigned more resources. You comprehend what I mean, right?"
Zi Jian was very confident in this aspect.
"Understood." Shi Yu wanted Captain Zi Jian to lower her voice. This was the other party's territory.
"Then I'll anticipate for your Cultivation Fruit," Captain Zi Jian said with a smile. With that said, she turned and left.
Shi Yu wanted to depart Epoch Square, but he recognized that people were waiting for him one after another. President Saatchi also stopped him from leaving.
"President Saatchi," Shi Yu said.
"Yo, hehehe." President Saatchi touched his beard and smiled. "Young man, you did well."
"The 177th Fleet is the elite fleet of the cosmic overlord army. The new recruits they recruit are all elites recruited from all over the cosmic range."
"I didn't expect a little monster like you to be hidden in the God Sealing Battle. I almost missed out," President Saatchi said, as if it was the first time he knew Shi Yu's strength.
Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment and said, "It was all just a coincidence that I countered the other party."
President Saatchi muttered in his heart that he didn't believe Shi Yu. He asked, "Did the 177th Fleet say anything to you?"
"No, I was just given the prize we agreed on."
President Saatchi said, "Well, then do you know the purpose of their trip to the World King Planet?"
Shi Yu said, "I think it's to have a friendly exchange."
President Saatchi smiled and said, "If the cosmic overlord army recruits you, what will you choose?"
Shi Yu's heart twitched. This old man was quite nosy. What other choice did he have? He should ask for the salary.
Without waiting for Shi Yu to answer, President Saatchi chuckled and said, "Forget it, how you select is up to you. As long as you remember that no matter where you go, don't become the enemy of World King Planet."

chapters.title: Chapter 1494 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1494 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (2)
There were too many experts from the World King Planet who had joined the cosmic overlord army. They couldn't be controlled.
In the face of this kind of thing, the World King Planet only had to ensure that the people who walked out of the World King Planet didn't point their swords at the World King Planet itself in the end.
Although the cosmic overlord army was a shit stirrer in the interstellar war, if it stirred up the Contaminated Land and the Worm Race Mother Nest, World King Planet would also be happy to see it.
As long as it didn't become the enemy of the World King Planet in the cosmic battlefield, there was no problem.
There were many factions in the cosmic overlord army. Some were close to the World King Planet, some were close to the Dark King Army, and some were close to the insect race. There were also internal battles. If the cosmic overlord army was really completely the enemy of the World King Planet, the World King Planet wouldn't let the other party enter and leave the planet freely.
Of course, this didn't mean that the official factions of the World King Planet were willing to see their geniuses seek refuge with other factions. However, from the perspective of President Saatchi, he was an old man who had retreated to an idle position. There was no need for him to spend so much effort on Shi Yu.
According to what he knew, the cleansing star spirit Susu was also Shi Yu's pet. It was focused on by the Environmental Protection Association. The Storm Battleship Ling was also Shi Yu's pet and was focused on by the Space Disaster Research Institute…
These factions would definitely think of a way to leave Shi Yu on World King Planet and give Shi Yu sufficiently superior conditions. As an unrelated old man, he wouldn't interfere.
"The World King Planet is my second home. I naturally won't become the enemy of the World King Planet." Shi Yu chuckled. Among the five major factions in the universe, the only ones he could rely on might be the World King Planet and the cosmic overlord army.
The Contaminated Land, the Worm Race Mother Nest, and the Behemoth Empire had all invaded Blue Planet before and were Blue Planet's life-and-death enemies. It was naturally impossible for him to rely on these three factions.
This was also the reason why the Blue Planet gods, the Space Emperor, and Lin Feng, who had entered the universe, chose to join the World King Planet. The environment here was the most suitable for continuous development.
"Alright, I'm looking forward to your performance in the God Sealing Battle~ I'll wait for the day you carry out the champion challenge." President Saatchi also left and directly confirmed that Shi Yu could definitely get first place.
Outside Epoch Square.
When Shi Yu came out, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng escorted Shi Yu home. At Shi Yu's residence, the five super divines of Blue Planet had been waiting for a long time. They were rather silent.
He had a new understanding of Shi Yu's ability to harvest resources and cause trouble.
At the same time, it also made the five of them realize how commendable a genius Shi Yu was. The genius recruited by the elite fleet under the cosmic overlord from various places in the starry sky was actually completely not Shi Yu's match.
Although they couldn't reach it at all, when they saw that the genius who walked out of their mother planet actually had such strength, the five super divines actually felt a little proud, as if they could see their high-spirited appearance back then.
"Seniors…" After Shi Yu returned, he looked at the five super divine seniors with hope.
"Can you… help again and open a stone?"
"Cough." The Space Emperor and Lin Feng coughed dryly. Could it be that the five super divines of Blue Planet had come to be tool gods?
If the divine beasts of the five major god races knew that their ancestor was commanded by a quasi divine, their eyes would probably pop out…
"You can drive," the Kirin Race super divine said after a moment of silence.
"Thank you, seniors… However, we might have to wait."
…
"We've arrived at World King City!"
At the teleportation point of World King City, a beautiful figure appeared. It was Teacher Gem Cat, who possessed rushed over from Sky City. She had opened the first super divine rock in a hurry and forgot to stack the buffs. This time, before planning to snatch the super divine stone, Shi Yu specially invited the gem cat over.
If she and Ling had stacked the buffs together back then, they might have had clothes in their previous life…
"Wuu!!" Outside the teleportation point, Eleven and the others, who had finished the God Sealing Battle, were in disguise like celebrities as they welcomed Teacher Cat.
After the two parties met, they arrived at Shi Yu's residence.
"Are we just waiting for her?" The five super divines waited for the gem cat girl for a long time. When the gem cat girl arrived, she instantly received the gazes of the five super divines.
"Uh…" The gem cat girl immediately cursed Shi Yu in her heart. Didn't Shi Yu say that there were many fun and delicious things in World King City? That was why she came.
Why did the situation… seem to be completely wrong now?
"Hello, seniors…" After Shi Yu introduced the five super divines of Azure Planet to the gem cat, the gem cat girl's expression darkened even more.
"That's what happened. Teacher Ying is the inheritor of the Star Prayer Race. I want to open this super divine rock under her wish power and Ling's blessing power!"
"I see. The power of luck of the Wind Kirin Race and the power of wishes of the Star Prayer Race are almost a perfect combination," the Kirin Race super divine said. "However, the things interior this rock have long been established. It's not random. Is it useful?"
"I'm just trying to comfort myself," Shi Yu said with a smile. In any case, he wasn't the one who was going through the trouble.
"Sigh. (I'm so silly… Really…)" The gem cat finally understood. She possessed been called over by Shi Yu and indeed wanted to work.
Next, like last time, the five super divines worked together to help Shi Yu open the stone.
Five streams of super divine power flowed towards the super divine stone. In the next moment, dense cracks appeared on the exterior of the super divine stone.
Right on the heels of that, it all shattered. Shi Yu took a deep breath and watched seriously.
Compared to Shi Yu's nervous mood, the five super divines were much calmer. At their level, they could be calm no matter what the super divine rock opened. After all, even the weakest super divine couldn't be compared to peak divine-level experts like the Space Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1495 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1495 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (3)
Moreover, the five god races had operated on the World King Planet for hundreds of millions of years. The wealth accumulated by generations was huge. This was also why the Space Emperor and Lin Feng still had to rely on the five god races to develop their mother planet.
Buzz~
A moment later, the super divine stone completely shattered. This time, it wasn't a corpse, but a genuine, super divine level resource.
"Huh??" This was a prismatic, transparent crystal. When the super divine stone shattered, the rich power of time on it directly emitted!!
"This!!" The Space Emperor was immediately shocked.
"Time Crystal!!"
"It's actually a time-element resource? Moreover, it's a quasi level-12 time-element resource!!" The five super divines were stunned and looked at Ling and the gem cat. Could it be that wishing and luck were really effective?
The super divine stone from before had a useless corpse inside.
However, this time, he directly made a killing.
90% of the super divine stones opened super divine level resources, so it was very normal to open Level 11 energy crystals.
But if it was an ordinary Level 11 energy crystal, its value would be only so-so. It was the lowest among Level 11 super divine resources.
However, time-element crystals were different. High-level time-element resources had a characteristic, which was that the longer they were placed, the better the effect. At the moment, the feeling that the time law power contained in this time crystal was already close to the pinnacle of the quality and level of a Level 11 resource. It could already be said to be a quasi Level 12 resource.
As for Level 12 resources, they were also known as cosmic treasures. They were super treasures that could only be born naturally in the universe and couldn't be created postnatally. For example, the source of transcendence was a cosmic treasure.
Therefore, with the rare Level 11 time-element resource opened, everyone instantly realized how lucky Shi Yu was this time.
The five super divines were alright, but the Space Emperor and Lin Feng almost drooled. They were poor!
"Dividends, dividends!!" The cat was also happy. Was it a top-notch resource?
"!!!" At the same time, Qi was also quite touched while inside Shi Yu's body.
She felt that if she could absorb this time crystal, her level should be able to easily recover to her peak!!
She might even have a chance to reach the level of a perfect god.
"This resource…" Shi Yu said, "Time element? It's still useful. Unfortunately, it's not what I want the most."
"It's better to have another era creature corpse for me to study."
He couldn't mess with his own body, but if a corpse of another era creature came, he could dissect and study it.
The super divines: "?"
Was there something wrong with this kid?
However, Shi Yu quickly understood and was satisfied. He still didn't know how difficult it was to add points after his pet broke through to the divine level. The consumption of points for divine skills would probably be even more terrifying.
And if he had this time-element crystal, Shi Yu estimated that he would give it to Qi to use, not sell it for resources.
With this, Qi should be able to quickly have strength that exceeded its peak. At its peak, the level of Space-time Travel was only an expert-level divine skill. If it could be raised to a perfect level, its escape ability would definitely be stronger.
At that time, a perfect divine-level Time Sprite could probably slap the face of a super divine level in person and make the other party unable to catch it… This ability was very useful to Shi Yu, whose name would spread throughout the entire World King Planet.
It could give Shi Yu enough stable development space.
Thinking about it this way, it wasn't a loss to open the time crystal. After all, it was impossible for Blue Planet's experts to protect him at all times. It was also impossible for him to hide in a place all the time.
He still had to have the ability to escape when he encountered danger.
"Thank you, seniors…" At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the time gem and smiled. "When I have the super divine rock next time, I'll have to trouble you, seniors…"
The five super divines: ???
…
The matter of the cosmic overlord army had come to an end. In the next period of time, Shi Yu, who had obtained the meditation jade, began to sleep and cultivate.
The meditation jade was a cultivation asset that could only trigger the effect during meditation. It originally required the user to concentrate on meditation without any distractions to use it.
However, when the meditation jade touched the Cultivation Fruit, it was as if a bug had been born. Shi Yu brought the meditation jade along and ate the Cultivation Fruit before starting to sleep. The effects of the two cultivation resources were directly activated and complemented each other at the same time, causing Shi Yu's meditation speed to rise like a rocket.
This feeling of sleeping and leveling up was actually no different from cheating.
For ordinary people, they still had insomnia and excessive energy, causing them to be unable to sleep. However, on Shi Yu's side, Buggy could hypnotize him, and Baby Ginseng could let Shi Yu sleep for hundreds of years. Moreover, Shi Yu, who had the talent of physical control, could additionally guarantee that he could perfectly control his sleep. From there, he would have the best cultivation experience.
The so-called good cultivation experience was to close and open his eyes. Before he felt anything, it was comparable to a few years of bitter cultivation for others. Shi Yu felt that there was almost nothing more satisfying than this.
This made Shi Yu have the thought of spending a lot of money to get more meditation jades. After the competition ended, he would slumber until he reached the zenith of the divine level.
During the period of period when Yu fell asleep to cultivate… the God Sealing Battle was still carried out in an orderly manner.
Among them, every one of the ten newbies was like a monster. They killed with one hit every round, no matter what opponent they encountered.
After a while, the top 16 were out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1496 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1496 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (4)
They were: Eleven, Worm of Imagination, Ginseng Emperor, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, World Destruction Dragon, World Cleansing Demon Duck, Time Sect Master, Super Holy Beast…
There were also the other six contestants. The other six contestants were all in the top 20 of the previous God Sealing Battle, but in this batch, no one thought that they could survive a single move in front of the 10 newbies. They didn't have much of a presence at all.
After all, it had to be known that the last World Destruction Dragon of the 10 newbies had strength comparable to Zavay. This was even without the enhancement of its mechanic, Shi Yu.
It could be said that the appearance of the 10 newbies made the old audience of the God Sealing Battle feel that this year's God Sealing Battle was the darkest and most chaotic in the history of the God Sealing Battle… They couldn't see through it or guess it.
However, it could be imagined how brutal the scene would be when the 10 newbies fought each other.
"A new battle list will be out later!! Guess, guess, guess!! This time, the 10 supernovas might finally meet. Let's guess who can get first place this year."
Now, in the various major domains, a bunch of dark gambling houses had bets on this God Sealing Battle. Batch after batch of gamblers bet with red eyes.
"God Eleven will definitely be first!"
"Chi Tong is the number one in the world."
"I guess the Time Sect Master is first! His name is definitely God Shi Yu's trump card. God Shi Yu contracted two great divine pets and has such strong confidence to let them register alone and not go on stage to assist. He must be confident of winning the championship."
As everyone was excitedly guessing, a new battle list was announced…
"Is the name list out?"
The tea internal competition was about to begin. Shi Yu, who had been obsessed with cultivation for a long time, also opened his eyes comfortably.
Now, his two Beast Taming Spaces had already been cultivated to the peak of Level 9. He could break through to the divine level at any time.
After the champion challenge ended, it would be the day Shi Yu broke through to the divine level. However, before that, Shi Yu wanted to see more which pet could obtain first place in this God Sealing Battle.
The first place in the God Sealing Battle would obtain the opportunity to challenge the champion and have a chance to obtain a permanent teleportation array.
From the second to the tenth place of the God Sealing Battle, one could obtain a Teleportation Key Stone and different numbers of divine-level cosmic crystals.
If Shi Yu took over the top 10, he would have at least nine Teleportation Key Stones and a pile of divine-level cosmic crystals. He would completely become rich overnight. Ordinary second-level Realm Lords might not be so generous.
No wonder some geniuses were willing to constantly participate in the God Sealing Battle. For example, Ming Gu had obtained nearly a hundred Teleportation Key Stones alone after being second in 79 consecutive years. Even if he didn't need them, he wouldn't have to worry about selling them to other realms and breaking through to the divine level.
The Teleportation Key Stones of the Space Emperor and the others were actually bought from this channel.
Of course, the most precious thing was definitely still the permanent teleportation array. This was a super treasure that countless ordinary Teleportation Key Stones couldn't exchange for.
If it weren't for the fact that the permanent teleportation array could only be taken once, if Shi Yu didn't think that after they broke through to the divine level, the benefits they would gain from being stuck at the demigod level would be greater and they could earn more resources, he even wanted to be stuck at the demigod level for hundreds of years.
"Let me see…" Shi Yu looked at the new battle list and fell into deep thought.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling encountered six other passers-by.
Little Ji, Duckie, Shorty, and the others were unlucky enough to bump into each other!
World Destruction Dragon vs World Cleansing Demon Duck!
Time Sect Master vs Super Holy Beast!
This time… the second team would kill each other first!
"Brilliant."
…
After the name list was out, the expressions of the six old contestants were also rather gloomy.
Among them, the genius of the Green Dragon Family, Tian Yu, who was "lucky" to enter the top 16, looked at the contestant he matched with and collapsed a little.
"You're the only one left in our Four Holy Family. Can you defeat Ling and enter the top 10?" the White Tiger Family's White King said.
"It's the only one left in the Four Holy Family, but it's not the only Four Holy Evolver in the top 16… This Time Sect Master and this Super Holy Beast are all Four Holy Evolvers! This time, we're completely crushed. The family will probably be very angry," the Black Tortoise Family's Ming Wu said.
After so long, Shorty, Turtle, and the others had previously entered the vision of the Four Holy Family.
The reason was very simple. They mainly cultivated the power of faith of the Four Saints, and they weren't members of the Four Holy Family!
Moreover, Shorty's battle style and that of the Super Holy Beast were too similar to the Guardian Holy Beast that appeared before the Four Holy Ruins. Even its appearance was a little similar.
After their investigation, the most important key was the Beast Tamer of the Time Sect Master, Shi Yu!
Shi Yu had additionally showed up in the Four Holy Ruins. He was an archeologist praised even by Zi Jian, and the Time Sect Master was his pet… Therefore, the geniuses of the Four Holy Family had a bold guess.
Shi Yu had received unknown benefits in the Four Holy Ruins. For example, the Time Sect Master had obtained the inheritance of the Guardian Holy Beast in the Four Holy Ruins. They even suspected that the Super Holy Beast was also Shi Yu's pet.
With the limit they could think of, it was that Shi Yu had received the benefits of the Four Holy Ruins under unknown circumstances. As for the fact that the Four Holy Ruins were controlled by Shi Yu at that time, they didn't even dare imagine it because it was too strange.
After all, even Zi Jian couldn't crack the Four Holy Ruins. What right did Shi Yu, a person he had not heard of before, have?
The Four Holy Family had previously started to investigate this matter…

chapters.title: Chapter 1497 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1497 The Gaze of the Four Saints Super Divine (5)
One of the Four Holy Family, the Black Tortoise Family!
In the Black Tortoise family, there was a time-element turtle that was an expert in divination and had reached the perfect god level.
Recently, it had been invited by the clan to divine something. That was, the origin of the turtle and snake evolver, the Super Holy Beast, in the God Sealing Battle. Was there any hope of pulling it into the Black Tortoise Family?
After a long time of hard work, it finally divined some clues. However, with a look, the old turtle immediately exploded. With a panicked expression, it found the head of the Black Tortoise Family, a super divine-level Black Tortoise Evolver!
"Ancestor, Ancestor, something's wrong!!!"
This old turtle arrived in front of the super divine mystic realm where the family head was in shock and greeted.
"What is it?" The super divine mystic realm opened, and an old voice sounded.
"Ancestor, sorry to disturb you. Recently, the clan asked me to make a divination of the situation of a new planet with potential and a Black Tortoise Evolver."
"Yes." The Black Tortoise super divine nodded.
"In the end, my divination was of a very terrifying thing. I saw a future scene. A human Beast Tamer will bring a Green Dragon, a White Tiger, a Vermillion Bird, and a Black Tortoise to move the ruins of the Four Saints Era!!"
"What??" The invisible Black Tortoise super divine let out an incredulous voice.
"You mean that one day, the ruins of the Four Saints Era will be cracked and taken away by someone, and the person who took it away is related to the Super Holy Beast you predicted?"
"That's right! The rule of my divination skill is that if the divination fails, I can't divine anything. Otherwise, the scene divined will 100% come true, so the result I divined… might be true. The ruins of the Four Saints Era are about to be cracked!"
"I understand…" The Black Tortoise super divine nodded and said, "Don't make this public first. You can leave now."
"Yes!" The old turtle took its leave.
After the old turtle left, the Black Tortoise super divine pondered for a long time.
In fact, it would also use the method of the tortoise shell to deduce the future.
A moment later, it took out a turtle shell.
The word "Great Misfortune" appeared on the shell.
This made the pupils of the Black Tortoise super divine shrink.
After a long time, after careful consideration, it put away the tortoise shell and took out three tokens. When the tokens were taken out, three figures automatically appeared in front of it.
A dragon-shaped phantom, a sparrow-shaped phantom, and a tiger-shaped phantom.
"Old turtle, why are you summoning us?" the dragon-shaped phantom said.
"My three old friends…" The Black Tortoise super divine said kindly, "I wonder if you still remember the Four Holy Ruins."
The Green Dragon, Vermillion Bird, and White Tiger were stunned. "That era ruin…"
They naturally remembered. Unfortunately, they couldn't crack this era ruin either, nor could they ignore the rules and take away the power of faith that made them envious.
However, although they couldn't be taken away, they wouldn't be affected even if they didn't have this bit of power of faith. At super divine levels, they had long established their own divine kingdoms. The power of faith was still enough.
Over time, the Four Saints super divine handed this ruin to the family to cooperate with the archeological association to manage. It was used to nurture the family's strength and nurture believers. As for them, they couldn't be bothered to waste time researching and cracking according to the rules mechanism of the Four Holy Ruins. The efficiency was too low, so it was better to cultivate on their own.
"Yes, just now, I obtained a confirmed divination. In the future, this Four Holy Ruins will be cracked and taken away by a human Beast Tamer with the four holy pets…"
The Black Tortoise super divine said slowly.
"Of course, the Four Holy Ruins is an ownerless item. It depends on whoever has the ability to take it away. However…" The Black Tortoise super divine said in a low voice, "You also know how huge and pure the power of faith of the era contained in the Four Holy Ruins is. Although it's useless to us and is just icing on the cake, there's still a chance to nurture a few invincible Four Holy Beasts with this ruin that have a chance of stepping into the super divine level."
"At this point, I think everyone understands what this means, right?"
The other three super divines naturally knew what this old turtle meant!
In fact, they didn't care if the power of faith in the Four Holy Ruins was theirs. It didn't matter to them if they distributed it to all the Four Holy Evolvers. However, if this power of faith was obtained by one person, there would be a big problem.
Every Four Holy Evolver was essentially a competitor.
The reason why the four super divine level Four Saints established their families was actually also to monitor every Four Holy Evolver under their noses and let their growth be controllable to avoid threatening their status and competing with them for the greatest power of faith.
No matter how much power of faith there was in the Four Holy Ruins, as long as it was divided equally among a group of Four Holy Evolvers, that group of Four Holy Evolvers couldn't pose a threat to them.
However, if they all fell into the hands of one person, just as the Black Tortoise super divine said, the other party would possess the potential to grow to the super divine level. At that time, one World King Planet, two super divine level Green Dragons, and two super divine level Vermillion Birds would be a very serious problem.
The Vermillion Bird supernatural deity said, "Old turtle, are you sure?"
If it was true, he definitely couldn't let the other party successfully take away the Four Holy Ruins. The best solution was to take the other party into the Vermillion Bird Family and let the other party serve the Vermillion Bird Family.
"I'm basically sure," the Black Tortoise super divine said.
As soon as it finished speaking, a trace of killing intent flashed in the Green Dragon's super divine eyes. It definitely wouldn't allow other Green Dragon Evolvers to challenge its position. "Do you know who the other party is?"
"There are some clues." When the Black Tortoise super divine saw that the other three super divine saints were so concerned, it knew that there was no need for it to solve this matter. This was good.
Initially, it wanted the Black Tortoise Family to come into contact with the guy who might possess taken away the Four Holy Ruins.
However, the result of its divination was very fierce!
This made the Black Tortoise supernatural deity wary and decide to allow the other three super divine experts test it… After all, there weren't many existences that could cause a super divine expert that had transcended several times to possess a "great ominous sign"…

chapters.title: Chapter 1498 Shi Yu Failed (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1498 Shi Yu Failed (1)
The sky gradually changed, and the light blue sky was embedded with countless stars.
As the God Sealing Battle was about to end, a large number of contestants were eliminated. Not only did the traffic in World King City not slowly decrease like in the past, but it also became more and more lively.
The ten new planets appeared out of nowhere. The downfall of the contestants of the old era was regarded as another turning point in the God Sealing Battle. The key to opening a new chapter was, for example, the time when Ming Gu defeated the first place 180 years ago, and the time when Zavay defeated Ming Gu 80 years ago… This year was also the time to witness history.
"Fast forward, fast forward!! Contestant Ling's battle has begun!!"
It was the Starry Sky Battlefield again. Ling looked at the Green Dragon in front of it and felt calm. It directly threw a Starry Sky Storm over as if the geniuses of the Green Dragon Family were facing a great enemy!
"Green Dragon Creation!!" Under its roar, a new world formed, but it was quickly destroyed by the Starry Sky Storm.
In less than a minute, the symbol of Ling's victory appeared in the live-stream.
"It hurts, it hurts too much. Haha, Dr. Ling is impressive, awesome!" The audience knew that this was the outcome.
Wherever the Starry Sky Storm passed, even a galaxy would be affected!
The creation power mastered by the genius of the Green Dragon Family was at most the creation power mastered by a low-level planet. It wasn't a match for the cosmic disaster.
In the outside world, the number one genius of the White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise families covered their foreheads and sighed.
On the other side, Eleven defeated its opponent with a punch. Buggy instantly killed its opponent with a dragon might. Chi Tong defeated its opponent with a sword. Susu used a Heavenly Frost Cold Energy to freeze its opponent. Baby Ginseng was even more brutal. After entering the time state, a flying leaf tore apart its opponent's body like a fast saber.
The battle of six of the ten newbies was exactly as the audience had expected. It was completely and overwhelmingly powerful.
Their figures were also worshiped by countless contestants like peerless villains.
However, the audience hoped that these ten newbies could bump into each other.
They wanted to see if it would still be an equally overwhelming battle process.
Until…
Little Ji and Duckie faced each other.
Now, under the analysis of many gods, only the 10 newbies, the Cosmic Crow, and Ming Gu were considered unique. They were considered first tier contestants.
Only they could pose a threat to each other.
Unfortunately, Zavay and Ming Gu had already been eliminated long ago. Their luck wasn't that good.
However, the World Destruction Dragon vs the World Cleansing Demon Duck was also quite interesting. The audience was very excited.
"Who do you think will win?" In the live-stream where the battle was about to begin, countless contestants of the God Sealing Battle were watching the battle. Shi Yu and the gem cat were additionally in the room, holding potato chips, drinking soda, and wearing immersion glasses, waiting to watch the battle.
The gem cat watched the show and ate as it asked.
"Usually, the two of them fight the most. In 10 battles, Little Ji can win three times, Duckie can win three times, and both parties can draw and fall four times at the same time… It's completely a draw."
"However! That's the chances of winning in a fair combat environment."
"There's a special mechanism in the God Sealing Battle, which is that the battle venue is random. If they're assigned to the dry land, if they're assigned to the abyss venue… The impact on their chances of winning is very big." Shi Yu additionally ate potato chips.
"This battle can also be seen as a battle between Ling and Susu. After all, Little Ji and Duckie were taught by them separately. From the looks of it, Little Ji might very well inherit Ling's good luck and be assigned to the dry field to defeat Duckie!" Teacher Ying analyzed.
As they discussed, the venue slowly formed.
The potato chips on both sides slowly stopped in front of their mouths.
It was, surprisingly, an endless and bottomless Blue Sea Arena. On the arena, there was only a larger stone arena. This was the venue of the battle between Little Ji and Duckie.
"Roar!!!"
"Quack!!"
After Little Ji and Duckie emerged on the arena, Little Ji's body immediately stopped, and its eyes under the bandage revealed ecstasy.
Ocean venue! Duckie was overjoyed!
Little Ji was shocked. It believed that it could inherit Ling's good luck and be assigned to the dry land. What was wrong with this land?!
Could it be that Ling's power of luck really had to follow the "law of conservation of luck"?
Some people's luck would become better, but others' luck would become worse. As Ling's closest little machine… it would directly suffer the backlash first!
"Roar! (Damn it, shouldn't it backfire on the Kirin Race?)" Little Ji thought.
…
"It's the ocean arena. The Abyss Race is water-type… Isn't it a little disadvantageous for the World Destruction Dragon? Although it's a dragon, it doesn't have wings." The audience suddenly discussed.
"At this point, why hasn't Great God Shi Yu emerged yet? Does he still plan to let the World Destruction Dragon fight on its own? The opponent is the World Cleansing Demon Duck ranked in front of it…"
"It shouldn't be a problem, right? After all, it's not like you haven't seen how fierce the World Destruction Dragon was when it fought the Yun Race Dragon. It's not afraid of pollution at all. This battle is definitely under God Shi Yu's control!"
The battle quickly began. Countless people were nervous. Seeing that it was really an ocean arena, Little Ji additionally decided to fight it out. With a roar, it activated Earth Control. With itself as the center, countless oceans began to turn into the ground, and red magma rose!!
At the same time, a dazzling hot sun floated in the sky, making the seawater hot and boiling.
"I am the overlord of the earth!!!" Little Ji's dragon's might swept through, and the destructive power shook the sky and earth, making space tremble.

chapters.title: Chapter 1499 Shi Yu Fails (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1499 Shi Yu Fails (2)
This… was still Little Ji's first time using the Earth Control skill!
So what if it was the sea? Wherever it stepped was the ground!
"Holy shit." Countless spectators saw that the mechanical dragon that used the Destruction Sun Sword to fight previously actually had the ability to change the terrain. They instantly realized that even when Little Ji fought the Yun Race Dragon of the cosmic overlord army, it didn't use its full strength!
"The World Destruction Dragon is stable!! The power to counter pollution itself also hides the strength to change the world. The World Cleansing Demon Duck is in danger. As expected of a pet cultivated by God Shi Yu!"
"That's it???"
"I'm… the overlord of the ocean!!" However, just as the audience thought that the World Destruction Dragon was stable, Duckie said disdainfully. The vortex that contained death fluctuations swept through the ocean shattered the ground, and the sky instantly darkened. Under the wreaking of the storm, countless black fluctuations and raindrops sank the land like meteors. It was the Dark Sky Wave Rain.
The hot sun also lost most of its light under the cover of the dark sky's wave rain.
Little Ji's expression darkened, and the audience was stunned. This was because Duckie's two moves didn't contain any abyssal power or cleansing power. They were completely pure. They were two disaster-type skills that vividly displayed the harshness of the ocean environment!
Death Vortex! Dark Sky Wave Rain!
This World Cleansing Demon Duck also hid a portion of its strength. Apart from the power of abyss and cleansing, there were other powers! Its control over the sea was also extremely strong, and its venue advantage became even more obvious!
The hearts of the audience thumped as they felt the excitement of this battle!!
"Roar!!!" In the next moment, Little Ji sacrificed its rationality and entered a berserk state. The Earth Regeneration speed was even faster. The hot sun was also working hard to penetrate the dark clouds. It even held the Sun Meteorite Sword and slashed at Duckie!!
Damn duck, die!
"Quack!!" Duckie's eye band was blown away by the storm. It opened the Eye of the Evil God and condensed the Vajra Demon Subduing Staff in its hand. It activated the Wave Vision, the Heart of the Abyss, and the power of the abyss all erupted, shaking the sky and earth, colliding with the destructive dragon's might!!
Similarly, its battle power was fully released. Its figure instantly disappeared and collided with Little Ji!!
The moment it moved, under the contamination of the power of the abyss, the endless sea directly turned into an abyss sea. Its strength was incomparably terrifying.
Before the 177th Fleet left, the super divine expert, Luster, continued to pay attention to the God Sealing Battle and watch Shi Yu's subsequent performance.
After seeing Duckie, he couldn't help but say, "Its pollution power is stronger than Yun Mo, and it used other powers to restrict it, thereby reaching a state where it can erupt without caring about the consequences. Is this the so-called ten newbies that have been in an uproar recently?"
"This guy is also very worth recruiting, but the Environmental Protection Association…"
Boom!!!
The Sun Meteorite Sword and the Vajra Demon Subduing Staff wrapped in the power of the abyss collided. In an instant, the arena under their feet completely exploded. Little Ji was forced to fall into the sea. However, the places it touched were all earth. A new arena instantly appeared on the sea surface, and Duckie's strength was indeed slightly inferior. It was sent flying and was pulled back by Little Ji with horizontal gravity!!
During the process of Duckie flying crazily, Little Ji waved its huge sword, wanting to deal a perfect blow.
"Gravity Control!" The audience saw Little Ji use a new divine skill.
In the blink of an eye, Duckie's body that was pulled back directly erupted with a powerful gravity. Its body turned into an abyss black hole and also sucked Little Ji over.
"Dark Control!!" The spectators was shocked.
Little Ji and Duckie's gazes contained a frightening concept. One was the Destruction Resistance, and the other was the Abyss Resistance.
With a boom, the fearless collision of the two parties was wrapped in the abyss black hole, causing a strong explosion. In an instant, a huge hole appeared in the sky and the sea. The aftermath of a pillar that reached the sky connected to the sky.
"Roar!!"
"Quack!!"
In the fluctuations, the two contestants retreated from each other with injuries. After pulling away from each other, they attacked the other party again.
"Gulp." The contestants of the God Sealing Battle looked at this brutal battle and were shocked. Were these two guys monsters? They actually hid a bunch of trump cards. They were mightier and stronger than they imagined at the start.
"This batch of newbies…" Ming Gu and Zavay, who had yet to leave World King City, watched the battle between Little Ji and Duckie in silence and felt an incomparable pressure.
They didn't know who could take first place this year.
But no matter who got first place, there were still so many monster newbies. In the next few decades or hundreds of years, this group of monsters would probably be active in the God Sealing Battle.
They… had worked hard for so long, but their rankings had even fallen? Zavay and Ming Gu felt stifled.
Next, the hearts of the spectators were additionally mobilized by the World Destruction Dragon and the World Cleansing Demon Duck. They watched as they collided crazily, the chaotic interweaving of the ground and ocean, and the violent impact of destruction and the abyss. In less than two minutes, this small world shattered, as if it had encountered countless natural disasters…
After an unknown period of time, just as the hearts of the spectators were about to jump out, Little Ji stood on the endless ground. Opposite it, Duckie additionally stood opposite, panting, and stopped attacking.
"You lost," Duckie said.
As Duckie finished speaking, the audience's hearts skipped a beat. Lost? They looked at the terrain. It was clearly the World Destruction Dragon that completely rewrote the ocean area into the earth area, as if it occupied the top. Why did it lose?
"I am the overlord of the earth!!!" In the face of Duckie's words, Little Ji's violent gaze gradually recovered its clarity. It stabbed the Sun Meteorite Sword into the ground and slowly closed its eyes unwillingly, but its body stood on the ground and never fell.

chapters.title: Chapter 1500 Shi Yu Fails (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1500 Shi Yu Fails (3)
Obviously, it had completely lost its physical fitness to fight. Only when they arrived did the audience realize that the World Destruction Dragon indeed seemed to be an arrow at the end of its flight.
"If it weren't for the venue advantage, it wouldn't have been so easy for me to defeat you. But even if I lose, you have to stand on the ground. I acknowledge you, the overlord of the earth!" Duckie coolly tied its eyeband and said in an extremely weak voice.
After winning the battle, Duckie didn't destroy the land anymore and let it stand steadily on the ground. It gave Little Ji enough face, and turned around calmly. The cleansing light on its body shone in all directions, cleansing the polluted venue and Little Ji.
The audience was shocked and had yet to react.
Wait… What was wrong with these two guys!!!
One was clearly about to lose, but it still wanted to create the ground and stand on the ground to lose.
After winning the battle, it had to weakly cleanse the venue and opponent…
These two strange guys… What kind of battle was this?
Why couldn't they understand these two contestants?
"The outcome has been decided. The World Destruction Dragon contestant lost consciousness and its stamina was exhausted, so the winner is the World Cleansing Demon Duck contestant!" The battle elf quickly announced the results.
In the next moment, the outside world exploded.
"Hehe." Susu followed beside Ling and was extremely happy. As for Ling, it looked at Susu speechlessly. Wasn't it just Duckie being lucky enough to draw the ocean venue…
At the same time.
Little Ji logged into the arena of the second world. As the unconscious Little Ji was teleported out, many contestants in the arena looked at it, who was still standing. The medical staff were already ready.
"Excuse me, excuse me." At this moment, a smile came from the crowd. Shi Yu walked out of the crowd and said, "I'm here to collect my pet and bring it back for treatment. I won't trouble everyone…"
At some point in time, Shi Yu had come here from his residence. Under the gazes of the contestants, he put Little Ji back into his space.
"The pet lost… Why is Shi Yu still so happy?" The contestants were extremely puzzled when they saw that Shi Yu still had a faint smile.
"He only lost one. He still has the Time Sect Master. Perhaps this is the calmness of an expert."
The World Destruction Dragon vs the World Cleansing Demon Duck. Shi Yu's battle pet losing the competition immediately made the people who supported Shi Yu feel stifled to the extreme. However, they had to admit that the World Destruction Dragon had already performed very well. It was purely unlucky to have encountered the Blue Sea Arena. If they wanted to fight successfully, they had to consume more energy than the other party.
"I hope the Time Sect Master can take first place in the end. Then, during the champion challenge, God Shi Yu will summon the World Destruction Dragon again to obtain the final honor!"
In everyone's expectations, the battle between the Time Sect Master and the Super Holy Beast quickly began.
There was no ocean venue in this battle. Shi Yu's supporters couldn't help but heave a sigh of relief. Otherwise, there was no way to fight the metal-element White Tiger Evolver vs the water-element Black Tortoise Evolver.
However, on the grassland arena, Shorty wasn't very happy. It looked at the Super Holy Beast opposite it solemnly.
Shorty could clearly determine that it couldn't defeat the combination of Turtle and Little Quas!
How could Shorty win a one vs two match?
In addition, because they were teammates, Turtle and Little Quas were very clear about Shorty's skills. Therefore, when Shorty faced these two teammates, it sensed something in despair…
Although they were about to fight, Turtle and Little Quas didn't have any hostility or negative emotions towards it!
They were emotion control masters!
This directly crippled its Retribution White Tiger!
"Meow…" At this moment, Shorty was in extreme despair. It felt that its path to becoming a god had ended here. However, it still chose to take the final gamble!
Because if it didn't perform well, when the overall battle results of the God Sealing Battle system gave it an automatic ranking, it was very likely that 9 to 16 places would be ranked outside the top 10. Shorty felt that it had to get 9 to 10 places no matter what. It couldn't fall out of the top 10!
"Roar!!!" In an instant, Shorty turned into a huge armored White Tiger and attacked the four-headed Turtle Snake standing opposite!!
Platinum Tiger Claw!!!
Shorty tore at its opponent.
Boom!!!
But on the other side, the Super Holy Beast combination of Turtle and Little Quas stood on the spot without moving, waiting for Shorty's assault with a calm expression.
After the violent sound, the hearts of the audience who had seen the power of the Time Sect Master trembled.
After all, the Time Sect Master could even instantly kill Red Ants…
However, at this moment, as the smoke dissipated, the spectators saw an incomprehensible scene. The super assault of the Time Sect Master directly hit the Super Holy Beast, but the Super Holy Beast stood on the spot without moving at all. It was unscathed.
It directly took the assault head-on.
"You're not our match. Admit defeat," Turtle and Little Quas said in four voices as they gazed at Shorty gently.
"We only have good intentions towards you. Don't waste your power and faith!"
"Roar!!!" Shorty exploded in anger and launched a fierce attack. It slapped its tiger palm over again, and its King's Treasure Vault opened. In the sky, countless sabers, spears, axes, and swords landed on the Super Holy Beast.
However, Turtle and Little Quas, who had mastered Shorty's battle style, calmly chose the Immovable Mountain strategy of the "Holy Black Tortoise Body" and the "Dark North Shield". They watched as Shorty couldn't break through its defense.
Boom.
Shorty's assault was fierce like a tiger, but looking at its battle results…
"What a joke…" The spectators saw the huge tiger that had enlarged to hundreds of meters slap the four-headed Turtle Snake standing on the ground and keep crushing it. The other party was still unscathed and directly stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1501 Shi Yu Fails (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1501 Shi Yu Fails (4)
Previously, this Super Holy Beast basically used divine skills like Water Control and Ice Control to end the battle when it defeated the enemy. This was the first time everyone knew that this guy's defense was also so terrifying, several times more terrifying than the Red Ant that had mastered top-notch defensive divine skills.
Perhaps even Zavay's combination divine skill that could injure Eleven couldn't break through the defense of the Super Holy Beast!
No wonder… No wonder the box god ranked the Super Holy Beast third among the ten newbies. The Time Sect Master, who was ranked fifth, really couldn't defeat this Super Holy Beast at all.
The difference between the two parties looked even greater than the tenth place's World Destruction Dragon and the sixth place's World Cleansing Demon Duck!!
"So, why didn't God Shi Yu go on stage to support his pet? This situation is too dangerous. This Super Holy Beast's defense is so strong!!"
Amidst everyone's confusion, the Super Holy Beast seized the gap between the Time Sect Master's attacks and launched its first attack. It chose absolute zero, instantly freezing the huge White Tiger on the spot.
Crack!!!
The huge tiger quickly broke free, but what awaited was the Black Tortoise Fist accumulated by the Super Holy Beast!!
Boom!!!
This punch instantly sent Shorty flying. Its armor shattered, and its huge body was blasted thousands of meters away with vast might.
Shorty was sent flying and lay on the spot in despair. Although it could immediately revive and fight again after mobilizing the power of faith, it didn't plan to get up.
Shi Yu had very strict rules regarding the internal battle of the team, restricting the number of power of faith that every faith beast could mobilize.
This was also for the sake of fairness. After all, the power of faith of the era was an external force obtained by Shi Yu. If he didn't restrict its use, it would be too wasteful. This power shouldn't be wasted too much in the team's internal battle. He just had to use a little.
Therefore, after Shorty deduced that it couldn't defeat Turtle and Little Quas, it gave up struggling. With its performance to this extent… it shouldn't fall out of the top ten, right??
The Time Sect Master… lost!
Moreover, it was defeated the whole time!
This scene stunned countless spectators, including the spectators of the cosmic overlord army.
What a joke… That Time Sect Master… That Time Sect Master who could shatter Red Ants like they were nothing…
Even without the support of a Beast Tamer this time, it actually couldn't even break through the opponent's defense??
Wait a minute, the World Destruction Dragon lost, and the Time Sect Master lost… Great God Shi Yu… was eliminated just like that??
"Impossible, definitely impossible!!" Countless Shi Yu supporters couldn't believe that Shi Yu's pet, which had swept through the cosmic overlord army, had lost just like that. They couldn't accept that Shi Yu had been eliminated without even going on stage.
…
In the outside world, Baby Ginseng, who was paying attention to the battle, felt that this kid was worth teaching when it saw the way Turtle defeated Shorty.
In the team internal competition, one should think of a countermeasure according to the opponent's skills in advance!
This was the battle method of intelligent creatures!
As long as they controlled themselves and didn't have any hostility towards Shorty, they could directly cripple Shorty's Retribution White Tiger and reduce its attack power by 30%. With the defense of the Super Holy Beast, Shorty couldn't break through their defense at all.
Of course, it wasn't easy to do this either. The reason why Little Quas and Turtle could do it was because they were teammates with a contract connection. This relationship was even more reliable than blood relations. If it were other non-Shi Yu pets, it would be impossible.
"Yi…" Baby Ginseng looked at the next battle list and adjusted its glasses.
Susu vs the World Cleansing Demon Duck!
Baby Ginseng vs Super Holy Beast!
Eleven vs Chi Tong!
Buggy vs Ling!
The elimination of Shi Yu's two pets directly caused a huge commotion in the various realms. Most people who didn't know were very unacceptable to this outcome.
A small number of people who knew were already numb. For example, Phoenix Man, Zi Lan, and the others, who had been to Blue Planet, exploded when they saw the pile of Shi Yu's pets left on the God Sealing Battle list.
If it weren't for the fact that they couldn't talk nonsense without Shi Yu's permission, they really wanted to spoil the show for these ignorant spectators.
The two who had just been eliminated, the two powerful pets that had swept through the geniuses of the overlord army, were only the second team of Shi Yu's second team!!
This God Sealing Battle… was about to be destroyed by Shi Yu!! This top eight battle directly became the team's internal competition!!
"In the end, it's finally come to this?" The Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the others looked at the battle list and were rather silent.
At this moment, the Floating Realm was going to lose.
"Shi Yu is really a strange person." The five super divines of Blue Planet were additionally together. They paid attention to Shi Yu's advancement progress the whole time. At this moment, when they saw that the top 10 had already been completely monopolized by Shi Yu, their feelings were extremely complicated.
If the Dong Xuan Region and the Heavenly Demon Region wanted to nurture a genius who could enter the top 10 and 100, they had to wait many years for one.
Shi Yu, on the other hand, had all his contracted pets and occupied the top 10…
"Perhaps our mother planet really has some great luck," the Phoenix Race super deity said. "I'm looking forward to returning to our mother planet more and more."
As a race born on Blue Planet, although the five god races had left Blue Planet for a long, long time, as long as they returned to Blue Planet, they could still quickly establish a "bloodline" connection with Blue Planet again.
At that time, when Blue Planet advanced, they could obtain a lot of benefits. On the contrary, if they supported other planets and other planets advanced, the benefits they obtained would be much lesser than Blue Planet's advancement. It was equivalent to the difference between a biological mother and a stepmother.
"Seniors, the championship is imminent. There's something I want to discuss with you."
"About Shi Yu."
"There might be someone who wants to harm Shi Yu."
At this moment, as the final fight approached, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng additionally found the five super divines of Blue Planet again.
"Who???" At that moment, the five super divines on Blue Planet treated Shi Yu even more intimately than their clansmen. Whoever dared to touch Shi Yu at this instant was undoubtedly provoking them.
"Who is it?" The angel goddess's tone was additionally a little cold.
"The Four Saints of the Four Holy Families are super divine!" Lin Feng said. As soon as he finished speaking, the expressions of the five super divines on Blue Planet froze.
"Why are they trying to harm Shi Yu???" The Kirin Race's super deity couldn't understand.
The super deity level was divided into exceeding 1 to transcendent 9. The five of them were all super divines who had transcended once. They were the weakest super divines, and the Four Saint super divines of the Four Holy Families were all powerful super divines above transcendent 4. Not to mention five against four, even if it was five against three, it was still a question if they could win.
"Seniors, don't panic first."
"Nonsense, why would we panic? Not to mention the Four Saints super divine, even if the cosmic overlord army wants to harm Shi Yu, they have to pass by us first… So, what exactly is going on?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1502 Current Situation of the Team Internal Tournament (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1502 Current Situation of the Team Internal Tournament (1)
Lin Feng chuckled and said, "It's not a big deal."
"After watching the competition for so long, in addition to the fact that you know about Shi Yu's pet information, I believe you've also noticed it, right?"
