"Shi Yu's four holy pets were all cultivated by Shi Yu to be very strong."
"The evolutionary path of faith is the cruelest. Countless lives are fighting for it. The birth of two gods of the same faith means that the strength of the other will be halved… Now, as Shi Yu's four holy pets show their potential, and they don't belong to the Four Holy Family, they will definitely become a thorn in the side of the Four Saints super divine."
"Although I heard that those four old guys indeed value their status very much, it shouldn't be that a Four Holy Evolver with potential will appear just like that, right?" The five super divine beings didn't understand.
"Of course it's not that simple," Lin Feng said. "Actually, Shi Yu… even cracked the Four Holy Ruins of the Heavenly Spirit Domain and has the power of faith of countless eras. This almost means that every four holy pets of Shi Yu can evolve to the extreme and have super divine potential."
The five super divines on Blue Planet were stunned. Then, they said in disbelief, "Shi Yu… cracked the Four Holy Ruins??"
"Yeah." Lin Feng smiled and said, "However, he hasn't had time to take away the ruins, but once he takes away the ruins, he will definitely become a thorn in the side of the Four Holy Families. Moreover, even if the procedures are legal, it probably won't be that smooth-sailing for him to take away the ruins."
"Therefore, we've discussed it. Seniors, when the time comes to take away the ruins, can you be Shi Yu's guardians and clean up all the enemies blocking his way?"
"This…" The hearts of the five super divines on Blue Planet kept changing. They completely didn't expect Shi Yu to actually crack the ruins of the Four Holy Era.
That was fat meat in the hands of the Four Holy Family, and it was fat meat that would make them hungry if others ate it.
At this moment, Blue Planet's Five super divines, who originally thought that they had already overestimated Shi Yu, immediately felt how terrifying Shi Yu was when they heard that Shi Yu had even become the master of the Four Holy Ruins.
This kid's possibility was countless times stronger than that of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng.
Not to mention the super divines of the Four Holy Family, even they were a little worried at this moment that Shi Yu would become the new super divine of Blue Planet after he grew up and competed with them for Blue Planet resources.
Fortunately, Shi Yu wasn't even at the divine level now. When Shi Yu became a super divine, the bulk of Blue Planet's resources would have long been divided between them… Moreover, on account of Shi Yu bringing back the permanent teleportation array, even if they gave some to Shi Yu, the five super divine beings could still withstand it.
At the thought of this, the five super divines sighed with emotion at their kindness. Although the Four Saints were stronger than them, their moral standards weren't as high as theirs!
"Can we seize the Four Holy Ruins later?" The dragon super divine said, "After Blue Planet advances to a high-level planet, our Blue Planet will definitely not be afraid of the Four Holy Families."
Emperor Kong said, "How long will this take? Moreover, not taking it away in advance doesn't mean that the Four Holy Family won't pay attention to Shi Yu. With the ability of a super divine level, Shi Yu won't hide the fact that he deciphered the Four Holy Ruins for long. For example, it's better to take the initiative than to be passive. Could it be that our Blue Planet bloodline can't protect a junior?"
"Who said so?" the super divine of the Demon Race said. "I'll be his guardian."
"I'll be his guardian too," the angel super divine said.
Dragon, Phoenix, Kirin: ???
The Angel Race and the Demon Race's super divine were just worried that they didn't have a deep connection with Shi Yu. At this moment, after analyzing the benefits of this matter, they immediately expressed their position.
Although there was a risk of becoming enemies with the Four Holy Family, it was impossible for the Four Saints to openly launch a super divine battle over such a thing. The Four Holy Family couldn't ignore public opinion.
If a genius with possibility appeared, they would have to suppress him openly. This would make the Four Saints super divine infamous. A large number of Four Holy Evolvers among the commoners would also treat the Four Holy Family as enemies.
Therefore, the Four Holy Family would at most have some cheap shots and cheap tricks. It was precisely because of this that the Angel God and the Demon Race agreed very readily.
Moreover, Shi Yu's Ling and Susu were both pets with special identities. They were from the Space Disaster Research Institute and the Environmental Protection Association. The Four Holy Family would definitely be more wary when the time came.
In addition, Shi Yu had been chosen by the cosmic overlord army. In this aspect, the Four Holy Family still had to be wary!
This way, after thinking about it carefully, they felt that this matter wasn't that unsolvable.
Under this pile of pressure, even the Four Holy Family had no choice but to admit defeat!
"Alright, it's just the Four Holy Family," the super divines of the Dragon, Phoenix, and Kirin races also uttered with stomachaches after thinking it through.
Let's do it!
The five of them had been silent for so long. Now that they had decided to come back, they couldn't be as timid as before. Now that the advantage was theirs, so be it if they provoked the mere Four Holy Family!
Moreover, the five of them might not necessarily be united in the Four Holy Family.
"Thank you, seniors," the Space Emperor uttered with a smile. He didn't expect the five super divines to be so straightforward this time. He said, "As for Shi Yu, he said that he will also go to the Environmental Protection Association, the Space Disaster Research Institute, and the cosmic overlord army to seek some support before taking action. In addition, he, who has just become the champion of the God Sealing Battle, will also be the center of attention on the entire World King Planet. Therefore, the taking of the ruins shouldn't cause too much of a commotion."
"Considering the pressure of public opinion, the Four Holy Family doesn't dare to be too brazen. They're not the only ones dominating the World King Planet."
Soon, the Blue Planet bloodline finished discussing. After the God Sealing Battle ended, they would go and seize away the Four Holy Ruins at any time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1503 Current Situation of the Team Internal Tournament (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1503 Current Situation of the Team Internal Tournament (2)
Although they were quite worried at the start, when they thought about how they might have to fight the Four Holy Family, the five super divines of Blue Planet, who had been keeping a low profile for a long time, felt an inexplicable sense of anticipation and excitement…
They were afraid, but how could they not have a hidden desire to court death when they dared to form five parties to explore the era ruins when they were young?
…
After returning to the God Sealing Battle competition, the defeat of the World Destruction Dragon and the Time Sect Master was completely unexpected. The strength of the World Cleansing Demon Duck and the Super Holy Beast was also unexpected. Even the super divine Luster suddenly felt that Shi Yu wasn't that desirable anymore.
Perhaps the other eight newbies were even more monstrous? What exactly was going on with this year's World King Planet… The 177th Fleet was confused.
The audience was only silent for a moment before paying attention to the battle of the top eight again.
"Do you think the cleansing of the Star Spirit Race this time will fall from the altar?"
"Among the top 10 newbies, the World Cleansing Demon Duck is ranked before the cleansing star spirit. At first, I was very confused, but now, I finally understand why."
"The World Cleansing Demon Duck that has mastered the power of the powerful abyss, purification, ocean, and darkness is a freak. Even in the abyss, it should be the batch with super divine potential, right? Even if it's the Abyss Race carefully modified by the abyss super divine, it's still a question if it can be as powerful as this duck."
Susu vs the World Cleansing Demon Duck!
This battle made the spies of the Abyss Race and the Environmental Protection Association make the various large factions very concerned.
When the battle room was created, an ordinary venue appeared. After the World Cleansing Demon Duck and the cleansing star spirit, Susu, appeared, the audience held their breaths, wanting to see this fated battle…
However, in the next moment.
As the battle began, everyone couldn't hold it in anymore.
The World Cleansing Demon Duck took off the white eyeband it was wearing today and held it in its hand. It looked at its opponent with clear eyes, waved the white cloth, and surrendered.
"Quack! (I surrender!)"
Duckie was on the brink of tears. Luck was indeed conserved. It was lucky to have encountered Little Ji, but in the next round, it encountered Big Sister Susu.
Did it dare to fight? It didn't dare fight at all!
Even if it encountered Eleven, Buggy, or Baby Ginseng, it had to learn a thing or two.
However, facing Big Sister Susu, who countered it from the beginning to the end, Duckie understood that it could be insta-killed in an instant.
After all, Susu's strongest cleansing power was a powerful method that could even crush intermediate-level Abyss Worms.
The World Cleansing Demon Duck admitted defeat.
If it weren't for the fact that it didn't want Big Sister Susu to be embarrassed, it wouldn't even want to come. It would directly stand Big Sister Susu up.
All the contestants watching this battle were instantly stunned.
Huh???
"We can fight." Susu frowned. It didn't want to win without fighting.
"If I can't you. I've never defeated you before, Big Sister." Duckie cried.
"Forget it…" After a moment of silence, Susu said, "If Duckie doesn't want to fight, so be it."
"Wu wu!!" Duckie raised its white flag and shouted for the battle elf to let it admit defeat.
The audience fell into deep thought. They… knew each other?
The World Cleansing Demon Duck called the cleansing star spirit Susu "Big Sister"??
Wait a minute… That made sense. Such a powerful Abyss Race definitely had an identity card to participate in the God Sealing Battle.
And only the Environmental Protection Association was qualified to apply for an identity card for the Abyss Race.
Since Susu was a genius of the Environmental Protection Association, it was only natural for both parties to know each other.
Then, it made sense that the World Cleansing Demon Duck said it had never won Susu and then directly surrended…
The audience who was still guessing that the World Cleansing Demon Duck might defeat the cleansing star spirit just now immediately fell into deep thought when they saw that the World Cleansing Demon Duck didn't even have the courage to fight. They looked at Susu in confusion.
It could be said that the direction of this battle made all the spectators feel that it was ridiculous and unbelievable again.
…
At another venue.
As the "battle" between Susu and Duckie ended, the battle between Baby Ginseng and the Super Holy Beast was about to begin.
This battle also received the same level of attention.
The audience couldn't forget the strength of the Super Holy Beast that crushed the Time Sect Master.
In comparison, although the ginseng emperor, who had mastered the power of time, could temporarily have divine-level battle power and wasn't weak, it didn't look like it could defeat the Super Holy Beast no matter how one looked at it.
In the rookie ranking, the Super Holy Beast ranked third was also far ahead of the ginseng emperor.
The sky arena wasn't the home ground of either Baby Ginseng or the Super Holy Beast. After they appeared, they gazed at each other.
The Super Holy Beast had a serious expression.
Baby Ginseng had a composed expression.
The expressions of both parties made the audience very confused.
Because in everyone's judgment, the power of the Super Holy Beast could completely crush Baby Ginseng.
Why was it the Super Holy Beast that had a grave expression?
"Your performance in your previous combat wasn't bad," Baby Ginseng stated after entering the battlefield, like a teacher teaching a student.
"However, you're still a little inexperienced!"
The expressions of the turtle and Little Quas turned bitter. They knew what Baby Ginseng meant. The trend of researching skills targeting teammates in team internal competition was started by Baby Ginseng. Their little tricks were definitely amateurish in front of Teacher Ginseng.
Even their birth was thanks to Teacher Ginseng.
Although they felt that their power wasn't inferior to Teacher Ginseng, and even if Teacher Ginseng self-destructed, they were confident that they could rely on the power of faith to defend, Little Quas and Turtle still felt pressure when facing the composed ginseng baby.
"Then, let the combat begin." Baby Ginseng snapped its fingers, and a tree sprout grew out from behind Turtle and Little Quas. A fruit manifested on the sapling, and this fruit emitted a shocking fragrance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1504 Current Situation of the Team Internal Tournament (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1504 Current Situation of the Team Internal Tournament (3)
Turtle and Little Quas's spirits swayed as they realized that this was their favorite taste.
But in the next moment, the fruit instantly filled with light, making Turtle and Little Quas defend with all their might as if they were facing a great enemy!
Energy Explosion Fruit?
When they defended, their expressions suddenly changed. They saw that this fruit didn't cause any damage at all. When it exploded, it didn't produce any power at all. Only a strong power of time spread and gently touched them.
"Roar!!!" In the next moment, under the shocked expressions of the audience, the Super Holy Beast let out a wail. Its body was filled with white light, and its entire body was actually splitting into two…!!
Buzz!!!
As Baby Ginseng used the Reincarnation Fruit as the core to investigate the principle of the Black Tortoise Fusion Technique, the explosion of the Turtle and Little Quas, and the combination of the Super Holy Beast instantly divided into two, turning into a standing turtle and a three-headed snake.
Before Turtle and Little Quas could react, they realized in despair that they were each suffocated by a wooden stick, unable to exert any strength from their bodies.
What?
Turtle and Little Quas were shocked, not understanding why Baby Ginseng could make them degenerate.
Could it be that… Baby Ginseng had obtained the Black Tortoise Fusion Skill from Shi Yu and studied it?
"F*ck…" At this moment, the spectators were directly shocked when they saw the Super Holy Beast being blown into two by the ginseng emperor's bomb.
In the outside world, Little Ji, Shorty, and the others who were watching the battle also swallowed their saliva crazily.
So… So… Senior Baby Ginseng was researching these things before the God Sealing Battle??
Shorty's hair stood on end. Fortunately, it didn't encounter Senior Baby Ginseng. Otherwise, who knew what anti-shorty energy fruit Senior Baby Ginseng had prepared for it…
Shorty originally thought that with the power of faith, they could compete with a team of seniors, but now, seeing that Turtle and Little Quas couldn't last more than a round in front of Senior Baby Ginseng, it instantly knew that it was wrong.
They were all cultivated by Shi Yu and a team of seniors. Their growth trajectories had been witnessed all the way, so how could they defeat them…
"We…" Turtle and Little Quas were controlled and extremely panicked. They wanted to admit defeat, but they were directly stabbed in the body by the wooden spikes. After the fusion was removed, they didn't have such a powerful defense at all. Moreover, Baby Ginseng was using poison.
When the venom entered their bodies, Turtle and Little Quas instantly fainted weakly and fell to the ground.
"Yi! (This venom is called 20s!)" As soon as Baby Ginseng finished speaking, it turned around coolly. Its research suit fluttered. 20s was a poison that would make the poisoned person faint for 20 seconds, but there were no other side effects. It was appropriate to deal with its loved ones.
[Winner: ginseng emperor!]
Words spread.
The audience was stunned. They understood that it was another completely incomprehensible and unscientific battle process.
Damn, the powerful contestant who had just defeated the World Destruction Dragon and the Time Sect Master was defeated just like that? One admitted defeat, and the other exploded in crushing defeat?
However, they clearly didn't see how terrifying the capabilities displayed by Susu and the ginseng emperor were. What exactly was going on!
Who could disclose exactly how strong these two guys were?
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1505 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1505 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (1)
The audience discovered that this year's God Sealing Battle was the most difficult to predict.
Shi Yu brought the World Destruction Dragon and the Time Sect Master to sweep through the elite recruits of the cosmic overlord army. Just as everyone thought that Shi Yu would be a powerful candidate to win the championship, the World Destruction Dragon was shattered by the World Cleansing Demon Duck. The Time Sect Master was crushed by the Super Holy Beast…
Just as everyone was lamenting the strength of the World Cleansing Demon Duck and the Super Holy Beast, the World Cleansing Demon Duck directly surrendered when it encountered its opponent. The Super Holy Beast was even insta-killed!
It gave people the feeling that there were reversals everywhere, and that each beast was stronger than the other.
"This ginseng emperor is simply unbelievable. I understand. The Super Holy Beast is a Black Tortoise Evolver. The Turtle Snake-type Black Tortoise is evolved from the fusion of two lives! However, the unique skill used by the ginseng emperor just now is like Time Reversal, reversing the Super Holy Beast to before evolution, splitting them into two, and their battle power is greatly reduced!"
"It doesn't seem like the ginseng emperor has displayed very powerful attack methods, but this is clearly more terrifying than Zavay!"
The audience felt their hair stand on end. They had completely underestimated this ginseng emperor previously. Why did it have such a terrifying skill?
"Next round… Eleven vs Chi Tong. Who do you think will win…"
"At the moment, Eleven's best battle result is to defeat Zavay, but winning isn't easy."
"And contestant Chi Tong's best battle result is to instantly kill the son of the Demon Emperor with a sword…"
"The two of them are ranked first and second among the newbies by the box god…"
"Of course, from the looks of it, the box god's ranking isn't accurate. Perhaps it's because Eleven and Chi Tong displayed more strength before the ranking that they're ranked first and second… The hidden methods of the ginseng emperor and the others at the bottom are also very terrifying."
"But it's undeniable that Eleven and Chi Tong are still very strong. Eleven should have used all his trump cards to fight Zavay, but contestant Chi Tong looked extremely calm when he fought the son of the Demon Emperor. Perhaps contestant Chi Tong still has trump cards."
"I bet that contestant Chi Tong will win. As long as contestant Chi Tong's trump card is powerful enough, he might be able to defeat Eleven!"
The audience kept analyzing the next battle between Eleven and Chi Tong. Among them, Eleven, who had defeated Zavay, was very strong in everyone's eyes, but there were no secrets.
However, they couldn't see the depth of contestant Chi Tong's sword that instantly killed the son of the Demon Emperor. They didn't know if it was its strongest strength, so from the looks of it, the outcome of the confrontation between the initial and second rookies was still uncertain.
However, considering the reversal of the previous battles, most of the audience felt that Chi Tong had a higher chance of winning!
There was no other reason than that Chi Tong was more mysterious and beautiful. It gave people the feeling that they could win to the end.
In response to this battle, the son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, Ming Gu, Zavay, and the others, also paid extreme attention.
Soon, the battlefield opened.
This was a forest venue. In the center was a large empty space, surrounded by a forest with rich natural energy. This randomly matched venue didn't look like it had any bonuses for both parties.
Just as Ling had said, luck was also a part of strength. On this point, the mechanism of the God Sealing Battle was also acknowledged. As for the confrontation between Eleven and Chi Tong, clearly, neither party's luck had the upper hand.
Eleven and Chi Tong slowly appeared on both sides of the ground and looked at each other.
Chi Tong, who was in the form of a Sword Maiden, was the initial to smile. From the first battle, the Death Sword Maiden Chi Tong had always been very cold and had a silent aura. This was the first time everyone had seen her smile!
Unbelievable!
"Since the opponent is you, I won't hold back!" After smiling, Chi Tong came up and chose the strongest ultimate move!! Its final profundity!!
Immortal Slaying Sword Formation!
"Wu wu wu!!" Eleven, who was opposite Chi Tong, was angry. Damn Chi Tong. Eleven was very stifled to encounter Chi Tong so early.
This was because Chi Tong was definitely very strong. Although Chi Tong had gotten initial place in the previous batch because of Shi Yu's support, Chi Tong's accompanying move could be said to be the most perfect existence in the entire team.
Eleven experienced that if it wanted to defeat Chi Tong, it had to pay a huge price.
"What is she doing?" As Chi Tong changed its usual expression, the audience was rather surprised. Chi Tong, who was opposite Eleven, directly let go of the fire-patterned Black Sword in its hand, took it out, and flew into the sky to disappear!
"A move I've never seen before." The gazes of the opponents who had been insta-killed by Chi Tong rotated cold.
In the next moment, with shocking sword cries, everyone also discovered that something was wrong and looked at the sky in shock.
At some point, four huge sword phantoms suddenly hung in the sky. Each of them was a thousand meters long.
At first, they were phantoms, but as the sword cry sounded, they gradually gained divine power. One of them had a purple light secret in the silver-white sword body. In an instant, it was as if it had transmigrated into an endless space and time and descended, reflecting the endless spatial profundities. Then, in front of everyone, it was instantly covered by a red light that filled the sky. The light was as dazzling as a blazing sun, and the sword cry that sounded like a sparrow's cry sounded. A red immortal sword suddenly appeared, like a world-destroying divine weapon.
The descent of the third immortal sword, accompanied by a vast death aura, swept up black clouds that stretched for thousands of meters. The black sword body was filled with death nirvana fluctuations.
The fourth one had just descended. The unstoppable metal sword aura seemed to have pierced through the sky and space, collapsing everything. It also formed a Heavenly Sword Formation that towered in all directions with the other three immortal swords. With shocking sword pressure, it sealed the entire small world in the sword formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1506 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1506 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (2)
"Impossible…" As the sword formation appeared, countless spectators cried out in shock.
Because the pressure each immortal sword gave people wasn't inferior to the sword Chi Tong, who instantly killed the son of the Demon Emperor back then. And now, there were four swords!
They seemed to have combined into a sword formation, perfectly and harmoniously becoming the ultimate profundity.
The son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, wielded a knife, indifferent to the distinction between knives and swords. He was astounded by the immense power of this sword formation, finding it unbelievable. The Immortal Slaying Sword Formation was composed of the four elements of space, fire, death, and gold, initially just a high-level divine skill.
However, the current Immortal Slaying Sword Formation no longer looked like a high-level divine skill. The Sword of Space contained the power of the spatial mastery divine skill mastered by Chi Tong. The Fire Divine Sword contained a portion of the power of the World Destruction Flame of the Vermillion Bird clone. The Death Divine Sword contained the power of the Death Control Divine Skill mastered by Chi Tong. The Metal Divine Sword was the power of the Metal Control.
After these four powers were given to the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation by Chi Tong, it used the Interlocking Sword and the Myriad Sword Convergence as guidance to completely perfect the ultimate Immortal Slaying Sword Formation and perfectly fused them. A profundity fused all the divine skills Chi Tong had mastered now.
It could be said that this move was the strongest profundity in Shi Yu's team now.
At this moment, even the intermediate god was secretly shocked when it sensed this sword.
"This sword can instantly kill me. I can't resist at all!" Zavay said in disbelief. If its opponent was Chi Tong, it would definitely have no chance of survival under this sword formation.
"It's impossible for a creature to be so strong." After the son of the Demon Emperor discovered the true difference between him and Chi Tong, he couldn't accept it either.
"As expected, I knew that Chi Tong must have a trump card, and it's a very terrifying trump card. Under this move, no matter how strong Eleven's physique is, it's impossible to resist…" The incomparably exquisite Immortal Slaying Sword Formation was like art, intoxicating countless spectators.
No one could imagine what methods below the God Realm could block this move.
"Go…" Chi Tong gave the order, and the air buzzed and vibrated. The void was pierced, and extremely terrifying mixed sword intent tore through the air from the four immortal swords. The Immortal Slaying Sword Formation directly trapped and killed Eleven!
Chi Tong's gaze burned. Logically speaking, it definitely couldn't withstand this move. Fortunately, it had a scapegoat!
Vermillion Bird clone!
With the support of the power of faith, the Vermillion Bird clone could be a scapegoat. It could maximize the power of this final profundity!
"Wuu!!" Facing the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation, Eleven didn't dare be arrogant. Its expression was solemn. It knew that Chi Tong would use this move, but if Chi Tong thought that it could defeat it like this, it was wrong!!
The audience looked at Eleven. Zavay, who had fought Eleven, and Ming Gu, who had indirectly fought Eleven with the crystal Zavay gave him, didn't think that Eleven could withstand this move. Even if Eleven erupted to its strongest state, it would probably only be able to barely resist, but it couldn't last long.
From Chi Tong's calm state, Eleven was in danger!
However, just as everyone judged that this move was invincible, Eleven stood on the spot and let the thousands of sword lights fall. It had no intention of blocking or dodging.
Although it appeared like it couldn't dodge either, was it just going to be indifferent??
No!
Just as everyone believed that Eleven was about to give up resisting, Eleven's gaze erupted with warpath. Eight figures appeared in all directions!!
Bean Bear, save me!
The eight trigram clones that controlled the power of laws in Heaven, Earth, Thunder, Wind, Water, Fire, Mountain, and Swamp appeared with a bang!
Eight Iron-eating Beasts in different colors and different styles of armor appeared, immediately stunning the audience. In the next moment, they saw that these clones protected Eleven and Four, forming the Taiji Eight Trigrams Formation!!
Buzz!!
Countless sword lights descended, and a Yin Yang Taiji Painting appeared under Eleven's feet. A hemisphere-shaped eight trigram law barrier directly enveloped the outside world of the nine iron-eating beasts. When the sword lights landed on it, it was like a stone sinking into the sea, not causing any ripples.
"Wuu~" Eleven stood in the center of the Eight Trigrams Formation, crossed its arms, and appeared straight at God Chi Tong!
Come on!
Let's hurt each other!
Did you think I didn't have a secret weapon either?
"Damn it." In the sky, Chi Tong couldn't help but say.
Eight Trigrams Clone!
The reason Eleven was confident in resisting Chi Tong's ultimate move was because of the Eight Trigrams clone. Now that the Eight Trigrams clone was maxed out, it had many functions. It was completely no problem to combine it into a defensive army skill.
Before the God Sealing Battle, as if Eleven had pinched a Bean Bear, Eleven had already condensed eight trigram clones at their peak who were waiting for powerful enemies.
However, Eleven felt aggrieved. The eight trigrams clone was like Baby Ginseng's Time Mark. It was especially time-consuming to condense it. Although it might condense clones in advance, if it was defeated in battle, the second batch of eight trigrams clones condensed in a short period of time would definitely not be as powerful as the current batch of eight trigrams clones.
Now, every one of these eight trigram clones had several times its strength. Every one of them had strengthened this battle for a long time.
But the newly condensed ones couldn't.
Therefore, if this batch of clones was consumed, its battle force would decrease greatly, like Baby Ginseng and Zavay, who had lost the Time Mark.
However, currently that he had encountered Chi Tong, there was no way to hide this move…
Taiji Eight Trigrams Formation vs Immortal Slaying Sword Formation!!!
The two peerless arrays collided!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1507 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1507 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (3)
Boom!!
Space distorted, and the world shattered.
Every audience looked at Eleven and Chi Tong in a daze, especially Zavay. His body kept trembling as he looked at Eleven, who was controlling the eight trigram clone…
This move…
Top-notch clone army divine skill…
"When it fought me, it didn't use its full strength at all…" Zavay was in a daze as it looked at the battle scene in disbelief. It originally thought that it had already forced Eleven to the limit and into its strongest state.
However, the other party actually still had such a trump card!!
The audience realized that they had made a mistake again!!
Not only did Chi Tong hide its peerless trump card, but Eleven was also the same. Moreover, its trump card was quite shocking and incomparably powerful. The eight armored Iron-eating Beasts whose auras weren't much inferior to Eleven gave everyone the same terrifying feeling. Every clone seemed to be able to take down the top 10 of the God Sealing Tournament!
Boom boom boom boom boom boom!!
Under the continuous collision of the two divine formations, the audience felt that the entire world had already collapsed. After losing consciousness, the audience didn't know how long had passed. When everyone returned to their senses, the eight trigrams array had already disappeared. The eight trigrams clones were all half-knelt on the ground, as if there was no life left.
In the sky, the Death Sword Ji Chi Tong had an indignant expression. The four immortal swords shattered with a bang.
Obviously, the Vermillion Bird clone and itself had already exceeded the burden and reached their limit.
She looked at Eleven, who was standing on the Taiji Painting. Its condition wasn't much better than the Bean Bears, but it was much better than her. Its eyes were still filled with warpath. It closed its eyes slightly unwillingly and fell from the sky.
"You win…"
Before landing, Chi Tong was directly teleported out of the world. Seeing Chi Tong admit defeat, Eleven roared excitedly as the eight trigram clone disappeared!!
"Roar!!! (I am the Panda King!!)" It was Little Ji and Duckie possessing him.
But soon, Eleven's expression turned bitter. Although it had defeated Chi Tong, its eight trigrams clone was gone. It hoped that Baby Ginseng and the others could also exhaust each other's trump cards. Otherwise, its champion position would really be in danger!
The competition ended!
Eleven won!
Although some people guessed this result correctly, the process completely shocked everyone. They didn't guess correctly.
This battle once again explained to everyone what a battle between gods was!!!
"I don't understand…"
"Scary, too scary… Chi Tong's move was already so terrifying, but it actually lost??"
"What kind of monster is this Eleven!!"
"Is this the strength of the first and second rookies??"
Everyone found it unbelievable. They felt that they couldn't understand the situation anymore.
Outside the battlefield hall, Chi Tong was teleported out. It sighed slightly, and sharp sword intent still lingered on its body. As the surrounding contestants looked at her in shock, she also looked weakly at the battle screen hanging on the wall.
"The next battle…"
Soon, everyone paid attention to the last battle of the top eight and top four, Ling vs the Worm of Imagination!!
Regarding Ling's strength, no one doubted at all that Ling, who had mastered the Starry Sky Storm, was definitely a super big boss of the Space Disaster Research Institute. Perhaps it didn't have a human mechanic at all. After all, after the audience thought about it carefully, they couldn't think of a Level 9 mechanic who could nurture the Starry Sky Storm machine.
Perhaps Ling was a quasi-divine machine created by some super divine mechanic or super divine mechanical life form without a contract.
As for Ling's opponent, no one actually felt anything. Firstly, Buggy's newbie introductions as the Time Sect Master and the Super Holy Beast were too ambiguous. Moreover, it had always been in Buggy's body, so they really couldn't tell how it was strong.
Of course, it wasn't strong. It was just that, compared to other newbies, ranking fourth was definitely not weak. However, Buggy had yet to display its true strength, making it impossible to see through.
"Ling is really lucky. It's the starry sky venue again!!"
After the battle between Buggy and Ling began, the audience realized that they had been matched to the starry sky venue again.
For Ling, who had mastered the Starry Sky Storm, this was simply a huge enhancement effect.
However, on the starry sky arena, Ling gazed at Buggy opposite it without any joy. As a constellation god, the Green Dragon was also a universe god from the last era. The starry sky was also its home ground.
This time… its good luck didn't take effect.
Or rather, Buggy's ability was too comprehensive and almost omnipotent. In front of absolute strength, luck seemed a little unnecessary.
"I bet on the Worm of Imagination to win!!! The previous battles were all reversals. This combat will definitely be reversals too. It must be the Worm of Imagination that hasn't displayed its strength before and hasn't been thought highly of!" This time, a gambler learned to be smart. The chances of winning were reversed. The villa was close to the sea!
Although Ling's Starry Sky Storm was very strong and its luck was heaven-defying, according to the rules of the previous matches, it definitely looked weak and had a higher chance of winning!
"A bunch of people believe they're smart. The power displayed by that Starry Sky Storm can definitely rank in the top three of the unique skills that have appeared in this God Sealing Battle!" Ming Gu thought!
Only Eleven and Chi Tong's unique moves might exceed that of Starry Sky Storm.
When the combat began, Ling didn't say a word and directly condensed the Starry Sky Storm, planning to trap Buggy. Then, it kept backing off and pulling away from Buggy.
This move stunned the audience. Although Ling had also began Starry Sky Storm previously, it had always been calm. But this time, why did it suddenly retreat as if it was facing a great enemy?
On the starry sky arena, Buggy stared at Sister Ling…
"Ji… (Sorry.)" For the sake of honor, it was going to eliminate Ling in this battle!

chapters.title: Chapter 1508 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1508 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (4)
Although Ling's Starry Sky Storm was powerful, it was only for ordinary people. Would the four cosmic emperors, that cosmic overlord, be afraid of the Starry Sky Storm?
Buggy, who was more ambitious than a cosmic-level expert and had watched the powerful Buggy of the Starry Sky Storm many times, naturally couldn't allow the team to have skills that it couldn't match.
It had long prepared a response strategy.
Dao validation with strength!
"Is it going to shapeshift?" Ling still kept retreating.
Facing the difficult Ling, Buggy didn't dare to be careless and directly went all out.
"Roar!!!" As the huge Starry Sky Storm condensed and surrounded Buggy, under the gaze of the audience, the so-called "Buggy of Imagination" directly shapeshifted. Accompanied by a dragon roar and dragon might, a ten-thousand-meter-long Green Dragon directly circled the starry sky arena and appeared shockingly.
At this moment, although Buggy had become a Green Dragon, its image had actually changed a little from its previous form.
The level of the evolution skill, the Dragon of Imagination, had increased to the quasi-divine skill stage. Coupled with the huge power of faith of the Green Dragon, Buggy had already reached the 2.5 stage of the Green Dragon's evolution.
When the Dragon of Imagination reached the divine skill stage, Buggy would definitely take another step closer to the Green Dragon and even awaken a new skill.
At this moment, Buggy was entrenched under the starry sky. It had golden dragon horns and was covered in green scales. These didn't change. What changed was that the golden faith flames that were originally burning on its body had already been restrained. Its body was already a perfect body of faith, and it no longer needed other faith substances to prove its identity.
In its place were some green dragon feathers on its head and body that turned into white dragon feathers. They landed on Buggy like a sea of clouds that stretched for thousands of miles, making it look ancient and honorable.
Buggy liked these white dragon feathers very much. It felt that they were like the worm silk from before—very warm.
Apart from that, Buggy was also holding a small star-like dragon ball in its claw!!
At this moment, the Starry Sky Storm swept over. The Dragon Ball in Buggy's hand burned with the flames of golden faith, and a world seemed to have been born inside. Buggy surprisingly activated its strongest profundity now!
Creation Domain+Star Refinement+Dragon Star Group!
The Dragon Star Group was an arms, and the Star Refinement was a skill to use arms, allowing the Dragon Ball to absorb the power of the stars in the surroundings. As for the Creation Domain, it opened a world inside the Dragon Ball and gave this star-like Dragon Ball the true power of the world.
The Star Refining Race could only use non-life stars as arms. However, the Dragon Ball Star that had fused with the power of creation was like a life star, and its power became stronger.
Such use was the supreme profundity that the genius of the Green Dragon Family could only dream of. It was also a combination that the Star Refining Race couldn't come into contact with.
"Roar!!!" Under Buggy's roar, it directly smashed the Dragon Ball at the Starry Sky Storm. The Dragon Ball shot out like a golden laser. Under the shocked gazes of Ling and the audience in the distance, the Starry Sky Storm was directly smashed into a huge hole violently. Buggy followed the trajectory of the Dragon Ball and also seemed to have turned into a green-gold light that instantly broke out of the Starry Sky Storm!!
"This!!!" The audience was shocked.
"Impossible!" Ming Gu was shocked when he saw the Starry Sky Storm being violently smashed open.
In the next moment, the Dragon Ball floated in the sky above the battleship, containing a powerful pressure. Buggy descended in front of Ling and grabbed Ling, who wanted to teleport and turn into light to escape, in its huge dragon claw.
Ling's spatial control was still copied from it. It was showing off in front of an expert.
"Don't even think about escaping," Buggy said.
"Is that necessary?" Ling said.
"Admit defeat," Buggy said. With Ling's skill configuration, it was impossible for it to win against something that could utilize the power of faith.
"Alright, alright… I admit defeat~" Ling raised its hand helplessly. It had stated that it wasn't interested in the championship. To be honest, it had already predicted this outcome before the battle began.
Star Refinement+Dragon Star Group+Creation Domain was simply a perfect combination. Its power under the starry sky arena was not much inferior to the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation. It was indeed a little difficult to deal with.
If the opponents were Shorty, Turtle, and the others, Ling could still find their weaknesses and combat the enemy enjoy Baby Ginseng. However, Buggy's weaknesses were too few. Its attributes were even more comprehensive than Eleven's, making Ling helpless.
"Thank you for the fight." Buggy let go of its dragon claws.
Ling was directly teleported out.
As for the gamblers who bet on Buggy winning, they were already stunned.
They were looking forward to Buggy reversing the battle, but…
They never expected that the powerful cosmic disaster would actually be directly smashed into a hole by violence and cracked by this method…
"What's going on… This guy… Green Dragon??"
After realizing Buggy's main body, the geniuses of the Four Holy Family looked at it in disbelief. This was the first time the Worm of Imagination had revealed its true body.
As a Green Dragon, why did this guy keep his worm form previously?
What was it thinking?
But most importantly, what was wrong with this guy's strength?
"Aiya, aiya." At this moment, Shi Yu and the gem cat, who had been watching the battle, sighed when they saw that the competition had all ended.
"Why did Ling admit defeat!!" the gem cat girl stated unhappily. It was looking forward to this battle, the battle in the starry sky.
Who knew that after Buggy shattered the Starry Sky Storm, Ling would directly admit defeat?
"Because Ling analyzed that its chances of winning aren't high, right? Now that it has mastered Future Prediction, it can basically decide its chances of winning before the battle…"
The gem cat: "Wuu… I know, but it's fine to combat anyway. What if something happens to Buggy if we're lucky?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1509 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1509 The Person Who Sees Through the Truth (5)
Shi Yu smiled and said, "Ling isn't interested in the team internal competition. The initial program I set for her is to assist Beast Tamers and teammates in becoming stronger. She will be even happier to see that her teammates are all very strong. However, when she has the strength to win the championship, I don't think Ling will give up the first place in the team. She's still waiting, waiting for the moment she rises."
"If it were Little Ji, it probably wouldn't analyze any chances of winning…"
With its intelligence, it would be over. Only after it was really defeated would Little Ji know that the person in front of it couldn't be provoked…
[Shi Yu, look at the number one trending topic.]
As Shi Yu and the gem cat were communicating, a voice transmission suddenly entered Shi Yu's ears. Shi Yu heard that it was the Senior Space Emperor.
God Sealing Battle Committee.
President Saatchi frowned and said, "Did we leak the information?"
"No, we manage the information very strictly here. Moreover, even we don't have the information!" An assistant with a camera on his face said.
"The other party is the 'Exposing King'. It's not impossible for him to obtain this information… It's not our fault."
"This is impossible." Somewhere in World King City, Ming Gu, Zavay, the son of the Demon Emperor, and the other contestants looked at the explosive video in front of them in shock.
Logically speaking, now that Eleven had defeated Chi Tong and Buggy had defeated Ling, it should occupy the top two of the trending list.
However, because of the appearance of a video, everyone, regardless of whether they paid attention to the God Sealing Battle, was attracted.
Because the producer of the video was the "Exposing King".
"The Exposing King appeared again? He still dares to post a video? What rumors did he create this time?"
Speaking of the Exposing King, almost everyone on the World King Planet knew him. His reputation was even greater than that of a super divine-level expert.
But it was said that he was only at the divine level.
The reason why the Exposing King was so famous was that he dared to say anything. As long as it was a topic with a big enough gimmick, he dared investigate. Even if it was a super divine level world overlord who seduced someone else's wife and the child wasn't his biological son, as long as he knew that and as long as there was a topic, he would dare expose it.
He could be said to be the most unpopular guy on the World King Planet.
He didn't belong to any faction and often wore a fox mask to post videos. No one knew his identity, so they kept calling him the Exposing King.
The Exposing King started to be active 800 years ago and exposed information of various sizes. His greatest achievement was to achieve "seven first-level realms and 141 second-level realms".
There were many super divine-level experts who wanted him to die, and there were countless divine-level experts. However, after so many years, he was still safe and sound, as if he had a great divine power that could escape the pursuit.
As for the revelations of this fellow who hid his face, the person involved naturally didn't admit it. Although everyone knew that some of the revelations were true, there were also some that couldn't be verified.
Therefore, no one knew if the content of this guy's revelation was true or false every time, but it was undeniable that every time the Exposing King appeared, it brought big news to people.
"What did the Exposing King say this time?"
The cosmic races on World King Star were extremely curious.
"Hehe, hello, everyone. We meet again." In the video with a black background, a figure in a fox mask said, "I'll bring everyone an interesting revelation this time!"
"I want to introduce to everyone the most brutal newbie in the World King Planet's God Sealing Battle in 100,000 years!!"
With that said, 10 photos were pasted into the video. They were surprisingly the 10 new planets that the God Sealing Battle Committee had counted, from Eleven to Little Ji.
"I believe everyone knows about these contestants of the God Sealing Battle."
"Moreover, there seem to be a lot of people investigating their information. Next, I'll expose it to everyone."
The fox-masked man chuckled again and took out two photos alone. They were the World Destruction Dragon and the Time Sect Master.
"Mechanical Beast, World Destruction Dragon, White Tiger Evolver, and Time Sect Master. Everyone should know that they are the pets of a human Beast Tamer named Shi Yu."
With that said, the Exposing King pasted Shi Yu's photo beside the World Destruction Dragon and the Time Sect Master and said, "However, what you definitely don't know is…"
"Abyss Beast, World Cleansing Demon Duck, is also Shi Yu's pet!"
"Black Tortoise Evolver, Super Holy Beast, is also Shi Yu's pet!"
"Cleansing star spirit Susu, vice president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association, and additionally Shi Yu's pet!"
"Ling, deputy director of the Blue Wave Space Disaster Research Institute…"
"Ginseng emperor, vice president of the Blue Sea Plant Association…"
"There's also the Worm of Imagination, Chi Tong, and Eleven, who have already been exposed from the Floating Realm. They're all Shi Yu's pets!"
"Yes, the 10 monster newcomers who appeared in this year's God Sealing Battle are all the animal companions of this Beast Tamer named Shi Yu!"
"They all come from the second-level realm, the Floating Realm, and who exactly is Shi Yu? He can actually contract so many monster pets… He's actually a newbie from the World King Planet who just came to the World King Planet less than a year ago from a border galaxy!"
"Haha, are you very shocked?"
"As usual, I'll just expose the truth. You guys can explore the truth yourselves."
The Exposing King looked at the camera with a smile. His figure slowly disappeared, leaving countless viewers stunned in front of the screen…
"Bullsh*t…" Soon, an audience member couldn't help but curse. Stop insulting their intelligence. How was this possible?
Was this Exposing King drunk again?
"I remember in a daze that I seem to have really seen the 10 newbies gathered together…" Someone commented.
"What does that mean? If the 10 newbies are all Shi Yu's pets, I'll directly twist my head off and let others kick it like a ball!" Someone additionally commented.
The audience that was paying attention to the God Sealing Battle was in an uproar. As expected, this Exposing King was here to farm his presence again. He stated that the 10 newbies, the geniuses of the Plant Association, the geniuses of the Environmental Protection Association, and the geniuses of the Space Disaster Research Institute, had abilities that participated different fields. In all aspects, they couldn't fight against eight races. There was nothing in common with the cultivation mode, and he said that they were the same person's pets?
Bullsh*t!
Most individuals immediately treated the return of the Exposing King as a joke.
Beside the Space Emperor, Lin Feng looked at the infuriating fox-masked man and was even angrier than Shi Yu.
"Calm down," the Space Emperor said.
"This guy, he previously spread gossip about me and my animal companions doing abnormal things! Although I f*cking cultivated beautiful pets, it's just to keep my eyes open. We're innocent! Old Wang, you aware that!!" Lin Feng exploded in anger. He was innocent!! This guy was really good at spreading rumors!

chapters.title: Chapter 1510 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1510 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (1)
"What's the origin of this 'Exposing King'?"
In the room, Shi Yu asked the Space Emperor and Senior Lin Feng.
"The reviews seem to be very poor. Although the information he exposed just now is all true, no one seems to believe it."
"I believe it!" The gem cat, who was looking through the comments, said.
"You're not human," Shi Yu said.
Gem Cat: Angry.
Although it was the truth, why did the gem cat feel like Shi Yu was scolding it?
Lin Feng said, "He bumped into a dead rat this time. In the past, the revelations were mostly rumors. Rumors of Senior Space Emperor and I were spread by this old kid."
The gem cat felt that someone was scolding her again.
Emperor Kong said, "It should be some unknown special race."
"I'd rather offend a super divine level than expose some big news…"
"Just like how the Future Prediction skill can receive feedback after the premonition thing is verified."
"Perhaps he also has the ability to become stronger by revealing unknown secrets."
The starry sky of the universe was huge, and there were all kinds of strange things. Many people also had a guess about the situation of the Exposing King.
"If that's the case, this ability isn't bad," the gem cat said.
It was suitable for curious people to be beaten up easily.
"Forget it, forget about this guy. If I know who he is, I'll beat him to death," Lin Feng said.
"Forget about killing it, why don't we exchange for a bounty? Our Floating Realm will have money," the Space Emperor said. "After all, it's multiple super divines who jointly issued a bounty in the previous hundred realms…"
"Is this for real?"
Although Shi Yu didn't care much about the Exposing King's revelations. After all, in two days, this wouldn't be a secret anymore, when he heard that he had actually spread rumors about the Space Emperor and Senior Lin Feng, Shi Yu, who respected his elders, immediately couldn't tolerate it.
Apart from being valuable, this guy's skills should be very interesting, right?
"Meow?" The gem cat beside Shi Yu also had an angry expression. She hated rumormongers the most in her life. This guy had to be captured!
The gem cat had decided. After Shi Yu became stronger, she would ask the owl to catch the Exposing King together!
"It's true, but it's indeed difficult to catch. If even a super divine level can't catch him, forget it. Next, let's pay attention to the top four…" Lin Feng and the Space Emperor looked at Shi Yu with slightly twitching expressions.
They had seen today's competition.
Eleven vs Chi Tong, Buggy vs Ling—what kind of battle between gods!
Why did it give them the feeling that there was no need for ten of them to attack together at all? They could just choose a few to attack together and farm past the intermediate gods.
"Yes, let me take a look." Shi Yu looked at the competition schedule.
The semifinals…
Susu vs Eleven!
Buggy vs Baby Ginseng!
Well… not bad.
There was another exciting battle to watch.
In fact, even Shi Yu himself watched the team internal competition very happily.
Because he didn't know what trump cards the pets had prepared for their teammates.
For example, Baby Ginseng vs Turtle and Little Quas. Shi Yu originally thought that it would be an evil battle, but in the end, Baby Ginseng directly blew the other party into two and developed the Anti Black Tortoise Energy Fruit, almost stunning Shi Yu.
Baby Ginseng… was really a talent.
He felt that to a certain extent, Baby Ginseng was more talented than Ling.
No, or rather, the two of them were extreme!
Ling's talent was how to make its teammates stronger!
It could think of many strengthening plans for its teammates.
However, Baby Ginseng could always think of ways to weaken its teammates… It could think of many ways to counter its teammates.
"Shi Yu, quickly tell me who can win," Lin Feng said.
"I don't know who can win either… Mainly, for the sake of fun, I indeed didn't look into their trump cards," Shi Yu said.
Lin Feng and the Space Emperor were silent. Did he really treat the God Sealing Battle as an entertainment venue?
"I can only tell everyone not to analyze their chances of winning according to conventional strength."
"Just like how Baby Ginseng dealt with the Super Holy Beast previously… They prepared many targeted countering trump cards for the other party."
"Everyone, wait and see. Well, they're back…" After Shi Yu finished speaking, Baby Ginseng, Buggy, and the others returned home. However, the opponents they encountered, such as Eleven and Susu, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng, were no longer as friendly as before. The atmosphere was filled with gunpowder.
"This is the manual that every pet in Shi Yu's team is very strong…" the gem cat girl said.
This made the Space Emperor and Lin Feng fall into deep thought about the cultivation idea.
Could it be that competing with each other in the team competition was the best way to increase strength?
"Perhaps…" The Space Emperor felt that he could additionally learn Shi Yu's team internal competition mode.
"I like to see women fight." After thinking about it, Lin Feng additionally decided to make a team internal competition in the future to let the pets fight and become stronger…
…
The next day.
The semifinals began.
Eleven vs Susu.
The audience felt that there was no suspense in this battle.
Although he possessed to admit that Susu was also extremely strong, Eleven, who was under the Eight Trigrams Formation, seemed to be one level mightier than when it fought Zavay.
It gave people a feeling of invincibility in the world.
In comparison, for Susu to be able to reach this stage, it gave people the feeling that it was already lucky.
Although the Cleansing Star Spirit Race was strong, its ranking of all races was only 77. It was a race not good at internal war and was only suitable to deal with external enemies like the Abyss Race.
Their unique skill, the Star Sea Contract, wasn't suitable to be used in normal battles.
Therefore, Susu could rely on the time and ice-element quasi-divine skills, the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, to prevail all the way until now. It even made the World Cleansing Demon Duck admit defeat willingly. Even the higher-ups of the Environmental Protection Association felt that Susu was already extremely proud and didn't embarrass the Cleansing Star Spirit Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 1511 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1511 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (2)
As for a higher ranking… Considering the monster performance of Eleven, Buggy, and the others, the chances were really not high.
"If nothing goes wrong, Eleven will be the champion of this God Sealing Battle," Zavay, Ming Gu, and the others thought in silence.
Chi Tong, Ling, Little Ji, Duckie, and the others, who had already been eliminated, also watched the final direction of the team internal competition seriously.
One was Susu, who had been at the bottom for several consecutive years, and the other was Eleven, who was the strongest candidate to win the championship every time. They felt that this was the end for Ling.
"Quack…" Duckie put its palms together piously.
Big Sister Susu, losing to Eleven is justified.
At this point, it's already a huge improvement. We'll work hard next time!
Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, the gem cat, and the others entered the live-stream immediately to see the cruelty of Shi Yu's team internal competition.
"Wuu!!" On the sky arena, Eleven looked at the Starry Sky Slime opposite it quietly.
"Admit defeat." However, to everyone's surprise, just as it appeared on the battlefield, Susu confidently spoke and asked the other party to admit defeat.
This…
The audience was stunned.
In front of it was a terrifying guy who had defeated Zavay and Chi Tong.
"Wuu!!!" Eleven was dissatisfied.
How is this possible?
Does Susu still want to rely on the origin fluctuations to cleanse all my battle intent?
Then let's see if Susu can cleanse faster or if my warpath can erupt faster.
The deterrence of both parties erupted at the same time!
At this moment, the Environmental Protection Association and even God Bing Ling were watching the battle in secret, paying attention to this new little cleansing star spirit.
However, even this super divine Beast Tamer shook his head at this battle.
Susu was indeed strong and had mastered a top-notch cleansing divine skill, but unfortunately, this skill alone wasn't enough to defeat Eleven, who had multiple top-notch divine skills.
That was unless Susu used the Star Sea Contract to strengthen the origin fluctuations. However, this undoubtedly violated the rules and restrictions of the Star Sea Contract. It would cause Susu to have a serious backlash and even lose the ability of a cleansing star spirit…
"Wait?! Is it crazy?" Just as the Bing Ling God felt that this battle might end in Susu's defeat, she discovered in disbelief that starlight suddenly lingered around Susu's body.
It was actually activating the Star Sea Contract to strengthen its origin fluctuations.
"The cleansing star spirit used the Star Sea Contract. Isn't it afraid of the backlash?"
Countless spectators were also shocked to discover that Susu directly used the forbidden skill, the Star Sea Contract.
This was a unique skill that could only be safely activated by protecting the starry sky environment.
If the opponent was from the Abyss Race, it wouldn't be a problem for Susu to activate it, but its opponent shouldn't be related to polluting the starry sky environment, right?
Could it be that in order to win, Susu didn't care even if it suffered the backlash of the Star Sea Contract?
"Huh?" Eleven was also stunned as Susu activated the Star Sea Contract.
In the next moment, Eleven's expression changed as if it had encountered a bolt from the blue.
"Ning!" Susu sent a voice transmission to Eleven.
"You devoured the meteorite fragment and evolved by devouring the pollution power of the Dark Demon God of the Yun Race. I think there's a potential risk of polluting the starry sky environment on you, so I want to cleanse your Demon God power!"
After Susu finished speaking, origin fluctuations directly bloomed from its body.
All the spectators could clearly see that as a cleansing wave that was as vast as the sea of stars came from Susu's body, Eleven seemed to be shocked together. The arena under its feet instantly shattered, and it turned around to escape at the speed of light.
"What's going on?" Seeing that someone as strong as Eleven was actually frightened by Susu in one round, the audience was stunned.
However, soon, they knew why Eleven wanted to escape. Eleven couldn't be faster than the origin fluctuations enhanced by the Star Sea Contract at all. In an instant, the cleansing fluctuations enveloped Eleven. While Eleven was stunned, it felt the power of the Demon God in its body quickly disappear.
"Wuu!!!!" All the spectators could hear Eleven's heartbreaking voice, like a child whose lollipop had been snatched away!!
It was very desperate!
All the spectators could additionally sense that Eleven's state was decreasing rapidly, and the power in its form was being extracted.
"This!!"
The audience was extremely shocked as they looked at Eleven, who was enveloped by the cleansing wave.
Could it be that the cleansing star spirit had cleansed Eleven's power?
What a joke. The purifying skill had already reached this level?
Zavay and the others couldn't believe it.
Fortunately, the power of the Demon God didn't disappear completely. It only disappeared completely.
But even so, Eleven was stunned on the spot. This was because the more energy its form had, the stronger its physique. Its One Thought of God and Demon additionally needed the power of a Demon God to activate it.
Now that it no longer had the power of the Demon God in its body, it was equivalent to having half its battle power crippled.
"Ning!!!" At this moment, Susu moved. Susu was additionally very difficult to cleanse this time. It more or less suffered a backlash, but using the relationship of Eleven eating pollution trash and the fact that it wasn't completely eliminating Eleven's power of the Demon God, Susu successfully restricted Eleven at the smallest cost.
Under the influence of Baby Ginseng, it was additionally thinking about how to target its teammates.
It had long been unhappy that Eleven ate pollution trash. Now, Susu could finally cleanse Eleven openly!
It directly triggered the time-element Heavenly Frost Cold Energy and froze the surrounding time. In the face of this move, Eleven could easily counter it perfectly with the One Thought of God and Demon, but now, with only half its strength, it couldn't activate the perfect One Thought of God and Demon at all, causing its reaction speed to greatly decrease…

chapters.title: Chapter 1512 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1512 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (3)
It could only watch as Susu whipped a ball of cleansing fluctuations onto its face again.
"Cleansing Water Cannon!" Susu said. The high-speed high-pressure water cannon sent Eleven flying!
Boom!!
Under everyone's incredulous expressions, Eleven, who was like a war god and was invincible previously, was sent flying.
"Warpath, cleanse! Energy, cleanse!" Susu cleansed Eleven's battle intent. If it were at the start, she definitely wouldn't have been able to cleanse it successfully, because, at that time, Eleven didn't think that it would lose at all. The cleansing effect would be very poor.
But now, Eleven, who felt that it was in a bad state, also began to panic, giving Susu an opportunity.
Even if Susu removed the strengthening of the Star Sea Contract at this moment, the origin fluctuations could still pose a huge threat to Eleven.
"Wu wu wu…" Eleven, who was sent flying, was like a confused child…
Susu, you've changed. You weren't like this in the past… You've become bad.
…
"Ah, this!" At this moment, the gem cat and the others watching the battle were stunned when they saw Susu suppressing Eleven.
"I see. It took advantage of Eleven and Yun An's relationship as the entry point?" Ling said. "Susu spent a lot of effort."
"The entire team… has been led astray by Baby Ginseng."
"Hahahaha, Susu can also lie with its eyes open." At this moment, Shi Yu knew that it was impossible for Susu to be unprepared when facing Eleven. On the other hand, Eleven was completely not as sinister as its teammates.
For the sake of victory, such a pure Susu's heart was the first to darken. Wasn't this making Eleven so aggrieved?
While the entire team was feeling amused by the situation, Eleven was sadly killed and eliminated by Susu. And what happened at this moment meant that the various realms on World King Planet trembled to different degrees again.
Zavay opened his mouth wide, not understanding why this battle had ended like this.
No!
Zavay couldn't accept that Eleven would lose like this.
What's wrong with this cleansing star spirit? How can it be so ridiculous?
"The cleansing star spirit, Susu, seems to have used some method to cleanse half of Eleven's power, causing it to be unable to display its full strength…"
"Hiss… Holy sh*t, it actually…"
"No wonder the World Cleansing Demon Duck wanted to surrender when it encountered it… Susu actually defeated Eleven?"
Not to mention outsiders, even the higher-ups of the Environmental Protection Association were slightly absent-minded. They completely didn't expect Susu to defeat Eleven.
Before that, Eleven was the most powerful candidate to win the championship.
At this moment, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the others also understood why Shi Yu said that they couldn't predict the direction of the team internal competition according to their superficial battle power.
Another battle that exceeded their expectations made the gamblers almost go crazy.
Baby Ginseng and Buggy, who were preparing for battle, were also shocked by the outcome of this battle.
They didn't expect that Susu would defeat Eleven in the end.
"Roar!!!" After being stunned, Buggy was overjoyed. In its opinion, Susu was much easier to fight than Eleven.
Susu's methods against Eleven were useless against it!
Buggy loved cleanliness, unlike Eleven, who ate the meteorite fragments randomly.
"Yi!!" Baby Ginseng also clenched its fists. It didn't matter. It just had countermeasures against Eleven and Susu.
But before that, Baby Ginseng had to defeat Buggy.
…
"What…" The battle between Susu and Eleven reversed again, making the hearts of some gamblers who didn't learn their lesson turn cold to the extreme.
They didn't expect that there would be so many reversals in this God Sealing Battle. The outcome couldn't be judged by superficial strength at all.
However…
Next, the ginseng emperor vs the Worm of Imagination…
At this moment, everyone already knew that the Worm of Imagination was a Green Dragon Evolver, and it was very strong.
A dragon ball could directly smash the Starry Sky Storm. Although that wasn't the real Starry Sky Storm and was only a disaster, a quasi-divine skill simulated by a mechanical pet, its strength was also extraordinary.
The outcome of Ming Gu and the others was the best example.
However, a Starry Sky Storm of this level was useless against the Worm of Imagination.
This undoubtedly meant that the Worm of Imagination was a monster on the same level as Eleven and Chi Tong.
No matter how hard every audience thought about it, they really couldn't imagine what methods this ginseng baby in front of them in a research suit had to defeat such a terrifying ten-thousand-meter-long Green Dragon.
Although Baby Ginseng was strong, the Green Dragon was also a wood god. It completely countered it!
"Don't tell me that this fight shall too have a reversal and the monster Green Dragon will lose."
Ming Gu didn't believe it.
Ming Gu watched the fight with red eyes.
Just like how Zavay couldn't tolerate Eleven, who had defeated him, being defeated, Ming Gu couldn't accept it either. The guy who defeated him, Ling, was defeated again.
"Hmph!" However, there were many things the audience couldn't imagine.
On the ground battlefield, Baby Ginseng looked at the little worm opposite and smiled kindly.
It didn't expect Eleven to lose. It used the Time Mark on Eleven.
However, the method to deal with Susu didn't need the Time Mark.
In other words, it could give both Time Marks to its dear friend, Buggy!
"Ji!!!" The little green worm too felt a threat from the ginseng baby opposite it.
Buggy too knew that there were two Time Marks on Baby Ginseng at this moment. It couldn't help but have a headache.
However, Baby Ginseng had never used the Sun and Moon Brilliance to self-destruct. Buggy, who didn't know the strength of self-destruction, felt that it might not be impossible to fight.
"Roar!!!" Buggy directly recovered its state and became the White Feather Green Dragon. The huge Green Dragon held the Dragon Ball and looked down at the ginseng baby underground.

chapters.title: Chapter 1513 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1513 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (4)
"He actually used his full strength right from the start. The Worm of Imagination takes the ginseng emperor very seriously!"
"Holy sh*t, it directly smashed the Dragon Ball?"
Not only did they take it seriously, but under the gazes of the audience, the Green Dragon almost ferociously smashed the Dragon Ball with its dragon claws!!
A shocking killing intent lingered around its body, as if it wouldn't stop until it smashed Baby Ginseng to death.
"Is there a problem…" The audience exclaimed.
Buggy's Dragon Ball could even smash a huge hole in the Starry Sky Storm. Its lethality was huge. Baby Ginseng's small body really didn't look like it could withstand it.
"Hey, hey, hey." In Zi Jian's special forces, Zi Jian watched Baby Ginseng's battle and frowned.
Because she knew that Baby Ginseng was Shi Yu's pet, she originally believed the Exposing King's revelation, but now that she saw Buggy's ruthlessness, she wondered if this was something a contracted beast of the same master could do?
These two probably had a grudge for killing their father!
"The ginseng emperor is in danger!" Baby Ginseng's supporters were also extremely nervous.
However, to everyone's surprise, in the face of this attack that directly wanted Baby Ginseng's life, Baby Ginseng itself also revealed an expression of facing death calmly.
"Bang~" Baby Ginseng's mouth changed and it emitted the onomatopoeic words. It was first raised to the divine level by the power of time. Then, the Sun and Moon Fire Seed spinning in its body was directly ignited!
The energy in its body began to expand and explode.
Any creature present was very familiar with this familiar energy waveform change.
Self-destruction.
The ginseng emperor actually started to self-destruct!
"What!" Zi Jian was so scared that she directly got up from her seat with a shocked expression. Wait, wait!!
All the spectators who were paying attention to this battle were stunned.
Damn it.
So there was really a life-and-death grudge between them?
One used the strongest killer move without any intention of holding back, while the other saw the other party offer its killer move and directly self-destruct, swearing to perish together. How much hatred and resentment was there?
"Yi!!! (Sun and Moon Brilliance, explode!!!)"
Under Baby Ginseng's voice, with a boom, Baby Ginseng fell like the sun and moon. Endless strong light bloomed from its body.
"Roar!!!" Buggy let out a heart-wrenching roar. The attack continued, letting the audience see the cruelest battle.
Both parties were fighting with their lives!
Bang!!!
Under the shaking of the entire small world, the screen was directly covered by strong light.
The entire sky first darkened. With a loud bang, it created a world that belonged to the night, changing the entire weather.
The dark sky and bright night moon made everything silent.
Right on the heels of that, a dazzling sun slowly rose and lingered with the moon in the night.
Under the alternation of the sun and moon.
Boom!!!
The explosion wave spread for the second time, and everyone could only vaguely see the state of both parties. Baby Ginseng undoubtedly died instantly, and the terrifying energy wave it released shook the sky and earth, as if the sun and moon had exploded at the same time. Even if the Worm of Imagination held a star world, in the face of self-destruction of this level, Buggy's Dragon Ball still instantly sublimated!
Including Buggy's dragon claws, Buggy's body was instantly devoured by the strong light.
"Roar!!!" Accompanied by Buggy's miserable cry, the audience and the battle elf looked at the scene in a daze. After Baby Ginseng died, the ten-thousand-meter-long Green Dragon was also burned to death by the strong light, leaving only the huge charred drake bone blown away by the frightening aftermath and losing its life fluctuations!
Such a terrifying confrontation made the hearts of hundreds of millions of spectators pound. Cold sweat flowed, and their bodies trembled.
"No, no way… Are they… worth it? Why?"
A large number of contestants who had encountered Baby Ginseng had pale faces. They were suddenly a little glad that they weren't strong enough and weren't worth Baby Ginseng self-destructing. They were extremely afraid.
Under the pale gaze of the audience, it was suddenly impossible to tell what venue it was. In the already messy small world, golden flames burned on the charred dragon bone. Under the burning of the flames, in just a few seconds, the power of faith reforged Buggy's body. It roared and bathed in the flames to be reborn, flying into the heavens again with a domineering and shocking posture.
"It revived?"
The audience looked at the Green Dragon in a daze, but before they could be surprised by Buggy's revival, they followed Buggy's gaze and looked at the dark ground.
"Yi…" Under the swaying of the light pollution, on the ground, a ghost-shaped ginseng baby grew up like a new sprout and looked at the Green Dragon with a burning gaze.
The ginseng emperor… also revived after self-destructing!
Moreover, it was in the form of a ghost!
Just as the audience was stunned, Baby Ginseng stretched out its hand and squeezed the Worm of Imagination. In the next moment, a strong soul explosion wave bloomed from Baby Ginseng!
The consecutive resurrections of both parties were undoubtedly a enormous reversal. Just as everyone's thoughts couldn't keep up, Baby Ginseng self-destructed again!
"Holy sh*t, again!!!" Everyone was surprised to discover that after the ginseng emperor revived, it surprisingly chose clueless consecutive explosions.
Baby Ginseng wasn't afraid of blowing Buggy up. Buggy, who had the reserves of power of faith and had mastered the Green Dragon Indestructible Body, had an immortal body.
In other words, as long as it consumed the power of faith specified by Shi Yu and let Buggy consume it, it would win.
And the resources it could use were two Time Marks. And now, it had yet to use one. It only used the Sun Moon Fire Seed and the Soul Fruit to fight the enemy!
Now, Baby Ginseng's battle power was fully released!
"Death Quartet. The second movement." Baby Ginseng's voice came under the light of the soul eruption, making Buggy in the heavens roar. Damn, it was truly so ruthless!

chapters.title: Chapter 1514 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1514 Who Will Be King After Becoming a God (5)
Buggy originally thought that it could resist Baby Ginseng's self-destruction, but it didn't expect that it couldn't resist at all. It couldn't even rely on the Creation Dragon Ball.
The self-destruction of the Sun and Moon Brilliance was definitely a move that could heavily injure intermediate gods.
It was directly blown up by Baby Ginseng until only the dragon bone was left. If it weren't for the fact that the power of faith made Baby Ginseng immortal, it would have died already.
However, the power of faith consumed to revive once was also incomparably huge. The power of faith specified by Shi Yu wasn't enough for it to revive continuously!!
As Buggy calculated the consumption, the terrifying soul explosion impact attacked again. Although the explosion this time wasn't as strong as the previous time, it also made Buggy feel a huge crisis and warned it crazily!
In the range of the explosion, there was nowhere for it to escape!
"Roar!!!" Buggy activated the Creation Domain, but the moment the domain came into contact with the soul explosion, it directly shattered. The soul storm sent Buggy flying again. This time, it didn't look injured on the surface, but the Green Dragon's soul suffered an incomparable impact, as if its soul was about to dissipate!
"Roar!!!" Under Buggy's painful roar, the power of faith quickly repaired its soul, allowing Buggy to withstand this attack. However, a despairing scene occurred.
The Time Mark was activated.
Under the gathering of the power of time, under the stunned expressions of Zavay, Ming Gu, and all the spectators of the God Sealing Battle, a seemingly unscathed ginseng emperor with a hexagram of time flowing in its eyes gathered in the sky again.
"Aren't you admitting defeat?"
Its petals ignited with the rich flames of life. It was in an excellent state, and its pupils were filled with invincibility.
"I, who have mastered the Time Mark, keep self-destructing. It's impossible for you to withstand it."
"The self-destruction just now was just a warning. The next time I self-destruct, I'll still add toxin." Baby Ginseng looked at Buggy and threatened.
"It made the incense poisonous because I've never tried it. I can't guarantee that you can still successfully revive."
At this moment, the eyes of the originally shocked audience almost popped out.
"Zavay's Time Mark???"
"It has two revival methods?"
"One is the revival of a race, and the other is… time revival!"
"Damn, no wonder it dared self-destruct!!"
"First, it revived with an undead, then with the Time Mark. In other words, if its Time Mark attainments are the same as Zavay, even if it self-destructs twice, it can still revive?"
"Wait, what kind of monster is this?"
"Most importantly, isn't this its self-destruction move? It actually contains the laws of the sun and moon. It's like the explosion of the sun and moon, and even the Dragon Ball that dispersed the Starry Sky Storm instantly sublimated."
Self-destruction+revival.
Zavay had also believed of this combination skill, but because it couldn't find a suitable self-destruction move, its self-destruction power was inferior to the five-element combination skill, so it finally gave up. Now, seeing someone use this strategy so perfectly…
Zavay collapsed again!
"What exactly is going on with this year's God Sealing Battle?" It gritted its teeth. It… was the number one quasi-divine on World King Planet. Now, it experienced so down and out!
"Roar!!!" In the face of the confident ginseng baby, Bugg bared its fangs and brandished its claws, its heart stifled to the extreme.
It wasn't just them. At this moment, no matter who it was, it was difficult to imagine the confrontation between the ginseng emperor and the Green Dragon just now.
