The confrontation between the two parties at the cost of their lives was actually like playing in the eyes of the two parties when they were extremely nervous.
On one side, it could revive with the power of faith.
On the other side, it could revive with undead and time methods.
What a joke. Was this a battle that a quasi-divine could fight?
At this moment, when everyone heard the threat of the ginseng emperor to the Worm of Imagination, they were extremely numb. Even some divine-level experts felt their hair stand on end.
This ginseng emperor was too terrifying.
Everyone looked at the Green Dragon in unison. At this moment, the Worm of Imagination's gaze kept flickering. In the end, it roared unwillingly, as if it admitted that its skills were inferior, and chose to admit defeat.
The faith incense offerings were poisonous?
Baby Ginseng even developed such a countermeasure?
Buggy was really a little afraid. Even if the incense wasn't poisonous, according to its calculations just now, the power of faith in the rules definitely couldn't let it defeat Baby Ginseng.
Although it experienced that it was a pity, in order to have a trump card to deal with the intermediate god in the end, it still chose not to fight Baby Ginseng and let Baby Ginseng preserve a Time Mark to increase its safety.
"Roar!!! (Wait next time, you win this time.)" The Green Dragon directly chose to admit defeat. However, every audience experienced that it was nothing for the Green Dragon to admit defeat because this ginseng emperor they had underestimated previously wasn't as simple as it looked.
If the Worm of Imagination insisted on fighting, it might really die.
"Who said that these 10 monster rookies are all Shi Yu's pets? I'll kill whoever says so. If they're all the same person's pets, is there a need to work so hard?"
"Shi Yu himself doesn't even dare make a sound."
"I finally understand why so many realms have desired the Exposing King. He's really unreliable."
At this moment, Buggy was teleported out of the world. Baby Ginseng stood in the arena and enjoyed countless gazes. It sighed.
Sister Susu, don't be afraid! The Anti-Susu Energy Fruit I readied for you is very gentle!
Baby Ginseng spun around, and Susu, who had made the outside world pay attention to the battle, experienced its heart skip a beat…
Who would become the king after becoming a god depended on the battle of Susu vs the ginseng emperor!

chapters.title: Chapter 1515 Champion Moment (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1515 Champion Moment (1)
"Hello, is this President Feng?"
In the luxurious manor, the gem cat girl wore a pair of sunglasses and leaned against a summer bench, looking at the screen in front of her like a rich woman.
On the screen in front of him was an excited old granny in a grass skirt.
"Madam Ying!!!"
The president of the Blue Wave Plant Association didn't expect that Madam Ying, who was with the ginseng emperor, would actually contact him at this moment.
Shi Yu had never interfered in Baby Ginseng's matters at the Blue Wave Plant Association. The gem cat did it for him.
Speaking of Baby Ginseng, the vice president of the Blue Wave Plant Association would also be speechless. Although they had finally fought for the ginseng emperor to become the vice president of the Blue Wave Association, apart from selling things, Baby Ginseng didn't have any presence at all. It didn't participate in any activities. Even if it sold things, it would let Madam Ying appear…
Not long ago, it had disappeared for a long time.
To the surprise of the Blue Wave Plant Association, as soon as they returned to their senses, the ginseng emperor was already killing everyone in the God Sealing Battle.
Now, it had even entered the finals and become one of the champion candidates.
"President Feng, you saw the God Sealing Battle, right?" the gem cat said.
"I've taken a look. President ginseng emperor is indeed powerful! It's simply the pride of our plant association!" President Feng said.
The gem cat said, "That's right. Don't the outside world want to know how the ginseng emperor became so strong?"
"What exactly is your plant association doing?"
"If we don't advertise now, when will we? I want its name to spread throughout the World King Planet in two days!"
"The advertising slogan is: Do you want to become stronger? Then eat one. Do you want to become a genius in the limelight? Then eat one. If you want to become the champion of the God Sealing Battle, eat one. The same Cultivation Fruit as the ginseng emperor, it'll send you straight to the top 10 of the God Sealing Tournament!"
"The botanical association's all-out gift! The best cultivation resource of the year! The story behind the ginseng emperor! No matter who suffers, we can't let the child suffer!" The gem cat girl took off her sunglasses with a serious gaze!
"I believe those gods who look forward to their sons becoming geniuses will definitely raise such resources to an astronomical price."
"After all, we can't let the child lose at the starting line."
President Feng was stunned… Huh?
…
"It's been arranged." The gem cat girl returned to the hall and said to Shi Yu, "The finals are about to begin. Why aren't you concerned at all?"
Just as the gem cat entered, it saw Shi Yu, Chi Tong, Eleven, and Buggy playing mahjong.
"Why don't you guys bring Ling along to play?"
Just as it finished asking, the gem cat felt that its question was a little unnecessary.
"The finals are about to begin. It feels really fast." Shi Yu stretched. He also understood very well that after this, it would be the true beginning of his life on World King Planet.
Before the God Sealing Battle, he was a newbie who had just arrived at the World King Planet and developed everywhere.
After the God Sealing Battle, he would inevitably walk into the vision of the various large factions and compete with many factions, including the five major divine races on Blue Planet, including the Four Holy Family.
At that time, he probably wouldn't be so free.
…
"The finals have finally come!!"
"I'm looking forward to it!!"
"I wonder who can win between Susu and the ginseng emperor."
It was time for the audience to be excited again.
It could be said that before reaching the semifinals, no one expected that the ones who entered the finals were actually the cleansing star spirit Susu and the ginseng emperor.
This final battle added a magical color to the ridiculous direction of the God Sealing Battle again.
The ratings of this year's God Sealing Battle were already the highest in 100,000 years. After all, in the previous batches, people didn't need to look to know that Zavay was probably first again.
But this year, Zavay was eliminated in the first round, directly making the popularity of the God Sealing Battle unprecedentedly high.
Then, the 10 monster newbies that appeared one after another also became the focus of the audience.
"The champion of this year will be decided between the two newbies."
"One is a genius secretly cultivated by the Plant Association, the ginseng emperor."
"The other is a genius secretly cultivated by the Environmental Protection Association, Susu."
"This isn't just the peak battle of the God Sealing Battle, but also the competition between the two major factions!"
"Did these institutions agree to release the hidden secret geniuses together… Is something big going to happen next?"
Compared to the rumors of the Exposing King, people were still more willing to believe that these newbies were secretly cultivated by some large factions and suddenly released.
The Cosmic Crow Race had been impressive for so long. Was it going to be attacked by the various large institutions collectively?
In the only live broadcast room, the number of people entering kept rising. Before the battle even started, the popularity had already exceeded any competition.
Soon, the two contestants who were in the finals appeared one by one.
This was an ordinary venue, and no one had the advantage. After Susu and Baby Ginseng appeared on both sides, both parties didn't immediately start a battle under countless gazes.
"Hu…"
"Hu…"
Instead, they looked at each other with extremely serious expressions.
"I didn't expect that the final opponent would be you."
"I didn't expect you to be the final opponent either."
Neither Baby Ginseng nor Susu expected that that final opponent would become the opposite party. They originally thought that the final opponent would be Eleven, Buggy, or Chi Tong, who had once won the team championship.
In that end, on one side was the only ginseng baby that had never won the championship.
On that opposite side was Susu, who was at the bottom of the first team every time.
Not toward mention that two of them, even Eleven and also the others were rather surprised.
This damn competition system!

chapters.title: Chapter 1516 Champion Moment (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1516 Champion Moment (2)
"Ning!"
"Yi!!"
After looking at each other for a moment, Susu and Baby Ginseng's might erupted.
Their gazes were filled with determination. As teammates, they were also telepathic.
It meant that no matter who lost the competition, they shouldn't complain.
Susu was at the bottom every time. It was very miserable. Baby Ginseng was forbidden from self-destructing every time. It was also very miserable.
This was their only counterattack. Both parties had a huge desire for first place.
"What a strong battle intent…"
The audience instantly sensed the violent warpath of Susu and the ginseng emperor. The shocking warpath seemed to be able to break through the shackles of space.
"Ning!!!" Susu was the first to move, directly activating the origin wave.
"This move again!" The audience was already familiar with Susu's move. This cleansing skill was too strong. It directly cleansed half of God of War Eleven's strength under the enhancement of the Star Sea Contract. Even if Eleven used the Light Control and Light Speed to escape and displayed extreme speed, it couldn't escape.
This was the first time everyone knew that cleansing methods could be so powerful.
However, this time, Susu didn't seem to have activated the increase in the Star Sea Contract. No one knew if the cleansing wave without the increase could have a huge impact on Baby Ginseng.
But soon, not only was the audience stunned, but even Baby Ginseng was stunned.
Because the target of Susu's purification wasn't the enemy, but itself!
"Ning! (I think my bottleneck, pain, physical load damage… are all impurities!)" Susu's gaze contained a shocking warpath as it surprisingly chose to cleanse itself. Baby Ginseng was very strong. Although Susu could also cleanse skills like Baby Ginseng's time mark, without the strengthening of the Star Sea Contract, it was impossible for Baby Ginseng not to resist.
In comparison, cleansing itself could be completed in an instant. After temporarily cleansing itself, Susu directly activated the countless powers accumulated in the Infinite Devour Space and erupted!!
Susu had also started preparing for the God Sealing Battle a long time ago. Eleven could accumulate Bean Bears, Baby Ginseng could accumulate the Time Mark, the energy of the sun and moon in the Sun and Moon Fire Seed, and water-element power!
Although it was inferior to the infinite energy on Blue Planet, it could definitely allow Susu to have a huge backup energy source. Logically speaking, this energy was originally nothing. No matter how huge it was, Susu couldn't use it and erupt in one go. It could only slowly mobilize it under the limit of its body's burden.
However, when Susu used the origin fluctuations to break through these restrictions, a great demon king that exceeded the limit was surprisingly born. From the explosive fluctuations displayed by Susu at this moment, it even exceeded the ginseng baby that used the Time Fruit to break through the limit.
"What a powerful wave…" The audience exclaimed.
"Susu is indeed not someone to be trifled with." The gem cat girl who was watching the battle also said to Shi Yu beside her.
On the arena, Baby Ginseng's gaze also turned cold. So that was the case.
"Is this your trump card? Although it's very strong, unfortunately… I'm more prepared."
Then, it also activated the nature of the Time Fruit and temporarily broke through the limit to step into a higher domain. Two huge aura fluctuations collided with a bang!
Baby Ginseng stretched out its palm, and countless huge trees immediately grew out beside Susu. The huge trees were filled with fruits. Then, fruits filled with light exploded!
"Clear!" Susu emitted origin fluctuations and looked around to eliminate the fluctuations of the fruits exploding. When the energy of the fruits exploding approached it, they instantly turned into nothingness.
"I feel that this ginseng baby is in danger," the gem cat said. "Although it has the trump card of self-destruction, it shouldn't dare use it, right? From the looks of it, only self-destruction can pose a threat to Susu, but if it dares self-destruct, Susu will dare risk its life to cleanse its Time Mark, making the Time Mark incomplete and the ginseng baby unable to revive. Both parties are in a state of 'forbidden arms deterrence'."
"Because it's not a life-and-death battle, they definitely aren't willing to take the last step and don't dare bet."
Shi Yu, Susu, and Baby Ginseng understood what the gem cat said. However, the direction of the battle still couldn't develop as everyone expected.
"Baby Ginseng… might have thought of this," Shi Yu said.
Seeing that the ordinary Energy Fruits created couldn't threaten Susu, Baby Ginseng took a deep breath and condensed 90% of its energy into an Anti-Susu Energy Fruit of the Wood Life Clone. It grew on a enormous tree closer to Susu.
Boom!!!
The explosion of the strongest Anti-Susu Energy Fruit directly made Susu's expression turn cold, and it experienced a enormous threat from the fruit.
"Clear!" Susu cleansed this extreme Anti-Susu Energy Fruit. However, because the power contained in this Anti-Susu Energy Fruit was too huge, Susu solely cleansed a portion. The energy aftermath still quickly swept through Susu's entire body!!
"Cleanse!!"
Susu first felt intense damage, but it wasn't afraid. It had already cleansed its pain, damage, and other negative states and broken through the limit. This power might not necessarily be able to threaten Susu.
However, Susu still experienced vaguely uneasy…
It looked at Baby Ginseng opposite it from the corner of its eye.
"General." As Baby Ginseng finished speaking, Susu was stunned. At random, its gaze suddenly became empty. Apart from the damage from the explosion, the power of reincarnation in the fluctuations erupted!
Susu experienced that it looked to possess been instantly pulled into an empty space with endless white and black light. Countless memories began to surge into Susu's mind. Many memories made Susu fall into a stunned state like a horse looking at a flower. These were the memories of the Blue Sea Sprite Susu that had reincarnated for hundreds of millions of years and was constantly activated by the Reincarnation Fruit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1517 Champion Moment (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1517 Champion Moment (3)
Although it was impossible to really activate all the memories over hundreds of millions of years, it was still incomparably huge. Information never stopped surging. Susu wanted to forcefully stop this state and cleanse a lot of trash information, but it felt that its thoughts were out of control. It even lost the ability to activate the origin wave.
However, under Susu's powerful obsession, the origin fluctuations still automatically began to cleanse the trash information. However, the reincarnation information of Susu was too huge, and the cleansing time needed was huge.
Therefore, in the eyes of the outside world, it became the cleansing star spirit that was still at an advantage just now. It was instantly frozen on the spot and kept cleansing itself as if it had lost its mind.
The weak ginseng baby walked towards Susu step by step. Countless tender shoots appeared beside Susu and stabbed into its body!
During this period of time when Susu couldn't react, the huge energy it could provide as a water-element life form was instantly absorbed by the plant life ginseng baby!
The originally weak ginseng baby began to recover, and the powerful Susu began to become weak!
"Yi!!!" As Baby Ginseng roared, the sea of trees that filled the sky grew crazily with Susu as energy, and the huge energy that Susu erupted with was crazily extracted!!
Under the stunned gazes of the audience, after Susu finished cleansing the pile of trash memory information and finally recovered control of its body, its expression froze again. It felt that its body had already lost most of its strength.
Opposite her, Baby Ginseng, who was leaning against the Infinite Tree Sea, looked at Susu and directly threw out a "20s Dizziness Fruit". Its research suit fluttered as it turned around coolly.
Boom!!!
"Ning!!!" Under the explosion, Susu directly fainted.
"Knowledge is power." Baby Ginseng wrapped its arms around it, unable to bear to see Susu eliminated by it.
Susu, forgive me. Although I know you want to get first place very much, I've never gotten first place!
[Winner: ginseng emperor!]
"Holy sh*t!!!" As soon as the battle ended, although the audience didn't understand what had happened, they instantly stood up in confusion.
At this moment, the battle elf gradually analyzed the process just now and explained in shock,
"Contestant ginseng emperor used unknown methods to make contestant Susu enter a special state where it lost its ability to think, thereby finding an opportunity to reverse the battle…"
"It's that unbelievable fruit effect again. The attack methods of the ginseng emperor contestant seem to be endless. It's impossible for the opponent to guess its battle goal."
"There's no doubt that this is a decisive battle that was won with skill instead of absolute strength!"
"The champion has appeared!!"
As they shouted at the battle elf, Shi Yu and the others also stood up. Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others also took a deep breath.
Baby Ginseng… This guy had really developed the Energy Fruit that countered all its teammates during this period of time!
After researching the Anti-Teammate Energy Fruit for so long, Baby Ginseng seemed to have finally mastered its research results and reached its peak.
"Damn…" the gem cat muttered.
"The champion is born. The champion of this team internal competition is Baby Ginseng." Shi Yu smiled.
"You have to work hard next time."
"Perhaps the reward for the next team internal competition champion is the source of transcendence, the second opportunity in the team to enter the super divine level." Shi Yu smiled.
The competition was intense.
The pets immediately had a high fighting spirit. As expected, the team internal competition was more exciting. No one knew what trump cards their teammates had created. It was much more interesting than fighting the geniuses of the World King Planet!
…
The champion of the God Sealing Battle was finally announced, and the multiple realms trembled.
Zavay, Ming Gu, and the other contestants stood on the ground and looked up at the sky, thinking about something.
Perhaps it was because they couldn't believe that this year's God Sealing Battle would be so complicated and that the champion would finally fall onto the originally ordinary white radish, the ginseng emperor.
"This is the power of the plant element!!!" As Baby Ginseng won the championship, a bunch of plant lives were extremely excited.
How long had it been since a plant life had won the championship?
Compared to the cosmic life forms of other races, plant life forms had always been the weaker party.
50% of the plant lives were in the status of food and supplements and were hunted.
If it weren't for the fact that this ginseng emperor looked powerful, everyone experienced that its appearance was truly quite like supplements.
In short, no matter what, this ginseng emperor immediately made the plant life form feel proud and confident again.
The title of ginseng emperor had also become a title pursued by some plant races.
"I want to be the Flower Emperor when I grow up!"
"I'll be the Grass Heaven Emperor!"
"I, the Garlic Emperor, am invincible!" Baby Ginseng's fans appeared in the various major domains. At this moment, the plant association also initiated to advertise according to the gem cat's requirements.
Now that Baby Ginseng was the champion, the advertisement effect would probably be even more explosive!
"Hahahaha, the ginseng emperor won the championship. Shi Yu's pet won the championship!" On the Blue Planet's side, the five super divines were extremely happy to see Baby Ginseng win the championship.
"What's there to be happy about? The pets in the top eight all belong to Shi Yu. Won't the winner definitely be one of his pets?" Emperor Kong said.
The five super divines were speechless.
"Next is the most important thing. It's the winner challenge. Only by passing the champion challenge can Shi Yu be qualified to obtain the permanent teleportation array."
"No problem." The five super divines were full of confidence now. Eleven against one, how could they lose?
…
As the finals ended.
The God Sealing Battle Committee also initiated to prepare.

chapters.title: Chapter 1518 Champion Moment (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1518 Champion Moment (4)
"President Saatchi, is the candidate for this year's examiner still 'Jermon'?"
"That's right, it's Jermon." In the face of his assistant's question, President Saatchi stroked his beard and said, "Go and send it this year's God Sealing Battle video."
"Well… Considering the special situation… Don't just send the video of the finals."
"Send the top 16 over."
"If I remember correctly, this is its last time as an examiner, right? After this, the modification points can accumulate to the standard and be released from prison."
"Yes," the assistant with a human appearance and a camera on his head said. This was clearly a modified person. Otherwise, it would be very unscientific for a human to have a camera on his head.
In the center prison of World King City.
This was the second largest prison on World King Planet, where a group of extremely ferocious sinners was imprisoned.
However, compared to the number one prison, "Cosmic Sea Prison", the prison here seemed a little docile.
In the Cosmic Sea Prison, even super divine-level criminals were imprisoned, while in the center prison of World King City, only some divine-level criminals were imprisoned.
Apart from that, there was another obvious characteristic of the prison in the center of World King Planet. There were more descendants of large families here.
Some descendants of large families who had committed crimes and were not easy to deal with would be sent here to be modified and undergo various hard work. When the modification was completed, there was still a possibility of being released from prison.
The examiners of the past champions of the God Sealing Battle were actually the criminals here.
Being an examiner of the God Sealing Battle was one of their modification quests.
After President Saatchi's assistant entered the first prison, he arrived at a cell under the lead of the prison guard.
In the cell, there was a black yak lying on the ground in boredom.
"Jermon!" President Saatchi's assistant said, "The God Sealing Battle has ended this year."
"Ah, it's over?" The black yak looked at the camera assistant and said, "Is the winner still that crow?"
"No, there's another candidate for the championship this year."
"What? Someone defeated that crow?" The black yak was in disbelief. It felt like the crow wasn't weak.
"Forget it, it doesn't matter. As long as I'm the last examiner, I can be liberated, right?" The black yak said, "99 consecutive wins, our fight results are still alright. I'm about to win 100 consecutive wins!"
"100 years, 100 years, it's so tough!" The black ox suddenly became angry.
"President Saatchi questioned me to tell you not to go against your grandfather after you go out. In addition, the champion of this year's God Sealing Battle is very strong…"
The black yak, Jermon, had a grandfather who was a super divine-level expert and an ruler of the World King Planet.
The reason it was locked in jail was also because of the family.
It was all because Jermon was ignorant, incompetent, and extremely good-for-nothing. It even wanted to run away from home and idolize the cosmic overlord. It wanted to be a universe pirate and join the cosmic overlord army.
If it weren't for these, it wouldn't have been sent here to reflect.
Now, Jemon had been locked up for 100 years. It had probably lost the intention of being a cosmic pirate.
"I understand, I understand," Jermon said.
A moment later, President Saatchi's assistant left, leaving behind a battle footage of the top 16.
Jermon originally didn't plan to look. After all, it was an intermediate god. It hadn't reached the point where it felt that it couldn't defeat a quasi-divine champion. However, considering that Zavay had been defeated, it still secretly took a look.
"What's going on? Why didn't Zavay even enter the top 16 this time? Who beaten him?"
"Where's Ming Gu?"
"Well… There are indeed many powerful new faces this time. No wonder, no wonder."
"This black and white bear is so fierce, and this one with a sword is also so fierce."
"This Green Dragon, this machine…"
"Holy sh*t, they're not bad."
After the black ox finished watching, it fell into deep thought. The new face this time was indeed a little strong. This ginseng emperor who won the title actually knew the Time Mark!
"Self-destruction+Time Mark, and so many strange fruits. No wonder they could break out of a group of monsters. Every one of these monsters isn't inferior to Zavay and the others. What's going on this year!!"
"Fortunately, a mark was removed… Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to withstand continuous self-destruction."
"However, it's wishful thinking to defeat your Grandpa Bull with this level."

chapters.title: Chapter 1519 God Sealing in this Battle (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1519 God Sealing in this Battle (1)
Shi Yu's manor.
The team internal competition finally ended. Shi Yu's pets recovered their peaceful and friendly relationship and played happily together.
Next, they had to unite against the outside world and fight an intermediate god. They couldn't let their tacit understanding be injured because of the team internal competition.
"Yi!" Although the ginseng emperor had won the championship, it also knew that it was impossible for it to defeat an intermediate divine examiner alone. It still had to rely on its teammates.
"Wuu!!" Eleven expressed that Baby Ginseng should leave the subsequent champion challenge to us. Don't even think about self-destructing.
Be a support obediently!
Baby Ginseng had already gotten first place, so it could forget about showing off in the champion challenge.
"Yi…" Baby Ginseng had a bitter expression, but it was refuted by its teammates' gazes. However, Baby Ginseng also knew that self-destruction indeed couldn't be played casually.
There were so many teammates beside him, and self-destruction wasn't controllable. Apart from blowing up the opponent, it might also blow up his teammates. It wasn't good.
Unless necessary, it couldn't use it!
"Quack…"
"Quack…"
In the distance, Duckie comforted Susu. Second place was already very good!
"Quack!! (Why don't we wait? No matter how much limelight the champion challenge gives, at that time, I'll pollute the intermediate god and let it have the aura of the abyss. Big Sister, activate the Star Sea Contract again, then cleanse and instantly kill it!)"
"Ning!" Susu glared at Duckie. If there were too many cheats, it would also suffer a backlash!
"Come, come, come, I've already summarized the examiner's battle moves and battle weaknesses. Everyone, come and take a look. I'll analyze it for everyone…" At this moment, Ling called out to everyone.
"The examiners of the recent 99th batch are all awesome. It's called 'Jermon'."
The entire team cast sharp gazes. F*ck!
After this battle, let's go home!
…
The next day, the God Sealing Champion Challenge began.
In the silver fire basin, the Sun Fire, which represented the power of the star, burned fiercely as the holy fire of the competition.
The audience was already full. The God Sealing Battle was held in the second world online the whole time, but the championship challenge was different.
This was an additional challenge organized by World King City online. The champion of the God Sealing Battle vs the intermediate divine examiner chosen by the competition authorities!
If one could successfully challenge someone two levels higher, they could obtain the highest honor and be recognized as having it. As long as they didn't die, they would definitely become a super divine aptitude and be able to obtain the quasi-cosmic treasure that even super divine level life forms yearned for, the permanent teleportation array of World King Planet.
At the scene, more than 1 million spectators were there. They were all high-quality spectators from the God Sealing Battle. Apart from that, the contestants who performed well in the God Sealing Battle and the major media outlets also had the qualifications to enter the God Sealing Arena.
In the center of the arena was a stone arena. It looked to be only a hundred meters in length and width, but the arena contained spatial laws rewritten by super divine-level experts. Ordinary people couldn't walk to the other end from one end in their lives. It was much larger than what they could see with the naked eye.
"You're here." It was almost competition time. Baby Ginseng and Shi Yu rushed over from home. When they wanted to enter the venue through the contestant passage, they realized that there were no other staff there. Instead, an old man was waiting for them.
"Ginseng emperor, Shi Yu." President Saatchi smiled and said, "You guys have turned the world upside down in this God Sealing Battle."
"Until now, most of the audience is still in the dark."
"Yi!"
"My family is too poor, so I had no choice but to do this," Shi Yu stated with a smile.
"The rewards for the second to tenth spot of the God Sealing Battle have been prepared. When the God Sealing Battle completely ends, you can go and collect them. As for whether you can receive the champion reward for first place, it depends on today's battle."
"Hurry up and go. It's not long until the competition starts."
"I've already greeted the host. He'll introduce your situation."
With President Saatchi's blessing, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng entered the contestant passage and entered the contestant's room to wait.
…
In the venue, the audience was extremely enthusiastic.
The host, who was wearing a black formal suit and black sunglasses, walked to the arena and said, "Hello, audience friends!!!"
"The championship challenge that everyone has been looking forward to is about to begin!"
"Firstly… President Saatchi said that he still doesn't want to talk this year. Let's fast-forward to the competition segment!"
"Alright!!!" The audience's enthusiasm increased.
"This year's championship test is different from the previous years. In the previous 79 years, it was contestant Zavay who won the championship consecutively and obtained the challenge opportunity. But this year, a newbie forcefully charged out and became the greatest dark horse. He won the championship when no one expected it!!"
"It's… the ginseng emperor!!"
On the duel screen, in all directions above the audience, a domineering photo of Baby Ginseng in a research suit appeared.
"Ginseng emperor! Ginseng emperor! Ginseng emperor!!"
As countless spectators shouted, somewhere in the audience, Zavay sighed and felt its chest tighten. Beside it, Ming Gu patted it with a smile.
"Next, do you still want to participate? Your Time Mark has already been tempered to a very high level through the God Sealing Battle, right? Why don't we forget it and break through to the divine level? There will be those monsters in countless years. It's meaningless."
"You want me to give up the contest and have one less competitor, right?" Zavay said.
"How is that possible? As long as you give up the competition, I'll give up the contest too. I feel that there's no way to struggle these guys."
The two of them looked at each other and sighed infinitely in their hearts.
On the venue.
The host continued, "And the examiner the ginseng emperor is going to test next is our old acquaintance, Jermon!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1520 God Sealing in this Battle (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1520 God Sealing in this Battle (2)
"Ever since Jermon became the champion challenger of the God Sealing Battle, it has already successfully defended its title in the 99th year. It has experienced the period when contestant Ming Gu and contestant Zavay ruled the God Sealing Battle one after another."
"And now, under this special number, examiner Jermon welcomes its third opponent!"
"I wonder if examiner Jermon, who has successfully repelled 99 challengers, can defeat the new challenger this time!"
"Next, let's invite examiner Jermon to appear!!"
In an examiner passage connected to the arena, an ordinary black yak walked out calmly. Although it looked ordinary, many people knew that Jermon's identity wasn't simple!
Jermon is from a race that's ranked 181st out of all the races in the Starry Sky, the Demolishing Divine Bull Race. It controls top-notch laws and can demolish everything!
Compared to laws like obliteration and destruction, the characteristic of the demolishment law was that it was continuous.
The damage produced was continuous. It wouldn't only last for an instant of attack. As time passed, the broken thing would continue to collapse.
Therefore, the intermediate god examiner of the God Sealing Battle wasn't a weak intermediate god. The examiner was also a top-notch god!
This was also why monsters like Zavay and Ming Gu had never been able to defeat the examiner.
If it was an examiner from an ordinary race who had only mastered ordinary divine skills, they might have long taken away the permanent teleportation array.
Of course, this didn't mean that Jermon was the first tier of an intermediate god. Many people who knew the inside story knew that Jermon was famous for being ignorant, incompetent, and rich. His level was basically piled up with resources. His battle power was very far inferior to geniuses of the same background.
This characteristic of the other party could be considered to have given some challengers a minimal chance of winning.
"I heard from the Exposing King that Jermon was thrown here as an examiner by its own clansmen because it ran away from home and wanted to join the cosmic overlord army."
"It seems to be because it's said that the cosmic overlord is also from the Bull Race?"
"I'm not sure about this. The name of a cosmic overlord is taboo. Not many people know it, let alone its race. The speculation about the cosmic overlord race also came from the symbol similar to a bull's head and horns on the battleship of the cosmic overlord army, right?"
"Stop talking, stop talking. I wonder if the ginseng emperor can defeat it…"
As the audience discussed softly, the host said, "Examiner Jermon has already appeared!! Then, let's invite contestant ginseng emperor to appear!!!"
In another contestant passage, the ginseng emperor in a research suit walked out of the dark passage step by step and walked onto the arena.
The black yak, Jermon, looked at it and smiled. It was a white and tender radish, but unfortunately, Jermon couldn't take a bite of it.
If it self-destructed in Jermon's stomach, Jermon might really not be able to hold on.
When the ginseng emperor appeared, everyone was paying attention.
When the ginseng emperor went on stage under cheers, the host continued, "Before the battle starts, please let me update you with some information."
"Although the ginseng emperor contestant won the championship alone, it actually has a contracted partner."
"In the champion challenge of this God Sealing Battle, its contracted target will also fight side by side with it."
After the host finished speaking, everyone was in an uproar.
"What? The ginseng emperor has a contracted partner?"
"Damn, why didn't its contracted target appear during the God Sealing Battle?"
"Are you stupid? With the self-destruction method of the ginseng emperor, would its contracted target dare appear?"
"It clearly has a contracted target, but it won first place in the God Sealing Battle alone. This is too inspirational." The audience of the cosmic races looked at the ginseng emperor in the arena in shock.
They originally thought that this was a big boss who ruled the ages alone, but who knew that the ginseng emperor actually had a contracted partner?
The ginseng emperor… was worried that it wasn't enough to resist examiner Jermon, so it decided to let the contracted partner assist it?
Opposite the ginseng emperor, Jermon was also stunned. What?
This guy had a contractor?
There were none in the video! It was all fighting alone!
Jermon's expression immediately became slightly serious. It didn't care about a ginseng emperor!
However, if this ginseng emperor still had a contractor, it might be a little troublesome.
"Then, next, let's invite the contractor of the ginseng emperor contestant to appear!!" As the host finished speaking, another figure strolled out of the dark contestant passage.
Examiner Jermon strolled past the ginseng monarch and looked at the contractor of the ginseng emperor. Jermon also wanted to see who was qualified to be contracted by such a powerful ginseng emperor.
Soon, an extremely handsome young man in a dark red archeological suit with short black hair walked to the arena with a smile.
The moment this young man appeared, time seemed to have stopped. The originally noisy venue was silent.
Through the live broadcast camera, countless spectators who were paying attention to this championship challenge were also stunned on the spot when they saw the appearance of the ginseng emperor contractor and rubbed their eyes hard.
"Huh?" When Jermon saw the common Shi Yu appear, it didn't feel like there was anything special about Shi Yu. It felt like Shi Yu was as weak as a mortal. This was because Shi Yu had the talent of physical control and controlled his aura very well. What confused Jermon the most was why the entire venue suddenly fell silent the moment this human appeared.
"Shi Yu??"
"What?? Shi Yu? How is that possible?"
"Why is he here?"
"The contractor of the panax monarch is Shi Yu??"
"Wait, is something wrong?"
When Shi Yu strolled into the arena, the silent venue instantly erupted again. Shock waves swept over like a storm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1521 God Sealing in this Battle (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1521 God Sealing in this Battle (3)
"Shi Yu? Is he very famous?" Examiner Jermon was stunned on the spot. Why did it feel that cheers for this human were even higher than for the ginseng emperor?
In the arena, the host was also stifled. When he learned about today's incident from the inside of the God Sealing Battle, he was far more shocked than these people.
At this moment, in the 177th Fleet of the cosmic overlord army, Luster, the super divine, sat on the throne and took a deep breath. As expected…
"He's actually really the contractor of the ginseng emperor."
Back then, when the Exposing King revealed that the 10 newbies were all Shi Yu's pets, Luster naturally received the news. He immediately sent his subordinates to investigate and verify it. At the same time, he asked Zi Jian, who seemed to know Shi Yu, in order to verify it with her.
The answer Luster obtained from Zi Jian was, "I can't be sure either, but what I can confirm is that at least the ginseng emperor is Shi Yu's pet."
Just obtaining this news was enough to surprise Luster. He didn't expect that apart from contracting mechanical beasts and faith beasts, Shi Yu also contracted plant pets.
After the ginseng emperor won the championship, Luster asked about Baby Ginseng's research results, the Cultivation Fruit and the Reincarnation Fruit. Luster's mood was even more subtle after finding out more. This meant that Shi Yu was at least an expert in three subjects: botany, machinery, and archeology.
This made Luster like and desire Shi Yu even more.
At this moment, seeing Shi Yu completely publicize his relationship with the ginseng emperor in public, Luster seemed to have also sensed the shock of the audience present and couldn't help but say, "Shi Yu has to be roped in at all costs."
Apart from the super divine Luster, the geniuses from the Blue Wave World Plant Association who knew Baby Ginseng were also shocked.
They couldn't believe that the ginseng emperor who created the Cultivation Fruit and caused a frenzy in the Blue Wave World actually had a contractor, and this contractor was God Shi Yu, who had swept through the cosmic overlord army.
This was simply ridiculous to the extreme.
At the venue of the champion challenge.
Amidst the commotion.
Shi Yu had already stood beside the ginseng emperor. The host said, "Alright, now that the ginseng emperor's contracted partner, Shi Yu, has already appeared. Next, I'll count down. The competition officially begins!!!"
"10…"
"9…"
When the host counted down, the audience had yet to react to their shock. They observed Shi Yu and the ginseng emperor.
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was beside the ginseng emperor, made a gesture that made all the spectators swallow their saliva.
Summon a pet!
According to the rules of the God Sealing Battle, as long as there was a contract connection, it was considered a whole being.
Therefore, even if Shi Yu summoned new pets, these pets and Shi Yu could be regarded as pendants for the champion ginseng emperor.
However, the audience knew very well that what Shi Yu summoned next wasn't a pendant equipment of the ginseng emperor!
What he wanted to summon was clearly the World Destruction Dragon that wasn't much inferior to the ginseng emperor!! The Time Sect Master!!
"What, there's a pendant?" On the other side, the unaware examiner, Jermon, was slightly stunned when it saw that Shi Yu actually continued to summon the battle pendant during the countdown.
This ginseng emperor was greedy. Just one pendant wasn't enough. It even had to contract a few more pendants to assist it.
Jermon's expression became even more serious.
However, soon, its serious expression couldn't hold it in anymore.
"Roar!!"
A huge summoning array appeared not far behind Shi Yu. Accompanied by a dragon roar, the World Destruction Dragon appeared in shock.
When it saw Little Ji, Jermon was directly stunned. Wasn't this guy the World Destruction Dragon that lost to the World Cleansing Demon Duck in the top 16??
How could it, how could it…
Before it could react, a second summoning array appeared.
Behind Shi Yu, a short White Tiger walked out of the summoning array and let out a king's roar.
"Roar!!!" Shorty looked at Jermon with battle intent.
Jermon was stunned again. Holy sh*t, wasn't this the Time Sect Master who lost to the Super Holy Beast Black Tortoise in the top 16?
Wait a minute, why was it also…
While Jermon was thinking, a scene that stunned not only it, but also all the spectators appeared.
Shi Yu's summoning array was still appearing!!
One, two, three, four… A total of nine summoning arrays appeared!!
Including the ginseng emperor, there were 10 summoning arrays!
Shi Yu was clearly a Level 9 Beast Tamer, and the color displayed on the array was also at Level 9, but he actually contracted 10 pets!!
Of course, this wasn't difficult to achieve on the World King Planet. The divine contract and special modification methods could allow the Beast Tamers to have a few more contract slots. However, the more creatures they contracted, the more spatial assets had to be distributed, and the greater the burden on themselves. Hence, very few Beast Tamers did this.
However, Shi Yu did it. Moreover, these weren't the most important things. Most importantly, the audience perceived that every one of the pets Shi Yu summoned was extremely familiar!
Examiner Jermon gazed at the creatures Shi Yu summoned one by one in shock…
"Quack!!!" The World Cleansing Demon Duck wore a black eyeband that fluttered in the breeze, looking evil.
"So many people." The main body of the Super Holy Beast Black Tortoise sighed after appearing. The three-headed snake behind it stared at the enemy with cold eyes.
"The climate is pretty good." After Ling materialized and perceived the weather, it nodded. It was suitable to use the Starry Sky Storm and wouldn't be affected.
"Ning!" Susu's eyes were filled with warpath. It decided to take revenge here and become the MVP of this battle to relieve the repentance of not being able to win the championship.

chapters.title: Chapter 1522 God Sealing in this Battle (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1522 God Sealing in this Battle (4)
"…" Chi Tong didn't say anything. It silently pulled out its sword, and its aura locked onto its opponent. Death was heartless.
"Roar!!!" After Buggy appeared, it immediately changed from the form of a worm that saved energy to the form of a Green Dragon. It flew behind Shi Yu and released its dragon's might!!
"Wuu!!" Panda Eleven stood in the middle of a group of pets, its left and right palms colliding, indicating that it was already prepared for battle.
"Yi!!" In the end, Baby Ginseng retreated from the position beside Shi Yu to behind Shi Yu, indicating its secondary identity. In terms of contractual relationship, Shi Yu was the master, and it was the secondary. Therefore, Baby Ginseng directly stood in the position of the other pets in the team, leaving the core position for Shi Yu.
At this moment, the 10 new stars had all appeared. The audience was already trembling and standing up. Many media reporters spoke to the live broadcast camera in a different tone from before.
"Impossible, definitely impossible!!!"
"I don't believe it!! Kill me!!"
"It must be me. I'm still dreaming. Haha, the champion challenge will only begin tomorrow. I'm still sleeping."
As the audience shouted, contestants like Zavay, Ming Gu, and the son of the Demon Emperor could clearly determine that this wasn't a dream!
Their eyes were filled with shock, and their mouths were agape. They were shocked to the extreme.
"Perhaps I don't have to retire…"
Not to mention them, even some famous top-notch gods and even some super divine-level experts who were secretly paying attention to this battle revealed shocked expressions.
"Exposing King… is it… true?"
"What a joke."
In the battleship of Zi Jian's Special Forces, although Captain Zi Jian already had some guesses, when she saw this scene while transacting with Shi Yu, she still took a deep breath as if she had encountered the most difficult thing to understand since her birth.
She felt that she was already a genius, but when she saw the lineup beside Shi Yu, her body still went slightly limp, and she shook her head in confusion.
"No wonder… you're protected by the five super divines."
What a… monster!
If such a person died, it would probably be the greatest loss to the World King Planet.
"What exactly is the Blue Planet like?" In the Environmental Protection Association, the super divine vice president, Bing Ling, walked to the window and looked at the sky. Then, Bing Ling looked in the direction of the God Sealing Arena.
In the 177th Fleet, Luster stood up after being stunned!
"It's true!" Exposing King actually exposed true news!
However, how was this possible…
It could be said that even super divine-level experts were unwilling or unable to believe that the 10 new stars who each displayed shocking strength were all one person's contracted pets.
The champion, the ginseng emperor, took a step back and integrated into the team, as if it was mainly Shi Yu. It shocked countless spectators who supported the ginseng emperor.
Now, even if one thought about it, one could understand that Shi Yu wasn't a pendant of the ginseng emperor at all.
Instead, the ginseng emperor was only one of Shi Yu's pets.
At this moment, there was finally an explanation for why Shi Yu didn't appear to assist the Time Sect Master and the World Destruction Dragon.
The top 10 contestants were all Shi Yu's pets. He couldn't favor one over the other and support a certain pet!
"In that case, the finals of the God Sealing Battle are equivalent to Shi Yu's… team competition?"
"From the moment the top eight were born, the champion was already destined?"
"Every pet signed up alone, which means that they… have the confidence to win alone! This is an entertainment competition!"
"They don't think the God Sealing Battle will be difficult at all."
"In fact, that's the case… The top 10 of the God Sealing Battle… were actually, unprecedentedly, surrounded by a faction… No, by an individual!!!"
The most intense and huge vibration since the God Sealing Battle occurred on World King Planet!
Countless spectators couldn't believe the scene in front of them.
Of course, the most unbelievable person at this moment was still the examiner, the Demolishing Divine Bull, Jermon.
It was stunned on the spot.
"Huh?" It made a cute voice.
At this moment, it felt like it was still in a dream. It wasn't time to test the champion.
Why were the 10 strongest rookies among the top 16, the 10 guys who would undoubtedly rank in the top 10, here?
What was going on?
Its bull eyes widened.
Suddenly, it recalled the words of the camera assistant.
"The champion this year is very strong. This is a battle video of the top 16…"
In the past, the God Sealing Battle Committee had only given it a video of the finals, but this year, they gave it to the top 16…
At the thought of this, the Demolishing Divine Bull, who had connected everything, suddenly felt a little heart attack.
Holy sh*t!
Wait a minute!
Why didn't this old man, President Saatchi, say it directly!
Damn it!! Just because it threw a temper the first time it saw him?
Was there a need?
It looked at the 10 battle pets behind Shi Yu and was a little stunned. A combination of a Beast Tamer and the ginseng emperor was already enough to give it a headache. Now, nine opponents not much different from the ginseng emperor had come. What was going on?
"Moo!!!" The Demolishing Divine Bull let out a cry, wanting to ask if there was a problem with the rules of their God Sealing Battle?
How could the top 10 of them be considered an individual?
How could it be considered an individual?
How was the examiner supposed to play with this?
This was unfair to the examiner!
At this moment, although the audience and examiners felt that a century had passed…
However, the whole time was within the host's ten-second countdown.
When the Demolishing Divine Bull let out a confused cry, the countdown… had already returned to zero!
"Battle, begin!" Shi Yu took a deep breath.
This Demolishing Divine Bull didn't feel as strong as that Abyss Worm.
Thinking about it, it made sense. Although that worm was cowardly, it had at least gathered the merits of the three invading races.
It had three top-notch talents.
It was far from what ordinary intermediate gods could compare to.
"Roar!!!"
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the 10 pets attacked the Demolishing Divine Bull!!
The scene was spectacular, almost the most exaggerated in the history of the God Sealing Battle.
And seeing this scene, in the eyes of the Demolishing Divine Bull, there was only an explosion. It didn't know… how to deal with it!
It only analyzed the abilities of the ginseng emperor. It subconsciously skipped the other nine!!
"You guys… don't come over!!" Jermon roared in its heart. It felt that something was very wrong with this 100th assessment!
Could it not participate in this assessment??
Countless spectators saw the intention to retreat from the examiner's expression and the swallowing of its saliva!
However, it was understandable!
Each of the 10 newbies was ridiculously strong.
Every one of them had the aptitude to be first in the God Sealing Battle.
And when the 10 of them gathered together, it was undoubtedly an all-star lineup!
Now, it was unveiled that these pets were all cultivated by one person…
Then, how terrifying would this Beast Tamer be?
With the addition of this Beast Tamer, what kind of power could the 10 companions display?
After an endless daze, they gathered thousands of words. Even Ming Gu and Zavay, who had been beaten up by Jermon many times, couldn't help but… cast sympathetic gazes at it!
"This guy named Shi Yu… He's not human!"
As the thoughts of countless spectators fell, no one actually thought that examiner Jermon would win.
They only sensed that this cow was so miserable!
It actually encountered a beast challenger in its career.
It had to be said that this was the most brutal championship challenge in history.
"Moo!!!! (Old Man Saatchi, I hate you!!)" Shi Yu's 10 companions attacked. Accompanied by a miserable cry that resounded through the "World King Planet," a moment later, the highest challenger symbolizing the God Sealing Battle fell. The entire planet was silent!
Shi Yu's countenance was directly branded in the eyes of every spectators member! He was like a great demon king who ruled everything!
"A challenge two levels higher without any suspense…" Future generations evaluated this battle.
Beast Tamer Shi Yu.
His 10 fight pets.
After this battle, Shi Yu became a legend!

chapters.title: Chapter 1523 Breaking Through to a Divine-level Beast Tamer (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1523 Breaking Through to a Divine-level Beast Tamer (1)
Shi Yu ascended to the top of the God Sealing Battle and became famous throughout the world.
After that, the revelations of the Exposing King were dug out by the audience again.
Those comments below, swearing never to believe, had tragically become the target of criticism…
At this point, Shi Yu's pile of information was gradually released.
The fact that the monster Beast Tamer Shi Yu and the 10 new stars were also from the Floating Realm was completely verified.
"I know the Floating Realm. Although it's only a second-level realm, their realm overlord is said to have a battle record that surpasses that of a super divine!"
"That's right. The super divine expert on that battlefield even personally praised the realm lord, Wang Kong's heroic and powerful strength, and thought that he had a chance of becoming a super divine in the future!"
"Hiss… Is the lord of this Floating Realm so strong? There are simply endless monsters in this realm. Now that Shi Yu has obtained a permanent teleportation array, won't this realm take off? Although it can't become a first-level realm, it can basically become an existence in the top 10 of the second-level realm."
The Floating Realm was filled with joy.
The Wang, Lin, Zhao, and Lu families were extremely excited. They didn't expect the geniuses brought back by World Master Wang and Lin from their mother planet to be so valiant.
Those Floating Realm factions who originally felt that the plan of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng to find their mother planet was unrealistic and not very meaningful fell silent. The benefits might not be reciprocated.
In the Dong Xuan Region and the Heavenly Demon Region, some top-notch gods who assisted Wang Kong and Lin Feng in carrying out the plan to find their mother planet also went blank the whole time in this God Sealing Battle.
Of course, the most difficult to understand was still the genius, who was also from Blue Planet like Shi Yu and was picked up by the Angel Race and the Demon Race.
The Fallen Angel Prince of the Demon Kingdom and the Holy Maiden of the Rongguang Nation were already completely depressed at this moment. They originally thought that when they arrived at the World King Planet and were brought back by the divine race as geniuses, it would be the start of their rise.
However, they didn't expect that Shi Yu, who had suppressed the younger generation of the entire planet on Blue Planet, would reach the top again and become the number one quasi-divine in the universe only a year after coming to the World King Planet!
As for them, they had only just adapted to the World King Planet in a year… The difference was so huge that it made them despair.
However, the Dong Xuan Realm and the Heavenly Demon Realm were allies with the Floating Realm, after all. The arrival of the permanent teleportation array would benefit the entire Blue Planet. They were still relatively happy.
Although there was joy, there was also worry. The powerful families that crossed hundreds of realms, the Four Holy Family, were very anxious!
The ancestors of the four major families started a meeting from afar again.
At this moment, the eyes of the Four Saints were also filled with disbelief.
When the Black Tortoise super divine said that someone would bring the Four Holy Beasts to take away the Four Holy Ruins in the future, although they believed it, they didn't take it seriously and thought that this matter wasn't difficult to solve.
However, as they paid attention to the God Sealing Battle, the Super Holy Beast, and the other Four Holy Evolvers, they were gradually shocked.
It was confirmed that the God Sealing Beast Tamer, Shi Yu, was the person in the Black Tortoise super divine prophecy.
However, the Four Holy Beast Tamers mentioned by the Black Tortoise super divine weren't as simple as the Four Holy Beast Tamers!
In his team, there was also the vice president of the Environmental Protection Association, the cleansing star spirit, the vice president of the Plant Association, the ginseng emperor, and the vice president of the Space Disaster Research Institute… the Starry Sky Storm battleship Ling!
In addition, Shi Yu had become the strongest Beast Tamer to complete the champion challenge in the new batch. The attention he received now was incomparably huge.
He was almost the focus of the entire World King Planet and even obtained the favor of the cosmic overlord army.
At this moment, the Four Saints super divine couldn't help but feel a trace of fear, thinking that Shi Yu couldn't be touched easily.
At this moment, the Black Tortoise super divine finally understood why the divination result was very ominous.
With the strength of the Black Tortoise Family, it was probably extremely difficult to come into contact with and stop the other party from obtaining the Four Holy Ruins.
"If it's said that before confirming that person, the other party only had the potential of the 'Four Saints super divine'…"
"Then now, combined with the other party's shocking battle results, the other party has become someone with the ability to definitely have the 'Four Holy super divine'," the Vermillion Bird super divine said. "How should we deal with it? Just watch helplessly as the other party takes away the Four Holy Ruins?"
The White Tiger super divine said, "With the other party's identity, it's indeed not easy to handle with. If the other party really comes to take the Four Holy Ruins, we can use other resources to exchange for the Four Holy Ruins. Let Shi Yu show us a few respect. The Four Holy Ruins is currently a public ruin and concerns the interests of all the Four Holy Evolvers on the World King Planet. With this pressure, he might not dare take the Four Holy Ruins with the risk of offending all the Four Holy Evolvers on the World King Planet."
"We can use righteousness and stand on the moral high ground to suppress him."
"No matter who the other party is, there cannot be a second Four Saints super divine on the World King Planet," the Green Dragon super divine said. "I won't allow a second Green Dragon super divine to be born."
As a powerful super divine that had transcended several times, it had this confidence. On the World King Planet, there weren't many people stronger than it.
"Of course, but this matter is troublesome and needs to be discussed at length," the Vermillion Bird super divine said. The Four Holy Family was nothing to be afraid of. With the four of them joining forces, apart from the World King, there was really no one to be afraid of on the World King Planet, even these special institutions.
Their Four Holy Family also had numerous clansmen holding important positions in the Plant Association, the Environmental Protection Association, and the Space Disaster Research Institute!
Moreover, their main target was solely Shi Yu's Four Holy Evolvers. The various huge institutions didn't have to extend their reach that far, right? They took care of the another party, but if the other party didn't show respect and didn't take care of them, they couldn't be blamed for not being polite.

chapters.title: Chapter 1524 Breaking Through to Divine-level Beast Tamer (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1524 Breaking Through to Divine-level Beast Tamer (2)
After some discussion, the unanimous opinion of the Four Saints super divine pets was that considering the complicated background of this Shi Yu's identity, they could give up other benefits, but they definitely couldn't allow someone to challenge their position. They definitely couldn't allow Shi Yu's Four Holy pets to have the chance to be super divine.
…
God Sealing Hall.
Shi Yu followed President Saatchi in. President Saatchi personally handed all the rewards to Shi Yu and sighed. "Ever since I became the president of the God Sealing Battle Committee, you're the strongest challenger I've ever seen."
"You successfully reached the top in one challenge, and in this way too. Perhaps hundreds of thousands of years later, there will be records of this battle that will make you worshiped by countless later generations."
"President Saatchi, you flatter me." Shi Yu smiled and took the reward the other party had already prepared. "Is the permanent teleportation array among them?"
"That's right," President Saatchi said. "Reasonably using and operating a permanent teleportation array will help you obtain huge benefits in the long term. This is the honorary proof of completing the champion challenge. On World King Planet, the distribution of every permanent teleportation array has a far-reaching meaning. Now, I'll leave it to you."
"Of course, if you don't want it, you can transfer it. I believe countless factions will flock to it. You can obtain huge benefits at once with this. How you choose depends on you."
"Thank you for the reminder, President Saatchi," Shi Yu said. He naturally understood how much benefits he could obtain by directly selling it. There was even no need to do it all at once. He could also choose the dividend model, but he still chose to let Blue Planet use it, planning to make Blue Planet more prosperous.
After Blue Planet upgraded, it was the same to squeeze Blue Planet dry. It was more convenient to do that to a familiar place, so there was no need to be afraid and embarrassed.
"President Saatchi, I remember that even if I don't complete the champion challenge, there's an additional reward for first place in the God Sealing Battle, right?" Shi Yu said.
"Huh?" President Saatchi was stunned. "You're interested in becoming a realm lord?"
There was indeed an additional reward for first place in the God Sealing Battle, which was that there was a fast passage to apply to become a realm lord, obtain a fief, and become the ruler of a third-level realm. Moreover, the chances of passing were very high.
However, this reward was undoubtedly useless to people with the ability to get first place in the God Sealing Battle.
This wasn't the only way to become a third-level realm lord. For example, if one contracted a low-level planet or made merits, they would have a chance to become a third-level realm's realm lord, so this reward wasn't special.
It was mainly because the benefits of becoming a third-level realm's realm lord weren't high. Developing a territory was time-consuming and tiring, and there was insufficient benefits. Therefore, some ambitious people would at least aim to become a second-level realm's realm lord.
Developing a third-level realm was equivalent to developing a remote and poor village… Although there were some resources inside, there were also a large number of ferocious beasts and danger that needed to be developed by oneself…
Apart from having an official identity and having some advantages in doing things, it was only suitable for those from humble backgrounds to work hard and advance from low to high. As for people like Zavay and Shi Yu, who had extraordinary backgrounds and didn't lack resources, there was no need at all.
"I just want to possess the identity of a realm lord," Shi Yu said.
After having the identity of a realm lord, he could legally take away the era ruins unearthed on World King Planet. It was very important to an archeologist like Shi Yu.
As for whether it was a third-level realm or a second-level realm, Shi Yu didn't care. When the time came, he would leave it to the gem cat to manage. In any case, the cat was free.
If Shi Yu wanted a second-level realm, it wasn't difficult. After Little Zi broke through to an intermediate-level planet, it would be qualified to apply.
"Alright, I'll apply for it for you myself." President Saatchi laughed.
"I wonder what the name of the realm is? What do you desire to call it? What are your considerations regarding the arrangements of the fief?"
Shi Yu said, "The name of the realm… Let's call it the Dong Huang Realm. It's best if the location is between the Floating, Dong Xuan, and the Heavenly Demon Realms. It's best if it's an empty wasteland."
"Is that so?" President Saatchi was stunned. Most people still hoped to take over some third-level realm lord who died accidentally after already developing the third-level realm. Someone like Shi Yu, who didn't mind if it was a wasteland, was probably really just doing it for the identity of a realm lord.
"At least a week, at most half a month. I'll get it done for you," President Saatchi said. "At that time, the realm lord token will be personally sent to your residence."
"Thank you, President Saatchi."
"There's no need to thank me. I look forward to you provoking an even greater turmoil on the World King Planet in the future," President Saatchi uttered with a smile. Now that he was in a half-retired and half-retired state, he liked to watch fun. He hoped that Shi Yu would make the World King Planet more lively.
…
After the God Sealing Battle ended, Shi Yu returned to his residence and waited for the arrival of the realm lord token.
At this moment, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and Blue Planet, the five super divines, were already anxious.
After Shi Yu returned, the five super divines of Blue Planet immediately asked, "Shi Yu, where's the teleportation array?"
"It's previously with me, seniors."
"By the way, it might take a while to take away the Four Holy Ruins. My realm lord identity is previously in the process," Shi Yu said. "During this period, I'll return to the Blue Planet and connect the permanent teleportation array."
"Alright." Upon hearing Shi Yu's words, the Space Emperor agreed. "There's no time to lose. Why don't we return to the Floating Realm now?"
Now, Lin Feng and the others were additionally extremely anxious. They were excited at the thought of returning to Blue Planet immediately!
"It's easy on Blue Planet, but the key is… which realm on the World King Planet the teleportation grid should be."

chapters.title: Chapter 1525 Breaking Through to Divine-level Beast Tamer (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1525 Breaking Through to Divine-level Beast Tamer (3)
At this moment, after finally confirming that they had obtained the permanent teleportation array, the five super divines began to think about it again.
The three races naturally hoped to settle in the Dong Xuan Region.
As for the angels and demons, they definitely hoped to settle in the Heavenly Demon Realm.
The permanent teleportation array was divided into two sets. One was brought to Blue Planet by Shi Yu, and the other was placed where?
"Seniors, you're also thinking about this?" Lin Feng said unhappily. "Shi Yu fought for this teleportation array. Why don't we place it in his realm?"
"Everyone, stop fighting."
"In any case, his realm is also established between the Floating, Heavenly Demon, and Dong Xuan realms. It's not troublesome for any of us."
"That's right." The Space Emperor nodded. In any case, it was impossible to build it in Dong Xuan Realm and the Heavenly Demon Realm.
When the five super divines on Blue Planet saw this, they couldn't say anything. Alright, alright, it was considered fair.
"Then it's decided. Shi Yu will go to Blue Planet to fix the teleportation array first. When the location of the realm is confirmed, we'll fix the teleportation array here," the Kirin Race super divine said.
"During this period, let Shi Yu's secretary safeguard the other teleportation array."
"Who is it?" Lin Feng said.
When did Shi Yu have a secretary?
"Isn't it that cat girl?"
"That's Shi Yu's teacher! Although it's not the kind of teacher who teaches Shi Yu how to increase his strength, it's just a teacher in the mother planet school."
The five super divines: ???
"But look, that guy always helps Shi Yu work."
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng didn't know how to quibble.
"Leave it to Teacher Ying…" Shi Yu smiled. This way, Teacher Gem Cat should be very happy.
In the future, she would also control the teleportation array. Just collecting the teleportation fee would probably make her happy.
That day, everyone returned to the Floating Realm without any reluctance to leave World King City.
Shi Yu had actually recorded the names and skills of many outstanding contestants in the God Sealing Battle, but now wasn't the time to slowly replicate them. He planned to return to Blue Planet and break through to the divine level first!
At that time, it wouldn't be too late to visit them one by one.
If he had the strength, he would be more confident in touching the various races in the starry sky.
Now, for Shi Yu, breaking through to the divine level was the most important thing.
Apart from having stronger battle power, it would be safer to go and get the Four Holy Ruins.
Of course, most importantly, after breaking through to the divine level, Shi Yu could finally explore a ruin on Blue Planet that he had yet to explore.
Back then, after he won the World Tournament, the World Tree had once told him to leave a ruin behind for "Goddess Wa", who had brought humans from the starry sky to Blue Planet.
Only divine-level humans could enter this ruin.
At that time, Shi Yu was regarded by the World Tree as the human with the greatest hope of being the first to step into the divine level.
Both parties agreed that after Shi Yu reached the divine level, Shi Yu would explore the ruins.
However, due to the interference of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng later, Blue Planet revived a step ahead of time. Many humans stepped into the divine level.
But even so, the World Tree still maintained its promise to let Shi Yu go over when he reached the immortal level.
It knew that Shi Yu was an archeologist and definitely wanted to explore this ruin very much. Now that Shi Yu had finished the God Sealing Battle, he could finally advance to the divine level. He could also return and complete the agreement with the World Tree.
Goddess Wa… This top-notch god was extremely mysterious. Although she was a native god of Blue Planet, even Blue Planet's Will didn't know her background.
After many gods on Blue Planet went to the starry sky and couldn't return, only Goddess Wa returned with a great immortal power and brought back the Seed of Human Hope. From this, it could be seen that she was extraordinary, even stronger than the initial ancestors of the five god races.
The World Tree guessed that Goddess Wa might have obtained opportunities from the starry sky in her early years like the gem cat. It was also possible that she had obtained benefits from the ruins of the era like Emperor Shi and Shi Yu before rising. In any case, it was impossible. She grew up through the inherent resources on Blue Planet.
As for what Goddess Wa had left behind, Shi Yu might know after entering Inatella's Goddess Wa's Ruins.
…
A day later.
In the starry sky outside Blue Planet.
A figure directly appeared.
Shi Yu looked at the blue planet below and sighed. He smiled. He was finally back!
"Dragon~ Let's go~" Shi Yu shouted. A Green Dragon crawled out of the golden summoning arrangement beside him. Shi Yu rode on the Green Dragon and rushed towards Blue Planet.
Boom!!!
A green light streaked across. The powerful might made Blue Planet's Inatella's World Tree directly awaken, transforming into a clone to look at the sky.
"Shi… Yu?"
Sensing the familiar fluctuations, the World Tree clone was stunned. Shi Yu had returned. Did this mean that the God Sealing Battle was over?
The World Tree naturally knew about the God Sealing Battle. In its opinion, Shi Yu's return this time was to report the results.
No matter what rank it was, there were huge resource gains!
"Roar!!" A moment later, the Green Dragon landed on Inatella. Shi Yu was teleported by Buggy and placed on the ground. Shi Yu instantly looked at the green vortex worm on a huge tree.
"Aunt World Tree~ Look."
Shi Yu took out something that looked like a transfer anchor from his spatial equipment and threw it out. "World King Planet's permanent teleportation array. Please place this in Inatella. This requires at least a divine-level placement. It's said that it consumes a lot of immortal power. I'll leave it to you."
"I'll go advance first. Take your time. After this side is fixed, it'll probably be a while over there. After that side is also fixed, the transfer of the two planets can be connected." Shi Yu left one of the permanent teleportation arrays behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1526 Breaking Through to Divine-level Beast Tamer (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1526 Breaking Through to Divine-level Beast Tamer (4)
"Wait, wait?" The World Tree was shocked. It looked at the teleportation anchor and said, "You obtained the championship of the God Sealing Battle and completed the champion challenge?"
"What's so difficult about that? I even killed the Abyss Worm. This guy is considered one of the best among the intermediate gods, right? To us, the God Sealing Tournament is naturally indiscriminate." Shi Yu smiled and gave him a thumbs up.
"It's just the baby cup!"
The World Tree was also speechless. The green worm's eyes were filled with shock as it looked at the teleportation array Shi Yu had left behind.
"Aunt World Tree, there's no problem, right? I'm going to break through. I'm so anxious. After I break through, I'll come back to Goddess Wa's Ruins. You probably haven't let anyone else in yet."
"No…"
"That's good. I'll leave first."
The World Tree watched in a daze as Buggy flew away with Shi Yu. It never expected that the permanent teleportation array that even the super divine level disciple of the Space Emperor, Zi Lan, mentioned would really be brought back by Shi Yu just like that.
However, on careful thought, with Shi Yu's monstrous strength, it seemed to be only natural. Now, the World Tree really wanted to see how the God Sealing Battle of the World King Planet was and how Shi Yu obtained the championship…
"Work!" It looked at the teleportation array. After building this, it should know.
…
At this moment, after throwing the teleportation array to the World Tree, Shi Yu directly got Buggy to build an island close to him. He didn't choose to break through in Inatella, afraid that it would affect the World Tree's establishment of the teleportation array.
On the island, after Shi Yu landed, he sighed and meditated on the spot without saying a word.
At the same time, Shi Yu's pets, including Qi and Little Zi, also came out of the Beast Taming Space.
They looked at Shi Yu with anticipation.
After Shi Yu broke through to the divine level, they could also break through to the divine level!
"Coming." Shi Yu had already cultivated to the extreme of Level 9 in World King City and was on the verge of breaking through at any time. At this moment, Shi Yu entered a meditative state again and attacked the shackles to strengthen the two Beast Taming Spaces. His Beast Taming Space with the golden barrier trembled with a bang.
"Huh?" The breakthrough this time was very special. It was a little different from any other time in the past. Under Shi Yu's gaze, his two Beast Taming Spaces appeared to have shed paint. The golden color began to fade and slowly change to colorless. It returned to the state of the Level 1 Beast Taming Space and felt like it had returned to its original state.
Shi Yu wasn't surprised. The Level 10 Beast Taming Space itself was a colourless barrier for restoration. He had long known about this. What surprised Shi Yu was that the first Beast Taming Space, the second Beast Taming Space, and the two Beast Taming Space appeared to be colliding with each other and squeezing each other. With a boom, as Shi Yu's two spaces changed, they actually fused together and became an even larger Beast Taming Space!
Boom!!!
At this moment, Shi Yu's physique, soul, and mental fortitude underwent another transformation.
It made him look like a humanoid ferocious beast, emitting an aura that was enough to crush demigods.
At this moment, Shi Yu had a feeling that the top 10 fighters in the God Sealing Battle would all be him,
However, this wasn't the focus of the pets.
"Quack?" After Duckie and the others sensed their home and fused with the home of a team of seniors, Little Ji and Duckie looked at each other and revealed ecstatic expressions.
Was this considered a different promotion to the first team?
"Ning?" Of course, Susu didn't seem to welcome Duckie and the others. When it thought of how Little Ji and Duckie wanted to be in the same Beast Taming Space as them, it felt a headache. This was because the entire team knew about Little Ji and Duckie's ADHD.
"Although it has fused, the contract rules haven't changed. The 20 contract slots are stable." Shi Yu sensed it again and confirmed that apart from fusing, the two spaces had become stronger and the environment had become better. There didn't seem to be any disadvantages.
Not only was there no disadvantage, but there were also benefits. As the two Beast Taming Spaces fused, Shi Yu discovered that two days had appeared in the sky of the Beast Taming Space. These two layers of sky contained a huge amount of origin power of the Beast Taming Space. It was a surprise.
"Second level of the divine level!" Shi Yu said.
He didn't expect that once he fractured through, he would reach the second level of the divine level. There were a total of 10 levels for the divine level. The two Beast Taming Spaces broke through at the same time, one level higher than the new divine level. It appeared to be the benefit of the accumulated foundation of the two spaces.
At this moment, the greatest benefit of the origin power of the two heavens to Shi Yu was that apart from allowing him to be reborn, increasing his stats in various aspects, and increasing his vitality, the origin power had also upgraded after fusing with the telepathy and physical control talent that came with the first and second Beast Taming Space!
Telepathy and advancing to the divine level contained the laws of the mind. At this moment, Shi Yu could even affect the emotions and thoughts of other lives through telepathy.
Body control and advancement to the divine level allowed Shi Yu to obtain unbelievable body control. He had the ability to regrow broken limbs, leave his soul, and create mental clones without the power of his pet.
