At this moment, what increased was the accompanying talent in the Beast Taming Space. Talents like space, time, and fusion didn't increase. Shi Yu still had to cultivate on his own, as well as the telepathy domain derived from telepathy. It was the same.
However, this wasn't the main point.
"Holy sh*t." As Shi Yu was shocked, every pet sensed Shi Yu's astonished mood.
What was going on? This was…
The pets gazed at Shi Yu in anticipation. What good thing happened?
"This is asking me not to be human!!!"
Shi Yu gazed at the skill index. As expected, as he fractured through to the divine level, the skill index also changed. It upgraded and had a new function!!
< Name > Origin Plunder
< Introduction > The user can materialize the book. When a super divine level life form dies in front of the user, by activating the Origin Plunder ability, it can increase the probability of drawing the other party's source of transcendence!
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1527 Everyone Breaks Through to the Divine Level (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1527 Everyone Breaks Through to the Divine Level (1)
"Sigh…"
Shi Yu looked at the Origin Plunder ability and sighed.
To be honest, he just wanted to be an honest person and a proper archeologist.
In the future, if he lacked the source of transcendence needed to advance, Shi Yu had already thought of letting the Prediction Owl cooperate with Shorty and the Gem Cat to search for treasures.
In addition to Ling's luck blessing, they could at least pick up a few sources of transcendence, right?
In this way, without a transaction, there would be no harm done to others.
Shi Yu didn't want to hunt other super divines for the source of transcendence either…
However, this function was very scammy.
It gave Shi Yu the feeling that if he didn't use it, he would lose a function. It gave Shi Yu the feeling that he had advanced to the divine level for nothing.
So… should he use it or not?
The drop rate of the source of transcendence was actually quite low.
To be precise, the weaker the super divine, the less likely it was to drop the source of transcendence.
However, this function might really increase the drop rate of the source of transcendence?
Shi Yu touched his chin. As expected, he still wanted to verify the drop rate…
"Sigh, lousy function…" Shi Yu realized that his pets were looking at him hopefully. He sighed and shared the new function with them.
This sharing shocked all the pets!
Wow!
They looked at each other.
"Wuu!!"
"Yiya!"
Initially, they were still thinking about how to walk the path to super divine after advancing to the divine level.
But now, a bright path appeared in front of every teammate.
As long as he shattered 14 super divines, everyone could advance. There was such a good thing?
"Can you guys calm down?" Ling looked at its chattering teammates and felt a headache.
"We haven't reached the divine level yet. Can you not think so far ahead? It's such a dangerous thing."
"Think about it after at least breaking through."
Shi Yu: "?"
"Alright, forget about this first. Even after breaking through, it's impossible for us to defeat a super divine level so quickly!" Shi Yu said.
"I'm done breaking through. Next, it's your turn."
Shi Yu sighed. He had already felt his strength. It felt really good.
Divine level.
Shi Yu clenched his fist and opened his palm. A seal mark filled with spatial power appeared in Shi Yu's hand.
Shi Yu pinched it and pinched the seal mark into the shape of a card, then into the shape of a gourd, and finally into the shape of a sprite ball.
This was a manifestation of Shi Yu's ability to materialize the contract sealing ability in the Beast Taming Space. It could be said that with this, he could directly suppress a weaker demigod and forcefully contract the other party as a slave.
"That's right." Shi Yu looked at Eleven and the others and said, "Who wants to go first?"
"I'll go first!" Ling said. "I'll break through to the divine level first. I can better test your state after breaking through with them, Master."
"Alright." Shi Yu smiled and said, "Then Ling will go first."
"Wuu!!" Eleven and the others had no objections.
"Yes." Ling looked at the pets one by one and said, "After we break through, Master, you can still receive huge feedback."
"My stats and the Beast Taming Space levels will also increase."
"With our overall stats, this increase won't be small."
"I know, I'm looking forward to it too." Shi Yu smiled.
There were so many benefits to contracting pets!
Could other Beast Tamers feel so good when they broke through to the divine level?
Could there be feedback from 12 pets leveling up?
Of course, Shi Yu's 12 pets were all top-notch divines. Even if ordinary Beast Tamers contracted so many, it was impossible for them to have the same feedback.
Shi Yu looked at the flying cube, Ling.
Ling now had 10 perfect quasi-divine skills… As long as it had one quasi-divine skill and added points to a divine skill, it could advance.
At that time, it would be a primary-level god.
"After breaking through to the divine level, the difficulty of adding points to quasi-divine skills has decreased a lot." Shi Yu looked at the success rate of adding points to Wind Control in the skill index. It was actually extremely high. He knew that even without the support of Baby Ginseng, he could easily add points to Ling.
Of course, this was also related to the low quality of Wind Control. If it were Ling's Starry Sky Storm, the success rate of adding points would decrease.
"Come on, even if it's easy, Baby Ginseng, you have to heal me!" Shi Yu said.
"Yi! (Healing!)" Baby Ginseng was calm.
As the number one in the team, this little job wasn't a big deal.
"Add the mechanical spirit first," Shi Yu said.
Then, Ling landed in Shi Yu's hand. Shi Yu directly activated the additional points in the skill index. A white halo emerged in his palm, and the light of the additional points entered his body. Ling entered an unprecedented comfortable state.
As the mechanical spirit changed from a quasi-divine skill (expert+11) to a godlike skill (initiate) state, an invisible divine heart directly condensed in Ling's body with the life source as the prototype.
This was the divine-level symbol.
The Formless Heart of God was a place to hoard divine power. Apart from itself and his contractor, it was impossible for outsiders to sense and come into contact with it. Moreover, it would completely disappear with the death of a divine-level life form!
At this moment, because Ling had grasped the first divine skill, a wisp of divine power immediately appeared in Ling's divine heart.
As this wisp of godlike power was born, Ling's divine heart began to pound, making the force in Ling's body quickly flow, surging into the divine heart and transforming into divine power.
Right on the heels of that, godlike power radiated divine power fluctuations again, subtly modifying Ling's body, modifying its body into a divine machine!
It had been strengthened beyond anything in the past!!!
Boom!!!
Divine Ling was born!
In the next moment, the powerful godlike power fluctuations on Ling's body emitted, making Chi Tong, Susu, and the others point.

chapters.title: Chapter 1528 Everyone Breaks Through to the Divine Level (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1528 Everyone Breaks Through to the Divine Level (2)
Why wasn't it as strong as that Demolishing Divine Bull?
Ling: "?"
"That's because the increase in divine power, apart from the strengthening of resources, mainly depends on the level and number of divine skills. I've just advanced a quasi-divine skill!"
"Because I've accumulated pretty well before the divine level. My current divine power level is already very high among primary gods!"
"At least it won't lose to Ancient God Golden Bull!"
"Master, continue to add points. Add all my remaining quasi-divine skills to divine skills. Show them my limit!" After Ling finished speaking, it looked at Shi Yu.
"Add!" Shi Yu chuckled.
After the Mechanical Spirit… was Wind Control… After Wind Control… was Wind Blessing!
Just like that, Shi Yu slowly added points to Ling. After Ling's Turning Misfortune into Luck, Wind Control, Wind Spirit Bead, and Wind Blessing from quasi-divine skills to the divine skill stage, Ling's divine power indeed increased to a terrifying level.
A large amount of divine power appeared in the Heart of God.
Soon, Ling seemed to have reached a bottleneck and broke through with a bang. Under the shocked expressions of Eleven and the others, Ling broke through to the primary-level god and reached the intermediate god level!
Compared to when it reached the bottleneck just now, its divine power had doubled.
Boom!!
Ling's powerful divine might directly made Eleven and the others' hearts pound. They felt that Ling could easily kill them at this moment.
"How is it!" Ling said.
Shi Yu was extremely excited. As expected of his pet, its aptitude was good. Its divine skills had just been upgraded, and its divine power had reached the level of an intermediate god.
"This is because the quality of these divine skills isn't low…" Ling said.
There were three ways to increase divine power. First, to increase the proficiency level of the divine skill. The higher the quality of the divine skill, the more divine power it would obtain after its level increased. Of course, it was even harder to increase the level of this divine skill.
Second, by cultivating a large number of divine techniques, for each divine technique cultivated, it could gain some divine power. The higher the quality of the new divine technique, the more divine power it would obtain, and this included non-racial divine techniques.
Third, it would still use resources to strengthen itself and let the Heart of God automatically transform energy into divine power.
The extent of the three's increase in divine power was that the level of the divine skills was greater than the number of divine skills and the strengthening of resources.
Battle power was also related to this.
Now, Ling's increase in level relied on the second method.
"There's more, there's more." Shi Yu continued to add points to Space Control, Light Control, Future Prediction, Starry Sky Storm, and Nine-Colored Divine Light.
One after another, it was added to the divine skill stage by Shi Yu.
The quality of these teaching skills was even terrifyingly high. Ling's divine power fluctuations were still increasing quickly. Soon, it was close to the peak of an intermediate god, giving Eleven and the others a feeling that Ling alone could fight that Space Worm alone!
Hu…
After all the points were added, Ling's level finally stopped at the intermediate god level. It was a pity that it couldn't break through to the high-level god level in one go.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu's brain rumbled. He felt that the Beast Taming Space had improved under Ling's feedback.
He had directly advanced to the third level of the divine level!
"How fierce," Shi Yu couldn't help but say.
"Thank you, Master." After Ling completed its breakthrough, it was extremely happy. It felt that in time, it could quickly advance to a high-level god.
At this moment, it could completely sense how impressive and unbelievable changes had happened to its skills with divine power and divine skills.
It now completely had the battle power to destroy planets!
"By the way, Master, is the difficulty of adding points to divine skills high?" Ling asked a question it was very concerned about.
If it wasn't high, they could completely instantly advance to perfect god.
"Of course it's high. What are you thinking?" Shi Yu smiled. "Even the success rate of Wind Control is extremely low. The success rate of Wind of Blessing and Starry Sky Storm is also 0. The difficulty of increasing it is huge."
"But there's no need to worry. As long as there are skills that could add points, it's easy. Your level enhance won't be slow. After my level increases, I believe these skills that can't add points will return to normal."
"Alright!" Ling was relieved.
"Wuu!! Wuuu!!" At this moment, Eleven and the others couldn't wait anymore when they saw how fierce Ling was after breaking through.
It expressed that it wanted to break through next.
"Add!!" Shi Yu's heart rippled. He felt that after the entire team leveled up, his battle power would definitely undergo a qualitative change!!
Even if it couldn't compare to Lin Feng, the Space Emperor, and the others, it should be considered an expert among divine-levels.
"Buggy, go first," Shi Yu said. After Buggy's Dragon of Imagination was raised to the divine skill stage, it could still let it evolve again and learn fresh skills.
Shi Yu wanted to know what kind of transformation Buggy's strength would undergo after it evolved into the Green Dragon 3.0!
"Roar!!!" Buggy immediately flew over excitedly and circled in the sky.
Shi Yu directly activated the Green Dragon Domain and added points to it.
For example, although Ling had only advanced to the divine level this time, because it involved evolution, Buggy's breakthrough was huge.
Fortunately, this island was all in Buggy's creation domain. It was harmless and couldn't affect the outside world.
"Roar!!!" A moment later, in the clouds, a huge divine dragon circled in the sky and let out a shocked roar. It was extremely excited.
Chi Tong, Shorty, Turtle, and Little Quas gazed at it in a daze.
It understood why it was so excited.
As the Dragon of Imagination advanced to a divine skill, Buggy directly evolved into the Green Dragon 3.0. Although its appearance didn't change, a fresh skill was indeed born.
Compared to a fresh skill, it was more similar to one of its old skills had undergone a transformation and advanced under this evolution!

chapters.title: Chapter 1529 Everyone Breaks Through to the Divine Level (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1529 Everyone Breaks Through to the Divine Level (3)
[Creation Domain] directly upgraded to [Creation God Domain]!
The effect was still the same, but it was already fundamentally different from the Creation Domain.
"Previously, Buggy consumed the power of faith to mobilize the laws of creation."
"This undoubtedly means that Buggy is a fake Green Dragon. Because the real Creation Green Dragon God is powerful because it's strong, so it's believed in, not powerful because it's believed in."
"A skill that can only display normal power with the power of faith is incomplete."
"And now, the Creation God Domain can mobilize the laws of creation even without the power of faith. With the power of faith, the Creation God Domain will be stronger. This undoubtedly means that Buggy has already completely controlled this top-notch divine skill and has already reached an extremely perfect level on the Green Dragon's evolution path!"
"This evolution is its own evolution. It's an evolution that leaves faith and exceeds faith."
"Roar!!!" At this moment, Buggy looked at Baby Ginseng excitedly.
It meant that the incense was poisonous, but even if it didn't use the power of faith, it was still very powerful!
It was still uncertain who the next first place in the team would be!
"Eh…" Baby Ginseng pouted. Wait a minute, it would first give the divine-level Anti-Teammate Energy Fruit to Buggy.
Who asked Buggy to be arrogant?
Next, Shi Yu continued to add points to Buggy and also added its quasi-divine skills to the divine skill stage.
In the end, Buggy undoubtedly advanced to an intermediate god, not far from a high-level god.
Unfortunately, apart from his own stats, Shi Yu's Beast Taming Space didn't receive any feedback to upgrade again.
Perhaps the difficulty of going from the third to the fourth level of the divine level was too high…
However, although it didn't level up, Shi Yu could clearly feel that Buggy's breakthrough still saved him countless bitter cultivation.
"Everyone, one by one, continue!!"
Then, Shi Yu seemed to have gone berserk as he kept adding points to his pets.
Eleven, intermediate god! Baby Ginseng, intermediate god! Chi Tong, intermediate god! Susu, intermediate god!
Little Ji, Duckie, Shorty, and Fusion Black Tortoise were all intermediate gods!!
"Hahahahaha." Shi Yu's unrestrained laughter came from the island.
Also, crazy laughter from various races rose and fell!
Shi Yu didn't know how long had passed, but now, the level of his Beast Taming Space had already been reflected to the peak of the fourth level of the divine level!!
He had just broken through and was about to reach the fifth level of the divine level. There was no one else with this leveling speed.
The Space Emperor and the others originally judged that Shi Yu could only reach this level through the meditation jade, but they still underestimated the breakthrough feedback of Shi Yu's pets. They could only say that Shi Yu's pets were too strong.
At this moment, Shi Yu's pets were also rather excited.
At this moment, each of them had obtained the strength of an intermediate god. At this moment, each of them was confident of instantly killing themselves and their teammates from before.
Among these pets, Shi Yu was the most satisfied with Baby Ginseng's breakthrough.
Because the number of divine-level Time Marks directly increased to three!!
How many times would it explode?
Unfortunately, it still couldn't be used by others.
However, only the Time Mark couldn't. The Cultivation Fruit, Reincarnation Fruit, World Tree Fruit, and other resources were completely fine.
Shi Yu had yet to try it, but he had already started to look forward to the effect of the Cultivation Fruit. Time, space, fusion, and other talents… He was just waiting to rely on the Cultivation Fruit to increase. Fortunately, the Cultivation Fruit could increase points.
The consecutive points and breakthroughs made Shi Yu's entire team in a very thrilled state. Soon, it was Qi's rotation to add points.
After Qi, this unlucky sprite, became the first to break through, it was still only a primary-level god.
There was no other reason than… Qi had too few skills. There was only one Space-time Travel and Star Refinement. Although these two skills were also very strong, others had seven to eight divine skills, but the two skills she had were still lacking something.
"Wu…" Qi felt stifled.
It wasn't because she was the weakest after breaking through, but because after finally recovering to the divine level, her body… became even smaller!!
It had completely become a mascot figurine the size of a mineral water bottle.
"Don't be sad. Little Zi definitely won't be able to become an intermediate god later."
"Although you're a primary-level god, you have a lot of attributes. I broke through to the fifth stage of the divine level again!"
Little Zi: …
"Moreover, this is for you." Shi Yu handed the quasi Level 12 Time Crystal he had obtained from the super divine stone to Qi. Qi's gaze instantly lit up.
"I love you, Shi Yu!" Qi happily took away the Time Crystal. She was very happy. With this and Baby Ginseng's Reincarnation Fruit divine skill, she was confident that she could return to the peak battle power of her previous life in a short period of time, which was the high-level divine realm.
She could even complete the advancement and surpass her previous life to reach the strength of a top-notch god… or even a perfect god!!
At that time, she would be the strongest battle strength in the team!!! Hehe!!
She couldn't participate in the team internal competition this time, but upcoming time, she would pray to kill everyone!
"Hurry up." Shi Yu smiled. He looked forward to Qi returning to the peak. At that time, he could go anywhere in the universe.
"It's your rotation next." In the end, Shi Yu looked at Little Zi. Little Zi also floated over in anticipation and landed in Shi Yu's hand.
It only had three skills, namely the Power of the World, the World Blessing, and the Inner World. Shi Yu had all helped it boost to the divine skill stage. At this point, Little Zi had finally reached the divine level. Of course, it was only a primary-level god.

chapters.title: Chapter 1530 Everyone Breaks Through to the Divine Level (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1530 Everyone Breaks Through to the Divine Level (4)
It meant that its body could at most give birth to a primary-level or god-level life form.
However, according to the standard of the planet, it was already considered an "intermediate planet" at the same level as the Blue Planet.
It was just that the difference was worlds apart.
As Little Zi advanced, Shi Yu's Beast Taming Space level completed the final increase. It was strengthened again on the standard of the fifth level of the divine level. At this point, Shi Yu's pets had finished strengthening. Shi Yu let out a long sigh and was very satisfied.
"I'm so tired. Baby Ginseng, give me a Cultivation Fruit. I want to sleep before exploring the ruins. You guys go to the Beast Taming Space to build a new home. Call me in a week. At that time, the teleportation array should be almost built…"
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he took a Cultivation Fruit from Baby Ginseng.
"Yi… (Well, well… After the Cultivation Fruit reached the level of a divine skill, it seemed to contain the smelly law. I don't know what's going on!)" Baby Ginseng said.
Shi Yu: "?"
Smelly law? There was such a law?
"Are you sure you're not kidding???"
For a moment, Shi Yu, holding the Cultivation Fruit, didn't know if he should eat it…
…
Five days later.
Shi Yu had obtained a breakthrough in his sleep. It wasn't that his Beast Taming Talent had broken through.
Instead, he, who was originally at the fifth level of the divine level, broke through again in the Beast Taming Space.
It wasn't because of the Cultivation Fruit.
The feedback this time came from the Time Sprite, Qi!
As expected, just as Shi Yu and Qi had expected, with the Reincarnation Fruit that activated the power of her previous life and the quasi Level 12 Time Crystal, Qi's growth level increase speed was like cheating.
In almost a day, she recovered to the divine power level of a high-level god in her previous life. The level of the Space-time Travel divine skill also recovered to the expert level.
In addition to refining the Time Crystal, her Space-time Travel level steadily advanced to the perfect level. Although she had yet to reach the perfect level, the strengthening brought by a top-notch divine skill directly made Qi break through and become the first top-notch god in Shi Yu's team!!
This breakthrough brought about huge feedback to the Beast Taming Space, directly allowing Shi Yu to reach the sixth level of the divine level, close to the seventh level of the divine level. The leveling speed was so fast that it was unbelievable. He was only four stages away from the peak of the divine level.
"Qi… stinks to death…" In his sleep, Shi Yu was happy and excited.
Qi: "?"
A week later.
"Ugh…" After Shi Yu woke up, he first vomited for three minutes. Then, he wiped his saliva and stood up, his gaze revealing an invincible expression.
"Dragon, let's go again!!"
Under Shi Yu's call, the intermediate-level godly Green Dragon appeared. With a cry, it flew into the sky with Shi Yu and headed for Inatella.
"You're not allowed to imitate Little White Dragon." Under Shi Yu's command, Buggy immediately roared obediently.
A moment later, Shi Yu returned to Inatella.
At this moment, sensing the arrival of an outsider, the green vortex worm of one of the World Tree clones immediately appeared.
"Completed a breakthrough? Wait a minute… What's wrong with your levels!" The World Tree clone sensed Shi Yu and Buggy's levels and was stunned.
At this moment, Shi Yu and Buggy didn't hide their auras at all. Sensing Shi Yu's spatial state which was almost at the seventh level of the godly level and Buggy's divine power level at the peak of the intermediate divine level, the World Tree clone was directly stunned.
Something was wrong, something was wrong. Didn't they reach the godly level a week ago?
They had just broken through. Shouldn't they all be new divine-level?
What was going on with peak sixth level divine-level and peak intermediate-level divine-level!
"The breakthroughs of the people on the World King Planet are all like this. There are even those who directly go from quasi-divine to super-divine. Don't mind it," Shi Yu said perfunctorily. "Aunt World Tree, is the teleportation array completed? Why don't I go to Goddess Wa's Ruins first?"
The World Tree clone was stunned. The people on the World King Planet were all like this when breaking through? Who were they kidding!
Did Shi Yu really think it didn't know anything? It had long supplemented the information on the World King Planet brought by Zi Lan!
Shi Yu's breakthrough progress was definitely abnormal. Definitely!
"Alright, alright. I know that the advance speed is a little unscientific, but our foundation is firm…" Shi Yu chuckled and said, "Unfortunately, we can only pursue a top-notch god at most now. It's still a little difficult to hunt perfect gods and super godly levels… But I feel that it won't be long."
"Give me another two years, I should be able to defeat the current super godly ancestors of the five divine races on Blue Planet…"
The World Tree clone's stomach hurt. It felt that the five super divines were in danger!

chapters.title: Chapter 1531 Goddess Wa's Ruins (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1531 Goddess Wa's Ruins (1)
"Forget it…"
The World Tree clone slowly calmed down, and the green worm's eyes recovered the calmness it should have.
In any case, it wasn't the first time Shi Yu had done something so ridiculous.
The World Tree clone understood what Shi Yu meant.
Wasn't Shi Yu trying to show that his fist was the strongest?
It would leave the good stuff to Shi Yu and the leftovers to the five super divines on Blue Planet who were about to come…
Otherwise, when he, Shi Yu, was powerful, he might not be able to eliminate the possibility of snatching things from the other party…
The corners of the green worm's mouth twitched, and then it nodded as if it had reached a consensus.
In the distance, on the World King Planet, the five super divines of Blue Planet vaguely felt a chill down their backs…
"Are we going to the Goddess Wa's Ruins now?" the World Tree clone said.
"Yes, I'll go now. I can't wait anymore. Haha." Shi Yu was eager to give it a try.
"Alright, I'll bring you over," the World Tree clone said.
Then, Shi Yu was led into the World Tree mystic realm by the World Tree clone again.
This time, apart from seeing the World Tree's main body and the tall and glorious huge tree, Shi Yu was also brought to a stone platform.
On the stone platform was a seven-colored divine stone.
"This divine stone is a ruin left behind by Goddess Wa. It's said that only specific bloodlines above the divine level can enter, which is humans," the World Tree said.
"Although it was left behind by Goddess Wa, I don't know the situation inside the ruins either. Are you sure you want to be the first to enter?"
"It's alright. Since it was left behind by Goddess Wa, there shouldn't be any danger. Then I'll go…" Shi Yu greeted the World Tree. After the World Tree nodded, Shi Yu touched the seven-colored divine stone in anticipation, as if he was touching ruins equipment.
In the next moment, Shi Yu, who was in the World Tree mystic realm, first entered the Goddess Wa's Ruins in the seven-colored divine stone with his mind. Then, his body also entered the Goddess Wa's Ruins!
In front of the World Tree, Shi Yu disappeared directly. The World Tree sensed it and realized that it couldn't sense Shi Yu. It looked at the seven-colored divine stone quietly and waited…
Goddess Wa…
This god had also left behind illustrious battle merits in the war of the Mythical Era. If it weren't for the fact that she repaired the laws of the world and repaired the damaged world, the World Tree was certain that Blue Planet would have long become a dead star.
Unfortunately, the super divine level cosmic behemoth was too fierce. Later on, it devoured Blue Planet to the point where it was broken. Goddess Wa was helpless and couldn't repair it.
However, Goddess Wa had already done enough. It was all thanks to her that Blue Planet could preserve a chance of survival. In the end, the top-notch Goddess Wa also left the Blue Planet with other gods.
Later on, Goddess Wa was the only god who successfully returned among the departing gods. Her clone brought back the method of creating humans and the Human Seed, indicating that humans were the hope of Blue Planet's rise.
Goddess Wa didn't say anything else, only leaving behind the instructions to nurture humans in Goddess Wa's Ruins. Her clone directly disappeared.
"Shi Yu, I hope you can explore more things from the Goddess Wa's Ruins."
In anticipation of the World Tree, in the Goddess Wa's Ruins, Shi Yu stood on the desolate ground and was already stunned.
He walked on the lifeless desolate land and fell into deep thought. This was the World Tree. Was this the other world Goddess Wa mentioned?
There was nothing!
Not to mention a transcendent life form, there weren't even any ordinary plants. It was a dead land.
"Shi Yu, this is… the era ruins." In the Beast Taming Space, Qi paid attention to the outside world through Shi Yu and said.
"I know. In short, let's fly around first." Shi Yu floated up, planning to observe more places first.
Soon, Shi Yu and the others confirmed that this was a spherical world that looked like a star. However, if they wanted to leave this star, they were isolated by space. This meant that the size of this place was what they saw.
After walking around, apart from desolate land, Shi Yu and the others could be said to have discovered nothing.
"Master, this ruins world has a surface area of about 510 million square kilometers and a diameter of about 12,742 kilometers. The other data are as follows…" Ling told Shi Yu the data that had been tested.
"Well…" As Shi Yu listened, he suddenly felt that something was wrong.
However, before Shi Yu could think too much, some changes finally happened in the ruins they had strolled around.
Boom.
In the east, the ground trembled. A temple-like building slowly rose.
"Let's go!"
After sensing it, Shi Yu and the others were overjoyed. Shi Yu quickly flew towards the temple.
Soon, Shi Yu arrived outside the temple and looked at the not-so-tall temple. Many marks were carved on it. After careful identification, he could tell that there was an image of a human body and a snake tail occupying the absolute protagonist position.
"Goddess Wa!" Through Shi Yu and seeing this scene, pets in Shi Yu's Beast Taming Space determined the other party's identity.
According to the descriptions of those revival gods and the World Tree, Goddess Wa also looked like a man with a snake tail.
"Left behind by Goddess Wa?" Shi Yu strolled straight into the temple. Just as he entered, Shi Yu grasped that there was only a table in the empty temple. The table was filled with three bottles and a map.
Before Shi Yu could approach the table to see what those were, dim musical instruments sounded in his ears… or rather, in his heart.
Accompanied by the sound of the musical instrument, Shi Yu seemed to have been dragged into another world. He perceived like he had heard the Voice of History.
"A distant era, a blue planet… My previous life and this life…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1532 Goddess Wa's Ruins (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1532 Goddess Wa's Ruins (2)
Accompanied by a voice filled with charm, Shi Yu seemed to have crossed space and time to see a god with a human body and a snake tail standing on the temple and looking at the four items he had left behind.
Although it was only a back view, it looked extremely beautiful.
"Later on, I know you have many questions. Next, I'll solve them for you one by one."
Goddess Wa had her back facing Shi Yu, and Shi Yu couldn't see her face clearly. He wanted to say something, but he couldn't say it. It was as if his entire body was frozen.
"Your arrival means that Blue Planet's will has fulfilled its promise to me to nurture the human race to strengthen."
"Listen to what I'm about to say."
"I was originally an ordinary snake demon on Blue Planet. I accidentally entered the ruins of the ancient era and obtained the inheritance of a god named Goddess Wa."
"After leaving Blue Planet, I kept exploring the ruins of the era and searching for traces of this Goddess Nuwa. I discovered a very interesting thing."
"Similar individuals will be born between different cosmic eras. Blue Planet, our mother planet, in the last cosmic era, was very likely a cosmic-level star that reflected the starry sky, and the life juggernaut above it was a human."
"And Goddess Wa also has an extremely close relationship with the humans on Blue Planet in the last era."
"The ruin you're in now is very likely a fragment of that star."
"Of course, I can't be sure of this yet, but I'm already exploring…"
"During the exploration process, I also discovered a very interesting era ruin. It should be related to Blue Planet from the last era, because it requires the power of at least five humans born from Blue Planet who have fused with the source of transcendence to open it. This is also the reason why I brought back the humans of the Starry Sky and handed it to Blue Planet's Will to nurture humans."
"In order to solve the mystery of the era ruin."
"Your appearance means that a divine-level human has already been born on Blue Planet, but this isn't enough. I left four things behind. One is a star map, recording the coordinates of that era ruin in the starry sky of the universe."
"There are also three divine items called 'Creation Soil'. They're the crystallization of my power. Hand them to the Blue Planet's Will and use this thing as a medium. It can revive three people from the long river of history about 2000 years ago. I hope that these three people can have the aptitude to fuse with the source of transcendence. They're the three most talented people in 2000 years."
"Bring five human experts to Blue Planet and increase some hope."
"As a parallel body suspected to be a cosmic-level star, the life form born on Blue Planet… Its true potential isn't weak. At the same time, it contains great luck, but it lacks opportunities. I'm very sure of this."
"When Blue Planet gathers five humans who have fused with the source of transcendence, I hope you can inherit my wish and unlock the secrets of Blue Planet's previous life and current life… For special reasons, I'll wait for you in the ruins of that era. When you come, we'll naturally meet."
"Goodbye, latecomer."
The scene shattered.
Shi Yu recovered his clarity.
Then, he was in a daze.
"Wait, wait!!!"
"Goddess Wa, give me a chance to communicate!!"
Shi Yu looked at the four things on the table and quickly walked forward.
"Master…" At this moment, Ling and the others also muttered. Clearly, they had also heard and seen the voice and scene just now.
"Earth is Blue Planet from the last era. It's definitely there," Shi Yu thought.
"Even Goddess Wa came out. It's ridiculous."
"An era ruin that can only be opened by five super divine level Blue Planet humans?" Shi Yu felt that the mystery of his transmigration might be solved here!
Because he had transmigrated from Earth to the Blue Planet.
The archeological discovery of the body of the last era from the super divine stone indeed meant that he came from the last era.
This time, there were finally more clues, but Shi Yu picked up the star map and expressed that he couldn't understand it at all.
"Master, the location displayed here isn't in the Cosmic Sea," Ling stated quickly. "But I can't be sure of the exact location. There are only relatively detailed records of the Cosmic Sea upon World King Planet."
"Perhaps… the cosmic overlord army has a more comprehensive understanding of the starry sky of the universe. We can ask Captain Zi Jian for the star maps of the other cosmic emperors."
"Alright, there's no hurry." Shi Yu turned to look at the three bottles of Creation Soil.
Then, he swallowed his saliva.
A planetary life form actually possessed the ability to revive the life form it had nurtured.
For example, at this moment, a native of Blue Planet had just died in front of the World Tree or had only died a few days ago. Blue Planet remained completely capable of spending a huge price to consume its origin power to revive him.
As long as the other party's death didn't exceed Blue Planet's understanding.
However, although it could be revived, it was only limited to lives that had recently died.
If it possessed died for too long, Blue Planet had no choice.
But from what Goddess Wa said, the soil she departed behind could allow Blue Planet to revive human experts from even further back?
The timeline remained extended to 2000 years?
"Then, can Emperor Wu, the Empress, the Dragon Emperor, and the three dead Dong Huang Emperors be revived?"
Shi Yu looked at the three bottles of Creation Soil and asked in his heart.
Shi Yu thought for a moment about the five super divine humans from Blue Planet. Apart from him, perhaps only the five emperors of Dong Huang, Lin Feng, and Divine Source Legendary possessed the highest chance of reaching the super divine.

chapters.title: Chapter 1533 Goddess Wa's Ruins (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1533 Goddess Wa's Ruins (3)
The seven of them basically represented the seven people with the strongest talent potential in Dong Huang.
Of course, if he looked at other countries, there might be many such people, but Shi Yu was mainly not familiar with the ancient legends of other countries.
However, in only 2000 years, there were only three sets of soil… Shi Yu recalled Mu Huiyin and the Yue Maiden and felt that it was a pity.
"The revival of the dead is the reason why many experts walk out of their mother planet but return to support their mother planet." Shi Yu shook his head.
Therefore, the relationship between the natives of the planet and the planet itself was extraordinary. For example, the gods of the Blue Planet's Mythical Era also relied on the help of the Blue Planet to sleep for hundreds of millions of years. If it were anywhere else and not their mother planet, they would have long slept to death.
This was also why gods who left Blue Planet but couldn't break through died so quickly.
Of course, there were also people who slept to death on their mother planet, such as the Earth Divine Dragon… But this was purely because of natural disasters.
The five super divines of Blue Planet hoped to develop Blue Planet, because, in terms of origin, they were also racial offspring born on Blue Planet. Although later on, after intermarriage, evolution, and traces of other places, the marks of Blue Planet were still deeply rooted.
If they came back to the Blue Planet and used this place as their home ground, they could also have the home ground advantage and attain the powerful blessings of the planet when fighting the extraterrestrial super divine.
For example, the Blue Sea Sprite, Susu, had two different treatments on Blue Planet and World King Planet.
Shi Yu stopped in the Goddess Wa Temple for a long time and fell into deep thought.
After an unknown period of time, Shi Yu looked at the seven-colored divine stone in his hand.
"Let's go back," Shi Yu said as he put away the map and the Creation Soil.
This way, he had basically completed his exploration of the Mythical Ruins on Blue Planet. However, he had a more important goal now.
The era ruins that Goddess Wa mentioned were suspected to be related to Earth.
Although Shi Yu felt that the world under his feet wasn't much different from the Earth in his impression…
But since this place was called a fragment of Earth by Goddess Wa, Earth might not be as simple as he knew.
On Earth, he was an archeologist and Mythical Scholar who studied myths. Perhaps his Earth at that time was also in some Cultivationless Age? Otherwise, how could he explain Goddess Wa and the Green Dragon?
Also, how should he explain that his previous life had reached the super divine level?
These were all things Shi Yu wanted to figure out very much.
…
As the World Tree waited, Shi Yu's figure slowly appeared.
"Shi Yu!" After identifying that Shi Yu had come out, the World Tree was extremely happy. "What's going on inside?"
Shi Yu said, "Nothing."
"I went in and took a look around. I came out without discovering anything."
World Tree: ???
"I was just kidding. I gained something." Shi Yu saw that the World Tree was stunned and smiled.
"…" The World Tree felt stifled.
Shi Yu has changed. He's no longer the kid who respected me after the world competition.
Shi Yu's wings have hardened.
He has already joked with me multiple times.
"Next, tell me if you find anything." At this moment, before the World Tree could say anything, a blue figure slowly appeared.
She had light blue hair and eyes, and was wearing simple clothes that looked like white pajamas. Her expression was calm, and her aura was as clear and ethereal as ice and snow. A faint halo spread from her body. Although she was in human form, she didn't look like a human, but like another being that had materialized into a human.
Her appearance surprised the World Tree slightly. Shi Yu was also stunned as he glanced at her in surprise.
"Mother," the World Tree said.
"Blue Planet's Will," Shi Yu said.
This… was the first time he had seen the Blue Planet's Will appear!
The World Tree was known as the embodiment of Blue Planet's Will, but those who knew the inside story knew that the World Tree was only created by Blue Planet's Will. During its restoration and sleep, it supervised Blue Planet's clone creation.
The connection between the two was like a mother and daughter.
Blue Planet's Will was a powerful planetary life form that could fight a super divine. The mother god of all life on Blue Planet wasn't something the World Tree could represent.
At this moment, the Mythical Revival and Blue Planet's Will itself finally slowly woke up.
Shi Yu glanced at the Blue Planet's Will and sensed her power. It was completely incomparable to the World Tree. This was a true master of the planet,
"Thank you for Blue Planet, Shi Yu."
"The World Tree is me, but I'm not the World Tree. I already know everything about your experience after I woke up," Blue Planet said. "Did you discover anything in the Goddess Wa's Ruins?"
"Well… Mother Blue Planet, I really made a big discovery!" Shi Yu said with a smile.
World Tree: ???
Why did my seniority decrease again?
You and Baby Ginseng used to call me Mother, so shouldn't you address my mother as Grandma Blue Planet?
"Senior Goddess Wa left a message in the ruins."
"According to her archeological discoveries in the universe, Blue Planet might have been a cosmic star in the last era, similar to the World King Planet, or even stronger than the World King Planet."
"I wonder if this is considered reincarnation… or the same individual from different eras."
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Blue Planet's expression was still calm, but the World Tree was very shocked. "What?"
"Blue Planet from the last era… I'll call it Earth for short. On Earth, humans are the juggernauts. Humans also seem to be a powerful Juggernaut Race from the last era. This is also the cause why Senior Goddess Wa found humans from the starry sky and handed them to the Blue Planet to nurture. Perhaps she hopes that Blue Planet can return to its peak with the power of humans."

chapters.title: Chapter 1534 Goddess Wa's Ruins (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1534 Goddess Wa's Ruins (4)
"Apart from that, there's another reason. Goddess Wa discovered an era ruin related to Earth in the universe. This era ruin requires five super divine level humans born on a specific star, Blue Planet, to open it."
"This is also why Senior Goddess Wa hopes that the World Tree will nurture humans."
"She hopes that when the five super divine level humans are born, they can solve the mystery of Earth and Blue Planet, and she seems to be waiting for us in the era ruin."
The World Tree didn't care that its seniority was lowered again. It still said in surprise, "Goddess Wa… is indeed still alive."
"I see…"
"At that time, she was even more mysterious than the Ancestral Dragon, the Origin Phoenix, and the other gods. From the looks of it, she's the same as you. She has come into contact with the era ruin," Blue Planet said. "As for Earth… Since it's a wish she left behind, I'll help her complete it."
Without Goddess Wa's repair rules back then, there wouldn't be the current Blue Planet. Therefore, after Blue Planet learned Goddess Wa's intention, it decided to cooperate fully.
Now that she had finally recovered, Goddess Wa meant to let Blue Planet nurture five super divine humans…
Blue Planet looked at Shi Yu. There was one… In addition to the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and Emperor Shi, who were trapped in the ruins of the era, there was still one left.
"Five super divine humans…" The World Tree muttered in its heart. It looked like the resources of the five divine races on Blue Planet were completely gone.
The assets of Blue Planet definitely had to nurture humans.
As expected, the five super divines of Blue Planet… were in danger!
"By the way, Senior Goddess Wa left the coordinates of the ruins. Apart from that, there are additionally these things." Shi Yu took out the Creation Soil.
"This is the Creation Soil. There are actually remnants." When the World Tree saw these soils, it immediately recognized them and said, "Back then, Goddess Wa and I used the Human Seeds of the starry sky to create the Blue Planet's humans, and we used these things."
"Could it be that Goddess Wa means…"
"Goddess Wa wants us to use these three soils as a medium to revive the three most talented humans on Blue Planet in the past 2000 years. This way, the probability of five human beings who are super divines in the same frame are able to be higher."
"I see…" The World Tree said, "Reviving the dead requires a lot of power, but if you use the Creation Soil, you can revive them relatively easily. After all, the essence of the Blue Planet's Human Race is created from the combination of the Creation Soil and the power of Blue Planet."
"2000 years? Shi Yu, do you have any suitable candidates?" Blue Planet gazed at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu said, "If I choose, it will definitely be Dong Huang's second Legendary Emperor, Emperor Wu Dong, Dong Huang's third emperor, Empress Huang Xi, and the fourth emperor, Dragon Emperor Long Qingyun."
"Emperor Shi has already stepped into the super divine level, and Senior Space Emperor additionally has the battle record of hunting super divines. The legends of our Dong Huang lineage all have super divine aptitude!"
"It's just that due to the restrictions of the Cultivationless Age, they can't display all their aptitude."
"Alright." Blue Planet nodded and said, "Then revive these three."
"I'll leave the ruins star map in your care. After these three revive, you'll additionally lead them to integrate into the current Blue Planet."
"Sure." Shi Yu nodded and handed the three sets of Creation Soil to Blue Planet.
Then, three sets of Creation Soil floated in front of Blue Planet.
Blue Planet closed its eyes slightly. First, its consciousness descended on Dong Huang and searched for the relics of the three ancient legends. Then, along with these like a guide, it searched for the traces of Emperor Wu Wu Dong, Empress Huang Xi, and Dragon Emperor Long Qingyun whom Shi Yu had mentioned in the long river of history.
Blue Planet's perspective crossed countless spaces and time at once. Soon, it saw traces of history on an isolated island and saw a male Beast Tamer covered in blood. He was wearing a dragon robe and had a determined expression. He controlled nine divine dragons to fight the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon!!
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1535 Legendary Emperor Revival (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1535 Legendary Emperor Revival (1)
This was the Dragon Emperor!
It was the Dragon Emperor who had fallen and sealed the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon in a pearl at the cost of his life.
"In the Cultivationless Age, the Dragon Emperor sealed the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon with a Level 9 body. The Dragon Emperor is extraordinary."
Blue Planet gave the Dragon Emperor a high evaluation. It used the power of the Creation Soil to collect the traces of the Dragon Emperor's existence and pour them into the soil.
Then, it was the era of the Empress. On Phoenix Island, Blue Planet saw a female Beast Tamer. Her skin was smooth, her eyes were like stars, and her white clothes fluttered. Her white and gray dress was embroidered with phoenixes and flowers, and every move she made emitted a unique aura as a hybrid legend.
She controlled nine phoenixes to fight a Vermillion Bird faith divine in a deeper ruins space.
Under the suppression of the Empress, the Vermillion Bird Phoenix retreated step by step, but at the most critical moment, the ruins collapsed, and the spatial crack swept both parties in.
Blue Planet's consciousness entered the spatial crack and realized that both parties had already perished under the devourment of the spatial flux. It couldn't help but feel a sense of pity.
"This woman is a hybrid. She perfectly combined the strength of a human and the strength of the Phoenix Race. She's also extremely extraordinary."
Blue Planet also captured the traces of the Empress's existence and fused them into the Creation Soil.
In the end, Blue Planet's consciousness traced back to the era of Emperor Wu and saw the Fusion Emperor fighting the demigods of the Yun Race, suppressing the other party until it retreated step by step. However, because it couldn't remove the Yun Race radiation, it could only choose to perish together.
"Emperor Wu defeated the Space Race head-on, but unfortunately, it couldn't deal with the other party's radiation. Live another lifetime. I hope you can break through the limit in the new era and become a super divine."
As soon as Blue Planet finished speaking, it threw out three pieces of Creation Soil. Under the white light, the soils slowly formed three human forms, turning into the final appearances of Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor before they died.
The burly Emperor Wu was wearing broken armor, and the Yun Race radiation on his body was cleansed.
The white-robed Empress's aura was still transcendent. The eyes on her exquisite face swayed slightly.
The Dragon Emperor in a dragon robe emitted a dignified aura. The three of them floated in the air for a moment and slowly landed.
Not only their appearance, but the clothes on their bodies were also perfectly replicated. Apart from that, in the Beast Taming Space, the pets that had contracted with them actually began to be reborn. Apart from Zhong Xuan, who had already left with Emperor Wu, they directly recovered their full strength under the power of the Creation Soil and Blue Planet and returned to their peak state!
A moment later.
Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor opened their eyes at the same time.
"I'm…" Sensing such a perfect state, Emperor Wu was in disbelief. Didn't he already perish with Yun An? Not only did he seem to have revived, but even the radiation injury and the wish curse had already disappeared!
"I'm not dead?" The Empress was also confused. She clearly remembered that she accidentally entered a spatial crack and was devoured to death by the spatial flux.
"I… clearly died to seal the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon…" The Dragon Emperor, Long Qingyun, was similarly shocked.
They raised their heads in unison and looked at Blue Planet's Will, Shi Yu, and the World Tree behind them.
The tall and glorious World Tree emitted shocking divine power, making the three emperors feel extremely strong pressure.
They couldn't see through the mysterious and holy Blue Planet's Will at all. An irresistible emotion appeared in their hearts as if they were facing a high and mighty god.
They were slightly stunned when they observed Shi Yu smiling at them.
Apart from the memories they already had, they had another headache in the next moment. A wave of memories that didn't belong to them also began to appear.
Emperor Wu Dong observed himself fighting a young man. With the other party's help, both parties worked together to destroy Yun An… This was clearly not his experience.
Empress Huang Xi saw a young man appear at her residence. She mistakenly thought that the other party was here to propose marriage. Then, both parties happily molded the [Mother Hunter Group], but this wasn't her experience.
Dragon Emperor Long Qingyun even observed a young man shatter the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon in front of him. However, wasn't the Ancestral Dragon sealed by him? Why was it killed by others in Dragon Palace City…
The chaotic memories made the three ancients fall into deep thought. However, they recognized the person in front of them.
"It's you," Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor looked at Shi Yu with different complicated emotions and said.
World Tree: ???
Why did these people who died thousands of years ago know Shi Yu??
"Hm?"
Not to mention the World Tree, even Shi Yu himself was stunned. Wait a minute, was something wrong?
Only the Blue Planet's Will observed the abnormality of the three legends. It stared at Shi Yu.
"Space-time entanglement…" Blue Planet's Will observed Shi Yu seriously and said, "That little guy is with you, right?"
"This might be a side effect of you playing with time wantonly."
"Sigh…" Blue Planet sighed. It didn't expect the Time Sprite to actually be with Shi Yu. Moreover, from the looks of it, it had already transmigrated through space and time.
This wasn't good… When the sprite encountered an archeologist, Blue Planet had already imagined how chaotic the universe would be.
In Shi Yu's Beast Taming Space, Qi observed Blue Planet's Will eagerly and chuckled.
Mother Blue Planet was still impressive enough to directly discover Qi!
As for the World Tree, it was created by the Blue Planet's Will at the end of the Mythical Era. Qi didn't know it, but Qi comprehended Blue Planet.
"…" At this moment, Shi Yu also comprehended that Qi had been exposed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1536 - 1536: Revival of the Legendary Emperor (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1536: Revival of the Legendary Emperor (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
At that moment, as they were revived, Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the various pets in the Dragon Emperor’s Beast Taming Space were also extremely shocked. They still didn’t understand what had happened and why they had revived from death.
“Seniors, calm down.” At this moment, Shi Yu, who had also realized what was going on, hurriedly smiled and said, “Everyone, calm down first.”
“l know that things like revival from the dead are very strange. Why don’t you guys calm down first and listen to what’s going on?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor nodded. They could also sense that the aura of the blue-haired figure beside them was very terrifying. It was probably above the divine level.
Presumably, their revival was the masterpiece of these people.
Emperor Wu looked at Shi Yu with a complicated expression. The interweaving of the two memories reminded him of this “transmigrator” who fought alongside him.
The Empress also looked at Shi Yu with a complicated expression. She recalled that this Mother Hunter who had contracted her “sister” was a supporter who had helped her establish the Dong Huang Empire.
When the Dragon Emperor saw Shi Yu, this “senior” who had “helped him kill the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon”, he was also silent. They all knew that the memory didn’t come from their own experience, but they felt that this memory was extremely real.
It was as if he had really experienced it in different spaces.
Memory of a parallel space?
“Now, about 2500 years after Emperor Shi established the Dong Huang
Dynasty, Blue Planet has already revived. The shackles of the divine level have already disappeared,” Shi Yu said. “The tree in front of me is the embodiment of Blue Planet’s Will, the World Tree.’
“The great existence in front of me is the main body of the Blue Planet’s Will.”
“It’s the Blue Planet’s Will that revived everyone from the long river of history. Seniors… And I’m a Beast Tamer from the modern Dong Huang. In terms of seniority, 1 1 m still your junior.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “If any messy memories appear, don’t take it seriously.
Just forget it. That might be the aftermath of me transmigrating into a parallel space and changing history… It’s not something you experienced.”
“Cough, cough… But if 1 offended you in parallel space, please forgive me.”
“It’s alright if you don’t forgive me. In any case, you can’t defeat me now.” Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor: ???
“As expected, you’re a person from the future,” Empress Huang Xi said. Although the memory didn’t belong to her, she felt as if she had experienced it personally. She had long had many guesses about Shi Yu’s identity. From the looks of it, one of her guesses was indeed correct.
“Transmigrated into space and time… No wonder he knew my secret and came to help me solve the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon in advance…” the Dragon Emperor said.
“Seniors, the reason why I revived you is actually because 1 have a favor to ask of you,” Shi Yu said.
“Forget it, it’s useless to tell you now. Why don’t everyone follow me back to Dong Huang first? The current Dong Huang might have people or things you’re familiar with there.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the three emperors were silent. They still found it unbelievable that they had revived after crossing a thousand years.
A moment later, they bowed to the Blue Planet’s Will in unison and said, “Thank you for reviving us, Senior. If you need anything, we’ll definitely do our best.’
Blue Planet nodded and said, “Just follow Shi Yu back. He will explain to you. It’s also his request for me to revive you.”
“Then, Shi Yu, I’ll leave them to you. When the teleportation array on the other side of World King Planet is built, I’ll inform you immediately.”
“Alright-ol’ Shi Yu said. No problem.
Haha, when the Space Emperor and Lin Feng teleported over, and even when Senior Dragon God teleported back, would she be stunned to see Emperor Wu, Empress, and the Space Emperor revive?
If he waited for Emperor Shi to come out too…
The five emperors could be in the same frame.
Sigh… However, wouldn’t Old Master Divine Source’s balls hurt if five legendary emperors were alive at the same time in a country?
With a group of ancestors crawling out, the pressure on him to govern the country should be huge.
Shi Yu, Emperor Wu, Empress, and Dragon Emperor were directly teleported to Inatella by the World Tree. “In that case, you’re Senior Emperor Wu?”
“You’re Senior Empress?”
For a moment, the three legendary emperors of Dong Huang were a little reserved.
They had never thought of the situation in front of them.
Apart from the communication here, they also kept communicating with the pets in the Beast Taming Space.
Emperor Wu’s pets sensed that the radiation injuries on their bodies had disappeared and their conditions were excellent.
“Wu Dong, Wu Dong, that guy Zhong Xuan isn’t around!! At that time, it was the only one who didn’t die in battle and was sent away by us. Is it still alive? Please tell me that we lived, but it died!”
“l know, it’s still alive, but I can sense that it’s still in reincarnation,” Emperor Wu said. “Give me time. I can find it.’
Apart from the three legendary emperors, a bunch of pets in Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space were also extremely excited.
Eleven howled. Emperor Wu had revived, and someone was playing the Iron-eating Beast ranking with it.
Chi Tong was also very happy. Its sister was alive. It could drag its sister to watch dramas again.
Sensing the joy of his pets, Shi Yu also smiled and said,
“Seniors.”
“Seniors, please take this.”
Shi Yu explained, “This is world history information from the establishment of the Dong Huang Dynasty to the establishment of the Seven Nation Alliance.
It’s all recorded in this memory water drop. After you receive it, you should know the current situation.’
“In addition, I recommend everyone to go to different places first. Senior
Emperor Wu, you can return to Wu Ling City. Senior Ji Mengzhu is over there. If you have any questions, you can ask her..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1537 - 1537: Revival of the Legendary Emperor (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1537: Revival of the Legendary Emperor (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Senior Dragon Emperor, you can return to Dragon Palace City. Some of the old Dragon Kings following you are still alive. If you have any questions, you can ask them. As for Senior Dragon God, she’s not on Blue Planet now, but she should be back soon.’
“As for Senior Empress, your mother is still locked up. You don’t seem to have any other relatives… Why don’t you come back with me to walk around? I might be your only relative. After all, your sister’s bloodline is now my guardian spirit.”
“Why haven’t you told us anything yet?” Empress Huang Xi looked at Shi Yu and said, “Alright, I’ll go back with you, but you have to tell me your goal in reviving me.”
“This… 1 didn’t tell the seniors because I was afraid that you would feel pressured. How about this? I’ll tell you after you reach the divine level. Your most important thing now is to adapt to the current Blue Planet and break through to the divine level. How about that?”
“It shouldn’t be difficult for you, right?” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “By the way, please don’t make a fuss about the parallel space. That might bring disaster to Blue Planet.’
The three legends wanted to hit the kid in front of them. What was there to keep them in suspense?
As legends of Dong Huang, they were very unhappy to be underestimated by their junior, although in their impression, Shi Yu was indeed very strong…
“Brother Dragon, we actually revived…”
“l didn’t expect so many things to happen after we died.”
“Sister Tian cultivated the Space Emperor, the evolution legend Lin Feng, and the Mechanical Legendary Divine Source… In short, it’s too unbelievable.”
“However, none of them are as unbelievable as this Shi Yu. He can actually ask the Blue Planet’s Will to revive us, revive Emperor Wu and Senior Empress, and… transmigrate space and time!”
At this moment, the Dragon Emperor was rushing to Dragon Palace City on a sea dragon. In his Beast Taming Space, the divine dragons were still in shock.
“Yeah, is this the power of a god? We have to break through to the divine level quickly in the future.” Long Qingyun took a deep breath and said, “Shi Yu said that we should return to Dragon Palace City to take a look first.”
“The dragons have a long lifespan. The Thunder Dragon King and the others should still be alive. After seeing someone we know, we’ll look for Shi Yu…”
“We should have some special mission to be revived. Since we were revived by Blue Planet, we should accept this favor. As long as we don’t violate our principles, my life belongs to Blue Planet… It’s just that… I don’t know where Ah Tian is now.”
The Dragon Emperor’s expression was in a daze. His greatest obsession now was to see the Dragon God. When he thought of how the Dragon God had protected Dong Huang for thousands of years for it, it felt that it had let the other party down.
“She actually left Blue Planet. Could it be that the current Dragon God of Dragon Palace City is already someone else? Otherwise, she wouldn’t have left Dragon Palace so easily.”
Soon, Long Qingyun went deep into the sea and found the Dragon Palace mystic realm. Before he could enter, with a cry, a totem-level little white dragon flew out happily from the Dragon Palace mystic realm.
The guards of Dragon Palace City didn’t discover Long Qingyun, who was approaching on a sea dragon, but the little white dragon immediately discovered them.
“Huh?? Who are you?” The little white dragon came over impressively. It looked at the top-notch totem sea dragon and the dragon-robed young man riding it and frowned.
Why did he look so familiar?
In Dragon Palace City, there were portraits of the Dragon Emperor in some places, but the little white dragon seemed to have a bad memory.
“You are…” Long Qingyun said, “Dragon King, may 1 ask if the Thunder Dragon King, the Space Dragon King, and the others are in the Dragon Palace? Where’s Prime Minister Turtle?”
“I’m not the Dragon King! I’m the number one general under the Dragon God, Buggy, the little white dragon of the Third Prince of Dragon Palace City!” The little white dragon said, “I’m much stronger than the Dragon King.”
Dragon Emperor: “?”
Dragon God… Buggy?
“But from the looks of it, you’re not weak. You don’t look like you’re lying. Are you really looking for the Space Dragon King and the Thunder Dragon King? Alright, I’ll bring you over,” the little white dragon said. “Also, you look pretty unfamiliar. Are you a foreigner? Do you want to be my little brother?”
Dragon Emperor:
What was wrong with the current Dragon Palace City?
Wu Ling City.
Emperor Wu, who was wearing broken armor, appeared outside the Wu Ling Ruins and looked at the familiar and unfamiliar environment with a disappointed expression.
Was his hometown already so prosperous?
Tall buildings stood in the sky. On the street, cars came and went. In the sky, aircraft flowed continuously.
All kinds of technology blinded Emperor Wu.
Among every pedestrian, they seemed to be dressed very well, and their expressions seemed to be very happy. The future was… not bad!
Emperor Wu sighed and felt that he didn’t sacrifice himself for Dong Huang for nothing… If he hadn’t dealt with Yun An, Dong Huang might face something even more terrifying than decomposition in the future. “Look, Emperor Wu cosplay! They really look alike!”
“Alike my ass. It’s not done properly at all. It doesn’t have the charm of Emperor Wu.
When Emperor Wu stood outside the Wu Ling Ruins, a group of tourists held cell phones and secretly took photos of Emperor Wu, making Emperor Wu fall silent.
“Let’s… find Zhong Xuan first.”
Emperor Wu could naturally easily enter and exit the Emperor Wu Ruins established by Ji Mengzhu, Zhong Xuan, and the others. His authority was very high, and he easily entered the Emperor Wu Ruins.
Then, he stepped into the deep space and searched for the traces of Zhong Xuan in reincarnation according to the contract connection.
In the deep space, on the ground, earth-brown light slowly condensed. An earth-brown patterned turtle egg appeared and slowly cracked. Among them, an earth-element turtle the size of a palm opened its eyes in confusion..

chapters.title: Chapter 1538 - 1538: Revival of the Legendary Emperor (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1538: Revival of the Legendary Emperor (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Wu…” It said in a daze, “Strange, why did I complete my reincarnation so quickly? The energy concentration is so high. Eh, why do I have memories when I was born? Holy sh*t, why is the broken contract shining?”
“Zhong Xuan!” Emperor Wu stood in front of Zhong Xuan and said. Zhong Xuan suddenly raised its head and looked at Emperor Wu.
“Holy sh*t, I’m still dreaming!!” Zhong Xuan said in shock. “Wu Dong should be dead. Could it be that I can still dream in my reincarnation??”
“Zhong Xuan, I’m Wu Dong. I’ve revived.” Emperor Wu sighed slightly and looked at Zhong Xuan. In the next moment, Emperor Wu r s pets walked out of the Beast Taming Space and looked at Zhong Xuan, who had turned into a baby turtle.
“You…” Emperor Wu r s snake pet looked at the small Zhong Xuan and shook its head. How could they fuse?
“Huh??” Zhong Xuan felt that this scene was more and more unreal, but soon, it was stunned. As Wu Dong summoned the contract halo and contracted it again, an incomparably real feeling stunned Zhong Xuan.
Then, its eyes were filled with tears! “Wu Dong… How are you guys alive! ! ”
“What exactly happened?”
“Where’s Yun An? How’s Yun An?”
“Aren’t you all dead? But I clearly feel that everyone has already…”
“Calm down, old turtle.” Emperor Wu r s pets looked at Zhong Xuan speechlessly. Why was this old kid even less calm than them after reviving?
“Roar! ! ! ” Emperor Wu r s Iron-eating Beast looked at the newborn Zhong Xuan happily, planning to train Zhong Xuan to help it return to the peak in the future.
Just as Zhong Xuan was incoherent, a figure suddenly appeared in the deep space,
After Ji Mengzhu sensed the change in the ruins space, she immediately came over. When Ji Mengzhu saw Emperor Wu in this space and the pets beside him, she directly revealed an incredulous expression.
Her voice trembled. “This… How is this possible…”
“Ji Mengzhu???” Zhong Xuan was even more shocked. Why was Ji Mengzhu also here? Wait, Ji Mengzhu’s condition seemed to be a little strange??
“Uncle… Wu Done?” fi Mengzhu looked at Emperor Wu and the pets beside him
in disbelief, not understanding what had happened.
“Mengzhu…” Wu Dong also looked at Ji Mengzhu. As Shi Yu had said, Mengzhu was also here.
“Ahhh, can someone tell me what exactly happened?” Zhong Xuan was about to go crazy.
“It’s Shi Yu. He asked the Blue Planet’s Will to revive us,” Emperor Wu said, explaining to Zhong Xuan and Ji Mengzhu.
“He also asked me to come here. Finally… I see you.”
“Shi Yu?? That brat with the Iron-eating Beast?? Blue Planet’s Will?? What’s going on, what’s going on? I don’t understand.” Zhong Xuan was stunned. Why was it still related to Shi Yu?
Zhong Xuan knew Shi Yu. It was the one who told Shi Yu the secret of Emperor Wu Dynasty. It was also the one who gave Shi Yu the evolution materials of the Iron-eating Beast!
“Shi Yu??” Although Ji Mengzhu was also shocked, she quickly recovered her calm state. She looked at Senior Chong Xuan in the form of a baby and said, “Senior Chong Xuan, Shi Yu is already extraordinary now.”
“He’s already the strongest Beast Tamer on Blue Planet. He once suppressed Yun An at Level 8 with one person and one pet. The current Yun An has already been captured alive. It’s a renewable resource for Dong Huang.”
“Every Iron-eating Beast in our Iron-eating Beast Corps can enjoy the evolution of the meteorite fragment in the future…”
“A month ago, in the starry sky, at Level 9, he even killed an Abyss God from the Mythical Era who had slaughtered several gods two levels higher. He’s already the fully deserving strongest expert on Blue Planet and is no longer the brat in your impression…”
“If it were him, he might really be able to ask the Blue Planet’s Will to revive Uncle Wu Dong…”
“Impossible, right? How is this possible?” Zhong Xuan opened its mouth wide with an incredulous expression. What? It clearly felt that it had only reincarnated not long ago. More than five years? Shi Yu? The strongest on Blue Planet? It really couldn’t imagine that the kid who praised the Iron-eating Beast and cursed the turtle on the arena back then could grow to the level Ji Mengzhu mentioned in such a short period of time..

chapters.title: Chapter 1539 - 1539: Beast Shi Yu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1539: Beast Shi Yu (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Dong Huang, Imperial Capital, Beast Tamer Association headquarters.
The headquarters of the Beast Tamer Association was in the capital, but the Beast Tamer Association in the capital wasn’t the headquarters.
Shi Yu invited Empress Huang Xi to the political center to meet the current divine-level mechanic of Dong Huang, Divine Source, and the president of the Dong Huang Association, Lin Xiao, the two current rulers of Dong Huang.
At that moment, the daily life of the old president was to study the cosmic technology Ling had brought back from the World King Planet and upgrade himself. Now that he was using the World King Planet technology, he had already returned to a humanoid body. Although he was a mechanical modified person and cyborg, fortunately, he retained the ability to contract.
As for President Lin Xiao’s daily routine… To be honest, President Lin Xiao wanted to abdicate and hand the position of president to others, such as Lu Qingyi. Then, he would work hard to cultivate and strive to become a god as soon as possible, but he couldn’t help it. He felt that no one who had the ability to inherit the position of president took a fancy to the position of president.
The new legendary Lu Qingyi would rather give up the archeologist class and be an international criminal police officer of the alliance to kill people all over the world than be President Dong Huang.
In a world with extraordinary power, it was just that ridiculous. Compared to pursuing power, more people were still willing to pursue the power of their own strength.
Therefore, after President Lin Xiao broke through to the Legendary level, he still had to deal with busy national affairs, and he was even busier than before.
“Senior Divine Source, President Lin, I’m back again. See you in our Wind Forest Garden Q’ After Shi Yu finished speaking, he sat d0ievn with the Empress in a garden in the headquarters and drank tea quietly, waiting for Senior Divine Source and President Lin to arrive.
Now that Shi Yu was at the divine level, it was easy for his psychic domain to perform mental voice transmission to Divine Source and President Lin.
After hearing Shi Yu’s voice transmission, Divine Source and Lin Xiao were stunned. Then, they headed to Wind Flower Garden together and saw Shi Yu sitting in the garden drinking tea with the Empress.
“Shi Yu, Chi Tong, you’re back,” they subconsciously said when they saw Shi Yu and the Empress.
At this moment, the Empress also turned around and observed this future Mechanical Legendary… He should be the Mechanical God now, as well as the descendant of the future evolution legends. the current ruler of Dong Huan, Lin Xiao.
During the process of coming over, Shi Yu had already introduced them to Empress Huang Xi.
“President Divine Source, President Lin Xiao, I’ve already seen Dong Huangs current scene. You guys… did better than me.”
Divine Source and Lin Xiao: “?”
“Huh? Shi Yu, what’s wrong with Chi Tong?” President Lin Xiao was stunned. Why did he feel that Chi Tong was strange today? Chi Tong wasn’t like this in the past. It was in character again?
Why was it getting more and more ridiculous?
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Senior Divine Source, President Lin, she’s not Chi
Tong.”
“Look carefully again?”
“This… is Empress Huang Xi, the third Legendary Beast Tamer of the Dong Huang Dynasty!
“Not long ago… 1 just revived.”
Divine Source and Lin Xiao: “?”
“What?” When Shi Yu finished speaking, Divine Source and Lin Xiao suddenly widened their eyes. Even when the Abyss Worm appeared and wreaked havoc on Blue Planet, they had never been so shocked.
Empress Huang Xi looked at them calmly and nodded. If they didn’t differentiate carefully, she was indeed more similar to Chi Tong…
“This, this, this, this…” The two of them were a little stunned and confused.
Shi Yu said, “For some special reason, the Blue Planet’s Will revived Emperor Wu, the Empress, and Senior Dragon Emperor… Now, Senior Emperor Wu has gone to Wu Ling City, Senior Dragon Emperor has gone to Dragon Palace City, and Senior Empress asked me to bring him over.”
“What, Emperor Wu and the Dragon Emperor revived too??” Divine Source and Lin Xiao were even more shocked and a little stunned.
Wait a minute, if Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor were all here, Emperor Shi was still alive, and the Space Emperor was still alive, then the five emperors of the ancient Dong Huang Dynasty… existed in this world at the same time??
Divine Source’s brain suddenly went blank, and President Lin Xiao’s reaction was also a little slow. This news was really too explosive, not inferior to knowing that Emperor Shi was still alive and had broken through to super divine.
“The two of you don’t have to worry about me. I won’t interfere in the current
Dong Huang matter. Just treat me as an ordinary Dong Huang Beast Tamer.”
The Empress sighed slightly. She also knew that the current situation was a little complicated.
For her, it was already very good to be able to revive. Huang Xi’s current idea was to break through to the divine level as soon as possible and achieve what she couldn’t achieve before in this magnificent Mythical Revival era.
“Yes, yes, calm down. Isn’t it just the revival of three ancient emperors?” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Divine Source and President Lin’s eyelids twitched. What did he mean… Wasn’t it just the revival of three ancient emperors? This was a f*cking huge matter.
“In short, I want Senior Empress and the others to familiarize themselves with the modern era first…” Shi Yu said, “Now that they’ve just returned, they should have a lot of questions.”
“Little Lin, bring Senior Empress to familiarize herself with the modern Dong Huang. No, I’ll be the guide myself,” Divine Source said.
“There’s no need.” Huang Xi smiled and said, “The two of you are busy governing the country. I’ll get Shi Yu to bring me around.”
Shi Yu:
“I’m also very busy, alright? I’m busier than the two of them, but it’s alright. I can get your Sister Chi Tong to bring you there.”
The Empress was speechless.
Although Shi Yu knew that this Empress wasn’t the one from a parallel space, due to some messy spatial entanglement phenomenon, the other party also had the memories of a parallel space, so it was convenient to communicate.
“This…” Divine Source and President Lin Xiao were speechless. Why was Shi Yu talking to the Empress like this!
“President Lin, remember to prepare a place for the three seniors to stay. This is the most important thing now. It’s best to have a mechanic assistant..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1540 - 1540: Beast Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1540: Beast Shi Yu (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“By the way, I’ve already taken first place in the God Sealing Battle on the World King Planet and completed the champion challenge. It shouldn’t be long before the teleportation between Blue Planet and the World King Planet is connected. The Space Emperor and Senior Lin Feng will also return. You also need to prepare in advance.”
“What?!” Divine Source and Lin Xiao were shocked again.
“You really killed your way through the God Sealing Battle?” President Lin Xiao said. He had also clearly learned the difficulty of the God Sealing Battle from Zi Lan.
“Why are you guys as surprised as the World Tree…” Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s just the Baby Cup, basic f*ck! I feel that fighting Gao Xuan at that time was even harder than fighting the God Sealing Battle.”
Divine Source said, “I’ll thank you on behalf of Gao Xuan. This might be the height of his life.”
“However, I knew Shi Yu could do it. Hahahaha.” Divine Source laughed. He was better than Lin Feng!
The Empress was puzzled. God Sealing Battle, Gao Xuan… She memorized it silently.
A moment later, after Shi Yu told President Divine Source and President Lin Xiao important things, he left with the Empress. After leaving the headquarters, Huang Xi asked Shi Yu,
“Shi… Yu, what’s the God Sealing Battle you’re talking about?”
“Uh, Senior Huang Xi, do you still have the memories of me sending the Teleportation Key Stones in parallel space?”
Huang Xi nodded and said, “The treasure I’m competing with the Phoenix Vermillion Bird is that Teleportation Key Stone. After you handed it to me in a parallel space, you said that it’s a teleportation equipment that connects a cosmic civilization and a super planet, but it requires cosmic crystals to open it. ”
“That’s easy to explain. The end point of that keystone’s teleportation is World King Planet. A cosmic star is two levels stronger than Blue Planet.”
