“As for the God Sealing Battle, it’s a super competition for the various races in the starry sky on the World King Planet. The contestants are demigods of the various races in the starry sky. It’s the largest competition in the universe. Those at the top can obtain a lot of resources.”
“The best is a World King Planet teleportation array that doesn’t need consumption and can be used by many people. With this, Blue Planet can obtain very good development. We can all easily head to World King Planet.”
“Not long ago, I successfully shattered the geniuses of the various races in the starry sky and obtained first place. I just brought back the teleportation array a while ago. Oh, now, Senior Space Emperor and Senior Lin Feng are on the World King Planet. They should be back in a few days.”
After a moment of silence, Huang Xi said, “The… largest competition in the universe? How many demigods are participating in the God Sealing Battle you’re talking about?”
“There are only about 10 million demigods every year. It’s mainly because there are no benefits for too weak demigods to participate, so there aren’t many demigods participating every time,” Shi Yu said.
The Empress was even more silent. 10 million demigods… wasn’t considered many?
“How high do you think the Vermillion Bird demigod of Phoenix Island can rank in the God Sealing Battle…” The Empress asked again.
Shi Yu thought for a moment and said, “At the bottom? Even if it’s not at the bottom, it probably won’t be able to last two rounds. The demigods on the World King Planet are ridiculously strong. For example, we encountered a crow named Zavay who has mastered 15 quasi-divine skills. For example, Time Reversal, Time Acceleration, Time Slow, and Time Stop… If it didn’t encounter me, it could destroy Blue Planet alone before Blue Planet’s revival.”
“Hehe, but Senior Empress, you don’t have to be sad. When you come into contact with the cultivation system of the World King Planet, your cultivation resources will definitely be able to quickly follow in the footsteps of the myriad races in the starry sky. Since I revived you, I naturally have an even more important mission for you… The God Sealing Battle is nothing.”
“Can I also participate in the God Sealing Battle?” the Empress said. “You seemed to have said just now that you can obtain a lot of resources in the God Sealing Battle. Since you want us to increase our strength, you should have something you need our strength for, right?”
“Since I want to increase my strength, resources are indispensable. I want to snatch them from this God Sealing Battle.”
Shi Yu looked at Empress Huang Xi in surprise and said, “In theory, Blue Planet’s Will should be able to provide enough resources…”
“l still prefer to fight for it myself,” Huang Xi said.
“It’s not impossible, but you can’t break through to the divine level. Only demigods can participate in the God Sealing Battle…”
“This is also good. When the World King Planet and Blue Planet are connected, Senior Empress, you can join the Dong Huang Realm I established and represent the Dong Huang Realm in the God Sealing Battle. Oh, right, I’ll ask Senior Emperor Wu and Senior Dragon Emperor if they’re interested.” Shi Yu suddenly wanted to give it a try.
This way… he didn’t know how far the three emperors of Dong Huang could reach in the end when they participated in the God Sealing Battle.
“Mother Blue Planet, Aunt World Tree, are you there? Help me transfer to Emperor Wu and the Dragon Emperor.” Shi Yu turned around and spoke telepathically to the Blue Planet’s Will and the World Tree.
They had different discussions.
Dragon Palace City.
“Wu vw…” The little white dragon hid in the corner and covered its teary eyes with its dragon claws. It looked at the Dragon Emperor, who was chatting happily with the Space Dragon King and the Thunder Dragon King.
Seeing that even its father had to call the Dragon Emperor ‘senior’, the little white dragon completely panicked.
Holy sh*t, this person was actually… actually the big boss who overthrew the previous Dragon God’s rule with Aunt Dragon God back then?
Even the little white dragon’s father’s Beast Tamer, Lin Feng, was its junior??
Just now, it actually wanted to take the other party in as its little brother? The little white dragon understood that it had caused trouble again. It only hoped that this Dragon Emperor wouldn’t talk nonsense and would give it a chance.
Otherwise, it would be locked up again…
“During this period… so many things actually happened.” The Dragon Emperor sighed, his expression filled with vicissitudes. Although he had obtained the history of the world from Shi Yu, he had only recorded some major events. For example, some minor details that he was more concerned about, he knew better from these old Dragon Kings who had followed them in the rebellion back then..

chapters.title: Chapter 1541 - 1541: Beast Shi Yu (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1541: Beast Shi Yu (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“In other words, in the current Dragon Palace City, the Dragon God is Shi Yu’s pet, the Green Dragon,” Long Qingyun said. ‘As for Tian Li, she went to the World King Planet to cultivate.”
“Wu wu wu, Your Majesty, you’ve revived. The Dragon God will definitely be very happy.” The Prime Minister Turtle who assisted the Dragon God back then was excited to see Long Qingyun revived.
As the Dragon God Statue in Dragon Palace City didn’t reject Long Qingyun, it meant that this Long Qingyun was real. At this moment, the Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City knew that the Dragon Emperor had returned.
“Sigh, after I die, not only will she have to take charge of Dragon Palace City, but she also has to take care of the huge Dong Huang. It’s been hard on her all these years,” Long Qingyun said. Just as he finished speaking, he was stunned.
After being stunned for a long time, he said, “Please let me go to the World King Planet and participate in this God Sealing Battle. Tian Li will also participate, right?”
“What’s wrong?” Seeing that the Dragon Emperor was suddenly distracted, the Dragon Kings were stunned.
“It’s nothing… It’s Shi Yu. I was talking to Shi Yu just now.” After Long Qingyun recovered, he said, “Can you tell me more about Shi Yu? And why the current Dragon God is called Buggy by the Third Prince?”
Long Qingyun remembered that Shi Yu’s Green Dragon was an existence that could defeat the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon in a parallel world…
“Shi Yu and Buggy.” Now, the Ice Dragon King, who had the highest seniority in Dragon Palace City, spoke and said, “It’s very simple, because that Green Dragon evolved from the Green Silkworm.”
“It was only so long when I first saw it back then.” Mother Dragon stretched out a finger.
Dragon Emperor:
“Green Silkworm?? Do I know that Green Silkworm? How is that possible?” The Dragon Emperor was stunned. It could understand if it evolved from snakes, lizards, and dragon carps into dragons, but why were bugs and dragons still connected?
The Green Dragon that defeated the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon evolved from a Green Silkworm?
The Thunder Dragon King said, “Big Brother Qingyun, times have changed.”
“Yes, yes, Senior Dragon Emperor, there are still many unscientific things in this era. Don’t worry, we’ll tell you slowly,” the Sea Dragon King said.
At the ruins of Emperor Wu.
“World King Planet? God Sealing Battle? Ranking Battle of all races? Alright, I’ll participate!” Emperor Wu said.
As soon as he finished speaking, Ji Mengzhu, Zhong Xuan, and the others looked at him.
“I’m talking telepathically to Shi Yu.” Emperor Wu laughed and said, “Looks like there’s a higher stage to show off soon.”
“Roar! ! Emperor Wu r s pets were also a group of battle maniacs.
Upon hearing Emperor Wu r s words, they were immediately extremely excited.
Only a young turtle lowered its face and said, “At that time… 1 might as well have died! ! ”
“Now that you all have the strength of totems, I’m only at the Awakening level. What should we do?”
“Ah, ah, ah, ah.” At the thought of starting over, Zhong Xuan’s face was covered in tears. It felt that what was its goal? Those who died had perfectly revived. On the other hand, it, who was alive, had suffered the radiation torture of 2000 years and was even forced to reincarnate and return to the young turtle stage.
“Senior Chong Xuan…” Ji Mengzhu stifled a laugh and said, “This might also be your mission. It’s all thanks to you that Shi Yu could obtain the Iron-eating Beast evolution materials so early back then.”
“If I remember correctly, Shi Yu seems to have a resource called the Reincarnation Fruit that can recover the power of his previous life. It was created by that ginseng baby. Using this, you might be able to quickly recover your power.”
“Baby Ginseng, Reincarnation Fruit?” Zhong Xuan was stunned. It recalled the big white radish it had educated back then and fell into deep thought. Back then, that ginseng baby wanted to help it recover from its injuries, but Zhong Xuan crticized the ginseng baby because it was too weak and failed. Now, was Zhong Xuan going to go over and beg that big white radish?
“Roar!! (Don’t trouble him, let me help you train! Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast shouted. It was guaranteed to be efficient!
“Go to the side.” Zhong Xuan’s expression turned bitter. It was better to beg to see that ginseng baby. What goes around comes around. Who would have thought that the supplements it despised at that time would now become a straw to clutch at to recover its strength?
After Shi Yu informed Emperor Wu and the Dragon Emperor of the God Sealing Battle, he was in a good mood.
Wasn’t his Dong Huang Realm developing just like that?
Before it even started, three Level 9 Beast Tamers with extraordinary potential joined.
Of course, it was only potential now.
Although the three emperors of Dong Huang weren’t weak, they were only demigods in terms of the Blue Planet standards. Each of them still had a lot of room for improvement at Level 9.
However, Shi Yu believed that if they were given a stable cultivation environment and enough cultivation resources, they could quickly rise and reach achievements like the Space Emperor and Lin Feng.
Moreover, the time used would definitely be much shorter than what the Space Emperor and Lin Feng used.
The Space Emperor and Lin Feng had wasted so much time in the starry sky before reaching the peak of the divine level. They had purely entered the starry sky by accident, and it wasn’t the World King Planet that they directly entered. They had no one to rely on and were full and hungry. They didn’t have time to cultivate at all. Most of the time spent was thinking of ways to live.
However, Dong Huang and the other two legends were different. They could directly rely on future high-level planets, the growth of resources in two first-level realms and a second-level realm, preventing them from wasting their energy on useless things.
Back then, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng regretted missing the God Sealing
Battle. Now, Emperor Wu and the others… could finally represent Blue Planet’s
Beast Tamer to verify how far Blue Planet’s Beast Tamer could go in the God Sealing Battle and whether it was true that he could have super divine aptitude..

chapters.title: Chapter 1542 - 1542: Beast Shi Yu (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1542: Beast Shi Yu (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t count himself in… He felt that he was an exception.
“Let’s go! ! ”
Shi Yu returned to his senses. Chi Tong had already pulled Empress Huang Xi along and prepared to bring her to see the current Dong Huang.
The Empress was rather uncomfortable being pulled by Chi Tong. Unfortunately, Chi Tongs grip was too strong, and the Empress couldn’t persuade her.
“Where… are we going?”
“Call me sister.” Chi Tong ignored the others and liked the Empress very much.
Huang Xi: ‘
Chi Tong thought for a moment and said, “Let’s go to the Ancient Capital first.’
“Bye, Have a good time.” Shi Yu smiled and waved.
After Chi Tong and Huang Xi left, Shi Yu sighed.
“Alright, let’s wait for the World King Planet to connect. Before that…’
Shi Yu teleported to a manor in the capital and took out his previous life.
Now that he had broken through to the divine level, he had a new research direction.
Shi Yu, who had the talent of divine-level body control, could now achieve Soul Out of Body, Spirit Clone, and Broken Limb Rebirth.
Then, could his soul attach to his previous life?
Logically speaking, there shouldn’t be a problem. Of course, Shi Yu didn’t dare to bet. There was only one soul. If anything happened, he would be in trouble. Unless his current body was completely dead and couldn’t be used, Shi Yu didn’t dare to easily let his soul change bodies.
However, although his soul didn’t dare to move, Shi Yu planned to try using his spiritual clone to possess his previous life.
Compared to the soul, the risk to the spiritual clone was much smaller.
In the room, Shi Yu took a deep breath. A pure spiritual clone with no face condensed beside him that was filled with white light.
It wasn’t a problem for Shi Yu to create it more realistically, but there was clearly no need to be so detailed at the moment. Next, Shi Yu told the pets in the Beast Taming Space that he was starting the experiment. Every pet also focused their attention on the spiritual clone and Shi Yu’s previous life…
“God Ling, bless success!”
After Shi Yu’s prayer was completed, he directly let his spiritual clone integrate into his previous life and tried to control it. The World King Planet Archeological Association had experimented with this experiment many times. Soul possession, mental control, mechanical modification control, and plant control. There were many ways, but they all failed. There was no compatibility at all.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu’s experimental process was surprisingly smooth under the incredulous gazes of Ling and the others. It was as if Shi Yu’s mental strength had returned to his body and directly perfectly fused into the ancient corpse.
In the next moment, the ancient corpse lying on the ground suddenly opened his eyes.
Then, he slowly got up.
He looked at Shi Yu, who had swallowed his saliva in front of him.
“This… This… succeeded?” The two Shi Yus spoke at the same time in disbelief.
“Holy sh*t.”
With a thought, Shi Yu e s previous life form raised his arm. With another thought, he lowered his arm.
At this moment, the feeling of Shi Yu controlling his previous life form was like forcefully controlling a pet’s consciousness. It felt like he had forcefully contracted the other party.
However, the problem with Shi Yu’s beast was very big. That was, after obtaining the right to control its body, Shi Yu didn’t find any extraordinary power on it. There was no Beast Taming Space, no soul power, no mental strength. Apart from its body that was comparable to a super divine level, there was nothing.
Even at this moment, it was only a puppet clone controlled by his mental contract.
But no matter what, Shi Yu was overjoyed. As long as he confirmed that he could control and fuse with his previous life, it would be a huge progress.
“Hahaha, I’ve subdued Beast Shi Yu!!” Shi Yu was extremely excited, even happier than contracting a new divine pet.
However, at this moment, Eleven and the others were only stunned as they watched Shi Yu constantly fiddle with the ancient corpse.
“Wu wu wu!!!” At this moment, Eleven and the others looked at the ancient corpse who was practicing Taiji Fist. They opened their mouths in shock, not understanding the situation.
Oh my god!! A corpse came back to life!! Didn’t they say that even the ancient corpses of the era couldn’t be controlled??

chapters.title: Chapter 1543 - 1543: The Five Emperors Are About to Be Together (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1543: The Five Emperors Are About to Be Together (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Master… Master!”
Ling didn’t understand why Shi Yu could control this body so smoothly.
Could it be that something dirty had possessed him? From Shi Yu’s current mental state, it didn’t seem right.
Shi Yu wasn’t even this happy to be first in the God Sealing Battle.
“Don’t be nervous.’
“Do you want to know why?” Shi Yu stopped controlling his previous life and chuckled. “Because this body is mine to begin with.” “It’s equivalent to my previous life.”
“This is also why my compatibility with him is so high.”
“Ning… (Previous, previous life?!!)” Susu was shocked. Shi Yu also had a previous life?
“Yi?! (Reincarnation Fruit?)” Baby Ginseng suspected that Shi Yu had secretly eaten the Reincarnation Fruit it had created.
“What Reincarnation Fruit? The most ridiculous thing is that Master opened his previous life’s body from the super divine stone, and this previous life’s body is still at the super divine level!” Ling said.
“Wu wu wu! (As expected of you, Ling.)” Eleven said, and Buggy nodded.
Ling: “I’m not praising myself!”
At this moment, Little Ji, Duckie, Qi, Little Zi, Shorty, Turtle, Little Quas, and the others were all shocked.
This was the first time they had heard Shi Yu talk about his previous life.
“No! Having a previous life… isn’t strange. However, Master, your previous life… why was it the last era? Didn’t they say that even cosmic-level lives can’t come to the next era through any method, even reincarnation?” Ling still couldn’t figure it out.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “I don’t know either, so… my next archeological goal is this.’
“Forget about this first. I’ve discovered something interesting.”
“Eleven, come out.’
Shi Yu called out. Eleven immediately walked out of the Beast Taming Space and looked at Shi Yu adorably.
Shi Yu said, “Punch him. Of course, control it well and don’t let the power leak. ”
“Huh??” Eleven was stunned. What, what, punch this…?
Now, Eleven, an intermediate god, could probably blow up a country with a punch. If it was Blue Planet before the revival, a punch could probably crack the entire Dong Huang continent and cause the world to tremble, causing volcanic eruptions and tsunamis to descend!
“Don’t forget, my previous life had a super divine level physique,” Shi Yu said.
Although there were no other powers, Shi Yu sensed this super divine level physique…
Shi Yu didn’t know what the super divine level physique mentioned by the five super divine gods on Blue Planet referred to. Did it refer to the physique of a super divine level human or the physique of a super divine level cosmic life form? In any case, Shi Yu felt that the physical strength of this super divine clone was definitely stronger than the current intermediate god Eleven.
“Wuu…” Eleven hesitated for a moment and listened to Shi Yu’s command. It gently punched the clone. In the next moment, the super divine clone caught Eleven’s punch with a palm.
“Harder, Eleven,” Shi Yu said. “Break free and take a look.”
“Wu? ? ?wu!” Eleven frowned and struggled free from the fist held by the super divine clone, but… it couldn’t break free no matter what!!
Eleven tried its best, but its fist couldn’t leave the palm of the super divine clone and was tightly pinched.
In the next moment, to Eleven’s surprise, the super divine clone directly pinched the back of its neck and lifted it up. The strength was so great that Eleven still couldn’t resist.
It was as if they had returned to their cub days and were pinched by the breeder until they couldn’t resist!
Eleven was shocked as if it had encountered a bolt from the blue. After all, it was now an intermediate god! !
Was the previous life of a Beast Tamer… so strong?
“Too strong!!!” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say. This super divine clone could also be used as perfect divine battle power, right??
Even if it only had physical strength, its battle power was still off the charts.
Although Eleven didn’t use its full strength and only used the power of the
Battle God Body. it was still comparable to a cosmic behemoth of the same level! And now, it couldn’t resist at all!
“Ji…” “Yi…” At this moment, in the Beast Taming Space, the other pets also looked at this scene in a daze.
Especially Qi, who had just become a top-notch god. She originally thought that she was already the strongest battle power in the team, but when she saw Shi Yu turn around and use a super divine Shi Yu Beast, she was immediately stunned.
This worked?
“Hahahaha.” Shi Yu controlled Beast Shi Yu to throw Eleven onto the sofa and patted Shi Yu’s shoulder. He said happily, “As expected of me!”
“Let’s leave it at that for now. We’ll find him some equipment later. It can directly be used as a secret weapon.”
“Beautiful! Little guys, from today onwards, I’ll help you adapt to the divine-level realm. I’ll be your sparring partner! At this moment, Shi Yu recalled his obligation as a Beast Tamer. He shouldn’t just add points.
He also had to help his pets accumulate battle experience!
Beast Shi Yu seemed to be a very good candidate.
Eleven, Buggy, Ginseng Baby: ???
“Beast Shi Yu can also participate in the next team internal competition.” Qi:
“Super divine stone…” Shi Yu looked forward to the more super divine stones Zi Jian brought back for him. A super divine stone opened a super divine level previous life, and a super divine stone opened a quasi Level 12 Time Crystal, allowing Qi to recover the power of her previous life and break through. This was simply… a lucky stone!
“Wait… I wonder if this body can be considered a human on Blue Planet…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought. In theory, this body was that of a human on Earth.. Was it possible to directly enter the ruins of the Earth Era? Without any special opening method?

chapters.title: Chapter 1544 - 1544: The Five Emperors Are About to Be Together (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1544: The Five Emperors Are About to Be Together (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Shi, Shi Yu!!” Just as Shi Yu was thinking, a familiar and unfamiliar cry suddenly sounded from the outside world.
Shi Yu was stunned. He walked out and saw a tall beauty flying in the sky.
She had dark blue, wavy hair, and her left eye was covered by a bang. Her eyes, like Baby Ginsengs, were a time hexagram. She didn’t have arms and had huge, dark blue wings. Even her feet were white sharp claws.
“Teacher Owl… I’m still not used to your astrologer form. What’s the difference between you and the owl girl?”
“Ridiculous, it’s not the owl girl, it’s the Astrologer Race! It’s just that the Astrologer Race has many forms. I’m more like a combination of humans and birds,” the Prediction Owl said. “Also, call me by my name next time, Tu .Na.”
“l know, I know.”
Teacher Owl smiled and said, “l predicted that you would come to the capital today. How is it? Are you here to pick me up?”
“More or less.” Shi Yu also smiled and said, “In a few days, everyone can go to the World King Planet. I brought back the permanent teleportation array of the World King Planet.”
“Great.” Teacher Owl said excitedly, “Speaking of which, what about the thing I asked you to ask about? How’s it going?”
“Well, the Astrologer Race is still on World King Planet and is developing alright. The current patriarch is an Astrologer Race big boss named Tu Tu. The race is still the same as before. There are no super divine levels.”
“Oh… As expected, after 1 disappeared, the position of patriarch was passed to my stupid brother?” Teacher Owl held its forehead and said, “It’s really rare that the Astrologer Race wasn’t destroyed under his lead.”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. It should be said that it was fortunate that it was given to the owl’s brother. If it was given to Teacher Owl, the problem would be huge!!
Perhaps it would have already been exterminated, like the Star Prayer Race.
“When we return to the World King Planet, Teacher Owl, you’re going back to your family, right?”
“Of course, you’ll go back with me!” Teacher Owl said. “Wait, can you call me by my name?”
“I’ve decided. I want to persuade the Astrologer Race to assist you together.
After I recover a portion of my power, I’ll take some of the great luck on you. Assisting you might be able to let the Astrologer Race give birth to a new super divine and become a super divine race!”
Because the premonition ability of the Astrologer Race was too strong, they could even predict the location of the source of transcendence, so their backlash was serious and their luck was bad. It had been a long time since a super divine level Astrologer Race was born.
However, the Prediction Owl felt that by following Shi Yu and being Shi Yu’s military advisor, it might not be impossible for it to become a super divine in the future.
“Really?” Shi Yu said. “Are you sure you can persuade the Astrologer Race?”
There were no super divines in the Astrologer Race, but on the World King Planet, they were a famous race. Although their battle power wasn’t good, they found many Sons of Luck to invest in through premonition methods and nurture them into their own people. There were also many who joined other factions and became hangers-on. Therefore, although they didn’t have top-notch battle power, their overall strength was at the top, below super divine factions. It wasn’t a problem for them to fight weak super divine factions like the Blue Planet Dragon Race and the Phoenix Race.
In addition, many experts would ask the Astrologer Race to help predict the future. The two parties had established good cooperation. The status of the Astrologer Race on World King Planet was completely not low, far from what the five major divine races on Blue Planet could compare to. Compared to the Star Prayer Race, they were doing much better.
If Teacher Owl could persuade the Astrologer Race to assist him and support the Blue Planet bloodline, Shi Yu felt that he could kill indiscriminately with his eyes closed!
“Logically speaking, I should be the current patriarch of the Astrologer Race… 1 have a very good relationship with my stupid brother. Don’t worry, when the time comes, you’ll go with me and let them predict your potential for you. They’ll know your potential! ”
“If they’re not as smart as me, I won’t play with them anymore. I’ll assist you myself! ”
The owl didn’t know how to lose to the monster Star Prayer Race+Wind Kirin Race+Astrology Race+Shi Yu.
It planned to invest in Shi Yu to ensure that its super divine path was smooth sailing. This way, it could avoid the tragedy of the backlash of luck last time and dying during the search for the source of transcendence.
“Wise Eye…” Shi Yu reminded.
Ancient Capital.
Standing on the bustling Ancient Capital Tower and looking down, Empress
Huang Xi felt a sense of loss. She had the same complicated feelings as
Emperor Wu when he saw the change in Wu Ling City. She was born in the
Ancient Capital, but the Ancient Capital was no longer what she remembered.
“Huh?” Chi Tong accompanied Empress Huang Xi and suddenly grunted, making Huang Xi turn to look at her. “Sister… Sister, what’s wrong?”
She didn’t want to call Chi Tong ‘Sister’ very much, mainly because she wasn’t used to it. However. under Chi Tong’s coercion and sharpness. the Empress still gave in. This was because she realized that Chi Tongs mind was only a few years old. She really didn’t want to argue with Chi Tong anymore. It was tiring.
If it weren’t for the fact that she wasn’t as strong as Chi Tong, she would definitely correct this little guy with the same bloodline and let the other party call her sister. Now, one of Empress Huang Xi r s big goals was to surpass Chi Tong.
“l discovered Senior Lu.” Chi Tong imitated Shi Yu’s tone and looked into Ancient Capital University. At this moment, Senior Lu happened to have returned to Ancient Capital University to visit her grandfather, Principal Feng.
“Senior Lu? Who’s that?” Empress Huang Xi asked.
“Wu.” Chi Tong revealed a sly gaze and said, “You guys, do you want to spar? You finally revived. Don’t you want to fight to your heart’s content for once?? She’s very strong..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1545 - 1545: The Five Emperors Are About to Be Together (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1545: The Five Emperors Are About to Be Together (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Empress Huang Xi looked at Chi Tong in silence. She kept feeling that she was up to no good.
“l refuse.’
“Boring.” Chi Tong snorted and patted the Empress. It used the spatial control divine skill to teleport the Empress to the garden where Senior Lu and Principal Feng were.
Empress Huang Xi’s sudden appearance shocked Lu Qingyi and Principal Feng. They turned to look at this woman with an extraordinary aura.
“Huh? Chi Tong?” After being stunned, Lu Qingyi said, “No, you’re not Chi
Tong. Who are you?”
“Hu…” At this moment, Empress Huang Xi was only depressed. This Chi Tong… The Empress looked at Senior Lu and indeed sensed a powerful aura on her body. Just as Chi Tong had said, this female Beast Tamer was very strong. Her strength was probably not inferior to that of the Empress’.
However, as Empress Dong Huang, Huang Xi believed that she wasn’t inferior to anyone!
“My name is Huang Xi.” When the Empress finished speaking, Lu Qingyi and
Principal Feng widened their eyes and said at the same time, “Huh?”
“l was wrong. It’s indeed Chi Tong. Are you too engrossed in the role again?”
Lu Qingyi held her forehead and said, “Chi Tong, are you acting as the Empress this time? When did you and Shi Yu return?”
“It’s not acting. I… am the Empress!” Huang Xi said.
“Alright, alright, alrightQ’ Lu Qingyi said dotingly, ‘You’re the Empress.”
“Hahaha, needless to say, your aura is pretty good this time,” Principal Feng praised.
Empress Huang Xi: “?”
Damn it, she couldn’t stay with this Dong Huang anymore! What exactly did Chi Tong do with an appearance similar to hers?
A few days later, World King Planet.
An envoy from the realm lord committee led the Dong Huang Realm’s realm lord token to the Floating Realm and searched for Shi Yu.
However, Shi Yu wasn’t around. It was the Space Emperor who appeared and took the World King Token in Shi Yu’s place. Before Shi Yu left, he had already asked President Saatchi to hand the World King Token to the Space Emperor.
“World Master Wang Kong, this is the World King Token of the Dong Huang Realm. Please pass it to World Master Shi Yu.” The envoy delivered the World King Token and bade farewell.
Before long, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, the Gem Cat, and the five super divines of Blue Planet gathered in the divine hall. Apart from that, the five divine races of Blue Planet also had a top-notch god each. They were all deputy realm lords who managed the realm when the five super divines were in seclusion.
This time, they would return to Blue Planet in place of the five super divines, mainly because before Blue Planet advanced, if a super divine level forcefully descended, it would drag down Blue Planet’s upgrade progress, causing Blue Planet to consume a lot of energy and overload.
In order to allow Blue Planet to quickly level up, the five super divine beings on Blue Planet clearly didn’t want to be in a hurry. They only planned to let their trusted clansmen occupy a position on Blue Planet first. With them around, no accidents would happen.
“President Saatchi isn’t bad. He really divided the three intersecting realms into Shi Yu’s territory according to Shi Yu’s request.”
“The resource level of this area far exceeds the other third-level realms and is already close to the second-level realm. It’s just that there are more dangerous places. We need to pay extra attention to development.” Lin Feng and the others saw the territory range represented by the Dong Huang Realm through the World King Token.
This area wasn’t suitable to be a territory, and the dragon vein luck wasn’t good either. However, Shi Yu had requested this position, so the realm lord committee would do him a favor.
If he wanted to develop such a place, he undoubtedly had to invest more resources. However, the geographical location was the most superior to Shi Yu. Choosing this place was definitely not wrong. As for development? With the support of two first-level realms and the support of a permanent teleportation array, it was actually not weak.
The Phoenix Race super divine said, “Let’s work together to modify this area first. Then, we’ll find a suitable location and build the teleportation array to contact Blue Planet!”
“Sure.” The group directly headed to the Dong Huang Realm. Five super divines, two peak divine-level Beast Tamers, five top-notch divines… Such a huge lineup was enough to modify and develop a first-level realm. Now, it was really a luxurious lineup to renovate a third-level realm.
Before long, Blue Planet, Blue Planet’s Will, and the World Tree sensed a reaction from the World King Planet’s teleportation array and immediately informed Shi Yu.
“He’s here!” Shi Yu, who had played a change of clothes for his previous life, suddenly stood up and revealed a shocked expression. He was finally here. The flowers he had waited for had withered.
“Pi Pi Dragon, let’s go. Forget it, Aunt World Tree, Teleport me. By the way, teleport Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, and Senior Divine Source over too.”
Under Shi Yu’s greeting, the people he mentioned had all received the teleportation invitation from the World Tree.
At this moment, Emperor Wu was cultivating bitterly in the Iron-eating Beast Ruins. He had already gradually adapted to this place and had also met the
Divine Source and President Lin. During this period, he even saw his fans White Brook and Lin Xiuzhu, who had passed the Iron-eating Beast inheritance to Shi Yu. He was rather emotional about the changes in the future.
On the Dragon Emperor’s side, after going to Dong Huang once, he still returned to Dragon Palace City. He realized that Shi Yu and Buggy were just hands-off bosses. Apart from giving Dragon Palace City enough power to suppress the external factions, they didn’t care about anything else. He couldn’t help but sigh and nurture some reliable subordinates for Buggy… For example, after the Dragon Emperor obtained the Sea Dragon Kings permission, he used a stick to educate it, hoping to make this little white dragon more reliable and be able to bear the title of the number one general under Buggy. It was considered one of his repayments to Shi Yu.
As for Empress Huang Xi, her final identity was also verified. Senior Lu, who learned that she had made a mistake, directly blushed. At the same time, she was extremely shocked by the Empress’s revival. In the end, she took the initiative to bring Empress Huang Xi to tour Dong Huang. With Chi Tong, the three women walked together and introduced Dong Huangs changes to her from the perspective of an archeologist..

chapters.title: Chapter 1546 - 1546: The Five Emperors Are About to Be Together (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1546: The Five Emperors Are About to Be Together (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
As for Old Master Divine Source, as the legends of Dong Huang revived, he was indeed very annoyed. He cultivated even more quickly, afraid that he would be left too far behind by the five legends. As for Emperor Shi and Shi Yu, he directly gave them a pass, thinking that these two guys couldn’t be chased.
Inatella.
As the World Tree Teleportation continued, Shi Yu, Emperor Wu, the
Empress, the Dragon Emperor, Divine Source, and the others appeared beside the teleportation array.
At the same time, on the World King Planet, it seemed to have also activated the teleportation array. Accompanied by spatial ripples, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, the gem cat girl, and the top gods of the Blue Planet descended one by one!
“Huh?” However, when the Space Emperor and Lin Feng returned to Blue Planet and saw Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor, they fell into deep thought.
Why did these three people look a little similar to Emperor Wu, Empress, and Dragon Emperor in the ancient portraits…
Just as they were teleported over, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng were stunned. They didn’t know what was going on.
“Old Man Divine Source!” However, Lin Feng knew the Divine Source. At this moment, when he saw Old Man Divine Source, he laughed out loud and said, “Long time no see, Old Man Divine Source. You’re still alive.”
“You damn little rabbit! The old president was about to die of anger. To think that he was a little touched to see Lin Feng, but now it was all gone!
“Senior Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng, let me introduce ????????? This is Senior Emperor Wu, Senior Empress, and Senior Dragon Emperor.”
“Huh?” Lin Feng stopped smiling and swallowed his saliva like the Space
Emperor Kong. He looked at Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor, who were watching them. Their strength was clearly higher, but when they saw the previous emperors of Dong Huang, who should have died, appear here, their brains still couldn’t process it.
“Shi… Shi Yu… What’s going on?” Lin Feng was stunned.
“As you can see, that’s what happened.” Shi Yu shrugged. “They revived.”
“The five emperors are in the same frame. It’s just around the corner!” Shi Yu looked forward to it. The connection between the two worlds meant that Blue Planet wasn’t far from leveling up.
Emperor Shi was the only one left!
“Space Emperor, Wind Emperor? Shi Yu has already told us about you. It’s all thanks to you that Dong Huang in the future,” Emperor Wu, Empress, and Dragon Emperor said.
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng:
Could they not tell them ghost stories as soon as they returned home?
Didn’t Shi Yu say that only Emperor Shi was still alive? Why did they all revive all of a sudden!!
This was ridiculous. The five emperors were about to be together in the same frame? Was Shi Yu playing stamp collecting here? This was archeology. He had even gotten the ancients??
Why did Shi Yu create a supernatural plot again after not seeing him for a while?
“Cough, cough, cough.” At this moment, as they listened to the Dong Huang humans reminisce, the five god races on Blue Planet were impatient. What was going on? A divine dragon, a Phoenix, a Kirin, an angel, a demon, and the five top-notch gods coughed dryly together, wanting to attract the attention of the World Tree clone and the green vortex worm beside the teleportation array. They also wanted to attract Shi Yu’s attention.
Could he take a look at them!
They were carrying important resources for Blue Planet’s breakthrough, as well as plans.
“Oh?” Shi Yu looked at the top gods of the five divine races. The permanent teleportation array was useful.
Well… The five super divines of Blue Planet wouldn’t come over before Blue Planet leveled up. They were the spokespersons, right? Shi Yu wondered if Beast Shi Yu could defeat these five top-notch gods. He pondered slightly.
“Welcome home, everyone.” At this moment, the World Tree clone finally spoke. It looked at Lin Feng, Wang Kong, and the top gods of the five god races with emotion and sensed their extremely strong power.
Apart from the gem cat girl, who was also a little stunned when she saw the three emperors, everyone was very strong!

chapters.title: Chapter 1547 - 1547: My Ruins (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1547: My Ruins (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
The return of the representatives of the five divine races on Blue Planet, Lin Feng, and Wang Kong, meant that World King Planet and Blue Planet had completely connected.
“Seniors, welcome home. Have you brought the resources? Let’s talk about business first. We’ll catch up later,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Yes…” The top-notch god of the dragon race looked at the World Tree clone and said, “This is the Mother Goddess, right?”
The World Tree clone said, “I’m considered a part of Blue Planet’s incarnation.
The core will of Blue Planet is still sleeping most of the time. After all, Blue Planet hasn’t completely recovered at the moment. At the moment, I’ll do everything in its place.”
“You can call me World Tree.’
“Lord World Tree.” The top divines of the five god races said, “We greet you on behalf of the super divine ancestor.”
“It’s all thanks to Sir Shi Yu that we can finally return to our mother planet. This time, in order to let Lord Blue Planet breakthrough, our first batch of resources brought 100 super divine level cosmic crystals. In the future, 10,000 divine-level experts will be teleported over to nurture our stars!”
“l believe that with this help, Lord Blue Planet can quickly break through the shackles and reach super divine!”
In the Mythical Era, Blue Planet was only a step away from advancing to a high-level planet. However, if there were no huge resources to help with this step, it could still be endured. In order to let Blue Planet break through this time, the five divine races could be said to have invested a lot.
100 super divine level cosmic crystals and 10,000 divine level experts using their divine power to nurture Blue Planet day and night as nutrients. No matter which one it was, these support resources weren’t affordable given the Space Emperor and Lin Fengs financial resources.
Even the five great divine races with rich foundations suffered heavy injuries this time. However, as long as Blue Planet could break through, everything was worth it.
On the side, Emperor Wu, Empress, and Dragon Emperor fell into deep thought just by hearing the names of this batch of resources and hearing 10,000 divine-level cultivators nurture stars with their bodies. Such a big move was just to let Blue Planet breakthrough. Then what quest was it that led them to be revived?
“Thank you, everyone,” the World Tree clone said.
“No, for the sake of our mother planet, this is what we should do,” the top-notch divine of the Kirin Race said.
At the side, Shi Yu whistled silently. Seeing the five divine races of Blue Planet work so hard, Shi Yu was embarrassed. Since everyone was family now, he still had to give them the resources the five divine races deserved. If he didn’t give too much, he couldn’t ask for them… After all, it was also very difficult for him to take the permanent teleportation array!
“Lord World Tree, this is the construction method for nurturing mystic realms. We estimate that 10,000 divine-levels will descend on Blue Planet in half a month. At that time, we hope to have a mystic realm for them to move, live, cultivate, and work in.” The Space Emperor took out a skill book and handed it to the World Tree.
“No problem, I’ll prepare as soon as possible,” the World Tree clone said. “Everyone, you’ve come from afar. Why don’t you rest in Inatella first?”
“Hahahaha, alright.” The top-notch divine of the Demon Race said, “We also plan to stay on Blue Planet for a few days this time. We plan to look around.
Perhaps we can find some clansmen with good aptitude and nurture them.”
“That’s right. Our Blue Planet can be said to have produced many talents, but unfortunately, we didn’t have good opportunities.” The top-notch divine of the Phoenix Race nodded. Blue Planet had monsters like Shi Yu, the Space Emperor, and Lin Feng. In theory, there should be many geniuses. Now that there was a permanent teleportation array, they could choose more widely.
Previously, the Dragon, Phoenix, and Kirin races didn’t care much and missed a good opportunity. The geniuses brought back by the Angel and Demon Races weren’t very awesome compared to Shi Yu. exciting, the five major divine races were clearly unwilling to let it go just like that. At the very least, they had to find a genius of the same level as the Space Emperor and Lin Feng to bring back and nurture.
The top-notch divines of the five divine races suddenly looked at Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor. They suddenly felt that these three humans weren’t simple.
Especially the top-notch divines of the Dragon Race and the Phoenix Race, their gazes stopped on the Dragon Emperor and the Empress again and again.
The Empress and the others also looked at these top-notch divines. The Dragon Emperor’s heart was heavy. He felt that although they were amiable, every pressure wasn’t inferior to the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon.
Was this… the five divine races Shi Yu mentioned who had left the Blue Planet for the starry sky in the Mythical Era?
It was indeed very strong.
“Stop looking, stop looking. These three seniors are the ancestors of our
Floating Realm. They’re our people,” Lin Feng said. “Blue Planet is so big. Don’t just stare at our Dong Huang. You can choose any other country you want.”
“It’s very difficult not to watch. After all, your Dong Huang has a genius like Sir Shi Yu, the number one quasi-divine in the universe… We’re in an alliance. Don’t be so polite. A powerful human and a powerful divine race are the best choices.” The top-notch divine of the Kirin Race smiled at Lin Feng.
It was mainly because… their Kirin Race had been exterminated on Blue Planet, unlike angels and demons who could still go to their corresponding factions in the future to find new blood to nurture.
In short, ever since Shi Yu ascended to the top of the God Sealing Battle, the five divine races completely didn’t dare underestimate the Blue Planet. The five super divines even personally gave the order to find a few human geniuses like the Space Emperor and Lin Feng from Blue Planet and bring them into the race to nurture.
“Lord World Tree, we won’t stay longer in Inatella. Lin Feng and I are eager to return to our hometown. When there is new progress in the breakthrough plan, we’ll continue to cooperate.” The Space Emperor cupped his fists and said, “After we settle down, Lin Feng and I will visit again..’!

chapters.title: Chapter 1548 - 1548: My Ruins (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1548: My Ruins (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
He and Lin Feng were indeed anxious to return to Dong Huang. At the same time, they wanted to immediately ask Shi Yu what was going on with the three Dong Huang emperors, Emperor Wu, Empress, and Dragon Emperor.
“Alright, then I’ll entertain the five of you first,” the World Tree clone said. “l also happen to have many questions about the five divine races and want to ask them.”
“Shi Yu, take good care of your two seniors.”
“Of course.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Looks like there’s nothing else. Aunt World Tree, why don’t you send us back to Dong Huang again? Just send us back to the capital.”
The World Tree was silent for a moment. After nodding, it sent Shi Yu and the others back.
Dong Huang, Imperial Capital, Beast Tamer Association headquarters, Wind Forest Garden.
In the garden, seven of the eight legendary figures of Dong Huang gathered. Of course, there was also a cat girl. She didn’t care about Blue Planet’s breakthrough the whole time and had been observing Emperor Wu, Empress,
and Dragon Emperor strangely. She still didn’t understand how they revived.
Emperor Wu and the Empress were thrown aside first. The Dragon Emperor had revived. The Dragon God of the World King Planet still didn’t know, right?
Living with the Dragon God these few days, the gem cat gossiped about many of the Dragon God’s little secrets. Both parties became best friends. At this moment, seeing the Dragon Emperor revive, the gem cat suddenly wanted to coerce the Dragon God…
Sister Dragon God, you don’t want your little secret to be known by the revived Dragon Emperor, right?
“Shi Yu…” At this moment, Dong Huang and the others were teleported back. Although the Space Emperor and Lin Feng had many things to deal with and many old friends wanted to see them, they still looked at Shi Yu first, wanting to ask him for an explanation.
“Hahaha, forget it. I’ll explain it to everyone.” Shi Yu saw that so many people were puzzled, including the three emperors of Dong Huang themselves. They wondered why they had been revived and couldn’t help but say, “It’s like this. This still starts from the last cosmic era…
Everyone:
Next, Shi Yu told the legendary figures of Blue Planet about the Goddess Wa’ s Ruins. When they heard that Blue Planet might have existed in the previous era and that its past life could be after becoming a cosmic-level star, everyone was deeply astonished.
“Therefore, Goddess Wa left behind a revival tool. Shi Yu, you and the Blue Planet’s Will chose the three of us as the candidates most likely to break through to the super divine level and revived us. Then, we hope that we can become the key to opening the ruins of Earth in the future,” the Dragon Emperor said.
“That’s about it. However, Seniors, you don’t have to feel too much pressure.
There are so many of us, Senior Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng, Senior Divine Source, and me. Even if someone can’t break through to the super divine level and falls behind, it’s fine. In the end, we just have to gather five,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Emperor Wu, Dragon Emperor, Empress:
Was this a problem that didn’t matter? This was a matter of face, alright?
Now, the various rulers of Dong Huang were all here. Choose five more and choose five super divine levels. If anyone didn’t reach a super divine level in the end, how embarrassing would that be? Didn’t that mean that he was the worst ruler of Dong Huang?
After using Goddess Wa’ s revival tool but not being able to help in the end, what would the Blue Planet’s Will think in the end… What would happen if Goddess Wa asked?
“Therefore. I don’t want to tell the seniors early. The super divine level is
still too far away… It won’t be good to create anxiety.” Shi Yu scratched his cheek and smiled.
Old Master Divine Source: Stop talking, stop talking. I’m also very anxious.
“Haha… I still feel that it’s a little unbelievable…” Lin Feng said, “Senior
Emperor Wu, Empress, and Dragon Emperor… actually revived. In addition to Senior Emperor Shi, who has already reached the super divine level, doesn’t that mean that the five legendary emperors of the Dong Huang Dynasty are really in the same frame?”
“What? Emperor Shi is still alive? Moreover, super divine level?” Emperor Wu, the Dragon Emperor, and the Empress were stunned when they heard this news.
“Yes, haven’t I told you?” Shi Yu then told everyone about the super divine Emperor Shi and said, “In other words, if we want to gather five super divine humans and explore the ruins of Earth, there are only four spots for us.”
Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, Space Emperor, Divine Source, Lin Feng, Shi Yu… Of the seven people, three were destined to be abandoned.
“This is even if other countries, or rather, other genius Beast Tamers on Blue Planet, can’t reach the super divine level,” Shi Yu said with a laugh.
At this moment, as Shi Yu finished speaking, Emperor Wu, the Empress, the Dragon Emperor, and the others felt that it was ridiculous. They didn’t expect that as soon as they revived, they would have to fight for that super divine spot with so many monsters, including Shi Yu.
“Super divine level… isn’t that easy, right?” The Dragon Emperor was speechless. He hadn’t even reached the divine level.
The remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon that was sealed died.
No matter how he thought about it, it was a little far away.
Of course, the Dragon Emperor was confident that it wasn’t inferior to anyone!
Lin Feng said, “Hahaha, Senior Dragon Emperor, it’s not as difficult as you think. Killing a few more super divines will definitely drop. Let’s work hard together. You don’t want to be the only one who hasn’t become super divine, right? Then, what will Senior Dragon God think of you?”
Dragon Emperor: “?”
Why was Lin Fengs mouth so annoying?
Seeing the Dragon Emperor’s dark expression, Divine Source was in a good mood.
“That’s about all. I wonder when Blue Planet can advance to a high-level planet… At that time, our levels might be led to increase a little,” Shi Yu said. “Senior Lin Feng, quickly go do your own thing.. Hurry up and finish your work so that you can return to the World King Planet and go to the Heavenly Spirit Realm with me to get the ruins!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1549 - 1549: My Ruins (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1549: My Ruins (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu was even more anxious to get the Four Holy Ruins now.
Because his Beast Shi Yu currently lacked a set of good equipment. How could just physical strength be enough? If he wore a good set of equipment, his battle power would probably be stronger. And if he wanted to create good equipment, Buggy’s power of creation, Shortys White Tiger Armor, and the Turtle’s Dark North Shield all needed more faith power.
As long as he borrowed the power of the Four Holy Ruins and let Buggy and the others help Beast Shi Yu forge a set of equipment from the Four Holy Era, Shi Yu felt that he should be invincible below the super divine level.
“Don’t worry, don’t worry. Old Master, have they… defrosted?” Lin Feng looked at the Divine Source.
“What do you think?” Divine Source said.
“I’ll go take a look at that mantis first,” the Space Emperor said. Apart from that, he also wanted to find out if he still had the bloodline left on Blue Planet. A bloodline of the same origin… He could still sense it himself. Regardless of the strength of the talent, he had to bring it back to the Wang family to nurture.
He had heard from Shi Yu that a little girl named Fang Lan was his descendant. This meant that he still had many bloodlines preserved after the Space Emperor Dynasty was destroyed.
“Seniors, sorry. I’ll visit you one by one after settling my family matters.” The Space Emperor cupped his fists at Dong Huang and the other two legends.
At this moment, Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor felt the pressure again. The Space Emperor, Shi Yu, and the others were clearly much stronger than them, but because of their seniority, they were still so polite to them. If their strength couldn’t increase quickly, they would feel a little ashamed.
Then, the Space Emperor left on his own to find the Void Mantis. Divine
Source brought Lin Feng to see Lin Fengs relatives. As for Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor, when they learned the truth of their revival, they held the cultivation system of the World King Planet even more solemnly and left to cultivate hard, waiting to head to the World King Planet to challenge the God Sealing Battle.
“What are you doing?” As for Shi Yu, he pulled the gem cat and left Wind Forest Garden.
“I’ll tell you a good thing. Don’t you want to hear it?” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Teacher Owl said that she predicted that you would have a huge opportunity, the kind that can break through several levels.”
“What!” The gem cat girl was rather surprised. “That old witch actually knows to think about me.’
“Stop calling it an old witch. After she restored her astrologer form, Teacher Owl is quite beautiful.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Its voice isn’t that sharp anymore.”
“Tsk.” The gem cat girl despised Shi Yu and said, “Did it give you any benefits? Why are you speaking up for it?” Shi Yu:
“Am I that kind of person?”
“I’m going to find the old witch. You play by yourself.” When the gem cat heard that the owl had predicted its opportunity, it couldn’t wait to ask carefully and let the other party calculate it.
“Boring…” Shi Yu looked at the gem cat’s figure and shrugged slightly.
Forget it, I’ll go play by myself. I wonder how long the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the others will take.
Shi Yu, who had nothing to do, chose to go back and continue using Beast Shi Yu to beat Eleven and the others up and give them special training. As for adding points, Shi Yu stopped. Firstly, adding points to divine skills was too tiring, and it was impossible for there to be too much progress in the short term. With the support of the Four Holy Ruins, the efficiency was higher.
Secondly, he had to give Eleven and the others an adaptation period. Otherwise, their foundation would be unstable.
Two days later.
As Shi Yu was resting, a voice resounded in the hearts of every intelligent life form on the Blue Planet.
Shi Yu heard it. It was the voice of the World Tree.
Ancient Capital University had already become the absolute main force here, such as Yu Shu, Miao Dongdong, An Chang, and the others. The fourth bureau of the Imperial Capital had already become Dong Huangs most impressive mechanic, Gao Xuan, after Divine Source and Shi Yu. Now, Heavenly King Zou and the others, who were still working hard to earn resources for the trending topic, looked up uniformly.
The Seven Islands, Tingxiang, Rongguang… Even the totem country, regardless of race, heard the voice of the World Tree.
“Hello, everyone. I’m the organizer of the World Tournament, the World Tree in Inatella.’
“Next, I announce an important piece of news.”
“The universe is extremely vast, and there are countless creatures. Our Blue Planet is only a corner of the universe. In the Mythical Era, the strongest expert on Blue Planet was only at the peak of the divine level. Above the divine level, there are even super divines. In the dark universe, it’s like the sun illuminating the starry sky. Above super divines, there are even invincible cosmic emperors and cosmic overlords who exist within the universe. With a raise of their hands, star domains are born and destroyed.”
“After the Mythical Era ended, Blue Planet shattered. The Blue Planet gods ran to the starry sky of the universe to find a new home.”
“And recently, Blue Planet has successfully recovered the Blue Planet gods who went to the universe hundreds of millions of years ago. Blue Planet has opened the teleportation passage that connects the starry sky of the universe to other civilizations.’
“That’s a world with richer resources. On it are the tens of millions of demigods from the various races in the starry sky participating in the God Sealing Battle. There’s the Void Battlefield that fought the Behemoth Empire, the Contaminated Land, and the Worm Mother Nest. There’s a super divine expert standing tall in the starry sky, presiding in all directions. That place is called the World King Planet. It’s a cosmic planet, located in the center of the starry sky of the universe.”
“The resource environment there is at most a thousand times greater than Blue Planet. After some setbacks, the gods of Blue Planet’s Mythical Era have already established a domain that belongs to Blue Planet on World King
Planet. Two months later, Blue Planet officially opens the passage to World King Planet. Those who are ambitious can head to the center of the universe.
World King Planet will break through its limit and challenge a larger stage..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1550 - 1550: My Ruins (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1550 - 1550: My Ruins (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“However, the number of people is limited. I’ll update the rules of the World Tournament. In a month, a new World Tournament will begin, targeting various races. Those with good results can prioritize entering the World King Planet to train and obtain the support of resources from Blue Planet.”
After the World Tree announced this, the creatures on Blue Planet were shocked.
“The center of the universe, World King Planet?”
“There’s actually… such a place?” “The God Sealing Battle attended by tens of millions of demigods??”
“Myriad races in the starry sky?”
“There’s such a terrifying competition? Compared to it, the World Tournament… is nothing. 1 wonder if Shi Yu can still be so powerful after participating in this God Sealing Battle.”
Many geniuses were extremely shocked. Then, when they heard about the endless opportunities on the World King Planet, they looked forward to it again.
The reform of the World Tournament this time was simply more exciting than the batch Shi Yu participated in.
Shi Yu, who heard this news, only smiled. From the looks of it, the World Tree had already reached a consensus with the Space Emperor and the five divine races to let Blue Planet attack the World King Planet.
On the World King Planet, there were actually many races from other planets, occupying more than 60%. The resources on the World King Planet were almost unlimited. Since Blue Planet now had the ability to teleport potential geniuses to the World King Planet on a large scale, there was no reason not to fight with the various races in the starry sky.
“Shi Yu.” The World Tree broadcasted completely and found Shi Yu telepathically. It made a call and said, “The Space Emperor and Lin Feng said that they have already finished handling their own matters and plan to return to World King Planet.”
“Coming, coming, wait.” Shi Yu picked up his cell phone and called the gem cat and the owl, informing them to prepare. Then, he called Senior Lu… “Senior Lu, we’re returning to the World King Planet. Do you want to go with
“Shi Yu… No, I plan to enter World King Planet through the passage of the
World Tournament organized by the World Tree in a month,” Lu Qingyi said. “Senior Empress has also decided to come with me.”
Shi Yu was speechless. He was the one who fought his way back to the teleportation array, so why was there a big wave? Weren’t they taking up the spots of others!
“Alright… There’s a buffer process,” Shi Yu said.
Next, Shi Yu called Senior Panda and the others to ask if they wanted to go together. Shi Yu remembered that ever since Eleven and Senior Panda finished the ranking battle of all races with sharpness, Senior Panda had always wanted to compete in rankings with Eleven.
“No, no, no. I’m not at the Legendary level yet. It’s useless even if I go, right? I want to rely on challenging the New World Tournament to go to the World King Planet. Although the cultivation fruit you gave me… is very effective, I’m confident.” On Senior Panda’s side, Shi Yu also obtained a similar regeneration and couldn’t help but be speechless.
Alright, I’ll go back myself.
Soon, Inatella, Shi Yu, the gem cat, and the owl arrived one after another.
However, to Shi Yu’s surprise, it was fine if the Empress didn’t come, but even Emperor Wu and the Dragon Emperor didn’t come.
“What’s going on? Senior Dragon Emperor isn’t going to see Senior Dragon God anymore?” Shi Yu asked.
“Isn’t that because the support resources given by the five divine races to the Floating Realm and Lord World Tree are too generous?” On this side, Lin Feng smiled and said, “They all plan to rely on their own hard work to head to the
World King Planet and give up on following us directly to take the resources.”
“Seniors all have their own pride.”
(Yes, yes.)” A discordant voice came from behind Lin Feng.
The corners of Shi Yu e s mouth twitched. “Then why is the little white dragon here?”
Lin Feng glanced at him and said, “Little Hai asked me to throw it to World King Planet to train. In any case, it doesn’t take up much space, so I’ll bring it along.”
“This guy doesn’t seem to be arrogant.”
“Shi Yu Big Pot! The little white dragon shouted.
Who knocked out your teeth?
“Cough, cough, Shi Yu,” the Void Mantis beside the Space Emperor also said.
“You guys…” Shi Yu was caught between laughter and tears. The gem cat and owl beside Shi Yu were also a little speechless. “Then Shi Yu, let’s go,” Emperor Kong said.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
Next, they, who had just arrived at Blue Planet from the World King Planet not long ago, stepped onto the path to return to the Back World King Planet. The teleportation array was activated, and Shi Yu and the others directly disappeared.
World King Planet, Dong Huang Realm, Dong Huang City.
At the moment, Dong Huang City was the only city in the Dong Huang Realm. Everything was still very simple. The staff from the floating, Dong Xuan, and Heavenly Demon Realm were also in charge of managing the interior.
After Shi Yu and the others returned, five super-divine fluctuations immediately swept their thoughts over.
Shi Yu also followed the fluctuations and said, “Seniors, why are you in such a hurry to welcome us? I know you’re impatient. There’s no time to lose. Let’s go to the Heavenly Spirit Realm to get the Four Holy Ruins now.”
The five super divines: ???
Who was in a hurry to get the ruins?
They didn’t want to get it at all, alright?
“Don’t worry, before I came, I asked the Astrologer Race to predict that there’s no danger on this trip!’
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the owl girl following beside Shi Yu had a bitter expression. Although she indeed didn’t pose any danger, just hearing that Shi Yu wanted to take the Four Saints Ruins that the Four Holy Family regarded as their exclusive property gave the owl girl a headache.
She could now confirm that the difficulty of convincing her family to assist Shi Yu would increase tenfold. Even she was a little afraid of Shi Yu at the moment, afraid that Shi Yu would provoke a strong enemy one day.
The Four Holy Family!! That was the Four Holy Family!
When she was still on the World King Planet, the Green Dragon super divine had already transcended five times. The Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and
White Tiger super divine had also transcended above transcendent 4. In the entire World King Planet, they were extremely rare and powerful super divines.
For example, the five super divines on Blue Planet were the weakest transcendent 1… Even if the five of them added together, they might not necessarily be able to defeat two of them… Sigh!

chapters.title: Chapter 1551 - Chanter 1551: The Unethical Shi Yu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1551 - Chanter 1551: The Unethical Shi Yu (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
If Shi Yu wanted to take the Four Holy Ruins, the five super divines of Blue Planet were helpless.
They had already promised the Space Emperor and Lin Feng previously, so it was difficult for them to regret it now.
In a hall, the five super divines turned into human forms. Some were sitting on the sofa, while others stood at the side. They looked at Shi Yu, Lin Feng, and the Space Emperor who entered.
As for the gem cat and the owl, they expressed that they didn’t want to get involved in this messy matter.
Their mission, wishing for a safe trip and predicting if there was any danger, had been completed.
“Seniors, Blue Planet has already been arranged. Shi Yu has been talking about us for a long time. Let’s accompany him,” Lin Feng said.
“It’ll be fine. After taking the ruins, let Shi Yu return to Blue Planet to develop wretchedly. Who can do anything to us?”
He was also waiting for Shi Yu to send the power of faith.
“Alright! Then let’s make a trip.” The five super divines on Blue Planet were helpless when Shi Yu courted death. However, they were also certain that the Four Holy Family wouldn’t do much on the surface when Shi Yu took away the ruins.
“Shi Yu, you’re a realm lord now. You’re qualified to take away the era ruins you cracked, but as super divines, it’s not suitable for us to follow you out. Just take it away. With us around, no one dares to stop you,” the dragon super divine said.
“Alright, thank you, seniors.” Shi Yu also knew that it was very difficult to let the five super divines go with him. He didn’t expect them to follow behind him like bodyguards. This was no different from an insult to super divine experts. It would lower their status.
“Senior Space Emperor and I will also accompany you,” Lin Feng said.
“Alright.” Shi Yu was overjoyed. He could finally take away the cracked ruins.
At the same time, in a secret space on World King Planet that didn’t belong to any realm.
A strange person in a fox mask was touching his crystal ball. At this moment, the crystal ball suddenly lit up, and the profile picture of a yarrow grass strange person appeared.
“Patriarch!” the yarrow grass monster said.
“How many times have I said this? Don’t call me patriarch, call me Exposing King!” said the person behind the fox mask. “Tell me, what is it?”
“Patriarch, there are new changes in our astrological trajectory. Your sister, Lady Tu Na, might have appeared on World King Planet! She… is back!”
The Exposing King was stunned. “What did you say?!! My sister, she…”
He had a look of disbelief. His sister had been missing for a long time in order to break through to the super divine level. He had divined many times, but it was always to the death. Of course, there was still a chance of survival in the death scene.
At this moment, when he heard his clansmen say that the clan’s treasure had divined a new result, the Exposing King immediately extinguished the crystal ball excitedly and personally divined again.
After a long time, he opened his eyes in disbelief.
“Sister, she… why is she with that Shi Yu?”
“Forget it, forget it. However, she actually fell to the demigod level… Did she escape through reincarnation?”
“According to the guidance of the divination results, Sister will return to the family herself. In that case… I’ll wait for her in the family.”
“However, before that, there seems to be big news in the Heavenly Spirit Realm and the Four Holy Ancient City. I have to go take a look!”
A day later, in the Heavenly Spirit Realm, in the Four Holy Ancient City.
Shi Yu and the others directly arrived at the Four Holy Ancient City.
Although it wasn’t time for the ruins to open, there were still many Four Holy
Evolvers cultivating and communicating here.
Shi Yu’s arrival wasn’t hidden. He swaggered and flew in the sky.
“Look, isn’t that… Shi Yu??” At this moment, Shi Yu was considered a public figure on World King Planet. At least for 100 years, Shi Yu!s reputation would definitely not disappear.
It was really too brutal for Eleven and the others to turn the God Sealing Battle into an internal team competition. As their Beast Tamer, Shi Yu was naturally covered in a layer of mystery.
“l remember him. When the Four Holy Ruins opened, he was also in the Four Holy Ancient City. At that time, Captain Zi Jian of the cosmic overlord army even praised his archeological attainments above President Zong Jie of the Heavenly Spirit Archeological Association! ”
“It’s said that he obtained quite a lot of benefits in the ruins of the Four Saints last time. His Four Saints pet is so strong because it obtained benefits in the ruins. I wonder if it’s true.’
After many of the Four Holy Evolvers present discovered Shi Yu, they discussed. Then, they realized that Shi Yu was flying straight in the direction of the Four Holy Ruins. They were slightly stunned before following over to
see what Shi Yu wanted to do.
A moment later, Shi Yu flew to the unopened Four Holy Ruins and used his authority as the owner of the ruins to move the Four Holy Ruins.
Boom!
An unprecedented vibration immediately resounded through the Four Holy Ancient City and quickly spread to the entire Heavenly Spirit Realm. The scale of the Heavenly Spirit Realm was countless times larger than the Floating Realm, but with this violent vibration, the hearts of many experts suddenly thumped as they looked at the cracked sky in disbelief.
The commotion of moving the ruins of the era was indeed very big. No wonder Lin Feng said that as long as the ruins were moved, they would definitely be discovered.
Shi Yu looked at the era ruins that were slowly leaving the space and took a deep breath as he waited quietly.
When the surrounding passers-by saw this scene, they opened their mouths wide and revealed shocked expressions… Shi Yu… Shi Yu was… moving the Four Holy Ruins?
They looked at the huge phantom of the Four Holy Ruins that was pulled out of the Heavenly Spirit Realm space and were directly stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 1552 - 1552: The Unethical Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1552: The Unethical Shi Yu (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
The weather continued to tremble. Soon, it attracted the attention of the entire Heavenly Spirit Realm. Even the super divine realm lord of the Heavenly Spirit Realm opened his eyes, but he quickly closed them.
At the Heavenly Spirit Archeological Association, President Zong Jie from the Green Dragon Family flew out in silence. He recalled the instructions of the super divine ancestor in the family… As expected… something still happened! “Shi Yu is using the Four Holy Ruins. He cracked the Four Holy Ruins!”
“How is this possible? Ever since the Four Holy Ruins appeared, it has never been cracked at all. Even the super divine level Four Saints are helpless. Even the top archeologists of the cosmic overlord army can’t do anything. He…”
At this moment, many passers-by picked up the camera device. Although it might invade Shi Yu’s privacy, such a big matter still made many Four Holy Evolvers and Beast Tamers unable to help but secretly take photos.
Soon, a live stream of the current situation even appeared on the World King Planet network.
“King of Gods Shi Yu descends to the Heavenly Spirit Realm and wants to take the ruins of the Four Saints Era!”
As soon as the live stream appeared, it was quickly reposted by the realm People of the Heavenly Spirit Domain. It spread. In less than two minutes, it became the explosive news that received the most attention.
“This…” After President Zong Jie descended, he saw Shi Yu, who was moving the Four Holy Ruins, and recalled the mission given by the patriarch.
“The person in front is the King of Gods, Shi Yu.” He rode the Green Dragon over and spoke directly after arriving.
The King of Gods was a respectful title for the person who completed the champion challenge of the God Sealing Battle. It expressed that after the other party stepped onto the divine level, he would definitely become a king among the divine level.
“Sir Shi Yu, please wait!” President Zong Jie shouted.
“Oh?” Shi Yu turned around and floated in the sky with his psychic power. He looked at President Zong Jie, who was riding a top-notch divine Green Dragon.
“Isn’t this President Zong Jie? What’s the matter?”
“Sir Shi Yu, what are you doing?” President Zong Jie said with an anxious expression, “The Heavenly Spirit Realm is currently in turmoil. Please stop!’
“President Zong Jie, aren’t you an archeologist? Can’t you tell? I’m moving the Four Holy Ruins. Moving the ruins is just a big commotion. It won’t cause any harm to the surroundings,” Shi Yu said.
“This commotion… You indeed cracked the Four Holy Ruins!” President Zong Jie pretended to be confused. At this moment, as Shi Yu confirmed it himself, the surrounding Four Holy Evolvers were even more shocked.
The Four Holy Ruins that hadn’t been successfully cracked for millions of years had actually been cracked this time.
And the person who cracked him… was the King of Gods, Shi Yu!
“Sir Shi Yu, then you’re going to take away the Four Holy Ruins??” President Zong Jie asked.
“Of course, since I’ve cracked the Four Holy Ruins and become the owner of the ruins, I have the right to deal with it. I plan to bring it away from the Four Holy Ancient City,” Shi Yu said very naturally. “Is there anything wrong?” “Of course not…!”
“Ever since the appearance of the Four Holy Ruins, it has long been an inseparable part of the Heavenly Spirit Realm and the Four Holy Ancient City.
It has already become a symbolic ruin here, and it’s even an open ruin for all
the Four Holy Evolvers…”
“l wonder how many Four Holy Evolvers are hoping to use the power of faith bestowed by the Four Holy Ruins to cultivate. If they take it away, it will cut off the path of the Four Holy Evolvers.”
President Zong Jie said, “Sir Shi Yu, please think twice.”
At this moment, when they heard President Zong Jie’s words, many of the
Four Holy Evolvers were also stunned. A portion of the evolvers from the Four Holy Families also realized what the consequences would be if Shi Yu took away the Four Holy Ruins.
The Four Saints Meeting that was held every ten years was directly gone.
There was no place to freeload the power of faith of the Four Saints anymore. “The Four Holy Ruins belong to everyone. You can’t take it away!’
“Sir Shi Yu, are you going to cut off the path of all the Four Holy Evolvers on the World King Planet because of your own selfish desires?” Below, someone quickly echoed President Zong Jie.
Shi Yu was speechless. He knew such a thing would happen.
This was a moral kidnapping.
“The Four Holy Ruins are ownerless to begin with. According to the rules of the World King Planet, it belongs to whoever cracks it, right? Why does it belong to everyone again?” Shi Yu dug his ears with his little thumb and said, “You guys are too noisy.”
“According to the rules of the World King Planet, only the realm lord has the right to have the era ruins that he cracked,” President Zong Jie said.
“Well, that’s right. I’m a realm lord now.” Shi Yu looked at the Four Holy Evolvers below and even flew into the sky to confront him. “There’s no problem, right? The procedures are in line, so don’t kidnap me morally.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, President Zong Jie was speechless. He knew that Shi Yu was definitely sufficiently prepared.
“Sir Shi Yu, the rules are like this, but the rules are dead. The Four Holy Ruins is indeed very important. It concerns the evolution path of the Four Holy Evolvers. I can’t represent the archeological association, but I want to represent the Green Dragon Family to negotiate with you and leave the Four Holy Ruins. Our Green Dragon Family is willing to compensate you in other aspects. ”
“Then let’s talk about it later. I’ll take it away first. If the discussion goes smoothly, I’ll put it back. However, you guys are so rich. Isn’t it better to directly compensate the Four Holy Evolvers who lack the power of faith? Why did you have to go through such a big round?” At this moment, Shi Yu had already pulled the Four Holy Ruins out of the Heavenly Spirit Space, and the commotion of taking away the Four Holy Ruins gradually shrank.
Soon, the phantom of the Four Holy Ruins kept shrinking, turning into a
spatial ripple that flew into Shi Yu!s hand..

chapters.title: Chapter 1553 - 1553: The Unethical Shi Yu (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1553: The Unethical Shi Yu (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“You…”
At this moment, seeing that Shi Yu refused to be soft, President Zong Jie really had no choice. In the next moment, a dragonman in a black robe emitted a powerful aura of anger and flew into the sky, flying in front of Shi Yu.
A top-notch divine might spread.
“Your name is Shi Yu, right? President Zong Jie has already given you a lot of face. Are you sure you want to take away the Four Holy Ruins?”
“Are you sure you want to cut off the path of our Four Holy Evolvers? This is no different from making an enemy of all the Four Holy Evolvers!”
“If you insist on taking away the Four Holy Ruins, I, Jin Ji, will be the first to disagree.”
“l don’t agree either!” Soon, another green divine dragon stopped in front of Shi Yu, its killing intent spreading.
[These are all “loose cultivators”, at least on the surface. They’re not members of the Four Holy Family. According to the rules, the Four Holy Family won’t attack brazenly, and the Four Saints super divine won’t appear, but you will definitely face the obstruction of many loose cultivators.]
[Shi Yu, don’t worry. If they dare attack, Senior Space Emperor and I will kill them.] Lin Fengs voice sounded in Shi Yu’s heart.
At this moment, the five super divines escaped into the void and secretly protected Guardian Shi Yu. As for Wang Kong and Lin Feng, they mixed in the crowd below and waited for changes.
[Thank you, Senior Lin Feng. However, a mere top-notch divine can’t stop me. When a perfect god appears, help me solve it. Leave what I can solve to me.] In the sky, Shi Yu smiled.
Lin Feng and the Space Emperor were stunned.
Shi Yu opened his palm, and the phantom of the Four Holy Ruins floated on it. He looked at the Green Dragon and Dragonman blocking in front of him and said, “What has it got to do with me if you don’t agree?” “I’m bringing the ruins away, how dare you stop me?”
“You guys are emitting killing intent. Do you want to kill me?”
