The Dragonman, Jin Ji t s killing intent began to materialize. “If you insist on taking away the Four Holy Ruins, I won’t kill you, but don’t even think about leaving standing! ‘
“For the sake of all the Four Holy Evolvers, I can’t let you take away the Four Holy Ruins either!”
President Zong Jie was expressionless. Most of the Four Holy Evolvers below watched the commotion, hoping that they would leave the Four Holy Ruins behind.
In the live stream, the audience who was paying attention here stood in different camps and kept arguing about this matter.
[Kill him if necessary.] Thinking of the order issued by the higher-ups, the hearts of the Dragonman and the Green Dragon skipped a beat.
However, before they could attack, Shi Yu, who was opposite them, moved first.
“l don’t like people threatening me, let alone people morally kidnapping me.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, a green-gold color appeared in his eyes and turned into dragon eyes. The huge Green Dragon Domain instantly spread throughout the entire sky. In the Green Dragon Domain, Shi Yu’s figure flashed. The two Green Dragons opposite him were shocked to discover that they could no longer mobilize the power of faith.
Before they could react, Shi Yu e s figure had already passed them. At the same time, their bodies directly shattered into pieces. Their heads and bodies were directly sliced open. A huge hole appeared on their foreheads, and blood flowed. Behind them, Shi Yu had already turned pink. He held the Umbrella of Time. Red blood was still dripping from the tip of the umbrella. The blood droplets flying in the sky matched Shi Yu’s pink hair.
Under incomprehensible shocked and afraid gazes, the top-notch divine dragon person and the high-level divine green dragon felt their lives flowing away and let out miserable cries, not understanding what had happened to them!
Wasn’t this guy a quasi-divine???
Did he break through to the divine level? But even so…
Also, didn’t President Zong Jie say that someone would protect them when their lives were threatened?
Why…
“Ah!!!” Screams spread through the sky. Shi Yu put away the Umbrella of Time, removed his fusion state with Qi, and the Green Dragon Domain enhanced by the Four Holy Ruins.
“Look, you only have killing intent towards me, so I’ll kill you first. Do you think a person like me has any morals? Kidnapping me was vwffong.”
Shi Yu was happy.
“Let’s go. Bye. Whoever wants to snatch the Four Holy Ruins is welcome at any time. But if they come, they’ll definitely die.”
“The Environmental Protection Association, the Space Disaster Research Institute, and the Plant Association behind me… won’t let you off either.” Everyone:
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he swaggered towards the crowd in the sky. At this moment, the eyes of the group of Four Holy Evolvers were filled with shock. As Shi Yu flew over with killing intent, they were instantly so frightened that they dispersed.
Below, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng looked at Shi Yu in a daze. They were a little stunned by the moment Shi Yu instantly killed top-notch divines and high-level gods.
“Holy sh*t.” Lin Feng was shocked. “l didn’t see clearly. What’s going on? I know that Shi Yu broke through to the divine level, but what’s with this battle power? Shouldn’t he be a new divine after breaking through?”
The Space Emperor also said in disbelief, “A spatial skill enhanced by top-notch divine power. He… F*ck, as soon as he broke through, he became a top-notch divine?”
“In addition, that special domain suppressed the other party’s power…”
In the void, the five super divines of Blue Planet were also extremely stunned. Holy sh*t, why was Shi Yu so fierce after breaking through to the divine level??
Instant kill a top-notch divine? What a joke. Even when they were top-notch divines, they weren’t this fierce.
Shi Yu didn’t say much at all. He didn’t even wait for the person who stopped him to attack first and directly insta-killed the person who stopped him. He scared the bunch of Four Holy Evolvers surrounding him out of their wits on the spot, also stunning President Zong Jie in midair and at a loss..

chapters.title: Chapter 1554 - 1554: The Unethical Shi Yu (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1554 - 1554: The Unethical Shi Yu (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Holy sh*t.. ” On the Internet, everyone was even more stunned. In that instant… what was going on?!
Shi Yu… Didn’t he just participate in the God Sealing Battle that only quasi-divines could participate in half a month ago?
He already… broke through to the divine level?
However, even if he broke through to the divine level, they could understand that Shi Yu could defeat a high-level divine with all his might and fight against a top-notch divine. However, he directly insta-killed the top-notch divine that provoked them and made outsiders unable to understand what was going on.
It was incomprehensible.
“No one’s stopping him anymore?” At this moment, although he still sensed several killing intent with the power of Shorty, just as the owl had predicted, there didn’t seem to be any danger. He successfully left the Four Holy City with the Four Holy Ruins.
“This bastard!!!” In the Green Dragon Domain, the Green Dragon super divine that was paying attention to the situation of the Four Holy Ruins was furious. Seeing Shi Yu take away the Four Holy Ruins so ungratefully, it was directly furious to the extreme.
However, soon, the Green Dragon super divine calmed down. No matter how strong it was, it didn’t dare openly target Shi Yu. According to their investigation, Shi Yu had at least five super divine guardians during the God Sealing Battle!
Although it was those pitifully weak guys from the Dong Xuan and Heavenly Demon domains, and it even dared fight five alone, because of this unreasonable thing, openly starting a super divine battle on the World King Planet, the Four Holy Family couldn’t withstand the pressure of public opinion. It would make Shi Yu’s connections in the Environmental Protection Association and the cosmic overlord army surge in. At that time, it would be even more troublesome.
But no matter what, in its opinion, Shi Yu already had a way to die.
“Ancestor, bad news. Look at this.” Just as the Green Dragon super divine was extremely angry, the Green Dragon family discovered explosive news.
It turned out that on the Internet, the Exposing King had appeared again and revealed big news.
In the scene, the Exposing King said excitedly, “Big news. I believe everyone saw the live broadcast of Shi Yu taking away the Four Holy Ruins just now.
Come and let me reveal some information hidden inside!”
“This involves three parties. The president of the Heavenly Spirit
Archeological Association and a member of the Green Dragon Family, President Zong Jie, the King of Gods, Shi Yu, and the independent cultivator,
Jin Ji, as well as the Green Dragon!’
“Actually, the itinerant cultivator Jin Ji isn’t a real itinerant cultivator. It attacked Shi Yu under the instructions of President Zong Jie. The reason why President Zong Jie wanted to target Shi Yu was because he was instructed by the Green Dragon super divine of the Green Dragon Family!’
“As for why it instructed it like this… It’s to let all the Four Holy Evolvers enjoy the Four Holy Ruins? Stop being silly and sweet. It’s obvious that the Green Dragon super divine is afraid. It’s worried that Shi Yu will obtain the Four Holy Ruins and nurture his Green Dragon to the super divine level before replacing it!’
“It’s afraid, it’s afraid.’
“Indeed, among the followers of evolution, they were truly enemies.”
“This guy values his status more than anything.”
“l even want to morally kidnap the King of Gods, but unfortunately, this King of Gods doesn’t seem to have any morals.”
“Pfft.” Seeing the video, the Green Dragon super divine almost spat out blood.
It was even more furious than Shi Yu taking away the Four Holy Ruins. The Green Dragon super divine’s voice resounded through the entire mystic realm.
“Shi Yu can be spared for the time being, but this Exposing King has to die!!! Gather the strength of the entire race and arrest him!! Don’t let me know who this guy is!! Roar!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1555 - 1555: Beast Shi Yu Evolution (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1555 - 1555: Beast Shi Yu Evolution (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Interesting, too interesting.”
The King of Gods, Shi Yu, cracked and took away the Four Holy Ruins, revealing that he had appeared in the martial world, immediately making the World King Planet lively!
After all, it involved the hottest Kine of Gods, super divine experts, and the
ruins of the era.
No one expected the God Sealing King, Shi Yu, to be so fierce. He had just taken down the permanent teleportation array when he obtained another powerful resource.
This rise was simply unstoppable.
“Damn it. He broke through.”
Zavay, Ming Gu, and the others didn’t expect Shi Yu to break through to the divine level so bluntly. Seeing the calm look on Shi Yu’s face as he instantly killed a top-notch divine in the video that was circulated, they felt a heart attack.
Be it the Green Dragon Domain that was in charge of suppressing the two Green Dragons or the pink-haired spatial Shi Yu form after fusing with Qi, it shocked everyone.
These were powers that Shi Yu had never displayed in the God Sealing Battle. How many trump cards did Shi Yu still have?
“So you want the identity of a realm lord for the ruins…” At this moment, even President Saatchi, who had cultivated several perfect divines, didn’t dare say that the perfect divine beast he cultivated could defeat Shi Yu when he saw the big news…
No one expected Shi Yu’s speed to be so fast. He was only the strongest quasi-divine half a month ago, and half a month later, he was close to the peak of divine-level battle power.
Breaking through was the peak!
Now, with the enhancement of the Four Holy Ruins, Shi Yu, who had the four holy pets, was terrifying.
“What the hell? The Four Holy Ruins… was really cracked by Shi Yu?” Outside the World King Planet, Captain Zi Jian also received the news and was immediately shocked.
When she saw Shi Yu’s Four Holy Beasts in the God Sealing Battle, she had some guesses. She felt that Shi Yu had definitely obtained benefits in the Four Holy Ruins that she didn’t know about. Now that Shi Yu had directly taken away the Four Holy Ruins, Zi Jian understood that she had lost to Shi Yu completely in the archeology of the Four Holy Ruins.
She had come to the World King Planet to suppress the archeologists of the World King Planet, but she didn’t expect to be suppressed before she could make any results. The key was that the person who suppressed her was her current long-term transaction partner. She still owed the other party a lot of resources…
This was a little difficult for Zi Jian to accept.
“However, the Four Holy Ruins have been taken away like this. The Four Holy Super divine definitely won’t let the matter rest. Can Shi Yu handle it?” After seeing this, Zi Jian also investigated the five super divines behind Shi Yu. Although they were also super divines, the difference was still a little big compared to the Four Saints super divines.
“Forget it, what am 1 thinking? The super divine won’t attack so easily, and with the threat below the super divine level, I believe this Shi Yu has enough confidence to deal with it before deciding to take away the Four Holy Ruins,” Zi Jian judged.
On the World King Planet, the super divine was the same as the forbidden weapon on Blue Planet. The various large factions checked each other and wouldn’t attack easily. However, she estimated that Shi Yu would encounter many threats below the super divine level.
In the face of Shi Yu and the Exposing Kings actions, soon news of refutation spread from the Green Dragon Family, and a bounty was issued for the Exposing King!
“The wandering cultivator, Jin Ji, has nothing to do with the Green Dragon Family. Although it’s immoral for Shi Yu to take away the ruins of the era, it’s legal. The Green Dragon Family has no right to interfere, nor will they interfere too much. However, the Green Dragon Family strongly condemns Shi Yu’s bloodthirsty behavior and also feels that it’s a pity that most of the Four Holy Evolvers have lost their cultivation places. They welcome the Four Holy Evolvers, who have nowhere to go and join the Four Holy Family.”
Apart from that, the Exposing King spread rumors, deliberately smeared the Green Dragon Family, and insulted super divine experts. This behavior will definitely be punished. Please don’t spread rumors, don’t believe in rumors, and don’t spread rumors. Let’s protect the peaceful environment of the World King Planet together. Here, my Green Dragon Family issues an S-level arrest warrant for the Exposing King. Anyone who captures the Exposing King alive or provides information about him will be rewarded with a quasi-cosmic treasure.”
The Green Dragon Family quickly refuted the rumors and issued a wanted order for the Exposing King. They also roped in a wave of scattered Four Holy Evolvers. Soon, at least on the Four Holy Evolvers’ side, many voices denouncing Shi Yu appeared.
As for the Exposing King, everyone was already used to it being wanted.
Among the super divines who wanted it, there wasn’t much of an extra Green Dragon super divine. No one thought that anyone could easily catch this guy.
As for whether what the Exposing King said was true or false, people on the Internet also had their own opinions. Some felt that what the Exposing King said was true, while others felt that there were many faith ruins at the level of the Four Holy Ruins in the Four Holy Family. How could they lack this one? The Green Dragon super divine was high above all others, so it wouldn’t be bothered with a small figure at all. It felt that the Exposing King was making a conspiracy theory to freeload on popularity.
But no matter what, Shi Yu was considered to be standing opposite most of
the Four Holy Evolvers. Shi Yu didn’t care about this at all. At this moment, he had already returned to the Floating Realm and happily protected the Four Holy Ruins.
With this thing, he could strengthen Beast Shi Yu into invincible battle power below super divine. It would be no problem for him to add points to all his other pets to top-notch divine.
With such huge benefits, what was wrong with provoking some enemies? How could he not be envious after obtaining benefits? Now that he had the Four Holy Ruins as an energy source, anyone who was hostile to him could be sensed by the Shorty in a certain range. If one came, he would kill one. If two came, he would kill two.
If he couldn’t defeat them, he would shake them and escape. Then, he would add points and kill it. Shi Yu felt that it wasn’t a loss.
“Master, you can tell the public that the Four Holy Ruins will still be opened once every ten years for the Four Holy Evolvers to use for free. This way, you won’t be affected in public positions. As for ten years later… there definitely won’t be anything left in the Four Holy Ruins, but at that time, we will definitely have already reached the super divine level, let alone care about this. In any case, you no longer have any morals. It’s fine to lie to the public for peace..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1556 - 1556: Beast Shi Yu Evolution (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1556 - 1556: Beast Shi Yu Evolution (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“I’m so lazy. Forget it, I don’t care about the views of the outside world. There are many immoral things I’ll have to do in the future. There are so many ruins of the World King Planet era. Every time I obtain one, I have to consider how troublesome it is for those with vested interests,” Shi Yu said as he dug his ears.
“Back then, didn’t the behavior of the epoch god, who killed several super divine level realm lords in a row, be even worse? But now, the other party is one of the three strongest super divines under the World King. Who dares talk about him? Just kill everyone who provokes us. It’s better than using Baby
Ginseng to fish for law enforcement.”
“l knew you were lazy,” Ling said.
Shi Yu and the others returned to the Floating Realm without any danger, just as the gem cat had made a wish and the owl had predicted.
After returning, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the five super divines immediately appeared and looked at Shi Yu speechlessly.
“Shi Yu, did you eat the source of transcendence to break through?” Lin Feng exaggerated.
“From a scientific point of view, the progress of your strength is unreasonable,” the super divine of the Demon Race said. “It’s too exaggerated.”
Shi Yu smiled. “Seniors, don’t forget, you helped me get a quasi Level 12 Time Crystal from the super divine stone. Now, I have a beast that had top-notch divine battle power in its previous life. With resources, together with Baby Ginsengs Reincarnation Fruit, its strength restoration is relatively fast.”
“In addition, I used the power of the Four Holy Ruins to suppress the Green Dragon Evolvers and prevent them from unleashing their full strength. This solution is clearly very scientific.”
After a moment of silence, the Space Emperor said, “Alright, there’s no need to say anymore. Seniors, why don’t you protect the Dong Huang Realm next and protect the permanent teleportation array until Blue Planet breaks through? As for Shi Yu, let’s send him back to Blue Planet and let him hide and digest the power of the Four Holy Ruins first.”
“l can return to Blue Planet, but can we wait a little longer? The owl who came with me was a member of the Astrologer Race in its previous life. I promised the owl to accompany it home to take a look…” Shi Yu smiled and scratched his head.
Blue Planet’s five super divines: ???
Didn’t he know that he had just offended the Four Holy Family? He still dared to go out and have fun?
“You brat.” Lin Feng was also shocked. Shi Yu must have grown up with the guts of the Exposing King.
“Uh, then if it really doesn’t work, let’s contact the Astrologer Race and get them to send someone over to pick up their family members themselves. I won’t go, I won’t go.” Seeing that Senior Kong and Senior Lin didn’t seem to be very supportive, Shi Yu shrugged.
At this moment, Qi had already finished absorbing all the Time Crystals. Its spatial travel had just broken through to the perfect level. In other words, the current Qi was a perfect divine who had mastered a perfect divine skill.
Although its battle power was low and it was biased to the point where it might only be the weakest top-notch divine, its escape ability was definitely top-notch. Apart from the five major cosmic levels, there should be very few who could capture it. After all, when she was still at the expert level of Space-time Travel, she could escape under the threat of the three super divines who invaded the Blue Planet. Now, unless it was a powerful super divine who specialized in both time and space, they shouldn’t be able to do anything to Qi.
There was clearly no such super divine in the Four Holy Families.
“If it’s not necessary, you should obediently stay in the Dong Huang Realm and accompany Blue Planet to grow. The digestion of the Four Holy Ruins can allow you to obtain considerable benefits when Blue Planet breaks through. There’s no need to take other risks,” the Space Emperor said.
If he wanted to mess around… he should at least wait for Senior Emperor Shi to come out.
Emperor Shi was definitely more reliable than the five super divines beside him.
“Alright.” Shi Yu expressed his understanding.
In the Dong Huang Realm, the gem cat and owl paid attention to the Internet the whole time. When they saw Shi Yu instantly kill the top-notch Green Dragon God and retreat unscathed, the two cats first exploded and heaved a sigh of relief.
“Why is this kid improving so quickly? I was right about him,” Teacher Owl said.
“This Exposing King is so fierce. No wonder you predicted that Shi Yu wouldn’t be at risk. If I were the Green Dragon super divine, I would definitely hate this Exposing King more than Shi Yu.”
“The risk has shifted,” the gem cat teacher said as it farmed the video of the Exposing King.
No wonder so many super-divines were chasing after it. It really dared say it.
The cat was very impressed.
“This guy can cause more trouble than Shi Yu. In comparison, I suddenly feel Shi Yu is relatively stable.” The owl’s eyelids twitched as it watched the video of the Exposing King.
“But it’s said that his bounty is quite high. Look, just the Green Dragon super divine alone has a bounty on a quasi-cosmic treasure. He offended more than one super divine. If we can capture it alive, won’t we make a killing?” the cat said.
“That makes sense. When I recover my power, I might be able to consider predicting its identity,” the owl said. “Cooperate with me.”
“Alright! We’ll predict our identities and let Shi Yu catch them. Then, the rewards will be divided equally.”
“I’m back.” As the two cats communicated, Shi Yu had already returned to the Dong Huang Realm. Then, he immediately found them.
The gem cat and owl looked at Shi Yu at the same time. Shi Yu, who was courting death.
“Teacher Owl, Senior Space Emperor and the others don’t seem to recommend us to go to the Astrologer Race now. Do you have any special way to contact them and get them to look for you?”
“There’s no need for them to say it, I don’t recommend it either,” Teacher Owl said. “If I follow you, I might encounter an assassination at any time. It won’t be good if I’m implicated.”
“Next, I’ll think of a way to inform the clan to pick me up…” The Prediction Owl also felt that this was more reliable..

chapters.title: Chapter 1557 - 1557: Beast Shi Yu Evolution (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1557 - 1557: Beast Shi Yu Evolution (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Ah, this.” Shi Yu was speechless. “Then I’ll wait for your clansmen to arrive.
I’ll go torment the Four Holy Ruins first!”
Next, Shi Yu returned to the realm lord mystic realm of the Dong Huang Realm and began cultivating.
Before Blue Planet broke through, the five super divines would definitely protect it here. Protecting the permanent teleportation array was also considered indirectly protecting Guardian Shi Yu. In this situation, no one would definitely dare to cause trouble.
Next, Shi Yu could also relax and increase his strength in peace.
“Buggy, Chi Tong, Shorty, Turtle, Little Quas, come here.” Under Shi Yu l s call, a few guys on the team who cultivated the power of faith were called over.
Shi Yu then called Beast Shi Yu out. He smiled and looked at Buggy and the others. “Next, your first quest is to use the power of faith of the era in the Four
Holy Ruins to forge a set of equipment for it!”
“No problem, right?”
“Use the power of faith as you wish to forge extreme equipment that you can forge now. Next, I’ll talk about my train of thought.”
“Sword Shield Knight!” Shi Yu said. “l want him to become a Sword Shield Knight. Buggy, use the laws of creation to forge a World Creation Sword. This sword has to be hard, heavy, and strong enough to allow Beast Shi Yu to perfectly display his strength advantage.”
“Then, through your Creation God authority, you can give the laws of this sword and transform physical strength into other forms of power.”
“Ji!” Buggy expressed its understanding.
“Turtle, Little Quas, you use the power of faith to forge a shield with the strongest defense, mainly defense mental strength. After all, Beast Shi Yu’s greatest weakness is mental strength.”
“And Shorty, it’s the same for you. Create an armor with a strong defense that’s mainly to protect Beast Shi Yu’s body and spirit. It’s still mainly defensive spirit.”
Beast Shi Yu was good at everything, but when Shi Yu used it to practice with his pets, he realized that Beast Shi Yu’s mental domain was especially easy to target.
Buggy successfully used the mental control divine skill to pull Shi Yu’s clone out of Beast Shi Yu, causing Beast Shi Yu to immediately be unable to be controlled.
Therefore, Shi Yu created equipment mainly to protect the spiritual clone in Beast Shi Yu. As for Beast Shi Yu himself, to be honest, even if Shi Yu let Qi fuse with him and poked around with the Umbrella of Time, its defense couldn’t be broken. Its defense was shocking.
After all, Qi now had divine power on the scale of a top-notch divine. In addition, Shi Yu also relied on the divine-level Cultivation Fruit to increase his Fusion Talent to the divine level. The combination of the two of them had very shocking attack power.
Otherwise, that top-notch Green Dragon God wouldn’t have died so miserably. But even so, it couldn’t break through Beast Shi Yu’s body, so it probably didn’t need special care.
Therefore, Shi Yu’s train of thought was to mainly focus on defense. In addition, he could transform Beast Shi Yu’s strength advantage into the sword formed by other forms of power, the Imagination Creation Sword. This way, it could increase Beast Shi Yu’s attack area, and Shi Yu wouldn’t have many shortcomings.
“As for Chi Tong, just condense a Vermillion Bird clone for me,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“AlrightQ’ Chi Tong nodded.
“Why don’t we still use the Vermillion Bird clone?” Chi Tong said. Beast Shi Yu was also Shi Yu, so Chi Tong should also protect him!
Chi Tongs main body protected Shi Yu, and the Vermillion Bird clone protected Beast Shi Yu!
“Use the clone to adapt first,” Shi Yu said. During his time on Blue Planet, Shi Yu often used Beast Shi Yu as an experiment. Apart from the Spirit Clone Possession Experiment, there was also the Undead Possession Experiment.
Of course, Shi Yu first went to the wild to catch a ferocious spirit to do the experiment. Shi Yu got it to possess Beast Shi Yu. Then, in the end, without a doubt, its soul dissipated.
Then, Shi Yu let the ferocious spirit possess Beast Shi Yu, who was controlled by a mental clone. In the end, the undead possession was successful.
This meant that under the circumstances where Shi Yu’s spiritual clone controlled Beast Shi Yu, the undead pet could possess Beast Shi Yu. This discovery was too strong. This could directly make up for Beast Shi Yu’s soulless disadvantage. If Chi Tongs Vermillion Bird clone possessed the fully armed Beast Shi Yu, it could directly let Beast Shi Yu evolve into the Beast Shi Yu Four Saints template.
Shi Yu estimated that Beast Shi Yu, who was controlled by his mental clone, could have perfect battle power without considering mental weaknesses.
As for Beast Shi Yu, who wore top-notch equipment forged with the power of faith in the Four Holy Ruins at all costs… Shi Yu couldn’t say for sure at the moment, but considering the growth of Buggy and the others, Beast Shi Yu’s battle power would definitely grow with them.
At that time, Shi Yu felt that it wasn’t impossible to strengthen Beast Shi Yu, who had the battle power of a perfect peak god.
The difference between a perfect god and a perfect peak god was definitely huge. The weak ones had just reached the perfect level with normal divine skills, while the strong ones had top-notch divine skills (Perfect+47). The latter was already close to the epoch god limit and could fight a super divine.
Of course… the premise was that he had to spend money. Apart from training and adding points to the four holy pets, he also had to spend a sum of the power of faith on Beast Shi Yu’s equipment. He didn’t know how long the power of faith in the Four Holy Ruins could last.
Lings speculation about using it all in ten years was probably conservative.
“Alright, I’ll leave it to you. I’ll go cultivate too.” After Shi Yu gave Buggy and the others quests, he threw Beast Shi Yu to them to measure and ran to cultivate.
He also had a bunch of content to cultivate.
At the moment, Shi Yu t s realm was at the peak of the sixth level of the divine level. His telepathy, body control, and Fusion Talent were at level 10. As for his Time and Spatial Strengthening Talent, it was still at Level 9..

chapters.title: Chapter 1558 - 1558: Beast Shi Yu Evolution (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1558 - 1558: Beast Shi Yu Evolution (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
In terms of the Beast Taming level, Shi Yu wasn’t in a hurry to increase it. He just had to wait for the pet’s feedback. Moreover, he still had two meditation jades, but with Time and Spatial Strengthening Talents, in order to make it more convenient for archeology in the future, Shi Yu couldn’t let them fall behind too much.
Apart from that, after the Time and Spatial Strengthening Talents reached Level 10, together with the Fusion Talent, their escape ability would definitely increase.
Therefore, Shi Yu planned to use the divine-level Cultivation Fruit to major in the Time and Spatial Strengthening Talents. The cultivation difficulty of these two talents wasn’t something the Fusion Talent could compare to. Even with the supply of resources, it would probably take a long time.
At this moment, the outside world was in an uproar because of the era ruin, the Exposing King, and the Green Dragon Family. As for Shi Yu, he slept as if nothing had happened.
During this period, the two cats didn’t stay idle either. One went to tell the Dragon God about the Dragon Emperor, and the other contacted their race…
Just like that, three days later…
A divine-level creature with powerful divine power descended into the Dong Huang Realm! !
“Perfect God?” The Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the five super divines of Blue Planet opened their eyes at the same time and looked at the spatial crack that appeared in the sky.
“No, this guy’s divine power is very ridiculous. He might be close to the legendary epoch god! ! ” The five super divine beings on the Blue Planet looked at the sky.
“Who is it?” They were puzzled.
A rat-headed person walked out of the spatial crack. It had a humanoid body and was wearing black clothes. Its red eyes were filled with intelligence.
Seeing this guy, the five super divines of Blue Planet, the Space Emperor, and Lin Feng were slightly stunned.
The Astrologer Race’s patriarch was currently known as the existence with the strongest premonition on the World King Planet. He had once strategized to change the situation of the super divine battlefield and let the World King Planet win.
Some super divine-level experts might have also mastered the power of
premonition, but they weren’t as strong as this guy.
The Astrologer Race was such a unique race.
“Why is he here? Wait.” The Space Emperor and the others suddenly recalled something. Shi Yu had said that Teacher Owl of Blue Planet was from the
Astrologer Race in its previous life. Then, clansmen would come to pick it up. Therefore, the one who came to pick it up… was actually the Astrologer Race’s patriarch?
They thought that the owl was at most an ordinary astrologer…
So, its identity might be very noble, and even the patriarch had to personally welcome it??
The arrival of the Astrologer Race’s patriarch, Tutu, also made the Prediction Owl quickly fly out of its residence. Looking at the rat person in front of it, it recognized at a glance that this guy was its brother.
Although it had been many years since they last met, its eyes were still so intelligent.
In another place, Shi Yu and the gem cat were very silent. They didn’t understand the complicated relationship of the astrologers. Why was the sister an owl and the brother a rat?
Cat and mouse?
This industry was really messy.
“Little Brother…” At this moment, in the sky, Teacher Owl finally saw its family. It couldn’t hold it in anymore on the spot and shouted with tears streaming down its face.
All these years, it had suffered so much!!!
It had predicted everything, but it didn’t expect that it would encounter a disaster and die during the search for the source of transcendence!
There was a bug in this premonition skill. It was scamming the owl!
“Sister…” At this moment, the Astrologer Race patriarch also shouted a word that stunned the five super divines of Blue Planet and Kong Lin.
Huh???
What?!!!
They had also investigated this owl. At first, it was just a hooligan from Dong Huang Imperial Capital University. It was about the same as the gem cat. It was already very ridiculous for it to be the reincarnation of an astrologer. In the end, this guy was the sister of the extremely noble Astrologer Race patriarch??
When did the Astrologer Race’s patriarch have a sister?

chapters.title: Chapter 1559 - 1559: Exposing King Tu Tu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1559 - 1559: Exposing King Tu Tu (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Brother, you don’t know how bitter I’ve been all these years.”
In Shi Yu’s realm lord mystic realm, Teacher Owl and the Astrologer Clan patriarch reminisced with tears in their eyes.
Teacher Owl held a wine glass and complained about how difficult things had been.
Shi Yu and the gem cat listened silently.
“So, Sister, you indeed encountered a mishap during the search for the source of transcendence…
“Then, you accidentally reincarnated into the mother planet of the realm lord Shi Yu…
“As Shi Yu, the realm lord, developed the Reincarnation Fruit and brought back the permanent teleportation array, you were able to recover your memories and return to World King Planet.”
The Astrologer Race patriarch sighed and said, “It’s indeed not easy for you after so many years. Fortunately, you died. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have been nurtured by the race and become the patriarch.”
Prediction Owl: ???
“Sorry!” Patriarch Tu Tu covered its mouth and said, “I’m too fast with my words. I’m used to it. Sister, you know me. It’s just the position of patriarch. I can’t compare to you. If it weren’t for you, I would have died long ago. I’m very happy that you could return! From today onwards, this patriarch position is yours.”
“l don’t want to. The patriarch still has to help people predict things. How tiring is that? You do it yourself. You just have to give me the patriarch’s resources.”
Patriarch Tu Tu: “?”
Teacher Owl said, “But to my surprise, you actually became so strong during the time I was away.”
“l remember that your premonition ability was clearly much weaker than mine.”
“Good brother, you’ve become successful. I’ll rely on you for the rest of my
Patriarch Tu Tu sighed and said, “After you disappeared, the Astrologer Race had no successor. I also paid a lot of price to have my current strength.
Fortunately, not only did the current Astrologer Race not fall, but it also developed very well.”
“Sir Shi Yu, thank you for your help to my sister. If you need the help of the Astrologer Race in the future, the Astrologer Race will be duty-bound.”
“Patriarch, you’re too polite. Teacher Tu Na is my very important teacher and has provided a lot of help on my path of growth. I should be the one thanking Teacher Tu Na,” Shi Yu said.
“There’s no need to be polite. Tu Tu, Shi Yu is pretty good. He’s also a newcomer and has just arrived at the World King Planet. See if there’s anything we can do to help him.”
“The realm lord Shi Yu is indeed extraordinary. I’ve already heard about the God Sealing Battle. No one has been able to take down the permanent teleportation array for many years,” Tu Tu said.
“Why don’t we? From today onwards, the Astrologer Race is a friend of the Dong Huang Realm. We can predict the future of the realm lord Shi Yu for free, no limit!”
“Too stingy,” Teacher Owl said. “Brother, are there any more Sons of Prophecy spots in our race?”
The Son of Prophecy was recognized by the Astrologer Race as an outsider who could lead the astrologers to a more prosperous realm. He was the one who invested the most among the geniuses of the astrologers.
“Sister.” Patriarch Tu Tu looked at the owl. Why was it helping outsiders as soon as it returned?
“This matter… might be difficult.” Patriarch Tu Tu smiled bitterly and said,
“Sister, realm lord Shi Yu just offended a large number of the Four Holy
Evolvers a few days ago. He might even have offended the Four Holy Family.”
“Although Sir Shi Yu is your friend and 1 1 m also willing to help him, some elders in the race will definitely be wary of this. It’s impossible to let Sir Shi Yu become a Son of Prophecy. Now, I’m also restricted everywhere in the race.”
“But his potential is indeed not bad. Isn’t his results in the God Sealing Battle very good…”
Tu Tu said, “Sister, 3,000 years ago, there was a guy who obtained first place in the God Sealing Battle like Sir Shi Yu and completed the champion challenge. This person was cultivated by our Astrologer Race. Even so, he couldn’t become the Son of Prophecy of the Astrologer Race.”
“Although Shi Yu’s battle results as a realm lord are very strong, it’s not enough.”
“…” Teacher Owl was helpless. It understood if its brother still looked down on Shi Yu.
“What Son of Prophecy? Teacher Tu Na, don’t make things difficult for Patriarch Tu Tu,” Shi Yu said. “You guys can reunite and talk about your own things. Don’t worry about me.”
“No,” Teacher Owl said. “Brother, to tell you the truth, Shi Yu completely has the aptitude of a Son of Prophecy!’
“Don’t forget, apart from his extraordinary potential, he also has a pet that’s expert in the power of luck.”
“Apart from that, he also obtained the support of the inheritor of the Star Prayer Race. If I’m not wrong, our race should have an inheritance item from the Star Prayer Race, right? Moreover, no one in the race can fuse with it, but this guy has the aptitude to fuse with the power of the Star Prayer Race!” Teacher Owl pointed at the eager cat girl beside him.
The gem cat had been waiting for a long time.
“She’s already the inheritor of the Star Prayer Race. The power of the Star Prayer, the power of the astrologer, and great luck. Do you know what this means? Although 1 failed in my breakthrough, I also found an opportunity to help the Astrologer Race reach its peak!”
“The heir of the Star Prayer Race??? At this moment, Tu Tu, who had never paid attention to the cat girl, suddenly looked at the gem cat. He didn’t expect that this cat, who looked like a decoration, was actually the heir of the Star Prayer Race that had been exterminated.
So that was the case. Sister’s astrological power, her power of the Star Prayer, and Lings outstanding luck… No wonder Shi Yu could become the King of Gods in such a monstrous manner..

chapters.title: Chapter 1560 - 1560: Exposing King Tu Tu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1560 - 1560: Exposing King Tu Tu (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“How is it? Is the Star Prayer Race qualified?” The owl realized that the cat girl seemed to be more useful than Shi Yu and could shock its brother more.
“This, this, this…
Tu Tu hesitated.
In fact, Tu Tu didn’t have the absolute right to speak in the race, and it was just lying to the owl. However, despite seeing that its sister valued Shi Yu so much, it still didn’t want to pull Shi Yu into the huge pit of the Astrologer Race. In fact, he had to hide some things from even his sister.
Because apart from its identity as the patriarch of the Astrologer Race, it had another identity, the Exposing King!
This identity involved an important skill. It was the one who created the Exposing King, a clone that helped it break through to the super divine level. The breakthrough method was very risky.
If Tu Tu was exposed, unless it advanced to the super divine level, the entire Astrologer Race would suffer a calamity. At that time, if its sister and Shi Yu were involved, who knew who would suffer?
Shi Yu had only offended the Four Holy Family, but not only did Tu Tu offend the Four Holy Family, but he also offended many super divines and hundreds of realms…
Were they sure they wanted to play with the Exposing King?
Tu Tu looked at his sister and Shi Yu. Of course, he didn’t say this out loud. However, Tu Tu thought for a moment and felt that its identity wasn’t that easy to expose. If there was really a Son of Prophecy who could give feedback to the Astrologer Race, not only would Tu Tu be able to obtain benefits and level up steadily, but it could also eliminate the hidden dangers brought by the identity of the Exposing King.
The Star Prayer Race… was the best partner of the Astrologer Race. Tu Tu stared at the cat girl and then at Shi Yu.
“You really want to become the Son of Prophecy of the Astrologer Race?” Patriarch Tu Tu looked at Shi Yue
Shi Yu said, “l don’t mind…
“Anything is fine. He’s the best candidate. Believe me,” Teacher Owl said.
“It’s definitely not wrong to assist him. Although he might bring a little external pressure to our Astrologer Race and might be very good at causing trouble, as long as we help him settle it, he can definitely become a top-notch expert!
Patriarch Tu Tu had mixed feelings. Tsk, what was Shi Yu’s ability to cause trouble? That was because Shi Yu didn’t know Tu Tu t s identity!
Could the threat Shi Yu posed to the Astrologer Race be greater than the threat the Exposing King posed to the Astrologer Race?
“It’s a slot, but it’s not enough to confirm it.”
“If you really want to push Shi Yu, the realm lord, to become the Son of
Prophecy of the Astrologer Race, it’s not impossible.”
“As long as he achieves one thing!’
“What is it?” Teacher Owl asked.
“Although there’s the support of the pet of luck, there’s still a gap from the standard of the Son of Luck.”
“As long as Shi Yu, the realm lord, can have a lucky star of his own, there’s no problem.”
“Lucky star…” Shi Yu was stunned. “What’s that?”
Patriarch Tu Tu said, “A planet, a very rare planet. As everyone knows, the planet has various stats. Metal, wood, water, fire, earth, light, darkness, and space… They all exist.”
“Apart from that, there are also some special planets, such as time-element planets, or planets that contain divine-level Dragon Veins of Luck.”
“Among them, the lucky star is a name for a planet that has reached the standard of the power of luck. After people born on such a planet walk out of the planet, their luck is almost full. They are real Sons of Luck.”
“As long as you, realm lord Shi Yu, can become the owner of a lucky star and cooperate with your lucky pet, I’ll acknowledge you and have the ability to become the Son of Prophecy of the Astrologer Race. At that time, our Astrologer Race will do our best to assist you in growing up. We won’t hesitate, even if we have to be enemies with the Four Holy Family.”
“l remember… that lucky stars can only be obtained through the World King Planet,” the Prediction Owl said.
“That’s right. There are also unknown lucky stars in the starry sky of the universe, but the universe is too big. It’s unrealistic to find them. Even the astrologers can’t predict their location.”
“Even if the cosmic overlord army obtains this lucky star, they won’t sell it to the public. Instead, they’ll use it themselves.”
“However, apart from discovering it yourself, there’s another way to obtain the lucky star and become the owner of the lucky star.”
“That is, go to the Void Battlefield and fight the foreign races. As long as your battle merits reach the standard, you can exchange for the star territory from the World King Planet. Among them, there are stars like the lucky star.”
“As long as you become the owner of the lucky star, realm lord Shi Yu, your own luck will multiply. From a Son of Luck to a Father of Luck. At that time, with the support of my Astrologer Race, you can definitely become the strongest expert in super divine life in the future.”
“Lucky star…” Shi Yu said, “Is this a dead star or a living star?”
“There are both dead and living stars. The difficulty of exchanging for a lucky star that hasn’t given birth to a life form is slightly lower… However, you can only exchange it by hunting the battle merits of a super divine-level expert of the enemy. My requirements aren’t high. As long as Sir Shi Yu can become the owner of a lucky star that hasn’t given birth to a life form, I have a way to persuade the entire race to assist you in becoming the strongest. You can even charge to the peak that no one dares to climb at the cosmic level.”
The corners of Shi Yu e s mouth twitched. When he could hunt super divines, would he still need the Astrologer Race’s support?
Of course, it would be a waste not to take a faction that came for nothing. The premonition power of the astrologers was indeed fierce. It would also be more convenient to explore ruins in the future.
Most importantly, Shi Yu felt that this lucky star wasn’t bad.
As for dead stars, he might be able to exchange it for Ling to refine into a star weapon through star refining.
At that time, the increase in luck brought by Ling on the foundation of the
Wind of Blessing might be even more explosive. This was what Shi Yu needed..

chapters.title: Chapter 1561 - 1561: Exposing King Tu Tu (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1561 - 1561: Exposing King Tu Tu (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“As long as I go to the Void Battlefield and hunt a foreign race super divine, is that enough?” Shi Yu asked.
It didn’t seem to be a loss. The source of transcendence+Lucky Star+Astrologer Race joining… was very profitable.
“Yeah.” Patriarch Tu Tu chuckled and said, “With Sir Shi Yu’s ability, it might not be difficult. You contracted a cleansing star spirit. When she trains the racial divine skill to perfection, Sir Shi Yu will have the strength to kill the super divine of the Abyss Race.”
“I’ll consider it.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Then it’s settled,” Patriarch Tu Tu said. Its sister had been powerful since it was young and was the chosen lucky one. Tu Tu chose to believe it for once!
“Hello, friend of the Star Prayer Race! Our Astrologer Race has always been on good terms with the Star Prayer Race a long, long time ago.” Tu Tu then looked at the gem cat and said, “Our race indeed has a Star Prayer Race inheritance item. Unfortunately, we haven’t found anyone who can fuse with it. If you’re willing to establish an alliance with the Astrologer Race, we can give you this Star Prayer Race inheritance item.”
“The so-called alliance is when we have needs. You have to use the power of a wish to assist the astrologers. In exchange, when you need to predict something, we will also help you.”
“In addition, we’ll also help you find the remaining inheritance items with all our might.”
“No problem!” The cat agreed immediately. Now, her wish power was strong enough. This was only one- seventh of the inheritance of the Star Prayer Race. If she obtained two-sevenths of the inheritance, she wouldn’t be inferior to “Alright!” Patriarch Tu Tu said, “Sister, are you satisfied with this outcome?” “Not bad, not bad.” The Prediction Owl nodded.
“Then, Sister, you and Madam Ying can return to the Astrologer Race with me as guests. You haven’t broken through to the quasi-divine level for a long time. You probably want to use the resources of the race to lay a stronger foundation, right?” Patriarch Tu Tu said.
“Hehe, I can’t hide it from you, kid,” the owl said. “Kitty, follow me back to the race to get the Star Prayer Race inheritance!”
“What about me…” Shi Yu asked.
The Astrologer Race’s Patriarch Tu Tu, looked at Shi Yu and grinned. “Shi Yu, realm lord, don’t run around. This is the first time we have met. I’ll give you a message. Someone will immediately harm you. It might be an assassin. I don’t want to be distracted to protect you. There are many super divine experts in the Dong Huang Realm. It’s safer for you to stay here.”
“This…” Shi Yu was speechless. “Alright, then you guys go yourselves.”
Soon, the Astrologer Race patriarch left the Dong Huang Realm with the owl and the gem cat. After they left, Lin Feng, the Space Emperor, and the others quickly came to find Shi Yu to ask about the situation.
“It’s nothing. It’s just a family meeting.”
“Teacher Cat followed the Astrologer Race patriarch back to break through. When they return, they should already be at the divine level, and they’re experts among the divine levels,” Shi Yu said.
“Damn,” Lin Feng said enviously. “He’s related to the Astrologer Race just like that? Damn, I used to look for the Astrologer Race to predict things. Not to mention the patriarch, I couldn’t even find an elder. Shi Yu, what kind of luck do you have?”
“If we can cozy up to the Astrologer Race, Dong Huang will take off.” “This is the strongest premonition race in the entire universe.”
“When are you going to introduce me?” Lin Feng expressed that he wanted to make friends with the Astrologer Race patriarch.
“We should indeed befriend the astrologers.” The Space Emperor agreed. “Speaking of which, Shi Yu, when do you plan to return to Blue Planet?”
“Uh, just now, the Astrologer Race patriarch helped me predict that I might encounter an assassination recently. I want to wait and see who wants to assassinate me.”
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng:
Why was Shi Yu so unrestrained?
Next, Shi Yu really waited in the Dong Huang Realm until… half a month later.
Beast Shi Yu was almost done creating the four holy equipment. He had also slept for more than half a month. Why hadn’t the assassination happened yet?
When exactly was this Patriarch Tu Tu referring to?
Not to mention the assassination, Shi Yu could sense the entire Dong Huang Realm through Shorty. He couldn’t even sense a strong hostility.
“Could it be that I have to leave the Dong Huang Realm and the protection of the five super divines before the assassinator appears?” Shi Yu woke up and sat up.
He suddenly had the urge to go out and take a look.
However, he suddenly recalled something that made him give up on the idea of using himself as bait.
Shi Yu hurriedly ran to the teleportation array, planning to return to Blue Planet. Seeing this, Senior Space Emperor, who was currently in charge of protecting the teleportation array, said in extreme confusion, “You finally want to go back?”
“Yeah, it’s been almost a month. The new world competition is about to begin. I almost forgot. I still wanted to see the performance of Emperor Wu, the
Empress, and the Senior Dragon Emperor.”
And Senior Lu!
“At the moment, on Blue Planet, it seems that the other countries and the surrounding totem countries don’t know that they’ve revived, right?” Shi Yu smiled.
He looked forward to the expressions of the other countries when they knew that Dong Huangs ancient, legendary emperors had revived.
He wondered if there were any more totem countries… that remembered Emperor Wu, Empress, and Dragon Emperor!
And Senior Lu… Although the Yue Maiden didn’t revive, Senior Lu, who had received the Yue Maiden’s inheritance, was stronger than the three emperors of Dong Huang? Shi Yu felt that if Senior Lu encountered Dong Huang in this world competition, the other countries would cry again. He liked to see others
cry..

chapters.title: Chapter 1562 - 1562: Revived Emperors (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1562 - 1562: Revived Emperors (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Blue Planet…
Shi Yu returned.
If Blue Planet broke through to a high-level planet, this was indeed the best place for Shi Yu to enter seclusion to cultivate.
The cultivation environment of high-level planets was better than most first-level realms. In addition, Shi Yu’s ginseng baby had the qualifications appointed by Blue Planet to mobilize the power of Blue Planet’s world.
It was equivalent to Shi Yu’s food and some supplements being able to efficiently freeload the power of Blue Planet. This was a treatment that didn’t happen on World King Planet.
Shi Yu returned with a panda sitting on his shoulder and the sun shining brightly. When the World Tree clone guarding the permanent teleportation array saw Shi Yu, it was extremely surprised.
“Why are you back?” the World Tree clone asked.
There was a permanent teleportation array here. It would be a waste not to use it.
“l offended four powerful super divines and came back to lie low,” Shi Yu said.
The World Tree: “Huh?”
“What the hell?” The World Tree couldn’t believe Shi Yu. At the critical moment of Blue Planet’s advancement, could Shi Yu not cause trouble? It was going to cry.
Shi Yu smiled. “It’s not a big problem. To be precise, I’m back to take a look at the new world competition. After all, many familiar faces want to participate.” “Wu wu!!!” Eleven nodded.
“Then do you want me to get you the position of a judge or a special guest?” the World Tree said.
Shi Yu said, “There’s no need. I’ll just be an audience. Speaking of which, the Blue Planet’s breakthrough project has already started, right? How long do you expect Blue Planet to break through?”
The World Tree pondered and said, ‘E ln terms of resources, we don’t lack them at all. The resources brought by the five divine races can completely support Blue Planet to break through many times, but if we want to break through the bottleneck, we still have to rely on feeling! Although it’s called feeling, it depends on Blue Planet’s ‘luck, ‘talent’, and ‘opportunity.”
“If it’s fast, it can break through in the next second. If it’s slow, it might take
years or decades.”
Shi Yu nodded. To put it bluntly, Blue Planet was already qualified to challenge high-level planets, but whether it could succeed was no longer about accumulation, but the correct method to break through the last barrier.
“Blue Planet should be considered a lucky star,” Shi Yu said. He felt that the people and things Blue Planet walked out of were also very lucky.
For example, Goddess Wa had obtained the inheritance of Nüwa in the last era. For example, Emperor Shi had accidentally entered the ruins of the era and obtained multiple sources of transcendence. For example, Emperor Kong and Lin Feng had pretty good luck.
Even a hooligan cat could obtain the inheritance of the Star Prayer Race. There was no one else with this luck.
In addition, Shi Yu didn’t believe that Blue Planet could nurture a creature like the Time Sprite that couldn’t even be nurtured on other high-level planets without cosmic star aptitude.
“All the best. When Teacher Ying returns, call her to assist,” Shi Yu said. “She’s accepting another portion of the inheritance of the Star Prayer Race.”
“Can she?” The World Tree was stunned.
“Probably?” Shi Yu wasn’t sure either, but after accepting two-sevenths of the inheritance of the Star Prayer Race, Teacher Cat’s strength would definitely reach the divine level. In theory, it wasn’t impossible for the divine-level Star Prayer Race to make a wish for a peak divine-level star. It was probably because it involved a super divine level, so the backlash might be a little big.
“l see.” The World Tree was happy. It didn’t expect that the weakest little guy who walked out of Blue Planet was actually the key hope of Blue Planet’s breakthrough?
Next, Shi Yu returned to Dong Huang and continued to cultivate wholeheartedly. In nearly half a month, Shi Yu’s Spatial Strengthening Talent wasn’t far from the divine level.
As for Beast Shi Yu, during this period, he had also successfully armed himself with the top-notch four holy equipment. Shi Yu estimated that he completely had battle power close to the epoch god.
The quasi epoch god Beast Shi Yu and the perfect divine-level Time Sprite, one with battle power and the other defense, were Shi Yu’s two strongest trump cards now.
With these two trump cards, Shi Yu felt much more at ease. However, if he wanted to move freely, Shi Yu still felt that it wasn’t enough. At least, he had to let his pets break through to top-notch divine.
“Ji!!!” Just as Shi Yu was still dozing off, Buggy ran over and woke Shi Yu up, reminding him that Inatella’s world competition was about to begin.
“Oh?” Shi Yu gradually woke up and said, “Alright, let’s go over there to watch and cultivate.’
Inatella.
The rules of this year’s World Tournament had been changed to a competition without age and race restrictions. The requirements for the participants were basically to bid for the World King Planet’s God Sealing Battle.
As long as one wasn’t at the divine level, they could participate.
However, although the conditions of the competition had been changed and the threshold had been lowered, the number of participants had decreased.
Because most people knew that this was the stage of legends and demigods. The other levels would also be sending themselves to death if they came. Most people still had some idea and knew that they couldn’t participate.
This time, although a large portion of the young people were eliminated and they missed the opportunity to participate in this year, it also gave many veteran experts a chance to participate.
Moreover, just because young contestants couldn’t participate now didn’t mean that they couldn’t participate in the future. As long as they reached the legendary level, they had the ability to participate in the future. On the current Mythical Revival Blue Planet, breaking through to the legendary level was no longer that far-fetched.
As for after Blue Planet broke through to a high-level planet, it would be even easier to break through to the legendary level. It would probably be like World King Planet, a young man with a little talent and potential. He would have a chance to break through to the legendary level.
Therefore, this World Tournament was basically the God Sealing Battle. It was a drill for Blue Planet’s life on Blue Planet to fight the God Sealing Battle. Only by getting first place among Blue Planet’s demigods was they qualified to challenge the God Sealing Battle on World King Planet..

chapters.title: Chapter 1563 - 1563: Revived Emperors (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1563 - 1563: Revived Emperors (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
As for the divine level, if he wanted to go to the World King Planet, he didn’t have to participate in any competition. He just had to pay the teleportation fee. The ability of the divine level to create resources was much stronger than below the divine level. At that time, using the divine level toll fee to nurture geniuses below the divine level could save a lot of resources_
Although the teleportation array was permanent and unlimited, it couldn’t be completely free to the outside world. Everything had to develop benignly.
“Shi… Shi… Shi Yu???” In the Dong Huang audience seats, Ji Feng, Gao Xuan, Zou Yun, Divine Bell, Jiang Tianyang, Zhou Ming, Zheng Hai, Ye Xing, and the other contestants of the previous Dong Huang World Tournament were sitting together. As teammates of the previous batch, they still gathered together to watch the battle and catch up. “Yo, long time no see, everyone.”
“Wu wu wu!”
“Shi Yu… Why are you here? Could it be that you’re also here to participate in this world competition? I remember that the World Tree said that you’re not allowed to participate after obtaining the Blessing of the World Tree once?” Zou Tianwang couldn’t help but ask.
“What are you thinking? Of course I’m not here to participate. Even if the previous champion can participate, my level no longer meets the requirements,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
When he finished speaking, the few of them were stunned. It was unbelievable. Could it be that Shi Yu had already reached the divine level?
At the moment, the lowest among them was still at Level 7, and the highest was only at Level 8. They were still considered the younger generation of Dong Huang and didn’t come into contact with too many secrets. For example, there weren’t more than five people from Dong Huang who were qualified to know a series of things on World King Planet. They couldn’t even participate in the World Tournament now, so they naturally didn’t know too much.
“I’m here to cheer for Lu Qingyi. The difficulty of this world competition is very high. It’s not easy for her to achieve good results,” Shi Yu said.
The few of them calmed down. Zheng Hai sighed and said, “The world competition changes so quickly. There’s no age restriction. After we reach the legendary level, we’re still qualified to participate. However, the difficulty is indeed as you said. It’s much higher.”
“Damn, my master, the Tyrannical Sea Legend, is already participating in this year’s world competition. It’s ridiculous!” Zheng Hai couldn’t help but say.
The Tyrannical Sea Legend was previously a Beast Tamer ranked in the top five of Dong Huangs battle power. With the revival of the mythical stage, he naturally broke through to the legendary stage. Now, even he had come to participate in the World Tournament. There were also the presidents of the various associations. Zheng Hai didn’t know how to play at all.
It was too difficult to enter that World King Planet.
“Haha.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Calm down, I’m quite familiar with the World
Tree. If you really can’t defeat the World Tournament and want to go to the
World King Planet, I can use my connections to open a back door for you…”
“Really?” The little fatty Zhou Ming’s eyes lit up. He didn’t want his integrity anymore and said, “Big Boss Shi Yu, please let me cozy up to someone powerful. ”
The corners of the others’ mouths twitched. This guy had no shame!
“However, I still recommend that you rely on your own ability to obtain the qualifications to go to the World King Planet. The competition there is even more intense. If you go over without any foundation, you might die very badly…” Shi Yu also looked at them with green eyes.
“I’ve already been there. Do you know why I came back? It’s because I was assassinated by a large faction and had no choice but to come back to lie low.”
“The World Tree holding the World Tournament to screen candidates to enter is actually a protective mechanism.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, their expressions turned cold. They felt their hair stand on end and a chill run down their backs.
“What did you do?” Zou Yun asked.
“What can I do? Our Dong Huang people love peace so much, what can I do?
It’s all because the cosmic races on the World King Planet are too stingy.” Shi Yu dug his ears. “I’m just cracking a ruin. Is there a need?”
Everyone fell into deep thought.
At this moment, the World Tree clone, the Green Eagle, appeared. It flapped its wings and flew into the sky, looking at the audience of the human and totem countries. There were a total of 100,000 spectators present, but there weren’t many humans. Apart from that, there weren’t many candidates to participate in the world competition this time.
After the World Tree clone flew into the sky, it announced, “l announce that this world competition officially begins!’
“A total of 128 contestants will participate in this world competition. The top eight will be able to obtain the opportunity to go to the World King Planet.”
128… was far from the current limit of the number of demigods on Blue Planet. There should be people who weren’t interested in going to World King Planet. For example, President Lin didn’t choose to participate. If he could directly get in through the back door, why would he participate?
“The matching mechanism is not completely random and fair. Instead, it will use the contestant’s own power of luck as the matching standard. Luck is also a part of strength, so just with strength, you might not be able to reach the end.’
“In the first round, it’s 128 to 64. Each round is limited to 10 minutes. The winner is to be determined in 10 minutes. After five minutes of battle, external pressure will be given to accelerate the battle tempo.”
After the World Tree finished speaking, the demigod contestants from the various countries became nervous.
“In the first round, Dong Huangs Level 9 Beast Tamer, Long Qingyun, vs the demigod of the Dragon Empire, Ai Yuan.”
At this moment, as a mirage-like screen appeared in the sky, showing the two parties, the participating countries were slightly stunned. They didn’t expect that enemies were bound to meet on a narrow road, and Dong Huang and the Dragon Empire directly encountered each other.
“Ai Yuan??”
As this name appeared, the expressions of the divine-level battle power of the various parties changed slightly. This was because this Ai Yuan was a reincarnation god!
Ever since the Black Dragon Ruler was killed by Shi Yu and the Mythical Revival happened, the revived Dragon Gods took over the Dragon Empire. At this moment, it had already become the headquarters of the Dragon Gods.
Among them, the name Ai Yuan wasn’t unfamiliar to the gods of the seven countries and other revival gods. The other party was a Thunder Dragon God and also a reincarnation god. Logically speaking, after the Mythical Revival, it should be able to quickly recover to the divine level like other gods.
Unfortunately, during a certain reincarnation process, the other party’s origin power was damaged. Although it recovered its memories, it couldn’t quickly recover everything..

chapters.title: Chapter 1564 Revived Emperors (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1564 Revived Emperors (3)
﻿﻿However, it was also because of this accident that it had the qualifications to participate in this world competition.
"Roar!!!" Accompanied by a roar, lightning rumbled in the sky. A black thunderstorm dragon directly flew out of the sky and landed on the arena. Then, it revealed an unlucky expression.
Dong Huang was familiar with this country. Back then, when a certain Beast Tamer named Shi Yu killed the three divine dragons of Dragon Palace City, he was present. He was almost scared out of his wits. Fortunately, the opponent this time wasn't Shi Yu, but a Beast Tamer from Dong Huang he had never heard of.
"Different from the previous world competition, there are no rules to restrict the existence of humans on both sides of the competition this time. Therefore, human Beast Tamers have a huge advantage in battle power against other races."
"But the opponent is a Reincarnation God with divine-level experience. Dong Huang's Beast Tamer won't be able to win easily this time." At this moment, Long Qingyun also walked from Dong Huang to the arena. After he appeared, everyone discussed.
"Who is this person? Why haven't I seen him before?" The Ancient God Golden Bull, the Demon King Dragon, and the others muttered to Dong Huang, "This guy's luck isn't very good."
At this moment, the Dragon Emperor, Long Qingyun, was wearing brown pants and a black short-sleeved T-shirt. There were golden dragon patterns on the T-shirt. It was very modern and looked like it had already integrated into the modern era.
However, soon, the various countries were puzzled. Why had they never heard of Dong Huang having a new legend named Long Qingyun? The new legends of the various countries were basically old experts from before, such as Dong Huang's Tyrannical Sea Legend, President Lin, and President Auland from Tingxiang. In the past, although they weren't legends, everyone was familiar with them.
However, this Long Qingyun, the seven countries, and the totem country were really a little stunned for a moment and couldn't react.
"Long Qingyun?" In the Shen Feng Nation, the Mechanical God Z pulled up the database information and searched for who this Dong Huang legend was. After searching, he revealed a shocked expression and a look of disbelief.
The empress of Tingxiang, who was already the elven god, was also watching this year's World Tournament as an audience, hoping that her citizens would have good results. When she heard the name Long Qingyun, she was also slightly stunned. Wasn't this the name of the Dragon Emperor of Dong Huang… She, who was more familiar with the former Dragon God, was also more familiar with this name.
"Wait a minute, who is this person?" Not to mention foreign Beast Tamers, even the Beast Tamers in their country were a little stunned. They didn't know the existence of "Long Qingyun". To be precise, they didn't know who this Long Qingyun was.
Of course they knew the name Long Qingyun. It was the name of the Dragon Emperor of Dong Huang, but the Dragon Emperor had died a thousand years ago.
"This senior… Who is he? Why does he have the same name as the Dragon Emperor? Is he a fan of the Dragon Emperor?" On the Dong Huang audience seats, the contestants of the previous world competition revealed puzzled expressions. Although they had yet to reach the Legendary level, they were certain that there was no such person in the legends of Dong Huang.
Just as Zou Tianwang was puzzled, Shi Yu's voice came from the side. "Is there a possibility that he's the Dragon Emperor, the Legendary Emperor of the fourth generation of the Dong Huang Dynasty, the Dragon Emperor?"
Zou Yun and the others: "?"
"What???" They looked at the smiling Shi Yu in disbelief.
At this moment, on the arena, the Dragon Emperor Long Qingyun and the Dragon Empire's reincarnation demigod, Ai Yuan, also looked at each other.
The Dragon Emperor was expressionless, while Ai Yuan looked down at the Dragon Emperor. However, as it continued to look, Ai Yuan's heart trembled. It subconsciously took a step back and actually felt a trace of fear.
Its retreat confused the audience.
"You…" The Dragon Emperor, Long Qingyun, said slowly. At the same time, the World Tree clone also gave the order for the battle to begin.
"Roar!!!!" In the next moment, as nine huge golden summoning arrays appeared in the sky, nine demigod-level divine dragons swept up terrifying dragon might and appeared behind the Dragon Emperor with a bang.
Under the nine dragons in the sky, a huge dragon might crushed over. The reincarnation demigod, Ai Yuan, was instantly pressed to the ground by the pressure under everyone's incredulous expressions. With a boom, it was as if it was crawling. Its entire body trembled and it didn't dare to move.
This scene directly made the Dragon God of the Dragon Empire and the other divine beasts present reveal incredulous expressions.
"One person contracted nine demigods. Who exactly is this guy?"
"Impossible. At Ai Yuan's peak, it was a junior god. How could it be suppressed by the dragon might of the nine demigod dragons?"
Not only did the outsiders feel that it was ridiculous, but even Ai Yuan itself felt that it was ridiculous. It didn't understand why its heart felt such a strong fear of the other party.
"If you're a Reincarnation God, you shouldn't be the drake of the Dragon Empire that invaded Dong Huang. In that case, admit defeat directly," the Dragon Emperor said, his tone unquestionable.
If it were the Dragon Emperor before the battle with the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon, it would definitely be a bitter battle with the reincarnated demigod, Ai Yuan. However, after the battle with the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon, the Dragon Emperor and his pet had lengthy been reborn in that battle.
Although it was the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon that was sealed at the cost of its own life, from his perspective, they were undoubtedly winners. This kind of life-
and-death battle above their level could best train the will of a individual and an army.
They could even defeat the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon and the ancestor of the drake bloodline. Now that they were facing a junior god of the dragon race, the powerful spiritual will of the Dragon Emperor and the pressure brought to the dragon, the Ancestral Dragon Ai Yuan, wasn't inferior to the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1565 Revival of the Emperors (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1565 Revival of the Emperors (4)
﻿﻿"Plop." The huge dragon, Ai Yuan, was unable to resist and was directly pressed to the ground by the pressure. Its eyes were shocked, and it felt as if it had encountered the Ancestral Dragon. "Who exactly are you?"
"I'm Dong Huang's fourth Legendary Beast Tamer, Long Qingyun. I'm just an ancient from 1,000 years ago," Long Qingyun said.
Boom!
In the next moment, Ai Yuan, who had yet to admit defeat, fainted from the dragon's might. The entire place was silent.
"Senior Dragon Emperor, you can show off better than me." In the audience, Shi Yu smiled under the stunned expressions of his other friends and said, "I didn't expect Senior Dragon Emperor to improve so quickly. You've all become demigods in such a short period of time."
"Abababa…" Zou Yun and the others looked at Shi Yu in shock and said, "He, he, he's really the Dragon Emperor??"
"Who else? Apart from the Dragon Emperor, who can rely on the dragon might of an emperor to instantly kill a Reincarnation Dragon God?" Shi Yu said.
"But, but hasn't the Dragon Emperor been dead for more than 1,000 years?" Divine Bell said in a daze.
"You'll know in the future. Consider it an archeological discovery." Shi Yu smiled.
The reincarnation dragon god, Ai Yuan, was insta-killed. He easily took down Dong Huang's Dragon Emperor, Long Qingyun, in the first battle, directly shocking the various countries on Blue Planet. Soon, according to the Dragon Emperor's own revelations, his information was known to the various countries.
Information about the Dragon Emperor quickly appeared in the Dragon Empire.
Long Qingyun was the fourth Legendary Emperor of Dong Huang. Back then, when the Dragon Empire attacked Dragon Palace City, the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City, Tian Li, couldn't stop it alone. At this moment, Dong Huang's Dragon Emperor charged out and directly killed the Dragon Empire back to the west, foiling the ambition of the Dragon Empire, making the Dragon Empire not dare to step into the Dong Huang Sea Region for 500 years. It was the shadow in the heart of the Dragon Empire.
It was only hundreds of years after the Dragon Emperor disappeared that the Dragon Empire dared to covet the east again. Unfortunately, at this moment, another Space Emperor appeared out of nowhere and cooperated with the Dragon God to attack the west, killing the Dragon Empire back…
"Dragon Emperor Long Qingyun… How can he still be alive?"
"Moreover, his strength… How can it be so ridiculous?"
In the face of the shock and confusion of the various countries, Dong Huang naturally wouldn't give too many answers. The competition of the World Tournament was still continuing.
Soon, the match results of Dong Huang's Legendary Beast Tamer Wu Dong vs Shen Feng's Legendary Beast Tamer Wexy were out.
"Dong Huang again."
"Wait, there's still Legendary Wexy!"
Legendary Wexy was the second Legendary Beast Tamer of Shen Feng. Before the Mythical Revival, he was a super genius who had reached the legendary level. He was the champion of the second World Tournament, the Blesser of the World Tree. He had once been the judge of the Alliance Meeting. Without a doubt, he was one of the best among the approved divine experts.
After the Mythical Revival, although he had yet to enter the divine level, he might be the batch of people closest to the divine level.
"Are you kidding???" However, at this moment, Shen Feng was completely not calm.
As an expert in the first tier of the legendary level, Legendary Wexy was only stunned. It was fine if it was the Dragon Emperor just now, but his next opponent was called Wu Dong??
Other demigods and legends might not be able to remember these names immediately, but as Legendary Mechanics, they could investigate important information immediately…
Wu Dong… was Dong Huang's second Legendary Emperor, an existence acknowledged as Emperor Wu!
He was also the Legendary Emperor with the strongest battle power in Dong Huang.
He was an ancient human from 2000 years ago!
"Impossible." Mechanical God Z was stunned. He didn't understand why another Legendary Emperor of Dong Huang had appeared.
A moment later, as Emperor Wu and Legendary Wexy stepped onto the arena, there was silence in the Dong Huang audience seats again.
The Beast Tamers who were invited to watch the world competition looked at Emperor Wu in shock.
Dragon Emperor… Emperor Wu… This was a world competition??
"You're a Legendary Mechanic, right?" As soon as Emperor Wu went on stage, he stated to Legendary Wexy, "This is the first time I'm fighting a mechanic. Let me see the power of a mechanic!"
With that said, Emperor Wu straightaway activated the divine- level Fusion Talent and let his pets become one with him. Emperor Wu's Fusion Talent was similar to Shi Yu's Psychic Domain, Psychic Resonance. It was a branch of the Fusion Talent. Now, it had been developed by Emperor Wu to the divine level and touched the nomological ripples!
Developing a divine-level law talent with a Level 9 body.
"Oh, ridiculous," Legendary Wexy muttered.
Boom!!!
A moment later, a mechanically modified demigod eagle and a mechanically modified demigod lion were continuously crippled by Emperor Wu's punches. Even the long-range forbidden missiles shot by Legendary Wexy were smashed by Emperor Wu with one hand without any injuries. Emperor Wu's puzzled voice came from the arena.
"Is that all there is to mechanics?"
It didn't feel as useful as the body.
As soon as he finished speaking, Emperor Wu had already arrived in front of Legendary Wexy, who was wearing a mechanical battle suit. Legendary Wexy gazed at Emperor Wu in surprise and said, "You, you're really Emperor Wu?"
"Emperor Wu of Dong Huang who killed Yun An 2000 years ago!"
"Yes." Emperor Wu smiled.
"It's true." Shi Yu also stated to Gao Xuan and the others, who were looking at him in shock, "Just like Senior Dragon Emperor, Senior Emperor Wu is also alive. Are you surprised? I feel that with them around, none of the legends abroad can fight."

chapters.title: Chapter 1566 Blue Planet Ascends (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1566 Blue Planet Ascends (1)
﻿﻿As Dong Huang's Dragon Emperor and Emperor Wu appeared, the people of the Blue Planet went numb.
Apart from the fact that the Dragon Emperor and Emperor Wu should have been dead ancients, their strength was also a little unbelievable.
They looked far stronger than other legends.
"Tragic." The World Tree clone, who was the judge, shook its head slightly.
Of course. The aptitudes of the few Legendary Emperors Shi Yu requested to revive were originally top-notch. Only the guys who had cultivated into legendary demigods in the Cultivationless Age could compare to them.
However, this wasn't enough. This pair was only for the Dong Huang emperors before they revived. Because of the modification of the power of the Blue Planet's Will and the power of the Creation Soil, their talent and aptitude were one level stronger than before they died. They carried a portion of the Blue Planet's luck, which was equivalent to everyone obtaining the blessings of Goddess Wa and the Blue Planet's Will.
Otherwise, even if they revived and had the resources provided by Dong Huang's bloodline, it was impossible for them to progress so quickly.
"The third match…" As Shi Yu watched the competition excitedly, he suddenly couldn't help but raise his eyebrows and look at the sky.
Not only Shi Yu, but many gods and even the World Tree suddenly looked at the sky.
They sensed the change in the laws and the vibration of the laws.
"Could it be…" Shi Yu muttered.
"What's wrong?" Beside Shi Yu, Ji Feng asked after seeing Shi Yu's expression suddenly change.
"It's alright, I'll leave first. Continue watching the competition. Remember to cheer for Senior Empress and Lu Qingyi."
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he disappeared in an instant. Ji Feng and the others were stunned again.
What??? The Empress had also revived???
"What about the emperor???" Ye Xing couldn't help but shout.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu didn't respond.
Zou Tianwang leaned weakly in the audience and said, "F*ck, I think I know why Shi Yu said that this world competition isn't easy and wants to cheer for Lu Qingyi."
"It's ridiculous that Emperor Wu, Empress, and Dragon Emperor have all revived to participate. Not to mention Lu Qingyi, even Zheng Hai's master, the Tyrannical Sea Legend, will have to be beaten up in front of these Legendary Emperors. No, even President Lin will have to be beaten up."
Zheng Hai also opened his mouth slightly and couldn't refute.
