In the World Tree mystic realm, while the World Tree clone was still presiding over the competition in the outside world, Shi Yu had already stepped in and asked, "Aunt World Tree, what's going on?"
The World Tree said, "It seems to be very smooth for Lady Mother to charge at a high-level planet this time. Perhaps she can succeed this time."
"Really?" Shi Yu was overjoyed. The five divine races on Blue Planet estimated that the time for Blue Planet to charge at a high-level planet would be either a few years or more than ten years. In the end, this was only the beginning. It succeeded without trying a few times?
Blue Planet was completely established after destruction.
"If it goes smoothly, it'll be in the next few days."
"There are already envoys from the five divine races who have gone to the World King Planet to inform them. If the breakthrough is successful, the super divines of the five divine races should descend immediately."
"Do you want to take a look at the ruins of the era where your Dong Huang's Emperor Shi is?" the World Tree suggested.
"You're right," Shi Yu said. "Then you preside over the world competition first. I'll go to the era ruin to receive Senior Emperor Shi."
After Shi Yu completed speaking, he headed to the island where the ruins of the Time Emperor Era were and entered the Passage of Time state. He turned himself into a light outside the ruins, wanting to guide Senior Time Emperor out…
In addition, the World Tournament was carried out in an orderly manner.
Soon, under the numb and excited anticipation of Zou Yun and the others, not long after, a battle between Dong Huang's Legendary Beast Tamer, Huang Xi, and the semi divine of Dragon Palace City appeared… The Ice Dragon King.
"Huang Xi, that's Senior Empress! Senior Empress is indeed here!!"
"Wait, f*ck, Her Majesty's opponent is… the Ice Dragon King??"
On Dragon Palace City's side, Mother Dragon was also directly stunned. It was actually not interested in going to World King Planet. It was just that it had finally broken through to the demigod level and was so bored that it came to register for the competition.
Mother Dragon, who had accepted a large amount of Shi Yu's resources, felt that it was quite strong.
But to Mother Dragon's surprise, it encountered the revived Empress in the first round.
Mother Dragon knew that the Empress had revived, but it had actually never come into contact with the Empress. With the relationship between the Empress and Mu Huiyin… At this moment, it didn't quite understand how this seniority should be discussed…
"This…" At this moment, Lu Qingyi, who was with Empress Huang Xi, saw this match. She didn't know whose luck was a little poor between the Empress and the Ice Dragon King. Senior Lu immediately smiled.
"The Ice Dragon King is Senior Mu Huiyin's pet…"
"I understand, but I won't show mercy," Empress Huang Xi said. With that said, she directly went on stage.
This world contest wasn't carried out live. However, with the development of Blue Planet's technology and the establishment of the global Internet, the speed of the news spreading was completely incomparable to before.
Even the totem country began to use technology. Soon, some information about this world contest was sent back to Dong Huang.
Every audience looked at the contest information transmitted in a daze.
In the first round, Dong Huang's Legendary Beast Tamer, Dragon Emperor Long Qingyun, contracted nine semi divine dragon pets and instantly killed the Dragon Empire's Reincarnation God?
In the second round, Dong Huang's Legendary Beast Tamer, Emperor Wu Dong, punched a mechanical beast, with his physical body carrying missiles, tore down the Gundam with his bare hands, and easily crushed the world Legendary Wexy?
In addition, still Empress Dong Huang had appeared. This world contest directly made Dong Huang's Beast Tamers and commoners unable to understand.

chapters.title: Chapter 1567 Blue Planet Ascends (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1567 Blue Planet Ascends (2)
﻿﻿"The Legendary Emperors of ancient times… have all revived??"
"This, this, this…"
"Moreover, it's representing Dong Huang to kill everyone in the world competition??"
Who could tell them what was wrong with this world and why it was suddenly so suspenseful and strange?
…
On the island of the era ruins.
Shi Yu quietly waited here for Senior Emperor Shi to come out of seclusion. He was very worried that the other party would get lost and not be able to come out even if Blue Planet advanced.
If that was the case, it would be a complete loss. It was equivalent to losing countless sources of transcendence for nothing.
"God!! God!!"
"Shi Yu!! Shi Yu!!"
Shi Yu didn't know how long he had waited. Suddenly, Shorty spoke anxiously, and Qi also spoke.
"What's wrong?" Shi Yu sensed their strange emotions and was slightly stunned. He exited the time travel state and opened his eyes.
"I feel a trace of killing intent approaching us," Shorty said nervously. "It's a very weak but terrifying killing intent. At the moment, the other party shouldn't know that we've discovered it. I haven't alerted the enemy…"
"There's a guy who's very good at spatial stealth. He's hiding outside Blue Planet Space and watching us," Qi said. "Even I can't accurately determine the other party's location and can only sense the other party's existence."
"I only discovered it after Shorty reminded me. Otherwise, I couldn't have sensed the other party directly from such a distance, unless the other party approached us…"
"No way…" Shi Yu's eyelids twitched.
At this time, in such a place… If it were on World King Planet, Shi Yu wouldn't be surprised if Shorty and Qi sensed such an enemy.
However, this was Blue Planet. It was god knows how far away from World King Planet…
Shi Yu felt that only the Four Holy Family or the Four Holy Evolver individual cultivators could have such killing intent towards him. However, Shi Yu felt that it was extremely ridiculous for the other party to chase him to Blue Planet.
"Meow!!!!"
"Master, be careful!"
Before Shi Yu could think about it carefully, a black crack suddenly appeared behind Shi Yu. The crack was filled with a black crystal barrier that looked like broken glass. In the cracked space, a terrifying killing intent enveloped Shi Yu, instantly making Shi Yu's heart pound. He felt the threat of death.
At this moment, time seemed to have stopped. Shi Yu's hair was instantly smeared with pink, and his eyes turned into a cherry-like pink. He fused with Qi, and an Umbrella of Time appeared in his hand.
In the dark space, a sniper projectile appeared. It seemed to have crossed endless space. Fortunately, at the critical moment, Shi Yu opened the Time Umbrella and resisted the black shadow bullet. However, the huge impact of the bullet still instantly sent Shi Yu flying. He felt that the skeleton on his body seemed to have shattered.
A small bullet instantly pushed against the Umbrella of Time and sent Shi Yu flying hundreds of meters away. Seeing that the Umbrella of Time was about to be penetrated, Qi straightaway transported to other places with Shi Yu. As for the sniper bullet that had lost its target, it escaped into the void again!!
"Cough…" Shi Yu, who had appeared in another location, floated in the sky. He coughed up a mouthful of blood and looked at the being that walked out of the black spatial crack with an unfriendly gaze. It was a black shadow carrying a sniper rifle. In front of him were two purple vortex-like eyes.
As he appeared, Shi Yu realized that he had already been sealed in a dark space. If he wanted to contact the World Tree in the outside world, the Blue Planet's Will couldn't communicate and was obstructed from communicating.
Without saying a word, the assassin carried the sniper rifle and fired the same bullets at Shi Yu again. Although the power was a little weak this time, it was ten consecutive shots. Ten bullets aimed at Shi Yu from various tracks, directly making Shi Yu's hair stand on end.
"Don't come out." Shi Yu quickly gave Eleven and the others an order not to come out.
This assassin wasn't something Eleven and the others could deal with now. Even if he and Qi fused, they could only be suppressed. The other party was definitely a top expert among perfect gods.
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Flat!
Then, ten consecutive collision sounds sounded. Under the silent expression of the killer, a young man in armor was summoned by Shi Yu. He held a light sword and waved it as he flew over, instantly cutting through the ten bullets. When he arrived in front of the killer, the other party raised the sniper rifle and used the body of the gun to block. The light sword and the sniper rifle collided, and there was actually no winner in terms of strength.
[Master, this guy… is an assassin from Assassin Planet!] Ling quickly determined the other party's identity.
[Assassin Planet is a faction established by a super divine level assassin. It's an assassin organization and also the largest assassin organization in the universe. It doesn't belong to any of the five major cosmic-level factions. It's uttered that as long as you give enough money, you can even assassinate a super divine level assassin.]
[This guy is definitely an assassin from the Assassin Planet, and his ranking won't be low among the assassins on the Assassin Planet! It's very likely that he's in the top five or top three!]
[He actually came to Blue Planet…]
"This organization is something." At this moment, Shi Yu also gritted his teeth. What the f*ck kind of organization was this? Why did they f*cking come to Blue Planet? Did they know that there were five super divine Guardians on World King Planet, so they straightaway chose to come to Blue Planet to wait for them?
Break.
Shi Yu relied on Qi's power to easily break free from the restraints of the other party's Assassinate Space. He planned to contact the World Tree to kill him together!
"Mission failed." At this moment, he couldn't succeed. Seeing that Shi Yu had summoned a strange guy and easily cracked the Assassinate Space, the assassin didn't fight. He straightaway escaped back into the void and chose to escape, unwilling to continue the stalemate. In his opinion, it was already very difficult to assassinate Shi Yu under the obstruction of this armored monster. In that case, there was no reason to continue fighting on this Blue Planet. The risk was too high, and he would probably be unearthed by the Blue Planet's Will soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1568 Blue Planet Ascends (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1568 Blue Planet Ascends (3)
﻿﻿This King of Gods was actually so difficult to assassinate!
Buzz!
Beast Shi Yu used the light sword to smash the other party away. The other party disappeared, and its killing intent toward Shi Yu actually disappeared, making Shorty very surprised. Qi said, "Shi Yu, it ran away. It ran out of Blue Planet!"
"I know. Let's chase after it," Shi Yu said. "Qi, Ling, lock onto it, and don't let it escape."
However, before Shi Yu could take action, as the Assassinate Space completely shattered, a time freeze domain that stretched into the starry sky formed with a bang.
Under the time freeze domain, Shi Yu felt that although he could still think with his consciousness, his body immediately seemed to be out of control. In the next moment, Shi Yu heard a familiar voice.
"Since you're here, don't leave."
Accompanied by this voice, the Assassin Planet assassin, who had already left Blue Planet in the starry sky, had a shocked expression. Then, like Shi Yu, he was enveloped by the time freeze domain. His last thought was why this planet… also had a super divine!
Moreover, it was a time-element super divine that he couldn't understand.
As the last thought fell, his consciousness directly fainted. An invisible time arrow condensed out of thin air in the starry sky of the universe penetrated his chest and fell towards the Blue Planet again.
Boom!!!
This assassin from the Assassin Planet was directly nailed to a floating, shattered island. At the same time, the time-stop domain dissipated. Shi Yu looked in the direction of the voice and saw a familiar figure.
It was a tall, middle-aged man. The pattern of a starry sky dragon was embroidered on his black and gold robe. Under the surging golden waves at the corners of his robe, his sleeves fluttered high with the wind. His flying, long eyebrows raised slightly. The eyes below were like autumn water, cold stars, and pearls, sharp and oppressive.
"Senior Emperor Shi???" Shi Yu said in disbelief.
Who else could it be but Emperor Shi?
"We meet again." Emperor Shi looked at Shi Yu with energetic eyes and said, "Looks like you've caused quite a lot of trouble."
"Is he dead?" Shi Yu asked.
"Not yet, but it has already lost the ability to resist," Emperor Shi said quietly. "You've done well. I didn't expect Blue Planet to advance so quickly."
"Wait, hasn't Blue Planet advanced yet? How did you come out then?" Shi Yu was stunned.
"Blue Planet is still in the midst of advancing. After advancing, I'm 100% confident of walking out of the ruins, but in Blue Planet's current state, I can also be 90% confident of walking out. 90% is already 100% for me," Emperor Shi said.
"I remember that your name is Shi Yu, right?"
"After I sensed that you were in danger, I came out of the ruins in advance. However, I underestimated your strength. Even if I don't attack, you can still keep him here."
"Senior Emperor Shi, you flatter me. If you didn't attack, this kid would have run away." Shi Yu was stunned. "In that case, Senior Emperor Shi, you came out in advance for me?"
Shi Yu said, "Senior Emperor Shi, I love you to death."
Emperor Shi frowned. "How inappropriate."
"In addition, you don't have to be humble." Emperor Shi gazed at Shi Yu, who had recovered his black hair, and Beast Shi Yu, who was standing beside him. In the end, he said, "Assassin Planet…"
"Someone wants to use the Assassin Planet to kill you through this assassin."
"I've seen his memories."
Shi Yu nodded.
Emperor Shi said, "I think it's a strong enemy you provoked to upgrade Blue Planet. I previously know the location of the Assassin Planet. Are you interested in following me to destroy this Assassin Planet?"
Shi Yu: "?"
Shi Yu was stunned. "Senior Emperor Shi… You, you're serious?"
"This Assassin Planet is the number one assassin organization in the universe. It has a super divine assassin presiding over it."
"Most importantly, their battle power might not be the strongest, but their escape skills are definitely top-notch. Naturally, their assassin is also top-notch."
"Since I'm back, I naturally won't let the descendants of Dong Huang be threatened." Emperor Shi said, "You don't have to worry. No one can escape the restraints of time."
"Wait a minute, Senior Emperor Shi, how much source of transcendence did you obtain in the ruins of the era?" Shi Yu asked.
Emperor Shi glanced at Shi Yu and said, "Five."
"I used one for myself and one for each of the four time- element pets."
"…Five." Shi Yu fell into a deep silence, his heart twitching a little. In other words, Emperor Shi had four super divine level pets now? And they were all time-element pets?
He was also a super divine-level Beast Tamer!
Shi Yu almost cursed in his heart. This was f*cking invincible. No wonder Emperor Shi dared to say that he would destroy the Assassin Planet.
Five time-element super divines had no idea how to lose.
"Although I obtained a huge amount of resources, I additionally bear a portion of the karma." Emperor Shi said, "These few sources of transcendence were specially left behind by someone. It's just an accident that I could obtain them."
"They might have other uses."
"Five sources of transcendence, ruins of the era… Could it be…" When Shi Yu heard Emperor Shi's words, he immediately said, "Could it be that these five sources of transcendence were left behind from the last era on Earth and were specially cultivated to nurture five super divine humans…"
"Huh?" Emperor Shi gazed at Shi Yu and said, "Do you understand something?"
Shi Yu acknowledged and told Emperor Shi about his exploration of the Goddess Wa's Ruins.
After saying that, Emperor Shi revealed a thoughtful expression and said, "An era ruin that requires five human super divines to open… Was Blue Planet suspected to be at the cosmic level in the last era?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1569 Blue Planet Ascends (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1569 Blue Planet Ascends (4)
﻿﻿"Perhaps you're right. There are indeed many secrets on Blue Planet. These five sources of transcendence should have other missions…"
"However, they've already been used by me, so there's no other way." Emperor Shi said, "However, I'm indeed a little interested in the era ruins you mentioned."
"I'll bear this karma. Next, I'll protect Dong Huang's bloodline until Dong Huang gives birth to four other super divine level Beast Tamers."
"And before that, let the entire universe know of Dong Huang's existence and my existence. Let the entire starry sky know that not everyone can assassinate Dong Huang's Beast Tamer," Emperor Shi said domineeringly.
"The founder of the Assassin Planet is a super divine level life form, right… From the looks of it, it doesn't seem to be difficult to nurture four more super divine level Beast Tamers."
Shi Yu smiled bitterly. Senior Emperor Shi wanted to destroy the Assassin Planet and take the source of transcendence.
"Senior Emperor Shi, this is indeed a way to quickly obtain the source of transcendence, but we need to consider it at length. After all, the Assassin Planet is a faction living in the shadows. If we can't eliminate it completely, the threat might be greater."
"Yes." Emperor Shi nodded, indicating that he understood. He said, "Then why don't we start with the faction that entrusted them to assassinate you?"
Shi Yu was speechless.
It was indeed as Mu Huiyin had described. Emperor Shi was the most unrestrained. However, Shi Yu liked it. This time, he had a super backer! The Four Holy Family, climb!!
…
On World King Planet, the super divine experts of the five god races on Blue Planet had already received the news that Blue Planet was already in a promotion state and were collectively excited.
Pseudo source of transcendence!
With Blue Planet's foundation and aptitude, if it could advance, it could definitely give birth to a large number of pseudo sources of transcendence.
With this resource, they should be able to reach more than two realms.
Using Blue Planet as his territory, many years later, it wasn't impossible for it to even exceed 3.
A happy future was correct in front of him.
On World King Planet, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng were also guarding the permanent teleportation array, waiting for news and waiting to go over with the five super divines of Blue Planet.
"Hurry up, hurry up, or you won't be able to make it in time for the blessings!!" Apart from them, in the sky, two anxious figures were also rushing towards the Dong Huang Realm.
The owl and gem cat that had returned from the Astrologer Race were previously at the divine level. Among them, the owl had even recovered to the realm of a top-notch divine. It had already recovered most of the power of its previous life with the help of its family resources.
As for the gem cat, with the help of one-seventh of the inheritance of the Star Prayer Race and the gift of the Astrologer Race, it also reached the intermediate divine realm and raised the wishing star skill to the expert level in one go.
"Madam Tu Na, Madam Ying."
At this moment, seeing the return of the owl and Teacher Ying, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the others immediately welcomed them. The five super divines of Blue Planet had previously appeared at this moment, planning to meet Madam Tu Na. This guy… was actually the sister of the Astrologer Race patriarch. They still felt that it was ridiculous.
"Everyone, is Blue Planet going to rise?"
After arriving, these were Teacher Owl's first words.
"That's right. The mother planet is about to rise. Did Madam Tu Na previously predict it??" The five super divine beings on Blue Planet were pleasantly surprised. Even the Astrologer Race had predicted it, so it was definitely stable this time.
At the thought that they could harvest a large wave of resources soon, the five super divines on Blue Planet couldn't help but smile. Then, they couldn't help but look at the Space Emperor, who had made a bet with them… They didn't know how to lose at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 1570 Emperor Shi Appears (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1570 Emperor Shi Appears (1)
﻿﻿At the critical moment of Blue Planet's advancement.
The permanent teleportation array swayed. The gem cat and owl rushed over from World King Planet first.
"Are you sure?"
"When have I lied to you?"
The gem cat and the owl spoke one after another.
"Then I'll freeload." The gem cat girl took a deep breath.
At this moment, Blue Planet was still in the process of breaking through.
Although it was very smooth this time, Blue Planet had yet to completely break through.
At this moment, the gem cat made a prayer gesture with both hands and said, "I have a wish for Blue Planet's breakthrough to be successful!"
After making the wish, a gem luster flashed in the cat's eyes. The cat activated the power of the star.
In the words of the Prediction Owl, no matter how much help it could provide, it definitely wouldn't lose out by helping Blue Planet breakthrough!
"I'll do it too!" At this moment, the owl also chose to get involved.
Obviously, after recovering its power, it had recovered its previous skills.
Just Future Prediction wasn't enough for the astrologers to become the number one race in prediction.
"Fate has been decided!" The owl muttered, and a time hexagram flicker appeared in its eyes!
Fate had been decided. This skill needed to be used with Future Prediction!
Fate could be changed. If the owl predicted that a person would die of old age, but if Shi Yu ran to send this person a Fruit of Life, the other party wouldn't die of old age.
As for fate, it was a move that was very difficult to change.
In a predetermined state of fate, even if Shi Yu sent this person the Fruit of Life, it was still very likely that the other party would lose the power brought by the Fruit of Life due to some accident and quickly die of old age.
This was fate.
Every life had multiple fate lines. Those who predicted the future might not necessarily be accurate.
However, if it cooperated with the power established by fate, it would affect luck and the future, making it very difficult to change what was predicted.
In contrast, the owl also mastered the unchanged fate. It could allow the things it predicted to change according to its mood and affect the luck of the target from afar.
It was even stronger than the Wind Kirin Race's Blessing Wind.
After all, the Star Prayer Race and the Astrologer Race were both rare races born on the World King Planet, and the Wind Kirin was only a race born on the Blue Planet.
Although Blue Planet might have been very strong in its previous life, it had yet to reach the level of World King Planet in this life.
On World King Planet, the Prediction Owl had already predicted that Blue Planet would successfully break through. At this moment, if she strengthened Blue Planet's fate of breaking through again, although it would undoubtedly be useless as tits on a bull, she could more or less freeload a little credit.
As a life form born on Blue Planet, the owl's current body was also born on Blue Planet. If they helped Blue Planet breakthrough at this moment, the luck of a high-level planet could more or less be touched.
"Thank you, the two of you…" As the two cats muttered, on a huge rock beside them, the other World Tree clone guarding the teleportation array was a little speechless.
Why did they have to come at this time? They were also talents, and the others were originally looking forward to their strengths.
"You're welcome, you're welcome." The two cats looked at the World Tree clone with bright eyes.
"Where's Shi Yu??" Teacher Ying asked.
"Well… Shi Yu has gone to work. Why don't I send the two of you to a competition to kill time first?"
A moment later, the gem cat and owl were teleported to the World Tournament.
At this moment, the world competition was already coming to an end. The top four had already been decided.
They were Lu Qingyi, Wu Dong, Huang Xi, and Long Qingyun…
The top four were directly from Dong Huang, paralyzing the Blue Planet countries in the audience.
It was fine if it was Dong Huang's three ancient emperors, but Lu Qingyi… What was going on?
Lu Qingyi actually mastered more than ten strange special Beast Taming Talents. Although the pets weren't strong, in every battle, they relied on very dirty tactical tactics to suppress the opponent.
There were endless trump cards.
The contestants of the Dong Huang World Tournament who were in the same batch as Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and the others were just short of kneeling to watch the competition.
"Haha." Of course, Divine Source, President Lin, and the others also laughed excitedly.
This time, Dong Huang rose again.
However, the World Tree clone, who was the judge, pouted. Those contestants from Dong Huang could clearly get in through the back door and teleport away, but they insisted on competing to bully other countries. It was really annoying…
Look at the children of other countries, their mentalities were about to collapse.
…
"It's going to level up… It's really going to level up this time."
As the gem cat and the Prediction Owl returned and assisted Blue Planet, not long after…
Boom.
As the world trembled, a sound of laws that all life could hear spread throughout the entire world. The world of Blue Planet changed drastically, and countless amounts of natural energy spewed out of the ground.
The scale of the space that could be opened up on Blue Planet too instantly expanded by a hundred times, and it was still expanding.
The life on Blue Planet had experienced this change twice.
The first time was actually the first revival of laws on Blue Planet, and the second time was when Blue Planet was restored to become an intermediate-level star. And this time… it came again.
It was actually as if the very force was even greater, making all lives raise their heads in shock.
"So fast. As expected of us." At the very venue of the World Tournament, Inatella, the gem cat and owl holding potato chips and soda had happy expressions when they saw Blue Planet breakthrough not long after they finished assisting.
This was actually too delicious!
The first thing Blue Planet's breakthrough affected was actually the very natural resources in nature.
Countless spiritual plants, spiritual fruits, and resources instantly increased by one to two levels. Some plant lives too awakened their intelligence and turned into transcendent life forms.

chapters.title: Chapter 1571 Emperor Shi Appears (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1571 Emperor Shi Appears (2)
﻿﻿At the same time, it would at most affect elemental transcendent lives in natural environments… During this period, countless wind element sprites, grass element sprites, and water element sprites were born.
There were also elemental life forms of stronger races that had awakened in various parts of the world. They were new lives born after Blue Planet broke through.
At this moment, the experts could clearly sense the changes on Blue Planet. Even ordinary people felt like they had inhaled some miracle medicine when they breathed, making their bodies especially comfortable. The little pain and illness in their bodies slowly disappeared.
"Great." At that moment, in a certain mystic realm, the 10,000 divine-level experts who had been pulled over by the five divine races to work also stopped feeding Blue Planet.
They originally thought that they would have to work here for several years or decades before returning home, but no one expected Blue Planet's aptitude to be so terrifying. Not long after recovering from the Cultivationless Age's peak, it successfully broke through with help.
There weren't many high-level life planets in the entire universe. There wouldn't be more than 100.
And now, Blue Planet had undoubtedly become a super big boss.
And with such work experience, their resumes would be much better. Divine-level workers hugged and cried!
"From today onwards, I am a super divine planet." In the sky of Blue Planet and Inatella's teleportation array, Blue Planet's Will condensed. The incarnation of Blue Planet's Will that Shi Yu had seen previously appeared and descended again.
As she appeared, the permanent teleportation array began to fluctuate frequently.
The five super divines of Blue Planet who had turned into humanoid forms returned to Blue Planet and looked at Blue Planet's Will.
"Is this Mother Goddess?" This was the first time the five super divines of Blue Planet had returned to Blue Planet. They stared at the shining Blue Planet's Will and felt that the divine power fluctuations on Blue Planet's Will definitely far exceeded theirs.
If he really fought with a super divine level and fought locally, he would probably have strength above three.
At this moment, countless stars shone in the starry sky of Blue Planet, as if they were celebrating Blue Planet's advancement. Even the light of the sun seemed to be dimmed by Blue Planet, but there was an even stronger power of sunlight flowing to Blue Planet, as if the sun was offering its strength to congratulate Blue Planet.
Starlight flowed, and the sun and moon shone together. The Blue Planet's Will stood in the sky, and one, two, three… A total of 81 mysterious substances that flickered weakly lingered around her.
Seeing these mysterious substances, the five super divines on Blue Planet were extremely excited. Their hearts thumped, and their voices were almost hoarse.
Pseudo source of transcendence!
There were a total of 81. Just as it advanced, 81 pseudo sources of transcendence were born. This was also extremely rare in the starry sky of the universe. No, or rather, it had never happened.
Blue Planet's aptitude was even higher than the five super divines on Blue Planet imagined.
They only felt that they didn't carry out Blue Planet's breakthrough plan for nothing at all. This time, they had made a killing.
If these resources were given to them… their strength would have made huge progress. It would be conservative to even exceed 2!
However, although he was tempted, the five super divine beings on Blue Planet didn't rashly take it.
They all sensed the power of their home planet. In any case, these things were ultimately theirs, so there was no hurry. After all, this thing was useless to planetary life.
In the universe, a source of transcendence would automatically be created every once in a while. This was the key to advancing from divine to super divine!
As for planetary life forms, they were the only race that could directly absorb the origin of the universe to advance to super divine without using the source of transcendence. After they advanced, they had the ability to transform the origin of the universe into a pseudo source of transcendence.
The pseudo source of transcendence was useless to the planetary life form itself. It was a remnant product of cultivation, but for other super divine life forms, it was a key cultivation resource.
Apart from self-cultivation, the fastest way for super divine tier life forms to advance was to rely on the pseudo source of transcendence to strengthen the transcendence source that they had already absorbed and then undergo second and third transcendences… They would constantly become stronger. It could be uttered that this was the most efficient cultivation resource for super divine levels.
"Mother Goddess, kudos on breaking through." The five super divines on Blue Planet immediately sent congratulations.
At this moment, Blue Planet also looked in the direction of the five super divines, the Space Emperor, and Lin Feng.
"It's all thanks to you that I can break through. Next, I'll feedback to everyone with my current strength," Blue Planet said.
The five super divines on Blue Planet were overjoyed.
Wasn't this what he was waiting for?
Next, Blue Planet chose the most useless resource, the pseudo source of transcendence.
Planetary life forms were actually equivalent to producers in the universe. This should be the best thing planetary life forms could produce.
In the World King Planet, one of the reward mechanisms of the World King Planet also had a pseudo source of transcendence, but it basically needed to rely on battle merits to obtain it. The five super divines of Blue Planet who had never been to the battlefield naturally had never obtained it.
Their idea was that if the enemy exploded the real source of transcendence for the sake of the fake source of transcendence, wouldn't that be a huge loss?
But now, they finally didn't have to rely on the World King Planet. As long as they joined their mother planet, they had everything they wanted.
Although Blue Planet didn't produce as much pseudo source of transcendence as World King Planet, Blue Planet cultivated even fewer lives.
"Thank you, Mother Goddess, but I wonder how you scheme to distribute the source of transcendence?" The dragon super divine took a step forward and asked.
Blue Planet looked at the dragon super divine and said, "According to the distribution of merits, Shi Yu, Wang Kong, Lin Feng, and the five of you have contributed the most to my advancement. The source of transcendence should be distributed to everyone according to merits."

chapters.title: Chapter 1572 Emperor Shi Appears (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1572 Emperor Shi Appears (3)
﻿﻿"In that case… it's inappropriate." After pondering for a moment, the dragon super divine said, "We're all descendants born from the Mother Goddess. It's only natural for us to contribute to the Mother Goddess. How can we contribute?"
"Only super divine level life forms can refine the pseudo transcendent source of transcendence. Shi Yu, Wang Kong, and Lin Feng haven't reached the super divine level yet. It's useless to want the transcendent source of transcendence. In addition, Mother has just broken through. As a new high-level planet, she will definitely encounter many covetous eyes. At this moment, she needs a powerful force to protect and deter the thieves. Therefore, I think these pseudo transcendent sources should be used in a more reasonable place."
"Hand it to the life form with the strongest battle power on Blue Planet. The stronger the battle power, the more it's distributed. This way, the resources can be maximized, and we can avoid wasting them. We've actually discussed this with Wang Kong and Lin Feng. The most important thing now is to strengthen the top-notch battle power and help Blue Planet stabilize in the starry sky."
"That's right." The other four super divines on Blue Planet also nodded. Logically speaking, it was only distributed to super-divine levels. Why would Wang Kong, Lin Feng, and Shi Yu join in the fun? They couldn't refine it even if they were given it.
The Blue Planet's Will looked at Wang Kong and Lin Feng.
Emperor Kong said, "That's indeed what we discussed. It's better to hand the source of transcendence to a super divine level to maximize its use. Therefore, the criteria we discussed back then was to compete on the strength of the strongest battle power of the various races at various stages. Whichever race is stronger will distribute more resources. Only then can we quickly strengthen the power that can protect Blue Planet."
Blue Planet looked at the five super divines and said, "Do you really want to split it like this?"
The five super divines nodded and said, "The capable work more, and the strong gain more. Of course, Shi Yu, Wang Kong, and Lin Feng also contributed greatly to the advancement of the mother planet this time. We're willing to give up resources other than the pseudo source of transcendence and distribute most of them to humans, but it's more reasonable to leave the source of transcendence to us."
Blue Planet shook its head and said, "Have you really decided?"
"I've decided." The five super divines nodded. Five points for them was better than three more points.
"In that case, let's compete first. The super divine of the Dong Huang Human Race will compete with the seniors to decide the ownership of the source of transcendence." The Space Emperor smiled.
"But let me say this first. We can't hurt the harmony because of this. We're all from the same planet…"
"Yes." The dragon super divine nodded, but soon, it was slightly stunned.
Not only him, but the super divines of the other four divine races were also slightly stunned, wondering if they had heard wrongly.
Dong Huang's human super divine? What the hell?
They looked at the Space Emperor and Lin Feng in unison.
"Wang Kong, what do you mean? You mean that you and Lin Feng want to challenge us?" the dragon super divine said.
"I wouldn't dare." The Space Emperor chuckled and said, "Lin Feng and I are naturally not your match."
"However, who said that the Dong Huang humans don't have super divine bodies…"
As soon as the Space Emperor finished speaking, a voice sounded.
"I'm not late, right?" Shi Yu's voice sounded. As he teleported, he and another figure teleported to Inatella.
"Of course not."
At this moment, when they saw the black-robed man beside Shi Yu, Emperor Kong and Lin Feng were excited.
Emperor Shi… had indeed come out!
"Senior Emperor Shi!" Emperor Kong and Lin Feng cupped their fists at Emperor Shi at the same time and greeted him as a senior.
They observed curiously, this senior who created Dong Huang.
Everyone thought that Emperor Shi had died. Who would have thought that he would actually break through to super divine in the Cultivationless Age of Blue Planet?
As expected of Emperor Shi… Even the proud Emperor Kong and Lin Feng had to admit that, be it the past Dong Huang or the future Dong Huang, there were geniuses stronger than them.
"You guys… aren't bad." Emperor Shi nodded. When he saw the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, he seemed to have seen their lives. He laughed and said, "The Dong Huang I established is indeed filled with talents. Leave the rest to me."
Emperor Shi looked at Blue Planet in the sky, and Blue Planet also looked at Emperor Shi. The gazes of the two parties collided. Even Blue Planet couldn't help but sigh in its heart. This human super divine of Dong Huang had many opportunities and was so strong.
Emperor Shi's strength was probably even higher than that of Blue Planet's, who had just advanced. He had already exceeded the mother planet and was far from what the five ancient superdivines could compare to.
Although they were all lucky enough to obtain the source of transcendence, there was still a difference in strength.
"Who are you…"
At this moment, the five super divines of Blue Planet had long had serious gazes. They looked at the human beside Shi Yu and didn't know where this person came from. Emperor Shi's appearance undoubtedly put them under huge pressure.
This pressure reminded them of a person they had encountered when they first advanced to super divine.
That epoch god who had killed seven super divine beings in a row was currently the strongest Beast Tamer on World King Planet, the strongest human.
But… how was that possible?
"We're going to fight, right?" Emperor Shi said.
"Senior Emperor Shi, let's stop when it's time." Shi Yu, who was beside him, whispered to Emperor Shi, "Senior Emperor Shi, these five seniors are a little cowardly, but their natures aren't bad. We're all from the Blue Planet bloodline. They indeed made a lot of contributions to Blue Planet's breakthrough this time…"
"If everyone can labor together in the end, Blue Planet's future will definitely be better~"
"Alright." Emperor Shi looked at the five super divines of Blue Planet and said, "In that case, the five of you can strike together. If you win, you can take all those resources. I won't take any."
"If you lose, those supplies will all belong to me, but on account of your contribution to assisting the advancement of your mother planet, I'll still allocate a certain amount of resources to you according to your merits."

chapters.title: Chapter 1573 Emperor Shi Appears (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1573 Emperor Shi Appears (4)
﻿﻿"How is it?" Emperor Shi waved his hand, and his black robe fluttered. He stared at the five super divine beings with spirit in his eyes and said extremely confidently.
Under the heavens, all was the emperor's land, and within the four seas, all were the emperor's subjects. At this moment, the emperor earnestly observed the five super divines.
Although he liked to kill, that was against his enemy. As long as it was one of his own, he wouldn't be stingy.
"Are you crazy?"
"Wang Kong, Lin Feng, Shi Yu, what do you mean? Where did you find this strange person?"
"Can we stop fooling around?"
The five super divines of Blue Planet weren't in a good mood, but in the next moment, their expressions were slightly stunned.
A sea of stars phenomenon appeared in the sky behind Emperor Shi. Three sun-like sources of transcendence slowly rose from the sea of stars. As the three sources of transcendence rose, four summoning arrays of the color of the starry sky appeared around Emperor Shi.
Behind him, a black divine dragon slowly appeared. It seemed to have crossed endless space and time. When it appeared, a dazzling sun-like source of transcendence rose on the sea of stars-like summoning array.
"Roar!!!" The black dragon rose into the sky, and time seemed to have stopped.
Then, it was a transparent fish that seemed to have swam out of the river of time. Its image was strange and mysterious. It appeared and disappeared from time to time. Right on the heels of that, a time ferocious beast more than ten feet long with eyes like copper bells came and went like the wind. It was very difficult to find an accurate prototype of the animal world. It looked like a beast but wasn't. It was like the embodiment of a natural disaster as it slowly walked out.
One on the left and one on the right, accompanying Emperor Shi.
In the end, a sword that lingered with the power of time was pulled out of the summoning array in front of him by Emperor Shi. Every item summoned by Emperor Shi appeared accompanied by the source of transcendence phenomenon. Including itself, it was at transcendent 7. Such a scene instantly shocked the five super divine beings on Blue Planet.
"One, two, three, four… Four super divine beasts that have transcended once."
"One, two, three… A super divine level Beast Tamer who has transcended three times. This, this is impossible!!"
"Who exactly are you?" The five Blue Planet super divines took a step back and looked at Emperor Shi in shock.
In front of him, there were a total of five superdivine individuals, which meant that the Beast Tamer in front of him had obtained at least five sources of transcendence!!
Moreover, the most terrifying thing was that this Beast Tamer had actually transcended three times.
After a super divine level life form refined a source of transcendence, every time its life level increased, its source of transcendence would automatically replicate a copy. According to the number of transcendence sources, it could be seen that the superdivine life form had transcended a few times. This also directly represented strength.
For Beast Tamers, transcendent a few times meant how much strength they could strengthen their pets. A Beast Tamer who had transcended once could strengthen one of his sources of transcendence on his pets and let them obtain the strength of a super divine beast. If there were many pets, Beast Tamers could freely choose which pet to strengthen to the super divine level.
The current Emperor Shi had already reached transcendent 3, which meant that he could attach his three sources of transcendence to a certain pet at any time, allowing it to have the strength at the transcendent 4.
If he had other pets that had reached the top-notch divine level, he could also temporarily strengthen three more pets that transcended more than once. Including the four in front of him, there were a total of seven super divine beasts!
Seeing Emperor Shi's ridiculous configuration, the five super divines of Blue Planet were immediately stunned. They didn't understand where this person came from.
The most terrifying thing was that this person… including himself, every life form flowed with strong time power.
This Beast Tamer must be an expert in the time element. These pets must also be time-element life forms. Realizing this, the five super divine gods on Blue Planet were even more shocked. This was because the battle power of the time element was generally one level higher than other elements. Only then would it match the powerful and mysterious characteristics of the time element.
Terrifying. In their opinion, the person in front of them was a great terror and was extremely terrifying.
"I… am considered the founder of the Dong Huang Dynasty."
"You haven't answered me. What do you think of my suggestion just now?"
Seeing that the five super divines were shocked into silence for a long time, Emperor Shi frowned and waved the sword in his hand. The time-space here seemed to have been divided from Blue Planet and entered another world.
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng looked at this scene in a daze. They watched as the five super divines of Blue Planet, Emperor Shi, and the others disappeared from under their noses.
"Gulp." At this moment, this was the first time the Space Emperor and Lin Feng realized that Emperor Shi had the four super divine beasts and had even reached the realm of transcendent 3.
They originally thought that Emperor Shi was already strong enough as an ordinary time-element super divine. At least, he could let Dong Huang stand firm under the pressure of the five super divines and get a share of the source of transcendence. This was enough, but they didn't expect Emperor Shi to directly display the strength to fight the five super divines alone!
"Unbelievable," Lin Feng said.
Emperor Kong said, "Senior Emperor Shi, this… what ridiculous level is this?"
Shi Yu shrugged and said, "How would I know? It's alright."
Shi Yu estimated that it would take a long time for him to surpass Emperor Shi at this level. However, the stronger Emperor Shi was now, the more comfortable his development would be. Not bad.
"It's impossible to find." At this moment, Blue Planet's Will actually didn't want to see internal strife, but it also knew that if they didn't fight, there would definitely be people who were dissatisfied with Blue Planet's resources, no matter how they divided them.
However, to Blue Planet's surprise, Emperor Shi's ability was so strong that he could actually cut through space and time alone, making the aftermath of a super divine level battle completely unable to affect Blue Planet.
What power…
In another time space.
The five super divines looked at the surrounding environment in panic. Then, they looked at Emperor Shi in front of them and said, "What exactly are your intentions? We… don't want to fight you."
"If you don't fight, how can you admit defeat?" Emperor Shi shook his head.
As Shi Yu had said, these five super divines… needed to be guided.
Otherwise, they couldn't display all their super divine level and strength at all.
"…" The five super divines cursed in their hearts. This was equivalent to seven super divines in single body, and they were all time-element. What was the point of fighting?
The quintuple super divines understood that they couldn't defeat it even if they thought about it.
This person was ridiculous. Initially, they thought that the Space Emperor and Lin Feng of Blue Planet were already monsters, but they didn't expect Shi Yu to appear later. They originally thought that Shi Yu might be the majority talented human on the Blue Planet, but where did this guy named Emperor Shi come from?
He was so powerful that even if they joined forces, they were a little afraid.
They had fallen into a trap!
The quintuple super divines were sad. They immediately understood the intention of the Space Emperor to discuss with them the power of their race to divide the resources.
It turned out that there was still a super expert waiting here for the Dong Huang humans.
But the previous Blue Planet was clearly in the Cultivationless Age. They had also been watching the teleportation array. Where did this monster super divine come from? This didn't make sense!
In short, although they didn't know where Emperor Shi came from, they understood that it wasn't that easy to obtain Blue Planet's resources.
"Fight me. Whether you win or lose, you can obtain the source of transcendence," Emperor Shi said.
However, the more Emperor Shi said this, the more panicked and afraid the quintuple super divines became. They felt that this strange person was completely confident of victory.
"Let's go! We can't give up because of this, right!!" The super divine of the Demon Race said, "I didn't expect the five of us to have a chance to join forces again."
It was the first to attack. The phantom of the source of transcendence, which was like the sun, rose behind it. The demon claw crossed space, and its battle power was fully released. The demon claw emerged from behind Emperor Shi and proceeded straight for its heart, but in an instant, it touched the phantom as if it had been emptied.
"Are you… sure we're on the same timeline now?" Emperor Shi said. Under the incredulous gaze of the super divine of the Demon Race, under the constricted pupils of the other quartet super divines, he attacked!
Boom!!!
The timeline flux instantly swallowed everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1574 Blue Planet's First Group Construction Event (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1574 Blue Planet's First Group Construction Event (1)
﻿﻿In the outside world.
Shi Yu and the others waited obediently.
It was unknown how long the super divine battle would take.
However, to the surprise of the Space Emperor and the others…
Not much time passed at all before the time-space shattered. Emperor Shi and the others came out of the alternate space with the five super divines of Blue Planet. At this moment, the five super divines of Blue Planet were all heavily injured and had stunned gazes.
As for Emperor Shi, although he also sustained some injuries, they were almost negligible.
"No way, it's been less than a minute and it's over??"
"So short?" Lin Feng was shocked when he saw them come out.
As Lin Feng finished speaking, the hearts of the five super divines on Blue Planet trembled again. They couldn't believe it, because they had clearly fought for several days in that alternate space and time. How could it be less than a minute?
"You guys can admit defeat."
On the other side, Emperor Shi was expressionless. In order to move his rusty body, he had finally found a suitable opponent to fight in this battle. He had indeed fought for a longer time, but he was worried that he would waste too much time on the outside world, so he could only do this.
It made the battle space and the outside space flow at different times.
"You…"
Upon hearing Lin Feng and the others' words in the outside world, they felt that the flow of time in the outside world was indeed different from the space just now. The defense in the hearts of the five super divines on Blue Planet completely collapsed.
Looking at Emperor Shi again, they felt the difference in strength between heaven and earth.
At this moment, they felt that even those monster super divines from the Four Holy Family were definitely not a match for the person in front of them.
The five super divines were silent. They knew that they had been completely schemed against by the Space Emperor, but Emperor Shi's strength made them unable to refute anything.
Because they were certain that Emperor Shi definitely had the ability to kill them.
"Mother Goddess, can you give them each five pseudo sources of transcendence?" Emperor Shi looked at the Blue Planet's Will.
"Yes," Blue Planet's Will said when it heard Emperor Shi's request. It took out 25 of the 81 sources of transcendence and distributed them to the five super divines on Blue Planet.
As the pseudo sources of transcendence landed, the five super divines of Blue Planet took a deep breath.
After receiving the sources of transcendence, the five super divines on Blue Planet said in unison, "We're willing to admit defeat. You're stronger than us, so we'll listen to you."
"That's good." Emperor Shi laughed and said, "I won't take any of the remaining sources of transcendence either. I've contributed nothing to Blue Planet's advancement, so I won't take these resources. Shi Yu, Wang Kong, Lin Feng, you guys take it yourselves. As for the rest, I suggest that whoever makes greater contributions to Blue Planet in the future can distribute them. What do you think?"
"I have no objections," the Space Emperor and Lin Feng said.
"Same." Shi Yu nodded.
The five super divines of Blue Planet looked at Emperor Shi in surprise. They didn't expect this person to be so reasonable… He had contributed nothing to Blue Planet's advancement, but he didn't take a single source of transcendence. The five super divines who originally had some complaints in their minds were slightly less resentful now.
They also understood that Emperor Shi's action was to bribe people, but the other party was stronger and was willing to share, so they couldn't say anything.
Five pseudo sources of transcendence… had already made up for their losses. Although it was less than expected, in essence, they had earned a little.
… Although that was the case, the five super divines still sensed stifled.
Looking at Emperor Shi, Shi Yu, and the others, they also sensed that these people were demons in human skin, even more demonic than the demons.
"Forget it, I won't take it for the time being. Let's talk about it after I advance to super divine," the Space Emperor said.
"Me too." Lin Feng shrugged. It was indeed as the five super divines on Blue Planet had said. They weren't super divines yet, so it was useless for them to want this.
Of course, just because they didn't want it now didn't mean that they couldn't use it in the future. They would save it first.
"Cough, cough, give me one!" Only Shi Yu was different.
Blue Planet: "…"
The five super divines, Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, and Lin Feng: "…"
"I like to study… I want to study it." Shi Yu laughed and said, "One portion is enough. I'll tell you again when I lack more."
Beast Shi Yu's physical level was at the super divine level. At this moment, Shi Yu was wondering if the pseudo source of transcendence could be used to strengthen Beast Shi Yu… If it was used for experiments, one was temporarily enough.
If it could be strengthened, it would be the same with Blue Planet later.
At this moment, out of the 81 sources of transcendence, the Blue Planet human only received one, and the five super divines each took five, so there were still 55 sources of transcendence left. For a moment, the five divine races on Blue Planet sighed.
They felt that they had to do their best to develop Blue Planet in the future. Otherwise, these 55 sources of transcendence would be wasted.
The current situation made their minds itch even more than if all the sources of transcendence were taken away by humans.
They gazed at Blue Planet in unison, like children waiting for their elders' lollipops, as if they were waiting for Mother Goddess's mission… They wanted to know what quests needed to be completed to obtain the reward.
"So, seniors, are we still fighting?" Lin Feng said. "The other resources, such as territory, haven't been divided yet. Now that Blue Planet has advanced, everyone definitely has to move a portion of their businesses back to Blue Planet to develop, right?"
The five super divines on Blue Planet gazed at Lin Feng with dark expressions.
Fight my ass!
Among the divine levels of the five major divine races, probably no one could defeat the Space Emperor and Lin Feng.
They couldn't defeat the super divine level, nor could they defeat the divine level. The five divine races on Blue Planet were directly crushed by the humans.
The few super divines' mentalities exploded. They sensed that it was a little different from what they had imagined at the start.
"Then, the eastern hemisphere of Blue Planet will belong to Dong Huang, and the western hemisphere of Blue Planet will belong to everyone. How about that?" the Space Emperor said with a smile.
"Sure." The five super divines on Blue Planet were unable to refute. Compared to splitting it according to battle power, they were still at an advantage in this kind of division.

chapters.title: Chapter 1575 Blue Planet’s First Group Construction Event (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1575 Blue Planet's First Group Construction Event (2)
?"That's good." Emperor Shi was especially happy. After he was trapped in the ruins, his greatest obsession was that he couldn't unify Blue Planet and only liberated the east. And now, the god who occupied the west had also been defeated by him. Emperor Shi's only obsession now was to let Dong Huang walk out of Blue Planet.
"Next, I hope we can cooperate with all our might," Emperor Shi said. "Now, Blue Planet, a one-star super divine, should be an extraordinary faction in the starry sky of the universe, right?"
Adding up the super divines of the five divine races, Emperor Shi's five super divines, and Blue Planet's Will's one super divine… One planet had 11 super divines.
However, it wasn't just 11 super divines. As a Beast Tamer who reached transcendent 3, Emperor Shi was basically equivalent to 3 super divines.
This was equivalent to a single planet having 13 super divines. In addition… when considering Beast Shi Yu, whose body was super divine, Blue Planet could barely be said to be one planet with 14 super divines.
There was also Goddess Wa, whose level was unknown… If she was also a super divine, it would be one planet with 15 super divines.
In the entire universe, only the five cosmic-level factions could compare. The current Blue Planet could already openly announce that it was the sixth major faction in the universe.
At that moment, when they heard Emperor Shi's words, the five super divines on Blue Planet were also stunned. They suddenly felt the horror of the current power of Blue Planet.
In the past, including them, although the Blue Planet had many super divines, they still lacked powerful super divine battle power. But now, the appearance of Emperor Shi completely broke this situation.
Emperor Shi, who was an expert in the time element, was definitely invincible among the super divine levels, apart from a few peak super divine monsters.
"Of course. Let's work together and look down on everyone in the starry sky." At this moment, the five super divines on Blue Planet could basically ensure that sometimes, with the emperor around, other invaders didn't dare come to Blue Planet to snatch their meat to eat.
When a strong enemy came, sometimes, Emperor Shi would block it, but Emperor Shi was still so easy to talk to. Thinking of this, the five super divines on Blue Planet suddenly felt that it wasn't a loss. They would just treat it like finding a bodyguard.
"Then, how about everyone follow me and descend to the Assassin Planet?" Emperor Shi said.
"Assassin Planet?" The Space Emperor said, "What's wrong with Assassin Planet?"
Emperor Shi looked at Shi Yu, who said, "Not long ago, an assassin from the Assassin Planet appeared on Blue Planet and assassinated me. It's all thanks to Emperor Shi appearing in time…"
"What?" The pupils of the five super divines on Blue Planet were constricted. They didn't expect that someone would actually hire an assassin from Assassin Planet.
"This?!" Lin Feng was shocked. "Shi Yu, are you alright?"
Emperor Shi said, "He's fine. Fortunately, I appeared. Otherwise, the fleeing assassin would have been chased and killed by him."
Everyone: "?"
Emperor Shi said, "I've searched his memories. He's an assassin ranked fourth on the Assassin Planet. His name is Dark Vortex. He was teleported to the vicinity of Blue Planet through a'magnetic path' mystic technique. This is a mystic technique unique to the Assassin Planet. Only a few specific assassins can use it."
Magnetic path…
This was a teleportation skill. It could give coordinates to a certain person and then teleport close to him, no matter where he was.
When cultivated to the extreme, one could even lock onto the other party's location with a portable item abandoned by a person and teleport over a long distance. The further away the two parties were, the greater the consumption.
"Shi Yu, remember to take good care of your personal items," the Space Emperor said. "It's not a good thing to be targeted by the Assassin Planet."
"On the Assassin Planet, there's a Teleportation Master who has mastered a magnetic-element divine skill. He's very terrifying. If you're targeted by him, you won't be able to escape, unless… you have absolute strength."
Shi Yu said, "I understand. My disobedient pets must have thrown things around and been locked onto…"
In Shi Yu's Beast Taming Space, his pets chattered.
It expressed that someone must have locked onto Baby Ginseng through the Cultivation Fruit and Reincarnation Fruit sold by Baby Ginseng and indirectly locked onto Shi Yu.
Baby Ginseng: "?"
"But there's actually such a skill." At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly wanted to destroy the Assassin Planet. Firstly, it was too dangerous. He kept feeling that someone could threaten him at any time. Secondly, this ability sounded too good.
"If you want to transport from the Assassin Planet to the vicinity of the Blue Planet, the distance is so far. You can't even support it by consuming the financial resources of the Floating Realm. The person who wanted to assassinate you must have paid a huge price. Only the Four Holy Family has this financial resources," the Space Emperor said.
"Everyone," Sovereign Shi said. "So are you willing to follow me to destroy this Assassin Planet?"
"Next, the Blue Planet lineage will use this Assassin Planet to establish their might. It's the most suitable. If anyone dares offend the Blue Planet lineage, how can the geniuses of Blue Planet dare wander freely in the starry sky of the cosmos in the future?" Emperor Shi said.
"Moreover, the culprit behind hiring them is the super divine group on the World King Planet, right? If I'm not wrong, wanting to launch a super divine battle on the World King Planet is a very testing matter of public opinion pressure, but if we can obtain decisive evidence that the other party wants to assassinate Shi Yu on the Assassin Planet, no matter what, it's perfectly justified for us to attack them."
"That makes sense, that makes sense…" The five super deities on Azure Sphere were numb. It wasn't enough to provoke the Four Holy Family, they also had to provoke the Assassin Planet.
However, when he thought of how there were more than ten super deities on his side, there was only one super divine killer opposite him… What was there to be afraid of?
The most powerful aspects of the super divine of the Assassin Planet were Stealth, Assassination, and Evacuation. However, were these a problem in front of time-element super divines?
In fact, the Assassin Planet didn't do just anyone's business. If they hired the Assassin Planet to assassinate top-notch talents of the cosmic overlord army, the Assassin Planet would definitely offer a super high price to persuade the hirer to leave, because they couldn't afford to offend the cosmic overlord army.

chapters.title: Chapter 1576 Blue Planet's First Group Construction Event (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1576 Blue Planet's First Group Construction Event (3)
﻿﻿Since the Assassin Planet dared to take on Shi Yu's business, it meant that the Assassin Planet didn't take Shi Yu seriously, didn't take the Blue Planet bloodline seriously, and didn't take the faction behind Shi Yu seriously. This was something Emperor Shi couldn't accept.
In that case, using the Assassin Planet to establish might on Blue Planet was indeed most suitable if it succeeded.
"Money…" Also, the Assassin Planet was definitely rich. The five super divines who had just thrown their assets on Blue Planet were immediately envious.
"He actually dared try to assassinate Shi Yu. This is too much. He simply doesn't take the five of us seriously," the Kirin Race's super divine said. "Assassin Planet should be destroyed!"
"It deserves to be destroyed!" the super divine of the Demon Race also said.
"Are we really going to do it?" Shi Yu suddenly became excited as he listened. Forget it, so be it!
"Then it's decided." Emperor Shi laughed and said, "Next, we can use that to go to the World King Planet, right? Shi Yu, you'll be the bait later. Let's see how many fish we can catch first before destroying the Assassin Planet. How about that?"
"You should have… offended many enemies, right?"
"Blue Planet and Dong Huang are in an important development period. It would naturally be best if someone could take the initiative to send resources."
"I see." The Space Emperor and Lin Feng were also excited. Emperor Shi wasn't bad. The last time the two of them assassinated a super divine was the last time. Could they finally hunt super divines again this time?
"In that case, let's do something big," Shi Yu said.
At this moment, under the persuasion of the group of lunatics from Dong Huang's lineage, the five cowardly gods of Blue Planet felt like they had been taken for a ride, but it seemed like there was nothing they could do.
As for Blue Planet's Will, who was watching them the whole time, it sighed deeply.
It looked like it was impossible for Blue Planet to want peaceful and stable development.
The humans of Dong Huang seemed to have a restless heart.
…
Soon, Shi Yu and the others discussed it. However, before setting off, be it Emperor Shi or the five super divines, they had to recover their strength first.
After being locked in the ruins for so long, they had just come out and had a high-intensity battle. Emperor Shi had consumed a lot of energy and needed to recover for a period of time. As for the five super divines, they also hoped to refine the pseudo sources of transcendence before taking revenge.
As for Shi Yu, there was even less of a need to talk about him. He also wanted to strengthen Beast Shi Yu.
Everyone went their separate ways, but they still chose to cultivate bitterly on Blue Planet. Blue Planet had just broken through, and this was the moment when it had the richest energy.
Before Shi Yu left Inatella, he teleported to the World Tournament and found the gem cat and owl.
"Heh," Shi Yu said. He originally wanted to scare them, but he received the disdainful gazes of the two cats.
Teacher Owl said, "Buggy's lousy spatial teleportation ability can't scare us."
"I sensed you during your teleportation. Crack." The gem cat ate a potato chip.
Shi Yu: "?"
Shi Yu understood now. He wouldn't let Buggy teleport next time. He would let Qi do it.
Buggy: "?"
Qi: "Alright!"
"Blue Planet broke through," Shi Yu said. "You already know, right?"
"Yes, yes, yes." The two cats nodded and said, "The world competition happens to be over."
"Senior Lu is so miserable. Fourth place. I've already made a wish for her to win the championship, but she still lost. She's too disappointing," the gem cat girl said. "But to be ranked only behind the three Legendary Emperors, it's already not bad for her age."
"Indeed, with some more training, we should be able to achieve pretty good results even in the God Sealing Battle," the Prediction Owl said. "Little Qingyi's luck isn't bad. She has the aptitude of an expert. It's almost just an opportunity. It won't be inferior to Captain Zi Jian's achievements."
"Are you here to watch the competition or Blue Planet's breakthrough?" Shi Yu was speechless. "In the future, our Blue Planet's bloodline will organize a team building exercise. I think the two of you are pretty capable. Let's go together."
Although he felt that the team configuration was very stable, Shi Yu didn't recommend having more wishing cats and premonition cats to increase safety.
If it really didn't work, he could still let them predict where the other party's treasures were hidden and wish for the drop rate of the sources of transcendence for the super divines to be higher…
"What team building?" The eyes of the wishing cat and the Prediction Owl lit up. They felt that there would be a lot of delicious food.
"Go and fight the number one assassination faction in the universe, Assassin Planet. Our Blue Planet's experts will form a team."
The gem cat and the Prediction Owl's faces fell.
Are you alright? You call this team building? "What's there to be afraid of? More than ten super divines went to raid the house together. Just standing there is enough to scare the other party to death. Don't be afraid, even I'm slacking off with you guys this time. With a big boss leading the way, we can just pick up the equipment."
"Meow, meow, meow???" The gem cat was stunned.
"Meow, meow, meow, meow?" The Prediction Owl was also stunned.
"Meow my ass," the gem cat said angrily. "You're an eagle, not a cat."
"We, the astrologers, aren't eagles!" Teacher Tu Na said angrily. "I have the right to speak freely!"
"Alright, alright," Shi Yu said. "I'll tell you in detail!"
…
Shi Yu's nest.
After tricking the two cats into joining the team, Shi Yu immediately ran back to strengthen Beast Shi Yu. He had completely forgotten that he had gone to Inatella to cheer for Senior Lu.
Shi Yu took out Beast Shi Yu and the fake source of transcendence given by the Blue Planet's Will. He took a deep breath.
Then… he fell into deep thought.
He and Beast Shi Yu looked at each other and fell into deep thought.
"Ordinary super divine level life forms absorb the fake source of transcendence through their true source of transcendence. However, although Beast Shi Yu's body is super divine, he doesn't have any extraordinary power in his body at all, nor does he have the source of transcendence. How can he absorb this…"
Shi Yu looked at the sun-like light ball locked in the crystal and fell into deep thought.
"Wuuu…" In the Beast Taming Space, pets walked out one after another to think of a way for Shi Yu.
"Yi. (Eat.)" Baby Ginseng was the first to say. There were no resources that couldn't be solved with food.
"Ning!" Susu felt that it made sense.
"Let's see if we can press it in through the chest. Isn't the main body of the source of transcendence a ball of light?" Ling said.
"Sob." Eleven expressed that it could also let its mental clone carry it and own it.
"Ji." Buggy expressed that it could try to transfer into its body.
"Let's try them one by one. Let's start with the safest and most reliable one," Shi Yu said. "Let's listen to Ling first and use the massage."
Shi Yu removed the armor for Beast Shi Yu and slowly pressed it on Beast Shi Yu with the source of transcendence like CPR.
As Shi Yu pressed down… As many pets swallowed their saliva, the source of transcendence was slowly pressed into their bodies…
In the next moment, the source of transcendence was stably fixed in its body. Under Shi Yu's observation, it kept shrinking, like a white halo inner core. It really became one with its body.
Boom!!
Under its nurturing, the entire body of Beast Shi Yu emitted a faint halo. This was the first time Beast Shi Yu had a phenomenon himself.
Suddenly, Beast Shi Yu's aura rose by a level. Shi Yu felt that Beast Shi Yu's physical strength had become stronger. He couldn't help but open his mouth slightly.
"Holy sh*t. This guy… can really do it. Its body is like a real source of transcendence. It can intake pseudo sources of transcendence!!"
Beast Shi Yu also quickly jumped up and clenched his fists. Immediately, thunder rumbled. Although he sensed that his power hadn't increased much and there were no qualitative changes, perhaps the pseudo source of transcendence wasn't enough, Shi Yu was certain that there was indeed an increase!
Shi Yu was shocked. "I understand. In any case, you can enhance your power by adding points. It's a waste to give you the pseudo source of transcendence. Just give it to Beast Shi Yu in the future."
Eleven and the other pets: Wu wu wu???
Ahhh, it was completely inhumane.
…
A few days later.
Shi Yu returned to the World King Planet again. As he was about to cause trouble, before he was done, the World Tree didn't open the World King Planet passage to the people who passed the World Tournament. It planned to wait for this group of reckless people to finish.
Otherwise, it was worried that this group of newbies would have to withstand pressure that they shouldn't withstand at this level as soon as they passed.
After returning to the World King Planet, the first thing Shi Yu did was to start the live broadcast.
Name of the live stream: "King of Gods Shi Yu is broadcasting a trip to witness the beautiful environment of the starry sky (dog head)."

chapters.title: Chapter 1577 - 1577: Blue Planet’s Cultural Promotion Ambassador (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1577 - 1577: Blue Planet’s Cultural Promotion Ambassador (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios       Editor: Atlas Studios
When Shi Yu started broadcasting, he didn’t receive any attention at the start.
After all, this was his first time. His account didn’t receive much attention. However, as the gem cat rewarded him with a gift, the livestream instantly became lively. They were all attracted by Shi Yu’s title.
“It’s really him?” The audience who entered the livestream could see a huge space center. Inside, a completely silver-white cosmic battleship landed on the arena. A group of pets was like a tourist group, taking photos outside the battleship as a memento.
Apart from the familiar King of Gods, Shi Yu, Eleven… the ginseng emperor… Chi Tong… These familiar God Sealing Battle contestants were all on the scene. It was strange. It was actually Shi Yu t s main body. He was leaving World King Planet to travel?
Moreover, it was a live broadcast trip?
With Shi Yu’s current reputation, starting a live broadcast could indeed earn him a lot. However, as the new King of Gods and the owner of the era ruins, Shi Yu didn’t look like he was short of money now, right?
The purple-skinned holey person of the Star Refining Race, the son of the
Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, the Cosmic Crow, Zavay, and the Beast Tamer, Ming Gu… A bunch of people who paid attention to Shi Yu opened the livestream to see what Shi Yu was up to.
“There are already so many people?” Shi Yu looked at the little robot that Ling had split out and looked at the screen data and comments. “Hello, everyone. I’m Shi Yu, the strongest, most handsome, and most powerful Beast Tamer, Shi Yu.’
The comments spammed the word “shameless”.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Pay attention to your manners. I saw a few people scolding me. I’ll track you down on the Internet and visit you another day. 1 still have this ability. Don’t forget that I don’t have any morals.”
“My mechanical assistant has divine-level intelligence. It can lock onto your coordinates now and invade your network…”
A bunch of low-intelligent comments instantly disappeared from the comments. When they thought of how the top-notch Green Dragon Divine Gold Chamber had only released killing intent at Shi Yu before being directly killed by Shi Yu, these spectators, who only knew how to talk excitedly felt cold all over.
[Shi Yu, what are you doing? Touring? Where are you going?] At this moment, an unknown bullet screen occupied a conspicuous position. This was because were many spectators on World King Planet. In order to have a good bullet screen experience, no matter what bullet screen was sent, it needed money. It blocked 99-99% of the freeloaders. For this bullet screen to be so conspicuous, it was obvious that it had spent a lot of money.
“I almost forgot about business…” Shi Yu said, “Just a few days ago, I encountered an assassin…
“l wonder if it’s out of jealousy of my talent, or because it wants to get rid of one of my pets, or because of the Four Holy Ruins.”
“However, this assassin is also a coward. He only dares to assassinate me when I’m alone. It’s meaningless to escape immediately after failing the assassination.”
“Therefore, I want to give the person who wants to assassinate me a chance. I’ll go on a trip and guarantee, with my integrity, personality, and the honor of the King of Gods, that I definitely didn’t bring any bodyguards. It’s just us.
You’re welcome to come and assassinate us.’
After Shi Yu finished speaking with a smile, the entire audience in the livestream was stunned. The audience behind the screen opened their mouths slightly and found it unbelievable.
Holy sh*t, Shi Yu was so arrogant. Moreover, how could he be so straightforward? He didn’t even hide it and directly said it. Even if he wanted to bait the assassins, he didn’t need to do it like this.
“Why don’t I f*cking believe it?” Moreover, at this moment, Shi Yu used his integrity and personality to guarantee that he definitely didn’t bring any bodyguards. Most of the audience didn’t even believe these words. Shi Yu himself had said that he didn’t have any morals. How could he believe these words?
“Alright, it’s time to set off soon. Welcome to the livestream, everyone. On this starry sky trip, apart from seeing if anyone else wants to assassinate me, I indeed want to see the scenery of the Cosmic Sea.”
“Actually, the Exposing King is right about one thing. I’m indeed a newbie who just came to World King Planet from a border galaxy. I’ve never appreciated the beauty of the starry sky, so this time… since the universe is so big, 1 want to take a look.”
“Apart from that, during this process, apart from admiring the starry sky, I will also introduce the situation in my hometown to everyone,” Shi Yu sighed.
With that said, he boarded the cosmic battleship with Eleven and the others, who were carrying backpacks and a pile of snacks.
“Wu wu wu…” Eleven waved at the audience.
Soon, the content mentioned by the Starry Sky punisher, Shi Yu, quickly spread, increasing the number of people in the livestream. Countless spectators wanted to see if someone really wanted to assassinate the King of Gods.
Of course, Shi Yu’s actions also made a bunch of people’s heads bigger. After the Environmental Protection Association, God Bing Ling, heard Shi Yu’s actions, she silently opened Shi Yu’s livestream. At this moment… the cosmic battleship Shi Yu and the others were on, Ling, had already left World King Planet and entered the Cosmic Sea.
“Is it the Abyss Race or the Four Holy Family?” God Bing Ling was slightly stunned. During this period of time, she had indeed ignored Shi Yu. However, because the Environmental Protection Association was too busy, in a certain star area, the Dark King Army invaded on a large scale. The pressure on the Environmental Protection Association was very huge now, making her unable to care about Shi Yu. However, who knew that in the blink of an eye, Shi Yu
would play so big?
“He’s baiting the assassins?” Bing Ling naturally didn’t believe that Shi Yu was alone. She judged that Shi Yu had probably brought Wang Kong, Lin Feng, and Blue Planet along with him, planning to carry out an open conspiracy to lure them.. Of course, Bing Ling didn’t think that the assassin would be so stupid as to really assassinate him at this stage..

chapters.title: Chapter 1578 Blue Planet’s Cultural Promotion Ambassador (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1578 Blue Planet's Cultural Promotion Ambassador (2)
