?While the situation on the Environmental Protection Association's side was happening, the plant association, the Space Disaster Research Institute, the 177th Fleet, Zi Jian's special forces, and other places with many big shots came to the same conclusion as Bing Ling. They didn't believe that Shi Yu would court death.
Shi Yu had most likely prepared some powerful trump cards to wait for the arrival of the assassin. Whether the assassin would arrive depended on the determination of the person who wanted to assassinate Shi Yu.
The Green Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermillion Bird domains, the super divine mystic realm of the Four Holy Families, and the Four Holy super divines met again in a long time. The shadows of the Four Holy Families floated in the void, and the Vermillion Bird super divine sent a question. "Green Dragon, what assassin did you hire? Why did you fail?"
The Green Dragon super divine frowned and said, "The assassins ranked in the top five of the Assassin Planet all have the experience of successfully assassinating a target and retreating unscathed under the gaze of a super divine level. The Assassin Planet also knows all the information about Shi Yu's guardian. Despite all that, they still failed the assassination. I also want to know what's going on."
"Now, Shi Yu is undoubtedly provoking us…" the White Tiger super divine said.
The Green Dragon super divine said, "I'll pressure the Assassin Planet. The contract between me and Siphane is to not rest until death. If we fail once, the Assassin Planet has to carry it out a second and third time until it succeeds."
"However, Shi Yu's behavior this time is clearly baiting us. The Assassin Planet shouldn't act rashly. Instead, it will choose to assassinate Shi Yu when he's most negligent. This time… let this King of Gods be arrogant for a period of time. It's not appropriate for us to show our faces."
In the Astrologer Race, the Exposing King, Patriarch Tu, revealed a puzzled expression in a small black room.
"Holy sh*t." It was shocked because it actually couldn't predict the trajectory of Shi Yu and the others' trip.
There seemed to be a fog in the future. This wasn't the first time Exposing King Tu Tu had encountered such a situation…
"Could it be that they encountered some powerful killer?"
"Could it be that guy made a move??" The Exposing King Tu Tu thought of a certain guy, the founder of the Assassin Planet, the super divine level assassin, Siphane.
Although he was only an assassin who had transcended three times, he had the experience of successfully assassinating a super divine level twice. The Assassin Planet he created was also infamous, making people tremble in fear in the Cosmic Sea.
Just like the Exposing King, there were also many super divine experts who really wanted to kill Siphane. However, no one knew his or the Assassin Planet's location at all. No one could find them at all.
It could be said that the super divine killer, Siphane, was even more hated than the Exposing King. The Exposing King only revealed some gossip information, but what the Assassin Planet did was mainly to murder elites of various races and geniuses with potential.
There were even some geniuses who were successfully assassinated in front of their super divine elders. How could such an Assassin Planet not be hated?
However, although it was hated, there were indeed many cosmic factions that had always maintained contact with the Assassin Planet and were inextricably linked. They had always entrusted the Assassin Planet to complete some shady things in his place, such as suppressing enemy factions.
The whereabouts of the super divine killer, Siphane, was one of the few unpredictable existences that the Exposing King Tu Tu didn't rely on external forces. The failure of the prediction this period made Tu Tu think that Shi Yu's trip this time might involve the other party… This… wasn't good.
"… It shouldn't be a problem. Sister is also with Shi Yu. If there's really danger, Sister won't let Shi Yu take the risk." Patriarch Tu Tu thought of its sister, who had recovered its power, and nodded.
Moreover, as long as Shi Yu was sufficiently prepared and convinced the five super divine Guardians, with its understanding of Siphane, the other party wouldn't carry out such a massive risk of assassination…
However, it couldn't forecast anything. It still made the Exposing King Tu Tu feel stifled. It went to the family's holy land and tried to use the power of the family's quasi cosmic prophecy treasure to assist it in predicting again…
In the depths of the gorgeous starry sky in the Cosmic Sea, a silver-white battleship was already slowly sailing in the universe, further away from World King Planet.
Shi Yu sat in the hall of the battleship and leaned comfortably against the window, admiring the scenery outside. The starry sky scene of the Cosmic Sea broke Shi Yu's inherent understanding of the starry sky of the universe. Strange things were everywhere here. The magnificence was far from what the border galaxy, where Blue Planet was located could compare to.
[Great God Shi Yu, when are you going to talk about your mother planet!] Because of the previous preview, many spectators were very interested in Shi Yu's mother planet.
In the confront of the enthusiasm of the audience, Shi Yu barely acted as the ambassador of Blue Planet's culture and introduced Blue Planet to the audience.
"My mother planet is called Blue Planet. A long period ago, it was an intermediate planet. It was rich in resources and had many races."
"However, the good times didn't last long. Just like the encounters of many resource planets, Blue Planet encountered the invasion of the Cosmic Behemoth Race, the Abyss Race, and the Space Worm Race one after another. Then, a planet defense battle that wasn't rare in the universe occurred."
The audience listened carefully. They didn't expect that the mother planet of the King of Gods, Shi Yu, had also been invaded by the pests of the three universes, like most planets in the universe…
"In that battle, Blue Planet barely won, but it also paid a heavy price. Its level fell to a low-level planet and it was no longer a habitable planet for the gods. Many gods went to the starry sky to find new homes."

chapters.title: Chapter 1579: Blue Planet’s Cultural Promotion Ambassador (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1579: Blue Planet’s Cultural Promotion Ambassador (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“After that, it will be hundreds of millions of years later. At this moment, Blue
Planet still hasn’t recovered to its peak. The god race that left has also completely lost contact with its mother planet. On the planet, the transcendent races and humans are on equal footing, competing for the few resources on Blue Planet.’
“On our side, the development time of humans is far inferior to that of transcendent races. Their strength system is also incomplete, and the growth environment is very arduous. They don’t know how to cultivate their second talent or how to carry out the divine contract. They experienced the totem era under the rule of transcendent creatures for a long time.”
In a few words, Shi Yu let the audience understand the general background of the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era and the totem era. Then, Shi Yu smiled and said, “Are you curious how I came to World King Planet in this context?” [Big boss, tell me!!] The comments flooded the screen.
“About 2,500 years ago, a Beast Tamer with very legendary colors was born among humans. His name was Emperor Shi, and he was the first to end the totem rule era in the east and establish a super empire mainly made up of humans called the Dong Huang Dynasty.”
“And I’m a Beast Tamer from this Dong Huang Nation, so after I became the King of Gods, I applied for a realm called the Dong Huang Realm. It’s considered a commemoration of my country.”
“In addition, the realm lord Wang Kong and the deputy realm lord Lin Feng of the Floating Realm whom everyone is familiar with are actually also from Blue Planet. They are also Beast Tamers from Dong Huang on Blue Planet.”
“Among them, the realm lord Wang Kong is the fifth emperor of the Dong
Huang Dynasty. The fourth Level 9 Beast Tamer is known as the Space
Emperor. As for the realm lord Lin Feng, he’s Dong Huangs seventh Level 9
Beast Tamer. Although everyone might sound very weak, a Level 9 Beast Tamer is actually a very impressive achievement on our Blue Planet. As for me, I’m the eighth Level 9 Beast Tamer in Dong Huang.”
“At that time, the upper limit of Blue Planet’s growth level was Level 9. It was impossible to break through to the divine level at all. And it was also extremely difficult to rely on Level 9 to wander in the starry sky. However, the realm lord Wang Kong and the realm lord Lin Feng were very lucky. They were the two Beast Tamers from Dong Huang who were lucky enough to come to the starry sky.”
“Next, everyone will definitely be familiar with their growth experience, right?
In the hundreds of years of wandering, they established the Floating Realm single-handedly and even had the battle record of joining forces to kill a super divine level. After obtaining such achievements, Wang Kong and Lin Feng, the realm lord, didn’t forget their hometown and kept trying to find their mother planet. In the end…”
“You called me here…
“When I was born, Wang Kong and the realm lord Lin Feng were no longer on Blue Planet. They were both legendary figures in my heart. I didn’t expect them to actually bring me to the starry sky one day… There are indeed more experts here than on Blue Planet. I like it very much.” Shi Yu explained Dong Huangs history with a smile. As for the audience, this was the first time they knew so much information about Blue Planet. They couldn’t believe it.
Wang Kong and Lin Feng, who had joined forces to assassinate a super divine level, actually came from a planet with restrictions that couldn’t break through the divine level?
Shi Yu, the King of Gods who crushed the geniuses of all races in the universe, was also a Beast Tamer who grew up on such a small planet?
Although the history Shi Yu mentioned was very real, it gave the audience a ridiculous feeling. They couldn’t imagine that an intermediate planet that had fallen to a low-level planet could give birth to such a genius.
[The fifth Level 9 Beast Tamer, the seventh Level 9 Beast Tamer, joined forces to assassinate a super divine. The eighth Level 9 Beast Tamer even obtained the King of Gods and became the strongest quasi-divine in the starry sky… The value of the Level 9 Beast Tamers in this country on this planet is so high!]
[Why do I feel that the content of the Level 9 Beast Tamer Shi Yu mentioned isn’t much different from the super divine level…]
[l wonder how the talent potential of the other Level 9 Beast Tamers is. It sounds more like the environment of Blue Planet restricts them. If they were placed on World King Planet, wouldn’t they all be as valiant as Wang Kong, Lin Feng, and the realm lord Shi Yu?]
[Probably not. The lifespan of humans on low-level planets is very short and can’t last long. Didn’t you hear Shi Yu say that Wang Kong and Lin Feng, the realm lords, also came to the starry sky by chance? The other Level 9 Beast Tamers have most likely died of old age… Otherwise, they would have died in battle. The transcendent races and humans on Blue Planet seem to be even more serious than the races in the starry sky on the World King Planet.]This essence is securely nested within the heart of Nøv€lß¡n★
For the next few days, Shi Yu promoted the culture of Blue Planet. Not only Dong Huang, but even other countries helped promote it.
It allowed the races in the starry sky to have a clearer understanding of the Blue Planet.
After some introduction. the feeling Blue Planet gave to the various races in
the starry sky was that although Blue Planet was small, its various experiences and culture weren’t inferior to those high-level planets’. The quality of the geniuses born was also terrifyingly high.
This was actually the first time the myriad of races in the starry sky understood the Blue Planet. Although the gods of Blue Planet in the Mythical Era had come to the Cosmic Sea early, that was hundreds of millions of years ago. Even among the five divine races of the Dong Xuan and Heavenly Demon Realms, apart from their own top experts, very few people knew where their mother planet was. After all, the five divine races had long taken root on the World King Planet.
The five divine races, Wang Kong, and Lin Feng had never deliberately
promoted Blue Planet at all. Therefore, this was the first time Shi Yu had
displayed the Blue Planet in front of all the races in the starry sky with the
influence of the King of Gods.
If it were in the past, this would actually be bad. It would cause Blue Planet to
be coveted by many factions and bring unknown risks. However, now that
Blue Planet’s power was enough to protect itself, it still had to start trading
with the various races in the starry sky to develop the planet. There was no
need to hide anymore..

chapters.title: Chapter 1580  Blue Planet's Cultural Promotion Ambassador (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1580  Blue Planet's Cultural Promotion Ambassador (4)
[Speaking of which, it's been so long, why haven't any assassins come to assassinate him…]
[Yes, yes, I've waited so long.]
[The cost of this live broadcast can probably raise 10 top-notch divine races from young. Such a big live broadcast, but no assassins came. What a disappointment.]
[It's not a loss. Didn't you see the many gifts? The Blue Planet story will still be good. Many big bosses of film companies want to cooperate to film Blue Planet movies.]
In the past few days, the battleship Shi Yu was on had stopped and rested on several planets. It had also experienced several interstellar teleportations.
However, not to mention an assassin, they didn't even see a single killer.
"It's alright," Shi Yu said calmly as he looked at the pile of comments.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, on the live broadcast screen, a star domain enveloped in a dark blue mist appeared in front of the battleship. The shape of the mist was like a deep sea shark in the cosmic sea.
"Where is this? Where in the Cosmic Sea…" Seeing this star domain, many spectators were stunned, indicating that they had never seen it before.
Many second-generation heirs took the video to look for their elders, but they obtained the same answer from the elders with rich experience traveling in the sea of stars. They didn't know this place.
[Could it be some ruin?]
[Don't go. It might be dangerous.]
[Go in and take a look. You've been rewarded.] Many comments flashed. Shi Yu had already arrived outside the battleship. He stood on the battleship and looked at the Assassin Planet Realm in front of him.
"I know where this is." Shi Yu looked at the Assassin Planet Realm and said, "Have you heard of the 'Assassin Planet'?"
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the audience was stunned.
Everyone had naturally heard of this place, the Assassin Planet. After all, it was the number one assassin organization in the universe.
Even those who had never heard of it quickly knew under the knowledge of those who knew.
So… this was the Assassin Planet? What a joke!
In less than a minute, a bloody comment appeared in Shi Yu's livestream.
[Realm Lord Shi Yu, I'm the realm lord of the Holy Flame Realm. Please give me your current coordinates. I'll definitely reward you heavily!]
The comments appeared, and many spectators were shocked. The Holy Flame Realm was a first-level realm. The realm lord was a super divine-level expert, and the reason why he wanted to know the location of the Assassin Planet was because his beloved disciple died from being assassinated by the Assassin Planet.
However, despite his aggro, the Holy Flame Realm's realm lord couldn't find the location of the Assassin Planet.
Of course, even if they found it, it was useless. It wasn't that the Assassin Planet had never been taken revenge on, but as long as the super divine killer, Siphane, didn't die, the Assassin Planet would be an eternal existence, and there were very few people who could kill Siphane.
No one expected that during Shi Yu's trip, he "accidentally" entered the secretive Assassin Planet Realm that was constantly on the move.
"It should be here. I've finally found it." Shi Yu stood on the battleship and said, "It's actually a pity that no assassins took the initiative to come over. I've clearly given them a chance."
"In that case, in order to vent the dissatisfaction in my heart, I've decided to take revenge on the organization of the killer who tried to assassinate me last time."
Shi Yu's words stunned the audience. In the next moment, Shi Yu pulled out a corpse and threw it into the air.
"Ranked fourth among assassins in the Assassin Planet, the Dark Vortex."
"This is the killer who tried to assassinate me last time. It should be an assassin from Assassin Planet…"
Looking at the assassin hanging in the starry sky, the audience was stunned. They didn't know if this person was an assassin from Assassin Planet. They were stunned that Shi Yu's goal this time was actually to take revenge on the group where the assassin was!
Moreover, this organization was the number one assassination faction in the universe, Assassin Planet!
[Wait a minute, didn't Shi Yu say that the assassin escaped after failing the assassination?? So the assassin didn't escape?]
[I remember that no matter the ranking, the assassins of the Assassin Planet were cultivated by that legendary assassin. They won't be captured alive at all, and they can't reveal any information about the Assassin Planet at all. Even their memories can't be spied on… How did Shi Yu find the site of the Assassin Planet through it!!]
No one expected Shi Yu to have such a wild path. After the Assassin Planet tried to eliminate him, he came all the way to the other party's headquarters. This was something many super divine factions couldn't do.
According to the battle outside the Four Holy Ruins last time, everyone already knew that Shi Yu was fearless, but they didn't expect him to be so bold. They still underestimated him. He had actually come to the territory of a powerful super divine faction that stood in the starry sky.
This was different from World King Planet, where there were only bloody forest laws.
For a moment, the Environmental Protection Association, the 177th Fleet, Zi Jian's special forces, and the Four Holy Family… In conclusion, on the World King Planet, many factions were shocked.
They watched as Shi Yu's battleship drove into the Assassin Planet Realm and arrived outside the Assassin Planet. That was indeed the Assassin Planet. Then, as everyone swallowed their saliva…
The cosmic battleship Ling launched an attack!!!
On the real-time broadcast, there were six main cannons at the bow of the ship, two large-caliber starry sky cannons, and four secondary cannons on each side of the ship. Colorful light flashed in unison…
Starry Sky Storm compression cannon!!!
Boom!!!
The dazzling starry skylight turned into countless incomparably thick pillars of light that penetrated the universe, targeting the Assassin Planet in front.
In the next moment, huge fluctuations rose inside the Assassin Planet. Like gorgeous fireworks, waves of aftermath appeared. Many assassins who stayed behind to guard the Assassin Planet blocked the strike outside the planet. Inside the planet, in the depths of the mystic realm, a terrifying existence suddenly opened its eyes, revealing killing intent that covered a star area.

chapters.title: Chapter 1581 One Planet, Ten Super Divines (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1581 One Planet, Ten Super Divines (1)
﻿﻿The interior of the Assassin Planet trembled from top to bottom. Before being attacked, no outsiders were discovered.
Many spectators in the livestream were also shocked. They didn't expect Shi Yu to directly start a strong battle with the Assassin Planet without any scruples.
In fact, even some factions whose people had been assassinated by the Assassin Planet didn't dare openly fall out with the Assassin Planet.
After all, the assassins of the Assassin Planet came and went without a trace. If anyone offended them to death and was targeted by them, it would be an endless stream of assassinations. Even if a super divine expert wasn't afraid, he had to think about his family and friends.
This obscure threat was the foundation of the various factions' fear of the Assassin Planet. However, at this moment, Shi Yu charged at the Assassin Planet without any fear. It was moving.
"Is he crazy?"
Under the exclamations of countless spectators, the entire Assassin Planet Realm was filled with terrifying mental pressure. Thousands of black dots came out of the Assassin Planet.
The nearly 10,000 divine-level assassins guarding the Assassin Planet turned into an army of assassins and charged out of the Assassin Planet together, wanting to see which overconfident guy had found the Assassin Planet.
However, when these assassins saw the corpse hanging in the starry sky, their pupils constricted.
"The fourth-ranked assassin, the Dark Vortex."
Then, they looked at Shi Yu, who was protected by Eleven, Chi Tong, Buggy, and the ginseng emperor…
At the same time that it was the strongest assassin organization, the Assassin Planet was also a powerful intelligence organization. Shi Yu's information was naturally not unfamiliar.
The invader was actually the new King of Gods on the World King Planet??
"Siphane, come out." In the face of the appearance of many assassins, Shi Yu stood on the battleship calmly.
"This person is an assassin from your Assassin Planet, right? Be good and come over to claim it. Tell me who hired you to assassinate me. I can consider sparing your life."
"Don't blame me for not giving you a chance. I'll only count to three."
Countless spectators looked at this scene in a daze. They didn't understand where Shi Yu's courage came from.
"3…"
As Shi Yu spoke, dozens of assassins from the Assassin Planet wanted to attack and kill Shi Yu to end this farce. However, at this moment, the star domain trembled, and a huge head completely formed by killing intent condensed in the starry sky.
Its purple hair was messy, and when its blood-colored cross eyes opened, the entire starry sky was about to be torn apart by killing intent. It was divided into two distinct domains, separating the Assassin Planet and Shi Yu, reversing the two worlds.
"Star Lord…" Seeing this huge head appear, countless assassins stopped moving. Their bodies trembled. They sensed the shocking killing intent of Siphane's super divine and felt that Shi Yu would definitely die without an intact corpse. If he alarmed Siphane, it meant that he had already said goodbye to his life.
[That's… the owner of the Assassin Planet?] Seeing Siphane's super divine appearance, countless spectators really didn't understand why Shi Yu wanted to provoke the Assassin Planet. This was simply courting death.
A super divine faction… wasn't that easy to provoke.
However, to everyone's surprise, this number one killer in the universe didn't attack directly. It only stared at Shi Yu with a murderous aura.
"Why are you so suicidal? Do you think those five guys are enough to shake my Assassin Planet?"
"My Assassin Planet wants to slaughter you. You can't stop it with just their strengths!"
Siphane's voice resounded through the starry sky. When the Four Holy super divines far away on the World King Planet saw this, they also laughed until the world trembled. They couldn't imagine that there was actually a stupid person like Shi Yu.
He actually took the initiative to find the Assassin Planet. Was he courting death?
What could the five super divines of Dong Xuan and the Heavenly Demon Realms do?
If it weren't for the fact that they were wary of public opinion on the World King Planet, the four of them could easily kill the five super divines on Blue Planet with their combined strength.
Although Siphane's strength was inferior to theirs, its assassination skills were first-rate. After being aimed by Siphane, those five super divines couldn't protect Shi Yu!
"I'm finally out." Shi Yu stared at the huge head of slaying intent excitedly and said, "Actually, I didn't desire to find trouble with you either, but after the failed assassination, the elders in my kin were unhappy."
"A mere ant is qualified to be unhappy?" Under the voice of the head, which was filled with killing intent, it directly attacked the entire starry sky battleship. The killing intent of the entire star field gathered, and a blood spear that was enough to penetrate the planet penetrated the nebula and penetrated the starry sky battleship!!
"Your path is narrow. We could have had a good talk." Shi Yu didn't react to the slaying intent. He uttered easily, "You're on your own."
"We'll know next if Blue Planet or your Assassin Planet is the ant."
Crack!
Just as everyone's hearts were beating faster as Shi Yu and the Assassin Planet collided, five terrifying black cracks tore open in the sky.
Accompanied by the wail of the starry sky, five sun-like sources of transcendence rose into the sea of stars. Five huge figures descended from the crack.
"You're the one… who wants to slaughter the genius of my Blue Planet?"
"A rat in the sewer dares to show its head and shout?"
"You're a frog in a well. You're very bold."
The five super divine beings of Blue Planet, the super divine dragon, the super divine Phoenix, the super divine Kirin, the super divine angel, and the super divine demon, descended together. A total of five super divine beings descended. Although they were all super divine beasts that had only transcended once, they still instantly shocked many assassins and many spectators.
They blocked in front of the blood-colored spear. The power of a super divine emitted, and the light of the sun instantly shattered the attack.
One by one, they stared at the number one killer in the universe domineeringly, and their slaying intent erupted!

chapters.title: Chapter 1582 One Planet, Ten Super Divines (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1582 One Planet, Ten Super Divines (2)
﻿﻿With the support of Emperor Shi, they were also bolder now. They felt that this feeling of courting death was so good.
After being silent for so long, their first battle today was to destroy the Assassin Planet and shock the starry sky!
[Holy sh*t! Five super divines! Where did they come from, what's going on!] The audience in the livestream was stunned. Was this what Shi Yu meant by using his integrity to guarantee that he didn't bring bodyguards?
Not only on World King Planet, but any planet in the Cosmic Sea that could receive the signal trembled as they waited for news.
It could be said that the current situation of the Assassin Planet Realm was the center of attention.
"You have a death wish!" At that moment, Siphane was furious. Others didn't know what these five super divines were, but didn't it know? A few trash, who were lucky enough to obtain the source of transcendence from the ruins of the era and then hid, actually dared to insult it?
It was fine if these weak super divines hid on the World King Planet, but now, they actually came to its territory. The feeling they gave Siphane was equivalent to the other party coming to deliver the source of transcendence. It was extremely ridiculous.
"Senior Emperor Shi!" At this moment, everyone was shocked that after Shi Yu instantly summoned five super divines to block the attack of the number one killer in the universe, Shi Yu's shake was still not over.
Shi Yu shouted a shocking name.
Emperor Shi.
Why did everyone feel that it was so familiar?
Wait…
When Shi Yu explained the history of Blue Planet, he said that the first Legendary Emperor of the Dong Huang Dynasty on Blue Planet was called Emperor Shi. Could it be that he was the same person?
In the next moment.
"Alright." Under Shi Yu's call, a voice that echoed in the starry sky and flowed in space and time sounded. Apart from the five super divines at the start, a black-robed man walked out of the starry sky and revealed his true appearance.
His expression was dignified. Although he looked no different from an ordinary person, when he appeared, even Siphane's super divine eyes were shocked and he couldn't believe it. This was because Emperor Shi's appearance was accompanied by the seven suns rising behind him.
Of the seven sources of transcendence, four were scattered and floated above the four super divine beasts summoned by Emperor Shi. Behind Emperor Shi himself, there were three sources of transcendence that were as dazzling as the sun, proving that his level wasn't inferior to Siphane's.
Boom!!!
Time passed. With Emperor Shi as the lead, 10 terrifying super divine pressures rushed towards the killing intent head.
"10 super divines…"
This time, Siphane panicked a little. It knew the five super divine pets on Blue Planet, but who was this Beast Tamer who could summon four super divine pets and had three sources of transcendence?
Moreover, it was certain that it had sensed the power on the other party correctly…
Time-element super divine… Five time-element super divine!
Including the five super divines on Blue Planet, there were a total of 10 super divine descents on Assassin Planet!
This scene was a little difficult for Siphane to accept.
"You… who are you!!!" Under his final voice, the huge head of killing intent was directly exploded by the 10 super divine pressures, turning into dispersed killing intent again.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!
Right on the heels of that, the gazes of the 10 super divines on Blue Planet stared at the nearly ten thousand assassins. A terrifying pressure enveloped them, and the eyes of the assassins instantly turned white. Blood flowed from their seven apertures, and their bodies were almost flattened. They let out miserable cries!!
"Ah!!!"
Under miserable cries, the members of the assassin organization that made the entire starry sky tremble in fear immediately fell into the boundless starry sky like blood-
colored raindrops.
They didn't die from the shock. There was still a use for them. They had many uses. Shi Yu was kind, and he couldn't bear to see anyone die in front of him. The Space Emperor and Lin Feng emerged and took over the unconscious assassins. Their eyes lit up.
This wasn't the end. The true goal of the 10 super divines on Blue Planet was the Assassin Planet. Emperor Shi held the super divine sword and waved at the Assassin Planet. The entire planet was instantly divided into two.
On the planet, a black light escaped outside the Assassin Planet Realm. Obviously, Siphane knew that it was impossible to fight 10 super divines alone and directly chose to escape.
As the number one killer in the universe, its escape ability was naturally at the top of the super divine level. Otherwise, the Assassin Planet wouldn't have existed for so long.
However, this time, what shocked Siphane was that no matter how he ran, he couldn't leave the range of the Assassin Planet Realm. It was as if the distance of the Assassin Planet Realm had become infinitely far.
"Not all of Dong Huang's juniors are qualified to assassinate."
"From today onwards, Assassin Planet, Star Destruction!"
Emperor Shi's black dragon pulled out the Space-time Dragon Vein from the Assassin Planet that had been divided into two and roared in its dragon claws. Emperor Shi said, "All creatures recorded in the Space-time Dragon Vein of the Assassin Planet will be dealt with next."
As soon as Emperor Shi finished speaking, the pupils of the assassins who were originally not on Assassin Planet suddenly widened.
World King Planet.
A sure killer who was carrying out a mission on the World King Planet seemed to have seen a transparent fish swimming in front of it. Seeing this fish that was identical to Emperor Shi's super divine beast in the live broadcast, it unveiled a shocked expression and instantly fled into the sky as if it had gone crazy.
But in the next moment, its body turned old infinitely. Its strength flowed away, and it immediately fell from the sky, its eyes emitting an incredulous divine color.
Boom!
It landed on the ground. The crowd on the road was shocked by this situation and dispersed.
This situation was happening everywhere.
Originally, there was a faction receiving the assassins from the Assassin Planet. They suddenly realized that the assassins in front of them quickly unveiled desperate expressions, coughed out blood, and quickly turned old while letting out a hoarse voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1583 One Planet, Ten Super Divines (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1583 One Planet, Ten Super Divines (3)
﻿﻿The entire starry sky was in turmoil. The Assassin Planet was really being dealt with. Shi Yu and the others didn't plan to give the Assassin Planet any chance of survival.
"Roar!!!" Soon, as Emperor Shi attached its three sources of transcendence to the monster that looked like a year beast, it roared in space and time. The number one killer in the universe who was fleeing suddenly felt that it was trapped in another space and time, and its life force accelerated!
"Damn it!"
Its bloody eyes widened, and its hair was messy. Siphane regretted taking over the assassination of the Four Holy Family very much.
If it had known that the power behind Shi Yu was so terrifying… Even if the Four Holy Family was a long-term partner of Assassin Planet… Assassin Planet definitely wouldn't have accepted it!!
"The Four Holy Family! You guys harmed me!"
Siphane roared in its heart.
"I knew it. Take care." At this moment, Shi Yu, who was broadcasting, sighed, attracting the attention of countless shocked spectators watching the live broadcast.
At this moment, no matter who the audience was, they were all shocked.
The pupils of the Four Saints super divine of the Four Holy Family constricted to the extreme, not understanding the current situation.
They were originally worried about Shi Yu, but when they saw Shi Yu easily shake out the ten super divines, their heads buzzed, and they found it difficult to understand.
"Let me introduce you to everyone. In the Blue Planet's Mythical Era, countless Blue Planet divines went to the starry sky. These five seniors were the descendants of the divines at that time, the current strongest experts of the five divine races."
"As for Senior Emperor Shi, he's the founder of the Dong Huang Dynasty. He's a mighty figure who has transcended three times, and his four pets have also reached the super divine level. Just like his title, they're all expert time element and emperors of the time domain!"
"Although the number one killer in the universe is good at escaping, it's impossible for anyone to escape the restraints of time. Speaking of which, he was still very arrogant just now. Why is he escaping now? Strange." When Shi Yu finished speaking, the corners of countless people's mouths twitched. They felt that Shi Yu was kidding.
Apart from the cosmic level, anyone who faced the 10 super divines, especially when five of them were time-element super divines, would only choose to escape.
At this moment, countless people were digesting Shi Yu's terrifying description. The five super divine beings of the Dragon, Phoenix, Kirin, Angel, and Demon were actually races from the Blue Planet's Mythical Era?
Not only that, but what was wrong with Emperor Shi? He actually contracted four super divine beings alone and was even a terrifying time Beast Tamer.
One planet with 10 super divines!
Now, everyone finally understood why Shi Yu had the confidence to assassinate the Assassin Planet Realm. This Blue Planet was actually so terrifying. It had a powerful foundation of one planet with 10 super divines. In the entire starry sky, apart from the five cosmic-level factions, this foundation was also peerless.
Blue Planet… wasn't to be trifled with!
Soon, the myriad races of the starry sky reached a consensus.
"Alright, the next scene might be a little bloody and not suitable for underage children to watch. I'm also afraid that the livestream will be banned, so I'll close the livestream first. Don't forget to farm everyone's gifts."
"When I find out who wanted to assassinate me from the Assassin Planet, there might even be the next round of live broadcast."
"Finally, I'll announce the coordinates of the Assassin Planet in the comments area. You're welcome to come to this place for a holiday."
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he directly turned off the live broadcast. Every audience swallowed their saliva and was stunned in front of the live broadcast.
"Impossible, definitely impossible." Among the four holy super divines, the Black Tortoise super divine broke out in a cold sweat. Seeing Emperor Shi's strength performance, it was shocked to the extreme, as if it knew what the great danger it had predicted back then was.
"Shi Yu's backing is actually so terrifying. I've never heard of one planet with 10 super divines." The White Tiger super divine also panicked and asked for everyone's opinion.
However, when it thought of the Assassin Planet that had been divided into two and was visited by the 10 super divines, the haughty Green Dragon super divine was also swayed, and its dragon eyes widened with disbelief.
The cosmic overlord army's 177th Army and Zi Jian's special forces, who had always wanted to recruit Shi Yu, were stunned. To recruit this guy… Could they start a war with the Assassin Planet for Shi Yu? Obviously not.
It wasn't just them. It was the same for the Environmental Protection Association, the Plant Association, and the Space Disaster Research Institute… No faction could do it.
But Blue Planet… did it.
Moreover, it had forcefully wrecked the Assassin Planet.
The people who regarded Shi Yu as a grassroots genius hadn't expected that this live broadcast would actually reveal such frightening information.
Originally, some of the Four Holy Evolvers who were biased against Shi Yu and had even insulted Shi Yu online were scared sh*tless on the spot. Their faces were pale, and they were momentarily uneasy.
An assassination against the genius failed, and the genius then sent 10 super divines to destroy the assassin's entire family. Even the cosmic overlord army wasn't so domineering.
The Astrologer Family watched the live broadcast and the prophecy scene of the family's treasure. The Exposing King, who had revealed the source of transcendence, took a deep breath, and shock appeared in his eyes.
What was going on with the Blue Planet that its sister had reincarnated into?
…
After the live broadcast was cut off in the Assassin Planet Realm, it was the celebration of the Blue Planet's lunatics. The gem cat girl and the Prediction Owl girl walked out of the cosmic battleship.
Seeing the blood-stained starry sky, they took a deep breath and were a little afraid.
"I saw it, I saw it. It's the source of transcendence!!!" The Prediction Owl said excitedly. However, it seemed that the owl, who had been lazing around the whole time, couldn't get it.
The gem cat girl didn't forget the serious matter and said, "Senior Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng, remember to keep them alive. Don't miss… Keep them for Little Qingyi to kill. Using the life of the Assassin Planet as a talent resource, we might be able to raise a super divine killer for Blue Planet…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1584 Who Should I Give the New Source of Transcendence to? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1584 Who Should I Give the New Source of Transcendence to? (1)
﻿﻿At this moment, in the eyes of Shi Yu and the others, the entire Assassin Planet was a treasure.
Assassin Planet was also a large faction that had existed for a long time. It must have accumulated a huge amount of wealth and was waiting to be plundered.
The assassins of the Assassin Planet also involved various races.
Among them, non-humans were also covered in treasures.
Their skills also belonged to the top-notch divine techniques in the assassination category. Perhaps there were some worth replicating.
Apart from that, the talent of a human assassin was definitely suitable for assassination.
It could be said that the top assassination talent in the entire universe was focused on Assassin Planet.
Every killer from various places in the universe was excavated, abducted, and brainwashed by the super divine killer, Siphane. Almost no one had poor talent.
If Lu Qingyi were to use the plunder talent to plunder all the assassination talents, she would definitely become a first-class assassin in the Cosmic Sea…
Although it was a little strange for an archeologist to change his profession to an assassin, the identity of an assassin also matched the plundering talent… In the future, it could maximize the use of plundering talent.
At this moment, the entire Assassin Planet Realm had become a battlefield.
"A super divine has descended. Aren't you going to submit?" After stunning a portion of the assassins in the outside world, the five super divines of Blue Planet descended inside the Assassin Planet.
Not only were there assassins on the Assassin Planet, but there was also a large number of support assassin logistics personnel. For example, the Teleportation Master who teleported the fourth assassin to the vicinity of Blue Planet was one of the best.
It was the same for these guys. As long as they didn't resist especially strongly and didn't self-destruct, they wouldn't kill them if possible. After capturing all of them alive, the benefits could be maximized.
In the divided Assassin Planet, a certain city was already in chaos.
"Lord Igor, please, I beg you. Teleport me away. This is all my savings. I'll give it all to you!"
Outside the Assassin Planet, the 10 super divines descended. Siphane chose to escape. The people who stayed on the Assassin Planet naturally wanted to escape.
Among them, a portion of them found the teleportation slot of Igor, who had mastered the "Magnetic Path" skill, hoping to leave this place with its power.
"It's over, it's all over. The entire Assassin Planet Realm has already been sealed. We can't go anywhere." However, in the face of the request for help from the outside world, the planet spun, but the Teleportation Master, Igor, could only sit in his room in a daze, helpless.
Now, it couldn't even teleport itself away, so how could it teleport others?
"It's here, I found it!!!" Just as many people gathered in this city, two figures appeared in the sky. One was a voluptuous owl girl, and the other was a beautiful cat girl. They flew into the sky and pointed at a building.
"Roar!!!" As they descended, space was torn open. One of the five super divine beings on Blue Planet, a Holy Kirin, stepped through the city and blew away the buildings. Its divine eye locked onto a strange cosmic life form that was blown away.
"Surrender or die." The Kirin super divine pressure spread in all directions.
"I submit!! I'm willing to submit!!!"
As a perfect god, Teleportation Master Igor was scared out of its wits when facing the descent of the super divine level Kirin Ancestor. It was unable to resist at all and could only shout during the process of being blown away.
The other people in the city were additionally firmly pressed to the ground by the power of the super divine. Their pupils turned white, and they didn't dare to look up or get up. Their bodies trembled.
"It should be it. I want it alive," the Prediction Owl said. Shi Yu had asked her to lead the super divine seniors to capture the Teleportation Master alive… This was simple!
Not only could the owl predict where this Teleportation Master was, but it could additionally predict where the treasure vault of the Assassin Planet was!
"You're pretty tactful." The Kirin super divine let out a thunderclap. The Teleportation Master, Igor, fainted from the vibration and was pinched in the Kirin super divine's huge palm.
"A mere Assassin Planet!" The super divine of the Kirin Race only felt like a super divine level today. It turned out that it was actually so strong.
The number one assassin organization in the universe could barge in and break through just like that…
Did the juniors in the race… see its heroic bearing?
When the gem cat and the others entered the planet to catch people and search for treasures, Emperor Shi additionally placed all his attention on the super divine killer, Siphane.
At this moment, Siphane was trapped, but it wasn't weak either. It was very difficult for Shi Yu and the others to capture Siphane alive like those divine-level creatures. They could only kill him on the spot.
"Senior Emperor Shi, so handsome."
"Wu wu wu!"
"Yi!! (You have my style!)"
Shi Yu and the others stood on the cosmic battleship and didn't run around. They weren't in a hurry to snatch the treasures in the star. Instead, they focused their attention on this battle, which was enough to destroy the star domain.
Shi Yu's pets cheered and supported him while staring intently.
In front of him, the river of stars reversed, and time was drowned. Space and time were trembling. The super divine assassin's body was covered in blood, and his killing intent rose, but he kept hiding, not wanting to fight Emperor Shi head-on.
However, the battle was almost one-sided, like a cat chasing a mouse. No matter how Siphane ran, it couldn't escape from Emperor Shi's palm.
The light of the radiant sun flowed, and divine power surged. The time laws were intertwined into an inescapable net, forming a gorgeous battlefield. There were several scenes on the level of law usage that even Shi Yu and the others couldn't understand now. Only Qi watched with interest.
"Shi Yu, if it's an expert at the level of Emperor Shi, there's a risk of failure if we travel through space and time in front of him…"
"Ah…" Shi Yu said, "That's normal. After all, it's five time-element super divines. Moreover, the second major element that Emperor Shi is an expert in is the spatial element. Space and time aren't separated… Fortunately, Senior Emperor Shi is from the same camp. Otherwise, such an opponent would be too terrifying."

chapters.title: Chapter 1585 Who Should I Give the New Source of Transcendence to (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1585 Who Should I Give the New Source of Transcendence to (2)
﻿﻿"Yes." Qi nodded in the Beast Taming Space. Back then, in the Blue Planet's Mythical Era, sometimes experts like the emperor were nothing.
"Wu wu wu." At this moment, Eleven and the others were getting more and more excited. There was more than one Assassin Planet in the Assassin Planet Realm. Of course, the other planets weren't as important as the Assassin Planet, and these planets were like exploding balloons in the battle between the two parties. They flickered in the starry sky and turned into gorgeous fireworks.
The aftermath exploded stars!
Eleven and the others looked forward to when they could have such battle power.
"It's not far. That time won't be far." Shi Yu's heart was also stirred during this team building. After this, be it him, the incoming Emperor Wu, the Empress, the Dragon Emperor, and the other seniors of Blue Planet's Dong Huang lineage, they would definitely have a good growth environment.
After this battle, Blue Planet's reputation of being protective could be completely spread.
Who dared to provoke a planet with 10 super divines?
He didn't believe that, at this point, the Four Holy Family still dared to continue assassinating him. That was no different from courting death.
Looking at the battle in the distant galaxy, Shi Yu and the others paid attention. Time seemed to be meaningless at this moment. Baby Ginseng and the others could clearly sense that the time flow of the Assassin Planet Realm had changed.
As for the time changes on Emperor Shi's and the others' sides, it was even more chaotic. It was impossible to tell how long they had been fighting.
However, the super divine battle was undoubtedly the longest. The current Assassin Planet had even been plundered. The gem cat, owl, Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and Blue Planet's five super divines had even returned to the starry sky.
Everyone watched the battle that shocked the galaxy together. The five super divines swallowed their saliva together. They felt that when Emperor Shi fought them, he didn't use his full strength at all, as if he was warming up.
And now, the battle with Siphane seemed to be an experiment. If he went all out, how much could he suppress the number one killer in the universe?
Shi Yu and the audience had already seen the outcome. That was, the "number one killer in the universe" could only use continuous escape to stall and avoid the battle. It was completely impossible to resist head-on.
"I hate it!!!" The crazy Siphane's thick purple hair turned white. Countless white wrinkles appeared on his black skin, and the two withered horns that connected to the dimensional space had already been broken.
This was the most miserable time for Siphane. As a powerful black shadow race, it had never expected that it would walk to the end of its life in such a miserable situation.
Accompanied by a cry that shocked the past and present, the super divine killer, who was covered in blood and had its life force constantly depleted, seemed to finally be unable to hold on.
"I want you to die!!!" The crazy Siphane seemed to have been calculating something the whole time. When it reached the extremely weak state, it finally broke through Emperor Shi's restraints. It didn't think of leaving, because there were even greater restraints outside the Assassin Planet Realm.
At this moment, it only wanted to kill the source of all of this, the culprit, Shi Yu.
Although the five super divines of Blue Planet were all around Shi Yu, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, at this moment, Siphane had already burned its origin and erupted. It was confident that it could definitely take away a divine-level.
As night approached, the river of stars reversed, and the dark curtain enveloped Shi Yu and the others. Shi Yu sighed and said, "Looks like it's over."
Did this guy really think that it was the spatial restraint he had shattered free from?
As the super divine killer attacked, the five super divines on Blue Planet had mocking expressions. The Space Emperor and Lin Feng also had looks of anticipation.
This segment was discussed with Emperor Shi, the buff segment!
He deliberately revealed a flaw and attracted the desperate super divine to take the buff!
"Come!" Shi Yu stretched out his right arm, and a black codex appeared in his palm, activating the Origin Plunder ability.
"Ling, Wind of Blessing!" Under Shi Yu's command, a light wind of luck blew on the universe battleship, sweeping up Shi Yu, the gem cat, and the owl.
"I make a wish and drop the source of transcendence!" The gem cat girl looked at the attacking killer. Although she was afraid, she still activated the ability of her Star Prayer Race.
"The premonition of fate is set!" It was the same for the owl girl. She strengthened it again and predicted the fate of the source of transcendence.
Under the superposition of the multiple buffs, the current super divine killer, Siphane, gazed at Shi Yu and the others who were looking at him like ferocious beasts and were slightly stunned.
In the next moment, a time sword crossed the Void and accurately stabbed into Siphane's heart, nailing it in the starry sky in a daze.
Right on the heels of that, Siphane's corpse began to collapse like a star, forming a divine power vortex. It exploded with a bang, and a large amount of nomological aura flowed…
"I'm indignant!!!" With its final cry, its body exploded with a bang, but it was all blocked in another space and time. As its body exploded, a large amount of power flowed out of its body. Two of the three transcendence sources that appeared began to disperse, but in the end, they didn't all disappear. The light of the radiant sun was all absorbed by the source of transcendence at the beginning and floated in the starry sky.
"It exploded, it exploded!!!" When Siphane's figure turned into dust in the universe, the source of transcendence that represented his super divine identity was permanently left behind. It was like a mini sun, emitting astonishing divine power and illuminating the entire star domain.
Upon seeing this source of transcendence, Shi Yu and the others were extremely excited. They felt that they had previously obtained the greatest gains from this battle.
The five super divines revealed yearning expressions. Although each life form could only absorb the real source of transcendence once, it was useless to obtain a second one. However, be it leaving it for their descendants or trading it, this universe treasure-level source of transcendence was undoubtedly the most precious thing in the entire universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1586 Who Should I Give the New Source of Transcendence to (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1586 Who Should I Give the New Source of Transcendence to (3)
﻿﻿"It really exploded." The Space Emperor and Lin Feng were also very excited. Who knew the despair when they spent so much effort and finally succeeded in assassinating the super divine without the source of transcendence appearing?
But this time… fate was finally not teasing them.
Generally speaking, the probability of obtaining the source of transcendence by killing super divine lives was very low.
Of course, this was for relatively weak super divines.
Their source of transcendence power had a high chance of flowing away as their main bodies died.
However, for powerful super divines who had transcended several times and had their source of transcendence replicated several times, the probability of the source of transcendence disappearing was undoubtedly greatly reduced.
If the probability of killing a transcendent 1 super divine and dropping the source of transcendence was one in ten, then at the moment, the probability of killing a transcendent 3 super divine and dropping the source of transcendence should be 30%!
In addition to the support of Shi Yu, Ling, Qi Xing, and astrology, they finally didn't let this battle miss the greatest gain.
"My luck is pretty good!" At this moment, Emperor Shi also crossed space and time and held the source of transcendence in his hand.
He looked at the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and Shi Yu and said, "Who wants this source of transcendence?"
Emperor Shi's words made Emperor Kong and Lin Feng smile bitterly. Emperor Kong said, "Senior Emperor Shi, I didn't help much in this operation at all. This source of transcendence can't be mine no matter what."
"Me too, Senior Emperor Shi. There's no reason for me to take this source of transcendence."
Although the Space Emperor and Lin Feng yearned for the source of transcendence, they also understood that this source of transcendence had nothing to do with them.
"Damn it." At this moment, the five super divines of Blue Planet were very envious. They felt that Dong Huang and the others were extremely ridiculous. They could actually refuse something like the source of transcendence?
No one wanted to give it to them.
"Meow!!!" The Prediction Owl was also envious. Hey, hey, hey, Emperor Shi, right? You used the five sources of transcendence I predicted. Now that a new one has popped up, why didn't you ask me?
Even if you don't want to give it to me, it's still good to be polite!!
"Looks like no one is embarrassed to take it. After all, you were the one who resolved this super divine killer, Senior Emperor Shi." Shi Yu smiled and said, "Why don't we let the remaining five pets use it?"
"No." Emperor Shi shook his head and said, "I don't plan to nurture the next pet with the source of transcendence."
"Uh." Lin Feng and the others were stunned.
Emperor Shi said, "The source of transcendence is the condition for a divine-level to advance to super divine, but do you know the condition for a super divine to advance to the cosmic level?"
The Space Emperor and the others shook their heads. There were only five cosmic levels in the entire universe. Probably only they knew how they advanced.
"I have a guess."
"Me and my four pets weren't in a perfect state when refining the source of transcendence, so they wasted a lot of the power of the source of transcendence and didn't perfectly fuse with them."
"It can be said that before fusing with the source of transcendence, the stronger one is, the better the absorption effect."
"Isn't there a legend of the epoch god in the universe? As a divine level that can fight against super divines and break through the restrictions of the divine level…"
"Therefore, I'm wondering if I need to reach a certain limit at the divine level and break through a certain limit before advancing to the super divine level to reach the cosmic level. Or rather, apart from the source of transcendence, there are other ways to advance to the super divine level."
"Is there another way to enter the cosmic level?"
"The epoch god is only a divine-level expert who broke through the perfect limit and mastered a transcendent divine skill. According to Dong Huang's division of skills, what if there's another level of divine skills above transcendent-level divine skills? At that level of divine-level, forget about fighting against super divines, can its battle power approach the cosmic level?"
"The epoch god breaking through to the super divine level is already a peak expert among super divines. Then, is there a stronger god?"
"Next, I want to use the remaining pets for experiments."
"For me, no matter how high I advance to the super divine level, it's meaningless. Next, what I have to do is see the truth of the universe level."
After Emperor Shi finished speaking, everyone fell into deep thought.
After a moment of silence, the super divine of the Demon Race said, "Sigh, the five of us can get the . Back then, we broke through before we reached the perfect god level. We couldn't understand the full limit of the divine level."
"Stop pretending to be good after taking advantage of me," Lin Feng said in disdain.
He would give them another chance, just like how they would give up the source of transcendence.
"Humans might also have new limits above the tenth level of the divine level, but unless I reincarnate and cultivate again, I can no longer explore," Emperor Shi said regretfully.
"I have a karma with Blue Planet. This origin of transcendence is also a tool to eliminate karma. It's better to leave it to you to deal with." Emperor Shi looked at Shi Yu and said, "How do you think we should allocate it?"
Emperor Shi also knew that Blue Planet needed five extraordinary deity humans to explore the ruins of Earth.
Therefore, he wanted to try his best to nurture five super divine humans first and end the fate of the five sources of ascendancy left behind by him using the remains of Earth.
"Well…" Shi Yu was speechless. "My level isn't high enough. Leave it to Senior Space Emperor and Senior Lin Feng to choose…"
"If I need it, I'll find it myself."
was confident that he could definitely obtain a lot in the future. He didn't think that this thing was that rare.

chapters.title: Chapter 1587 Who Should I Give the New Source of Transcendence to (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1587 Who Should I Give the New Source of Transcendence to (4)
﻿﻿In addition, Shi Yu felt that what Emperor Shi said seemed to make sense. He had once tried to constantly add points to his pets to prevent them from fusing with the source of transcendence and seeing where their limits were.
If Senior Emperor Shi's guess made sense, then rashly breaking through might cause him to be unable to advance to the cosmic level for the rest of his life. Shi Yu suddenly wanted to figure out the conditions for advancement to the cosmic level before planning to break through. Otherwise, he would probably regret it for the rest of his life.
"Don't look at me." Realizing that everyone was looking at him and the Space Emperor, Lin Feng waved his hand and said, "No one really wants it. Why don't we give it to Senior Wang Kong?"
"Back then, Senior Wang Kong and I went to hunt super divines together. We had an agreement. If the source of transcendence is revealed, Senior Wang Kong will use it first. When Senior Wang Kong surpasses it, I'll work hard on the battlefield until a source of transcendence is revealed to me…"
"Haha, unfortunately, it didn't drop at that time."
The Space Emperor was a little speechless. Back then, he and Lin Feng indeed had this agreement.
"Wang Kong, you've been at the peak of the divine level for hundreds of years. This source of transcendence can allow you to take another step forward. Next, I might not stay on Blue Planet at all times and stay in Dong Huang. I'll search for the truth of the universe level, but Blue Planet and Dong Huang also need a human super divine being to protect them. Are you willing to take on this source of transcendence and take on the responsibility of protecting Blue Planet and Guardian Dong Huang?"
Emperor Shi asked Emperor Kong.
"In that case, I'll accept it respectfully." The Space Emperor cupped his fists and said, "After I advance to the super divine level, I'll definitely devote all my life's effort to Dong Huang's development. I'm here, Dong Huang is here."
"Hahaha, good, you're indeed the best candidate." Emperor Shi said, "Your spatial talent is even above mine. You also look much more honest than that Lin Feng and Shi Yu."
"If we let them advance to the super divine level early, they will probably only go around making enemies for Dong Huang and Blue Planet. And now, what Blue Planet lacks is time and space for development. After you advance to the super divine level, you can help Blue Planet establish interstellar teleportation arrays that connect more places. You can also create more cultivation resources to allow Dong Huang to develop faster."
"Ah." Lin Feng was shocked. He didn't know why he was on the same level as Shi Yu in Senior Emperor Shi's heart.
What a joke. He had worked hard on World King Planet for hundreds of years, but he didn't cause as much trouble as Shi Yu in a year!!
"Yes, if you want to become rich, you have to build roads first. After Senior Space Emperor advances to the super divine level, you can build many roads. Just the main path of the permanent teleportation array isn't enough. You also need a lot of branches. In addition, the cultivation resources of the geniuses on Blue Planet shouldn't be lacking." Shi Yu was amused.
Back then, the characteristic of the Space Emperor Army was that the average level of the soldiers was the highest among the various dynasties. The number of legendary Beast Tamers during the Space Emperor Era was also the highest in the previous generations before the Mythical Revival.
Even in the modern era, it couldn't compare to that time.
This was all because the Space Emperor could produce many resources to accelerate the cultivation speed of the Beast Taming Space… And if the Space Emperor reached the super divine level, he would clearly evolve into an even more powerful resource tycoon. Perhaps he could even nurture peak-level divine-level Beast Tamers in batches.
"Alright." At this moment, the Space Emperor smiled bitterly. Being willing to accept this important quest was clearly nothing compared to the opportunity to advance to super divine.
"In that case, I'll leave the source of transcendence to you," Emperor Shi said. He threw the source of transcendence at the Space Emperor, and the five super divines on the Blue Planet became more and more envious. At the same time, their expressions turned bitter.
The Space Emperor was already fierce enough at the peak of the divine level. If he advanced to the super divine level, what would happen? In the first place, the five divine races on Blue Planet were no match for humans. Now that the Space Emperor had advanced, the main race on Blue Planet was clearly humans.
Dong Huang's Space-Time emperors were both the most valiant attributes. No matter how he thought about it, the development of the human race was already unstoppable.
"Thank you, everyone." At this moment, after taking the source of transcendence, the Space Emperor was also filled with emotions. He first looked at Emperor Shi and said, "Senior Emperor Shi, I will continue to protect Dong Huang's foundation and let Dong Huang's name resound through the starry sky."
"Lin Feng, our agreement is still there. One day, I'll definitely obtain a source of transcendence for you."
"Shi…"
"Senior Space Emperor, don't stand on ceremony. You have a true source of transcendence now. You have those fake sources of transcendence on Blue Planet. Why don't you give it to me?" Shi Yu chuckled and said, "I really developed something the last time I took one."
Beast Feng Yu could become stronger by eating fake sources of transcendence. Then, next, he would definitely not refuse this resource.
Senior Space Emperor laughed and said, "No problem."
"And Teacher Tu Na and Teacher Ying, thank you too. If not for the support of your skills, the source of transcendence might not have been obtained so smoothly this time. If you have any needs in the future, feel free to tell me," Monarch Kong said.
"Breakthrough," Emperor Shi said.
"Alright." The Cosmic Monarch nodded, while the super divines of the five major holy races on Blue Planet had question marks on their faces.
What about them?? So, why didn't they thank them at all!! Even if they didn't participate to this operation, they had gave efforts hard.

chapters.title: Chapter 1588 Predicting Loneliness (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1588 Predicting Loneliness (1)
﻿﻿Two days later, following the coordinates left behind by Shi Yu, countless factions arrived at the Assassin Planet Realm and saw the blood-stained starry sky and the desolate Assassin Planet.
Spaceships and cosmic battleships of large factions landed on Assassin Planet. The people who walked down looked at the environment of this star in silence.
A certain crew member of the cosmic overlord army with the pirate flag immediately cried.
"B*stard, you didn't even leave a Level 1 energy crystal behind?"
"The energy mineral veins of the Assassin Planet have also been completely drained??"
"Even this planet is about to explode in a few months."
"Why is Blue Planet even more ruthless than our cosmic pirates?"
"Damn it, I originally wanted to come over as soon as possible and see if I could pick up some trash and spoils of war. With the richness of the Assassinate Planet, any thing I threw was worth the cost of this voyage, but… how did I do it without leaving anything? Who can tell me?"
"The resources are gone. There's not even a corpse to be seen. There's only blood. They didn't even let the dead go."
The current situation of the Assassin Planet Realm made the men and women who arrived cry.
"A super divine battle once happened here. The time flow in this star domain is still a little different from the outside world. This is the change in the laws after the super divine battle."
There were also super divine-level experts who came to the Assassin Realm. They were all super divines who had enmity with the Assassin Planet. At this moment, when they saw the destruction of the Assassin Planet, their feelings were extremely complicated.
There were also super divine-level experts who came to the Assassin Realm. They were all super divines who had enmity with the Assassin Planet. At this moment, when they saw the destruction of the Assassin Planet, their feelings were extremely complicated.
"Although you ignored my reward question and committed a heinous crime, I'll remember this favor."
"Also…"
Many experts looked at the current situation of the Assassin Planet Realm and felt a sense of horror. This should be the result of the battle between that human super divine named Emperor Shi and Siphane.
The battle of overlords could change the natural environment of an area, and the battle of super divines was even enough to change the laws of a star domain. The laws of this star domain were clearly changed and affected by the power of super divines. He didn't know how long it would take to recover.
"No one survived the Assassin Planet."
Soon, the news of the Assassin Planet spread throughout the Cosmic Sea, making the World King Planet and countless planetary factions in the Cosmic Sea know about Blue Planet and the horror of Dong Huang's bloodline.
On World King Planet, as Shi Yu cut off the live broadcast, there was no rest.
Countless realms were looking forward to when Shi Yu found out who wanted to assassinate him.
If Shi Yu continued to seek revenge, there would probably be another storm of blood!
In this boring era, no one didn't like to see blood flow like rivers.
And when such a thing happened, there was no lack of fanning the flames.
The Exposing King appeared again and expressed that the one who contacted the Assassin Planet to assassinate Shi Yu was definitely the Four Holy Family.
"The Four Holy Family and the Assassin Planet have a long-
term cooperation. The Four Holy Family requested the Assassin Planet to assassinate countless Four Holy Evolvers with super divine aptitude. The Four Holy Family offended the Blue Planet… It's over."
The Exposure King's fanning the flames caused the Four Holy Family furious again.
"Bullsh*t!!!" The Four Holy Family jointly appeared and announced that this matter undoubtedly had nothing to do with the Four Holy Family. They additionally increased the arrest warrant for the Exposing King.
At this moment, on the battleship that returned to Back World King Planet, Shi Yu and the others were discussing how to deal with the Four Holy Family.
In fact, just thinking about it, Shi Yu and the others could lock onto the Four Holy Family.
Moreover, it had been proven again on Siphane.
In the pursuit, Siphane kept giving in, saying that Assassin Planet only took the order because they were under the pressure of the Four Holy Family and had no choice. They were just paid to do it. There was no irreconcilable conflict between them.
Of course, Emperor Shi naturally didn't listen to these words. Things enjoy killer organizations existed before and after the establishment of the Dong Huang Dynasty. They were all uprooted by him.
He couldn't stand this kind of rat living in the shadows and chasing benefits the most. If the Four Holy Family chose to send a genius of the same level in the race to openly challenge Shi Yu, even if it was with the goal of killing Shi Yu, he would still think highly of the Four Holy Family.
"Forget it, forget it."
"I think it's not appropriate to fall out with the Four Holy Family now," Shi Yu said. "The Green Dragon super divine is at transcendent 6, and the other three Four Saints are additionally above transcendent 4. If they want to fight, they will undoubtedly fight four at the same time. Moreover, they also have their own allies."
"On our side, there's only one big boss, Senior Emperor Shi. The pressure is too great. Even if we succeed, we will suffer heavy losses."
"After all, Floating, Dong Huang, Dong Xuan, and the Heavenly Demon Realm are all on World King Planet. It's easy for us to attack, but it's difficult to defend."
"I agree. Wang Kong has just advanced and still needs to adapt to the power of the super divine. It's not suitable to fight such a strong enemy immediately…" The five super divines nodded.
The Four Holy Family was incomparable to the Assassin Planet. The Assassin Planet wasn't a faction on the World King Planet. So be it if it was destroyed, but the Four Holy Family was a large faction that crossed hundreds of realms. If one couldn't destroy them quickly, the impact was too great.
"Senior Emperor Shi, let's put aside the matter of the Four Holy Family first. After this battle, they undoubtedly won't dare to play any cheap shots or tricks," Shi Yu said. "Actually, in essence, this is still my own business. When I become stronger, even if it's not for the revenge of this assassination, for the path of my Green Dragon pet and the others, I'll finally fight the Four Holy Family."

chapters.title: Chapter 1589 - 1589: Predicting Loneliness (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1589: Predicting Loneliness (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“When I’m strong enough, I’ll take revenge this time and kill the Four Saints in the form of an official duel. I’ll make the decision myself and the Four Saints. This can minimize our losses.’
Although Shi Yu also wanted to solve all the trouble immediately, he knew that if he started a war with the Four Holy Family, it wouldn’t be a one-sided battle. At that time, there would definitely be casualties on Blue Planet. If it was because of him and involved innocent people, Shi Yu was unwilling to see it happen.
“How long do you think it will take you to have the ability to defeat them?” Emperor Shi looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu said, “10 years, within 10 years.”
“Alright.” Emperor Shi said, “Then I’ll leave the Four Holy Family to you to settle.’
Seeing that Shi Yu was so determined and not only living under protection, Emperor Shi admired him even more. Only such a junior genius was worth protecting.
“10 years?” Upon hearing Shi Yu and Emperor Shi’s conversation, the five super divines had bitter expressions. They only felt that it was ridiculous. What a joke… Among the Four Saints, which one of them wasn’t an old monster who had lived for hundreds of millions of years?
He wanted to hunt the four of them in 10 years?
“Hahaha, interesting. The Four Saints are so strong in super divine. The drop rate must be higher.” Lin Feng laughed at the side. The Space Emperor was meditating in other rooms. It was a pity that he didn’t hear such an interesting conversation.
“Well… Only you guys dare to think about it,” the Prediction Owl muttered.
Before she was born, those four old guys were already experts who dominated the World King Planet. Shi Yu had to work hard.
“Speaking of which, after traveling for so long, didn’t you predict where the third wish star inheritance is?” The gem cat paid attention to the outside world at all times and was not interested in fighting and killing. In any case, sometimes, when the emperor was around, she knew that no matter how unrestrained Shi Yu was, there were at least people who could back him up.
“How can it be that easy to find? We’ve only walked the tip of the iceberg in the Cosmic Sea. Moreover, who knows if the Star Prayer Race threw the inheritance further away…”
“Unfortunately, when I was in the era ruin, I didn’t mainly cultivate the power of premonition. Otherwise, I could assist in premonition,” Emperor Shi said.
Another thing was that he didn’t really believe in the power of premonition… “Hehe, it’s alright. Our Astrologer Race is good at this! Leave it to us!”
“By the way, is the matter of the Four Holy Family spending money to assassinate you temporarily not publicized?” the owl asked Shi Yu.
“Well, this… Forget it, I’ll save it first…” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “As long as we don’t announce it first, no one will know who tried to assassinate me, and who hired the assassin. At that time, apart from the Four Holy Family, we can also label whoever we don’t like and attack them legitimately.”
“The one who sent the Assassin Planet to assassinate me can be the Four Holy Family, or it can be another faction joining forces with the Four Holy Family. After announcing it all at once, it won’t be very useful anymore…”
“At the same time, I can also pretend to have obtained the transaction directory of the Assassin Planet. Didn’t many geniuses of super divine factions get assassinated by the Assassin Planet? It feels even easier to splash dirty water now…”
Was he still human?
The two cats looked at Shi Yu in a daze. This guy was really f*cking immoral. He wanted to use the Assassin Planet to slander others??
Before long, Shi Yu and the others returned to World King Planet.
In the Floating Realm, a huge battleship descended in the sky above Sky City.
Countless Beast Tamers appeared with excited expressions.
Through Shi Yu’s explanation of Blue Planet’s history and Dong Huangs history, these Beast Tamers knew for the first time that their realm lord was so impressive and awesome.
Through this battle, they also knew for the first time that their mother planet was so powerful.
This battle could be said to have increased the pride of the Beast Tamers of Wang Kong and Lin Fengs direct bloodline.
Although only Shi Yu, the super divines of the five divine races, and Emperor Shi appeared in this battle and no Space Emperor or Lin Feng appeared, it didn’t stop them from being excited too. They were all family.
At this moment, before the battleship landed, a super divine might swept across the entire Floating Realm. The powerful spatial fluctuations were shocking. As a source of transcendence that was like a sun rose in the sky, a figure was the first to come out of the battleship. His aura was transcendent and peerless.
“The realm lord???” Seeing his figure, many people were stunned. The realm lord of Wang Kong… also went to Assassin Planet this time??
Wait a minute… Behind him…
Countless people couldn’t believe it.
In the next moment, the Space Emperor looked at the thousands of cities, and almost all the realm citizens could hear his voice.
“From today onwards, I’m a super divine.”
“The Floating Realm has applied to become a first-level realm.”
As soon as the Space Emperor finished speaking, with a boom, lightning flashed in the sky of the entire Floating Realm. Countless Beast Tamers looked at the sky in shock and looked at their realm lord with their mouths wide open, wondering if they had heard wrong.
“Super, super divine???” The Wang family disciples looked at the sky in a daze.
The disciple of the Space Emperor, Zi Lan, also looked at the figure of the Space Emperor in the sky in disbelief, suspecting that she was dreaming.
Soon, the news of Blue Planet and Dong Huangs lineage, the realm lord of the
Floating Realm, Wang Kong, advancing to super divine spread throughout the World King Planet.
This shocked all the races in the starry sky and they suddenly understood what was going on.
“Siphane is really dead. Its source of transcendence was extracted and absorbed by this Wang Kong!”
“This Wang Kong is a powerhouse himself. He has the battle record of a divine-level assassin super divine and is even expert in the spatial element.
This time, when he advances to the super divine level, it will be even more terrifying.”
“Wait a minute, in that case, Blue Planet is a planet with 11 super divines? What a joke..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1590 Predicting Loneliness (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1590 Predicting Loneliness (3)
﻿﻿The news of the Space Emperor advancing to super divine quickly spread to the Four Holy Family, making the Four Saints super divine of the Four Holy Family fall silent again and feel a little dizzy.
"Men." The Four Saints summoned their subordinates together and ordered,
"Take a generous gift and head to the Floating Realm. Congratulations to realm lord Wang Kong for advancing to super divine. You have to eliminate the influence of my rumors."
At this moment, the Four Holy Family was clearly very afraid of the Blue Planet bloodline that was at the height of its power. They didn't want to fall out immediately, nor did they want the Blue Planet bloodline to fall out with them immediately. They chose to admit defeat and tried to negotiate for the time being.
As Shi Yu and the others returned, not only the Four Holy Family, but countless factions also used the excuse of the Space Emperor advancing to super divine to come to the Floating Realm to send gifts and congratulate them, hoping to establish friendly relations with the Blue Planet.
