Some were also here to thank the Blue Planet for helping them destroy the Assassin Planet.
During this period, everyone who arrived could see another prison-like city in the sky of the Floating Realm.
This prison was currently holding tens of thousands of assassins. They were all enemies captured alive by Shi Yu and the others in the battle of Assassin Planet.
At this moment, under the power of Emperor Shi, most of their strength had already been erased and controlled below the divine level. It was suppressed to wait for judgment.
Shi Yu was free and liked to chat with the talents here. Their words were super nice.
"You're the one called Igor?" Shi Yu stood outside a prison and looked at the Teleportation Master, Igor, who was suppressed by the chains inside.
"Lord, Lord! Spare me." Teleportation Master Igor begged for mercy and said, "My ability is very rare. I was also captured by that bastard Siphane to join the Assassin Planet. I had no choice."
"I don't want to help the evildoer either. Spare me, I'll do my best to serve the lord…"
Shi Yu chuckled and said, "Did you teleport that killer near me through the magnetic skill?"
Teleportation Master Igor said with a bitter expression, "Lord, it's me, but I don't know anything. I'm just a tool."
"What level is your magnetic skill now?" Shi Yu asked.
Igor said, "Perfect divine skills. As long as the target is within the range of the Cosmic Sea, it can be teleported. But after leaving this range, it can't…"
"So useless??" Shi Yu was stunned.
"Huh??" Igor was stunned. This was useless?
It hurriedly said, "It's very useful. As long as you have the other party's personal items, you can locate it. On the Assassin Planet, I'm the most indispensable support, Lord…"
"Alright," Shi Yu said. "Show me a good performance. If the effect is really not bad…"
Igor was overjoyed. It knew that its ability was irreplaceable and that no one could bear to kill it.
"No problem, Lord!"
A moment later, Teleportation Master Igor was beaten to the verge of death by Shi Yu again for no reason. Shi Yu left the prison happily, feeling comfortable. He felt that his life-saving skills were increasing.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh…
Shi Yu walked past the prison and heard a pile of pens. They were assassins writing about their talent and talent. Initially, this was a group of sacrificial soldiers. Most of them wouldn't betray the Assassin Planet even if they died. However, they couldn't help it. The time capability was too buggy, so they directly deleted their memories of being loyal to the Assassin Planet.
Next, it depended on how many valuable skills and talents could be squeezed out of this group of people.
Shi Yu was still looking forward to it. At least, the resources plundered by the owl and cat on the Assassin Planet were really rich. It was enough to pile up a third-level new realm in the Dong Huang Realm to a point where it was even richer than a first-level realm.
In short, Senior Lu was considered lucky for the next emperors who came from Blue Planet. She might be even richer than Shi Yu, who had just arrived at World King Planet.
…
"Sister, I've decided."
"Decided what?" Somewhere in the Floating Realm, the owl received the Exposing King, who had also come to send blessings.
"I've decided. I won't add any additional conditions to Shi Yu. Let's select him as the Sons of Prophecy of our Astrologer Race. Our race will assist him in his growth with all our might!"
"Hmph." The owl looked at the other party in disdain and said, "What were you doing earlier? I told you he had potential, but you didn't believe me. Do they lack your support now? That Emperor Shi, time-element super divine, four super divine time pets!!"
Patriarch Tu Tu looked conflicted and said, "You didn't tell me that Blue Planet was so lucky previously. If you had told me that Blue Planet was a high-level lucky star, if you had told me that Blue Planet's bloodline was so strong, wouldn't I have been conflicted?"
Moreover, it didn't agree easily because it was afraid that its identity as the Exposing King would drag Shi Yu down.
"In addition, although that Emperor Shi's capability is strong, Sister, don't forget that with the backing of our family's treasure, not to mention super divine, we can even divine a cosmic level…"
"Tell Shi Yu. He definitely has something he wants to know…"
The Prediction Owl fell into deep thought and said, "Alright, now you know how sharp my taste is, right?"
Exposing King nodded crazily.
Soon, Shi Yu was found by the owl.
"Hehe, realm lord Shi Yu, you guys are very powerful this time."
"I questioned Sister to call you here this time because I want to discuss to you about the cooperation again."
"Oh? What cooperation?" Shi Yu said.
Patriarch Tu Tu said, "In our Astrologer Race, there's a gem that can strengthen the premonition ability. Only the Astrologer Race can use it. The highest can predict things about the universe level."

chapters.title: Chapter 1591 - 1591: Predicting Loneliness (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1591 - 1591: Predicting Loneliness (4)
Chapter 1591: Predicting Loneliness (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“However, using this treasure will cause the treasure to suffer a lot of wear and tear. It can only recover one premonition opportunity every thousand years. This premonition opportunity is actually not very useful to astrologers. This is because there will always be some backlash when the astrologers predict themselves, but for outsiders, the accuracy is extremely high.”
“Therefore, I want the Astrologer Race to form an alliance with Blue Planet and use three premonition opportunities as a greeting gift. Moreover, I want to give the realm lord Shi Yu the treatment of the Sons of Prophecy. As long as there’s a need, vou can use the Dower of the Astrologer Race’s treasure to
make a prophecy at any time.”
Shi Yu smiled as he looked at Patriarch Tu Tu. He knew that it had changed its position when it saw Blue Planet’s performance this time.
“Alright, I happen to have a few things I want to predict. Patriarch Tu Tu, estimate if you can do it.”
“What?”
Shi Yu said, “l want to know the exact method to advance to the cosmic level.’
Even Emperor Shi didn’t know this, nor did he know if the Astrologer Race had any way to know.
Patriarch Tu Tu t s ears twitched. “Ah, this, this, in theory, it can be done, but it’s not a one-time prediction.”
“What do you mean?” Shi Yu said.
Patriarch Tu Tu said, “There was also a super divine expert who came to me to seek a way to advance to the cosmic level, but unfortunately, the premonition didn’t give clear instructions. It only guided the other party to continue staying on the World King Planet. Perhaps there’s a glimmer of hope in the future.’
“He originally thought that he could learn from Lord World King that after waiting for a long time and finally waiting for Lord World King to wake up once, because Lord World King was a planetary life form, the method to advance to the cosmic level was different from other life forms. He didn’t obtain any results. Then, he died here.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “Then I’ll try too.”
Patriarch Tu Tu said, “Sure, but I can only give you an answer after returning to the family. Is there anything else you want to predict?”
“Hehe, but the realm lord Shi Yu is indeed ambitious. He’s actually also coveting that cosmic throne.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Apart from that, I also want to know where the remaining five inheritances of the Star Prayer Race are. It shouldn’t be a problem, right? Didn’t you say that you wanted to assist Teacher Ying in finding the inheritance?”
“That’s not a problem, but like the previous prophecy, it requires time. The former involves the cosmic level, while the latter’s premonition range might exceed the Cosmic Sea, but the entire universe also requires time.”
“l see. Then let’s talk about these two questions first.”
After Shi Yu and Patriarch Tu Tu finished communicating, the other party immediately bade farewell and returned to the Back family to help Shi Yu predict the future.
After his brother left, the Prediction Owl smiled and looked at Shi Yu. “Shi Yu, I guess you’ll be recuperating here for a year next and won’t go out to wander.”
“Right?”
Shi Yu rolled his eyes and said, “Teacher Owl, don’t predict such a meaningless thing. You might as well divine more. Are there any era ruins similar to the one Emperor Shi entered on Blue Planet?”
“I know, I know.” The Prediction Owl felt bored.
In a few days, the top eight of the Blue Planet’s competition was finally received from World King Planet.
Just as they entered, Dong Huang and the other Beast Tamers found their own places to fight the next God Sealing Battle.
Yes, in the top eight, there were a total of five Beast Tamers from Dong Huang. Apart from the three emperors and Lu Qingyi, the Tyrannical Sea Legend also successfully entered the top eight.
After the Mythical Revival, the evolution speed of his Giant Leviathan, which seemed to have the inheritance of a worm and had mastered Infinite Devour, increased greatly. After arriving at the World King Planet, it was immediately pulled over by Lin Feng, who had the evolution talent, to be his assistant.
As for Lu Qingyi, she entered the Assassin Prison and became the prison director. With the cooperation of the Space Emperor’s pet, she controlled the prison.
As for Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor, they were strongly requested by the five divine races to invest in the three emperors.
The five divine races finally realized the potential of the Blue Planet’s human race. They had missed the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and Shi Yu. This time, they chose to target the three emperors. They planned to strive to let their future tenth pet choose among the five divine races no matter what.
Emperor Kong, and Lin Feng weren’t free at the moment and didn’t have time to take care of them. The Empress, who had the bloodline of the Phoenix, could obtain much better cultivation in the Phoenix Race than him messing around.
As for the Dragon Emperor, he could clearly obtain better development from the dragon race. As for Emperor Wu, the Angel Race and the Demon Race took a fancy to Emperor Wu’s outstanding Fusion Talent at the same time. As everyone knew, the effect was greatest when humanoid creatures and humans fused. However, Emperor Wu wasn’t interested in birdmen and demons, but he was a little interested in the extinct Kirin Race on the Blue Planet.
This made the Kirin Race, who usually suffered grievances, extremely touched.
“Sleep!”
Ever since the Blue Planet destroyed the Assassin Planet, the Floating Realm had become dozens of times more lively every day. As for Shi Yu, under the lively background, he chose to cultivate quietly again…
After breaking through to the divine level, he began to mess around. Now that he didn’t lack any resources and had the protection of a big boss, Shi Yu could finally work overtime in peace.
However, before Shi Yu could calm down for long, the Prediction Owl rushed to find Shi Yu.
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu, the prediction result is out!!!”
“What??” Shi Yu looked at the owl and said, “Which one is it?”
The owl said, “The cosmic level… This is actually the first time the Astrologer Race predicted how humans would break through to the cosmic level and obtained a clear answer. The last time they found the Astrologer Race to predict it, it wasn’t humans, but cosmic life forms.”
“My brother predicted it for you and your initial pet, Eleven…”
“What conditions do Eleven need to break through to the cosmic level?” Shi Yu asked.
The owl said, “The outcome I predicted was… the cosmic overlord army.”
“Huh?” Shi Yu was stunned. “What do you mean?”
The owl said, “That’s it. If Eleven can really break through to the cosmic level, the opportunity will be in the cosmic overlord army. This kind of thing is to search for traces of possibility from countless impossible things. There won’t be any clear direction at all. We can only search for it ourselves.”
Shi Yu: “..You guys are so lonely. Don’t tell me I still have to join the cosmic overlord army?”
The owl: “Cosmic level, this is a cosmic level!!”
Shi Yu said helplessly, “Alright, then what about the opportunity for me to break through to the cosmic level? If I break through to the cosmic level and become a cosmic Beast Tamer, theoretically speaking, I should be like a super divine Beast Tamer who can casually strengthen a certain super divine pet to the cosmic level”
“Your method of breaking through to the cosmic level is really very clear!” the Prediction Owl said. “Even my brother said so. I didn’t expect it to be such a clear method.”
“In short, the method for lives other than humans to advance to the cosmic level is still unclear, but the method for humans, or rather, yours, is very clear.”
“What?”
“The result of the premonition is that as long as you can contract a cosmic life form, you will be a cosmic Beast Tamer.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Shi Yu’s face darkened. He felt that the Astrologer Race was talking bullsh*t.
“I don’t want to cooperate with the astrologers anymore. What should I do?”
“Teacher Owl, why do I feel that the Astrologer Race is as unreliable as you in the Imperial Capital University before you awakened?”
“Isn’t this obvious? I cultivated a cosmic-level pet, so I’m definitely a cosmic-level Beast Tamer.”
“Cough, cough, cough,” the owl said. “Wait, that’s not what I mean. I mean, you need to contract a cosmic pet at the super divine level to break through to the cosmic level, not nurture it yourself. After all, we don’t know how to nurture a cosmic level.”
“Probably. When you reach the peak of the super divine level, if you can successfully contract one of the universe-level big shots of the World King, Beast King, Dark King, Worm Queen, and cosmic overlord, you can break through the level of life and reach the cosmic level from the super divine level.
Of course… it still seems a little unreliable..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1592 Master Arms (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1592 Master Arms (1)
﻿﻿"Goodbye."
Shi Yu chose to bid farewell to the owl.
There was no such scam.
No matter how he thought about it, it was impossible for those five guys sitting on the cosmic throne to be contracted.
It was better to rely on himself to nurture a cosmic level than to contract them.
"Wait!"
The owl said, "By the way, by the way, there seem to be more than five choices."
"Hm?"
"It's said that there's still a sixth cosmic level in the universe that might or might not exist."
"Us astrologers know that this sixth cosmic level actually exists."
"Therefore, it's very likely that your contracted target is it!"
"After all, its traces of existence have already been lost in the history of the universe. As an archeologist, you will definitely explore its traces, right? You might be fated because of this!"
Shi Yu looked at the owl and said, "Your deduction this time seems to be a little complicated. I did have the thought of searching for it."
"Hehe." The owl was smug.
"But it's still unreliable! You've also guided us to the cosmic overlord army. Do I still have a chance to contract a cosmic overlord? Are you sure I won't be killed?"
The owl said with a bitter expression, "Well, it's already very impressive that I can predict things like this to this extent."
"You have to know that you've just entered the divine level and are still a distance away from super divine. It's always a good thing that your direction is clearer now…"
Shi Yu said, "Alright…"
"Then next, let me walk around more with the cosmic overlord army and explore who the sixth cosmic level is. Right."
The owl nodded. That was right, that was right.
"Wait, do you think it's possible for me to see Lord World King later and ask about the method for the planet to advance to the cosmic level?" Shi Yu said. "Planet life forms indeed have different advancement methods from other life forms…"
"But I also have Little Zi."
"Then, if Little Zi breaks through, is it possible for me to use its power to reach the cosmic level myself?"
The Prediction Owl was stunned. "Uh, Lord World King doesn't wake up all the time. He sleeps for hundreds of thousands of years or millions of years. At any point, it's run of the mill. If you want to wait for him, who knows how long it will take."
"Unless the World King Planet encounters a crisis and the other four cosmic levels make a move and leave their territory, the World King basically doesn't care…"
"Even if it awakens, only by reaching the peak of the super divine level… In other words, transcendent 10 will I have the chance and qualifications to see it. Well, the guy who once sought a cosmic-level advancement method from the Astrologer Race later became a peak super divine."
"He's now one of the three peak super divines under the World King."
"In addition, actually, I don't recommend you directly ask the cosmic level for the method to break through to the cosmic level. You just have to explore it secretly."
"Have you ever thought that if a universe can only accommodate five cosmic levels at most, the birth of a new cosmic level will definitely mean the death of another cosmic level? At that time, what should we do?"
"Just like how the Four Holy Evolvers with super divine potential aren't allowed to challenge their positions, five cosmic levels might not be allowed to challenge their positions either."
"You're not a direct descendant of the World King Planet. Why should the World King tell you? Finding other cosmic levels to ask… That's even more unreliable."
"Have you heard of such a rumor? The reason why the sixth cosmic level disappeared might be because only five cosmic levels can exist in the universe. Its existence is not allowed, and then it was erased by someone."
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and felt that it was extremely troublesome.
"I understand." Shi Yu nodded and said, "Then quickly help Teacher Ying predict the wish star inheritance. I'll take advantage of this period of time to enter seclusion to cultivate. After we're done with both parties, I'll take a trip to the real starry sky."
"I also want to find Goddess Wa… Speaking of which, could she be the sixth cosmic level?"
The owl: ???
"Why are you only thinking about beautiful things? Are you addicted to cozying up to someone powerful?"
"Haha." Shi Yu smiled and scratched his head. "I think it's unreliable too. I'm presently satisfied that she's super divine. After all, if she's at the cosmic level, it's easy for her to nurture a super divine human herself. There's no need to ask Blue Planet at all."
"Hmph," the Prediction Owl said. "When that cat obtains all the inheritance of the Star Prayer Race, perhaps with its support, it can predict the truth of the universe additional clearly."
"At that time, there's no need to guess randomly."
"That's true. Let's do this first." Shi Yu sent the owl away and didn't continue his seclusion. Instead, he walked out of the room and waited for another guest. Calculating the time, she would be here soon.
As expected, not long after, Shi Yu waited for a battleship marked with the symbol of a universal overlord to land in this city.
Zi Jian's special forces!
At this moment, when he saw the universal overlord army, Shi Yu's heart was complicated. The opportunity for Eleven to break through to the cosmic rank was here?
Could it be that it was as the owl had said? There were limits to the cosmic level. Eleven could only advance after they defeated the cosmic overlord?
But in that case, why didn't he fight the Dark King, the Worm King, the Beast King, and the World King?
It was uttered that these four universal emperors were weaker than cosmic overlords.
If he had to challenge a universal level, Shi Yu would definitely choose the Dark King and not a cosmic overlord. After all, there was Susu…
Of course, at that level, it was uncertain if the cleansing star spirit could yet counter the other party.

chapters.title: Chapter 1593 - 1593: Master Arms (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1593 - 1593: Master Arms (2)
Chapter 1593: Master Arms (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
The president of the Environmental Protection Association was also a cleansing star spirit. He even had the support of the super divine vice president. Not to mention the Dark King, he couldn’t even kill the peak super divine under the Dark King. It was unrealistic for him to jump levels later.
“Congratulations, realm lord Shi Yu.” Captain Zi Jian arrived and congratulated Shi Yu with a smile when she saw him for the first time.
“Now, your Blue Planet bloodline’s reputation has already resounded in the Cosmic Sea. Impressive, impressive.”
“It’s just an empty title. The Blue Planet lineage looks to have many super divines, but their overall strength is far inferior to the real top factions.” Shi Yu also smiled and said, “It still needs a long time to develop. Next, we can walk around more.’
If he built a good relationship with the cosmic overlord army, he could also buy some resources outside the World King Planet and the Cosmic Sea.
“Sure,” Captain Zi Jian said. “Here, I’ve brought you the super divine stone I owe you, the planet resources you want, and the cosmic star map you want.”
“Happy transaction,” Shi Yu said happily. He didn’t expect Captain Zi Jian to be so agile.
On the World King Planet, there was only a star map related to the Cosmic Sea. It wasn’t easy to obtain the star maps of the other four cosmic-level factions. If he really wanted to obtain it, he still had to rely on the cosmic overlord army.
Although the one Zi Jian brought wasn’t very comprehensive, it was already much better than what Shi Yu could obtain. It could be very helpful when he went out in the future.
As for planetary resources, Shi Yu naturally bought many planets from the cosmic overlord army.
He had previously promised his pets to prepare a set of Star Arms for each of them.
This time, he had fulfilled his promise.
There were a total of 12 intermediate planets that had yet to give birth to life. All of them were top-notch.
After refining it, Eleven and the others’ battle power should increase greatly.
Shi Yu had spent a lot to buy this batch of resources, but he also had money now. The resources distributed after ransacking the Assassin Planet were enough to support Shi Yu in buying 12 intermediate-level dead stars. Moreover, there was still a portion that Zi Jian hoped to pay for the Cultivation Fruit.
“Happy transaction,” Captain Zi Jian also said.
“Shi Yu…” After the transaction was completed, Zi Jian said, “Can you
introduce me to Emperor Shi?”
Shi Yu was stunned. “This might be a little difficult. After Senior Emperor Shi returned, I don’t know where he went. I can’t find him either.’
Of course… these words were fake. After Emperor Shi returned, he chose to enter seclusion again, indicating that he didn’t see anyone and rejected all visitors.
“Ah.” Zi Jian was stunned. “When the emperor returns, if you see him, help mention it.”
“Why are you looking for Senior Emperor Shi?” Shi Yu asked.
“Did Emperor Shi teach you your archeological skills?” Captain Zi Jian asked with a smile.
“Uh, half of it,” Shi Yu said.
“I’m not wrong. A super divine expert who’s an expert in the time element must also be a powerful archeologist. Actually, that’s the case. Soon, 1 might have to return to the headquarters,” Zi Jian said.
“Weren’t you just assigned to the Cosmic Sea?” Shi Yu said in surprise. “How long has it been? It’s not enough time to travel.”
Captain Zi Jian shrugged and said, “l have no choice. An extremely special and important era ruin was discovered over there. The headquarters has already started to gather archeologists who don’t have any important missions for the time being to explore.”
“This ruin isn’t ordinary. I’m not confident, so I want to find more external help to explore it together. Of course, I’ll definitely be rewarded.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Senior Emperor Shi shouldn’t fancy ordinary remuneration, but what kind of ruin is it that even Captain Zi Jian has to admit defeat?”
Zi Jian looked at Shi Yu and said, “‘Up’ to the ruins of a cosmic era.”
When Zi Jian said that, Shi Yu was stunned.
The ruins of the last cosmic era???
The era ruin usually referred to the ruins of the last cosmic era, which was the era where Shi Yu’s previous life was, the era where Earth was.
And to be honest, there were very, very few ruins from the previous cosmic era that were still left in this era.
No wonder Zi Jian said that she wasn’t very confident either. This interval was even longer.
“If you’re looking for Senior Emperor Shi, why don’t you look for me?” Shi Yu said. “He’s not interested in archeology.”
Captain Zi Jian chuckled and said, “l can trust your ability, but do you dare to come with me?”
“I’m afraid that before I could leave the World King Planet, my fleet was stopped by the realm lord Wang Kong and the super divine of your Blue Planet.’
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “That’s true, but if there’s a chance, we might be able to cooperate.”
“After all, 1 might not necessarily stay on World King Planet all the time…”
Zi Jian thought of the star map Shi Yu had asked her for and understood that Shi Yu definitely had other plans.
“Since Emperor Shi isn’t around, forget it. I’ll visit the realm lord next,” After tying her purple hair to her head, she turned around and said.
“If you really go to the territory of the cosmic overlord army one day and I’m still over there, you can come and find me.”
“No problem,” Shi Yu said. “By the way, bring more good wine to visit the
Senior Space Emperor. He likes to drink.”
Captain Zi Jian: “…I understand.”
Shi Yu was a reverse cultivator. Emperor Wu, the Empress, the Dragon
Emperor, Lu Oingyi, and the others had all come to World King Planet to train, but Shi Yu packed up and planned to return to Blue Planet to cultivate bitterly.
The reason was very simple. Letting pets refine stars here was too
eye-catching. It was better to go to the remote galaxy where Blue Planet was..

chapters.title: Chapter 1594 Master Arms (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1594 Master Arms (3)
?Moreover, if he wanted to add points, the power of the world that Baby Ginseng had neglected for a long time was finally useful. Wasn't the power of freeloading on Blue Planet better than on World King Planet?
With the power of Blue Planet, the power of the Four Holy Ruins, and Shi Yu's remaining resources, he planned to charge forward.
If it went smoothly, it shouldn't be long before he could strengthen everyone to a top-notch divine or even a perfect god.
After packing up, Shi Yu directly returned to Blue Planet and left a pile of resources for Teacher Ying to take care of the Dong Huang Realm.
"Why are you back?" At this moment, on Blue Planet, the World Tree and Blue Planet's Will also knew that they were famous in the Cosmic Sea.
All of this was naturally thanks to Shi Yu making enemies. Otherwise, the Blue Planet bloodline wouldn't have had the chance to show their might. The last time Shi Yu returned, it was to avoid the limelight. What was it this time?
The World Tree suspected that… Shi Yu had caused trouble again.
"Cough, what's with that look? I came back this time to cultivate in seclusion," Shi Yu said. "Aunt World Tree, where's our mother? Hurry up and get me some pseudo sources of transcendence."
"There are still 55 left, right? Give me 35 first. I've also taken Senior Wang Kong's share. I've already agreed with him."
World Tree: ???
"Why do you want so many of these?" It was at a loss. Didn't Shi Yu not have a super divine level yet?
"Hehe, it's naturally useful. It's to increase strength," Shi Yu said. "Hurry, hurry, hurry."
"I… I understand." If Shi Yu wanted it, he would give it to Shi Yu.
"I'll get it for you." The World Tree sighed and took out a portion of the pseudo source of transcendence stored in Blue Planet and handed it to Shi Yu.
35 pseudo sources of transcendence could allow super divines with better aptitudes and low realms to break through 1 to 2 times. He didn't know what Shi Yu wanted it for.
"Let's go." Shi Yu took away the pseudo source of transcendence and immediately left.
Naturally, he ran to strengthen Beast Shi Yu immediately.
Shi Yu returned to his hometown, Icefield. He entered the cultivation mystic realm he had established in the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain and summoned all his pets.
Before assigning the cultivation quests, Shi Yu first used the source of transcendence to strengthen Beast Shi Yu under their gazes.
Previously, Beast Shi Yu, who had fused with a pseudo source of transcendence and was fully armed with the four holy equipment, already had the battle power of a quasi epoch god. And now, under the gift of Blue Planet, his physical strength had obtained a terrifying increase again.
At that time, when Shi Yu fused him with a third of the pseudo source of transcendence, he already felt that Beast Shi Yu's physical strength had undergone a qualitative change again, as if a god was roaring in his body.
Under Shi Yu's control, his eyes were like stars, and his body seemed to be able to support the world, containing peerless divine power.
"Not bad." Beast Shi Yu clenched his fists.
"According to my judgment, at this moment, Beast Shi Yu, with the enhancement of the power of faith of the Four Saints, should have the ability to fight against weaker super divines without his mental clone dispersing," Ling said.
"Very good." Shi Yu was also very satisfied. He felt that this pseudo transcendence source was not a waste. He continued to strengthen and fuse. After an unknown period of time, Beast Shi Yu's body was already filled with the hazy light of the sun. After his physical strength consumed all the pseudo transcendent source of transcendence, it reached an unbelievable level.
At this moment, every pet looked at Beast Shi Yu in shock. Just looking at him and approaching him, they could feel a huge super divine pressure. This feeling was no different from them facing other super divine experts.
"Wu wu wu…" Eleven's expression was solemn. It felt that it couldn't defeat Beast Shi Yu anymore.
Damn it.
"Perhaps with the help of Beast Shi Yu… even if we quickly defeat one of the five super divines on Blue Planet, it's not difficult," Ling said.
"Unfortunately, we lack powerful offensive and defensive methods," Shi Yu said. "If Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others reach the level of perfect gods and cultivate all their faith divine skills to perfect level, with the help of the Four Holy Ruins, Beast Shi Yu should have strength comparable to super four, right?"
Transcendent 1 to 3, transcendent 4 to 6, transcendent 7 to 9, and transcendent 10 respectively represented transcendent four major stages. The difference between each small stage might still be able to be crossed, but it was relatively difficult to cross between the major stages.
This was likewise the reason why Emperor Shi could suppress the super divine killer. Apart from the fact that the moment element was very strong, it was also related to his higher level.
Shi Yu estimated that Beast Shi Yu's current limit, with the power of the Four Holy Pets and the Four Holy Ruins, should be more than 2 to 3. With this strength, he could bully the five super divines on Blue Planet. It wasn't impossible to resist the super godly killer, Siphane, but there was clearly yet a gap between him and Emperor Shi and the Four Holy Ruins.
It wasn't enough!
However, it could yet be improved.
"Yes," Ling said. "So more strengthening needs to be completed."
"Oh~" Shi Yu uttered tiredly, "Sigh, I'm so tired no matter what. Damn, the stronger it is, the greater the burden on the clone. Let's do this first. I have to increase my mental might too."
"Ling, bring everyone to a quiet place in the starry sky to refine the Star Arms. I want to sleep for a month first."
"When you're all done refining and I'm awake, we'll add points."
"Alright."
After Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone immediately rubbed their fists and acquired their Star Stones. They were very expectant. They had wanted the Star Arms for a long time.
"Buggy, Qi, you formerly have weapons. I have something else to ask of you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1595 - 1595: Master Arms (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1595 - 1595: Master Arms (4)
Chapter 1595: Master Arms (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Buggy, use the Four Holy Ruins and the laws of spring to take care of the
Cultivation Fruits planted by Baby Ginseng.”
“Qi, you have the experience of already refining stars. Help Eleven and the others, and let them take fewer detours.’
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Buggy was shocked. Why had it become a gardener… But forget it, using the power of the Creation God in the Four Holy Ruins was also a form of cultivation.
“Ah, don’t you need me to stay beside you? This way, you only have…” Qi was worried that Shi Yu would encounter another assassin or something.
“It’s alright. With Buggy and Beast Shi Yu around.” Shi Yu had already taught the magnetic skill to Buggy, the only one who could learn this move. Although this move was called the magnetic skill, it had nothing to do with the lightning element. It was a dual-element skill of the spatial and spiritual elements. Its arrival strengthened Shi Yu’s escape ability again.
Unfortunately, the Hole of the Universe that he had replicated previously still didn’t have any learning conditions. This made Shi Yu very silent. Should he find a cosmic behemoth to contract? Otherwise, the skill would be wasted.
“Alright…” Qi said.
“Go, go.” Shi Yu saw that a group of pets was still staring at him eagerly and chased them away with a smile.
“Wuu! Then, many pets began to act according to Shi Yu’s instructions.
Shi Yu also entered a sleeping state. Although his spatial and time talents had yet to reach Level 10, Shi Yu chose to cultivate the Beast Taming Space this time.
He hoped to use the two meditation jades and the divine-level Cultivation Fruit to quickly raise his Beast Taming level to the seventh level of the divine level.
At that time, his physique would undergo another qualitative change. It would also be easier to add points to his pet.
Also, it could reduce the burden of controlling Beast Shi Yu.
Beast Shi Yu was in a daze. Buggy farmed, and Shi Yu’s main body slept, forming a diligent painting. In the starry sky, Eleven and the others also got busy.
This was another thing that everyone competed in and did at the same time. Every pet hoped that the Star Arms they refined were the strongest.
“Wuu! Among them, Eleven obtained a top-notch metal and wood-element star. It stood on the star and naturally hoped to refine it into the shape of bamboo…
At that time, not only could the bamboo cooperate with its Battle God Body as a weapon and contain one-star divine power, but it could also be eaten as food, supplements, and medicine. It was beautiful.
Of course, the way every pet refined weapons was different. Some chose to strengthen themselves, while others chose to fill in the gaps. For example, Baby Ginseng was ridiculous and decided to refine a huge cauldron.
It had obtained a star that was the secondary wood of the main fire. It planned to… refine a cauldron to assist it in researching and cooking various foods, and even refining pills. In the plant association, there was also a batch of cultivators who used plants to refine pills. Baby Ginseng planned to learn from them and broaden its path.
“Yi…”Baby Ginseng prepared to name it the Heavenly Emperor Cauldron.
On the other side, Chi Tong had obtained a top-notch metal-element and fire-element star. Initially, Shi Yu wanted to prepare a new star for Chi Tong to refine. However, considering that Chi Tongs fire-element power was already very strong, but it lacked metal-element power to neutralize it, he chose the metal-element star. On Chi Tongs side, it naturally wanted to refine a sharp metal sword to match its illusion as a heroic spirit. One was illusionary, and the other was real. The two swords were harmonious.
As for Susu, it had obtained an ice and snow star that had been corroded by the cold silence of the cosmic disaster. The time of this star had been frozen. Shi Yu planned to see if he could cooperate with the skill deduction and the
Heavenly Frost Cold Energy in the future to let Susu learn the disaster skill ‘Cold Silence’. Susu decided to refine the star into the appearance of a crown and turn itself into the Starry Sky Slime King.
Ling, on the other hand, had obtained the same spatial star as Qi to strengthen the spatial ability of the battleship. He planned to refine it into a special device and load it onto the battleship. Shi Yu actually wanted a lucky star to strengthen Lings luck, but unfortunately, the cosmic overlord army couldn’t find time, luck, and other stars. Shi Yu could only let Ling refine a
spatial star first and replace it in the future when he found a lucky star.
On Little Zi’s side, it was the most excited. Learning the Star Refinement skill meant that it could finally master attack methods that didn’t affect it too much. The stars it obtained were also spatial. Spatial stars were already the best stars that could be found under normal circumstances. Before encountering a better one, Shi Yu could only let them make do.
The weapon Little Zi wanted to refine was the Star Ring.
In the second team, Little Ji, Duckie, Shorty, Turtle, Little Quas, and the others also displayed their divine powers. They held their stars and refined huge swords, Demon Subduing Pestle, and other weapons they liked.
Just like that, a month passed as Shi Yu slept. During this sleep, the consumption of the meditation jade was especially fast. Two pieces were directly crippled. Of course, Shi Yu didn’t lack this thing now. Although it was expensive, with Blue Planet’s current wealth, he could buy whatever he wanted.
At this moment, he had also successfully broken through to the seventh level of the divine level. As for his pets, they had also completed the refinement of the stars one by one. At this moment, they had already entered the stage of adapting and familiarizing themselves with new weapons.
Next was naturally adding points. At this moment, Shi Yu, who had reached the late stage of the divine level, had divine skills that could be added at the moment. There were ordinary divine skills like Wind Control and high-level divine skills like Light Control. Unfortunately, top-notch divine skills still couldn’t be added. It was probably because Shi Yu’s level wasn’t high enough and he needed to wait for the peak of the divine level to try.
However, as long as there were points, it was fine. After the pets returned, Shi Yu directly chose the few divine skills that should be upgraded the most in the current theory to add points.
As the previous first place… Baby Ginseng naturally enjoyed the treatment of being the first to add points.
The World Grace of Baby Ginseng and the Cultivation Fruit were both classic examples of the more benefits there were the earlier one added points.
Four months later, World King Planet.
The deputy realm lord of the Dong Huang Realm, a gem cat girl in a formal suit, received the owl happily.
“l didn’t disappoint,” the owl said. “It’s finally over.”
“You’ve worked hard,” the gem cat girl said in anticipation. “How is it?”
The owl said, “The remaining five wishing star inheritances are no longer in the range of the Cosmic Sea. Four are in the range of the cosmic overlord’s territory, and one is in the range of the Dark Kings territory…”
“If I want to find it, I might have to go on a long trip…”
“Huh?” The gem cat had a bitter expression. That was really far. She definitely didn’t dare do it herself. She didn’t know how bitter Shi Yu e s cultivation was.
It had been four months. Could he defeat a super divine level??
If possible, they could have a trip just like that.
The gem cat clearly trusted Shi Yu and his unscientific breakthrough speed.
“I’ll go ask Shi Yu. He also seems to have been wanting to go out and find Goddess Wa and the ruins of Earth,” the gem cat said. “If it weren’t for the prophecy you guys made about the Wish Star, he would definitely have been cultivating bitterly while traveling.”
Shi Yu mainly wanted to try and see if he could open the ruins of Earth mentioned by Goddess Wa without gathering five super divines with the help of Beast Shi Yu himself.
“Wait!” The owl said, “Don’t tempt him randomly. I previously predicted that he would cultivate bitterly for a year before going out to have fun. It’s only been four months… The prophecy will be successful in a few months.”
The gem cat said, “Today, I’m going to ruin your cultivation!”
“???”
“Damn it, you bad cat! Wait, I’ll go too!” It had actually used the family’s treasure to predict the location of these five wishing stars and snatched its brother’s job. It was mainly because if the prediction was successful, it would be a large amount of EXP. The owl didn’t want to miss it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1596 Going to the Contaminated Land (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1596 Going to the Contaminated Land (1)
?On Blue Planet, in the blue sky, two figures flew at high speed.
They were the two young dragons, the gem cat Ying and the owl Tu Na, who had come to find Shi Yu.
Before long, they arrived at Icefield and discovered Shi Yu, who was piling up snowmen.
Gem Cat, Prediction Owl: "?"
"Is he really cultivating seriously?" the Prediction Owl said.
The gem cat girl was also silent. Both parties quickly landed.
At this moment, Shi Yu, who had finished building the snowman and smashed it with a punch, also discovered the arrival of the gem cat and the others.
"What are you doing?" As soon as it descended, the gem cat couldn't help but ask. Was this the bitter cultivation Shi Yu mentioned?
Even the children in the kindergarten next door in Icefield Ping Cheng weren't as bored as him!
"Oh, Teacher Ying, Teacher Tu Na." Shi Yu let out a cold breath and looked at them.
"To be precise, it's cultivating the mind and nurturing the personality, allowing the mind to integrate into nature."
"???"
If you just build a snowman and don't smash it with a punch, we'll believe you.
"What's wrong? From the looks of it, you've almost predicted where the inheritance item of the Star Prayer Race is, right?" Shi Yu asked.
He was wearing white and was doing Taiji in the snow, making the two cats' faces darken.
Strange, too strange.
It had only been less than half a year, but Shi Yu was already like this.
Was he stimulated by something?
"Yeah!" The gem cat said, "How's your cultivation? Can you defeat a super divine level? When are we leaving for a trip together?"
Shi Yu said, "It's about time."
The owl: ???
There was something wrong with both of them.
One dared to ask, and the other really dared to answer.
"As expected of you!! No wonder you're lazing around. So you're almost done cultivating." The cat was happy.
Alright, if he went with Shi Yu now, his safety would at least be guaranteed.
"I'm really cultivating my heart…" Shi Yu couldn't help but say.
It had to be repaired.
Because his mentality had collapsed continuously in the past few months.
If he didn't take a break quickly, it would definitely affect his condition.
Initially, Shi Yu's additional points had been very smooth in the past few months.
For example, Baby Ginseng's World Grace divine skill. From entry-level to proficiency, to expert, to perfection (+47), Baby Ginseng's growth level increased with a whoosh.
Soon, it reached the level of a perfect god.
Just as Shi Yu was looking forward to being able to upgrade a transcendent-level divine skill and add points to an epoch god… he was finished.
The point of perfection to transcendence directly stuck, and the success rate of adding points was zero.
It was as if Baby Ginseng had a bottleneck from the Era God, and this bottleneck couldn't be broken with ordinary points.
This was the beginning of Shi Yu's mentality collapse.
Next, Shi Yu changed his skill in Baby Ginseng, the Cultivation Fruit experiment. It was still stuck (Perfect+47).
Helpless, Shi Yu had no choice but to change pets and add points to Ling's Blessing Wind and Mechanical Spirit. In the end, it was still the same outcome. He was stuck in front of the epoch god and couldn't break through.
This made Shi Yu very depressed.
When these four divine skills were pulled to the extreme of perfection, it was almost all Shi Yu had gained in the past four months.
As for the other pets, they had yet to level up.
However, although Baby Ginseng and Ling's divine power levels had reached the perfect divine level, Baby Ginseng and Ling's normal battle power wasn't very strong among perfect gods.
Because the holy skills that upgraded them were all supportive.
The World Grace of Baby Ginseng was a skill that could freeload the power of the world.
After reaching the perfect level, this skill was no longer a useless skill. Even if Shi Yu and the others went to other planets at this moment, they could forcefully plunder the strength of the world. Finally, they didn't have to take advantage of Blue Planet anymore.
If they were to undergo starry sky travel next, the strength of this world could be said to be a very good skill to replenish energy. In the universe, there were many planets. With a casual stop and entry into a planet, Baby Ginseng could plunder a large amount of the power of the world to replenish itself.
The second was the Cultivation Fruit. This was clearly not helpful in increasing Baby Ginseng's battle power either. Instead, it was helpful for the cultivation of all the team members. Thanks to Baby Ginseng's perfect Cultivation Fruit, Shi Yu's time and spatial talent finally followed his level and reached Level 10.
After that, Shi Yu began to wonder if ordinary divine skills couldn't be raised to transcendent. Just like how the highest level of quasi-divine skills was only perfect, he began to strengthen Ling's Wind of Luck, this high-level divine skill.
He hoped that his luck would be better.
In the end, after the Wind of Blessing was maxed out, it was the same. It couldn't break through.
At this moment, Shi Yu realized that if he wanted to nurture his pet to an epoch god, apart from the skill level, he might still lack something.
At this moment, Shi Yu no longer worked hard. Instead, he chose to go to the World Tree and inquire it to help awaken Blue Planet. He wanted to ask about this ancient existence.
In the end, he obtained an answer.
Will level.
The Blue Planet's Will stated that the Ancestral Dragon and the others back then were above perfect gods and below epoch gods.
When these peak-level gods invaded the war and fought the super holy invaders, they entered a mysterious state and erupted with stronger power.
This mysterious state was like a pet that had mastered the overlord's will erupting above its level. However, it was stronger than that. It could be called the sublimation of the overlord's will.
The peak gods on Blue Planet called this [Super Divine Heart] or [Super Divine Will].
This was the key ability of the perfect gods of Blue Planet to resist the three super holy invaders.

chapters.title: Chapter 1597 - 1597: Going to the Contaminated Land (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1597 - 1597: Going to the Contaminated Land (2)
Chapter 1597: Going to the Contaminated Land (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
At this moment, Shi Yu gradually understood.
Just like how the overlord’s will determined the difficulty of adding points to super skills and quasi-divine skills back then.
If he wanted to reach the transcendent divine skill, he might also need a higher level of willpower to cooperate.
Only by mastering the [Super Divine Will] could he cultivate the [Transcendent Divine Skill] and become the [Epoch God].
And if he wanted to cultivate the [Super Divine Will], he had to reach the divine level and challenge a super divine with a certain determination.
It wasn’t that the [Epoch God] could fight the [Super Divine] above its level, but that only by having the strength and determination to fight the super divine at the divine level and survive could it become the [Epoch God].
After thinking about this clearly, adding points wasn’t what Shi Yu mainly pursued.
With Beast Shi Yu around, he didn’t lack high-end battle power. How to nurture the [Super Divine Heart] and [Super Divine Will] for his pets was what Shi Yu needed to think about the most now.
He tried to use Beast Shi Yu as a super divine level sparring partner for Eleven and the others to challenge, but the effect wasn’t good at all.
Although Beast Shi Yu had super divine battle power, it was accumulated by various elements. In addition, Eleven and the others couldn’t have any determination to win against Beast Shi Yu. It didn’t meet the conditions to give birth to the Super Divine Will at all.
In other words, Beast Shi Yu wasn’t an enemy. He couldn’t give Eleven and the others the pressure to affect their hearts. It was completely incomparable to the super divine pressure when Blue Planet was invaded and Mythical Races were exterminated one after another.
Restricted by this, Shi Yu was no longer in a hurry to increase Eleven and the others’ strength. He began to add points to functional divine skills first. After the Wind of Luck was the Mechanical Spirit.
This skill largely determined the speed and safety of Shi Yu and the others when sailing in the starry sky in the future. It could be said to be a very necessary skill to increase. Coupled with the Wind of Blessing, Ling might be one of the best cosmic battleships in the World King Planet.
Even the cosmic overlord army might not necessarily be able to find a few cosmic battleships with better configurations than Ling.
As for Shi Yu, he had made these preparations in advance, undoubtedly waiting for the gem cat to come looking for him.
He planned to bring the gem cat to travel in the starry sky of the universe to see if there was a way to help Eleven and the others break through their will.
In addition, carrying out a cosmic tour actually wouldn’t waste too much time cultivating.
Because Baby Ginseng had mastered Star Refinement+Perfect Perfect World, it had already gotten a lot of the power of Blue Planet stored in the Heavenly Emperor Cauldron in advance. Coupled with the Four Holy Ruins, it was enough for Shi Yu to use outside for a long time and years.
In addition, most of the time in interstellar travel was meaningless flying time. This time was most suitable to be spent sleeping.
This was also the reason why Captain Zi Jian liked to cultivate the Cultivation Fruit so much. Sleeping was undoubtedly a waste of time, but if sleeping could also cultivate efficiently, the nature would be different.
“Where are the remaining five inheritances?” Shi Yu asked.
“Four in the territory of a cosmic overlord, and one in the territory of the Dark
King. ”
The gem cat took out a star map and handed it to Shi Yu. “As expected of a place where the wealth of the entire universe settles… There are actually four over there. 1 feel that it’s not easy to take.”
“As for the Dark King, it also feels very dangerous. Fortunately, from the interstellar location, it’s not too far from the Cosmic Sea. There’s no need to go deep into the other party’s territory.”
Shi Yu looked at the star map, and his eyes lit up. “Not bad.”
“What’s not bad??” The gem cat was stunned.
Shi Yu said, “Of course, it’s the location of the Wish Star… This Wish Star in the Contaminated Land is very close to the location of the era ruin marked on the star map left behind by Goddess Wa.”
“Really?” the gem cat said. “On the way?”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “It’s on the way. Moreover, Dark Kings territory…”
Shi Yu’s eyes were green, making the Prediction Owl shiver.
“What do you want?” the owl asked.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “It’s alright, it’s alright…”
In fact, the Dark Kings territory was the best place for Shi Yu to train his pet’s will.
For example, Susu had the determination to cleanse the Contaminated Land. If it fought with a super divine level Abyss Race, it might be able to train the Super Divine Heart.
Compared to other pets, as long as Susu found the right method, Shi Yu felt that it was most likely to be the first pet to nurture a Super Divine Will.
“There’s no time to lose. Prepare yourself. We’ll set off in two days,” Shi Yu said. “Well… Teacher Owl is going too?”
“Yes,” the owl said.
“Aren’t you afraid?”
The owl was speechless. “What’s there to be afraid of?”
Shi Yu was surprised. He had almost forgotten that Teacher Owl was no longer the same Teacher Owl as before.
Having awakened the memories of its previous life, it had already returned to the genius girl of the Astrologer Race.
It was a big boss who dared to go to the border of the Cosmic Sea to find the source of transcendence on the Blue Planet alone.
“If we go to the Contaminated Land, it seems to be closer to Blue Planet.” The geographical location of Blue Planet was located at the intersection of the Worm Mother Nest, the Contaminated Land, the Behemoth Universe Empire, and the Cosmic Sea. Apart from being far from the headquarters of the cosmic overlord army, it led to the other three places. They were all closer than directly setting off from the World King Planet.
Of course… this might also be the reason why Blue Planet was so miserable back then and was invaded by the three major factions consecutively.
“Are we… going to set off from Blue Planet?” the gem cat said.
“Yes, we’ll set off from Blue Planet, but before we set off, I have to tell the Senior Space Emperor and Blue Planet’s Mother Goddess,” Shi Yu said. “Why don’t we leave directly? They should be anxious if they can’t find us.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1598 Going to the Contaminated Land (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1598 Going to the Contaminated Land (3)
﻿﻿"Alright!! Then I'll go prepare first. I'll throw the Dong Huang Realm to Senior Divine Source to manage. He's also gone to the World King Planet to learn more profound mechanical technology. One thing is to do, and two things are also to do…" the gem cat said.
"Alright, alright." Shi Yu nodded.
After the three of them finished communicating, Shi Yu immediately set off and arrived at the permanent teleportation array, planning to return to the World King Planet.
When the World Tree clone saw Shi Yu coming over, it asked, "You're leaving?"
Just now, when the gem cat and owl came, it knew that Shi Yu definitely wouldn't stay long.
"Can't bear me to leave?" Shi Yu said with a smile.
The World Tree clone said, "You flatter yourself."
"Looks like you've saved enough resources."
Shi Yu had stayed on Blue Planet for half a year. The power of the world he consumed was more than all the divine and demigod levels on Blue Planet combined. Fortunately, Shi Yu was only at the divine level and had yet to reach the super divine level. Otherwise, according to the World Tree, Blue Planet definitely couldn't afford to raise Shi Yu of the same level!
This kid didn't use it, but saved it. He couldn't use it all at the moment. He even stored the power of the world he had extracted elsewhere and kept it as a backup. It directly made the World Tree speechless.
However, this way, even if Shi Yu left Blue Planet, he still had a large amount of reserve resources. It was more convenient.
Of course, although he was speechless, this consumption was a drop in the bucket for Blue Planet, which had advanced to a high-level planet. Blue Planet was also happy to see Shi Yu have the ability to take it away and use it to increase his strength.
"Yes, but I'll be back later. Teacher Ying, I, and the others are going to set off from Blue Planet to find the Wish Star inheritance that has been lost in various places in the universe. I'll tell you first."
"You're going on a trip?" The World Tree was stunned. "Are you sure??"
Space travel was much more dangerous than cultivating on World King Planet.
If they encountered a cosmic disaster, even a few lives wouldn't be enough.
"Don't worry, it's alright. I'm already sufficiently prepared," Shi Yu said. With that said, he stepped onto the permanent teleportation array, planning to tell the Space Emperor.
"Wait, the most important thing is, why are we setting off from Blue Planet…" The World Tree's expression darkened.
If it was a trip to the Cosmic Sea, setting off from World King Planet was clearly more suitable.
If he set off from Blue Planet… Obviously, Shi Yu's destination wasn't a certain place in the Cosmic Sea.
It was the territory of the other super creatures sitting on the throne of the universe!
Shi Yu… wanted to travel to the territories of other cosmic emperors…
At the thought of this, it suddenly felt a little nervous.
Damn.
Shi Yu could provoke a bunch of strong enemies in a relatively peaceful and stable place like World King Planet.
The World Tree didn't dare to imagine what would happen if he went to the enemy camp.
"Blue Planet is already high-level, but it actually can't keep him! What kind of person is this?"
World King Planet, Dong Huang Realm.
At this moment, the Dong Huang Realm had already developed thriving.
A large number of Beast Tamers from the floating, Dong Xuan, and Heavenly Demon Realms moved here to stay. Clearly, they had taken a fancy to the future development potential of the Dong Huang Realm, which had a permanent teleportation array.
Of course, there were still a few people in the Dong Huang Realm who relied on the immigration of the three major realms and the arrival of Blue Planet.
In order to introduce a population, Shi Yu chose to let Little Zi move the Star Continent in its body out of its body and move it to World King Planet, turning it into a huge island in the middle of the lake in the Dong Huang Realm.
The lives on the Star Continent still didn't know that their world had already changed. When they had the ability to tread out of the Star Continent and directly come to the Dong Huang Realm, they would be received by the Four Holy Faith clones Shi Yu had left on the Star Continent.
The reason why he let Little Zi move all the lives in its inner world was because Little Zi now had the ability to fight. There might be a lot of battles next. In order to not affect the lives in its body, it was safer to let them move away from the World King Planet.
Apart from that, the cultivation system of the Star Continent was the power of faith. Little Zi's inner world had always been an important source of power of faith for Shi Yu to use to produce the Four Saints.
But now, Shi Yu had already obtained the Four Holy Ruins. His need for the power of incense in the Star Continent was no longer that great.
This way, it was better to let the natives of the Star Continent join the Dong Huang Realm and let them add to the construction of the Dong Huang Realm.
Compared to the citizens from other places, the cultivators on the Star Continent were Shi Yu's true direct descendants. Little Zi was their mother planet, and Shi Yu was Little Zi's contractor. This relationship wasn't something the immigrants from other places could compare to.
"Senior Space Emperor… Senior Emperor Shi is also here??"
After arriving at the World King Planet, Shi Yu went all the way from the Dong Huang Realm to the Floating Realm. When he arrived at the Sky City Temple to visit the Senior Space Emperor, he realized that the Senior Time Emperor had already come out of seclusion and was discussing something with the Space Emperor.
The two space-time emperors looked at Shi Yu and could inform that Shi Yu seemed to have become stronger.
"Shi Yu, you came at the right time." When the Space Emperor saw Shi Yu return, he said, "I prepared some good things for you and was about to send them to you."
"What is it?" Shi Yu was stunned.
"Could it be a resource to accelerate cultivation speed?"
The Space Emperor laughed and said, "That's right. During this period of time, I've condensed three specially modified Level 11 space crystals. The effect should be better than the meditation jade. If you cultivate with it, you should be able to reach the peak of the divine rank earlier."
"Really?" Shi Yu was overjoyed. "Thank you, Senior Space Emperor. I'm lacking such resources."

chapters.title: Chapter 1599 - 1599: Going to the Contaminated Land (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1599 - 1599: Going to the Contaminated Land (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
As expected of a spatial super divine.
“During this period of time, I’ve also established a mystic realm in the Dong Huang Realm.” At this moment, Emperor Shi was beside him and smiled.
“Unfortunately, it’s not very suitable for you to use.”
“But if you have suitable recommendations, they can all enter to cultivate.”
Shi Yu said, “Time mystic realm?”
“Yes, a time mystic realm with a different time flow from the outside world.” Emperor Shi said, “After cultivating bitterly inside for a long time, only an instant passed in the outside world.”
“However, the restriction condition is that only people below the divine level with powerful willpower can stay inside for a long time. Divine-level experts who contain stable power of laws in the mystic realm will conflict with the time laws and have a greater burden. They won’t be able to stay for long. This was established by me for Wu Dong, Huang Xi, Long Qingyun, and the others in order to let them quickly accumulate the foundation before the Divine Realm.”
Wasn’t this the time mystic realm of Imperial Capital University! Only those below the overlord level could enter the time mystic realm of Imperial Capital University, and for Emperor Shi to establish this, it seemed that anyone below the super divine level could enter.
No… He should be able to experience this feeling above the super divine level.
Shi Yu remembered that when Emperor Shi fought the five super divines of Blue Planet, it was in space and time with a different time flow from the outside world.
However, that mystic realm that should need Emperor Shi himself to maintain and leave the mystic realm maintained by Emperor Shi himself probably didn’t have that power.
Shi Yu said regretfully, “If only there was a time mystic realm that could allow divine levels to enter steadily…”
He would sleep inside for a hundred years first.
“Perhaps when I reach the peak of the super divine level, I’ll have a chance to build it after spending a certain amount of time.” Emperor Shi said, “But you didn’t come this time to continue cultivating, right?”
“It’s something else that I want to discuss with Wang Kong.”
Shi Yu said in surprise, “Senior Emperor Shi, don’t you not like premonition?” “It’s not a premonition, but a guess.” Emperor Shi shook his head.
“Shi Yu, what’s the matter?” The Space Emperor also felt that Shi Yu didn’t seem to be the kind of person who would come to him for no reason.
“Hehe.” Shi Yu looked at Senior Space Emperor and said, “Senior Space Emperor, I plan to travel to the universe with Teacher Ying and Teacher Tu Na for a period of time. It’ll probably take a few years, at least a few years, to tell you.”
“Well, it’s mainly to find the Wish Star inheritance of the Star Prayer Race for Teacher Ying. I heard that if seven are gathered, you will have the power of the entire Star Prayer Race to make a wish. You can use a wish to hang a super divine level wish.’
“You…” The Space Emperor was speechless. Now that Blue Planet and Dong Huang were developing so well, he still had the mood to go out and play?
If it were him, he would definitely cultivate in seclusion on the Blue Planet for hundreds of years.
“Let him go,” Emperor Shi said. “He’ll be fine, and there should be new opportunities. With his current ability, even those five super divines can’t do anything to him.”
“There aren’t many in the entire universe who can pose a threat to him.”
“Senior Emperor Shi is still more far-sighted,” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say. The Space Emperor was slightly stunned. After a long silence, he said,
“Alright, your current strength… is indeed not weak,” the Space Emperor said.
He had started to wander in the universe at the demigod level. Now that Shi
Yu was almost invincible below the super divine level, there was indeed no reason to stop Shi Yu from wandering.
“However, every once in a while, try your best to come back and report your safety. Safety first. Don’t provoke enemies you can’t defeat. After all, we’re not beside you.”
“Alright, no problem. In order to return as soon as possible, I specially came to get some resources. Can you give me a few more super divine cosmic crystals as battleship energy? This way, we can fly faster. If we encounter a cosmic disaster, the success rate of escaping will be higher.” Apart from telling his elders, Shi Yu also wanted navigation resources…
“Sure, our Blue Planet doesn’t have anything else now, but we have a lot of money…” The Space Emperor waved his hand and was heroic.
He wanted to thank the Assassin Planet for the gifts.
As expected, war was the most profitable.
A few days later, Blue Planet.
After Shi Yu and the others prepared a pile of resources, they were about to set off.
The huge cosmic battleship stopped on the snowfield. Shi Yu, the cat girl, and the owl girl boarded the battleship one by one.
Then, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Little Ji, Duckie, and the other pets were also all excited like a tourist team.
Previously, it was built by the Blue Planet.
This time, Shi Yu’s entire team went out to build.
“Seeing this battleship, 1 know it’s stable this time.” After entering the battleship, the owl clicked its tongue in wonder.
The captain was more than a thousand meters tall, and the internal space was huge. This was Lings mechanical spirit with Perfect (+47). Coupled with the new top-notch mechanical materials, the newly upgraded battleship could drive super divine energy.
Apart from being fast and safe, the interior was also completely different. Every member had their own mystic realm room.
“That’s…” Shi Yu chuckled. How could he not be prepared for a trip? In the universe, there were definitely less than 20 battleships that could surpass Ling.
“Wu            WII.” Eleven was already lying by the window, waiting to set off.
It was rare for them to travel in the universe, so Shi Yu naturally let all his pets out. Everyone would be happier together.
“Let’s go!!” After a long time, the joint cry of Shi Yu and the others came from inside. The huge battleship on the Icefield flashed and disappeared from Blue Planet.
“That direction… is the Contaminated Land, right?”
In the World Tree mystic realm, the World Tree looked at the departing battleship and fell silent.
“The Contaminated Land, the territory of the Abyss Race. No, perhaps it can be said that the Abyss Race is only one of the many races in the Contaminated
Land,” the World Tree said. “Mother Goddess, they shouldn’t be a problem,
“Do you think it’s a problem to bring the Blue Sea Sprite and the cleansing star spirit to the Contaminated Land?” A faint voice came from Blue Planet, stunning the World Tree.
“Moreover, would a normal person plant a pirate flag on a battleship when traveling?”
“No problem… No problem. Perhaps when they return, they can also bring back good news of overthrowing the Dark Emperor… They all say that, Lord Mother Goddess, you’re a cosmic-level reincarnation, but why do I feel that
Shi Yu is only a cosmic-level reincarnation…” the World Tree said..

chapters.title: Chapter 1600 Wolf in Front, Tiger Behind (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1600 Wolf in Front, Tiger Behind (1)
﻿﻿In the vast universe, in the endless void, the planet was only a speck of dust.
The white battleship ran crazily in the starry sky, as if a ferocious dog was chasing and biting it behind. Its speed was extremely fast.
Now that Ling had become a perfect mechanical divine and driven the super divine level cosmic crystal, its travel speed in the universe could already exceed most super divine levels.
In the words of the gem cat, this was the power of paying money!
After all, back then, when the Space Emperor and the others searched for Blue Planet, they couldn't bear to use the super divine cosmic crystal. If they had used the super divine cosmic crystal at that time, in addition to a battleship that could drive super divine energy, the genius of the Kirin Race wouldn't have been swept up by the cosmic storm.
But now, in order to let Shi Yu finish early and go home, in order to ensure Shi Yu's safety along the way, Blue Planet didn't dare to save anymore. They all used the best.
However, although their speed wasn't slow, Shi Yu and the others still experienced the situation of not seeing a single figure for three months.
In addition, the environment here wasn't as beautiful as the Cosmic Sea. Before long, apart from Ling who was working hard to pilot the ship, everyone else was already sleeping soundly.
Shi Yu, the gem cat, the owl… Even Eleven and Baby Ginseng themselves ate the Cultivation Fruit and entered a sleep state to cultivate in the nutritional cabin, waiting to reach their destination.
Of course, it wasn't sleeping all the time, but going through the cycle of adding points, sleeping, adding points, and sleeping. After Baby Ginseng reached the perfect divine level, the feedback of the supplement pet on its body had already allowed Shi Yu to add points to top-notch quality divine skills with extremely high difficulty.
Since he was here to pollute the land, Shi Yu naturally began to choose Susu's origin fluctuations and the Star Sea Contract to add points…
Just like that, after three months, Ling finally discovered the first life planet.
"This life planet's level has actually reached the intermediate level. The abundance of resources and the strength of the world's power are incomparable to the planets we encountered previously. Yes, it seems like we can replenish resources here."
"Baby, wake up," Ling called Baby Ginseng. In the nutritional cabin, Baby Ginseng rubbed its eyes and woke up in a daze.
"Yi," Baby Ginseng said. What?
"We discovered an intermediate-level life planet. We'll rest here for half a day. After you go up and replenish your energy, we'll continue forward."
"Yi!" Baby Ginseng expressed its agreement and went to the clothes rack to get its white coat to go out.
Although they had brought a lot of resources, who knew how long they would have to drift outside? As long as they encountered a pretty good resource planet, they would absorb a little of the power of the world before leaving. This could ensure that they could sustainably add points.
"Wait." Ling suddenly stopped Baby Ginseng, who had put on its clothes and was preparing to go out.
"What's wrong?" Baby Ginseng asked.
"This planet doesn't seem to be as simple as it looks."
At this moment, as it prepared to descend to this planet, Ling suddenly realized that the state of this planet didn't seem right.
This was a life planet similar to the Blue Planet. It was made of the ocean, the ground, and the sky. Among them, the ocean occupied most of the area. There were even fewer landmasses here than on Blue Planet. It could only be called an island, and it sat scattered on the ocean.
However, under Ling's scan, it found that most of the ocean of this star was dyed black.
Abyssal power!
This planet might be the territory of the abyssal faction. Otherwise, it would be a planet invaded by the abyss, just like Blue Planet back then.
"Looks like I have to find you a partner." After Ling finished speaking, it woke Susu up.
A moment later, Baby Ginseng and Susu were dragged into the observation room by Ling. They glanced at the surroundings on this planet through the screen.
"This is too much!!"
The Star Sea Sprite King with the crown looked at the polluted planet, its eyes filled with anger.
Unforgivable!
Baby Ginseng said, "Yes, yes."
Let Susu cleanse this planet first before it extracted the power of the world. Otherwise, what it extracted would all be the polluted power of the world.
"Susu, you go first," Baby Ginseng said. "I'll stay behind."
"I have the same plan." Ling appeared and turned into an illusory mechanical vessel girl. It stood between Baby Ginseng and Susu and said, "Susu, cleanse the Abyss Sea. Because there's a Star Sea Contract, it won't consume power, so help this planet cleanse first."
"There shouldn't be any extremely divine level existences on this middle planet, so there's nothing to worry about. The three of us can just charge over directly."
"But to be safe, give me 10 minutes. I'll send the exploration robot to enter the planet first before investigating," Ling said.
There was no need to disturb Shi Yu and the others from sleeping and cultivating over such a small matter. Ling felt that it could solve it with itself, Baby Ginseng, and Susu.
A moment later, an almost invisible Rubik's Cube little robot left the battleship and flew towards this star first.
About ten minutes later.
The reconnaissance robot Ling sent had delivered enough information about this planet.
[Name]: Heavenly Water Star
[Level]: Intermediate planet
< Introduction > It's a natural planet two billion years old. A million years ago, a ball of strange water collided here. The planet gave birth to an autonomous consciousness and developed into a low-level planetary life form. Due to the internal environment, a large number of water-element life forms and water-element creatures were the first to evolve.
Then, the planet's will turned into a Sea God and created the seven sea beasts to manage the Heavenly Water Star together. Just like that, the Heavenly Water Star began to slowly evolve under the management of the Sea God and the seven sea beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1601  Wolf in front, Tiger behind (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1601  Wolf in front, Tiger behind (2)
Until now, the Heavenly Water Star had already evolved into an intermediate planetary life form.
However, the good times didn't last long. Two years ago, an abyss army descended and tried to occupy the Heavenly Water Star. The two parties started a huge battle, and the Heavenly Water Star was no match for them. In just a year, it was completely defeated. The seven sea beasts all became Abyss Beasts, and the Sea God, the embodiment of the Heavenly Water Star's will, was also polluted and bound…
That day, the will of Mercury was completely turned into an abyss. The Heavenly Water Star would be modified into an abyss star and become the territory of the Abyss Race.
As for the Abyss Army that attacked the Heavenly Water Star, it was under the super divine of the abyss, Benos. The highest command of the army was one of the nine top-notch Abyss Gods under the command of the Abyss God, the Blood Salamander, Xina.
At this moment, inside the Heavenly Water Star.
The Blood Salamander Xina, who was like a Tyrant Dragon and had bright red wings that were like a blood moon, walked step by step towards the "Heavenly Water Star's Will" sealed on the Abyss Altar in front of it under the escort of thousands of abyss life forms.
It was a little elf less than a meter tall with light blue eyes that looked like a water-blue balloon. As the embodiment of an ocean-type planet, its body should have been pure, but at this moment, it was already infected with countless abyss traces, and its will was constantly corroded.
"Planet's will, stop resisting in vain. There's no harm for you to enter the embrace of the abyss. At that time, you will obtain the opportunity to evolve to a higher domain!"
The Blood Salamander Xina stared at the will of the Heavenly Water Star. The other party's resistance to the pollution would only make them waste too much time on the Heavenly Water Star. Lord Benos was preparing to attack the Cosmic Sea and had already gathered its subordinates from all over. As one of the other party's generals, Xina could no longer waste too much time here.
"In your dreams!" The will of the Heavenly Water Star couldn't accept it because it understood that when it entered the abyss, it was no longer itself. During the war, it could clearly hear the cries of the sea beasts that it had created when it turned into an abyss.
Even after obtaining powerful strength and evolving into a stronger race, although it looked fierce and powerful on the surface, its heart still kept wailing.
If they also sank into the abyss, there was completely no possibility of them being cleansed. On the Heavenly Water Star, those lives who still resisted the invasion of the abyss had no hope.
"Is that so? Do you really think you can resist us?"
The Blood Salamander Xina said, "The reason why the war has lasted for so long is not because of how strong the Heavenly Water Star is, but because a traitor appeared in the Abyss Army and provided you with a way to cleanse the power of the abyss."
It swept its gaze fiercely at this batch of elites of the Abyss Army and said, "If I know who that traitor is…"
"I'll definitely let it have a new life!!!"
"After dealing with the will of this planet this time, you're next."
The will of the Heavenly Water Star was silent.
During this year, there was indeed someone secretly helping the Heavenly Water Star, but it didn't know who the other party was.
It looked at the many abyss soldiers.
Where the Abyss Beast Tamers of the Abyss Army were, among the group of divine-level Beast Tamers, a black-robed woman standing beside an Abyss Sea Serpent had a calm expression. She took a deep breath. She was the traitor mentioned by the Blood Salamander.
Her name was Yue Ling. Although she was a member of the Abyss Army, she had indeed been secretly helping the Heavenly Water Star.
Hopefully, she wouldn't be discovered…
The so-called obtaining of a new life was to give all its rationality to the abyss. At that time, it would become a heartless battle machine. Demon beasts without hearts were no longer as simple as their will being affected by the abyss.
However, the most regrettable thing was that after helping the Heavenly Water Star for so long, this star… finally fell.
Today, the Abyss Army wanted to activate the super divine pollution source and pollute the planet's will in the end. They no longer wanted to delay here for too long.
"Planet's will." The Blood Salamander Xina took out a super divine pollution source bestowed by the Abyss super divine, and looked at the will of the Heavenly Water Star. "This is your last chance. Take the initiative to accept the abyss. It's best not to let me use this."
It still hoped that the Heavenly Water Star would become an abyss star with some rationality. If it was polluted by the super divine pollution source, it couldn't guarantee what the Heavenly Water Star would become in the end.
"Looks like you haven't given up. Do you still think someone can help you now!! Hahaha, you can see if it dares to appear." The Blood Salamander laughed.
However, in the next moment, the sky changed.
The will of the Heavenly Water Star, the Blood Salamander Xina, the undercover Beast Tamer Yue Ling, and the abyss life forms suddenly looked at the sky.
Without knowing what had happened, the rain clouds that covered the entire planet suddenly condensed. The intense rain that enveloped the world began to descend, and countless cleansing water droplets descended from the sky!
The Blood Salamander Sina gazed at this scene in a daze.
The desire of the Heavenly Water Star was also a small confused, then it gazed at the Blood Salamander, Xina.
"What… strange request is this?"
Although he didn't know who it was, it seemed similar to someone had come to help Heavenly Water Star.
What a strong cleansing power!
Was it the person who had been secretly helping Heavenly Water Star?
These raindrops touched on the Abyss Sea, and the power of the abyss was instantly cleansed.
When it touched on the abyss sea beasts, their minds that were affected by the abyss immediately recovered.
