"Ah!!!" As for the abyss life form that had previously entered its heart with the power of the abyss, when it encountered this water drop, it was similar to touching boiling water as it was forcefully sterilized.
In an instant, the huge cleansing rain made the Abyss Army into a mess.

chapters.title: Chapter 1602 Wolf in Front, Tiger Behind (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1602 Wolf in Front, Tiger Behind (3)
﻿﻿Seeing this scene, the Blood Salamander Sina was directly shocked and shocked.
In the next moment, it wasn't allowed to have too many thoughts.
The strong cleansing rain actually made it, who had reached the top-notch divine level, feel some impact.
"Ah!!!" This cleansing rain seemed to have its own consciousness. It was a targeted cleansing. The effect of the cleansing rain that the Blood Salamander Xina encountered was especially strong. It was impossible to resist at all. After a few drops fell, it was as if an entire sea of stars was pressing on its body, making it prostrate and roll on the ground. It was in extreme pain, and white smoke came out of its body.
"This…" At this moment, Beast Tamer Yue Ling, who was undercover in the Abyss Army, was very shocked. She didn't know what was going on at all.
Apart from her, Heavenly Water Star had help?
Suddenly, she thought of something.
She had heard that the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association had recently made a big move against the Contaminated Land. Could it be that this remote star that had been invaded had been discovered by the purifier of the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association?
Although she didn't understand why the purifier of the Environmental Protection Association would come to such a remote place and not go to the main battlefield, Yue Ling was overjoyed. This way, at least this star could be saved.
"Cleansing rain…" The sealed and polluted will of the Heavenly Water Star also discovered that the entire planet was being cleansed. It couldn't help but be very shocked. What kind of power was needed to instantly release the skill to cleanse the entire planet?
Moreover, even the powerful Blood Salamander was suppressed by the cleansing rain to roll on the ground.
"Is it the Environmental Protection Association?" Although it was a rural planet, this year, the will of the Heavenly Water Star had also understood a lot of the division of cosmic factions. It knew that the Abyss Army also had their enemies.
From the looks of it, its insistence was indeed right.
If not for this persistence, it would have been impossible to wait for "reinforcements" to arrive.
Boom!!!
Not long after the rain of purification fell, the sky trembled, and a huge white battleship appeared in the sky.
"Damn it!!!" As the Blood Salamander and countless abyss life forms roared, the Heavenly Water Star's will and Yue Ling looked at the battleship in anticipation and excitement.
Pure white, flawless color.
But soon, their happy expressions stopped.
On the huge white battleship, black pirate flags were densely inserted. On every pirate flag, there were very terrifying and evil skulls and… slogans.
[Era Pirate Group]
[When you encounter us, please don't resist. We will only plunder a little of the power of the world within the acceptable range of the planet.]
Heavenly Water Star's will: ???
She opened her mouth slightly and felt a little dizzy.
Her originally happy mood was gone.
Sea pirates??
Not reinforcements from the Environmental Protection Association, but pirates??
In the impression of the Heavenly Water Star's will, the Dark King Army and the cosmic pirates… were all bad people!
Although the other party's slogan said that it would only plunder a little of the power of the world within the acceptable range of the planet…
However, how could the will of the Heavenly Water Star believe what a bandit organization said?
One was corroded into an Abyss Star by pollution, and the other was drained of the power of the planet and became a dead star. No matter which it was, the will of the Heavenly Water Star couldn't embrace it a little.
They experienced that there was no love in this world, with wolves in front and tigers behind.
The universe was too dangerous, so she shouldn't have evolved into consciousness.
"Ah!!!" The will of the Heavenly Water Star also collapsed. It looked at the pirate flag with its watery eyes and experienced that there was no love.
"Holy sh*t." Yue Ling, who was beside him, was also shocked. She didn't expect that the one who descended on Heavenly Water globe wasn't the fleet of an Environmental Protection Association, but… a Space Pirate Organization.
"What a joke!!!" At this moment, the most unacceptable thing was the Blood Salamander of the Abyss Army.
"A mere pirate…"
In the Contaminated Land, there were also many Space Pirates. Most of these Space Pirates had no choice but to become pirates.
The Dark King Army had always been dedicated to polluting the life planet into their territory and expanding the power of the Dark King Army. Some planetary life forms who were unwilling to be polluted but couldn't resist would escape their planet and be cosmic pirates in the starry sky, free.
Therefore, in the eyes of most of the Dark King Army, these pirates were just rags and didn't amount to much at all. But now, a baffling pirate crew suddenly appeared and instantly constrained them. No matter how they thought about it, this was very humiliating and difficult to understand.
"A mere Dark King Army, a group of dregs, disappear."
Susu flew out of the battleship and floated on it, looking at the black ocean below.
Its appearance stunned these people again because Susu's image was that of a Slime King.
No one expected a slime to walk out of this pirate battleship. However, one way or another, the Star Refining Crown that Susu was wearing was black and blue. It indeed looked like a pirate hat.
Of course, most importantly, Susu's arrogant words stunned the group of abyss life forms.
This pirate team clearly knew their origin, but they were still so bold. Did they want to die?
"Cleanse…" After coming out, Susu didn't even look at those abyssal lives and purified them alone. If it didn't cleanse soon, this planet couldn't be taken anymore.
Through the Star Sea Contract and origin fluctuations that Shi Yu had added to perfection not long ago, with a thought from Susu, the origin fluctuations enveloped the entire Abyss Army.
Boom!!
The origin fluctuations dissipated. The pollution strength on the top-notch Abyss God below instantly became the source of its death, washing away traces of it for no reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 1603: Wolf in Front, Tiger Behind (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1603: Wolf in Front, Tiger Behind (4)
Playvolume00:00/01:35TruvidfullScreen
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Ah!!!” The powerful Abyss God was cleansed into ashes under the shocked expressions of the Heavenly Water Star’s will and Yue Ling, and it was directly insta-killed.
This situation happened to every soldier of the Abyss Army. They were instantly cleansed into ashes and were unable to resist. As a spy, Yue Ling was almost scared to tears when she saw this.
Her pet was also almost scared to tears, because the origin wave had already come into contact with it.
wait!
They were good people! Good people.
Don’t kill!
It was a huge Abyss Sea Serpent. Yue Ling quickly looked at it. To Yue Ling’s relief, although the abyssal power on its body was being cleansed, it wasn’t like other abyss life forms. Even its body was cleansed into ashes, and it completely died.
She… and her Abyss Beast didn’t seem to be completely affected.
In a short moment, the entire Abyss Army on Heavenly Water Star was completely destroyed by Susu with full battle power.
“Ning?” At this moment, Susu also noticed the will of the Heavenly Water Star below and the two Abyss Army soldiers who hadn’t been destroyed.
Its origin wave judgment method was that it would only be destroyed if it had the power of the abyss and the heart to yearn for the abyss.
If it was only polluted by the power of the abyss, but like Duckie, it could resist the power of the abyss and yearn for purity, it would only cleanse the power of the abyss on its body but not be destroyed.
Susu didn’t expect such a person to exist in the Abyss Army.
The battleship slowly landed.This chapter was first shared on the N0v3l-B1n platform.
The will of the Heavenly Water Star had also escaped pollution and was cleansed. In the face of this situation, the will of the Heavenly Water Star should be grateful, but when she saw the slogan of this pirate crew, she panicked even more.
Wu wu wu, one had been destroyed, and an even more terrifying one had come. Help.
After the battleship landed, the door of the battleship opened, and Baby Ginseng, who was wearing a research suit, walked out.
Seeing that a slime first came out of this pirate crew, and then a ginseng, the will of the Heavenly Water Star and Yue Ling gradually began to be a little confused about the configuration of this pirate crew.
“The planet’s will is also here!” Baby Ginseng was slightly surprised when it discovered the will of the Heavenly Water Star.
It stood on the battleship and said, “We seem to have just helped you solve a big problem. In that case, it’s not too much to take away some reward, right?” “Yi, don’t worry, I won’t take more!”
“It’s not too much. As long as… the power of the world left behind is enough for the world to circulate, it’s fine.” When the will of the Heavenly Water Star saw that Susu and Baby Ginseng were “fiendish”, it didn’t dare say anything else.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng was very satisfied.
On the spot, under the shocked expression of the Heavenly Water Star’s will, it activated the World Grace and forcefully plundered the power of the Heavenly Water Star’s world to inject it into its Heavenly Emperor Cauldron.
It could really be plundered!
The will of the Heavenly Water Star felt its strength being continuously extracted.
“Ning.” At this moment, Susu looked at Yue Ling and her Abyss Sea Serpent.
At this moment, Yue Ling was also silent. She had never seen such a cosmic pirate actually use plundering the power of the world as the main goal… After all, in the universe, the most famous race that could plunder the power of the world was the cosmic behemoth.
Apart from that, very few races could plunder the power of the world so easily, but from the looks of it, this research ginseng easily did it.
In addition, this slime’s terrifying ability could actually instantly kill the entire Abyss Army and cleanse the entire planet. Yue Ling only felt that she had encountered a terrifying existence.
The Contaminated Land… actually had such a strong pirate crew?
“Not bad!” However, what Yue Ling didn’t expect was that this Slime King that had destroyed the entire Abyss Army only praised them before returning to the Back Battleship.
“Wait, wait!” Yue Ling hurriedly shouted.
“Shh! The will of the Heavenly Water Star flew over. Seeing that these two people had not been cleansed, it guessed that this human Beast Tamer had been helping the Heavenly Water Star. It could sense that the other party was different from other abyss soldiers.
“Do you also want to be snatched? Just let me bear it,” the planet’s will said..

chapters.title: Chapter 1604 The Fierce Shi Yu Pirates (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1604 The Fierce Shi Yu Pirates (1)
Playvolume00:06/00:44TruvidfullScreen
“Good person, you’ve been secretly helping the Heavenly Water Star, right?”
“I just saw that the cleansing rain just now was basically useless to you,” the Heavenly Water Star’s will said.
Yue Ling said, “Yes…”
“There’s no need to thank me. I only want to know how I can leave this planet after the Abyss Army is destroyed…” She felt stifled.
Susu returned, and only Baby Ginseng was left outside. It sat on the Heavenly Emperor Cauldron and drew the power of the world.
Without stopping Susu, she chose to ask Baby Ginseng.
“Sir… May I ask… are you really cosmic pirates?”
“Can I join you?”
Yue Ling’s heart thumped.
Now that the Abyss Army had been destroyed, even if their spaceships stayed, she, who didn’t know how to pilot a spaceship, didn’t know how to leave this planet at all.
She didn’t want to stay on this planet forever.
If this Abyss Army was destroyed, other Abyss Armies would definitely come to investigate next.
She couldn’t stay long.
“Yi? (Who are you?)” Baby Ginseng looked at the Beast Tamer combination that Susu had left behind and not destroyed in confusion.
It was a woman in a black robe with a black single ponytail. Her eyes were watery and she looked pretty. Her figure wasn’t bad, but she shouldn’t be Shi Yu’s type.
“No,” Baby Ginseng rejected directly.
“Well… By the way, why weren’t you destroyed? The cleansing power just now didn’t seem to be effective on you,” Baby Ginseng asked curiously.
Yue Ling smiled bitterly and said, “My name is Yue Ling. I’m not affected. Perhaps it’s because my heart isn’t in the Abyss Race.”
She looked at the cleansed bare Abyss Sea Serpent…
After pondering for a moment, he summoned another array. In the next moment, a water-element sprite with antennae and a water-blue body appeared.
“Yue Ling~” After being summoned, the little elf immediately flew into the woman’s arms.
“Ocean Faith Cleansing Sprite.” Baby Ginseng was slightly stunned. It immediately discovered that this little elf was very similar to Susu at the Blue Sea Sprite stage.
“I joined in to overthrow the Abyss Army,” Yue Ling said.
“Good.” The Heavenly Water Star’s will cried.
However, not long after it was touched, the will of the Heavenly Water Star was stunned.
“Hello.” Another figure suddenly appeared on the battleship.
It was a cat-eared, lightly dressed cat girl.
Her burning gaze was staring at Yue Ling’s chest. “Little girl, you seem to have brought some precious treasure. Can you take it out and show it to me?”
“!!!” The Heavenly Water Star’s will was shocked as it looked at Yue Ling resentfully.
It had said not to provoke this group of pirates.
Look, it was already snatched away, and now even it was going to be snatched away.
Although the gem cat had just woken up, it was extremely energetic.
It woke up on its own because it sensed the Wish Star inheritance.
‘How lucky. As expected of Ling,’ the gem cat girl thought to itself. Then, it looked at the woman Susu had left behind.
It felt that the Wish Star inheritance was on the other party.
Yue Ling covered her chest and looked at the new member of the Era Pirate Group, her expression changing slightly.
“Good child, don’t be afraid. Do you have something special on you, something that contains very strong power of faith?”
“Can you… show that to me?”
“I…” Yue Ling took a step back, confused as to why the cat girl in front of her knew what treasure she was carrying.
No, logically speaking, that shouldn’t be considered a treasure.
At least, after carrying it for so many years, she had never discovered anything magical about that pendant.
At this moment, facing the extremely ferocious pirate crew, Yue Ling felt that she couldn’t hide or resist anything. She stiffly took out a pendant-like accessory embedded with a circular sapphire from her chest and said, “Is… is this it?”
“Mimi!!” The gem cat girl teleported in front of Yue Ling and said, “Not bad, not bad. This is it. Where did you get this??”
The thing in front of them was one of the Wish Star inheritances Shi Yu and the others had come to find.
Now, it had clearly not reached the destination predicted by that owl, but it directly appeared in front of it. The gem cat was pleasantly surprised.
It directly pushed the credit to Ling. This luck was awesome.
“This is our family’s inheritance treasure. It’s said that… with it, you can achieve whatever you want and have your wishes come true. Although that’s the case… It looks like an ordinary object.”
“This isn’t an ordinary item, but you don’t recognize how to use it. It’s a waste!”
“Give it to me,” the gem cat said. “Can we use a transaction? What do you want?”
“Otherwise, I can satisfy one of your wishes.”
Yue Ling and the intent of Heavenly Water Star were a little shocked.
They didn’t understand why this cat was so easy to talk to.
They thought that the other party would directly come to snatch the treasure, but in the end, it was a transaction?
“Ah, this!!” The Heavenly Water Star’s intent was confused, and it looked at the bandit-like ginseng baby.
Therefore, why was it a transaction with this human, but it was directly plundered by her?
“Yi!! (Helping you cleanse the power of the abyss isn’t a transaction.)” Baby Ginseng seemed to have sensed what the will of the Heavenly Water Star was thinking and glared at it.
“!!!” The Heavenly Water Star’s intent was stunned. That made sense.
A rescuing favor was greater than anything.
“…” Baby Ginseng sighed. It felt that the intent of this world wasn’t very smart. It should be a new planet.

chapters.content:
Chapter 1605: The Fierce Shi Yu Pirates (2)
Playvolume00:00/00:00TruvidfullScreen

The amount of milk it plundered with World Grace didn’t look like much, but it was better than nothing.
“This…” In the face of the gem cat’s request, Beast Tamer Yue Ling appeared very silent.
It was as if she was reluctant to part with this pendant.
“What’s there to be conflicted about about a pendant that can’t be used?” The cat was anxious.
“How about I exchange delicious and useful Cultivation Fruits with you?”
Baby Ginseng: “… Damn it.”
The cat might as well ask Baby Ginseng to pay!
“Sir, I’m a Beast Tamer from Divine Planet in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain. 20 years ago, my planet suffered an invasion by the Dark King Army. My family was reduced to just me. This thing here is the only relic left by my mother,” said Yue Ling.
“Ah…” The gem cat was stunned. Don’t do this to me…
“I can give this to the Lord, but if possible, can I ask you to bring me to the Cosmic Sea?” Yue Ling said.
“That’s all??” The gem cat was stunned.
“Yes.” Yue Ling nodded.
“You want to go to the Cosmic Sea? Why are you going there?” the gem cat asked.
“I… I want to join the Environmental Protection Association,” Yue Ling said.
“After the planet was invaded, I successfully escaped. Then, I kept thinking of ways to save my planet.”
“Later, I learned that the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association had been fighting the Dark King Army, so I wanted to join this organization…”
“However, because I don’t have the ability to travel long distances in the galaxy, it’s almost impossible for me to head to the Cosmic Sea alone. Therefore, 10 years ago, I chose to join the Dark King Army again and waited for the opportunity.”
“Of course, I only pretended to have joined the Dark King Army and didn’t join in with them. During the period of the Abyss Army, when they invaded other planets, I tried to think of a way to help the invaded planets. Unfortunately… it didn’t affect the outcome much.’
Yue Ling sighed deeply. The strength of the Dark King Army was far from what the invaded small planet could compare to.
“If the Environmental Protection Association and the Dark King Army are opponents, I’ll be able to meet them sooner or later after joining the Dark King Army. At that time, I might be able to provide them with some important information.
“Originally, this time, I thought I had encountered someone from the Environmental Protection Association, but I didn’t expect…” Yue Ling smiled bitterly. In the end, it was a pirate. It was ridiculous.
“Well, in a sense, you’re also very lucky,” the gem cat said. The Environmental Protection Association. What a coincidence. Although they were pirates, who said pirates couldn’t be members of the Environmental Protection Association?
Unfortunately, they still had something to do next, so they might not have time to run around with this guy.
“Well, Ling, can you teach her to drive a spaceship and let her head to World King Planet herself? The Dark King Army should have left a spaceship behind, right?” the gem cat asked the battleship Ling.
“No problem, no problem. I can even leave a mechanical assistant behind. However, with her strength and the battleship left behind by the Abyss Army, as a newbie, it’s as difficult as ascending to the heavens for her to go to the Cosmic Sea alone.”
At this moment, under the surprised expressions of the Heavenly Water Star’s will and Yue Ling, the battleship spirit appeared. The battleship girl, Ling, walked towards the gem cat and said, “Teacher Ying, is this real?”
“It’s real.” The gem cat was extremely excited.The debut release occurred at N-ov3l-Bin.
This way, there were only three inheritance items.
Yue Ling didn’t know how to use this. She felt that it was no different from an ordinary object because she didn’t have the aptitude to accept the power of the Star Prayer Race.
Well… If it were her, after fusing with this Wish Star inheritance, her strength should be able to reach top-notch divine.
Not bad, not bad. This was her strength that quickly increased with resources without any bitter cultivation.
As expected, if she wanted to level up, resources were faster.
“You just said that your hometown is the Divine Planet of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain?” Ling asked.
“Yes.” Yue Ling nodded and said, “The location of the Divine Planet is already very close to the Cosmic Sea. It’s at the edge of the Contaminated Land.”
“Scarlet Blue Star Domain…” Ling conjured a star map and said to Yue Ling, “Look, is the Scarlet Blue Star Domain this place?”
“Yes, that’s the place.” Seeing the star map conjured by Ling, Yue Ling’s eyes turned slightly red. “Now, the nine life stars in the Scarlet Blue Planet Domain have already been occupied and polluted into Abyss Stars.”
“Wu.” Ling looked at the star map and said, “Are you sure that the Scarlet Blue
Star Domain has already become an abyss territory?”
“That’s right.”
“Who’s the strongest Abyss Race over there?”
“The super divine level abyss lifeform, Benos,” Yue Ling said, “The army I joined is under Benos.”
“The other party is very strong. It’s an abyss monster that has transcended twice. It’s said that at the moment, Benos is preparing to join forces with the other nine Dark King Army super divines to launch a new round of attacks on the Cosmic Sea and expand the Contaminated Land, ” Yue Ling said.
Ling fell into deep thought.
“What’s wrong?” The gem cat girl saw Ling in deep thought and asked, “10 super divines, quite a lot.”
“The place we’re going to is in this Scarlet Blue Star Domain,” Ling said.
“Uh.” The gem cat suddenly thought of something.
Oh.
Yue Ling came from the Scarlet Blue Star Domain. The Wish Star inheritance was brought out of the planet in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, so the location originally predicted should be the Scarlet Blue Star Domain.
Now, although it had found the Wish Star inheritance in advance and didn’t have to search, the Goddess Wa’s Ruins was also over there.
If Shi Yu wanted to go to the Goddess Wa’s Ruins to take a look, he still had to go to the Scarlet Blue Star Domain.
And this place was the temporary military garrison of the abyss super divine. It was probably not easy to enter.
“Why don’t we send her to the World King Planet before making plans?” the gem cat suggested.
At that time, it might be safer to kill his way back with the Environmental Protection Association before going to the Scarlet Blue Star Domain.
Now that he had found the Wish Star inheritance in this area, there shouldn’t be a need to rush into the Goddess Wa’s Ruins, right..
“No, let’s go to the Scarlet Blue Star Domain directly.” At this moment, another figure appeared on the battleship. He was wearing a red and white battle suit and a smile.
Above his head, the Star Sea Sprite, Susu, was lying quietly.
“Ah.” The gem cat’s expression turned bitter. Shi Yu, Shi Yu…
“I happen to have something to talk to the super divine of the Abyss Race.” Shi Yu leaned on the railing and said, “Transcendent 2 is still acceptable.”
Goddess Wa’s Ruins, 2. Super Divine Will, 3. Battle merits can be exchanged for top-notch stars to refine stars for pets. 4. Source of transcendence…
“Let’s go liberate the Scarlet Blue Star Domain and destroy that abyss super divine. We’ll directly return to the Cosmic Sea from the Scarlet Blue Star
Domain.”
“It’s also convenient. Consider it a gift to thank this little girl.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Teacher Ying, you’re not afraid, right?”
“What’s there to be afraid of?” Ying muttered. In any case, she wasn’t the one fighting. She was the support!
“Alright, I guessed so.” Ling looked at Yue Ling and said, “Thank you for the goodwill item. As a reward, we’ll try to help you liberate your home. Oh right, the person who spoke just now is the captain of our pirate crew.”
“On this battleship, you have to listen to his orders for everything big and small. ”
At this moment, Yue Ling was stunned.
Annihilate the abyss super divine and unseal the Scarlet Blue Star Domain?
She looked at Shi Yu in shock.
What kind of extremely ferocious pirate crew could casually destroy an abyss super divine? What kind of monster organization had she encountered?

chapters.title: Chapter 1606  Ruins of Earth and Goddess Wa (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1606  Ruins of Earth and Goddess Wa (1)
Heavenly Water Star.
It had just experienced the invasion of the Abyss Army, but it was ridiculously clean.
The will of the Heavenly Water Star listened to Shi Yu's demonic words in confusion.
Annihilate the abyss super divine?
At this moment, Baby Ginseng also made a sound.
"It's over!"
It put away the Heavenly Emperor Cauldron and plundered the power of the world for nearly half an hour.
"That's it?"
The will of the Heavenly Water Star was stunned and looked at Baby Ginseng.
This was nothing…
"Yi!"
Baby Ginseng pointed at the battleship sign.
[When you encounter us, please don't resist. We will only plunder a little of the power of the world within the acceptable range of the planet.]
The will of the Heavenly Water Star was stunned. This was actually true???
"Yi. (I don't want to only plunder so little either. The key is that you're too weak. If you take too much, you'll be gone.)"
Baby Ginseng shook its head, making the will of the Heavenly Water Star a little uncomfortable.
Listen to me… Thank you…
"Since we're done replenishing, let's go."
Shi Yu stretched and said, "This place shouldn't be far from the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, right?"
"Yes…"
The Beast Tamer of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, Yue Ling, swallowed her saliva slightly. So, the other party was serious?
Was he really planning to go to the Scarlet Blue Star Domain to find the abyss super divine, Benos?
"Ling, replicate a star map for the will of this planet."
After Shi Yu and Ling finished speaking, they looked at the will of the Heavenly Water Star and said,
"If you're worried that the Abyss Army will make a comeback, you can leave this star domain according to this star map and head to the Cosmic Sea."
"Of course, the journey is long and dangerous. You decide for yourself if you want to go."
"Actually, I think that when the Dark King Army and the Environmental Protection Association start a battle next, they should be too busy to take care of themselves. It's also a good choice for you to try to hide yourself during this period of time."
"For you." Ling gave the Heavenly Water Star's will a replicated star map according to Shi Yu's request.
The little elf took the star map and was stunned.
It was difficult to believe that this was the style of pirates.
Why were these cosmic pirates different from the pirates who had invaded Heavenly Water Star previously?
"Good," it said.
Shi Yu was amused. Then, he looked at Yue Ling and said, "How is it? What about you? Do you have any thoughts on where to go?"
Yue Ling said, "If you really want to liberate the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, I can be your guide!"
"I'm very familiar with that star domain…"
Yue Ling was a little tempted. She had also seen Susu's strength just now.
Instant kill a top-notch divine!
It definitely had the strength of a perfect god.
Moreover, it was a perfect god that specialized in countering the Abyss Race, similar to her ocean sprite.
However, it should be stronger than her ocean sprite.
After all, after she left her mother planet, the power of the ocean sprite was directly halved, but looking at the Starry Sky Slime just now, its power was endless and terrifying.
With such a perfect god that countered the Abyss Race, in addition… to a group of pirates whose strength couldn't be seen through…
The other party was so confident. Perhaps this pirate crew really had the ability to liberate the Scarlet Blue Star Domain.
Of course, there was another problem. If there was a big battle with the abyss super divine, how would the Scarlet Blue Star Domain deal with the Dark Alliance from all directions?
The Scarlet Blue Star Domain was an important military place for the Dark King Army to fight the Cosmic Sea. If an accident happened here, the super divines of the other nine Contaminated Lands would definitely notice.
Forget it!
Yue Ling shook her head and looked at Shi Yu, choosing to listen to them.
"Sure, then you'll be the guide. Ling, take good care of her."
"Next, we'll try our best to enter the Scarlet Blue Star Domain without alarming the Abyss Army and the abyss super divine,"
Shi Yu said.
Yue Ling had scruples, but so did he.
If he wanted to fight the abyss super divine, he would definitely fight before leaving.
After fighting, he would depart immediately.
If he slowly explored the ruins after the battle, there was indeed a risk of being surrounded by more super divines.
As for the mess of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, it was naturally given to the Environmental Protection Association. He and Susu didn't have time to stay in the Contaminated Land at all times.
…
Then, under the eager gaze of the Heavenly Water Star's will, the "extremely ferocious" Era Pirate Group departed again.
"I should go too."
After this battle, the will of the Heavenly Water Star followed Shi Yu's suggestion and tried to wander to the Cosmic Sea.
"This is your room."
As for the Beast Tamer of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, Yue Ling, she was invited to the battleship by Ling and arranged a room for her alone.
"Next, tell me about the situation in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain." Ling left a clone and looked at Yue Ling.
Yue Ling nodded quickly.
Ling planned to use her understanding of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain to plan the advancement route again.
On the other side, the gem cat with the richest harvest also left impatiently.
"Shi Yu, I'll leave the rest to you!!"
"I'm lying down!"
"Alright." Shi Yu nodded. This cat was really lucky.
As expected, maximizing Ling's Wind of Blessing before setting off was still beneficial.
He felt that there should be more good things waiting for him in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain ahead.
Shi Yu snickered and summoned his pets.
"The battle is imminent. Everyone, wake up."
Although he could rely on luck, he had to have some basic strength. Shi Yu didn't dare to be sloppy.
"Before we proceed to the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, let's raise Susu's origin fluctuations and Star Sea Contract as high as possible."
"Wu wu wu." Shi Yu's pets awakened one after another.
Even Eleven rubbed its eyes and arranged to assist in adding points.
The current Eleven was no longer the previous Eleven.

chapters.title: Chapter 1607 Ruins of Earth and Goddess Wa (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1607 Ruins of Earth and Goddess Wa (2)
?The healing and cleansing abilities derived from the control of light that had reached the divine skill stage could also be used as support.
Apart from that, a few of the gossiping Bean Bears had also mastered support abilities.
When it came to suffering, Shi Yu had never let himself suffer. He had tried his best to pull in all the support that could be of help.
…
Half a month later.
In the cultivation room, the gem cat opened its gem-like eyes.
"Meow, meow, meow, meow!!!" It leaped down from the bed excitedly, returned to its cat form, and landed on the blanket to roll around crazily.
It was so excited!
It leaped up excitedly and pounced on the soft bed, transforming into a human form.
After spending half a month, she finally fused the third inheritance, the Wish Star.
Her Wish Star skill directly increased to the level of expert perfection under the enhancement of the inheritance power of the Star Prayer Race. It was only a step away from perfect proficiency.
Using Shi Yu's additional terminology, it was (expert+11).
It was extremely cool.
The gem cat felt that it was extremely strong now.
Under the lead of the skill level, in addition to the various Cultivation Fruits and super divine level resources in the past half a year, its growth level directly increased to the top-notch divine level in one go.
As long as there were resources, money, and divine power levels, it was actually the easiest to improve. It just needed to spend resources. Of course, if it wanted to obtain battle power compatible with its realm, it still had to increase its skill proficiency.
After being happy, the gem cat hugged its pillow and fell into deep thought.
It was clearly at a higher level now, but its strongest attack unique skill, the nine-element combination skill, Meteorite Disillusionment, was still stuck at the quasi-divine skill stage… This was awkward.
Not only this, its spiritual control and nine-colored divine light were also at the quasi-divine skill stage!
"Forget it, as long as the key skill level is high."
"Take your time! I'm still young!"
The gem cat comforted itself.
Now, its strongest skill was the Wish Star.
At least the level of this super race skill didn't fall behind.
Wish Star, which was close to perfect divine skill, might be able to be used as a battle skill and escape skill.
"Teacher Cat!"
At the same time, sensing the earthquake-like commotion on Teacher Cat's side, Ling's voice appeared on the radio in the room.
"Teacher Cat, congratulations on your advancement. After the fusion, please come to the conference room."
"Huh?" The gem cat in the Star Prayer dress was slightly stunned. It tidied its appearance and teleported into the conference room.
Shi Yu, Ling, the owl, Susu, and the others were all there.
"Wow, this is a top-notch divine. This is too fast." After the owl saw the cat, it couldn't help but say.
This was only three-sevenths of the Wish Star inheritance…
As expected of the inheritance crystal of the Star Prayer Race.
If it could collect all the inheritance crystals, the gem cat's achievements would definitely exceed any previous Star Prayer Race.
After all, this was the crystallization of the wish of the Star Prayer Race to gather the power of the entire race.
"It's alright, it's alright." The gem cat girl had a proud expression on her face.
"Did something happen?" she asked.
Shi Yu said, "Yes, we've already arrived at the periphery of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain. At the moment, this star domain is sealed layer by layer. We plan to sneak in."
"I've already obtained a more detailed star map from the Beast Tamers of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, but this isn't the most important thing. Most importantly, the star map left behind by Goddess Wa only indicates the approximate range of the ruins in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, but not where."
"It's quite troublesome to find it."
"Therefore, next, we have to rely on Teacher Owl's premonition power, together with your wish power. We'll try to predict it."
"That's not a problem," the gem cat agreed.
"Then I'll start?" the Prediction Owl said.
"Let's begin, let's begin." At this moment, the Prediction Owl took the thing left behind by Goddess Wa and used it as a medium to predict.
"Wu…" She closed her eyes and began to have the enhancement of the gem cat and Ling.
Soon, a yellow-brown planet appeared in the owl's dark vision.
Of course, if there was only this hint, what Shi Yu and the others had found in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain was still no different from finding a needle in a haystack.
"Three stars…"
But soon, the scene predicted by the owl changed. Three stars surrounded the yellow-brown planet!
"This is the place!"
"Found a yellow-brown planet surrounded by three stars. That's where the ruins are!"
She opened her Time Eye and confirmed. This special environment shouldn't be difficult to find, right?
"Let's go." Shi Yu got up.
…
Two days later, in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain.
The battleship used invisibility, meld, spatial jump, shrinking, and other methods to pass through the heavy blockade of the Abyss Army and enter the Scarlet Blue Star Domain.
Although the defense line was huge, the technological content was too low, far inferior to Ling's strength.
The Abyss Race that sealed the Red Blue Star Domain wasn't strong enough, nor was it inferior to the perfect divine Ling.
This was also normal. Under the super divine of the abyss, there wouldn't be many perfect gods. The star domain was so huge, it was impossible for all places to be perfectly defended and investigated.
In terms of technological methods, it wasn't this Dark King Army's forte. World King Planet claimed that its technology were second, and only the cosmic overlord army dared to claim to be first.
And now, Ling's technological crystals clearly belonged to the World King Planet.
After entering, according to the Prediction Owl's hint, Shi Yu and the others began to search for the yellow planet surrounded by three stars.
"Found it." With the exact hint, it were much more convenient to search. As long just as the starry sky environment didn't match, they themselves were able to directly ignore it. There was no need to investigate the planets one by one.

chapters.title: Chapter 1608 - 1608: Ruins of Earth and Goddess Wa (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1608 - 1608: Ruins of Earth and Goddess Wa (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
There weren’t many life planets in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, and most of them were dead stars. The hot, starry sky where the battleship Ling had stopped was clearly also a desolate galaxy.
The resources here were scarce, and the environment was so harsh that even the Abyss Army didn’t leave any traces here.
This situation was what Shi Yu was most happy to see. If the ruins of Earth were located in the enemy’s headquarters, it would be troublesome.
“Ling, Star Ascension.”
Under Shi Yu’s call, Ling began to descend on this harsh yellow-brown planet.
This planet was indeed desolate. After stepping in, it was an endless desert. There was nothing.
“There are life fluctuations.
After descending, Shi Yu originally thought that there would be no life on this dead star, but soon, he realized that he was wrong.
Just as they arrived, Ling detected a life wave that existed on this planet.
Who was it? Could it be Goddess Wa?
It was unlikely.
Abyss Race?
That was impossible.
Here, earth and tire-element lite forms could survive, but there was no need for other lives to come.
As for the Abyss Race that invaded the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, they were all water-element and dark-element. Even if there were resources here, the chances of them coming here to dig weren’t high.
Buzz!
Soon, the battleship appeared above the life fluctuations.
At this moment, a sand vortex began to rumble on the desert-like ground.
Yellow sand flew, and a monster more than ten meters tall that looked like a desert castle rose.
Its entire body was made of wild sand, looking like sand piled together. Sand dunes, its eyes, and its mouth were empty holes. This appearance reminded Shi Yu of the purple-skinned holey people of the Star Refinement Race.
At the moment, it was most suitable to describe this elemental life form as the Sand Dune Beast.
At this moment, this Sand Dune Beast rose. It looked at the battleship in the sky and let out a heavy voice.
“After so long, someone has finally come to this place.”
“Is it a coincidence or something?”
It stared at the battleship. At this moment, Shi Yu also walked out of the battleship and landed alone. He stood in the desert and faced the Sand Dune Beast.
“Hello,” Shi Yu said. “Excuse me, are you a native of this planet?”
“I’m the owner of this planet, an outsider. This planet doesn’t have any scarce resources. If there’s nothing else, leave this place,” the Sand Dune Beast said.
“I’ll leave after asking a few questions.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Don’t be such an outsider, friend. I wonder how long you’ve been on this planet.”
The Sand Dune Beast fell into deep thought and said, “It should be tens of thousands of years.”
Shi Yu said, “Then did you discover anything special on this planet, such as…”
Shi Yu used time to search for the fluctuations of the era ruins but couldn’t find it at all.
“For example, the era ruin?” Shi Yu asked the Sand Dune Beast. He kept feeling that the other party’s identity wasn’t simple.
Even if this planet was suitable for an elemental life form like it, there were countless better choices for divine-level creatures.
There was definitely something wrong with a divine-level being willing to stay on such a godforsaken planet for tens of thousands of years.
As expected, as Shi Yu mentioned the era ruin, the aura of the sand fortress monster gradually strengthened. Its emotions also underwent a violent change.
“Where are you from?” it asked.
“Blue Planet,” Shi Yu said.
Upon hearing that, the emotions of the Sand Dune Beast suddenly became active from the silence. It said in shock, “You’re from the Blue Planet?”
“You indeed know something,” Shi Yu said.
“Do you know Goddess Wa?”
The Sand Dune Beast quickly nodded and said, “Our race is the guardian left on this planet by Goddess Wa. I don’t know how many generations of guardians we’ve been. Our goal on this planet is to wait for the arrival of the people from the Blue Planet.’
“I didn’t expect that it would finally come in my generation.” It cried tears of joy. Although it couldn’t cry, quicksand fell from its eyes.
“You’re guardians left behind by Senior Wa?” Shi Yu was even more excited and excited. “Then, do you know where Senior Wa is?”
“Senior Wa left a message saying that you can see her when we reach the ruins.
She’s still alive, right?”
The Sand Fortress Guardian said, “Of course, Goddess Wa is still alive. However, have you gathered enough to meet the conditions to enter the ruins?”
Shi Yu’s expression froze. He said awkwardly, “That condition is too difficult. I haven’t reached it yet. I just came over to take a look according to the location of the star map…
The Sand Fortress Guardian said, “Damn it, doesn’t that mean I have to continue staying here?” Shi Yu:
So this was the key point?
The Sand Fortress Guardian said, “Goddess Wa’s main body is sealed and sleeping in the depths of this star. For some special reason, I can’t awaken Goddess Wa before you have enough conditions to open the ruins.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
What was wrong with Goddess Wa?
Sleep…
Could it be that his life had come to an end and he could only use sleep and seal to wait for a change?
Or could it be that something unexpected happened and he could only sleep?
What exactly had Goddess Wa experienced after leaving Blue Planet?
However, compared to the outcome of the Ancestral Dragon, Yuan Feng, and the other ancestors of the five divine races already dying, Goddess Wa was at least still alive. It was already very good.
“Senior Guardian, can you tell me what’s wrong with Goddess Wa?”
The guardian shook its head and said, “I don’t know either.”
Shi Yu pondered for a moment. “Then, Lord Guardian, can you tell me where the ruins are? Although I didn’t gather five super divine humans, I found another key that might open the ruins..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1609 - 1609: Ruins of Earth and Goddess Wa (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1609 - 1609: Ruins of Earth and Goddess Wa (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“I want to give it a try. If I give it a try, it shouldn’t affect me, right?”
“Uh.” The Sand Fortress Guardian looked at Shi Yu and said, “You found other ways to open the ruins?”
“Is this for real?”
“Yes, I want to give it a try, if possible,” Shi Yu said.
“This shouldn’t be a problem,” the Sand Fortress Guardian said. “In that case, follow me.
After saying that, it crawled underground. At the same time, a huge abyss hole that connected to the ground appeared.
Shi Yu was slightly stunned before quickly following.
After flying for an unknown period of time, Shi Yu arrived at the underground world and saw a stone wall door.
On the stone door, there was a pattern. There were five sunken places. Four of them were in four directions, and the other was in the center.
After Shi Yu saw it, he guessed that this might be one of the reasons why Goddess Wa wanted to find five super divine humans?
At this moment, the Sand Fortress Guardian was already waiting for Shi Yu in front of the stone door. It said, “This is the door that connects to the ruins of the era. Try using your method.”
“Alright.” At this moment, after entering the underground world, Shi Yu activated the Passage of Time skill again.
He closed his eyes slightly and tried to communicate with this era ruin with the soul on Earth.
Then, he even went forward to touch it.
However, there was no effect.
He didn’t give up and summoned Beast Shi Yu again.
As Beast Shi Yu, who had a super divine aura, appeared, the Sand Fortress Guardian beside him was stunned.
[Strange person.]
In the next moment, under its gaze, Beast Shi Yu walked forward and touched the door of the ruins with one hand, trying to communicate and resonate.
Unfortunately, nearly half an hour passed quickly, but there was still no reaction.
Shi Yu was silent on the spot.
“what’s going on…
His Earth soul and Beast Shi Yu’s Earth body couldn’t make the ruins react??
He came for nothing?
As expected, he still had to take the path of five super divines.
“Damn, I looked forward to it for nothing. Come on.” The Sand Fortress Guardian, who had been watching for a long time, changed from anticipation to disappointment. “Goddess Wa won’t miss anything. The opening method she left behind should be the only way.”
“You guys should continue to work hard.”
“Well…” It looked at the indignant Shi Yu and said, “By the way, if it’s really difficult to achieve that condition, actually, before Goddess Wa fell asleep, she left something for our race. Apart from leaving enough power to protect this planet, there’s also a tool that can be handed to the person from Blue Planet at a critical moment.”
“What?” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up.
The Sand Fortress Guardian said, “A tool that contains Goddess Wa’s clone. Goddess Wa said that if the humans on the Blue Planet aren’t enough to have five super divine bodies in the future, they can summon Goddess Wa’s clone and provide Blue Planet with some help.”
“Then this… can you give it to me?” Shi Yu asked.
Although he was certain that the Blue Planet could gather five super divines in a hundred years, it would be a waste not to have more help.
“Alright.” At this moment, the Sand Fortress Guardian also gave up. It spat out a bottle from its body. The bottle was also filled with resources similar to Creation Soil.
The Sand Fortress Guardian opened the bottle. In the next moment, the soil emitted a weak light.
Crack.
The bottle shattered, and the clay kept changing. Just like how the Blue Planet’s Will relied on the Creation Soil to create humans previously, at this moment, this soil quickly revealed a human form.
To be precise, it was in the form of a snake with a human head.
The life form with the body of a snake and the head of a human floated in midair with its eyes closed. Its face was covered in clothes, and its expression was emotionless.
Its movements in midair were as agile as a goddess. Not only was its body graceful, but the clothes it conjured also appeared light and elegant.
Soon, Shi Yu sensed a shocking divine power from her. She definitely had divine power that exceeded that of Baby Ginseng, Ling, and Qi. It completely exceeded the standard of a perfect god, as if it was a mighty power that only the legendary epoch god could have.
And this was only a clone.
Goddess Wa… was indeed very strong.
At this moment, Goddess Wa’s clone opened its spirit eyes and looked down at its surroundings from midair. Its gaze landed on the Sand Fortress Guardian and Shi Yu..

chapters.title: Chapter 1610 - 1610: Contracted Myself (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1610 - 1610: Contracted Myself (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Goddess Wa!!” Seeing this clone, the Sand Fortress Guardian was extremely excited and immediately greeted her.
Goddess Wa’s clone nodded. In the end, her gaze focused on Shi Yu, who gulped and asked, “Are you a human Beast Tamer from Blue Planet?”
“No.” Her gaze instantly landed on Beast Shi Yu. Then, she fell into a deep thought.
From expressionless to slightly incredulous.
“You have a big secret about you. Your previous life came from the last era.” The guardian scratched its head at the side, unable to understand at all.
It, who had grown up on this planet, had even less knowledge than the Heavenly Water Star Will.
“Senior Wa.”
When Shi Yu saw that Goddess Wa could tell the relationship between Beast Shi Yu and him at a glance, he couldn’t help but say, “Senior Goddess Wa, I’m considered a human on Blue Planet in this life, but I really don’t know anything about my previous life.”
“This is also the reason why I keep exploring the era ruin.”
Goddess Wa said, “Using this method, you escaped the curse that the era was destroyed and you couldn’t survive to the next era?”
“I don’t know if it’s a success or a failure.” She shook her head.
She looked at Shi Yu and said, “Your previous life must have been very
powerful, but in order to reincarnate into this era, your strength seems to have completely dissipated. Now, it’s even difficult to resist a super divine level.”
Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, “Sort of…’
However, the problem was that he had no idea why he was so powerful in his previous life.
He was just an ordinary person.
Could it be that after he died, some crazy scientist used his body as an experiment…
“How many super divine humans are there on the Blue Planet now?” Goddess Wa asked.
“There are two,” Shi Yu said.
Emperor Shi and Emperor Kong.
“I understand.” Goddess Wa said, “I was in a hurry previously and indeed didn’t give the World Tree enough guidance. Being able to give birth to two super divines has already exceeded my expectations.”
“But this isn’t enough. If we want to open this ruin, we need at least five super divine humans.”
“At the moment… we’re still short of three, no, two.” She looked at Shi Yu and said, “You’ll be able to become a super divine soon. I can provide you with some help.”
Shi Yu was delighted, but he still asked the question he was concerned about first.
“Senior Wa, may I ask what level your main body is and why you can’t be awakened from sleeping here?”
Goddess Wa was silent for a moment before saying, “There’s no harm in telling you. My main body is at the quasi-cosmic level, the peak of the super divine level. Back then, I suffered a backlash from failing to break through to the cosmic level and could only be forced to seal myself to recuperate.”
“The situation at that time was very complicated. My attempt to break through was also related to this ruin. In short, before I can enter this ruin, I don’t plan to unseal my main body.”
“Failed to break through to the cosmic level??” Shi Yu was slightly shocked.
Previously, he had joked with the owl about what would happen if Goddess Wa was the sixth cosmic level.
In fact, Shi Yu quickly abandoned this thought.
According to some secret records, when the sixth cosmic level was active, Goddess Wa might not have left the Blue Planet or been born.
The time didn’t match at all, so the sixth cosmic level must be someone else.
Therefore, Shi Yu felt that it was already not bad for Goddess Wa to have a super divine level and the strength of an emperor.
However, Shi Yu didn’t expect that Goddess Wa was stronger than he imagined. She even had the capital to charge to the cosmic level.
Although she failed, the level of a peak super divine was already very unbelievable.
Under the five cosmic levels, every cosmic emperor only had two to three peak super divine followers. The number was pitifully small.
“Senior Wa, what exactly are the conditions to break through to the cosmic level?” Shi Yu asked.
Goddess Wa looked at Shi Yu and said, “You…”
“If I knew, would I have failed?” She made Shi Yu speechless.
Goddess Wa said, “I do know some conditions to break through to the cosmic level, but it might not necessarily be suitable for you.”
“I can only tell you that the conditions for every race and individual to break through to the cosmic level are different. You have to find it yourself and try it yourself. Others’ paths can’t be replicated.”
“The breakthrough conditions for every individual… are different…” Shi Yu muttered Goddess Wa’s guidance. He nodded and felt that it made sense. He was enlightened.
Indeed, as the highest level in the universe, it would be a little strange if it could replicate someone else’s path.
“Alright, this clone can’t exist for long. Next, I can provide you with three help. I hope the Blue Planet humans can give birth to five super divines as soon as possible.”
Shi Yu looked at Goddess Wa, wanting to hear what the three helps were.
Goddess Wa said, “The first help is that during the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era, apart from Goddess Wa’s Ruins, I actually discovered a second era ruin that was related to Blue Planet in the last era.”
“However, at that time, because some conditions didn’t meet, I couldn’t explore this ruin. At that time, I hid this ruin and waited to explore it in the future.”
“This ruin contains pretty good opportunities and resources. You can try to explore and crack it.”
“Could it be that there are five sources of transcendence inside?” Shi Yu asked, thinking of the ruins Emperor Shi had entered.
Could it be that Goddess Wa was talking about that ruin?
“Source of transcendence?” Goddess Wa shook her head and said, “That’s an ancient war ruin. It seems to have been opened up by the battle of two powerful Beast Tamers from the last era..

chapters.title: Chapter 1611 - 1611: Contracted Myself (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1611 - 1611: Contracted Myself (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“My impression of this ruin is that it was a Beast Tamer who controlled a winged dragon and started a huge battle with another Beast Tamer who controlled the black and white Bear Race. Most of it, you need to explore it yourself.”
Shi Yu:
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and cursed in his heart.
Damn, was this the Mythical War between Emperor Huang and Chi You?
Wait a minute, was there really such a ruin?
What exactly was on Earth in the last era? The Four Holy Beasts, Goddess Wa, Chi You… Why did they have everything?
“You seem to have some understanding of this ruin,” Goddess Wa said. “In that case, the probability of you cracking this ruin should be higher. This is one of the help.”
“Second help, do you know about the cosmic overlord army?”
Shi Yu: !!!
“I know.” Shi Yu asked, “Senior Wa, what’s wrong with the cosmic overlord army?”
“If you have any difficulties, you can seek the help of the cosmic overlord army.”
“I once helped Cypos manage the cosmic overlord army for a period of time in the cosmic overlord army and also helped it crack many era ruins. Although I don’t really want to ask it for help, if you need anything, you can mention my name.”
“Cypos is a cosmic overlord.”
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly again.
Holy sh*t!!!
Shi Yu felt that Goddess Wa had shocked him more than Emperor Shi.
First, she exposed the ruins of Chi You and Emperor Huang. Then, she said that she had once held an important position in the cosmic overlord army and even managed the cosmic overlord army?
The gods who left Blue Planet lived really well, and those who lived badly were really poor.
Goddess Wa was clearly one of them. She was doing very well.
It was unbelievable.
Shi Yu was stunned. He felt that Senior Wa was too awesome and exciting.
Although she wasn’t a cosmic-level backer, she had found another cosmic-level backer for Shi Yu.
Moreover, it was the strongest existence in the universe.
In an instant, Shi Yu felt that there was nothing to be afraid of in this world.
Even a cosmic overlord was one of them. What was there to be afraid of?
Shi Yu instantly swelled up with confidence.
“The last help is my help against you.” Goddess Wa looked at Shi Yu and said,
“That body is your previous life, right?”
“Yes…” Shi Yu nodded.
Goddess Wa said, “You only control it with your mind, but your soul hasn’t returned. You’re worried about something, right?”
Shi Yu nodded again.
“Your worry is right. Although your current soul has an extremely high compatibility with your previous life’s body, your previous life’s body is too strong. Your current soul is too weak.”
“Forcibly fusing will cause you a huge burden.”
“You also feel it, right? If you use your mental clone to control him, you will also consume a lot of energy.”
“It’s like this,” Shi Yu said. “Before I strengthened my previous life, the consumption wasn’t that big, but after strengthening my previous life, the consumption of controlling it became greater and greater…”
Shi Yu suddenly regretted using the pseudo source of transcendence to strengthen Beast Shi Yu.
If it wasn’t strengthened, according to Goddess Wa, the level of the soul and body might be able to match quickly.
However… if he didn’t strengthen Beast Shi Yu, Shi Yu wouldn’t have dared to come out and play, nor would he have dared to come to the Contaminated Land. Then, he wouldn’t have been able to see Goddess Wa’s clone… Thinking about it this way, it wasn’t a loss.
“I can teach you a special contract method to let you contract it. This way, your previous life and current body can be safer and easier to fuse.”
“After the contract is completed, you can directly control his movements with your thoughts. Its status will temporarily be no different from the pet you contract. At that time, you can also simulate fusion through the fusion ability until the match is 100%.”
“Can I??” Shi Yu said. “But wasn’t I a human in my previous life?”
“Moreover, he’s at the super divine level, while I’m only at the divine level.”
Goddess Wa said, “It’s alright. He’s not a human of this era. He’s a super divine, but not a super divine. He can be contracted. It’s not difficult to do. You just have to change the contract method. It’s similar to the divine contract of the World King Planet.”
“In addition, your compatibility with it is extremely high. It’s not a problem even if you contract above your level. Although you have to bear a greater burden than now, you can also receive huge feedback after the contract is completed.”
No one knows humans better than me! Goddess Wa’s tone was very certain.
“Contract!” At this point, Shi Yu immediately wanted to know how to contract Beast Shi Yu.
“Follow my clone into the Psychic Resonance state and meditate together. I’ll guide you to complete a new contract,” Goddess Wa said.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
In the next moment, he closed his eyes again.
Goddess Wa’s voice appeared in his heart. Her hands were very warm as she
guided Shi Yu to learn the divine contract.
After an unknown period of time, the mental connection between Shi Yu and Beast Shi Yu gradually became stronger.
Under the feedback of Beast Shi Yu, Shi Yu’s various stats quickly increased.
In particular, his physical strength quickly approached the standard of a super divine human.
Of course, the super divine standard Shi Yu’s main body was close to was different from Beast Shi Yu’s super divine standard.
Shi Yu was only close to the super divine physique standard of the Human Race, while Beast Shi Yu wasn’t human at all. The super divine physique standard it had matched the myriad races in the starry sky, and it matched the transcendent life form. It was far stronger than the physique of ordinary humans of the same level. This was also something Shi Yu only discovered later..

chapters.title: Chapter 1612 - 1612: Contracted Myself (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1612: Contracted Myself (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Of course, under the feedback of Beast Shi Yu, what delighted Shi Yu the most wasn’t the increase in physique but the increase in Beast Taming level.
Although he indeed felt a very strong burden when he contracted Beast Shi Yu at the start, now, this burden was slowly disappearing. His Beast Taming Space level actually directly crossed many levels.
It directly reached the peak of the divine level, the tenth level of the divine level.
“Peak of the divine level…” Shi Yu opened his eyes in disbelief. He didn’t expect his advancement to be so fast. With the cultivation resources given by the Space Emperor and the Cultivation Fruit, he had only increased by one level in the past few months.
However, only contracting Beast Shi Yu directly gave him feedback to the peak of the divine level.
“In other words, as long as I fuse with a source of transcendence now, I can also be a super divine Beast Tamer?” Shi Yu said in disbelief.
A long time ago, he was the one who dragged his pet down.
Eleven and the others advanced from transcendent to commander, from commander to monarch, and from monarch to overlord. As soon as they advanced, they immediately reached the peak of the next realm and had the strongest tier battle power of that level.
However, at the same time, Shi Yu was basically very far from the next level, very far from the current level bottleneck.
It was the culprit behind the pet’s inability to continue breaking through. Of course, this was also related to the fact that the additional points were too strong.
However, everything seemed to have reversed at the divine level. As soon as Eleven and the others broke through from the strongest demigod, they were only close to the high-level divine level. They were still several levels away from the peak of the divine level, the high-level divine, the top-notch divine, and the perfect divine.
Now, most of Shi Yu’s pets were still stuck at high-level divines. They were very, very far from the peak of the divine level.
However, this time, Shi Yu himself had finally reached the peak of the divine level before his pet. This made Shi Yu feel that he might be able to break through to the super divine level before his pet this time.
The benefits of contracting multiple pets had finally come. This was still the feedback from some pets… He was already at the peak of the divine level. If Eleven and the others’ subsequent levels increased, could he break through the limit of the tenth level of the divine level as Emperor Shi had guessed?
“You’re very talented,” Goddess Wa also said at this moment. “However, although I really want to see the birth of five super divine Blue Planet humans immediately, the number is far insufficient now, so there’s no hurry.”
“Don’t easily fuse with the source of transcendence.”
“Uh.” Shi Yu looked at Goddess Wa and said, “Senior Wa… What… does this mean?”
“To be precise, don’t easily fuse the source of transcendence that others have fused. The source of transcendence also has quality.”
“The fusion of a weaker source of transcendence might affect your future path,” Goddess Wa said. “There are a total of three sources of transcendence.” “The universe naturally condenses one every 100,000 years.”
“There’s a chance to plunder if you kill a super divine, or if a super divine commits suicide and takes the initiative to pass it down to others.”
“From the era ruin, remnants of the last era.’
“Among them, in terms of quality, the source of transcendence obtained from killing super divines and the remaining source of transcendence in the era are all ordinary. The quality of the source of transcendence naturally condensed every 100,000 years is the best.”
“There’s a saying that only by fusing with the source of transcendence born naturally in the universe can one have the chance to enter the cosmic level. It’s one of the many sayings of breaking through to the cosmic level.”
“Of course, this source of transcendence is also the most difficult to obtain. It’s even harder than hunting super divines.”
“The peak divine level you’re seeing in the universe now is far from the true limit of the divine level.’
“Among the divine-levels, there’s a batch of divine-levels who have the ability to defeat super divines. They pursue higher and don’t care about the super divine level. They only want to take a gamble and enter the cosmic level. They’re unwilling to fuse with the sources of transcendence that others have fused. They chose to wait for the source of transcendence that appears once every 100,000 years. They didn’t even hesitate to seal themselves for 100,000 years, 200,000, 300,000 years, constantly sealing to extend their lifespan. They only appear once every 100,000 years just to fight for the naturally condensed sources of transcendence.’
“Every time this source of transcendence appears, the universe will also stir up a storm of blood. Apart from the cosmic level, even super divine levels will join in the competition. If possible, it’s best if you advance yourself and fuse with this source of transcendence. With the protection of your previous life, you’re qualified to compete with those monster divine levels who have sealed themselves for hundreds of thousands, millions, or even tens of millions of years..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1613 - 1613: Shouting at the Abyss Super Divine (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1613: Shouting at the Abyss Super Divine (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“This…
At this moment, when he heard Goddess Wa say that the source of transcendence naturally condensed in the universe every 100,000 years was the best, and that the rest were second-hand goods and weren’t good, Shi Yu was instantly stunned.
In his mind, Senior Space Emperor’s excited expression when he obtained the source of transcendence appeared.
No…
Senior Space Emperor…!!
Not only Senior Space Emperor, but even the source of transcendence obtained by Senior Time Emperor was incomplete…
It didn’t count the best quality. It might affect the advancement of the cosmic level in the future…
Senior Emperor Shi…!!
Shi Yu instantly felt that the two space-time emperor’s luck wasn’t very good.
However, it didn’t seem to affect Senior Space Emperor very much.
Senior Space Emperor was already very satisfied to be able to become a super divine.
However, Senior Emperor Shi was also determined to pursue the cosmic level and fuse with the remaining source of transcendence of the era. He felt that he had taken the wrong step and didn’t know if he could turn it back.
At the moment, Emperor Shi didn’t let other pets continue to fuse with this source of transcendence. He seemed to be making up for it.
“Speaking of which, I wonder how long has it been since the last time the universe naturally condensed the source of transcendence,” Shi Yu thought.
Upon hearing Goddess Wa’s words, Shi Yu naturally wanted to fight.
However, if he still had to wait tens of thousands of years, it would be meaningless.
Unless he sealed himself and waited for tens of thousands of years, even if he was still alive at that time, Shi Yu felt that it was meaningless. He wasn’t such a patient person.
Well…
Wait a minute.
Shi Yu discovered a blind spot.
Was it possible to directly let Qi bring him to transcend the origin??
He transmigrated to the past and fought an ancient era god.
After going back and forth more than ten times, he took more than ten naturally condensed sources of transcendence and gave them to his pets… But this way… the karma involved was a little huge.
Of course, Shi Yu also had to consider if he could defeat other competitors.
According to Goddess Wa, the reason why the legendary epoch gods in the universe looked small was because in order to extend their lifespans, they basically didn’t appear in the world and were sealed at all times?
This wasn’t the most important thing. Most importantly, Goddess Wa said that some super divines might join in the competition…
With Shi Yu’s current strength, it was alright to fight a weaker super divine.
However, if they wanted to compete for transcendent origin, it was no different from becoming enemies with all the competitors. At that time, as long as they displayed a little advantage, they would probably be attacked by a group.
Its strength was far from enough. Without battle power that exceeded transcendent 4, it probably had no fate to transcend the origin.
At this moment, Shi Yu only thought for a moment. Goddess Wa’s clone opposite him suddenly began to become a little illusory and dim.
Shi Yu immediately looked at Senior Wa and shouted.
“Senior Wa.”
However, without any answer, her figure slowly disappeared.
“Goodbye, Goddess Wa.” Beside him, the Sand Fortress Guardian immediately shouted when it saw Goddess Wa disappear.
Then, it explained to Shi Yu, “Because of the main body, Goddess Wa’s clone will also suffer a huge backlash. Next, I’ll leave it to you to quickly fulfill the conditions to enter the era ruin.’
“There must be something in the ruins that’s helpful to Goddess Wa’s restoration, that’s why she’s so concerned about this ruin,” the Sand Fortress Guardian guessed.
“Alright…” Shi Yu nodded.
“Thank you, Senior Guardian. Are you still staying here next?” Shi Yu looked at it.
“That’s right,” the Sand Fortress Guardian said. “Although this place is remote, it’s alright. Let’s go up first. I’ll send you.”
Soon after.
The silver-white battleship set off from the yellow-brown planet again.
Looking at the scenery outside the battleship, Shi Yu felt a sense of loss. Coming early was indeed the right choice.
He turned and walked to the conference room. At this moment, the pets were already waiting for the meeting.
Pushing open the door, the pets looked at Shi Yu eagerly.
“Wuu, vwu! Eleven patted the table excitedly.
“l know you’re anxious, but don’t worry.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Wu wu ??? Eleven was naturally anxious.
In fact, Shi Yu had also told his pets about the myths on Earth.
When Eleven was still a child, Shi Yu had been telling stories to it all day.
Whether it was true or false, novels and myths had all been told.
For example, the story of a Beast Tamer, surnamed Tang, contracting a stone monkey, a pig-headed man, and a river boy to challenge ferocious beasts along the way.
For example, the story of Emperor Huang summoning Ying Long and fighting the Demon God Chi You had been told.
Now that Eleven knew that Chi You and the Iron-eating Beast might really have existed in the last era and had extremely powerful ruins, how could it not want to explore the ruins Goddess Wa mentioned?
“What exactly happened down there?”
Apart from the pets with mental connections with Shi Yu, the gem cat, and owl wanted to know what exactly happened after Shi Yu arrived.
“It’s nothing.” Shi Yu sat down and said, “As expected, I can’t open the ruins.”
“However, I saw Goddess Wa’s clone.’
Gem Cat, Owl: What!!!
“Senior Wa, in order to accelerate the appearance of five human super divines on the Blue Planet, she provided me with some help.”
“Did you sense my current level?”
Shi Yu smiled, and the gem cat and owl carefully observed Shi Yu.
Then, they opened their mouths wide, as if they could vaguely see the unreachable 10 levels of the sky behind Shi Yu.
A powerful spatial pressure bloomed from Shi Yu t s body.
This spatial power was enough for Shi Yu to rely on the pressure of the Beast Taming Space to suppress ordinary divine levels and forcefully contract them to become slaves..

chapters.title: Chapter 1614 - 1614: Shouting at the Abyss Super Divine (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1614: Shouting at the Abyss Super Divine (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Peak divine level?” The owl said, “Damn, you ate Goddess Wa!”
Shi Yu:
“l ate myself!” Shi Yu said.
“In short, it was Goddess Wa who helped me increase my strength and told me that an era ruin on the Blue Planet could be explored. Then, she said that if we encountered any difficulties, we could look for her old friend.”
“Well, that’s about it.’
“By the way, when Senior Wa was at her peak, she was once a powerful life form at the peak of the super divine level. It’s really impressive.” The gem cat and the owl were very shocked. Peak super divine?
Goddess Wa was too strong.
“Big harvest.” The owl was excited. As expected, she had reincarnated to Blue Planet and was definitely guided by Lady Luck.
Although the World King Planet wasn’t bad, there were too many powerful races. The astrologers were nothing.
He felt that only by playing with Blue Planet could he have a huge opportunity.
“So next, are we going back to Blue Planet to explore the ruins?” The gem cat looked at Eleven.
This little guy was so anxious.
“Wu wu wu!” Eleven felt that it wasn’t far from strengthening.
It would be the first place in the next team internal competition!
Apart from being first place in the first year, Eleven hadn’t gotten first place in a long time.
“We haven’t done the serious thing yet. What’s the hurry, right, Susu?” Shi Yu looked at Susu on the chair opposite him.
“Ning, Ning! Susu expressed that it was very right. It had yet to fight the abyss super divine. How could it go back just like that?
Niany places in this star domain were dirty. If it didn’t cleanse it before returning, it could be troubled for ten thousand years.
“Let’s stay for a while more.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s rare for us to come out. ”
“Next, our mission is to hunt the abyss super divine, Benos!’!
“Let’s see the true difference between us and super divines. In addition… battle merits and the source of transcendence, we can take a gamble.” “The main force this time is Susu, and the others are supports.”
“A super divine level definitely has many subordinates close to the super divine level under him. There might even be subordinates who can counter the power of cleansing. The mission of the others is to help Susu eliminate the obstacles and let it fight the abyss super divine quietly.”
“So what should we do next?” The owl had an ominous feeling of working. “At the moment, the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association and the Dark King Army are in a confrontational state. A war can happen at any time, and a huge battle is about to break out,” Ling said. “If we want to fish in troubled waters in this situation, the most important thing is to find the right time.”
“Next, if we can accurately know when the Environmental Protection Association and the Dark King Army will make big moves, it’s the most beneficial to us.’
“Therefore, after that, we’ll split up. Teacher Owl, you and Teacher Ying can predict the day to attack together. It’s the most beneficial for us.”
“From a metaphysical perspective, let us occupy the sky.”
“As for me and Duckie, we’ll find an opportunity to observe the situation of this abyss army everywhere. The situation of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain…
Well, we still have to call that Yue Ling and strive to also occupy the advantage of the geographical sharpness!”
“Ah…” Upon hearing that, the owl said, “Do we still need people?”
“Of course, before we become sh*t stirrers, Susu and I can still work harder.’ Shi Yu chuckled.
“Ning, Ning! Susu looked expectant. Alright.
Let’s go to the abyss together!
Soon, the Beast Tamer Yu Ling, whom Shi Yu and the others had picked up from Heavenly Water Star, was also called to the conference room.
“Captain Shi Yu, you’re looking for me…”
After Yue Ling entered the conference room, she looked at Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the others sitting neatly in two rows.
She was silent for a moment. She still felt that this pirate crew was a little strange.
Apart from Shi Yu, who was a man, it wasn’t a cute creature (Eleven, Shorty). It was some strange creature (Three-Headed Black Tortoise, Blind Demon Duck), or a bunch of beautiful women (two cats, Chi Tong).
She kept feeling that this pirate crew was a little abnormal.
“Yes, I want to ask you a few questions,” Shi Yu said. “Let’s confirm again.”
“You previously told Ling that the current location of the abyss super divine,
Benos, is on your mother planet, the Divine Planet, right?”
“Yes.” Yue Ling nodded and said, “After my mother planet fell, the headquarters of the Abyss Army have been stationed there.”
“We plan to attack soon. Next, I’ll let you go out and observe the surrounding environment of the Divine Planet with Ling. Is there a problem?” “No problem,” Yue Ling said. “Is it just me and Miss Ling?” She looked at the battleship, Ling.
“No, for safety’s sake, one more.” Shi Yu looked at Duckie.
“Quack!” Duckie stood up from the chair and tilted its blindfolded eyes, turning into a one-eyed pirate duck. The power of the abyss spread from its body.
“!!!” Yue Ling widened her eyes. Abyss Race!
She didn’t expect that not only were there members who were expert cleansing power on this pirate ship, but there was also an abyss life form. This was simply… What was the background of this pirate crew?
“With it around, your aura can better integrate into this starry sky,” Shi Yu said.
Then, time passed quickly.
With a goal, everything had motivation.
When Lings clone, Duckie, and the others went out to search for information, Shi Yu crazily added points to Susu.
After Shi Yu contracted Beast Shi Yu and his strength increased, the speed at which he added points also increased greatly.
In just half a month, Susu’s attributes were as follows..

chapters.title: Chapter 1615 - 1615: Shouting at the Abyss Super Divine (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1615: Shouting at the Abyss Super Divine (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
[Race Skill]
“Divine-level”: Faith skill, Star Sea Contract (Perfect+47), Origin Wave (Perfect+8), Inheritance Water Droplet (Initiate), Water/Quasi Control
(Proficient), Heavenly Frost Cold Energy (Proficient)
[Taught Skill]
“Divine-level”: Infinite Devour (Initiate), Star Refinement (Proficient)
The current stats were actually not Susu’s optimal state.
As time was tight, Shi Yu only had time to increase Susu’s Star Sea Contract level, but the Origin Wave had yet to be maxed out.
Apart from that, Susu actually had another change from the God Sealing Battle.
It was Infinite Devour that successfully advanced. The Infinite Devour that Shi Yu had replicated from the Abyss Worm could finally be taught to Susu during this trip.
This way, Susu could devour resources above the devouring divine level more efficiently and evolve. Shi Yu already had an idea and planned to let Susu swallow the Cold Silence Crown he had refined.
The Cold Silence Crown was a weapon refined by Susu through star refining. It was the ice and snow star that had been corroded by the cosmic disaster, Cold Silence.
Cold Silence, like the Starry Sky Storm, was a cosmic disaster. It contained the nature of ice and time. Wherever it flowed, time would be frozen. Everything would be frozen and become a forbidden zone for life. It was incomparably terrifying.
This skill was actually similar to Heavenly Frost Cold Energy. Therefore, Susu swallowed the Cold Silence Crown to see if it could upgrade the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy skill to a high-level skill because of this cosmic disaster skill, Cold Silence.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t have time to do these things now.
This was because he knew that the outcome of the owl, gem cat, and Lings joint prophecy was that the best time to hunt the abyss super divine was tomorrow.
If they missed tomorrow, the variables might be greater. After careful consideration, Shi Yu and the others decided to challenge the abyss super divine at this time.
