Although Susu wasn’t in its optimal state, at least the Star Sea Contract had been maxed out. It was indeed only a step away from the epoch god. It could be called a quasi epoch god.
In addition, its power countered the abyss element, so it might be able to fight.
At this moment, Duckie and the others had already completed their investigation and returned.
Scarlet Blue Star Domain, the Divine Planet.
This star was now the headquarters of the abyss super divine, and it was also where the other party was stationed.
Outside the planet, an invisible battleship slowly approached.
Beside him was the Beast Tamer of Divine Planet, Yue Ling, whom Shi Yu had called over.
Shi Yu stood in the battleship and stared at the already dark planet through the screen with an expressionless face.
“Captain Shi Yu, what should we do next?” Beside Shi Yu, Yue Ling took a deep breath and looked at her mother planet as she asked Shi Yu.
“What should we do?”
“We’re pirates, so of course we’ll attack openly.”
Shi Yu’s words made Beast Tamer Yu Ling, who was beside him, open her mouth slightly. Attack openly?
Was there no tactical strategy?
So, they have been lingering here for so long to search for information just to attack today? Instead of choosing a more suitable strategy?
She couldn’t understand!
As if to verify Shi Yu’s words, Ling didn’t say a word and directly approached the Divine Planet!!
After all, the Divine Planet was the headquarters of this super divine Abyss
Army. The defense measures were indeed incomparable to those in other places.
However, just as the huge battleship approached, it was immediately discovered by the Abyss Army.
Countless abyss members stationed outside the star looked at this huge battleship that suddenly appeared with fear.
“Who is it!!!”
They were even more nervous than Shi Yu because they were currently in the confrontation stage between the Dark King Army and the Cosmic Sea Army. Any commotion could be fatal.
A sneak attack by the Cosmic Sea army?
Or was it one of their own?
They sensed a huge abyssal power from this battleship.
“Wait, pirate crew???” But soon, the Abyss Army stationed outside the Divine Planet discovered the dense pirate flags inserted on the battleship.
Apart from that, life forms that emitted the power of the abyss were also discovered.
“Holy sh*t, Pirate Duck!”
It was a huge duck filled with muscles. It stood in front of the battleship with a pirate hat and a black eye mask to protect its strength, revealing only the Eye of the Evil God.
The huge abyssal power that swept through the starry sky made Duckie indeed look very much like a member of the Abyss Army, but in terms of clothes, it was undoubtedly a pirate.
The next shout was undoubtedly very arrogant.
“Quack! !!! (The Era Pirate Group has arrived, unrelated people, get out of the way!!)”
‘Quack! !!! (Robbing!! Call your boss out!!! You’re called Benos, right!!)”
The huge shout stunned the Abyss Army.
Damn it.
What was going on?
The cosmic pirates… snatched it from their Abyss Army? Didn’t they know that the boss of this Abyss Army was a super divine-level expert?

chapters.title: Chapter 1616 - 1616: Duck Combination (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1616: Duck Combination (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Scarlet Blue Star Domain, outside the Divine Planet.
Many abyss life forms stared fiercely at the Pirate Duck of the Era Pirate Group.
Although it was also an abyss life form and everyone was “of the same race”, the Pirate Duck’s arrogant behavior was no different from provoking their regular army.
The abyss was a large race. Because of the nature of pollution and contagion, its race was spread throughout the universe. It wasn’t impossible for some individuals to become pirates.
However, these regular armies really couldn’t imagine why a lousy organization like the Space Pirates had the guts to rob the super divine army.
“Quack!”
Duckie stepped into the starry sky and walked out of the battleship step by step. A circular dark wave ripple appeared under its feet, and ripples appeared with every step. In the blink of an eye, it formed a confrontation with the thousands of Abyss Race armies outside Divine Planet.
Boom!
Duckie’s aura erupted further, and the might of a high-level god was undoubtedly displayed.
When Shi Yu’s pets first broke through half a year ago, their divine power levels were already at the peak of intermediate gods.
And now, half a year later, it had almost increased to the growth level of a high-level divine.
It wasn’t relying on skill points, but purely on the divine power level piled up with various divine-level cultivation resources and food created by the ginseng baby.
With Buggy using the Four Holy Ruins to activate the creation farming domain and Baby Ginseng using the power of the world to farm for free, under the strong alliance, Shi Yu’s pets ate big meals that other divine levels could only eat once every day.
However, although the high-level divines weren’t weak anymore, seeing this, the Abyss Army opposite only wanted to laugh.
Damn it, he was a high-level divine. Even on any intermediate planet, he wasn’t the strongest. How could this Pirate Duck dare?
“A guy with a death wish.” In the Abyss Army, a black mermaid who looked like a sergeant held a gun and directly aimed at Duckie, shooting a blue water bullet with a bang.
The water bullet was as fast as a light bullet, drawing a blue light in the starry sky. What was unbelievable was that this water bullet actually contained a strong cleansing power.
“It’s really rolling.” In the battleship, Shi Yu shook his head. The Dark King Army and the Environmental Protection Association were at odds. In order to understand how to counter the other party, many purifiers of the
Environmental Protection Association contracted pollution pets. On the Dark King Army’s side, there were actually many pollution monsters who had mastered the cleansing ability..
“That’s the Death Cleansing Spear, the ultimate weapon developed by the Environmental Protection Association. It was later mastered by the Dark King Army. The highest level of cleansing bullets fired can cause huge damage to abyssal creatures below top-notch divines. Apart from huge consumption and single effects, there are basically no other shortcomings,” Yue Ling looked out at the starry sky and said nervously.
“Don’t worry, it’s just the cleansing power mastered by external forces,” Shi Yu said.
It wasn’t enough to rely on this method to deal with a monster duck that cultivated two powers at the same time.
Swoosh!
As the cleansing bullets attacked, Duckie frowned and condensed a weapon in front of it!
It was a blue-gold pestle!!
“Quack! Duckie swung, and the arc of the water bullet instantly changed. The Demon Subduing Pestle directly absorbed the cleansing bullet, shocking the Abyss Army opposite.
“What’s that!!”
“What is it? The attack of the Death Cleansing Spear was absorbed??”
“Quack! (I’ll return it to you!)” Duckie swung again, and the cleansing bullet in the Demon Subduing Pestle was thrown back intact. It was even faster, making the pupils of the black mermaid who fired the attack shrink.
Boom!!!
“Ah!!!” Its right shoulder was penetrated by the water drop. A huge cleansing power began to sweep through its entire body, making it sway in the starry sky in pain. The weapon in its hand also fell into the starry sky.
“Quack… (Damn it, they actually dare to attack me.)” At this moment, Duckie was angry and planned to give the Abyss Army a greeting gift.
It raised the Vajra Demon Subduing Staff high and activated its Wave Vision, Heart Eye. At the top of the pestle, a constantly expanding cleansing bomb began to condense. However, this cleansing bomb was ridiculously large!!
In an instant, it expanded into a cleansing water star that was like an asteroid. The blue-gold cleansing light shone like the sun.
“Roar! Just seeing this light, many soldiers of the Abyss Army were in extreme pain and let out wails.
“What’s that?” In the battleship, Yue Ling was in disbelief. This Pirate Duck had clearly erupted with an abyssal power comparable to that of a high-level Abyss God just now, but at this moment, why did it erupt with such a dazzling cleansing power?
She didn’t understand!
But without a doubt, Duckie planned to fight against thousands of Abyss Races alone.
At this moment, Duckie gently headed towards the incomparably huge water star under the Divine Planet. Then, as the water star exploded into countless rains of light, it charged into the Abyss Army!
“Don’t ask so much. Just watch.”
“The other party’s super divine… No, forget about the other party’s super divine, even the other party’s perfect divine doesn’t seem to think much of it.
It’s just some trash guarding outside the planet. In that case, let Duckie play with the other party first,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Although Duckie was only a high-level divine now, that was its own strength. Apart from itself… it still had weapons at this moment!
Duckie refined an intermediate cleansing star and turned it into the Demon Subduing Pestle, cooperating with its Vajra Demon Subduing Staff skill.
Apart from its very strong self-cleansing power, Susu also specially gave this weapon the Sea Cleansing Spirit to make it even stronger.
It was equivalent to Duckie, who was holding this weapon, inheriting several times the cleansing power of Susu. Against the Abyss Race, it was simply killing indiscriminately and could easily jump levels..

chapters.title: Chapter 1617 - 1617: Susu and Duck Combination (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1617: Susu and Duck Combination (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
At this moment, the weaker Abyss Race instantly lost their ability to fight when they touched the rain of light and fell from the starry sky. Although the stronger Abyss Race could resist the rain of light, they were also strongly affected. Duckie descended and waved the Vajra Demon Subduing Staff in its hand. A large number of figures were flipped over like a mountain and exploded in the starry sky!
The Vajra Demon Subduing Staff in its hand seemed to have shocking divine power. It could kill gods and demons in its path. It seemed that Duckie was too ridiculous. A stronger Abyss Race finally appeared in the guard army of the Divine Planet.
It was a huge water ghost that looked like an ape. Its entire body emitted a black aura. It held a trident and attacked in anger. Dark laws lingered on the trident, sweeping up the power of the super divine abyss and directly attacking Duckie.
Boom!!!
Duckie didn’t show any weakness. Its body enlarged, and it also held the Demon Subduing Pestle to sweep up the cleansing power and smash it at the other party’s dark trident. After a violent sound, cracks appeared on the dark trident, and the aura of the abyss leaked, shocking the water ghost.
HUI!
The Demon Subduing Pestle swept up the duck’s strength and one-star strength. Susu’s strength instantly broke through the other party’s weapon limit. The quality wasn’t on the same level at all, and it directly stabbed into the water ghost’s abdomen.
“Quack (Dark Water!!).” Under the incredulous expression of the top-notch god of the Abyss Army, it realized that apart from cleansing itself, this Pirate Duck also wanted to absorb its abyssal power!!
After using weapons to penetrate it in the starry sky, Duckie’s other hand directly turned into black mist. A black hole-like vortex appeared in its palm and directly pinched its neck. As it cleansed its abyssal power into pure abyssal power that was easier to absorb without the marks of others, it absorbed this abyssal power into its body to strengthen itself.
“Pfft! In an instant, a top-notch divine was destroyed by Duckie’s consecutive moves. Not only was its entire body cleansed, but most of its strength had also been absorbed. In the blink of an eye, it was extremely weak and on the verge of death.
Duckie swung its remaining body and threw it away. It charged into the Abyss Army again like a Demon God and God of Slaughter. Through the many combination methods of cleansing, Dark Control, and the Eye of the Evil God, it hunted and strengthened itself.
“This…” Yue Ling continued to watch in a daze. That was top-notch divine. It was the same on Heavenly Water Star. A top-notch divine was insta-killed by a Starry Sky Slime without any resistance. It was the same here. This Pirate Duck was also brave.
No wonder Shi Yu dared to challenge the super divine. Any member of this pirate crew seemed to have the strength to defeat a top-notch divine.
“Not good!!!” Not long after, the Abyss Army guarding Divine Planet discovered the BUG of this Pirate Duck. It wasn’t afraid of the power of the abyss or the power of cleansing, and it didn’t seem to have any methods to counter it.
Moreover, Duckie, who was fighting and devouring the power of the others, seemed to have endless power. Especially that weapon, which had released a huge amount of power from the beginning to the end and had never weakened.
At that moment, Duckie was extremely excited. Although it was a trick and had borrowed the power of Big Sister Susu, the feeling of absorbing the power of the abyss infinitely to strengthen itself was too good. It was really addictive.
Of course, the duck was also very alert. It cleansed its power before absorbing it. Otherwise, it would definitely fall under the power of the abyss and be killed by the Beast Tamer and Big Sister.
“Unbelievable. Who is this guy?” At this moment, apart from Shi Yu and the others, there was another uninvited guest in the endless void.
They also infiltrated the Scarlet Blue Star Domain through high-tech methods and infiltrated the vicinity of the Divine Planet.
This was a four-man elite team. There were two humans and two cosmic life forms. Among them, two cosmic life forms, one was a cleansing race ranked in the top ten thousand of the cosmic races, and the other was also an Abyss Beast. However, from the looks of it, they controlled the power of the abyss very well.
“Pirates? Ridiculous. At a time like this, why would a pirate attack the Divine Planet?”
“To be precise, how dare the pirates attack the Abyss Army?” At that moment, the team was shocked.
They were actually members of the Environmental Protection Army stationed at the edge of the Cosmic Sea. The Cosmic Sea had already made the overall attack decision. They were equivalent to scouts who came to scout first. In the end, they didn’t expect to see such a good show at the enemy’s headquarters.
The headquarters of the Abyss super divine which they regarded as a great enemy was being attacked by pirates!
It was ridiculous!
The key was that the Pirate Duck was still so strong. It actually cultivated the power of cleansing and the abyssal power at the same time and defeated a top-notch Abyss God. Where did this pirate come from?
Unfortunately, they were stationed at the edge of the Cosmic Sea all year round and were in a highly tense battle state at all times. They had no time to pay attention to the demigod competition on the World King Planet. Otherwise, if it were someone from the World King Planet who saw Duckie’s current performance, they should be able to recognize it.
“So strong.” Under their surprise, Duckie swept through the army again and sucked the ten divine-level Abyss Beasts to its side with irresistible force. It was tyrannical and heaven-defying.
“Quack! Duckie ferociously defeated the enemy and portrayed the pirate vividly. However, at this moment, Duckie and the scouts of the Environmental Protection Army made the pupils of Yue Ling in the battleship shrink at the same time.
“On account of your strength, submit to me, and I’ll spare your life.”
Countless mantras gathered in the starry sky, and a terrifying black mist seemed to have enveloped the entire Scarlet Blue Star Domain. Everyone was dragged into a new abyss world, disappearing from the stars and falling into the dark sea..

chapters.title: Chapter 1618 - 1618: Susu and Duck Combination (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1618 - 1618: Susu and Duck Combination (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Duckie suddenly raised its head solemnly and saw that above the higher sea of stars, this place was filled with a large amount of mist, filled with strangeness and horror. A smelly aura circled in the starry sky. It activated the Wave Heart Eye with all its might, wanting to observe the huge figure behind the star mist, but it failed.
I can’t defeat it.
Soon, this thought appeared in Duckie’s heart.
“Abyss super divine, Benos.” The Environmental Protection Army reconnaissance team trapped in the abyss was extremely afraid. They knew that the crazy actions of this pirate crew would definitely cause the super divine to descend.
“Lord Benos! ! ” The remaining Abyss Army was also extremely surprised to see Lord Benos appear.
However, contrary to their imagination, Benos didn’t attack this Pirate Duck. Instead, he seemed to admire the other party and had the intention of making it submit to him.
“You’re not worthy.” However, in the eyes of anyone, the Pirate Ducks answer was no different from dancing on a landmine. It was clearly trembling from the terrifying aura, and the hand holding the Demon Subduing Pestle was a little shaky, but it still looked straight at the strange mist and disdained it.
“It’s not up to you.” Before Benos could see its body, it displayed a difference in strength that seemed to be a dimension apart from the divine level. An abyss tide that was like the collapse of the starry sky drowned the battleship and Duckie in this shattered world.
Just as it said, it couldn’t be helped.
With the power of a super divine level abyss life form, it was easy to corrode the will of a life form and change its race.
“It must still have a trump card.”
Seeing that Duckie was so arrogant and was also invincible in the face of the super divine, the scouts of the Environmental Protection Army swallowed their saliva crazily. In this situation, they could already determine that they had definitely been discovered by the abyss super divine.
However, because they were too weak and not worth the attention of the abyss super divine, now that they were surrounded by the abyss, if they wanted to leave alive, they could only rely on this pirate crew. As long as the other party could give the abyss super divine some pressure, they could escape.
The news here had to be spread quickly.
Under everyone’s gaze, Duckie looked straight at the incoming abyss tide and took a deep breath, using its ultimate move, “Quack!! (Switch, switch, Big Sister, save me!!!)”
Sensing such a terrifying abyssal power, Duckie instantly analyzed that it couldn’t devour or cleanse it. It raised its head and roared for help.
At this moment, the starry sky seemed to be silent. The corners of many people’s mouths twitched.
But in the next moment, accompanied by the sound of water falling into the water, Duckie’s request for help seemed to have really worked. From the center of the starry sky, a holy light wave kept spreading and illuminating the surroundings.
Then, in front of everyone’s disbelief, this cleansing wave began to forcefully push away the abyss tide from all directions. The terrifying cleansing wave also instantly cleansed the remaining abyss life forms. Even the black mist in the sea of stars was dispersed, revealing the true body of the abyss super divine.
Its entire body was dark green, and it was extremely huge. It vaguely had the outline of a Sea Horse, and its entire body was filled with spikes. Not only were ten red eyes flickering with light, but dense seaweed-like hair was also wrapped around it, looking extremely terrifying.
Benos, who was floating in the starry sky, looked in the direction of the battleship in surprise.
A Starry Sky Slime, wearing a crown, also floated in the starry sky and looked at it calmly and in disgust.
“Cleansing star spirit.” The moment Benos saw Susu, it recognized its race. “You’re from the Environmental Protection Association?”
It knew that it was impossible for such a powerful pirate to appear for no reason. The appearance of the cleansing star spirit confirmed the identity of this pirate crew.
Only the Environmental Protection Association had the cleansing star spirit. As soon as this race was born, it would be absorbed by the Environmental Protection Association and very few would be missed.
“I see. Is it going to launch an all-out attack today? But launching an all-out attack in such a stupid way and sending such a weak star spirit is a little disrespectful to my existence.”
The abyss super divine, Benos, could sense SUsU’s power. It should have the strength of a perfect divine, but it was still wishful thinking to defeat it above its level.
On the Cosmic Sea’s side, no matter how insufficient the military force was, there should be several super divines, even if they couldn’t gather ten super divines. Now, he was actually underestimated like this and thought that he could resist a cleansing star spirit that wasn’t even super divine. Benos couldn’t help but find it funny.
“Ning. (You talk so much nonsense.)” Susu looked at Benos calmly. Its gaze flashed, and its body kept enlarging, also enlarging into a huge slime that was like a star, making Benos’s expression freeze.
Of course, what it cared about wasn’t the change in Susu’s body, but the sound of countless stars in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain. They were asking this cleansing star spirit for help.
Not only were the countless stars in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain wailing, but even the stars in the surrounding star domains were also contributing endless power to gather here.
“You…” Benos instantly knew that it had made a mistake just now. The other party’s strength was definitely not as simple as an ordinary, perfect divine. The other partys intrinsic skill, the skill that signed a contract with the starry sky, was terrifyingly high.
Boom!!!
In a daze, light spread from Susu’s body and turned into a cleansing wave. In an instant, it flipped and blew Benos’s huge body away. Benos was like a flying star, shattering countless small meteorites..

chapters.title: Chapter 1619 - 1619: Susu and Duck Combination (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1619 - 1619: Susu and Duck Combination (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Roar! ! ! ” The brutal origin wave enhanced by the quasi-transcendent-level Star Sea Contract hit Benos, making it let out an angry roar.
At this moment, the audience watching this battle was already completely silent. The four scouts of the Environmental Protection Army were stunned when they saw Benos being sent flying. They let out miserable cries.
Moreover, what was Benos saying just now?
Cleansing star spirit? Environmental Protection Association?
They looked at Susu in disbelief. They were very certain that the other party was definitely not one of them. Their battle plan didn’t have this ring at all. They had never seen such a teammate in the Void Battlefield.
What exactly was going on with this battle?
“l!!” At this moment, after being attacked by Susu, Benos first confirmed that it had indeed underestimated the other party. If it was an Abyss Race that was of transcendent 1, it might really lose to this cleansing star spirit.
The other party’s Starry Sky Contract level was terrifyingly high, but unfortunately, it was above transcendent 2. Moreover, although the skill level was terrifyingly high, it didn’t seem to have reached that level—the level that was enough to support the cleansing star spirit to cleanse above its level.
“You succeeded and angered me.” Soon, black light spread from Benos’s figure, looking like it had self-destructed, making people afraid.
Boom.
In the next moment, Benos’s body indeed directly exploded. A large amount of abyssal power poured out of its body. The Abyss Beasts that had been defeated by Duckie just now all revived at this moment. Moreover, every one of them had the strength of a top-notch divine. Hundreds of top-notch Abyss Gods instantly densely appeared in the entire starry sky, extremely shocked.
“Go.” In the void, with a command, hundreds of top-notch gods of different forms who had already lost consciousness attacked Susu crazily. Seeing this, Susu frowned and swept with origin fluctuations.
The blue wave instantly froze many Abyss Gods in the starry sky. However, accompanied by Benos’s figure, it turned into a humanoid sea monster with a face like blue indigo, hair like sand, and a huge mouth and fangs. These Abyss Gods that had been revived by it also self-destructed right on the heels.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!
However, this time, it wasn’t the appearance of a huge abyssal power, but the birth of a strange curse power that directly appeared out of thin air on Susu’s body, causing pitch-black abyssal patterns to appear on its Starry Sky Slime-like body.
“Ning!” Susu wanted to cleanse, but it realized that cleansing these abyss patterns seemed to be as difficult as completely cleansing the abyss super divine in front of it. Even with unlimited energy, it took a lot of time.
“I need your power.” Just like how Susu could mobilize the power of the starry sky, this abyss super divine seemed to be able to mobilize the power of the starry sky. However, what it mobilized was the power of the abyss on the polluted planet.
In the face of the angry Susu, the abyss super divine, Benos, also began to absorb the abyssal power from the Scarlet Blue Star Domain. The reason why the Abyss Race expanded their territory was also because of this. The wider the abyssal range, the stronger the Abyss Race.
Countless abyssal powers gathered in Beno’s mouth. Its huge abyssal mouth seemed to be connected to another dimension. A purple pillar of light flickered, like a light wave that could destroy stars, and instantly penetrated Susu.
At that moment, Susu couldn’t care less about the Abyss Curse on its body and chose to resist the enemys attack with all its might. Its origin fluctuations also turned into a green and white pillar of light that condensed in front of it
and shot out.
Two light waves intertwined.
Boom!!!
Purification and the abyss wave collided. When one side’s strength was too strong, the restraint relationship weakened the limit. The current situation was that although Susu’s strength countered that of the other party, because its level was weaker than that of the other party, it could only barely resist.
“You’re not my match.” Benos spat out the light of the abyss that polluted the world. In the end, it suppressed Susu’s power. The huge pillar of light instantly shattered Susu’s body.
In the blink of an eye, a new body condensed in the starry sky. This time, Susu turned into the form of a holy maiden of the Blue Sea at the Blue Sea Sprite stage again and appeared behind Benos. Elemental condensed, and the Origin Sword of the Sea of Stars swung down.
Swoosh!
Benos’s body was divided into two. Susu instantly returned to its Slime form, and the abyss patterns on its body became deeper and more corroded.
“Difficult guy.” Benos’s body, which had been divided into two, exploded again. Then, a terrifying scene appeared. Abyss vortex that filled the sky appeared. 10,000, 100,000, 1 billion…
Tens of billions of abyss creatures were summoned by Benos from the abyss vortex in all directions. The lower limit of the strength of these creatures was very low. The weakest was only at the transcendent level, and the strongest was only a demigod, but the number was incomparably terrifying.
These were all creatures polluted by the Abyss Army in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain. Benos had the ability to summon them. At this moment, these creatures had already been corroded by the abyss into forms, souls, spirits, and monsters that could be controlled wantonly.
These demons increased the pressure of Susu’s cleansing again. The starry sky was no longer light. Sensing that this cleansing star spirit was about to reach a dead end, Benos’s expression was calm as he looked in a certain direction.
“Captain Shi Yu.” At this moment, in the silver battleship, surrounded by so many abyss monsters, Yue Lings heart kept accelerating. However, at this moment, she didn’t understand the most. There were clearly many members of the pirate crew, so why did Shi Yu only let that slime go out alone?
Even the Pirate Duck had already returned to the battleship to recuperate.
“Life can only break through bottlenecks when it’s at its limit,” Shi Yu said calmly. He stared at the outside world, stunning Yue Ling. So now, he was…
using the abyss super divine as a sparring partner?
“Of course, if a special situation happens, like now, I’ll send help,” Shi Yu said.
“Master, I’m late.” In the starry sky, Susu faced the abyss super divine and tens of billions of abyss creatures and fell into a huge disadvantage.
However, at this moment, Benos’s reinforcements seemed to be endless. A new abyss vortex appeared, and a perfect divine appeared here.
It was a white dragon. Its appearance looked like a combination of a white bird and a dragon. Its entire body was covered in soft white feathers that were like lightning, and its entire body emitted the light of lightning.
“Kill it.” Benos glanced at its capable general, the White Abyss Lightning Beast. This was the only subordinate under it who didn’t cultivate the power of the abyss and had reached the perfect divine level. It recruited such a subordinate for the current situation.
The strength of the cleansing star spirit was the Starry Sky Contract. However, the restriction of the Starry Sky Contract was that it could only be used on specific lives. In other words, although this cleansing star spirit could pose a certain threat to it, it might not necessarily be able to gain much advantage against other elemental experts of the same level.
The White Abyss Lightning Beast was a special existence it had cultivated. It had the strength of a perfect divine level. Although it wasn’t super divine, it could definitely pose a huge threat to this cleansing star spirit.
Benos only wanted to win as soon as possible and didn’t want to be entangled too much. If it fought this cleansing star spirit itself, it might be an endless, protracted battle. And now, if it could win as soon as possible, it could go and split the spoils of war from the other areas.
“Master, leave it to me.” The White Abyss Lightning Beast locked its gaze on Susu and spread its lightning wings, flying towards Susu. However, just as it was about to do so, with a boom, a Blind Demon Duck stepped out of the battleship again and appeared in the path of the White Abyss Lightning Beast in a flash.
“Quack (Get lost!)!!!”
The White Abyss Lightning Beast was sent flying. Its eyes flickered with lightning as it looked at the World Cleansing Demon Duck that stopped it.
“If you want to stop Big Sister, pass me first.” Duckie completely took off all its eye masks and looked at the White Abyss Lightning Beast calmly.
“You?” Lightning flashed on the White Abyss Lightning Beast’s body again.
“Not because of me, but because I’m in first place on the team!” Duckie held several Time Fruits in both hands and ate them all as if it was taking medicine..

chapters.title: Chapter 1620 - 1620: First Clear of Super Divine (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1620: First Clear of Super Divine (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
After eating the Time Fruit, Duckie’s aura rose steadily and erupted towards that of a perfect divine.
With Duckie’s strength, it clearly couldn’t stop the White Abyss Lightning Beast. However, if it and Baby Ginseng’s power fused into one, it would be a different story.
“Roar!!!” Under the eruption of the dark power on the duck’s body, the level of divine power instantly suppressed the White Abyss Lightning Beast. It even plundered the abyssal power summoned by the abyss super divine for its own use.
Bang!
The White Abyss Lightning Beast was forced back half a step by the duck’s power and revealed a dissatisfied expression.
“Useless thing.” At this moment, seeing that the White Abyss Lightning Beast was stopped by others, the transcendent divine couldn’t help but frown. In the next moment, Susu also launched a counterattack against the current situation.
“Wu ah!!!” Susu’s body kept enlarging, as if it was going all out, staring fiercely at the abyss super divine.
It opened its huge mouth and directly activated Infinite Devour!!
It actually wanted to directly devour the ten billion abyssal creatures on the arena into its body and complete the strongest combination cleansing.
Boom.
The entire starry sky was trembling. The power released by Susu’s endless devouration made Benos’s pupils shrink.
“The power of the worm.” It was incredulous, unable to understand why the cleansing star spirit had mastered the strongest skill of the Space Worm.
Under the terrifying devouring power, regardless of whether it could be digested or not, the abyss creatures that filled the sky instantly flowed into Susu’s mouth under unbelievable power. It was very difficult to resist.
“Wu wu wu wu wu.” The entire starry sky let out a gust-like cry.
If the Space Worm dared to play like this, it would definitely be instantly polluted. However, as a cleansing star spirit, Susu could swallow the enemy to cleanse and digest. Not only could it save energy, but it could also break down the devouring creature into the power it needed to use.
“Damn it, I can’t let it succeed.”
After realizing this, Benos had no choice but to subvert the starry sky and detonate the sacrifice to deepen the curse on Susu.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!
Under the eruption of black fireworks that filled the sky, Susu’s body was blown into pieces, but it was also unstoppable. As it swallowed everything, it launched a counterattack against Binos. Although it didn’t want to swallow these dirty things very much, in order to win, Susu could only use all the methods it could use.
“It’s too scary.” At this moment, if it weren’t for the fact that they were certain that the Environmental Protection Army had yet to launch an all-out attack on the Dark King Army of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, the few scouts of the Environmental Protection Army would definitely think that the battle scene was in front of them.
In the starry sky, the body of the Starry Sky Slime shone and moved quickly. It turned into a cleansing source and kept attacking Benos with the enhancement of the Star Sea Contract. Wherever it passed, countless abyss creatures died.
As the battle went deeper, Susu was still at a disadvantage and had no time to care about the curse on its body. It had collapsed several times, but Benos’s situation wasn’t very good. It didn’t expect this cleansing star spirit to be so stubborn. It didn’t care about its curse at all and attacked it with all its might.
But this way, as long as it stalled for time, this cleansing star spirit would definitely lose.
As expected, as time passed, Susu’s power was still a little inferior. The curse backlash on its body kept intensifying, very affecting the speed at which it mobilized the power of the sea of stars.
“Aba Aba.” In the battleship, the gem cat and the owl hugged each other and looked at the situation outside nervously.
Damn Shi Yu! In such a situation, why was Susu still fighting alone?
Although Susu was very strong, couldn’t it send all its pets to attack together?
“Captain Shi Yu!!” In the captain’s room, Yue Ling was also anxious. “If you don’t send reinforcements, open the door and let me support.”
“This can’t go on.”
“Therefore, there’s no hurry,” Shi Yu said with a deep breath.
It could be said that not only Shi Yu, but anyone who wasn’t from the Dark King Army present also had endless expectations for Susu.
However, it was still too difficult to fight a super divine above his level without reaching the epoch god level. Moreover, it wasn’t an ordinary super divine, but a super divine that had transcended twice.
At this moment, Susu was gradually at a disadvantage, but Benos still maintained a pretty good state.
After watching for a while, Shi Yu understood that he was still in a hurry. Although the owl had predicted that today was the best time to attack, if he waited a little longer and maxed out Susu’s origin fluctuations, the battle situation might reverse.
“Captain Shi Yu!” Yue Ling said anxiously again.
“I understand,” Shi Yu said.
At that moment, not only did Shi Yu’s attitude change, but the super divine that was suppressing Susu also noticed something.
As Susu’s aura became weaker and weaker, he realized that this cleansing star spirit began to be constantly distracted, as if it was unwilling and cared very much about the direction of the battleship.
Coupled with the previous battle, the super divine quickly realized that this cleansing star spirit might be very worried about that battleship because, in the battle just now, it had deliberately stayed away from the battleship.
And now, as it was at a disadvantage, it was worried about the battleship again. There should be other personnel on this battleship, but they weren’t the main combatants.
This cleansing star spirit should be worried that it would be implicated after it lost.
At the thought of this, Benos said, “White… Forget it, I’ll do it myself.”
“Useless thing.” It couldn’t help but be unhappy when it realized that the White Abyss Lightning Beast was still fighting the explosive Pirate Duck. It still lacked powerful subordinates. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have needed to spend much effort to solve today’s battle..

chapters.title: Chapter 1621 - 1621: First Clear of Super Divine (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1621: First Clear of Super Divine (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“You’re worried about that battleship, right?”
At this moment, Benos had already changed several forms. Now, it had turned into the form of a huge dark squid floating in the chaotic turbid mist. Hundreds of dense eyes were incomparably terrifying. With a wave of its tentacles, several meteorites had already been blown up.
This time, it looked at the retreating Susu and didn’t choose to continue chasing. Instead, it looked at Ling and stretched out its huge tentacles, constantly spreading and enlarging as it whipped at the battleship that had been dodging the battle from the beginning to the end.
“Ning!!!! (No!)” Seeing this, Susu’s pupils constricted.
“Ning!! (You’re mine.)” It shouted anxiously and said something that Benos didn’t understand. At this moment, Susu was just about to stop Benos from attacking Ling, causing its head to be snatched away. However, the corrosion of the curse that it had never cared about previously deepened again, making Susu, the cleansing star spirit, almost fall.
This time, the huge power of the abyss corroded over, forcing Susu to quickly divert its energy to cleanse itself.
If it wasn’t cleansed immediately, even it would be infested.
At this moment, a sigh came from the battleship in the face of the attack.
It still failed.
It wasn’t that the hunt for the super divine had failed, but that Susu had failed to hunt the super divine alone.
In the captain’s room, under the anxious expression of Beast Tamer Yue Ling, a summoning array appeared beside Shi Yu. Yue Ling had never seen such a situation because the person who appeared in the summoning array was a person?
Was this a human? She couldn’t say for sure.
In any case, she only saw that, under Shi Yu’s summoning, a creature in platinum armor with a handsome face and black hair fluttered was summoned. It held the shield sword and disappeared from the captain’s room with a leap, appearing in the void.
His appearance attracted the attention of everyone.
“There’s someone else.” It attracted the attention of the Environmental Protection Army’s reconnaissance team. After seeing Susu retreat step by step, their hearts were already in their throats. They even wanted to go out to support, but their rationality made them stop their stupid actions.
With their strength, facing a super divine, they were just tempting fate.
The only thing they could look forward to was that there were other battle powers in the battleship, or that the Environmental Protection Army headquarters had sensed the situation here and sent reinforcements.
As if looking forward to the effect, Beast Shi Yu appeared. Seeing the human who appeared outside, the super divine was stunned, but he still continued to attack.
But in the next moment, a shocking scene appeared. The armored young man outside the battleship only swung his sword with pity in his eyes.
In an instant, an incomparably terrifying sword light instantly severed the super divine whiskers and streaked further away without disappearing. The White Abyss Lightning Beast in the battle with Duckie only felt a light light up in front of it. In the next moment, its body collapsed, turning into a blood mist that filled the sky and was shattered by the sword aura.
Duckie took a step back and exclaimed.
The sword light didn’t stop and was still slashing at Benos’s super divine body, making him shocked and furious. “Super divine!!!” It roared in disbelief.
Why?
Why did a super divine appear in the battleship now?
Moreover, this was definitely not a new super divine. It definitely had the strength of a transcendent 3.
It was stronger than him!
The appearance of Beast Shi Yu directly made Benos’ mentality unbalanced, and it also made the scout of the Environmental Protection Army open his mouth wide. It even shocked the extremely nervous Yue Ling. She looked at the “captain of the Era Pirate Group” , who had been calm the whole time.
At this moment, Shi Yu also stepped out of the battleship and appeared in the starry sky. He appeared on the battleship and looked in Susu’s direction. “Susu, try again next time. I’ll come back first this time. We should go.” His voice was soft as he summoned Susu.
“Ning…” However, the current Susu was extremely stubborn. After slightly cleansing the curse, its eyes were still filled with battle intent, not wanting to give up.
[I… want to defeat it.]
[I… want to obtain the Super Divine Will.]
In Susu’s gaze, the abyss super divine had already been slashed into pieces by Beast Shi Yu’s sword light. Its entire body was covered in blood, and it let out a painful wail. This was the first time the abyss super divine had suffered such a serious injury.
It was mainly because the attack just now was indeed powerful. With the support of the four holy pets, Beast Shi Yu spent a lot of power of faith and displayed a full-strength attack comparable to that of a transcendent 3.
“There’s no hurry,” Shi Yu comforted Susu.
There was still time.
[Ning. (Do you know why I’m paying special attention to you?)]
[Ning. (Because you have a very strong will. This is your talent, your shining point.)]
Susu repeated what Shi Yu had said when it contracted it. It was very indignant.
When it joined the team, it was the only pet with the will of an overlord.
However, in the team, it couldn’t defeat anyone.
Until now, it had never been fated to be the strongest in the team. Now, there was finally something that seemed to be able to use its shining point. If it still failed, Susu couldn’t accept it.
She hoped that, at least at the shining point, she could always obtain Shi Yu’s highest evaluation.
Therefore, she prayed that Shi Yu would take back Beast Shi Yu and let her and the abyss super divine carry out the final battle. She would definitely win!
“You…” Shi Yu shook his head speechlessly on the battleship. He couldn’t do anything to the stubborn Susu.
Susu, Susu, did you make a mistake?
The Super Divine Will required one to have the super will to defeat the Super Divine Will and protect the Sea of Stars, not to obtain its recognition…

chapters.title: Chapter 1622 - 1622: First Clear of Super Divine (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1622: First Clear of Super Divine (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
However, Shi Yu didn’t expect that unknowingly, his position in susu’s heart might even be more important than guarding the Sea of Stars.
Forget it…
“Alright then, but this time, I’ll fight side by side with you,” Shi Yu said. He summoned Beast Shi Yu back and retreated behind him.
At the same time, the phantoms of the heavens that were equivalent to the peak of the divine level appeared behind Shi Yu. Substantial blue mental fluctuations spread throughout Shi Yu’s body, filling him with holy light…
“This can at least be done, right? Susu, let’s enter the Psychic Resonance state.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Susu, who was in the distance, was very pleasantly surprised. It nodded heavily, and its entire body also emitted a blue holy light. It was strengthened by Shi Yu, who was at the peak of the divine level.
At this moment, the power on its body directly surged continuously, attracting Benos’s attention.
“Damn it…” Under the recovery of the abyss super divine, Benos looked crazily at the two new figures that appeared in the direction of the battleship and also at the cleansing star spirit that seemed to have been reborn.
“l want to defeat you.”
“In order to not disappoint the Beast Tamer’s trust.” Susu floated up again.
Moreover, what made Susu feel a little incredulous was that after entering the Psychic Resonance state with Shi Yu, its Star Sea Contract level and its will level had loosened.
“This is…” Shi Yu was also slightly stunned as he sensed the change in Susu.
Although he didn’t know the principle, Shi Yu was pleasantly surprised to feel that Susu had improved.
“Susu, let’s defeat it together. The chances are very high this time. Let’s do our best! ”
“Ning! Susu’s eyes were firm. At this moment, the level of its will finally underwent an extreme sublimation. From the previous overlord will to the
Super Divine Will, an invisible and invincible Super Divine Heart similar to the Heart of God condensed in Susu’s body.
Under the lead of the Super Divine Will, Susu’s Star Sea Contract directly broke through the original restrictions and finally reached transcendence.
In an instant, Susu felt that an incomparably vast starry sky world appeared in front of it. It could mobilize its power as much as it wanted.
“What happened?”
At this moment, the abyss super divine, Benos, was also very confused. He felt that something seemed to have changed in this cleansing star spirit.
Was it because of the enhancement of the Beast Tamer?
He never expected such a strong cleansing star spirit and Beast Tamer. If there was, why didn’t he come out earlier?
At this moment, he found it difficult to understand. But no matter what, the battle couldn’t continue.
This battlefield had to be abandoned.
That human holding the shield sword was too terrifying.
At the thought of this, most of its battle intent had already disappeared. It turned around and ran, planning to meet the other super divine alliances first.
However, Susu’s shocking strength could finally be displayed at this moment. After having the transcendent-level Star Sea Contract, its strength level finally increased to the super divine level!
Moreover, there was a full-strength increase from the Beast Tamer at this moment!
“Clear.” With a thought, a terrifying cleansing light pierced through the abyssal shadow of the entire Scarlet Blue Star Domain, making the pupils of Benos, who wanted to retreat, shrink. He suddenly turned around.
“No, impossible.”
Under its shocked cry, its body, which had already been heavily injured by Beast Shi Yu, suffered another destructive cleansing.
Under the wail of the abyss super divine, its body disappeared bit by bit under the cleansing light.
Under the shocked and stunned gaze of the Environmental Protection Association’s scout, the power of the abyss super divine, Benos, also dissipated bit by bit.
The entire Scarlet Blue Star Domain seemed to be enveloped in endless cleansing light at this moment, and countless abyssal lands were cleansed.
Seeing this scene, Yue Ling, the gem cat, and the owl were stunned.
“He really did it… He.” Yue Ling found it unbelievable.
Were they really pirates??
“Did you see it, did you see it?” On the other side, the gem cat kept pushing the owl.
“l saw it. Susu and Shi Yu are so cool!” the owl shouted.
“I’m f*cking asking if you saw the source of transcendence. Predict it for me!” The gem cat wanted to beat this silly bird up.
“I’m making a wish for the source of transcendence to appear!” the cat immediately said.
Only then did the owl react. It suddenly recalled the mission Shi Yu had arranged for them.
F*ck, I almost forgot.
The owl didn’t expect the source of transcendence to appear this time.
However, it didn’t affect anything.
Since fate had decided that it couldn’t be used, it would use something else.
“Fate hasn’t been decided!!!” Its eyes spun as time flew, trying to affect fate.
At the same time, in the starry sky outside.
“Ah!!!” Under the wail of the abyss super divine, its body disappeared bit by bit. As the Star Sea Contract reached transcendence, Susu could be considered to have come to the same level as the abyss super divine. At the same level, when the cleansing star spirit faced the Abyss Race, it was a fatal blow.
Under endless wails, the abyss super divine body finally disappeared completely.
In its place was a sun-like source of transcendence floating in the starry sky.
Seeing this scene, the scouts of the Environmental Protection Army swallowed their saliva crazily, their eyes filled with shock.
Therefore, what was going on? Before their Environmental Protection Army could attack, an important fortress of the Dark King Army was… destroyed Just like
Now, they really wanted to send this news back. It would definitely shock the entire Environmental Protection Army.
However, at this moment, what made them feel the most ridiculous was the source of transcendence and… the person who was about to obtain it.
Who exactly was this guy?
Why had they never heard of the Era Pirate Group?
Under their gazes.
Shi Yu held the black law code in his hand and walked towards the weak Susu under the protection of Beast Shi Yu. “You’ve done very well.” “Ning! Susu was extremely happy.
This way, she should be the strongest in the team now…
However, when she saw the figure of Beast Shi Yu, Susu’s expression instantly darkened. Ning… She almost forgot about this guy. Damn it.
Shi Yu also smiled and said, “But here’s the problem. Everyone is happy.. Then how should we arrange this source of transcendence?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1623 - 1623: Ownership of the Source of Transcendence (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1623: Ownership of the Source of Transcendence (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
The starry sky was silent as the battleship slowly drove towards Shi Yu.
Shi Yu put away the source of transcendence first and waited for the distribution.
Now, in the accompanying team, there were neither too many nor too few who could use the source of transcendence.
He had to reach the peak of the divine level to refine the source of transcendence.
The standard of a human Beast Tamer was at the tenth level of the divine level.
The standard of a pet was a top-notch divine power level, which was also a top-notch divine.
At the moment, he, the gem cat, and the owl had reached this standard.
Of course, there was also Qi, Ling, Baby Ginseng, and Susu, but the premise was to break the contract first.
There was another way, which was to send it to Dong Huang to help Lin Feng.
As for how to do it, Shi Yu still needed to consider it. After all, Goddess Wa had said that this source of transcendence wasn’t perfect.
“Damn, why are you running so quickly?”
At this moment, Shi Yu, who had put away the source of transcendence, looked in a certain direction.
Not long after the battle began, Ling sensed that someone was secretly observing the battle.
After Ling investigated, it realized that it might be a member of the Environmental Protection Army.
Shi Yu originally wanted to call them over to clean up the battlefield after the battle.
Then, they would take Yue Ling away from the ship.
In the end, just as this battle ended, these guys ran away?
He had defeated a great demon king like the abyss super divine. A heroic figure shouldn’t be so scary, right?
Shi Yu looked at the dense pirate flags on the battleship in silence. “Forget it, let’s leave this place first and return to the Cosmic Sea with them.” “As for this place…” Shi Yu looked at Susu and said, “Are you alright?”
“Ning!” In the starry sky, Susu nodded. Then, with the power of the Star Sea Contract, it separated into countless cleansing clones and flew to various planets.
As for its main body, it entered the battleship with Shi Yu.
At this moment, Ling already had the strength of an epoch god. The threshold of the epoch god’s strength was equivalent to a super divine that exceeded transcendent 1.
However, Susu’s situation was a little biased.
It was an epoch god that had relied on the Star Sea Contract to reach it. The Star Sea Contract could only be used on polluted races under the Dark King, such as the Yun Race, the Qi Race, the Abyss Race, the Flame Race, and the Disaster Race. Therefore, its strength level was even more fluctuating than that of other epoch gods.
If it faced these races, Susu could fight them even if it exceeded transcendent 1 to 3?
However, if it encountered other normal races, Susu, who didn’t have the Star Sea Contract, would still lose even if it faced transcendent 1.
Of course, if Susu ignored the backlash of the Star Sea Contract and forcefully mobilized the power of the Sea of Stars, that would be a different story.
In fact, this was nothing because Shi Yu and the others realized that the so-called contract backlash was nothing more than losing level proficiency… At most, it would drop a little quickly, but it didn’t matter.
Although the skill level had fallen, it was equivalent to forgetting this skill and breaking the contract, Susu, who had skill points, was completely different from other cleansing star spirits.
Other cleansing star spirits might cower because it would take a long, long time to increase a little skill proficiency, but Susu… actually didn’t need to care much.
Now that it had the Super Divine Will, it was easier to add points. If necessary, so be it. So be it. At most, it would add points again.
In addition, Shi Yu felt that susu’s biased situation wouldn’t be long.
After obtaining the Super Divine Will, it meant that her other skills could also successfully be added to the transcendent level and above.
Soon, she should be able to become a very comprehensive epoch god of the skill type.
Now, there was no doubt that the one with the strongest individual battle power in the team was Susu.
“Hehe.” Shi Yu held Susu in his hand and pinched it as he returned to the battleship.
“Everyone, gather in the conference room.”
Shi Yu called out. Soon, everyone ran to the conference room.
In the captain’s room, Ling turned into a figure and looked at Yue Ling, who was limp in the corner, speechless.
Seriously, this small scene was already scary.
“Alright, if everything goes smoothly, the Scarlet Blue Star Domain should be liberated. Go back to your room and rest first. Now’s not the time for you to go back. We’ll enter the Cosmic Sea from here and see if we can hand you over to the Environmental Protection Army.”
“Well, you don’t have to worry about your mother planet. Its clone has already gone everywhere to cleanse. There won’t be any abyss remnants left.”
After saying that, Ling teleported the hesitant Yue Ling back to her room, while Ling herself headed to the conference room.
“l did it!”
“Again!’
“Yay!”
The gem cat and the owl hugged and celebrated in the conference room.
It was unexpected.
A trash transcendent 2 could also drop a source of transcendence.
As expected, their combination with Ling was super invincible.
“Perhaps we can start a business in the future, super divine prayer!’
“There will definitely be many powerful, divine-level people who place the order. I’ve thought about it. For every prayer, I want 648 divine-level energy crystals,” the gem cat said.
“Too little, too little. At least ten sets of 648,” the owl said. “This is the source of transcendence.’
“Don’t look at how smooth our support for Shi Yu is. That’s because ‘the more likely something happens’, the smaller the consumption. Shi Yu’s luck was originally good, so our consumption wasn’t high. But if it were anyone else, that might not be the case. We’ll probably be half dead from the backlash.”
“Then ten sets!”
The two cats openly communicated about killing people..

chapters.title: Chapter 1624 - 1624: Ownership of the Source of Transcendence (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1624: Ownership of the Source of Transcendence (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Quiet, quiet.” Shi Yu sat down and placed the meritorious Susu beside Baby Ginseng.
After Susu broke through, because of the stronger Star Sea Contract, its consumption quickly recovered, but its injuries weren’t that fast. Next, it needed the help of the ginseng baby very much. It probably needed to recuperate for a long time.
“Yi, Yi! However, Baby Ginseng pointed as it assisted, its anger burning.
Because Susu whispered seven words beside it. It directly broke Baby Ginsengs defense.
“Your super divine first clear is gone.”
Baby Ginseng was furious.
At the side, Buggy shook its head. This was the so-called version of a god.
“Firstly, let’s congratulate Susu for breaking through to the epoch god level
after this battle!!!”
After Shi Yu finished speaking with a smile, the pets were overjoyed. Susu had succeeded. This meant that this path was feasible. Before long, it would definitely be their turn!
“Epoch god!” The gem cat was also very eager. This was a legend on World King Planet.
She was indeed right about Shi Yu. He could do something that others couldn’t do so easily.
“Ah.” The owl also looked up at the sky and sighed. Before coming, Shi Yu wanted Susu to challenge the abyss super divine to try to break through. It originally felt that it was ridiculous.
But from the looks of it, he had to learn from that cat in the future and slowly accept Shi Yu’s unscientificness.
“The current problem is the source of transcendence that just popped up,” Shi
Yu said.
“Come and brainstorm. How should we arrange it?”
“Goddess Wa said that the quality of the source of transcendence that erupted from others might be a little poor. I don’t want to fuse it. How can I do it?”
“Ning! (l don’t want it either.)” Susu turned around. She couldn’t accept the source of transcendence that had fused with the abyss super divine! “Senior Lin Fengs breakthrough conditions are met, but I reckon that after hearing the disadvantages of this source of transcendence, he definitely doesn’t want it either, so 1 won’t consider him.’
[Lin Feng: ??? ]
“l wonder if I can fuse it for Beast Shi Yu, but even if I can, it’s a little of a loss. Moreover, my level is already very difficult to support higher-level Beast Shi Yu.”
After Shi Yu’s analysis, Eleven and the others shook their heads repeatedly.
Although they yearned for the super divine, Baby Ginseng, Ling, Qi, and the others didn’t plan to want it.
They had always wanted the best from Shi Yu, and they didn’t want to fuse with a low-quality source of transcendence to affect their future growth.
Most importantly, if it wanted to fuse, it had to break the contract with Shi Yu first.
Although they could contract it again when Shi Yu’s level increased in the future, the pets basically didn’t have this intention.
Unless it was a special situation, the pets didn’t want to break the contract with the Beast Tamer for the sake of strength.
Moreover, the increase in battle power brought by skills fusion, skill deduction, and other functions wasn’t necessarily inferior to a breakthrough. If If the contract was broken, one wouldn’t be able to enjoy these benefits.
Also, Susu’s path had already proven the feasibility of becoming an epoch god. Since there were other methods comparable to super divines, there was no need to pursue a low-quality source of transcendence.
“I want it, I want it!!!” At this moment, Teacher Cat spoke.
“l don’t care if the quality is low.” The cat hit the table. Didn’t Goddess Wa mean that after fusing with this source of transcendence, she might not be able to break through to the cosmic level?
Putting aside whether this saying was supported or not, whether it was a rumor…
It was just a wishing cat. How could it be so ambitious?
Super divine level was already a level it dared to imagine previously.
“Me too…”
“You don’t want to.” The gem cat reprimanded the owl and said, “I came first.”
The owl: ‘
Although the owl wanted to see the gem cat say in despair, “l was the one who…” But it also felt that it was unrealistic.
“From a scientific perspective, with Teacher Yings top-notch divine power, it can indeed refine the source of transcendence…” Ling fell silent after analyzing.
“Emmm.” Shi Yu also looked at the gem cat in silence.
“Really.”
“I’m not purely trying to break through,” the gem cat said. “You can pursue perfection, kid, but how can there be so much perfection to pursue?”
“Can you afford to wait for the transcendent origin that happens once in 100,000 years?”
“Next, let me, a teacher, give you a lesson. I want to use this source of transcendence to study and experiment. With my own experience, I’ll guide your future path!”
“Let me see if 1 can use the wish skill to raise the quality of this source of transcendence to the highest!”
Everyone:
“That works???” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Why not?” The gem cat took out a worn fruit knife from somewhere and placed it on the table.
Then, she said to the fruit knife, “I’ll make a wish. Its quality will increase.”
In the next moment, starlight circled. The worn fruit knife directly turned from an ordinary object to a Level 9 quasi-divine weapon, containing world-shaking golden light.
“Wow.” Chi Tongs eyes lit up.
Sure, sure.
“Look, it’s the same principle. At most, it’s a little difficult to make a wish with the source of transcendence, but as long as I collect enough Wish Star inheritance, it shouldn’t be a problem for me to reach the super divine level, right??”
“This way, I can also try to make a wish to increase the quality of the low-quality source of transcendence that erupts in the future.”
“In essence, all the sources of transcendence are naturally condensed from the universe at the start. It’s only after they’re fused that their quality gradually decreases. My wish only allows them to return to their original quality. This is very scientific..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1625 - 1625: Ownership of the Source of Transcendence (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1625: Ownership of the Source of Transcendence (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu and the others: “?”
“From a scientific perspective, it’s very scientific,” Ling said.
“Look, look! ! ”
“Why does that make sense?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
“Brilliant, we have another business.” The owl looked at the cat. It finally knew why the Star Prayer Race was exterminated before the Astrologer Race was exterminated. Their ability was too shameless.
“Very good, then I’ll leave this source of transcendence to you to study,” Shi Yu said. “Teacher Cat, I’ll leave it to you.”
“Yay! ! ! ” The gem cat was extremely excited.
Sigh~Who would have thought that a super divine expert would actually appear in a small Ancient Capital University? The gem cat thought narcissistically.
At the edge of the Cosmic Sea, Void Battlefield, Environmental Protection Army encampment.
The Environmental Protection Army was the general name of the Cosmic Sea Army that fought against the pollution land. Most of the members came from the various planets’ Environmental Protection Associations. Even the temporary soldiers from various planets and the various domains of the World King Planet were also called the Environmental Protection Army.
Of course, apart from the Environmental Protection Army, there were also many mercenaries. The number of mercenaries from the cosmic overlord army was the highest.
At this moment, an aircraft that had gone to the Scarlet Blue Star Domain to investigate quickly returned to the Environmental Protection Army. This was the first to return from the reconnaissance team sent by the Environmental Protection Army.
“Emergency information.” Just as this reconnaissance team approached the
Void Battlefield, they were connected to the internal network of the
Environmental Protection Army. After both parties confirmed their identities, they quickly communicated.
In the Environmental Protection Army’s intelligence center, a white-haired and white-eyed woman immediately said, “Please go ahead.”
“In the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, the super divine life form of the Abyss Race, Benos, has already fallen.”
“A cosmic pirate named the Era Pirate Group invaded Benos’s headquarters.
Both parties fought fiercely, and soon, Benos was destroyed!”
Intelligence personnel: “?”
“What???”
The staff member who was waiting for information suddenly widened her eyes. As she exclaimed, many intelligence personnel joined in the communication with the reconnaissance team and eavesdropped together.
“Video!”
The staff’s breathing immediately quickened. Although she felt that this team seemed to have been corroded by the abyss and was talking nonsense, the process still had to be carried out.
“It’s already been transmitted, hasn’t it been transmitted yet?”
“Yes.” Just as the other party finished speaking, a bunch of staff from the intelligence center began to differentiate the authenticity of the video sent by the other party.
The video was very blurry, and the recording was also intermittent. Many key scenes were missing. From the looks of it, they were very miserable on the battlefield. However, one could vaguely see a slime the color of the starry sky fighting the abyss super divine, Benos.
The staff immediately connected to the database and analyzed the identity of this so-called Era Pirate Group. With this analysis, everyone’s pupils constricted.
“No, bad news.” At this moment, a panicked voice came from the reconnaissance team. “This pirate crew appeared behind us…”
“They… followed!”
“Calm down first!” The staff member didn’t believe it herself and said, “This pirate crew might not be the enemy. According to the identity analysis, the life form that fought Benos is very likely to be second place in the last World King Planet’s God Sealing Battle, the vice president of the Blue Wave Branch of the World King Planet’s Environmental Protection Association, cleansing star spirit Susu.”
“And the last human to appear is this batch’s King of Gods, its Beast Tamer, shi Yu. t
After the staff finished speaking, she felt that it was ridiculous. The other party also fell silent.
Everyone found it unbelievable.
But according to the scene transmitted, this seemed to be true.
“Inform Lord Bing Ling…”
As they muttered, in the deepest part of the Void Battlefield, in a prep room, the vice president or the Environmental protection Association, Bing Ling, and the president of the Environmental Protection Association, Bing Ling, stopped meditating at the same time.
The names of the president and vice president of the Environmental Protection Association were both called Bing Ling. Both parties had a contractual relationship. Among them, the vice president was a human, and the president was an ice-element Cleansing Star Spirit Race. They had both reached the super divine level.
The human Bing Ling looked like a mature older sister with a cold aura. As for the Cleansing Star Spirit Race Bing Ling, it looked like an ice maiden made of ice crystals. Both parties were telepathically connected. Many higher-ups of the Environmental Protection Army basically regarded them as one person.
At this moment, after the human Bing Ling received the news of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, her expression was incredulous.
“When did he run to the Contaminated Land?” Bing Lings tone was shocked.
“Moreover, it actually… This is impossible.”
Perhaps no one in the Environmental Protection Association was more familiar with Shi Yu and Susu than Bing Ling. Ever since Shi Yu joined the
Environmental Protection Association, she had been paying attention to Shi Yu’s growth.
Shi Yu had displayed shocking potential. Bing Ling had been looking forward to Susu growing to the divine level. Just a while ago, Shi Yu had successfully broken through to the divine level. This also meant that Susu had definitely broken through too.
At this moment, Bing Ling was originally prepared to personally nurture Shi Yu and Susu, but unfortunately, the battle ahead was suddenly urgent, forcing her to come to the Void Battlefield to preside over it.
However, no matter how Bing Ling thought about it, she didn’t expect that while she was presiding over the Void Battlefield, Shi Yu and Susu would actually head to the Contaminated Land without anyone noticing. They came to the headquarters of an abyss super divine and destroyed this abyss super divine.
“The fifth stage of the Starry Sky Contract…” When the human Bing Ling was shocked, the Ioli Bing Lings gaze was calm, but her tone wasn’t calm.
“It’s already the epoch god. Benos won’t be their match..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1626 - 1626: Ownership of the Source of Transcendence (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1626 - 1626: Ownership of the Source of Transcendence (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“But.” The human Bing Ling still couldn’t understand why Susu, who was still a demigod a year ago, had already reached the peak of the divine level a year later, the epoch god.
Epoch god… wasn’t that easy to reach.
They were all a group of monsters.
Even the strongest cleansing star spirit now, the person beside her, was only a perfect divine when it broke through back then.
Although Benos was a weaker existence among the 10 super divines, it was still at transcendent 2. Shi Yu and Susu’s growth   speed was a little too terrifying.
Was Blue Planet going to have a new 12th and 13th super divine?
“Also, what the video didn’t record is that in a certain direction, a sword light seems to have heavily injured Benos. Who is it? Who’s the human following beside Shi Yu? Who released the sword aura? That person?”
“Let’s not care so much first. There’s a change in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain. We have to start moving too,” the Ioli Bing Ling said.
“But before that, let’s meet this Shi Yu.’
The attention of the 10 super divines of the Dark King Army was all on the Environmental Protection Army in the Void Battlefield. It was probably impossible for them to imagine that someone would ambush from the back and easily destroy a super divine.
“Why are you guys running so quickly?” At the same time, Shi Yu and the others also stopped the reconnaissance team.
The four guys of the reconnaissance team were forced to leave the aircraft and fly in the starry sky. They looked at Shi Yu standing on the battleship in a daze.
There were two young men in cleansing clothes, a man and a woman, and two pets. One was a plant life form, the Heart Cleansing Lotus Demon, and the other was an abyss life form, the Dark Abyss Jellyfish.
Although they had never paid attention to the God Sealing Battle on the World King Planet all these years, they also knew about the God Sealing Battle.
The information center of the Environmental Protection Army told them… that the owner of this pirate crew was a Beast Tamer from the World King Planet? The vice president of the Environmental Protection Association branch? One of their own? Moreover, he was the winner of the God Sealing Battle?
Most importantly, he was from the previous batch?
What a joke. In the previous batch, didn’t that mean that these people were only quasi-divine a year ago? What kind of person could go from quasi-divine to super divine battle power in a year?
“Sir… are you the King of Gods, Shi Yu?” One of the short-haired young men in a cleansing suit stuttered as he asked Shi Yu.
“Eh, don’t you recognize me? Then why are you running?” Shi Yu said.
The young man smiled bitterly and said, “l just contacted the Environmental
Protection Army headquarters and recognized Sir Shi Yu…”
“In short, the Void Battlefield is nearby, right?” Shi Yu looked ahead and said,
“Just nice, help me with something.”
“l just recruited a newbie for the Environmental Protection Army. Help me go through the procedures.”
“By the way, the other party previously worked in the Abyss Army…”
The two of them: ???
“But there’s no need to worry about his identity. I can help guarantee that the other party is a descendant of the royal family of Divine Planet. After his mother planet was invaded, he was lucky enough to escape. Then, in order to take revenge, he joined the Abyss Army and searched for an opportunity.”
“No problem…” The woman in the cleansing suit nodded. If Shi Yu vouched for her, there shouldn’t be a problem, right?
At this moment, under Shi Yu’s call, Ling also teleported Yue Ling out. At this moment, when it saw the Environmental Protection Army personnel in cleansing clothes, Yue Ling was slightly stunned.
“Little girl, they’re from the Environmental Protection Army. Didn’t you say previously that you wanted to join the Environmental Protection Army? I’ll get them to bring you to do the procedures.”
“This…” Yue Ling was completely stunned. She didn’t understand why a big pirate like Shi Yu knew the Environmental Protection Army.
“Huh?” At this moment, after Shi Yu arranged Yue Lings matter, he suddenly looked at a certain place in the starry sky.
As a spatial crack appeared, two figures stepped on the frost in the air and walked over step by step, descending in front of Shi Yu and the others.
Seeing these two people, the reconnaissance team was stunned. Then, they immediately said, “Lord Bing Ling!’
“Bing Ling…” Shi Yu looked at the two people who were like sisters, emitting a powerful super divine aura. He also took a deep breath and understood the other party’s identity.
They were the Bing Ling Gods.
He didn’t expect to see them on such an occasion.
Sigh… He originally wanted to cozy up to someone powerful, but in the blink of an eye, he was a powerful figure. He was so helpless~
Of course, the Bing Ling of the Environmental Protection Association was still strong. One person might not be strong, but with the combination of both parties, they basically had strength close to the peak of the super divine level.
“Shi Yu, we finally meet.” The human Bing Ling looked at Shi Yu and said, “Did you kill Benos?”
She wanted to confirm again.
“Yes, I’ve already killed it. I’ve also eliminated most of the abyssal power in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain.’
“Alright, I’ll help you count this battle merit. The situation is tense now. 1 only have one last question.”
“Can you still fight?”
Seeing Shi Yu’s powerful strength, Bing Ling wanted to invite Shi Yu to participate in the next battle.
However, Shi Yu shook his head and said, “Not in the short term. Susu is injured and needs to recuperate.”
As for Beast Shi Yu… Shi Yu didn’t want to spend the power of faith to fight. Even if he had battle merits, it was too much of a loss.
To be honest… there wasn’t much strength left in the Four Holy Ruins. He had to use it sparingly.
It was really as Susu said. If this thing was in their hands… it would disappear very quickly.
The human Bing Ling nodded slightly and said, “Alright, in the Void
Battlefield, there’s a permanent teleportation array of the World King Planet. You guys should return to the World King Planet to rest well first. When we return, we’ll talk about other things related to the cleansing star spirit.”
“Little brats, you’re not bad. After this battle, I’ll personally give you a gift.” At this moment, the Ioli Bing Ling, the president of the Environmental Protection Association, also said in admiration.
At this moment, Yue Ling was still looking at them in shock. In her impression, these two people seemed to be the supreme commanders of the Environmental Protection Army…
Therefore, who exactly was Shi Yu?
*•
Next, Shi Yu wasn’t prepared to continue fighting anyway. He was too tired. He planned to exchange for the battle merits promised by Bing Ling first. With the help of Bing Ling, they directly arrived at the Environmental Protection Army headquarters of the Void Battlefield.
However, just as he stepped in, Shi Yu calculated the time and suddenly realized something.
“Ling, is the new God Sealing Battle on the World King Planet about to begin? I wonder how Sister Empress, Senior Lu, and the others are cultivating in the time mystic realm created by Emperor Shi.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1627 - 1627: New God Sealing (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1627 - 1627: New God Sealing (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios       Editor: Atlas Studios
“Yes.
In the face of Shi Yu’s question, Ling quickly replied.
“So fast,” Shi Yu sighed.
So much time had passed since their championship of the God Sealing Battle.
Without them, Zavay, Ming Gu, the son of the Demon Emperor, and the others should participate again, right?
However, although they were gone, these veteran contestants were very likely to face a new batch of monsters…
Shi Yu was amused.
“Interesting.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I reckon it’s very difficult for our battle merits to be settled before their battle ends. Let’s not wait anymore.”
“Let’s follow what God Bing Ling said first and go back to World King Planet to rest. We can see the progress of the God Sealing Battle.”
“Alright,” Ling said.
After arriving at the Void Battlefield, not long after, Shi Yu chose to leave. He returned to the World King Planet through the permanent teleportation array of the Void Battlefield.
World King Planet.
Floating Realm.
Ever since the Space Emperor advanced to super divine, the first thing he did was apply to upgrade the Floating Realm to a first-level realm.
However, the Space Emperor didn’t plan to change and expand his territory.
In this situation, if he wanted to upgrade the environment of the Floating Realm, he needed the realm lord committee to transplant the energy mineral vein and the Dragon Vein of Luck to improve the environment of the Floating Realm.
After some torment, the appearance of the Floating Realm had already improved slightly.
Apart from that, official organizations like the Starry Sky Myriad Races Committee, the World King Planet Planet Plant Association, the Space Disaster Research Institute, and the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association also settled in the Floating Realm one after another.
It could be said that the current Floating Realm also had the ability to open a second world like Blue Wave, Dong Xuan, and the Central Realm.
The Beast Tamers of the Floating Realm no longer had to run to other first-level realms to register in order to participate in the God Sealing Battle.
They could register and participate at their homes.
When the new God Sealing Battle began, apart from the Beast Tamers of the Floating Realm, a few Beast Tamers from the Dong Huang Realm would also choose to register here.
They were Emperor Dong Huang, the Empress, the Dragon Emperor, Lu Qingyi, and the others.
Under normal circumstances, no matter how talented and lucky they were, it would take years for them to compete with the geniuses of the cosmic races from the backward version of Blue Planet to enter World King Planet.
However, in Emperor Shi’s time mystic realm and after plundering the Assassin Planet, these people walked out of Blue Planet under the full nurturing of more than ten super divine- level experts in the three first-level realms, a high-level planet, and improved quickly.
Compared to the outside world, it didn’t take long for him to have absolute strength to fight for supremacy in the quasi-divine domain.
