Today happened to be two days before the start of the new God Sealing Battle.
After Shi Yu returned from the Void Battlefield, he arrived at the Central Realm and learned the competition time. Without a word, he directly teleported back to the Dong Huang Realm through Buggy’s magnetic skill without even using the teleportation array.
Dong Huang Realm, the glorious ancient city in the east, Dong Huang City. At this moment, there were already many people here. The streets and alleys were very lively. Brand shops from the surrounding realms had all joined.
In a high-end dessert shop by the roadside, a woman with long hair and a blue sleeveless shirt was sitting alone at the table, waiting for delicacies.
“Guest, your clear spring is flowing and the starry sky is filled with flavors.” A waiter girl in an apron served the food.
“Thank you.” Lu Qingyi looked at the drinks that emitted a clear taste and the tempting desserts and smiled. “Excuse me, can you explain these food materials and allusions to me?”
“No problem!” The green-haired waiter girl smiled and said, “This little store comes from the Blue Wave World. All the ingredients chosen here are transported from the Blue Wave World. Ahem, ahem, because of this, they’re all a little expensive, so there are a few customers, but I guarantee that it’s definitely worth it. Among them, this cup of clear spring water flows…”
In the face of the green-haired girl’s introduction, Lu Qingyi kept nodding. After the green-haired girl finished introducing with a dry mouth, she couldn’t help but ask curiously, “Guest, are you also here in the Dong Huang Realm to seek opportunities?”
The Dong Huang Realm belonged to the Blue Planet. There were many opportunities, and talents were in short supply in all walks of life. Recently, too many people had surged in here. Not to mention quasi-divines, there were many divine-levels. The waiter girl couldn’t help but ask curiously when she saw that Lu Qingyi’s aura was extraordinary and she was very beautiful.
“More or less.” Lu Qingyi took a bite of the dessert and her smile was a little sweet. As expected, after staying in the Assassin Prison for a long time, compared to the skill of cleansing killing intent and murderous aura, it was better to solve it through dessert. It was more healing to the heart.
“Sister, all the best. You’re so beautiful, you can definitely do it,” the waiter girl encouraged.
At this moment, the door of the dessert store was pushed open. The waiter girl immediately looked over and said, “Welcome, Uh…”
She was slightly stunned as she looked at the young man who entered. It was a young man in a black and white battle suit with a sleepy bear on his shoulder.
After he entered, he said, “Sorry to disturb you, I’m looking for someone.
Senior Lu, you’re here.”
“Shi, Shi, Shi…” The waiter girl hugged the tray and looked at Shi Yu in shock.
The realm lord of the Dong Huang Realm, the King of Gods, the son of the Blue Planet, the immoral Shi Yu!
It was impossible for the people who had come to the Dong Huang Realm to not know about the realm lord of the Dong Huang Realm, Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s experience was really too legendary. Just as he arrived at World King Planet, he turned the God Sealing Battle upside down.
Then, under the protection of a bunch of big shots, they killed their way into the Assassin Planet and destroyed the number one assassin organization in the universe..

chapters.title: Chapter 1628 - 1628: New God Sealing (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1628 - 1628: New God Sealing (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
It even made a saying spread on the World King Planet that it was better to provoke super divines than Shi Yu.
“Eh!!” At this moment, Lu Qingyi also turned around in surprise and looked at Shi Yu. She said in surprise, “Why are you here? You’re done cultivating?”
“Yeah.” Shi Yu walked forward and sat opposite her. He looked at the waiter and said, “Please help me get that blue drink too.”
“Yes!” The waiter girl ran back in panic, still shocked. Wait a minute, that beautiful customer actually knew the King of Gods, Shi Yu?
Moreover, what did Shi Yu call the other party just now… Senior?
What level of person was Shi Yu l s senior? She actually encouraged him just now.
Heavens, the Dong Huang Realm was indeed filled with crouching tigers and hidden dragons. Any random guest might have a big background.
“Senior, you’re alone? Where’s Senior Empress and the others?” Shi Yu asked.
“They’re still in the time mystic realm… They’re all a group of cultivation fanatics. They plan to come out on the last day of the God Sealing Battle registration…” Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “Because I wanted to relax, I came out first. Hehe. t
“You… feel that you will still lose to the three emperors in the God Sealing Battle,” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
“Not necessarily!” Lu Qingyi said. “I gained a lot in the Assassin Prison.”
“Are you still used to it?” Shi Yu asked with concern. It wasn’t easy to plunder that talent and skill and perfectly match, right?
“It’s alright. Actually, before Grandpa recommended me to become an archeologist, I had another dream when I was young, which was to become a handsome killer,” Lu Qingyi said seriously.
Shi Yu was confused.
He suspected that Senior was implying something about him!
He would remember this.
“It’s good that you can adapt.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched.
“I’ll stay on the World King Planet during this period of time. It depends on your performance.” Now that Susu had advanced to the epoch god level, Shi Yu planned to pull its origin fluctuations to transcendence first.
It shouldn’t take long.
At that time, with the support of the origin fluctuations, he could also quickly nurture Eleven and the others to perfect divines.
Right on the heels of that, he could consider how to help them cultivate the Super Divine Will.
“Realm lord Shi Yu, your clear spring is flowing.” Soon, the drink Shi Yu ordered was served. After Shi Yu took a sip, he nodded and said, “Not bad, it’s very delicious.”
“Really?” The waiter was pleasantly surprised.
“Of course…
“Thank you for your praise. We’ll continue to work hard.” The waiter girl was very satisfied. “By the vvay, can I treat you to this meal…”
“I’m a waiter and the owner of this store.’
“Are you sure? My dozen or so pets haven’t eaten…” Shi Yu looked at the young girl.
Of course, she looked young, but perhaps she could be his mother at this age.
No… He was already an ancient from the last era. Even World King Planet wasn’t as old as him.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Oh no, he couldn’t casually acknowledge a mother in the future.
The oldest was actually him.
“Emmm, I was just kidding. You don’t have to take it seriously, realm lord Shi Yu.” The girl fled in a sorry state.
Lu Qingyi turned around and smiled. “Eh, isn’t Teacher Ying with you?” “She,” Shi Yu said. “She went to study and refine the source of transcendence.”
“Oh…” Lu Qingyi nodded. Then, she suddenly frowned and sensed that something was wrong. “Refining the source of transcendence?”
“Well, we set off from Blue Planet a few months ago and walked around the universe. We encountered an abyss super divine and killed it. It happened to drop a source of transcendence.”
“This news will probably take a while to be sent back to World King Planet from the Void Battlefield…
“At the moment, Teacher Cat is the most suitable to fuse in the team. Well, she was already a top-notch divine previously. After this fusion, she should be a super divine.”
Lu Qingyi: “?”
“Huh?” She was stunned.
“These are all small matters. Eat first. I’ll talk to you about interesting things like Goddess Wa’s Ruins later.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Well, and although there might not be enough time, do you want Eleven and the others to help your pet undergo special training in the next two days?”
Ruins! Special training!
“Alright.”
Lu Qingyi nodded.
In the Floating Realm, Shi Yu’s super luxurious manor was even larger than the realm lord temple.
After learning that Shi Yu had returned, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng naturally came.
The two of them didn’t expect Shi Yu to return in such a short period of time.
However, when the Space Emperor and Lin Feng learned that Shi Yu had successfully hunted a super divine and even dropped the source of transcendence, they were shocked for ten thousand years.
“You, this, how is this possible?” The Space Emperor and Lin Feng couldn’t understand.
Previously, Shi Yu had just broken through and already had the strength to defeat a top-notch divine. It was already ridiculous.
Considering the enhancement of the Four Holy Ruins, it was understandable. But why could he fight a super divine head-on in such a short period of time?
“The Four Holy Ruins is exciting, and in addition, the cleansing star spirit race counters the abyss type.” Shi Yu laughed and said, “It’s not that difficult. It’s mainly because the other party underestimated the enemy.”
The two of them were silent.
“In that case, it won’t be long before you can advance to super divine??” Lin Feng said enviously.
Including the Space-time emperors and Shi Yu, this time, there were only three human super divines in the Blue Planet.
Considering that there were still three ancient emperors chasing after him, he felt a sense of danger..

chapters.title: Chapter 1629 - 1629: New God Sealing (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1629 - 1629: New God Sealing (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
He was now at the peak of the divine level. At that time, Emperor Wu, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor would have their own opportunities to advance, but he had yet to advance!
That would be a tragedy.
“No, I didn’t choose to fuse it myself. Instead, I gave the source of transcendence to Teacher Ying.” Emperor Kong and Lin Feng: ???
What?
Wasn’t this crazy…
No, considering that the cat had the inheritance of the Star Prayer Race now, it wasn’t a waste.
“The reason why I did this is because I saw Goddess Wa’s clone and obtained some things from her to break through to the cosmic level.” Shi Yu was right on the heels of that and said something that shocked the Space Emperor and Lin Feng.
Right on the heels of that, Shi Yu told them about his encounter with Goddess Wa in the ruins of Earth.
After hearing that Goddess Wa had the strength of a peak super divine and said that there might be no hope for the cosmic level of the source of transcendence that had been fused by others, the Space Emperor directly couldn’t hold it in anymore.
“Low quality… This.”
“It’s alright… I like it when others use it. I originally had no hope of reaching the cosmos level. After all, too many monsters hundreds or thousands of times more talented than me have fallen on this path.” He forcefully comforted himself.
“Hahaha, you like things that have been used by others. What’s the difference between you and that Wang thief… Wait a minute, you’re Wang Kong. That’s fine,” Lin Feng said.
“Get lost!” The Space Emperor was furious.
“l think Senior Lin Feng definitely despises the low quality source of transcendence, so he let Teacher Ying study it first. After experimenting, her wish power seems to have the ability to increase the quality of the source of transcendence.’
“Now, because she fused with the third Wish Star inheritance, she has top-notch divine power and is also qualified to refine the source of transcendence.’
“Perhaps after reaching her peak, she can also help others make up for their incomplete foundation.”
Lin Feng cried. Firstly, he had never said that he despised low-quality source of transcendence.
However, when they heard Shi Yu say that the Star Prayer Race might be able to increase the quality of the source of transcendence, their eyes couldn’t help but light up.
In fact, even Shi Yu himself didn’t expect the Star Prayer Race to have this power. The source of transcendence was naturally condensed by the universe. The power of the Star Prayer Race relied on praying to the cosmic stars to obtain power of faith. In essence, it seemed to be really from the same source.
Even Susu couldn’t do this. Its source of transcendence fluctuations couldn’t let the source of transcendence return to its original appearance. Perhaps this was the incompatibility of the power system.
In short, it wasn’t a loss to give it to the cat. It wasn’t a waste.
“So your next idea is to continue to the territory of the cosmic overlord army and help her find the Wish Star inheritance, right?” the Space Emperor said.
“That’s right. Goddess Wa seems to be old friends with the cosmic overlord. This way, it’s much safer to go to the territory of the cosmic overlord army.” Shi Yu nodded.
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng looked at each other. They kept feeling that even after coming to the starry sky for hundreds of years, their lives weren’t as exciting as Shi Yu’s year.
“By the way, where’s Senior Emperor Shi?” Shi Yu asked.
“Emperor Shi… I wonder where he went.”
“Let’s pay attention to the God Sealing Battle first,” the Space Emperor said. “l wonder how far Senior Emperor Wu and the others have reached.”
Lin Feng said, “l feel that it can definitely be done. I don’t understand Emperor Wu and the others, but the little fish, who hasn’t entered the time mystic realm, has been by my side for not too long. It has reached the level of ten thousand years before the God-sealing Battle after spending such a short time with me. Senior Emperor Wu and the others are definitely not bad.”
Little Fish… Fish Convergence… Tyrannical Sea Legend! It should be
Tyrannical Sea Legendary now.
“There’s definitely some in the top 10. After all, they’re equivalent to 10 years of bitter cultivation in the time mystic realm! ! ”
“Let’s wait and see. The top 10 should still be stable.” Shi Yu smiled. At least, he already knew part of Senior Lu’s strength.
Apart from Zavay, Ming Gu, and the others, there shouldn’t be many who could pose a threat to them.
Soon.
As the registration for the God Sealing Battle was about to end, Emperor Wu and the others also broke out of seclusion. They first went to register before being called over by Shi Yu to stay.
At night, Emperor Wu, the Empress, the Dragon Emperor, the Dragon God, Lu Qingyi, Shi Yu, and the others gathered and had a barbecue gathering.
Compared to the previous batch, many more people signed up for this God Sealing Battle. The number of registrations exceeded 10 million.
Perhaps it was because the last God Sealing Battle was too lively, making a bunch of quasi divines’ hearts itch, so they chose to go out and participate. “My opponent’s historical ranking isn’t very high,” the Dragon God said.
This year, she also chose to participate.
The rise of the Blue Planet bloodline allowed her to obtain more cultivation resources.
Although her strength progress might not be inferior to the Empress and the others, she wouldn’t fall behind too much.
“Same,” the Dragon Emperor said. “Ah Tian, do you want to compete to see whose final ranking is higher?”
The Dragon God was speechless. “Boring.”
“It’s indeed boring!” Lu Qingyi said. This was it. The Dragon Emperor had revived. Lu Qingyi, who had eaten a lot of gossip previously, originally thought that he and the Dragon God could make any progress, but in the end, this was it.
She sighed slightly at the side.
As the first round of matches that night was announced, Shi Yu and the others gathered and communicated with each other.
“Are they all so ‘lucky?” Emperor Wu said. “My opponents are also very weak.”
“Mine too.” Empress Huang Xi looked at her matching results and shook her head.
Her opponent was also a guy millions away.
“Wow.” However, Chi Tong cried out in shock from behind the Empress.
“Their opponent’s ranking isn’t high because it’s really not high. Yours is different,” Chi Tong said. “The son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang. His father is a super divine-level expert. He was eliminated in the second round last year because he encountered me..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1630 - 1630: New God Sealing (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1630 - 1630: New God Sealing (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“What a coincidence. He’s here again this year. Moreover, he encountered you in the first round.’
“What fate.’
“Oh?” Chi Tongs words attracted everyone’s attention. Son of a super divine?
There was such a contestant.
Emperor Wu and the others looked at the Empress in unison and felt envious.
Compared to the seemingly weak opponents they encountered, the Empress’s opponents looked more comfortable fighting.
“Is that so?” Huang Xi nodded and said, “But no matter who it is, I’ll defeat them too.’
“Enemies are indeed bound to meet on a narrow road,” Shi Yu said as he ate a lamb skewer.
“Senior Huang Xi’s luck is similar to when we participated. We both encountered powerful contestants a few rounds in advance.”
“Isn’t that pretty good?” Emperor Wu said. “Haha, we’ll meet sooner or later anyway.”
“l understand. Ling, help Senior Emperor Wu apply a reverse blessing wind tomorrow and make Senior Emperor Wu’s luck worse. Perhaps he can encounter Zavay and Ming Gu in the second round.”
“Perhaps we’ll encounter Senior Dragon Emperor and the others in advance.”
Ling: “Roger.”
Emperor Wu: “?”
The Dragon Emperor, who was eating barbecue.
“There’s no need,” he said.
For life forms at Shi Yu and the others’ level, unless they used the Cultivation Fruit, sleeping was no longer a necessary activity.
Therefore, after Shi Yu finished eating, he immediately pulled Eleven and the others to a new round of points.
However, at this moment, in another realm, a contestant fell into deep thought.
This person was the son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang.
Although he lost the last God Sealing Battle, because his opponent, Chi Tong, was too monstrous, he didn’t receive much criticism from his father.
His father just wanted him to work hard next time.
Therefore, this year, the son of the Demon Emperor came again.
However, now, when this noble son looked at his opponent’s profile picture, he only felt deep confusion.
He took out contestant Chi Tongs profile picture from last year and compared it. Then, he carefully observed Empress Huang Xi’s profile picture. In the end, he was stunned.
Even if it wasn’t exactly identical, it was 99% similar. The only difference was its aura!!
What was going on?
“I don’t understand.” The son of the Demon Emperor was shocked. Don’t tell him that Chi Tong still had a sister.
With Chi Tongs exaggerated strength, how could her sister be weak?
When the new God Sealing Battle began, those contestants were still the ones who received the most attention…
Zavay, Ming Gu… Even the super dark horse of the previous batch and the unlucky son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang.
Therefore, apart from Tian Shang himself, many people were paying attention to his match results. Then, like Tian Shang, the people who paid attention fell into deep thought.
Right on the heels of that, it was to investigate crazily who this Huang Xi was.
As for where to investigate, it was naturally from the Dong Huang Realm, the Floating Realm, and other places that were closely related to Shi Yu.
This investigation was impressive.
Someone dug out the story Shi Yu told when the Blue Planet super divine went to assassinate the Assassin Planet.
Huang Xi, the third legendary emperor of the Dong Huang Dynasty, was the only female emperor. She was a hybrid of a human and a Phoenix and had peerless talent. She was known as the strongest female Beast Tamer in Dong Huang.
Tian Shang clearly quickly found this information, but not only did his shocked mood not ease, but he also felt that it was even more ridiculous.
What???
Dong Huangs third emperor?
Why was she still alive?
When Shi Yu told the story, although he didn’t say that the Empress and the others had already died, the dynasty had changed so frequently, the totem battle had happened so tragically, and the story of the rise of the new emperor was so complicated. Everyone had already subconsciously judged that the Empress and the others had already fallen.
However, the current situation caught them off guard.
Some people also searched Wu Dong, Long Qingyun, and the others. This search made them even more silent.
Because Emperor Dong Huang, the Empress, and the Dragon Emperor had all come to participate. This was ridiculous!
Their opponents were stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 1631 - 1631: World King Planet Quake (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1631 - 1631: World King Planet Quake (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
That night, this was what the trending headlines were talking about. There were even people kneeling before the Exposing King to expose the news and ask what was going on. Even if it was a rumor, the crowd wanted to watch the show too much.
However, the Exposing King, Patriarch Tu Tu, who had reached a cooperation agreement with Blue Planet, didn’t dare to continue blowing up.
It would be bad if the Beast Tamers of the Blue Planet were unhappy.
A long time ago, it seemed to have exposed the matter of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng. Although it didn’t know if what it had predicted was accurate, the other party seemed to be very unhappy.
However, Patriarch Tu Tu felt that the Space Emperor and Lin Feng could get along!
At least it wasn’t wanted like the others.
The next day.
Everyone paid attention to the battle between Huang Xi and the son of the Demon Emperor, wanting to verify Huang Xi’s true identity.
In the winter snow arena, a noble son with silver hair and golden eyes holding a demon saber looked at Empress Huang Xi opposite him with a serious expression.
“You’re Dong Huangs third empress, Empress Huang Xi.”
Opposite him, Huang Xi was expressionless. “So what if I am?”
“l didn’t expect you to still be alive,” the son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, said. “What’s your relationship with Chi Tong?” This was also what everyone wanted to know.
Why did the Empress and Chi Tong look the same?
The Empress was a human, and Chi Tong was a heroic spirit. What complicated relationship was there?
In addition to hybrids…
Everyone smelled gossip.
They really wanted to know!
[Boss Tian Shang, continue asking. Ask.]
[Big boss Tian Shang, please, ask clearly. I’m curious.]
The audience in the live-stream flooded the screen crazily.
“In terms of age, you’re older. Could it be…” The Demon Emperor’s son had just finished speaking.
In the next moment, the Empress opposite directly attacked!
Fusion Talent, Phoenix Strengthening, and Bloodline Strengthening were all activated.
Among them, the Fusion Talent learned from Emperor Wu. Because she had the phoenix bloodline, she could quickly fuse with the nine phoenix pets. In addition to her Bloodline Strengthening talent, Huang Xi’s aura instantly reached a terrifying level.
Of course, most importantly, the legendary emperors who entered the starry sky cultivated the divine contract later, restricted themselves, and stimulated their potential.
This was the strongest thing about Space Beast Tamers.
In fact, Shi Yu had also unknowingly undergone a divine contract. The upgraded blessing of the World Tree was a type of divine contract that external forces helped Shi Yu reach. His divine contract was the upper limit of the pets that could be contracted. It exceeded ordinary people, and his cultivation speed exceeded ordinary Beast Tamers. There were also some other miscellaneous attribute enhancements. The enhancements were many and complicated. As for the side effects, there didn’t seem to be any. If one had to say, the side effects were that raising too many pets costs too much money. Ordinary people couldn’t afford to raise them, right?
As for Huang Xi’s restriction on herself, she could only contract pets with the phoenix bloodline in exchange for a fivefold increase in her Beast Taming Talent! !
Similar to Ming Gu t s divine contract, the content of the contract could only be reached by super geniuses. The other party’s was ten times, and the Empress’s was five times. Of course, this couldn’t mean that the Empress’s talent was worse than Ming Gu t s.
Because Ming Gu seemed to have only contracted one pet. This might also be a price, but the Empress didn’t have the number of pet contracts restricted. She still had nine pets now.
The difference in the number of pets was enough to close the increase in Beast Taming Talent.
After being blessed by Goddess Wa and Blue Planet, the Empress’s talent was clearly higher. This was equivalent to a gift from a peak super divine and a cosmic-level star in her previous life.
At this moment, every phoenix pet of hers had mastered more than four quasi-divine skills. When nine fused into one, it was equivalent to dozens of quasi-divine skills gathering in one body. Although the quality might not be inferior to Zavay, under the enhancement of the Empress’ five times Beast Taming Talent, her strength instantly reached an unbelievable level.
Two pairs of huge nine-colored feathers floated behind her. Empress Huang
Xi calmly attacked.
“Phoenix Seal.” She gave the order, and a nine-colored treasure seal condensed in the sky. Accompanied by a phoenix cry, it instantly collapsed the sky and space, suppressing the son of the Demon Emperor, making its pupils shrink. It pulled out its saber and stood up.
Boom.
Under the dazzling light, the third son of the Demon Emperor was directly suppressed by the treasure seal on the snow, his body flattened.
The Empress felt that the person in front of her was too noisy and had too many questions.
At this moment, the entire place was silent.
“I’m younger than her,” the Empress said.
Chi Tong, who was watching the battle: ???
Nonsense! Chi Tong expressed that it was younger, but it was a sister!
Of course, no one cared about this now.
For the first time, Empress Dong Huangs strength appeared in front of everyone. Everyone felt that her strength wasn’t much inferior to Chi Tongs monster…
“It’s over.” At this moment, the hearts of the old contestants, like Ming Gu, turned cold.
They knew that nothing good would happen if the few emperors of Dong Huang appeared this year.
This Empress was so strong.
The Blue Planet was filled with monsters!
Next, there was still Emperor Wu and the Dragon Emperor. How was he going to play this batch?
On the first day, Emperor Wu and the Dragon Emperor basically didn’t even fight. They didn’t even summon their pets and relied on deterrence from afar to instantly kill their opponents.
Senior Lu was the same, but she didn’t rely on deterrence. Instead, she relied on the killing intent fluctuations tempered by her pets during this period, directly scaring her opponent into collapse. It was similar to deterrence.
As the Blue Planet bloodline appeared again, many monster experts surged out at once. The other realms were numb.
Especially the Four Holy Family, who had an even greater sense of urgency.
The Four Saints super divine met online again.
“The grudge between us and the Blue Planet lineage is almost impossible to erase. Now that the Blue Planet lineage is gradually strengthening, if we’re still afraid of Emperor Shi and refuse to attack for a long time, the geniuses of the Blue Planet lineage will increase in number and become stronger and stronger,” the Vermillion Bird super divine said. “Green Dragon, your killing intent was the strongest previously, but later on, you were the first to say that we have to delay the conflict. You said that you would find a safer method.
Have you found it now?”
“Of course,” the Green Dragon super divine said. “Even if the other party knows it’s us, we definitely can’t attack personally.”
“Heh, this Blue Planet bloodline is really domineering. They can destroy the Assassin Planet just like that, but if they can destroy the Assassin Planet, can they destroy the cosmic overlord army? Can they destroy the Dark King Army?”
“Shi Yu contracted a cleansing star spirit and contracted so many pets. No matter what, he will head to the Void Battlefield sooner or later. A person like him won’t be willing to cower on the World King Planet.”
“At that time, the super divine of the Blue Planet lineage won’t be able to protect him all the time.”
“On the battlefield, there are the Dark King Army and the Death Mercenaries of the cosmic overlord army.”
“Letting him die on the battlefield is the best choice. At most, I’ll let him grow for a period of time. When he feels that he’s strong enough, it’s also time for him to die.’
“In the World King Planet, the more talented they are, the faster they die. This is because they are confident in their strength, especially those divine-level geniuses who try to challenge super divines above their level. They often die the fastest.’
“What we need to do is guide Shi Yu to the battlefield to try to challenge a super divine above his level and let him ‘die of arrogance’.”
“l understand the logic, but what should we do?” The White Tiger super divine said, “He’s not an ordinary divine-level genius. If he chooses a super divine challenge that exceeds transcendent 1, even if he loses, the other party might not necessarily be able to stop him. If he wins, it will be even more of a disaster.’
“Take a step back. What if he doesn’t go to the battlefield?”
“Leave it to me. This is a meticulous and complicated trap,” the Green Dragon super divine said.
“He has to go!’
“F*ck, you’re really smart (big idiot),” the Black Tortoise super divine suddenly said.
Green Dragon: “?”
“You’re scolding me?” The Green Dragon super divine was angry. Black Tortoise said, “Go and see the news headlines that just appeared.”
The three super divines: “?”
The top trending topic in the news!
It should have been about the God Sealing Battle, but today’s situation was really special.
That was because, at the edge of the Cosmic Sea, the Environmental Protection Army and the Dark King Army finally collided head-on. Both parties launched an all-out attack and started a battle!
It involved nearly 20 super divines and a huge battle in dozens of star domains!
The name of the person who accelerated the battle made the super divines of the Four Holy Family widen their eyes.
On the news, it was Bing Lings mobilization before the battle.
The main content of the mobilization was that the Environmental Protection Army had already successfully killed an abyss super divine that was of transcendent 2, the abyss super divine, Benos!
As for the person who killed Benos… his name was Shi Yu!
This was what the news said. After the Environmental Protection Association’s Shi Yu and Susu went deep into the enemy, they killed the abyss super divine Benos and the abyss army of a star domain alone in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain.
In the defense line of the Dark King Army, a huge gap was opened, laying a solid foundation for the final victory of the Environmental Protection Army.
It had to be said that Shi Yu e s battle results were indeed useful. It immediately stimulated the fighting spirit of the Environmental Protection Army, letting them know that there was such a future star and super genius in the Environmental Protection Army.
A divine-level expert had hunted a super divine transcendent 2 above his level and even succeeded. This was simply a textbook miracle battle.
All the attention of the Dark King Army was on the super divine. In this battle, both parties had a peak super divine presiding over them. The super divine source or transcenctence was like tne sun to tne peak or tne super divine. 11 a super divine level entered the range of the Dark King Army, it would definitely be sensed immediately. Therefore, it was almost impossible to suddenly attack and kill a super divine and open an opening on the battlefield. This was because if they wanted to do it, they could only do it by the divine level. Moreover, they couldn’t enter the enemy’s range head-on.
However, how could there be so many divine-levels that could kill super divines? Therefore, Shi Yu and the others were considered to have been stuck in a huge bug. Be it Susu or Beast Shi Yu, who didn’t have the source of transcendence, they were both “weak” existences that were extremely difficult to detect in the Dark King Army. Moreover, they had passed through from the remote Blue Planet, so it was even harder to detect.
If they could obtain a huge victory in this battle, Shi Yu t s contribution would undoubtedly be huge.
“No, impossible!!!” After seeing this news, the super divines of the Four Holy Family were directly stunned.
Especially the Green Dragon super divine. It originally planned to use the power of the enemy super divine to kill Shi Yu after he grew up. In the end, Shi
Yu… This…
“l don’t believe it! The Green Dragon super divine was extremely shocked.
At this moment, the entire World King Planet was shocked. Another enemy super divine had fallen!
Moreover, it died in the hands of a divine-level genius.
Most importantly, this genius was only a quasi-divine a year ago, Everyone was shocked by such a ridiculous battle result.
When the geniuses who were still fighting Shi Yu in the God Sealing Battle a year ago saw this news, their expressions were numb, and their eyes were shocked. It was difficult to understand.
Those super divine realm lords in high positions also fell into deep thought. They looked in the direction of the Dong Huang Realm and felt that another invincible epoch god had been born.. How long had it been since such a terrifying divine level appeared on the World King Planet…?

chapters.title: Chapter 1632 - 1632: Breaking the Divine Level Limit (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1632: Breaking the Divine Level Limit (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu’s successful hunt of a super divine immediately became a big matter that attracted the attention of the entire World King Planet.
Last year, during the God Sealing Battle, Shi Yu’s news made the entire World King Planet pay attention.
This year, during the God Sealing Battle, Shi Yu should have left, but no one expected him to return.
He made big news again and let everything stop on him.
“How exactly did he do it…”
“Even if the cleansing star spirit is known as the Heavenly Nemesis Abyss Race and can fight above its level, it’s too magical to go from a quasi-divine to super divine battle power in such a short period of time.”
“Could it be that Benos was heavily injured because he was weak for some special reason? Although the news says that Shi Yu is alone, don’t forget, he alone represents more than ten monster pets. If we cooperate…”
“I’ve already imagined it. Lings luck was so good that it exploded. Perhaps Benos’s army encountered the Starry Sky Storm and was picked up by Shi Yu and the others. But even so, it’s very strong.”
Compared to believing that Shi Yu could really kill super divines above his
level, people were still willing to imagine more storytelling experiences.
After all, Shi Yu directly killed his way to the Divine Planet of the Scarlet Blue Star Domain. It sounded even more unreliable than the Starry Sky Storm that the Benos army encountered.
But no matter how they argued, no one could obtain concrete information.
Now, people still wanted to know if Shi Yu had obtained a new source of transcendence, but unfortunately, no additional information was circulated in that battle,
Bing Ling only used this battle report to encourage the Environmental Protection Army after obtaining Shi Yu’s agreement.
“This kid.” Apart from the Four Saints and the super divine, the five super divines on Blue Planet also felt that it was ridiculous. They each felt that it was unbelievable.
They couldn’t imagine that Shi Yu, who still needed their protection in the previous God Sealing Battle, had… surpassed them so quickly!
Ignoring strength, just Shi Yu’s battle results alone had undoubtedly exceeded them by too much to defeat a transcendent 2.
After obtaining the pseudo source of transcendence, the dragon super divine that had just advanced to transcendent 2 looked in the direction of the Dong Huang Realm in confusion.
The dragon felt that it had lived for nothing at its age. This Dong Huang lineage was too ridiculous.
At this moment, in the Floating Realm, Shi Yu was yawning. He was lying on an old rocker, leisurely.
The exposure of his battle results also meant that the Environmental Protection Army should have calculated his battle merits.
As expected, before Shi Yu could take the initiative to investigate, Shi Yu’s World King Token swayed.
After Shi Yu chose to answer, there was first silence before an unfamiliar voice sounded.
“Realm lord Shi Yu, I’m the person-in-charge of the Central Realm’s Battle
Achievement Bureau, Feng Lan. During your service in the Environmental Protection Army, the battle merits you accumulated have been verified and have already been logged in. As the value is too large, I’ll personally contact you next.”
Shi Yu said, “Hello, Director Feng Lan. May I ask if there’s a planet among the resources that can be exchanged for battle merits, right?”
“That’s right,” Feng Lan said. ‘Your battle merits are enough to exchange for some rare planets, such as the lucky star and the time star…”
Shi Yu said, “I want a lucky star and a time star at the same time. Are my battle merits enough?”
Feng Lan said, “It might not be enough…”
Shi Yu said, “Then I want a lucky star. The rest can be exchanged for a pseudo source of transcendence.”
“Alright, I’ll help you arrange it next.”
Shi Yu closed the call. After thinking about it, he still decided to get a lucky star.
He would change Lings weapon first.
Although the spatial weapons on the battleship weren’t bad now, when he added Lings spatial control to (Perfect+47), the advantage wouldn’t be that great. It was better to change them as soon as possible.
On the contrary, Shi Yu felt that the more metaphysical things, like luck value, the better.
In short, it was spatial attainments. Apart from spatial weapons and spatial control skills, there were many ways to increase them. However, on the contrary, there were very few ways to increase the luck stats. He couldn’t miss any of them.
As for the rest, it was all to exchange for the pseudo source of transcendence. This was because the pseudo source of transcendence was a high-level universal currency among super divine levels. It was also very convenient to exchange it for other things later. Apart from that, it could be stored to strengthen Beast Shi Yu in the future.
Shi Yu also valued the growth of his previous life very much. After all, he might have to fuse with it in the future.
While waiting for the battle merit reward to be transferred, Shi Yu naturally added points with all his might. Of course, he would occasionally pay attention to the new God Sealing Battle, but before Senior Lu and the others encountered troublesome opponents, there was nothing to pay attention to.
It had to be said that after Susu reached the Super Divine Will, it was easy to add points to her.
The proficiency level of the origin wave increased almost visibly. However, the Star Sea Contract that had already reached transcendence seemed to have encountered a bottleneck and couldn’t increase.
At the same time, the Star Sea Contract was also in a deletable state in the skill index. This meant that the index judged that it had been maxed out.
This situation had puzzled Shi Yu for a long time.
Transcendent was max level… This situation only happened in teaching skills.
The Star Sea Contract was a racial skill. In theory, the upper limit of the level should be Dao Proficiency.
Could it be that the upper limit of the proficiency of a divine skill was transcendent? It no longer differentiated between racial skills and teaching skills.
However, Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to think too much. So be it if it was transcendent. In any case, it was still far from transcendent. It was useless to think too much now.
“I’m so tired.’
At the lake, Shi Yu hugged Susu and sighed slightly..

chapters.title: Chapter 1633 - 1633: Breaking the Divine Level Limit (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1633: Breaking the Divine Level Limit (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Susu looked at Shi Yu with its big eyes and directly condensed a cleansing water drop to cleanse Shi Yu’s lazing heart.
“Ning, Ning!’
Beast Tamer, this isn’t your limit! “This is the last time…” Shi Yu said.
[Race Skill]
“Divine-level”: Star Sea Contract (transcendent), Origin Wave (Perfect+47),
Inheritance Water Droplet (Initiate), Water/Quasi Control (Proficient), Heavenly Frost Cold Energy (Proficient)
[Taught Skill]
“Divine-level”: Infinite Devour (Initiate), Star Refinement (Proficient)
Shi Yu felt that it was enough. With one last time, the origin fluctuations could reach transcendence.
Having a transcendent-level divine skill was an epoch god, so what if he had two?
Although the level upper limit of a single divine skill couldn’t increase, Shi Yu could still choose to compete in numbers.
The Star Sea Contract combined with the origin fluctuations to form a combination skill. Even if there was really a divine skill with Dao Proficiency, this combination skills should be able to resist.
At the moment, Susu’s strength was much stronger than when it fought the abyss super divine. If they fought again, Susu would definitely not be so miserable.
And if he raised the origin wave to transcendence and fought again, Shi Yu was confident that Susu could defeat the other party even without his support.
“Come! ”
“Ning! (Come!)”
Shi Yu’s final palm landed on Susu’s head.
In the next moment, an extremely dazzling light appeared on susu’s body.
Buzz!
It instantly illuminated the entire mystic realm.
If Shi Yu hadn’t asked the Space Emperor to help strengthen his mystic realm manor with the power of super divine, the current light would probably have been like the light of the sun, shocking the entire Floating Realm.
“What a strong power wave…” In the manor, Ling and the others stuck their heads out one by one.
Eleven’s hand, which was holding the bamboo in the corridor, trembled slightly with envy.
“Quack (As expected of Big Sister.)” Duckie was excited. If Susu became stronger, it was actually equivalent to it becoming stronger.
With Susu around, it could devour and activate more abyssal power without restraint…
“Huh?” However, not only did Susu break through again, Shi Yu also sensed an indescribable change in his body.
During the process of adding points, Shi Yu closed his eyes tightly and frowned. He sensed the attribute feedback from Susu.
Generally speaking, the power Susu gave back was resistance. It had more willpower, mind, and mental strength, which could make Shi Yu’s magic resistance and abnormal state resistance stronger.
Of course, apart from that, there was naturally the feedback from every pet to break through the standard and the Beast Taming Space.
Long before this, Shi Yu had already been fed back to the tenth level of the divine level by Beast Shi Yu, which was the peak of the divine level. Logically speaking, this was already the limit of the divine level.
Even if Susu had just become an epoch god, the Beast Taming Space didn’t change much. But now, as Susu became an epoch god with two transcendent divine skills, the feedback from the Beast Taming Space finally became obvious.
Ten phantoms of the sky automatically appeared behind Shi Yu. The sky behind him was blurry, as if it had been divided into ten levels. The sky rumbled and trembled, as if it was opening up a new world.
“This is…” Qi, Ling, and the others watched eagerly at the side. “Master is opening the eleventh level. Because of Susu’s feedback, he broke the limit of
the divine-level Beast Taming Space.”
“Wow,” Qi said. “That can happen? Then when we all become epoch gods, can we build higher and higher?”
“This is a possibility…” Ling muttered. At the same time, Shi Yu also felt that he and Susu were breaking through together. As Shi Yu broke through, a large amount of origin power was tilted out of the eleven heavens. Even Eleven and the others had obtained the divine power purification and increased some divine power.
At this moment, strange phenomena appeared frequently in Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space as Shi Yu’s own meditation consolidated. However, just as Shi Yu was about to solidify the eleventh level, an accident appeared.
Boom.
In the sky, countless lightning bolts suddenly struck down. They were nomological lightning, as if they were tribulation lightning fused from transcendent spatial laws and transcendent lightning laws. They were incomparably terrifying, and every one of them seemed to be able to destroy a world.
“No way.” Shi Yu suddenly looked at the sky.
The violent lightning tribulation struck in the direction of the new eleven heavens. Shi Yu had never heard of this situation or expected it.
This lightning tribulation was incomparably terrifying. Even if a super divine was hit, it might be heavily injured. If it successfully hit the 11th heavenly layer, not only would Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space collapse, but the weight that had just been opened would definitely be gone.
Moreover, the other ten heavenly layers would definitely suffer a serious backlash and crack. At that time, Shi Yu estimated that it would take him a long time to recuperate. It would be so serious that his life would even be in danger.
“Meow!!!” In the distance, Shorty was the first to explode. It thought that someone wanted to harm Shi Yu, but its White Tiger Retribution power had expanded. Even with the power of the Four Holy Ruins, it didn’t feel that any expert in the Floating Realm was hostile to Shi Yu.
Moreover, this lightning tribulation didn’t seem to be targeting Shi Yu’s life. Instead, it seemed to be purely targeting Shi Yu’s newly opened 11th heavenly layer…
“This is… the will of the great universe.” As if it represented some taboo to open up the 11th heavenly layer, Ling immediately judged that this lightning tribulation was like a cosmic disaster. It was born naturally, but it seemed to contain the will of the universe and was only targeted at certain specific situations..

chapters.title: Chapter 1634 - 1634: Breaking the Divine Level Limit (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1634 - 1634: Breaking the Divine Level Limit (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Wuu! The lightning tribulation landed. Eleven had already rushed into the sky, wanting to help the 11th heavenly layer resist the lightning tribulation with its lightning body, but it was directly stopped by Beast Shi Yu.
“Danger.” Beast Shi Yu flew into the sky and directly threw Eleven back to the ground. He rushed into the sky alone and resisted the storm-like lightning tribulation in the shaky 11th heavenly layer.
He raised the sword shield as high as a Lightning Rod, trying to attract the lightning to himself.
Boom!!!
The aftermath instantly made the manor mystic realm into a mess, causing cracks to appear in the spatial mystic realm created by the Space Emperor. It was about to collapse at any time.
Under the indiscriminate bombardment of lightning, Beast Shi Yu’s equipment gradually shattered, and injuries appeared on his body. Fortunately, his physical strength was still strong enough, thanks to the strengthening of the pseudo source of transcendence previously!
“Stay away!” At that moment, all of Shi Yu’s pets were called back by Shi Yu. The strength of this lightning tribulation was so strong that, apart from its super divine battle power, it was invincible. At the moment, in the team, only Beast Shi Yu and Susu could try to resist it.
“Ning! Under the worried expressions of Eleven and the others, Susu finally opened its eyes and looked at the sky fiercely. Clearly, it had finished digesting the power of the additional points and completely stepped into the new realm of the era.
It directly leaped up. During the process, it combined it with the Star Sea Contract and ignored the backlash. It activated the Origin Wave with all its might, trying to erase the lightning.
“Ning!! (Breaking lightning, disperse!!)”
As soon as Susu finished speaking, the fluctuations of the Sea of Stars spread out and filled the entire sky, causing the Milky Way to appear again. Soon, countless lightning bolts dimmed.
Boom boom boom boom boom. The lightning tried to launch a new round of attacks, but it was forced back by Susu and Beast Shi Yu. At this moment, Shi Yu’s manor was already in a complete mess. The mystic realm space had also collapsed. Before Shi Yu noticed, the sound of tribulation lightning had already resounded throughout the entire Floating Realm. Even the experts from the surrounding realms suddenly woke up and looked in the direction of the Floating Realm.
“What happened?” In the Floating Realm, the Space Emperor was shocked. He looked in the direction of Shi Yu’s manor and at the lightning that had already dimmed in the sky. He was shocked, and he quickly teleported over.
However, by the time he came over, everything had already calmed down. Although Shi Yu e s main body didn’t come into contact with the lightning, he still seemed to have been electrocuted and was charred from the explosion.
“Hu…” Shi Yu spat out black smoke.
In the sky, Susu was lying on Beast Shi Yu’s head, still looking at the sky. After confirming that there was no movement, they heaved a sigh of relief.
“Yiya!!!” Baby Ginseng and the others, who were protecting Shi Yu, also started chattering.
“It’s alright… Don’t worry,” Shi Yu said. “Damn, what’s this? All the good equipment is gone.”
“Shi Yu!” In midair, the Space Emperor looked at the miserable Shi Yu and said, “Shi Yu, what happened? Enemy??”
He sensed his surroundings, but he didn’t find anyone.
“Senior Space Emperor.” At this moment, Shi Yu also noticed the Space Emperor. He looked over and said, “1 don’t know either. It doesn’t look like an enemy. Have you read any cultivation novels? Have you heard of the Tribulation Transcendence Stages? Heavenly tribulation, lightning tribulation, and so on. It seems to be that.”
Emperor Kong:
“I’ve heard of it. I once had a subordinate who cultivated a Dragon Carp. When that Dragon Carp evolved into a lightning dragon in a special way, it experienced the test of the heaven and earth lightning.”
“On the World King Planet, there are also some races who need to undergo the test of heaven and earth when breaking through.”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Although the mechanism might be different, nature feels about the same. When I just broke through, I seemed to have also encountered the lightning that filled the void.”
“Of course, it’s all thanks to Susu, and… the guy from the super divine stone. I’m fine.’
The Space Emperor looked at Beast Shi Yu and Susu in the sky in silence, as if he understood why Shi Yu could defeat the abyss super divine.
At the same time, they were shocked again that Shi Yu could control Beast Shi Yu to display such strength. Shi Yu had managed to do something that the archeological association had never been able to do… He was really a monster.
Of course, apart from Shi Yu l s own pets, the Space Emperor and the others didn’t know that this era’s ancient corpse was Shi Yu’s previous life. Even Emperor Shi and the Blue Planet’s Will couldn’t tell. Perhaps they could tell, but they didn’t say it.
“It’s good that you’re fine, but why would a breakthrough attract lightning tribulation…” The Space Emperor couldn’t understand.
A human breakthrough would attract lightning? He had indeed never heard of it.
Shi Yu used his body control to recover his fair skin and short black hair. “1 1 m also very puzzled. It might be related to this?”
With that said, Shi Yu directly activated the Beast Taming Space. The colorless summoning array was a divine-level symbol. It was already difficult to see its real form, but in contrast, the sky phenomenon that represented the level of the Beast Taming Space became an important symbol to determine the strength of the Beast Tamer.
At that moment, a total of 11 heavenly layers rumbled as they appeared behind Shi Yu, making the Space Emperor reveal an incredulous expression.
“11 layers??” He said in disbelief.
“Well, perhaps it’s because of the blessing of the Blue Planet’s World Tree. Previously, I had two Beast Taming Spaces. After they fused, they seemed to have the ability to break through the upper limit of their level. It’s also possible that the feedback from the pets is too huge, allowing me to break through the limit.”
Shi Yu himself didn’t understand why he had successfully broken through. However, he had indeed never heard of the Beast Taming Space of the eleventh level. As a spatial talent, the Space Emperor had been stuck at the tenth level for a long time.. He needed to rely on the source of transcendence to change to other upgrade systems, but for Shi Yu…

chapters.title: Chapter 1635 - 1635: Breaking the Divine Level Limit (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1635 - 1635: Breaking the Divine Level Limit (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Could this be the new domain that might exist above the divine level that Senior Emperor Shi mentioned? The realm after breaking through the limit of the divine level?” The Space Emperor pondered.
At this moment, the Prediction Owl, Lin Feng, Emperor Wu, and the others also arrived. Even the five super divine beings on Blue Planet, far away in their own world were attracted by the commotion in the Floating Realm and descended.
When they saw the phenomenon of the eleven heavenly layers behind Shi Yu, they also revealed shocked expressions to different degrees.
“Sorry to disturb everyone. There was an accident during my cultivation. It’s alright, it’s alright…” At this moment, Shi Yu laughed and scratched his head. “This isn’t a surprise. You’ve cultivated to the 11th layer?” The dragon super divine said in shock.
“Holy sh*t.” Lin Feng was uncultured. What was this? Did the tenth layer crack or something?
“Isn’t the divine level only at the tenth level?” Emperor Wu, the Empress, the Dragon Emperor, and the others clearly had already understood the profundity of the divine level.
Shi Yu, this kid, indeed didn’t make sense. Now, they seemed to understand why Shi Yu could defeat a super divine above his level.
“You broke the limit?” Lu Qingyi smiled and looked at Shi Yu. She quickly understood what was going on. Being happy for Shi Yu didn’t look like a bad thing.
“Could this be…” The Prediction Owl also fell into deep thought.
“Seniors, the five divine races have a long inheritance. Do you know anything?” The Space Emperor asked the five super divine races. Although the overall strength of the five divine races was low, to be able to be passed down for so long and be knowledgeable, it was definitely not something he and Lin Feng could compare to. The knowledge he had accumulated might not even be comparable to the Blue Planet’s Will and Emperor Shi.
“There are some records in the race, but not many. It seems that there are indeed legends of realms above the tenth level of the divine level. However, because the five divine races aren’t mainly humans, I don’t know much,” the Kirin Race’s super divine said.
“Didn’t Emperor Shi also guess previously that there are still divine-level new realms after humans reach the peak of the human divine level?”
“This…” The Space Emperor was speechless. He naturally knew this. He looked at Teacher Tu Na.
“Don’t ask me. The Astrologer Race fell into dire straits once tens of thousands of years ago and lost a large amount of information.” The owl girl shrugged and said, “However, according to what I’ve understood recently, I can roughly deduce it.’
“Now that Susu is an epoch god, the feedback Shi Yu obtained from it must be very strong. Since there are relevant records in the five divine races, it means that there must be Beast Tamers who have reached this realm. As for why everyone has rarely heard of it, it might be because they don’t have any special circumstances and basically don’t appear in the world.”
“As an outstanding figure at the divine level, they must be waiting for the source of transcendence that’s born every 100,000 years.”
“Under normal circumstances, in order to preserve its power, it’s definitely safer to sleep and seal itself. From the looks of it, apart from preserving its power and delaying its lifespan, there might be another reason why it sleeps and seals itself.’
“That is, dodging the lightning tribulation,” the owl said. “After breaking through the limit of a certain realm, you might encounter the backlash of the cosmic will and be entangled by the lightning tribulation…”
“With the commotion of that lightning tribulation just now, Shi Yu can withstand it, but if it were other Beast Tamers… Even if the other party has also cultivated an epoch god, it’s not that easy to block.”
The corners of Shi Yu t s mouth twitched. “You mean that this lightning tribulation will still come after?”
The owl blinked and said, “l don’t know either… But I’ll call my brother to help you predict it later.”
Shi Yu was speechless.
Damn.
In the future, who could withstand being struck by lightning every day?
From the looks of it, the work of adding points to Eleven had to be increased.
Otherwise, blocking the lightning tribulation would consume another lot of energy, but if these lightning tribulations could be fed to Eleven, it wouldn’t be a loss.
Shi Yu had decided on Eleven!

chapters.title: Chapter 1636 - 1636: Fan Behavior, Zavay Paid the Money (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1636: Fan Behavior, Zavay Paid the Money (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Sigh, I wonder if it’s luck or bad luck,” Shi Yu said. “Speaking of which,
100,000 years isn’t too long for the five divine races. Have the five divine races never participated in the competition for the source of transcendence?”
“A human who cultivated to the 11th heavenly layer hasn’t participated before?”
The five super divine ancestors looked at each other with awkward expressions.
What a joke. At that time, it was the super divine Asura, the super divine meat grinder. Although it was mainly a divine-level competition for the source of transcendence, at least ten super divines would die every time. How could they dare?
The super divines who died… were basically the guardians of those divine-level geniuses. The five of them clearly wouldn’t sacrifice themselves for the path of the geniuses in their race.
Every time the source of transcendence was born, the five divine races would immediately enter seclusion to seal the world.
It could be said that every 100,000 years, the super divine factions would reshuffle.
Shi Yu looked at their expressions and knew that it was a wasted question.
As expected, this kind of thing still had to be asked by a super divine like Goddess Wa who had been in the universe for a long time.
“Shi Yu, is there any special change in the eleventh level?” Lin Feng asked curiously. He was now at the tenth level. He didn’t know if there was any hope of reaching the eleventh level like Shi Yu. He felt that Shi Yu was so cool.
“Hmm, changes? I don’t think so? It’s just the enhancement that can be obtained from a normal breakthrough,” Shi Yu said.
“So lackluster?” Lin Feng was stunned.
“It’s not exactly lackluster.” Shi Yu smiled. He felt that with his enhancement, Eleven and the others, who were high-level divines and didn’t add much points, could fight a perfect divine. This was the power of Beast Taming levels increasing and Beast Tamers and pets cooperating.
Shi Yu looked at everyone.
“Seniors, now isn’t the time to stay with me, right? Isn’t the commotion very big this time… Don’t you need to help eliminate the impact…”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the super divines fell silent.
“It’s good that you’re fine.” Emperor Wu was also stunned and shook his head. Alright, alright, he felt a difference in his heart when he saw Shi Yu. It was better to concentrate on the God Sealing Battle.
Two days after Shi Yu broke through to the 11th heavenly layer, Shi Yu finally recovered.
On this day, the Prediction Owl finally sent Shi Yu some useful news.
“Shi Yu, through the channels of the Astrologer Race, I’ve already asked about what needs to be asked for you.”
Teacher Tu Na flew over to the “Lightning Avoidance Mystic Realm” that Shi Yu had already rebuilt. She landed on the ground and looked at Shi Yu, who was lazing around.
“What?” Shi Yu’s center of gravity tilted. He stood up and said, “Let’s talk about whether it’s a good thing or a bad thing first.”
“A good thing,” the owl said. “Apart from premonition, my brother also visited an ancient race. This race was on good terms with the Astrologer Race a long time ago and obtained some inside information from them. Of course, my brother didn’t mention anything about you.”
“Okay.” Shi Yu nodded.
“In the universe, there are indeed a portion of human geniuses who broke through the restrictions of the tenth level of the divine level and reached the eleventh level. There are even some terrifying guys who have reached the eleventh level.’
“These people all have one specific thing: their pets have reached the epoch god level.”
“An epoch god is already strong enough. If there’s still a Beast Tamer’s enhancement, what will happen? It’s considered a trick for humans and Beast Tamers to cooperate. This might also be a restriction of the cosmic will on humans after breaking through a certain limit.”
“I guess the reason why such Beast Tamers are restricted is very likely because they took the right path. This has a chance of reaching the cosmic level.”
“Didn’t we predict how you would reach the cosmic level previously?”
“It’s contracting a cosmic level at the super divine level, right? Under normal circumstances, divine-levels naturally can’t contract super divines above their level, and super divines naturally can’t contract a cosmic level above their level, even if they reach the theoretical peak of their current realm.”
“But if, like this 11th heavenly levels, the limit of the level can also be broken multiple times, then maybe it’s possible.”
“You’ve already broken the limit at the divine level. When you reach the super divine level, if you break the limit again and fight a few more times, you might really be able to contract a cosmic level at the super divine level.”
“Is that so…” Shi Yu said, “Indeed, I feel that the Beast Taming Space of the 11th heavenly layer has a greater bearing on pets.”
“Of course, there should still be a gap between it and contracting a super divine above its level.’
The owl said,
“In addition, just as I predicted, this kind of lightning tribulation will still appear frequently in the future, but the good news is that it will only descend once in 100 years. Although it will be stronger at that time, we can avoid it through some special methods. If you want this kind of evasion method, we can also think of a way.”
“It should be a way to seal oneself and let one sleep,” Shi Yu said. “It’s indeed good news. It only descended once in 100 years. There’s no need to think about something so far away now. Don’t worry about it.”
“For you, 100 years is indeed a little far. Let’s talk about it when the time comes.” The owl nodded.
“However, I’m not done. Apart from automatically descending once every 100 years, every time you open up a new world, which is to try to break through the limit the next time and reach the 12th heavenly layer of the divine level, the lightning tribulation will still descend.”
“There’s no way to dodge. Moreover, it’s best not to try to resist with external forces. You can only let pets with contracts with space resist. Otherwise, the power of the lightning tribulation will be stronger.”
Shi Yu:
F*ck, now that it was mentioned, how could Shi Yu dare to continue adding points to his pet?
“Alright, I’ll remember that.” Shi Yu nodded. He understood. Next, he would crazily replicate skills that countered lightning.
“Speaking of which, what’s the background of the race Patriarch Tu Tu visited?” Shi Yu asked.
Teacher Tu Na said, “They’ve experienced the battle to transcend the origin many times. They’re a large race with rich foundations. My brother guesses that there should be sleeping epoch gods in their race or divine-level Beast Tamers who have broken through the limit.”
“My brother also said that if Shi Yu wants to participate in the competition to transcend the origin in the future… you have to tell him hundreds of years in advance and let him prepare well…”
“That’s my suggestion too. This matter does seem to be dangerous.” Teacher Owl was serious.
Shi Yu was speechless. “Come on, the last time the universe naturally gave birth to the source of transcendence was 80,000 years ago. In other words, a new universe transcendence source will only be born about 20,000 years later…
“20,000 years, the flowers have withered.”
Shi Yu didn’t expect to obtain a transcendent origin in this space and time.
“Not necessarily. Although transcendent origins are born every 100,000 years and this is a natural law, there are still some lives in the universe who have the ability to affect these natural laws,” the owl said.
“For example, the five cosmic levels have the ability to do it.”
“For example, the power of the Star Prayer Race and the Astrologer Race.” The owl chuckled.
Shi Yu:
“Really?” Shi Yu was shocked.
“The Astrologer Race and the Star Prayer Race have the ability to compare to the five major cosmic levels?”
The owl said that the five cosmic levels could change the laws of the universe and let the source of transcendence condense in advance. Shi Yu believed it.
However, weren’t the Astrologer Race and the Star Prayer Race only races born on World King Planet…
Although the power source of these two races was indeed quite related to the planet and the universe…
“Don’t underestimate our two races. Back then, at the divine level, I predicted five existences with the source of transcendence, although I didn’t obtain them.”
“In short, it’s naturally true, but it’s very difficult. It’s very difficult for us to do it now.” The owl shrugged and said, “If that cat and 1 can become peak super divines, perhaps we can do it together.”
Shi Yu:
“l think 20,000 years might come faster,” Shi Yu said.
“Wuu, heartless,” the owl girl said. “When do you plan to set off for the cosmic overlord army?”
“In a few months,” Shi Yu said. “After the God Sealing Battle ends, I’ll go to Blue Planet to explore the ruins of that era. Then, I’ll cultivate for a period of time. I think it’s about time before going to the cosmic overlord army.” “Sure, sure, don’t forget to call me when the time comes!” the owl said.
“Don’t worry, 1 won’t forget,” Shi Yu said.
After the owl brought Shi Yu a lot of useful information, it left. As for Shi Yu himself, he temporarily gave up on adding points. He packed up and planned to leave.
It wasn’t to return to Blue Planet to explore the ruins of Chi You and Yellow Emperor, but to head to the central realm.
In the last God Sealing Battle, he had recorded many rare skills.
Unfortunately, due to the number and form of the skill column, he didn’t have time to replicate them.
But now, after contracting Beast Shi Yu and adding points to the divine skill to transcendence to delete it, Shi Yu’s skill column was much richer.
For example, Shi Yu had been envious of the Zavay Crow’s Time Reversal, Time Acceleration, and Time Stop for a long time. He had to replicate it this time.
In the central realm, World King City.
After Zavay had just experienced a battle without any suspense, it left the battle facility in a flash, planning to return to its residence.
However, its expression suddenly froze. It looked at the figure that suddenly appeared in midair and stopped it.
“It’s you! Upon seeing this figure, Zavay was shocked and revealed an incredulous expression. Who else could it be but Shi Yu, who was blocking in front of it?
Apart from Shi Yu, there was also that hateful bear.
“Wu wu wu!” Eleven stood on Shi Yu’s shoulder and waved at Zavay. Long time no see.
“Zavay.” Shi Yu smiled at Zavay and said, “I’m here.” “You’re here? What’s the matter?” Zavay was silent.
“What is it??”
Shi Yu said, “A few days ago, I received a letter. The owner of the letter claims to be your fan. He said that after you lost the last time, he was very unconvinced and wanted to fight me again. He worked hard for a year.”
“l saw that your fan was more sincere, so I came over personally, planning to fight you again.”
“Of course, we’ve all broken through to the divine level now. 1 don’t know what your fan was thinking, but in order to satisfy his wish, I can suppress my level to that of a quasi-divine.”
Zavay was stunned.
“Really???”
What was this???
Why didn’t it remember that it had such a fan who deserved a beating??
It looked at Shi Yu, who had already successfully hunted a super divine in front of it, and was stunned. It felt that it was sitting at home, and a pot had come from the sky.. Zavay also had to pay for the behavior of its fans?

chapters.title: Chapter 1637 - 1637: Skill of Blue Planet’s Will (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1637: Skill of Blue Planet’s Will (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
World King City.
Under Shi Yu’s warm heart, he and Zavay engaged in a “guidance battle”.
Zavay couldn’t persuade Shi Yu, so he silently ordered Baby Ginseng, wanting to compete with the previous champion.
Firstly, Baby Ginseng was very strong, and secondly, Baby Ginseng had also mastered the Time Mark and was also a time element. Fighting Baby Ginseng might yield greater gains.
This made Baby Ginseng very happy.
After all, Zavay had been eliminated by Eleven in the first round. It had yet to use the pile of anti-Zavay energy fruits it had prepared for Zavay.
This battle finally didn’t make Baby Ginsengs efforts useless.
Of course, this guidance battle was also to stop when it was time. After all, Zavay still had to keep his physical fitness and Time Mark to prepare for the next God Sealing Battle,
“What’s this!”
“What’s this!”
“Did it really suppress its level?”
“Really!’
Throughout the whole process, under Zavay’s surprise, Shi Yu left in satisfaction. He left with the four skills, leaving behind a lying Zavay.
These four skills were Time Acceleration, Time Deceleration, Time Reversal, and Time Stop.
Four pure time-element domain skills.
“Let me see.”
After leaving, Shi Yu immediately checked the compatibility of the four time skills and his pets.
His will first locked onto Eleven in the Beast Taming Space.
Eleven was naturally not compatible at all.
However, Shi Yu didn’t expect it to be compatible…
“Wu wu wu!”
Eleven was furious. Time-element skill. How aloof but impressive!
It could already think and react faster than time. Next, Eleven planned to train its body to exceed time.
“Ji (Ji)!” Buggy couldn’t either. Shi Yu skipped it.
In the end, Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng, who had just entered. “Oh?” Shi Yu realized that he couldn’t teach Baby Ginseng either.
Obviously, there was no compatibility.
Thinking about it carefully, it made sense. The time skills mastered by Baby Ginseng were all related to wood. They were purely time-element skills, but they had never been mastered.
“Yi??” Baby Ginseng sighed and lowered its head slightly, its green eyes revealing a depressed expression.
After working for so long, it actually couldn’t learn it. Damn it.
NO!
It wanted to study it!! It wanted to evolve!!
“Damn!” Initially, Shi Yu didn’t have much hope. Ling, who had modified itself on its own and learned Future Prediction, couldn’t control these skills either. However, when Shi Yu looked at Qi, an accident happened.
In theory, Qi, who couldn’t learn any skills other than Space-time Travel, actually had a compatibility with these four skills.
“Mimi??” In the Beast Taming Space, Qi raised its head, its eyes filled with hope.
Could it be… Maybe…
“Have you tried to learn similar skills like Time Deceleration and Time Reversal previously?” Shi Yu asked Qi.
“Yes,” Qi said. “I once tried to learn on my own, but I didn’t succeed.”
“Didn’t succeed? Perhaps it wasn’t time yet. Perhaps you can master such a pure time-element skill.” Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “You’re already different from before.”
“It’s like a newborn tiger. It’s very difficult to master fierce hunting skills, but when it reaches adulthood and learns those hunting skills, it’ll be good at it.”
“After your Space-time Travel reaches the perfect level, you’ll actually be considered a complete body in the true sense of the word. Perhaps… you’ve already undergone some changes and can learn some other skills that aren’t too overboard.’
“Of course, although these skills are also very overboard, compared to your
Time Sprite identity, they’re not too overboard.”
“Is that so?!” Qi’s eyes lit up. “Then next, can I learn more and more skills?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “From the looks of it… the skills that can be learned are mostly external skills and basic time transformation skills.”
“In short, it’s good that someone can learn the new skill replicated. I’ll teach it to you later. You can slowly study the rest.”
“Yay~~”Qi said happily.
Qi could learn new skills again. The other pets also smiled. This little guy had yet to realize anything, right?
Although Qi’s Space-time Travel was an indispensable skill in the team, it was very rare for Shi Yu and the others to use it.
However, when Qi learned the four time skills, it would be different.
“Yi.” “Ning.” Baby Ginseng and Susu looked at Qi’s happy expression and knew in their hearts that in the future, when Shi Yu added points, they could give a portion of their work to Qi…
Wasn’t Time Reversal also a proper support skill? It could directly reverse Shi Yu’s fatigue state to a period of time ago…
It could even rewind their consumption to a period of time ago…
“Yi! (Good gardener.)” Baby Ginseng nodded. Apart from that, the Time Acceleration and the other skills could also be used to assist it in cultivating various fruits. Some fruits, even if they were nutritious enough, had its wood control to accelerate their ripening. The growth period was still very long.
Apart from Buggy, there was another helper!
Obviously, the way many pets looked at Qi had changed. The young pets were still immersed in the joy of learning new skills. The mature pets were already thinking of ways to squeeze the labor of their teammates at the greatest value to make themselves stronger and easier.
Next, Shi Yu originally wanted to stay in World King City and replicate the last skill. However, he had yet to choose what this skill was.
As Shi Yu strolled around, his realm lord token sounded again. So it was someone from the battle merits bureau..

chapters.title: Chapter 1638 - 1638: Skill of Blue Planet’s Will (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1638 - 1638: Skill of Blue Planet’s Will (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Realm lord Shi Yu, your lucky star and pseudo source of transcendence are ready. We expect to reach the Dong Huang Realm in a day. Are you in your own realm?”
“Are we leaving now?” Shi Yu held the token in front of his face with two fingers on his right hand and squatted on a tall building to look at it.
“Not yet. The resources are still in World King City.”
“There’s no need to send it. Give me a spot. I’ll go get it myself. At the moment,
I’m also in World King City,” Shi Yu said.
The other party was clearly surprised before telling Shi Yu a location.
Soon, Shi Yu obtained the resources exchanged for the battle merits he had accumulated in the Contaminated Land.
Among them, the most important star of luck was stored in a transparent bottle that was like the starry sky. It was the only star floating inside. Obviously, the way the World King Planet stored stars was different from that of the cosmic overlord army.
This star was golden. Shi Yu sensed it and discovered that although the planet was lifeless, there were several Dragon Veins of Luck inside. The most powerful Dragon Vein of Luck was very high-level and didn’t have a physical body. If Shi Yu hadn’t contracted Ling, he wouldn’t have been able to sense it.
Shi Yu could confirm that most of the Dragon Veins of Luck in first-level realms on World King Planet weren’t as strong as this lucky star’s Dragon Vein of Luck.
Of course, Shi Yu only took a look before throwing the star bottle to Ling. He planned to let it find an opportunity to refine it after returning to Blue Planet.
Then, Shi Yu planned to search for prey in World King City. There were a bunch of good skills here, but he couldn’t replicate all of them. He needed to choose according to the current situation. The difficulty of choosing really relapsed.
During the search, Shi Yu didn’t forget to watch the God Sealing Battle.
It had to be said that the three emperors were too strong now. Their strength should only be one level inferior to that of Shi Yu back then. They had completely reached the level of Zavay and Ming Gu.
Apart from that, it was Senior Lu.
Apart from the three emperors, Senior Lu could be said to be the greatest dark horse in this year’s God Sealing Battle. Her limelight was close to the three emperors.
She had more skills than pets. With the support of various skills, she could only last a few minutes when she encountered the top 50 of the previous batch.
He also obtained the terrifying nickname “Black-Clothed Lu” because his
battle style was special and his attacks were too dark. Moreover, he was wearing a black trench coat… This nickname made Senior Lu want to kill the people who called him names randomly.
Blue Planet, Inatella.
At this moment, the gem cat girl was still refining the source of transcendence under the protection of the Blue Planet’s Will.
Advancing on its mother planet, be it for itself or its mother planet, had a certain number of benefits.
A planet was equivalent to a Beast Tamer, and the lives inside were equivalent to pets. When the gem cat advanced to super divine, Blue Planet would also receive a lot of feedback.
Therefore, the gem cat decisively chose to return to Blue Planet to break through.
“Things change.” At that moment, the World Tree clone standing at the top of the mountain looked at the gem cat girl and shook its head.
If it were a few months ago, it wouldn’t believe that this cat would be the next to advance to super divine.
The cat was clearly still a hooligan previously, but now, its status had leaped to the same level as Blue Planet. This was too strange.
At this moment, the Blue Planet’s Will and the World Tree also knew Shi Yu, the gem cat, and the others’ gains from this trip to the Contaminated Land…
Just one word. Ridiculous.
“Lord Mother Goddess, I knew it. Shi Yu and the others are fine. This is too awesome!” the World Tree muttered.
He went out and obtained a super divine. Wasn’t this awesome? At this moment, a blue figure appeared beside her, scaring it.
“Mother Goddess??”
Blue Planet’s Will appeared and looked at the World Tree clone. “Inform Shi Yu and the others.’
“Blue Planet has been targeted. A super divine expert with extraordinary strength is approaching Blue Planet. His strength is conservatively estimated to be above the transcendent 4. From the power source, it’s suspected to be from the same source as the Abyss Race.”
“Perhaps it’s because Shi Yu set off from Blue Planet and even destroyed an abyss super divine, causing Blue Planet to be discovered by the Dark King
Army.”
World Tree clone: ???
“What!!” It was shocked and wanted to take back its words. Shi Yu was awesome, but why did he provoke the enemy to its house?
This awesome direction was a little wrong.
It couldn’t help but look like it was about to cry. It quickly contacted Shi Yu, the Space Emperor, and the others far away on World King Planet.
At this moment, Blue Planet’s Will also left Blue Planet and flew in the starry sky, staring into the distance.
Soon after.
