In the distant starry sky, a super divine Flame Race member flying in the universe suddenly swayed, as if it had encountered a terrifying guy. It turned and left.
“Something happened to Blue Planet.”
At this moment, before the God Sealing Battle ended, Dong Huang and the other three had already displayed their aptitude in the top ten. However, at this moment, a message from Blue Planet made Shi Yu suddenly put down what he was doing and go to Blue Planet with the Space Emperor.
Blue Planet, Inatella.
After Shi Yu and the Space Emperor returned through the permanent teleportation array, the World Tree heaved a sigh of relief when it saw Shi Yu and the Space Emperor return.
“What happened to summon us in such a hurry?”
Shi Yu and the Space Emperor sensed it but didn’t sense anything unusual about the current Blue Planet.
“Mother Goddess sensed that she had been locked onto by a super divine level life form. Moreover, the other party’s aura seems to be from the Abyss Race.”
The World Tree said, “Now, it shouldn’t be close to Blue Planet yet, but soon. The other party is very strong, suspected to be above the transcendent 4.” “Did you call Emperor Shi?” Shi Yu said.
Although Emperor Shi had disappeared again, before he left, he left behind many mysterious rocks, saying that if there was an emergency and he crushed the rocks, he could immediately rush back..

chapters.title: Chapter 1639 - 1639: Skill of Blue Planet’s Will (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1639 - 1639: Skill of Blue Planet’s Will (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Not yet.” The World Tree clone shook its head.
“There’s no need to worry too much,” Shi Yu said. “If it’s the Abyss Race, I’ll be fine since 1 1 m here.’
“That’s right.” The Space Emperor nodded, but he was still a little worried. After all, he had just advanced to the super divine level, and his battle power was at most on par with those five guys…
However, just as Shi Yu and the Space Emperor were prepared for battle, a voice directly made them speechless.
“Alright, the crisis has been resolved.” At this moment, Blue Planet’s Will condensed and appeared in Inatella again.
“It’s been resolved??”
“Didn’t they say that a super divine was approaching?” Shi Yu asked.
Blue Planet’s Will said, “That’s indeed the case, but 1 called you back just in case. My will condensed and gave the other party a warning from afar. The other party left directly.”
“The battle of the super divine is very important. Even if it’s an enemy relationship, as long as one isn’t 100% confident, they usually won’t carry it out easily.”
“It’s good that you’re fine.” The Space Emperor heaved a sigh of relief. Emperor Shi had handed Blue Planet to him to protect. If something transcendent happened, he really didn’t know what to do.
Although he didn’t even see the enemy, the Space Emperor broke out in cold sweat. The corners of his mouth twitched as he looked at Shi Yu, who didn’t take it seriously.
This super divine… was most likely summoned by Shi Yu.
Probably because of Benos’s death, the other super divines of the Dark King Army came to take a look at the situation here.
“Damn it, the source of transcendence was scared away…”
Blue Planet and the Space Emperor: “?”
“Forget it. Although the enemy has left, let’s stay on Blue Planet next. It’s safer,” Shi Yu said. “Perhaps it will return.”
“Yes, I have the same intention. Although I can also fight, if I fight, 1 won’t be able to protect the lives on the planet with all my might. It’s very difficult to do both, so I still have to rely on you,” the Blue Planet’s Will said.
“Oh?” At this moment, Shi Yu was slightly stunned, as if he had finally thought of something.
He suddenly looked at the Blue Planet’s Will, his gaze making the Blue Planet’s Will very uncomfortable.
“I’ve decided.” After Shi Yu made a choice, he finally decided what to replicate with the fifth skill.
He wanted to teach Little Zi an attack skill. He shouldn’t look for the participants of the World King Star. Although there were also third-level realm lords among the participants of the God Sealing Battle who had contracted stars that mastered the power of attack, Shi Yu didn’t fancy ordinary attack skills either. They weren’t suitable for Little Zi.
He didn’t even fancy what the Space Emperor’s Floating Planet had mastered.
There weren’t many powerful planets, but Shi Yu happened to be able to find a suitable one now. That was Blue Planet. After all, it was the reincarnation of a
cosmic-level star. It definitely had many trump cards. Otherwise, it would have been impossible for it to resist the three super divines at the peak of the divine level.
“Lord Blue Planet, you’re free anyway. Why don’t you help me take care of the baby?”
“Speaking of which, this guy can be considered half your daughter.”
“After it’s stronger, it can guard you like a satellite.”
Shi Yu stretched out his hand and summoned the purple white rice ball. When Little Zi saw the World Tree and the Blue Planet’s Will, it immediately revealed a friendly gaze.
After all… it was born through the branch liquid of Blue Planet.
“Mi! Little Zi acknowledged its kin.
“After I became the realm lord of the World King Planet, I originally wanted to find some suitable star attack skills to give to it, but those that are publicly given to the realm lord are too ordinary.”
[Space Emperor: Indeed.]
“Do you have any suitable divine powers to teach it?” Shi Yu said.
The World Tree and Blue Planet’s Will were silent.
So that was the case.
“If I remember correctly, you also contracted a star, right?” Blue Planet’s Will looked at the Space Emperor and said, “How about this? I’ll teach them the same skill, but I can’t guarantee that they can learn this skill.”
“This skill is the skill that scared away that super divine just now. It’s also a skill that allows Blue Planet to withstand the invasion war.’
“Thank you, Mother Goddess!” The Space Emperor felt pleasantly surprised.
Blue Planet was now a super divine planet. In her previous life, it was suspected to be a cosmic-level star. The skills she comprehended were definitely not weak.
“Great,” Shi Yu said.
Blue Planet’s Will looked at the sky and said, “This skill is called the ‘Star
Contract’. It’s actually very similar to the Beast Taming Contract of humans.” “Star Contract?” The Space Emperor pondered for a moment and confirmed that he had never heard of this skill in the Cosmic Sea.
This should be a skill that belonged to Blue Planet alone.
“Well, I can actually sign a contract with other lives like human Beast Tamers.”
“However, after signing the contract, the one summoned isn’t the life form’s main body.”
“On the other hand, I can materialize the power projection of my contractor by consuming the power of the world. The projection conjured depends on the power of the world consumed. It has strength close to, comparable to, or exceeds the main body. It’s not afraid of death and doesn’t have the concept of life and death.’
“Just now, 1 summoned the projections of Emperor Shi, the super divines of the five divine races, and the others and added my own power to scare the other party away.”
“Back then, Blue Planet could resist the three super divine invaders because the perfect gods of Blue Planet had made a Star Contract with me. As long as I consumed the power of the world at all costs, I could summon their immortal power projections. This skill once brought quite a lot of trouble to the three invaders.’
When the Blue Planet’s Will finished speaking, Shi Yu and the Space Emperor were stunned.
Shi Yu said, “When did you contract with Emperor Shi and the others? Why didn’t I know?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1640 - 1640: Skill of Blue Planet’s Will (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1640 - 1640: Skill of Blue Planet’s Will (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Emperor Kong said, “l…”
Why didn’t it contract with him? Did it look down on his power projection?
Blue Planet’s Will shook its head and said, “There are some restrictions to the Star Contract. For example, the upper limit of the number of contracts is 10. At that time, you had yet to grow to super divine battle power.”0
“Do you want to learn it?”
“Mimi!! (Learn, learn!)” Little Zi’ s eyes lit up.
What kind of abnormal skill was this?
Little Zi had already started to imagine summoning their power projections to fight after signing a contract with Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng.
She, Little Zi, was known as Little Shi Yu!
“It’s very similar to phantom illusions.” Shi Yu also fell into deep thought. However, it should be higher than the upper limit of phantom illusions.
At this moment, the Space Emperor clearly realized the power of this skill. He took a deep breath and nodded heavily.
Then. the Space Emperor first ran back to the World King Planet and retracted
the Floating Planet outside the World King Planet. He returned to Blue Planet and released the Floating Planet outside Blue Planet.
Shi Yu also temporarily entrusted Little Zi to the Blue Planet’s Will to let Little Zi learn the Star Contract skill in peace.
This skill was undoubtedly an attack skill. It looked like a contract, but on the outside, it was written in a distorted manner: pulling external help+group fight+cheating.
Apart from Little Zi who wanted to learn, Shi Yu also let Ling out and let it refine the lucky star. Apart from that, Susu originally wanted to learn Cold Silence, but because he was worried that the enemy of the Dark King Army would attack again, Shi Yu didn’t let it learn for the time being.
Skill: Cold Silence
[Learning Method]: It has an ice-element and time-element physique. Through refining a star, it will refine a star that has been corroded by Cold Silence and contains the power of Cold Silence into a resource that is compatible with it. Then, through Infinite Devour, it will devour this resource. During the digestion process, there is a chance of successfully comprehending it. The success rate of learning depends on the user’s talent and comprehension.
In fact, when Shi Yu was exchanging the ice and snow stars that had been corroded by the Cold Silence disaster, he had yet to use the index to deduce the learning method of Cold Silence.
Refining the Cold Silence Star and planning to let Susu evolve through the
Infinite Devour Devour and combine it with the upgrade skill of the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy was all Shi Yu’s own speculation. To Shi Yu!s surprise, the method deduced by the index was the same as his deduction. This made Shi Yu feel helpless. He felt that he had wasted his physical strength for no reason.
In this learning method, Shi Yu estimated that the process of devouring the planet would definitely consume a lot of time. After all, the target of devour was a divine-level star, so the current situation wasn’t suitable for Susu to devour and sleep.
It would be bad if the enemy attacked while she was sleeping.
Of course, Shi Yu had also thought of a way to shorten the time. That was to increase the proficiency of Star Refinement, Infinite Devour, and Heavenly Frost Cold Energy.
However, this kind of thing wasn’t urgent. At the moment, there were more important things to do on Blue Planet.
Apart from Shi Yu and the Space Emperor, who came immediately, the super divines of the Dark King Army also descended on Blue Planet one by one.
After understanding the situation a little, the Phoenix Race super divine said,
“Why don’t Blue Planet start moving?”
“It’s still not as safe as in the Cosmic Sea in this border area.’
The dragon super divine said, “That’s right. Blue Planet is in a period of high-speed development. After the development stabilizes and the speed decreases, it’s not too late to leave the Cosmic Sea and go to the undeveloped star area to collect resources.’
Soon, they also planned to return to Blue Planet to cultivate in seclusion… Who could withstand super divine attacks at every turn?
“We agree too.” Emperor Kong and Shi Yu had no objections.
The current Blue Planet wasn’t in urgent need of resources to develop and had no choice but to open up its own territory.
Only by developing steadily in the Cosmic Sea could the benefits be maximized.
“Alright, the Cosmic Sea?” Blue Planet’s Will looked at the starry sky, looking forward to meeting other high-level stars and even the World King Planet.
“Cosmic Sea! However, there’s no hurry to set off.”
“Wait another month!” Shi Yu laughed and scratched his head. “l still have something to do in this Star Domain…”
“Don’t tell me you want to wait for that super divine to come again and detonate the source of transcendence?” The Space Emperor was silent.
“How could this be! It’s a ruin, a ruin!”
Before leaving, Shi Yu had a place he had to go to. It was the Chi You Ruins that Goddess Wa mentioned. If Blue Planet left the existing coordinates and he couldn’t enter the era ruins, Shi Yu would have nowhere to cry.
Therefore, after preparing, Shi Yu arrived at the coordinates Goddess Wa mentioned. Dong Huang Continent, Divine Capital!
Buggy had evolved into the Butterfly of Imagination and participated in the Butterfly Meeting.
He realized that the location of the Chi You Ruins was coincidentally in the crowded Divine Capital University. This was troublesome…
“From the looks of it, the ancient words similar to an ancient language on Earth discovered in the Ancient Capital should have been circulated from other era ruins.” When Shi Yu walked into Divine Capital University, it was noon..

chapters.title: Chapter 1641 - 1641: Chi You Ruins (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1641 - 1641: Chi You Ruins (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
As it was noon, the school was very lively. The students who had just finished class went to eat or bought delivery food…
Shi Yu walked in the crowd. What made Shi Yu very uncomfortable was that no student recognized him.
Did he become handsome again recently?
Or did the students think that it was impossible for God Shi Yu to appear here and not dare greet him?
When Shi Yu shook his head, he was suddenly stunned. This was because he discovered two familiar figures passing by.
One was a beautiful woman in a butterfly-patterned cheongsam, and the other was a young woman in a black and white panda outfit. They passed by and chatted and laughed, not paying attention to their surroundings. They were paid more attention than Shi Yu. Vaguely, they could hear students whispering about “Hua Xiajin legend” and “Lin Xiuzhu legend”.
This made Shi Yu’s face darken. Damn, when did Senior Panda become more famous than him? He trembled in anger. When could a male Beast Tamer stand up… Of course, Shi Yu judged that even if President Lin and Divine Source Legendary stood here, these students wouldn’t be able to recognize them.
“Senior Panda.” In short, Shi Yu didn’t expect Lin Xiuzhu to be here either. He subconsciously shouted.
This voice made Legend Hua and Lin Xiuzhu suddenly stop. Lin Xiuzhu revealed a puzzled expression. Senior Panda?
What was this title? Why was this voice so familiar?
She turned to look at Shi Yu. At this moment, Shi Yu only wanted to slap himself.
He accidentally said what was on his mind.
Senior Panda, was that something you could call randomly?
“Cough, Senior Lin, why are you here?” Shi Yu tried to remedy the situation and waved as if nothing had happened.
“Shi Yu???” Lin Xiuzhu and Legend Hua looked at the young man in front of them in surprise. Similarly, they didn’t expect Shi Yu to appear at Divine Capital University.
“Holy shit, Shi Yu??” At this moment, a passerby finally noticed Shi Yu and spoke in shock. It was even more strange than seeing a mythical creature descend. Pairs of big eyes landed on Shi Yue
“Shi Yu!! It’s a living Shi Yu!!”
That day.
The number one trending topic on the Dong Huang Network became Shi Yu’s shocking appearance at Divine Capital University.
As for the second trending topic… Heavenly King Zou fought the Rongguang exchange team alone and won a huge victory against the legendary Knight of Rongguang!
In a quiet garden in Divine Capital University, Shi Yu snapped his fingers and teleported Senior Lu, Legend Hua, and himself here. The roadside just now was clearly not suitable for communication.
“Let’s teleport. There are too many people over there.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Aunt Hua, Senior Lin, you haven’t said anything yet. Why are you here?”
Senior Panda smiled and said, “l also want to know why you’re here… Aunt
Hua and I were invited to help.”
“Yeah, Shi Yu, it’s more strange for you to appear in such a place, right?” Hua Xiajin’s legend smiled and said, “Even if you appear in a university, shouldn’t it be Ancient Capital University? Or are you specially here to find Xiu Zhu?” Senior Panda was speechless. “How is that possible?”
Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment and said, “Actually, there’s a special ruin at Divine Capital University. I came to take a look.”
“Well, but from the looks of it, there seem to be a little too many people here. I’ll have to trouble the principal to give the students here a week off first. After all, I can’t guarantee if anything will happen here next.” He touched his chin and fell into deep thought.
The era ruin… The era ruin suspected to be a battlefield wasn’t easy to deal with.
“Ruin?” Lin Xiuzhu said, “What ruins are there now that can interest you?”
She had heard from Senior Lu that even the Mythical Ruins on Blue Planet made Shi Yu lose interest.
“It’s related to the origin of the Iron-eating Beast. It’s the real origin, not the recognized one in the archeological world now,” Shi Yu said.
“Huh???” The panda senior was stunned. “Iron-eating Beast? Really?”
“Of course. Do you want to take a look together?” Shi Yu smiled. He knew that this guy would definitely be interested after saying it.
At this moment, Senior Panda and Legend Hua looked at each other and fell into deep thought.
“Shi Yu, where did you get the news?” Senior Lin asked.
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but be curious when he saw Senior Lin so surprised.
“Actually, we came this time to solve a supernatural incident related to the Iron-eating Beast,” Lin Xiuzhu said.
“Therefore, when I heard you mention the Iron-eating Beast, I was wondering if it was related to the Iron-eating Beast Ruins you mentioned.”
Shi Yu was surprised. “Tell me in detail, what happened to you?”
The panda senior said, “Probably not long ago, Divine Capital University had a
Beast Tamer who contracted an Iron-eating Beast. He often had strange dreams.’
“In the strange dream, he dreamed that he had become a soldier riding an Iron-eating Beast. Then, he went to the battlefield and was killed.” “Generally speaking, normal people will only think that this is an ordinary nightmare, but then, there were several Beast Tamers who contracted Iron-eating Beasts in Divine Capital University who had such dreams.
Moreover, after they woke up, they were very tired.”
“Divine Capital University hired a mental doctor and also carefully checked
Divine Capital University, but they didn’t find anything unusual.”
“Then, Divine Capital University gave these students a collective leave. During the holidays, they didn’t have this strange dream, but after returning, a new round of dreams began…”
“During this period, Divine Capital University also studied it themselves and hired other Iron-eating Beast Tamers to stay in the school. The outcome was the same. These Beast Tamers also had similar dreams..

chapters.title: Chapter 1642 - 1642: Chi You Ruins (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1642 - 1642: Chi You Ruins (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“However, because these Beast Tamers aren’t strong, they almost can’t remember what happened in the dream. Their memories are very vague.”
“This kind of thing is really strange. In the end, the old principal of Divine Capital University came to me and Aunt Hua. After all, I’m now the recognized strongest Iron-eating Beast Tamer in Dong Huang apart from you and Senior Emperor Wu.” Lin Xiuzhu smiled.
“And the new Dream God Butterfly cultivated by Aunt Hua also has extraordinary attainments in the Dream Dao. In addition, she’s an honorary principal of Divine Capital University… So we came to take a look.”
“Is that so?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
He closed his eyes slightly and sensed the current situation of Divine Capital University, but he didn’t feel anything.
“Did you discover anything?” asked the panda senior.
“We might still need to investigate further,” Shi Yu said. “You’ve never entered that dream, right?”
Lin Xiuzhu shook his head and said, “l only arrived today. I just understood the situation and haven’t started the investigation with Aunt Hua.”
“Aunt Hua, I think I know what’s going on with this matter. Let me join the investigation too.”
Legend Hua Xiajin smiled and said, “I’m relieved to have you. Initially, I was still worried about whether I could help my old friend solve this matter, but now that you’re taking action, it should be able to be resolved perfectly soon,
“After all, you’re the strongest Beast Tamer on Blue Planet.”
Shi Yu smiled bitterly. “This matter… has already exceeded the scope of Blue Planet. In fact, it has already exceeded the scope of this cosmic era. It’s better to be serious.’
Even Goddess Wa only said that there was a high chance of him cracking it, not 100%.
Legend Hua and Senior Panda were stunned.
What did he mean?
“In short, don’t try it on your own next. Be my assistant and act with me.”
Shi Yu guessed that Blue Planet had upgraded and broken through Goddess Wa’ s seal on the era ruin.
After all, when Goddess Wa sealed this ruin, it was only a top-notch divine.
The strange dream was the leakage of the power of this era ruin that affected the surroundings.
“Alright!” Lin Xiuzhu immediately said, “Assistants are fine too, as long as you bring us along!’
“Yes, but you have to listen to my command.”
“Firstly, Aunt Hua, let the principal of Divine Capital University clear the place first.’
“Alright.” Legend Hua nodded.
Soon, when he learned that Shi Yu had taken action, the principal of Divine Capital University was flattered. He immediately followed Shi Yu t s request and gave all the teachers and students a month off. During this period, the school was sealed and no life was allowed to appear in Divine Capital University.
Even the guardian and guardian overlord of Divine Capital University were sent flying…
After that, the principal of Divine Capital University immediately slipped away, leaving Divine Capital University City, which was larger than a second-level city, to Shi Yu, Lin Xiuzhu, and the others.
“Shi Yu, what kind of ruin is it?” Senior Panda couldn’t help but ask.
At this moment, Shi Yu and Lin Xiuzhu had already strolled to a back mountain of Divine Capital University. As for Legend Hua, under Shi Yu’s entrustment, she tried her best to disperse the residents around Divine Capital
University City and temporarily arrange for them to be elsewhere. Shi Yu got Buggy to casually create a mystic realm space that they could stay in and imagined a bunch of villas.
“Senior, have you heard of it? The universe will be destroyed and reborn every 10 billion years. Then, a new reincarnation will begin,” Shi Yu said. “This reincarnation is called a cosmic epoch.”
Lin Xiuzhu shook her head. She had been nurturing the Panda Army and was only at Level 8 now. She didn’t know much about things outside Blue Planet.
“The Iron-eating Beast Race actually existed on Blue Planet in the last cosmic era more than 10 billion years ago.”
“The origin is so far away?” Lin Xiuzhu was shocked.
“It’s alright, and no one can say for sure if the last cosmic era was the true origin,” Shi Yu said. “Next, the ruin I’m going to explore is the era ruin that survived the last era until now!”
“It’s said that it’s a battlefield ruin.’
“It was born from a battle between a powerful Beast Tamer who controlled a
Creation God Dragon and a powerful Beast Tamer who controlled an
Iron-eating Beast Corps.”
“According to the clues I understand, only humans who have contracted pets of specific races have any hope of entering this ruin.”
“Among them, the Iron-eating Beast is one of the specific races.”
“l reckon that those Beast Tamers who had strange dreams were affected by this battlefield ruin.’
“Gulp.” Lin Xiuzhu’s beautiful eyes widened. She finally knew why Shi Yu liked to explore ruins so much. Now, her curiosity had already been aroused by Shi Yu’s few words.
At this moment, if Shi Yu left her to explore the ruins, she would be extremely curious.
“Then what should we do next! Lin Xiuzhu was already eager to give it a try.
“Well, I just took a look. The main body of the ruins is still sealed by a seal. Although the seal has loosened, 1 don’t plan to break it immediately at the moment. It would be fine if it were elsewhere, but this is a big city after all. No one knows what kind of impact the ruins of the era will bring.”
“l plan to passively let the ruins affect me through entering the dream first and see if I can find any clues before making a decision.”
“This method should have the least impact on us and the outside world. At most, we’ll be a little tired after waking up like those students.”
“So, you mean that I’ll hug Flower first and you hug Eleven. We’ll sleep first and let the power leaking from the era ruin pull us into the Dream Battlefield like those students?” Lin Xiuzhu asked.
“That’s right.” Shi Yu stretched out his hand, and an apple-sized panda appeared in his hand.
When it sat in Shi Yu’s palm, Eleven yawned. It first looked around cautiously before greeting Lin Xiuzhu with a cry.
“Flower, come out too.’
On Senior Lin’s side, she also summoned her Iron-eating Beast. It had already reached the invincible overlord level, the panda named Flower that had evolved into the Demon God Iron-eating Beast.
It was also in a restrained state at this moment. It was still so cute. After being restrained, it didn’t have the posture of a Demon God at all.
“Wu wu wu!” Eleven greeted again.
“Wuu!” Lin Xiuzhu!s Iron-eating Beast was also very surprised to see Eleven.
“When Aunt Hua is almost done preparing, let’s eat the Cultivation Fruit and sleep,” Shi Yu said.
“Ah.” Lin Xiuzhu was stunned. “Eat that thing to sleep…?”
Shi Yu said, “Of course, the Cultivation Fruit can increase comprehension and learning ability. Eat it and sleep. If we encounter any special things in the dream world, we can comprehend and learn faster.”
“l see.” Lin Xiuzhu was still a little nervous. “But 1 forgot to take the neutralizer.’
“What’s that?”
“Eat it with the Cultivation Fruit. It’s my favorite drink that can slightly resist the taste…
Shi Yu was speechless.
When it was about time, Shi Yu carried Eleven and Lin Xiuzhu carried Flower. Both parties found a place in Divine Capital University and ate the Cultivation Fruit, planning to enter a sleep state.
Even at the peak of the super divine level, they couldn’t see the source of the power of the era ruins. Therefore, Shi Yu and the others could only investigate step by step.
Because of the Cultivation Fruit, Shi Yu and the others quickly fell asleep…
In his blurry consciousness, Shi Yu gradually opened his eyes. However, due to his powerful control over his body, Shi Yu knew that this was a dream.
After opening his eyes, he realized that he was in a military tent.
“I see. In this dream world, I became a soldier who really existed in the last era but was already dead. A character? Then what about you?”
Shi Yu looked at the panda lying on the ground. The panda also opened its eyes and howled.
It was clearly Eleven.
Apart from Eleven, the current Shi Yu couldn’t sense any connection with other pets. Fortunately, he could sense that his and Eleven’s level power was still there. That was alright…
No wonder those students from Divine Capital University died the moment they entered. With their strength, it would be strange if they could survive the battle between Ying Long and Chi You..

chapters.title: Chapter 1643 - 1643: Battle of the Era (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1643: Battle of the Era (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
In the dream world.
Shi Yu shook his head.
For him, this seemed to be a lucid dream.
As expected, under the circumstances where he deliberately controlled, the stronger the mental strength, the harder it was to lose himself in the dream.
Now, he could freely control his movements and state.
However, the premise of everything was that it couldn’t exceed his original strength.
“Eleven, let’s go find your big sister first,” Shi Yu immediately said to Eleven after confirming that he could break free from the dream at any time.
“Wuu!” Eleven nodded heavily.
Shi Yu brought Eleven out of the tent and fell into deep thought.
This was clearly a huge camp, but at this moment, the camp was extremely desolate. There were injured soldiers everywhere, and their morale was extremely desolate.
The hot sun shone on the dry ground.
Perhaps it was because of his dream, but Shi Yu was in the best state among this group of people.
“Go there.” Shi Yu saw many Iron-eating Beasts in this army.
Apart from the Iron-eating Beasts, there were also tigers, leopards, and other beasts. Their forms were strange.
They were suspected to be mutated beasts from ancient times on Earth. Shi Yu had seen these guys in ancient books.
He and Eleven came to a crippled soldier leaning against the wall. The other party and his mount, the Iron-eating Beast, were both on the verge of death.
He and Eleven realized that the pets here weren’t very strong, but the soldiers were strong and strong. Every ferocious beast’s physical strength was comparable to that of a demigod.
This made Shi Yu ponder slightly. He felt that the state of “Beast Shi Yu” seemed to be a little similar to these people. They all had super physical strength.
However, Shi Yu also sensed other special powers on them. It wasn’t just physical strength.
“Eleven, treat him.” At Shi Yu’s request, Eleven used the Light Control to help the crippled soldier illuminate his injuries. Soon, the half-conscious soldier recovered a lot and opened his eyes weakly.
“Doctor?” he muttered.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“We lost. We lost. Even if we recover, we won’t be able to reverse the situation…” He covered his eyes weakly and said in pain, “However, we can still fight…”
Just as he finished speaking, his eyes suddenly widened because the violent sound of the thunder drum suddenly sounded.
Bang, bang, bang, bang!!
The thunderous drumbeat made a high voice come from inside the broken army.
“The enemy is attacking, prepare to fight! !! ”
Under the high voice, the soldiers, regardless of their injuries, got up with difficulty.
It was the same for Shi Yu and the soldier who had just been treated by Eleven. His expression was ferocious as he shouted, “Let’s fight.”
With that said, he looked at his Iron-eating Beast. Under his gaze, the Iron-eating Beast’s entire body immediately lingered with black and white light. It directly turned into a spear under Shi Yu and Eleven’s noses and was grabbed by the soldier.
“This is…” When Shi Yu saw this, he quickly looked around.
Some beast-type creatures that should have been mounts turned into weapons under the control of this group of crippled soldiers.
Blades, spears, swords, armors, and big crossbows.
Of course, there were also those that didn’t change and were rode under by the soldiers.
Now, with weapons in hand, this group of crippled soldiers immediately descended like divine weapons, their auras increasing greatly.
Boom.
However, compared to the thunderclap coming from afar, the morale here was still much weaker.
At this moment, many clouds suddenly appeared in the originally clear sky. In the clouds, a light rain gradually fell, and the figure of a winged divine dragon was vaguely visible.
“Not good, it’s Ying Long!!!”
Seeing this divine dragon phantom, the crippled soldiers below were shocked.
“Chi You, why aren’t you surrendering?”
Four figures appeared in the clouds behind the divine dragon. Three men and a woman rode the clouds and appeared in the sky, shouting at the remaining soldiers below.
At the same time, behind them, a vast army charged towards the remaining army with the war drums. It was pitch-black.
“Hahahaha.” Accompanied by a loud laugh, a strong man from god knows where looked at the sky from the ground.
His ears were like a sword, and he had a horn on his head. Several divine beasts followed beside him, and one of them was an Iron-eating Beast that Shi Yu was familiar with.
Before the burly man could say a word, he charged forward. The Iron-eating Beast directly turned into a black demonic saber in front of Shi Yu like other ferocious beasts. It was held in the burly man’s hand and let out a demonic roar.
Boom.
In the sky, the aura of Ying Long and the Demon Blade resisted each other, instantly overturning the world. The army below also attacked the other party under the protection of the Bosses of both parties.
“They’re fighting just like that?” Shi Yu exclaimed and retreated repeatedly. He naturally had no intention of joining the battle.
He kept searching to see if there were any “soldiers who didn’t fight” similar to him, but he realized that he didn’t see any soldiers suspected to be Senior Lin and Flower.
“Wait…”
“l subconsciously judged that everyone will enter the same dream, but it’s also possible that everyone will enter a different dream world.”
“Therefore, it’s understandable that we can’t find Senior Lin here. I have a contract with Eleven, but not with Senior Panda…
Realizing this, Shi Yu looked at Eleven and said, “Let’s find a safe place to watch the battle first.’
“Roar, roar.” At this moment, Eleven nodded crazily. In the sky, Ying Long controlled the storm and displayed an invincible aura, giving Eleven the feeling that it was an epoch god.
As for the burly man holding the demon saber formed by the Iron-eating Beast, he was also very powerful. With a slash, he split open the wind, rain, and sky. The two parties quickly started an intense battle..

chapters.title: Chapter 1644 - 1644: Battle of the Era (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1644 - 1644: Battle of the Era (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu, who only had Eleven beside him at the moment, indeed couldn’t interfere in a battle of this level.
After all, after breaking through to the divine level, Eleven had yet to add points. At this moment, it only had high-level divine battle power. Even with his strengthening, it was still very far from super divine battle power.
“Troublesome.’
Everyone was fighting. Shi Yu originally only wanted to observe and didn’t want to join, but the soldiers from Ying Longs side didn’t care.
Shi Yu and the others were weak to begin with, and there were very few people. Soon, an enemy army locked onto Shi Yu and Eleven and charged over.
“There’s someone over there!”
This group of people didn’t control wild beasts. They all revealed powerful auras and attacked with weapons.
“Eleven, finish them,” Shi Yu called. Eleven nodded and knocked the other party out with a thought. The soldiers of Emperor Huang Army immediately fell to the ground with white eyes and white foam coming out of their mouths.
“Interesting, don’t be anxious.” Shi Yu took a deep breath, his eyes shining.
He and Eleven were digging deeper into the power system mastered by the Chi You Army in the dream world.
Although Shi Yu and Eleven didn’t inherit the memories of the two dream illusions, under their hard memories and their observation of the battles of the other soldiers, some special feelings still made them understand something.
Soon, they entered a state of “enlightenment”.
The Cultivation Fruit fused with the Time Fruit, the World Tree Fruit, and other powers. The enhancement to the learning ability in the dream was very huge.
When he first saw the soldiers of the Chi You Army transforming their pets into weapons, Shi Yu originally thought that this was a Beast Taming Talent.
On Blue Planet and World King Planet, there was also such a Beast Taming Talent that could turn pets into weapons, armors, and other equipment.
However, after careful identification, Shi Yu discovered the difference between the two. The ability mastered by the Chi You Army should be higher.
Compared to the traditional weaponization Beast Taming Talent, these beast soldiers of the Chi You Army were stronger. Their weapons bodies combined all the abilities of their pets and refined them into a divine weapon. A casual attack was the ultimate profundity sublimated by the fusion of all the pets’ skills.
In other words, if Shi Yu mastered the traditional soldierization talent and turned Eleven into a weapon, Eleven’s skill wouldn’t change much. Not only might it not be able to increase, but it might also be restricted by its new form and be unable to perfectly display its original strength.
However, the soldier power mastered by the soldiers of the Chi You Army allowed the pet to fuse all its power and form a perfect divine weapon. Not only would the pet not be burdened by its form, but it could also make itself stronger.
With one attack, it would be the fusion of multiple divine skills.
“Is this the true ultimate skill of the weapon master, the God of Arms?” Shi Yu looked at the two parties fighting and thought to himself. No wonder the myths and legends said that Emperor Huang had already lost nine times to Chi You before he obtained the help of Ying Long.
Although these crippled soldiers looked miserable, they should be elites of the Nine Li Horde. Otherwise, it was impossible for them to use this powerful divine power so proficiently.
[l have to learn this ability.] Shi Yu made up his mind.
This skill was very strong. After mastering this, it was equivalent to letting the pet fuse all the skills into a super combination skill. The increase in strength would definitely be a qualitative change.
This ability was several times more impressive than the combination of the four holy equipment worn by Beast Shi Yu.
The four holy equipment was equivalent to an additional skill.
And this soldier divine skill was equivalent to multiplication.
At the moment, Chi Tongs Immortal Slaying Sword Formation was the most luxurious combination skill in the team. It was made of a total of eight divine skills. Chi Tong had used all its skills, so its power was naturally needless to say.
However, apart from Chi Tong, the strongest combination skills of the other pets couldn’t be used all the skills. However, with this divine power, every pet should be able to do similar things to Chi Tong. This increase in strength was undoubtedly huge.
However, at the moment, Eleven and Shi Yu could only learn with difficulty through “seeing”, “recalling”, and “enlightenment”. Without systematic teaching, it was still too difficult to learn in this chaotic battle.
“Wuu!” Eleven summoned the Eight Trigrams Bean Bear clone and let them protect itself and Shi Yu to comprehend and learn.
After an unknown period of time, the voice gradually fell. Apart from Shi Yu and the others, all the other Chi You soldiers seemed to have been killed. In the sky, Chi You, who was fighting Ying Long, had already been beheaded.
In the rain, it was already a rain of blood.
“I’m indignant…” In the sky, Chi You, who was beheaded, could still roar. Its expression was tragic, and it clearly couldn’t accept its failure.
As he roared, his powerful obsession with victory even changed the rules, forcing Ying Long and the other divine beasts to retreat and not dare to approach.
“Huh? Wait, there’s someone else.’
At this moment, the people in the clouds seemed to have discovered Shi Yu and the others. They immediately ordered Ying Long to deal with them.
“Roar!!” In the sky, the golden dragon swung its claws down. Shi Yu and Eleven suddenly opened their eyes.
“Damn it, the time is too short. There’s no time at all.’
“Wuu!!!” Eleven condensed its strongest power and activated One Thought of God and Demon at the same time to resist, but it was no match for it at all.
Soon, even Shi Yu and the others were slapped to death like the other Chi You Army soldiers.
“Hu…e
In reality, Shi Yu and Eleven, who had been dreaming, suddenly opened their eyes and broke out in cold sweat. They felt that their bodies were even weaker than after adding points many times..

chapters.title: Chapter 1645 - 1645: Battle of the Era (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1645 - 1645: Battle of the Era (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
It looked like maintaining a lucid dream consumed a lot of energy.
“You’re awake.” At this moment, a gentle voice came from the side. Shi Yu looked over and realized that Senior Panda woke up earlier than him. She was also haggard and drenched in sweat. She was clearly shocked by the scene in the dream.
“Senior, are you alright?” “I’m fine.’
“As long as you’re fine.”
Shi Yu said, “Do you still have any impression of what you experienced in the dream?”
The panda senior said, “Well, I seem to have become a logistics unit in the army that takes care of the iron-eating beasts. Then, I heard a drumbeat and the war began. Flower and I were no match for those soldiers at all. We were quickly killed and woke up.”
“Is that so…” Shi Yu said, “Did you see a battle between a dragon and an Iron-eating Beast?”
“No…” The panda senior was stunned.
“l understand.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Wu wu vvu!!!” At this moment, Eleven was still sulking at the side. Clearly, it was very unconvinced by the outcome of its crushing.
“Looks like the situation everyone experiences after entering the dream is different.’
Shi Yu felt that what he had experienced should be the final battle between Emperor Huang and Chi You. Ying Long had helped Emperor Huang kill Chi
You.
At this moment, the Chi You Army was a beaten army in total collapse. The soldiers didn’t have much strength left.
However, what Senior Panda experienced should still be the previous battle.
When it came to Shi Yu, all the logistics troops would have long been gone.
“Did you discover anything useful?” Senior Panda asked. “I discovered that the Iron-eating Beast evolution system over there is different from ours. Apart from that… the human cultivation system seems to be different from ours.”
“Every soldier… is very strong.”
“Yes, I roughly know how this era ruin was born,” Shi Yu said.
Next, Shi Yu recounted what he had experienced in the ruins to Senior Panda.
“On both sides of the war, one is Emperor Huang, and the other is Chi You. The outcome of the battle is Chi You’s death.”
“However, because Chi You is very strong, he developed an unwilling obsession with the outcome of his death. His obsession turned into an era ruin.”
“Therefore, if you want this ruin to not affect the outside world and crack the ruin, the way is to unlock Chi You’s obsession and help him defeat the Ying Long that killed him in the obsession world.”
“This…” Senior Panda was shocked. “Can you do that? Didn’t you say that you and Eleven were also instantly…”
“Wu wu wu!”
Shi Yu scratched his head with both hands and said, “This is actually not the main thing.”
“The main thing is that this dream world isn’t simple. Although it’s only formed by the obsession of an expert, the composition of the entire illusory world has many inheritances from the last era.”
“Just like the different evolution paths of the Iron-eating Beasts you’ve seen, the strange skills mastered by the soldiers… might be able to be learned.”
“In the Dream World, Eleven and I tried to learn the power system of the previous era, but because the time was too short, we didn’t succeed.”
“Of course, if I successfully unseal Chi You’s obsession, I might be able to obtain greater benefits. However, it’s not easy. It’s even harder than the one I mentioned,” Shi Yu said.
“Then… what should we do next?” the panda senior said.
“Of course it’s to try to crack it,” Shi Yu said. “Senior, you’re still relatively awake in the dream, right?”
“Yes.” Senior Panda nodded
Shi Yu said, “How about this? Next, enter the dream ruins one or two times a day. I’ll get Baby Ginseng to provide you with enough World Tree Fruits, Cultivation Fruits, and spiritual nourishing food.”
“Help me as much as possible to collect useful information and the power system of the last era in the ruins world.”
“Finally, pass your learning results to me through Susu’s inheritance water drop.”
“What about you?” asked the panda senior.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “You’ve realized, right? After we enter the dream world, our real strength can be incorporated.”
“Although it’s only a portion of strength… related to the Iron-eating Beast.” Shi Yu looked at Eleven.
“But it’s enough, so I wonder if I can enter the ruins again after increasing my strength in the outside world and see if I can defeat that Ying Long and crack the ruins.”
“I have a way to quickly increase Eleven’s strength, but this way, I can’t be distracted from entering the ruins to explore in the short term. I need someone to help me enter the ruins to collect information to avoid wasting too much time.”
“Alright.” Senior Panda didn’t doubt that Shi Yu couldn’t do it. She said, “Then we’ll do as you say.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “I’ll do it as soon as possible. If you feel any discomfort after entering the dream multiple times, you can stop at any time. However, with Baby Ginseng’s supplements, it shouldn’t be a problem.”
“Yes,” the panda senior said. “But I really didn’t expect the Iron-eating Beast Corps of the last era to be so strong.”
“Of course,” Shi Yu said. “But if you can gain anything, Senior, you should be able to use it on the Iron-eating Beast Corps of this era.”
“Oh right.” Senior Panda’s eyes lit up. Entering the ruins to explore many times seemed to be an opportunity to increase her Enhancement strength. If she and Flower could also learn the power system of the last era, she would definitely be able to achieve good results in world competitions. She might not be inferior to Senior Emperor Wu, Senior Lu, and the others…

chapters.title: Chapter 1646 - 1646: Battle of the Era (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1646 - 1646: Battle of the Era (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Wait, do you want to call Junior Bai, Senior Emperor Wu, and the others to explore together? This way, the progress might be faster,” said Senior Panda.
“Senior Emperor Wu is fighting the God Sealing Battle. It’ll probably take another half a month to end. Senior White Brook’s strength is about the same as yours… Forget it,” Shi Yu said impoverished. “Baby Ginseng still has to assist Eleven in its cultivation. There are too many people exploring. Its supplements won’t be able to supply them.”
“Is that so?” The panda senior nodded and felt the pressure increase. This time, whether the exploration could produce results… depended on her.
“Don’t worry, I believe you. It’s related to the cultivation of the Iron-eating
Beast. Senior, you’re the strongest!”
“Don’t do this…”
“Truth,” Shi Yu said with a smile. If not for the skill index, he wouldn’t have been able to develop so many Iron-eating Beast skills like Senior Panda’s family.
After raising the Iron-eating Beast for so long, Senior Panda had surpassed her master and obtained all of Senior Ji Mengzhu’s teachings. Her current cultivation EXP for the Iron-eating Beast shouldn’t even be comparable to Emperor Wu.
After all, it was also Senior Ji Mengzhu who helped feed Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast at that time.
“Let’s talk to Aunt Hua about the situation of the first exploration first. The holidays of Divine Capital University will probably still be delayed. This battlefield ruin is very dangerous. If it completely descends, the obsession might materialize the battlefield and cause huge damage,” Shi Yu said with a sigh.
He might have to ask Senior Space Emperor to come and strengthen the seal of the ruins. He would see if the battle in Dream World could dispel his obsession first.
“Alright,” said the panda senior.
Next, Shi Yu decided to split the work with Senior Panda to crack the ruins.
Senior Panda took a side mission and tried to explore the power system of the Nine Li Horde’s Chi You Army in the previous era.
As for Shi Yu, he was preparing for the main storyline to see if he could obtain benefits from Chi You’s obsession by defeating Ying Long.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, the difficulty of this main mission was even greater than Susu defeating the abyss super divine. After all, the strength displayed by that Ying Long in the dream world was comparable to super divine battle power.
It was almost impossible for Eleven to defeat it without the battle power of an epoch god.
Of course, although it was difficult, as long as Shi Yu was given time, it shouldn’t be a problem. After breaking through to the divine level, Eleven had yet to start adding points. All the divine skills’ proficiency was still below expert level.
As long as he added all the divine skills to perfection, he could definitely fight the other party even if he didn’t defeat it.
At that time, with Chi You’s obsession, he might not lose.
And it all the points were added to the perfect state (Pertect+47), although it wasn’t an epoch god yet, with the quality of Eleven’s skills and him, it shouldn’t be a problem to wait for an epoch god.
Therefore, in the end, if he wanted to crack this ruin, he had to add points.
Somewhere in Divine Capital, Shi Yu found a place that wasn’t affected by the ruins and settled down.
He summoned Susu and the others and said, “Susu, don’t eat the crown first. Come and support Eleven’s points first.”
“Ning!” Susu looked at Shi Yu eagerly and asked if it couldn’t enter the dream world?
If possible, it could deal with Ying Long!
“Ji! Buggy also wanted to fight Ying Long.
Between the Green Dragon and Ying Long, which was stronger?
It felt that the Green Dragon should be stronger. After all, one was at the cosmic level in the last era, while Ying Long looked to only have super divine battle power.
Unfortunately… it couldn’t enter Shi Yu’s dream. This made Buggy very confused.
“Wuu… (Don’t be like this.)” Eleven stood on Shi Yu’s shoulder and protested. Ying Long was clearly its experience bag. Could it be that it was going to be snatched away too?
“The power of the era ruins is that strange. If it could easily change the rules, there wouldn’t be so many era ruins in World King Planet and the universe that no one could crack.”
“You have to know that even cosmic overlords have era ruins that can’t be cracked,” Shi Yu said.
“Yiya-” The pets nodded. Alright, they looked at Eleven. Then they would assist Eleven in adding points first.
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven bowed to its teammates.
Next, Shi Yu and Senior Panda stayed near Divine Capital University and started to split the work.
With the help of Shi Yu’s resources, the senior entered the dream ruins day after day to explore.
As for Shi Yu, he added points in the outside world.
Just like that, half a month passed in the blink of an eye. At this moment, the God Sealing Battle on World King Planet should have already ended. Another powerful perfect god was also born in Shi Yu’s team.
< Name > Eleven
Skill:
“Divine-level”: Yin Yang Millstone (Perfect), Battle God Body (Perfect), Eight
Trigrams Clone (Perfect), One Thought of God and Demon (Perfect+47), Light
Control (Perfect), Dark Control (Perfect), Metal Control (Perfect), Star
Refinement (Perfect)
From the high-level divine battle Dower half a month ago, with the suDDort of
a bunch of pets, Eleven directly had the battle power of an epoch god. As Shi Yu mainly added points to the self-mutilating explosive skill, One Thought of God and Demon, perhaps Eleven could instantly have the battle power of an epoch god now.
As the saying went, good things came in pairs. After Shi Yu temporarily completed a small goal, Senior Panda worked hard to explore for half a month and finally gained something.
“Shi Yu! Lin Xiuzhu, who was wearing a panda suit, came to Shi Yu in surprise. “I got something.”
“Are you there!”
“I found the evolution path of the Iron-eating Beast in the last era!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1647 - 1647: Gradually Understanding Everything (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1647 - 1647: Gradually Understanding Everything (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Senior Panda’s energetic arrival seemed to have dispersed the fatigue of exploring the ruins.
The evolution path of the Iron-eating Beast in the last era?
When Shi Yu heard Senior Panda’s voice, he was also overjoyed.
He was pressed for time the last time he explored the ruins and didn’t pay too much attention. Now that Senior Panda had gained something, it was undoubtedly the first surprise from the feedback of this ruin.
“Wuuu! Upon hearing the new evolution form, Eleven took a step forward, raised its arm, and danced around.
“Hehe.” After Senior Panda arrived, she said, “Moreover, the evolution method is very simple. There’s no need for external objects at all. You just have to rely on the Iron-eating Beast’s own strength.”
“Oh?” Shi Yu said, “The kind of evolution that optimizes one’s race? The threshold is at the totem level?”
Totem-level creatures could optimize their bloodlines and evolve on their own. If they didn’t use the evolution resources of the outside world, Shi Yu would have thought of this immediately.
“No, no, no,” the panda senior said. “It’s fine at the Awakening level, but…”
“However, it requires a hardening skill at the Dao Proficiency level and a certain talent,” Senior Panda said with a smile.
Dao Proficiency, this proficiency level, had already been popularized in Dong Huang through Shi Yu.
When a super skill was trained to Dao Proficiency, there was a chance to advance to a quasi-divine skill.
As for quasi-divine skills, they were the key to the evolution of ordinary races into Mythical Races.
Requiring the hardening of Dao Proficiency… This condition was already very simple in Shi Yu and the others’ current realm. After all, it was only a low-level skill.
Even super skills weren’t difficult. After the revival of the Blue Planet’s laws, the skill level had already improved a lot. Apart from that, many resources to increase comprehension talent had also appeared.
Transcendence was no longer the highest skill level pursued by Beast Tamers.
“It’s probably because the Iron-eating Beast needs to use the Hardening Skill to modify itself, just like how it circulates the ‘cultivation method’. After mastering it, it can evolve and awaken new skills.” “It’s still hardening.”
“How about this? Flower, come, show Shi Yu.
Under Senior Panda’s call, the panda on her shoulder crawled down. “Wait, your ‘found’ means that you’ve already ‘successfully evolved!?”
“Of course,” Senior Panda said proudly, puffing out her chest.
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and said, “Alright, the progress is much faster than I imagined.”
“Actually, it’s all thanks to the Cultivation Fruit and the World Tree Fruit.” The panda senior shook her head and said, “I can feel that without the support of your resources, even if we were given a few years, it would be impossible to enter this evolution method.”
“Practicing this is too difficult. It’s dozens of times more difficult than training the proficiency of super skills. It even involves the modification of the brain.”
“You guys are still powerful enough,” Shi Yu said. “Alright, quickly let me take a look.”
“No problem.” Lin Xiuzhu smiled. In the next moment, she looked at her Iron-eating Beast. This Iron-eating Beast let out a cry and began to show a new evolution form that was no longer restrained.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Its entire body emitted a spatial vibration sound. Its eyes were deep, and black hardening substance flowed on its body…
In the next moment, a huge aura erupted. Law patterns lingered on Senior Panda’s Iron-eating Beast. With a whoosh, two new pairs of arms and two new heads grew on the Iron-eating Beast.
“Roar!!” The three-headed and six-armed Iron-eating Beast roared, its aura sweeping out.
“Three heads and six arms?” Shi Yu was surprised. Was this the evolution path of the Iron-eating Beast in the last era?
To be honest, it didn’t give Shi Yu much of a surprise. This was because even in this era, there were many similar evolution methods, such as Little Quas optimizing itself into a three-headed snake.
A long time ago, Shi Yu had also encountered a Ming Hua Beast Tamer who had mastered the three-headed and six-armed Beast Taming Talent.
At this moment, Shi Yu could indeed sense that Senior Lin’s panda had become stronger. It should have reached the Mythical Race.
Of course, Shi Yu wasn’t in a hurry to deny it. He understood that this form might not be the key. The key was what accompanying skills the Iron-eating Beast had mastered after evolution.
“It’s not over!” At this moment, under Shi Yu’s witness, Senior Panda took out six swords from her spatial equipment. Every level had reached Level 7, so it wasn’t high.
She threw the swords and sabers to the three-headed and six-armed Iron-eating Beast one by one. After her six arms took the swords and sabers one by one, under Shi Yu’s slightly stunned expression, the Iron-eating Beast’s strength increased further. Soon, with its overlord body, it temporarily approached the strength of a demigod.
At this level, it was no longer inferior to Shi Yu’s pet’s battle power at the overlord level. At the overlord level, it was close to a demigod!
“What’s this?” Shi Yu asked.
“After the Iron-eating Beast evolves, it will awaken a new skill.” “This new skill is a quasi-divine skill. It’s called ‘Weapon Control’.”
“No matter what divine weapon it is, as long as I hold it in my hand, I can immediately control them perfectly like I’m controlling my hands and feet. I can display 200% of the power of this weapon and increase my battle power greatly.”
“The Iron-eating Beast’s three heads and six arms should also have evolved to match this skill. Six arms can allow it to control more weapons. Three heads can allow it to react faster and multitask.’
“The Chi You Army is very proficient in using weapons.”
“I see. Arms expert, this is the first time I’ve seen such a skill,” Shi Yu said. On World King Planet, he had never heard of any arms expert skill. At most, it was a single weapon expert. For example, the Sword Dao Will and Sword Body Chi
Tong had previously mastered could allow it to have a higher mastery of Sword Arms, but compared to this arms expert, there was clearly a small difference..

chapters.title: Chapter 1648 - 1648: Gradually Understanding Everything (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1648 - 1648: Gradually Understanding Everything (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
From Flower’s performance just now, the powerful thing about this skill was that even if the weapon had nothing to do with the user and was purely an external object, it could immediately be expertly used.
He didn’t remember when Senior Lin’s Iron-eating Beast would use swords… But from the looks of it, the other party’s control over swords was no longer inferior to or even exceeded most Sword Spirit Races.
“How is it? Is this skill powerful?” Senior Panda felt that it was very powerful, but she didn’t understand. She needed Shi Yu to analyze it.
“Very strong, and the future is promising. On the World King Planet, there are many ancient divine weapons, even era divine weapons. They don’t have life and purely have powerful strength. No one can control them at all. Perhaps, the control of this weapon can control them to further strengthen the Iron-eating Beast. ”
“Also, didn’t those soldiers in the ruins battlefield master the ability to turn pets into weapons? Not only can Beast Tamers use this beast soldier themselves, but they might also be able to give it to Iron-eating Beasts who know how to control weapons. At that time, it’s equivalent to two pets fusing, and it’s not an ordinary fusion. Their battle power will also increase greatly.”
“This ability is top-notch even on World King Planet, let alone Blue Planet.”
“Great.” Senior Panda was excited.
Shi Yu was telling the truth. What power could a skill from the last era display with the divine weapons left behind from the last era? Shi Yu didn’t know, but it definitely couldn’t be weak.
Of course, this wasn’t the key for Shi Yu. Shi Yu felt that the evolution system of the three-headed and six-armed panda was a little inferior to that of the Chaos Panda.
However, although it was a little lacking, Shi Yu could accept this weapon control skill with a smile.
After all, his pets all had Star Refinement skills and their own exclusive weapons. The Weapon Control might be able to make them even more powerful when using their Star Arms.
“Then I’ll pass these EXP to you through the inheritance water droplet now?” Lin Xiuzhu said.
“There’s no hurry. Apart from these, are there any other gains?”
Lin Xiuzhu shook his head and said, “No, my exploration direction is the evolution of the iron-eating beasts and the cultivation system of the humans of the last era. Among them, the progress of the Iron-eating Beasts is pretty good, but the feeling I get from the humans… It’s as if the humans of our era are not the same species as the humans of the last era.”
“The cultivation system is completely incompatible.”
“On the other hand, the Iron-eating Beasts are definitely the same species.” “You feel that way too?” Shi Yu was stunned and fell into deep thought.
The last time he entered the ruins and wanted to comprehend the ability of those soldiers to turn their pets into weapons, he also felt this way. He clearly felt that the skill was right in front of him and he could learn it immediately, but his body…
[Brain: I know it.]
[Body: No, you won’t.]
“It’s alright. There are more solutions than difficulties,” Shi Yu said. He already had an idea.
That was, he would let his brain learn it first. As for whether his body knew how to do it, it didn’t matter.
If the humans of this era were really not suitable to cultivate the system of the previous era, then… what about Beast Shi Yu?
Beast Shi Yu was a life form from the last era.
Perhaps he could use his consciousness to control Beast Shi Yu to cultivate the power of those soldiers?
“Senior, 1 want to enter the ruins dream again,” Shi Yu said.
“Enter now??” Lin Xiuzhu was surprised. Only half a month had passed since the last time.
“Yes, enter now,” Shi Yu said.
Although Eleven still had a lot of room for improvement, Shi Yu still planned to give it a try. Most importantly, leaving a ruin behind and not exploring it could only add points. Shi Yu was stifled.
Shi Yu prepared to enter the ruins again. After giving his pets instructions, he ate the Cultivation Fruit and entered the dream. Apart from him, Eleven also entered the dream. As for the other pets, they were protecting Shi Yu at the side, including Beast Shi Yu. They were all beside him.
“Uh…
Shi Yu closed his eyes and opened them. In the dream world, Shi Yu rubbed his head with a headache. Then, he rubbed a horn.
“Holy shit…” Shi Yu exclaimed and completely woke up.
“Moo! !
“Roar!!”
Just as Shi Yu was cursing, beast roars came from beside him. He took a closer look and realized that he was in an even larger army tent. He seemed to have been recuperating just now. There were especially many bottles of medicine around him.
As for the surrounding creatures, apart from a familiar panda, there was also a huge bull and a huge bird.
There was an 80% chance that the panda was Eleven, but this huge bull and huge bird were definitely not Shi Yu’s pets. However, Shi Yu knew them!!
When Chi You and Ying Long fought, these two guys were divine beasts on Chi You’s side and gave Chi You a lot of help.
Unfortunately, in the end, they were all killed by Ying Long.
“Damn, I changed my identity this time??”
“l became Chi You??” Shi Yu was stunned.
Was it because after Eleven became stronger, his identity in their dream changed?
As expected, Eleven was the one dragging him down the last time. With his strength at the 11th heavenly layer of the divine level, he should have possessed Chi You long ago…
Bang, bang, bang, bang!!
While Shi Yu was still in a daze, the thunderous drumbeat sounded again.
“The enemy is attacking, prepare to fight! ”
“Not good, it’s Ying Long!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1649 - 1649: Gradually Understanding Everything (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1649 - 1649: Gradually Understanding Everything (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Chi You, why aren’t you surrendering?”
Familiar voices sounded, making Shi Yu’s expression darken.
Previously, he was a soldier and could still slack off. This time, he directly became Ying Longs hunting target. He couldn’t slack off even if he wanted to.
Although it was a dream, Shi Yu felt that he was too filial to participate in the battle of a group of ancestors and even beat up a few.
“Forget it, it’s a dream anyway. Eleven, let’s go!’
Shi Yu and Eleven walked out of the tent under the confused expressions of the bull beast and the bird beast and arrived at the center of the battlefield.
“Boss! Seeing Shi Yu appear, many crippled soldiers shouted excitedly.
At this moment, Shi Yu only had eyes for the golden dragon in the sky.
“Chi You, surrender,” Emperor Huang said in the clouds, thinking that this battle was definitely won.
As an orthodox, he had already obtained the recognition of the world. Even if Chi You was stronger than him, he definitely wouldn’t lose with the help of Ying Long.
“Hahahaha.” Shi Yu smiled and directly activated his Beast Taming Talent, Spirit Taiji Domain.
In the next moment, the phantom of the eleven heavenly layers appeared behind Shi Yu.
A realm formed.
The entire battlefield was instantly covered by the Taiji Domain. Above the eleventh heavenly layer, two stars appeared, and a pair of Yin Yang fish surrounded Shi Yu.
“Roar! Standing in the Taiji Domain, Eleven kept enlarging to a few hundred meters. It stopped after having a size that could resist Ying Long.
At that moment, as Shi Yu displayed his strength, Ying Long and the others revealed incredulous expressions. “What’s this?”
“Chi You still has a trump card!”
“Roar! ! !
After enlarging, Eleven directly gave Ying Long a greeting gift. Yin Yang divine power flowed in its body and directly activated One Thought of God and
Demon. God and demon coexisted on its body, and it slashed its palm at Ying Long.
“Roar!!”
The huge Ying Long couldn’t react to Eleven’s attack and was instantly sent flying to a nearby mountain, blasting several mountains before stopping.
“The power of Taiji… Impossible. It’s impossible for Chi You to master such power.”
Emperor Huang was shocked. After seeing that Chi You’s third-ranked mount pet could even smash over to assist his strongest trump card, Ying Long, he was extremely confused.
Similarly confused were Chi You’s bull beast and bird beast. These two pets were Chi You’s true capable subordinates.
On the other hand, the Iron-eating Beast dragged down a lot in the previous battle. In the end, Chi You even turned it into a weapon to use to avoid being dragged down again.
However, from just now, they had felt that there was something wrong with Chi You and that Iron-eating Beast.
Now, seeing that the Iron-eating Beast had sent Ying Long flying and directly defeated them, the cow, beast, and bird beast were completely stunned.
What was going on?
“Who exactly admitted defeat?” Shi Yu floated in the sky. Under the black and white stars, he was like Eleven, a god and a demon. He was extremely domineering.
Seeing that Eleven, who was both a god and a demon, could indeed temporarily suppress Ying Long with his support, he laughed out loud and felt that it was very exciting.
However, Shi Yu also understood that this was only a temporary suppression.
Eleven’s body couldn’t maintain the One Thought of God and Demon for long. The level of the physique skill was too different from the One Thought of God and Demon.
Moreover, there were still many experts on the Huang Emperor’s side who had yet to attack, such as the Heavenly Maiden Ba who had come from the upper world and defeated the Fengbo Rain Master.
Of course, the power system displayed by Shi Yu was definitely something
Ying Long and the other gods had never seen on Chi You before. Of course, Shi Yu could only do this. He couldn’t use Chi You’s power at all and could only use his own.
However, the three ancestors weren’t very strong at this stage. Even the invincible Ying Long only had the battle power of an era divine and super divine. Shi Yu felt that he could deal with it himself.
[Unfortunately, I can only use my own power system. If I can use Chi You’s power system to fight, I might be able to learn more.]
[It’s not a problem to use its own system, but there’s no time to learn… If only Beast Shi Yu could also enter a dream. He can fight himself and let it learn.
Then, we can split the work.]
As Shi Yu muttered in his heart, a change suddenly occurred in the mental connection, surprising Shi Yu slightly.
He suddenly felt a mental connection with Beast Shi Yu.
It was as if it could summon Beast Shi Yu at any time.
“It really works?” Shi Yu was stunned.
At this moment, in the distance, Ying Long flew up again. Its body was heavily injured by the black and white lightning. However, the first thing it did when it flew up this time was not to counterattack, but to say, “You’re not Chi You.
Who are you?”
“You’re not Chi You,” Emperor Huang and the others also said.
“Of course…” Shi Yu was just about to talk nonsense, but at this moment, even Chi You, who was possessed by Shi Yu, began to reject him, stunning Shi Yu.
“Uh ah! ! !”
“Get out.”
Accompanied by an uncontrollable roar from Chi You’s body, Shi Yu’s spirit seemed to be squeezed out of Chi You’s body.
This made Shi Yu curse. It wasn’t like he wanted to possess this lousy man.
It’s your obsession that let me enter your body, and you’re the one who wants me to get out now.
Why was it so difficult to be a good person and help you get rid of your obsession?
As Shi Yu cursed, he was still squeezed out of his body by Chi You. However, to Shi Yu’s surprise, after he came out, he wasn’t in a form like a soul, nor was he a spiritual body, let alone awakening.
Instead, it gradually materialized into Beast Shi Yu..

chapters.title: Chapter 1650 - 1650: Gradually Understanding Everything (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1650 - 1650: Gradually Understanding Everything (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
He summoned Beast Shi Yu and possessed him.
Boom.
Shi Yu stopped in midair, and the Taiji Domain directly disappeared. Eleven discovered the change and immediately shrank, instantly appearing beside shi Yu.
“Wu wu wu.” It didn’t understand what was going on.
“You are…”
“It’s you…”
In the world of obsession, Emperor Huang, Chi You, Ying Long, and the others had incredulous expressions when they saw Shi Yu’s face.
Right on the heels of that, Ying Long shouted something that made Shi Yu i s hair stand on end.
“Shi Yu, do you want to interfere in this war? Do you want to challenge the
Shi Yu:
Eleven:
Shi Yu looked like he had seen a ghost. Wait, what was going on?
“You know me??” Shi Yu was stunned. Stop kidding.
“I’ve heard of you, but why are you helping Chi You?” Emperor Huang said.
At this moment, Chi You, who had recovered, also had a furious expression. “Shi Yu, why are you occupying my body?”
In an instant, Shi Yu fell silent.
Before he could ask more, the figures of Emperor Huang, Chi You, and Ying Long shattered like a dream bubble, and the entire dream world shattered.
The second time Shi Yu entered the ruins, it directly ended in this strange and strange way. In the outside world, in the room, under the worried expressions of a bunch of pets, Shi Yu suddenly opened his eyes. His entire body was drenched in sweat. He immediately got up and panted heavily.
“Wuu!” Eleven also woke up with a stunned expression. Its round face revealed confusion as it looked at Shi Yu curiously.
He kept feeling that… Beast Tamers had many secrets!
Ah, but it had yet to fight. Why was it… over?
Beside him, Beast Shi Yu didn’t seem to have changed much. Shi Yu looked at him and then at the many pets and took a deep breath.
“What’s going on…”
“Yi. (What’s wrong! What’s wrong!)” Ling wasn’t around and was refining the lucky star. Baby Ginseng took the initiative to be the think tank to help Shi Yu analyze,
“Me too!” The turtle also took the initiative to volunteer with the scholar hat it had taken from Baby Ginseng.
“He was killed again?” Qi looked at Shi Yu and Eleven with heartache.
“That’s not it.” Shi Yu shook his head.
“However, in this dream, I seem to have successfully established a connection with Beast Shi Yu. It can also enter the dream world like Eleven. Perhaps this is related to him coming from the last era.”
“But the problem is that some obsession illusions in the dream seem to know Beast Shi Yu… It’s ridiculous.’
Shi Yu went crazy.
“Ji! (Know??? Could it be that his mind has already been interfered with by the dream and has purely become the ‘dreaming’ stage?)” Buggy said.
It had studied dreams. Most dreams were fake. It could even control dreams and let Shi Yu fall in love with the Worm Empress in the dream. Anything ridiculous could happen in the dream.
Just like what Shi Yu had said just now… Therefore, was Shi Yu already disturbed by the dream just now?
“That’s a possibility. Perhaps it’s because I’m too tired from adding points that my dream is distorted. However, I keep feeling that things aren’t that simple,” Shi Yu said in deep thought.
“Yi. (Didn’t they say that Beast Shi Yu came from the last era? Then is it possible that they’re your acquaintances?)” Baby Ginseng analyzed from the perspective of reincarnation.
“Yi. (Because it’s an acquaintance, the obsession phantom will change when it sees you.)”
“Impossible,” Shi Yu said. “When I was born in my previous life, it was already thousands of years after the Battle of Zhuo Lu, or even further! In the era I was in, there were no longer transcendent existences. It seems to have entered the Cultivationless Age again. I’m just an ordinary person. How can I be recognized by Ying Long?”
“Then is it possible that Shi Yu, you… After your previous life died, your soul didn’t directly come to the next era, but during this period… there was an experience you forgot.”
“In this experience, returning to the past isn’t impossible…” Qi said. As a Time Sprite, she was qualified to say this…
As soon as Qi finished speaking, Shi Yu fell into deep thought again. During his death and transmigration, was there still… an experience he had forgotten? In fact, during this experience, he was so powerful that he transmigrated into space and time and let Ying Long and Chi You know him?
Looking at the super divine Beast Shi Yu, Shi Yu was directly numb.

chapters.title: Chapter 1651 - 1651: Protection Archeology and Destruction Archeology (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1651 - 1651: Protection Archeology and Destruction Archeology (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Looks like the direction of exploring the Chi You Ruins is about to change.”
After entering the Chi You Ruins this time, Shi Yu no longer thought about the evolution method of the Iron-eating Beast Era or the cultivation system of the previous era.
These were all unimportant. He only cared about why Ying Long and the others knew him.
“Eleven, let’s not fight Ying Long anymore. I’ll take you to the overlord territory to fight real super divines later!”
The name of the overlord territory was the same as the Cosmic Sea, the
Contaminated Land, the Worm Mother Nest, and the Behemoth Empire.
“It’s an obsession phantom to begin with. Defeating it probably won’t be very helpful in training you. It’s not a necessary battle, unlike Susu and the abyss super divine, who are incompatible like fire and water. There’s a reason to win.”
“Sob…” Eleven expressed that Shi Yu was talking nonsense. It was already very happy to be able to fight a dragon, but… it listened to Shi Yu.
“If I help Chi You resolve his obsession, the ruins might completely disappear.
On the other hand, if Chi You’s obsession can’t be resolved, the ruins will definitely exist forever.”
“This way, there are also more opportunities to enter the dream ruins and explore the mystery of my transmigration in my previous life.” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
Brother Chi You, since you know me, be unwilling for a while longer.
In any case, Brother Chi You, you’ve already been indignant for tens of billions of years. It’s fine to endure a few more years.
Next, after Shi Yu ate some supplements, he worked very hard. Then, he planned to enter a dream a second time.
This time, Shi Yu still possessed Chi You.
Emperor Huang and Ying Long stj.ll followed the script.
However, this time, Shi Yu wasn’t in a hurry to fight. Instead, he stood in the air and looked at Emperor Huang and Ying Long.
“Ying Long, do you know Shi Yu?” he asked directly.
Ying Long was also stunned. It didn’t expect Chi You to ask about others when he was about to die.
“You still know that scourge?” Ying Long said, “No matter who you know, you won’t be able to escape death this time!!!”
Disaster!
Shi Yu cried. Yes, it was him!
However, not long after Shi Yu was touched, a bug seemed to have appeared in this world of obsession.
It collapsed with a bang.
Shi Yu consumed a lot of energy again, even greater than the last time. He woke up.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng handed over a root for Shi Yu to hold in his mouth.
“Why, why, why.” Shi Yu got up and was very unconvinced. Why was it fine for Senior Panda to explore the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast in the ruins, and it was fine to explore the cultivation method of the previous era?
It was so difficult for him to just know who he was.
“Ten more.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, he ate the supplements under Baby Ginsengs shocked expression.
Soon, Shi Yu entered the ruins again.
Before Ying Long could attack, Shi Yu casually found something that could be carved. He wanted to use the “online communication” method to send a pigeon to ask Shi Yu who he was.
However, there were still changes this time.
Shi Yu had just written his name when the ruins collapsed again not long after.
This time, the backlash Shi Yu suffered was even more serious. He even coughed out blood. After all, after he reached the 11th heavenly layer, even if he added points and deduced, he had never been in such a miserable state.
“Why don’t we try another day… The seal that Senior Space Emperor just strengthened is about to crack again.”
Chi Tong helped Shi Yu up and spoke worriedly like a father taking care of a terminally ill father.
The difference was that she was already used to Shi Yu’s weak and old state.
However, even if it was very used to a weak state, it definitely couldn’t explore for the time being. If it came again, it would really be dangerous.
“Baby Ginseng, medicine!” Chi Tong said. Baby Ginseng immediately carried the Heavenly Emperor Cauldron and brought over a pot of medicinal soup boiled inside.
This was its new research. The effect should be better.
“No.” Shi Yu had a headache.
In the surroundings, Eleven, Buggy, Susu, and the others watched eagerly, not knowing how to help the Beast Tamer.
“In my opinion, there’s no hurry.”
Just as everyone was at a loss, Ling suddenly appeared. Space ripples blinked, and a mini cosmic battleship descended.
On the mini battleship, a battleship girl phantom shot out. “Ling? You’re finally done refining,” Shi Yu said. “Eh, your eyes…” “Yes,” Ling said. “l refined the lucky star into contact lenses.”
Chi Tong, Susu, and the others: ???
This was also a weapon???
“Uh.” Shi Yu looked carefully into Lings eyes. His original eyes had turned into a starry sky with a golden star floating inside.
“This makes it easier to see the changes in luck… But this isn’t the key.”
“Master, you’re in trouble, right?”
