Shi Yu said, “What do you think?”
As he leaned against Chi Tong, he gulped down the medicinal soup and transmitted his experience to Ling in greater detail.
After pondering for a moment, Ling said, “My suggestion is that Master continue to improve your archeological abilities.”
“Improve archeological abilities?”
Ling said, “Generally speaking, the goal of Beast Tamers’ archeology is to obtain rarer resources, stronger skills, and stronger inheritances from ancient ruins. In order to achieve this goal, it doesn’t matter even if they destroy ruins… After all, it’s profitable.”
Shi Yu felt that Ling was implying something about him. Passage of Time,
“However, in the universe, there are also many ordinary planets without extraordinary power. The archeology there is usually ‘protection-type archeology’, protecting ancient ruins to better obtain information from them and restore history.”
Shi Yu nodded. He knew this. On Earth without extraordinary power and without any transcendent treasures in the ruins, the archeological teams were all like this..

chapters.title: Chapter 1652 - 1652: Protection Archeology and Destruction Archeology (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1652 - 1652: Protection Archeology and Destruction Archeology (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“In my opinion, protective archeology is far harder than destruction archeology,” Ling said. “Just like how the laws of creation are harder to master than the laws of destruction.’
“A baby can destroy a vase, but creating a vase requires a certain amount of skill or a mature industrial system.”
As soon as Ling finished speaking, Buggy looked at Chi Tong arrogantly.
Chi Tong: “?”
“l understand what you mean. You mean that my destructive archeological ability has already been maxed out and reached the pinnacle of my current level, but my protective archeological ability isn’t very expert.”
“And exploring the ruins of Chi You’s obsession requires protective archeological abilities. The reason why we didn’t ask about any gains is that the word ‘Shi Yu r is like a keyword that will cause destruction to the ruins of the obsession.’
“But if 1 master some protective archeological skill, it’s possible that even if I
communicate with Shi Yu normally with those obsession illusions in the ruins, the ruins won’t collapse.”
“That’s right!” Ling said. “So my suggestion is to let Lord Blue Planet strengthen this ruin again first. As for you, Master, increase your skills first.
As for the ruin, you can explore it in the future.”
Shi Yu had a headache.
“As expected of Ling.”
“If I had known, I would have asked Senior Wa to give me more back then. She even helped the cosmic overlord crack the ruins. Her archeological proficiency must be extremely high.”
Emperor Shi couldn’t be relied on. The last time Shi Yu told Zi Jian that Emperor Shi wasn’t interested in archeology, it was actually true.
Although Emperor Shi was expert in archeology, archeology was essentially only one of his abilities. He didn’t major in it, and even the research order was under the unpopular skill of Emperor Shi, Future Prediction.
What Shi Yu obtained from Emperor Shi was all that Emperor Shi had mastered.
Shi Yu had long communicated with Emperor Shi about this. Moreover, in that chaotic era, Emperor Shi wouldn’t study protective archeology at all. As long as he could quickly strengthen his strength and destroy a few ruins, it didn’t matter at all.
He wasn’t interested in the history of the totem era and the history of the Mythical Era. He only wanted to open up the future that belonged to humans.
Ling suggested, “Actually, we can go to the overlord territory first. The best archeologists in the entire universe are all gathered in the cosmic overlord army. There must be many protective archeologists over there.”
“Captain Zi Jian is only one of the many top archeologists in the cosmic overlord army. Just her alone is enough to suppress the World King Planet Archeological Association. It’s obvious that there must be many capable people over there.”
“Moreover, the reason why the cosmic overlord, Cypos, supported archeology seems to be to understand how to dodge the fate of the universe’s destruction. This goal is also to collect more information, not strength. Therefore, many protective archeologists should be influenced.”
“We can go there to learn. It’s on the way anyway.”
Shi Yu said, “That makes sense. I happen to be going to the overlord territory to find the Wish Star inheritance for Teacher Cat. When I reach the overlord territory, I can look for Zi Jian’s special forces and get Captain Zi Jian to help introduce me.’
After making the decision, Shi Yu walked out of the room and muttered in his heart.
“Godmother, are you there?”
Blue Planet’s Will, who was teaching Little Zi, fell silent slightly and looked in the direction of Dong Huangs Divine Capital angrily.
“What is it?”
“The ruin sealed by Senior Wa… I’ll call it the ruins of Chi You’s obsession for the time being. I want to ask you to strengthen the seal and help me protect it. Don’t let others destroy and crack it.”
“This ruin contains some important information. If I rashly crack it, it might cause the information to be lost. It needs to be protected. With my current ability, it’s not enough to crack it. I plan to try again after a while.”
Blue Planet’s Will said, “Alright, but we still have to head to the Cosmic Sea next. Aren’t you worried that the movement of the planet will affect the ruins?”
“I’m worried about that,” Shi Yu said.
“How about this? Before you finish exploring this ruin, I’ll still stay where I am. There’s no need to worry about danger. The current Blue Planet is stronger than you imagine.”
“Before leaving, I’ll think of a way to increase Blue Planet’s defense power,” Shi Yu said.
“There’s no need to go through so much trouble.”
“And not leaving isn’t all for you.”
“In the past few days after deciding to set off for the Cosmic Sea, I have a bad premonition. Perhaps the Cosmic Sea isn’t as safe as I imagined.”
“Premonition?” Shi Yu was stunned.
Was something big about to happen in the Cosmic Sea? Could it be because of the war in the Contaminated Land? No way.
“I’m not sure either, but this galaxy might be more peaceful.”
“Alright,” Shi Yu said. “In short, I’ll obtain the ability to explore the ruins as soon as possible.”
“MJell, by the way, after you’re done, you can already take this guy away. It has already completely mastered the ‘Star Contract’.”
“Little Zi has mastered the Star Contract??” Shi Yu was pleasantly surprised.
The last time the Space Emperor came to strengthen the seal of the ruins, he even complained to him. He spent a lot of effort to bring the Floating Planet here from the Cosmic Sea. In the end, Blue Planet only taught it for a day and said that it couldn’t be taught. He directly “persuaded” the Floating Planet to leave.
Shi Yu was originally nervous. Could Little Zi learn it? If it couldn’t, he could only try replicating and teaching. However, from the looks of it, Little Zi, who had hatched from drinking the World Tree’s sap, had a pretty high
compatibility with Blue Planet. It was really like a biological daughter who could learn the skills mastered by Blue Planet..

chapters.title: Chapter 1653 - 1653: Protection Archeology and Destruction Archeology (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1653 - 1653: Protection Archeology and Destruction Archeology (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“That’s right, Ling, let’s prepare!’
Shi Yu turned around and said to Ling.
“Yes!”
••
Before setting off, Shi Yu found Senior Lin and said, “Senior, there’s a reason. Let’s not explore the Chi You Ruins first. With our current abilities, it’s not enough to completely explore it. I plan to talk about it in a few days. In the next two days, you can instill all your gains here through this inheritance water droplet.”
He took out a pendant that looked like a water droplet and said, “Don’t worry, this is already very different from the memory water droplet. It won’t affect the user’s memories anymore.”
“Alright.” Senior Panda also felt a little tired. She felt that her gains in the ruins these few days were enough for her to digest for a year or two. There wasn’t much meaning in exploring further.
“Also, tell me what weapon Flower likes to use. I’ll get Eleven to use Metal
Control to help create a divine weapon later.”
“Well, this…” The panda senior said, “l don’t know either… It didn’t use weapons before.”
“Then let’s use the bamboo stick. In any case, the Iron-eating Beasts should be able to hold the bamboo easily.” Shi Yu smiled.
“That makes sense.” It was very difficult for the panda senior not to support it. After all, her family opened the Iron Bamboo Breeding Forest, and she was the most familiar with bamboo… If she had to say, what weapon was the most convenient for the pandas in the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base? It would definitely be a bamboo stick…
“Please,” said the panda senior.
“It’s not a big deal. You just have to win the next world competition.”
“No problem.” Senior Panda was especially confident now.
After all, she was now a woman who had obtained the Iron-eating Beast inheritance from the last era!
After deciding not to explore the Chi You Ruins for the time being, Shi Yu!s only thing was to add points and cultivate.
Not only were the ruins not successfully explored, there were also more troublesome things.
For example, he wanted to develop protective archeological skills, while Beast Shi Yu wanted to try cultivating the cultivation system of the previous era.
The information that had been explored at the moment could still be used by Beast Shi Yu to try cultivating.
This was something Shi Yu and Beast Shi Yu wanted to cultivate, and the additional points of the pets would definitely still be the same. Only by having a perfect (+47) divine skill could they have the possibility of challenging the Super Divine Will. In the team, apart from Susu, Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Ling, the other pets clearly had yet to reach the standard.
Of course, although Shi Yu was in a hurry to explore the Chi You Ruins, he also knew that it couldn’t be rushed. The gem cat had yet to successfully break through to super divine and was still refining the source of transcendence.
If he wanted to go to the overlord territory, he definitely had to wait for the gem cat.
Therefore, Shi Yu chose to see if there were any valuable protective archeological skills from the World King Planet Archeological Association first.
Shi Yu temporarily returned to World King Planet.
At this moment, the God Sealing Battle on the World King Star had already ended. Unfortunately, although Dong Huangs bloodline was fierce this time, it was still a little inferior to the previous Shi Yu.
In short, the methods were too simple and the accumulation wasn’t enough. The Empress specialized in the Phoenix Race, the Dragon Emperor specialized in the Dragon Race, and Emperor Wu specialized in the physique… The changes in the methods weren’t exquisite enough… The first place of the God Sealing Battle was still snatched by Zavay. Among them, the Dragon Emperor and Emperor Wu both destroyed a Time Mark from Zavay and were forcefully defeated by Zavay.
It was just like how Emperor Wu had once fought Yun An. Because he didn’t have enough methods, he was defeated by Yun An with radiation.
Although he had the time mystic realm to accelerate his accumulation, Zavay also came from a time-element large race. He also had super divine elders, and he definitely had decades more accumulation than Emperor Wu and the others. It was still a long way for ordinary geniuses to defeat Zavay.
However, It was precisely because of trus that the people on World King Planet were extremely silent.
He understood even more what kind of monster Shi Yu was.
Dong Huangs Emperor Wu and the others were also so terrifying. None of them were inferior to Ming Gu, but they were still defeated by Zavay. As expected of its identity as the 79th champion.
However, such a Zavay was directly defeated by Shi Yu e s single pet… It was simply unimaginable.
Shi Yu’s talent definitely far exceeded the previous emperors of Dong Huang!
This was how the Beast Tamers of the World King Star felt after watching this batch of God Sealing Battles.
However, although Zavay won, it still lost miserably to the intermediate divine examiner, the new examiner, after losing two Time Marks.
As for the previous Demolishing Divine Bull, it had been directly beaten down by Shi Yu and retired. No one knew where it had gone.
As for Dong Huangs faction, although no one could win the championship this time, they had also gained a lot. They had caught up to the quasi divines of the first tier of the universe less than a year after reviving. They were already very satisfied and felt that in another year, they could defeat Zavay.
Shi Yu wasn’t very surprised by the outcome of this battle. This was because when he replicated Zavay’s skill, Shi Yu also discovered that Zavay had improved quite a lot this year. Perhaps it had undergone a new transformation after losing to him. These old geniuses were also improving at all times.
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu.’
After Shi Yu returned to the World King Planet, the Prediction Owl found Shi Yu immediately.
“What’s wrong?”
Shi Yu was surprised to see the owl rushing over.
“When are you going to the overlord territory?” the owl asked.
“When Teacher Ying successfully breaks through.”
“Well, the cat hasn’t successfully broken through yet? In short, hurry up. I can’t wait anymore,” the owl said.
“From your expression, you don’t look like you can’t wait to travel, nor do you look like you want to level up…” Shi Yu was suspicious.
“It’s nothing. It’s just that in the past few days, 1 vaguely feel that something big will happen in the Cosmic Sea. I don’t want to stay here any longer. My brother feels the same, but the foundation of the Astrologer Race is here. It can’t leave..

chapters.title: Chapter 1654 - 1654: Protection Archeology and Destruction Archeology (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1654 - 1654: Protection Archeology and Destruction Archeology (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“But it doesn’t matter to me. I’ll go on a long trip with you for a while.” “What?” Shi Yu was stunned. “You all sensed it? M/hy didn’t I sense it?”
“Who else is there?” The owl was puzzled.
“Blue Planet’s Will also sensed that the Cosmic Sea isn’t calm. It might not be as safe as the border of the universe, so she plans to decide whether to go to the Cosmic Sea after a while.’
“Ah, this.” The owl was stunned.
“Can’t your astrologers predict what will happen in the Cosmic Sea?” Shi Yu asked.
The owl shook its head. “Buji Island, 1 can’t predict anything. From the perspective of premonition, everything is peaceful and quiet. Even the battle between the Contaminated Land and the Environmental Protection Army won’t affect anything.”
“Unless the Dark King attacks the Cosmic Sea… But it’s basically impossible.”
“In short, it’s the unscientific feeling. It makes me and my brother feel that there’s something wrong with the situation recently. Strange.”
“It’s fine if it’s just the two of us. It can be seen that the state of prediction has decreased too much, but Blue Planet’s Will actually…”
She fell into deep thought. What could it be that could make the Cosmic Sea not calm?
“Forget it, forget it. There’s no need to dodge a small disaster. You can’t dodge a huge disaster. Do what you have to do. Even if the sky collapses, Lord World King will hold it up,” the owl said.
“That’s true,” Shi Yu said. “The Cosmic Sea isn’t safe, so World King Planet will definitely be safe. That’s all for now. You go to Blue Planet to wait for Teacher
Cat first. I have something to do. Then, we’ll set off from the World King Planet.’
“Alright,” the owl said. “I’m also going to communicate with Blue Planet.”
Next, Shi Yu first arrived at the archeological association of the Floating Realm. After the Floating Realm advanced to a first-level realm, the archeological association also opened a branch here.
As for the president, he was the ancestor of the Lu family, one of the four major families in the Floating Realm.
The last two could actually be seen as the families where the Space Emperor and Lin Fengs wives were. Their families also had peak divine-level experts presiding over them, but compared to the two peak divine-level experts, Wang and Lin, there was still a huge difference in strength.
Among them, the ancestor of the Lu family had a certain amount of research on archeology. Previously, he was a member of the archeological association. This time, as the status of the Floating Realm increased, he was also promoted to the president of the archeological association in the Floating Realm.
President Lu was extremely shocked when Shi Yu visited. However, Shi Yu only asked for some information about protective archeological skills through his authority before leaving.
Then, just as Shi Yu thought, the level of the World King Planet Archeological
Association was indeed a huge difference from the cosmic overlord army. Shi Yu only looked at this information once and judged that the exploration of the
Chi You Ruins wouldn’t be useful.
“If I join, I can get a president of the headquarters,” Shi Yu said.
However, it was more or less new knowledge. Shi Yu still learned it, laying the foundation for him to learn skills similar to the Passage of Time in the future.
Then, a few days later.
Two figures appeared in the Dong Huang Realm.
“From today onwards, I’m a super divine!!!”
“Aren’t you annoying? This is the seventh time you’ve said this. When you broke through, you muttered to yourself once. When you saw the Blue Planet’s Will, you said it once. When you saw the Space Emperor, when you saw me…” Teacher Tu Na followed beside the gem cat and muttered.
“You don’t understand!” The gem cat smiled richly and looked at the gloomy sky. It felt that the weather was especially clear.
“You have no idea how strong a super divine level is!”
“Who said I don’t understand!”
The two cats kept arguing. It was surprisingly the gem cat that had already broken through to the super divine level. It returned to World King Planet with the owl.
As the two cats argued, they snorted and went to find Shi Yu.
At this moment, in the Dong Huang Realm, in the realm lord mystic realm, Shi Yu also opened his eyes and smiled. Teacher Cat had finally broken through.
He teleported to the outside world in a step and appeared in front of Teacher Cat and the others.
“From today onwards, she’s a super divine!” The owl was the first to introduce her to the cat, making the gem cat look angry.
“Forget it, when are we leaving?” the gem cat asked.
“Don’t worry, tell me how it feels to be at the super divine level. Have you successfully developed how to increase the quality of the source of transcendence?”
“Don’t worry, don’t worry. I don’t have this yet. The power of faith isn’t enough. I’ll try again when I’ve gathered enough inheritance,” the gem cat said. “Hmph, but in terms of strength, it’s stronger than I imagined.”
“If I want to, I can make a wish that there’s a huge planet that leaves its orbit and collides with Blue Planet. I can make a wish that the sun accelerates for some reason and finally explode, destroying the galaxy. If it’s Blue Planet before the breakthrough, it’ll definitely be very difficult to survive such a disaster…
“Even if it’s a cosmic disaster like the Starry Sky Storm, there’s a high chance of making a wish… Isn’t it very strong to let people encounter it!”
“Stop, stop, stop.” Shi Yu’s face darkened. “Why are they all murdering Blue Planet?”
The gem cat said innocently, “It’s more direct to use planets as an example.”
Shi Yu said, “Moreover, it’s Blue Planet before it broke through. It means that it can only deal with divine-level creatures.”
“Be careful. Don’t expose your identity as the weakest super divine… Otherwise…
The cat was furious. “Who’s the weakest super divine?”
“When we reach the overlord territory, I have to defeat a super divine for you to see.”
“Let me tell you. When I saw the ancestors of the five divine races on Blue
Planet, I wanted to ask them to spar with me, but they didn’t dare to agree.”
The owl thought to itself that it didn’t dare to agree. There was no benefit in defeating it. It was only natural. If it lost to it, it would be the real weakest super divine. They weren’t stupid, so why fight?
“Low profile, low profile. When we reach the overlord territory, we have to keep a low profile. There are many more powerful divine-levels over there than on World King Planet,” Teacher Tu Na reminded, afraid that Teacher Cat would be arrogant.
“Let’s go.” The gem cat snorted.
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled. At this moment, everyone was already here. It seemed like they could set off for the overlord territory.
Not only was the overlord territory the furthest from Blue Planet, but it was also very far from World King Planet. This voyage was the true voyage. Although he didn’t cultivate to a bottleneck on World King Planet, it was the same as before. It was the same to slowly cultivate on the trip. In any case, Shi
Yu still brought a lot of resources this time.
“Prepare, prepare. Let’s go,” Shi Yu said.
After Shi Yu and the others bid farewell to their acquaintances, they set off from World King Planet and began to head to the overlord territory.
The overlord territory was indeed far away. During the voyage, the concept of time faded again. Shi Yu spent time cultivating and adding points. In the blink of an eye, a year passed.
This was even under the situation where Shi Yu used super divine level energy to drive it. In the past year, after leaving the Cosmic Sea, they had basically not encountered any life.
It seemed to be a long way from the overlord territory.
Just as Shi Yu thought that he was going to work overtime for a long time on such a boring voyage, Ling said, “Master, a spaceship has been detected sending us a distress signal.”
“After deciphering it, the other party encountered a Starry Sky Storm during the voyage and was lucky enough to escape. However, the energy has been exhausted, and the spaceship is already broken. They hope to receive our
“It’s not good, right? We don’t have much energy left,” Shi Yu said. “After saving others, we encountered an accident during this period. What if we lack energy?”
“It said… that after it became a super divine, although it lacked navigation energy, it brought a bunch of other rare cultivation resources. It will definitely repay us. It can do anything.”
“Saving people is more important. If there’s not enough energy, we can delay the replenishment of the planet on the way,” Shi Yu said.
“Wait, it seems to be someone familiar,” Ling exclaimed.
In the distance, in a broken spaceship, a divine bull flew out and mooed for help in the starry sky.
It was Shi Yu and the others, the final examiner of the God Sealing Battle, the Demolishing Divine Bull Jermon.
At this moment, the Demolishing Divine Bull was crying in the starry sky. Unlucky, too unlucky. After being released from prison, because it was beaten up by that God Sealing King, it directly became the focus of discussion on the World King Planet. After being beaten up so badly, it felt that it instantly didn’t have the face to stay on the World King Planet, nor was it willing to its relatives and friends.
The originally dim intention of joining the cosmic overlord army appeared in the Demolishing Divine Bull Jermon’s heart again.
Not only did it want to join the cosmic overlord army, but it also wanted to see the cosmic overlord’s main body and worship its idol. Therefore, it chose to run away from home and bring its mechanical assistant to the overlord territory alone.
However, they had only set off for two years when they encountered the Starry Sky Storm and almost died…
However, there was always a way out. It looked at this battleship from the direction of the Cosmic Sea excitedly and expectantly, hoping to obtain their help…
“Moo, speaking of which, why does this battleship look so familiar?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1655 - 1655: Overlord Territory (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1655 - 1655: Overlord Territory (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
The Demolishing Divine Bull confirmed that it wasn’t wrong. It had definitely seen this battleship at a certain time. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be so familiar.
Where was it?
As it was thinking, the battleship opposite also slowly drove towards it.
Seeing that the battleship was paying attention to him, Jermon was delighted.
But soon, its joy stopped.
Because the battleship was densely filled with pirate flags.
What a sin! Space pirates?
This was like a weak girl getting lost in the forest and calling for help.
The Demolishing Divine Bull was stunned. However, so be it.
No matter who it was, as long as a life passed by, it was better than losing it in the universe.
At most, it would be stripped naked.
At most, it would join the other party and work.
It believed that the other party wouldn’t refuse a high-level divine.
But in the next moment, Jermon was stunned again.
Because a huge projection quickly appeared on the battleship. It was a figure. “Examiner Jermon, long time no see. Why are you so down and out?”
He was a divine-level big boss who had defeated Zavay 79 times in a row.
The huge figure was Shi Yu. Shi Yu greeted the examiner Jermon through the starry sky, stunning him.
“It’s you! ! ”
The Demolishing Divine Bull was extremely shocked. It looked at this familiar figure that made it fall into dire straits and was shocked.
Why was this King of Gods here?
“That’s right, it’s me…” Shi Yu said, “Examiner Jermon, looks like you need help.”
The Demolishing Divine Bull was stunned and wanted to say something.
But when it recalled that its broken spaceship couldn’t fly anymore, it hurriedly said, “Help me.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu opened the door for the Demolishing Divine Bull and let it come first.
Soon, the Demolishing Divine Bull flew directly to the accompanying flying reception cabin of the cosmic battleship. Then, it saw the clean and energetic Shi Yu inside.
“Moo! !
“It’s indeed you.” After the Demolishing Divine Bull entered, it had a complicated expression and asked, “Why are you here?”
“I’m here to find someone I know,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Speaking of which, Examiner Jermon, why are you here?”
“I…” Jermon was really embarrassed to say that he had run away from home.
He lied and said, “I’m also looking for an acquaintance.”
“Then, you encountered the Starry Sky Storm?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yes…” The Demolishing Divine Bull had a bitter expression.
“If it weren’t for that battle and the battle experience I obtained from you to deal with the Starry Sky Storm, I might have died now.”
“Now, my spaceship is already broken, and my energy supply is severely insufficient. My mechanical assistant is also broken, and it can’t help me lead the way. The range it’s in has also exceeded the upper limit of the Teleportation Key Stones. If I hadn’t brought enough resources, I would definitely have starved to death in the starry sky.”
“On account that we’re fated to fight, help me.”
“Examiner Jermon, don’t worry. I’ll get Ling to help you repair your navigation assistant and give you some energy,” Shi Yu said.
“Thank you…” The black yak was immediately extremely touched. Initially, after being beaten up by Shi Yu in the God Sealing Battle, it didn’t like Shi Yu and the others very much, but now, it felt that this group of people was alright.
“Are you going to the overlord territory to find someone?” Jermon asked.
Shi Yu said, “That’s right.”
“Can I go with you?” Jermon said. “I’m also going to the overlord territory.”
It suddenly remembered that even after the spaceship was repaired, it might still encounter danger.
It was a guy who knew nothing about cosmic navigation. It was still too difficult for it to sail alone.
However, Shi Yu and the others were different. Shi Yu’s Ling was a super mechanical life form that had mastered the cosmic disaster skill. It was definitely very expert in cosmic navigation. It would be best if he could hitch a ride.
“Uh, about that,” Shi Yu said.
“l won’t let you lead the way for free. What do you want? Energy crystal, cosmic crystal, super divine stone. I have many resources here,” the Demolishing Divine Bull said.
“You have a super divine stone??” Shi Yu was surprised.
“l heard that the super divine stone is very popular in the overlord territory, so I brought one from home.”
Shi Yu said, “In that case, it’s not impossible to spend some effort to give you a ride, Examiner Jermon, but I want this super divine stone.”
“Sure,” Jermon said in pain. This was the rarest resource he had brought.
Shi Yu smiled. The last time Captain Zi Jian gave him a super divine stone, he had yet to open it and was still saving it. Now that there was another one, it wasn’t bad.
The reason why Shi Yu wasn’t in a hurry to open it was because he felt that it was too troublesome to find the five super divines one at a time. He planned to gather five consecutive draws and ten consecutive draws before opening it.
Now, including this one, it was already clueless.
“In that case, Ling, help repair that spaceship and modify it into a companion spaceship. We’ll set off with Examiner Jermon,” Shi Yu said to Ling.
“Yes.” After answering, Lings clone flew out of the battleship and towards the Demolishing Divine Bull’s spaceship.
At this moment, the Demolishing Divine Bull said, ‘You guys… have already broken through to the divine level, right?”
It sensed the extraordinary aura of Ling.
“When did you leave World King Planet? Everyone should know about our
breakthrough,” Shi Yu asked.
“Not long after the God Sealing Battle ended, I left World King Planet.” “Divine level… Impressive… What have you done again? Everyone actually knows…” The corners of the Demolishing Divine Bull e s mouth twitched.
“l see. Haha, it’s nothing. We’ve indeed broken through to the divine level, and it’s been a while.. Fortunately, Examiner Jermon, didn’t you also break through to the high-level divine level?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1656 - 1656: Overlord Territory (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1656 - 1656: Overlord Territory (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu said. From the looks of it, forget about the battle result of them defeating a super divine, Examiner Jermon didn’t even know about the Blue Planet team building and him taking the Four Holy Ruins.
“High-level divine…” High-level divine was nothing. The Demolishing Divine Bull muttered in its heart. These guys in front of it could even defeat it, an intermediate-level divine, at the quasi-divine level. They were even more abnormal than that Zavay. Now that they had broken through to the divine level, wouldn’t they be able to compete with top-notch divines? As a high-level divine, it definitely couldn’t defeat the other party.
“It’s fixed.” Just as Shi Yu and the Demolishing Divine Bull were chatting, Lings clone flew back. After reporting, it fused back into its main body.
“It… it’s repaired?!” Examiner Jermon looked at his spaceship in the distance with a stunned expression.
How long had it been? Was it even a minute?
It turned around, looked at the intact spaceship, and was stunned. It was really repaired.
“It’s very good at these jobs. Since it’s repaired, let’s continue setting off. Let’s not waste too much time.’
“This, this.” Examiner Jermon still didn’t understand why it was repaired so quickly.
It quickly flew back to its spaceship and checked again. It realized that the broken mechanical assistant had also woken up.
“Monster machinery!” it muttered. It had never seen such a ridiculous mechanical life form. No wonder it could master cosmic disaster skills at the
quasi-divine level.
Just like that, under Shi Yu’s arrangements, Ling dragged Jermon’s spaceship and brought an additional burden to continue sailing.
Now that it had a pilot, Jermon relaxed. But soon, it suddenly felt that something was wrong.
Wait!
Shi Yu had clearly said that they were going to the overlord territory to find someone.
But… what was with the dense pirate flags he saw just now?
The other party’s goal was definitely not as simple as finding someone!
The Demolishing Divine Bull immediately felt that it had gotten into a pirate
“What happened?” As the battleship stopped, the super divine gem cat woke up from its sleep and stretched in boredom. It first went to find something to eat before strolling leisurely on the battleship. When it passed by Shi Yu, it asked.
For the past year, it had either slept or eaten. The gem cat didn’t feel free. It only felt that it was living very comfortably.
She liked this life too much.
“It’s nothing. I’ll save a cow along the way and obtain a super divine stone,” Shi Yu said. “Teacher Ying, can you stop sleeping? It’s time to work. Next, make a wish and encounter a few resource stars.’
“I’ve been working hard to cultivate other skills. I didn’t slack off!” the gem cat girl said.
“Sleeping isn’t lazy. I’m cultivating in a dream.” It had to be said that with a super divine level physique, learning quasi-divine skills and raising them to divine skills was as simple as adults learning addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
Now, the gem cat already had more than ten divine skills. Moreover, with the powerful control of the super divine level, it completed the nine-element combination divine skill and completed the upgrade of Meteorite Disillusionment.
Its battle power… was gradually approaching transcendent 1.
“Like hell I believe you. I got Baby Ginseng to develop this Cultivation Fruit skill just to slack off. Why did it become hard work so confidently when it came to you?” Shi Yu exposed it mercilessly, leaving the gem cat speechless.
“I’m leaving.” The gem cat left directly, and Shi Yu left to continue cultivating.
He summoned Beast Shi Yu. After a year of hard work, Beast Shi Yu had already cultivated to a certain extent.
As expected, just as Shi Yu had guessed, although the human bodies of this era couldn’t cultivate the Dower system of the previous era, Beast Shi Yu from the previous era could directly cultivate!
It wasn’t that he had completed the ability to transform into a Beast Taming Weapon, but apart from his physique, a new extraordinary power appeared in Beast Shi Yu’s body compared to before.
This extraordinary power was like a white aura that was purely extracted from Beast Shi Yu l s body through Shi Yu’s spirit.
Shi Yu didn’t know its name, but this aura could not only protect the mind and soul, but it could also cooperate with physical strength to attack. It was very useful.
The increase in Beast Shi Yu had already exceeded the use of the four holy faith equipment.
As Beast Shi Yu relied on the pseudo source of transcendence to strengthen, Shi Yu named it “Essence Energy”.
The Essence Energy was very strong.
Therefore, Shi Yu had already taken off all the equipment of Beast Shi Yu. There was no other reason… The power of the Four Holy Ruins had almost been used up by Shi Yu.
This was the price of adding all pets to the perfect divine level…
In short, raising the four holy pets and supporting points had already consumed a lot of energy. He really couldn’t afford to raise Beast Shi Yu.
Therefore, this new cultivation system came very timely. After losing the four holy armor, not only did Beast Shi Yu not become weaker, but he also became stronger.
Facing transcendent 1 to 3, it should be able to have a huge advantage. It had battle power comparable to that of transcendent 4.
Without a doubt, it was Shi Yu t s greatest trump card at the moment.
Unfortunately, apart from the new power system named “Essence Energy” by Shi Yu, Beast Shi Yu had yet to master the skill to turn life into a weapon. It wasn’t that the power system of the previous era was very difficult to learn. Those soldiers could all learn it, so there was no reason for Beast Shi Yu to learn it so slowly. After thinking about it, Shi Yu could only attribute it to the fact that Beast Shi Yu’s body was incomplete and lacked spirit and soul, causing his learning speed to decrease. Unfortunately, if he learned all of it, Beast Shi Yu t s battle power could still further increase his enhancement.
Next, Shi Yu entered a boring cultivation life..

chapters.title: Chapter 1657 - 1657: Overlord Territory (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1657 - 1657: Overlord Territory (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Apart from the accidental experience of picking up the Demolishing Divine Bull, the trip was smooth.
In the blink of an eye, another two months passed.
Shi Yu had never cultivated so hard for so long in one go.
Fortunately, Lings performance was not bad, and its energy was also very high-level. It only took a year to enter the overlord territory. Otherwise, Shi
Yu might have to experience what Phoenix Man and the others had experienced…
They set off from the World King Planet to the edge of the Cosmic Sea to find Blue Planet. With the help of many interstellar teleportation arrays, it took nearly ten years.
If Shi Yu used their aircraft to sail, Shi Yu estimated that he wouldn’t be able to reach his destination in a hundred years.
“Master, there’s someone else.’
“According to the star map, we seem to have finally approached the core of the overlord territory.”
“After arriving here, the number of interstellar fleets we might encounter will increase. ”
Shi Yu was awakened by Ling from his cultivation.
“Not bad. I haven’t seen anyone alive for so long. I thought we were lost.”
“But Master, the guy we encountered this time doesn’t seem to have good intentions,” Ling said.
“Huh??” Shi Yu was stunned.
At the same time, the Demolishing Divine Bull, which had been brought away by Shi Yu and the others for two months, also received a reminder from its mechanical assistant. When it learned that it was about to encounter other life forms, it couldn’t help but be excited.
It looked like it was close to the core area of the overlord territory.
However, just like Shi Yu and the others, when they observed the battleship in the distance, they were stunned.
Because this battleship was also filled with pirate flags…
Of course, most importantly, apart from the pirate flag, this pirate crew also had the symbol of the cosmic overlord army!
“The overlord territory and the Cosmic Sea. These two places should be the most popular places for Space Pirates,” Shi Yu said.
“That’s right…” Ling said, “However, the pirates in the overlord territory are relatively different.”
“The pirates here basically have more official identities. In other words, not only are they from the cosmic overlord army, but they’re also Space Pirates. They’re lawfully looting and even snatching from their own people.”
“They’re even snatching things from their own people. It’s really f*cking crazy,” Shi Yu said. “So we… encountered someone in the same industry?” “Yes, the other party should want to snatch our stuff.” Ling nodded.
As soon as they finished speaking, the pirate battleship opposite had already issued a warning. A red sigh instantly appeared on Lings display, and the voice came from afar!
[Warning! The pirate ship in front, stop quickly.]
[Warning! If you don’t carry out the ‘rules battle; we will launch a full-scale attack.]
[Warning! ]
Under the continuous warnings of the other party, at this moment, Examiner Jermon hurriedly asked for a conversation and shouted for Shi Yu in the conversation channel.
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu, the pirates of the cosmic overlord army are opposite. Talk to them nicely and don’t get into a conflict!”
“It’s best to carry out a ‘rules battle r .”
Examiner Jermon was very familiar with the cosmic overlord army and the matters in the overlord territory.
“This is a big characteristic of the overlord territory. Many factions plunder for a living. However, because everyone belongs to the cosmic overlord army and many foreign merchant groups want to do business with the cosmic overlord army, it’s not easy to destroy the trading ecology. Therefore, the Space Pirates here basically won’t be ruthless.”
“Generally speaking, it’s two groups that act according to the rules. One person from each group will carry out a duel of some resources. The winner will take away the other party’s resources. Everyone, continue sailing. If there’s no deep hatred, it won’t lead to a full-scale life and death battle.”
“We should just admit that we’re unlucky and fight the other party according to the rules. Don’t offend the local tyrant.”
Shi Yu, Ling, and the others stopped the battleship and opened the door for the Demolishing Divine Bull. The black yak immediately entered.
“Examiner Jermon, you’re very familiar with this side,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Moo,” the black yak said with a chuckle. That was true. After all, in order to join the cosmic overlord army, it had done a lot of homework. If it weren’t for the fact that the overlord army of the Cosmic Sea didn’t dare to take it in due to the pressure ot its family, it would have long joined.
At this moment, the two battleships stopped in the starry sky. Soon, dense figures appeared in the battleship opposite. About dozens of people came out of this battleship, from quasi-divine to divine-level.
Although they were humans, they weren’t humans, but Darekians. They had red humanoid bodies. Compared to humans, they had a pair of long red antennae and belonged to the Space Race and aliens.
“It’s the Darekians. Their battle power is very strong.” When the black yak saw the composition of this pirate crew, its heart turned cold. It knew that the resources were completely gone.
“He looks a little familiar,” Shi Yu said when he saw the other party. It seemed that Captain Zi Jian’s two top-notch divine bodyguards were Darekians. “Since it’s not suitable for a conflict, let’s go too. We’ll settle it peacefully,” Shi Yu said.
With that said, Shi Yu teleported out of the battleship and arrived in the starry sky, facing the pirate crew opposite.
At this moment, the Darekians saw the unfamiliar symbol and name of the Era Pirate Group and felt strange. When they saw that only two people had appeared on the other side, a human and a black yak, they felt even more strange.
“Where are you from? Why are you so unfamiliar?” The top-notch divine Darekians in the lead said, “We’re the ‘Seventh Division of the Darekians
Pirates’. You know the rules, right?”
“l know, but before that, let me ask you a question. We’re from the Cosmic Sea and came to find someone we know. I wonder if you’ve heard of her. Her name is Zi Jian. She’s also from the cosmic overlord army and specializes in archeology. She’s the captain of the Zi Jian Special Forces,” Shi Yu asked for directions..

chapters.title: Chapter 1658 - 1658: Overlord Territory (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1658: Overlord Territory (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Zi Jian’s special forces?” Upon hearing Shi Yu mention this side, the surrounding Darekians discussed. Clearly, they had heard of the Zi Jian’s special forces. The Darekian in the lead narrowed his eyes and said, “So you’re a friend of the Zi Jian’s special forces. I’ve indeed heard of the Zi Jian’s special forces going to the Cosmic Sea.”
“However, even if you know the Zi Jian’s special forces, you still have to follow the rules. How about this? If you can win, we’ll tell you where the Zi Jian’s special forces should be at this time.”
“And if you lose, one super divine resource will be left.”
“I’m the captain of the Seventh Division of the Darekians Pirates, Fa Kun. I swear on the honor of the cosmic overlord army that the battle is fair and just.”
“No problem,” Shi Yu said. It was still difficult to say, but from the looks of it, Captain Zi Jian’s reputation was useless. This group of people actually still wanted to fight. However, considering that the pirates of the cosmic overlord army had even snatched from their own people, he was relieved.
“The rule is for a 1 vs 1. If the one fighting is a human Beast Tamer, it’s fine to only count the number of humans, right?”
“No problem,” Shi Yu said again.
As soon as he finished speaking, the group of pirates smiled, feeling that they had encountered a fat sheep.
“Are these guys really pirates? Why do I feel like they’re fat sheep? They actually agreed to bet with the ‘super divine resource’ for a lousy position information.’
“Moreover, when they heard the name of our Darekians Pirates, they actually didn’t feel any sense of danger at all. This super divine resource was taken too easily.”
“The gains this time aren’t small. I feel that Boss should want more. From the looks of it, they don’t look poor.”
“Hey, hey, hey.” Jermon was also vexed by Shi Yu’s arrogance.
Darekians were a large race in the overlord territory. In the Cosmic Sea, they definitely had the strength of the top 50 races in the starry sky. Not only did they have top-notch experts, but they also had many members. The lower limit of their race was also high, and they would definitely be divines when they reached adulthood.
They had infiltrated various fields of the universe overlord army, and their strength couldn’t be underestimated at all…
However, Shi Yu was really here to find someone? It had also heard of the Zi Jian’s special forces!
“All the best. The other party is very strong,” Jermon said. “You’ve broken through, so you should still be stronger than me. You don’t need me to fight, right? Moo.”
“Of course not, but if I lose, you can give me the resources,” Shi Yu said.
The Demolishing Divine Bull’s heart cracked.
“Call Shalud over.” Just as Shi Yu and the others had yet to decide on their battle target, on the Darekians Pirates’ side, under the call of the captain of the seventh division, a huge green fat dragon monster that looked like a dinosaur walked out of the other party’s battleship.
“Shalud, there’s another battle. Please,” the captain of the Darekians Pirates said.
“l understand. Leave it to me.” The green fat dragon spread its wings and flew to the center of the starry sky.
Seeing this green fat dragon, Jermon’s expression darkened again. “Perfect divine…
“As expected of the Darekians Pirates of the cosmic overlord army. There’s actually a perfect divine presiding over one team. It’s over. It’s completely over now.”
With a top-notch divine, he thought that Shi Yu could still fight, but from the looks of it, it was better to admit defeat directly and give resources.
No… his resources!!!
“Isn’t this normal? We’re out to rob and bet. If we don’t have some strength, we’ll lose so much that we won’t even have our pants,” Shi Yu said indifferently.
Hu hu hu.
The flying green dragon stopped and shouted,
“Hey, little brats opposite, I’m a combatant of the Seventh Division of the Darekians Pirates, Shalud. Who wants a duel? Come out quickly.”
Just as it finished speaking, the mechanical hatch of Shi Yu’s pirate crew’s battleship opened, and an extremely beautiful mechanical Wind Kirin flew out of the battleship.
This was a battle mechanical clone created by Ling.
“It’s here. It’s your next opponent.” As Shi Yu spoke, the Wind Kirin had already flown opposite Shalud. Seeing its opponent and the Wind Kirin that appeared, be it the members of the Darekians Pirates or the Demolishing Divine Bull, their pupils constricted.
The Wind Kirin in the starry sky had an elegant form and aura, but it couldn’t hide the shocking divine power on its body.
The surrounding people actually sensed the huge divine power fluctuations of a perfect divine on this Wind Kirin.
The Darekians Pirates, who thought that they had encountered a fat sheep, instantly understood that the pirates of this era weren’t to be trifled with.
This unknown little pirate group actually had a perfect divine presiding over it.
Without the appearance of a super divine, a perfect divine was already the core battle power of most factions.
“It’s…” Jermon was stunned. He didn’t remember such a pet among Shi Yu’s pets.
Could it be a new pet?
No.
Shi Yu had just reached the divine level not long ago. There was no reason for him to be able to control a perfect divine.
Perhaps this was the guardian of Shi Yu’s trip. Hope rose in the bull’s heart again.
Perhaps its super divine resources could still be saved!
“Don’t worry, Lord Shalud has experienced hundreds of battles. The unknown creature opposite looks delicate and weak. It should mainly cultivate wind-element power. It won’t be a match for the powerful Space Dragon Race,” someone in the Darekians Pirates analyzed the situation.
The originally one-sided battle of rules in the eyes of the Darekians Pirates instantly became confusing.
“You attack first.” Shalud had indeed never seen a pet like the Wind Kirin. It couldn’t help but be cautious. The other party’s divine power wasn’t inferior to its own, and its ability was unknown. It planned to be safer and counter every move to find the other party’s weakness. After all, it was related to a super divine resource, so it didn’t dare to be sloppy..

chapters.title: Chapter 1659 - 1659: Overlord Territory (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1659 - 1659: Overlord Territory (5)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Roar! However, although it let the other party attack first, it still condensed a tall and huge dragon armor and armed its entire body. The towering divine armor body made Shalud’s aura even more terrifying.
A vast green divine power swept through the starry sky, forming a shocking galaxy phenomenon that flowed around.
“In that case, I won’t hold back,” the Wind Kirin clone replied calmly.
When it spoke, the examiner, Jermon, was stunned. It felt that this voice was familiar. In the next moment, as the Wind Kirin muttered softly, a small seven-colored typhoon condensed in front of it. This small typhoon was extremely violent, like the chaos caused by thousands of stars falling into a star.
Buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz!! In the small typhoon, a fatal aura kept emitting, making Shalud’s heart skip a beat. In the next moment, as the Wind Kirin swung its head, the small wind ball was directly thrown out and disappeared from the spot. In an instant, spatial ripples appeared in front of Shalud.
It was only when the Starry Sky Storm approached that Shalud realized how terrifying this skill was. Its expression instantly trembled.
“This is… Starry Sky Storm?? How is this possible!!!” As Shalud shouted in
shock, its body was instantly hit. The armor on its body seemed to have encountered a terrifying attack and instantly turned into powder. The cells on its body also kept dying, as if it had encountered an incomparable toxin-like heavy injury. Under its heart-wrenching scream, the small storm even emitted a boom that was like countless stars exploding, drowning its voice.
“Shalud!!!” Seeing this scene, everyone from the Darekians Pirates was shocked and couldn’t believe it.
When everyone opened their mouths in shock to react, the light had already dissipated. At this moment, Shalud, who had just turned into a god, directly lost consciousness from all the injuries. Its body emitted smoke in the starry sky. It was first swept up by the gust and stopped for a moment. Then, in a miserable state… it slowly fell down.
“Lord Shalud!!!” Everyone was shocked again. He was… insta-killed?
“Who exactly are you!” The captain of the seventh division was shocked and couldn’t understand this scene. If the other party was a super divine, he could still understand, but they were both perfect divines. How was this possible?
“Looks like we won.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Don’t worry, its injuries aren’t fatal.’
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Jermon, who was beside him, was the most stunned. It could tell that the Wind Kirin’s move just now was clearly a skill that compressed a disaster like the Starry Sky Storm to the extreme. Jermon, who had escaped death in the Starry Sky Storm not long ago, was very familiar with the Starry Sky Storm.
But how was this possible? How could the Starry Sky Storm be compressed? Even if it mastered a similar disaster skill, how much proficiency would it take? Control?
“Could it be that it’s… Ling?” At this moment, examiner Jermon spoke beside Shi Yu. Could it be that this Wind Kirin was Ling?? After all, Ling also mastered the Starry Sky Storm!
However, in such a short period of time, it really couldn’t believe that Ling, who had yet to even enter the top three of Shi Yu e s team, could grow to this extent and instantly kill a perfect divine!
“Oh? To be precise, it’s Lings clone. Its main body is still in a navigation state, so it’s not easy to attack,” Shi Yu said.
A year ago, Ling was a quasi epoch god with two perfect (+47) divine skills. Now, Space Control, Starry Sky Storm, and other divine skills had also been maxed out by Shi Yu. A pile of quasi-transcendent divine skills could defeat a perfect divine with a clone. If it wanted its main body to attack, it had to be a super divine.
This examiner, Jermon, left the World King Planet so early. As expected, it didn’t know anything. It was just a perfect divine. What was it nervous about? It wasn’t a big deal. However, Shi Yu realized an important problem… This guy had other super divine resources in its pocket!
“What, clone???” When Shi Yu finished speaking, Jermon found it even more difficult to accept. It couldn’t understand.. Stop lying to it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1660 - 1660: Challenging a Cosmic Overlord (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1660 - 1660: Challenging a Cosmic Overlord (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Because they had lost the rules battle, the Darekians Pirates had no choice but to fulfill their promise.
As the rescue personnel ran to retrieve Shalud, the captain of the Darekians Pirates looked at Shi Yu, the Demolishing Divine Bull, and the Wind Kirin in silence.
Although it didn’t know their identities and origins, it was already certain that this was a very terrifying pirate crew. Fortunately, there had been no direct large-scale conflict previously. Otherwise, their seventh division would have suffered.
This time… it had kicked an iron plate.
However, fortunately, what was used as a bet this time was only ordinary information.
“We admit defeat,” Captain Darekian said. “According to the bet, we will tell you where the Zi Jian’s special forces are.”
“That star path isn’t easy to walk. From the start, we were the ones who took advantage of the bet. Next, we’ll lead the way and escort you over.”
“Alright,” Shi Yu said. “Then I’ll leave it to you. However, we’re in a hurry. It’s best if we can drive faster.’
“About a month’s flight,” Captain Darekian said.
“No problem.” As Shorty didn’t sense the other party’s malice, Shi Yu chose to believe the other party.
Then, both parties returned to their battleships.
Examiner Jermon followed behind Shi Yu and saw with its own eyes that after the Wind Kirin entered the battleship, it slowly integrated. It couldn’t help but be stunned again.
“Moo Q’ It stepped on the ground, and its cow hair stood on end. “Why are you so strong?”
Even if the upgrade of the mechanic class was relatively simple in theory, it shouldn’t be that fast.
As long as there was a higher-level mechanical system and the guidance of a powerful mechanical god, the upgrade of the mechanic class was very fast. If there was no way, researching it itself would be the slowest.
The Demolishing Divine Bull felt that, with Shi Yu e s identity as the King of Gods and his identity as a doctorate in disaster science, it wasn’t difficult for him to come into contact with higher-level mechanical systems. But even so, wasn’t this leveling speed a little too fast?
In more than two years, from a quasi divine to the top of a perfect divine, not to mention a descendant of a super divine family like it, even a son of a super divine wouldn’t be so fierce.
“It’s very simple. Just use more resources,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Resources…” The corners of Jermon’s mouth twitched when it saw Shi Yu so calm.
“They’re not second-generation heirs, but they’re definitely going to leave a deep mark in the starry sky of the universe and become the first generation of super divines who are the most dazzling!” Although examiner Jermon was ignorant and incompetent, it had been locked in the prison of the World King Planet for 100 years and had seen all kinds of geniuses. It had also interacted with geniuses like Ming Gu and Zavay for so long. It was still good at judging people.
Shi Yu’s growth trajectory was different from some second-generation geniuses. The only ones it could associate with were the capable subordinates at the peak of the super divine level under the thrones of the various universes.
“Shi Yu, is the Zi Jian f s special force you’re going to find the same special force that’s good at archeology?”
“That’s right, you know it too,” Shi Yu said. “So who are you looking for? I can help you ask Captain Zi Jian.” “Ah…” Jermon said, “This, that, actually…”
“I’m actually looking for…”
“The cosmic overlord!”
Shi Yu:
“You’re probably dreaming, right?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
Although one of his goals on this trip was also to see if he could see a cosmic overlord, thinking about it, a cosmic overlord wasn’t that easy to see.
Only by being at the peak of the super divine level could one see a World King. It slept all year round.
It was probably even harder to see a cosmic overlord stronger than a World King.
Not to mention Jermon, even its super divine grandfather would probably find It difficult to see a cosmic overlord.
“There’s no hurry…” Jermon said, “I’ll think of a way slowly.”
“Actually, I’ve accidentally heard of a way to see a cosmic overlord, but I’m not sure yet. I need to verify it. When the time comes, let me talk to Captain Zi
Jian. I’ll definitely know!”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded. This cow looked to know a lot about the cosmic overlord army.
“Next, let’s follow them first.” Shi Yu looked ahead.
Nearly a month later.
Twilight Star Realm, Heavenly Net Planet.
“Not long ago, an era ruin appeared in the Twilight Star Realm. It’s suspected to be a ruin mystic realm from the ‘last era’. The headquarters summoned many archeological teams to return. Among them, the Zi Jian’s special forces were temporarily summoned back to explore the ruins.”
On the screen of the space battleship, Ling, a message from the Darekians Pirates leading the way appeared.
“Now, their location should be here. Twilight Star Realm, Heavenly Net Planet.’
“This planet is the temporary camp of Zi Jian’s special forces.”
“Who is it!!”
When the Darekians Pirates approached the Heavenly Net Planet, two powerful auras came from the area. Each of them had reached the top-notch divine level and wasn’t inferior to Captain Darekian.
With two beams of light, two aliens with red antennae flew into the starry sky and looked at the symbol of the Darekians Pirates with puzzled gazes. “Hello, fellow clansmen. There’s no need to be nervous. We mean no harm.’ Captain Darekian appeared and spoke politely.
“What’s the matter?” The two Darekians in the Zi Jian’s special forces weren’t nervous at all. Now that cracking the era ruin was a big project of the cosmic overlord army, although they were of the same race and camp, if the Darekians Pirates dared to cause trouble, not to mention a division, even the entire pirate crew would probably be dealt with..

chapters.title: Chapter 1661 - 1661: Challenging a Cosmic Overlord (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1661 - 1661: Challenging a Cosmic Overlord (2)
“We’re just leading the way and helping a guest come to find Captain Zi Jian,” Captain Darekian said.
At this moment, the door of the Era Pirate Group after the Darekians Pirates was also opened. Shi Yu and the Demolishing Divine Bull heaved a sigh of relief.
They had finally arrived at their destination.
Shi Yu flew over and smiled when he saw Captain Zi Jian’s two guards. “Brothers, long time no see. How’s Captain Zi Jian?”
When the two top-notch divine-level Darekians saw that the guest Captain Darekian mentioned was Shi Yu, their expressions were instantly shocked.
“Realm lord Shi Yu?!” They said in disbelief.
Unlike Captain Darekian, they had just returned from the Cosmic Sea. When they returned, the Blue Planet bloodline behind Shi Yu had already completed the construction of the Assassin Planet cluster.
Therefore, the two Darekians knew very well how terrifying the faction behind Shi Yu was.
One planet with 11 super divines!
Of course, Shi Yu wasn’t simple either. He had obtained the title of King of Gods at a young age and was one of the strongest Kings of Gods. He could be said to have considerable potential.
Shi Yu had actually come to the overlord territory…
“Captain Zi Jian is here. Let’s inform Captain Zi Jian to welcome the realm lord Shi Yu.’
“You’re all guests. Why don’t everyone rest on Heavenly Net Planet?” Right on the heels of that, they looked at Captain Darekian again. Captain Darekian nodded. Their pirate crew indeed needed to be replenished.
At the same time, it also wanted to know the origin of this era’s pirate crew… Was Shi Yu… the realm lord of the World King Planet? However, why did he bring the pirate flag… and even come from afar to visit the Zi Jian’s special forces?
“Shi Yu?!” After learning that Shi Yu had come, Zi Jian was very surprised.
Heavenly Net Planet’s palace.
Shi Yu, examiner Jermon, and Ling were outside. The other pets were in Shi Yu t s Beast Taming Space, while the gem cat and owl were still sleeping soundly in Lings body.
Before anything important happened, Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to wake them up. It was better to sleep more and increase his strength.
“Shi Yu, why are you here? And this is… I remember now. Isn’t this the examiner from the God Sealing Battle?” Captain Zi Jian came to welcome Shi Yu and the others.
“Moo.” Jermon felt very embarrassed by Captain Zi Jian’s familiarity. It didn’t expect to encounter someone who had seen that battle in the overlord territory.
“l accidentally encountered examiner Jermon on the journey, so we went together.” Shi Yu smiled and said, came to the overlord territory to do something. I happened to think of Captain Zi Jian, so I came to visit.”
“It shouldn’t be purely to visit, right? Instead, it’s to ask for something,” Captain Zi Jian said with a chuckle.
“But it’s also suitable. I happen to want to buy a batch of Cultivation Fruits from you. You should have brought the goods, right? On this side, you can have as many super divine stones as you want.”
“That’s easy,” Shi Yu said. “1 do have something to ask of you.”
“Let’s talk inside,” Captain Zi Jian said.
In the palace, Zi Jian led Shi Yu and the others to say, “This is the palace of the Heavenly Net Planet’s royal family. After we came, they moved out. The environment is a little simple. Please forgive us.”
“Cool Q’ Jermon said. It liked the bandit-like cosmic overlord army.
“l wonder what you need. I’ll definitely help if I can. However, if it’s something that even your Blue Planet can’t solve, I feel that I can’t help much,” Captain Zi Jian said.
The few of them sat looking at each other. Examiner Jermon also turned into a black bull in a suit and sat on the sofa.
“l wonder, Captain Zi Jian, have you heard of the Star Prayer Race?” Shi Yu said.
“Star Prayer Race??” Captain Zi Jian was slightly surprised. “You mean, on that World King Planet, a race that’s good at using the power of the stars to make wishes?”
“Weren’t they destroyed?” Jermon asked.
“Indeed, but when the Star Prayer Race was destroyed, it gathered the power of the entire race to make a wish and turned the inheritance of the entire race into seven Wish Stars to teleport to the entire universe. I wonder if Captain Zi
Jian has heard of this legend.”
“WI-I…” Captain Zi Jian was stunned. She nodded and said, “I’ve heard of it.”
“So the goal of your trip is…”
“l want to ask around. Who in the overlord territory has the Wish Star inheritance or has fused with the Wish Star inheritance?” Shi Yu asked.
Strangely enough, the owl predicted the location of the five Wish Star
inheritances. One of them was in the Contaminated Land, and the other four were all in the overlord territory.
In the Contaminated Land, the owl predicted the exact location and was precise to the “star domain”. Although this was also a very large range, it wasn’t impossible to find. In fact, that was the case. Shi Yu and the others were very lucky to obtain it in seconds.
However, the four pieces in the overlord territory were different. Their locations were very vague, and the owl couldn’t lock onto them accurately. The premonition range was far vaster than the star domain in the Contaminated Land. It would be very troublesome to find them.
Shi Yu estimated that this reason appeared because these four Wish Stars were all in the hands of experts.
Moreover, it was very likely a super divine-level expert.
This way, it was relatively difficult for the owl to predict. It made sense. Because the holder of the piece on the divine-level Beast Tamer Yue Ling was relatively weak, it was naturally easy to predict. It was definitely impossible for it to be so easy to predict on experts.
Therefore, he should first come to the local tyrant to ask for some information. Then, he would investigate and screen according to this information. It should be able to shrink the range a lot and save a lot of time.
“I’ve never paid attention to this, but give me some time. It won’t be long. I should be able to help you investigate through the overlord network.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1662 - 1662: Challenging a Cosmic Overlord (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1662 - 1662: Challenging a Cosmic Overlord (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Thank you, Captain Zi Jian,” Shi Yu said.
“I’ll get my assistant to investigate now.” Zi Jian took out a special device and hung it in his ear. He wore it on the side of his face, as if it was connected to some special Internet. He said, “Little Bei, help me investigate the Star Prayer Race and the Wish Star inheritance.’
With that said, she looked at Shi Yu and the others again and said, “That’s it, right?”
Shi Yu looked at Jermon, and Jermon also looked at Captain Zi Jian and asked,
“Captain Zi Jian, I’ve once heard that there’s a challenge called the Glory
Challenge’ in the overlord territory. Does it really exist?”
“Glory Challenge??”
“You want to see the cosmic overlord?” she asked.
“The Glory Challenge is indeed related to the cosmic overlord!” The Demolishing Divine Bull was extremely excited.
Zi Jian said, “There is indeed such a thing.”
She looked at Shi Yu, Jermon, and Ling and said, “The Glory Challenge is also a battle of honor. Only members of the cosmic overlord army can participate.”
“Success or failure, there are essentially no rewards. However, the successful one can see the universe overlord. This is a great honor for any challenger. It can also be seen as a reward. This is also the origin of the name of the Glory
Challenge.”
“Generally speaking, even for me, even for super divine experts, it’s very difficult to see the cosmic overlord. The Glory Challenge might be the only chance for those whose strength hasn’t reached the standard to see the cosmic overlord.’
“l wonder what the details of this Glory Challenge are,” Shi Yu asked.
“Yes, yes,” said the Demolishing Divine Bull.
Captain Zi Jian smiled and said, “Well, it’s actually very difficult. Don’t think about it.’
“Lord cosmic overlord once left a will deterrence somewhere in the starry sky.
The Glory Challenge is this deterrence.”
“You can only pass if you withstand the deterrence of the cosmic overlord. 1 forgot to tell you. The cosmic overlord once killed a peak super divine who wanted to resist it with a deterrence hundreds of millions of years ago…”
“What!!!” The Demolishing Divine Bull said in shock, “Then isn’t it impossible to pass this Glory Challenge?”
“It’s not that absolute. The example I gave only means that the power of a cosmic overlord is different from the strength of the challenger. Its will will also automatically adjust the strength.”
“In other words, the weaker the challengers strength, the weaker his willpower, the stronger he is, and the stronger his willpower. It’s equivalent to the ‘low-level battle’ we often talk about. It’s equivalent to a cosmic overlord suppressing his willpower deterrence to the same level as the challenger.”
“But even so, the chances of passing are very small. There was once a guy who had just become a super divine and wanted to see the cosmic overlord, so he challenged the Glory Challenge. In the end… he only lasted for a few seconds before being suppressed by deterrence and giving up.”
“There was once a super genius who defeated a super divine at the divine level. He also wanted to meet the cosmic overlord, but he was still suppressed by a will deterrence and gave up on seeking an audience.”
“Well, someone has once made an evaluation. The difficulty of the Glory Challenge is dozens of times harder than becoming the King of Gods on World King Planet, right?”
“Even if it’s a real super divine level divine-level genius with super divine battle power, it’s extremely difficult to pass.”
Jermon:
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
The bull felt that it had no hope of seeing a cosmic overlord in its life. It completely didn’t think that it could withstand the deterrence of the will of a cosmic overlord.
“Of course, there’s another point. Not everyone can undergo the Glory Challenge. Firstly, what I just said is that only members of the cosmic overlord army can participate. Moreover, ordinary members aren’t enough. Only members above the purple medal can participate.”
“Red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, and purple. The purple medal is the highest medal grade that ordinary members of the non-officer cadre can attain.”
“And if you want to obtain the purple medal, either your strength reaches the super divine level, or you make huge contributions to the cosmic overlord army in a certain field. Here, for example, I obtained the purple medal through my achievements in the archeological field. My status is basically equivalent to the super divine level. However, even I spent more than a hundred years to obtain this purple medal. I only obtained the purple medal after helping the cosmic overlord army find a source of transcendence and handing it in. In terms of difficulty, it’s basically equivalent to nurturing a super divine level. It’s not easier than becoming a super divine level myself…”
“Ah, ah, ah, ah.” Jermon!s head almost exploded with this information, and its bull lungs also exploded. It felt that it was too difficult to see the cosmic overlord. It was even harder than fulfilling its grandfather’s expectations and becoming a super divine level.
“Of course, it’s not like there’s no other way. If you don’t have a purple medal, but you’ve obtained the recommendation of someone with a ‘purple medal’, you can also undergo the Glory Challenge. However, the recommendation spot of someone with a ‘purple medal’ is only once in your life. The recommended person can only be recommended once in his life.”
“Examiner Jermon, if you’re interested, I can sell my recommendation spot to you. I’ll sell it to you with tears. I only want 10 super divine stones. I remember that you want to join the cosmic overlord army very much, right?”
Jermon’s eyes rolled back and it fainted.
“Aiya,” Captain Zi Jian said. “l found it.”
At this moment, Captain Zi Jian said, “Shi Yu, there’s news about the Wish Star you’re looking for..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1663 - 1663: Challenging a Cosmic Overlord (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1663 - 1663: Challenging a Cosmic Overlord (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Her expression was strange, very strange, making Shi Yu, who was opposite her, have a bad feeling.
“What’s wrong, Captain Zi Jian…”
“If you want to collect Wish Stars, you might not have a chance.”
“What do you mean?” Shi Yu said nervously. Even if the Wish Star inheritance was in the hands of a super divine-level expert, he still had to collect it.
Searching half of it, wouldn’t this force someone with OCD to death?
“There is indeed the Wish Star inheritance in the overlord territory, and there are four Wish Stars!” Captain Zi Jian said.
Shi Yu nodded. Yes, four pieces!!
Captain Zi Jian said, “These four Wish Star inheritances were originally scattered in the overlord territory, the Behemoth Empire, and the Worm
Nest.”
“They were all captured by the cosmic overlord army in the war.”
“After a few turns, they didn’t successfully be fused by anyone. In the end, they all landed in the hands of the ‘collector’.”
“The collector is a super divine expert in the cosmic overlord army. He’s famous for his hobby of collecting various rare treasures.”
Shi Yu asked, “The four inheritances are all in the hands of this collector??”
[l can tell from the name. This guy must be very stingy!] The bull thought to itself that it wouldn’t be easy to obtain the inheritances.
“No, if that’s all, you still have hope of obtaining it. As long as you take out a rarer treasure and trade with him, he might not refuse,” Captain Zi Jian said. “But the problem is that on the ‘overlord’s birthday’, the collector gave the four Wish Stars to the cosmic overlord as a gift.”
“The birthday of the overlord is a festival that’s spread in the overlord territory to celebrate the day the cosmic overlord becomes the strongest in the universe. On this day, many experts will send gifts to congratulate the cosmic overlord.’
“Of course, the cosmic overlord doesn’t care about this at all. It might not even know the information of these gifts. Basically, these gifts will be transported by the cosmic overlord army to the overlord treasure vault to collect.”
“It’s impossible to take out something that has entered the overlord’s treasure vault… That’s impossible,” Captain Zi Jian said. “No one dares to touch Lord Cosmic Overlord’s things, even if it’s at the peak of the super divine level, even if Lord Cosmic Overlord doesn’t care about those things.”
“Ah, this.” Shi Yu was stunned. The four Wish Stars were together. When he heard this information, Shi Yu was originally pleasantly surprised. He felt that it could save a lot of time to collect them, but now that he heard Captain Zi Jian’s words, it seemed a little complicated to obtain them.
“Therefore, if you want to obtain it, you can only get it personally from the cosmic overlord, right?” Shi Yu asked.
Captain Zi Jian was amused. What kind of daydream was this?
The bull also looked at Shi Yu as if it was looking at an idiot.
It was already as difficult as ascending to the heavens to see a cosmic overlord, and he still wanted a cosmic overlord to give him a gift? He even specified items? And four? Dream on!!
“Moo!!! (As expected of you.)” The bull scoffed.
“Captain Zi Jian, let’s talk about something. Give me the recommendation spot for the Glory Challenge with your purple medal. I want to undergo the Glory Challenge and meet the cosmic overlord.”
Captain Zi Jian and the Demolishing Divine Bull: “?”
“What, you also want to undergo the Glory Challenge?” Captain Zi Jian said in shock. “Didn’t I tell you the premise? You have to be a member of the cosmic overlord army to be recommended and challenge.”
“Then I’ll join the cosmic overlord army,” Shi Yu said. If it were in the past, he might have been conflicted. After all, World King Planet was the most suitable support for Blue Planet.
However, after learning that Goddess Wa r s strength was at the peak of the super divine level and that she had once managed the cosmic overlord army on behalf of the cosmic overlord, Shi Yu understood that Goddess Wa had a deep relationship with the cosmic overlord. Otherwise, it was impossible for Goddess Wa to let him ask the cosmic overlord for help.
The cosmic overlord army was the best support! So be it. The World King Planet didn’t specify that he wasn’t allowed to join the cosmic overlord army or not. Using his relationship with Goddess Wa, he was still embarrassed to directly ask the cosmic overlord for the Wish Star.
“Moo!!!” The bull also looked at Shi Yu in shock. Wait a minute, why did he also want to join the cosmic overlord army? Wasn’t he the supernova of the World King Star, the King of Gods?
“Are you sure???” Captain Zi Jian was confused. She could tell that Shi Yu really wanted the Wish Star. She said, “Even if you join, even if 1 recommend you, the Glory Challenge is really difficult. If you’re still at the quasi-divine level, you might have a chance… After all, you can be called the strongest quasi-divine…”
“But you’ve just broken through to the divine level…”
Shi Yu said, “I’ve made up my mind. I still want to challenge the deterrence of the cosmic overlord..

chapters.title: Chapter 1664 - 1664: Luck Turns Around (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1664 - 1664: Luck Turns Around (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Looking at Shi Yu’s gaze, Zi Jian could confirm that this guy was serious.
She wanted to say something, but in the end, she gave up.
“So you mean…”
“I’ll join the overlord army first. Then, Captain Zi Jian will recommend me. Sorry to trouble you, Captain Zi Jian! Well… With your status, Captain Zi Jian, you should be able to directly approve my entry, right? I’ll register under the Zi Jian’s special forces first,” Shi Yu said.
Zi Jian was silent. If that skeleton, Luster, knew that Shi Yu planned to join her team, it would probably be envious to the point of madness.
“I still have to remind you…”
“Elementary-level, intermediate-level, high-level, top-notch, and perfect-level… Above this, there are even stronger divines that have reached the extreme.’
“But even if it’s them, the chances of passing the Glory Challenge are minimal.
The last Glory Challenge was completed by someone hundreds of millions of years ago…”
“What you do next might only be useless.”
“Perhaps the cosmic overlord doesn’t want to see outsiders at all, so he set an impossible challenge from the start.”
Shi Yu said, “Captain Zi Jian, don’t worry. If I can’t pass, I won’t force it. Of course, in order to increase the success rate of passing, I’m not too anxious. I’ll prepare for a period of time first.”
“By the way, didn’t you say last time that you were here to explore a cosmic ruin from two eras ago? How’s this ruin?”
“Forget it, as long as you’re happy. But speaking of which, regardless of
whether you can pass, my recommendation spot isn’t free.” Zi Jian shook her head.
“In addition, although you can also withdraw after joining the overlord army, the rules of our overlord army are strict. If you want to withdraw after the battle, you have to pay a certain price.”
“I know, I know.” Shi Yu nodded. Money was just like terminating the contract to compensate for the breach of contract. However, the cosmic overlord army wanted more. Of course, the benefits that any member of the overlord army could obtain weren’t bad.
Although it was the infamous bandit army in the universe, the internal rules were very clear.
“It’s good that you know all of it… As for that ruin…” Captain Zi Jian said, “Although it has been successfully opened, no one has successfully explored it. ”
“What are the ruins like??” Shi Yu was immediately very curious.
In the last cosmic era, Shi Yu guessed that it was probably a mythical system led by gods like the Four Holy Beasts and Goddess Wa.
Then, what about a ruin from two eras ago?
“What we can know at the moment is that this ruin is very special. It’s like a maze.”
“According to speculation, the number of changes in the route of this ruins maze is endless.’
“Perhaps only by walking out of the maze can we see the truth of the ruins. However, up until now, no archeologist has been able to crack the maze.
