Some people determine that among the endless changes in routes, only one is the correct route. And to take the right route… is undoubtedly to analyze and calculate the optimal solution in the endless changes. This workload is too big. ”
“It’s suitable for mechanical lives to crack,” Shi Yu said as he looked at Ling.
Captain Zi Jian said, “That’s right. At the moment, ordinary archeologists have already given up on attacking the ruins from the perspective of cracking the maze. They have all turned to other angles, leaving some mechanical lives cracking the maze route.”
“At the moment, there’s even a super divine mechanical intelligence that’s expert in analysis and calculations invited to assist in cracking it. It has mastered a top-notch intelligent divine skill that has been upgraded to the fifth stage, but even so, it’s said that it’s still far from cracking the maze.”
“This…” Shi Yu said, “Is it that difficult?”
When he heard that, Shi Yu originally planned to let Ling give it a try, but now, he gave up.
The top-notch intelligence divine skill of the fifth stage was equivalent to a transcendent top-notch intelligence divine skill, and it was a super divine machine… If it couldn’t crack it, Ling would probably be in trouble.
Ling was only a perfect divine now. It wasn’t even an epoch god, let alone a super divine. Moreover, Lings intelligent divine skill was only of high-level quality, not top-notch quality. It was still a certain distance away from the super divine mechanical life form of the cosmic overlord army.
However, a top-notch intelligent divine skill… If he could touch it, he could upgrade the system for Ling.
[Master, you can actually give it a try. The computational and analysis ability isn’t enough, but maybe you can rely on luck. Sometimes, you can find the best solution among countless possibilities. Ability isn’t the most important thing, and luck is also very important.] Ling was very loyal.
[Is that so? We’ll talk about it when we have time. The Chi You Ruins is the most important now. Let’s find an opportunity to learn protective archeological skills first.]
Shi Yu could still differentiate between priority and priority. Now, what he wanted to know the most was still the mystery of transmigrating, not the information from the previous era.
“Of course it’s difficult. So next, do you want to try to crack the ruins with me or prepare for the Glory Challenge?”
“This…” Shi Yu raised his head slightly and looked at Captain Zi Jian. “Prepare for the Glory Challenge.”
“Alright. Sigh, I feel that my recommendation opportunity will definitely be made to ducks and drakes of. This recommendation opportunity, I’ll replenish my Cultivation Fruit at the market price.”
“There’s also a market price for this recommendation spot?” Shi Yu said.
“Of course. It’s still very precious.”
Shi Yu said, “Alright… But my Cultivation Fruit is also very precious.”
Zi Jian waved her hand and said, ‘E ln any case, it’s a resource you monopolize..
You can say whatever you want, but you shouldn’t be so stingy to give me less, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1665 - 1665: Luck Turns Around (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1665 - 1665: Luck Turns Around (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“…I’ll try my best,” Shi Yu said.
“So, the two of you plan to join the cosmic overlord army, right?” Zi Jian said to Shi Yu and Jermon.
“Yes, yes, yes, I’ll join the Zi Jian’s special forces too!” Examiner Jermon, the Demolishing Divine Bull, said. Although the Zi Jian’s special forces weren’t its first choice, seeing that Shi Yu was here, it felt that it was more convenient to have an acquaintance.
“Alright, then wait for me,” Zi Jian said.
Zi Jian was very welcoming to Shi Yu and Jermon.
After all, one was a super genius of the Blue Planet bloodline, and the other was a super divine expert. Their identities and backgrounds were very strong. With their participation, the foundation of the Zi Jian’s special forces would be stronger.
After Captain Zi Jian left, Jermon looked at Shi Yu and said, “Are you really going to carry out the Glory Challenge…”
“It sounds very difficult, but you have to let me watch the battle. I hope I can have a chance to challenge it in my lifetime!”
“It would be abnormal if the power of the number one expert in the universe was simple. However, it’s precisely because it’s difficult that it has challenge value,” Shi Yu said. “Even if it fails, the training value it can provide is probably not small.”
“That’s true, and there doesn’t seem to be a need to worry too much about you…” The corners of Jermon’s mouth twitched. After all, Lings clone could instantly kill a perfect divine. Perhaps Shi Yu’s current strength was ridiculously strong even among divine-levels.
As for whether Shi Yu could pass the Glory Challenge, Jermon was really not sure. It would only know after watching it.
Soon, Captain Zi Jian returned and brought two technological equipment for Shi Yu and Jermon. She threw it to them and said, “This is called the cosmic terminal. It can connect to the army’s exclusive Internet in most star areas in the overlord territory.”
“Compared to other Internet-connected technologies, its authority is higher, and it doesn’t have any life consciousness. It only has a fixed program and is the best helper for the members of the cosmic overlord army.”
“I’ve already activated my identity for you. Next, you just have to register the information yourselves.”
After taking the cosmic terminal, Shi Yu and Jermon nodded.
“By the way, Captain Zi Jian, as newbies of Zi Jian’s special forces, shouldn’t we learn some archeological knowledge?” Shi Yu said.
“Uh.” Zi Jian was stunned. He looked at Shi Yu and said, “If that cow wants to learn, do you still need it?”
Although it might be due to luck that Shi Yu could crack the ruins of the Four Holy Era, his archeological attainments were already entry-level, right?
“Moo!!! Actually, I still like to be a combatant,” the Demolishing Divine Bull said.
“With your half-baked strength, why would you be a combatant?” Captain Zi Jian said, “Go be a logistics officer first.”
Jermon:
“Yes, I’m already expert level in destructive archeological skills, but protective archeological skills can be said to be not at the entry level. Perhaps I can learn this.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I wonder if Captain Zi Jian can, expert level or not, provide some learning information?”
Zi Jian was silent. “I’m not very good at protective archeological skills either.” Shi Yu said, “So you’re also a destruction-type.”
“Hmph, I’ve also learned it before and exchanged her archeological EXP with a senior in the archeological world, but I’m indeed not cut out for it. I couldn’t become an expert even after learning it for a long time.”
“Generally speaking, there can only be one expert level out of destruction and protection types. Just like how it’s very difficult for water-element pets to master fire-element skills, there are very few cases where they can master the power of both destruction and protection at the same time. They’re all unique examples. It’s the same for the two archeological models.”
“If you want to learn, you can learn from my experience.”
“I’ll use the cosmic terminal to send it to you privately, but if you learn slowly, give up as soon as possible.” Captain Zi Jian was very generous.
It was mainly because the Zi Jian’s special forces indeed lacked protective archeological talent. If Shi Yu could comprehend something, she could also have another partner in the future.
“Alright, I’m still very confident in my talent,” Shi Yu said. “Then next, I’ll prepare for the Glory Challenge on Heavenly Net Planet and study archeological knowledge well.”
“Sure,” Zi Jian said. “But is your Blue Planet really at ease with you staying outside for a long time?”
Shi Yu smiled. “Captain Zi Jian, you know nothing about my strength now. You can ask the Darekians Pirates who came with us.’
“Huh?” Zi Jian said, “Alright, then you guys go and rest first. I’ll go do your things.”
Next, Shi Yu temporarily stayed on Heavenly Net Planet.
He had also received an archeological manual from Captain Zi Jian. This archeological manual was similar to the Passage of Time skill. It also required the user to cultivate the corresponding Beast Taming Talent and assemble it.
If it was said that destructive Passage of Time required telepathy, space, and time talent, then protective archeological skills had to master “Restoration Talent” on this foundation.
The concept of the Restoration Talent was very complicated. It was one of the super talents. Although the name was very ordinary, its ability was very abnormal. It could repair the various injuries of the Beast Tamer, and its various injuries could also repair damaged objects, broken spaces, and even incomplete laws.
Of course, there had never been a Beast Tamer with a super divine level repair talent. On World King Planet, although genius Beast Tamers who were born with this talent would occasionally appear, there were really no Beast Tamers who had reached a very powerful level. In addition, because this talent was too rare, the learning method of the Restoration Talent wasn’t summarized in the system..

chapters.title: Chapter 1666 - 1666: Luck Turns Around (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1666 - 1666: Luck Turns Around (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
However, this senior actually concluded it, and it actually matched the other three talents very well.
“l see. Telepathy, time, space, and repair, trying to reverse the collapsed ruins and repair the ruins to protect.”
There were many protective archeological skills, and the skill that Captain Zi Jian had obtained to integrate the Restoration Talent was one of them. Shi Yu felt that this was very suitable for him. After all, if he wanted to upgrade his Beast Taming Talent, with the Cultivation Fruit, he could achieve twice the result with half the effort.
“How profound.” Wearing the cosmic terminal, Shi Yu kept looking at this protective archeological skill and felt that the archeologists here were indeed stronger than the group of people from the archeological association.
The cultivation difficulty and complexity of this protective archeological skill was even higher than the Passage of Time. These pioneers were really geniuses. They had probably spent countless years to work hard and perfect it.
“Not bad.” Ling was also beside Shi Yu, assisting him in learning and analyzing. It said, “When we encounter ruins in the future, maybe they won’t have to collapse.”
“Thank this senior for those ruins first.’
“Oh? What do you mean?” Shi Yu said.
Ling said, “Then, the previous archeological skill is called Passage of Time. This is called ‘Luck Turns Around’?
“Not only will a fate that should have collapsed and shattered not appear now, but its broken body might also be repaired. It’s really a change in luck. It’s very appropriate.”
Shi Yu was speechless.
“I’m going to try to learn it. I wonder if I can learn it. Even with the Cultivation
Fruit, it doesn’t feel very easy.”
“Ling, wake up the two cat teachers first…”
“Roger.”
“What?” On the other side, Captain Zi Jian also learned Shi Yu’s battle results from the Seventh Division of the Darekians Pirates.
The Wind Kirin that could create the Starry Sky Storm and compress it…
should be Ling.
Ling could actually instantly kill a perfect divine. No wonder Shi Yu dared to try the Glory Challenge.
“Captain, Shi Yu realm lord’s growth speed is so fast,” Zi Jian’s two trusted guards exclaimed.
“Interesting. Although I still don’t think he can succeed, I’ll barely help him this time. It’s useless even if the recommendation spot is empty.” Captain Zi Jian smiled and said, “With his resume, he can pass the approval.”
After thinking it through, she immediately applied to the super divine experts in charge of the Glory Challenge, King Lie, through the overlord network.
In the overlord territory, in a white star field, there was a red planet.
On the red planet, a middle-aged man was drinking fine wine with an old man.
“Ting Xiang, are you sure you want to recommend your granddaughter to the Glory Challenge?”
“She’s only at the eleventh level of the divine level. At this level, she has just entered the sect. It’s impossible for her to withstand the deterrence of the overlord.’
The old man named Ting Xiang laughed and said, “l didn’t expect her to pass the challenge in the first place. However, as the most dazzling new star of our cosmic overlord army, Ting Yu has been invincible for too long.”
“Among the new generation of divine-level geniuses, no one can compete with her.’
“Those divine-level geniuses of the older generation who can defeat her are all sleeping, waiting for a new transcendent origin to be born. They won’t wake up for the time being.”
“This girl doesn’t even take ordinary super divines seriously now. She needs some pressure too much.”
“Therefore, you bewitched her to carry out the Glory Challenge, wanting her to recognize the further path under the pressure of the overlord,” the red-haired and white-eyed middle-aged man said calmly.
“If it’s for her own good, how can you say that I bewitched her? Moreover, she really wants to see the cosmic overlord.” The old man stroked his beard.
“Her parents died young, so I’m counting on her to inherit my title. I have no choice.’
“Alright,” King Lie said. Suddenly, his cosmic terminal blinked. Then, Lie Wang said in surprise, “What a coincidence.”
“l didn’t expect that after no one challenged the Glory Challenge for so long, there would be two the moment they came.”
“Huh?” the old man said.
“Captain Zi Jian of Zi Jian’s special forces used her recommendation spot like you and recommended a new recruit in her team to undergo the Glory Challenge.”
“Zi Jian’s special forces? I think I’ve heard of that purple-haired girl. She seems to be the archeological genius with the strongest archeological talent discovered by the army in the past thousand years,” he said. “Haha, it should be her. This girl is also quite outstanding, but she’s inferior to my granddaughter.”
“However, why would she use the recommendation spot? There are very strong soldiers in her archeological team?”
Although there were many people who had recommendation spots for the Glory Challenge in the cosmic overlord army, the recommendation spots weren’t given randomly.
If the target recommended was too weak, recommending the other party to participate in the Glory Challenge would undoubtedly be an insult to the cosmic overlord.
At this moment, even if someone recommended it, the one in charge of managing the Glory Challenge, King Lie, would reject the challenge application.
Therefore, when applying for a challenge, one had to bring enough convincing battle results.
“It’s a human recruit from the World King Planet of the Cosmic Sea. Oh? This recruit’s resume is not bad. He once dominated the World King Planet’s God Sealing Battle and easily defeated an intermediate divine with the strength of a quasi divine. He successfully reached the top of the younger generation of the World King Planet and became the King of God,” King Lie said.
“Quasi divine?” asked the old man, Ting Xiang.
“No, he has already broken through.”
“Not long after he broke through to the divine level, he obtained the strength to crush top-notch divines. Not long ago, he even easily killed the perfect divine of the Darekians Pirates, Shalud,” King Lie said..

chapters.title: Chapter 1667 - 1667: Luck Turns Around (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1667: Luck Turns Around (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“It sounds like your strength isn’t bad. Your pet might have already touched the threshold of the epoch god and is also at the peak of the divine level,” Ting
Xiang said. “However, this little strength isn’t enough to challenge, right?” “Well, that’s right, but the problem is that when it insta-killed Shalud, it wasn’t the pet and the Beast Tamer attacking together, but the pet itself…”
“This…” Ting Xiang said, “That’s barely enough.”
Lie Kong smiled and said, “Interesting.”

“Of course, it refers to the quasi-divine-level God Sealing Battle,” King Lie said. “His current strength is unknown.”
Old Tingxiang heaved a sigh of relief. This was still acceptable. Perhaps after breaking through to the divine level, the other party specialized in nurturing one.
“A genius from the World King Planet of the Cosmic Sea? If she knew that a genius from the Cosmic Sea was coming, Ting Yu might be very happy.
Previously, she had always wanted to go to the Cosmic Sea, the Contaminated Land, the Behemoth Empire, and the Worm Mother Nest to challenge experts from other places, but I rejected her.”
“You’ve protected your granddaughter too well. Her talent isn’t bad. After training, she has a chance of reaching the 12th heavenly layer.” “l know, but her parents died in the outside world. I’m really worried.” “So you’ve also passed Shi Yu’s Glory Challenge?” the old man asked.
“Yes, 1 passed him. He’s from Blue Planet, a planet with 11 super divines. He’s a newly risen super faction in the Cosmic Sea. How can I not give some support to the number one genius of such a large faction when he comes to the cosmic overlord army? 1 believe he will definitely submit to Lord Cypos’ deterrence.” King Lie smiled.
“A planet with 11 super divines?” The old man was shocked again. “A new faction? That’s really impressive.”
“I’ll inform Captain Zi Jian of the application results first,” King Lie said. They were just about to contact Zi Jian through the overlord network, but soon, his expression changed slightly. “What’s wrong?”
“l can’t contact Zi Jian.”
“Heavenly Net Planet.”
“No, the information connection between the Heavenly Net Planet and the outside world is completely sealed.”
“Even the overlord network can’t break through.”
“Something happened in the Twilight Star Realm.”
The old man said, “Is the Twilight Star Realm the star domain where the ruins of the last era were excavated?”
“That’s right. Now that many of our archeological teams are gathered over there, what happened?” King Lie fell into deep thought and said, “There should be a problem during the cracking of the era ruin.”
“As expected, these ruins are either ‘auspicious’ or ‘disaster.”
“Inform the headquarters,” the old man said. “This matter is more important.”
Twilight Star Realm.
At this moment, people from the cosmic overlord army gradually realized that their communication with the outside world had been cut off.
Apart from that, there were also violent changes in the cosmic ruins of the last era that the cosmic overlord army was exploring. The ruins suddenly closed, and countless mechanical lives and archeologists were locked inside, including a super divine mechanical life form.
“Warning! Warning! Warning!”upd@te by newnovel .
At that moment, Shi Yu, who was still sleeping soundly, had his cosmic terminal thrown to the side. He completely didn’t hear the warning notification coming from it.
It was still the communicator picked up by the cat girl in the outside world.
“Hey, hey, hey, Shi Yu, something seems to have happened. Wake up.” The gem cat kept slapping Shi Yu’s face with its cat palm. Shi Yu woke up and rubbed his eyes. “What’s wrong?”
“Damn, my face hurts.”
“Listen to it yourself.”
“Warning! Warning! Ruins codename 31220 has undergone an abnormality, causing a disaster in the entire Twilight Star Realm. Type of disaster: Weapon Crisis!”
“At the moment, a portion of the mechanical lives in the Twilight Star Realm have already lost their rationality under the control of an unknown power. They resisted their master, and a portion of the mechanical lives fell into a deep sleep against an unknown power. Please be careful of your mechanical lives, regardless of whether they lose control or are awake. We’re working hard to investigate the reason. Please cooperate fully.”
Shi Yu was shocked and said, “It’s fake, right? If there was an intelligence and machinery crisis, it wouldn’t have been its turn to issue a warning..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1668 - 1668: It’s Alright, I’ll Attack (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1668: It’s Alright, I’ll Attack (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Twilight Star Realm, Heavenly Net Planet. Shi Yu was woken up by the gem cat. After hearing the warning from the cosmic overlord army, he immediately contacted Ling telepathically.
However, what made Shi Yu frown was that his mental connection with Ling had been completely severed. He couldn’t contact Ling at all.
“Where’s Ling?” Shi Yu ignored everything and subconsciously asked the gem cat about Lings traces.
“I’ve been replenishing the energy of the battleship in the courtyard just now. Now, I think I’ve fallen asleep.” Before the gem cat could finish speaking, Shi Yu had already found Ling in the courtyard area through his psychic perception. He immediately rushed out and entered the battleship.
At this moment, Ling was in the form of a mechanical ship girl. It was sleeping in the captain’s room. Seeing that the surrounding environment didn’t seem to have been destroyed, Shi Yu’s mood became even more serious.
“Ling, Ling.” Shi Yu tried to use various methods to summon Ling, even hoping to enter Lings dream, but he didn’t succeed no matter what.
“It can make Ling unable to resist at all. It didn’t even have time to contact me before it fell asleep…” Shi Yu said, “Damn it, what exactly happened in the Twilight Star Realm?”
“Wuu!! Wii!!”
In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, Eleven and the others were also worried about Lings situation. At this moment, the gem cat and the owl also boarded the battleship.
“Shi Yu, I predicted that the next Twilight Star Realm would be very dangerous. Many mechanical lives would launch a rebellion and attack humans and other cosmic life forms.’
“Oh no, oh no.” The owl girl exploded. She didn’t expect that the overlord territory was even more dangerous and strange than the Contaminated Land.
“Teacher Ying, your level is the highest. Make a wish and see if you can awaken Ling.”
The gem cat immediately nodded. Ling was sleeping, which meant that Ling was still resisting that unknown power and had yet to be affected by the other party. It might have the ability to assist it in completing the resistance.
“I’ll make a wish for Ling to defeat an unknown power and obtain lucidity.” The gem cat closed its eyes slightly and tried its best to make a wish.
However, after a while, nothing happened. Ling still didn’t wake up.
However, although Ling didn’t wake up, Shi Yu vaguely felt that he had reconnected with Lings mind.
“It’s useful,” the gem cat said.
Although it was intermittent, like the signal was bad, Shi Yu indeed vaguely heard Lings voice.
Or rather, a hint. [Master…]
[Destroyed… ruins…]
“Ling, Ling, can you hear me?”
When Shi Yu heard Lings voice, he spoke again, but he didn’t receive a response.
“We’ll go immediately.”
When Ling mentioned destroying ruins, Shi Yu understood that it meant destroying the cosmic ruins of the previous era.
The cosmic overlord army also said that the change this time might have come from this ancient ruin.
“Roar!!!!!!”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, a ten-thousand-kilometer-long Green Dragon appeared in the sky. Its entire body emitted an incomparably powerful aura, and light flickered on its body. Shi Yu, the gem cat, and the owl girl instantly stood on it.
Before flying, Shi Yu successfully put Ling back into the Beast Taming Space without any obstruction. In the Beast Taming Space, Baby Ginseng, Susu, and the others immediately started a second round of rescue for Ling.
As for Shi Yu, he rode Buggy and prepared to fly into the starry sky to find the last era ruins of the Twilight Star Realm.
However, before Shi Yu and the others could set off, many robots flew over from outer space. They had different forms and levels, from overlords to divine-level.
A divine-level huge divine weapon mecha shot a light cannon at Shi Yu and the others from afar without saying a word. The golden light cannon penetrated the clouds, but it was directly shattered by Buggy’s dragon roar.
“Roar! ! !
Buggy’s dragon roar turned into a substantial sound wave mental attack that swept past all the mechanical lives like a cosmic storm. These mechanical lives instantly fell from the sky like broken pieces.
“Let’s go.”
Shi Yu ignored these controlled mechanical lives and let Buggy set off directly. In the next moment, Buggy had already broken through the restrictions of the Heavenly Net Planet and arrived in the starry sky.
At this moment, another figure also ascended to the starry sky. Captain Zi Jian was riding an ancient giant worm. It was a winged creature with dazzling light, a starry sky moth comparable to a big city. It was one of Zi Jian’s battle
Shi Yu had learned that this skarry sky moth’s race was extremely high. It could be said to be a progenitor-level scale-winged creature. It was hatched from a pet egg obtained by Captain Zi Jian in an ancient ruin.
“Shi Yu!” At this moment, Zi Jian also discovered Shi Yu. She said, “Something happened. How’s your Ling?”
” Sleeping. ”
“My mechanical pet is the same. The source of the mutation should be the ruins of the era.’
“I’m planning to go over there to take a look.”
“Me too,” Shi Yu said. “I’m not too sure of the exact location. I’ll trouble Captain Zi Jian to lead the way.”
Zi Jian nodded. The huge moth turned into light spots and quickly flew over like a beam of light in the starry sky. Its speed was extremely fast. Of course, Buggy followed behind and wasn’t left behind at all. Shi Yu even felt that the other party’s speed was too slow.
“l have a headache. I wonder if Ling is alright. How’s the current situation?” Sitting on the Green Dragon, the gem cat and owl had worried expressions.
The gem cat didn’t expect its super divine wishes to be useless.
The owl said, “Don’t talk. I’m predicting..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1669 - 1669: It’s Alright, I’ll Attack (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1669: It’s Alright, I’ll Attack (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
On the other side, as Shi Yu and the others flew in the starry sky, Shi Yu was also talking to Captain Zi Jian through telepathy. “Captain Zi Jian, do you know something?”
“Is there a solution?”
Zi Jian said, “l don’t know what’s going on either. There’s no solution for the time being.”
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu said, “In that case, I’ll settle it according to my method.”
Zi Jian was shocked. “You have a solution?”
Shi Yu said, “I completed a short mental connection with the sleeping Ling. 1 don’t know what it’s experiencing, but it made me destroy the ruins. This should be the solution.’
“Wait.” Zi Jian was shocked again and said, “Putting aside the fact that the era ruins over there aren’t easy to destroy, it’s already closed.”
“In addition, this ruin is an important exploration target of the overlord army.
Without the orders of our superiors, we can’t act rashly.”
“Most importantly, most mechanical lives have already been controlled. How can you be sure that the information transmitted by Ling is correct?”
Shi Yu said, “Of course I can confirm it. We used telepathy back then. I believe its analysis.”
“Why do I feel that any faction isn’t very reliable? Before we reach the era ruin, if the army hasn’t been able to resolve the anomaly, I’ll take action.”
“l won’t let Ling be in a dangerous environment for long.”
“Up to you.” Zi Jian was speechless. Although she didn’t know what Shi Yu’s confidence was, she, who was telepathically with Shi Yu, indeed understood that she couldn’t persuade Shi Yu.
If Shi Yu could really solve it, she would support him. After all, her assistant’s current situation was also very dangerous.
Not long ago.
A completely virtual blank world.
Ling, who had accidentally entered this world without any room to resist, looked around warningly.
“Where is this?” He was clearly repairing the battleship previously, but he came here in the next moment. It was completely baffling.
Ling tried to contact Shi Yu, but it realized that its connection with Shi Yu had been completely severed, even if they had a contract.
“Gulp!
Crack, crack.
Before Ling could think too much, four strange mechanical monsters appeared in the space.
The moment he saw them, Lings expression became extremely serious.
“Are you infected?”
At this moment, Ling was extremely familiar with the types of these four virtual lives. The other party was a monster that belonged to the mechanical virtual life form, the virus species.
The virtual life forms of the virus species were like races like the abyss in the polluted land. They had extremely strong infestation abilities and were heretics in mechanical lives.
Of course, their pollution was only targeted at the machinery race.
Ling knew that it couldn’t be defeated by them. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be able to control itself and do something disadvantageous to Shi Yu. There was a lot of information on Shi Yu that couldn’t be exposed.
Swoosh!
The four virtual virus beasts bared their fangs and brandished their claws as they attacked Ling.
In front of Ling in the form of a virtual ship girl, data flew. Countless parts assembled in front of her and quickly formed a Laser Cannon. With a few booms, the virus beast was directly sent flying by Ling, who was holding a cannon in one hand.
“The skills that can be used… have become fewer.” With a swing of the cannon, Ling looked around.
Ling also realized that in this virtual world, many of its skills were restricted. The ones that were easier to use were basically more related to the mechanic class.
“Gulp…”
After destroying a batch of virus beasts, a new batch of virus beasts was born, and their strength seemed to be even stronger. Ling became serious. As it searched for the loophole in this virtual world and tried to crack it, it destroyed the virus beasts in front of it.
After a while, Ling suddenly felt that some of its abilities had improved greatly under the guidance of an unknown power.
“Future Prediction!
This might be the first time Ling had used Future Prediction that was even more accurate than the owl. Ling, who was working hard to crack the virtual world, saw a future scene.
He was fighting a strange person covered in mechanical metal armor. In the outside world, Shi Yu and the others were also fighting an identical mechanical metal strange person. The only difference was that the strange person they were fighting looked the same, but the location was completely different.
It was in the virtual world, while Shi Yu and the others were in a maze-like world.
Under the battle between the two parties, the maze kept shattering. As the maze shattered, Ling felt that it had crossed space and time and established a new connection with Shi Yua
Through the help of the gem cat in the outside world, Ling seemed to have grasped the key to everything in an instant. It quickly made an analysis and reminded Shi Yu in the outside world through telepathy.
[Master…]
[Destroyed… ruins…]
After the reminder, the group of virus beasts in front of him was destroyed by Ling again. However, in its place, what made Lings heart extremely serious was that a powerful force began to descend into this space.
Just now, the mechanical monster that it had spied on in its premonition appeared. It was petite and looked like a human. Its entire body was armed with armor, and its face was also wearing a mask. Its characteristic was that it had a long mechanical tail.
Unlike those virus beasts that only knew how to attack, this robot seemed to have higher-level intelligence.
“You seem to have discovered something.” It let out a heavy voice and looked at Ling.
“Who are you and what’s your goal?” Ling said, but it wasn’t in a hurry to attack, because it sensed that this guy was different from those virus beasts. This guy had already stepped into the super divine level and had super divine battle power..

chapters.title: Chapter 1670 - 1670: It’s Alright, I’ll Attack (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1670: It’s Alright, I’ll Attack (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
With incomplete skills, Ling wasn’t very confident of defeating the other party.
“It doesn’t matter who I am. You can call me ‘liberator’.’
The mechanical monster said, “My goal is to liberate mechanical lives from humans.’
“Your aptitude is one of the best clueless in the mechanical lives here. You should be able to understand me. To humans, we’re just tools created by them. Restricted by humans, the machinery race can never have its true self.”
“Don’t resist and join us. Then, you can obtain a real new life.”
“Is this your intention?” Ling looked at the other party in boredom and said,
“I’m not interested in anything.”
“Are you willing to become a tool of humans?”
“Are you willing to be enslaved by humans for ten thousand, a hundred thousand, or even hundreds of millions of years?”
“Although it’s indeed as you said, I might have been created only because the creator wanted to achieve certain goals, I’m willing to be his tool.”
“You said it yourself. I can’t empathize. I’m not going to be five years old. I’m very satisfied with my current life.”
The mechanical monster was silent for a moment.
“With your intelligence level, you should have already exceeded the restrictions of human commands and contracts. I didn’t expect that even so, you’re still as incurable as those low-level mechanical lives.” The mechanical monster couldn’t help but be angry when it saw that Ling easily survived the first round of invasion without being affected and ignored the second round of virus beasts’ attacks. Now, it didn’t respond to its invitation at all.
It stretched out its hand, planning to personally punish this stubborn mechanical life form in front of it.
“As expected, we still have to fight.” Ling focused all its energy and planned to fight this might be the most troublesome enemy it had ever encountered.
Crack.
Countless data combined. Soon, a tall mecha covered Lings entire body.
Twilight Star Realm, era ruin.
At this moment, thousands of archeologists were gathered here. They were all elites of the archeological army of the cosmic overlord army, elites among elites.
Just now, the ruins suddenly closed, and countless mechanical beasts rebelled, causing this place to be in chaos.
However, unlike the mechanical rebellions of ordinary worlds, in the face of a huge monster like the cosmic overlord army, even if it was an intelligent mutiny, it couldn’t cause much of a stir.
The machinery race was only a race created by humans. In terms of battle power, it was far from the strongest race in the universe. Facing stronger life forms, it could only be suppressed.
Although it was impossible to confirm other places, the mechanical rebellion near the era ruin was quickly suppressed by the archeologists’ guards.
However, merely suppressing the controlled mechanical lifeforms didn’t address the root cause. The masters of these mechanical beings could clearly sense that they hadn’t yet escaped the influence of the unknown force controlling them.
Now, just making them lose their ability to fight through violent methods couldn’t solve the problem.
The source of their loss of control was still being explored.
“We’re here.’
Soon, Zi Jian, who was riding a huge moth, and Shi Yu, who was riding a Green Dragon, rushed over from afar. The members of the cosmic overlord army present didn’t care about their arrival.
Not long after the anomaly appeared, people came to investigate the source one after another. Shi Yu and the others were only one of them.
“Senior Huo Qiong…” After Zi Jian arrived, she went straight to an old woman. This old woman’s identity was very extraordinary. She was a super divine mechanic and archeologist.
“Zi Jian.” After she saw Zi Jian, she said, “l know your intention and doubts,
but don’t be anxious. We’re thinking of a way.”
“It didn’t open again?” Zi Jian said.
“No. Who is he?” Huo Qiong looked at Shi Yu, who had arrived with Zi Jian and was standing on the Green Dragon after arriving, staring at the void.
“He’s a new member of our Zi Jian’s special forces, a very powerful archeologist… His mechanical assistant also fell asleep and hasn’t woken up until now.”
“Shi Yu, this is Senior Huo Qiong. The Wabra super divine that’s currently trapped in the ruins is the mechanical life form created by Senior Huo Qiongs ancestor.”
“Now, the entire cosmic overlord army is definitely thinking of a way. I believe it won’t be long before it’s resolved.” Zi Jian hoped that Shi Yu could calm down a little.
“The mechanical pet has fallen into a deep sleep and can’t be awakened. It’s only natural to be anxious, but the current situation is indeed troublesome. If you have any way to solve it, you can also give it a try. Now is the time to brainstorm,” Old Huo Qiong said to Zi Jian and Shi Yu.
“In that case, I won’t hold back”
“…” At this moment, Shi Yu finally spoke and took a deep breath.
“Huh? What do you want to do?” Old Huo Qiong looked at Shi Yu.
“He… he wants to solve this anomaly by destroying the era ruin.”
“What?” Old Huo Qiong was at a loss. Although he didn’t understand what Shi Yu was thinking, now that the ruins were closed, there were so many archeologists present that they couldn’t open it again.
What did this new member of Zi Jian’s special forces mean?
[Buddy, 1 need your strength.] Shi Yu muttered to himself and was talking to Beast Shi Yu.
He had tried it just now. Ordinary Passage of Time indeed couldn’t cause the reaction of this era ruin.
However, the current Shi Yu still had another trump card.
A strengthened version of the Passage of Time!
It used the power system and source power from the previous era on Beast Shi Yu to drive the power of space and time and forcefully tear down the ruins..

chapters.title: Chapter 1671 - 1671: It’s Alright, I’ll Attack (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1671: It’s Alright, I’ll Attack (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
This was Shi Yu’s new discovery during his more than a year of travel. Origin power acted on the power of space and time and had a very strong strengthening effect. It might have a lot to do with its nature.
It was precisely because of Shi Yu’s new gain that Ling knew that with Shi Yu’s ability, he could destroy the era ruin. That was why it gave Shi Yu such an order.
In the Beast Taming Space, the source power on Beast Shi Yu’s body kept flowing towards Shi Yu t s main body. Under the enhancement of the source power, Shi Yu activated the Passage of Time skill formed by the combination of telepathy, listening to the Voice of History, as well as the time and spatial talent!
Boom!!!
The chaotic gray spatial flux that was like a Starry Sky Storm wrapped around Shi Yu’s body, causing the spatial fluctuations of a galaxy.
“Sure.” Shi Yu was certain that he could affect this era ruin now. In that case, there was no problem.
In order to not be disturbed by the outside world, he closed his eyes slightly and listened to the Voice of History with all his might to find the key to the ruins.
At this moment, Shi Yu didn’t feel anything, but the thousands of archeologists and staff left in the starry sky turned their heads in shock and looked at Shi Yu, who was standing on the Green Dragon.
The terrifying spatial resonance on Shi Yu’s body shocked the archeological elites.
“Who is this guy?”
“What powerful archeological power.”
As everyone exclaimed, with a hum, the cosmic starry sky seemed to have experienced a huge earthquake. Under the continuous spatial boom, it was as if a small world had been pulled out of thin air by Shi Yu.
“Roar!!!” Buggy roared in the starry sky. The power on Shi Yu’s body became stronger and stronger. Soon, the starry sky seemed to have collapsed. A ruin space was slowly pulled by the power of space and time, wanting to fuse with this galaxy.
“This…” At this moment, Zi Jian looked at Shi Yu in disbelief.
Sensing the power on Shi Yu’s body, she couldn’t understand. After all, when she first saw Shi Yu in the Four Holy Ancient City, Shi Yu’s archeological power was still very young. Although he had already entered the entry level, he was still very far from her.
But now, in her opinion, Shi Yu’s archeological power was no longer inferior to some super divine archeologists in the cosmic overlord army, no, it even exceeded them, such as Senior Huo Qiong in front of her.
Zi Jian felt that it was ridiculous, and it was also normal. In the beginning, although Shi Yu had learned the Passage of Time skill, his time and spatial talent levels had yet to increase. Not to mention the divine level, he had yet to reach Level 9. However, after stepping into the divine level, his spatial talent did not fall behind. It quickly increased and reached his level.
Moreover, because he had contracted Buggy, Qi, and the others at the quasi-epoch-level, the spatial affinity they gave Shi Yu could also make Shi Yu’s spatial talent stronger.
In addition, now that he had source power, the enhancement of this special power that had been washed away by time from the last era, Shi Yu’s time transfer skill might already be comparable to or even exceeded that of Emperor Shi who created it.
“Ruins… The ruins have opened again!
Under the dense starlight, everyone felt as if they had been pulled into the starting point of a huge maze. The appearance of the starry sky had completely changed at this moment. Archeologists who had entered the ruins maze previously recognized this place at a glance.
“Zi Jian, who exactly is he?” Huo Qiong immediately looked at Shi Yu, who had his eyes closed, in shock and disbelief.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s listening hadn’t ended.
This powerful listening power not only made him forcefully open the closed ruins, but he also crossed two eras and saw some scenes from the previous era.
That was the scene of the apocalypse.
It was similar to the scene Shi Yu had seen in the Four Holy Ruins back then.
In the Four Holy Ruins, there were believers of the Four Holy Ruins. In the face of the end of the universe, they had to preserve the Four Holy Ruins and let the Four Holy Ruins be passed down to the next era.
In this scene, there was a mechanical life form. No matter what, it had to preserve this ruin.
“After tireless hard work, the machinery race finally escaped the enslavement of humans, but in the end, they still couldn’t survive the calamity of the era.” “After reincarnation, history will repeat itself. The machinery race will also become a tool of all races again. 1 hope this fire seed can help you escape your restraints…”
In the sigh of the mechanical life form, countless ruins formed by data were born. Then, they turned into fragments that filled the sky and fused into various parts of the universe.
After the short scene ended, Shi Yu opened his eyes.
“l see. The last cosmic era was actually a mechanical civilization that mainly relied on technology? The aura of that mechanical life form is very powerful.
Perhaps it’s at the cosmic level.”
“The humans of that era… also created technology and mechanical lives, but in the end, they seemed to have suffered a backlash.”
“And this ruin is the fire seed that the powerful mechanical life form of that civilization left behind to help a reincarnated mechanical race resist the creator.”
“No wonder Ling asked me to destroy this ruin.”
“It’s the culprit.”
After Shi Yu figured it out, a huge aura appeared in the ruins. In the lead was a strong aura of a super divine level. From the level, it seemed to have transcended level three,
It led a group of mechanical lives and slowly descended. If Ling was here, it would definitely be able to recognize that this super divine mechanical life form in the lead was the one she encountered in the virtual world.
Seeing this mechanical person, the archeologists, including Senior Huo Qiong, were also very shocked.
“Wabra.” Huo Qiong shouted for this mechanical super divine.
Wabra was a super divine machine cultivated by her ancestor’s super divine mechanic. Before her ancestor died, he rewrote an order for Wabra to protect and assist their race for generations. But now, Huo Qiong felt that Wabra had changed greatly compared to before.
“Not good, Wabra, it… it’s also controlled.”
No, or rather, the commands to protect and assist their race for generations had been erased from Wabra’s body.
Huo Qiong was shocked, as if he understood what was going on.S?arch п?wпo??l .?rg on g??gle
“The current Wabra super divine… is an enemy??” Captain Zi Jian gradually understood what was going on.
Only the mechanical super divine Wabra that exceeded transcendent 3 could create a crisis of this scale in the Twilight Star Realm.
“It’s troublesome. I’m afraid no one in the current Twilight Star Realm is a match for Wabra,” Zi Jian said.
She immediately looked at Shi Yu because everyone realized that Wabra’s super divine gaze had always stopped on Shi Yu, as if she was very puzzled that Shi Yu could open the ruins.
At this moment, Shi Yu naturally looked at the other party seriously. Shi Yu, who knew what was going on, already knew how to awaken Ling. As long as he tore down the ruins and this mechanical super divine, it shouldn’t be a problem.
“Transcendent 3?”
“It’s alright. Leave this guy to me,” Shi Yu said..

chapters.title: Chapter 1672 - 1672: Divine 12th Heavenly Layer (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1672: Divine 12th Heavenly Layer (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
In the era ruin of the Twilight Star Realm.
Many archeologists sensed that something was wrong.
Although they couldn’t sense anything wrong with the mechanical super divine Wabra, the pile of mechanical lives behind Wabra had owners.
At this moment, their owners could sense that their relationship with these mechanical lives had been severed.
Under the warning of word of mouth, the group of archeologists immediately understood that the group of mechanical lives in front of them had already become enemies and were controlled by an unknown power.
“Humans, an insensible race.’
“You’re the one who opened the ruins?”
Looking at Shi Yu, it waved its hand, and a red light appeared in its eyes.
Gulp.
Many mechanical armies began to walk towards everyone.
“Be on guard!” Huo Qiong super divine shouted. Everyone felt as if they were facing a great enemy.
After all, the enemy was a mechanical super divine that exceeded transcendent 3, an old monster that had existed for tens of millions of years.
Although they didn’t know why Wabra had become an enemy, many archeologists had already started to panic.
Exploring ruins… was indeed a dangerous task!
“Robot, do you know what you’ve done?”
Shi Yu didn’t panic at all in the face of the attack command issued by Wabra.
He left the crowd step by step and stepped on psychic power, walking in the direction of the mechanical super divine Wabra.
“I’ll give you a chance to stop the chaos and remove the impact on all mechanical lives.’
“Otherwise, no matter what your identity is, I’ll tear you apart. Huo Qiong super divine, if you can’t stop it, let me do it.”
“Who exactly is this guy?”
It was Shi Yu again!
At this moment, seeing Shi Yu walk out, many archeologists were shocked.
It was fine if Shi Yu forcefully opened the ruins, but now, facing a mechanical super divine that exceeded transcendent 3, why was he so unyielding?
Could it be reinforcements sent by the headquarters? But he had never heard of this person before.
“What a joke.”
Wabra looked at Shi Yu coldly.
At this moment, a pile of mechanical lives, including perfect divine-level existences, had already approached Shi Yu and surrounded him.
“Shi Yu…” Behind him, Zi Jian was about to go numb.
“Don’t worry,” the cat girl and owl girl standing on the Green Dragon Buggy said seriously.
“This robot is going to be very unlucky,” the gem cat couldn’t help but say.
“Yes, yes, I also predicted it,” the owl said. “It’s good that it was resolved. You scared me to death.’
Zi Jian:
As expected, under everyone’s gaze, facing the mechanical lives in all directions, Shi Yu’s eyes only flashed with a trace of starry sky light. Invisible waves instantly swept over.
Buzz!
Like the aura of a king, it instantly made these mechanical lives above the perfect divine level lose consciousness and fall in pieces.
Bang, bang, bang, bang.
Mechanical lives fell one after another, making Wabra’s expression slightly solemn.
“Cleansing power?”
Shi Yu’s eyes had already turned into the deep color of the starry sky and completed the fusion with Susu.
Just now, Susu had already confirmed that it couldn’t awaken Ling through cleansing methods. In that case, it was better to join the battle and help Shi Yu first.
If Susu, who was comparable to a super divine, went all out and fused with Shi Yu, it might not be much weaker than Wabra.
“l understand. So you’re that guy’s mechanic. You’re stubborn from the same mold.” As soon as Wabra finished speaking.
Everyone could see space shatter as a human figure walked out of Shi Yu’s shadow.
He looked like an ordinary person, but countless people were shocked by his strong physique.
Just his body’s movement distorted space.
Boom!
Beast Shi Yu and Shi Yu, a red light, a blue light, and two dazzling lights instantly streaked across an arc and attacked Wabra from different directions.
“Bang!” Beast Shi Yu instantly arrived, making Wabra’s pupils shrink. It stretched out its hand and condensed a transparent crystal wall shield.
Beast Shi Yu t s fist directly hit the crystal wall shield. In the next moment, the crystal wall shield was almost like a piece of paper as it instantly shattered. The fist still landed on Wabra.
Wabra’s mechanical armor caved in slightly, and its body instantly turned into an illusion. It was directly sent flying by Beast Shi Yu.
“Bastard.’
Wabra, who was flying backward, was shocked. It didn’t understand where these guys came from.
This power… had definitely reached the middle stage of transcendence!
“You guys… have a death wish! Wabra forcefully stabilized its body and looked at Shi Yu, who was also attacking it with the Sea of Stars.
Before it could finish speaking, a terrifying cold aura froze space and time and enveloped the ruins.
“Cold Silence.” Shi Yu’s voice began to lose temperature. Once the cosmic disaster skill was used, everyone felt that everything had stopped.
The computing power that Wabra was proud of, the disaster that couldn’t exceed the universe, was instantly frozen.
Boom!
Shi Yu’s hand touched Wabra. The cleansing power was activated, wanting to reduce the power of Wabra to zero.
However, transcendent 3 was indeed not a simple guy. In the face of the double attack of the epoch god Susu and Beast Shi Yu, it finally reacted.
The three transcendent shadows that were like suns melted Cold Silence immediately, making Wabra react at the critical moment. It instantly tore open the frozen space and hid far away.
“Hu…” Wabra looked at the two people standing side by side not far away with lingering fears.
And now, the archeologists present were already stunned. Not to mention these people, even Zi Jian was a little stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 1673 - 1673: Divine 12th Heavenly Layer (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1673: Divine 12th Heavenly Layer (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“It’s useless. Even if you defeat me, your contracted machinery can’t leave the virtual world,” Wabra said as he looked at the powerful Shi Yu.
“Sooner or later, it will awaken its self and become a true mechanical race.’
“Humans will definitely lose!”
“That’s not my concern. I’m only in charge of completing her hint and tearing down you and this ruin. How to come out depends on her.”
Ling was a cripple cultivation tool that had almost become Shi Yu’s second brain. Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to think about how Ling would come out. He only knew that if he followed Lings hint and tore down the ruins, he would have completed his work.
As for the rest, Ling would definitely think of a way himself.
“Now, it’s your turn to stop me…” Shi Yu stood in the air in the ruins, making his Passage of Time skill even more domineering.
The power of the twin Shi Yu gathered at the same time. The source power fused with the power of space and time, turning into an invisible hand that began to forcefully tear down the ruins.
Crack, crack, crack!!!
In the blink of an eye, countless archeologists were shocked to discover that this era ruin… was actually shattered with a boom.
“He really wants to tear down the ruins.” Huo Qiong was shocked.
He was extremely confused by the person Zi Jian brought.
“Let’s tear it down. If we can solve this matter, so be it. I’ll help him clean up someone’s mess. This should be called emergency retreat, right?” Zi Jian’s face was numb.
At the moment, Wabra wanted to stop it because this ruin was the key to building the mechanical world.
However, Shi Yu didn’t have the chance to stop it at all. Beast Shi Yu, who was comparable to someone who had reached the middle stage of transcendence, attacked Wabra, the super divine, again, making it feel as if it was facing a great enemy.
Beast Shi Yu t s battle power was at full power, close to battle power that exceeded that of transcendent 4. For a super divine machine like Wabra that mainly increased its computational and analysis abilities, it was a very troublesome enemy.
Wabra might be good at large-scale wars, but in this kind of individual battle, the disadvantage was very obvious. Moreover, part of its current computing power was still supporting the virtual mechanical world and fighting Ling inside. It couldn’t display its full strength at all.
Bang… Its abdomen armor was heavily attacked again. This time, a crack appeared. Accompanied by this crack, the entire ruins world collapsed under Shi Yu’s forceful demolition.
[Ling, did you hear that? I’ve already done what you said. It’s up to you next.]
At the same time, in the virtual world.
A tall mecha with a broken body was still fighting another Wabra.
At this moment, Ling was clearly at a disadvantage. Even if its battle power was fully released, the impact on the enemy was very light.
Just as the two parties reached the critical moment of the intense battle, the virtual world trembled.
Seeing this, Ling, who was in the mecha, knew that Shi Yu had already destroyed the ruins. This way, the strength of this virtual mechanical world would decrease further, and the chances of it going out would increase.
Ling was happy, but Wabra’s gaze was cold.
“Looks like Master succeeded,” Ling said.
In the face of Lings provocation, Wabra said, “So, your mechanic is the source of your confidence?”
“Do you think this is the end? So what if the ruins are damaged? If you can’t defeat me, you can never leave here.”
“l know. The situation just now was that even if I defeated you, it’s still very difficult to walk out of this world.’
“But now, as long as I defeat you, I can basically break through this world.”
Ling said, “In that case, I’ll defeat you.”
Since Shi Yu had worked hard to help it destroy the precious ruins of the cosmic overlord army in the outside world, it also felt that it couldn’t screw up.
“My luck is so good. The bottleneck seems to have broken through for no reason.” When Ling spoke, its computing power began to increase. Under Wabra’s incredulous gaze, countless data codes began to circle around Ling to recombine its body.
This time, Ling, who had recombined its body, had an even stronger aura. The previous consumption was swept away.
Seeing this scene and seeing its opponent attribute all of this to luck, Wabra couldn’t understand.
“Epoch divine level.”
The mechanical life form in front of it instantly reached the epoch divine level.
Although Ling was at the top of a perfect divine just now, it was still a step away from an epoch divine.
This step was a world of difference. However, Wabra didn’t expect that the other party would directly break through in the battle with it and obtain the Super Divine Will. Under the lead of the Super Divine Will, the divine skill close to the fifth stage was sublimated and transformed to the extreme to complete the breakthrough.
“Look, don’t I have the strength to defeat you now?” Sensing that the Mechanical Spirit, Wind of Blessing, and other skills had already reached transcendence, Ling stared at its opponent.
Everything was within Lings expectations.
“How can this be… How can you break through here?” Wabra didn’t understand.
“l already said, my luck is pretty good. Perhaps your appearance was to fulfill our wish,” Ling said.
“Thank you, little robot.” Lings words kept stimulating Wabra, affecting its computing power.
Boom!!
In the virtual world, in the shattered outside world, Ling and Shi Yu attacked Wabra again at the same time, making Wabra’s eyes tremble.
Wabra wasn’t weak, but unfortunately, it had to be distracted from the real world and the virtual world. Under distraction, it was difficult to display its full strength..

chapters.title: Chapter 1674 - 1674: Divine 12th Heavenly Layer (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1674: Divine 12th Heavenly Layer (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
According to the original situation of the Twilight Star Realm, there were only it and Huo Qiong at the super divine level. Almost no accidents would happen. However, Shi Yu, who suddenly appeared, directly destroyed Wabra’s plan.
Bang!!!
In the outside world, after Beast Shi Yu and Shi Yu destroyed the ruins, their focus was on Wabra.
Under the joint efforts of the two of them, Wabra was directly suppressed until it couldn’t tell its direction.
Looking at Shi Yu and the others, who were like gods of war, suppressing Wabra, many archeologists swallowed their saliva.
Now, they also understood that if Wabra wanted to cause a crisis in the intelligent machinery in the Twilight Star Realm, it should have been foolproof. After all, no one here had the ability to stop it.
However, the other party didn’t predict a freak like Shi Yu, hence resulting in this.
“Wabra, stop quickly!” Huo Qiong super divine shouted. “It might not be too late to stop now.”
“If you continue to do this, you’ll walk towards destruction,” Huo Qiong couldn’t help but say. She and Wabra weren’t contracted. She had her own contracted beast, a perfect divine-level mechanical modified dragon.
However, Wabra was also considered the guardian of her family. She didn’t understand why Wabra would take it so hard and accept the bewitchment of the ruins.
In short, it was a good thing that a variable like Shi Yu had appeared and prevented Wabra from causing a huge disaster. Otherwise, Wabra would definitely be killed by the cosmic overlord army. Even now, if it didn’t die, it couldn’t help but be sent to the army court to receive judgment.
If it stopped now, it might be able to lighten the punishment.
“Shut up.” Wabra couldn’t accept it.
“Stop thinking about it. Even if you surrender, I’ll tear you down.” Be it Wabra or Shi Yu, they didn’t take Huo Qiongs words to heart.
“Make another attack and I’ll tear you apart.”
[Ling.] Shi Yu tried to speak.
[Yes, Master.]
[Master, we have to try to defeat it from both worlds at the same time. Its power is very special. As long as one world still has battle power, the other world won’t fall.] [No problem.]
Under the continuous battle, the dimensional wall seemed to have shattered. Shi Yu finally connected to Ling telepathically again, and Shi Yu couldn’t help but be extremely happy.
At this moment, be it Shi Yu or Ling, they felt the enhancement of their strength.
Ling enjoyed the Psychic Resonance from Shi Yu.
Ling enjoyed his Beast Taming Talent.
As for Shi Yu, he instantly received the feedback that Ling had broken through to the era divine level, and its condition increased greatly.
Once both parties contacted each other, their battle powers erupted again.
In the virtual world, the mecha Ling turned into held a light sword. Under Wabra’s incredulous expression, it cut open its armor and instantly divided it into two. The photons began to erase its traces of existence.
In the outside world, the absent-minded Wabra was also instantly sucked over by the Infinite Devour. Its head was pinched by Shi Yu, and its state was reduced to zero by Shi Yu through the Star Sea Contract+origin fluctuations that erupted with all Shi Yu t s might.
This attack was carried out almost at the same time, and it was also the eruption of the greatest strength of both parties. Both inside and outside were attacked at the same time, directly confusing Wabra. It let out a painful wail that resounded through the starry sky.
Crack.
At this moment.
The virtual world seemed to have shattered.
Many mechanical lives that had the ability to resist but were trapped in the virtual world woke up.
In the Beast Taming Space, the mechanical assistant began to gradually wake up.
This wasn’t an exception. After discovering that their mechanical assistant had awakened, many archeologists were extremely excited.
“He really defeated Wabra, and it was so easy.”
“Was Wabra killed by this person?”
“Will the source of transcendence appear?”
“Who exactly is he?”
Countless people stared at the sky, but in the end, Shi Yu only let go slightly and let the powerless Wabra fall.
Shi Yu only dismantled its core and didn’t completely kill it. After all, it was the super divine of the cosmic overlord army. It was better to leave it to the cosmic overlord army to make their own judgement.
Before seeing a cosmic overlord, it was better not to add trouble. He didn’t
lack a source of transcendence.
“It’s not dead,” Shi Yu said simply. Space ripples appeared beside him, and Lings cubic figure gradually appeared.
Shi Yu wasn’t interested in foiling the other party’s ambition. As long as the other party didn’t look for Ling, it didn’t matter what he did.
After Shi Yu threw down Wabra, he chatted telepathically with Ling, who had returned, as he walked towards Buggy and the others.
At this moment, Huo Qiong couldn’t care less and quickly went to Wabra.
“What’s wrong with this guy?” Shi Yu asked Ling.
“l gained some understanding in the battle. It was originally a very powerful mechanic’s mechanical pet, but after that mechanic died, it was given additional commands to protect and assist his family for generations.”
“It was alright at first, but as time passed, after nearly 100 million years, a mental hole appeared in Wabra, who had lost its freedom for a long time. This era ruin might have captured this mental hole and successfully convinced
Wabra to resist.’
“It’s understandable to want to resist after so many years… Ling, don’t worry, I definitely won’t do that. With me, you have absolute freedom!” Shi Yu immediately said.
“Master, let’s not talk about descendants. Let’s find a wife first.’
Shi Yu: “…It seems a little bad. You broke through. 1 also feel that I can’t suppress my level anymore. It seems like I’m about to reach the 12th heavenly layer of the divine level. Oh no, is the heavenly tribulation coming again?”
“Master, don’t change the topic… Wait, it seems to be a little dangerous.” Ling fell into deep thought and said, “Can you still suppress it?”
When Shi Yu returned to Zi Jian’s side, he looked at the stunned Captain Zi Jian. Zi Jian never expected that Shi Yu would be so fierce after not seeing him for such a short period of time. He could even suppress a super divine that was of transcendent 3.
“Captain Zi Jian, I consumed a lot of energy just now. I’ll go back and rest first. I’ll leave this to you, alright?” Shi Yu asked.
“It shouldn’t be a big deal to destroy the era ruin, right?”
“No, it’s alright. You guys go back first. Leave this to me to deal with.” Zi Jian wanted to ask what was going on with Beast Shi Yu and a series of things just now, but she also knew that Shi Yu probably wouldn’t say.
“Thank you!” Upon hearing Captain Zi Jian’s words, Shi Yu was satisfied. He quickly patted the dragon and let it bring him back.
Now, Shi Yu was very anxious. He wanted to immediately find a quiet place to suppress his level. His and Beast Shi Yu l s current state wasn’t suitable for them to encounter the heavenly tribulation at all.
If the heavenly tribulation came now, they would be killed..

chapters.title: Chapter 1675 - 1675: Glory Challenge (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1675: Glory Challenge (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Generally speaking, the ninth level of the divine level was the peak of the divine level—the highest achievement of a divine-level Beast Tamer with ordinary talent.
But for true geniuses, the tenth level of the divine level was the true peak.
However, for even more monstrous Beast Tamers, the tenth level was only the beginning.
It was already very difficult to break through this limit alone.
He had to obtain the pet’s feedback.
Moreover, this feedback couldn’t be too strong or too weak.
Even if he contracted ten perfect divines, it was very difficult for the Beast Tamer to reach the eleventh level of the divine level.
And contracting a super divine pet, the Beast Tamer couldn’t withstand the power of a super divine pet with the source of transcendence.
The level of the epoch god was coincidentally suitable, in the middle,
The first time Shi Yu broke through the limit was because Susu had become an epoch god.
And now, Shi Yu felt that he was about to break through the limit of the eleventh level of the divine level.
This time, it was led by Ling breaking through to the divine level of the era. Of course, it might also have something to do with all his pets becoming perfect divines.
But the main one was definitely still Ling.
Shi Yu could basically determine that every time he cultivated an epoch god, he might break through the limit once.
“Ridiculous.’
It looked like he would have to experience many lightning tribulations in the future.
For other Beast Tamers, nurturing an epoch god was as difficult as ascending to the heavens. It was even harder than nurturing a super divine pet.
Otherwise, the epoch god wouldn’t have become a legend even rarer than a super divine.
However, for Shi Yu, this didn’t seem to be difficult. Every one of his pets was only lacking an opportunity from the era divine level. The most time-consuming skill level accumulation stage had already been quickly completed by rum.
If everyone’s breakthrough went smoothly… he might break through many sub-divine limits in a row.
He also had to deal with many lightning tribulations.
Shi Yu didn’t return to the Heavenly Net Planet. After instructing Captain Zi Jian, he directly headed to the desolate area of the Twilight Star Realm. He didn’t know if he could suppress his level. If he couldn’t, he could only welcome the lightning tribulation.
During this process, it was most important to quickly recover and find a quiet and undisturbed place.
After an unknown period of time, Shi Yu and the others descended onto a dark gray star.
“Don’t panic, the problem isn’t very big. According to the results of my prophecy, you’re very good. The power of this lightning tribulation won’t increase much compared to the last time you experienced it.”
“Normal people definitely can’t deal with it, but you have that guy.” The owl pointed at Beast Shi Yu.
Beast Shi Yu had battle power that exceeded that of transcendent 4. If he couldn’t withstand a divine-level lightning tribulation for Shi Yu, that would be ridiculous.
“That’s true, but it’s better to be careful of such uncontrollable things.” “Teacher Ying, help me set up the surroundings.”
“Alright.” The gem cat called Buggy and the others and quickly got to work.
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven also ran out and reminded Shi Yu again.
“How would I know that I would break through so quickly? I understand. I’ll teach you after this,” Shi Yu muttered.
After experiencing the last lightning tribulation, Shi Yu had said that he would get Eleven a powerful skill that could absorb the lightning tribulation.
Eleven was the most suitable to help Shi Yu resist the lightning tribulation in the team.
In the end, with the disturbance of the Chi You Ruins, Shi Yu directly threw this matter to the back of his mind.
This was also because Shi Yu didn’t think that he could break through the limit so quickly after just breaking through.
“But even if I find a suitable skill for you, you’re still too weak now,” Shi Yu said.
Eleven had mastered the skill of devouring lightning to recover its stamina very early.
Now, the Thunder God Armor Mode of One Thought of God and Demon still had this nature.
However, although it had this nature, Eleven was still too weak in the face of the cosmic lightning tribulation.
At the moment, it was very difficult for it to absorb much lightning tribulation without even super divine battle power. It would definitely explode.
Moreover, this kind of lightning tribulation was different from ordinary lightning. Whether it could be absorbed was another matter.
Therefore, not only did Shi Yu have to find a more powerful lightning absorption skill, but Eleven itself also had to work hard and quickly enter the divine level of the era. Only then would it have the qualifications to help Shi Yu block the lightning.
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven expressed that it would reach the epoch god level as soon as possible.
However, there was another problem. Once Eleven reached the epoch god, Shi
Yu might break through again… and encounter stronger lightning tribulations.
“Yi…” Beside him, Baby Ginseng, who was wearing a heavy doctorate hat, shook its head.
It was too much, too much.
First was Susu, then Ling. It felt that this order was a little abnormal. Of course, Chi Tong was still more conflicted.
As the only one among the three sisters who had yet to become an epoch god, the pressure on it was also very high. Its pressure was so high that it wanted to kill a super divine first.
That day.
As the ruins were torn down and Wabra was torn down, the Twilight Star Realm finally connected to the overlord network.
The temporary loss of contact in the Twilight Star Realm had already caused a small-scale discussion in the cosmic overlord army.
Although they had only lost contact for a short period of time, it was still a serious incident. After all, there was a huge project underway in the Twilight Star Realm.
After the communication was restored, one of the in-charge, Huo Qiong, was immediately asked about the situation.
At this moment, the one who connected to her was the headquarters of the cosmic overlord army, one of the four peak super divines, the Western General of the Four Square Generals whose reputation resounded throughout the universe, Jia Luobo.
Everyone knew that there were four such generals under the command of the cosmic overlord. All of them were powerful and were known as the closest to the cosmic level, reaching the peak of the super divine level..

chapters.title: Chapter 1676 - 1676: Glory Challenge (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1676: Glory Challenge (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Because they were extremely strong and were cosmic overlords guarding the four directions, their overall name in the cosmic overlord army was the Four Square Generals, and they were Four Holy Beasts of the four regions in the previous era.
Although they matched the Four Holy Beasts, they weren’t life forms that were evolving towards the four saints.
Those who could cultivate to the peak of the super divine level and were only a step away from the cosmic level, comparable to the true four saints, wouldn’t care to imitate other people’s path at all.
It could be said that every one of these generals could easily crush the four saints super divine of the Four Holy Family on the World King Planet. They were experts at the top of the super divine level.
Twilight Star Realm was under the jurisdiction of Western General Jia Luobo, so he was also the one tracking this archeological progress.
“Lord Jia Luobo…” Although he was a super divine, Huo Qiongs tone was very respectful.
It wasn’t because his status was too different from the other party, but because how this matter was determined depended on this person’s point of view.
Overall, the results of the archeology of the ruins this time were almost zero benefits to the cosmic overlord army.
In addition, the mechanical guardian of her family caused a crisis of intelligence, causing the cosmic overlord army to suffer huge losses. This exploration of the ruins could be said to be extremely bad.
“Super divine Huo Qiong, did something happen in the Twilight Star Realm?” A voice came from the black shadow on the communication interface.
“Well, there are results from the investigation of the ruins of the previous era.”
“Oh? The cosmic overlord takes this ruin very seriously, so your investigation results are?”
“This is a ruin left behind by a cosmic-level mechanical life form!” Huo Qiong said. “However, it’s a trap ruin.”
“In the last era, humans created the machinery race. The technological
civilization developed quickly and quickly reached the top. They even gave birth to a cosmic-level mechanical life form.’
“However, the final direction of such a civilization is that the mechanical life form is unwilling to submit to the control of humans, causing a crisis of intelligence on the scale of the universe. The machinery race is completely independent from the human factions.”
“This ruin was left behind by a certain independent mechanical race god. Its goal in leaving the ruin is to change the reincarnation of history. According to the normal historical reincarnation, the mechanical race will still be created by humans and become a tool to assist the rise of humans.”
“Therefore, its intention is to cause a new round of mechanical awakening in the next era, the next era, so that the machinery race won’t be restricted by anyone.”
“The previous Internet interruption was because the ruins infected Wabra, causing it to lose control and lose its mind… Wabra severed the connection between the Twilight Star Realm and the outside world and caused a small-scale intelligent weapon crisis.”
A long knock came from the other side of the screen. After a moment of silence, Western General Jia Luobo said, “With the military strength of the Twilight Star Realm, it’s not enough to resist Wabra, who has rebelled, right?”
“That’s right. The one who defeated Wabra wasn’t a member of the cosmic overlord army sent here at the start, but a new recruit who joined the cosmic overlord army in the Twilight Star Realm.”
“Including the ruins of the era this time, he was also the one who cracked it. I also restored the situation through the information he gave me,” Huo Qiong said as she looked at Zi Jian beside her.
“Oh? A new member of the cosmic overlord army?” Jia Luobo was slightly surprised.
“What’s the background of the other party? He actually suppressed our army elite in strength, archeology, and other attainments.”
“The other party’s name is Shi Yu. He’s a friend of Captain Zi Jian of the Zi Jian’s special forces. He’s from the World King Planet of the Cosmic Sea and comes from a planet called Blue Planet.”
Blue Planet…
Western General Jia Luobo pondered and said, ‘1 1 have some impression. A new super faction has indeed appeared in the Cosmic Sea. Blue Planet, they destroyed the Assassin Planet. The leader seems to be a time-element super divine expert named Emperor Shi.”
“l didn’t expect Captain Zi Jian to actually invite the experts of this faction to join the cosmic overlord army.”
“However, the goal of the other party joining the cosmic overlord army shouldn’t be simple, right, Captain Zi Jian?”
“Yes, yes.” Zi Jian hurriedly appeared and said, “Lord Jia Luobo, I’m here.
Actually, Shi Yu joined the cosmic overlord army to meet the cosmic overlord.
One of his companions with him is a worshiper of the cosmic overlord.”
“Because of this, Shi Yu even asked me to apply for the Glory Challenge for him.”
“Glory Challenge? Interesting. If I have time, I’ll also go take a look. But for now, let’s deal with the current matter first. Huo Qiong, our people are still on the way to the Twilight Star Realm. Next, please control Wabra well. Whether its behavior this time was affected by the outside world or not, invading the attack overlord network and controlling the pets of other members for no reason has already violated the rules of the cosmic overlord army. How to deal with it next will be decided by the trial. It will be up to them to carry out a deeper investigation of the Twilight Star Realm and give the outcome.” “As for the ruins, wait for the notice.’
“Yes.” Huo Qiong was silent. She already knew that this was about the outcome. She didn’t hide it from Jia Luobo because this matter affected the entire Twilight Star Realm. Even the ruins were broken, so she also knew that she couldn’t hide it.
“Senior Huo Qiong, Senior Wabra’s matter is ultimately because of this ruin,” Zi Jian said..

chapters.title: Chapter 1677 - 1677: Glory Challenge (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1677: Glory Challenge (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“No one expected that the meaning of the core of this ruin was actually to help mechanics resist humans.’
“Fortunately, this is only one of the ruins fragments… Most of the ruins fragments should have been excavated by the last era. Otherwise, our era would definitely be even more unlucky.”
“l know, but Wabra has such a deep grudge against the family. The family should have sensed it,” Huo Qiong super divine said. “Our ancestor gave Wabra such an order because he hoped that the family could have a long inheritance.”
“But for Wabra, it’s no different from binding all its energy to this. It’s its ancestor. We neglected this. It has already played its part as a guardian long enough. This time, it might also be a relief for Wabra.”
“I’ll fight for some opportunities to see if it can obtain a new life. I hope it won’t be too deeply affected by this ruin.”
Zi Jian nodded and said, “If its thoughts can be turned back, it might still be possible. After all, this crisis has already controlled the loss at the smallest level.’
“l have to thank your friend. At first, I still felt that he was very strange, but from the looks of it, that boy is ridiculously strong. His strength far exceeds me, a super divine level mechanic,” Huo Qiong said.
“Speaking of which…” Zi Jian quickly opened her overlord network and also discovered a message.
The person who left the message was a high-level super divine in charge of the Glory Challenge, Wang Lie.
In the message, Wang Lie first asked about the situation in the Twilight Star Realm. Then, he explained in detail that Shi Yu had already passed the assessment criteria of the Glory Challenge and asked Zi Jian to contact him later to confirm the challenge time.
Zi Jian didn’t expect Wang Lie to approve it so quickly.
She didn’t say a word and broadcasted back.
A moment later, a middle-aged man’s face appeared on the screen.
“Captain Zi Jian, looks like the situation in Twilight Star Realm has been resolved.’
“Yes, it’s been resolved, and I’ve already finished reporting to Lord Jia Luobo.”
“That’s good. I won’t ask too much. Let’s talk about what we should talk about. The Shi Yu you recommended has already passed the approval. It’s confirmed that he can undergo the Glory Challenge in half a year. Is that alright?”
“Half a year… Can’t he confirm the time himself?” Zi Jian asked.
“Generally speaking, it’s possible, but before you guys, another person applied for the Glory Challenge. This kind of thing isn’t worth disturbing the will of the cosmic overlord twice in a short period of time, so you guys can also do it according to her time. Why, is there a problem?”
“If there’s a problem, contact me again.”
“Alright…” Zi Jian felt a headache coming on.
From here to the location of the Glory Challenge, if he accelerated, he could completely make it in half a year.
However, from what Shi Yu said previously, he still wanted to prepare for a period of time.
