Half a year… was too short.
It was better to ask Shi Yu later. If half a year was too short, she had to think of a way to delay the challenge. This opportunity was rare.
However, after watching the battle just now, Zi Jian felt that it didn’t seem to be a problem for Shi Yu to challenge it now.
She realized that she had completely underestimated Shi Yu previously. This guy had gone from the strongest quasi divine to the strongest divine-level tier in more than two years. It was ridiculous.
The matter of the Twilight Star Realm was sealed by the cosmic overlord army.
After all, it involved a super divine insider and a super divine family. Before the final outcome was dealt with, it wasn’t suitable to publicize it, nor was it suitable to let the rumors spread themselves.
In its place was another big matter that suppressed the limelight of the Twilight Star Realm’s era ruins.
After many years, someone finally challenged Glory Challenge again.
Compared to the archeology of ruins that only a small number of people paid attention to, it was clearly more gimmicky to involve a super genius from the overlord territory challenging the deterrence will of a cosmic overlord.
And the challenger this time not only surprised the various factions in the overlord territory, but also surprised them.
Unsurprisingly, the challenger was indeed the genius Beast Tamer Ting Yu who received the most attention in the current overlord territory.
Ting Yu came from one of the Ting clans. After becoming a super divine, her talent was shocking. She had just been born and didn’t need to meditate to have a Level 7 Beast Taming Space. She could contract overlord-level pets with her baby body.
With a little meditation, she had already broken through to the divine level before she was of age.
After entering the divine level, she also improved greatly. Her meditation speed was several times faster than other geniuses, and she quickly reached the peak of the divine level.
If this was nothing, then relying on her powerful talent, the strength of her pet was also ridiculously strong.
It was an epoch god!
Under the enhancement of the divine contract and the support of her powerful talent potential, Ting Yu used the divine contract to nurture an epoch-level pet. During this period, she even completed the battle record of killing super divines above her level.
She had also successfully broken through the restrictions of the 10th heavenly layer of the divine level and reached the 11th heavenly layer of the divine level.
If this wasn’t enough to prove Ting Yu’s power, her age would definitely shock everyone. This was because this proud daughter of heaven was less than 30 years old now. Even that epoch divine-level pet was less than 30 years old. She was completely young and promising, and her future was immeasurable.
In the entire universe, some factions in the overlord territory also felt that
this woman was invincible in her generation.
Even people like Zavay and Ming Gu on the World King Planet were much inferior to Ting Yu. Even if the former grew up in the future and had a high chance of becoming a super divine, that was nothing. For people like Ting Yu, super divine was just a starting point. The peak of super divine and even the cosmic level was their goal..

chapters.title: Chapter 1678 - 1678: Glory Challenge (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1678: Glory Challenge (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
People like Ting Yu were the most talented, had the greatest potential, and the most terrifying genius in the starry sky. However, such people were basically sleeping, dodging the lightning tribulation, and waiting for the appearance of a transcendent origin. Ting Yu was active in the overlord territory because she was young. It was also because she was separated from other monster geniuses that Ting Yu made an invincible name in the overlord territory.
If it was her who challenged the Glory Challenge, no one would be surprised. She was completely qualified.
To everyone’s surprise, there were two people who carried out the Glory Challenge this time. Not only was Ting Yu one of them, but the other was originally unknown. However, with such a big matter, Shi Yu’s identity couldn’t be hidden at all.
“Have you heard? The Glory Challenge will begin in half a year. Apart from the inheritor of one of the Ting clan, Ting Yu, there’s also a Beast Tamer from the World King Planet. It’s said that his name is Shi Yu.”
“Shi Yu?? Why haven’t I heard of him? I’ve heard of someone named Wang Kong from the World King Planet. There’s also a divine-level Beast Tamer named Lin Feng who joined forces to assassinate a super divine. However, compared to Lord Ting Yu, he’s still far inferior.”
“What the hell? Shi Yu is the latest super genius of World King Planet. Let me put it this way. The Environmental Protection Army of the Cosmic Sea is now fighting the Dark King Army in the polluted land. This war involves nearly 20 super divine-level experts.”
“The current situation is that the Environmental Protection Army has a huge advantage. Do you know why?”
“It’s because of Shi Yu!”
“As everyone knows, in war, super divine levels have nowhere to hide like the sun. They’re the sure-kill weapon of various parties. Therefore, the Environmental Protection Army sent a divine-level assassin, which is Shi Yu, to directly let him charge into the territory of the Dark King Army alone.”
“Right on the heels of that, guess what? Shi Yu hunted an abyss super divine that exceeded transcendent 2 alone and helped the Environmental Protection Army open a huge war gap, laying the foundation for victory.”
“Holy sh*t… What fierce person? Why does he sound even stronger than Lord
Ting Yu?”
“That’s not necessarily so. It’s said that there’s a countering factor. He has a cleansing star spirit pet that’s very counter to the abyss type, but it’s also very strong. ”
“Wait a minute, you just said the Environmental Protection Army… Then why is he here in the cosmic overlord army again?”
“You’re asking me, but who should I ask? However, the Environmental Protection Army has always cooperated with the cosmic overlord army. It doesn’t seem to be prohibiting members from joining the cosmic overlord army, right?”
Although it was very far away, Shi Yu e s battle results of killing the abyss super divine in the Contaminated Land still spread here.
In an instant, Shi Yu’s reputation instantly soared, making people pay more attention to the results of Ting Yu and Shi Yu’s Glory Challenge.
Especially since Shi Yu came from the Cosmic Sea, the factions of the overlord territory wanted to know if the geniuses of the overlord territory were stronger or the geniuses of the Cosmic Sea were stronger…
Twilight Star Realm, Heavenly Net Planet.
At this moment, Shi Yu had just returned.
“Where have you been for the past half a month??”
After Shi Yu returned, Captain Zi Jian immediately asked.
If not for the fact that she could still contact Shi Yu through the overlord network, she would have gone crazy.
Through the overlord network, she asked Shi Yu if he could carry out the Glory Challenge in half a year. After Shi Yu agreed, he directly stayed outside for half a month before returning.
In the past half a month, Shi Yu t s name had gradually spread in the overlord territory, but Shi Yu still didn’t return to the Heavenly Net PLanet. Zi Jian was really afraid that Shi Yu would still be out of contact after the preview had already been released, and he would have stood the Glory Challenge up.
In that case, as a recommender, she would definitely be beaten to death.
“Didn’t I say that I had some enlightening? I’m going to break through,” Shi Yu said with a smile. What was the hurry?
“How can we not be anxious? Prepare yourself. We have to set off in half a month. We have to arrive a little earlier,” Zi Jian said.
“Now, half the experts in the overlord territory are discussing you and Ting
Yu. How do you feel?”
Captain Zi Jian looked at Shi Yu in front of her and asked.
“I don’t feel anything…” Shi Yu said, “I’m more concerned about how strong the deterrence of the cosmic overlord is.’
“But Ting Yu is quite powerful. I’ve seen her information recently. It’s really spectacular. It should have been a long time since a genius of this level appeared on World King Planet.”
Apart from him, the most recent human genius to break through the limit of the divine level to Level 11 in the Cosmic Sea was probably 100,000 years ago.
He had long slept for an unknown period of time,
Unlike this girl, who was energetic and arranged fights everywhere.
As expected of the territory of the universe boss…
“Well, I’ve met her once. She’s indeed powerful,” Zi Jian said.
“It’s very ridiculous to be able to break through the limit of the divine level at this age. However, why do I remember that you don’t seem to be very old either? You’re also in your twenties.” The corners of Captain Zi Jian’s mouth twitched slightly. “By the way, what’s your current level…”
Zi Jian didn’t know if Beast Shi Yu was Shi Yu’s pet, but according to the rumors, Susu definitely had the strength of an epoch god to defeat an abyss super divine. Also, Shi Yu t s mechanical pet could defeat the virtual Wabra in the virtual world, so its strength was definitely not ordinary…
“Me? I just broke through to the 12th heavenly layer of the divine level. I’m barely one level higher than Ting Yu. I didn’t work hard for nothing in the past half a month.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “l wonder if I can pass the challenge…”
“12th heavenly layer?” Zi Jian’s stomach hurt as she looked at Shi Yu numbly. In the God Sealing Battle, Shi Yu had already left a very deep impression on the audience over there. She never expected that Shi Yu, who had broken through to the divine level, would come to make the experts of the overlord territory’s stomach hurt again.
Ting Yu was already ridiculous.. Shi Yu was younger than Ting Yu and had a higher level than the other party, so what kind of demon was Shi Yu?

chapters.title: Chapter 1679 - 1679: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1679: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu still didn’t dodge the lightning tribulation and couldn’t successfully suppress his level.
However, just as the owl had said, the lightning tribulation of the 12th heavenly layer wasn’t much stronger than the lightning tribulation of the 11th heavenly layer.
If Shi Yu, who had Beast Shi Yu, couldn’t withstand it, then probably none of the geniuses from ancient times until now could either.
“Confirm the time. I can set off anytime,” Shi Yu said to Captain Zi Jian.
Zi Jian said, “Alright, then a day later. If an accident happens, it won’t be good if we’re late.’
An accident? A cosmic disaster, right?
Shi Yu thought to himself that that was definitely impossible.
The current Ling had the Wind of Blessing.
The strength of luck was at least comparable to a son of cosmic luck at the peak of the super divine level.
If luck of this level could still be extremely unlucky, that would be too unlucky.
A day later.
The two battleships set off. One was from Zi Jian’s special forces, and the other was Shi Yu l s Ling.
At this moment, Examiner Jermon, the Demolishing Divine Bull, had already been chased away by Shi Yu.
The other party went to Zi Jian’s special forces to receive worship.
“Brother Jermon, were you really the examiner for Captain Shi Yu when you were on the World King Planet??”
Although Shi Yu had just joined Zi Jian’s special forces, he was quickly promoted to captain by Zi Jian.
It couldn’t be helped. Shi Yu’s battle results and strength were too valiant. How could such a person really be a new recruit?
As Shi Yu’s reputation increased, the identity of Jermon who came with Shi Yu also rose.
Some of the new recruits on the Zi Jian’s special forces battleship were shocked when they heard that Jermon was once Shi Yu’s examiner.
“Yeah…” The Demolishing Divine Bull’s balls hurt.
Because the ones worshiping it at this moment were only some new recruits recruited by the Zi Jian’s special forces, as well as some members of the Zi Jian’s special forces who had previously stayed in the overlord territory.
As for the other members, they might have seen its competition with Shi Yu and seen it beaten up by Shi Yu.
Fortunately, these people didn’t say anything and were very sensible. Otherwise, it would be awkward.
However, now that it had become like this, Jermon heaved a sigh of relief. Damn, this wasn’t bad either. It wanted to see who still dared to mock it.
It turned out that Shi Yu, this abnormal guy, could even destroy a super divine level now. Then what was wrong with Jermon losing a competition?
“Brother Bull, what do you think of Captain Shi Yu’s Glory Challenge this time? Can he pass?” A subordinate of the Zi Jian’s special forces held a cup of wine and asked Jermon.
“Needless to say, Shi Yu is a Beast Tamer who passed my test! Naturally, he can also pass…” the cow gradually shouted.
On the other side, on Shi Yu’s battleship.
Shi Yu and the others were also holding a banquet to celebrate Shi Yu’s breakthrough.
“Speaking of which, we’re going to see a cosmic overlord soon. Aren’t you nervous?” the owl girl asked nervously at the wine table.
Previously, as the strongest genius of the Astrologer Race, ordinary super divines had once asked it for a favor and asked it to make a prophecy, so its horizons had always been very high.
However, a cosmic overlord was a cosmic supreme master after all. Not to mention the owl girl, anyone would definitely be a little nervous.
“Wu wu wu!! (Sooner or later, I’ll defeat a cosmic overlord!)” On the table, Baby Ginseng got Eleven a bowl of bamboo wine. Eleven was already dizzy. When it spoke nonsense, no one took it seriously.
Only Baby Ginsengs eyes flashed with a sharp luster. It looked like this alcohol was very resistant to Eleven… Perhaps it could be used next time.
“Wish Star, boohoo, my Wish Star.” The gem cat girl also drank wine, its face red. At the thought that it was about to gather the Wish Star, it was very excited.
Even if these Wish Stars were all with the cosmic overlord, with the smooth sailing in the past, their small group didn’t have any thoughts that it was impossible to achieve.
After experiencing so much, Shi Yu’s small group had already established the confidence that they were omnipotent. They knew that as long as they wanted to, they could definitely achieve it.
“Don’t think too much. Let’s talk through the Glory Challenge first,” Shi Yu
said as he ate the hot roasted divine-level sweet potato.
“Eat, eat, eat.”
“Ji!!” Buggy and the others started eating again.
In the blink of an eye, Shi Yu and the others sailed in the starry sky of the universe for another four months.
After breaking through to the 12th heavenly layer of the divine level, Shi Yu!s physique was further strengthened. In addition, Susu and Ling had become epoch gods, and their support abilities had greatly increased. Shi Yu’s efficiency of adding points also increased further.
At this point, all Shi Yu’s pets had mastered at least one divine skill (Perfect+47). Every pet could be said to be a quasi-epoch god and had the qualifications to charge at the epoch god.
Shorty’s Gem King Eye, the Holy Black Tortoise Body that fused with the Black Tortoise, Duckie’s Eye of the Evil God, Little Ji t s Destruction Body, Buggy’s Spirit Control, and so on were all maxed out by Shi Yu.S earch ?ew?o?el. ?rg on g??gl?
For example, Susu and Lings divine skills reached transcendence.
This was also Shi Yu’s preparation for the Glory Challenge. He prioritized upgrading the skills used to resist deterrence. Apart from that, the skills used to support points were also prioritized upgrades. They were also maxed out.
Of course, the price of nurturing a team of quasi-epoch gods quickly appeared.
In just two years, the reserves were enough for the Four Holy Evolvers on the entire World King Planet to use the power of faith in the ruins of the Four Holy Evolvers for millions or even hundreds of millions of years…
It was directly cleaned up by Shi Yua
The Four Holy Ruins was already completely crippled. It had no strength at all.
If the Four Holy Evolvers of the World King Planet knew about this, their eyes would definitely pop out and they would scold Shi Yu for wasting money..

chapters.title: Chapter 1680 - 1680: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1680: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Although the Four Holy Ruins was indeed a consumable, under normal circumstances, it was impossible for anyone to become fat in one go. They had to slowly use and digest it.
Only Shi Yu could squeeze the Four Holy Ruins dry in two years. Even if it was the Four Holy super divine, it was impossible for them to consume it so quickly.
Of course, it was also thanks to the contribution of the Four Holy Ruins. Otherwise, it would have been impossible for Shi Yu’s entire team’s battle power to increase by leaps and bounds.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu’s additional points efficiency would decrease a little. This was because their net worth had already been reduced to only food resources and navigation resources to maintain normal life activities during this period of time.
Not only the Four Holy Ruins, but even the power of the world taken away from Blue Planet had basically been used up.
However, the problem wasn’t especially big. Shi Yu prioritized increasing the support points skills of his pets. Even if the efficiency wasn’t as high as before, there wouldn’t be much of a difference. He believed that their remaining skills could quickly be maxed out in the future.
“Shi Yu, we’re here.’
A message from the Zi Jian’s special forces came from Shi Yu!s battleship.
After Ling received it, it was conveyed to Shi Yu. Shi Yu stretched out his hand, put on his coat, and walked out of the ship. At this moment, the two battleships were already approaching a red planet.
This planet was called Origin Planet. It was a very special place in the overlord territory.
Although it wasn’t the headquarters of the cosmic overlord army, it was the second most important planet in the overlord territory.
It was the mother planet of the cosmic overlord, Cypos.
As for the most important thing, it was naturally the current location of the cosmic overlord, Cypos, who was at the Overlord Planet.
That was also the headquarters of the cosmic overlord army.
The place of the Glory Challenge wasn’t the headquarters of the cosmic overlord army, but the starry sky near the Origin Planet.
The cosmic overlord took very good care of its mother planet. It was said that at the start, the deterrence left behind was only to protect its mother planet.
After that, it became a test that anyone could challenge.
“Is this the Origin Planet? From the level, it seems to be close to a top-notch planet.”
After Shi Yu walked out of the battleship, the battleship Ling kept shrinking into a pendant-like equipment that Shi Yu wore.
“Yes, the Origin Planet and the Overlord Planet are the two planets closest to top-notch planets in the overlord territory.” The other landed on the battleship on the ground. Captain Zi Jian also walked down and looked at the sky.
When they arrived, someone immediately came to receive them. A mature female-looking cyborg appeared at the landing point of the battleship and spoke to Captain Zi Jian, Shi Yu, and the others.
“Captain Zi Jian, Mr. Shi Yu, welcome to Origin Planet. I’m Lord King Lie’s secretary, Ma Xia.”
“Lord King Lie has been waiting for you for a long time.”
“Miss Ma Xia, bring us to see Lord King Lie,” Captain Zi Jian said.
The others from the Zi Jian’s special forces didn’t come down. Only Zi Jian and Shi Yu followed the secretary to see the person in charge of the Glory
Challenge.
In an aerial pavilion, there was a middle-aged man with red hair. His name was Lie Kong, and he was known as King Lie. He was one of the eight kings of the cosmic overlord army. The Four Square Generals of the cosmic overlord army were all experts at the peak of the super divine level. As for the eight kings, they were eight powerful super divine experts who had transcended more than seven times. They were in charge of managing various important things.
At this moment, King Lie was standing at a corner, holding a branch and fighting the two little bugs in the jar in front of him.
The small bottle was like a world, spreading strong spatial fluctuations. The aura of the two little bugs inside was also incomparably terrifying. Each of them had reached perfect-level divine power. From the bloodline fluctuations, they seemed to be one of the disaster races in the universe, the Space Worm.
“Lord King Lie.” After Ma Xia brought Zi Jian and Shi Yu over, she spoke slightly. King Lie didn’t reply. Zi Jian and Shi Yu only watched the red-haired man fight the worm quietly.
A moment later, a worm died and was swallowed. Only then did King Lie smile and look at Zi Jian and Shi Yu.
“Welcome, Captain Zi Jian. Long time no see. This is Mr. Shi Yu, right?”
“Lord King Lie,” Captain Zi Jian said. “You still like to fight bugs so much.” She had once stayed in the archeological school on Origin Planet for a period of time, so she had met King Lie a few times.
“l just want to see if I can fight an epoch-level worm. Unfortunately, it’s difficult to become an era god, even harder than a super divine level. Among the 50 perfect-level cosmic worms, there are less than five left that have devoured each other. There are still no signs of an epoch god.”
King Lie shook his head regretfully and looked at Shi Yu. “Therefore, in my opinion, every genius who can nurture an epoch god is very impressive.”
“Lord King Lie, you flatter me,” Shi Yu said. “An expert like you makes me look forward to it even more.’
“The Glory Challenge will begin in 45 days. For the next period of time, the two of you should rest on the Origin Planet first. There’s nothing special about inviting the two of you this time. I just want to see Sir Shi Yu. Now, my goal has been achieved.’
King Lie looked at Shi Yu very seriously. He wanted to see Shi Yu and see how strong Shi Yu t s strength was. Unfortunately, he actually couldn’t see through Shi Yu. Before Shi Yu displayed his strength, he was like a mortal. His control over strength was very exquisite.
This made King Lie very incredulous. There were very few divine-levels that could hide from his perception. Shi Yu was clearly one of them. Since he didn’t gain anything, King Lie didn’t force it. It wasn’t too late to look at it after the
Glory Challenge..

chapters.title: Chapter 1681 - 1681: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1681: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“In that case, I won’t disturb Lord King Lie anymore,” Captain Zi Jian said.
“Yes.” King Lie nodded and said, “There’s one more thing to remind Mr. Shi Yu. During this period, if you encounter a challenge, it’s best not to accept it or do anything dangerous. Please welcome the Glory Challenge in your best state.”
After only meeting King Lie once, Shi Yu and Zi Jian returned. King Lie’s final words were thought-provoking, making Zi Jian smile.
“Shi Yu, do you know what King Lie’s last words mean?”
“It means that I should perform better in the Glory Challenge. He passed the approval. If my performance in the Glory Challenge is lousy, won’t it show that he doesn’t have a good eye for people?”
Zi Jian and Shi Yu chatted as they flew.
“You’re half right. In fact, King Lie wanted to say that he didn’t want you to accept Ting Yu’s challenge. I’m dying of laughter. Looks like the other challenger has long arrived at the Origin Planet. Ting Yu has almost challenged all the famous divine-levels in the overlord territory. Now that you have appeared, she might also want to challenge you.”
“At that time, if both of you are injured, King Lie won’t have anywhere to cry.”
“Ah, this,” Shi Yu said. “Don’t worry, I won’t accept the challenge.”
“I’m relieved to hear that.”
On Origin Planet, in a manor.
A young girl with thin eyebrows, black hair, black eyes, and two ponytails was about to leave when an old man stopped her.
“Where are you going?”
“Grandpa, Shi Yu seems to have arrived at Origin Planet. I heard that he’s very strong. I want to meet him first,” the girl said, as if she was saying something very normal.
“You’re not allowed to go.” Old Man Ting Xiang widened his eyes and said, “Do you still want to carry out the Glory Challenge? What if your condition is affected and you delay the Glory Challenge?”
“It’s alright. I know my limits,” she said.
“I said not to go, so you’re not allowed to go. During this period of time, you have to stay here obediently.”
“It’s not too late for you to challenge after the Glory Challenge ends. There’s no hurry these few days.”
“Tsk.” Ting Yu curled her lips and said, “Stubborn guy.”
With that said, she disappeared.
Ting Xiang: “?”
“Clone??? Damn girl.”
The old man gritted his teeth and contacted King Lie. “Lie Kong, why don’t we do this…
Soon, Shi Yu had already found a temporary place to stay.
The gem cat girl and the owl girl came out of the battleship lazily and lived in a large manor with fresh air.
The environment of Origin Planet wasn’t inferior to that of the World King Planet.
In fact, to a certain extent, it was even better.
This was because compared to the World King Planet, this place was much smaller. There were much fewer races to support.
In addition, the cosmic overlord army had snatched many good things to modify Origin Planet, making the environment here very comfortable. The two cats immediately liked this place.
“I can still work hard for more than a month!” Shi Yu said. “By the way, if I let Baby Ginseng freeload the power of the world on the Origin Planet, will it be beaten to death?”
“Yi… (To be honest, I don’t want to try.)” Baby Ginseng was modifying plants and flowers in the manor, optimizing the environment here again.
“Hm?”
Not long after Shi Yu and the others rested, the gem cat raised its head slightly and sensed a powerful aura slowly approaching.
Shi Yu also sensed it and couldn’t help but look over. A moment later, they discovered a heroic-looking girl in a loose white battle short-sleeved shirt and black battle shorts. She wasn’t tall and stopped in the air above the manor.
“The most dazzling new star of the cosmic overlord army, Ting Yu, who is still active in the strongest Divine Realm.”
After seeing her, Ling immediately detected the other party’s identity and reported it to Shi Yu.
“Beauty, what’s the matter?” Shi Yu also put down what he was doing and looked up with a smile.
He felt strange in his heart. Captain Zi Jian was really right. Ting Yu seemed to be really a battle maniac. They had just arrived, and she actually came looking for them.
“Shi Yu, right? I heard that you’re very powerful. You have the battle record of hunting super divines in the Contaminated Land.”
“Are you interested in fighting?”
“This…” Shi Yu was just about to refuse when Ting Yu said, “According to the rules of the cosmic overlord army, if I lose the bet battle, I’ll give you ten super divine resources. If I win, I don’t want anything from you.”
“Of course, in order to not affect the Glory Challenge, the battle rules can be changed. The main body of the deterrence of the Glory Challenge is a human Beast Tamer. Therefore, this battle is only a battle between pets. Beast Tamers don’t participate. Even if they’re injured in the battle, with the recovery speed of the pets, such a long time is enough.”
“This time, let’s fight IVSI first and spar with the strongest pets of both parties.”
“After the Glory Challenge, we’ll each use our full strength to fight. You win both times, so it’s ten super divine resources. If you win once, it’ll be five.”
“This… isn’t impossible,” Shi Yu said. “I also want to see how powerful the strongest divine level in the overlord territory is.”
“Then it’s settled.” The corners of Ting Yu’s mouth curled up. “I’ll wait for you in the starry sky.”
With that said, she turned and flew into the starry sky. Seeing this, Shi Yu was
first silent before sighing deeply. “How can there be such a bold woman?”
“Ten super divine resources? Give me the feeling that if I don’t accept it, I’ll suffer a huge loss..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1682 - 1682: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1682: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Captain Zi Jian, I’m sorry.”
Shi Yu gritted his teeth and said, “Let’s go.”
Ling sighed. However, according to its analysis, it was indeed a huge loss not to fight this battle.
It would try her best to win this battle steadily.
With that said, Shi Yu and Ling also flew into the starry sky under the speechless gazes of the gem cat and the others.
“Where are you going?”
However, it was really not easy to fight this battle. Clearly, they were being watched at all times. When Ting Yu and Shi Yu flew out of the starry sky one after another, a huge phantom directly appeared under the starry sky.
The phantom of a red-haired man appeared in their path and stopped them.
“Lord King Lie?” Ting Yu!s eyelids twitched. Trouble was here.
“Uh, Lord King Lie?” Shi Yu was also a little guilty. He had previously promised the other party not to accept challenges randomly, but now, he had been directly caught red-handed.
“Since the two of you are so anxious, the Glory Challenge will begin in advance,” King Lie said.
After the Glory Challenge, these two guys could do whatever they wanted.
In the beginning, it was set to be half a year later. It was originally to wait for Shi Yu. Since Shi Yu had arrived in advance, it was fine to start now.
“Can I?” Ting Yu t s eyes lit up, indicating that there was no problem.
“Alright.” Shi Yu thought for a moment. In a month, there wouldn’t be any qualitative change in his improvement. It wasn’t impossible to accept it in advance.
As the two of them nodded, King Lie said, “In that case, follow me.”
Then, Ting Yu and Shi Yu looked at each other. Both parties followed King Lie to the starry sky. Soon, both parties were brought outside the Origin Planet.
“You guys go together.” After arriving outside the starry sky and facing the empty starry sky, the King Lie phantom directly spoke.
“As for the rules, I believe you already understand them. I won’t explain too much.’
“If you’re ready, just nod at me. I’ll summon the deterrence will of the cosmic overlord.’
“It’s done.” Shi Yu and Ting Yu were currently in their optimal state. They thought that there was nothing to prepare for and nodded.
In the next moment, King Lie looked at the starry sky, and his expression became extremely serious. He was very serious, and he muttered a special language, as if it was some kind of incantation.
In the universe, there were countless languages. Among them, some languages indeed contained some special power.
At this moment, as King Lie finished chanting the incantation, with a boom, the star space seemed to illuminate the entire overlord territory and rose like a sun. A terrifying will wave turned into a Sea of Stars and flowed to various places in the universe.
At this moment, on the Origin Planet closest to this place, all life sensed an indescribable power. No matter what life form it was, they raised their heads and looked at the starry sky that contained the light of the supreme power.
“This is… the power of a cosmic overlord.” On Origin Planet, countless lives subconsciously knelt on the ground and prayed extremely sincerely. There were also some super divine experts who muttered to themselves, feeling the shocking difference between them and the cosmic level.
“What, why did it start in advance?” On the Zi Jian’s special forces’ side, the group of members led by Captain Zi Jian were slightly shocked.
“Ting Yu, see the power of a cosmic overlord.” On the ground, Old Ting Xiang looked at the starry sky and said. This was more worth experiencing than any opponent.
Since he wanted to experience the power of a cosmic overlord, he had to experience it in the most perfect state!
At this moment, the light transmigrated through the Star Domain. In the Star Domain where the Origin Planet was, the lives on countless planets also sensed this power. Even in the surrounding Star Domains, many experts flew out of the planets and looked in this direction.
In an instant, the starry sky at the Origin Planet became the focus of the entire overlord territory.
“The Glory Challenge has opened.” It wasn’t the first time some old things had seen the Glory Challenge open. At this moment, as the change appeared, they paid attention, wanting to see the “talent” of the challenger this time.
And now, as challengers, Shi Yu and Ting Yu’s faces were pale.
“Lord Cypos, please lower the test.” King Lie also bent down piously and begged the will of the cosmic overlord.
As soon as he finished speaking, deterrence slowly condensed in the endless light. There was no true body of a cosmic overlord, nor was there anything to symbolize it. It was just an even more dazzling ball of light that was like the source of transcendence and the sun condensed inside.
Boom!!!
When this ball of light appeared, the deterrence began to retract. Then, it suddenly focused on Ting Yu and Shi Yue
During this period, Ting Yu and Shi Yu had already contracted their pets and made a mental connection, condensing the power of everyone.
But even so, in just an instant, the valiant Ting Yu had already turned pale and weak. Blood still flowed out of the corners of her mouth, nostrils, ears, and eyes at the same time.
Her pupils were filled with disbelief. Behind her, the spatial phantom of the eleven heavens was stimulated.
She could sense that the deterrence in the light ball had already been restrained to the limit. From a level that was enough to instantly kill a peak super divine, it was enough to shatter countless Star Domains and make the universe tremble to the divine level.
But this divine level was simply worlds apart from the divine level she understood.
Boom.
At this moment, cracks began to appear in her Beast Taming Space under this deterrence. The figure of a nine-tailed fox gradually appeared in the phantom of the eleven heavens. At this moment, the nine-tailed fox also had a panicked expression, and its body involuntarily trembled..

chapters.title: Chapter 1683 - 1683: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1683 - 1683: The Strongest in the Cosmic Sea and the Strongest in the Overlord Territory (5)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Look, Ting Yu of the Ting clan…”
At this moment, Ting Yu’s miserable appearance reflected the starry sky. The experts on the Origin Star looked at Ting Yu with trembling hearts. Under the circumstances where those ancient geniuses slept and didn’t come out, Ting Yu was the strongest divine level in the current overlord territory.
It was also the person in everyone’s impression who was most likely to pass the Glory Challenge.
However, even she found it extremely difficult to face the power of a cosmic overlord. She was about to be crushed.
Ting Yu’s gaze was filled with a dead and lifeless expression. Her consciousness had already almost collapsed under the might of the overlord. At this moment, she seemed to have experienced countless deaths, as if she could see countless star domains being destroyed in front of her eyes.
“As expected, it’s still a little lacking,” King Lie said in the starry sky. Since ancient times, countless geniuses had undergone the Glory Challenge, but
only when they really experienced that moment would they know how terrifying the remaining power of the strongest in the universe would be.
It wasn’t that they were too weak, but that the cosmic overlord was too strong.
The current deterrence had already been suppressed to the divine level, but the divine level in the concept of the number one expert in the universe was definitely different from the divine level in the impression of these “ordinary people”.
“The 11th heavenly layer of the divine level is actually unable to resist!” Countless experts were shocked. Even some super divines were shocked. Even if it was just perception, it made them a little afraid. They felt that even they couldn’t block such a level of deterrence.
Was this really a divine-level deterrence test?
“Do you have a direction now?” On Origin Planet, Old Ting Xiang was paying attention to his granddaughter. Many geniuses who had experienced the deterrence of a cosmic overlord had completely fallen. Their willpower had disappeared, but there were also some geniuses who had found a new direction and became braver. He hoped that his granddaughter would be the latter.
Failure wasn’t scary, but as long as one absorbed the EXP, they would succeed.
“Pfft!!!” In less than a minute, under the deterrence of the cosmic overlord, Ting Yu spat out blood crazily. Her internal organs and bone marrow were flattened, and the Beast Taming Space had already collapsed several times. She indeed felt the danger of death.
As her consciousness gradually fainted, Ting Yu saw Shi Yu’s figure. At this moment, she was in extreme disbelief because Shi Yu’s condition was much better than hers. It was just that his face was pale.
Indeed. After seeing Ting Yu’s miserable appearance, most people also noticed Shi Yu. This was said to be the strongest divine-level person in the Cosmic Sea today.
Compared to Ting Yu, Shi Yu’s condition was much better. It was so good that it was unbelievable. Under such a long deterrence, he still stood in the starry sky with his main body without any performance.
Just now, people thought that he didn’t mainly experience deterrence, but after careful observation, they realized that the deterrence level he endured had always been exactly the same as Ting Yu.
“What’s wrong with this guy?” Countless people were shocked.
“So scary. Is this the deterrence of a cosmic overlord? It’s just a deterrence left behind. Without the main body around, I feel that it can instantly kill Shi Yu,” the gem cat girl said from below.
“Why not insta-kill you?” the owl said.
“Shi Yu, he… is… holding on??” On the Zi Jian’s special forces’ side, the Demolishing Divine Bull was panicked and nervous.
“It’s not over at all. The deterrence of the Glory Challenge will last for three minutes. Every minute, it will even increase enhancement a little. This is just the beginning…” Zi Jian said.
In less than a minute, Ting Yu, who was at the 11th heavenly layer of the divine level, lost the three-minute challenge, making countless divine and super divine experts fall silent.
So, did the cosmic overlord really want someone to see it?
No one thought that Ting Yu was weak, but they realized again how ridiculous the Glory Challenge was.
“Come back.”
When King Lie saw that Ting Yu had already lost consciousness, he directly pulled her back, helping her give up the challenge. If she persisted, after a minute, Ting Yu would definitely die.
At this moment, after pulling Ting Yu back, King Lie looked at Shi Yu in surprise.
Buzz!
A minute passed. The deterrence Shi Yu endured finally reached an unimaginable level. As Shi Yu stubbornly raised his head and looked at the overlord light ball, the spatial phantom behind Shi Yu was forced out.
Boom.
The light was dazzling. Layer after layer, the Beast Taming Space phantom of the 12th heavenly layer stood behind Shi Yu like a starry sky pavilion. Under the unity of everyone, they could completely withstand the deterrence of a cosmic overlord.
“It’s much stronger than I imagined… But this is more interesting. Come on!” Shi Yu exclaimed in his heart. The Beast Taming Space opened, and the 12th heavenly layer crossed the starry sky, stunning countless people.
This… was…
“The 12th heavenly layer of the divine level? How is this possible? There’s such a realm???” On the Origin Planet, countless divine-level experts were shocked. Even some super divines saw this terrifying realm phenomenon for the first time.
It was actually one level higher than Ting Yu. What kind of monster was Shi Yu?
No wonder he could last so long.
“I see. It has actually reached this stage.” King Lie was also very surprised. After all, even among the sleeping ancient geniuses, there were very few who had reached the 12th heavenly layer of the divine level.
“No wonder it could defeat Wabra.” In the distant starry sky, a super divine expert was also watching this place. The Western General looked at the 12 heavens phantom behind Shi Yu and muttered. As expected of the strongest divine level in the Cosmic Sea.
As soon as the 12th heavenly layer appeared, regardless of level, every person who saw this shocking phenomenon had different emotions in their hearts. There was shock, envy, jealousy, and disbelief..

chapters.content:

Even if he had the courage to face a transcendent at the divine level, he might be able to temper the will of a transcendent. Wouldn’t the chances of tempering the Super Divine Will be higher if he faced a universe supreme master at the divine level?
Even if he didn’t succeed, the increase in experience in the level of his own will was definitely a huge amount. It could lay a solid foundation for him to train his Super Divine Will in the future.
Therefore, no matter how strong the deterrence from the starry sky was, Shi
Yu still stood firm. The spiritual will phantoms of every pet in his Beast Taming Space also resisted this strongest deterrence with all their might and seriousness.
Eleven’s divine might that was like chaotic lightning, Buggy’s Green Dragon Creation Might, Baby Ginsengs deterrence that seemed to have exceeded the time limit, Chi Tongs focused sword intent deterrence to the extreme, and the world-destroying might of the Vermillion Bird clone. Susu seemed to contain the deterrence of the will of the Sea of Stars, and Lings deterrence that was like a cosmic storm erupted with a bang!
Apart from that, Little Ji’s Earth Overlord Might, Duckie’s Abyss Demon God Might, Turtle and Little Quas’s Black Tortoise Guardian Might, Shorty’s White Tiger Battle Might, in addition to Little Zi t s World Might, Shi Yu’s pets fought the cosmic overlord especially intensely.
Their different deterrence was condensed by Shi Yu’s spirit, turning into a unique deterrence that relied on Shi Yu’s will as the main body to resist the suppression of the cosmic overlord.
“Too strong, too strong.”
Shi Yu and the might of a cosmic overlord resisted each other. Countless people exclaimed in their hearts. Although Shi Yu looked very forced and his face was a little pale, one had to know that the other party was a deterrence left behind by a cosmic overlord. It was the strongest expert in the universe.
Shi Yu could actually resist to this extent. Therefore, it should be said that he was indeed a genius who had broken through the limit of the divine level twice.

“Two epoch gods and nine powerful pets with perfect divine-level power. No wonder Shi Yu can last so long.” At this moment, as his granddaughter lost, Old Ting Xiang also came to the starry sky and took over Ting Yu from King Lie.
At the same time, he didn’t forget to pay attention to Shi Yu. After discovering Shi Yu’s terrifying strength, he was also shocked. He didn’t expect Shi Yu to be so much stronger than Ting Yu.
From the looks of it, stopping Ting Yu and his challenge was the right choice. Otherwise, losing a match before the Glory Challenge would wear down his will even more.

General, also stared at Shi Yu.
The rarest thing wasn’t that Shi Yu had many pets, and every one of them was very strong. The rarest thing was that the level of the will of these pets was also very high. At this moment, Shi Yu had already used his strength to subdue many spectators in the overlord territory. Zi Jian, the Demolishing Divine Bull, and the others looked at the starry sky, their hearts thumping. They were just short of shouting that Shi Yu was impressive.

“Lord Cypos finds it very troublesome. He can’t even be bothered to see us under normal circumstances. He can’t even be bothered to personally manage the cosmic overlord army or manage the overlord territory. It’s as difficult as ascending to the heavens to see it.”
“Unless someone with the aptitude to charge into the universe appears, it’s impossible to pass his test..”

chapters.content:

“Epoch god, very good. The 12th heavenly layer of the divine level is also very good, but it’s not like no one has reached it since ancient times. It’s not like no one has challenged the Glory Challenge like this…”

Perhaps due to the restriction of age, he couldn’t break through the Glory Challenge today, but if he could transform because of this, he might be able to pass in the future.
As expected, as a peak super divine, the Western General’s horizons were very impressive. After two minutes, the will of the cosmic overlord further strengthened its enhancement and reflected a wider starry sky. Shi Yu’s expression suddenly changed.

However, in an instant, Little Ji, who only wanted to be the overlord of the earth, felt that it was small and shocked. This was because the other party was the overlord of the entire universe and the entire starry sky. As for Duckie, it even felt the fear that came from its bloodline. That was the target of fear for the entire Abyss Race, no, even the highest commander above the Abyss Race, the Dark King on the cosmic throne, the cosmic overlord, Cypos.
“What a joke.” Shi Yu sensed the pets’ will gradually collapse. In the end, the evil thoughts contained in this condensed deterrence were too strong. chapters.title: Chapter 1688 - 1688: Cosmic Overlord Cypos (1)

Boom.

After the Devour Lightning Behemoth destroyed the lightning tribulation, it even faced the power of the cosmic overlord head-on and erupted with the temporary power that had just been charged. Warpath swept through the lightning. For the first time, it reached a head-on outcome with the deterrence of the cosmic overlord in an “evenly matched” manner! ;
“This is a miracle!” Shi Yu said.
Boom!!!
Perhaps three minutes had passed, or perhaps Eleven’s deterrence had suppressed the deterrence of the cosmic overlord. In the starry sky, the will of the cosmic overlord slowly dissipated, and the starry sky returned to calm.
Shi Yu stood on the Chaos Thunder Beast’s shoulder and looked at the vast starry sky. He was excited. Then, his roller coaster-like mood calmed down for the first time before he continued to smile.
“Ji (Ji!!)!!!” Buggy and the others also shouted. Seeing Eleven so brave, they completely forgot the danger just now and felt that they had sent it again. They didn’t know when they could surpass Eleven, who was enjoying the benefits of the lightning tribulation version.

It actually easily withstood the lightning tribulation of a 13th heavenly layer of the divine level under the deterrence of the cosmic overlord?

“Perhaps when those hidden divine-levels appear, they will discover that there’s an even more ridiculous existence waiting for them in the current era.” Today, he wanted to create a miracle!
No one doubted what Shi Yu said anymore. At this moment, he had indeed created a miracle, an extremely ridiculous miracle.
Under the deterrence of the cosmic overlord, it broke through realms and resisted the universe’s lightning tribulation to complete the counterattack.
In a cosmic era, this might also be called one of the most dazzling miracles.
Just as everyone was marveling at this shocking scene, a huge black hole suddenly appeared where the cosmic overlord’s will had disappeared.

Without a doubt, the current Shi Yu had already successfully challenged the Glory Challenge and obtained the qualifications to see a universe supreme master!
“You can see a cosmic overlord after entering this black hole?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1689 - 1689: Cosmic Overlord Cypos (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1689: Cosmic Overlord Cypos (2)

At this moment, Eleven slowly shrank. Hu…

Moreover, the wealth of a cosmic overlord was peerless in the universe. It was rare for someone to spend so much effort to see him, so how could he not reward him?
“Brilliant, Shi Yu, charge forward, but remember to be polite. Don’t casually acknowledge Mom…” On Origin Planet, the gem cat was already looking forward to the arrival of the Wish Star.
“A cosmic overlord shouldn’t be a woman, right?” The owl muttered beside him.
“Wu…” At this moment, in the starry sky, Ting Yu, who had been healed by Old Nian Ting Xiang, gradually recovered her consciousness. At this moment, her mind was very hazy. She sensed the remaining power in the starry sky and coughed dryly again.
Then, there were violent after-effects that made her tremble continuously.
“Good granddaughter, don’t be afraid, don’t be afraid. Grandpa is here, and it’s over. After all, he’s a cosmic overlord. A failure doesn’t mean anything. Now, you understand that you still have a long way to go, right?”
“l…” Ting Yu trembled. She suddenly recalled something and said, “Where’s that Shi Yu?”
Just as she asked, Old Ting Xiang fell silent, not knowing how to answer. This was really a sad story…
At the same time, in the endless darkness, Shi Yu seemed to have crossed countless star areas.
When he woke up again, he had already arrived at a special space. This special space was not big, and it wasn’t even very gorgeous. It was like a very ordinary mountain cave. It was surrounded by strange rocks without any energy fluctuations. The surrounding mountains and rivers were extremely simple.
Although it didn’t look like there was any extraordinary power, Shi Yu had just entered when he sensed an aura that was as heavy as an era, making him subconsciously speak.
“The ruins of the era.’
This space was a place of an unknown era, a corner from the previous era.
Shi Yu suddenly shook his head and didn’t care about this. This wasn’t the most important thing. Most importantly, where was the cosmic overlord?
He looked at the only passage in the mountain cave and walked deeper step by
step. With every step, his heart felt stifled. He sensed a power that wasn’t much different from before. Although this power was very weak, Shi Yu could sense that they came from the same source.
Soon, Shi Yu arrived in front of a stone door. He took a deep breath and slowly pushed open the stone door. In the next moment, as if his vision kept lengthening, he saw a stone staircase with hundreds of millions of steps. He couldn’t tell if this was an illusion or real, but on the highest throne, there was indeed a supreme life form that Shi Yu couldn’t even raise his head to see.
Shi Yu didn’t forcefully look up at the true appearance of the cosmic overlord.
He only immediately bowed and said, “Your Majesty, the cosmic overlord..”
“How long has it been? I thought that deterrence setting was too strong. Looks like someone can still pass.” A low voice came from above.
Shi Yu was speechless.
“Tell me, what’s your goal in seeing me? Don’t tell me you only want an autograph like that guy 300 million years ago?”
Shi Yu was speechless.
Shi Yu kept feeling that the cosmic overlord was different from what he imagined.
Shi Yu took a deep breath and directly revealed his goal.
“Lord cosmic overlord.’
“l wonder if you know Goddess Wa Wind Spirit.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he could clearly sense that the life on the throne was silent for a moment.
It was said that Goddess Wa had helped the cosmic overlord manage the cosmic overlord army in his place. However, Shi Yu had investigated that there was no god title like Goddess Wa or her real name in the cosmic overlord army.
Therefore, he guessed that Goddess Wa had joined the cosmic overlord army under an alias.
However, the main body of the cosmic overlord should know Goddess Wa’ s other names.
“l see. I was wondering why someone would suddenly come. So it’s her.” The cosmic overlord, Cypos, chuckled, as if he had fallen into memories.
“After she left the cosmic overlord army and disappeared for so long, I thought she was dead.”
“The person you’re talking about has also passed the test of will. She once took charge of the cosmic overlord army for a period of time and is the most outstanding archeologist in the cosmic overlord army.. Are you her junior?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1690 - 1690: Cosmic Overlord Cypos (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1690: Cosmic Overlord Cypos (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Yes,” Shi Yu said.
“In that case, tell me your goal. Whether she asked you to come or you wanted to come, there’s no need to tell me the reason. 1 don’t want to know.” After the novelty, it spoke with a lazy aura, as if it wasn’t interested in anything.
Or rather, the name Goddess Wa couldn’t interest it much.
“Lord cosmic overlord, I heard that the ‘collector’ once gave you four Wish Stars as a gift on your birthday. Then, you collected them in the overlord’s treasure vault. I want those four Wish Stars.’
“l see. When you go back, just find someone and ask him to get it.” “Is there anything else? If not, go back to where you came from.”
Ah, this…
Shi Yu didn’t expect that even if he mentioned Goddess Wa, it would only make the other party fall into deep thought for a moment.
Why did this supreme existence look like it wasn’t interested in anything?
However, since the other party asked if there was anything else, Shi Yu was naturally unsatisfied with just the Wish Stars.
Shi Yu took a deep breath and said, “Actually, I still have two questions. I want to ask…
“Then ask quickly. Seeing that you’re her junior.”
“Lord cosmic overlord, I want to know the way to break through to the cosmic level.’
“As expected, it’s this boring question,” the cosmic overlord said and yawned.
“Let me tell you the simplest method, which is to fuse with the source of transcendence that is naturally born in the universe every 100,000 years. With your aptitude, after fusing with that, you will naturally grow. It’s very likely that you will find your own path to the universe in the future.”
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. That was indeed the case. This rumor didn’t seem to be false.
However, the cosmic overlord didn’t seem to have any other reaction to his desire to break through to the cosmic level.
This made Shi Yu involuntarily want to ask another question.
“Thank you, lord cosmic overlord… 1… have one last question.”
“I’m also an archeologist. I’ve heard that there’s a sixth cosmic life form in the universe, but I’ve asked many people and searched for a lot of information, but there’s no information about it…
“l want to ask if this cosmic level really exists?”
After Shi Yu finished asking this question, the cosmic overlord seemed to be interested again and laughed. “Finally, an interesting question.”
“You’re asking at the right time.”
“This might be one of the few pleasures that suddenly appear after this universe has been boring for so long.”
“The sixth cosmic life form does exist, but for some unforgivable reason, it was jointly suppressed and sealed by me and the World King.”
“It’s imprisoned and sealed in the deepest part of the Cosmic Sea Prison.”
“Your question is very interesting, and it’s what I’ve been looking forward to the most recently.”
“Because this so-called sixth cosmic life form seemed to have successfully escaped from prison not long ago. Next, it might crazily take revenge on the World King and me. I really look forward to its arrival.”
The cosmic overlord was delighted. After being invincible for so long, it already felt bored by most things. The revival of its former enemy might be a rare and interesting little game.
What? However, when the cosmic overlord finished speaking, Shi Yu widened his eyes.
The sixth cosmic life form was actually still alive, and it was a criminal?
A criminal sealed and suppressed by a cosmic overlord and a world king?
Holy sh*t, could the crisis of the Cosmic Sea that Blue Planet, the owl, and the others sensed be referring to… the escape of the sixth cosmic life form?

chapters.title: Chapter 1691 - 1691: Land of Sleep (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1691 - 1691: Land of Sleep (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Alright, do you still have any questions?”
At this moment, the cosmic overlord spoke after a short moment of joy.
“No.” Shi Yu said honestly.
The questions were endless, and he was already satisfied.
He was afraid that if he asked too many questions, this cosmic overlord would get impatient.
This trip to the overlord territory… could be considered to have ended perfectly.
A moment later.
A black hole slowly appeared in the starry sky outside Origin Planet.
Where Shi Yu came from, he finally returned to.
After leaving the territory of the cosmic overlord, Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief.
The pressure was too strong. Although they had previously said that they wanted to defeat a cosmic overlord, in fact, they still had a long way to go.
When Shi Yu returned, the crowd in the starry sky had yet to disperse.
For example, the Zi Jian’s special forces had already flown out of the Origin Planet and had been waiting for Shi Yu’s return.
After Shi Yu returned, he was immediately observed by various parties.
“Shi Yu!” On a battleship, Captain Zi Jian was delighted.
He actually returned alive!
This was because Shi Yu kept giving her the illusion that he would anger the cosmic overlord.
Fortunately, it was just an illusion. Shi Yu looked like he knew his stuff.
“Shi Yu is back!” At this moment, the gem cat girl, the owl girl, and the others were all waiting on the battleship of Zi Jian’s special forces. When they saw Shi Yu return, they were pleasantly surprised.
Shi Yu looked around and was the first to fly in the direction of Zi Jian’s special forces’s battleship.
A moment later, he landed on the battleship.
“Have you seen the cosmic overlord?” Zi Jian immediately asked.
“Sort of, but I didn’t see the other party with my own eyes. The pressure is too strong, and I can’t look up.”
“Ah, what a pity.” Not only Zi Jian, but even Jermon, who had appeared out of nowhere, exclaimed in regret.
“Damn it, I have no hope in my life.” Jermon was pained. After seeing the difficulty of the Glory Challenge, it felt that it would never see its idol in its life.
“Why are you like my cat?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
“Ah. the cat?” Jermon looked at the harmless and beautiful cat girl.
Gem Cat:
Get lost, he was talking about Shorty!
The gem cat felt that it should release its aura.
A little black bull could even be rude to it. This bull was too detestable. A super divine couldn’t be humiliated!
“Tsk tsk.” The owl girl shook its head. This was the first time it had seen such a miserable super divine.
However, this was also related to the cat’s restrained aura being very perfect…
As expected of a cat. Its skill proficiency in hiding its aura, escaping, and lazing around was not low.
“Speaking of which, you and the cosmic overlord..” Zi Jian wanted to know what they were talking about.
Her gossipy soul burned fiercely. Archeologists were extremely curious creatures.
“It’s nothing. The greatest gain is that I successfully obtained the reward of the cosmic overlord and successfully asked for the four Wish Stars in the overlord treasure vault.’
“Sure!!!” The gem cat’s eyes flashed. Shi Yu covered his eyes and felt that the brightness had even exceeded the previous shadow of the cosmic overlord’s will, exceeded the light of the tribulation lightning, and almost blinded the entire universe.
“Re-really?” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, Captain Zi Jian also exclaimed.
Then, he revealed an envious expression and said, “You’re really lucky.”
“The cosmic overlord said that after I return, I can just find anyone to ask for it…”
“Just find anyone… Don’t you have a written order?” Zi Jian said. “Those who can go to the overlord’s treasure vault to take things have to be at least the higher-ups of the army at the level of the eight kings.”
“Well, I can ask Lord King Lie.”
Probably no one dared to lie about this kind of thing, so it didn’t seem to be a big problem to ask for it directly.
“I’ll help you tell Lord King Lie,” Zi Jian said.
“Thank you,” Shi Yu said. “Thank you for the recommendation. Sorry to trouble you during this period of time.”
Protection-type archeological skills, recommended by the Glory Challenge, and even learning the materials of the Chaos Thunder Body. She was simply a huge help.
Of course, Shi Yu had also paid the price. He just needed a huge amount of stinky fruits as a reward.
“No, you’re from our Zi Jian’s special forces. You’re being too polite!” Captain Zi Jian revealed her canine teeth and said very happily.
“By the way, you don’t look very good. Let’s go to Origin Planet to rest first,” she said.
After experiencing the Glory Challenge consecutively, breaking through the tribulation, and meeting a cosmic overlord, it would be strange if Shi Yu’s condition was good.
“Well…” Upon hearing Captain Zi Jian’s words, Shi Yu also nodded and felt tired. Not only him, but the pets in the Beast Taming Space were also tense. Shi Yu felt that everyone could sleep for a few days and nights.
In fact, this was considered a small number. It wasn’t a problem to let go and sleep for a few years.
“I indeed need to rest…
On Origin Planet, after Shi Yu and the others returned, they entered a recuperating state.
Shi Yu and the others needed to rest, while the gem cat was still very excited as it waited for the arrival of the Wish Star.
On King Lie’s side, the speed at which he took the Wish Star was also very fast. Soon, the four Wish Stars representing the final inheritance of the Star Prayer
Race arrived in the hands of Shi Yu t s secretary, the gem cat girl, through King Lie and Zi Jian.
At this moment, the news of Shi Yu passing the Glory Challenge had almost spread throughout the overlord territory.
The entire cosmic overlord army knew that a super monster had appeared in the army and completed the magnificent feat of an era miracle. With the realm of the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level, it completed the Glory Challenge and saw the cosmic overlord.
And the protagonist who had completed all of this had just woken up..

chapters.title: Chapter 1692 - 1692: Land of Sleep (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1692 - 1692: Land of Sleep (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
After waking up, Shi Yu dragged his still tired body and found the gem cat. At this moment, the gem cat was guarding the shining Wish Star and had yet to begin fusing.
“We’re here. Teacher Ying, how long is the estimated time?” Shi Yu rubbed his eyes and asked.
“In the past, refining was very time-consuming, but now, I’m already at the super divine level. In less than a month, I can refine these four Wish Stars,” the gem cat analyzed for a moment and said.
“A month…
“It shouldn’t be a problem to refine it during the return process, right?” Shi Yu said.
“We’re going back?”
“Yes, almost two years have passed since we came out. In addition, it will take a long time to return. I’m not very at ease with Blue Planet,” Shi Yu said.
Especially after learning from the cosmic overlord that the sixth cosmic life form escaped from prison.
Good heavens, when he returned, he had to suggest that Blue Planet transform into a hidden star. Everyone would hide for hundreds of years and wait for the World King and the cosmic overlord to finish that guy before coming out.
Otherwise, even if Blue Planet was at the edge of the Cosmic Sea, it might be affected by the cosmic battle.
“Alright!” The gem cat said indifferently, “l wonder how far my level can reach after fusing with these four Wish Stars. Transcendent 2 is inevitable, but I wonder if I can reach transcendent 3.”
“Hehe, when the time comes, my strength…”
“After fusing, let’s see if we can increase the quality of the source of transcendence first,” Shi Yu said. “Why are you always thinking about strength?”
Was that something he should be thinking about?
“l know, I know. After this, it’s time to start working hard and see if I can condense the source of transcendence in the universe in advance,” she said. “That’s right.” Shi Yu smiled and nodded. “Of course, it’s not very urgent.”
“l realized that constantly breaking through the limit of the divine level seems to be a path too.”
“Right now, only Eleven, Susu, and Ling have reached the epoch god level, but
I’m already at the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level. What if Buggy, Baby
Ginseng, and Chi Tong also reach it?”
“The increase in battle power after breaking through the limit of the divine level isn’t bad. I feel that with my current strength, it shouldn’t be a problem to crush the super divine ancestors of the five major divine races on Blue Planet.’
“Therefore, if I can’t obtain the source of transcendence in the short term, I plan to continue like this first. No… Even if 1 can obtain the source of transcendence in the short term, I want to continue like this first.’
“It feels pretty good to increase my level to the 11th or 12th heavenly layer of the divine level, et cetera…
“At that time, the enemy on the other side will show ten sources of transcendence. I’ll show 20 heavenly layers. Let’s see who’s impressive…”
“Hey, hey, hey, you’re getting more and more ridiculous,” the gem cat said. “l heard from them that there are no records above the 13th heavenly layer. You still want 20?”
“Let’s give it a try,” Shi Yu said. “Even if it’s harder the further we go, we can definitely break through one or two more times.”
After all, there were still so many pets. Shi Yu didn’t believe that there weren’t even 15 heavenly layers.
“Hm?”
“Wait a minute, an honored guest is here,” Shi Yu said.
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he threw down the sighing gem cat and left the manor alone to the outside world.
In the sky outside, King Lie’s figure appeared and gradually landed. He looked at the manor in front of him with a complicated expression.
When they first saw Shi Yu, they didn’t see anything. Who would have thought that this Shi Yu could really see the cosmic overlord through the Glory Challenge?
With Shi Yu’s strength of 13 heavenly layers, he could already match a super divine expert who had exceeded 3. Shi Yu’s potential also belonged to the type with a high chance of reaching the peak of the super divine level.
Therefore, in the eyes of some experts, Shi Yu instantly became a target worth befriending.
Even King Lie, who was already of transcendent 8, treated Shi Yu as an expert of the same status and thought that he could invest in Shi Yu.
“Sir Shi Yu, sorry to disturb you,” King Lie said when he saw Shi Yu come out.
“Lord King Lie?” Shi Yu said. “What’s the matter?”
“l just have a premonition that Sir Shi Yu won’t stay on Origin Planet for long, so I specially came to visit before you left.” King Lie smiled.
“Senior King Lie, please come in,” Shi Yu said.
A moment later, the two of them sat at the stone table in the courtyard and drank tea and chatted.
“l wonder what Sir Shi Yu thinks of the current cosmic overlord army.”
“It’s a pretty good place,” Shi Yu said. “Although the reputation of the cosmic overlord army isn’t very good elsewhere in the universe, 1 still like this kind of organization with clear rules.”
“That’s right. In terms of benefits and treatment, the cosmic overlord army is definitely the best in the universe. Unfortunately, the status of humans in the army is on the decline.”
King Lie said, “In the current cosmic overlord army, no one is human among the generals of the four directions. Among the eight kings, only two are human. The power of humans has already fallen a lot compared to their previous glory days and has already fallen behind the Cosmic Sea.”
“A little girl like Ting Yu can’t be compared to the monsters in the past. As for you, you’re essentially also from the Cosmic Sea. However, as a human, I’m very gratified to see your rise.”
Shi Yu said, “Senior King Lie, you flatter me…”
“No, with your aptitude, if you can fuse with the source of transcendence, you should be able to become an expert at the ‘eight king level’ very quickly. At that time, the power of the human race in the cosmic overlord army can still be even stronger.”
“Do you know why humans have such a special status in the universe? Even the five cosmic-level experts take good care of humans?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1693 - 1693: Land of Sleep (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1693 - 1693: Land of Sleep (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Oh? Why?” Shi Yu said.
This question had actually been troubling him, but because Shi Yu already had a guess in his heart, he didn’t pursue it.
“This is all because of the cosmic overlord.’
“Because in the past, the cosmic overlord explored an era ruin and obtained a key piece of information.”
“If you want the universe to stop the reincarnation that happens once every ten billion years and let the universe live forever, the key is humans,” King Lie said.
“Why is it a human?” Shi Yu said. “According to what I know, humans were also very powerful races in the last era. There might even be cosmic-level humans, but those eras still didn’t escape the fate of end.”
He didn’t know about the last era, but in the last era… Since there was a cosmic-level mechanical life form, theoretically speaking, there should also be a cosmic-level mechanic who created it, right?
King Lie shook his head. “l don’t know about that. After all, no cosmic-level human has been born in this era.’
“Lord cosmic overlord once seemed to want a cosmic-level human Beast Tamer to appear and let it study it. Unfortunately, after so many years, even if lord cosmic overlord nurtured it very carefully, no such human Beast Tamer could be born.’
“In the end, it gave up.”
“In the beginning, the cosmic overlord was very concerned about exploring the ruins of the era and nurturing humans. Unfortunately, he didn’t obtain any positive results.”
“That period was the most glorious time for humans.”
“Compared to that time, although the status of humans in the universe is still not bad, it has already decreased a lot.”
“The reason is largely because of the loss of the interest of the cosmic overlord.’
Shi Yu was silent. So, the guardian of the cosmic human race was actually a cosmic overlord?
Because of its archeological results, no matter how much cosmic factions like the Worm Queen, the Dark King, and the Beastmaster expanded their territories, they wouldn’t kill the humans.
“Senior King Lie, you mean?”
“l think your talent doesn’t just stop at the 13th level of the divine level,” King Lie said.
“Perhaps you should have stronger achievement in the future, so that… Lord cosmic overlord can regain his interest in humans.”
“At that time, you won’t be the only one benefitting. The entire human race will also benefit.’
“Senior King Lie, you’re kidding. How could l?” Shi Yu smiled…
“No, you can,” King Lie said. “The first time we met, you got the cosmic overlord to give you four Wish Stars as a reward. This means that it thinks very highly of you.”
“If you’re willing, the human factions in the cosmic overlord army can assist you in competing for the next transcendent origin.” King Lie smiled.
Shi Yu was stunned.
“Although you’re very strong now, 1 believe you also know the speciality of that source of transcendence. That’s no longer a divine-level battle. The divine-levels who are preparing to break through to the super divine level will also be involved.’
“In tact, behind some divine-level geniuses, there will be life forms at the peak of the super divine level protecting them.”
“In this situation, it’s as difficult as ascending to the heavens for ordinary divine-levels to compete for that source of transcendence.”
“Although the Blue Planet bloodline you’re from is strong, it’s not enough to protect you from steadily seizing that source of transcendence. Of course, you’re still young. You might be able to wait, but any life form has a golden age. Even if you seal yourself and sleep, it can’t change some things. The earlier you break through to the super divine level, the higher the chances of breaking through to the cosmic level in the future.”
“Moreover, in the universe, there’s no lack of geniuses. Countless geniuses will appear every once in a while, so the competitors will never decrease. If this drags on, they will only be eliminated by the universe in the end.”
“Of course, the reason why I made this promise is also because you’re indeed the most special Beast Tamer I’ve seen in so long. Even if it’s a Beast Tamer at the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level like the one sleeping in the Cosmic
Sea, I feel that it’s inferior to you.”
“Perhaps you really have hope of making the cosmic overlord interested again.
This way, our group can also benefit along.”
King Lie said. The wealth of the cosmic overlord army was almost the best in the universe. If the cosmic overlord suddenly had a whim and liked a certain race and wanted to nurture it, that race could completely quickly become a large race that dominated the universe.
“There’s no need for Senior King Lie to say this. I’ll also work hard to improve myself,” Shi Yu said.
“Haha, I believe that too,” King Lie said. “But you’re still young and lack training. Back then, when you challenged Glory Challenge, I could tell that every one of you was incomparably young. You shouldn’t have much experience. The opportunities were greater than training.”
“But it’s alright. Believe in yourself. The Glory Challenge is far from the end. I look forward to your next challenge. You’ll challenge the cosmic overlord himself, not a will.’
“Huh??” Shi Yu was stunned. “Lord cosmic overlord… can still challenge?”
King Lie said, “Of course. As long as you reach the peak of the super divine level, you can challenge it in theory. Moreover, as long as you can force out 1% of the strength of the cosmic overlord, the cosmic overlord will allow this challenger to manage the cosmic overlord army in its place for a period of time and enjoy the treatment of the cosmic overlord. He will use the resources of the cosmic overlord army to improve himself..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1694 - 1694: Land of Sleep (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1694 - 1694: Land of Sleep (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“It can be called.. the second overlord in the cosmic overlord army.”
“Of course, just like the Glory Challenge, it’s been a long time since such a person appeared.”
“The reason why the cosmic overlord created such rules is probably because it’s too boring and invincible for too long. It longs for an opponent that’s evenly matched with it, and it doesn’t even hesitate to nurture it personally.” Shi Yu:
“Of course, these are still far from you. However, you do have this aptitude.” King Lie smiled and said, “Just do as I said previously, step by step.” “You can think about it first. Next, I recommend a place for you to go.”
“That place can definitely let you take another step forward.” “Where to??” Shi Yu was surprised.
“Don’t worry, it won’t delay your return to the Cosmic Sea.”
King Lie seemed to know that Shi Yu would return to the Cosmic Sea in the near future. “Have you heard of the Land of Sleep?”
Shi Yu shook his head.
“Then you should have heard that many epoch gods and even human Beast Tamers who broke through the limit of the divine level have sealed themselves in order to delay their lifespans and dodge the lightning tribulation, right?”
“I’ve heard of this.’
However, with Shi Yu’s configuration, he could already say to other dodgers,
“This thing can also kill people? Is there a need to dodge?”
“The sleeping place is the sleeping place of a group of epoch gods. They are all a group of monsters accumulated in the overlord territory for countless years. ”
“The epoch god sleeping here has a characteristic, which is that it’s willing to contract humans.’
“But the premise is to obtain their recognition.”
“Your divine contract should be to increase the number of contracts, not reduce the number of contracts, right? The reason why I recommended you to go here is because if you can obtain the recognition of two to three epoch gods and complete the contract with them, you might be able to break through to the 14th heavenly layer that no one has reached yet.”
“You have to know that not everyone is qualified to go to the sleeping place. Compared to Ting Yu, the guys sleeping here are one of the deeper foundations of the cosmic overlord army,” King Lie said. “You should still be able to contract new pets, right?”
Shi Yu could tell that King Lie really wanted the cosmic overlord to regain his interest in the human race and let the cosmic overlord support the human race.
This was already sending the epoch god pet to him.
“It sounds a little interesting,” Shi Yu said.
It wasn’t that he was very obsessed with contracting a new epoch god, but he felt that fighting an epoch god should also be able to train the will of Buggy,
Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong.
The epoch god was no different from a super divine level.
Moreover, fighting at the same level could stimulate the battle passion of pets.
Apart from that, as the most impressive and awesome group of divine-levels in the overlord territory, their skill bars should be very abnormal. He could casually replicate a few and strengthen the entire team.
Of course, if there was really an epoch god whose race was extremely rare, similar to the Star Prayer Race, and if the two parties had an affinity and were very compatible, Shi Yu didn’t mind contracting one.
“Of course.” King Lie laughed and said, “Don’t worry, you’ll be satisfied there. You can see all kinds of monsters there. You might be able to see Space Worms at the epoch god level, Yun Race at the epoch god level, and even cosmic behemoths at the epoch god level.”
“They’re all monsters recruited by the cosmic overlord army from various places in the universe. Of course…”
“I’m very confident in your strength, but whether you can find a suitable new partner doesn’t depend entirely on strength. The sleeping place is on your way back to the Cosmic Sea. It’s on the way. If you’re interested, go take a look.”
“If you can obtain a suitable new partner, the possibility of you creating a new miracle will also be higher. This opportunity is rare. I’ll use the privilege of my identity as the eight kings to send you over. Although you’ve just joined the cosmic overlord army, the other higher-ups shouldn’t say much just because you’ve seen the cosmic overlord.”
“l strongly suggest that you… think of a way to contract a cosmic beast.
They’re known as the number one race in the universe, and their feedback to Beast Tamers is incomparably huge. There… is more than one monster abducted from the Behemoth Empire.”
Little Zi: “?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1695 - 1695: Accelerated Era (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1695: Accelerated Era (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
A few days later, the silver-white battleship set off from the Origin Planet.
After replenishing the Origin Planet, Shi Yu decided to return to the Cosmic Sea.
Only Shi Yu and the others returned this time. Jermon temporarily stayed in the overlord territory with the Zi Jian’s special forces.
Ling estimated that this return trip would take at least eight months to reach the Cosmic Sea.
