This was the shortest time. As Shi Yu and the others still planned to take a look at the Land of Sleep on the way, the exact time was still uncertain.
As soon as they set off, Shi Yu began to sleep to cultivate protective archeological skills.
He hoped that he could enter the sect during the process of returning so that he could crack the Chi You Ruins.
Some of the other pets chose to sleep, while others chose to train in the training room in the battleship.
Apart from that, there was also the gem cat. It had cultivated hard for a long time.
“One…”
“Two…”
“Three…
In the nine-colored room that could collect starlight, the gem cat girl in a magic robe sat cross-legged on a star stone and tried her best to fuse with the Wish Star.
From the looks of it, the ones who obtained the greatest gains from this trip to the overlord territory weren’t Ling and Eleven, who had broken through to the epoch god, nor was it Shi Yu, who had obtained protective archeological skills. Instead, it was the gem cat that had obtained the inheritance of the remaining Wish Star.
During the fusion and refinement process of the wishing star, the gem cat, which was originally the weakest super divine, kept strengthening in its body, and its source of transcendence was even more dazzling.
When she fused and refined the fifth Wish Star inheritance, her source of transcendence seemed to have reached a limit. The power of the super divine overlapped into a phantom, and the phantom materialized into a new source of transcendence.
In her body, the two sources of transcendence spun and wrapped around each other, indicating that she had already broken through to the second realm. These Wish Star inheritances were simply better breakthrough materials for the Star Prayer Race than the fake source of transcendence.
“Three… four…
“l hope I can reach transcendent 3 myself.”
During the fusion process of the gem cat, it kept making wishes and began to fuse the sixth and seventh Wish Stars. The Star Prayer Race threw out seven Wish Stars. In essence, it hoped that there were seven lives compatible with the Star Prayer Race who could each fuse the Wish Stars and let the Star Prayer Race spread in the entire universe. This way, it wouldn’t be easy to be wiped out at once.
However, the Star Prayer Race didn’t expect that the seven Wish Stars were all gathered and fused by a lucky person first. During this process, the gem cat seemed to be evolving towards the king of the Star Prayer Race.
After a long time, after integrating all the power of the Star Prayer Race, its level instantly reached the peak of transcendent 2, only a step away from transcendent 3.
At this moment, although the fusion had ended, in order to reach a higher realm, the gem cat’s cultivation had yet to end. It kept mobilizing the power of starlight to transform into power of faith to help it break through this bottleneck.
After an unknown period of time, the two source of transcendence phantoms gradually replicated into three portions. The three portions of the source of transcendence circled around the gem cat’s body like the sun, making it open her sun gem-like eyes.
“Hahahahaha.” At this point, the gem cat couldn’t help but laugh. When the Star Prayer Race was developing pretty well, there might not necessarily be any experts who exceeded transcendent 3, right?
Its current strength could definitely be ranked among the top in the history of the Star Prayer Race.
However, the gem cat understood that the pressure on it was even greater. It couldn’t let anyone kill it. Otherwise, even if the inheritance of the Star Prayer Race was completely broken, it would be a sinner of the Star Prayer Race.
“Shi Yu!! Look at my level.” After the gem cat broke through, it couldn’t wait to run out to share it with Shi Yu and the others. Then, it saw Shi Yu and the others, who seemed to have been waiting for her for a long time.
“Wu wu wu…” In the room, the owl girl covered her mouth with a handkerchief and let out an envious gaze.
Damn it, this cat was really too lucky. It only used a few years to reach an achievement that countless geniuses on World King Planet couldn’t achieve even after millions of years.
“Transcendent 3,” Shi Yu said. “l already know. When you broke through, we sensed that you were charging at the realm. It was Ling and the others who helped you block the aura. Otherwise, the commotion of your breakthrough would definitely alarm the surrounding galaxies.”
“However, it took you a little long. You promised to complete the fusion in a month. It’s been four months.’
“Did I use it for so long…” The gem cat recovered and said, “It can’t be helped.
It was already very fast when it was stuck at the end.” Shi Yu looked at her eagerly and said, “So, so?”
“What so?”
“So can you increase the quality of the source of transcendence now?” Shi Yu said.
Compared to the level of the gem cat, this was the most worth paying attention to. Even if the gem cat exceeded transcendent 4 and 5, Shi Yu estimated that in battle, there weren’t many places where it could be used.
On the contrary, increasing the functionality of the source of transcendence was very useful.
The only time the gem cat could protect Shi Yu and fly with him was probably when Shi Yu was still in university…
“Now that you mention it…” The gem cat was stunned before meditating.
Soon, a spectacular scene appeared in the star field where the battleship was. Countless starlight swam in the silent and dark universe like fireflies. Soon, an ocean of light appeared in the empty universe, making this area seem to have gathered countless stars. It was very dazzling..

chapters.title: Chapter 1696 - 1696: Accelerated Era (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1696: Accelerated Era (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
In the prayer, the gem cat carefully observed its source of transcendence. Shi Yu and the others stared at the gem cat for about a day. A day later, the gem cat opened its eyes again and panted.
“If I say yes, but increasing a trace of quality requires a huge amount of physical strength and terrifying time, will you… squeeze me dry?” She raised her head and asked carefully.
Shi Yu’s eyes were green. Seeing Shi Yu t s gaze, the gem cat’s heart skipped a beat.
“It can really increase???”
The gem cat said, “That seems to be the case, but it’s very difficult. Although I don’t know the quality of the transcendence source born naturally in the universe, I feel that if I work hard and pray for ten thousand years, there might be hope of raising the quality of my current source of transcendence to a level.’
“Ten thousand years?” Shi Yu’s teeth hurt. If they had the time, wouldn’t it be better for them to wait for the universe to condense?
“This is still a wish that you don’t eat or drink. If you touch the fish and rest, you won’t be able to fight for hundreds of thousands of years.” The gem cat shrugged.
“So in the end, you’re still too weak.” The owl that had been watching for the whole day couldn’t help but say, “If you’re at the peak of the super divine level, you might be able to do it soon.”
“So troublesome!” Shi Yu said. Peak super divine level was too difficult. At the moment, there were only four active peak super divine level under the cosmic overlord. This level already belonged to the level of Goddess Wa.
“Damn it, it’s clearly not long,” the gem cat said angrily. “We’re too young, so we think this time is long. As long as we don’t court death, it’s as difficult as ascending to the heavens for the super divine to naturally die of old age. How can there be such a good thing if we spend some time to increase the quality of the source of transcendence?”
“You have to know that the super divines of the Dragon, Phoenix, and Kirin have been in seclusion for hundreds of thousands of years and haven’t even improved by one level. I’m already very powerful!”
Shi Yu looked at the two cats that were more than a hundred years old in this lifetime and said, “That’s true, but it’s still too long. Forget it, I’ll think of a way in the future. Teacher Ying, try again if you can accelerate the speed at which the universe naturally condenses the source of transcendence through prayer.”
“Alright, I’ll give it a try,” the gem cat said.
“Under normal circumstances, the condensation of the source of transcendence in the universe will be 20,000 years later. I wonder how much faster you can increase your speed…” Shi Yu looked at her and said.
“It’s definitely a little difficult for her to do it alone. It’ll end two years in advance. I said that the two of us still have to reach the super divine level and work together to have a high chance of reaching 20,000 years in advance…” the owl said.
“l heard your plan on Blue Planet.” The gem cat had reason to suspect that the owl was envious of its rapid leveling up.
With that said, the gem cat entered the state of prayer again and tried to accelerate the universe…
This attempt shocked the gem cat.
It was as if it wanted to reach out and push a difficult car, but this car wasn’t as slow as it imagined…
The car was unexpectedly fast!
Under the overlapping of the power of prayer and the unknown power, the gem cat saw six pairs of eyes in the dark world of prayer.
These six pairs of eyes were incomparably terrifying. The pressure they brought directly reminded the gem cat of the power of a cosmic overlord. As the gem cat joined this space, a pair of moon eyes looked at the gem cat.
Then, another dark and deep eye looked at her.
“A total of six cosmic levels!!”
In an instant, the gem cat exploded, as if it had entered a thief’s den. It was panicked to the extreme. Before it could react, it exited the state of prayer in shock. It was almost scared to death. Even after unknowingly leaving, it was still covered in sweat.
“What’s wrong?” The gem cat’s shock shocked Shi Yu and the others. They immediately looked at the gem cat.
At this moment, the gem cat looked like it was about to cry. “Somethings wrong, somethings wrong.”
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu said. “What happened?”
“Are you alright?” The owl also saw the panic in the cat’s eyes and immediately asked.
“l originally wanted to accelerate the speed at which the universe condenses the source of transcendence, but I realized that there are others doing this now.”
“That guy is extremely terrifying, and his strength is terrifying to the extreme.
He gives me the feeling.. that he’s like a cosmic overlord!”
“Apart from that, there are five pairs of equally terrifying eyes, as if they’re staring at it.”
At this moment, the gem cat was like a little cat that had infiltrated the tiger group. It trembled and felt a lingering fear.
“What did you say…”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned and found it unbelievable.
“Wait a minute, six pairs of eyes, similar to the power of a cosmic overlord…
Someone is also accelerating the universe… changing the laws of the
universe…”
“Teacher Owl, didn’t you say previously that apart from borrowing the power of the Star Prayer Race and the Astrologer Race, the other people with the ability to accelerate the universe are the five major cosmic levels?”
“Yes, if it’s a cosmic level attack, it can limit the time it takes for the natural condensation of the source of transcendence in the universe. It might be very difficult for us, but it shouldn’t be difficult for them to do…
“In other words, what Teacher Ying sensed is really other cosmic levels?”
“Six… Apart from the four cosmic emperors and the cosmic overlord, is the other one the sixth cosmic life form that escaped from prison?”
“l don’t know,” the gem cat said. “Tell me… what exactly is going on.”
“F*ck, I sensed that I seemed to have been watched by two people. Tell me, will I be fine?” The gem cat was nervous..

chapters.title: Chapter 1697 - 1697: Accelerated Era (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1697: Accelerated Era (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“If it’s really a cosmic level and they discover that I actually have the ability to do such a thing, will they have the thought of ‘Eh, not a bad little guy, 1 have to get it?”
Shi Yu and the owl: ‘
“Teacher Ying, calm down first,” Shi Yu said.
“If all the cosmic levels are really here, even if they recognize your identity as a member of the Star Prayer Race, it should be fine.”
“The Star Prayer Race is a race born on the World King Planet. The World King definitely won’t harm you. Our Wish Star inheritance was just obtained from a cosmic overlord. The cosmic overlord definitely knows that you have a deep relationship with me, so he naturally won’t harm you…”
“With two cosmic levels on our side, what are you afraid of?”
“That’s true, that’s true.” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s analysis, the gem cat heaved a sigh of relief.
“However…” Shi Yu said, “Teacher Owl, if the universe is accelerated, some powerful experts should be able to sense it, right?”
“Well, we’ve been sailing and cultivating. Our perception of the outside world might not be very obvious, but if it’s some high-level super divines or some sleepers who have been waiting to transcend the origin, they should be able to sense it,” the owl said. “The former is because they’re strong, and the latter is because they’ve mastered some special method, right? Something like a time-sensing alarm clock?”
Shi Yu said, “In that case, the situation Teacher Ying sensed happened recently.”
“The five cosmic levels usually don’t care about such a small matter like the natural birth of a source of transcendence in the universe. The chances of them attacking are very small.”
“And apart from them, there’s only the cosmic level that escaped from prison. It’s it… It’s it that’s accelerating this era, wanting the universe to quickly condense a new source of transcendence??”
“If it were any other cosmic level doing this kind of thing, it probably wouldn’t attract the attention of the other four cosmic levels. However, if it’s the sixth cosmic level that escaped recently, it’s different. Because of the novelty, the other cosmic levels will also have to pay attention to his movements.” “Therefore, Teacher Ying felt that there were six pairs of eyes at that time.”
“l see.” After Shi Yu finished analyzing, the gem cat and owl nodded and felt that it made sense.
“Master, you’ve finally become smart.” Ling’s voice came from god knows where.
“Cut the crap. Start your battleship.”
“But it’s already at the cosmic level. It’s useless to use the source of transcendence, right?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
“Wait a minute, the birth of a transcendent origin represents a huge battle, At this time, it will undoubtedly make the entire universe very chaotic… Countless divine and super divine levels will be swept into it and a huge chaotic battle will happen to fight for it.”
“This guy… wants to stir up… the war of the entire universe in advance?” Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
It had just escaped from prison, and it was already doing such an exciting thing?
This should only be the surface goal. Shi Yu couldn’t guess the other partys true goal.
“So… is this a good thing or a bad thing?” the gem cat said.
“With a cosmic-level attack, a transcendent origin will probably be born soon.
However, it’s not easy for us to be involved in a cosmic-level dispute.” Shi Yu said, “Who knows if it’s a good thing or a bad thing…”
As they were thinking, Ling said, “Master, a very strong guy is coming towards us.’
“Initial judgment is that the strength of an epoch god far exceeds that of ordinary perfect gods.”
“However, it’s not my match.”
“Well…” Shi Yu said, “How can there be such a place in the middle of nowhere…
Wait a minute, Ling, how far are we from the Land of Sleep?”
“It’s less than half a month’s journey.”
Shi Yu slapped his forehead and said, “The universe has been accelerated. If the sleepers can sense it, do you think the epoch god in the Land of Sleep has woken up?”
“That’s a possibility,” Ling said. “The probability of one of the many sleeping epoch gods in the Land of Sleep rushing towards us is very high.”
“Ling, can you accelerate?”
“I’m worried that after the guys in the Land of Sleep woke up, they left.” “In that case, won’t it be meaningless for us to go here…”
“Alright.” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, Ling nodded. The battleship’s speed increased a little.
At the same time that it accelerated, Ling also captured the situation of the epoch god that was coming towards them more clearly.
In the distance, a strange life form sitting on a wandering meteorite was licking his lips.
His entire body was red, like a water-element life form. On a closer look, he looked more like a demon made of blood.
“I’m so hungry.”
This monster-like bloodseeker’s aura was messy and powerful. Sensing the fragrant aura in front of it, it also accelerated.
“Master, there’s information about the other party’s race in the database. This seems to be a cosmic life form that evolved by sucking blood. It’s considered the ancestral race of all vampires. It’s similar to the Space Worm. Its devour evolution ability is very strong…”
“Meow!!!” At this moment, Shorty suddenly meowed in its own room, as if it was reminding Shi Yu of something.
“l understand.” Shi Yu nodded.
It meant that the Blood Origin God in the distance had just woken up from its sleep and was thinking about their blood.
“The path is narrow.” Because of Susu, who had mastered the Infinite Devour, Shi Yu wasn’t very interested in this race… Therefore…
He placed his hand on the battleship and touched the battleship. His eyes lit up slightly. He directly used the power of his divine-level 113th heavenly layer to temporarily strengthen Ling..

chapters.title: Chapter 1698 - 1698: Accelerated Era (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1698: Accelerated Era (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Buzz!
From an old distance, an attack called the Compression Starry Sky Storm Bullet began to condense in front of the battleship Lings many cannon barrels…
In the distance, when the Blood Origin God on the meteorite was stunned, many Starry Sky Storm Cannons were directly activated, causing the power of the starry sky in all directions to sweep towards the Blood Origin God.
“What is it!!!”
At this moment, sensing the attack in the distance, the bloodseeker was shocked.
Boom!!!
Countless Starry Sky Storm cannonballs attacked from all directions, making the pupils of the Blood Origin God shrink. In the next moment, its entire body was swept into the Starry Sky Storm.
Moreover, the attacks from all directions never stopped.
“Unlucky guy.”
Two gloating sighs came from the battleship. After an unknown period of time, there was only a fist-sized blood core left in the starry sky. It used a powerful force that didn’t belong to it to protect itself and fled crazily.
However, it couldn’t escape at all. A powerful spatial seal instantly sealed it in the starry sky.
There was also a difference in the epoch god. The epoch god that had mastered a transcendent divine skill was still on a different level from a monster like Ling, who had more than ten transcendent divine skills.
Under the circumstances where the Blood Origin God was confused and vomited blood, it directly landed in Shi Yu and the others’ hands and became a prisoner of war.
The battleship slowly drove over. A voice came from inside, waking the Blood Origin God up.
“Kid outside, did you have a trace of malice just now and want to rob us and plunder our blood?”
The Blood Origin God, who was squeezed by space, was just about to deny it when it saw several cannon barrels spreading fluctuations again, making its eyelids twitch.
Damn it, what was it? Why did it encounter the first unfamiliar life form it encountered when it woke up this time? It was an incomprehensible monster combination. Although it indeed wanted to rob, all its thoughts and evil thoughts were left in its heart.
This could also be sensed and insta-killed?
“Wait.” Before the Starry Sky Storm Cannon was fired, the Blood Origin God hurriedly shouted for it to stop. “1 admit that 1 did think about it for a while, but I’m really too hungry. It’s completely instinct.”
“You’re from the Land of Sleep?”
The Starry Sky Cannon didn’t fire, and a voice came from inside again. When he heard this voice, the Blood Origin God heaved a sigh of relief and quickly nodded. Since the other party knew about the Land of Sleep, it was easy.
Seeing that it was a member of the cosmic overlord army, it shouldn’t make things difficult for it, right?
“Are there any sleeping epoch gods in the Land of Sleep?” Shi Yu asked.
“Almost gone. For some special reason, we all woke up in advance and left the Land of Sleep.”
“At this time, they might have all left.”
Thump.
After the Blood Origin God finished speaking, Shi Yu almost pressed the trigger excitedly.
As if sensing that the surrounding situation was wrong, the Blood Origin God hurriedly added, “Wait, I was just guessing… Perhaps there’s still a group of guys who haven’t left…”
“l think I should send you away,” Shi Yu said unhappily.
Ten days later, Shi Yu and the others still worked hard to come near the Land of Sleep.
Along the way, apart from the Blood Origin God, they didn’t encounter any other epoch gods.
When they arrived at the core galaxy where the Land of Sleep was, they also sensed it. They didn’t sense the existence of other powerful epoch gods, which couldn’t help but make Shi Yu a little puzzled.
Most importantly, even the overlord network couldn’t be used in this godforsaken place, causing him to not know where to start looking for the star guardian King Lie mentioned.
“Are you guys looking for me?”
However, fortunately, the guardians here seemed to be paying attention to the commotion in this galaxy at all times. Shi Yu and the others were noticed the moment they entered.
A purple-haired Ioli in the form of a spirit body appeared out of thin air in front of the battleship..

chapters.title: Chapter 1699 - 1699: Cursed Genius (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1699: Cursed Genius (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Spirit Queen.”
Upon seeing this Ioli, Shi Yu t s heart skipped a beat as he shouted her name.
In the cosmic overlord army, the Spirit Queen, one of the eight king-level experts, was an expert above Level 7.
It was said that this Spirit Queen’s experience was very extraordinary. At the start, she was a human Beast Tamer.
Later on, she accidentally became an undead and cultivated all the way to her current strength.
This experience was very similar to the relationship between Mu Huiyin and Chi Tong… No, it was better to say that Chi Tong and the others’ experience was very similar to hers.
The current Spirit Queen was no longer considered a human, but she still treated herself as a human.
Her current responsibility was to protect the Land of Sleep. Or rather, she usually slept in the Land of Sleep herself.
There was a reason why so many epoch gods slept here. This star domain had a unique star vein that could effectively increase the quality of their sleep and bring many benefits. It was unique in the overlord territory.
Apart from the incomplete Spirit Queen, the cosmic overlord army only allowed some geniuses at the epoch god level to consume the power of the star vein here to sleep.
“You’re Shi Yu, whom King Lie mentioned, right? Unfortunately, you’re a little late,” the Spirit Queen said.
She already knew the purpose of Shi Yu and the others’ visit through King Lie.
Shi Yu came out of the battleship and stood in the starry sky to look at the purple-haired Ioli. He smiled bitterly and said, “Don’t tell me the epoch gods really woke up and left?”
“That’s right.” The Spirit Queen nodded and said, “Looks like you already know.”
“For some special reason, in the overlord territory… No, in the entire universe, be it the sleeping ancient epoch god or the human divine-level experts who broke through the limit of the divine level, they should have woken up.”
“Because of the special situation, I didn’t ask them to stay and leave just because you came. After all, I don’t know when you’ll arrive. However, I’ve preserved their information here. With this information, you might be able to find them. It can be considered my explanation to King Lie.”
In the eyes of the Spirit Queen, it was the same whether Shi Yu tried to subdue a new pet in the Land of Sleep or took the initiative to search.
“l understand,” Shi Yu said with a nod. After all, these epoch gods might be busy preparing for the cosmic battle. A new round of cosmic wars to compete for transcendent origins… was about to begin.
“However, is there no longer an epoch god left in the Land of Sleep?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but ask.
How could they have all left?
The Spirit Queen said, “That’s not it. There’s still a special guy left, but it might not necessarily meet your requirements.”
“Even if you’ve seen the cosmic overlord, you might not necessarily be able to subdue it.’
“There’s still one left?” Shi Yu was immediately a little touched when he heard this.
Previously, the situation was rushed. Even if he encountered the Blood Origin God, he didn’t have the time to pull it along as a sandbag sparring partner.
Moreover, the Blood Origin God was too weak.
At this moment, when he heard the Spirit Queen say that there was a special existence, Shi Yu immediately heaved a sigh of relief. He felt that at least it wouldn’t be useless to circle around.
In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, the pets were also in a meeting.
Good lord!
There was still one+special individual+subduing difficulty…
Eleven and the others looked at each other. They felt that the buff was full.
It was clearly the rhythm of a new teammate joining the team.
It depended on how special this guy was and whether Shi Yu took a fancy to it.
In any case, at least, the level of the epoch god was definitely not weak. After coming to the team, its strength was definitely in the top five.
At that time… they didn’t know who would be squeezed out of the top six…
“Senior Spirit Queen, can you tell me in detail?”
“Alright.”
Seeing that Shi Yu was quite interested, the Spirit Queen introduced, “It’s called Bu Lu. It’s a cosmic behemoth.’
At this point, Shi Yu’s team instantly exploded.
The pets looked at Little Zi. What kind of luck was this?
A pile of epoch gods had left, and the only one left happened to be a cosmic behemoth.
Cosmic behemoths and planetary life forms could be said to be natural enemies… If a cosmic behemoth really came to the team, Little Zi and the other party would have some training.
Just like Susu and Duckie back then.
“Mi.” Little Zi’s expression was calm, as if it felt that it didn’t matter anymore. So be it if it was a cosmic behemoth. Sister Susu could nurture a powerful abyss life form, so why couldn’t it nurture a cosmic behemoth that listened to
Tigers even ate humans, but there were still Beast Tamers who tamed tigers and treated them as pets!
It, Little Zi, definitely could too!
“Little Zi, calm down. The other party is an epoch god.” Qi, who was holding Little Zi, said, “You’re only a perfect divine. You can’t defeat the other party.”
Little Zi: Hmm???
“Why do you say that the other party might not necessarily meet my requirements?” In the outside world, Shi Yu asked the Spirit Queen.
The Ioli Spirit Queen said, “As a Beast Tamer and a contracted pet, you must want to find suitable help and not a burden, right?” “Burden?” Shi Yu was surprised.
“To be able to reach the epoch god level, what burden…”
“The cosmic behemoth I’m talking about is a mutation of the Cosmic Behemoth Race. It has suffered the curse of the universe and its body is filled with misfortune. It can be said to be a jinx. According to statistics, it suffered a total of 196 cosmic disasters in 196 interstellar voyages.”
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly. Huh?
“There’s already no need to consider its previous race, but now, it’s more suitable to describe it as a disaster behemoth.’
“Only when it’s in a sleeping sealed state will its bad luck not bring misfortune. Even so, do you still think it’s suitable for you?”
“This… But why?” Shi Yu didn’t understand why such an individual existed. “According to the research results of the cosmic overlord army, its mother once entered an era ruin. Perhaps this is the foundation of its curse.”
The Spirit Queen said, “Even the most powerful scientists and archeologists in the cosmic overlord army can’t understand this strange curse on its body.”
“In 196 interstellar voyages, it suffered a total of 196 cosmic disasters… I want to know how it survived.’
The Spirit Queen said, “Originally, many people thought that it would definitely die because of this curse, but the truth is often very ridiculous. Its talent potential is unique, far exceeding the so-called nobles and even royal families in the Cosmic Behemoth Race.’
“It’s very suitable. Although it has encountered disasters many times, it can always avert disasters. Its learning ability is also very strong. It can learn new skills very quickly and absorb enough experience to resist disasters.”
“Just like that, it grew to the epoch god level under the circumstances where no one thought highly of it.”
“Whether it is unlucky or lucky… No one can say.”
[l don’t understand such a strange luck curse either.] Even Ling, the Master of
Luck, spoke.
“Perhaps for itself, it’s considered a combination of luck and misfortune, Although it encountered many unlucky things, at least it has tempered such strong strength in difficulties. But for the people around it, even if they don’t know it, as long as they get too close to it, they will suffer an undeserved disaster.’
“Therefore, it has been a lone traveler in the cosmic overlord army from the beginning to the end. If it weren’t for the fact that the luck curse on its body can’t affect people much stronger than it, I’m afraid the cosmic overlord army wouldn’t be able to tolerate it.’
“By the way, it has even participated in 11 battles to transcend the origin, but without exception, before it arrived at the main battlefield, it encountered an accident midway because of various disasters. It didn’t even see a shadow that transcended the origin.” Shi Yu:
“Over time, this guy Bu Lu…”
“What’s wrong with it?”
“It’s been smashed. It hasn’t participated in the competition to transcend the origin several times. It’s the same this time. The other epoch gods went to prepare, but it’s still sleeping.”
Shi Yu was speechless.
“There are also people who recommend it. Forget about fusing with an ordinary source of transcendence. However, it has already successfully killed four super divine-level experts on the battlefield, but not once has the source of transcendence appeared.”
“In addition, because they’re worried that after Bu Lu upgrades to super divine, not only will the curse not improve, but it will also become stronger. The cosmic overlord army doesn’t dare to take the initiative to distribute it to the source of transcendence. If this curse physique reaches the super divine level, I’m afraid it will bring an even greater disaster to the army.”
“At the moment, it might also be a relatively good choice to sleep. Perhaps when the army’s technology breaks through again, there will be a chance to study the strangeness on its body.”
“It sounds a pity,” Shi Yu said.
“It’s indeed a pity. Its strength can be said to be the strongest among this group of epoch gods. Its talent is also the strongest, but it’s only because of this physique that it restricts its life,” The Spirit Queen shook her head. “So, after hearing so much, you understand, right?”
“Although it yearns to have a partner and slept here, in fact, we don’t recommend anyone to be its partner. This is also for your own good.”
“Of course, there are also stubborn Beast Tamers. There have been people who have heard of Bu Lu’s deeds and think that they are the person it’s destined to be, but in fact, Bu Lu looks down on them, who are weak.’
“In the past, a Beast Tamer with the 12th heavenly layer of the divine level lost to Bu Lu.”
“Therefore, it’s completely difficult and unrewarding to contract it. If you want to contract the epoch god, you should choose other candidates. Apart from Bu Lu, there are also other cosmic beasts in the cosmic overlord army. Although there aren’t as many as in the Behemoth Empire, it’s enough for you to choose.’
“What do you think?” Shi Yu asked after some thought.
In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, Eleven and the others looked at each other with interested expressions.
“Wuuu!!”
Eleven and the others felt that this cosmic behemoth was very interesting. Eleven wanted to fight the other party and take a look, while Baby Ginseng wanted to see if it could develop a medicine to break the curse…
With Shi Yu’s deduction, there might be a chance!
“Interesting. I wonder if my Wind of Blessing can offset the disaster of its backlash against us.” Ling also felt that it was very interesting. If someone could tame this cosmic behemoth, it felt that it could only be Shi Yu. This was because Shi Yu had its blessing. Ordinary disasters couldn’t wrap around Shi Yu at all.
“It sounds… like it’s very difficult to deal with.” Qi pinched Little Zi and said, “However, the stranger it is, the more secrets it means. From the experience analysis of my archeological master, the curse on the other party isn’t simple.”
Qi’s thoughts were what Shi Yu liked the most. If the Spirit Queen purely said that a cosmic behemoth was the strongest here and that no one could tame its strength, Shi Yu wasn’t very interested.
However, if it was said that the other party had a cosmic curse suspected to have been obtained from entering the ruins of the era, it made Shi Yu, an archeologist, a little curious.
Under the gaze of the Spirit Queen, Shi Yu’s eyes became more and more determined.
The Spirit Queen: “?”
“Interesting,” Shi Yu said. “Can you give me a chance? I want to give it a try…”
“l want to try subduing this cosmic behemoth called Bu Lu. I’ve always been lucky. I also have a lot of experience cracking era ruins, and my strength is even heaven-defying. If I can’t, no one can..” Shi Yu smiled confidently and said, “Of course, I also want to test it…

chapters.title: Chapter 1700 - 1700: Space Behemoth Slaying (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1700: Space Behemoth Slaying (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“After saying so much, it looks like it’s useless.” The Spirit Queen couldn’t help but shake her head when she saw that Shi Yu still insisted on seeing Bu Lu.
As expected, these geniuses were terrifyingly stubborn.
But that made sense. He could even pass the test of a cosmic overlord. It seemed normal to think that nothing could stump him.
“Forget it,” the Spirit Queen said. “You probably won’t give up until you see Bu
Lu.”
“In that case, I’ll awaken it. Then you guys can communicate yourselves.”
“No problem.” In the starry sky, Shi Yu smiled.
He hoped that he wasn’t digging a hole for himself!
He had heard so much about it from others, but it wasn’t as important as meeting it. This was because Shi Yu also had very high requirements for the appearance of his pet.
A moment later, Shi Yu followed the Spirit Queen and began to travel through the galaxy where the Land of Sleep was.
Soon, they arrived outside a yellow planet.
“These resource planets all belong to the Land of Sleep. On a planet I happened to pass by, an epoch god might have slept previously.” The Spirit Queen floated in the starry sky with Shi Yu following behind.
“And this Earth Star is the Land of Sleep. To be precise, it’s the key to its Land of Sleep.”
“Bu Lu!” With that said, the Spirit Queen shouted at this planet.
In the next moment, a sound wave-like soul wave quickly transmitted over and penetrated the entire star.
At the start, there were no changes, but soon, the entire starry sky began to tremble.
An extremely terrifying power wave began to spread in the universe.
Countless meteorites trembled crazily, and a small number of meteorites directly collapsed into pieces.
“As expected of the strongest epoch god here. Your strength isn’t bad,” Shi Yu said.
This power aura was more than five times that of the Blood Origin God he had encountered previously. It was definitely a monster close to the level of Susu, Ling, and Eleven.
If it were Little Ji, Duckie, and the others, they would probably only be crushed by this guy.
“Of course.” The Spirit Queen nodded. As soon as she finished speaking, a black crack appeared in the star space.
This crack kept expanding, and then another composite-colored star about the size of Earth Star appeared.
The outer layer of the star was yellow, and the inside was white and pitch-black. With a bang, the Earth Star seemed to have exploded, as if its outer skin had exploded, and it had also become a planet of similar color. No… To be precise, including the Earth Star, this wasn’t a star, but an eye.
It was the eye of the cosmic behemoth called Bu Lu.
First, two huge eyes appeared and opened. Then, in the torn cosmic hole, five fingers that were enough to pinch the hairy Earth Star slowly stretched out as if they wanted to grab something.
It seemed to have captured this world in another world.
“Roar! Accompanied by a sound like the tribulation lightning of the universe, space completely shattered. Bu Lu, who was sleeping in this hole of the starry sky universe, finally crawled out. Its body that was enough to pinch stars with a palm was finally displayed.
This was a creature similar to a huge ape and monkey. Every part of its body
was filled with rich reddish-brown hair and was extremely messy. Its long tail circled in the starry sky, and the feeling of power was so strong that it seemed like it could shatter stars with one tail.
After Bu Lu appeared, the entire starry sky seemed to have frozen, because it was really too huge. After all, although the Earth Star just now wasn’t big, its volume had at least exceeded the moon in the galaxy where Blue Planet was, and this was only Bu Lu’s eye.
If it weren’t for the fact that they were far enough away, Shi Yu and the others wouldn’t even be able to see the full appearance of the cosmic behemoth.
“This size is indeed a cosmic behemoth.” Shi Yu stood on a shattered meteorite and looked at the behemoth in the starry sky in front of him with a smile.
Not bad. Overall, he looked pretty good. He was filled with the violent and domineering aura of a wild beast. He was very handsome.
Fighting side by side was maxed out.
Although Eleven, Buggy, and the others had enlarged to the extreme and could also be called behemoths, they were still far inferior to the other party. For example, the height Eleven finally enlarged to was the length of the other party’s finger. They weren’t on the same level at all.
Although sometimes, large creatures might not necessarily be able to defeat small creatures, usually speaking, large creatures had strong battle power.
This rule was applicable in the natural world without transcendent creatures, and also in the cruel natural world of the starry sky.
“Eh, its body…”
At this moment, Beast Shi Yu’s source power gathered in Shi Yu’s eyes. Shi Yu activated the Passage of Time skill and observed the behemoth. He vaguely sensed an aura different from this era from it.
This aura was very similar to the aura of Beast Shi Yu. It felt like this cosmic behemoth was also left behind from the last era.
[Could it be that this is the reason why this behemoth was rejected by this era?]
Shi Yu guessed in his heart. Although he didn’t know how this behemoth was infected by this “curse”, it was indeed the same as the corpses of the era like
Beast Shi Yu. Of course, although there were traces of the last era on Beast Shi Yu and the others, they were all dead, so they wouldn’t be rejected by the will of the era universe.
However, this cosmic behemoth was a living creature. This variable seemed to be the key to its rejection.
“Bu Lu.” Under the shout of the Spirit Queen, the huge monster looked over and said, “What is it?”
“Don’t tell me it woke me up because the origin of the universe is about to condense again?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1701 - 1701: Space Behemoth Slaying (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1701: Space Behemoth Slaying (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“I’ve said before, I’m not interested in these anymore.”
Shi Yu could clearly hear the tone of “I’m tired. Destruction!” in its mouth.
“It’s not because of this, but because someone wants to become your Beast Tamer. He’s here, so 1 won’t care how you communicate,” the Spirit Queen said.
“Huh??” The cosmic behemoth Bu Lu looked at the little Shi Yu beside the Spirit Queen.
It didn’t expect that there would actually be another human who hoped to become its Beast Tamer.
“Who are you?” it asked. Although it didn’t have any social connections and had been alone for many years, it didn’t mean that it didn’t know some human experts from overlord territories and even the entire universe.
It was really unfamiliar with Shi Yu’s words.
“You can call me ‘Shi Yu l . Since ancient times, I’m the future seventh king of the universe,” Shi Yu said.
“According to my experience, the more pretentious a guy is, the more unlucky he is beside me. He dies faster,” the cosmic behemoth said.
“Indeed.” The Spirit Queen nodded. It seemed that the more arrogant a guy was, the faster he would die beside Bu Luz
He would be struck by lightning if he postured.
“Don’t be so serious,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Now that he was a famous figure whose name shook the starry sky, Shi Yu felt that he should be more arrogant. This would help his pet condense an invincible will heart in the universe.
But others… didn’t seem to give him any face.
“l don’t want to. He doesn’t look very smart,” Bu Lu said.
“WII.” Shi Yu didn’t expect this lying guy to have so many things to do.
At the side, the Spirit Queen said that she didn’t care, but she still said, “He’s very strong. He passed the Glory Challenge and saw the cosmic overlord.”
“Aren’t you going to try?”
After the Spirit Queen finished speaking, Bu Lu v s eyes swayed as he looked at Shi Yu. He couldn’t believe that Shi Yu had actually passed the Glory Challenge?
Among the so many epoch gods in the Land of Sleep, which one had never challenged Glory Challenge? Even it had challenged them, but they had all failed.
However, this human in front of him actually did it… Bu Lu didn’t expect that such a monster would actually appear in the cosmic overlord army during his sleep.
Compared to it, it felt that passing that Glory Challenge was even more monstrous.
“Why, have you changed your mind?” Shi Yu said.
“Well, you might really be very strong,” the cosmic behemoth said. “However, I’m very curious why an expert like you would choose me.”
“Because you’re the most special one,” Shi Yu said.
The cosmic behemoth’s heart raced.
“I’m late. When I arrived at the Land of Sleep, you were the only one left here. The other eras have all left. There’s nothing to choose from,” Shi Yu said.
Bu Lu: ???
So this was my special point??
“It’s like this,” the Spirit Queen said.
Bu Lu’s blood pressure immediately rose. Was this the reason?
“However, I was indeed very surprised when I heard about your deeds from Senior Spirit Queen,” Shi Yu said. “It doesn’t sound easy for such an unlucky guy to live to this age.”
“It’s none of your business,” Bu Lu curled his lips and said.
“Don’t mind me. I have no intention of discriminating. I just admire you very much for being able to survive so many disasters.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “How about this? After you complete my test, I’ll contract you as a pet. How about that?”
“Stop kidding,” Bu Lu said. “Even if you pass the Glory Challenge, you might not necessarily be qualified to contract me.”
“Even if you want to contract me, I should be the one giving you a test.”
“In that case, let’s test each other.” Shi Yu crossed his arms and looked indifferent.
“Then let me see your strength first,” Bu Lu said.
“If you want to fight, don’t do it here,” the Spirit Queen said. “Please move to other star areas yourself.”
“Alright,” Bu Lu said. “Leave it to me.”
With that said, its body quickly shrank. Although the Cosmic Behemoth Race ate planets, they also moved on planets. In order to move on some planets, this race naturally evolved a skill to casually control its size.
Basically, it was mainly shrinking. Their normal state was already huge enough. If they wanted to expand, the difficulty was many times greater than shrinking, and the consumption was also huge.
Soon, this behemoth that could pluck stars with its bare hands shrunk to a normal few hundred meters tall. Then, with a tap of its tail, it poked a huge pitch-black hole in the starry sky.
Hole of the Universe!!
Moreover, it was a transcendent-level Hole of the Universe. Its ability was much higher than that Abyss Worm. Shi Yu could sense that the back of this hole was connected to an extremely far star domain.
Even if Ling wanted to sail over, it would take a long time. As for it, it only created a Hole of the Universe and connected two places. Shi Yu was too curious about this ability.
After all, the Hole of the Universe he replicated had yet to have a target to teach. If he could contract this guy, it seemed…
Even if he contracted this guy, it seemed to have been replicated for nothing. The other party’s Hole of the Universe level seemed to have already been maxed out on its own, and there was no way to continue adding points.
Unless there was a higher level above transcendent that could be unlocked in the future… However, at least for the time being, Shi Yu had yet to unlock a divine skill close to the Dao level.
For skills below the divine level, close combat was almost a law.. Divine skills represented laws, and for divine skills, what was close to cultivating to the extreme?

chapters.title: Chapter 1702 - 1702: Space Behemoth Slaying (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1702: Space Behemoth Slaying (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Origin of the universe?
As Shi Yu was thinking, the cosmic behemoth Bu Lu had already taken the lead and entered the Hole of the Universe.
“In that case, I’ll take a trip with it. Senior Spirit Queen, do you want to go
together?” Shi Yu looked at the loli phantom, not understanding why an old monster that had lived for so long was maintained in the form of a little girl.
“Sure, it’s good to go take a look,” the Spirit Queen said.
“Then let’s go together.” With that said, Shi Yu and the other party stepped into the Hole of the Universe.
In the next moment, both parties entered an extremely far star domain from the Land of Sleep. However, just as they came over, they heard Bu Lu l s helpless voice.
“Yes!!” Bu Lu said, “Our luck is a little bad. The place we appeared at seems to be a little bad. We were directly surrounded by the Starry Sky Storm the moment we came up.”
“Ha… Ha…” It was quite optimistic.
As soon as Bu Lu finished speaking, faint storm ripples that were like waves had already formed around this place. Under the chaotic starry sky fluctuations around, even the Hole of the Universe began to become unstable.
“But it’s alright.” When Bu Lu saw that the Spirit Queen had also followed over, he knew that even if he encountered the Starry Sky Storm, he would be fine. It was still easy for a high-level super divine to deal with a small-scale
Starry Sky Storm.
Its bad luck wouldn’t affect a high-level super divine.
“There’s no one else with your luck.” Shi Yu looked at his surroundings and couldn’t help but hold his forehead. Therefore, what ruins did Bu Lu’s mother enter to be infected with the traces of the previous era?
Moreover, it was actually passed down to the next generation.
Shi Yu felt very lucky that he could successfully transmigrate and come here without being cursed by the cosmic will. If he were like this Bu Lu, he couldn’t guarantee that he could still live until now.
“The scale of the storm isn’t small.” The Spirit Queen was also speechless.
“Wait,” Bu Lu said. “Can you leave it to him to settle?”
Bu Lu looked at Shi Yu and said, “Even if a storm of this level takes shape, I can escape, but can you?”
“l don’t want a partner who drags us down,” it said.
“But logically speaking, you’re not the one who attracted the storm, Shi Yu asked.
Bu Lu: “?”
Shi Yu smiled. This big idiot probably meant that it was afraid that the disaster it attracted would hurt others, so it had to differentiate others first and see if they had the strength to resist the disaster.
“One way or another, the curse on your body is indeed quite serious.”
“In my life, I’ve been sailing in the starry sky for a tenth of the time. During this period, forget about a cosmic disaster of this scale, I’ve never even encountered a small cosmic disaster. It’s someone favored by the Lady Luck.”
“You actually let me encounter the Starry Sky Storm. You’re indeed not bad.”
“Heh, Lady Luck… If you’re someone favored by the Lady Luck, I’ve been cursed by the Goddess of Disaster.” Bu Lu looked at the gradually forming Starry Sky Storm around him, and his gaze darkened.
“Then who do you think is stronger, the Lady Luck or the Goddess of Disaster?” Shi Yu said.
“It should be the Goddess of Disaster.” After so many years of disaster, Bu Lu had gradually gotten used to it.
“No, actually, the Lady Luck is more powerful,” Shi Yu said.
“Looks like my luck is on your curse. If I encounter other cosmic disasters, it might mean that we’re not suitable. But now, the appearance of the Starry Sky Storm makes me certain… Your curse might not affect me,”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, under the gaze of the Spirit Queen and Bu Lu, a white mechanical glove appeared in his right hand. Five Wind Spirit Beads of different colors were embedded in the glove. In the next moment, Shi Yu e s palm was aimed at the Starry Sky Storm in front of him.
Right on the heels of that, an extremely shocking scene appeared. The storm sea in all directions of the starry sky suddenly trembled, as if it had encountered the master of the storm. It quickly condensed into a huge wind ball, forming a storm planet completely compressed and combined by the
Starry Sky Storm. It floated above Shi Yu and the others and was raised up by Shi Yu’s arm.
At this moment, Bu Lu looked at all of this in shock and felt that it was extremely unbelievable. That Starry Sky Storm that could heavily injure a low-level super divine was controlled just like that?
With this compressed storm smashing down, it felt that it could completely destroy a star and a small galaxy.
“That’s all?” After controlling the Starry Sky Storm, Shi Yu snapped his fingers. Accompanied by a whoosh, the huge Starry Sky Storm ball quickly disappeared crazily. The power that was still extremely violent just now seemed to have returned to nothingness and had never appeared.
A moment later, the Starry Sky Storm completely disappeared. Shi Yu’s mechanical glove also began to disappear. “Alright, let’s continue looking for a suitable battle venue,’
“You…” Bu Lu looked at Shi Yu and fell silent.
At the side, the Spirit Queen subconsciously smiled and said, “As expected of a guy who passed the Glory Challenge. He’s indeed very strong.”
“Yes, there’s no need to fight. I’ve already acknowledged your strength,” Bu Lu said. “Whether you fight or not isn’t that important…”
“Among those of the same level, you’re the first person to transform my curse into a controllable ability…”
“Not fighting anymore??” Shi Yu said.
“No, my strength standard for my partner is only that the other party has the strength to deal with the disaster I brought. You undoubtedly did it,” Bu Lu said..

chapters.title: Chapter 1703 - 1703: Space Behemoth Slaying (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1703: Space Behemoth Slaying (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Of course, once might not be enough. I have to test it a few more times… This time, it might just be a coincidence.”
“Well, let’s fight too,” Shi Yu said.
“No more.”
Shi Yu:
“Wait, big guy, don’t tell me you’re suddenly afraid,” Shi Yu said suspiciously.
Seeing Ling defeat the Starry Sky Storm so easily, it realized the difference in strength?
“I’m not afraid!” The cosmic behemoth revealed an angry expression.
In the next moment, a rumbling sound came from its stomach, resounding through the starry sky.
At the side, the Spirit Queen said, “l forgot to tell you previously. Because Bu Lu is a mutated cosmic behemoth, it’s very difficult to eat. After the epoch god level, the planet laws eaten by other cosmic behemoths can no longer satisfy its nutritional needs. It’s not very to its taste.”
“And a high-level planet isn’t something it can afford to provoke.”
“Therefore, it hasn’t had a full meal for a long time. It’s basically fine to sleep normally, but after moving around with the body of a cosmic behemoth for a while, the hunger should return immediately.”
“It doesn’t want to fight anymore. It should be because it’s gradually feeling hungry,” the Spirit Queen said.
“Damn it.” Bu Lu was furious. Even if it had shrunk, it still felt very hungry.
If he had known earlier, the Hole of the Universe wouldn’t have opened so far.
Shi Yu was speechless.
“How pitiful. It’s fine if it’s unlucky, but it can’t even fill its stomach.” Shi Yu shook his head.
“So what are you eating when you’re active?”
“In the army, a super divine expert who’s expert in nutrition specially developed suitable food for Bu Lu. However, the creation difficulty is too high and the price is very expensive, so even Bu Lu can’t eat it often. Using sleep to numb yourself is the best choice.”
“Therefore, I reckon that you should be able to take care of one of the tests of
“So hungry…” At this moment, the more the Spirit Queen spoke, the hungrier
Bu Lu felt.
“Yes, it must be included.” [Eleven thinks it’s very good.]
It couldn’t eat, let alone fight. Even if it moved, it was a little lazy at this moment.
It only wanted to sleep now.
As it spoke, the body of the cosmic behemoth became smaller and smaller. Soon, it shrunk into a one-meter-tall little monkey. It was really unscrupulous in order to save energy.
For cosmic behemoths, maintaining their huge bodies was the most comfortable state. Although it consumed a little energy, a state where they could display their strength to the extreme would make them feel very comfortable.
At this moment, Bu Lu e s behavior was no different from abandoning the pride of the cosmic behemoth and bowing down to life.
Small was humiliation to the cosmic behemoth. Large was glory. It had clearly given up the glory of its race and only wanted to lie steadily.
“Didn’t you bring any food?” Shi Yu asked.
“l originally had a backup before I slept, but from what I saw just now, the spatial equipment was worn out, and all the food was lost because of the spatial crack,” Bu Lu said angrily.
Food, its food.
It would rather be unlucky to encounter the Starry Sky Storm than to be so unlucky as to accidentally lose emergency food.
“l really have no choice.” Shi Yu scratched his head and took out a Cultivation Fruit. He threw it to Bu Lu and said, “Try this and see if it can fill your stomach.’
“It’s more or less nutritious. Since ordinary food doesn’t suit your taste, try something extraordinary. ”
“What’s this?”
After taking the Cultivation Fruit Shi Yu threw over, Bu Lu sensed its extremely high quality. The quality didn’t seem to be far from the food tailor-made for it by that super divine expert.
After obtaining the fruit, Bu Lu ate it without thinking. It wasn’t afraid that the fruit was poisonous or anything.
After so many years, it had already come into contact with countless poisonous substances by accident. Its body was already immune to hundreds of poisons and had antibodies. Even the poison on the Dark Kings side couldn’t pollute it.
However, after the little monkey ate the Cultivation Fruit in one bite, its gaze instantly changed. It was suddenly a little stunned and confused.
In an instant, its face turned green and white. It grabbed its neck and retched. However, it didn’t last two seconds before fainting from the stench and falling asleep at the side.
The Spirit Queen: ???
“You, what did you feed it!!”
Shi Yu touched his chin and said, “It’s not used to ordinary food, and refuses to eat even if it’s not ordinary? Why is it so picky?”
In addition, Baby Ginseng wasn’t an epoch god yet! Why was Bu Lu insta-killed with a fruit?
Was this cosmic behemoth really reliable?
Of course, it was also possible that it was related to this guy’s current state. It should have been really hungry previously.
“Here, Senior Spirit Queen, do you want one?” Shi Yu took two Cultivation Fruits and handed one to the Spirit Queen. He bit one himself. Although his face was green and white, he seemed to be used to this taste..

chapters.title: Chapter 1704 - 1704: Nesting Children (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1704: Nesting Children (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“You eat it yourself.”
The Ioli Spirit Queen didn’t seem to be interested in the Cultivation Fruit. She took a look and said directly, “So, what’s next?”
“If you use this thing to stunk it out, how are you going to test each other?”
“No hurry, no hurry.” Shi Yu scratched his head and said, “How about this? I
don’t think it has much strength to fight in the short term. Why don’t you ?return to the Land of Sleep first, Senior Spirit Queen?” “I’ll drag this guy along and spend some time with it first.” “I’ll also look for anything suitable for it to eat on the way.”
“You want to take it away?” the Spirit Queen said.
“Well, I plan to return to the Cosmic Sea. Along the way, I can also see what other disasters it can attract and see if we can resist it.’
“Didn’t it want to test me with this?”
“It’s indeed very special. Being in a hurry to contract it is an irresponsible manifestation of both parties. Why don’t we be partners for a period of time?” Shi Yu said.
“It’s also a choice,” the Spirit Queen said. “In that case, bring it away.”
“However, if you want to compete for the transcendent origin that’s about to appear, it’s best not to bring it.”
“Otherwise, I might miss it for strange reasons.”
“In addition, the appearance of the transcendent origin this time is a little strange. There might be a mastermind behind it. I’m not sure who it is yet.
Investigate it yourself before deciding if you want to join.”
As Shi Yu was introduced by King Lie and was a key member who had seen the cosmic overlord, the Spirit Queen reminded him a little more.
“l understand.” Shi Yu nodded. On the other side, the Spirit Queen was silent.
She didn’t know if letting Shi Yu take Bu Lu away was a good or bad outcome.
Just like that, Bu Lu was directly abducted by Shi Yu.
On the battleship, Shi Yu casually found a place and threw the cloth kill over there. Then, he looked at it and fell into deep thought.
He could still see the weak traces of the last era on the other party’s body.
Shi Yu wasn’t sure if others could see this mark, but he could only see it with the enhancement of source power.
This power… could be said to be the existence that attracted Shi Yu the most on Bu Lu.
“Baby Ginseng, I’ll deduce food suitable for cosmic behemoths other than planets. You’re in charge of making it.”
“Let it sleep first. Although the nutrition of the Cultivation Fruit isn’t low, it might not be suitable for it. It still has to sleep and recover.”
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng came out of the Beast Taming Space with a long face.
Damn, I almost forgot. After the cosmic behemoth joins the team, the one who’ll suffer the most is definitely not Little Zi, but me!
With the size of the cosmic behemoth, the demand for food was incomparably terrifying. If they couldn’t eat high-level planets, they could only let Baby Ginseng make food again.
“Don’t panic, don’t panic,” Shi Yu said. “When we return to the Cosmic Sea, we’ll hunt two super divine levels and exchange them for money. At that time, we won’t lack your resources. It’s easy to create food.”
“Yi!! (I’ll hunt! Although the first clear was gone, Baby Ginseng also wanted to personally fight a super divine.
“Alright, alright,” Shi Yu said. However, he would deduce the food first.
[Contract Pet]: Baby Ginseng
[Skill Effect]: All-purpose delicacy. It can allow any race to feel delicious and replenish high nutrition. [Deduction success rate]: Low
[Deducing…]
Soon, Shi Yu and the others deduced the so-called all-purpose food recipe.
After obtaining the recipe, Shi Yu’s vision darkened. He finally understood why the deduction success rate was so “high”. It was because the recipe was indeed extremely simple, but the materials were a little “expensive”.
It was actually a tree fruit cultivated with the “pseudo source of transcendence” as the main fertilizer.
“Damn it, it’s ridiculous. Are they going to snatch cultivation resources from Beast Shi Yu?” Although all-purpose delicacies were omnipotent, no one in the team needed them. Everyone had their own favorite food, so there was no need to eat this standard.
Probably only that cosmic behemoth needed this thing to replenish its nutrition.
The pseudo source of transcendence was a resource used for cultivation at the super divine level. Those below the super divine level couldn’t use it at all. The skill index actually deduced food with this kind of thing as fertilizer. The nourishing level was obvious.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu eagerly. Then should it learn?
It remembered that there seemed to be a few fake source of transcendence in the team. They were exchanged for battle merits from hunting Benos, the super divine.
“Learn. ”
“It would be a waste not to learn.’
Baby Ginseng didn’t expect Shi Yu to really be willing to spend a lot.
However, with Baby Ginsengs understanding of Shi Yu… It looked at Shi Yu, who had licked its lips, and understood that the Beast Tamer most likely still wanted to taste the source of transcendence.
“Wii…”
Just as Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng were chatting, the sleeping Bu Lu suddenly revealed a pained expression.
Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng looked over and knew that this was a nightmare.
“Yie (What nightmare is it?)” Baby Ginseng asked curiously.
“It’s better not to look. Hurry up and cook,” Shi Yu said. He had telepathy.
Compared to Baby Ginseng, he could understand Bu Lu’s current mood better.
It was almost equivalent to seeing the other party’s dream.
Shi Yu scratched his head. He felt that this guy was actually still miserable. Although its strength was not bad, he had not made a friend. Even passers-by he had just met died beside it due to various disasters.
This also made Bu Lu not dare to come into contact with people weaker than it..

chapters.title: Chapter 1705 - 1705: Nesting Children (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1705: Nesting Children (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
At this moment, Bu Lu was in a similar dream, recalling those bad experiences.
“Sigh, why does the universe reincarnate? Why was the last era rejected by a new era?” Shi Yu was puzzled.
After abducting a cosmic behemoth from the Land of Sleep, Shi Yu and the others continued to return to the Cosmic Sea.
Because of the teleportation, they were even closer to the location of the Cosmic Sea.
In less than two months, he could reach the Cosmic Sea. As for returning to the World King Planet after arriving at the Cosmic Sea, it was easy. There were various methods to quickly reach the World King Planet.
Almost three years had passed. Shi Yu was also very curious about the situation over there. Did Emperor Wu and the others win the God Sealing Champion and break through to the divine level?
“Roar!!!” After sailing for several days, a heart-wrenching roar came from the battleship.
A little monkey was sitting on the ground. After waking up, it was still retching, as if it had eaten something with lingering aftertaste.
The automatic door opened. Shi Yu entered and looked at the cosmic behemoth sitting on the ground, falling into deep thought.
“Is it really that bad??”
After eating too much, he felt that it was alright.
“Ugh, what did you feed me?” The cosmic behemoth kept rolling on the ground. It pinched its neck and looked like it had nothing to live for.
“Let me tell you, I definitely won’t forgive you. If this is your usual food, I’d rather die than sign a contract with you.”
Although it sensed some benefits brought by the Cultivation Fruit, Bu Lu really couldn’t accept this taste.
The taste of the Cosmic Behemoth Race was already tricky, and the Cultivation Fruit was something that people who didn’t have any requirements for taste couldn’t accept. The collision of the two undoubtedly produced a magical chemistry…
Shi Yu was speechless.
“I’ll just give it a try.’
“Try this again this time.” Shi Yu threw a white fruit to Bu Lu. This time, when he saw the fruit flying over, Bu Lu acted as if it was facing a great enemy. However, unlike the Cultivation Fruit, Baby Ginseng didn’t restrain the scent of this all-purpose delicacy.
If the taste of the Cultivation Fruit spread out and affected the environment too much, Baby Ginseng would restrain the taste inside the fruit, but it didn’t matter if it was a fragrant food like the all-purpose food.
Therefore, Bu Lu quickly sensed the difference between the all-purpose delicacies and the Cultivation Fruit. It frowned and took this thing. It quickly used this thing that at least smelled more fragrant to wash its mouth.
After eating it, the cosmic behemoth Bu Lu was instantly stunned. It held half the fruit in one hand and immersed itself on the spot. It kept chewing the all-purpose delicacies with a look of disbelief.
“Wu.” It quickly ate it in two bites. Apart from the shocking delicacy, a large amount of power surged in its body. It felt that its weak state was quickly recovering to the peak.
It couldn’t help but raise its head and look at Shi Yu. “This, what’s this??” “Is there anything else? This thing is much more delicious than the previous one.”
“It’s the most delicious thing I’ve ever eaten.”
It was simply more delicious than the food made by the super divine nutritionist in the army.
“Well, don’t think about it. This price is very expensive.” It was mainly because fertilizer was expensive and couldn’t be eaten casually.
“Wait, where is this?” Bu Lu suddenly realized the unfamiliar environment here.
“After you faint from the stench, I’ll tell Senior Spirit Queen to bring you on a trip for a period of time first. I want to see if your curse is stronger or my luck is stronger.” Shi Yu smiled.
“In fact, a week has passed, and we haven’t encountered any disaster.”
Bu Lu was silent on the spot. He looked at Shi Yu and said, “Then where are you going now?”
“Cosmic Sea,” Shi Yu said. “Can l?”
“l don’t mind, but are you really not afraid? Don’t blame me for not reminding you. It might have been an accident previously. My luck is really bad. If it affects you later, don’t blame me.”
“On account of your food, let me remind you.”
“It’s not your fault. Don’t worry, no curse can make me unlucky,” Shi Yu said.
“Speaking of which, what test are you talking about?” Bu Lu suddenly looked at Shi Yu and said.
“It’s nothing. It’s also a battle. Although you’re an epoch god, 1 don’t fancy ordinary epoch gods either.”
“In a one-on-one battle, I won’t lose to anyone at the same level,” Bu Lu said. “You’re very strong. At least, you contracted more than one epoch god. If 1 fight all of you, I don’t have much confidence of winning, but I definitely have no problem fighting any of your pets alone,”upd?t? ?t ?ew?o?el. ?rg
“Contract me. I’m your strongest trump card. However, you haven’t completely passed the test at the moment. I haven’t decided if I’ll contract you,” it said.
Bu Lu looked at Shi Yu. It was mainly because it felt that Shi Yu wasn’t bad. Although it liked to brag a little, it still had strength. Most importantly, the less there was, the more it yearned for something. Shi Yu had previously displayed strength that wasn’t affected by its bad luck, making it look forward to it a little.
However, it was precisely because of this that Bu Lu was afraid that if it easily contracted Shi Yu, it would transmit bad luck to Shi Yu and let something happen to him. In the end, it would also be disappointed.
Therefore, it had been in a very conflicted state and was still watching.
“A trump card?”
“You’re too narrow-minded,” Shi Yu said.. “Tell me, if I have a pet that can defeat you one-on-one, what will you do?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1706 - 1706: Nesting Children (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1706: Nesting Children (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Impossible,” Bu Lu said.
“Try it?” Shi Yu said.
“So be it.” Bu Lu wanted to see what tricks Shi Yu could play.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Let’s compete in arm-wrestling. We won’t specially find a place.”
“Aren’t you cosmic behemoths proud of your physical strength?”
“Wu,” Bu Lu said. “That’s indeed the case, but apart from strength, I’m expert in many other things. Forget it, let’s compete on this.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu directly activated the summoning array. In the next moment,
Beast Shi Yu was summoned by Shi Yu.
“Huh??” Seeing the human appearance of Beast Shi Yu, Bu Lu was stunned.
Then, right on the heels of that, he didn’t sense any divine power fluctuations on Beast Shi Yu. It was very strange.
“It’s your pet???”
“Well, this is the first time you’ve seen a humanoid pet, right? Do you want to give it a try?”
“Humans can also be contracted?” Bu Lu felt that it had lived for a long time. However, it also felt that it was very ridiculous. Weren’t humans known as the race with the worst battle power? Shi Yu actually wanted a pet to compete in strength with it? What a joke…
A moment later… Beast Shi Yu picked up the shrunken Bu Lu as if he was holding a little chick.
“Impossible, I don’t believe it. Put me down! Bu Lu’s expression changed drastically with a shocked expression. It felt that it couldn’t use any strength in its entire body.
It wasn’t that its strength was restricted, but that the other party was stronger than it and suppressed it.
Although it had shrunk, Bu Lu could confirm that it could still use at least 80% of its strength. But even so, it was still instantly suppressed. This situation was really difficult for it to accept.
This meant that the other party’s strength was several times higher than its.
“Look.” Shi Yu was amused.
Why did he feel that dealing with this supposedly invincible cosmic behemoth was like teasing a child?
Was this because this guy rarely interacted with others and had been sleeping? This caused its mental age to be far inferior to its true age.
“Who is it?”
Shi Yu controlled Beast Shi Yu and put down Bu Lu. Bu Lu retreated continuously and looked at Beast Shi Yu cautiously.
However, at the same time, Bu Lu was also a little confused because it actually felt a sense of closeness from Beast Shi Yu.
It had only experienced this kind of closeness with its mother before.
“Could it be that it’s not human, but also a cosmic behemoth?” Bu Lu said in shock.
A cosmic behemoth wearing the skin of a human?
“He’s not a cosmic behemoth, but like you, it has traces of the last era on its body. Do you know what the traces of the last era are?”
“It’s because you’re infected with the traces of the last era that you’re rejected and cursed by the cosmic will of this era. Do vou understand?”
Bu Lu’s expression changed. “What do you know?”
“That’s all I know at the moment, but if you cooperate, you can study it more.”
“How can I cooperate?” To be honest, Bu Lu also wanted to figure out what was going on with his physique, but unfortunately, the most powerful scientists and archeologists in the cosmic overlord army couldn’t figure it out. “Lie on the bed.” Shi Yu pointed at Beast Shi Yu. “I’ll get it to check your body.”
“I’ve long wanted to do this, but you were sleeping previously. Without your agreement, it’s not easy to carry out.”
“Alright…” Bu Lu nodded and obediently lay on the bed according to Shi Yu l s request.
At this moment, Shi Yu controlled Beast Shi Yu to help Bu Lu check his body through the power of the last era.
However, just as Beast Shi Yu’s source power circulated around Bu Lu’s body, a big problem occurred.
“Holy sh*t.” Shi Yu couldn’t help but exclaim. The cry even woke up the sleeping gem cat and owl.
It also shocked Eleven, Ling, and the others.
Bu Lu, who was lying on the bed, revealed an angry expression. “What are you
“l, I didn’t do it on purpose,” Shi Yu said. “This is the first time I’ve encountered such a situation.’
“Why didn’t you resist?”
“l couldn’t resist successfully, but you did it on purpose. You know that it’s stronger than me.”
“I’m really not. You’ve encountered such a situation before? I’m also very confused, alright?”
Shi Yu was stunned because Beast Shi Yu seemed to have accidentally contracted this cosmic behemoth.
It wasn’t using the contract method of this era. It should be from the last era. It was a simple contract without the Beast Taming Space.
Shi Yu had clearly tested the various uses of source power on other creatures many times, but this was the first time such a situation had happened.
Was it related to the fact that this cosmic behemoth also had traces of the previous era?
Shi Yu was stunned. His contracted pet contracted its own pet?
At the same time, Shi Yu could also sense that Beast Shi Yu had obtained some feedback from this cosmic behemoth. The physical feedback wasn’t big. Most importantly… the feedback from learning adaptability. At this moment, Shi Yu sensed that the battle system of the previous era that Beast Shi Yu couldn’t learn previously had become much clearer.
At the same time, Shi Yu instantly knew the little monkey’s luxurious skill column through Beast Shi Yu…

chapters.title: Chapter 1707 - 1707: Behemoth and Little Zi (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1707 - 1707: Behemoth and Little Zi (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Hey, hey, hey.” At this moment, Bu Lu was anxious.
How could he contract someone so silently without its agreement?
“Then what do you want to do?” At this moment, Shi Yu gave up. “To be honest, I don’t know the way to break the contract.”
“You also sensed that this contract is different from the contract of the Beast
Taming Space…”
“Why don’t you break free and take a look?”
“If I could break free, I would have already broken free,” Bu Lu said. Shi Yu was speechless. “Alright, I’ll take you in. I won’t test you.”
“You’re taking advantage of the situation.”
Bu Lu: “?”
“Heh heh,” Bu Lu said. “My bad luck will be transmitted to others just by talking to others.”
“If you contract with me now, it’s equivalent to sharing bad luck with me. I can’t guarantee that if anything happens, I’m confident of saving you.”
“If anything happens to you, don’t blame me.”
Shi Yu said, “It doesn’t matter. I’ll be responsible for you. Since I’ve contracted with you, I’m willing to bear the bad luck you bring.”
Ling was eavesdropping at the side. Why did he sound like a scumbag?
“Forget it, forget it.” Realizing that it couldn’t break free from the contract, Bu Lu started again.
So be it. Perhaps with Shi Yu’s strength, he could really resist its bad luck.
The premise… was that it didn’t break through again.
Bu Lu realized that the bad luck on its body would change according to its strength.
When it was still weak, the disasters it encountered were relatively weak. After becoming stronger, the level of disasters it encountered would also increase.
As long as it was still at the divine level, it shouldn’t affect the current Shi Yu too much.
Of course, with its luck, Bu Lu also felt that things like the source of transcendence had no fate with it.
“But speaking of which, your skill is a little terrifying,” Shi Yu said.
<Name> Bu Lu
[Race Divine Skill]: Star Destruction, Body Control, Hole of the Universe, Star
Collapsing Roar, Eye of the Stars, Star Reincarnation (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, Thunder, Light, Darkness, Light, Darkness, Ice, Poison, Space).
Among them, the four skills of Star Destruction, Body Control, Hole of the Universe, and Star Reincarnation had all been trained to transcendence by Bu
Lu.
The other skills were also above perfect proficiency.
This was too terrifying. It could be said that it could completely suppress any pet of Shi Yu other than Beast Shi Yu, Eleven, Ling, and Susu.
Star Destruction: Mobilize and fuse the power of the universe to strengthen the physical strength and launch an attack that easily destroys stars.
Body Control: Ultimate control over the body, switching between attack and defense, super regeneration, shrinking of size, omnipotent.
Shi Yu also had the Body Control talent and knew the power of this talent. With a body the size of a cosmic behemoth, it was too difficult to control it in detail. With this skill, it was just right.
The Hole of the Universe was naturally the most powerful and comprehensive teleportation and meld skill in the current universe. The stability of the Hole of the Universe was also the highest of all spatial skills. Even a cosmic disaster would find it difficult to completely destroy the passage.
Shi Yu estimated that the Hole of the Universe was indispensable for Bu Lu being able to dodge so many disasters.
Star Collapsing Roar. This move was relatively common. It was a skill that specialized in countering cosmic life forms. Its lethality to cosmic life forms was more than twice that to other enemies.
Under the roar, the star would directly explode like self-destruction, causing huge damage to the enemies on the star.
The Eye of the Stars was the reconnaissance skill of the cosmic behemoth. They could refine the planet into an eye and throw the planet out. The cosmic behemoth could also share the witness of the planet in the universe.
It was said that hundreds of millions of stars in the Behemoth Empire were the eyes of Beastmasters.
Star Reincarnation was the life-saving skill of the cosmic behemoth. In extreme circumstances, it could abandon everything and directly reincarnate on a certain planet, using the planet as nutrients to nurture a new life.
At the same time, it could also change its stats according to the different stats of the Star Reincarnation. Cosmic behemoths also had stats. Generally speaking, they had the same stats as their parents.
However, if they nurtured new life on the planet, their stats would be determined by the power of the star and reincarnate into the star. Then, the new life stats would most likely be fire-element.
As for Bu Lu, it was actually a little exaggerated. It was almost all attributes. Apart from a few exclusive racial skills of the Cosmic Behemoth Race, it knew all kinds of stats control power. This was also an extremely ridiculous existence among the Cosmic Behemoth Race.
After all, not all racial skills like Star Destruction, Body Control, Hole of the Universe, Star Collapsing Roar, Eye of the Stars, and Star Reincarnation could be awakened. Only royal families could learn them. Ordinary cosmic behemoths only knew three or four of many skills.
“l didn’t want to either,” Bu Lu said. “l was forced to learn those skills.”
“l accidentally encountered spatial flux and was teleported to the core of the star. I could only be forced to adapt to skills like Fire Control. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to come out.’
“If I accidentally entered the pollution mystic realm left behind by the super divine of the Abyss Race, I could only be forced to awaken the control of the poison. Otherwise, I would have been polluted.”
“l have reason to suspect that the cosmic will is jealous of your talent, so it cursed you,” Shi Yu joked.
As everyone knew, apart from a few racial skills, it was not easy for a cosmic behemoth to learn other skills.
