Their racial advantage was their incomparable physical strength. It was very suitable to describe them as “sacrificing intelligence in exchange for strength”. In movies and novels everywhere in the universe, the image of brutes and wild beasts was often used to describe the cosmic behemoths..

chapters.title: Chapter 1708 - 1708: Behemoth and Little Zi (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1708 - 1708: Behemoth and Little Zi (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
In fact, in some works, the cosmic behemoth didn’t even use racial skills and only used physical strength.
It could be seen that in everyone’s understanding, the cosmic behemoth was a monster with brute force.
However, Bu Lu knew the skills of a bunch of races. It was fine if it knew one or two, but it had learned more than ten.
No wonder… it gave Beast Shi Yu feedback on learning, comprehension, and adaptability. Did this guy add talent in the wrong direction?
“So annoying,” Bu Lu said. This damn luck.
“After following me, your luck might change.”
“In short, from today onwards, we’re partners. No problem, right?”
“There’s a problem…” Bu Lu reacted and said, “So, why can your pet sign a contract with me? Am I your pet or your pet’s pet?”
“Ah, this…” Shi Yu scratched his head and said, “There’s no difference, right?”
“It says it’s my pet, but it’s actually more like my embodiment and clone. We’re all me.’
Bu Lu t s eyes widened. Was that so?
Wait a minute, something was still wrong. Why was the physical strength of a
human Beast Tamer’s clone comparable to a super divine level cosmic behemoth?
“Don’t worry about this…” Shi Yu pondered for a moment and suddenly said,
“Speaking of which…”
Shi Yu stretched out his hand, and a halo quickly appeared on it. On the contract ring, strong spatial fluctuations condensed.
He suddenly had a bold idea.
“Bu Lu, try and see if you can receive this.”
Generally speaking, a contracted pet couldn’t be contracted by a second person.
However, could Beast Shi Yu be considered a human?
Moreover, the contract method between Beast Shi Yu and Bu Lu wasn’t the contract system of this era.
Were the two contract systems conflicting?
Under Shi Yu’s request, Bu Lu touched the contract ring condensed by Shi Yu in confusion and spoke in shock.
“What’s going on?” It stretched its hand back.
“Why are there still contract fluctuations.”
“Looks like it’s working??” Shi Yu was surprised. “Don’t resist. Try contracting it. ”
“Wait, wait, wait.” Bu Lu hugged his head. He was a little dizzy and confused.
However, under Shi Yu’s strong request, it still completed the contract with Shi Yu’s main body.
It became Shi Yu’s new pet after Shorty.
At the same time, Shi Yu’s main body also received a pile of physical strength feedback and learning ability feedback… “Holy sh*t.” Shi Yu couldn’t help but exclaim. “Holy sh*t?” Bu Lu said. “What do you mean?” “By the way, why can I be contracted twice?” “Is your contract method frivolous or not?”
“This keeps giving me a bad feeling.”
“l know you’re very puzzled, but don’t be puzzled first. I’m also very confused,” Shi Yu said. “Do you know what this means?”
Bu Lu shook its head in confusion.
“It means that I can receive feedback twice. This bug is awesome,” Shi Yu said. “Unfortunately, you’re not very impressive. You couldn’t let me reach the 14th heavenly layer…”
“As expected, it’s getting harder and harder later.”
“By the way, does the cosmic overlord army mean that the curse on your body was infected because your mother once explored an era ruin?”
“l think so, but when I was born, my mother died in childbirth. I don’t know the exact situation,” it said.
Shi Yu was helpless to complain about why a cosmic behemoth would find it difficult to give birth to its child, but… “Did you look for that era ruin after that?”
“No. That ruin is said to be a mobile and uncertain ruin. My mother and the others seemed to have entered by chance. In the end, that team was completely wiped out, and only my mother came out alive.”
“What do you want?” Bu Lu was alert.
Shi Yu said, “I’m also an archeologist. I want to see if 1 can help you solve your bad luck and find the source by exploring ruins.”
“You’re talking nonsense.” The cosmic behemoth sensed that Shi Yu didn’t have this goal.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Of course, there’s another reason. You’re my clone’s first contracted pet.”
“It only circulated its power around your body and completed the contract. This is very unbelievable, because I’ve also experimented like this on other lives, but there are no similar effects.’
“Therefore, you should be different, and the reason why you’re different is very likely because your body is contaminated with the power from the last era from that ruin.’
“My clone also cultivates the cultivation system of the last era. Perhaps… the cultivation contract system of the last era can only contract creatures from the last era, and you are recognized as a creature from the last era.”
“Therefore, I’m wondering if this ruin can mass-produce pets that can be contracted by clones…” Shi Yu touched his chin. There was such a good deal for a pet to give feedback twice?
He seemed to have found a way to cheat.
“You’re crazy,” Bu Lu said in shock. “Do you want the entire team to have bad luck?”
“l won’t allow you to do this.”
As a Beast Tamer, he didn’t seem to be afraid of bad luck.
Bu Lu, who was so unlucky that it exploded, knew very well how terrifying this thing was.
It didn’t want its teammates to be all guys with as bad luck as it. It was already very difficult for it to survive alone. If the entire team was this lucky, it was probably only a step away from being wiped out..

chapters.title: Chapter 1709 - 1709: Behemoth and Little Zi (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1709: Behemoth and Little Zi (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Bu Lu really didn’t expect that when it woke up this time, it would actually encounter a guy who wasn’t afraid of its bad luck and wanted to pursue more bad luck.
“Uh, it seems to be a problem,” Shi Yu said. Lings luck was at most medium to one cloth kill, but neutralizing more bad luck seemed to be a little difficult.
However, Shi Yu was still a little curious about that ruin. Who said that there would definitely be bad luck? Moreover, he had to solve the bad luck on Bu Lu sooner or later. As long as he found a way to solve the bad luck, it wouldn’t be a problem, right?
“Forget it, let’s not think about this first,” Shi Yu said.
Although Bu Lu didn’t know the location of the ruins, Shi Yu wasn’t worried.
He had the invincible Astrologer Race and the Star Prayer Race.
As long as he used Bu Lu as a medium and let Teacher Owl use the power of the family’s treasure and the power of the super divine cat to predict the location of that ruin, it would be enough.
“Alright, I’ll take you to meet my other pets first, right?” Shi Yu said. “Although you’re very confident in your strength, even if you don’t include my clone beast, there are at least three other pets stronger than you.”
“l don’t believe it,” Bu Lu said.
“Believe it or not, you’ll know after getting to know them.” Shi Yu was amused. “In addition, although most of the other pets might not be as strong as you now, it might not be the case in the future. You have to know that their age might not be even a fraction of your age…”
“My team is very messy.”
“Well, before you get to know them, I’ll let you familiarize yourself with them overall.’
“Ling, bring Eleven and the others’ resumes over.” With a shout from Shi Yu, the wall of the room immediately turned into a screen.
“Roger, Master.” A light voice came from the screen, making Bu Lu subconsciously look over.
The first thing that entered his eyes was Eleven’s picture.
Seeing the little bear in the scene, Bu Lu frowned.
“It’s called Eleven. It’s about seven or eight years old this year,” Shi Yu said.
As Shi Yu spoke, the video displayed Eleven’s battle results at various ages and the accompanying battle video.
At the age of two, he won the newbie championship of the class competition. At the age of three, he won the national championship. At the age of four, he won the world championship…
During this process, Bu Lu didn’t feel anything. It had just been born and was already stronger than Eleven when it was the world champion.
However, after seeing Eleven’s achievements since entering the universe, Bu Lu couldn’t hold it in anymore.
The five-year-old Eleven directly defeated Zavay and became the strongest quasi divine in the universe.
At the age of seven, he directly broke through to the epoch god and endured the cosmic lightning tribulation of the 13th heavenly layer. He used the power of the cosmic lightning tribulation to shatter the deterrence of the cosmic overlord!
Seeing this, Bu Lu was stunned.
“Is this an achievement that can be achieved in a few years??”
“It’s a reincarnator, right?”
After all, it was already in the seven digits. Bu Lu’s age was in the seven digits, and Eleven’s was seven years old. It kept giving Bu Lu a ridiculous feeling.
“This guy is my initial partner. Its current dream is to defeat a cosmic overlord.” Shi Yu smiled and looked at Eleven’s photo.
“Why? Is it because it’s not much weaker than you?”
“However, there are indeed reincarnators in my team,” Shi Yu said.
“If the age before reincarnation is added together, it’s probably hundreds of millions of years old.”
“But in this life, it’s only six or seven years old.”
“Your Star Reincarnation level is so high. You should have been forced to reincarnate many times.”
“Yes…” Bu Lu nodded.
Then, Ling broadcasted Susu’s scene to Bu Lu.
“It’s the faith god of my mother planet’s ocean, born to cleanse.”
“Every time it reincarnated, its strength would weaken until its life was about to completely end when it encountered me.”
In the scene, it was an extremely weak Water Slime that had just been born.
But in a few years, like Eleven, susu’s improvement speed was ridiculous. It directly had the strength to instantly kill a super divine that had transcended the second abyss.
Ordinary epoch gods only exceeded one. Seeing that Susu could instantly kill more than two, Bu Lu fell silent again.
“By the way, it has mastered the transcendent top-notch cleansing law and source fluctuations. In the future, it can try to see if it can cleanse the bad luck on your body, although I feel that the chances aren’t high,” Shi Yu said.
After being in the cosmic overlord army for so long, Bu Lu had definitely encountered a super divine level cleanser stronger than Susu. The bad luck on its body was probably not that simple.
“Alright, next is Ling, the mechanical life form in front of you.”
“It was also the guy who defeated the Starry Sky Storm at that time.”
Ling was even younger. It was created by Shi Yu alone. After seeing Lings shocking luck, Bu Lu was stunned.
Apart from that, not only was Lings luck heaven-defying, but its strength was also very terrifying.
It had actually just broken through to the epoch god and could directly resist the mechanical super divine Wabra that had reached transcendent 3.
“It’s precisely because of her that I’m not afraid of your bad luck. She’s my Lady Luck,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“What a joke. Are your team filled with monsters?” Bu Lu couldn’t help but say. After looking at its resume, it realized that Shi Yu was indeed not bragging.
Even if it wasn’t considered the enhancement of a Beast Tamer, these three pets were also very strong. Their strength wasn’t inferior to it, nor was it inferior to its strength. In the Land of Sleep, they were at the top.
And these pets were actually all gathered in the hands of a Beast Tamer. This made Bu Lu find it unbelievable.
It thought that Shi Yu’s epoch god was at most at the level of the Blood Origin God…
“Aren’t you also a monster with ridiculous strength?” Shi Yu said. “How is it? With this group of companions, you can rest assured, right? Since the disaster you attracted can’t affect you, it’s impossible to affect them..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1710 - 1710: Behemoth and Little Zi (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1710: Behemoth and Little Zi (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Bu Lu was speechless, but in the blink of an eye, he became even more excited. Perhaps this “monster headquarters” could really accommodate a “monster” like him.
“l want to continue watching,” it said.
“Alright,” Shi Yu said in amusement. “Here, next. When I encountered it, it was only a few months old Green Silkworm…”
“Now, it’s the most perfect Four Symbols Green Dragon Holy Beast in the evolution stage in the entire universe.”
On the other side, after Shi Yu contracted Bu Lu, Little Zi hurriedly found Lings main body and asked it to help think of a way.
As everyone knew, when the pets of the second team entered Shi Yu’s team, they had to acknowledge them as big brothers first.
Little Ji joined the team, worshiping Big Sister Ling. Duckie joined the team, worshiping Big Sister Susu. The Turtle and Little Quas of the Dragon Palace joined the team, worshiping the Dragon God Buggy. Shorty joined the team and directly worshiped the entire team.
Little Zi originally wanted to take in the new cosmic behemoth as its underling, but this cosmic behemoth seemed to be a little too strong. Unless it consumed the power of the world at all costs and summoned the projections of Eleven and the others to help it fight, it definitely couldn’t defeat it.
Such strength wasn’t enough to have an absolute status.
“Wu…” Ling said, “But it seems that with the outcome I’m seeing now, there’s a high chance that this cosmic behemoth will become Beast Shi Yu e s exclusive support. It has nothing to do with you.”
Little Zi: Huh?
“However, you don’t have to worry. Don’t forget, you’re the Star Race, the most special race in the universe. The only race without a bottleneck between the divine and super divine levels.”
“Not long ago, Master and I discussed a growth system that can allow you to obtain battle power that exceeds the other party.”
“Mi!” Little Zi was willing to hear the details.
“Go and beg Teacher Ying. If it’s willing to sign a contract with you, there’s no problem.”
Little Zi learned the Star Contract from Blue Planet. It could sign a contract with any life form and summon their power projections to become its guardian.
There was no restriction on the level of this contracted target. Even if the other party was at the super divine level, Little Zi could still contract it. However, it couldn’t mobilize the other party’s full strength.
“As a member of the Star Prayer Race, Teacher Ying has mastered the power of the Wish Star. If you can become her student, you can borrow her power to a certain extent to make a wish for yourself.”
“You’re a star life form. You can break through to super divine without using the source of transcendence. In theory, it’s the race that’s easiest to rely on external forces to reach super divine battle power. You can temporarily break through the bottleneck through the combination of Teacher Yings Wish Star power and Baby Ginsengs time power and have the battle power of a high-level planet. This way, not many people in the team are your match.”
“No matter what, Teacher Ying is the strongest expert of the Star Prayer Race, an existence that exceeds transcendent 3. As long as you obtain her help, defeating the cosmic behemoth is easy.”
Upon hearing Lings analysis, Little Zi felt that it made sense and immediately ran to cozy up to Teacher Ying.
“Little guy, why are you here?” The gem cat saw that Little Zi had run over to look for it eagerly, as if it had something to ask of it. It couldn’t help but smile lazily.
“l see. You want to sign a contract with me and let me be your guardian?”
“l have to say, you really have good taste.” The gem cat was filled with emotions. Not long ago, she was also a guardian existence in the eyes of all students in Ancient Capital University. However, after seeing Shi Yu, this guy’s entire team regarded her as a hooligan. It was very overboard.
Fortunately, this seaweed rice ball knew who the real backer was and who could really make it stronger.
“Alright, from today onwards, you’re my student. I’ll teach you to become stronger.”
“But I have a condition. In the next team internal competition, you have to get into the top three for me to prove yourself!” The gem cat was excited.
“Mi, Mi!! (Hello, Teacher!)” Little Zi was extremely excited.
The gem cat sighed. As expected, competition within the team was the first motivation for Shi Yu t s team to become stronger. When the cosmic behemoth arrived, this little star was indeed anxious. The subsequent strengthening speed… should be very ridiculous..

“Alright.”

Ling said, “Don’t worry, Little Zi is experimenting with new tactics in the outside world.’

Knock, knock, knock.

Duckie. If it was taken in as a underling, it would definitely have full cards.
Abnormal, abnormal, this team was abnormal. Although it wasn’t interested in planetary life forms, in the past, planetary life forms were afraid to death when they saw it, but why did this guy look like it wanted to eat it up??
“Stop fooling around. Home is more important.” Shi Yu said to Little Zi, “Let’s talk about it in the next team internal competition.”
“The team internal competition? Another god?” Bu Lu said.
“You’ll know in the future. In the next period of time, after getting to know your teammates, you can cultivate with Beast Shi Yu first.”
“You should have sensed its feedback to you too, right??”
“Yes, my physical strength is a little stronger,” it said.
“This is only the beginning. When I study the battle system of the last era carefully, you definitely have more cooperative methods,” Shi Yu said.

However, when it turned around, it immediately saw the purple planet stuck to the window looking at it eagerly.
Bu Lu: “…”
Soon, Bu Lu, who had gotten to know his new teammates, was sent by Shi Yu to meet them.
Through its body control, Bu Lu, who had turned into a little monkey form, entered the welcoming hall of the battleship in fear.
Then, it saw a pile of figures that it had already familiarized itself with just now.

“Hello,” Bu Lu said.
Soon, Bu Lu and his pets mixed around and got to know each other better. They obtained a lot of information that couldn’t be obtained from the resume video.
For example, Baby Ginseng was the team chef who created the Cultivation Fruit and all-purpose delicacies.
For example, Ling was the secretary who supervised everyone’s training plans to become stronger.
Every pet had its own division of labor in the team.

[Combatant X New Generation Transport 4]

chapters.content:

With Bu Lu joining the team, Beast Shi Yu’s cultivation direction became incomparably clear. The pet arms transformation skill that had never been initiated gradually became initiated during the nearly month of travel.

“You’re only an epoch god. You haven’t reached the super divine level. When you break through to the super divine level, together with Beast Shi Yu, you can definitely kill indiscriminately below the cosmic level. An invincible combination.’
“Apart from you, Eleven and the others can’t become weapons even if they want to.”
Buggy still protested. It had seen it all. Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others all had their own Star Arms.
It, on the other hand, was being thought of by the purple stars in the team every day. In the end, it even became a weapon itself. It was unfair!
“Don’t worry, don’t worry. When I’m free, I’ll also help you find a star weapon,” Shi Yu said.

Even with Lings own luck, it might not necessarily be able to encounter the Starry Sky Storm every time to increase its battle power. However, together with Bu Lu’s bad luck, the frequency of the Starry Sky Storm appearing was actually much higher.
Could this be the legendary positive and negative?
It was much more unscientific than negative.
“Therefore, don’t keep talking about your bad luck. Here, everyone is equal.”
“What’s wrong with World King Planet?” After a moment of silence, Bu Lu asked. Why did he say that it wasn’t peaceful over there?
According to its memories, World King Planet should be one of the most peaceful places in the entire universe.
“Eh, didn’t I tell you? I don’t think so…”
“Do you know the sixth cosmic life form?”
“The sixth cosmic life form has appeared again. It seems to be the enemy of the World King and the cosmic overlord. If it wants to take revenge, the first battle will definitely be on the World King Planet.”
“Therefore, the Cosmic Sea and World King Planet won’t be peaceful,” Shi Yu said.
“In addition, you’ve also sensed it, right? A new transcendent origin is about to condense. Generally speaking, the condensation location is the center of the universe, the Cosmic Sea. At that time, the epoch gods of the Contaminated Land, the Behemoth Empire, the Worm Mother Nest, and the overlord territories who have broken through the limit of the divine level will also come here.’
“It’s impossible for the Cosmic Sea to be calm.”
“Moreover, according to the information I obtained, the one who accelerated the condensation of transcendent origins is at the sixth cosmic level. Therefore, it’s obvious that a huge conspiracy is definitely brewing in the Cosmic Sea area.”
“Then let’s go back!” Bu Lu was shocked.
“Why not go back? My mother planet and friends are still over there. Moreover, we have to fight for the birth of a new transcendent origin,” Shi Yu said. “Even if there’s a conspiracy inside, we have to jump.”
“Wu ah!!” The club that Bu Lu had turned into swayed helplessly. Damn it, it had been lying flat for so long. Why did it encounter so many troublesome things the moment it appeared with Shi Yu?
It still wanted to take the initiative to jump into a cosmic-level conspiracy?
Why did it feel that it was also unlucky to have encountered Shi Yu?
“Didn’t you also try to fight for the transcendent origin more than ten times previously but didn’t succeed?”
“l heard from the Spirit Queen that she seemed to have encountered a traffic accident on the way before even arriving at the Cosmic Sea.”
“You’re already so strong, but you’ve never really fought with the epoch gods of the ten thousand races in the starry sky. Wouldn’t you be indignant?”
“This time, it’s rare to have a chance to challenge the myriad races in the starry sky. I’m not looking forward to it.”
“This…” Upon hearing Shi Yu, it would be a lie to say that it wasn’t looking forward to it.
“Alright, let’s go take a look first,” Bu Lu said. “However, transform me back first! ”
After a few days, Shi Yu and the others finally arrived at the edge of the Cosmic Sea.
After arriving, Shi Yu let Buggy sense it and his mind became active.
“Little ones,” Shi Yu shouted. “Come back”
“Next, I’ll let Buggy directly teleport us to World King Planet through the magnetic line,”
In the magnetic field, Shi Yu had replicated the skill from the Teleportation Master on the Assassin Planet. In theory, the upper limit of this skill’s teleportation distance was even further than the Hole of the Universe, but in other aspects, it was inferior to the Hole of the Universe..

For example, it was easy to be interrupted. Before seeing the cosmic overlord, he didn’t even know that a sixth cosmic life form had appeared. This guy actually knew.
“Of course, this isn’t the most important thing. Most importantly, according to the Exposing King, the sixth cosmic life form should be a ‘female’. It’s so brave. It even dares to say this. If it’s wrong, won’t it be killed by the cosmic life form?” the little white dragon said..

chapters.content:

Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“It’s indeed brave.’
After hearing what the little white dragon said, Shi Yu couldn’t help but admire the Exposing King.
No matter what his goal was… It was fine if he exposed divine and super divine levels, but he actually dared to talk nonsense about the cosmic life form. Ha!
Cosmic-level life forms were all indescribable existences. This guy was actually still discussing other people’s gender.

Ask him.

“On them is the protective talisman given by Senior Space Emperor. The Space Emperor sensed that something had happened to them, so he hurriedly rushed to the Yu Nie Realm.”
Shi Yu’s expression also changed. “Something happened to Senior Empress and Senior?”
If he had known earlier, he would have directly gotten Buggy to lock onto Senior Lu. Unfortunately, Buggy was already lying down and didn’t have any strength. It was soaking in Baby Ginseng’s medicinal bath to recover.
“Don’t worry, Senior Space Emperor went over. The problem isn’t very big. The Space Emperor said that their protective talisman wasn’t destroyed, which means that the danger isn’t that fatal.”
“Moreover, apart from Senior Wang Kong’s protective talisman, they also have the protective talisman given by Emperor Shi.”
Shi Yu said, “That’s good. Senior Lin Feng, I’ll go over too. Look after the two major domains.”
“Alright.” Lin Feng nodded and said, “Go take a look.”
As soon as he finished speaking, a special hole appeared in front of Shi Yu. Seeing this hole, Lin Feng was stunned.
When Yu entered, he reacted and said, “The Hole of the Universe??”

At the first- level realm, around the Yu Nie Realm.
Era ruin, outside the nirvana ruin.
The golden -haired Lu Qingyi in a black trench coat and Empress Huang Xi, who was wearing a white dress and had orange-red long hair, were in a spatial barrier.
Outside the barrier, the Space Emperor Kong was also wearing white clothes and had black hair that fluttered in the wind. His super divine pressure emitted as he looked straight at the young man opposite him.
However, the young man opposite wasn’t at a disadvantage in the face of Wang Kong’s deterrence at all. He was extremely calm.
There were still many people around the ruins here, and there were even super divine levels paying attention to the current situation.

The two handsome women cracked this era ruin and became the owners of the ruins.
But soon, an unfamiliar powerful young man stopped them from taking away the ruins.
Both parties started fighting.
“What do you mean?” The Space Emperor looked straight at the young man in front of him with a sullen expression and surprise.
He could sense that the young man in front of him was definitely not a super divine. He was only at the divine level, but he could actually destroy the barrier he created to this extent… At the same time, his expression didn’t change in the face of his pressure.
The Space Emperor instantly understood that the person in front of him should be a Beast Tamer who had broken through the limit of the divine level.
Perhaps it had reached the eleventh heavenly layer of the divine level like Shi Yu.
Moreover, the pet definitely had the strength of the epoch god. Otherwise, it would definitely not be so easy to face him.
The reason why the Space Emperor guessed this was because of the recent revelation of the Exposure King.
According to the Exposing King, many sleeping ancient geniuses woke up one after another and prepared to compete for transcendent origins. The person in front of them might be one of them.
“This ruin is my item. Leave the ruin and you can leave.”

The black-haired young man stared at the Space Emperor and at the two women who had cracked the ruins in the barrier. He was also very surprised.
Firstly, it was an accident. The nirvana ruins was actually cracked by such a weak pair of people.
After all, even he had spent many years to crack this ruin.

Fortunately, he felt that the Space Emperor wasn’t strong.

“So what if I am? What can you do?” The black-haired young man smiled and said, “You guys are nothing.”
“I announced my sovereignty over this ruin 1.2 million years ago. They casually cracked the nirvana ruins without my agreement. I haven’t held them accountable.”
“I took advantage of my sleep to steal my ruins and disturb my bitter cultivation. If I don’t punish them, I’ll be considered kind.”
“This guy…” In the barrier, Huang Xi’s expression was unfriendly and filled with killing intent.
The nirvana ruins had been ownerless for so many years and no one had cracked it. How did it become his?
“The other party isn’t weak. Senior Space Emperor might encounter a fierce battle.” Lu Qingyi was silent.
However, this ruin was very rare and couldn’t be given up.
“So, are you sure you want to be our enemy?” The Space Emperor issued a final warning.
At that moment, many people around had already determined the identities of the Space Emperor, Huang Xi, and Lu Qingyi. “Floating Realm realm lord, Space Emperor Kong.” “Empress of the Dong Huang Realm, Huang Xi.”
“Dong Huang Realm, Lu Qingyi.’ “Good lord, this young man is so bold to actually provoke the Blue Planet.”

“After all, the Blue Planet… But even that Assassin Planet…

didn’t expect you to be quite famous.”

When I dominated the World King Planet, you might not have been born yet.”
“Reincarnator, Zhou Lan.”
“Gentlemen, if you want to fight, can you stay away from my domain?
Boom!
When the mysterious young man faced the Space Emperor, another super divine aura flowed.
The realm lord of the Yu Nie Realm, a super divine expert of the Holy Feather Race, descended.
He looked like an angel, had six wings that shone with light, and was wearing a holy pure white shirt. When he descended, he looked at Zhou Lan and said.
“I thought it was someone else. Why do you have to care about my business? Zhou Lan saw the realm lord of the Yu Nie Realm descend and said bluntly.
At this moment, the surrounding people fell silent.
Who exactly was this young man named Zhou Lan?
He actually spoke bluntly to the super divine realm lord.
Why had they never heard of this person’s existence before?
“I remember!!!” Suddenly, in the void, someone said, “I don’t know the name Zhou Lan, but I have an impression of the title ‘reincarnator’.”
“The other party has an era ruin that can constantly be reborn. It’s said that even super divine-level experts can’t kill him!”
“But the strange thing is that the reborn clearly have very strong strength, but they don’t break through to the super divine level. They keep appearing with divine-level strength.”
“He’s actually still alive… No, or rather, he appeared again.”
Upon hearing that someone knew Zhou Lan, many people who paid attention were in an uproar.
“He probably hasn’t broken through to the super divine level in order to fuse with the transcendent origin. No wonder he’s so arrogant. So it’s a guy with a heart at the cosmos level. I’ve indeed heard of his name in a few battles,” a super divine realm lord from the surrounding realms muttered.
“Hehe, I’m doing this for your own good.” The realm lord of the Yu Nie Realm had a calm expression. When he wasn’t a super divine, he had already heard of the power of this reborn person. He was also considered a new super divine, but this reborn person was even older than him, Elder Gu.
Moreover, the rumors about him were also true.
Because he had become the owner of a special ruin, even super divine experts couldn’t completely kill him. After killing him, he would also be reborn in a certain place. It was also because of this that he could constantly compete to transcend the origin without any fear, in order to become a super divine in the most perfect posture.
Therefore, there was no point in killing him at all. If they wanted to completely kill him, they had to crack the mechanism of his era ruins. Even peak super divine experts who weren’t expert archeologists couldn’t do this.
However, the reason why the Yu Nie Realm realm lord appeared was firstly because he didn’t want a huge battle to happen around his realm. Secondly, this newly awakened reborn person didn’t seem to know the power of the Blue Planet bloodline.
Although it might still not be able to completely kill him, it was still easy to kill him several times.
However, seeing that Zhou Lan wasn’t polite to him at all, the Yu Nie Realm realm lord didn’t want to interfere.
He knew that it wasn’t easy to make Zhou Lan let go. This nirvana ruins that had been cracked by those two little girls was similar to the effect of the nirvana ruins that Zhou Lan had. It was suspected to be related to the ruins and had always been chosen by Zhou Lan. He had long announced his sovereignty and cracked it alone. He didn’t expect that before he could successfully crack it, it would be completed by someone who came later than him.
“Whether it’s a reborn or a reincarnator, you can stay today.” The Space Emperor no longer wanted to waste his breath. No matter what, the other party had already violated the forbidden by attacking the Beast Tamer of Dong Huang unreasonably.
Originally, the battle of the Assassin Planet had already made no Beast Tamer on Blue Planet dare to provoke it, but now, these sleeping and awakening ancient geniuses seemed to have to be intimidated again..

Otherwise, all the hard work he had done previously would be in vain.

who?”

“Looks like I’m not too late.” Shi Yu looked at the confrontation between the Space Emperor and Zhou Lan and closed his eyes slightly. Then, he opened them again and said, “I more or less know what’s going on.”
“Leave this to me to settle.”
Shi Yu l s appearance undoubtedly shocked everyone.
Shi Yu l s reputation was much greater than the Space Emperor. First, it was the King of Gods, then the live broadcast of the Assassin Planet. Then, it was the promotion of the Environmental Protection Association, making Shi Yu the most famous divine-level now.
Because he had the battle record of hunting super divines, his reputation was even greater than the new super divine, the Space Emperor.
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the reborn with a burning gaze. The reborn narrowed his eyes and landed on the Nirvana Fire Phoenix, looking at Shi Yu.
“And who are you?
“You’re also a rising star on World King Star?”
“The first thing a guy who has failed in so many competitions to transcend the origin will do after waking up is to show off his extremely pitiful strength?” Shi Yu said.
“The 11th heavenly layer is nothing. M/hat’s there to be arrogant about?”
Shi Yu l s words were undoubtedly more ear-piercing than anything Zhou Lan had ever heard. Not to mention Zhou Lan, even Bu Lu in the Beast Taming Space felt uncomfortable hearing it. It felt that Shi Yu was also cursing it!
This Beast Tamer was pretty good in everything, but unfortunately, he had a mouth.
“Do you know what you’re saying?” Zhou Lan’s expression instantly darkened, and killing intent filled the air.
After failing many times in the competition to transcend the origin and constantly dying and being reborn, his hostility became very heavy.
Shi Yu said, “I’ll give you a chance. Tell me quickly if you have any big boss behind you.”
“If there is, I’ll spare your life.”
“If there isn’t, you’ll end here.”
As he spoke, countless people cursed under their breaths. As expected, the
King of Gods, Shi Yu, was unethical. He actually said things without integrity.
“This is a genius Beast Tamer who exceeded the limit of the divine level millions of years ago, fighting the most dazzling divine-level Beast Tamer in the Cosmic Sea now?
“A huge battle is about to happen!’
Zhou Lan and Shi Yu’s confrontation immediately made everyone’s hearts skip a beat as they focused.
Who was stronger?
()n one side, it was a terrifying ancient genius who had broken through the limit of the divine level and was suspected to have contracted the epoch god.
On one side, it was the strongest new star in the Cosmic Sea, the King of Gods who had the battle record of hunting an abyss super divine…
“Eleven, give them a hit.” Although it was said to give the other party a chance, Shi Yu l s attack command followed. Eleven directly stepped on Shi Yu l s shoulder and leaped up, materializing a bamboo stick.
It directly smashed towards the other party.
Everyone only heard the roar of a Behemoth. Accompanied by a green staff shadow and a black and white figure, an unbelievable scene appeared.
Boom.
Even the space of the surrounding realms seemed to tremble. The sky and ground trembled violently at the same time. That was caused by Eleven’s attack. Its staff directly made the opponent’s pupils shrink and he hurriedly resisted. However, how could the difference in strength be so easy to resist? Under Zhou Lan’s incredulous expression, the shock wave directly shattered this Zhou Lan’s Beast Taming Space and turned the Nirvana Fire Phoenix into a blood mist with a staff. If Zhou Lan didn’t have the protection of the Nirvana Fire Phoenix, he would have already become dregs in the starry sky.
“Pfft.” However, even with the protection of his pet, he still suffered incomparable injuries. The Beast Taming Space was directly shattered. Under the protection of endless flames, he fell to the ground like a kite with a broken string, and blood dyed the sky.
The surrounding perfect divines and super divines were stunned. They sensed the terrifying spatial aftermath attacking them and revealed shocked expressions.
“So weak.” In the sky, Eleven’s figure was clear. It, who was holding a bamboo stick, revealed a dissatisfied expression.
Transcendent Battle God BodY+Star Refinement+Weapon Control… There was no need for any other fancy operations to launch an attack that was enough to instantly kill ordinary super divines..

chapters.title: Chapter 1717 - 1717: Enemies on a Narrow Road (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1717: Enemies on a Narrow Road (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Zhou Lan might only be a little stronger than the little girl in her twenties in the cosmic overlord army. Her talent was far inferior to the other party. Shi Yu naturally didn’t feel any pressure to beat her up.
However, in the eyes of others, this scene was extremely unbelievable. The surrounding super divines watched everything in shock. What a joke.
Which genius who broke through the limit of the divine level wasn’t an existence with peerless talent? Which cosmic life form that could become an epoch god wasn’t an absolute king among the myriad races in the starry sky? The scene in front of them really caught them off guard.
What happened…
“Damn it.” Even the Space Emperor widened his eyes and looked at Shi Yu and Eleven in the sky in confusion.
“Shi Yu, he…” Huang Xi and Lu Qingyi were also a little confused by Eleven’s attack.
The current miserable state of Zhou Lan was simply worlds apart from her confident expression just now.
“You’re not afraid of death, right?”
Shi Yu looked down and directly activated the Passage of Time with the
support of source power.
In his gaze, he could clearly see that a mysterious era power protected the origin of Zhou Lan and the Nirvana Fire Phoenix.
This power of the era was very difficult to capture. Even super divine experts found it extremely difficult to affect. Unfortunately, they encountered him.
Shi Yu stretched out his hand and squeezed in the air. With a boom, the power of the era that protected Zhou Lan and the Nirvana Fire Phoenix’s origin disappeared.
On the ground, Zhou Lan, who was bleeding from all seven apertures, suddenly panicked as she lost control of the era ruins.
“Eleven, hit it again,” Shi Yu said. In the sky, the familiar Iron-eating Beast King, Eleven, who had defeated Zavay, howled. It raised its bamboo stick and was about to continue smashing it at Zhou Lan.
It seemed that it wasn’t enough to smash a Nirvana Fire Phoenix to death. It wanted to completely shatter Beast Tamers and pets.
“Wuu!!”
Eleven fell from the sky and suddenly smashed the staff at Zhou Lan in the huge pit on the ground. If nothing went wrong, this staff was enough to change the terrain here.
However, to everyone’s surprise, at this moment, the extremely arrogant Zhou Lan began to ask for help. As he asked for help, the equipment on his body instantly shattered.
Even when he was almost smashed to death by a staff just now, he didn’t choose to ask for help. He thought that the ruins could protect him and allow him to be reborn to hide from this ridiculous guy. However, as the ruins were cracked by Shi Yu, he completely panicked.
This was the first time he had encountered such a strange person.
“Master, save me,” he shouted. Eleven’s rod didn’t smash down.
A red light ball that seemed to have a powerful repulsive force appeared between Eleven’s bamboo stick and Zhou Lan. This light ball kept flickering, sending Eleven flying back to Shi Yu’s side.
In the next moment, with a sparrow cry, the phantom of a Vermillion Bird filled the sky.
The Vermillion Bird phantom flickered with the light of the red flame and emitted a powerful aura. The fire patterns formed five dazzling suns in the sky.
Seeing this phantom, everyone revealed looks of disbelief.
“Vermillion Bird super divine,” Realm Lord Yu Nie and the other super divines said in disbelief.
The master of a reborn person was the Four Saints super divine of the Four
HOIY rarn11Y(
At this moment, the phantom of the Vermillion Bird super divine was summoned and was also very silent.
It also instantly knew the cause and effect. It couldn’t help but feel that it was ridiculous.
“Master.” On the ground, Zhou Lan kept coughing blood and begging for help. His face was pale, unable to understand why the strange person opposite him could ignore his era ruins.
“Vermillion Bird super divine?” Shi Yu was also very surprised.
He knew that as a genius at the 11th heavenly layer of the divine level, it was impossible for him not to have the support of some faction.
However, this faction was the Vermillion Bird Family, one of the Four Holy Family. Shi Yu really didn’t expect it.
Not only him, but the surrounding super divines also didn’t know that behind the reborn was actually the Four Holy Vermillion Birds.
This was because the reborn had never obtained the protection of the Vermillion Bird Family in the past when competing to transcend the origin. They fought alone.
“Shi Yu.” The Vermillion Bird super divine phantom looked at Shi Yu and focused.
Killing intent rose in his heart. He felt that enemies were bound to meet on a narrow road.
Shi Yu was too much.
First, it coveted the Four Holy Ruins, and then it coveted the ruins of the person it had cultivated.
However, Emperor Shi of the Blue Planet behind Shi Yu was indeed not easy to deal with.
Initially, the Four Holy Family was prepared to deal with this matter coldly, but they didn’t expect that as a cultivator, he would have a conflict with the Blue Planet bloodline just as he woke up. This gave the Vermillion Bird super divine a headache.
They felt that they were from the Blue Planet everywhere.
“l don’t want to hear you talk. This is the second time, right?” Shi Yu faced the Vermillion Bird super divine directly. This time, he wasn’t afraid at all.
Not to mention a clone phantom, with his current strength, he wasn’t afraid even if the Four Saints super divine main body came.
This Four Holy Family… Shi Yu was also angry this time. It was fine if they first assassinated him because of the Four Holy Ruins, but now, they were actually behind Zhou Lan again.
Damn it.
If it were other super divines, Shi Yu might have given face and only shattered the other party once before giving up, but now…
“Eleven, smash them,” Shi Yu ordered, completely shocking the surrounding spectators. They didn’t expect Shi Yu to ignore the Vermillion Bird super divine and still attack Zhou Lan.
“Shi Yu, you’re too much. Don’t force me to descend with my true body.” The Vermillion Bird super divine was also burning with anger at this moment. It wanted to stop Shi Yu, but its body was only an illusion and its strength was limited.
“I’ve thought about it. There’s no need for you to descend. I’ll visit personally in a few days.”
“It’s time to settle the matter of your Four Holy Family hiring the Assassin Planet to assassinate me.’
“l want to initiate a transcendent duel with the four of you. 1 hope you can respond to me as soon as possible.”
As Shi Yu’s voice fell, Yin Yang lightning wrapped around the Eleven Metal Bamboo Rod. It directly activated One Thought of God and Demon and smashed with all its might.
“Roar! This time, Eleven turned into lightning and directly shattered the Vermillion Bird super divine phantom in one hit. Under the incredulous expression of the Vermillion Bird super divine, it completely smashed an abyss here along the phantom, completely turning the reborn into dregs. Only a ruin tool floated in the void and was grabbed by Shi Yu.
The entire place was silent, wondering if they had heard wrongly.
“Transcendent duel??” Realm Lord Yu Nie was stunned.
“Shi Yu!” The Space Emperor was also shocked.
The supreme duel was an agreed-upon duel method on the World King Planet. It was a life-and-death duel witnessed by a peak super divine expert under the World King.
Usually, it was released from the divine level to the super divine level, and not all divine levels were qualified to release it, but Shi Yu was undoubtedly qualified.
As everyone knew, transcendent origins were rare, and the source of transcendence in the ruins of the era was also difficult to find. The easiest way for divine-level life forms to advance to super divine was to hunt other super divines and obtain the source of transcendence.
However, every divine level and super divine had a complicated faction behind them. If they fought each other, it would definitely cause the people of the World King Planet to be plunged into misery and suffering, causing huge chaos, causing many innocent lives to be implicated.
Therefore, such a duel method was born. It was only a duel between divine-level and super divine-level parties. It was both victory and defeat, as well as life and death. At the same time, the grudges didn’t involve the factions behind both parties. The super divine-level experts under the World King and the entire World King Planet witnessed the whole process.
At this moment, no one expected Shi Yu to actually mention the supreme transcendent duel to the four super divines of the Four Holy Families at this moment. Moreover, he wanted to challenge four super divines in a row!
After all, ordinary divine-levels basically chose super-divine duels that exceeded transcendent 1. Shi Yu actually directly chose four super divines that exceeded transcendent 4 to 6. Was he crazy? Of course, Shi Yu wasn’t crazy. He purely felt that his current strength was enough. Ever since he was assassinated for the first time, he had long started preparing for this duel.
He wanted to use the Four Holy Family to give Buggy, Chi Tong, Shorty, Turtle, and Little Quas to directly ascend to the God Realm of the era and change the Four Saints system of the World King Planet!

chapters.title: Chapter 1718 - 1718: Inviting You In (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1718: Inviting You In (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Outside Yu Nie Realm.
This place had attracted many people because of the commotion of the era ruins. Shi Yu’s high-profile announcement here was almost no different from announcing the entire World King Planet.
In the sky, Shi Yu stood in the air. Eleven held the green bamboo and took a fierce bite.
“Crack! ”
It was as if it was saying that the peerless divine weapon that could instantly kill a divine level expert at the 11th heavenly layer and an epoch god was only its food.
Everyone present, including Senior Lu and Huang Xi, looked at Shi Yu in shock.
Transcendent duel…
Was Shi Yu serious?
No one expected that the competition for the era ruins here would evolve into a transcendent challenge between the most famous rookie on the current World King Planet and the older generation of super divine experts.
“l, the realm lord of the Dong Huang Realm, Shi Yu, initiate a ‘transcendent duel’ with the Green Dragon family’s Green Dragon super divine, the
Vermillion Bird family’s Vermillion Bird super divine, the White Tiger family’s White Tiger super divine, and the Black Tortoise family’s Black Tortoise super divine.’
“In order to consolidate your position as a faith super divine, the Four Holy Family has been cooperating with the Assassin Planet for a long time to assassinate evolvers with potential. I’m one of them.”
“A few years ago, I cracked the Four Holy Ruins and mastered the evolution path of the Four Holy Ruins. The Four Holy super divines were afraid and didn’t dare to do it personally because of my identity, so they hired the Assassin Planet assassin to get rid of me.”
“But due to the insufficient strength of the assassins on the Assassin Planet, I killed them instead. Then, in the battle of the Assassin Planet that everyone is familiar with, in this battle, I finally confirmed the dirty side of the Four Saints super divine.”
“Although the Four Holy Family has repeatedly denied it, the evidence is conclusive. It’s time to end the faith monopoly of the Four Saints super divine.’
“Since the Four Saints are so afraid of the birth of a new Four Saints super divine and are competing with them for faith, next, I’ll bet my life to challenge their divine positions one after another and rewrite the Four Saints system of the World King Planet.”
“l hope they won’t refuse my ‘transcendent duel’ because they’re afraid.”
“This ‘transcendent duel’ only represents the grudge between me and the Four Saints super divine. It doesn’t involve other factions. It’s both a competition of strength and life and death. I hope to obtain Lord World Kings gaze and carry out a public duel!”
Shi Yu announced in a high-profile manner here. Without a doubt, the hidden busybody broadcasted the entire process and released it.
World King Planet trembled!
In the world where the Vermillion Bird Family was.
His anger directly ignited the sky of a realm.
The sky that was filled with fire and blood made all the creatures in the entire realm tremble.
“Super divine anger.”
Sensing huge anger, countless creatures in the realm where the Vermillion Bird super divine was raised their heads in panic and looked at the sky. “Who offended the Vermillion Bird super divine?”
As an existence that exceeded transcendent 5, as one of the most perfect evolvers who had evolved towards the Four Saints of the previous era, it had been a long time since anyone dared to provoke Its dignity.
“Shi Yu, you’re dead.”
The Vermillion Bird super divine roared. It didn’t expect Shi Yu to be so bold.
It actually dared to ignore its will and attack its cultivator. It even dared to challenge it to a “transcendent duel” without knowing the immensity of heaven and earth.
A divine-level sending a “transcendent duel” to a super divine level was definitely a big matter that was enough to alarm the World King Planet.
Therefore, soon, the races in the realm where the Vermillion Bird super divine was located knew why the Vermillion Bird super divine was so angry. At the same time, they felt that it was unbelievable.
“Is this King of Gods crazy?”
Transcendent duel. This was a duel issued by the divine level with the determination to definitely kill the super divine. The King of Gods, Shi Yu, was using the Vermillion Bird super divine as a hunting target, hoping to step on its corpse and advance to the super divine level!
This was no different from provoking the dignity of a super divine expert… The hatred between the two parties had really reached this point?
Not only in the realm where the Vermillion Bird super divine was, but also in the various realms of the World King Planet, experts were shocked.
From President Saatchi and the other official figures of the God Sealing Committee to the God Sealing Battle geniuses like Zavay, Ming Gu, and the son of the Demon Emperor, Tian Shang, everyone on the World King Planet was in turmoil and felt that it was unbelievable.
In the Floating Realm, Lin Feng was originally waiting for information. He didn’t expect to receive a notification from his subordinates. Then, the corners of Lin Fengs mouth twitched as he saw the live broadcast of Shi Yu declaring war on the Four Saints super divine.
“Crazy guy.” Many experts unrelated to Shi Yu and the Four Holy Family couldn’t help but sigh.
They didn’t care about the cause and effect, but Shi Yu’s actions were undoubtedly shocking.
Challenging powerful super divines who had transcended more than four times at the divine level, moreover, challenging four in a row, how crazy was this?
Not to mention the divine level, even existences at the same level as the Four Saints super divine wouldn’t have this heart, right?
“It can’t be helped. The Four Holy Family is really going too far. According to what I know, Lu Qingyi and Huang Xi from the Dong Huang Realm successfully cracked the nirvana ruins, but at this moment, the disciple of the Vermillion Bird super divine came to snatch it. Many people saw this.”
“If what Shi Yu said is true, the Vermillion Bird family is simply carved from the same mold. They’re too arrogant and despotic. Shi Yu might really be unable to tolerate it anymore, although he was indeed a little rash.”
Many people had witnessed the nirvana ruins and couldn’t fake it. No one felt that Shi Yu was lying about the Assassin Planet.
If it weren’t for the fact that he was really assassinated, why would Shi Yu offend a huge monster like the Four Holy Family?
However, although they were willing to believe Shi Yu, Shi Yu’s challenge action was still too ridiculous in everyone’s eyes.
No one knew where Shi Yu’s confidence came from. They only treated him as someone who had been blinded by anger and couldn’t control himself this time..

chapters.title: Chapter 1719 - 1719: Inviting You In (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1719 - 1719: Inviting You In (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Not to mention outsiders, even their own people were the same.
At the same time, Shi Yu, who had shocked the entire World King Planet, had already brought the Space Emperor and the others back to the Floating Realm through the ultimate hole.
“Ahhh, it exploded.” The moment he returned, Lin Feng said with a toothache, “Shi Yu, why did you go over?”
“Shi Yu, you’re too rash,” the Space Emperor couldn’t help but say after returning.
“Isn’t it too early to fall out with the Four Holy Family?” the Empress and Lu Qingyi said.
After all, even including Emperor Shi previously, the Blue Planet lineage was also very afraid of the foundation of the Four Holy Family and didn’t easily fall out.
But this time, because of the nirvana ruins, Shi Yu actually directly challenged the Four Saints super divine…
“I’m not rash. Do I look like someone who’s prone to rashness?” Shi Yu smiled and said, “l purely feel that this is a good opportunity.”
“l won’t do anything I’m not confident in.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, Lin Feng wondered if he had heard wrongly.
“You mean that you’re confident of defeating the Four Saints super divine?” “Yes.” Shi Yu nodded heavily.
It was precisely because Shi Yu was so confident that the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, the Empress, Senior Lu, and the others had blank expressions.
Especially the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, their brains rumbled.
It was fine if Shi Yu grew quickly below the divine level or even the super divine level.
However, wasn’t it a little too much to directly go from the strongest quasi divine to an existence that could defeat a transcendent 6 in three to four years?
Even novels didn’t dare to write like this.
“Wu wu wu.” At this moment, Eleven tried to seek its presence on Shi Yu’s shoulder.
Seeing Eleven, the Space Emperor was speechless again. The feeling that Zhou Lan gave him was that even if he could win, it would take a lot of effort.
Moreover, he might not necessarily be able to perfectly kill the other party.
However, everyone clearly saw Shi Yu t s performance just now. Eleven directly insta-killed Zhou Lan and the others in an extremely brutal manner with a stick. Moreover, Shi Yu casually restricted the other party’s ruins and even ignored the Vermillion Bird super divine phantom to forcefully kill the other party.
The Space Emperor asked himself. Unless he had a pet that had also reached the super divine level and both parties worked together, it was very difficult to do this.
And this… was only Eleven’s own strength. Shi Yu had yet to even increase Eleven’s strength, and Shi Yu’s other pets had yet to appear.
“What exactly did you guys do on this trip…” Lin Feng was numb. He didn’t think that Shi Yu would lie about such an important thing, but… it was still difficult to understand.
“The greatest gain might be seeing the cosmic overlord’s main body. Eleven even broke through as an epoch god under the deterrence of the cosmic overlord.’
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng: ???
“So, there’s no need to worry.”
“We even withstood the deterrence of the cosmic overlord. The Four Saints super divine won’t be our match,” Shi Yu said. In order to reassure the Space Emperor and the others, the spatial phantom of the 13th heavenly layer gradually appeared behind him.
Seeing the layers of the Beast Taming Space, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, the Empress, Senior Lu, and the others revealed ridiculous expressions.
“Divine level… 13th heavenly layer??”
“That’s it.” Shi Yu retracted the phenomenon and smiled. “Now, you guys finally believe that I have the ability to fight the Four Saints super divines, right?”
“l can say clearly that this isn’t all my trump cards now.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the Space Emperor and the others were silent. To be honest, they didn’t know how powerful the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level was, but this unbelievable scene indeed made them have some confidence in Shi Yu…
“We can definitely win, right?” Senior Lu asked.
“Don’t worry, we can definitely win,” Shi Yu said. “Don’t dwell on this.”
“By the way, Senior Empress, Senior Lu, what are the ruins you cracked?” Shi Yu asked.
After a moment of silence, Lu Qingyi said, “After the nirvana ruins recognize its master, it’s equivalent to a tool that can be revived. Before its power is exhausted, it can allow the user to revive multiple times.”
“Senior Empress revived in an extremely special way. In addition to my support, we happened to crack this ruin…”
“No wonder Zhou Lan cares so much about this ruin. The rebirth ruin I snatched from him also had the effect of reviving previously,” Shi Yu said.
It was probably because of this that Zhou Lan could have such strength.
Shi Yu looked at the ruins in his hand and said, “Unfortunately, the one in
Zhou Lan’s hand was directly broken after the Beast Tamer who recognized it as his master died.’
He casually threw the broken nirvana ruins to Senior Lu and Senior Empress and said, “You guys can study it.”
“Wait, 1 think… you need this thing more now. This nirvana ruins thinks that I’m its master now. I don’t know how to remove it. Next, you and 1 will study it together. If this nirvana ruins changes its ownership to you, your chances of survival in the transcendent duel will be higher…” Huang Xi said when she saw Shi Yu throw the nirvana ruins over.
It didn’t matter about the ruins. The key was Shi Yu’s transcendent duel. “No.” The Space Emperor said, “The transcendent duel is a battle that will definitely determine life and death. As long as the duel is established, the loser will definitely be killed. If you use other methods to escape death, you will be hunted by a peak super divine inquisitor.”
“Therefore, once it’s established, we can only win and not lose. This is also the cruelest aspect of the transcendent duel..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1720 - 1720: Inviting You In (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1720 - 1720: Inviting You In (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Yes, don’t worry about me,” Shi Yu said. “If I have the time to study the nirvana ruins, 1 should still think of a way to increase my strength before the duel. The approval of the World King Planet for the transcendent duel shouldn’t be that fast. According to past practice, I won’t be able to fight for at least a year and a half. During this period of time, 1 can still sprint for strength.”
“But.”
“No buts. Next, let’s wait and see,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“l gave the Four Holy Family a reasonable way to kill me for nothing. They will definitely cherish this opportunity.”
“If you miss this opportunity, there won’t be a next time…”
Emperor Kong said, “No matter what, I should think of a way to contact Senior Emperor Shi first. I also have to tell the five super divines about the situation. They’re all on Blue Planet…”
Lin Feng said, “If you tell them, won’t you scare them to death…”
“Actually, my intention of issuing the transcendent duel was to not involve others. It’s better if you don’t work. Leave this matter to me to handle,” Shi Yu said.
“There’s no need to contact Senior Emperor Shi. There’s even no need to tell the super divines of the five divine races.”
“In the next few days, I’ll be deeply preparing for battle. You don’t have to worry. Just manage the Floating Realm and the Dong Huang Realm well.”
“I’m not talking to you anymore. Let’s go. If we continue, it’ll be a waste of time to prepare for battle.” Seeing that they still looked like they wanted to help, Shi Yu directly teleported and left, leaving the Space Emperor and the others speechless for a long time.
“Forget it, believe him…” Lin Feng said.
“Yes, he indeed won’t do anything he’s not confident in,” Lu Qingyi said. However, the rules of the transcendent duel were just lying to herself.
If Shi Yu really died in the transcendent duel, how could it not involve others? Even she would fight the Four Holy Family to the death until the destruction of the Four Holy Family.
Of course, Lu Qingyi still believed that Shi Yu could definitely win.
Next, Shi Yu returned to the Dong Huang Realm. Since he wanted to challenge the Four Saints super divine, he naturally had to make sufficient preparations. “How is it, Bu Lu? Is it exciting!” After returning, Shi Yu said to Bu Lu, who was using a new transportation tool.
As expected of a cosmic behemoth. It felt good to use it, like any door.
“Exciting…” The cosmic behemoth Bu Lu was depressed. As expected, its Beast Tamer was a lunatic.
It had heard of the Four Saints super divine. They were four very ancient super divines.
Just as he returned with Shi Yu, Shi Yu wanted to have a life-and-death duel with them. Ten thousand Iron-eating Beasts rolled across Bu Lu’s heart.
It felt that the probability of encountering life-and-death danger beside Shi Yu was higher than it being alone.
“Now I know why my bad luck can’t counter you. You don’t have to be countered at all. You’re looking for trouble every day,” Bu Lu said.
“I’m asking you if you dare to fight.”
“Fight!” Bu Lu said. “You just said that they tried to assassinate you, right?”
“You’re my Beast Tamer. No matter who the enemy is, we’re all together.”
“So what if they’re super divine? I’ll directly turn them into sticks and beat them to death!!” Bu Lu said.
It might not be able to defeat the Four Saints super divine itself, but with Beast Shi Yu, it was fearless.
It had really never fought a super divine that had transcended the middle stage.
“Wu        wu!!” Eleven praised Bu Lu.
“That’s enough.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I’ll give you a surprise in two days.”
Bu Lu: Huh??
Shi Yu planned to pull the other skills of the cosmic behemoth to transcendence.
It only had four skills that had transcendence, but it was already so strong. If those dozen or so control skills reached transcendence, its strength might be able to leap even faster than Eleven and the others.
Coupled with Beast Shi Yu, it would definitely kill indiscriminately.
Of course, this was only one of Shi Yu’s many battle plans. When all the battle plans were completed, forget about transcendent 5, even if it was transcendent 6, he was confident that he could kill it with one hit.
“Alright, let’s get busy with other things first,” Shi Yu said.
“Teacher Ying, Teacher Owl.” Shi Yu invited the two cat teachers who had watched the whole process out.
“Ah.” At this moment, the two cats were also a little depressed. They didn’t expect Shi Yu to do such an exciting thing again just after returning.
“Tell us, what do you want us to do?” The gem cat sighed. It already knew that Shi Yu was about to start preparing for battle.
Moreover, he had to pull them along to help.
“Teacher Ying, help make a wish. I heard that the Black Tortoise family’s Black Tortoise super divine is good at divination. I’m afraid that it will divine its own death and is unwilling to accept the challenge. Even the other Four Saint super divines are afraid. Although the chances aren’t high… Please interfere with the divination of the others with Teacher Owl.’
“You don’t have to worry about that,” Teacher Owl said. “Ever since you contracted that Beast Shi Yu, not everyone can observe fate anymore. With that old turtle’s ability, he definitely can’t divine anything. However, it’s not impossible for us to jointly affect it. Perhaps we can give the other party a wrong judgment. ”
“Alright, there’s one more thing,” Shi Yu said. “I want to know more information about the Four Saints super divine and even the Four Holy
Family. As the saying goes, know yourself and the enemy, and you’ll win a hundred battles.’
“So… help me find out who the Exposing King is. This guy is so powerful, its information network must be very powerful. Find its identity and we’ll make a deal with it.”
“Sure!!” The owl said, “However, I reckon 1 have to borrow the power of the family’s treasure. I’ll contact my brother..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1721 - 1721: Inviting You In (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1721 - 1721: Inviting You In (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
With that said, the owl took out a crystal ball and knocked on it. Then, the profile picture of a ratman appeared in the crystal ball.
As soon as this ratman spoke, it let out a furious voice.
“Sister, what are you guys doing? I’ve heard it all. Shi Yu, why are you launching a transcendent duel with the Four Saints super divine?”
“Who should I ask?” the owl said.
“Does he want to die? That’s the Four Saints super divine.”
“Patriarch Tu Tu, don’t panic. I’m definitely confident enough to issue a challenge,” Shi Yu said with a smile as he looked at the crystal ball.
“Come and help us. We plan to predict the true identity of the Exposing King. The Exposing King should know a lot of information about the abilities of the Four Saints super divines. We need to cooperate with it.”
“Ah, this.” Patriarch Tu Tu never expected that it would even attract trouble for itself.
“It’s very difficult. How can the identity of the Exposing King be so easy to investigate?” it said.
The owl said, “Don’t worry, let me tell you. Did you see the cat beside you? We successfully found the other four Wish Stars on this trip to the overlord territory. She has already reached transcendent 3 and is the strongest Star Prayer Race in history. Coupled with its power, it’s not a problem to divine the identity of a mere Exposing King.”
“I’ve thought about it. After knowing who the Exposing King is, we’ll first use our identities as a threat to squeeze out the value of the Exposing King. Then, we’ll sell it. Beautiful.’
“l wonder how many years of revenue its bounty can match our family’s.”
“Hmph.” The cat nodded. Meow.
Patriarch Tu Tu: “?”
Holy sh*t, that Star Prayer Cat had reached transcendent 3?
Ridiculous, how could it be so fast?
With the power of the Astrologer Race’s treasure, it was really possible to divine the identity of the Exposing King…
Large beads of sweat flowed down Patriarch Tu Tu’s forehead.
Wait a minute, damn, its big sister wanted to sell itself for money???
“There’s no need to kick someone to the curb when they’ve outlived their usefulness like this. As long as the Exposing King cooperates obediently…” Shi Yu said.
“Hey, hey, hey. Actually, there’s no need, right? Isn’t it just information about the Four Saints super divine? There are also some records in the Astrologer Race…” Patriarch Tu Tu said.
“I think the Exposing King isn’t simple. It’s better not to provoke it easily.”
“Indeed, so we have to predict its identity first before deciding whether to come into contact with it,” Shi Yu said.
“Brother, bring the family’s treasure to the Dong Huang Realm now. Hurry up. Why don’t we pick you up?” the owl said.
Patriarch Tu Tu: “You guys…”
Patriarch Tu Tu began to panic. Damn, this group of people… Could they do something serious?
“Brother? What’s wrong with you?”
The owl girl looked at the sweating ratman in the crystal ball with a strange expression.
Shi Yu also looked at Patriarch Tu Tu in surprise. Why was this guy panicking when the owl divined the identity of the Exposing King?
[Master, is there a possibility that it’s the Exposing King?] Ling said in the
Beast Taming Space.
Shi Yu was speechless.
Holy sh*t.
“From the general analysis results…” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched as he looked at the crystal ball.
“Patriarch Tu Tu, you’re so unwilling to cooperate with us to investigate the identity of the Exposing King. In addition, the Exposing King knows everything… Why do I feel that your Astrologer Race surprisingly matches the identity of the Exposing King?” Shi Yu looked at Teacher Owl. “Don’t tell me your little brother is the Exposing King?”
Prediction Owl: ???
The owl widened its eyes and looked at its brother in the crystal ball, its expression gradually changing.
“No, no, how is that possible? What revelations, what king?” In the crystal ball, Patriarch Tu Tu hurriedly waved its hand to deny it.
“Then bring the family’s treasure over and assist us in divination,” Teacher Owl said.
“This, this, this…” Patriarch Tu Tu was stunned.
“It can’t be true, right!” The gem cat was also very shocked. The Exposing King was Brother Owl??
What a joke.
Damn it, how could he exchange it for money then?
“Alright! I admit that I’m the Exposing King. You guys are so annoying,” Patriarch Tu Tu said angrily.
As soon as Tu Tu finished speaking, Shi Yu, the gem cat, the owl, and the others fell silent. They stared at Tu Tu intently with incredulous expressions.
What, really?
“I’m also forced by life. For the revival of the Astrologer Race, don’t talk nonsense and don’t think about divination. You can’t leave any traces. Otherwise, the Astrologer Race will die, and you won’t be able to escape. This is even more serious than offending the Four Holy Family.”
“F*ck, you’ve already cooperated with me, so why are you still running to predict the cosmic level? Do you want me to die?” Shi Yu said. What this guy did was indeed more dangerous than offending the Four Holy Family.
“Aren’t you the same? You’ve already become the Sons of Prophecy of the Astrologer Race. Isn’t it good to develop steadily? Why are you still messing around!”
Both parties instantly started arguing.
“Damn it, the Exposing King is actually my younger brother. How can I sell this for money?” Teacher Owl was dejected.
“Put righteousness before family?” the gem cat suggested.
“Shut up! Exposing King Tu Tu said, “The most important thing now is Shi Yu’s transcendent duel. I indeed have information about the Four Saints super divines here, but the strength of these guys isn’t something that can be defeated with information alone.’
“What exactly are you guys thinking?”
“Don’t worry about it first… Since you’re the Exposing King… Help me do something first,” Shi Yu said.
“What is it?”
“Tactical poof, inviting you into the trap. It’s just to help expose some fake news and confuse the Four Saints super divines. It’s not a problem for them to let their guard down, right?”
“???” the Exposing King was speechless..

chapters.title: Chapter 1722 - 1722: Second Transmigration (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1722 - 1722: Second Transmigration (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
This day, the Exposing King reappeared.
The current absolute hot topic on the World King Planet was Shi Yu launching a transcendent duel with the Four Saints super divines.
At this moment, the Exposing King appeared. As expected, this guy came to ride on the popularity again.
Of course, as the most infuriating video owner on the World King Planet, the Exposing King received a lot of attention.
Many people wanted to see what the Exposing King thought of this incident.
Soon, the masked Exposing King appeared in the video.
“Hello, everyone. I believe you already know what I’m going to talk about next…”
“That’s right. Today, I’m going to expose why Shi Yu dares to challenge the Four Saints super divine!”
“Let’s start from the start of this incident. Lu Qingyi and Huang Xi of the Dong Huang Realm cracked the nirvana ruins. Then, they were snatched by the reborn, Zhou Lan!”
“Who’s Zhou Lan? He’s a genius secretly cultivated by the Vermillion Bird super divine. He’s a genius whose Beast Taming level has reached the 11th heavenly layer of the divine level. As everyone knows, the divine level is only at the 10th heavenly layer.”
“However, that’s not the case. As long as the Beast Tamer nurtures an epoch-level pet, he has hope of breaking through the limit and reaching the special realm of the 11th heavenly layer of the divine level.”
“This realm has battle power that’s not inferior to transcendent 1.”
As the Exposing King finished speaking, many divine-level experts found it unbelievable. This was the first time they knew that divine-levels had such a realm.
“However, Zhou Lan was instantly killed by Shi Yu’s pet outside the ruins!”
“Tell everyone the reason. The current Shi Yu is already terrifyingly strong. 1 hope he won’t be wanted by Shi Yu after this revelation.”
“He has already broken through the limit three times in a row and reached the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level. His pets, Eleven, Susu, and Ling, have even reached the epoch god level, and they’re not ordinary epoch gods.”
“Eleven instantly killed Zhou Lan, a divine-level expert at the 11th heavenly layer a million years ago, and his epoch god-level pet, without the enhancement of a Beast Tamer.’
“l can tell that Shi Yu’s current strength, even including himself and Eleven, is definitely comparable to transcendent 3.”
“In addition, Shi Yu has a lot of pets. If we work together, we should be able to display strength that exceeds transcendent 4.”
“No, according to my understanding, it’s 100% that it has battle power that exceeds transcendent 4.”
“The Black Tortoise and White Tiger super divines are only above transcendent 4. Shi Yu might have the strength to fight them. Shi Yu wants to use their pressure to break through to a higher realm.”
“Although it’s still a little dangerous to do this, the train of thought of a genius is always unimaginable. Therefore, it’s still uncertain who will win.”
“This is all Shi Yu’s trump cards.”
“I’m really curious about the outcome of this battle.” After the Exposing Kings words, World King Planet trembled.
13th heavenly layer of the divine level!
Even most super divines had never experienced this realm.
The Exposing Kings words stunned them.
“Impossible. Shi Yu has actually reached the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level.” On World King Star, many epoch gods and divine-level Beast Tamers above Level 10 who had woken up from their sleep were shocked by Shi Yu’s strength.
They were all the strongest divine-levels of the various eras on World King Planet. The oldest could even be traced back to hundreds of millions of years ago.
Among them, they were basically Level 11 and 12 Beast Tamers.
It was precisely because of this that they knew how difficult it was to reach the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level. It was definitely not something that could be reached with just three epoch god pets.
These geniuses had participated in the Origin Battle countless times. According to their memories, there was only one Beast Tamer at the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level in the Cosmic Sea now.
They didn’t believe that Shi Yu, a rising star, could actually surpass them and reach this realm in just a few decades.
If that was the case, then Shi Yu was too terrifying. He was definitely a great enemy for them to fight for the source of transcendence.
However, if it was really the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level, no wonder Shi Yu had the confidence to challenge the Four Saints super divine level. Above the 10th heavenly layer of the divine level, it was already comparable to super divine battle power.
The 11th heavenly layer was comparable to super 1, the 12th heavenly layer was comparable to super 2, and the 13th heavenly layer was comparable to super 3. From the looks of it, although the difference between Shi Yu and the Four Saints super divine was still there, it wasn’t as big as they had imagined previously.
Therefore, in the eyes of these people, the revelation of the Exposure King was reasonable.
The ridiculous thing was Shi Yu t s level, and the reasonable thing was that only with such a level was he qualified to challenge the Four Saints super divine. “We have to watch this battle,” many experts thought.
“However, this Exposing King is really immoral. He actually directly exposed Shi Yu’s trump card. I remember that during the God Sealing Battle, it was also him who exposed Shi Yu’s information.”
“This guy is a crazy dog that bites everyone. The Four Holy Family has also been exposed by it. However, its revelation this time is equivalent to helping the Four Holy Family. I reckon Shi Yu will hate it to the core.” Countless people participated in the discussion.
In the Dong Huang Realm, Patriarch Tu Tu looked at Shi Yu and said, “Are you satisfied now? However, such ridiculous information is actually not your trump card??”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Of course not. It can only be considered basic information, the foundation of the foundation. However, it’s enough. After knowing this information, it’s impossible for the Four Saints to refuse the challenge.”
“It’s impossible for them to let a Beast Tamer at the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level who has a grudge with them grow up and transcendent duel, giving them a legal and reasonable place to deal with me… This level can both make them afraid and make them fearless… However, when they really step into the Duel Arena, they will discover that the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level is only my most inconspicuous trump card..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1723 Two Transmigrations (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1723 Two Transmigrations (2)
"At that time, the roles of hunter and prey will be reversed."
The Exposing King, Tu Tu, looked at Shi Yu's smile with a disgusted expression. It had watched Shi Yu grow all the way, but in the blink of an eye, Shi Yu had already made it completely unable to see through him. It was really ridiculous...
A day later.
Outside the World King Planet, the most dazzling star among the many super divine level stars disappeared.
All the races on the World King Star saw a sun slowly disappear. Only some super divine experts knew that that star was one of the three peak super divine life forms under the World King.
Sun God General Hepri.
At this moment, the Sun God General Hepri up from its sleep and turned into a human figure surrounded by orange-red flames, staring at World King Planet.
The various super divine experts looked at the sky and felt a terrifying power of flames. Everyone understood that the overseer of the transcendent duel had appeared.
As the strongest divine level in this era, the faction behind Shi Yu involved several super divines. He was qualified to receive a response to his challenge.
Otherwise, if the grudge between him and the Four Saints super divine was resolved in other ways, it would definitely cause a super divine battle that swept through more than ten domains. In order to maintain the stability of the World King Planet, the Sun God General Hepri didn't allow such a situation to happen.
