Therefore, agreeing to Shi Yu's application and presiding over the transcendent duel was the best solution. All the grudges would be resolved by Shi Yu and the Four Saint super divines alone.
"Do you accept the transcendent duel from the realm lord of Dong Huang Realm, Shi Yu?"bender
The Four Saints super divines of the Green Dragon Family, the Vermillion Bird Family, the Black Tortoise Family, and the White Tiger Family heard the voice of the Sun God General, Hepri.
"Accepted."
At this moment, the expressions of the Four Saints super divines were extremely unfriendly. Shi Yu's high-profile announcement of their connection to the Assassin Planet placed the reputation of the Four Holy Family at a very disadvantageous point.
Although the Four Holy Family had once refuted the rumors, they couldn't sway public opinion. Now, the Four Saints only wanted to get rid of Shi Yu. It was indeed
impossible for the four of them to let go of the opportunity that Shi Yu had delivered to their door.
Shi Yu coveted the position of super divine of the Four Saints and slandered the Four Holy Family. His ambition was unfathomable. Because of this, they also had to respond to the challenge and personally deal with Shi Yu on Duel Star.
As long as Shi Yu died, everything could be settled. The loser never had the right to speak. The truth was written by the winner. At that time, the defeated Shi Yu would completely lose.
As for why Shi Yu dared to challenge them, the Exposing King had already made it very clear.
Although the Exposing King wasn't liked on the World King Planet and had even exposed the matter of the Four Holy Family... It was precisely because of this that the Four
Saints super divine knew that what the Exposing King said was basically correct.
From the information revealed by the Exposing King, Shi Yu indeed had the initial qualifications to challenge them. At the very least, his battle power had reached the
mid-stage super divine level. This was undoubtedly very unbelievable.
However, if this was all Shi Yu's trump cards, Shi Yu had underestimated them.
It was unknown how long it had been since they last attacked, but as the strongest Four Holy Evolver, their strength was far stronger than it looked!
If he wanted to use them as stepping stones, it had to be said that Shi Yu had a death wish.
This opportunity was rare. Shi Yu's potential was too terrifying, and he had even revealed his fangs. The Four Saints super divine had no choice but to take it seriously. Just as Shi Yu had said, this transcendent duel was one of the few opportunities they had.
Of course, the Four Saints didn't underestimate the enemy. They even asked the Black Tortoise super divine to divine the outcome of this battle.
After countless chaotic divinations, the outcome was surprisingly auspicious, indicating that Shi Yu had no chance of winning this transcendent duel.
Although it wasn't a blessing, the word "luck" had already explained Shi Yu's fate.
"This battle is a blessing, not a blessing. This means that there are indeed some hidden dangers in this battle. It might be from the Blue Planet lineage or Shi Yu, but it's already worth fighting. Therefore, Vermillion Bird, I'll leave it to you," the Black Tortoise super divine said.
"It doesn't matter. I'll completely destroy it," the Vermillion Bird super divine said.
Because of Shi Yu's provocation, it was the first to respond to Shi Yu's transcendent duel. Therefore, at that time, it would be the first to fight Shi Yu.
Now, the entire World King Planet knew that Shi Yu had killed its cultivator and defeated its clone phantom in front
of it. If it didn't respond to the challenge, there was no need for it to stay on World King Planet.
"Vermillion Bird, I hope you can kill him directly. If you lose, that will be too ugly," the Green Dragon extraordinary divine said. It was the second to respond to the transcendent duel.
Its and the Vermillion Bird's super divine levels were also the highest among the Four Saints. One was at transcendent 5, while the other was at transcendent 6. Even if Shi Yu had battle power comparable to transcendent 4, he was definitely not their match.
Of course, even the White Tiger and the Black Tortoise extraordinary divine that had reached transcendent 4 didn't think that they would lose to Shi Yu. They each had their own unique skills, and their strength wasn't much inferior to the Green Dragon super divine.
"Green Dragon, watch your words," the Vermillion Bird extraordinary divine said. "You think I'll lose?"
"I didn't say that."
In the void, the phantom of the Four Saints extraordinary divine echoed. Its power stood vast, sweeping through the firmament of more than ten domains.
As for the experts who were watching the Starry Sky Bright Sun, they finally waited for the specific time of the transcendent duel.
During this period of time, Shi Yu had also received the condolences of many familiar faces, such as Senior
Emperor Wu, Senior Dragon Emperor, and Senior Panda, but they were all told by Shi Yu that it stood fine.
"In half a year, I'll confrontation the Vermillion Bird, the Green Dragon, the White Tiger, and the Black Tortoise on Duel Star one after another."

chapters.title: Chapter 1724 - 1724: Two Transmigrations (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1724 - 1724: Two Transmigrations (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“No way, it’s so overboard. It’s really a continuous challenge.”
In the Dong Huang Realm, after Shi Yu learned the exact time of the duel, he smiled bitterly. One way or another, he even felt that he was a lunatic. Challenging four super divines in a row didn’t look like a move to live no matter how he looked at it.
In his impression, there seemed to be no example of a divine level launching a transcendent duel with multiple super divines in a row.
Shi Yu originally thought that the Sun God General would staggered these battles and let him fight one first. After a while, he would fight another one and give him enough time to rest. However, he didn’t expect the mechanism to be like this… It was all pushed to a period of time for the battle.
“However, it doesn’t matter. As long as I have the skill to nurture battle with battle, it’s fine. At that time, not only will my condition not decrease, but my strength will also increase.” Shi Yu stood up, and an eager little monkey followed beside him.
“Shi Yu, why aren’t you adding points anymore?”
“Rest for a while. We’ll add more later. Teacher Ying and the others are here.” In just a few days, the cosmic behemoth completely fell.
For the first time, Bu Lu knew that there was such a way to increase strength.
“Shi Yu, I’ve found all the materials you want.” The gem cat teleported over and panted as it held a spatial equipment. There were various special resources inside.
After obtaining the information about the Four Saints super divine from the Astrologer Race, Shi Yu naturally began to prepare targeted accompanying moves.
Just like resisting the cosmic lightning tribulation and letting Eleven learn the Chaos Thunder Body.
Why couldn’t they learn the accompanying moves to counter the Four Saints super divine?
This should be the correct usage of the skill index. Skill Deduction. “I’m preparing to return to Blue Planet. Are you going?” Shi Yu took the resources and asked the gem cat.
“Go, go, go. I don’t want to stay on World King Planet anymore,” the gem cat said.
“Then let’s go,” Shi Yu said. He had gone to Blue Planet this time firstly because he wanted to take the remaining fake source of transcendence from Blue Planet and use it to strengthen Beast Shi Yu again. Secondly, he had almost cultivated his protective archeological skills.
He wanted to explore the Chi You Ruins on Earth again and see if he could gain anything.
On Blue Planet, Inatella. Just as Shi Yu returned, he was scolded by the World Tree.
“Lady Mother Goddess said that she respects your choice.”
“The will clone left behind by Emperor Shi also said that he respected your choice.’
“Strange, strange. These two actually trust you so much.”
Shi Yu covered his ears and said, “As expected, the stronger you are, the more reliable you are. So where are the five super divines?”
“l didn’t tell them. They’re in seclusion on Blue Planet,” the World Tree said.
“It’s right not to tell them. Otherwise, they probably won’t be able to close up well.” Shi Yu was amused.
“So what are you doing back this time? Do you need the help of your mother planet?” the World Tree said.
“Of course. How much fake source of transcendence is left on Blue Planet? Give it to me. I know that some of them were stored here by others, but it’s alright. I’ll return them soon. Lend them to me first,” Shi Yu said.
“That’s not a problem,” the World Tree said. “Is there nothing else?”
Shi Yu said, “No, I’m going to continue exploring the era ruins next. Just don’t disturb me if there’s nothing.”
“Hurry up and leave, kid.” The World Tree chased Shi Yu away.
Since Blue Planet’s Will and Emperor Shi, the strongest on Blue Planet, chose to believe Shi Yu, it could only believe it.
Shi Yu shrugged. He was in a hurry to return from the overlord territory this time. He originally wanted to tell Blue Planet and the Space Emperor and the others about the birth of the sixth universe level. Unfortunately, Shi Yu didn’t have to tell him about World King Planet at all. There was already news.
In order to not be involved in the chaotic dispute, Blue Planet had already decided to continue staying at the edge of the Cosmic Sea.
“Let’s go to the Chi You Ruins.” Shi Yu shouted for Bu Lu to teleport himself to Divine Capital.
As for Buggy, it was still resting… The recoil of the magnetic bank was really fierce, mainly because there were too many people it teleported in one go.
Even the gem cat, a super divine level with super high load.
Fortunately, it could definitely recover before the transcendent duel.
At this moment, many people had already moved out of this first-level city, including Divine Capital University. They moved the entire school in order to stop outsiders from being affected by the Chi You Ruins.
After protecting this place for a period of time, Senior Panda also successfully relied on the cultivation system of the previous era to win first place in the World Tournament and ascend to the World King Planet.
Shi Yu returned again and sighed.
The last time they explored this ruin, the phantoms of the Yellow Emperor, Chi You, and Ying Long seemed to know him…
Unfortunately, when Shi Yu wanted to ask more, the dream couldn’t take it anymore and collapsed.
This time, he had learned protective archeological skills. He had to stabilize the dream and get more useful information from these ancestors.
He descended to Divine Capital University and unlocked a portion of the seal of the Chi You Ruins. Then, he took out Baby Ginsengs cultivation fruit and entered the dream.
It was still the same script. Shi Yu possessed Chi You and became a defeated
Chi You.
However, this time, unlike the last time…
“Eh, where is this?” Shi Yu felt a familiar voice appear in his sea of consciousness.
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “Bring Bu Lu in too.”
“It’s indeed a special existence. It can actually follow us into the era ruins like Beast Shi Yu..

chapters.title: Chapter 1725 - 1725: Two Transmigrations (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1725 - 1725: Two Transmigrations (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Shi Yu, this is the Chi You Ruins?” Bu Lu asked curiously in his sea of consciousness.
“Yes, stay here obediently first.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, the outside world indeed continued to act according to the obsession script.
Ying Long and Emperor Huang came looking for him.
Shi Yu was still not in a hurry to fight. Instead, he stood in the air and looked at Emperor Huang and Ying Long.
“Ying Long, do you know Shi Yu?” Shi Yu asked directly.
Ying Long was stunned.
“You still know that scourge?” Ying Long said, “No matter who you know, you won’t be able to escape death this time!!!”
It was the same script!!
According to his previous experience, after this, the dream obsession world should begin to collapse.
However, this time, Shi Yu directly activated the Luck Turns Around skill. A special wave spread from Shi Yu’s body. The rumbling world of obsession didn’t immediately collapse.
However, Emperor Huang and Ying Long seemed to be shocked as they carefully observed the surrounding environment.
“Chi You, what are you doing?”
“Answer me.” With Chi You’s body, Shi Yu said with difficulty, “Answer my question. I’ll admit defeat directly and listen to your judgment.”
Emperor Huang and Ying Long were shocked. They didn’t expect that the God of War, Chi You, would say such a thing.
This time, perhaps because Shi Yu was stronger, he wasn’t expelled from his body by Chi You’s obsession. Otherwise, Shi Yu felt that if Chi You knew that he had said such things with its body, he would definitely kill himself with a slash.
“Why are you mentioning that guy?” Ying Long said.
“So, you know Shi Yu, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“Answer me, who is he? Who is he? Where did he come from? What has he done? Tell me quickly.” Shi Yu felt that it was very difficult to maintain this dream ruin from collapsing. The consumption was very huge. His mental strength kept being consumed, and he couldn’t wait to obtain information from Ying Long.
Emperor Huang said, “I’ve heard of him.”
“It’s said that Shi Yu is a descender from the future. He used the power of space and time to come to the past and became a god in the ruins of the era. He was originally wanted by the ‘Heavenly Palace’ as a violator, but later on, the ‘Heavenly Palace’ inexplicably withdrew the arrest warrant.”
“He’s active in the various ruins and even offended many people in order to explore the ruins. You… What’s your relationship with Shi Yu?”
Shi Yu’s gaze swayed. Although he, Ling, and the others had long made such a guess, Shi Yu still had an indescribable emotion after learning the conclusion from the Yellow Emperor illusion.
He had really… transmigrated twice. The first time was when he transmigrated to the ancient Mythical Era on Earth. The second time was when he transmigrated to the Blue Planet’s Beast Taming Era in the next era.
“l…” Shi Yu still wanted to ask something else, but because he was too excited, his mental strength was greatly consumed. His body couldn’t withstand it, causing the dream to collapse again. Everything disintegrated, and he was forced to wake up.
“Hu…” Shi Yu suddenly got up and said while drenched in sweat, “Damn it, there’s not enough time.”
Moreover, although they didn’t obtain much information, they could tell that even Ying Long and Emperor Huang didn’t know much about “Shi Yu”.
“Shi Yu” at this stage wasn’t very strong. It was basically impossible to send “himself” to the next era.
Something else must have happened after that.
“Qi, with your current strength, how many years has it been since you transmigrated?” Shi Yu asked telepathically.
“About tens of millions of years ago…” Qi said, “l went myself. If I bring you along, it’ll be even closer…”
Ever since the Space-time Travel skill reached perfect proficiency, Qi could already bring contractors of the same level to transmigrate, but the consumption was still too huge.
“After you reach the epoch god and transcendent in space and time, it might be better. At that time, you might be able to transmigrate to hundreds of millions of years ago, but it’s not enough. Far from enough,” Shi Yu said. “If only you could transmigrate to ten billion years ago.”
“If possible, I really want you to be the first cosmic level in the team. Perhaps there’s hope of crossing the cosmic era…”
“Meow, meow, meow??” Qi didn’t know what stimulation Shi Yu had suffered again, but it liked to hear this..

chapters.title: Chapter 1726 - 1726: Transcendent Duel (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1726 - 1726: Transcendent Duel (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
In the next few days, Shi Yu continued to explore the Chi You Ruins.
Unfortunately, the mystery of his identity was limited by Chi You’s understanding. He only obtained very little information.
After all, this wasn’t a real world. It was purely formed by Chi You’s obsession.
Its understanding of Shi Yu was everything Shi Yu could detect.
However, in the world of obsession, Beast Shi Yu’s control over source power improved day and night.
Although he didn’t know the identity of “Shi Yu”, in this world of obsession, humans’ control over source power was still very good.
Under Shi Yu’s secret learning, his improvement was rapid.
He was even more confident in torturing the Four Saints super divine.
Because his main body should be able to fuse with Beast Shi Yu.
“This way, my fusion compatibility with Beast Shi Yu is nearly 100% ”
Shi Yu stood on the empty university building, facing the breeze and staring at Beast Shi Yu opposite him.
“Can we finally fuse?” Beast Shi Yu said.
To put it bluntly, Shi Yu was talking to himself and controlling his clone to talk to him.
“l feel that it’s about time. Back then, Goddess Wa said that your level is too high, and my level is too low. There’s a lot of risk in forcefully fusing.” “Therefore, she gave us the contract method and let us contract it.”
“After you and I contract, 1 can use the Beast Taming Talent, Fusion, to fuse with you and simulate fusion.”
“Before this, our fusion has always failed. Firstly, it’s because the level difference is too big. Secondly, it’s because although we contracted you, you’re not a real pet after all. If we want to fuse with you, the method needs to be slightly changed.”
“But now, my level is already close to yours. Moreover, I’ve also modified my Fusion Talent. Most importantly, I have a deeper understanding of your strength.”
Shi Yu and Beast Shi Yu nodded. Then, they held hands and slowly stuck together.
“Wow.” On a tall building in the distance, Chi Tong shook its white thighs and made a photo pose with its hands, watching this scene eagerly.
He had just returned from training and saw something impressive.
In order to fight the Four Saints super divine, Shi Yu’s pet had also been working hard recently.
Apart from the new skills of Buggy, Chi Tong, Shorty, the Turtle, Little Quas, and the new skill of Buggy, they had already been maxed out.
There wasn’t much improvement from Shi Yu. Therefore, Shi Yu sent them to the Blue Planet’s Will.
It made the Blue Planet’s Will open up a special space. M/ith the Star Contract, it summoned Emperor Shi’s illusion and trained Shi Yu e s entire team.
“What a special aura,” Chi Tong said as it looked at the halo.
On Shi Yu’s side, slowly, under the special light, Shi Yu and Beast Shi Yu directly fused into a person. After this person appeared, Chi Tong was very surprised.
The fused Shi Yu still retained Shi Yu’s appearance, but his aura had completely changed.
It turned out that it had long short hair. If it wore casual clothes and walked in Blue Planet’s city, apart from being handsome, it might be regarded as a big star, not much different from modern people.
But now, under Chi Tongs gaze, Shi Yu’s hair lengthened a lot with a whoosh. The muscles on his entire body increased exponentially, and he directly became incomparably strong from the normal young man from before. Terrifying white flames lingered from top to bottom, wrapping around his entire body, as well as… his long black hair that was more than ten meters long that shot into the sky and stood up.
“What the hell!” Chi Tong couldn’t help but say.
She now sensed the aura of a demon god on Shi Yu. Originally, Beast Shi Yu’s battle power was about transcendent 4. Coupled with Bu Lu, it should be transcendent 5.
However, now, she felt that when Shi Yu and Beast Shi Yu fused, their aura was even more terrifying than when Beast Shi Yu and Bu Lu went all out together.
This way, if Shi Yu maintained this state and turned Buggy into a weapon, would there still be her, Buggy, and the others in the duel with the Four Saints?
She felt that Shi Yu himself could kill the Four Holy Beasts with one hit…
“Stop looking.” Shi Yu turned around and looked at Chi Tong.
“Have you eaten? If not, come and eat my punch and test your battle power.”
Chi Tong: n?”
“Are you trying to murder your own daughter?” Chi Tong said from the roof opposite.
“I’m just kidding,” Shi Yu said. “It still doesn’t seem to work.”
“Isn’t it perfect? With this power, I even doubt if Emperor Shi’s illusion created by the Blue Planet’s Will can defeat you in this state,” Chi Tong said.
“In terms of strength, it’s very perfect, but I don’t seem to be able to control the power in this form,” Shi Yu said.
“So I can freely control my body through physical control. If my hair grows long, I can directly let it fall by itself. There’s no need to cut my hair at all. I miss when I was young. I can directly become a child a few years old. If I consume too much energy, I can also maintain my body at the energy level of a mortal and reduce the consumption…”
“But once I enter this state, I don’t even feel that it’s very difficult for me to do the most basic control power, let alone precise operations like controlling hair,” Shi Yu said as he looked at the ridiculous black hair that shot into the sky.
“Now, if I punch the enemy, I’m afraid I won’t be injured.”
“Moreover, the consumption of this state is also very high. Although it has perfectly fused with Beast Shi Yu, it can’t be maintained for long. If I want to perfectly fuse my previous life and current body in the true sense of the word, I’m afraid I’m still lacking…”
“Perhaps I need the basic strength of Level 14 and 15..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1727 - 1727: Transcendent Duel (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1727 - 1727: Transcendent Duel (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“However, the experiment that relied on the Fusion Talent this time is considered a success.’
“Yes…” Chi Tong nodded. It was already very good.
Moreover, he remembered that the fake source of transcendence Shi Yu had obtained from Blue Planet had yet to be used, right? If it was strengthened again, it would definitely be very strong. Well, Bu Lu still had room for improvement!
“Alright.” Shi Yu exited the fusion state with Beast Shi Yu and panted.
He looked at the starry sky and couldn’t wait anymore.
Next, Shi Yu continued to cultivate bitterly on Blue Planet. As Bu Lu had the Super Divine Will to begin with, its points were added very quickly. Its skill level was already high, so it didn’t take long for Shi Yu to maximize it.
Apart from that, Shi Yu had already maxed out the killer moves prepared for the Four Holy Beasts on Buggy, Chi Tong, Shorty, the Turtle, and Little Quas. As for himself, he kept training with Beast Shi Yu and strengthening the
“Fusion Shi Yu”.
In the blink of an eye, the time for the transcendent duel was getting closer and closer. Shi Yu, who was basically ready for battle, also prepared to return to the World King Planet to wait.
Before leaving, he came to the Ancient Capital and found Teacher Gem Cat and Teacher Owl.
During this period of time, the two of them had also been helping Shi Yu prepare for battle. The target of their teaching was one of Shi Yu t s pets, Little Zi.
“Mi! Seeing Shi Yu come over, Little Zi was extremely excited.
It had already signed a star contract with Teacher Gem Cat and Teacher Owl.
Not only could it summon their power projections, but it could also communicate with their power from a very far distance.
This way, Shi Yu could enjoy the power of the “Star Prayer Race” and the “Astrology Race” at any time.
This also saved Shi Yu the trouble of wandering outside in the future and being unable to borrow the full strength of the gem cat and owl teacher.
Well, there was one more thing that could increase the probability of the source of transcendence dropping in the transcendent duel.
In the transcendent duel, the gem cat and the owl teacher probably couldn’t provide support outside the arena. It all depended on their luck!
“Are you leaving?” Seeing Shi Yu arrive, the gem cat asked.
“Let’s go.”
“This day has finally come.” The Prediction Owl was a little expectant.
At the peak of the Astrologer Race, they wouldn’t have offended a huge monster like the Four Holy Family. Now that Shi Yu clearly wanted to destroy the Four Saints, she was a little excited.
“Let’s go, let’s go. This battle is much more profitable than going to Assassin Planet.’
“The Four Holy Family! the gem cat said. “Although the transcendent duel is a personal battle and doesn’t interfere with the faction behind it, the Four Saints super divine are the absolute pillars of the Four Holy Family. Once they die, the Four Holy Family will definitely immediately shatter.”
“At that time, this huge pie will definitely still be divided equally among the strongest Four Holy Evolvers today…”
It was Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others!
“That’s right,” Shi Yu said. “If I can defeat all the Four Saints in one go, I can almost monopolize the faith of the Four Saints like the previous Four Saints super divine…”
“The Dragon Slayer has finally become an evil dragon!” The owl sighed.
“That’s not necessary,” Shi Yu said. “l won’t restrict the other Four Holy Evolvers from breaking through to the super divine level. In a few years,
Buggy and the others will break through the evolution restrictions of the Four Holy Evolvers and find their own path. We’re not interested in constantly imitating the Four Holy Evolvers.”
“Alright, alright, alright.” The Prediction Owl knew that it couldn’t win against Shi Yu. This guy was becoming more and more arrogant, not even taking the Four Saints seriously.
But that made sense. What he wanted to do at the moment was to challenge the most perfect Four Saint lives that had evolved…
“Let’s go to Inatella,” Shi Yu said after putting Little Zi back into the Beast Taming Space.
Upon hearing that, the gem cat teacher nodded. It very consciously took on the role of a transportation tool and teleported everyone present!
Inatella.
“Are you leaving??”
After Shi Yu and the others descended, the World Tree appeared.
“I’ll go with you.”
“Oh?” Shi Yu said, “You’re going too??”
“Well, although Blue Planet can’t move, I can temporarily be Blue Planet’s eye to witness this battle,” the World Tree said. “When I return, I’ll transmit the entire battle back.”
“l understand. We definitely can’t miss this battle,” Teacher Owl said.
“Then let’s go together!” the gem cat said.
The World Tree directly made the special photo clone it created turn into a green vortex worm, planning to follow the cat team.
Half a year passed very quickly. For super divine levels, it was in the blink of an eye. Ever since the Sun God General announced the time of the transcendent duel between Shi Yu and the Four Saints, the entire World King Planet had been looking forward to this battle.
The experts of the entire Dong Huang Realm and the Floating Realm had already entered a level-one battle state to prevent all the accidents that might be caused by the transcendent battle.
As for Shi Yu, who was in the center of the vortex, he was definitely not the most nervous. After he returned to World King Planet, the first thing he did was actually invite Senior Panda to a meal.
“Senior Lin, I heard from Senior Space Emperor that you’re very worried about my situation. Actually, it’s nothing. Do you want to get together? I’ll show you a thing or two.”
During the time Shi Yu was cultivating bitterly on Blue Planet, he didn’t lose contact with World King Planet. The Space Emperor had looked for Shi Yu a few times to discuss business and private matters.
Among them, it mentioned how Lin Xiuzhu had asked about Shi Yu a few times.
The Space Emperor originally wanted Lin Xiuzhu to go to Blue Planet to find Shi Yu herself, but Senior Panda was afraid that it would affect Shi Yu’s cultivation, so it didn’t take action..

chapters.title: Chapter 1728 - 1728: Transcendent Duel (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1728 - 1728: Transcendent Duel (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“You’re free?” Lin Xiuzhu was surprised. “It won’t affect you, right? You should hurry up and cultivate again.”
“I’m already done preparing. Next is the time to relax before the battle,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright… Then I’ll call everyone together and tell everyone that you’ve already returned to World King Planet,” Lin Xiuzhu said.
“Wu.” Shi Yu touched his head. Forget it, let’s go together.
That night, a huge banquet was held in the Dong Huang Realm.
Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, Lu Qingyi, Dragon God, Lin Xiuzhu, Divine Source, President Lin, and the others were all present. They were all absolute core figures of Dong Huangs bloodline on Blue
Planet.
Apart from that, there was also the gem cat, the owl, and the World Tree clone. It could be said that apart from Emperor Shi, everyone who should have arrived had arrived.
As the transcendent battle approached, these people indeed wanted to understand Shi Yu’s state. Only the pitiful super divines of the five divine races were still in the dark. It was mainly because Dong Huang and the others were afraid that they would drag him down…
The Dong Xuan Region and the Heavenly Demon Region had long exploded because of Shi Yu’s transcendent duel. Many top-notch divines were so scared that they peed their pants. They wanted to contact their ancestors, but they were stopped outside the teleportation array…
At the banquet, after reassuring his acquaintances, Shi Yu came to the roof in
a long time. He lay on it and looked at the moonlight.
“Speaking of which, after so long, the news of us completing the Glory Challenge and meeting the cosmic overlord in the overlord territory hasn’t been sent back to the Cosmic Sea?” Shi Yu said.
Ling said, “It hasn’t been long indeed. In addition, it might have involved a ‘cosmic overlord’. At least, no one in the cosmic overlord army dares to talk about it casually.”
“And within the cosmic overlord army, there are only a handful of people who have the ability to reach the Cosmic Sea before us. With their identities, they naturally won’t publicize this matter openly. If the news from that side wants to be transmitted, we have to at least wait for the epoch god there and their guardians to come to the Cosmic Sea.”
“According to various judgments, there might be less than 1,000 years until the universe condenses a transcendent origin. Moreover, it’s still accelerating…”
Shi Yu said, “1,000 years. From 20,000 years to 10,000 years, it’s pretty fast.
From the looks of it, it shouldn’t be long before we can have a big battle.”
“There’s not much time left for us to prepare. In the battle to transcend the origin, the highest possibility is the peak of the super divine level. This time, we have to borrow the power of the Four Saints to let Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others break through to the epoch god level!”
“Yes.” Ling nodded.
No one knew Shi Yu and the others’ bold plan this time. Next, they wanted to stage a grand “plunder” in front of the entire World King Planet, no, the entire Cosmic Sea, and the entire starry sky.
As the transcendent duel approached, the entire World King Planet became more and more oppressive.
Duel Star was one of the countless stars surrounding the World King Planet.
Duel Star was a dead star that didn’t give birth to life, but it had been personally modified by the World King a long time ago. Even if it was at the peak of the super divine level, it wouldn’t be affected by fighting on Duel Star.
All the power inside would be sealed in the Duel Star and wouldn’t affect the outside world.
At this moment, countless fleets had already ascended to the starry sky and arrived outside Duel Star.
Generally speaking, only the parties who transcendent dueled, as well as the witnesses and supervisors, were allowed to ascend the Duel Star.
However, the transcendent duel didn’t prohibit outsiders from watching. If they wanted to watch, they had to pilot the battleship themselves and watch outside the Duel Star.
Whether there was that technical method to observe the battle in a star in the starry sky depended on the audience’s own methods.
However, for a big matter that everyone was paying attention to, there was naturally no lack of spectators with superb methods. Several media outlets that crossed hundreds of major domains had already arrived at Duel Star a few days before the start of the duel and started a live broadcast.
On World King Planet, some spectators who didn’t have the ability to fly out of World King Planet also benefited from these few media outlets with strong backgrounds to pay attention to this shocking battle.
Through the technological equipment of these media outlets, they could even be immersed in it. It was equivalent to being in the starry sky and witnessing this battle with their great divine powers.
Of course, most capable people still chose to personally come to the starry sky of Duel Star to witness it.
“The legendary Shi Yu has really reached the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level?” Some geniuses who had awakened from ancient times were undoubtedly here. They were all from rich families and definitely had the support of super divine factions behind them. Until now, there were still people who were puzzled that Shi Yu had already broken through to the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level, but soon… they could see the truth.
“Unfortunately, Lord Bing Ling is deep in the Contaminated Land and can’t pay attention to this battle.” The battleship of the Environmental Protection Association arrived. Inside was the president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association, the genius of the Environmental Protection
Association that Duckie had encountered in the God Sealing Battle, and the
Purification Master who gave Duckie and Susu the assessment in the Blue Wave World. They came outside the Duel Star with extremely complicated expressions.
Compared to Shi Yu’s acquaintances, they had no chance to contact Shi Yu at all. They couldn’t know the specific situation at all.
In the Blue Wave Domain, Dr. Lei Nuo of the Space Disaster Research Institute also brought his granddaughter, Jin, and a bunch of big shots from the headquarters to the starry sky. Because this battle was important, even his old friend, the Space Emperor, didn’t say anything to them.
The old president of the Plant Association and a group of descendants of large families who had received the favor of the ginseng emperor also came to the starry sky.
Director Sen of the Myriad Races Committee, Director Di Yin, President Saatchi of the God Sealing Committee, and even Senior Sun and his son, who had lost to Lin Feng and the others with a super divine stone, came over. They stood in the starry sky and looked at the Duel Star in silence..

chapters.title: Chapter 1729 - 1729: Transcendent Duel (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1729 - 1729: Transcendent Duel (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
This battle was really unexpected. Some people even started not to be on World King Planet, such as the cosmic overlord army’s 177th Fleet. They had only heard of it recently, but after hearing it, they undoubtedly rushed back immediately, wanting to witness it with their own eyes.
“It’s almost time…
“Zavay, do you think that guy has really reached the thirteenth level? Divine level… do those realms really exist?” Ming Gu, Zavay, and the other veteran contestants of the God Sealing Battle also came to the starry sky. Ming Gu rode the battleship of the Cosmic Crow family and came to watch the battle together.
“l don’t know. My old master said that even it isn’t a match for the Four Saints super divine. Even if Shi Yu really reaches that legendary realm, it’s still very difficult for me to believe that he’s a match for the Four Saints super divine.” Zavay was silent.
At the moment, it was still fighting in the God Sealing Battle, but Shi Yu had already exceeded the limit of the divine level. These people really couldn’t accept it.
Just as countless factions from all over gathered outside the Duel Star, the starry sky… suddenly lit up.
A supreme existence holding a scepter and a golden light wheel hanging behind him descended. Its entire body was filled with orange-red hot flames, and its face couldn’t be seen at all. It emitted a holy aura, like an elemental life form or a human god.
He opened his star-like eyes and stared at Duel Star. Under his gaze, in the distant starry sky, the real protagonist also began to arrive outside Duel Star.
In the distance, the four battleships representing the Four Saints family arrived one by one. In the opposite direction, the battleship representing the Blue Planet also carried countless people to this starry sky.
“Roar!!!” No, the real protagonist, the Four Saints super divine, wasn’t in the battleship. They had unknowingly revealed their figures in the starry sky. Four huge Holy bodies descended into this universe. A green dragon, a red divine bird, a white battle tiger, and a huge black turtle that was like a star stepped on the starry sky and arrived. Their aura spread infinitely into the starry sky.
“Looks like the relevant people are already here,” the Sun God General’s emotionless voice sounded.
As soon as he finished speaking, the Four Saints looked at Blue Planet’s battleship in unison. The Vermillion Bird super divine said in a low voice, “Little brat Shi Yu, get out here. As you wish, we’re here. Next, I’ll burn your body and soul clean and turn them into cosmic dust.”
“Who’s farting?” The door of the super battleship of the Blue Planet lineage opened. Shi Yu slowly walked out and used his psychic power to fly out calmly. He flew to a place higher than the Four Saints super divines and looked down at them.
They finally met… Shi Yu, who was sent out by the Space Emperor and the others, looked at the figures of the Four Saints super divines, reflecting different colors. His heart wasn’t calm.
When he took away the Four Holy Ruins, he was still afraid, but he didn’t expect that in just four to five years, he wasn’t afraid of such a huge monster.
“You’re still arrogant at the brink of death.” The Green Dragon super divine and the other supreme gods ignored Shi Yu. With the start of the transcendent duel, Shi Yu couldn’t escape today.
Even that Emperor Shi couldn’t save Shi Yu. The Sun God General would witness everything and preside over it in absolute fairness.
“Since both parties have already arrived, let’s start the transcendent duel under the gaze of Lord World King.” The Sun God General really didn’t seem to have any emotions. Upon hearing his words, countless people didn’t feel any warmth, and even felt their hearts turn cold.
This Sun God General was actually very terrifying. It only knew how to coldly and mercilessly carry out some rules set by the World King in a very long time. Many super divine lives that made mistakes were judged by it.
At this moment, although it had said that it would start the transcendent duel under the gaze of the World King, everyone actually knew that the World King wouldn’t pay attention to this kind of thing at all. He was in charge of this transcendent duel!
As the Sun God General finished speaking, Shi Yu and the Vermillion Bird super divine descended towards the Duel Star calmly!

chapters.title: Chapter 1730 - 1730: Smashing to Death with a Stick (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1730 - 1730: Smashing to Death with a Stick (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
On the desolate Duel Star, two figures descended from the starry sky. The Vermillion Bird’s super divine main body was burning with flames that were enough to destroy the world. Every feather that landed could easily destroy a planet.
When it landed, the temperature of the entire Duel Star rose to the extreme. This place seemed to have turned into a new star. Although duelists couldn’t destroy the Duel Star, they could still have different effects on the Duel Star according to their strength.
Seeing that the Vermillion Bird super divine had only descended, and its aura was about to dye the Duel Star into a fire star, countless spectators were terrified. After all, the size of this Duel Star was more than ten thousand times that of the Assassin Planet that Shi Yu and the others had destroyed previously.
Before Shi Yu landed, the ground of Duel Star had already turned into a sea of fire. In the sky, the Vermillion Bird’s super divine gaze had already calmed down. It wanted to see what confidence Shi Yu had to challenge the four of them.
“Although you slandered the Four Holy Family because you coveted the position of super divine, I admire your ignorant courage to actually dare to challenge us.”
“Next, I’ll let you see that the position of the Four Saints super divine isn’t something a child like you can easily touch. The power of a super divine isn’t something a brat like you can easily provoke.”
“We haven’t attacked for millions of years. The world has already forgotten the power of the Four Saints. Today, you will feel the power of the Four Saints for a long time and spy on that domain that can never be involved,” the
Vermillion Bird super divine said indifferently to Shi Yu.
“I’ll burn you to ashes.”
Boom!!!
Although that wasn’t the truth, under the gaze of the entire World King
Planet, the Four Saints super divine had no choice but to throw the dirty water back at Shi Yu and describe Shi Yu as an arrogant genius who didn’t know the immensity of heaven and earth.
At the same time, the Vermillion Bird super divine was also prepared to use its full strength to deal with Shi Yu. Regardless of whether Shi Yu t s true strength was weak or strong, only by killing Shi Yu with the strongest method could it firmly determine this matter and make all the people who had secretly touched the Black Four Sacred Families tremble in fear.
It wanted to display absolute battle power and let the world experience the power of the Four Saints again.
Under the condensation of the Vermillion Bird’s super divine will, countless people were extremely shocked. In an instant, the entire starry sky had already turned red. Even from the starry sky, red spots began to appear on the entire World King Planet.
Looking at the planet from the starry sky, the color of the planet basically depended on the internal environment, but at this moment, people shockingly discovered that the faith of the Vermillion Bird had already spread all over the World King Planet. At this moment, under the mobilization of the Vermillion Bird super divine and the mobilization of the strongest Vermillion Bird God, the phenomenon was incomparably terrifying. The power of faith that was even more terrifying than the power of faith in the Four Holy Ruins resonated!!
“What a terrifying power.”
At this moment, even some super divines who had reached transcendent 6 took a deep breath as they looked at the power of faith that resonated with the
Vermillion Bird super divine.
In the path of faith, the Four Saints had reached the extreme. With the remaining faith from the last era, the four of them could be considered experts who had cultivated their faith system to the highest realm. With the power of the Four Saints, they could basically fight one level higher.
“This isn’t something a divine-level can deal with at all.”
At this moment, in the Cosmic Sea, in hundreds of star areas and countless planets with Vermillion Bird Legendarys, the power of faith on the Vermillion Bird resonated.
On some low-level planets that couldn’t pay attention to the major events on the World King Planet at all, people were shocked to discover that the ancient Vermillion Bird item emitted light and suddenly revealed its divinity.
Under the resonance of such a terrifying power, the dark universe had already lit up. The Vermillion Bird super divine was indeed worthy of its constellation god’s evolution path. If it could increase its perspective, it could see countless light of faith. It directly outlined a Vermillion Bird divine shadow in the dark starry sky and looked down on the entire Duel Star.
The experts here could even feel the whispers of countless believers in the countless light and shadows.
Kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill!! The killing intent that represented the Vermillion Bird’s will had already filled the entire starry sky.
Sensing this power, even the expressions of the Space Emperor, the World Tree, and the others couldn’t help but change.
Shi Yu… was it really alright to fight four such world-shaking experts in a row? Although they had been instilled with confidence by Shi Yu time and time again, they were still worried about Shi Yu when they sensed the power of faith that resonated with the Vermillion Bird super divine.
“Do you feel it? This is a domain you can never covet.”
The goal of the Vermillion Bird super divine at this moment was no longer to purely kill Shi Yu, nor was it in a hurry to fight. Instead, it wanted to shock the starry sky to prevent another “genius” like Shi Yu, who overestimated himself, from trying to touch the power of the Four Saints.
At this moment, it had even thought of Shi Yu’s extremely serious expression. Not to mention that Shi Yu was at the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level, even if he was at the 14th heavenly layer or 15th heavenly layer, it was useless…
It wanted to see Shi Yu cry and kneel down to beg for mercy in its absolute power. Only then could it be satisfied. Killing Shi Yu was simply a gift to Shi Yu!
However…
“Is that all?” Shi Yu stood in the fire world in the air and watched as the Vermillion Bird super divine resonated with the Vermillion Bird faith without any ripples.
What did it mean… that was all?
As Shi Yu spoke, the anger of the Vermillion Bird super divine burned to the extreme. The countless spectators who were paying attention to this battle were also very speechless. This… was the power to casually resonate with the power of faith of hundreds of starfields!!
Although it was restricted by the distance and couldn’t be mobilized immediately, as long as he was given enough time, the Vermillion Bird super divine undoubtedly had that ability!

chapters.title: Chapter 1731 - 1731: Smashing to Death (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1731: Smashing to Death (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
It could be said that as the strongest Vermillion Bird evolver now, it could plunder the power of faith of the Vermillion Bird in the entire universe at will even if it was on someone else’s body. This was the terrifying thing about the Four Saints super divine. It was almost equivalent to unlimited power.
Countless super divines looked at the dazzling starry sky and even felt the pressure. However, Shi Yu seemed to not take this situation seriously at all. At this moment, even the Sun God General focused all his gaze on Shi Yu.
“So arrogant. I thought you were the Vermillion Bird itself.” “How much of this power of faith is born because of you?”
“You’re just a thief who stole the power of faith of the last era.”
“You think you can ignore everything just because you obtained the power of the strongest Vermillion Bird. You’re really stupid.”
Under the gaze of the entire World King Planet, Shi Yu said calmly, “Letting you mobilize this power of faith is really sullying them.”
“What did you say!!!” The Vermillion Bird super divine didn’t expect Shi Yu to still be stubborn at this moment.
“How dare you! The Green Dragon super divine and the other holy beasts also had furious gazes.
“As expected, he’s a lunatic.” Countless people were stunned. At this moment, Shi Yu’s battle power gradually activated. He, who had once trained under the will of a cosmic overlord, was extremely relaxed in the face of the deterrence of the Vermillion Bird super divine.
Boom.
He opened the Beast Taming Space incomparably naturally. One, two, three, four layers… A total of 13 layers clearly fell into everyone’s eyes, shocking them.
“It’s really the 13th heavenly layer. That Exposing King… is telling the truth! ! ”
As soon as the 13th heavenly layer appeared, Shi Yu’s aura was completely not inferior to that of a super divine expert who had reached transcendent 3. It shocked countless divine and super divine experts. Those ancient geniuses who had woken up from their sleep looked at Shi Yu’s 13th heavenly layer phenomenon in shock and took a deep breath.
“Is this your trump card???”
However, at this moment, when the Vermillion Bird super divine saw Shi Yu e s “strongest trump card”, it only wanted to laugh. Therefore, these geniuses were all conceited.
“Who told you that this is my trump card?” Shi Yu said. “As a Beast Tamer, isn’t opening the Beast Taming Space basic before summoning a pet?”
“The little bird in the cage hasn’t fought in many years.”
“Since you’re still immersed in your beautiful dream, then…” Shi Yu couldn’t help but laugh. His laughter was especially ear-piercing in the eyes of the Vermillion Bird super divine.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu was indeed summoning his pet!!
However, the pet he summoned was beyond everyone’s expectations! !
It wasn’t the most likely Eleven, Ling, and Susu exposed by the Exposing King, but another one. No one had any information at all.
On Duel Star, countless spatial cracks appeared. In the torn cosmic hole, five fingers that were enough to shatter stars and were covered in hair slowly stretched out as if they wanted to grab something.
“Roar!!!” Accompanied by its shocking roar, the entire starry sky trembled. Countless star life forms revealed incredulous expressions.
Some experts were first stunned. Then, their expressions were extremely incredulous.
Under their gaze, a monster that wasn’t small compared to the Duel Star and was countless times larger than the current super divine Vermillion Bird directly descended.
“Cosmic behemoth!! Shi Yu actually contracted a cosmic behemoth! ! ” “This aura… Epoch god level, there’s definitely no mistake.”
“Moreover, it’s not an ordinary epoch god. It’s the highest level among the epoch gods, an existence comparable to transcendent 3.”
Seeing this behemoth appear, countless Beast Tamers were shocked. The difficulty of contracting a cosmic behemoth could be said to be the highest among all pets. Where exactly was Shi Yu? When…
The pet Shi Yu sent was actually not a pet that anyone was familiar with. It completely stunned everyone.
Even the Green Dragon super divine and the others were stunned. However, after being stunned, they were confused. Could it be that Shi Yu’s trump card was this cosmic behemoth?
It had to be said that Shi Yu summoning an invincible cosmic behemoth shocked many people. However, from the perspective of the Four Saints super divine, even if Shi Yu and this cosmic behemoth worked together, it was definitely impossible to defeat the Vermillion Bird super divine…
However, no one expected that this was only the beginning.
Under everyone’s gaze, this invincible behemoth directly used its eyes that were comparable to stars to stare at the Vermillion Bird super divine that had focused on it. Then, it was willing to give up the glory of the Cosmic Behemoth Race and its huge body. Under the gaze of countless people, it began to slowly shrink and turn into a stick in the light!
Yes, it was a stick.
Everyone was extremely incredulous. When they saw the stick fall into Shi Yu’s hand, they were even more incredulous. When they saw Shi Yu’s change, terrifying white flames began to spread from his body. His aura, fluctuations, and might were rising at an unbelievable speed.
At this moment, even the Sun God General couldn’t help but look sideways.
Boom! !!!
Under the eruption, Shi Yu’s muscles increased exponentially, and his hair stretched infinitely. It was like a black waterfall in reverse, shooting into the sky and filled with a sense of power. On his body, the inner layer was wrapped in a black aura, and the outside was wrapped in white flames. One was black, and the other was white. In addition, the huge red staff in his hand that had turned from a cosmic behemoth directly made Shi Yu’s image unfamiliar.
“Then… let me break your dream.” Shi Yu’s change could be said to have exceeded everyone’s expectations again. At this moment, several deeply hidden figures couldn’t help but appear..

chapters.title: Chapter 1732 - 1732: Smashing to Death (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1732: Smashing to Death (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Emperor Shi’s figure appeared on the Blue Planet battleship, shocking the surrounding Emperor Kong and the others. However, soon, everyone looked at Shi Yu.
“F*ck, what’s this!!!” Ming Gu and the others were extremely shocked. Unlike the power of the Vermillion Bird super divine that infinitely resonated with the outside world and stretched out before gathering, Shi Yu’s eruption completely erupted from their bodies. It was a terrifying power that belonged to them alone. It was so terrifying that it was enough to ignore everything. “Even that cosmic behemoth can only become a vassal of this power.”
Countless Beast Tamers’ pupils constricted. As Shi Yu Shapeshifted, they understood why that cosmic behemoth was willing to become a weapon.
“Impossible!” At this moment, even the Green Dragon super divine and the others exclaimed in their hearts. This was because what Shi Yu was displaying now was really an extreme difference from what they had expected.
They originally thought that Shi Yu’s strongest trump card was the realm of the thirteen heavens and the combined strength of a few epoch god pets. However, this ridiculous scene stimulated the hearts of the Four Saints super divines at all times because they sensed power that exceeded everything and was comparable to a high-level transcendent on the current fused Shi Yu!!
“Exterminate! At that moment, the most shocked was still the Vermillion Bird super divine. It was originally waiting for Shi Yu, this little white rabbit, to display its strength before being mercilessly crushed by it, but who would have thought that the originally harmless little white rabbit would instantly turn into a terrifying black hole, as if it wanted to devour everything?
As soon as the word “annihilate’! fell, Shi Yu waved the huge stick in his hand and fused with the source power. He smashed at the Vermillion Bird super divine from afar. On the side of the planet, a terrifying shock wave instantly made the entire planet tremble, making the planet coat that isolated all power tremble violently!
“Vermillion Bird…” In the face of this terrifying attack, the Vermillion Bird super divine let out a high cry. It waved its Heaven Sweeping Wings, and the World Destruction Flame that fused with the power of faith swept over like a sea of fire.
However, in the face of this simple shock wave, the endless World Destruction Flame was smashed into oblivion by the rod with a boom. The shock wave devoured the World Destruction Flame and landed on the Vermillion Bird super divine at a speed faster than the speed of light.
In an instant, the huge body of the Vermillion Bird super divine shattered like paper. Accompanied by the cry of the Vermillion Bird super divine, its body was actually directly blown up. Flame-like blood rain splattered in all directions, filling the sky with stars.
In an instant, the entire place fell silent.
Countless people who were paying attention to this battle revealed incredulous expressions. However, this wasn’t the end. How could the Vermillion Bird super divine be defeated so easily? As the strongest faith god, as long as its faith wasn’t destroyed and it didn’t die, it was already a basic operation.
Almost instantly, the Vermillion Bird super divine that was killed by Shi Yu’s club was reborn from the flames and recovered to its original state. However. at this moment, everyone could feel an indescribable shock in its eyes.
It seemed to not understand why Shi Yu had such ridiculous battle power.
“As long as your faith isn’t destroyed and you don’t die, I’ll make you lose your faith.” Shi Yu’s voice resounded through the starry sky as he swung his rod again. This time, the Vermillion Bird super divine let out an angry cry. The five Sun of Transcendences on its body flickered as it used a killer move different from the World Destruction Flame. However, in an instant, everyone saw Duel Star darken. With a swing, the Vermillion Bird super divine’s body collapsed again, turning into a blood mist that filled the sky that was smashed by the rod!
The transcendent Yang on its body was also extinguished. At this moment, the White Tiger and Black Tortoise super divines were shocked and couldn’t understand.
And this was only the beginning of everything Shi Yu had planned. As the Vermillion Bird super divine revived for the second time, a black-clothed Sword Maiden slowly appeared beside Shi Yu and protected him.
She had a beautiful appearance with a small red Vermillion Bird on her shoulder. Both parties looked at the condensed Vermillion Bird phantom with cold expressions.
“Shi Yu!!!” The Vermillion Bird super divine roared angrily. However, it saw that Shi Yu was already sitting on a throne that slowly materialized in the sky, standing tall in the sky with the huge rod.
“You’re too weak.’
“He’s not worthy of him attacking.” Chi Tong was like a guard on a throne. It conjured the Vermillion Bird Sword and attacked the Vermillion Bird super divine.
At this moment, the Vermillion Bird super divine couldn’t understand why a weak ant whose aura wasn’t even comparable to the epoch god dared to attack him.
But soon, it realized that it was wrong. At some point in time, it realized that it had actually started to slowly lose control of the power of faith of the Vermillion Bird and replace it. It was the guy in front of it who plundered its strength.
Skill: Faith Plunder
[Effect]: As long as you kill it once, you can plunder a portion of its faith authority.
The move Shi Yu had deduced for Chi Tong and the others, together with the martial power of the fused Shi Yu, could weaken the Four Saints super divines to the greatest extent and strengthen his Four Saints pets.
Although this move belonged to a pet, because Shi Yu had a contract with a pet, it could also be seen as the same body.
Under Shi Yu’s killing, after two rounds, Chi Tong had already plundered a lot of the Vermillion Bird super divine’s faith authority. Even the Vermillion Bird super divine itself didn’t realize that because it had lost its faith authority, it had revived for the second time. Because it didn’t have enough power of faith, its strength was already less than one-tenth of its peak strength.
On the other hand, although Chi Tong wasn’t an epoch god, after plundering the authority of faith, under the enhancement of the power of faith, it relied on the faith system to obtain super divine battle power in one go..

chapters.title: Chapter 1733 - 1733: Smashing to Death (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1733 - 1733: Smashing to Death (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
When enemies met, their eyes were especially red. The Vermillion Bird super divine glared at the thief who had plundered its power of faith, but what awaited it was Chi Tong, whose killing intent had accumulated to the extreme.
After Shi Yu was assassinated, the existence of the Four Saints super divine had long infuriated Chi Tong infinitely.
This time, there was finally a chance to fight. Chi Tong had fulfilled its wish.
Boom!!!
No one expected that the final battle would evolve into a battle between Chi Tong and the Vermillion Bird super divine. Shi Yu didn’t even send all his pets in the face of the incomparably powerful Four Saints super divine.
Apart from arming his pets, he even sent only one pet of the same faith as the opponent of the Vermillion Bird super divine.
He… really planned to use the Four Saints super divines as his stepping stones and his pets’ stepping stones to personally kill the corresponding Four Saints super divines and rewrite the Four Saints systems of the World King Planet! !
It was an extremely crazy move. “You will definitely die!!!”
“l won’t lose.’
However, what shocked everyone the most was that Chi Tong, who wasn’t even a epoch god, also displayed a strong pressure when facing the Vermillion Bird super divine. A will that exceeded everything was tempering Chi Tongs heart.
Chi Tong didn’t allow her to lose. The Beast Tamer had even paved the way for her. If she still lost in the faith competition, she would be ashamed of her identity as the sword’s guardian.
At the moment, Shi Yu was protecting her path of growth.
Then, she also had to use her determination to prove to Shi Yu that she would respond to this guardian.
At this moment, Chi Tongs heart gradually strengthened. Although Shi Yu didn’t interfere in the battle and was preserving his strength, he didn’t forget to strengthen Chi Tong through telepathy!
With his current strength, it was enough to strengthen Chi Tong to the invincible realm.
For the growth of her pet, the Beast Tamer protected her in battle. In order to obtain stronger power to protect the Beast Tamer, the pet also responded.
Under the illumination of the two parties, everyone only saw this scene. The red-haired Sword Maiden holding the Vermillion Bird Sword shone with the huge Vermillion Bird Divine Sword Feather in the sky. Under the continuous confrontation of the two parties, accompanied by a violent cry, as the red-haired Sword Maiden’s will sublimated, an extremely dazzling sword light that illuminated the starry sky and destroyed countless rivers of faith broke through the resistance of the Vermillion Bird super divine and landed on its body.
“Jiu…” The Vermillion Bird super divine’s miserable cry resounded through the starry sky. This time, it lost to Chi Tongs main body. Its faith authority was completely plundered, and it directly lost the power to be reborn. Under its confused, frightened, and lost expression, the body of this Four Saints super divine that had dominated for countless years was divided into two, and its soul was completely obliterated.
Just like that, the battle that almost no one thought highly of ended with the Vermillion Bird super divine being broken in two. In the silent universe, countless people panted as they watched the Vermillion Bird super divine figure slowly turn into light and completely disappear from this world.
If it weren’t for the power of faith, it wouldn’t have been able to live for so
At this moment, without the power of faith, its traces of existence would completely disappear.
The Green Dragon, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise looked at their old friend in shock. They died tragically under Chi Tongs sword just like that, and their hearts turned extremely cold.
What they were most unwilling and hoped for had still happened.
“Ancestor…”
On World King Planet, the faces of the members of the Vermillion Bird Family were almost pale to the extreme. They couldn’t believe that the supreme god spirit they had believed in for countless years had died tragically in the hands of Shi Yu, who was only a newbie who had become a god a few years ago.
“He…”
“Shi Yu… Shi Yu, he…” Countless people looked at Shi Yu, who was sitting on the throne and watching his pet kill the Four Saints super divines. Their hearts… were filled with extreme panic.
Those divine-level experts who had woken up from their sleep were shocked to the extreme. It was difficult to understand such an existence.
What kind of monster could kill a fifth-stage super divine like a dog with a divine-level body and even treat it as a sparring partner for pets?
Not to mention outsiders, even the Space Emperor and the others gasped. Their originally unstable hearts completely stabilized.
As expected, Shi Yu was a monster.
At the side, Emperor Shi couldn’t help but smile. He had indeed chosen the right person.
“Alright.” At this moment, as Chi Tong took the source of transcendence dropped by the Vermillion Bird super divine from the sky, Shi Yu got up from the throne and looked at the remaining three holy super divines with shocked expressions.
“Who’s next?”
“Come up and receive your death. Don’t make me wait too long..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1734 - 1734: Battle of Pets (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1734 - 1734: Battle of Pets (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
How arrogant.
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was pointing at the “three holy super divines” and letting them come up to receive their deaths, was really too arrogant.
However, the audience was already trembling and speechless.
The members of the Four Holy Families who were paying attention to this battle had pale faces. They couldn’t even say a word for the family ancestor.
Shi Yu t s strength had already infinitely risen to a level higher than the Four Saints super divines. Ants like them had no right to comment.
“He’s really dead…” Until now, there were still people who felt like they were in a dream.
The Vermillion Bird super divine died just like that(
The Four Saints and the super divine were all at the middle stage of transcendent. There wouldn’t be an excessive difference in strength in essence.
Although the Green Dragon’s super divine growth level was the highest, that was because it had lived the longest among the Four Saints. In terms of true strength, it was definitely impossible for it to kill the Vermillion Bird super divine so easily.
However, Shi Yu did it. The battle process was like crushing a prey and throwing it to the pet to enjoy.
At this moment, the experts could sense Chi Tongs gradually stronger aura. After personally hunting the Vermillion Bird super divine, Chi Tongs eyes returned to indifference. It held the source of transcendence for Shi Yu and waited for the order.
“Another invincible epoch god.”
“Moreover… it even dropped the source of transcendence!”
Many experts took a deep breath, wanting to see how the three saint super divines faced this scene.
At that moment, the Green Dragon, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise super divines panicked.
Seeing that the Vermillion Bird super divine was beaten to death twice by the two clubs and couldn’t even defeat Shi Yu’s pet, their faith was plundered and they became nutrients for others. They shouted crazily in their hearts.
Something was wrong, something was wrong! !
Didn’t the Exposing King say that Shi Yu t s strongest trump card was his miraculous level in the era of the 13th heavenly layer?
What was going on now!
They looked at the ghost hair that shot into the sky and could sense that Shi Yu’s current strength was extremely rich. The pressure was comparable to transcendent high-level.
“Eh, heh.” Exposing King Tu Tu was also hiding in the dark. After the shock, he was completely convinced by his sister. She was right to run out to find the source of transcendence. Sister, she was right!
Otherwise, how could he have encountered a monster like Shi Yu and grown up with him?
At this moment, in the eyes of the Exposing King, Shi Yu was completely destined to reach the peak of the super divine level. From ancient times until now, apart from the six cosmic levels, his talent potential was seventh!
It really had the bearing of a cosmic emperor.
“This is the auspicious you’re talking about?” At the moment, although the
Green Dragon and White Tiger super divine had cold and silent expressions, their hearts weren’t calm. They were still questioning the Black Tortoise super divine.
As for the Black Tortoise super divine, it couldn’t understand no matter what. It had divined three times, and the outcome of the transcendent duel was clearly auspicious!
However, what it didn’t know was that its divination results had already been disturbed by the gem cat. Shi Yu’s fate involved the last era, and not everyone could spy on him at will.
“The duel continues.” The Sun God was the only one who was relatively calm among these people. It looked at the Green Dragon super divine and signaled for the transcendent duel to continue.
Shi Yu had issued a transcendent duel application to the Four Saints super divine, and the Four Saints super divine had also agreed. According to the order of the response, it was the battle between the Green Dragon super divine and Shi Yu.
“Green Dragon, quickly, quickly kill it.”
“Don’t give it a chance to recover. In its state, it consumes a lot of energy. The two strikes just now have already exhausted it severely.”
“You can’t use it a third time in the short term!” the Black Tortoise super divine said.
“Are you serious?!”
The Green Dragon super divine’s current heart was very ferocious. It had been a long time since it had felt the palpitations of facing a strong enemy when it was weak.
What the Green Dragon super divine never expected was that the guy who made it feel this way again was actually just a divine-level human.
“Roar! !!! ” The Green Dragon super divine swung its green body that crossed the starry sky and aimed its five claws at the Duel Star. Its golden-red eyes were filled with killing intent, and the dragon roar contained extreme anger, as if it wanted to cover its other emotions with anger.
“You’re unforgivable! ! ! ”
Under the gaze of the White Tiger super divine and the Black Tortoise super divine, it flew towards Duel Star.
“l guessed it.” The Black Tortoise super divine saw that the Green Dragon super divine had finally passed and thought to itself. However, it felt that its guess made sense. It couldn’t delay!!
The Vermillion Bird super divine was really too unlucky to have encountered such a strange eruption mystic technique. Fortunately, it was the last response. It hoped that the next Green Dragon would directly defeat Shi Yu!
Otherwise… the White Tiger and it would have to fight. The Black Tortoise super divine’s gaze was nervous. If it couldn’t even defeat the Vermillion Bird and the Green Dragon, would they be a match?
Then, the Green Dragon super divine descended on the Duel Star, making everyone fall silent again.
If it were in the past, no one would have thought highly of Shi Yu, but now, they felt that the battle was developing in an abnormally strange direction.
“Are you the one who came to die?” Shi Yu said. “l remember that you were the one who contacted the Assassin Planet to assassinate me, right?”
“Of course, the assasination plan was planned by your Four Holy Family together.”
Shi Yu was still sitting on the Void Throne. The rod was placed beside him. Chi Tong had already returned and was guarding the side.
“Little brat, you’re still slandering me! The Green Dragon descended and attacked Shi Yu. “Do you know what you’ve done?”
“Can you still continue using such an attack by relying on opportunistic methods?”
“You… are simply guilty. You actually caused such a big killing for your own selfish desires..

chapters.title: Chapter 1735 - 1735: Battle of Pets (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1735 - 1735: Battle of Pets (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
When the Green Dragon super divine descended, the environment of the entire Duel Star instantly became a new world. The entire star turned green, as if it had become the home ground of the Green Dragon super divine.
Although it wasn’t as high-profile as the Vermillion Bird super divine, it still used the power of creation with all its might. With the power of a world, it fused into the huge claw and tore at Shi Yu.
In Shi Yu’s eyes, it was as if a world filled with starlight was smashing down. That was not an ordinary world. This world could accommodate thousands of stars, and its weight was no longer something ordinary Star Arms could compare to.
In fact, although the Green Dragon super divine’s words sounded like he was comforting himself that Shi Yu couldn’t use such a third strike, the experts watching the battle were more willing to admit this in their hearts.
Because those two terrifying attacks were definitely something that could only be launched by super divine experts who had transcended above seven times. They felt that such an attack was acceptable even if a super divine level Beast Tamer used it with his pet.
However, with Shi Yu at the divine level… Even if Shi Yu broke through the limit of the divine level three times, it was too unbelievable. If there was no huge price, it would really make them doubt life.
Could he still hit the third stick?
Everyone stared at the Duel Star and wanted to know because this might be related to the final outcome of the battle between Shi Yu and the Four Saints super divine.
Initially, no one thought highly of Shi Yu at all. They thought that Shi Yu, who rashly challenged the Four Saints super divine, would definitely lose. However, from the moment Shi Yu shapeshifted, the situation had completely reversed. Now, the final outcome depended on how long Shi Yu could last in that state.
“As you wish,” Shi Yu said in the face of the Green Dragon super divine attack.
His figure disappeared from the Void Throne almost instantly. It was the same for the red rod that Bu Lu had turned into. When they appeared, they directly flashed in front of the Green Dragon super divine attack.
“Smash it!!!” Bu Lu shouted. The effect was that the huge staff emitted a strong sound of breaking through the air. Under the gaze of the Green Dragon’s super divine dragon eyes, Shi Yu held the Red Golden-Hooped and swung it at its dragon claws.
In the next moment, with a boom, the Green Dragon World Creation shattered. A world was shattered by this rod, and the entire Duel Star recovered its original appearance as if it had shattered. A peak-level dragon claw that had fused with many skills of the Green Dragon super divine also
instantly festered and turned into fragments of starlight. Then, this rod ruthlessly smashed onto the Green Dragon super divine!
In an instant, the Green Dragon super divine, whose physical strength was much stronger than the Vermillion Bird super divine and whose vitality was much larger than the Vermillion Bird super divine, directly didn’t escape the outcome of being smashed by a club under everyone’s gaze.
“Roar! Accompanied by a wail, its body exploded. Blood mist filled the sky, and a green halo shone in all directions, making countless power of faith have nowhere to lean.
“That’s it.” Shi Yu swung his staff and steadily put away his weapon. He looked down at the blood mist that filled the sky.
The entire place was silent.
“Did you treat my normal attacks as some very powerful move?” Shi Yu stood in the air and looked at the constantly reviving Green Dragon as he spoke calmly.
Combining with his previous life’s body was really not an overload mystic technique. Of course, the consumption was huge, but it was completely not to the extent of withering after just two strikes.
“Do you need me to smash it again?” Shi Yu was extremely considerate.
“…Forget it, I’ll let my pet play with you next.” However, Shi Yu thought about it and shook his head.
“If I smash all of you, they won’t be able to accumulate battle experience. That bird just now clearly isn’t lively anymore after smashing it twice.”
“Roar!!!” As Shi Yu kept mocking, the revived Green Dragon was shocked, furious, and panicked. What awaited it was another roar.
“Roar!!” In the spatial ripples, Buggy, who was covered in green scales, had golden dragon horns, and had white dragon feathers that stretched like a sea of clouds, directly took over the battle. It held the star-like Dragon Ball and smashed it at the Green Dragon super divine!!
“Little brat! As the Green Dragon super divine roared, it realized that the
Green Dragon in front of it was ridiculously strong. Apart from the terrifying Green Dragon body, there was also a huge, noble, and supreme phantom that looked like a real Green Dragon superimposed on this Green Dragon.
In an instant, the Green Dragon super divine actually felt that it couldn’t mobilize a trace of the power of faith at this moment.
The main reason wasn’t that the faith authority of the Green Dragon super divine had been plundered, but that its evolution speed in the direction of the Green Dragon was inferior to Buggy to begin with. At this moment, Shi Yu activated the Green Dragon Domain through the source power. Under the enhancement of the two power systems of the previous era, Buggy was the most orthodox Green Dragon in this world.
The pupils of the Green Dragon super divine constricted. Although it was shocked, it could only be forced to deal with the enemy. In an instant, the wind and clouds changed, and space wailed. The two huge Green Dragons collided. Everyone was shocked to discover that not only could the Vermillion Bird super divine not defeat Chi Tong, but even the Green Dragon super divine didn’t have any advantage over Shi Yu’s Green Dragon pet.
Boom!!!
The dragon claw and the dragon ball collided. The dazzling light directly swallowed the two Green Dragons. Countless constellations flickered in the light and collided. Then, they turned into fireworks and disappeared!! “Roar! The Green Dragon super divine’s angry roar came from the light. “The faith authority of the Green Dragon super divine… was also deprived!!!”
Countless experts discovered in shock and sensed the anger and panic of the Green Dragon super divine. They clearly couldn’t understand Shi Yu’s strange methods.
After all, the Four Saints were super divine life forms that had reached the extreme in the faith system..

chapters.title: Chapter 1736 - 1736: Battle of Pets (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1736 - 1736: Battle of Pets (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Did they lose their faith authority so easily?
“Looks like you, who has lost your faith, are only a stronger dragon. I wonder if you will be devoured by your faith in the end?”
At this moment, Shi Yu had already left the battlefield again. He stared at Buggy, who was enhanced by the source power Green Dragon Domain, fighting the weakened Green Dragon super divine.
This action was undoubtedly very ridiculous. Although this was most likely the case in the Beast Taming Duel, Shi Yu clearly had the strength to instantly change the situation, but…
“Does this guy really use the Four Saints super divine as a sparring partner and as an EXP package??”
At this moment, the experts watching the battle were numb.
How could there be such a person? He didn’t have any respect for his opponent, but his strength was ridiculously terrifying, enough to treat battle as a game.
“Green Dragon…”
At that moment, the most uncomfortable were still the White Tiger super divine and the Black Tortoise super divine. Although they weren’t the ones fighting, they were more shocked than anyone when they saw the Green Dragon super divine being suppressed.
If the Green Dragon also lost, wouldn’t it be their turn?
“Green Dragon, you can’t lose!”
To be honest, they no longer wanted to fight Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s methods were really too strange. Until now, they still couldn’t understand.
“Roar!!!” At that moment, the Green Dragon super divine was still extremely angry. For faith gods, there was nothing more infuriating than plundering their faith.
At this moment, the Green Dragon super divine understood. Shi Yu had already defeated them from the start and was the most prepared.
It had never expected that it would one day be like a beast in the colosseum for others to play with.
But no matter what, at least it wanted to kill the Green Dragon in front of it.
It was even more unforgivable for a thief who stole its power of faith.
“Without the power of faith, you’re just an ant, as weak as a worm.” Although it didn’t have the right to believe, the Green Dragon super divine was still powerful. It fought back and forth with Buggy, who had been strengthened by the fusion Shi Yu and had complete faith authority.
Roar!!!
