Under the roar, many parts of Buggy’s body shattered. The blood that Buggy fell on burned in the fire of faith, igniting the starry sky.
Of course, Buggy could also smash the opponent’s body. A bead could make the Green Dragon super divine explode once, and neither side would give in.
“Do you look down on bugs?”
On the Duel Star, Buggy, who was fighting the Green Dragon super divine, had always been very calm. It definitely had to kill the Green Dragon super divine, but most importantly, it wanted to find its way forward under the pressure of the Green Dragon super divine.
As it fought, combined with its experience, Buggy finally understood what it should do.
In the eyes of the Green Dragon, Buggy, an ethereal blue butterfly slowly appeared. This ethereal blue butterfly slowly degenerated into a white cocoon. In the end, there was only a Green Silkworm left as the core of the Green Dragon.
“Buggy, so what?”
Until now, Buggy’s heart had never changed. Even if it evolved into the strongest Green Dragon, it still didn’t forget that it was only a Green Silkworm at the start. That was its original appearance.
Everyone knew that the Green Dragon was strong, but after Buggy experienced so many evolutions, its understanding went from thinking that dragons were the strongest to thinking that even if it was just a worm, it could still climb to the highest peak.
If the Queen of the Worms could reach the same realm as the Green Dragon, why couldn’t it, the Green Silkworm?
Courage? Shi Yu gave it to him.
The evolution body of the Green Dragon that it had imagined was just a shell that absorbed the power of the outside world on its evolution path.
In the end, the power of these shells would integrate into its heart and become its nutrients.
With such faith and 100% trust in Shi Yu, Buggy’s Green Silkworm main body directly absorbed the Green Dragon shell and collided with the Green Dragon super divine in the form of an extremely small Green Silkworm that was less than 1% the size of a super divine scale.
Boom!!!
The incomparably small Green Silkworm was wrapped in white light like worm silk and collided with the Green Dragon super divine. It wasn’t at a disadvantage at all. Instead, the Green Dragon super divine was in pain as one of its claws exploded.
“What a joke!!!” Seeing the life in front of him humiliate him like this, the Green Dragon super divine was about to lose its mind.
“Buggy, crush it,” Shi Yu said.
Another epoch god.
This was the Super Divine Heart. No matter what race it was, it was still confident of defeating all enemies.
Shi Yu and the others felt that there was nothing wrong with Buggy, but outsiders didn’t think so. At this moment, when they saw Buggy abandon the Green Dragon Body and directly transform into a green worm at the bottom of the transcendent world, their stomachs hurt.
This pair of Beast Tamers and pets really knew how to stir up everyone’s nerves. There were simply no restrictions.
“l miss it so much.” At this moment, seeing Buggy show its might and suppress the strongest Green Dragon with the posture of a Green Silkworm, in Dong Huangs direction, be it Senior Lu or Senior Panda, their gazes flickered as they recalled the scene of Buggy driving the Ice Dragon Phantom to kill everyone in the vocation examination.
In the blink of an eye, the Butterfly of Imagination and the Dragon of
Imagination returned to their Green Silkworm state. Perhaps this was why Buggy named itself the Worm of Imagination.
After Buggy broke through to the epoch god level, although it abandoned the Green Dragon shell, 100% of the Green Dragon’s power fused into its body. Not only did it not weaken, but it was even stronger. This was because the skills it mastered had all reached transcendence.. This was also the power of the transcendent divine-level Dragon of Imagination!

chapters.title: Chapter 1737 - 1737: Battle of Pets (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1737: Battle of Pets (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Hundreds of rivers flowed into the sea, and then, ten thousand bodies became one.
Under the enhancement of the power of the Creation God, it was now the Worm of Creation, with the ability to split the sky and earth.
“Buggy silk.” Shi Yu gave Buggy the final command. A white worm silk that had fused with the spatial strengthening of Shi Yu and fused with the power of creation was waved out by Buggy like a piece of art.
It first drew a beautiful arc in the sky, then danced straight across the Green Dragon super divine body!
This attack shocked the Green Dragon super divine. This was because Buggy had recovered its Green Silkworm form and was even stronger than when it was in the Green Dragon form. It was extremely ridiculous.
“You guys…” Until now, the Green Dragon super divine still couldn’t understand why Shi Yu would grow so quickly and why it would lose so badly. It only had regret now, regret that it didn’t immediately kill Shi Yu personally after Shi Yu took away the ruins.
At that time, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t have been so troublesome. However, there was no medicine for regret in the world. No matter who it was, they couldn’t imagine that a divine-level could grow to the point where he could crush a Level 6 transcendent in just a few years.
The Green Dragon’s super divine eyes were filled with dead silence and unwillingness. Its body was sliced into pieces by the worm silk in the blood mist without any traces. Even its soul was only left with a dazzling source of transcendence floating in the void, indicating that the Green Dragon super divine had completely fallen like the Vermillion Bird super divine!
“Next!” Shi Yu said calmly. He didn’t even look at the source of transcendence
and looked outside Duel Star.
“One by one, perhaps it’s too troublesome. Why don’t the two of you attack together?”
“Let my other pets practice too…”
The White Tiger and Black Tortoise super divines were completely stunned in the starry sky.
The Green Dragon Family was the same as the previous Vermillion Bird Family. They looked like they had lost their parents.
The Green Dragon Family genius who had once fought on the same stage as Shi Yu in the God Sealing Battle saw his super divine ancestor die in the hands of his former opponent. His eyes dimmed and he found it unbelievable.
At this moment, the starry sky boiled. After the Vermillion Bird super divine, the Green Dragon super divine also died in Shi Yu’s hands…
No! The pet that died in Shi Yu’s hands, a Green Silkworm, had become Shi Yu’s pet training EXP package! !
The God Sealing Battle became an internal team competition.
A transcendent duel became a pet training battle.
Since ancient times, perhaps only this monster in front of him could do it.
“Why did such a guy appear when I woke up this time?” The eyelids of the awakened experts who originally wanted to go all out twitched when they saw such a fierce Shi Yu. They had the urge to go back and sleep for another 100,000 years.
“Its strength is already completely not inferior to an existence that has transcended the high-level and below seven times. It’s definitely not his match when it encounters him. He has already ascended to the ranks of the experts in the universe.”
Many super divine experts gave Shi Yu a high evaluation. Apart from the cosmic level, the peak of the super divine level was the top expert now. With battle power that exceeded Level 7, it was an incomparably powerful existence,
“Next!!!” At this moment, Blue Planet’s side was also extremely excited.
Even countless experts from the Blue Planet in the Dong Huang Realm, the Floating Realm, the Heavenly Demon Realm, and the Dong Xuan Realm followed Shi Yu’s rhythm and couldn’t help but shout.
“The White Tiger super divine and the Black Tortoise super divine are in trouble! ”
Just as everyone was waiting to see how White Tiger and Black Tortoise planned to deal with Shi Yu, a shocking scene happened.
Two of the Four Saints super divine beings whose reputation resounded through countless eras turned around and ran.
It was as if they had no intention of carrying out a transcendent battle at all.
Seeing their ancestor escape in such a panic, countless members of the White Tiger family and the Black Tortoise family couldn’t believe it. They never expected that before the battle even started, their ancestor would escape without fighting, as if he was shocked.
At this moment, the White Tiger and Black Tortoise only had one thought in their hearts. They definitely couldn’t fight this monster.
They still had some idea in their hearts. They knew that the Vermillion Bird and the Green Dragon super divine had lost so badly, so it was definitely impossible for them to be Shi Yu’s match.
At this moment, even if they gave up their families and everything, they definitely didn’t want to die just like that.
Even if they violated the rules of the transcendent duel and couldn’t survive in the Cosmic Sea on World King Planet, even if they escaped to the hostile Contaminated Land, the Behemoth Empire, the Worm Nest… They definitely didn’t want to die here.
Therefore, the moment the Green Dragon super divine died, they chose to escape. At this moment, they were a little regretful. Why did they accept this transcendent duel? They should have just let the Vermillion Bird super divine take it.
“No way, it escaped???” On the Blue Planet battleship, the gem cat, owl, and the others had incredulous expressions. They didn’t expect to actually see the scene of the White Tiger super divine and the Black Tortoise super divine fleeing.
Their escape speed was extremely fast, and they left this star field in the blink of an eye. Some people whose strength was lower than the super divine level couldn’t even react.
“What the hell?” At this moment, Shi Yu was also rather shocked. He didn’t expect the other party to actually escape in the transcendent battle. However, it wasn’t a big problem. He was even a little surprised. This way, he could openly target the White Tiger family and the Black Tortoise family…
As for them, they couldn’t escape!
“You want to run?” Shi Yu flew out of Duel Star under the escort of Chi Tong and Buggy to pursue his opponent.
However, at this moment, the strongest expert here, the Sun God General, looked indifferently in the direction where the White Tiger super divine and the Black Tortoise super divine escaped.
“A transcendent duel is definitely determined by life and death. Once you accept it, it can’t be changed. According to the rules, those who escape will die.’
It raised its arm that was filled with the flames of the sun and swept it across the air. In an instant, trillions of stars lit up in the Cosmic Sea. Raging flames lit up the pitch-black Cosmic Sea. Even on Blue Planet at the edge of the Cosmic Sea, countless ordinary people raised their heads and looked at the changes in the starry sky.
At this moment, the experts who rushed over from the Behemoth Empire, the Worm Mother Nest, and the overlord territories to the Cosmic Sea to participate in the origin competition saw the pitch-black Cosmic Sea suddenly light up. It was especially spectacular.
In the Contaminated Land, the Dark King Army, who was fighting the Environmental Protection Army, was shocked when they saw the lit Cosmic Sea.
“The Sun God General will awaken.’
“What’s wrong with that guy?” Bing Ling recalled the direction of the Cosmic Sea. Apart from Lord World King, only the Sun God General could do such a phenomenon.
Under the endless light, the White Tiger super divine and the Black Tortoise super divine had nowhere to escape. On the other side of the starry sky, the fleeing White Tiger super divine and the Black Tortoise super divine looked at the flames that swallowed them in shock and let out desperate cries.
In an instant, life was devoured by the power of the star in the Cosmic Sea and instantly insta-killed. It didn’t have the slightest resistance. Even the source of transcendence that erupted was burned by the flames and turned into nothingness.
“The violator is dead.” Outside the Duel Star, the Sun God General said emotionlessly, shocking the experts here. This was the strength of a peak super divine?
Shi Yu, who walked out, also opened his mouth wide. Wait, wait???
That was his opponent!!
In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, Shorty, the Turtle, and the others looked outside and listened to the voices of the outside world. It was like a bolt from the blue, and their expressions froze.
“But…” Shi Yu was just about to say something and ask if the source of transcendence had exploded and who it belonged to. The Sun God General looked at Shi Yu.
“Dong Huang Realm’s realm lord, Shi Yu, the World King wants to see you.
She’s been waiting for a long time..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1738 - 1738: World King’s Mission (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1738: World King’s Mission (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
What?
The World King actually wanted to see Shi Yu?
The words of the Sun God General undoubtedly caused a huge ripple here.
No matter how strong they were or where they were, many people revealed incredulous expressions.
Lord World King… had already woken up?
Logically speaking, the realm king wouldn’t pay attention to such a small matter like a transcendent duel…
“That’s true. With such a big thing happening, it’s impossible for Lord World King to still be sleeping.”
In the direction of the Blue Planet battleship, the Prediction Owl said.
However, why did the Realm King want to see Shi Yu?
Moreover, it had been waiting for a long time?
In other words, from the start of this battle, or even earlier, the World King had already paid attention to Shi Yu?
The Prediction Owl was nervous. She had been around Shi Yu quite a lot. Could it be that she had also been paid attention to by the World King?
“What’s going on?” Lin Feng shouted.
“Because Shi Yu is a special existence,” Emperor Shi said.
“Senior Emperor Shi, what do you mean?” Emperor Space asked in confusion.
In the face of the worried gazes from Lu Qingyi and the others, Emperor Shi said, “It’s alright. If the World King wants to harm Shi Yu, there’s no need to go through so much trouble.”
The Sun God Generl, who was at the peak of the super divine level, could destroy the Four Saints so easily.
It would only take an instant for him to kill Shi Yu.
As for a peak super divine against a World King, it could also be killed in a breath. The difference in battle power was already comparable to a cosmic era.
That was why Emperor Shi said that if the World King wanted to harm Shi Yu, there was no need to make such a big fuss.
On this trip, apart from searching for the path to the cosmic level, Emperor Shi also used his time-element ability to find many opportunities. After breaking through many times in a row, he was even more afraid of the power of the cosmic level.
According to his understanding, every cosmic level was expert in the two major stats of time and space. In other words, the current six cosmic levels had much more time attainments than him.
At the same time, being expert in time and spatial power was a necessary condition to become a cosmic level!
“It’s like this,” the Space Emperor said. “l think… with Shi Yu!s terrifying talent potential, it’s not too much to say that he’s the strongest below the cosmic level. He’ll definitely reach the peak of the super divine level in the future. It seems to be understandable for Lord World King to want to see him.”
“Perhaps the World King wants to nurture Shi Yu into a right-hand man, just like the Sun God General and the others.’
The epoch god who had once killed many super divines on the World King Planet was later incorporated by the World King. He was one of the three peak super divines on the World King Planet and the right-hand man of the World
King.
Perhaps, in the eyes of the World King, Shi Yu was next!
Cosmic-levels didn’t value ordinary super divines, but they still cared a little about peak super divines.
“Lord World King wants to see me?” At the same time, Shi Yu exited his battle state in confusion.
His train of thought was immediately interrupted by the Sun God General. In the face of the envious gazes of countless people around him, Shi Yu only felt strange.
In a year, he had seen two cosmic levels in a row. His experience was probably the only one in the entire universe.
He just didn’t know what the World King wanted to do…
Shi Yu instantly imagined many guesses.
“You’ll understand when we get there.”
When the Sun God General’s will arrived, a spatial black hole appeared not far from Shi Yu. Before Shi Yu could react, he was directly sucked in.
Seeing this scene, Chi Tong, Buggy, Bu Lu, and the others quickly entered the Beast Taming Space and went over with Shi Yu.
“Lucky guy,” the Sun God General thought to himself when he saw Shi Yu’s disappearing figure.
He didn’t know why the World King was looking for Shi Yu.
He only knew that after Shi Yu returned to the World King Planet and issued a transcendent duel to the Four Saints super divines, the World King had already reminded him…
Let him approve this transcendent duel.
If Shi Yu could defeat the Four Saints super divine, she would let Shi Yu meet
her.
If Shi Yu couldn’t defeat the Four Saints super divine, he had to protect Shi Yu t s life under the Four Saints super divine.
Regarding Lord World Kings order, the Sun God General was silent.
The rules of the transcendent duel were definitely determined by the World King. And now, it didn’t matter if the World King broke the rules for this Shi Yu. This was undoubtedly an unbelievable thing.
It could be said that regardless of whether it was stronger than Shi Yu, the fate of the Four Saints super divine had already been decided from the moment the World King paid attention to Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s weight in the heart of the World King was far more important than a mere Four Saints super divine…
“Talent potential? No, it’s not that simple.”
The Sun God General didn’t dare to spy on the reason behind this. He only carried out the orders of the World King one by one.
“Yes, yes, ah.”
At the same time, Shi Yu was teleported to a very unfamiliar place in a daze.
The feeling of the world spinning almost made him vomit.
Damn, did the Sun God General know teleportation?
It wasn’t half as good as Buggy’s skills.
After Shi Yu stabilized his state with physical control, he looked around.
He realized that… he should be on a sky bridge??
The white stone sky bridge floated in the sky, surrounded by a white sea of clouds. Looking up at the blue sky, there were no traces of the starry sky at all.
This was an independent world…
Shi Yu quickly made a judgment.
However, after paying attention to this bridge in the sky, he realized that be it in front or behind, it looked endless. He couldn’t reach the end at all.
“Lord World King, you were looking for me?” Shi Yu didn’t walk around rashly.
Instead, he asked..

chapters.title: Chapter 1739 - 1739: World King’s Mission (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1739 - 1739: World King’s Mission (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios| Editor: Atlas Studios
Zizizizizi…
After Shi Yu spoke, something suddenly changed in front of him.
It was as if countless blue lightning bolts were blinking, or as if a gust was squeezing and howling, gradually forming a pair of blue eyes with white traces above Shi Yu.
“Shi Yu.’
After the incarnation that was suspected to be the World Kings eye appeared, a voice also came from all directions. It was a neutral voice. Shi Yu sensed a power that hit his heart from it.
“Lord World King,” Shi Yu hurriedly greeted.
“You’ve already learned about her from Cypos, right?”
Shi Yu was stunned.
“You mean… the sixth cosmic life form?”
“Yes.
“Lord cosmic overlord did tell me that the sixth cosmic life form had already escaped from prison…”
“As for the rest, I only said that she was sealed by you and the cosmic overlord, Lord World King,” Shi Yu said.
Shi Yu was a little panicked. Sigh, he was the realm lord of the World King
Planet. Although the World King Planet only restricted him from joining the Contaminated Land, the Behemoth Empire, and the Worm Mother Nest, Shi Yu still felt a little guilty.
It was as if something had been discovered.
However, the World King looking for him was related to the sixth cosmic life form?
“This is enough,” the World King said. “Shi Yu, 1 have a quest for you to complete. ”
“Can 1?”
“Quest?” Shi Yu was confused. There were definitely experts stronger than him among the many experts under the World King. Why did they have to look for him…
“What kind of quests?” Shi Yu asked.
“It’s related to ‘archeology’, right?” the World King said. Shi Yu’s eyes lit up. “l see. Lord World King, you’ve found the right person.”
“l can’t guarantee the other quests, but this matter…”
“l believe in your ability.”
“Moreover, you’re the only person who meets the conditions to carry out this mission,” World King said.
“Only you have the two conditions of being a ‘transmigrator’ from the last era and contracting the ‘Time Sprite’.”
As the World King finished speaking, Shi Yu was relatively calm. So that was the case. As expected, everything about him had been seen through by the World King.
Perhaps the cosmic overlord had also seen through it, but it wasn’t interested in caring about this.
Shi Yu guessed that although the mission the World King wanted him to complete was archeology, it should be related to the sixth cosmic life form. As for the sixth cosmic life form, the World King and the cosmic overlord probably had different attitudes…
The cosmic overlord was looking forward to the sixth cosmic life form finding trouble with it, and the World King wanted to achieve some goals through “archeology”.
“Lord World King, please speak,” Shi Yu said.
“l want you to use the Time Sprite to transmigrate to the past and stop the sixth cosmic life form.’
Shi Yu:
“What?” Shi Yu was stunned again.
“Lord World King, can you explain in detail?”
The World King said, “Your Time Sprite’s level isn’t high. It’s very difficult to transmigrate to that distant past now, but with the support of my strength, you can give it a try.”
“But ‘memory’ also has weight. The more you know about her, the harder it will be for you to transmigrate. At that time, I’m helpless.”
“You can only rely on yourself to explore there and find the answer.”
“Besides, what I know isn’t that important. The key information that’s really hidden still needs you to explore it yourselves.”
“Of course, I’ll answer some unimportant information next.”
“One of the information I can tell you is that your Time Sprite is already the last Time Sprite in this universe. As for the power of the other Time Sprites, they have all been stripped away by the sixth cosmic life form.”
“If you don’t deal with her, sooner or later, you will also walk into her line of
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, Qi also shuddered.
“Why is she doing this?” Shi Yu asked.
She was already at the cosmos level, so why was she still interested in the Time Sprite?
There was no need, right?
“You need to find out why yourself,” the World King said.
Initially, Shi Yu was only interested in the “archeological quests”, but now, he felt that he had to listen to the World King in detail.
After all, this concerned Qi. He had to ensure her safety.
Apart from this information, the “memory” mentioned by the World King also had weight, making Shi Yu’s heart skip a beat. Therefore, was this the reason why he had only transmigrated to this era with memories from the mortal stage?
Did he take the initiative to “abandon” the other memories?
Shi Yu looked at the World King. She didn’t seem to be surprised that he was a transmigrator. However, why was this condition an important condition for completing the quests… Shi Yu didn’t understand. “Lord World King, aren’t you surprised by my identity?”
Shi Yu asked.
He was a transmigrator from the last era.
Logically speaking, everything from the previous era couldn’t be preserved until now, right?
“It’s not strange. You’re not an ‘extraordinary the World King said. “Your previous life might have been an impressive expert from the last era, which is why you could achieve such a thing.”
“This might be one of the few ways to survive until the next era. However, I believe you’ve also paid an extremely heavy price.”
Shi Yu smiled bitterly. He really didn’t know what heavy price he had paid because of his memory loss.
Perhaps it was also a price to transmigrate a 20-year-old mortal memory and forget all other experiences.
Shi Yu was quite interested in the topic that he wasn’t “extraordinary”.
In other words, apart from him, were there other lives that had survived in a similar way to him from the last cosmic era?

chapters.title: Chapter 1740 - 1740: World King’s Mission (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1740 - 1740: World King’s Mission (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Even if it was just a memory…
“This is unimportant,” the World King said.
“This is the ‘Space-time Jade’. Its power can support you to transmigrate once.
Its interior records the time coordinates you need to transmigrate.”
“At the same time, its power can also cover the aura of your Time Sprite, preventing it from being detected by anyone. It can even support you staying longer in the past space and time.”
As the World King finished speaking, an emerald green jade appeared in front of Shi Yu.
“Apart from that, there are also some support tools that you might need.”
Then, another spatial stone appeared beside the jade. This was a spatial equipment that contained support tools provided by the World King.
Shi Yu took the two tools and the World King spoke again.
“Whether you can complete the mission not only concerns yourselves, but also determines the peace of the Cosmic Sea to a certain extent.”
“It’s not that there are no risks in this mission. Instead, it’s extremely dangerous.”
“l won’t let you carry out the mission for nothing. As a reward, you can say whatever you want.”
Shi Yu said,
“Well, 1 can only say that I’ll try my best, but 1 might not necessarily be able to complete it. After all, the target is at the cosmic level…”
“What I want is that I think it’s impossible to complete the quests. I can interrupt and give up the authority of this mission at any time… After all, I can’t let my pets take the risk with me.”
“Also, if possible, I’ll go during this period of time. Please take good care of Blue Planet.’
“l understand your wish,” the World King said. “l promise you. After you’re ready, transmigrate to your and the Time Sprite’s mother planet in the near future. From there, you will explore as a starting point. You will slowly know the truth.’
“Remember, don’t use the source of transcendence to break through to super divine. Be it you or your pet, as for why, you should have transmigrated before. There’s no need for me to remind you, right?”
Shi Yu and the World Kings meeting was very short. The other partys riddle made Shi Yu’s heart itch.
Why would the sixth cosmic life form capture the Time Sprite of the entire
universe?
Why must Shi Yu, a transmigrator, do this mission?
What exactly was the sixth cosmic life form doing? What exactly was Shi Yu stopping her from doing?
Shi Yu was a guy with the highest battle power that exceeded the sixth stage.
What ability did he have to stop a cosmic life form?
Even if it transmigrated to the past, it was only a parallel space-time. Could it be that it would affect this space-time?
“Perhaps it will really affect this spacetime,” Shi Yu thought.
Even Emperor Wu and the others below the divine level would obtain the memories of parallel space and time because of the “space-time entanglement” phenomenon.
Then, if he did something in the past, the sixth cosmic life form of this space and time might also be able to obtain relevant memories.
Therefore, what the World King wanted to do himself might be to change some of this sixth cosmic life form’s thoughts.
From there, it affected this space-time from a parallel space.
Of course, this was only Shi Yu’s guess. Perhaps the truth was even more ridiculous. For example, the power of the Time Sprite and the World King could enter the real “past”. If that happened, it would change the “future”.
But no matter what, since the World King had spoken, Shi Yu had no choice but to accept this mission. At the same time, there was also a reason why he was very curious about this archeological quest.
In the outside world.
Shi Yu directly appeared inside the World King Planet, in the Dong Huang Realm.
After being teleported back, he looked at the starry sky and sighed slightly.
“Sob…” In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, Qi was nervous. After the World King mentioned its existence, Qi was shocked.
After saying that the Time Sprite at the sixth cosmic level “specialized in eating”, he was even more shocked.
Archeological Qi was originally quite interested in the archeological sixth cosmic life form, but now… What sixth cosmic life form? Who was it? Did it want to know?
“Shi Yu, are we really going over?” she asked.
“I really didn’t expect that the Time Sprite in the entire universe would actually be stripped of its strength by the sixth cosmic life form. You’re the only one left…” Shi Yu said.
“The current situation is, what if the sixth cosmic life form discovers you and is disadvantageous to you?”
“If the World Kings Space-time Jade can cover your aura, it’s good for us to go over and avoid the limelight first,” Shi Yu said. “If we can deal with the sixth cosmic life form and stop her from targeting the Time Sprite, you’ll be safe after we return.’
At this moment, Shi Yu’s entire team exploded.
Just now, they didn’t dare to communicate, but now, they felt that the World Kings mission was unbelievable.
“According to my analysis, Master, perhaps we don’t have to be so nervous,” Ling said.
“What do you mean?”
“Is it possible that the sixth cosmic life form hasn’t reached the cosmic level at the time we’re going?”
“If the other party is really at the cosmic level, it’s no different from hitting a rock with an egg if the World King lets us go. But if the other party isn’t at the cosmic level at that time, but at the peak of the super divine level, the situation will be very different.”
“In the eyes of the World King, our battle power is close to the high-level super divine level. It might not be impossible to complete such a quest.”
“Moreover, Master, you should be reaching the 14th heavenly layer soon, right?”
“Yes..” Shi Yu nodded. After contracting the epoch god Bu Lu, Chi Tong, and Buggy to break through to the epoch god, he finally felt an opportunity to break through again. He was still suppressing it..

chapters.title: Chapter 1741 - 1741: World King’s Mission (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1741 - 1741: World King’s Mission (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
However, it probably couldn’t suppress it for long.
No wonder no one had broken through to the 14th heavenly layer. The further they went, the harder it became.
Shi Yu had already contracted six epoch gods. In the first team, apart from Baby Ginseng, everyone had already broken through.
In addition, Beast Shi Yu, a guy with mid-stage super divine battle power, felt the opportunity to break through to the 14th heavenly layer.
If it were other Beast Tamers, they would probably need 10 epoch gods to barely match the quality of Shi Yu and the other pets.
At the same time, the lightning tribulation… wasn’t that easy to withstand.
Not all Beast Tamers had a luxurious pet configuration like Shi Yu.
“Wu wu wu.” At this moment, Shi Yu’s team was very concerned about what the World King said.
Only Shorty, Turtle, and Little Quas were depressed, as if they had missed a hundred million dollars and were still depressed.
“Don’t worry, there’s still a chance in the future,” Baby Ginseng said.
But the happy smile on its face showed that it was happy that Shorty and the others couldn’t break through.
Eleven and the others curled their lips.
He thought that the number one in the team, ginseng baby, could be surpassed by the second team’s pet this time.
They were disappointed.
Shi Yu summoned Ling and said, “The Space Emperor and the others should still be outside the sky. Call them back and tell them that I’ve already returned to the Dong Huang Realm.” “Roger, Master,” Ling said.
In the starry sky.
The people here had yet to disperse, and even the Sun God General had already left. There were still tens of thousands of battleships stopping here.
On the Blue Planet battleship, the Space Emperor and the others were waiting for Shi Yu’s return. At this moment, the gem cat received Lings message.
On the battleship, the gem cat looked up and said, “Everyone, Shi Yu has already returned. They’re on World King Planet now. Let’s go back too.”
“Shi Yu is back?” Lin Feng said. “He’s pretty fast. 1 wonder why the World King is looking for him…”
“Don’t tell me he wants to acknowledge a godson,” the gem cat muttered.
“What did you say?” the prediction owl sked.
“No, nothing.” The gem cat covered its mouth and said, “Alright, let’s go back.”
The gem cat did not want the World Kings followers, like the Sun God General, to hear this.
If it was judged for such a small matter, it would cry to death.
The strength of the Sun God General had really frightened the cat just now. It was too terrifying to directly mobilize the power of so many stars in the Cosmic Sea.
Ahhh, when would it become so strong?
Although it was a super race born on the World King Planet, compared to a peak super divine stellar life form, its battle power seemed to be so much inferior.
At this moment, on the Blue Planet battleship, Dong Huang and the others heaved a sigh of relief.
They looked at the messy Duel Star and the already dim universe, and a huge rock in their hearts completely fell.
At least, once the Four Saints super divine were destroyed, there would be no faction that posed a threat to the Blue Planet.
After the allies of the Four Holy Family saw Shi Yu’s strength, they definitely wouldn’t be so bored. For the sake of the Four Holy Family that was destined to be destroyed, they came to make an enemy of the Blue Planet, which was at its peak.
After all, Shi Yu had seen the World King now. Just like how Shi Yu had seen a cosmic overlord in the overlord territory, no one knew what Shi Yu and the World King had discussed. It was equivalent to having a death exemption card on Shi Yu.
In the same camp, even a peak super divine expert like the Sun God General definitely didn’t dare to rashly touch Shi Yu without the command of the World King.
“Blue Planet is gone…” As the Blue Planet battleship left, the ten thousand races in the starry sky noticed.
“Is Shi Yu already back?”
As they watched the Blue Planet battleship leave, all the races in the starry sky were silent. These two transcendent duels could be said to be the highest battle above their level since ancient times.
At the divine level, it was extremely easy to kill a transcendent Level 6. It was simply terrifying.
Until now, no one had known Shi Yu’s true strength.
After all, Shi Yu had more than ten pets. In the current situation, who knew what other trump cards Shi Yu was hiding?
Now, even a super divine that had transcended the high-level was extremely afraid of Shi Yu. The level of fear even exceeded that Emperor Shi of Dong
Huang.
Emperor Shi was down and out..

chapters.title: Chapter 1742 - 1742: A Million Years at a Glance (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1742 - 1742: A Million Years at a Glance (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“I give up.”
At this moment, the people who had been dealt a blow by Shi Yu were everywhere. As the Blue Planet battleship disappeared, on the Star Crow Race’s battleship, Zavay let out a long sigh and shook his head.
“Have you given up on surpassing him?” Ming Gu said. “It’s not embarrassing. Look at those unfamiliar faces that emit a powerful aura. They’re probably divine-level experts who woke up from ancient times. They’re also guys who broke through the limit several times.”
“Even they look panicked by Shi Yu e s existence. Let’s lie flat.”
It wasn’t that these geniuses couldn’t realize that no matter how talented they were, there were even more abnormal guys in the huge universe.
“It’s also a form of self-awareness to be able to recognize the difference.” On the Cosmic Crow Race’s battleship, the super divine ancestor of the Cosmic
Crow Race had appeared at some point in time. It looked at the outside world and said, “The Cosmic Sea is about to change.”
“I wonder what the other four epoch god Beast Tamers will think when they hear the rumors about Shi Yu.’
“If there’s no support from experts who have transcended the high-level or even the peak of the super divine level behind them, those of the same level will probably live in the shadow of Shi Yu…”
“However, it’s said that the accelerated condensation of the transcendent origin this time is controlled by the sixth cosmic life form. What will the direction of this battle be like…” The old time-element super divine seemed to have sensed something bad and said, “This time, the Cosmic Crow Race should try their best to wander outside and not be involved.”
Zavay and Ming Gu looked at the old crowman and lowered their heads to accept his teachings.
At that moment, the entire Cosmic Sea was shocked by this transcendent duel. Shi Yu’s name had already spread widely in the Cosmic Sea. Now, Shi Yu’s name would be even more terrifying. This was because he had destroyed the Four Saints alone and monopolized the Four Saints system alone. The Four Holy super divine had been destroyed. It was obvious that no one would dare to compete with Shi Yu in this faith system in the future.
It could be said that if the name of the Four Holy super divine was very famous in the universe, Shi Yu’s reputation was more than the sum of them.
Dong Huang Realm.
Shi Yu had been waiting for a long time for the descent of the battleship from Blue Planet.
When many familiar faces came down, Shi Yu saw one of the figures and said in surprise, “Senior Emperor Shi??? You’re here too? When?”
In the crowd was Senior Emperor Shi.
Emperor Shi walked down and said, “When you started the battle.”
“I thought you didn’t care about my situation,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“I already have a premonition that you will win this battle. Whether you come or not isn’t that important.” Emperor Shi shook his head.
“In short… it’s good that you’re fine,” the Space Emperor said. “Next is the crusade against the Four Holy Families.”
“That’s right, that’s right. I’ve long disliked them,” Lin Feng said.
Although the transcendent duel said that it didn’t involve the family, how could it not? If the person fighting Shi Yu wasn’t the sect master of the Four Holy Family, but someone else, then it was indeed possible not to involve the family later, because the strongest battle power of the Four Holy Family was still around.
If Shi Yu lost and was killed, it indeed wouldn’t involve Blue Planet. This was because Blue Planet still had a pile of super divine battle power and Emperor Shi. The Four Holy Family wouldn’t act rashly.
However, now that the strongest battle power of the Four Holy Family was dead, the core pillar of the family was gone. Even if Dong Huang didn’t Devour the businesses and factions of the Four Holy Family, the other factions wouldn’t let go of such a popular person.
In fact, even if the other factions didn’t interfere, the Four Holy Family would also be in chaos because of the death of their ancestor. No Four Holy Evolver wouldn’t desire that supreme position.
If the emperor had already fallen, the group of “princes” would definitely be restless.
“Everyone, don’t worry… This kind of thing… is unimportant. I have something more important to discuss with you next.”
“About the World King meeting me just now…”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, Emperor Shi and the others! gazes landed on shi Yu.
When what Shi Yu was doing concerned the cosmic level, they wouldn’t ask further, but now that Shi Yu had taken the initiative to mention it, they had to listen carefully. It meant that it might really be something important.
Then, Shi Yu looked at Emperor Shi, the Space Emperor, even the gem cat, Senior Lu, and the others. “It’s just a World King mission…”
“That’s it. The escape of a sixth cosmic life form might pose a certain threat to the Cosmic Sea. After that, this place might become chaotic.”
“As for me, because I have some special characteristics, I was entrusted by the
World King with a heavy responsibility to carry out a quest. I don’t know how long it will take me to return.”
“During the time I’m not around, Lord World King will take extra care of Blue Planet. Everyone, take care, but I’ll complete the mission as soon as possible and come back. You don’t have to worry.”
“This…” Shi Yu threw the two source of transcendence to the gem cat. The gem cat looked surprised.
“As for this, I’ll leave it to you to study, Teacher Cat. If it’s useless, you guys arrange to split it. I don’t need these for the time being. With my current strength, I don’t rely on the source of transcendence much.”
“Can’t you bring me along for the quests??” The gem cat didn’t expect that Shi Yu wouldn’t bring it along after it became the strongest Star Prayer Race.
“Perhaps not this time, unless you sign a Beast Taming Contract with me.” Shi Yu looked at the car.
“I don’t want to.” The gem cat immediately rejected. Although Shi Yu was very strong, it was a free cat..

chapters.title: Chapter 1743 - 1743: A Million Years at a Glance (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1743 - 1743: A Million Years at a Glance (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
If it didn’t sign a contract with anyone, wouldn’t it still be super divine?
On the other hand, was Shi Yu!s pet super divine? No way!
“You can’t even if you want it. You’re already at the super divine level. I can’t contract you,” Shi Yu said.
“l can!” The Prediction Owl was eager to try.
“I’m at the divine level!”
In any case, the owl had unknowingly been contracted by the first-generation principal of Imperial Capital University once. It was nothing to be contracted by Shi Yu again.
It was really a vicious cycle, giving up the pride of the astrologers.
“l don’t want to,” Shi Yu said. “You should accompany Teacher Owl… Your strength will only be powerful if you use it together. I’ll leave it to you during this period of time…”
“You just don’t fancy me!!!” In Teacher Owl’s humanoid form, it was considered a beauty. It was so angry at Shi Yu that its chest trembled. It didn’t expect Shi Yu to be so disrespectful. How was it inferior to that cat?
Everyone laughed.
Shi Yu also laughed. In short, this mission involved transmigrating through space and time. Only lives who had contracted with him could travel together.
With the contract connection, the consumption of Qi’s teleportation and the others would be much smaller, but if it involved other non-contractors, then… Qi’s small body probably couldn’t withstand it.
Moreover, it didn’t matter if Teacher Cat and Teacher Owl weren’t around this time. Little Zi had completed the Star Contract with them and had already engraved their power projections. If necessary, Little Zi could also use it as a little cat. Although the quality of the skill was definitely inferior to them, it could make do with various buffs.
“Be careful.” Everyone tactfully didn’t ask about Shi Yu t s quests, but a few people, such as the World Tree clone, had already guessed what it was.
It was something special about Shi Yu… A mission that only Shi Yu could complete…
[Time Sprite?] Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, Dragon God, and the others were all very smart, but they didn’t point it out. It involved space and time. This was indeed a difficult mission.
Thinking about it, it must be very related to the sixth cosmic life form. It concerned the stability of the Cosmic Sea.
If there was a dispute between the cosmic emperors, the super divine level was only a number. It wasn’t much different from the divine level in the eyes of the super divine level. It didn’t matter how many people died. It was better not to let such a bloody storm happen.
The mission on Shi Yu might be very difficult.
“This mission is very rushed, so I won’t exchange more pleasantries with everyone. 1 plan to set off soon and return to Blue Planet to prepare later. I’ll leave the matters of the World King Planet to everyone. You guys can handle the Four Holy Family as you wish,” Shi Yu said.
“Forget about the celebration banquet.”
“Shi Yu…” Lu Qingyi, Senior Panda, and the others looked at Shi Yu when they saw him leave in such a hurry again.
They felt that no matter how hard they tried, they couldn’t catch up to Shi Yu. Every time, they couldn’t help him at all.
“Huh? What’s wrong?”
“It’s nothing.”
“Don’t worry, I’ll definitely return safely. This kind of quest… isn’t the first time I’ve carried it out.” Wasn’t it just transmigration archeology? Even if it wasn’t related to the safety of the universe and Qi’s safety, his curiosity would still make him explore with 100% enthusiasm.
Since the World King, this riddler, didn’t say anything, he could investigate it himself.
A few days later.
Blue Planet…
Shi Yu began to transcend the fourth lightning tribulation.
One way or another, this heavenly tribulation only gave Shi Yu more pressure the first and second time,
During the first time, the lightning tribulation came suddenly, and Shi Yu wasn’t prepared at all. The only epoch god, Susu, wasn’t very proficient in resisting the lightning tribulation.
The other pets couldn’t resist at all.
If not for Beast Shi Yu, Shi Yu would have been in danger that time.
From this, it could be seen that even Shi Yu’s configuration was so difficult to resist the first lightning tribulation. One could imagine how miserable the others were.
It was probably a helpless move to avoid the lightning tribulation by sleeping
and sealing itself.
The second time, it was also sudden. Shi Yu and the others also spent a lot of effort, but fortunately, at that time, Susu and Lings skills were all upgraded. There were several transcendent divine skills that were relatively awesome. Only then did it pass. It was only on the third time that Shi Yu created a skill to resist the lightning tribulation for his pet that it became easier. As for now, with the fusion ability of two lifetimes, the lightning tribulation could be destroyed casually, even if it was at the 14th heavenly layer.
No matter how heaven-defying he was at the 14th heavenly layer, he couldn’t possibly be able to kill a high-level super divine battle power, right?
After shocking the entire Blue Planet’s lightning tribulation, Shi Yu reached the 14th heavenly layer of the divine level!
Even excluding the power of Beast Shi Yu, he could still have strength comparable to the middle stage of super divine if he cooperated with the other pets alone.
Including the fusion of Beast Shi Yu, it was definitely not a problem for it to be comparable to an upper-level super divine. No matter where it was, it was an expert.
Shi Yu was even more confident in carrying out this mission.
“This wave, what’s going on!’
“A super divine invasion??”
During the tribulation lightning, the five super divines on Blue Planet were awakened.
“There’s no need to be nervous. Shi Yu is undergoing the lightning tribulation.” The World Tree’s voice lingered in the hearts of the five super divines on Blue Planet.
“Another tribulation transcendence?? Didn’t he just transcend not long ago?
He broke through to the 12th heavenly layer of the divine level so quickly??” The five super divine beings of Blue Planet didn’t understand. This was too sick.
They felt that they had already been completely surpassed by Shi Yu.
World Tree:
“As long as you’re happy,” the World Tree said. “Close your doors.”
As various places on Blue Planet were trembling, Shi Yu clenched his fists under the encirclement of a group of pets and said, “This feeling is really good. Since I’ve broken through, it’s time to set off..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1744 - 1744: A Million Years at a Glance (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1744 - 1744: A Million Years at a Glance (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Did the World King let us set off on Blue Planet because it’s easier to transmigrate on our mother planet, or because of something?”
“Are you leaving?” At this moment, the Blue Planet’s Will also noticed Shi Yu and asked.
“Yes, I’m leaving.” Shi Yu looked up at the phantom in the sky. “Be careful.” This was all the Blue Planet’s Will could say.
“Of course, of course. You guys too,” Shi Yu said.
After the handover to the Blue Planet’s Will was completed, Shi Yu and the others arrived at the Space and Time Island.
Ever since the Mythical Revival, Shi Yu and the others had never come here.
Shi Yu’s plan to clock in to the five dynasties was only interrupted after three. He had never been to the totem era. Shi Yu didn’t expect that his fourth transmigration would be carried out under the commission of the cosmic world king.
“Qi, are you ready?”
“Everyone, are you ready?”
After Shi Yu asked, the pets nodded.
“Ridiculous.” There were also people like Bu Lu who were still shouting ridiculously.
It never expected that it would experience such excitement after following Shi Yu.
First, he killed the Four Saints super divine, then he saw the World King. Then, right on the heels of that, he had to transmigrate to the past to meet the sixth cosmic life form.
Exciting. It felt that although it was a little unlucky for the first half of its life, it had no regrets in this life.
“Bring me there. Nothing bad will happen, right?” Bu Lu whispered. He asked Shi Yu for the umpteenth time if he wanted to keep it.
“Do I look unlucky?” Shi Yu said. “We’ve already defeated the Four Saints super divine. It’s all thanks to you. Without you, I wouldn’t have been confident of coming into contact with the sixth cosmic life form.” “Fighting a cosmic level…” Bu Lu was looking forward to it.
“Calm down, it’s not a fight, it’s a PY.”
“What!s PY?”
“When the opponent is strong, if you can play the emotional card, there won’t be a fight.”
“Wu wu       Eleven and the others let Bu Lu learn more.
In this universe, there was not only fighting and killing, but also the ways of the world.
If he fought with a sixth cosmic life form in the past, wouldn’t the sixth cosmic life form in this space also obtain relevant memories??
On the contrary, if he became friends with the sixth cosmic life form of the past, wouldn’t he have another powerful backer after returning!
In short, since the World King had sent them to the past, the sixth cosmic life form in the past would definitely be easier to talk to!
Then, as Qi appeared, Shi Yu took out the Space-time Jade and said, “Qi, activate it.”
“Alrightm ” Qi took the Space-time Jade and said, “Then I’ll activate it.”
“Okay.” Shi Yu nodded.
As Qi injected the power of space and time, Qi suddenly said in surprise, “Eh, eh, eh, eh.’
A pink and white light enveloped the Space-time Jade and Qi. Qi said in surprise, “Shi Yu, Shi Yu.”
“What’s wrong?”
“The time coordinates recorded by the Space-time Jade are from the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era.”
“It was the time when the three foreign races invaded Blue Planet!!!” “Oh?” Shi Yu was also surprised. Then, a pink transmigration light wrapped around them.
Blue Planet, Mythical Era.
At this moment, Blue Planet was experiencing a disaster.
The descent of the Space Behemoth, the Space Worm, and the Abyss Evil God dyed the blue and beautiful planet in the remote galaxy with a thick layer of war smoke.
From the starry sky, the blue planet was long riddled with holes. A large portion of the ocean had already been dyed in dark colors, and most of the sea area had already been occupied by the Abyss Evil God.
The ground was also in a mess. An intense war was happening everywhere. Countless abnormal monsters fought with the various races on Blue Planet, accompanied by killing and devour.
There were even occasional roars of behemoths coming from the shattered space.
With a flash of light, Shi Yu and the others appeared on an island in the sea that had yet to be polluted.
The moment they arrived, Shi Yu and the others felt the thinness of natural power.
At the same time, it also sensed the incomplete power of laws in this world.
Their strength had more or less been affected and suppressed. If they wanted to use their full battle power, they would probably cause this planet to tremble. However… the impact was not very big. In any case, Blue Planet was already so broken. Where could it break if it destroyed a little more?
It couldn’t be worse than the end of the war, right?
“Wu wu.” After arriving, Qi covered its mouth on the spot, tears flickering in its eyes.
Finally, finally, it had returned to the Mythical Era.
After being touched, the pink-haired Ioli floating in the air looked around excitedly.
Although Qi could transmigrate back with the power of the cosmic realm king, after returning here, the first thing Qi wanted to do was not to investigate some sixth cosmic life form, but to use the battle power it had obtained from Shi Yu to crush the enemy who had bullied it previously!
With Qi’s current strength, forget about those divine-level soldiers who bullied it, it wasn’t even afraid of their boss and those super divine levels now.
Now, Qi was holding a spatial star divine weapon, an enhanced version of time sprite that was expert in Time Acceleration, Time Deceleration, Time Stop, Time Reversal, and other time divine skills!!
The ginseng emperor had once said that space was king, and time was supreme. Now that she had the dual strength of space and time, it wasn’t too much for her to fight a super divine above her level, right?
If the divine-level in the team didn’t have the ability to surpass super divine-level, they wouldn’t have to stay in the team.
“Is this the Mythical Era??” Shi Yu said. “The Blue Planet’s Will has probably already fought with the cosmic behemoth. The laws here have already shattered. Although it’s not that serious, it looks like it was caused by the Abyss Evil God and the Space Worm..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1745 - 1745: A Million Years at a Glance (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1745 - 1745: A Million Years at a Glance (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“Yes, yes. Blue Planet’s mother has indeed fought with the cosmic behemoth several times. Every time, both parties are injured. After they recuperate, they fight again.”
“In short, it lasted for a long, long time. At this time, Blue Planet is still at the peak of the divine level. It’s not that strong…”
“Qi, can you confirm how long we can stay in this space-time?” Shi Yu asked.
“Sure, we can stay for about a year. If I can break through to the epoch god level, I can stay longer.”
“Only a year??” Shi Yu asked. “Well…” Qi said.
“About the same,” Shi Yu said.
“Then let’s do it as soon as possible,” Qi said.
“There’s no hurry. Don’t you want revenge?” Shi Yu smiled and said, “We don’t lack those few days. Why don’t we bring you along first and find the guys who bullied you previously to take revenge one by one?”
“Will this waste time…” Qi said.
“It’s not a waste. Qi, are you stupid? Don’t you understand why the World King wants us to transmigrate from Blue Planet?”
“Isn’t it because transmigrating on the mother planet might consume less energy?”
“Ling, tell her,” Shi Yu said.
“Well, looks like you’ve analyzed it too, Master,” Ling said. “Qi, didn’t you say previously that you were captured by many people on Blue Planet?”
“Yes, yes, yes. I feel that their liking for me is even higher than their liking for Blue Planet,” Qi said.
“That’s right,” Ling said. “If the active era of the sixth cosmic level is at this time, guess why these invaders like you so much?”
Qi fell into deep thought for a moment before its eyes gradually widened.
Suddenly, Qi also came to a realization.
“At that time, I was the only Time Sprite in the entire universe.”
“In other words, the sixth cosmic life form once captured Time Sprites wantonly in the entire cosmic range.”
“These invaders might have come to Blue Planet to invade at the start, but after learning of my existence, they immediately changed to capturing me. This means that there’s a sixth cosmic life form bounty on the Time Sprite in the universe…
“In fact, it’s possible that they didn’t come from the Contaminated Land and the Worm Mother Nest to invade Blue Planet. They purely came to capture me after knowing about the sometimes sprites on Blue Planet. They might even be subordinates of the sixth cosmic life form!! The cosmic overlord army has subordinates of various races. It’s not strange for the sixth cosmic life form to incorporate various races! ”
“Therefore, if our guess is correct, as long as we start with them, we can quickly obtain information about the sixth cosmic life form. The World King didn’t tell us, and he couldn’t even tell us the appearance, name, and abilities of the sixth cosmic life form, so we can only investigate ourselves,” Ling said.
“Starting from Blue Planet, it’s a small hint from the World King to avoid us taking too many detours.”
“Is that so?” Qi said.
“It’s also possible that we’re imagining too much. It’s really because transmigrating on our mother planet saves us more energy.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “But no matter what, we don’t lack these two to three days. Three super divine levels.”
“Isn’t this perfect? I’ll be your opponent to train your will??”
“If you can train your Super Divine Will through them and break through to the epoch god, cultivating the Space-time Travel skill to transcendent, we can have more time.’
“Yay!!!” Qi agreed with both hands and said, “1 want to kill! Well, wait a minute, I want to defeat a super divine level in front of someone I know. Before we fight the invaders, can we pull the Ancestral Dragon and the others over as spectators? I want them to admire the strength of my Time Sprite,
“Why not?” Shi Yu said. “Well… At this time, I wonder if the Wind Kirin Race has been exterminated.. I wonder how strong the young version of Goddess Wa is… Ancient God Golden Bull and the others probably haven’t even reached the divine level, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1746 - 1746: Descent of the Mythical Era (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1746 - 1746: Descent of the Mythical Era (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu and Qi discussed very well.
They wanted to take revenge together.
However, there were always some unromantic guys in the team.
Ling said, “Master, dote on her.” “Apart from fighting in your minds, can you consider your own situation?” “Oh?” Shi Yu and Qi were stunned.
“Master, are you sure that in Qi’s state, she can fight a super divine level?” After being stunned, Shi Yu cursed.
He patted his head and said, “It’s all Qi’s fault… for leading me astray. Didn’t I want her to fulfill her dream?”
After Qi heard Ling’s reminder, its expression froze.
“Eh, eh, eh.’
Qi’s expression turned bitter. It suddenly realized that just as Shi Yu had said, it was fine to delay for a day or two by dealing with the super divine here.
However, if Qi solved it, it would be a big problem.
Because she had just transmigrated, her current state was already unstable. If she fought a super divine battle and her state fell, the time they could stay in this space-time would be even shorter. Perhaps in the battle, Shi Yu would directly be expelled from this space-time.
This was the factor that might delay their business.
It wasn’t worth risking it for an epoch god opportunity. After all, they only had one chance.
If it failed, this mission would be over.
“Qi is still only suitable for sleeping,” Ling said. “Go back to the Beast Taming
Space and sleep with the Space-time Jade.”
“Leave the mission of this space-time to us. Don’t help blindly.”
“This mission isn’t a joke. It won’t be too late for you to fulfill your dream after we have the ability to transmigrate back to the Mythical Era ourselves.”
Qi: 04Q.
“It wasn’t easy for me to come,” Shi Yu said. “If I don’t do anything, it’ll be too pitiful.”
“In that case, it’s fine if we can’t fight with all our might, but it shouldn’t be a problem for Tiny to attack, right?”
“Qi, when the time comes, throw a skill at your enemy to vent your anger and let the familiar people look at you in a different light. Then, let me settle it.
How about that!”
“Of course, you can also take revenge personally in the end!”
“This way, it won’t affect my condition, but 1 can fulfill my dream.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Yay!” Qi’s eyes lit up. She was very satisfied.
“Sigh, that’s it then.” Ling sighed. It couldn’t do anything to Shi Yu and the others.
However, taking care of his pet’s mood was indeed one of Shi Yu t s few merits. This mission was indeed very difficult. It had to constantly remind Shi Yu and the others not to be playful.
Next, Shi Yu and the others formulated a plan.
“In other words, the first to capture you are the Space Worms. They were the first to obtain your information.”
“The cosmic behemoth has been fighting the Blue Planet’s Will and doesn’t pay much attention to you.”
“As for the Abyss Evil God, it was only expanding its territory at the start. It was only after the Space Worms wanted to capture you for a long time that they realized your existence.”
“Yes, yes.” Qi nodded.
“Then, let’s start with this Space Worm first.”
“They might be subordinates of the sixth cosmic life form, or they know information about the sixth cosmic life form…
“Of course, it’s also possible that he purely wants to eat you and inherit your spatial travel power.”
“Ling, scan the world,” Shi Yu said.
“Roger.” Ling followed Shi Yu’s request and began to scan the world, searching for the three super divine levels.
However, not long after Ling started scanning, its expression suddenly changed.
“Master…”
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu said.
“Look…
Ling had just scanned when it discovered a divine-level worm not far away… No, a group of Space Worms.
There were no super magical bugs in this group of Space Worms. They weren’t what Shi Yu and the others were looking for.
However, what they did at this moment made Ling very angry.
It shared the scan results with Shi Yu. Then, Shi Yu instantly fell silent.
“Is it over?”
“Let’s go.”
Then, Shi Yu and the others quickly teleported to a place.
Shi Yu stopped in the sky. Below was a very huge island.
In the future, this land had already completely disappeared. It should have been sunk. As for now, it seemed to have already experienced a tragic war and become a place of desolate.
On the desolate land, a scene that shocked Shi Yu and the others happened.
A creature with a deer-like white body and a light and slender body was fleeing under the gray cloud. Its green patterns and cloud-like hair were too familiar to Shi Yu and the others.
Such an elegant, beautiful creature with a body that looked like the embodiment of wind was the Wind Kirin Race in Shi Yu and the others’ impression…
As for this Wind Kirin, it was the one Shi Yu and the others were most familiar with.
This Wind Kirin was the opportunity for Lings initial birth, the owner of that fossil.
Shi Yu never expected to encounter this little guy. At this moment, it was experiencing the same scene that Shi Yu and the others had seen in the fossil dream.
Pursued by a Space Worm.
“This is the island of the Wind Kirin Race.’
“Unfortunately, it’s the only one left.” “Ling, I’ll leave it to you,” Shi Yu said.
Seeing this familiar scene, Shi Yu couldn’t leave it in the lurch. After all, this guy could be said to be half Ling.
Soon, Shi Yu landed on the ground. On the other side, the Little Wind Kirin ran towards him with a panicked expression.
Every time it stepped on the ground, a light breeze lingered around it. The even more elegant green-blue silk-like hair on its head also fluttered in the wind. It was very beautiful..

chapters.title: Chapter 1747 - 1747: Descent of the Mythical Era (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1747 - 1747: Descent of the Mythical Era (2)
"No... no..."
This petite and weak Wind Kirin that was filled with fear and uneasiness was still the same as in the dream. Without thinking, it flipped Shi Yu onto its back and escaped with Shi Yu.
Shi Yu couldn't help but be speechless.
"It's exactly the same as in the dream. It's still so kind."
"But little guy, there's no need to run this time."
"Stop."
Upon hearing the voice of the person on its back, the Little Wind Kirin was very confused. At this moment, Shi Yu gently patted its head.
"Look behind, the monster has been dealt with."
"Roar!!" Accompanied by Shi Yu's voice, a monster's scream came from behind. Right on the heels of that, it fell to the ground violently.
The Little Wind Kirin subconsciously turned around and looked shocked. The creature that was chasing it just now...
The incomparably huge monster that looked to be made of different species with a purple-red ant-like body was already torn into pieces by the wind blades and lying on the ground.
Its sharp dragon claws that were like the limbs of a dragon had already separated from its body. Its ferocious demonic face was filled with disbelief, as if it had died with remaining grievances.
The Little Wind Kirin was very shocked. It never expected that the life it wanted to save in passing was actually a super expert.
After all, even the elders in the race weren't a match for these monsters...
However, what shocked the Little Wind Kirin even more was still to come.
At some point in time, a Wind Kirin had also appeared above the Space Worm. It seemed to be the monster that this Wind Kirin had defeated. Seeing this Wind Kirin, the Little Wind Kirin's eyes were filled with tears as it felt a sense of closeness.
It thought... that it was already the last Wind Kirin.
But it didn't expect...
"You, you guys." It sounded like a little girl and was very confused. It knew every Wind Kirin. Although it felt a sense of closeness from the same source, be it Shi Yu or Ling, it was extremely unfamiliar.
"Don't be nervous. You can treat us as... distant relatives?" Shi Yu said.
"Well, don't be afraid. We'll protect you." Ling stepped on the light breeze and came to the Little Wind Kirin's side, using the power of the breeze to comfort its heart.
Upon seeing this little Wind Kirin, Shi Yu and the others knew that the Wind Kirin Race had already been exterminated. This was because this little Wind Kirin was the last Wind Kirin. All the luck of the Wind Kirin Race had already been focused on it.
Ling had long obtained its memories to the greatest extent through powers like Mythical Revival. It could be said that Ling was the reincarnation of this Wind Kirin and knew its matters very well.
Its talent was very good, and it was also the hope of the Wind Kirin Race. This was also the reason why the Wind Kirin Race, which was almost extinct, had to send it away. Although the subsequent experience was even more bumpy, the Wind Kirin Race didn't work for nothing. Its fossil was preserved in the modern era, allowing Shi Yu to successfully revive the might of the Wind Kirin Race.
"But, everyone..." The Little Wind Kirin choked. Seeing this, Shi Yu continued to touch its head and said, "Don't be sad. Perhaps your relatives still have a chance to revive."
"Re-really?" It couldn't believe it.
"In theory," Shi Yu said. "As long as we eliminate all the enemies as soon as possible and help the Blue Planet's Will recuperate its restoration power, with the might of our mother planet, we can completely restore the lives that die on the planet."
"Next, follow us first."
"We're very strong. Next, we'll expel all the bad people. At that time, we'll ask Lord Blue Planet to revive your family."
"Yes, yes." The Little Wind Kirin was extremely excited. Then, it seemed to be very tired. It suddenly blinked and was a little sleepy.
"Sleep..." Shi Yu knew that it had just experienced the ache of its species being exterminated not long ago, so he didn't want it to keep awake. At this moment, it was better to sleep.
"Ling."
Ling put it into the battleship space and said, "Before we go back, please ask the Blue Planet's Will of this world to settle it down."
"Alright."
Shi Yu nodded and said, "Bu Lu, you can find the location of the super divine level cosmic behemoth hiding in the cosmic hole, right?"
"If you want Blue Planet to recover, shouldn't you deal with it first? Otherwise, it'll have worked for nothing again."
"No problem!!" Bu Lu said. "Its attainments in the Hole of the Universe aren't as high as mine!"
"I can pull it out at any time."
"However, in Blue Planet's current situation, just pulling it out will cause relatively serious wounds to Blue Planet."
"I suggest that we recuperate Blue Planet's state first before pulling it out. This way, the damage to Blue Planet will be relatively small, at least not a second injury."
"Is that so?"
Shi Yu said, "Baby Ginseng, you still have a lot of world might stored in your Heavenly Emperor Cauldron, right? Feed it to Blue Planet later. Fix Blue Planet's wounds first and wake her up."
"Then, Bu Lu, you pull out the cosmic behemoth and we'll kill it. There's no issue with that, right?"
"Yi. (Roger.)"
"No problem, but this way..." Bu Lu hesitated.
"What's wrong now?" Shi Yu said.
"When Blue Planet slept, it pulled out the cosmic behemoth. Although it will cause Blue Planet a second violent injury, Blue Planet won't feel any pain. After all, it's sleeping."
"But if we repair Blue Planet first and awaken Blue Planet before pulling out that cosmic behemoth, although the damage to Blue Planet will be relatively small, it will be very painful. After all, it's awake!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1748 - 1748: Descent of the Mythical Era (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1748 - 1748: Descent of the Mythical Era (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“One is equivalent to general anesthesia surgery, and the other is equivalent to lucid surgery.”
“So no matter what, Blue Planet…
Shi Yu:
“Where did you learn this strange metaphor?”
Bu Lu said, “Don’t underestimate me. I’ve lived for a long time. I’m very smart and know everything.”
The corners of Shi Yu’ s mouth twitched. “This is unimportant. Blue Planet has already survived the tragic Mythical War. This little pain doesn’t matter now.”
“That’s good.” Bu Lu heaved a sigh of relief. Because the opponent was a super divine level cosmic behemoth, it had to analyze more with Shi Yu to prevent Shi Yu from saying that it was unprofessional.
“Ling, continue scanning,” Shi Yu said.
“Bu Lu, smash all the Space Worms here first.”
“Baby Ginseng, stay here and help Blue Planet recover its strength.”
Shi Yu gave the order. Bu Lu and Baby Ginseng appeared. The three pets began to work.
The red-haired little monkey disappeared in a flash and went to fight the Space Worm on this land.
As for Baby Ginseng, it took root on the spot and took out the huge cauldron, preparing to heal Blue Planet.
They had freeloaded so much power from Blue Planet. This time, they could “return the favor”.
“Sigh…” At this moment, Qi was flying beside him. The scene just now made Qi think of many bad things.
Even if Qi couldn’t attack, the Mythical War on Blue Planet had to end…
Otherwise, more than 90% of the races on Blue Planet would be extinct. “Master.” Ling continued to scan, but after scanning for a while, its expression changed slightly.
“Master, the Abyss Evil God is moving in the direction of Dragon Palace City. It seems to be preparing to enter the Eastern Sea Region.”
In the Mythical Era, the Western Sea Region was instantly lost due to the invasion of the Abyss Evil God. Then, the Abyss Evil God wanted to attack the Eastern Sea Region many times, but it was stopped by Dragon Palace City.
It was mainly because there were no powerful life forms in the Western Sea Region. Be it the angels or demons, their territories weren’t in the ocean.
However, the east was different. With a huge monster like Dragon Palace City, if the Abyss Evil God wanted to completely occupy it, it had to pass the Ancestral Dragon first.
“Shi Yu!” Qi floated beside Shi Yu like a floating spirit. Upon hearing Lings words, she suddenly recalled something, and her expression changed.
“Let’s go fight this Abyss Evil God first.” “I’ll deal with the Space Worm later.”
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu asked.
“l have a good friend who’s a member of Dragon Palace City. It died in the war with the Abyss Sea.” Qi looked at Shi Yu eagerly.
“It should be this war…
“You still have friends in Dragon Palace City? Why didn’t I hear you say so previously?” Shi Yu was surprised.
Qi said, “Because it’s a bad memory… 1 wanted to change everything after 1 became stronger, but I never had the chance.”
“Alright, no problem. Then let’s help Dragon Palace City resist the Abyss Sea first and let Bu Lu fight here himself. After it kills wantonly, maybe the super divine worm will be lured out by it.”
“Yes, yes.” Qi nodded.
The Abyss Evil God was indeed the one they should deal with the most. Firstly, Susu didn’t like this guy. Secondly, its war with Dragon Palace City also violated the interests of Buggy, Turtle, and Little Quas.
Cough, although the Ancestral Dragon was in charge now, it wasn’t a big problem.
Since they were here, Dragon Palace City was still theirs.
“Use the future sword to kill the Dragon God of the previous dynasty.”
However, not long after arriving, Shi Yu indeed felt the cruelty of the Mythical War.
The Wind Kirin Race, no, at this time, the entire Kirin Race, Phoenix Race, Angel Race, and Demon Race were being hunted by the Space Worms all over the world, and the Abyss Evil God was preparing to start a war with Dragon Palace City.
The current Blue Planet… had completely been devoured by the flames of war.
Dragon Palace City.
At this moment, Dragon Palace City had already sensed the approach of the Abyss Sea and was already in a full battle state. Even the door of the Dragon Palace mystic realm had already been tightly sealed.
Under the lead of the generals of Dragon Palace City, the Dragon Palace Navy
formed by countless shrimps and crabs was stationed in the Eastern Sea
Region.
Shi Yu and the others didn’t directly head to the Dragon Palace mystic realm. Instead, they searched for the friend Qi mentioned.
This friend from the Dragon Palace was a general of the Dragon Palace Sea Army in this war. Not only was he in a high position, but his strength was also pretty good, reaching a high-level god.
“Who is it?!”
After Shi Yu and Qi teleported into the battle preparation mystic realm where the other party was stationed, a pink-scaled divine dragon in meditation cultivation suddenly widened its eyes.
An external enemy invasion??
After sensing the invader, the Cherry Divine Dragon was shocked on the spot. But soon, it sensed that it wasn’t an enemy…
“Little Cherry, Little Cherry.” Accompanied by a familiar voice, the Cherry Divine Dragon looked at the pink elf flying over and said in surprise, “So it’s you. I was wondering who had the ability to barge in here.”
“Long time no see! Qi looked at the Cherry Divine Dragon in surprise. Qi didn’t expect to see it again one day.
“Wait, who is he?” The Cherry Divine Dragon suddenly discovered Shi Yu, who had followed Qi over, and couldn’t help but feel like it was facing a great enemy.
It was very shocked. Just now, even now, it actually didn’t sense any aura on Shi Yu t s body. Even if Shi Yu was in front of it and it saw it with its own eyes, it still didn’t sense any aura.
“Little Cherry, don’t be nervous. He’s my… Well…”
Qi didn’t know what to say, because there were no humans on Blue Planet at all, nor was there a Beast Tamer profession..

chapters.title: Chapter 1749 - 1749: Descent of the Mythical Era (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1749: Descent of the Mythical Era (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“He’s my most important partner,” Qi said.
“Hello, my name is Shi Yu,” Shi Yu said as he walked over.
“Really?” The Cherry Divine Dragon looked at Shi Yu strangely, unable to believe that he could obtain such trust from Qi. “Forget it, it’s not important anymore. Qi, how many times have I told you not to use your ability to barge into some strange places?”
“This is a prep mystic realm. If you barge in casually like this, it’s very easy for something to happen.”
“Moreover… Do you know the current situation? Why do you still dare to run around? The Space Worms are hunting races everywhere. You should find a safe place to hide now.”
“This place… You should leave quickly. There’s going to be a war here soon, and the scale is very large. Lord Ancestral Dragon is even prepared to die in battle.’
“That evil god is coming…”
“Don’t worry!” Qi patted its chest and said, “Didn’t you notice any changes in my body?”
“Your chest has become smaller,” the Cherry Divine Dragon said.
Qi: “?”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Your ability improved again?” the Cherry Divine Dragon asked.
Every time the Time Sprite’s spatial travel ability increased by a level, its body would shrink a little. Others might not know this, but as one of Qi’s few friends, the Cherry Divine Dragon knew very well.
“Yes,” Qi said.
“l won’t escape with you.” The Cherry Divine Dragon shook its head and said, “l still have to protect Dragon Palace City. Running won’t solve any problem.
There are still trillions of ocean lives behind me. The tragic situation in the
Western Sea Region can’t happen here…”
“Who said I was going to escape! Qi stomped its feet in the air angrily and said, “l mean, I’ll help you too. Let’s fight the enemy together.”
“Stop kidding,” the Cherry Divine Dragon said. “You should leave quickly…”
As one of Qi’s friends, didn’t it know that the little guy in front of it was very timid?
As she didn’t have battle power, once she encountered danger, Qi would run away quickly as if she was shocked.
And now… the opponent was the invincible Abyss Evil God on Blue Planet. This matter had nothing to do with Qi in the first place. Letting Qi leave was the best choice.
“Hmph…” Qi said, “Little Cherry, do you understand the value of unscientific beasts…
“Huh? Science?” The Cherry Divine Dragon was stunned.
“Cough, cough.” Shi Yu coughed dryly at the side.
Don’t casually give me a nickname for my cultivation method. I’m a proper Beast Tamer.
“The two of you, let’s end the chatting here. The enemy is already here,” Shi Yu said.
The Cherry Divine Dragon widened its eyes: !!!
Boom!!!
The preparation mystic realm shook.
In the mystic realm, countless Dragon Palace soldiers focused 120% of their attention. However… their trembling bodies marked their fear.
“Roar!!!” At this moment, the pink-scaled divine dragon no longer cared about Qi and Shi Yu, nor did it have the time to care. The most important thing now was to stop the navy from resisting the abyss invasion.
As for Qi… Even if the Ancestral Dragon died in battle, it might not necessarily be fine.
“So weak! ”
At the same time, on the other side.
Bu Lu used the Earth Control to condense a stone rod and hit these Space Worms that had hunted the Wind Kirin Race to death.
The Space Worms it knocked to death were all born of the Space Worm
Empress. There was a close bloodline connection between the two parties.
As these worms died, the Empress of the worms on the moon far away from Blue Planet woke up from her egg-laying state.
Her heirs hunted rare races from Blue Planet and sent them to the moon. After she devoured them, she gave birth to new worms. Then, these worms entered the battle. This was her battle method.
Generally speaking, resisting such a small planet was enough even with the battle power of its heirs. However, this time, after sensing that it was suddenly concentrated at a time and that a large number of heirs and descendants had died, the insect empress was directly awakened.
