“Cosmic behemoth?”
“Why would a second cosmic behemoth appear on this planet?”
“Damn it, first the Abyss Race, then the cosmic behemoth. Could it be that the information about the existence of the Time Sprite on this planet has been completely exposed? No, I have to go over and take a look at the situation. I can’t be afraid of them anymore..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1750 - 1750: Information of the Sixth Cosmic Life Form(1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1750: Information of the Sixth Cosmic Life Form(1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Eastern Sea Region.
The various armies of the Dragon Palace Navy were already prepared for battle from top to bottom of the ocean. They looked at the black Abyss Sea that suddenly accelerated in front of them and swallowed their saliva crazily.
“It’s pollution! ! ! ”
“Cleansing Army, prepare! !! ”
The Cherry Divine Dragon circled in the sky and looked at the surging black waves. It was extremely nervous.
It was a fighter, but at this moment, it was also forced to learn cleansing skills. At the moment, most sea creatures were like this. It didn’t know if their unfamiliar cleansing skills could resist the abyss invasion.
“Roar! ! !
Apart from the various Dragon Palace Navies, in the ocean, a dark blue divine dragon with golden patterns on its back and a huge black and white intertwined on its abdomen soared into the sky from the Dragon Palace sea area. The aura of a quasi-epoch god was undoubtedly revealed.
With the descent of the Ancestral Dragon, the aura of the Eastern Sea Region immediately increased.
However, it only increased its aura. It was impossible for the Ancestral Dragon to help these armies reach the abyss invasion. It wanted to preserve all its strength and concentrate all its energy on the unappeared Abyss Evil God…
That guy… was the most terrifying existence.
Only by defeating that guy could the threat disappear.
“No, I can’t resist!!!”
“Lord Cherry, we can’t resist at all. What should we do?”
A million navies under the jurisdiction of the Cherry Divine Dragon used the cleansing wave together to push out the cleansing power to resist the abyssal wave that attacked.
However, it failed in a few seconds. This situation was happening everywhere. The ocean lives on Blue Planet were completely no match for the abyss army polluted by the Abyss Evil God.
“How is this possible…”
At this moment, the Cherry Divine Dragon had also joined the cleansing army, but when the cleansing power fused, it was helpless. It could only watch helplessly as the black abyss continued to attack.
“Could it be that… even Dragon Palace City is going to be swallowed by the
Abyss Sea this time? What should we do?”
“It doesn’t matter. I’ll attack.”
Just as the army under the jurisdiction of the Cherry Divine Dragon was extremely panicked, a pink and white wave swept across the sea. A familiar voice of the Cherry Divine Dragon came from the sky.
In the next moment, the Abyss Sea that was corroding from the west to the east suddenly stopped there. The flow of time became very slow and almost stopped.
Then, under the contact of the pink and white fluctuations, the black water recovered into blue seawater in a ridiculous and even unbelievable way.
In fact, the Western ocean life form that pushed the Abyss Sea over and was polluted by the Abyss Evil God also recovered to its original appearance under this pink and white wave. It was in the sea in a daze.
This power not only helped the sea area under the jurisdiction of the Cherry Divine Dragon, but also shocked the countless Dragon Palace soldiers in the surrounding sea area. They didn’t know what had happened.
The Cherry Divine Dragon was the first to notice the abnormality. It looked at a certain place in the sky in disbelief and saw a very small pink elf holding a very small umbrella. With a light wave, pink and white time fluctuations flowed like a tide.
Under the lingering time fluctuations, she was incomparably holy, and her divine power was as vast as the universe.
“What power is this?” The Cherry Divine Dragon said in disbelief.
It looked at Qi, who had returned the Abyss Sea and the abyss life form to their previous state before they were polluted with a gentle wave, and its gaze was shocked to the extreme.
This was Qi? It didn’t remember Qi mastering such power.
This scene not only shocked Qi’s good friend, the Cherry Divine Dragon, but also made the cautious Ancestral Dragon in the sky suddenly look over.
After its gaze landed on the Time Sprite, it was also extremely incredulous.
“Time Sprite? It’s her?”
“But how is that possible… Isn’t that the only skill the Time Sprite can use?”
“Apart from the Blue Planet’s Will, it’s impossible for any other life form to use this power of time.”
“And her aura…” The Ancestral Dragon was quickly shocked to discover that the divine power fluctuations of the Time Sprite, which was originally barely at the high-level divine realm, were actually not inferior to it.
They were all at the peak of the top-notch Divine Realm, the limit of a perfect divine.
“What did she experience?” The Ancestral Dragon was confused. At this moment, there was actually an area that was black and had yet to be turned back.
In this area, two strange lights suddenly lit up.
That was a terrifying creature under the Abyss Sea. It was about to appear.
Its figure was slowly outlined like a monster. It vaguely had the outline of a person, but it had a head with many tentacles like an octopus. Its body was covered in scales, and it had huge claws. There was also a pair of long and narrow wings behind it…
The image had some characteristics of octopuses, bats, and humans.
It appeared from the Abyss Sea, dragging its bloated and fat body… Its huge green body staggered out of the dark sea and walked into people’s vision… Its body emitted indescribable fear waves.
“Abyss Evil God.” The appearance of the Abyss Evil God made the Ancestral Dragon extremely nervous, and it also made countless ocean lives tremble. Just seeing it made them almost crazy.
“Invaders, so weak,” Qi said. Under everyone’s incredulous expressions, Qi waved its small umbrella, and a powerful spatial wave turned into a wave of attack. With a boom, it flipped over the Abyss Evil God that had just descended!!
“Roar!!!” As the Abyss Evil God roared, the Ancestral Dragon and the Cherry
Divine Dragon, who were looking at the Time Sprite, were completely numb..

chapters.title: Chapter 1751 - 1751: Information of the Sixth Cosmic Life Form (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1751: Information of the Sixth Cosmic Life Form (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Compared to the Time Sprite in their memories, there was something wrong.
“You’re too weak and not worth my time, but 1 can’t forgive you for invading
my friend’s home. (Susu, please!)” Qi put away the umbrella and said.
“Ning…” With a sigh, the power of the Sea of Stars converged. Countless Sea of
Stars fluctuations instantly appeared around the abyss super divine that had just been flipped over. In the blink of an eye, under everyone’s incomprehensible gazes, the incomparably terrifying abyss super divine let out a shocking scream.
“Ah!!!!”
Its scream was especially miserable. In the blink of an eye, the Abyss Evil God with the rich pollution power was directly cleansed of the abyss power on its body. Moreover, even the power on its body continued to be cleansed.
After a shocking scream, the Abyss Evil God that had just made the entire Eastern Sea Region feel like it was facing a great enemy directly turned into a quasi-divine-level huge water-element octopus and stopped on the ocean in a daze.
Under Susu!s power, not only it, but even the Western Sea Region that had already become the Abyss Sea had been completely cleansed.
The Blue Planet life forms infected by the power of the abyss returned to normal.
“No!!!” Somewhere in the west, a certain turtle that had just overcome and defeated the power of the abyss and obtained powerful battle power revealed an unacceptable expression. It had just experienced pain and despair to subdue the power of the abyss, but it was instantly deprived, making it feel stunned.
It was the Xuan Ming Crocodile Turtle that used the Abyss Seed as a prize in the World Tournament…
“Roar!!!” There were also evil dragons on the volcano island who looked at the receding seawater with lingering fears. They made a great wish in their hearts. They had to become the overlord of the earth, the Earth Divine Dragon, and not be threatened by the sea anymore.
At this moment, this shocking change shocked all the creatures on Blue Planet.
The experts everywhere could feel the aura of the Abyss Evil God disappear almost instantly.
“Space-time seal!” In the sky, accompanied by Qi’s action of putting away the umbrella, countless runes appeared and flowed. An alternate space sealed the Abyss Evil God inside. With a desperate cry, its figure disappeared without a trace. A super divine monster at the level of life was subdued just like that.
“How is it?” Qi looked at the Cherry Divine Dragon.
On an island, in Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, countless pets looked at Qi and could only think Qi was impressive.
“Quack! In the Beast Taming Space, Duckie sighed. Unfortunately, it couldn’t “Roar! Little Ji also felt that it was a pity that it couldn’t fight.
This couldn’t be helped. It was true that Blue Planet’s galaxy couldn’t withstand the torment anymore.
Although Shi Yu wanted to train every pet, he couldn’t build it on the pain of the Blue Planet’s Will, right?
It was better to find an opportunity in the universe.
“Qi, you…” The Cherry Divine Dragon looked at Qi in a daze.
“Little Cherry, let’s catch up when we have the chance. I suddenly realized that the super divine life form of the Space Worm Race has also descended on Blue Planet.’
“l have to deal with it too,” Qi said.
“Don’t worry, with us around, the invaders of Blue Planet will all be eliminated!”
With that said, Qi teleported away under the silent gazes of the Cherry Divine Dragon, the Ancestral Dragon, and the other powerful life forms.
“What is it?”
At that moment, the Worm Empress, who had just torn open a spatial crack and arrived at Blue Planet, was also shocked.
She had a beautiful humanoid body, and her very thin body was mostly milky white, looking like a cockroach.
Behind the slender body were organs that looked like long hair. Every end of those hair-like organs was like a white Nepenthes hybrida, dripping with mucus.
Before the Worm Empress descended, she sensed that Blue Planet had at least one super divine level, which was the Abyss Evil God. She couldn’t sense the other super divine level cosmic behemoth in the cosmic hole.
However, just as it descended, the Worm Empress realized that she couldn’t even sense the aura of the Abyss Evil God at this moment. This made her have a bad feeling.
But soon, the Worm Empress was attracted by the life in front of her. After descending to the desolate land, she immediately saw an alluring ginseng baby boiling itself in a huge cauldron that was burning, emitting a beautiful aura that was enough to heal the entire planet.
“This is…” At this moment, the Worm Empress couldn’t even care less about any changes. She stared at Baby Ginseng intently and felt that it was the most beautiful thing on this planet apart from the Time Sprite.
She had a feeling that after eating this guy, she would definitely be able to give birth to a very, very strong worm king with the strength of an epoch god…
The moment she saw Baby Ginseng, she even thought of the child’s name. “Yi! (Do you want to eat me?)” In the cauldron, Baby Ginseng suddenly opened its eyes and looked at the super divine cockroach woman in front of it.
Its gaze flickered with a sharp gaze, and then it sighed.
This was because Shi Yu’s figure had already appeared behind the Worm Empress. At this moment, he was holding a stick and suddenly swung it at the Worm Empress’s head without her reacting.
Bang!!!
The head of the Worm Empress was directly smashed. Then, right on the heels of that, Buggy, Chi Tong, Ling, and the others also used spatial abilities to seal the Worm Empress together.
“Baby Ginseng, don’t mess around.”
“If you want to self-destruct and fight a super divine on Blue Planet, I don’t know if it’ll die, but your Blue Planet mother will definitely be gone.”
“Yi! ! (l know my limits!)” Baby Ginseng wu wu. Damn it, it was the only one in the first team now who wasn’t an epoch god.. Why was it so difficult to find a super divine level opponent?

chapters.title: Chapter 1752 - 1752: Information of the Sixth Cosmic Life Form (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1752: Information of the Sixth Cosmic Life Form (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
The three invasion super divines on Blue Planet definitely couldn’t be their opponents. They had to deal mith them quickly, accurately, and ruthlessly. After thinking about it, Baby Ginseng estimated that its destined self had to go to the starry sky to find it again.
At the same time.
Under the power of Baby Ginseng, the incomplete power of laws on Blue Planet had already been Restored by the power of the world. Blue Planet’s Will slowly woke up from its sleep.
The first thing she did when she recovered her consciousness was to find the creature that helped her recover. Then, she discovered the existence of the ginseng baby and sensed a familiar wave from it.
“Why don’t I remember such a creature on Blue Planet?”
The familiar fluctuations on Baby Ginsengs body made the Blue Planet’s Will extremely puzzled.
At the same time, she quickly looked at Shi Yu, but she couldn’t see anything at all. This was because the fluctuations of time transmigration on Shi Yu and the others had already been covered by the Space-time Jade. Unless it was stronger than a World King, it was very difficult to see.
However, as it saw Qi beside Shi Yu and the others, the Blue Planet’s Will immediately understood something.
Although it couldn’t sense the transmigration wave, it knew Qi and her identity.
“l see. Are they reinforcements Qi found from the future?”
“l didn’t expect this little guy to have already grown to this extent.”
“Hehe.” When the Blue Planet’s Will stared at Shi Yu and the others, Shi Yu and the others also discovered the Blue Planet’s Will.
Qi even smiled at the Blue Planet’s Will, as if it was very happy with the praise.
In the next moment, Shi Yu also held a stick and looked up at the sky, as if he was looking at the Blue Planet’s Will.
“Hehe.” Shi Yu also chuckled. Although he didn’t know Shi Yu, when he saw Shi Yu’s smile, the Blue Planet’s Will immediately had a bad feeling.
“Sorry, it’s just a little pain.”
Shi Yu held a stick and directly knocked on Blue Planet’s space, wanting to forcefully open the Hole of the Universe where the super divine level cosmic behemoth hid.
The violent impact directly caused Blue Planet, which had just recovered its state and consciousness, to encounter a powerful collision again.
“This reinforcement…” The Blue Planet’s Will felt dizzy. It felt like it had been swung with a stick, and it was very painful.
However, Bu Lu’s prediction was right. Under its power, even the independent Hole of the Universe opened by a super divine-level cosmic behemoth was very easy to open.
In the cosmic hole, a golden gorilla-like cosmic behemoth suddenly opened its eyes and looked at Shi Yu, who was holding a stick outside, in shock.
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was at the 14th heavenly layer of the divine level, faced this cosmic behemoth that had transcended the low-level. He didn’t even need to fuse with the Beast Shi Yu. He directly relied on the combination of source power and Bu Lu to charge in.
“Who are you?”
“A super being from Blue Planet,” Shi Yu said. “Eat this!”
Boom boom boom!!!
Blue Planet trembled again. At this moment, every high-level god and top-notch divine clearly sensed the changes on Blue Planet.
The super divine level cosmic behemoth was also insta-killed. The Blue Planet’s Will was almost silent. It couldn’t believe that the reinforcements Qi brought from the future were actually so powerful.
What exactly happened to the future Blue Planet to actually have such a powerful life form?
It never expected that this disaster that might cause the complete destruction of Blue Planet would be resolved by the Time Sprite.
“Alright.” At this moment, after sealing the cosmic behemoth, Shi Yu looked at the sky and said, “I’ll take these three guys away. Next, please recover Blue Planet yourself.”
“It’s best to revive the Wind Kirin Race. I’ll excuse myself first. After a while, I’ll come and answer your questions.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he brought Qi, Baby Ginseng, and the others into the sealed space.
Compared to answering some questions to the Blue Planet’s Will in the past, he wanted to find information about the sixth cosmic life form from the three super divine invaders more now.
First was the last golden giant ape that had been beaten up. It was extremely injured.
As it was nailed to the huge pillar in a daze, Shi Yu summoned Susu, Buggy, and the others and let them find its memory information through their own methods.
Buggy had mental control, and Susu could transfer the other party’s memories through the memory water drop.
“Ji. (This guy doesn’t know anything. It came to Blue Planet purely by accident and saw that Blue Planet was more delicious.)” Buggy gave an answer.
“Ning.” Susu also gave an answer. It was probably the same.
“Is that so??” Shi Yu was stunned. Damn, Blue Planet was really unlucky.
“Next, it’s the Abyss Evil God’s turn.”
Shi Yu and the others changed to the sealed space of the Abyss Evil God. Buggy and the others used the same method to investigate memories.
The results of the investigation this time made Shi Yu and the others frown.
Because the Abyss Evil God… also accidentally discovered Blue Planet and decided to occupy it!
After learning from the World King that the sixth cosmic life form was hunting the Time Sprite, Shi Yu and the others originally thought that the invaders of Blue Planet might have come with one goal.
However, from the looks of it, Blue Planet was still too fragrant.
“As expected, it still has to be the Worm Empress.”
“It’s definitely the most important.” Shi Yu left the most likely to know some information at the end.
Then, Shi Yu and the others, who had turned to the sealed space, fell into ecstasy after investigating through the same method again.
Because this insect empress finally didn’t know anything like the first two guys.
“Space Worm Race, super divine life form, Fei Lang. It’s a Space Wanderer of the Space Worm Race. It belongs to the Space Worm Mother Nest. Its racial instinct is to invade various life planets and absorb the essence of the planet’s life to strengthen the racial faction..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1753 - 1753: Information of the Sixth Cosmic Life Form(4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1753: Information of the Sixth Cosmic Life Form(4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“It came to Blue Planet… It’s still the same as the Abyss Evil God and the cosmic behemoth. It’s also an accident!”
“Blue Planet is a popular hot topic. It might be related to the fact that Blue Planet is at a critical stage of breaking through to a high-level planet at this time… causing it to be especially dazzling in the universe.”
“However, unlike the Abyss Evil God and the cosmic behemoth, it does know more.”
“It once passed by a star field on its journey. In that star field, an expert issued a bounty to find information about the Time Sprite with the ‘Universe
Treasure of the Era’ as a reward.”
“As long as you provide accurate information about the Time Sprite, you can obtain a cosmic treasure.’
“Initially, Fei Lang didn’t think much of it, but after arriving at Blue Planet by accident, it didn’t expect that it would really discover the information about the Time Sprite.”
“However, according to Fei Langs memories, it didn’t seem to be prepared to exchange the information of the Time Sprite for a bounty. Instead, it had the thought of devouring the Time Sprite itself.”
Shi Yu said, “So, could this be the reason why Qi accidentally escaped capture??”
“Originally, it only wanted information, but this guy actually wanted to
capture it…”
Qi: “Fortunately, this guy wanted to eat me. Otherwise, I would be finished!”
Qi heaved a sigh of relief. So, this little idea of the Space Worm was still the key to saving Qi?
If this worm transmitted the information of Blue Planet to that expert suspected to be at the sixth cosmic level and the other party came personally, Qi might not be able to escape.
After all, according to the World King, at least there was only one Time Sprite left in the space they were in.
Susu said, “The key, the key is that the expert in its memory isn’t at the cosmic level.’
“There’s no information about the sixth cosmic life form in the memories of these three guys.”
“At the moment, there are only five cosmic levels in this universe. The expert who searched for the Time Sprite is nameless and surnameless, but Fei Lang can confirm her strength. She’s at the peak of the super divine level and transcends ten times. Because someone once coveted a cosmic treasure and was killed by her, she displayed her strength once.”
“The main ability method she displayed is Psychokinesis.”
Although this information was not much, it made Shi Yu and the others fall silent in the sealed space for a long time.
“Could this guy carrying out the Time Sprite information bounty be the sixth cosmic level in the future?”
“She’s really only a super divine now… She’s not at the cosmic level. Then, the chances of completing the mission are very high. Therefore, next, it’s time to set sail to the star domain in the memories of the empress of the worms and to the planet occupied by the future cosmic level to try to get close to her…” “There’s another message,” Ling said.
At this moment, everyone had already shared the useful memories of the Worm Empress.
Ling said, “Although the peak of the super divine level isn’t as rare as the cosmic level, there are also a few in the universe. There won’t be more than 20. Generally speaking, the growth experiences of these peak super divine levels are very dazzling. It’s impossible for them to all grow to the peak of the super divine level and still be unknown.”
“However, according to this guy’s memories, this guy suspected to be at the sixth cosmic life form in the future seems to have suddenly appeared and occupied a certain territory.”
“Before this, there were legends of her in the Behemoth Empire, the
Contaminated Land, the overlord territory, the Cosmic Sea, and the Worm Mother Nest. She seemed to have suddenly appeared from a stone. If she was just a weak super divine, that would be understandable. But at the peak of the super divine level, it’s not too much to say that she’s in the top ten of the universe…”
“Don’t you think it’s strange that such a person suddenly appeared without anyone hearing about her before?”
Shi Yu said, “So I understand what you mean.”
“The World King previously said… that I have two conditions that others don’t have. One of them is that I’m a transmigrator.”
“I was wondering if it was because it was easier to use the Time Sprite to transmigrate through space and time because of transmigrators, but from the looks of it, according to the previous hint of the World King, there’s more than one transmigrator in the universe. Could this guy also be a transmigrator?”
“Moreover, like Beast Shi Yu, she suddenly came out of the ‘stone’ and transmigrated. Therefore, there was no information about her previously..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1754 - 1754: Super Empress (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1754: Super Empress (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Next, after Shi Yu and the others obtained useful information, they directly killed the three super divine invaders.
Killing a child with one slash.
Painless death.
“Tell me, which one of you is holding us back!”
At this moment, Shi Yu held the black Book of Origin Plunder and looked at a source of transcendence floating in the air. He said fiercely.
“Although the three super divines are all trash who have transcended once, only one of them dropped after stacking so many buffs??”
Shi Yu didn’t believe it.
The Book of Origin Plunder increased the probability of the source of transcendence dropping. In addition, Little Zi projected Teacher Gem Cat and Teacher Prediction Owl and used Wish+Fate Lock at the same time. With so many buffs stacked together, Shi Yu originally thought that he would obtain three sources of transcendence, but in the end, only the Queen of Worms exploded.
If the cosmic behemoth and the Abyss Evil God died, they would completely
die, leaving nothing behind.
Not only was it useless before death, but it was also useless after death. Useless thing.
“According to my calculations, it’s impossible for only one source of transcendence to drop when our abilities superimpose…” Ling said.
“This probability is extremely small, almost negligible.”
“Mimi.” Little Zi also revealed an innocent expression, feeling that it wasn’t a burden.
It had already tried its best to restore the power of Teacher Gem Cat and Teacher Prediction Owl.
“Roar, roar, roar.” Eleven and the others were noisy. They looked at the retreating little monkey. Could it be Bu Lu?
This guys luck was pitifully poor. Perhaps it caused the entire team’s luck to worsen?
Even if its luck was heaven-defying previously, it would be normal luck if it neutralized it.
Shi Yu looked at Bu Lu.
“Wu!!!” Bu Lu said, “Don’t wrongly accuse a good beast. It’s not my last saber.”
“You mean, it’s my fault?” In the end, Qi couldn’t help but say, “My luck is very good, alright?”
“It must be because these three guys are too weak.”
Losing two sources of transcendence, in addition to the two lost in the transcendent duel, meant losing four.
Who knew how serious Shi Yu and the others’ losses were during this period of time?
“Wu wu ?????? Shi Yu couldn’t help but say, “Forget it, one is enough. We don’t need it anyway.”
“l can’t be too greedy.”
Shi Yu and the others were prepared to use this source of transcendence as a “bribery”.
This thing was at least equivalent to a “cosmic treasure” resource. When they went to the sixth cosmic life form, they could directly use the resources to open the way. It should be able to allow them to approach the sixth cosmic life form more smoothly.
If they didn’t need it in the end, they would throw it to the Blue Planet’s Will in this space and time.
After Shi Yu put away the resources, he said,
“So next, we’re going to that place called the ‘Hundred Flowers Starfield’, right?”
“Ling, how long will it take to reach that place?” Shi Yu asked.
“That star field is also at the edge of the Cosmic Sea. Although it’s a distance away from us, it’ll be done in about seven days. We have the energy gifted by the World King, so we can travel very quickly,” Ling said.
“Moreover, there’s also Bu Lu’s Hole of the Universe.” Ling looked at Bu Lu.
“l suddenly remember why I killed that guy so early. Its labor could clearly be free… I’ll kill it after freeloading.” Bu Lu recalled the cosmic behemoth that it had just killed and felt that it was a pity.
With this guy, Bu Lu didn’t have to be a laborer. At the same time, it could also make the cosmic behemoth look not so useless.
Unlike now, Shi Yu and the others probably despised the cosmic behemoth and the Abyss Evil God to death.
Shi Yu said, “…You’ve improved a lot. Learn from Bu Lu. You’ll save more.”
“Forget it this time, we’ll pay attention next time.”
“Right, right?” Bu Lu was very happy to be praised.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the other pets looked at Bu Lu in silence. They didn’t expect that this guy would be assimilated by Shi Yu so quickly.
It was too scary. They had to hold on to their hearts.
After finishing their work, Shi Yu and the others headed to the outside world. At this time, Inatella didn’t seem to have been born. The World Tree hadn’t even been born.
However, there was no need for Shi Yu and the others to take the initiative to look for the Blue Planet’s Will. The Blue Planet’s Will appeared on its own.
Compared to the humanoid will of this space-time, the Blue Planet’s Will of this space-time transformed into a blue sprite that looked like Qi and appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
The Blue Planet’s Will in this space and time had yet to experience a complete
Mythical War. Compared to the mature, stable, and powerful Blue Planet’s Will in the future, it still looked like a girl. It was a little inappropriate to call her Mom.
“Thank you.”
The Blue Planet’s Will thanked Qi and Shi Yu.
“There’s no need to thank me. This is what 1 should do!” Qi flew in midair and was smug. It didn’t expect that one day, it could actually bring powerful reinforcements to save Blue Planet and end the Mythical War.
Now, the Blue Planet’s Will should have a whole new level of respect for her.
Everyone should have a whole new level of respect for the Time Sprite.
“You didn’t come to this space-time specially to save Blue Planet, right?” Blue
Planet’s Will looked at Shi Yu and the others and said, “l can sense that you’re
also born on Blue Planet.”
“In other words, according to the normal historical direction, Blue Planet also won the Mythical War.”
Shi Yu said, “As expected of Blue Planet’s mother.”
It was still convenient to call it that.
Blue Planet’s Will, who had turned into a blue elf, was silent, although it wasn’t wrong for these lives born on Blue Planet to call their mother planet
Mom..

chapters.title: Chapter 1755 - 1755: Super Empress (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1755: Super Empress (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
However, the sudden appearance of a pile of powerful children still made it a little uncomfortable.
After all, it didn’t watch the children grow up.
“In the future, Blue Planet indeed obtained victory in the war, but it also paid a heavy price. Mother Blue Planet, you slept for a long time before Blue Planet recovered.’
“After the war, Blue Planet is no longer suitable for divine-level life forms to stay. Almost all the divine beasts have gone to the starry sky to find a new home. There are also a small number of divine beasts sleeping on Blue Planet or choosing to reincarnate and wait for the Mythical Revival.”
Blue Planet said, “From the looks of it, Blue Planet seems to be developing very prosperously in the future.”
Shi Yu said, “You can understand it that way. This is all thanks to a life form that walked out of Blue Planet… Do you mind if I borrow the power of Blue Planet to find her?”
“l don’t mind,” Blue Planet said.
Next, the Blue Planet’s Will shared its strength with Shi Yu. Shi Yu instantly seemed to have become the master of Blue Planet and clearly understood the situation of every life on Blue Planet.
He discovered a demigod-level metal-element big bull and punched the worm’s corpse fiercely.
“Moo!!!” Ancient God Golden Bull was still a rookie at this moment, although it would still be a rookie in the future.
He also discovered some confused Wind Kirins and revived in his wind domain.
This time, the Kirin Race in this space had the responsibility of luck. They finally didn’t have to be so unlucky.
However, these weren’t the targets Shi Yu was looking for. What he was looking for…
“Eh.” Shi Yu finally discovered traces of Goddess Wa on an island. At this time, Goddess Wa was only an intermediate god…
It had yet to grow to the peak of the divine level. Although Goddess Wa was also one of the few supreme gods of Blue Planet in the Mythical Era, she slowly grew up during the war and wasn’t a supreme god from the start.
“Looks like I’ve already obtained benefits from the Goddess Wa Ruins,” Shi Yu said. This was because the current Goddess Wa already had a human body and a snake tail.
Initially, he wanted to see if he could freeload on the Goddess Wa Ruins in this space-time, but from the looks of it…
He wouldn’t waste time playing with Goddess Wa. He would do business first. If there was time, he would talk about it later.
“In the future, she will bring back the humans from the starry sky and let the humans take root and sprout on Blue Planet. The rise of the humans largely determines the rise of Blue Planet.’
Shi Yu said, “Since the invaders have been destroyed, Blue Planet can actually still try to open the Stargate and let the various races head to the starry sky to take a look.”
“However, I don’t recommend this time. Next, Blue Planet should recuperate for ten thousand years,” Shi Yu said.
At this time, if he couldn’t deal with the sixth cosmic life form next, the sixth cosmic life form would definitely fight the World King and the cosmic overlord.
It was safer for Blue Planet to stay at the edge of the universe.
“Alright, I’ll listen to your suggestion,” the Blue Planet’s Will said.
Shi Yu looked at Qi beside him. Qi also looked at Shi Yu.
“In that case, we won’t stay long. I’ll leave it to you. If possible, you can focus on nurturing it.” Shi Yu also sent the Little Wind Kirin out and in front of Blue Planet.
Although the Blue Planet’s Will didn’t know the reason, it still nodded in the face of the future savior’s instructions.
The Wind Kirin Race, a race that bore the luck of the Kirin Race, looked like they had a deep karmic connection with the person in front of them in the future.
“Are you guys leaving?”
“Well, we’re leaving.”
Shi Yu and the others and Blue Planet were silent. Blue Planet knew that Shi
Yu and the others didn’t transmigrate purely to save Blue Planet, but since Shi Yu and the others didn’t say anything, it wasn’t appropriate for her to ask.
In order to hurry, Shi Yu and the others had already approached the Hundred Flowers Star Domain a few days later.
The Hundred Flowers Star Domain was named after a huge flower-like nebula in the star domain. This place was completely unknown previously. There wasn’t even a super divine life form.
In the entire universe, it was just a place like dust. It belonged to the corners of the universe, and it was only slightly better than the star domain where Blue Planet was.
However, as the mysterious expert who suddenly appeared in the Hundred Flowers Star Domain occupied this place, it was quickly visited by many super divines.
The reason was very simple. This mysterious expert used the treasure of the era universe as a reward to find information about the Time Sprite.
For the sake of a cosmic treasure, even super divine levels were tempted. During this period, there were also super divines who had ill intentions, but they were instantly crushed by a psychic power, so no one dared to be greedy.
This mysterious expert was undoubtedly very strong. So strong that she made the starry sky of the Hundred Flowers Star Domain famous just by staying here.
A few days later, Shi Yu and the others had already entered the Hundred Flowers Star Domain. According to the memories of the Worm Empress, Fei Lang, they searched for the star where the sixth cosmic life form lived.
This planet called Morning Star was still open to the public even after it was occupied. When Shi Yu and the others arrived, they could even see many battleships and spaceships parked outside the planet.
“Ling, looks like we still have to register.” After arriving, Shi Yu and the others realized that unlike Fei Langs memories, although this Morning Star could still be entered, there was an additional registration process.
There was a huge starry sky city outside the star, seemingly holding many functions. Many battleships needed to stop here before entering Morning Star before they could be allowed to enter the star.
Shi Yu and the others queued obediently. Soon, it was their turn. After landing in the starry sky city, a human in a blue spacesuit welcomed them outside the battleship..

chapters.title: Chapter 1756 - 1756: Super Empress (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1756: Super Empress (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Hello.”
“To enter Morning Star, you have to pay ten divine-level energy crystals as a pass fee. Apart from that, you also have to register your intention.”
Crack.
Shi?Yu?got?down?from?the?battleship?and?smiled.?He?welcomed?the?young?man?|in?charge?and?said,?“Brother,?I’m?the?owner?of?this?battleship.?Can?I?ask?you?|more?questions?”Shi Yu took out 15 divine-level energy crystals and handed them to the other party. The young man frowned and said, “Just ask directly. What do you mean?”
“Do you think I’m that kind of person without organization or discipline?” “l think so,” Shi Yu said seriously.
“You’re really good at judging people.” The young man quickly changed his expression and took the crystal with a smile. “Brother, from the looks of it, you just came to the Hundred Flowers Star Domain, right?”
“Just ask me if you have anything to ask. I’m a local of Morning Star. If you need anything, I can be your guide the whole time. I’ll get my colleague to help me take over…
“Oh right, my name is Zhang Gui. Just call me Little Zhang.”
Seeing Shi Yu so generous, Zhang Gui understood that Shi Yu must have come from the Cosmic Sea and was the heir of a large faction. Look, this beautiful and luxurious battleship, look, the aura of a dragon among men, look… this thick wallet.
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu said, “Before I came, I heard that entering
Morning Star wasn’t that troublesome…”
Zhang Gui said, “Didn’t Her Majesty completely unify Morning Star? Many things have to be done according to the rules. It’s also a good thing. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to obtain such a good job. After working for ten years, most of the resources after the divine level can be solved.”
“Her Majesty??” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Could it be that mysterious expert who appeared in the Hundred Flowers Star
Domain…”
“That’s right. After Her Majesty unified the Hundred Flowers Star Domain, she allowed outsiders to call her the super empress. She even established her own direct army, the Hundred Flowers Army. Now, almost all the experts in the Hundred Flowers Star Domain are working for the Super Empress.”
“There’s even a super divine expert who joined the Hundred Flower Army and became a general under the Super Empress.”
Shi Yu was surprised. The other party had yet to do these things before the worm left the Hundred Flowers Star Domain. It looked like it had made a decision after leaving.
Could this expert who called herself the Super Empress be that sixth cosmic life form?
“l wonder why Brother came to Morning Star,” Zhang Gui asked.
Shi Yu asked, “Why are these people here?”
He was referring to the battleships that entered Morning Star one after another.
Zhang Gui said, “Some of these people are here for the bounty, while others are here to join the Hundred Flower Army…”
“The reward for the Time Sprite??” Shi Yu asked.
“Partly!” Zhang Gui said. “Brother, let me remind you. If you don’t have concrete information about the Time Sprite, don’t lie for greed. The consequences will be very tragic…”
“During this period, many people lied about the information of the Time Sprite in order to reward them. They all died on Morning Star.”
Shi Yu said, “No, no… The Time Sprites are so rare that you can’t find many in the entire universe. I’m not that lucky to know their traces.”
“l actually ran away from home and wanted to travel outside. After hearing that a mysterious expert had appeared in the Hundred Flowers Star Domain, I wanted to see if 1 could become a disciple or something.”
Zhang Gui’s expression turned cold. He said nervously, “Brother, stop thinking about it.”
He said telepathically, “Her Majesty is cold and heartless. The few times she appeared, she killed the enemy. Until now, I’ve never heard of Her Majesty having any trusted aides…”
“Even the secretary who often accompanys her and deals with her affairs has never been treated well.’
“Well… It’s said that even that super divine expert who relied on the Super Empress couldn’t even see the Super Empress.”
“So terrifying.” Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
Damn.
World King tricked him.
Shi Yu thought that the sixth cosmic life form at this stage was easier to talk to, so the World King sent him over and let him have fun.
In the end, why did it still sound like a villain character who killed without blinking?
“Cough, cough, I was just daydreaming.”
“l heard that the Super Empress is at the peak of the super divine level. Even if she just joins the Hundred Flower Army, I feel that her future is limitless,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes, the Hundred Flowers Army has just started, but I believe that in the future, the Hundred Flowers Army will definitely be a super army famous in the universe!”
“If you join now, you’ll be an elder!”
“However, if you want to join the Hundred Flower Army, you probably have to at least have divine-level strength now. Moreover, you can still only start from the bottom, unless…
“Unless what?” Shi Yu asked.
Zhang Gui said, “Unless there are other talents. At the moment, the Hundred Flowers Army is very generous to a type of talent. As long as you have archeological talent, you can immediately occupy a high position after joining the Hundred Flowers Army.”
Archeologist!
Archeologist again!
This Hundred Flower Army also valued archeologists like the cosmic overlord army?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. So, the Super Empress was very interested in the last era??
She was certain that he was also a transmigrator from the last era.
This made Shi Yu even more certain of his identity as a transmigrator at the sixth universe level.
“If it’s a powerful archeologist, can he become a higher-up of the Hundred Flowers Army?” Shi Yu asked.
In his opinion, if he wanted to come into contact with the sixth cosmic life form, he had to first become a higher-up of the Hundred Flower Army..

chapters.title: Chapter 1757 - 1757: Super Empress (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1757 - 1757: Super Empress (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios    Editor: Atlas Studios
“More or less,” Zhang Gui said.
“Moreover, the most important thing is that it’s easy. The archeologists of the Hundred Flower Corps haven’t had to do anything in the past few years. They can enjoy extremely high resource treatment every year. I’m envious.” “You don’t have to do any work??” Shi Yu was surprised.
“Yeah, maybe there aren’t any ruins to explore at the moment. It’s simply a retirement class that I dream of. Unfortunately, I don’t have archeological talent.’
Shi Yu was dissatisfied. He originally wanted to join the Hundred Flower Army through his identity as an archeologist, but from the looks of it, if he didn’t even have a chance to perform, he might not be valued for a long time.
If it wasn’t valued, it would be difficult to see the Super Empress.
He couldn’t rely on the other party by showing his true strength, right… That would make his goal seem too clear.
He could also directly cause trouble and come into contact with it… But then, there was no need to fantasize. He felt that he would die.
“By the way, what you just said is the secretary of the Super Empress. Who is this person and how did she become the secretary of the Super Empress?” Shi Yu planned to start with this guy.
“You mean Lady Lily?” Zhang Gui said. “That lord has been following beside Her Majesty ever since she appeared. No one knows how she obtained Her Majesty’s recognition.”
“But compared to the Super Empress, this lord is much easier to talk to. Moreover, she’s equivalent to the right-hand woman of the Super Empress. She’s in charge of everything big and small in the Hundred Flower Army.”
“Including the Time Sprite, she’s also in charge of the reward for recalling resources.”
Shi Yu caught some key words and said, “Memory resource? What kind of bounty is this?”
Zhang Gui said, “Uh, the Hundred Flowers Army has been buying ‘memory-type resources’ recently, requiring them to be above super divine quality.”
“However, such resources are extremely rare. After so long, I feel that I’ve also bought some, but it’s still continuing. I feel that the use isn’t that simple.”
“Wu.” Shi Yu fell into deep thought again.
“Speaking of which, I’m an archeologist.”
“Really??” Zhang Gui widened his eyes and said, “It doesn’t look like it… Ah, no, I mean, aren’t archeologists all old people?”
“That’s not right either. I just feel that your aura… Well, you should have other more powerful identities.”
For example, the kind of silly and rich son of a landlord… Zhang Guixin thought.
“You’re biased,” Shi Yu said. “Moreover, I happen to have two super divine-quality memory-type resources here. Tell me, if I offer these memory-type resources and join the Hundred Flower Army as an archeologist, can I see Lady Lily and obtain her recognition?”
“This…” Zhang Gui said, “l, I don’t know.”
“However, if the quality of your resources passes, you might really be able to see Lady Lily in person. Her status in the Hundred Flower Army is supreme. If you can obtain her recognition and become the core higher-ups of the
Hundred Flower Army, it will definitely be a done deal! ! ”
“Then you should be in charge of reporting, right??” Shi Yu said.
“Yes, yes, sure. I’ll just report it to my superior…”
Shi Yu smiled. “Then I’ll leave it to you. I have two different types of super divine-level memory-type resources here. One is a wood-element fruit-type resource called the Reincarnation Fruit, and the other is a water-element memory resource called the Memory Water.”
“Alright, leave it to me!” Zhang Gui thought. As expected of a rich family.
Next, Shi Yu began to wait. At the same time, he analyzed in his heart. Bounty for memories??
He had an unbelievable guess.
Could this memory-type resource be something that the sixth cosmic life form wanted to use?
For example, if she was a transmigrator, was it possible that she had forgotten some memories like him?
Therefore, he put up a bounty for rare memory-type resources, wanting to try and develop a way to recover his memories…
Title… ability… goal…
Shi Yu felt that he had obtained a lot of useful information. Wait a minute, if all the analysis was correct, could it be that the other party also wanted to transmigrate back to the last era and find his lost experience??
Shi Yu felt that he was getting closer to the truth.
As for what the World King wanted to do himself, could it be to change the idea of the sixth cosmic life form and make her give up transmigrating to return to the last era?
“This is a possibility, and another possibility. The Super Empress captured the Time Sprite to break through.”
“Emperor Shi seemed to have said previously that every cosmic level is expert in spatial and spatial stats.”
“This Super Empress has only displayed powerful psychic power now. Although she might have other abilities, but she hasn’t displayed them, is there a possibility that she captured the Time Sprite just like the Space Worm? In order to devour them, she made her spatial attainments stronger and then reached the cosmic level.’
“Before capturing the Time Sprite, it wasn’t at the cosmic level. After capturing the Time Sprite, it was at the cosmic level. It doesn’t make sense to say that there’s no connection.”
“Therefore, the other party might not necessarily want to transmigrate, but it’s also possible that he purely wants to break through to the cosmic level.”
“Damn it, both theories make sense. What exactly is the truth?” Shi Yu t s head exploded.
[The problem now is why the cosmic overlord said that the sixth cosmic life form did something unforgivable.]
[Capturing a Time Sprite. Is breaking through to the cosmic level an unforgivable thing? No, the cosmic overlord seems to be looking forward to a new cosmic level expert challenging him.]
[Is it unforgivable to transmigrate with the power of the Time Sprite?]
[It doesn’t feel like it either. At least, the World King took the initiative to letme transmigrate to change some things. If transmigration is such a big taboo,as a supreme cosmic level, the World King shouldn’t help me transmigrate.]
[From these two perspectives, the two guesses just now have beeneliminated…]
[I’m still lacking some important information, information I don’t know..]

chapters.title: Chapter 1758: Key to Breaking Through (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1758: Key to Breaking Through (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Zhang Gui, is this the person who brought memories?” While Shi Yu was waiting, the big shot of the Hundred Flower Army, who was suspected to be Zhang Gui’s superior and had a higher-level position, arrived.
“Yes, Master Feng,” Zhang Gui said. “His name is Shi Yu. He claims to have two memories of different types of super divine quality.”
“Lord, please come in.” Master Feng invited Shi Yu and said, “We need to appraise the resources.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu snapped out of his daze.
Then, Shi Yu followed the other party to the appraisal room. Under Master Feng’s expectant gaze, Shi Yu took out the Reincarnation Fruit created by Baby Ginseng and the memory water drop created by Susu.
The emerald-green Reincarnation Fruit and the light blue memory water drop didn’t look like ordinary items. After all, they were created by divine skills (Perfect+47) and (transcendent).
“This is…” Sensing the time fluctuations emitted by the Reincarnation Fruit and the memory water drop, Master Feng said in surprise, “It’s indeed a super divine-quality resource, and they’re both rare time-element resources!”
During this period of time, it wasn’t that there were no memory-type resources, but there were more spiritual-type resources. There were very few people like Shi Yu who took out two different types of time-type resources at once.
“Excuse me, what are the effects of these two resources?” Master Feng asked.
Shi Yu sat on the chair and introduced, “This fruit’s effect can allow life to recover the memories and power of its previous life. It can even recover its strength, let alone its memories.”
“And this drop of water can strengthen memory abilities, even making forgotten memories become clear.”
“Excuse me, do these two resources meet the requirements?”
“It fits, it fits too well.” Master Feng looked up at Shi Yu and said, “Sir, what do you want? Generally speaking, we exchange other super divine resources for memory-type resources.”
“So arrogant?” Shi Yu was surprised.
Using super divine resources to exchange for divine-level resources. Good lord, if the gem cat knew, it would definitely be angry. How could anyone do such a transaction? It was a waste.
“Haha, our Hundred Flower Army doesn’t have anything but money,” Master Feng said. “This kind of resource is very useful to us. It’s naturally a high-level acquisition.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Actually, I don’t have any special requests. I just heard that the Hundred Flowers Army was established by a big shot at the peak of the super divine level. I feel that it has a lot of potential, so… I want to join too.”
“It would be best if I could become a higher-up.”
“You want to join the Hundred Flower Army??”
“Yes, I wonder what position I can get if I offer these two resources.” Shi Yu asked, “Oh right, I’m still an archeologist. Is my EXP pretty rich? I even have the battle record of cracking an era ruin.”
Master Feng opened his mouth slightly and looked at Shi Yu. He was a little confused. What day was it today?
“This matter has already exceeded my range of handling. I can help you ask Lady Lily.”
“Alright, I can wait,” Shi Yu said.
Couldn’t this Little Zhang directly call that secretary called Lily over in one go? However, considering the other party’s quasi-divine level and low identity, it was unrealistic to get it done in one go. Shi Yu sighed.
Shi Yu only waited for about half an hour before Master Feng said, “Alright,
Lord Baihe has replied. Next, I’ll bring you to Morning Star to see Lady Lily.”
In half an hour, Shi Yu chatted a lot with this Master Feng. Unfortunately, he didn’t get any useful information. Shi Yu had already heard everything he knew from Zhang Gui.
“You’ve worked hard,” Shi Yu said.
As for more information, Shi Yu estimated that he could only see who this empress’s secretary was.
As the Super Empress, the person beside the future sixth cosmic life form… She should know a lot of inside information.
He just didn’t know… if she was easy to get along with.
Next, Shi Yu and Master Feng headed to Morning Star. After passing through the starry sky, Shi Yu and Master Feng descended onto a pavilion floating in the sky.
Flowers were planted everywhere in this floating pavilion. Under the beauty of the hundreds of flowers, a special fragrance spread. It was naturally fragrant, like a paradise.
“Is this really a place for a secretary to stay?” Shi Yu complained in his heart.
[That’s a future cosmic-level secretary. Of course it’s powerful. Not all secretaries are as bitter as me.] Ling said.
“How have I mistreated you?” Shi Yu said. “Speak with your conscience.” “You have no conscience. Alright, be careful,” Ling reminded.
As Shi Yu walked, he spoke to Ling in his heart. Soon, he arrived at his destination.
“Lady Lily,” Master Feng said when they arrived at a courtyard-like place.
Shi Yu looked over and saw a woman in a white silk slit cheongsam standing quietly beside a tree. She was holding an ancient book. Not only was she white, but she also had white hair. She had two buns on her head, and two ponytails extended from the buns. Her black eyes were as calm as the lake. The secretary named Lily said, “He stays. You can leave now.”
“Yes.” Master Feng immediately took his leave.
In the next moment, only Shi Yu was left. Shi Yu took a deep breath and raised his guard. This was because he realized that he couldn’t see through Lady Lily at all. The other party was like a mortal. There didn’t seem to be any power fluctuations on her body..

chapters.title: Chapter 1759: Key to Breaking Through (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1759: Key to Breaking Through (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Hello, my name is Lily. I’m Her Majesty’s secretary.” She closed the book with both hands and looked at Shi Yu, her gaze flickering with an indescribable luster.
“Esteemed guest, I’ve already heard about you from Master Feng. I’m very interested in your resource called the Reincarnation Fruit and the memory
water drop. Can I take a look?”
“Of course.” Shi Yu nodded. Then, he took out the Reincarnation Fruit and the memory water drop from the equipment space and placed it on the stone table.
Secretary Lily didn’t move on the spot. She looked at the Reincarnation Fruit and the memory water drop. “This fruit should have been watered by that water drop.”
“Lady Lily, you’re indeed impressive. You can even tell.” Shi Yu was surprised.
In terms of quality, Baby Ginseng’s Reincarnation Fruit was actually better, because the Reincarnation Fruit was cultivated with a bunch of resources such as the Time Fruit and the memory water drop. It was a huge mix.
“It’s indeed a very rare resource,” Lily said. “Unfortunately, although the quality isn’t bad, the level is too low. If this fruit can reach the level of super divine quality and super divine level, it will be a very rare treasure.”
“Dear guest, can you tell me where you obtained this Reincarnation Fruit?”
Shi Yu pondered for a moment and said, “Lady Lily, it’s not a problem to tell you… However, I also want to know what you want to do with such resources.”
Lily smiled and looked at the plants. “It’s naturally to treat the Super Empress. Because the Super Empress’s mental strength is too strong, she’s been troubled by illnesses all year round and lost many key memories. These resources are the key to her recovery of her memories.”
“If the resources you provide can be one level higher, you might be able to help a lot.”
“The Super Empress lost many key memories???” Shi Yu was shocked. Although he had long guessed it, he didn’t expect this secretary of the Super Empress to say it so easily.
So, his previous guess was right?
“Oh, I might have said something important.” Secretary Lily shook her head and said, “Don’t talk nonsense, or there might be very serious consequences.”
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. Holy sh*t, he completely couldn’t understand Lily.
What was Lily doing?
If it was something important, she shouldn’t have told him.
“Well, let me think. It shouldn’t have been long since this fruit was born, right? In addition, it was watered by this water drop. In other words, you have mastered the cultivation method of this fruit,” Lily said. “Am I right?”
“That’s right…” Shi Yu said.
“In that case, that’s great. I heard from Master Feng that you want to join the Hundred Flower Army, right? However, compared to your identity as an archeologist, I think another identity is more suitable for you. That is, quickly think of a way to increase the level of this fruit to Level 11.” “At that time, I can satisfy whatever you want,” Lily said.
“Is it alright to see the Super Empress??” Shi Yu asked.
“You want to see her?” Secretary Lily said. “With your current strength, it’s not easy to stop her.”
“If you say something that makes her unhappy… Well, Her Majesty has a very bad temper. When she’s angry, it’s very terrifying.”
“Huh…?” Shi Yu was stunned. “Lady Lily, what do you mean?”
Stop the Super Empress? Shi Yu suddenly became nervous, his heart thumping.
“Didn’t you borrow the power of the Time Sprite to come from the future to the past to stop the Super Empress? However, your strength seems to be a little weak. Such strength can’t even deal with ordinary peak super divines, let alone the Super Empress. She probably only needs a thought for you to die without a complete corpse. Your Time Sprite will probably be eaten like soup.” Secretary Lily smiled faintly, making Shi Yu’s heart almost explode.
In the Beast Taming Space, Qi also let out a miserable cry like a pig being slaughtered.
Shi Yu suddenly retreated.
Damn it, damn World King, you tricked me.
Didn’t they say that the Space-time Jade would cover the aura of the Time Sprite and make it impossible to see their identities as transmigrators?
Why could even a little secretary tell that he came from the future now? From her tone, it was more like she had already seen through his full strength!
At this moment, Shi Yu didn’t want to play anymore. He only wanted to immediately use the Space-time Jade to let Qi bring him back to this space- time dimension.
“She doesn’t seem to have any ill intentions.”
However, the reminder of the pets made Shi Yu calm down. Secretary Lily indeed didn’t seem to have any ill intentions.
Although she didn’t look like a good person either.
“Who exactly are you?” However, Shi Yu still chose to ask.
“Me? I’m just a pitiful tool,” Secretary Lily said. “At the same time, I don’t completely agree with what the Super Empress does.”
“What exactly does the Super Empress want to do?” Shi Yu asked.
This person seemed to be able to answer him.
Secretary Lily said, “What she wants to do is only to recover her memories.” “You should have a guess about her origin, right?”
Shi Yu said, “Could it be… that the Super Empress was a transmigrator from the last era and lost her memories during the transmigration process?”
“That’s right,” Lily said. “Her Majesty indeed came from the last era, just like you. After she came to this era, she had powerful strength, but she lost all her memories, including her name and identity. She has even forgotten who she is.
She has no memories at all..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1760: Key to Breaking Through (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1760: Key to Breaking Through (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“However, although she forgot everything, she often cried for no reason. She felt that she had something to remember, so she started a trip to find her identity.”
“During this process, she understood. She was a transmigrator from the previous era, but she successfully transmigrated. She also paid a huge price, which was to forget everything. After the Super Empress tried various ways to recover her memories and failed, she finally chose a path of no return, which was to capture the Time Sprite, hoping to use the power of the Time Sprite to return to the previous era.”
Secretary Lily said, “In this way, can I solve your doubts?”
“No…” Shi Yu said, “If that’s all, as the secretary of the Super Empress, why don’t you agree with her? If it were me, I would definitely be willing to help her.”
Lily said, “Of course not, because if she successfully transmigrates, this universe will be completely destroyed.”
“I thought you could know more. Don’t you know some of the taboos that exist in transmigrating space and time?”
Shi Yu shook his head.
“The evil consequences of casually playing with space and time are unimaginable. At best, it will reduce the lifespan of the universe and cause the universe to end in advance. At worst, it will cause the universe to be directly destroyed. This shouldn’t be the first time you’ve transmigrated through space and time, but you weren’t punished. This might also be related to your weak strength.”
“It might also be related to the year you transmigrated and the smaller change in the history of the universe.”
“Otherwise, some supreme experts would definitely have attacked you long ago. ”
“But Her Majesty is different. Her power is unimaginable. Once her transmigration succeeds, the only path waiting for this cosmic era is destruction. She will definitely exhaust all the power of this universe before she can complete her transmigration.”
“It’s not just me. I’m afraid the other five cosmic levels won’t sit back and do nothing either.” Lily looked at Shi Yu and said, “Could you have been sent here by a certain cosmic level?”
“Looks like the other party didn’t tell you anything. She probably paid a considerable price to let you transmigrate.”
Shi Yu was silent. Why did he feel that this woman knew everything?
However, Shi Yu now knew that what the World King wanted to do himself was to change the idea of the Super Empress transmigrating to the last era.
Son of a b*tch, was it that serious to transmigrate to the last era??
To be honest, Shi Yu also had the intention of transmigrating to the last era to play. If the five cosmic levels knew, would he also be imprisoned..
Ah, no, the strength of the sixth universe level was powerful and couldn’t be killed. It could only be sealed, but he… was probably directly crushed to death.
Transmigrating through space and time… So there were hidden dangers. However, even so, the World King directly sent him to this space and time. This meant that the hidden dangers of the sixth cosmic life form insisting on transmigrating through space and time were much greater than his transmigration this time. It was something the universe couldn’t withstand, causing the World King to have no choice but to make a choice.
The sixth cosmic life form might be very, very strong, with strength comparable to a cosmic overlord. Otherwise, how could the combination of a cosmic overlord and a world king only seal her and not kill her?
The World King probably didn’t want to cause a cosmic war, nor did he want the Super Empress to achieve her ambition.
As for cosmic overlords… they were probably tired of living. Previously, they still cared about the lifespan of the universe and cooperated with the World
King, but now, they didn’t care. It didn’t matter even if a cosmic war happened.
Probably this time, the World King and the cosmic overlord couldn’t cooperate.
Therefore, how was the current strength of this Super Empress? Shi Yu felt that the peak of the super divine level was a little unreliable.
“I don’t agree with her approach, so I’m looking for other ways to help Her Majesty recover her memories, such as what I’m doing now,” she said. “However, I also know that the chances aren’t high.”
“So next, are you going to cooperate with me to study the Reincarnation Fruit, or are you determined to stop Her Majesty?”
“If you choose the latter, you’re also a transmigrator from the last era like her. Perhaps she’ll let you die faster,” Lady Lily said.
“Can you not casually say such a terrifying thing?” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “Lady Lily, can I believe you?”
“I’ll cooperate with you to study the Reincarnation Fruit first. It shouldn’t be long before I can nurture a Level 11 Reincarnation Fruit,” Shi Yu said.
“That’s good.” Secretary Lily smiled and said, “Well, Her Majesty has marked to go to the World King Planet to hunt the Time Sprite. She might not be back for a while. During this period of time, you should stay on Morning Star well. If you need anything, you can look for me.”
“Of course, if you want to choose to escape, do it as soon as possible.” Then, Shi Yu left with a heavy mood. Shi Yu’s pets were all in a heavy mood. “Shi Yu, sob, sob, let’s escape…” Qi said, “Let’s go back ‘
“So scary, but it seems that after returning, I still can’t escape the fate of being hunted…”
Shi Yu said, “Let’s wait a while and take a gamble. Let’s see if we can persuade the sixth cosmic life form. F*ck, I also want to transmigrate back to the archeological era of the last era. Let’s see if we can be partners with her.
Although this might offend the World King or something, at least choose like this first. Our safety is most likely guaranteed…”
“As long as we surrender quickly, the Super Empress won’t kill us.”
The pets: ‘Q”
Eleven, Bu Lu, and the other pets were speechless. So the World King sent them back and they even defected to the enemy?
“It’s mainly because this Super Empress sounds more similar to me.”
“We might be able to think of a way to transmigrate back to the last era, but we won’t let the universe be destroyed.”
At the same time.
Secretary Lily watched Shi Yu leave and fell into deep thought for a long time. “Why does this guy give me a very familiar feeling? Perhaps…”
“He can be the key to breaking out of the situation..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1761: Path to the Universe (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1761: Path to the Universe (1)
Although his identity had been seen through, Shi Yu didn’t sense any danger for the time being, so he chose to stay.
“Ling, do you think that Lily’s words can be believed?” Shi Yu asked.
“It’s worth believing. At least, we don’t have any other clues. No matter what this Lily’s goal is, she’s already the closest person to the Super Empress. If what she said is true, then she’s the only power we can rely on. The teammate most worth roping in is better than us fighting alone,” Ling said.
“So next, are we going to let Baby Ginseng break through to the epoch god?” Qi asked.
“Well, as long as Baby Ginseng breaks through to the epoch god and uses the power of the Time Fruit to erupt, we should be able to nurture a super divine level memory resource at a certain price.”
“Yiya…” Baby Ginseng scratched its head and felt a little pressured. Among the initial six pets, it wasn’t the epoch god anymore. However, it still needed its strength this time. Baby Ginseng immediately felt that it was a burden.
“Yi… (What should we do? Do we need to find a strong enemy to fight?)” Baby Ginseng asked.
“It’s not easy to find. Your increasingly inflated hearts make ordinary super divines unable to pressure you anymore. How can you have so much time to find suitable opponents? Choose other methods to train your willpower,” Shi Yu said.
“I’ve thought of letting Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and Bu Lu take turns being your opponent.”
“The former team champion can only be at the bottom now. He can’t even defeat the newbies.
“During the battle process, I’ll record a video. Then, after returning to World King Planet, I’ll publicize it.’
“It will also be thrown to Ancient Capital University to let those students and teachers who have attended classes with you see how the ginseng emperor, who has been studying hard, is like in the team now.”
“Baby Ginseng, you don’t want your supporters and fans of the ginseng emperor to know that the former number one in the team has already fallen to this state, right??”
“So… can you think of a way to break through yourself with the conditions already in the team for this mission?”
Baby Ginseng:
Baby Ginseng’s eyes widened.
Wasn’t this shameless?
It was just a little behind and would soon reach the epoch god level. Eleven and the others were only a year and a half earlier. What was there to compare?
As for doing such a ruthless job in the short period of time it was behind?
“Wuuu!!” Eleven and the others didn’t mind. As long as they could help Baby Ginseng, they were willing to help.
No matter how powerful Baby Ginseng was, the Anti-Teammate Energy Fruit couldn’t be very effective at the same level.
It could be said that its battle power was the worst among the few people Shi
Yu had named.
“Mi, Mi.” At this moment, Little Zi was also eager to give it a try. To be honest, it felt that its current strength wasn’t weaker than Baby Ginseng. It could also join it.
Although there was a high chance that it was second to last, at least it wasn’t last.
If it missed this opportunity to defeat Baby Ginseng, it would be difficult to find in the future.
It also wanted to be Baby Ginseng’s sparring partner.
“Yiya! At this moment, facing the covetous gazes of a group of teammates, Baby Ginseng was completely angry. An unconvinced mentality surged in its heart.
Ridiculous.
It was the previous first place…
Shi Yu and the others arrived in the starry sky and left Morning Star. He and Lily’s secretary agreed to meet after it produced the super divine level Reincarnation Fruit.
Therefore, Shi Yu and the others used the power of Buggy, Bu Lu, and the others to open up a Void Battlefield and start seclusion cultivation here.
It had to be said that Shi Yu knew training. His training method was undoubtedly the best effect for Baby Ginseng.
Although the opponent wasn’t a life-and-death strong enemy that had to be defeated and had an absolute reason to defeat it, Baby Ginseng, who had finally obtained first place in the team after countless hardships, had a rather proud heart.
It even made up his mind to protect the trump card throne in the team continuously.
However, after being controlled by Shi Yu, it was directly reduced to the bottom of the team. It lost to its teammates consecutively and didn’t have a chance to make a comeback… This stimulation was undoubtedly the greatest training for Baby Ginseng, who was still first in the team a second ago.
In comparison, facing three super divine invaders at the same time, Baby Ginseng might not be able to have such “certainty”.
This training method was only suitable for Baby Ginseng. It wasn’t very useful for pets like Little Ji, Duckie, and the others, because they were often at the bottom. No matter how much they were ravaged by the big brothers and sisters of the first team, they felt that it was nothing.
However, Baby Ginseng was different. It was the person who had won the strongest title… Therefore…
After Baby Ginseng lost to Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and Bu Lu more than 30 times, Baby Ginseng’s unwilling will finally reached its limit.
Break through under pressure and be reborn in adversity.
“Yi!! In the void, Eleven and the other pets were all forced back by the shocking aura erupting from the broken half radish in the center of the starry sky, revealing slightly serious expressions.
“Yi! ! ! ” Baby Ginseng was angry. Its Super Divine Will condensed. After being tortured by its teammates more than 30 times, its gaze was filled with unconvinced emotions. At this moment, it reached the extreme, and its heart that pursued invincibility was completely perfect.
Yiya, Yiya, Yiya. Facing super divine level opponents, it was only amused. Its ginseng baby’s wish and determination was to always suppress these guys and become the strongest among them..

chapters.title: Chapter 1762: Path to the Universe (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1762: Path to the Universe (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Therefore, Baby Ginseng became the first and only pet in the team to break through to the epoch god level due to the pressure of the team’s internal competition.
“Yiya!!!” After breaking through to the epoch god, Baby Ginseng’s battle power increased greatly, and the difference between it and pets like the epoch god Susu was infinitely smaller.
“Impressive, impressive.” However, what awaited Baby Ginseng wasn’t the revenge battle it was yearning for, but the even stronger and invincible Beast Shi Yu instantly pulled it up by the leaf.
Shi Yu said at the side, “You’ve finally broken through. Let’s fight when we get back. Let’s hurry up and nurture the Reincarnation Fruit first. Although you’ve broken through to the epoch god, it’s still not simple to nurture a super divine resource.”
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng’s expression turned bitter. It had just broken through to become a god of the invincible era. Why was it going to be a gardener in the blink of an eye?
“This is very important,” Shi Yu said. Not only was this the key to solving the cosmic battle, but this thing might also be what Shi Yu needed himself.
He had also forgotten a very important memory, but he was luckier than that Super Empress. The other party had forgotten all his memories, and he still remembered at least his experience at the mortal stage, so he wasn’t that hesitant.
About two months after Shi Yu and the others arrived at this space-time, Shi Yu and the others returned to Morning Star.
“Ah, we meet again. So you’ve completed the cultivation of super divine resources?”
Just as Shi Yu arrived outside the pavilion, a familiar voice came from inside. Secretary Lily walked out of the pavilion with her arms crossed and looked at Shi Yu in the sky.
Her exquisite face was filled with a smile, still so unfathomable.
Shi Yu slowly landed and said, “Yes, I didn’t disappoint you.”
After he landed, he took out a green and purple fruit that looked like a small pineapple with flowing light. “This… is it alright?”
Secretary Lily stretched out her hand, and the Reincarnation Fruit in Shi Yu’s hand slowly flew over. Shi Yu’s gaze focused because he couldn’t tell what power system the other party was using.
It wasn’t stats energy, nor was it the power of space and time, nor was it spiritual power or soul power. It wasn’t any power he was familiar with.
“Wu.” Secretary Lily looked at the Reincarnation Fruit carefully. This
Reincarnation Fruit was a super divine resource carefully cultivated by Baby Ginseng and the others for a month. It took a lot of effort and even used the support tools given by the World King to cultivate two.
One of them was eaten by Shi Yu. The other one was here.
When Secretary Lily looked at the Reincarnation Fruit, Shi Yu was very nervous because he felt that relying on the super divine level Reincarnation Fruit was still not enough.
Because at least after he ate the fruit, apart from making his body’s control talent permanently more exquisite, he had no other gains…
He didn’t remember anything from his previous life.
Well, the ability to become bigger and smaller referred to the ability to casually control the age. After eating the super divine level Reincarnation Fruit, not only did he obtain the reincarnation ability of those divine beasts, but he also became more proficient in becoming a child or old man.
“What a pity.” After looking at the Reincarnation Fruit for a while, Secretary Lily said regretfully, “Although this thing is the highest quality and Effect I’ve seen since the bounty was carried out, and it might also be the best memory resource, I feel that with its power, it’s still a certain difficulty to awaken Her Majesty’s memories.”
“Sigh, it would be even better if you can nurture a cosmic treasure-level fruit.”
“Hey, what a joke.” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say. Could that thing be artificially created?
“So you mean that we’ve worked for nothing for two months?” Shi Yu said.
“You only took a look and determined that this fruit is useless. Then, before we go to cultivate, you should be able to determine that super divine level memory resources still can’t solve anything, right?”
“That’s right.” Secretary Lily smiled and said, “From the start, I knew that the super divine fruit you developed was still useless.”
“I also know that the resources obtained from the bounty are all useless.”
Shi Yu:
Baby Ginseng:
In the Beast Taming Space, Baby Ginseng was angry. Since this bad woman knew that it was useless, she shouldn’t have said anything. She caused it to be beaten up so many times for nothing. Even that new monkey that joined the team could beat it up.
“Don’t be angry first.” Secretary Lily smiled and said, “Although it’s useless now, it doesn’t mean that it’s useless after being strengthened.”
“In theory, cosmic treasure-level resources can only be born naturally, such as the source of transcendence.’
“However, through hard work the day after tomorrow, it might not be impossible to upgrade a super divine resource to the cosmos level.”
“As long as I find the right method.”
“What do you mean?” Shi Yu said.
“You have a way to upgrade the level of this Reincarnation Fruit to the cosmic level?”
Secretary Lily said, “This fruit is indeed the most suitable resource I’ve seen in so long. As expected of you. As transmigrators, you indeed know what Her Majesty needs the most.”
“So next, let’s tamper with this fruit.”
Shi Yu understood what the other party meant. It was almost equivalent to increasing the quality level of the Reincarnation Fruit. It was the same nature as him wanting the gem cat teacher to increase the quality of the second-hand source of transcendence.
However, what did the other party want to do…
“Have you heard of the Universe Tree?” Secretary Lily asked.
What was that…

chapters.title: Chapter 1763: Path to the Universe (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1763: Path to the Universe (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
[Master, the Universe Tree is a cosmic-level treasure born naturally in the universe.]
[Although it’s called a tree, it’s not alive.]
[The cosmic treasures born naturally in the universe are also divided into levels. For example, the source of transcendence is the lowest-level cosmic-level resource, while the cosmic tree is a relatively powerful cosmic-level resource.]
[It’s said that the Universe Tree records all the information about a cosmic era from birth to destruction. Through the Universe Tree, one can be omniscient and know everything that happens in the universe.] [It contains unbelievable spatial power…]
[Why haven’t I heard of such a thing?] Shi Yu asked.
Ling said telepathically, [Because in the timeline we’re in, the cosmic tree has long been destroyed for unknown reasons. Just like the sixth cosmic life form, traces of its existence have almost been lost in the long river of history.]
[After I came here, I combined the information here with the information on our side and updated the information.]
Shi Yu looked at Secretary Lily and said, “Of course.”
“That’s easy. I won’t tell ordinary people about this secret. Apart from being an encyclopedia, the Universe Tree has another effect, which is its power. It can increase super divine level resources to the cosmic level the day after tomorrow.”
“Although it will cause a certain amount of damage to it, well… this is also the only way I know to quickly upgrade this fruit to the universe level.’
“You mean that next, you’re going to find the Universe Tree and use its power to increase the level of the Reincarnation Fruit again??”
“Wrong, it’s not me, it’s you.” Secretary Lily smiled and said, “You should still have time. Do you want to take a look?”
