[Master, this Universe Tree grows in the Cosmic Sea. However, it belongs to the World King and is protected by the guardian at the peak of the super divine level under the World King. Anyone who has ill intentions towards the Universe Tree will be judged…]
“Do you think I can come into contact with the Universe Tree?” Shi Yu asked.
“You also said before that we can’t even defeat ordinary peak super divines…
That tree should have a guardian, right?”
Secretary Lily said, “Of course I know this, but I believe you have a way.”
There was a way… Of course.
They were sent by the World King. In fact, apart from the Space-time Jade, the World King had even prepared many support tools for them.
For example, the navigation energy of a battleship, or the token that represented the identity of a World King…
If he used that token, the guardian of the Universe Tree should be able to let him pass.
However, Shi Yu felt that Secretary Lily already knew that he was sent by the World King and was using him as a tool.
If he were to borrow the power of the Universe Tree, the guardian over there might not stop him. However, if it were her and the Super Empress borrowing the power of the Universe Tree, there would definitely be a conflict with the World King.
In order to avoid rashness, this guy planned to let him go?
According to normal history, could it be that the destruction of the Universe Tree was also done by the Super Empress?
“Actually, it’s still worth going.” Secretary Lily smiled and said, “The Universe Tree is known to be omniscient and omnipotent. Don’t you want to use this opportunity to ask it some questions?”
“If you miss this opportunity, you won’t have another chance.”
This guy definitely knew his relationship with the World King! He even knew that the Universe Tree would be destroyed in the future!
Shi Yu took a deep breath and said, “It’s still a little dangerous.”
“Since you’re so worried, why don’t I go with you?” Secretary Lily said. “I’ll go to the Universe Tree with you. Are you relieved?”
“If there’s danger, the two of us will bear it together. Although I’m only a weak woman, Her Majesty left a protective technique on me. If we encounter danger,
Her Majesty will definitely come to save us.”
“The Super Empress… isn’t back yet??”
“No. There aren’t many Time Sprites in the universe, nor are there many. It’s not easy to catch these little guys. If we don’t want them to escape, Her Majesty can only do it herself. I reckon… she has something to catch.”
“If you want to see her, cooperate with me obediently and complete the upgrade of the Reincarnation Fruit together. At that time, I’ll help you contact Her Majesty.”
Shi Yu was silent for a moment before saying, “Alright, let’s go together.”
Next, Shi Yu didn’t know why he had inexplicably formed a party up with this secretary named Lily.
After this guy boarded Shi Yu’s battleship, he said very familiarly, “When we reach the cosmic tree, what do you want to ask?”
“This…” Shi Yu thought to himself. He wanted to ask the cosmic tree who it was.
“I want to ask about the method to break through to the cosmic level,” Shi Yu casually chose a topic and said perfunctorily.
“This isn’t a question that can only be answered by the Universe Tree. I can tell you,” Secretary Lily said happily.
“Hm?”
“As long as the most instinctive ability of the race is developed to the extreme, it will be at the cosmic level. At the moment, the five major cosmic levels of the universe and starry sky have all become cosmic levels like this.”
“The World King is a planetary life form. Whether a planetary life form becomes a super divine or a cosmic level, they are all unique races. They just need to directly absorb the power of the universe.”
“The World King is considered one of the top five stars with talent potential in this cosmic era. It’s not strange for it to become a cosmic level..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1764: Path to the Universe (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1764: Path to the Universe (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“What about the other four stars?” Shi Yu asked.
“In theory, the other four stars have better aptitudes than the World King Planet. The four of them originally had hope of reaching the cosmos level faster than the World King, but what could they do? It was precisely because their aptitudes were good enough that they were targeted by the Beastmaster.”
“Beastmasters, as the Cosmic Behemoth Race, the most instinctive ability of their race is to devour planets, so you understand, right? The other four stars have already become the Beastmaster’s meal.”
“Originally, the World King should have been devoured by the Beastmaster, but what could it do? Even after devouring four of the most talented stars, the Beastmaster still couldn’t advance, so the Beastmaster judged that it could only advance perfectly after devouring the cosmic stars.”
“Therefore, it began to assist the World King in breaking through and didn’t attack again. Until the World King completed the breakthrough and became a cosmic star, the Beastmaster began to invade the World King Planet.”
“I have to say that this Beastmaster is very powerful. Although it was killed by a World King who advanced to the cosmic level and its life was on the line, under its long plan, it still successfully swallowed a portion of the power of the World King Planet in the end. Then, it reincarnated elsewhere and completed its advancement after recuperating for a long time.”
“There’s also the Dark King . It’s even simpler. It’s the embodiment of the polluted matter in the universe. The most instinctive talent of races is that the more lives and areas polluted, the stronger its own strength.”
“After it occupied most of the territories in the universe and created countless pollution races, it naturally completed its breakthrough.’
“Well, there’s also the queen of the Worm Mother Nest. As a Space Worm, her most instinctive talent is relatively similar to the cosmic Behemoth. However, the cosmic behemoth devours planets, while it devours normal lives.”
“In the beginning, there were countless powerful races in this universe. The cosmic behemoth wasn’t the race with the strongest overall stats, but now, these races have already been extinct, and the reason for their extinction is because they were all devoured by the Worm Queen.”
“As the strongest mutated individual among the mutated worms, the Worm
Queen gathered the best genes in the entire universe and completed the optimization of its genes, breaking through to the cosmic level…”
“Of course, the premise of completing all of this is to have a good foundation. Otherwise, even if you obtain the opportunity to break through to the cosmos level, you will still be in a bottleneck and regret it for the rest of your life. You should understand what the foundation I’m talking about is, right? For example… when you become a super divine level, you have to fuse with the purest source of transcendence, not the source of transcendence that has already been branded by others. The latter, even if the foundation isn’t good.” “What about the cosmic overlord?” Shi Yu asked.
“As the strongest individual in the universe, how did it break through to the cosmic level? What’s its racial ability?”
“A cosmic overlord…” Secretary Lily said, “Didn’t I tell you just now that at the start of the universe, there were many unique races… They were even stronger than the cosmic behemoth race.”
“These races are actually even more terrifying. Like planetary life forms, there aren’t many restrictions if they want to break through to the super divine level or the cosmos level. What they lack is time.”
“It’s not too much to say that they’re ‘cosmic races’. As long as they grow up naturally, there’s hope of them reaching the cosmic level.”
“Unfortunately, although this batch of powerful races was born strong, their growth path wasn’t smooth. Just like what I said just now, most of them died in the mouths of the Worm Queen and became nutrients for others.”
“As for the cosmic overlord, Cypos, it’s considered the only one among this batch of powerful cosmic races who has survived until now. Even among those powerful cosmic races, it’s the most talented. The path it took to break through to the cosmic level can be said to be a legend, an invincible legend. Other races can’t imitate it.”
After Secretary Lily finished speaking, she continued to add, “Therefore, if you want to break through to the cosmic level, you naturally have to develop your racial abilities to the limit. Here, if you successfully contract a cosmic level above your level, you should be able to break through, right?”
Lily said the same conclusion as the Prediction Owl and the others. She even said a lot of information that the astrologers didn’t know and displayed knowledge that didn’t match her identity again.
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu asked, “Miss Lily, who exactly are you?”
Lily smiled and said, “I’ve already told you. I’m just a miserable tool. Her
Majesty only told me this.”
“When Her Majesty just started to wake up and search for her memories, she was unfamiliar with this starry sky. I helped her a lot and explored many ruins with her. I also gave her many ideas. It’s also thanks to me that I helped her a lot before she became like this. Otherwise, how many people like me who want to stop her plan wouldn’t be enough for her to kill…”
“Alright, the message just now is my reward for asking you to be busy for so long. How is it? Did it solve some of the doubts in your heart?”
Shi Yu’s heart turned solemn. Was this the only way to break through to the cosmic level?
It was… simpler than he imagined, but also difficult.
Then, if Eleven, Buggy, and the others wanted to break through to the cosmic level, they had to develop their primitive racial abilities to the extreme?
Eleven was an Iron-eating Beast… So, it had to rely on eating metal to reach the cosmic level?
However, what kind of metal was needed to support Eleven to reach the cosmic level? After all, when a Beastmaster broke through to the cosmic level, it ate the four most talented planetary life forms in this cosmic era and ate a mouthful of cosmic stars to complete the breakthrough.
Were there any metals that could match the quality of these planets?
If Buggy wanted to break through to the cosmic level, could it be… that it still had to transform into a cocoon and evolve again?
The most instinctive talent of the Green Silkworm was to transform into a cocoon and evolve. Although it couldn’t compare to the talent of those powerful races, this seemed to be the path most in line with Buggy’s own body. No wonder Buggy vaguely felt that if it wanted to go higher, it couldn’t imitate the Green Dragon. It turned out that if it wanted to reach the cosmic level, it had to develop the most primitive racial abilities..

chapters.title: Chapter 1765: Super Empress Appears (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1765: Super Empress Appears (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu was in a hurry. They sped along the path of the cosmic tree.
A few days later, Shi Yu and the others arrived at the forbidden land of the Cosmic Sea, the Tree Sea Realm.
“What’s going on with the environment here?”
Shi Yu and the others, who were still in the starry sky of the universe just now, seemed to have accidentally entered a forest maze without any warning.
Unknowingly, it was as if he had entered another space. There was a blue sea of clouds around him. Above the sea of clouds, special star-blue grass grew and fluttered with the wind of the starry sky.
“This is the location of the cosmic tree.’
Secretary Lily, who had chosen to rest on the battleship for a while, finally woke up. She came to Shi Yu, Ling, and the others and said, “The maintenance of the Universe Tree requires a large amount of cosmic power.”
“Therefore, in the environment it’s in, there won’t be any planets around, so naturally, there won’t be life. As time passed, this starless land evolved into such a strange environment.”
“Let’s go and find the Universe Tree,” Secretary Lily said. She teleported to the outside world before Shi Yu and the others.
“This guy…” Shi Yu said, “Let’s go too, Ling.”
“Alright.” As he spoke, Ling’s battleship body disappeared, turning into a smaller wrist guard that was worn on Shi Yu’s wrist.
Shi Yu, who was floating in the air, immediately followed Lily.
Shi Yu discovered that the place they were stepping on next should be a branch of the incomparably huge cosmic tree. The cosmic tree was connected to countless alternate spaces. Its entire body was even larger than a planet, andits entire appearance was very difficult to capture.
There was nothing special about this crystal-like branch, but this wasn’t what they were looking for. They wanted to go to the core of the Universe Tree, the core inside the tree.
Only by borrowing the power of that could he increase the quality of super divine resources…
Boom!!!
As the two of them went deeper, a terrifying pressure suddenly appeared in the invisible place. This pressure instantly made Shi Yu’s expression freeze.
With his current level of Level 14, it was still difficult for him to breathe in the face of this pressure. He felt that only by fusing with Beast Shi Yu could he barely resist it.
“Has it appeared?”
“The guardian of the cosmic tree, the God of Fertility.”
Secretary Lily wasn’t far from Shi Yu. She didn’t seem to be suppressed by this deterrence. She looked at the supreme void with a calm expression.
Crack.
In the starry sky, many green cubes suddenly appeared. These green cubes kept forming a spatial passage. Among them, a strange life form that looked like a knight wearing a gladiator’s helmet stepped out of the air. Its body was completely made of white and blue. Its body was like the trunk of a tree, its elbows were like blades, and its head was like a gladiator’s helmet.
“Outsider, tell me the purpose of your trip.”
After the guardian of the cosmic tree descended, its gaze landed on Shi Yu and Lily. It said, “If you accidentally entered, please leave immediately.”
“Of course not.” Miss Lily smiled and said, “We just plan to borrow the core power of the cosmic tree. May I?”
“I see. Another person coveting the power of the cosmic tree?”
“On the orders of the World King, I’m here to protect and kill all those who have ill intentions.” As the God of Fertility landed, countless starlight gathered at the edge of its hand, and a power that was fierce enough to pierce the Sea of Stars gathered.
“Kid, quickly think of a way.” Secretary Lily looked at Shi Yu.
However, Shi Yu was indifferent.
Aren’t you very powerful? Why don’t you settle it yourself? Shi Yu thought to himself.
Seeing that Shi Yu was indifferent, Lily glared at Shi Yu.
“Alright, Lord Protector, don’t be in a hurry to attack.” Lily made a surrender posture and said, “The World King asked us to come.”
The attack of the God of Fertility had always been accumulated and not activated because it couldn’t see through the woman in front of it.
Although it could tell at a glance that this white woman wasn’t human, even it, a peak super divine, couldn’t see through her main body and her strength.
This made the guardian of the Universe Tree very afraid.
It wasn’t that it was worried that it couldn’t stop the other party, but that an overly intense battle would damage the Universe Tree.
“Lord World King.”
“That’s right.” Lily looked at Shi Yu and said, “Hurry up.”
“Tsk, I’m looking again.” Shi Yu took out the token representing his identity as a world king that the World King had given him before he left as if he was rummaging through trash.
“Here, use this to prove your identity, right?”
The token Shi Yu took out was completely brown, like wood. A faint golden
light lingered. To be honest, Shi Yu and the others studied it for a long time but couldn’t figure out anything strange about this token.
However, after the guardian of the Universe Tree saw this token, the attack posture in its hand was restrained, and its expression gradually calmed down.
“World King Token, you have the qualifications to use the Universe Tree.”
“However, it can’t exceed the right to use it.”
“Great.” Secretary Lily looked happy and said, “I knew you were still useful. I’ll leave the rest to you.”
Shi Yu looked at Secretary Lily in silence. He felt that if he was useless, this woman might directly fight the guardian of the Universe Tree.
“I want to borrow the power of the Universe Tree to upgrade a super divine resource to a cosmic resource. Can I?”
The cosmic tree guardian said, “Only one.”
“I also want to search for some information recorded in the cosmic tree.. Can I?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1766: Super Empress Appears (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1766: Super Empress Appears (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
The God of Fertility said, “Sure, but searching the memories of the universe through the cosmic tree will also consume a large amount of the cosmic tree’s power.”
“The number of questions you can ask will depend on the state of the cosmic tree after increasing the level of the resource.”
“Alright, I understand.”
“Next, can I head to the core of the cosmic tree?” Shi Yu asked.
“You can, but she can’t.” The Universe Tree Guardian looked at Secretary Lily. “Alright, I don’t have any intention of going in anyvvay,” Secretary Lily said.
“Then, I’ll leave everything to you.” She smiled at Shi Yu.
This guy was really not liked… Shi Yu sighed and chose to follow the footsteps of the Universe Tree Guardian into the depths of the Universe Tree.
In the world that was like a blue crystal palace, Shi Yu stepped in with the God of Fertility. The God of Fertility said, “Just place the resources you want to increase your quality in the center.”
After entering, Shi Yu discovered a blue tree stump that looked like it had been half cut off in the center.
“Is that all?” Next, Shi Yu took out the Reincarnation Fruit and placed it on the tree stump.
“Yes.” Seeing that Shi Yu was ready, the Space Tree Guardian walked in front of the tree stump and stretched out its hand.
In the next moment, a special power surged out of its body and was released to the root of the tree stump. Right on the heels of that, the entire cosmic tree stump lit up.
Then, the powerful power of space and time in the universe bloomed and shot into the sky from the cosmic tree root, turning into a blue pillar of light that connected the sky and the ground.
The Reincarnation Fruit was wrapped in this pillar of light, as if it was experiencing the baptism of the entire universe.
In the outside world.
Lily stood in the sea of trees and looked at the lit sea of trees. The same luster was reflected in her eyes. She stretched out her hand and let the starlight sprinkle down.
“I hope it can succeed..
Although she sensed the birth of a treasure that was enough to cause a storm of blood in the entire universe, her tone was still filled with uncertainty.
Boom!!!
It didn’t take long for the energy fluctuations on the Reincarnation Fruit created by Baby Ginseng to suddenly become incomparably deep under Shi Yu’s witness, containing a power source that even Baby Ginseng couldn’t spy on.
This feeling was just like them staring at the source of transcendence. They only knew that this thing was very good and was very valuable to them after fusing, but they couldn’t spy on the essence of its power.
“That’s it?” As the pillar of light slowly dissipated, even the surroundings became much dimmer than before. Shi Yu asked the God of Fertility, who had stopped what he was doing.
“Well, the cosmic tree can only do this much,” the God of Fertility said.
“Alright, you can take away your resources.”
“As for you wanting to search for cosmic memories, just touch it with your hand. As long as the cosmic tree knows what you’re thinking, you can search for it.
“However, I can sense that the cosmic tree has already consumed a lot of strength. There aren’t many questions you can ask anymore.”
“Treasure this opportunity.”
“Alright, thank you,” Shi Yu said. “Then I’ll start.”
Shi Yu first took away the Reincarnation Fruit and touched the cosmic tree according to the other party’s teaching.
In the next second, Shi Yu seemed to have connected his consciousness to the entire universe. This feeling was similar to him listening to ruins through the Sound of History. It was as if he was checking the previous historical scene through a special ability.
Damn.
The Universe Tree was simply a treasure in the archeological world.
Why was such a good thing destroyed in this space and time?
With it, there was no need to spend any effort to do archeology. He just had to directly connect to its consciousness and search for history.
Which bastard destroyed such a good thing?
Super Empress? Huh?
In his sea of consciousness, in order to not miss this opportunity, Shi Yu first searched for one of the questions he wanted to know the most.
[Lily’s identity.]
Secretary Lily’s figure appeared in Shi Yu’s mind, but the cosmic tree didn’t respond to him for a long time.
It was as if it had died and didn’t know this question.
[Is the search method wrong?]
Shi Yu changed his search method. [How many transmigrators from the last era are there in this cosmic era?]
“Trash, this is the tree of all knowledge?” Shi Yu was angry.
However, he also understood that this might be a little out of the scope.
The Universe Tree was a treasure condensed from the power of this era in the universe. It only recorded the history of this era. With the influence of the previous era, it was understandable that it didn’t know.
However, why couldn’t he find Lily either?
Could it be that this guy was also a transmigrator from the last era?
Otherwise, why would he be so close to the Super Empress?
In fact… she was the Super Empress herself??
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat because Lily was too mysterious.
However, this was unrealistic. It was mainly because the difference between Lily and the sixth cosmic life form he understood was too big.
[I want to know…]
Shi Yu looked at the cosmic tree and asked again. This time, the cosmic tree finally knew and gave Shi Yu an answer. However, before Shi Yu could be happy for two seconds, he seemed to have been kicked out of his sea of consciousness and opened his eyes in the outside world in a daze.
“The state of the cosmic tree has already fallen severely and is about to enter a sleeping state. This is the end. I hope you obtained the answer you wanted,” the cosmic tree guardian said..

chapters.title: Chapter 1767: The Super Empress Appears (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1767: The Super Empress Appears (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu patted his head and said, “Alright.. “Can I ask you a question?”
“Tell me,” the Universe Tree Guardian said.
“There are several possibilities for people or things that the cosmic tree doesn’t know.”
The God of Fertility said, “The cosmic tree was born with this universe when it was born. It knows nothing about the last era and the future.”
“The people or things it doesn’t know might involve the last era. 2, that is, these people or things involve the universe level.”
“The cosmic level already has the ability to erase its traces of existence and not be recorded in the universe.”
“Even the Universe Tree doesn’t have the right to spy on the other party’s experience.”
“Then does the cosmic level have the ability to erase the traces of the existence of others so that they can’t be recorded by the cosmic tree?”
“Yes,” the Universe Tree Guardian said. “The authority of the universe level is very powerful. If you want to know more, forgive me for being helpless, because I know nothing about the cosmic level either.”
Shi Yu nodded in silence.
“Alright, no problem,” Shi Yu said.
Then, Shi Yu was sent to the outside world by the God of Fertility. In the outside world, Secretary Lily was still waiting. When she saw Shi Yu come out, she said, “Have you succeeded?”
“Alright.”
“Then let’s go quickly. Her Majesty seems to have already captured the target and is returning to Morning Star,” Secretary Lily said. “If she discovers that I’ve neglected my duty and left my post, I’ll be unable to bear the consequences of failure.’
“Is that so?” Shi Yu revealed a suspicious gaze.
Then, after thanking the Universe Tree Guardian again, Shi Yu left the Tree Sea Realm with Lily and returned to the Hundred Flowers Star Domain.
The God of Fertility looked at their departing backs and fell into deep thought for a long time.
“Lord World King, is this enough?”
“It’s done.” A phantom appeared beside the God of Fertility. She looked at Shi Yu and the others’ departing figures and said, “Although I’m not sure of my future thoughts, this is already one of the few things we can do.”
“I hope Shi Yu… can change her mind…”
“Otherwise, if there are no corresponding results for this action of sending him back, ‘I’ might have to withstand a lot of pressure from the other four guys…” “There might be hope.”
“This power should have a huge impact even on the cosmic level.”
At this moment, on the battleship, Lily held the Reincarnation Fruit Shi Yu had handed her and was very satisfied with the effect of the upgraded Reincarnation Fruit.
“Sigh, it’s so slow.”
“Can you be faster?” Lily urged. “I can’t wait to return to Morning Star.”
“This is already the fastest speed,” Shi Yu said.
“There’s a faster way, but we can only teleport ourselves. I can’t guarantee that we can also quickly teleport you over there…”
“Seriously?” Lily looked conflicted.
“It’s over. Her Majesty seems to have already arrived at the Hundred Flowers
Star Domain. It’s over, it’s over.”
“Why did she return so quickly this time?”
“Really?” Shi Yu said. “Since you can sense her location, she should be able to sense your location too. You must have been discovered long ago for neglecting your duty.”
“What do you know?” Lily said. “I’m just a small figure who has the energy to pay attention to Her Majesty at all times. How can Her Majesty have the energy to pay attention to me at all times?”
“What do you know?” Lily said. “I’m just a small figure who has the energy to pay attention to Her Majesty at all times. How can Her Majesty have the energy to pay attention to me at all times?”
“Well, if this Reincarnation Fruit can have an effect, then everyone will be happy. If it still can’t work, then…”
“Then it’s still all for nothing??” Shi Yu asked.
Shi Yu was also envious of this cosmic-level Reincarnation Fruit. Now that he had taken it out and given it to the Super Empress, if it still didn’t work, it was better for him to eat it himself.
“In short, go back as soon as possible,” Lily said. “Next, little guy, stabilize yourself. I’ll provide you with some special energy that can help you accelerate…”
“Huh??” Before Ling could react, Secretary Lily had already taken out a blue gem and thrown it to the ground.
In the next moment, the gem fused into the battleship. Before Ling could even react, it felt that the power source had enlarged several times.
“Ahhhhhhhhh…”
Under Ling’s cry of surprise, the battleship that was originally almost the fastest in the universe displayed incomparable speed again. Not only was Ling a little “stunned”, but even Shi Yu, who had contracted Ling, sensed Ling’s mood and almost wanted to vomit.
“Ugh, what did you feed Ling?”
“Acceleration agent,” Lily’s secretary said.
After eating the acceleration potion, Ling’s speed was indeed much faster. In the blink of an eye, it arrived at the Hundred Flowers Star Domain. However, the current Ling was almost half crippled. It was similar to Buggy, who used the magnetic skill. It would probably have to rest for a long time to recover.
“This guy.” Ling was about to cry. They were both secretaries, so why make things difficult for it?
“Are you back?” Shi Yu gradually woke up after being dizzy.
“You’re back.” Lily looked out of the battleship and said, “However, it doesn’t seem to be the time.”
“What do you mean?”
After Shi Yu became more and more awake, he realized that he was outside Morning Star. At this moment, the outside of Morning Star was already in a mess.
The city in the sky where Shi Yu and the others had docked previously had already turned into ruins of the universe. Fragments floated in the starry sky..

chapters.title: Chapter 1768: The Super Empress Appears (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1768: The Super Empress Appears (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Invader.” Lily revealed a playful expression and said, “A very powerful invader.”
“What, what?” Shi Yu instantly woke up. He quickly used Ling’s power to look into the distance.
At this moment, a bearded alien with pale skin like a zombie was floating outside Morning Star in the uniform of the cosmic overlord army.
At this moment, he raised his left arm high. The nine fingers of the hand with ten fingers closed. One of the fingers was in the air, and an energy ball the size of a small star floated on it.
This energy contained a strong world-destroying law. If it landed, Morning Star would undoubtedly be instantly destroyed. It wasn’t even difficult for the fluctuations caused by its explosion to destroy the entire Hundred Flowers Star Domain.
“Peak super divine…” Shi Yu took a deep breath and said.
“It’s the Northern General of the cosmic overlord army,” Lily said.
“Why is he here?” Shi Yu asked.
“Perhaps Her Majesty captured the Time Sprite too brazenly. After so long, her actions should have long been known by the various large factions.” “Perhaps the cosmic overlord sent the Northern General to destroy Her Majesty,” Lily said.
“Of course, it’s more likely that this Northern General made a decision on his own…”
“Unfortunately.”
“What’s unfortunate?” Shi Yu asked.
“Unfortunately, Her Majesty isn’t that easy to deal with. A peak super divine isn’t enough. His behavior is very stupid,” Secretary Lily said.
“Isn’t the empress only at the peak of the super divine level?” Shi Yu asked.
Lily looked at Shi Yu and said, “Aren’t you only at the peak of the divine level, but what about your battle power?”
When Lily finished speaking, Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. Son of a b*tch, he had almost forgotten about this.
Since the Super Empress was a transmigrator from the last era and still retained extremely strong power after transmigrating, the retained power was definitely the power system of the last era.
Judging from her battle results, she was definitely different from Beast Shi Yu. It wasn’t as simple as having strong physical strength.
With Beast Shi Yu and the source power he developed, he could kill super divines indiscriminately while the power system of this era was only at the peak of the divine level.
If the power system of the Super Empress of this era was cultivated to the peak of the super divine level, together with the cultivation system of the previous era, her battle power… wasn’t as simple as the peak of the super divine level?
In the outside world.
The Northern General from the cosmic overlord army stared at Morning Star coldly and said, “Super Empress, you ignored the ban of the cosmic overlord army and casually captured the Time Sprite in an attempt to interfere with the order of space and time.”
“I want to judge you and the faction you established here. Carry out…”
Before the Northern General at the peak of the super divine level could finish speaking, a dazzling light appeared in Morning Star. The light enveloped the entire Hundred Flowers Star Domain, making the Northern General instantly reveal a serious expression.
“What?”
Obviously, they were a little shocked by the power of the Super Empress.
Boom!!!
These lights were all made of spiritual power. They seemed to have formed a huge hand. In an instant, under the incredulous expression of the Northern General, they descended from the void and landed. They held the world-destroying energy ball in their palms and the Northern General in their palms.
Buzz!
The energy ball shattered, and no ripples appeared.
No ripples appeared. There was only a figure that emitted an absolute aura
standing on the fist-sized psychic palm and staring at the Northern General in
the light.
She was wearing a loose black empress suit, and her long black hair draped casually behind her. She had a queen-shaped baby face, a delicate figure, skin, and huge charm. Unfortunately, the coldness and heartlessness revealed in her red eyes prevented anyone who looked at her from admiring this beauty.
“Super Empress, what do you want to do?” Being grabbed by the psychic palm, the Northern General was extremely panicked. He felt that this guy’s strength wasn’t inferior to a cosmic level.
“I’m a cosmic tyrant..
Boom!!
His body was instantly crushed by psychic power. Countless traces of existence were instantly erased. Standing on the huge palm, the Super Empress looked at the battleship Ling, making Shi Yu and the others not dare to breathe loudly. Lily also smiled in embarrassment and said, “Your Majesty…”
“I want an explanation.” The Super Empress stared at Secretary Lily and said,
“You went out without my orders to bring them back?”
“A Time Sprite is considered a serious matter..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1769: Lily’s Identity (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1769: Lily’s Identity (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“A Time Sprite is considered a serious matter.”
The Super Empress’s voice was very cold.
“Wah!!!” In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, Qi let out another pig-like scream. Ahhh, the Super Empress, who had eaten the Time Sprite, had discovered her. It was over, it was over.
This guy was so scary. A peak super divine was insta-killed.
Shi Yu also had a serious expression. He knew that the Super Empress was very strong, but he didn’t expect her to be so strong.
According to the rules of the cosmic overlord army, as long as one had 1% of the strength of a cosmic overlord, they could temporarily control the cosmic overlord army. Ordinary peak super divines undoubtedly didn’t even have 1% of the strength of a cosmic overlord. As for this Super Empress, even if she hadn’t stepped into the cosmic level, her strength was definitely at the cosmic level…
It was probably even stronger than Goddess Wa of the same level.
“I already said, stop thinking about the Time Sprite all the time. Look, the people from the cosmic overlord army came looking for us,” Lily said. “The cosmic overlord is thinking of a way to delay the lifespan of the universe and make this cosmic era eternal, but you’re thinking about how to destroy the universe. At this rate, the main body of the cosmic overlord will come personally sooner or later…”
“So what?” the Super Empress said. “Is this all you want to say?” “Of course not. Moreover, you can’t move this guy,” Lily said.
“My empress, didn’t you sense anything from them?”
“They’re also transmigrators from the last era. Perhaps in the last era, you were still familiar with each other. If you directly kill them and recover their memories, you’ll realize that if it’s someone you know, won’t you have nowhere to cry?” Secretary Lily said with a smile.
The Super Empress was silent as she stared at Shi Yu. Shi Yu also stared at her.
Would it?
To be able to transmigrate from the last era to this era, they were definitely talented people from the last era. Shi Yu had done it, and the Super Empress had done it. The two of them might indeed have interacted in the last era.
Of course, it might not necessarily be a friend, but an enemy.
But no matter what, Lily’s words made the Super Empress listen. Perhaps this was also why the World King thought that Shi Yu could stop the Super Empress.
Before she could determine Shi Yu’s identity, it was indeed difficult for the empress to touch Shi Yu.
“Your Majesty, he’s helped me a lot recently. We’ve successfully brought you cosmic memory resources. Why don’t you give it a try?”
“I said that this kind of thing is useless,” the Super Empress said indifferently.
“There’s no harm in trying.” Lily directly left the battleship and walked in front of the Super Empress step by step, handing the Reincarnation Fruit to her.
The Super Empress glanced at the Reincarnation Fruit, and her gaze flickered. She didn’t refuse. She guided the fruit into her hand with her psychic power. In the next moment, the Reincarnation Fruit that landed in the Super Empress’s hand began to shrink, turning into a ball of green light spots that slowly flew into the Super Empress’s mouth.
In the next moment, the Super Empress closed her eyes slightly. On the battleship, Shi Yu and the others couldn’t help but swallow their saliva.
After two silent minutes, the Super Empress opened her eyes again and looked at Lily. “Are you satisfied?”
“Wu wu wu.” Secretary Lily looked like she was about to cry. “Isn’t that enough?”
“Give me another chance, alright?”
“I’ve already given you many chances.”
“This is the last time!” Lily looked at Shi Yu and said, “Perhaps we can place our hopes on him.”
Shi Yu was sudddenly mentioned. Although the Reincarnation Fruit in his heart had been wasted, he had no choice but to appear.
Shi Yu took a deep breath and appeared in the starry sky. He appeared not far from the Super Empress and looked at her. “Your Majesty, perhaps we can find other methods to not cause too much damage to this cosmic era. We can also return to the last era or find a way to find memories.”
“I’ve also lost my key memories and also want to find the truth, but this shouldn’t be using other innocent lives as sacrifices.”
“Yes.” Secretary Lily nodded.
“Then have you found any other way?” The Super Empress stared at Shi Yu.
“Of course,” Shi Yu said.
“Lady Lily told me that in an era, transmigrating into space and time and giving birth to parallel spaces will cause the lifespan of this cosmic era to decrease and accelerate the destruction of the universe. And if you want to transmigrate to other eras, it will cause this universe to directly be destroyed.”
“Transmigrating through space and time consumes the power of the universe. If Your Majesty wants to transmigrate across an era, the consumption is undoubtedly something this universe can’t afford.”
“Transmigrating through space and time consumes the power of the universe. If Her Majesty wants to transmigrate across an era, the consumption is undoubtedly something this universe can’t afford.”
“Why every cosmic era only has 10 billion years of lifespan is undoubtedly an unsolved mystery. Even the cosmic overlords are thinking of ways to explore and find a way to solve the lifespan problem of the universe. This way, not only can the universe be immortal, but they can also indirectly be immortal.”
“Therefore, I’m thinking that if we solve the lifespan problem of the universe and make the lifespan and power of the universe endless, can this universe support transmigration across eras?”
Since the universe couldn’t support the era’s transmigration, he would strengthen the universe and let it be able to support it!
“This is impossible,” the Super Empress said. “Is this all you’ve got?”
“Ah.” Shi Yu smiled bitterly.
“Why do you say it’s impossible?”
“Do you know what conditions are needed to make the lifespan of the universe endless?”
Shi Yu was immediately speechless.
“It’s related to humans… right?” Shi Yu said.
Lily looked at Shi Yu and said, “Are you willing to give it a try?”
“Actually, it’s very simple to make the universe immortal,” Secretary Lily said. “Yes, it’s very simple.”
“The old holder has already died, and a new holder has yet to arrive. The reason why every cosmic era is so short is because the universe lacks an ‘eternal’ energy source, a holder to assist its ‘growth’.”
“What do you mean?” Shi Yu said.
Secretary Lily said, “The meaning is very simple. You’re right. If the universe wants eternal life, it’s indeed related to humans.
“To describe it in a way you can understand, there has to be a Beast Tamer who treats the ‘universe’ as a pet and contracts it. Then, this Beast Tamer will become the energy of this universe and continuously provide nutrients for the growth of the universe. The universe can continue to exist forever.”
Shi Yu and Ling.
“A contract with the universe???” Shi Yu said.
“You’re very surprised, right?” Lily said. “This is a shocking archeological discovery between Her Majesty and me.”
“Ordinary people don’t know.”
“Above the cosmic level, there’s also a level called the cosmic maintainer. The cosmic maintainer is the true lord of the universe. If there’s no maintainer, the fate of the universe is what we see.’
“Humans should be the only race that can be maintained.”
“Contract the universe…” Shi Yu was shocked. He was already shocked enough to be able to contract a planet. The universe could also be contracted??
“I know, this is very difficult to understand, but this is our discovery. As for the difficulty of contracting the universe, although I can’t be sure, thinking about it, it should be several times, or even ten, or a hundred times more than contracting a cosmic life form.”
“Now, it’s difficult to even give birth to a cosmic-level Beast Tamer, let alone a Beast Tamer who can contract a ‘universe’.”
“It’s impossible for Her Majesty to listen to your illusory suggestions alone,” Lily said. “So, are you willing to give it a try? Try to work hard and become the guardian of the universe to support Her Majesty’s transmigration.”
“I…” Shi Yu was speechless again.
“On account that you’re not a life form of this space and time, I’ll allow you to return to the space and time that belongs to you,” the Super Empress said. “But you have to remember that there won’t be a next time.”
At this point, Shi Yu should have heaved a sigh of relief that the Super Empress was willing to let them go. However, looking at the expectant expression of Secretary Lily beside him, Shi Yu said, “The cosmic guardian? Your Majesty, can you give me some time?”
“Why?” the Super Empress said.
“You want to try contracting the universe?”
“I’m not in the mood to waste time with you. However, if you still insist on stopping me, I’m willing to accept your challenge.”
Shi Yu’s scalp went numb. The challenge she was talking about should be a life-and-death battle, right?
No, no.
“It’s decided,” Lily said. “Your Majesty, if Shi Yu can defeat you, give him a chance and see if he can become the holder of the universe. Wait for him for hundreds of millions of years. If he can’t defeat you, you’ll still follow the original plan. How about that?”
“Hey, hey, hey.” Shi Yu wanted to strangle this secretary to death. How could she casually agree to things in place of him?
Damn, could he defeat this Super Empress in a short period of time??
Even if he was given ten thousand lives, it wouldn’t be enough for her to kill.
Unless he, including all his pets, broke through to the super divine level. Perhaps there was still a trace of hope…
At this moment, the Super Empress was staring at Lily, and Lily was also staring at her. Their expressions seemed to be very persistent.
“Up to you.” The Super Empress turned and left. Accompanied by the light that filled the sky, she disappeared from the starry sky, leaving Shi Yu and Secretary Lily.
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at Secretary Lily with a worried expression.
“You can still stay in this space and time for a period of time,” Lily said. “Since you want to challenge Her Majesty, you can’t relax during the next period of time.”
“You were the one who challenged it for me.” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say, “That’s not what I meant at all.”
Lily smiled and said, “From the looks of it, this is the only way to change her mind. Believe me, believe in yourself. In the next period of time, I’ll give you special training.”
“The Reincarnation Fruit is useless. It was my mistake.”
“You’re giving me special training?” Shi Yu said.
“Yeah, I’ll give you special training. You shouldn’t be able to combine your previous life and current power very well now, alright? I’ve stayed beside Her
Majesty for a long time and happen to know her cultivation journey very well. Try to work hard. Perhaps there’s a chance.”
“Her Majesty isn’t a human, but a demon beast in human form. The upper limit of her strength won’t be higher than the upper limit of your strength as a human Beast Tamer. However, the special training I mentioned is also very dangerous. I wonder if you’re willing to accept it.”
“You also know the cultivation system of the previous era??” Shi Yu asked.
“Of course, Her Majesty once wanted to teach me and see if I could learn it. Unfortunately, my physique is still not very suitable, but for you, it shouldn’t be a problem,” Lily said.
“Even now, you still want to hide it from me?” Shi Yu said.
He stared at Lily intently and said, “If you don’t tell me the truth about challenging the Super Empress, I won’t accompany you.”
“Well…”
“Alright, alright.” Secretary Lily smiled helplessly and said, “You’re really an annoying person.”
“The Super Empress is you, and you’re also the Super Empress, but you’re not the same person, right?” Shi Yu said.
“That’s right. I’m indeed a part of the Super Empress. I’m a ‘weak side’ that she separated from. I’m a consciousness that lost the battle of thoughts.. Is this alright?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1770: Epoch Breakthrough (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1770: Epoch Breakthrough (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
After Lily finished speaking, Shi Yu wasn’t surprised at all.
Because only such an identity could explain the mystery and specialness of the lilies.
Hu…
Shi Yu took a deep breath and looked at Lily. “Alright.”
“Teacher Lily, teach me.”
“You accept it pretty quickly.”
Seeing that Shi Yu had even called him teacher, Lily was speechless.
“It’s alright, it’s alright.” Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment. He had a flexible position and the ability to cozy up to people at the speed of light. This was one of his few merits.
If it weren’t for the fact that he could settle everything without fighting, he could even call the empress ‘Mom’.
In any case, he was an orphan in both lifetimes and didn’t have any moral pressure. He couldn’t abandon his strength for his dignity, right?
“Alright, then I’ll tell you everything I know,” Lily said as she looked at the Morning Star.
“Now, there are a total of two ways to quickly increase your strength.” “One is for you and your pets to fuse with the source of transcendence.”
“This can be eliminated first. It’s not suitable for your current situation. Fusion of the source of transcendence is equivalent to being marked by the universe.
Although it’s not impossible, this isn’t the best time.”
“The second is that the power systems of the two eras on your body are completely unified.”
“As for what strength you can reach after the two powers on your body are completely unified, I can’t say for sure now.”
“It’s mainly because I’m not too sure how strong your potential is.”
“Then what should I do…” Shi Yu said, “I feel that my mastery of the power of the last era is already very good, but I still can’t perfectly fuse it.”
Lily said, “Can you summon all your pets?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded. Then, he summoned Eleven, Buggy, Little Zi, Qi, and all his contracted pets.
After they came out one by one, they stared at Lily extremely seriously.
He wondered how Lily’s strength was… How much weaker than the empress was she?
“As expected, there are many pets.” When Lily saw the pile of pets Shi Yu had contracted, especially when she saw Beast Shi Yu and Bu Lu, she stopped and watched more.
“You used this method to preserve your previous life’s body until now. You must have been a powerful guy in the last era,” Lily said as she looked at Beast Shi Yu.
“You guys aren’t bad either,” Shi Yu praised each other.
“Perhaps we were comrades in our previous lives who fought against the end of the era together,” Shi Yu said.
“If you want to make connections, you should make connections with the empress. The key is to make her believe it.” Lily smiled.
“Moreover, we’re not ‘resistance’.”
“Here.” At this moment, Lily looked at Shi Yu’s pile of pets and said, “You still can’t perfectly fuse with the body of your previous life. You should have some thoughts yourself, right? Tell me.”
“Pet,” Shi Yu said. “My body has signed a contract with a bunch of pets, but my previous life’s body doesn’t have any obvious connection to them.”
“My current body has already completely turned into the shape of a pet, and the shape of my previous life’s body hasn’t changed much, so the shapes of the two parties are inconsistent, causing them to be unable to perfectly match.” “Well…” Not only was Lily silent, but Eleven and the others also fell silent. What a bad metaphor.
It was clearly Shi Yu who changed their shapes, so why was he blaming them? “I understand what you mean. It’s similar to what I want to express.”
Lily said, “The reason why your previous life’s body still can’t match your current body is because of the pet.”
“The pets you contract will have a certain rejection when your body fuses with your previous life’s body.”
“The only one who won’t reject your previous life is probably that little monkey.”
Bu Lu: “Wu! (What’s the trump card treatment?)”
The little red monkey crossed its arms behind the pet group.
Eleven looked at it unkindly and suddenly turned around.
This little monkey had been restless recently!
Why did every teammate who joined the team later have baffling ambitions? Eleven didn’t understand.
Be good and stay still!
“Because it’s very special. Not only did it contract your previous body, but it also contracted your current reincarnation. If you only contracted one pet, then now, the two bodies can undoubtedly fuse perfectly.”
“Unfortunately, you have other pets.”
Shi Yu said, “Therefore, if I want to truly fuse perfectly with my previous life, I have to let this bear, that worm, and that ginseng complete the contract with my previous life like that monkey, right?”
Baby Ginseng and the others couldn’t help but sigh when they saw that Shi Yu couldn’t even be bothered to call them by their names.
“When all my pets not only contract with my current body, but also my previous body, they can complete the fusion.”
“Yes,” Lily said. “That’s right.”
“Is that so?” Shi Yu said. “Then what should I do? Let the other pets replicate the encounter of that little monkey?”
Lily said, “Your cosmic behemoth should have accidentally entered the ruins of the era and been infected with the aura of the last era, right?”
“This aura modified its physique into a physique close to a life form from the last era.”
“It’s precisely because of this that your previous life’s body can contract it normally.”
“If you want to do the same thing, let your other pets be infected by this aura and evolve their physiques a little..”

chapters.title: Chapter 1771: Epoch Breakthrough (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1771: Epoch Breakthrough (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Well, that power is the remnant of the last era. It’s called the Breath of the Epoch. Just like the source of transcendence, it’s a special substance in the ruins of the era.’
“If you want to find it, you can try your luck in the ruins of the era.”
“Ordinary lives won’t have much of an impact on them even if they encounter the aura of the era, because their life forms have already stabilized. Only new lives are easily affected and modified by the aura of the era.”
“However, you don’t have to worry. You can turn your pet into an unstable cub form through that Reincarnation Fruit and absorb the aura of the era.”
“Of course, although this can increase strength, there are also disadvantages. The stronger the traces of the last epoch, the easier it is to be rejected by the will of the universe of this epoch.”
“However, it’s not a big problem. With me around, I’ll help you solve it.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu felt a headache. If he had known earlier, he would have transmigrated a little later.
He originally had a plan to search for the ruin that Bu Lu’s parents had accidentally entered.
That era ruin definitely had the aura of an era.
His original idea was to let Eleven and the others become like Bu Lu. They could contract with Beast Shi Yu and enjoy two stats feedback.
However, from the looks of it, apart from the two stats feedback, the key to whether he and Beast Shi Yu could perfectly fuse seemed to be related to whether Beast Shi Yu could contract Eleven and the others.
It wasn’t too late…
In this space and time, the ruins of the era that Bu Lu’s parents had entered were also there.
They just had to find it.
“Do you have any thoughts?” Lily asked.
“I plan to find the Breath of the Epoch, but I might have to enter a dangerous ruin. Moreover, the location of the ruin might be a little far. In terms of time…”
“As long as you can find the ruins, I’ll escort you over and assist you in cracking the ruins,” Lily said calmly.
“It’s settled.”
“Little Zi.”
Shi Yu looked at Little Zi.
“Mimi!!” Little Zi immediately flew out and transformed. Like a charlatan, it circled around the cosmic behemoth.
“Here!” Shi Yu threw Little Zi a super divine level cosmic crystal as the energy for its premonition this time.
“Mi! (Welcome, Teacher Cat, to your descent!)” Little Zi said after eating the crystal.
At this moment, Little Zi kept circling and killing. Starlight filled the surroundings. Soon, endless starlight outlined two figures.
“Well, am I going to use my power again?”
“Hmph, take it, my strength.”
The power projection of Teacher Gem Cat and Teacher Prediction Owl was summoned by Little Zi.
They had both made a Star Contract with Little Zi, so even if they weren’t beside him, Shi Yu still had these two invincible supports.
Although Little Zi wasn’t even an epoch god, with the speciality of a planetary life form and the energy of the cosmic crystal, the skill level of the gem cat and owl projection summoned by it to the limit by consuming the power of the world wouldn’t be much worse than their true level.
“Astrology Race, Star Prayer Race?” Lily revealed a surprised expression. She didn’t expect that Shi Yu, a small planet pet, could actually summon the power projections of the two special races under the World King.
She seemed to understand what Shi Yu wanted to do.
Now, Shi Yu wanted to use the power of the gem cat and the owl to divine the location of the era ruin that Bu Lu had come into contact with.
Under the unbelievable divination, a portion of the image information appeared in Shi Yu’s mind. Little Zi also turned into a crystal ball, and many images appeared on its body.
“The Behemoth Empire,” Shi Yu said. “It’s said that the location of this ruin has changed. It’s currently at the border of the Behemoth Empire. Its luck is pretty good. According to its previous speed, it’s not far from us.”
“Teacher Lily.” Shi Yu looked at Lily, meaning…
“Sure, then I’ll accompany you again.”
“It’s not a problem to use that little guy, right?” She looked at Ling.
Ling:
“Stop, stop, I haven’t recovered yet,” Ling protested.
“I’ll help you recover,” Lily said.
“No…” Ling seemed to finally have a nemesis.
Soon, Shi Yu and the others set off again to search for ruins with the aura of an era.
In Morning Star, the Super Empress stood in the pavilion and stared at the starry sky with a slight frown.
“Could it be that she wants to…’
Following the guidance of the divination, Shi Yu and the others didn’t waste much time on the voyage.
Although Lily’s strength might not be inferior to the Super Empress, as an individual separated from the Super Empress, her strength was definitely not weak.
In fact, there might even be a peak super divine. In any case, Shi Yu couldn’t see through it.
At this moment, under the protection of the lily, Shi Yu and the others were very fast. Soon, they arrived at a remote starry sky.
This place looked no different from other starry sky areas, but Shi Yu knew that behind this starry sky was a small world fragment from the previous era.
It was also commonly known as the ruins of the era.
Shi Yu retracted his pets and stood side by side with Lily in the starry sky. Lily didn’t seem to plan to attack when it came to opening the ruins. Instead, she waited for Shi Yu to settle it himself..
It was indeed not difficult for Shi Yu to solve such a small matter. He immediately activated the Passage of Time ability. In the next moment, the entire starry sky began to hum and tremble. Countless spatial cracks seemed to want to cut this starry sky out of this place!
At the same time, countless black mist surged out of the spatial crack.
The power fluctuations of this black mist were very strange. Shi Yu felt that most divine-levels might not be able to resist them..

chapters.title: Chapter 1772: Epoch Breakthrough (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1772: Epoch Breakthrough (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“This is resentment,” Lily said. “After the death of an expert from the last era, the unwilling resentment combined with the power of space and time to form a ruins space.”
“If you’re entangled by these resentments, your consciousness will be affected, like a filthy upper body.”
With a gentle wave of her hand, all the black mist immediately turned into nothingness. At this moment, the surrounding world completely shattered like the mirror, forming a new world. Shi Yu and the others had already completely entered the ruins.
“Let’s just find the Breath of the Epoch next,” Shi Yu asked.
“Well, there’s no dangerous place in this ruin. The Breath of the Epoch is also very strong. Not bad.”
“There’s no danger, but it’s only for us,” Shi Yu said. At this moment, he closed his eyes slightly and explored everything in the ruins.
In the surroundings, the sky collapsed and the ground caved in. Countless experts wanted to resist, but they couldn’t escape the descent of the apocalypse.
Shi Yu could sense their strong hatred for the cosmic consciousness.
“These people can be collectively called ‘resistance’.”
“As for us, we can be collectively called ‘evaders’.”
Lily said, “The reincarnation of the universe is actually the independent choice of the universe. It’s equivalent to some creatures whose lifespans are almost at the end choosing to reincarnate and start over from the cubs.”
“The universe doesn’t want to welcome true death, so it can only sacrifice everything it has to reincarnate and restart.”
“According to our archeological discoveries, 10 billion years is far from the true lifespan of the universe. However, after this time, the state of the universe will begin to fall, approaching true death and end. In order to avoid this situation, the universe has no choice but to restart at this time.”
“And these resisters are people who are dissatisfied with the choice of the cosmic consciousness. They think that the universe clearly still has a very long lifespan, so why did they choose to destroy themselves at this time and restart? Those experts who were unwilling to die with the universe chose to resist the cosmic will.”
“But the outcome is obvious. Apart from cosmic life forms that can affect the cosmic will to a certain extent, other life forms find it difficult to resist the cosmic will. Even if it’s a cosmic life form, the final outcome of resistance is the same.”
“And the reason why people like us are called escapees is also a title bestowed by those who resist.”
“We didn’t dare to be enemies with the ‘cosmic will’ and chose to find the loophole of the universe’s reboot, hoping to survive until the next era. There are actually many people who choose like this, countless. However, there’s only one in a hundred million transmigrators who can really cross the era and come to the next era. Most of them died during the reboot of the universe.”
“Therefore, I have to say that you and I are both lucky. We’re the only life forms who successfully came to this era among this group of ‘evasives’,” Lily said. “Now, you know why I refuted you previously and said that we weren’t comrades who resisted the apocalypse, right?”
“What, I’m actually an escapee,” Shi Yu said. “I thought I would be a super expert whose life was up to me and not the heavens to fight the cosmic will to the death.”
Lily was silent.
Did he believe it himself?
So he must be livening up the atmosphere.
Ling and the other pets were also silent. With their understanding of Shi Yu, this had nothing to do with Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s style was to think of a way to slip away when he encountered danger that he couldn’t disobey.
Living was more important than anything.
“I’m just kidding,” as expected, Shi Yu said with a smile the next moment.
“Alright.” As soon as Lily finished speaking, countless light gray epoch auras around her had already been condensed by her power. She said, “The rest is up to you.”
“I understand.”
“Bu Lu, is it alright for you to guide Eleven and the others?” Shi Yu said to the red monkey.
“Alright,” Bu Lu said.
“Yiya.” Then, Baby Ginseng began to stretch out its finger and point at Eleven and the others.
At its skill level, its strength form was no longer restricted to the Fruit. As long as the opponent wasn’t strong or didn’t resist, it could use the power of reincarnation on it from afar.
At this moment, under Baby Ginseng’s guidance, Eleven immediately shrank into a transcendent-level little panda that wasn’t even knee-high. It cried on the meteorite.
Chi Tong had become a little loli, and Little Ji had become a little dinosaur that looked like a chicken. Of course, Duckie couldn’t escape the fate of becoming a little duckbill beast.
Soon, Shi Yu’s pets returned to their baby forms. If not for the protection of Shi Yu’s power, it would have been a problem to stay in the starry sky.
“All the best.” As Lily cheered, Shi Yu and the others began to efficiently use the Breath of the Epoch to modify their physiques.
First was Eleven, then Buggy, then Baby Ginseng…
Just like that, a month passed. Only then did all Shi Yu’s pets complete the modification and evolution of the epoch physique.
Although it was said to be evolution, after they completed it, they basically didn’t feel any qualitative changes in their bodies. However, the current Shi Yu indeed felt that Beast Shi Yu seemed to be able to contract them too.
“Alright, continue,” Shi Yu said.
“After the contract, you should be able to improve again.” Lily watched from the side for a month and gave guidance from time to time. At this moment, seeing that Shi Yu had already completed a round of cultivation, she said, “Remember to be careful of the lightning tribulation.”
“Well, your next breakthrough progress might be a little fierce.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1773: Epoch Breakthrough (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1773: Epoch Breakthrough (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Yes.” Shi Yu felt a sense of urgency. He began to let Eleven and the others line up like ragdolls to complete the contract with Beast Shi Yu.
“Wuu!!” After Eleven clocked in, it felt that its physical fitness had become stronger. It seemed to have received feedback from Beast Shi Yu, and Beast Shi Yu himself had also improved a little, but not as much as Eleven.
After Beast Shi Yu and Eleven became stronger, Shi Yu’s main body naturally received feedback. As the saying went, “Three wins”.
Right on the heels of that, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling…
Little Ji, Duckie, Little Zi, Qi, Shorty, Little Quas, Turtle…
Shi Yu’s pets contracted with Beast Shi Yu one after another. Beast Shi Yu and them also received feedback from each other. As Shi Yu also drank the soup, after a round of contracts was completed, Shi Yu immediately sensed the changes in his body.
He had just broken through to the 14th heavenly layer not long ago, and at this moment, he had yet to fuse with Beast Shi Yu. However, Beast Shi Yu had contracted the pets he had contracted one after another. With the contract connection with Beast Shi Yu, he made his bottleneck loosen again.
The phantom of the 15th heavenly layer vaguely appeared.
“This is the first time I’ve seen someone like you.”
At the side, Lily was amazed when she saw that Shi Yu was about to break through to the 15th heavenly layer of the divine level.
And this seemed to be only the beginning.
After Beast Shi Yu and Shi Yu’s pets contracted, its compatibility with Shi Yu finally reached 100%. The two parties were perfectly compatible, enough to fuse perfectly.
This time, Shi Yu fused with Beast Shi Yu through the fusion method. There was no longer the subtle feeling that was difficult to control previously. However, what was even more terrifying was that the increase brought by the fusion with Beast Shi Yu was simply unimaginable, shocking Shi Yu.
Boom!!!
The lightning illuminated the entire starry sky. It was unbelievably powerful. The power of the lightning was enough to move even high-level super divines. It seemed to have condensed into a Lightning Fist and was ready to smash at Shi Yu.
The crackling lightning arcs only landed on the stars and instantly destroyed them.
To be able to trigger such a terrifying lightning tribulation was also related to the changes in Shi Yu’s body.
During the fusion process with Beast Shi Yu, Shi Yu’s physique instantly reached the level of initial transcendent high-level and underwent a qualitative change. Beast Shi Yu’s physical strength perfectly fused into Shi Yu’s body.
Apart from that, the special power of source power had also completely become a power controlled by Shi Yu. There was no need for Shi Yu to mobilize it a second time.
The increase in physical strength made the strength of the soul and mind have a greater space to expand. Although the increase wasn’t as terrifying as physical strength, it was gradually approaching and compatible with physical strength.
Boom.
It wasn’t as simple as the 15th heavenly layer of the divine level. After Shi Yu’s two bodies fused, the upper limit of his Beast Taming level was still increasing drastically.
16th heavenly layer!
17th heavenly layer!
18th heavenly layer!
Shi Yu’s pets were stunned by the increase.
“That’s the effect.” Only when Shi Yu’s realm broke through to the 18th heavenly layer of the divine level consecutively did he stop. Lily smiled. This was the only way to have hope of defeating the Super Empress.
“I’m about to transcend the tribulation,” Shi Yu shouted. “The lightning tribulation this time does seem to be very powerful…”
“Wuu!!!” Eleven and the others were also prepared to assist Shi Yu at all times.
The lightning tribulation this time was accumulated from breaking through four levels in a row in the 15th, 16th, 17th, and 18th heavenly layers. The constantly expanding Thunder Fist that looked like it was enough to destroy the Sea of Stars smashed down like a cosmic hammer, very oppressive.
Just the aftermath of waving it caused a Starry Sky Storm in the entire Star Domain.
“According to what I know, from ancient times until now, the highest achievement of a Beast Tamer at the divine level is the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level. It’s definitely impossible for a Beast Tamer to advance to the cosmic level, let alone become the eternal holder of the universe.”
“But you’re different. You carry the power system of the last era on you. The combination of the power of the two eras might be able to create a miracle that hasn’t happened since ancient times.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1774: Shocking That the Sixth Cosmic Life Form Was Actually… (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1774: Shocking That the Sixth Cosmic Life Form Was Actually… (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Next, it depends on whether you can withstand this lightning tribulation.”
Upon hearing Lily’s words, Shi Yu remained silent. At this moment, he had added all his strength and the enhancement of the 11th heavenly layer of the divine level to Eleven.
“Taiji Domain, activate!”
“Roar!!!”
Eleven, who had the Chaos Thunder Body, was Shi Yu’s sure-kill skill to resist the lightning tribulation. At this moment, Shi Yu’s Taiji Domain, enhanced by source power, enveloped Eleven’s body, making its body instantly look like a chaos container that could devour everything.
Black and white lightning bloomed on its body. Under the enhancement of the Beast Tamer, Eleven’s strength level also rose steadily to the high-level super divine level. Its body leaped up and smashed towards the huge Thunder Fist that descended from the starry sky like a black and white meteor, shattering the starry sky.
Boom!!!
As the purple-gold Tribulation Lightning Fist landed, Eleven’s black and white Thunder Fist also smashed over. After the two parties collided, this Heavenly Tribulation Thunder Fist directly shattered. Just as Eleven was happy, the Tribulation Lightning exploded in the next moment. Eleven couldn’t completely absorb it, and its body seemed to have exploded from the lightning, tearing apart in many places.
“Wuu!” Although the Heavenly Tribulation Wex Fist had been broken, the power of the lightning tribulation this time was beyond imagination. Even Eleven, who had high-level super divine battle power and the corresponding resistance methods, couldn’t perfectly deal with it.
After Eleven cried out in pain, the explosive lightning tribulation devoured it again and penetrated it in the erupting thunder pillar. It directly shot it down from the starry sky at Shi Yu and the others. A smoking panda slowly landed.
“Eleven!!” Shi Yu was shocked and immediately teleported away.
“It can’t resist it alone. Don’t be greedy,” Lily reminded. She told Shi Yu and Eleven not to be greedy and absorb the lightning tribulation. This time, the lightning tribulation that had accumulated after breaking through four realms was very terrifying. This was the first time since ancient times. Moreover, Shi Yu and the others were rejected by the universe. Even if they had peak super divine battle power, they might not necessarily be able to withstand this lightning tribulation. And now, Shi Yu and the others had yet to become super divine. If they wanted to resist it, they had to deal with it seriously and with all their might.
Buzz.
As Eleven landed, Shi Yu went forward and directly entered a fusion state with Eleven, who had fallen. He used his strength to repair Eleven’s injuries. Shi Yu also changed from a normal human to a panda person.
Boom!!!
In the next moment, the Tribulation Lightning Fist descended from the sky again and smashed towards Shi Yu. This time, although Shi Yu’s state was a little stronger than before, it was also a little stronger. After he tried his best to welcome it, although he dispersed the Tribulation Lightning again, he was also blasted down by the exploded Tribulation Lightning like Eleven just now.
Shi Yu and Eleven were immediately slashed out of the fusion state. Eleven was still alright, but Shi Yu’s entire body had already exploded and was badly mangled. Fortunately, his physique was strengthened high, allowing him to arrive relatively easily.
“This is a good opportunity to train.” Lily sensed the surrounding environment and said, “This lightning tribulation will last for a long time. You have to grasp it.”
“If you can’t even withstand this lightning tribulation, forget about challenging the Super Empress.”
“Will it be a long time…” Shi Yu’s stomach hurt. What the hell?
The lightning tribulation this time hurt.
In just two shots, he and Eleven were already almost heavily injured. The cosmic will didn’t allow the existence of Beast Tamers at the eightenth level of the divine level, right?
“Apart from Qi, everyone, prepare for battle,” Shi Yu shouted as he fell.
In the next moment, Ling, who had long been prepared and used itself as a container, directly began to change. It shapeshifted into a super mecha that was very huge even if it stood in the starry sky.
The green and white mecha was no different from the fusion mecha controlled by Shi Yu and the others previously. However, the difference this time was that there was no need for every pet to fuse into the mecha.
With Ling’s current mechanical attainments and Shi Yu’s contract connection, it was already more proficient in connecting the strength of everyone.
A very huge light wheel appeared behind the cosmic mecha and hung behind it. Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Little Ji, Duckie… Every pet of Shi Yu was in the light wheel. They were distributed evenly, like the equipartitions in the light wheel. Through the light wheel, power was continuously transmitted into the mecha.
As for Shi Yu and Eleven’s main bodies, they teleported to the chest of the mecha and entered the cockpit in a fusion state. After they entered the cockpit, the main stats of the entire mecha also became mechanic and thunder-element.
Electricity lingered around the light wheel and the entire mecha body.
The Super Demon God of the Light Wheel was the name Shi Yu gave this mecha.
It was a Demon God Mecha that could casually change its strength attributes according to the power of Shi Yu and the fusion pet in the cockpit.
After integrating into the mecha, Shi Yu controlled the mecha to swing its fist. Its power shocked the starry sky and collided with the lightning tribulation again. This time, it was much easier than before. The terrifying lightning tribulation shattered with a bang. The power of the lightning tribulation’s explosion was also endured by all Shi Yu’s pets. It was no longer that terrifying.
Unfortunately, Eleven couldn’t eat the lightning tribulation this time. However, at such a critical moment, Shi Yu indeed didn’t dare to be greedy. It was fine to eat one less meal.
“Machinery fusion?” Lily nodded silently at the side. It looked like it should be able to last for a long time.
“All the best, all the best!!” Qi was also secretly anxious at the side. Its power was used to support its transmigration, so Shi Yu didn’t let it join in the resistance of the lightning tribulation. However, seeing that everyone was resisting the lightning tribulation together, it was very difficult for Qi to be indifferent.
After shapeshifting into a Super Demon God, it was indeed easier for Shi Yu and the others to resist.

chapters.title: Chapter 1775: Shocking That the Sixth Cosmic Life Form Was Actually… (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1775: Shocking That the Sixth Cosmic Life Form Was Actually… (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
The next ten days and ten nights of lightning tribulation were endured by Shi Yu and the others. However, the frequency of the lightning tribulation was indeed too terrifying. Shi Yu and Eleven were alright, but the pets fused into the mecha in the light wheel began to be in different states. Some of them fell severely.
Those epoch gods could still persist. After all, they had also obtained the protection enhancement of the mecha. However, Little Ji, Duckie, Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty had yet to reach the epoch god level. Even if they fused with the mecha and endured the protection of the mecha, the backlash of the lightning tribulation still injured them severely.
Boom!!!
Soon, the magnificent lightning pierced through the protective screen and directly turned the body of the Fusion Black Tortoise into ashes. Shi Yu instantly felt the tearing of the contract. The turtle and Little Quas were dying.
After they fused, their defense should be the strongest in the second team. However, in order to protect Shi Yu in the mecha center, the Black Tortoise consumed more strength and became the first pet to be killed by the lightning.
“Little Turtle, Little Quas!!” Qi, who was watching, was extremely worried. Fortunately, the turtle and Little Quas, who had the Holy Black Tortoise Body, wouldn’t die so bluntly as long as they still had the power of faith. After a body died, they quickly relied on the power of faith to condense a new four-headed Black Tortoise on the light wheel.
“Hu…” However, the condition of the turtle and Little Quas was really poor.
“Heh.” The turtle told everyone not to worry about it and continued to use the Dark North Shield with all its might to strengthen the defense of the mecha.
“Meow!!!” Seeing the turtle and Little Quas die for Shi Yu once, Shorty felt uncomfortable and worked even harder.
Buggy, Chi Tong, Turtle Quas, and Shorty were undoubtedly the ones with the most capital to mess around. This was because they had the power of faith and could still revive after death.
As long as the faith wasn’t destroyed, it could still persist.
Therefore, the four of them took the initiative to bear the greatest pressure. After another period of time, Buggy, Chi Tong, Turtle/Little Quas, and Shorty had already died and revived several times.
For example, it was all thanks to their protection that Little Ji and Duckie could withstand it.
Of course, Baby Ginseng was also the one with the ability to revive. However, Baby Ginseng in the light wheel didn’t dare to show off at all. Its Time Mark also bore an even more important effect, which was to protect Shi Yu.
The transcendent Time Mark could finally imprint other people’s marks. At this moment, only one of Baby Ginseng’s three Time Marks was branded himself. The other two were branded Shi Yu.
At this moment, the experts in the starry sky could sense a terrifying change brewing somewhere. However, when they wanted to investigate, without exception, they all failed.
“A human Beast Tamer is transcending the tribulation, but we can’t find any traces at all.”
On World King Planet, the super divine ancestor of the Astrologer Race held the family’s treasure in confusion and divined, but he could only divine a fog.
Now, it was already very difficult to divine Shi Yu’s strength alone. As for Lily, she didn’t stay idle at the moment. She covered Shi Yu’s heavenly secrets and hid this cosmic starry sky to prevent others from disturbing Shi Yu’s tribulation.
It had to be said that the heavenly tribulation was a very good sparring partner. Although Shi Yu and the others had suffered heavy injuries, their deaths and failures one after another forced them to defeat the lightning tribulation. The opportunity for all the pets to be determined to connect together was especially precious.
Under this tempering, Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty broke through the original shackles and completed the breakthrough under the most terrifying lightning tribulation in this world. They broke through from a perfect divine to the era divine level.
As for Little Ji, Duckie, and Little Zi, who had been protected by Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty with their deaths many times, as seniors, they had long broken through and completed the sublimation of their will before them. They didn’t want to drag the team down and step into the epoch god together.
The increase in the second team was undoubtedly quite helpful for Shi Yu and the others to resist the lightning tribulation.
At this moment, seeing that apart from Qi, all of Shi Yu’s team had reached the epoch god under the pressure of the lightning tribulation, Lily finally spoke to Qi beside her evilly.
“From the looks of it, if they continue, the injuries might be uncontrollable.”
“The lightning tribulation will still continue for a period of time. I have a way to help them dodge the lightning tribulation, but you can only attack as the target they contract. Otherwise, it’s very likely to cause the stress reaction of the lightning tribulation. Do you want to learn?”
Qi: “?”
“Why are you only saying such an important thing now!” Qi said angrily.
“How can helping them dodge the lightning tribulation too early have any training effect? The so-called cosmic will is only a manifestation of the power of space and time. As long as you hide all aura through the power of space and time, you can avoid the rejection of the cosmic will.”
“As a Time Sprite, your sensitivity to space and time is naturally comparable to a cosmic level. Helping them hide their aura can only be you.”
“Hurry up, hurry up, I want to learn.” Shi Yu and the others’ current situation made Qi anxious.
