If not for Shi Yu’s orders, Qi would have long rushed up to help.
“Alright.” Then, Lily transmitted the corresponding spatial skill to Qi through memory sharing.
Then, Lily saw a scene that made her rather silent.
Qi’s face turned green and purple as she took out a pile of smelly fruits from her spatial equipment and forcefully stuffed them into her mouth, eating with her eyes closed like she was sleepwalking…

chapters.title: Chapter 1776: Shocking That the Sixth Cosmic Life Form Was Actually… (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1776: Shocking That the Sixth Cosmic Life Form Was Actually… (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“It’s too slow to learn it myself. It’s better to learn it offline…” Qi muttered in her dream.
The Cultivation Fruit was undoubtedly a fruit that could activate the pet’s learning potential 100% or even 200%. In order to hurry, Qi endured the stench and ate more than ten Cultivation Fruits to maximize their effect.
“You guys always have some strange things,” Lily said.
It was fine if it was the Reincarnation Fruit, but how did he nurture it?
A long time later.
Shi Yu and the others might have already endured the lightning tribulation for a month, but they were still far from the time limit mentioned by Lily. Shi Yu could confirm that the lightning tribulation of the 18th heavenly layer wasn’t something a normal person could resist at all.
It was simply killing him.
His brain was buzzing and his entire body was numb, including every pet. At this moment, they were all relying on their willpower, super divine willpower, to instinctively resist the lightning tribulation.
Even the Super Demon God’s main body of the light wheel was broken at this moment, and its performance had decreased greatly.
“When will this end…”
“Son of a b*tch, cosmic will, right? I wasn’t very interested in contracting you at first, but now, I’ve made up my mind. I have to contract you no matter what.”
“Regardless of whether you really have consciousness, I have to nurture your consciousness and punch you every day.”
“F*ck.”
As Shi Yu swore in his heart, suddenly, with a hum, the lightning tribulation stopped in the starry sky. It didn’t look like it was about to disappear. Instead, it seemed to have lost its target at once and began to spin around in the starry sky like a headless fly.
After being stunned, Shi Yu and the others looked at Lily and Qi.
He saw Qi raising the umbrella and looking at the lightning with a determined expression. The Space-time Umbrella seemed to have blocked the heavenly secrets and immediately covered the traces of Shi Yu and the others’ existence. In this way, it helped Shi Yu and the others withstand the next lightning tribulation.
“It’s Qi…”
After realizing what was going on, Shi Yu and every pet heaved a sigh of relief. They felt relieved that it was finally over…
At this moment, apart from Qi, Shi Yu and the others almost instantly fainted. The last string they tensed up broke and they floated in the starry sky. With the starry sky as their bed, they fell asleep.
The tribulation lightning dissipated, and Qi looked at her teammates who had fallen asleep while panting. She also felt tired.
But soon, she let out another pig-like cry. The cry was very loud.
“Wu wu wu wu wu wu.”
“What’s wrong with you again?” Lily looked at her in confusion and said, “Shouldn’t you be very happy to have helped your teammates? Otherwise, it won’t be that easy for them to withstand this lightning tribulation. Perhaps three or four teammates will really die before Shi Yu can successfully resist.”
“Wu wu wu, it stinks. Apart from me, even Little Zi and Shorty have reached the epoch god level, but I’m not. I’ve become the last in the team again. When can I break through?”
Qi cried her heart out. After all, when everyone broke through to the divine level, she was the first to reach the top Divine Realm because she fused the power of her previous life. At that time, her other teammates were only intermediate gods.
But now, in the blink of an eye, all her teammates were epoch gods, and she was at the bottom again. In this situation, Qi felt that it was unscientific.
Buggy made too much sense. The first to evolve would definitely be the weakest at the end, and the first to break through would also be the weakest.
“You’re a Time Sprite. It’s better for you to be a vase in peace.” Secretary Lily crossed her arms and said, “Alright, it’s my turn next. Let me treat them.”
“The lightning tribulation this time is really terrifying. I’m afraid even a peak super divine will lose a layer of skin if they want to completely withstand it.”
“Well, I roughly understand your battle power now. It’s almost the strongest level below the peak of the super divine level.”
“So weak?” Qi said eagerly.
“I still feel that I can’t defeat the empress,” she said.
“Because the special training hasn’t ended,” Lily said with a smile.
Shi Yu didn’t know how long he had slept. He woke up in a daze. When he woke up, he felt a fragrance enter his nose.
Shi Yu suddenly opened his eyes and saw Lily looking down at him.
“Teacher Lily…”
“You’re awake.” Lily got up and took a few steps out. “How do you feel?”
“Wuuu!!” As soon as she finished speaking, Shi Yu also heard some familiar voices. Eleven and the others instantly ran over.
Eleven shook its arm in joy. It was a huge success this time! Apart from not eating much lightning tribulation, it was very perfect.
“Ji!!” Buggy also crawled over. Even the power of faith was about to be exhausted and gave it a headache.
The restoration of the power of faith was too slow… It wanted to evolve and evolve again! It wanted to obtain stronger exclusive power!
The pets woke up before Shi Yu Restoration. Shi Yu was the last to wake up.
“Chi Tong is the best,” Shi Yu said with a smile after his daughter, Chi Tong, helped him up.
“Hmph,” Chi Tong said. “That’s true.”
“Is everyone alright?” Shi Yu immediately asked after getting up.
“No, everyone’s condition is very good.” Cube Ling swept its gaze at Chi Tong, Susu, and the others and reported to Shi Yu.
“Where’s Qi?” Shi Yu said.
“After eating too many Cultivation Fruits, the medicinal effect was too strong. After waking up for a while, she fell asleep again. In theory, it’s very difficult for the Cultivation Fruit to eat the effect of sleeping pills, but Qi ate too much at once,” Ling said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1777: Shocking That the Sixth Cosmic Life Form Was Actually… (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1777: Shocking That the Sixth Cosmic Life Form Was Actually… (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“…It’s good that you’re all fine.” Shi Yu smiled as he looked at the pets that had reached the divine level of the era. Apart from that, his level…
18th heavenly layer!
It was a ridiculous level.
In terms of level alone, it was almost equivalent to a super divine Beast Tamer who had “transcended eight times”.
Coupled with the abilities of the pets, they were almost invincible below the peak of the super divine level. They might even be able to touch the weaker peak of the super divine level.
Shi Yu really didn’t expect that he would reach the strongest battle power below the cosmic level in such a short period of time.
Was this the strength after the fusion of past and present power?
It felt too good.
Unfortunately, if only there was a future body…
If he fused another source of transcendence, Shi Yu couldn’t believe how strong he would be.
“Teacher Lily, thank you.” Shi Yu was really grateful to this guy this time. If it weren’t for the fact that she had taught them the method to hide the will of the universe, they would definitely have been severely injured by the lightning tribulation.
Shi Yu would have to reach this step sooner or later. If they dealt with it themselves, it would be very dangerous. Fortunately, Lily was here this time. This time, Shi Yu was willing to call her teacher.
Well, Qi’s teacher.
“No need to thank me,” Lily said. “Next, it’s time for you to challenge Her Majesty.”
“Oh??” Shi Yu was stunned. “Wait, wait.”
“Something’s still wrong, right? With my current strength, challenging the empress is still courting death.”
Lily said, “Of course not alone. From the start, I didn’t plan to let you challenge it alone.”
“What do you mean?” Shi Yu asked.
“Didn’t you realize? When you were sleeping, I had already paid a small price. The modified contract method of the previous era signed a ‘temporary contract’ with you. I’ll assist you in this battle.” After Lily finished speaking, Shi Yu suddenly opened his mouth wide. The pets also opened their mouths wide.
Wh-what!!!
Shi Yu… contracted a portion of the sixth cosmic life form??
“Why didn’t you ask for my permission!”
“I don’t really want to ask for your opinion,” Lily said. “If you’re unhappy, I can remove it now.”
“No, no need. It’s pretty good.”
“However, why don’t I feel any powerful attribute feedback…”
“Do you want to die?” Lily was speechless. “I already said that it’s an improved contract method. Under normal circumstances, it’s impossible for us to contract.”
“I understand, I understand.”
Shi Yu hurriedly checked his situation. Then, as expected, he saw an unbelievable phantom representing Lily in her contract connection.
However, it wasn’t in human form.
Instead, it was a white and fat big white rabbit. It seemed to be the main body of Lily??
Shi Yu was extremely shocked.
It was really inhumane.
Of course, what shocked him the most was that he kept feeling that this big white rabbit had a familiar feeling…
This fat and beautiful feeling…
Shi Yu’s thoughts immediately returned to his previous life, the era on Earth.
At this moment, he was still a young and energetic non-mainstream mythical scholar and archeologist.
The reason why it was said to be non-mainstream was that his research direction was very different from the mainstream research direction in society.
After all, he only decided to become an archeologist after watching “The Adventures of the Dragon”. How could he become a proper archeologist?
Therefore, Shi Yu’s archeological activities were basically carried out alone.
One mission was carried out in a certain mountain area…
He passed by the thorny forest and was just about to sit down and rest for a while when he discovered a fat and white rabbit in the swaying grass.
From the looks of it, his leg was injured and he couldn’t run.
“Eh, heh.” Shi Yu didn’t even think about it. He directly pulled up her two big ears and raised them, revealing a happy expression.
“We’re pretty lucky. Lunch is here.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1778: Returning to the Origin Universe (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1778: Returning to the Origin Universe (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
He was pretty lucky. He had lunch…
Shi Yu didn’t know why he had recalled this memory.
Logically speaking, he should have long forgotten such an unimportant matter.
Shi Yu felt that he was too good at making connections…
What happened after that?
Shi Yu couldn’t remember clearly if he had eaten it or not when it came to the key point.
Because he had eaten too much wild food during the archeological process in the wild.
Shi Yu shook his head, not daring to let his imagination run wild.
Don’t tell him that the sixth cosmic life form was that rabbit.
Then the sixth cosmic life form would definitely kill him.
“Damn it, I can’t remember the key points.”
However, it was better not to talk nonsense about this.
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. His life was more important.
“You seem to be very unhappy with my main body?” Secretary Lily wrapped her arms around him and stared at Shi Yu.
“How could that be…” Shi Yu shook his head in embarrassment.
“You guys should still have a while, right?” Secretary Lily asked.
“There’s more.”
“That’s good. Next, let’s slowly return.”
“During this period, come and familiarize yourself with your current state.”
A few months of special training allowed Shi Yu to enter the most perfect state in history.
The fusion of the two bodies completely made Shi Yu become one of the experts.
At this moment, the greatest change was that apart from Bu Lu, other pets could also become weapons.
Especially Chi Tong. Shi Yu felt that Chi Tong was more convenient to use.
Chi Tong’s main body was a sword spirit. When it became a weapon again, Shi Yu’s handyness wasn’t something a stick like Bu Lu could compare to.
After all, he was already a sword master back on Blue Planet!
“Wu!!!” On the battleship, Bu Lu quickly realized that it had lost favor.
Of course, the weapon transformation alone couldn’t allow Shi Yu to obtain the power to defeat the Super Empress.
Secretary Lily leaned against the wall of the training room and looked at Shi Yu and the others. “After familiarizing yourself, you can try to integrate their power.”
“The huge mecha you turned into when you resisted the lightning tribulation was a pretty good method.”
“After all, such a big guy can also be seen as a weapon.”
“You can combine the existing methods and upgrade it.”
“I understand.”
“What about you? How do you plan to help me when the time comes?” Shi Yu asked.
This big white rabbit had signed a contract with him while he was sleeping, but up until now, he knew nothing about her abilities.
The other party didn’t seem to have any intention of fighting side by side.
“There’s not much I can do. It’s just that when the time comes, I’ll strengthen your strength and affect the power of the empress. That’s all, so it’s the same with or without my existence. You guys just have to undergo special training yourselves.”
“As the burden is too great, this cooperation can’t be used as training content. I can only perform it at the last minute.”
Upon hearing Secretary Lily’s words, Shi Yu didn’t ask further.
A few days later.
Morning Star.
At this moment, Qi had already woken up. Seeing that she was about to return to Morning Star to challenge the Super Empress, she was more nervous than anyone.
“Don’t worry.”
“Even if I lose, I’ll try my best to protect you from the empress.”
Secretary Lily stood on the battleship and said to Shi Yu and the others behind her.
“Change of the empress’s thoughts is something I need to do in the first place. Meeting you only gives me more hope. At least, I’m not fighting alone.”
“Hu… Even if Teacher Lily says so, I’m still a little nervous,” Qi said.
“It’s alright.” Lily smiled.
“Qi, you should watch the battle this time.” Shi Yu, Eleven, and the others had already begun to give it a try.
It was mainly because they were looking forward to their current strength.
He really wanted to use the tall mountain of the future sixth cosmic life form to test his current strength results.
“That’s not what I meant!” Qi had a headache. She wanted to join the battle!
“Are we fighting here? Will it affect the surrounding planets?”
“There should be quite a lot of life planets here, right?” Shi Yu said.
“Well… I just have to create a new space. Leave this to me.”
“Alright, since you’re ready, I’ll wake that guy up,” Lily said after thinking about it.
With a wave of her hand, the space and time here seemed to have been isolated from the Hundred Flowers Star Domain.
A pure white space-time instantly formed around them. The white space-time was endless and incomparably vast. Looking at the changes around them, Qi and the others were very surprised.
What strong spatial attainments.
Even if it was only a portion of the empress, Lily had probably already touched the threshold of the cosmic level. At least, in terms of spatial attainments, she had touched the threshold of the cosmic level.
At this moment, as the surrounding space and time changed, that person was indeed alarmed.
As the black space and time were torn apart, a figure in a loose black empress suit with long black hair casually draped behind him slowly descended.
The moment she descended, the surrounding space and time began to sway. The empress’s red eyes stared at Shi Yu and the others and said, “Is this the special training you gave them?”
“Don’t tell me you think that just this level is enough for them to defeat me?”
“How will you know if you don’t try?” Secretary Lily patted Shi Yu’s shoulder and said, “Then, I’ll leave everything to you.”
“I understand…”
Shi Yu sighed and looked at the Super Empress. “Your Majesty, please enlighten me.”
The Super Empress was expressionless as she watched Shi Yu’s body float up. She watched as the pets behind him floated up and kept changing, still indifferent, as if she planned to give Shi Yu and the others a chance to attack first.

chapters.title: Chapter 1779: Returning to the Origin Universe (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1779: Returning to the Origin Universe (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Soon, a huge mecha descended in this space.
Apart from Shi Yu himself who had entered the mecha book, 13 light balls of different colors floated on the light wheel behind the mecha.
They represented Shi Yu’s pets.
The current mecha was even more perfect than before. It had a total of 13 sure-kill skills that represented the strongest profundities of various pets. Apart from that, there were also some profundities with pretty good compatibility that could be combined a second time.
It could be said that he had used the Beast Taming Talent such as Fusion and Weaponization to the extreme.
Boom!
After arming it, a huge sword with four colors appeared in the huge mecha’s hand. It was completely condensed from the power of faith of the four saints and was called the Four Saints Sword.
Swoosh!
Shi Yu waved the Four Saints Sword. The phantoms of the Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise roared in the sword light and swept across, slashing at the Super Empress.
The feeling of tearing through the air penetrated and instantly arrived in front of the Super Empress. However, in the face of this attack, she only slowly raised her hand. The terrifying black psychic wave was instantly like a huge hand, blocking in front of the Four Saints Sword.
No matter how hard Shi Yu tried, he couldn’t slash down the Four Saints Sword.
“Damn.” In the mecha, Shi Yu couldn’t help but feel stifled. No way.
Bang!!
In the next moment, as the Super Empress squeezed her palm, the Four Saints Sword exploded with a bang. Cracks suddenly appeared in the four light balls representing Buggy and the others.
“With this power, forget about me, I’m afraid you can’t even defeat the guy beside you.”
“Is this your full strength? It seems a little wishful thinking to only have such strength to become the holder of the universe.”
“Contracting the universe is even more difficult than resisting the restart of the cosmic consciousness in the apocalypse. I feel that you didn’t realize the difficulty of the problem from the start.”
The Super Empress seemed to be very disappointed in Shi Yu’s strength.
“Regardless of whether I can contract the universe or not, I have to think of a way to stop you.”
“Just because I’m very weak now doesn’t mean that I’m also very weak in the future. From the strength of a mortal to now, we only used less than ten years.”
Shi Yu’s Four Saints Sword shattered. Two black and white Yin Yang Fish appeared in his hand again, turning into two illuminates that penetrated.
The light was vast, but still, the Super Empress didn’t even move before the skills were crushed by its psychic power.
“The reason why I let you leave and allowed you to mess around is because you do give me a familiar feeling.”
“Just as she said, it’s indeed possible for us to know each other in the last era. This is the reason why I tacitly agreed to your nonsense.”
“But now, you should have realized the difference, right?”
“I can give you a chance now. If you’re also very interested in returning to the last era, we can cooperate, as long as you don’t have other unrealistic fantasies.”
In the eyes of the Super Empress, the difficulty of directly returning to the previous era was far smaller than becoming the holder of the universe.
Now, she didn’t even have concrete confidence in returning to the last era. She really didn’t have any intention of placing her hopes on any cosmic holder.
“Although I do want to go back and figure out some things, this premise shouldn’t be the destruction of this cosmic era.”
Shi Yu kept attacking and changing his attacks, but he was still easily resolved by the Super Empress every time.
“Is it because of your boring saintly heart?” The Super Empress was very disappointed.
“That’s not it. What happens to people I don’t know has nothing to do with me. It’s just that if this era is destroyed, I might have a headache. This is because apart from unrelated people, I still have many friends here.” Shi Yu thought of the gem cat and the others.
“I can’t satisfy my curiosity with the premise of hurting them, so it seems that becoming the holder of the universe is the best solution. This way, it’s fine no matter how I mess around.”
“Your Majesty, you’ve been in this era for so long. Don’t you have any nostalgia for this era?”
Boom!!!
Shi Yu was immediately flipped over by psychic power. The mecha was in pieces, but it barely withstood the attack. However, in the mecha, Shi Yu was still forced to vomit blood.
“F*ck, big white rabbit, didn’t you say you wanted to strengthen me? Why don’t I feel that I’ve been strengthened at all after attacking so many times?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but shout.
“Huh??” Lily, who was meditating at the side, frowned. How bold.
What was a big white rabbit?
She sighed heavily and said, “I’m just looking for my state. How can it be that easy?”
“The empress indeed made some friends at the start, but these friends didn’t live as long as her. As time passed, she was the only one left.”
“In addition, the obsession left behind by the previous era tortured her day and night, making her suffer endlessly. In the end, she made such a decision.”
“All the nostalgia for this era is on me, but unfortunately, I can’t defeat her. Of course, she can’t destroy me either. In short, you can’t convince her with just this.”
“Then what should we do? I can’t defeat her either.”
The little thoughts that Shi Yu had swelled up at the start disappeared immediately.
At this moment, Eleven and the others also had a long face. They felt that even if they used their full strength, they couldn’t cause any damage to the Super Empress.
It was like a scratch.
This guy’s strength was much stronger than he imagined.
Perhaps now, the other party had the power to challenge a cosmic level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1780: Returning to the Origin Universe (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1780: Returning to the Origin Universe (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Otherwise, why would they dare to start capturing the Time Sprite and killing the people of the cosmic overlord army?
“Alright.” At this moment, as Lily opened her eyes, Shi Yu and the others finally sensed a powerful force slowly rising from their bodies.
It had been strengthened by Lily!
This strengthening method wasn’t the strengthening of traditional power, but seemed to be the strengthening of will and heart.
But no matter what, Shi Yu and the others immediately felt their strength increase steadily in an instant.
Apart from that, all the injuries on his body began to slowly recover.
Just as Shi Yu and the others were excited and prepared to fight the Super Empress again, the Super Empress sighed and looked at Lily. “As expected, you still chose this path.”
“This is the only way for me to defeat you.”
“It wasn’t easy to find a suitable and gullible guy. I naturally have to make good use of him.”
“If I can defeat you, you’ll listen to me this once. How about that?”
The conversation between the Super Empress and Lily confused Shi Yu and the others.
But soon, Shi Yu and the others’ expressions changed.
Because they suddenly felt that although they had been strengthened in an instant just now, in the next moment, their strength was suddenly absorbed.
In its place, the power on Lily’s body increased greatly.
Buzz!!
White psychic waves formed a substantial aura around her. Opposite her, the Super Empress’s body also began to emit a black aura. The collision of the auras of the two parties directly dyed the space and time here into a black and white world.
Under the two powers close to the cosmic level, Shi Yu and the others were like rookies who had been involved in a battle between experts. Just resisting the aura impact of both parties was already very difficult.
“Ahhh.” Qi had already been blown away and grabbed Shi Yu’s mecha’s light wheel to escape.
“Big white rabbit, what are you doing?” Shi Yu felt that his strength was being extracted by Lily and that he was becoming weak. He was furious.
“Sorry, I’ll borrow your power. As expected, it’s still too difficult to rely on you to fight her. Leave the rest to me.”
“I mean, why are the traces of your life burning when you extract my power??” Shi Yu questioned.
“Wait a minute.” Shi Yu was very puzzled by the contract signed by Lily.
Lily didn’t say anything. At this moment, segments appeared in Secretary Lily’s mind.
Senior Panda Lin Xiuzhu handed Iron-eating Beast Eleven to Shi Yu.
The frost dragon threw out the Ice Dragon Whiskers and snorted coldly as it taught a little worm how to shapeshift into a real Ice Dragon.
The archeological senior, Lu Qingyi, brought Shi Yu to the senior of Bureau 11 to take away the ginseng baby that was unwilling to be an ingredient…
There was also a gem cat that brought Shi Yu to the Undead Battlefield to farm monsters and help Chi Tong evolve continuously.
Every time Shi Yu contracted and cultivated a pet, he would establish a deeper connection with many people through this pet. This connection even made Shi Yu not care much about his previous life. Compared to Earth, Blue Planet was the place for him to stay more comfortably.
He wanted to go back only because of curiosity and exploration.
But it was definitely impossible to ignore everything now because of this curiosity.
Originally, the Super Empress also had such emotions, but because the obsession to return was too strong, these emotions separated and became Lily.
Lily knew that if she wanted the empress to change her mind, she had to at least have the strength to fight the other party.
In fact, her strength was far inferior to the empress. She might be helpless to change everything with her own strength.
As for Shi Yu, he appeared at the right time.
From the start, what Lily wanted to do was not to be a “supporting pet” to assist Shi Yu in defeating the empress.
Instead, as a “Beast Tamer”, Shi Yu strengthened her strength and let her defeat the empress.
In the beginning, Shi Yu didn’t have the ability to sign a contract with her even if it was a temporary contract. Only when Shi Yu completed the fusion and broke through to the eleventh heavenly layer of the divine level did Lily see a trace of hope.
However, even at this moment, because Shi Yu was too weak and Lily’s strength was too strong, she still had to pay a certain price to complete the contract.
And the price was that when borrowing the power of a Beast Tamer, the traces of one’s life would quickly be consumed.
Although she hadn’t interacted much with Shi Yu, with Lily’s understanding of Shi Yu, Shi Yu probably wouldn’t accept such a contract and wouldn’t accept such a battle method. Therefore, Lily took the initiative and didn’t discuss it with Shi Yu.
The Super Empress looked at Lily, who not only burned her life, but also borrowed the power of others. She didn’t understand why Lily had to do this.
Next, apart from Qi, Shi Yu and all his pets were drained of their strength by Lily and fainted.
As for Qi, she watched in panic as Lily and the empress started a protracted ideological battle.
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu, get up quickly.”
Qi shouted as she used Time Reversal to recover Shi Yu’s state.
In the distance, the powerful Super Empress and Lily had already returned to their main bodies.
A white rabbit and a black rabbit were wrapped in a Psychic Shield and kept colliding in the air.
From the situation, Qi could tell that Lily was better.
However, Qi could also sense that Lily’s life state was falling rapidly through the contract with Shi Yu…
If she lost, Lily would definitely die, and if she won, she didn’t know what would happen…

chapters.title: Chapter 1781: Returning to the Origin Universe (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1781: Returning to the Origin Universe (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Your mission has been completed.”
“Next, regardless of whether the future is good or bad, please be confident.”
Lily’s words appeared in Qi’s heart.
“What are you doing?” Qi asked.
In the battle, Lily was still distracted and talking to Qi. She said, “You’ve already stayed in this space and time long enough. In the next battle, I’m afraid it’s difficult to determine the winner without several years.”
“Next, I’ll send you back first.”
“It’s still too dangerous to stay here.”
“Hello.” Before Qi could react, she felt that her strength, the power of the Space-time Jade gifted by the World King she carried, was being activated.
Under the control of an unknown power, her power began to wrap around Shi Yu and the others.
“Hey, hey, hey.” Qi didn’t want to go back at all yet, but she couldn’t resist anything in the hands of the Lily. She was forced to activate the last power of space and time the whole time and began to return to the original space and time with the unconscious Shi Yu and the others.
In this space and time, Lily, who burned her life force and contracted power, was still fighting the Super Empress.
Origin Universe, Blue Planet, Space and Time Island.
Boom.
The spatial coordinates kept changing. Under the lightning and thunder, a pile of unconscious figures fell from the sky.
The violent rain and pitch-black dark clouds covered everything. After more than half a year, Shi Yu and the others returned to the original space and time. However, Shi Yu and the others were completely unaware of the completion level of the mission this time.
“Shi Yu…??”
Not long after Shi Yu and the others fainted on the Space and Time Island, the Blue Planet’s Will and the World Tree discovered the return of Shi Yu and the others. The World Tree clone instantly appeared on the Space and Time Island. It looked at the unconscious Shi Yu and the others and panicked.
As she had exhausted her strength, Qi had also fallen into a coma. At this moment, Shi Yu and the others could be said to be unconscious. In addition, their states were also terrifyingly weak, and their strength was almost dried up.
Seeing Shi Yu and the others’ state, the World Tree was immediately shocked. However, fortunately, Shi Yu and the others still had life auras, making the World Tree heave a sigh of relief.
Without saying a word, the World Tree began to bring Shi Yu and the others back to Inatella for treatment.
However, this was the first time Shi Yu had been squeezed so clean. Even if the Blue Planet’s Will appeared, it took a full three days and three nights before Shi Yu and every pet connected to Shi Yu’s consciousness gradually woke up.
“Wu…”
Although he had woken up, Shi Yu’s current state was still ridiculously poor. His brain exploded as he opened his eyes and saw a familiar huge tree and a familiar blue figure.
“Am I dreaming?”
Shi Yu covered his head and said, “This is… Blue Planet?”
“Wait, which space and time is it, Blue Planet?”
“You’re already back. Shi Yu, what exactly happened?” Blue Planet’s Will said slowly. At this moment, it could sense Shi Yu’s power. This was also why it had nursed Shi Yu for a long time.
Shi Yu’s current strength gave it the feeling that he was much stronger in comparison.
“What?” When Shi Yu heard Blue Planet’s words, he was immediately shocked and looked at every pet around him.
“But wasn’t I clearly still here just now…” Shi Yu saw that his pets had also woken up. He said, “Hey, hey, hey, wake up. Do you know what happened?”
“Wuu…”
“Yi…” But clearly, the brains of the pets were also like mush, not knowing anything.
“Wu…” Only Qi hugged her exploded brain and said, “Shi Yu, Shi Yu… Teacher Lily sent us back in advance. She started the battle with the empress.”
Yes… Lily…
Shi Yu quickly checked the contract between him and the big white rabbit, but with a look, he finally knew why his brain hurt a little.
Because the contract with Lily had already been completely torn and disappeared. There were no traces of the contract at all…
Although it was only a temporary contract and it was almost impossible to preserve the contracts of other spaces until now, there were no traces at all. It still gave Shi Yu a bad feeling.
Hu…
Shi Yu’s heart was heavy. He looked at Blue Planet’s Will and said, “It’s alright…”
“I can’t be sure about the quests either.”
“Since I’m back, there’s nothing I can do.”
“It’s good that you’re fine.” Blue Planet’s Will didn’t ask further. Seeing Shi Yu and the others return safely was enough.
At this moment, although Shi Yu said that he was fine, he wouldn’t feel fine at all if he didn’t figure it out. Therefore, after they were teleported back by Lily, what exactly happened and what was going on?
Did Lily win? Was she still alive??
If he wanted to figure all of this out, Shi Yu knew that he couldn’t think of a result no matter how hard he tried. Perhaps, he could only know what happened after asking the World King or coming into contact with the sixth cosmic life form again.
“By the way, Shi Yu,” Blue Planet’s Will said. “It’s about to condense after transcendent. Time is already very tight. Do you still want to fight? Your state… I feel that it’ll be a long time before you recover.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1782: Goodbye, World King (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1782: Goodbye, World King (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“The source of transcendence is about to condense?”
When the Blue Planet’s Will finished speaking, Shi Yu pretended to be in deep thought and said,
“Looking at the time, it’s indeed about time.”
“Fight, we naturally have to fight.”
This source of transcendence was too important to him.
Although they were already very strong, it wasn’t enough.
According to what Shi Yu understood now, there were three conditions to advance to the cosmic level.
1. Expert in the power of space and time.
On this point, it shouldn’t be a big problem for Shi Yu, who had cultivated the Time Strengthening Talent, the Spatial Strengthening Talent, and contracted the Time Sprite.
2. Perfect foundation.
This was at least reflected in the source of transcendence. It had to fuse with the natural condensation of the universe.
For example, Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, and the others didn’t have a perfect foundation to advance to super divine with the second-hand source of transcendence.
Therefore, if Shi Yu wanted to break through to the cosmic level, he couldn’t miss this source of transcendence.
The cat was unreliable. When she stood up and cultivated to the point where she could increase the quality of the source of transcendence, who knew how long it would take.
It was impossible for Shi Yu to wait 100,000 years for the next round of source of transcendence, so this time, it was especially important.
3. The racial talent ability developed to the extreme was still a little far.
Therefore, in order to meet all three conditions, Shi Yu couldn’t give up on this competition.
Moreover, if he fused with the source of transcendence, it would definitely be the battle power of the first level below the cosmic level.
This was also very tempting to Shi Yu.
Moreover, at this moment, Shi Yu kept feeling that the empress’s condensation of the source of transcendence didn’t seem to be completely to disturb the starry sky.
Her goal was only to return. The source of transcendence didn’t have any effective support for achieving this goal.
If he had to talk about it… the only thing related…
“Master, is it possible that the current empress has already changed her mind?”
“Perhaps we’re a part of history to begin with.”
“She condensed the source of transcendence in advance to let you quickly become the strongest super divine after returning and break through to the cosmic level as soon as possible.”
“Therefore, in order to become the holder of the eternal universe, lay a good foundation.”
Ling looked at Shi Yu and communicated with his gaze.
“This transmigration involves two cosmic-level experts proficient in the power of space and time. Perhaps we can’t treat it with our previous transmigration EXP anymore.”
“After all, this time, from the beginning to the end, we were led away by two cosmic levels.”
“Moreover, looking at Lord Blue Planet, it seems…”
Ling’s words were also what Shi Yu was thinking. Was it possible that Lily had successfully defeated the empress and their goal had been achieved?
Everything now was a continuation of the agreement between him and the empress…
An agreement that crossed hundreds of millions of years and became the holder of the eternal universe.
However, Shi Yu couldn’t confirm this even if he guessed randomly.
He looked at Blue Planet’s Will and said, “When we returned to the past this time, we even did some things on Blue Planet. Didn’t your memories change at all??” Shi Yu asked.
Even spatial entanglement appeared on Emperor Wu, the Empress, the Dragon Emperor, and the others.
It couldn’t be that nothing happened to the Blue Planet’s Will, right?
Could it be that it had been too long ago and couldn’t be pestered anymore?
“No,” Blue Planet’s Will said.
“This…” Shi Yu fell silent.
“Is there anything important?”
“That’s not true.”
“I’ll fight for the transcendent origin. Before that, I’ll go to the World King Planet first.”
“I have something to ask the World King.”
“Yes.” Blue Planet’s Will nodded and said, “Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, and the others are also on World King Planet. Transcendent Origins will also condense in the Cosmic Sea. After you go over there, you can seek their help.”
“This time, I’ll also head to the Cosmic Sea to help you fight for the transcendent origin.”
“No need, no need. I’ll do it myself,” Shi Yu said.
With his current strength, it shouldn’t be a problem to fight for the source of transcendence, right?
“I mean, I hope you can advance to super divine on Blue Planet. With your current strength, if you advance to super divine on the mother planet, I’ll also benefit endlessly,” Blue Planet’s Will said.
This was the same principle as when a pet broke through and the Beast Tamer received feedback.
“Uh, I see. Haha, no problem,” Shi Yu said with a laugh.
Since the Lord Mother Planet had spoken, there was naturally no problem.
“It’s just that at that time, the pressure Blue Planet will face might be a little high,” Shi Yu said.
“Risk and benefits coexist,” Blue Planet’s Will said.
“Alright,” Shi Yu said. “I’ll try my best to clean up all the enemies before breaking through.”
Then, Shi Yu rested for a while before immediately putting away his pets and starting to use the permanent teleportation array to head to World King Planet.
However, this was the first time an accident had happened in this Teleportation!
Shi Yu wasn’t teleported to the familiar Dong Huang Realm. Of course, it wasn’t that he had encountered an accident during the teleportation.
Instead, just as he came over, he arrived at a familiar space and time again. Shi Yu looked at the surrounding clouds and the stone bridge under his feet and immediately understood what was going on.
“Lord World King??”
Shi Yu looked ahead. As expected, in the next moment, something unexpected happened in front of him.
It was as if countless blue lightning flashed Blink, or as if a white gust was squeezing and howling, gradually forming a pair of blue eyes with white traces. They appeared above Shi Yu and stared at him.
World King Planet’s will!
“You returned faster than I imagined.”
She looked at Shi Yu and said, “Your strength has already increased to this extent? Looks like you’ve gained a lot in the quests this time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1783: Goodbye, World King (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1783: Goodbye, World King (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“As expected, letting you carry out this mission is the right thing to do.”
Shi Yu hurriedly asked, “Then, how’s the current situation?”
The World King said, “When you were away, that Super Empress once visited the World King Planet with her clone.”
“The Super Empress came??”
“That’s right. She has a very deep intention of condensing the transcendent origin in advance.”
“Because this transcendent origin is different from any other time in the past. Its quality is no longer something the transcendent origin that’s born once every 100,000 years can compare to.”
“It’s not too much to say that its quality can be said to be a transcendent origin born once in a hundred million years. The cosmic power contained in it is incomparably vast.”
“This Super Empress is indeed the cosmic level with the strongest spatial attainments. She can actually do such a thing.”
“Looks like she has completely entrusted her hopes to you,” the World King said.
“You mean that the Super Empress condensed this transcendent origin for me??” Shi Yu was stunned.
“That should be the case,” the World King said. “I don’t know what exactly happened between the two of you. Space and time have been modified. At the cosmic level, even if it’s oneself in a parallel space, they can sense it and be related.”
“However, a portion of my perception of that space and time has been blocked. It should also be her masterpiece.”
“However, the current outcome is enough. I can confirm that she’s temporarily not interested in transmigrating to the era. In her place, she should be planning the same thing as the cosmic overlord.”
World King looked at Shi Yu.
Nurturing humans.
Extend the lifespan of the universe.
Shi Yu had successfully changed the Super Empress’s thoughts. This made the World King feel that it was indeed not wrong to spend a lot of effort to send Shi Yu back.
This way, at least a cosmic war could be temporarily avoided.
“Lord World King, what does the Super Empress you saw look like?” Shi Yu asked.
“Black clothes, white hair, red eyes,” the World King said.
Shi Yu was stunned again. Lily had white hair, while the Super Empress was in black clothes. In other words, Lily, who represented a special memory, wasn’t dead, but had fused with the Super Empress?
Didn’t this mean that Lily had successfully defeated the empress?
Or rather, both parties didn’t decide the winner. They just shared the same body again.
“Where’s the Super Empress now?” Shi Yu asked.
The World King said, “I’m not sure either. Her arrival only indicates that she no longer has any ill intentions. At the same time, she hopes that I can supervise the other cosmic levels and not let them interfere in this competition that transcends the origin.”
“Her meaning should be for you to compete for the transcendent origin this time.”
“Me? I’ll go,” Shi Yu said.
“It’s not as simple as you think,” the World King said. “The quality of this transcendent origin is especially high-quality. It’s equivalent to a cosmic life form paying a huge price to accelerate the condensation.”
“If it’s used on you, not only will you successfully break through to super divine, but every pet of yours will also successfully become super divine.”
“I’m afraid even peak super divines will covet such a transcendent origin.”
“For such a transcendent origin, it’s even worth scattering its power and cultivating again.”
“Therefore, the transcendent origin competition this time is no longer a matter of divine-levels and their guardians. Even the peak super divines of the Contaminated Land, the Behemoth Empire, the Worm Mother Nest, and the overlord territories will interfere.”
“Apart from that, there might also be some super divine peaks hidden in the depths of the universe that don’t belong to the few cosmic factions. They will also revive.”
“Because it’s not too much to say that the transcendent origin this time is a key opportunity to become a cosmic level.”
“The Super Empress seems to want to test you. You have to rely on your own strength to compete,” the World King said.
“I understand.” Shi Yu’s teeth hurt.
This didn’t seem like the style of Lily, but the style of the empress.
He was helpless in the hands of the empress. This guy probably still didn’t trust him very much.
That made sense. In the hands of the empress, he indeed didn’t have any outstanding performance.
Apart from being a charger for Lily…
This time, it was even harder to deal with. From the previous opponents and competitors being a group of epoch gods to the peak of the super divine level.
It directly increased the strength of the competitors by a large level.
However, after learning the quality of this transcendent origin, Shi Yu was even more excited.
Refining one was equivalent to the entire team’s super divine?
There was such a good thing?
No matter who the opponent was, he wanted this source of transcendence. After all, it was prepared by the empress for him.
If he couldn’t snatch it, forget about the empress, even he looked down on himself.
“Then will the peak of the super divine level on the World King Star compete?” Shi Yu asked.
The World King said, “No, the peak super divine level of the World King lineage won’t fight for the transcendent origin this time, but I won’t interfere with the freedom of other super divine lives.”
“Moreover, the World King bloodline won’t assist you in this competition. It’s the same for me. The balance between the cosmic levels can’t be broken. At the same time, this is also my ‘contract’ with her.”
“This is her test for you. You need to complete it alone.”
“I understand,” Shi Yu said. “Interesting. I can already imagine what kind of bloody battle will still happen in the next Cosmic Sea…”
“But no matter who it is, I’m determined to get the transcendent origin this time. This is also my ‘contract’ with her.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1784: Goodbye, World King (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1784: Goodbye, World King (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Not a bad determination,” the World King said. “Then, I’ll give you one last reminder. Your current strength might be enough, but it’s far from the supreme suppression power. There’s still a risk of failure.”
“Although I can’t help you, I can still remind you.”
“In your current situation, you’ve already exceeded common sense. Perhaps you can do something that breaks through common sense.”
Just as Shi Yu and the World King were communicating, the entire universe erupted.
Be it the Cosmic Sea, the overlord territory, the Worm Mother Nest, the Contaminated Land, or the Behemoth Empire, all the experts sensed the change in the starry sky.
At this moment, in the center of the Cosmic Sea, a seed of light was suddenly born. Although this seed of light only looked like an embryo, any life form above the divine level could clearly sense it as long as they were in this universe.
It was like the most dazzling star in the pitch-black universe, piercing through countless darkness.
At this moment, many cosmic experts who went to the Cosmic Sea felt their hearts ripple.
On the route from the overlord territory to the Cosmic Sea, the genius girl of the cosmic overlord army, Ting Yu, who had once been stimulated by Shi Yu, was extremely shocked.
At this moment, she already knew the difference between her and a real genius and no longer had any impossible hopes. However, the battle to transcend the origin was about to appear. Even if she didn’t participate, she wanted to see it with her own eyes.
There were many people who had this thought, but the current scene made some veteran super divines reveal serious expressions.
“Old Master, is that transcendent?” Ting Yu stood on the battleship and asked her grandfather.
Old Ting Xiang said with a serious expression, “It’s only the prototype now. It’ll take a while to really take shape, but why do I feel that the source of transcendence this time is very different from the past?”
“What’s different?” Ting Yu asked.
“It’s like the quality is more than ten or a hundred times higher than before. In the past, the light that transcended the origin could only be seen in the Cosmic Sea. Even in the universe, it wasn’t so dazzling. But now, we’ve already seen such a scene when we’re still in the overlord territory…”
“Strange.”
“This transcendent origin battle might not be calm.”
“Is there any hope of that Shi Yu succeeding?” Ting Yu asked. Shi Yu was the most powerful guy she had ever seen in her generation.
Old Ting Xiang said, “If it’s only under normal circumstances, there are rarely any divine-level competitors who are his match. What he needs to have a headache about is only the guardians of those divine-level competitors.”
“With his talent, it’s not that difficult to find a guardian with extraordinary strength.”
“But in the current situation, this is no longer a competition between hidden divine-levels. Even some super divine-level old monsters will probably be tempted…”
Initially, only a few cosmic levels noticed that the transcendent origin condensed by the Super Empress was a little different. But now, as the prototype of the transcendent origin began to condense, many super divines and epoch gods who had participated in the transcendent origin battle discovered the abnormality this time.
“This is…”
“How is this possible?” On the Origin Star, the human expert, King Lie, who had once presided over the Glory Challenge for Shi Yu, was shocked when he sensed the abnormality that transcended the origin.
Without saying a word, he immediately headed to the Cosmic Sea.
Initially, he had promised to assist Shi Yu in this transcendent origin battle and become Shi Yu’s guardian.
But now, when he saw the transcendent source, he immediately threw these promises to the back of his mind. This was because even he was abnormally tempted the moment he saw this quality source of transcendence.
He felt that if he could obtain such a transcendent origin, it would be very worth it even if he dispersed his cultivation and re-cultivated. Taking a step back, even if he didn’t use it, he could still use his pets. He was a human Beast Tamer and could nurture many pets.
Previously, he said that he was willing to nurture Shi Yu because Shi Yu’s aptitude was indeed not bad. In addition, ordinary source of transcendence was no longer attractive to super divines at his level. But now, if a treasure that could increase him greatly appeared, how could he take a step back and nurture others?
In the end, the so-called investment was all to obtain better returns. And now, the greatest return was right in front of him. Without a doubt, his competition benefits were the greatest.
Not only the eight kings of the cosmic overlord army, but even the peak super divine expert who had once watched Shi Yu challenge the Glory Challenge, the Western General, and many experts at the peak of the super divine level were attracted by the condensation sign that transcended the prototype of the origin.
This… it was no longer suitable to call it the source of transcendence.
It wasn’t too much to say that it was the source of the universe. It was the source of transcendence that increased the chances of super divine experts advancing to the universe level!
At the border of the Cosmic Sea and the Contaminated Land.
The battle between the Environmental Protection Army and the Dark King Army had yet to stop.
However, today, because of the birth of this special source of transcendence, the experts of either side stopped fighting.
The peak super divine of the Dark King Army and the super expert President Bing Ling of the Environmental Protection Army were simultaneously attracted by the source of transcendence.
They instantly understood that the current battle for territory was no longer the most important thing. Next, no matter which faction it was, they would come to fight for this thing.
Its value was enough to make the entire universe go crazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1785: Goodbye, World King (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1785: Goodbye, World King (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
At the edge of the Cosmic Sea, the Blue Planet’s Will suddenly discovered the prototype of the source of transcendence that had condensed. Then, it was extremely serious.
“Now, it won’t be so easy for Shi Yu to fight for it…”
Apart from that, Lin Feng, the owl, the Time Emperor, the Space Emperor, and the gem cat, who had already advanced to super divine, also noticed the abnormality of the source of transcendence on the World King Planet.
“Damn, top-notch.” Lin Feng, who was letting his pet massage him, suddenly exclaimed.
He suddenly regretted breaking through to super divine so early.
“Forget it, such a top-notch item definitely has nothing to do with me.”
“Huh?? Holy shit, Shi Yu is back. What a coincidence??”
Lin Feng received a message from Shi Yu that he had returned.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already been teleported to the Dong Huang Realm by the World King. At this moment, Shi Yu’s condition had surprisingly completely recovered. The World King had probably healed him when it teleported him.
“As expected of a cosmic-level star. It’s much more healing than Blue Planet.”
The energetic Shi Yu also discovered the abnormality of the universe and discovered that the prototype of the source of transcendence had already condensed.
The appearance of the prototype meant that the source of transcendence had already entered the final growth stage.
It shouldn’t be long before it completely took shape.
“They really don’t give me any time.” Shi Yu was disappointed.
Initially, Shi Yu wanted to continue strengthening his strength.
At this moment, he didn’t know if there was enough time.
This source of transcendence seemed to be in a hurry to be absorbed, making Shi Yu rather speechless.
Perhaps he could do something that broke through common sense…
Shi Yu recalled the World King’s reminder and started thinking carefully on the spot.
Well.
He was still very smart. He knew what the World King meant without Ling’s reminder.
Common sense: It was impossible for a divine-level Beast Tamer to contract a super divine level pet.
Breaking through common sense: Divine-level Beast Tamers can also contract super divine level pets!
This was what it meant to want his battle power to increase again.
He had to quickly nurture a super divine pet to strengthen the team before the source of transcendence condensed!
What did something that even a Beast Tamer at the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level couldn’t do have to do with him, a Beast Tamer at the 18th heavenly layer of the divine level?
Perhaps it really worked.
Of course, conventional pets like Eleven and the others definitely couldn’t. When they broke through, they had to transcend the source of transcendence.
Right now, Shi Yu couldn’t find a good quality source of transcendence for them, but he didn’t want them to have an imperfect foundation. Therefore, he could only find special pets…
In other words, a pet that could break through to super divine without the source of transcendence.
Shi Yu looked at the Beast Taming Space, at a seaweed rice ball, and at Little Zi.
[Yes, this guy is a cosmic life form. There’s no need for the source of transcendence to break through to the super divine level. Just absorb the power of the universe directly.]
[Perhaps I can let Little Zi try breaking through to the super divine level in advance.]
Although there were no restrictions on cosmic life forms breaking through to the super divine level, the power of the universe wasn’t that easy to absorb.
Under normal circumstances, absorbing it for billions of years might not necessarily make it a super divine planet.
But…
Before Shi Yu transmigrated, the World King had given him a pile of support tools.
Among them, cosmic crystals were the most common.
That was because this was an important energy source for cosmic navigation. In order to make Shi Yu in a hurry, the World King had given him a lot.
This thing was the crystallization of the power of the universe, the most important resource for planetary life.
As for Shi Yu, forget about super divine level cosmic crystals, there were even several quasi cosmic crystals.
Due to the interference of Lily, Shi Yu and the others didn’t use too much of this thing on the voyage, so they left a lot behind.
Shi Yu felt that with Little Zi’s current transcendent divine skill and the level of the Super Divine Will, it didn’t seem to be a problem for it to rely on these resources to forcefully break through to the Super Divine Will.
“It’s decided. Let Little Zi try to break through to super divine.”
“In other aspects…”
“It’s very difficult to increase greatly, but a small increase should be alright. Let’s see how it goes.”
“It’s time to undergo a new wave of skill fusion!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1786: Little Zi, Attacking the Super Divine Level (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1786: Little Zi, Attacking the Super Divine Level (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Now, the pets basically had the Super Divine Will, and their divine skills had already transcendent. Their physiques had even reached the peak in history.
Shi Yu glanced at the success rate of fusion and felt that he could give it a try. He could fuse these skills that had already become ridiculously abnormal into even more ridiculous skills.
For example, Eleven’s Light Control and Dark Control. The current fusion success rate was no longer “0”.
For his current strength, it was no longer too draining to give pets fusion skills.
Shi Yu planned to increase all of this on the way to the place where he transcended the origin.
But before that, he had to tell his acquaintances that he was safe.
Shi Yu summoned Ling and said, “Help me send a message to the gem cat and the others to say that I’m back.”
“Roger.”
Under Ling’s message, soon, the Space Emperor and the others knew that Shi Yu had returned safely.
As Shi Yu hadn’t left for long, no one felt anything. However, since Shi Yu had returned safely, everyone was happy.
“Everyone, let’s meet in the Dong Huang Realm.”
After Shi Yu’s message, right on the heels of that, unexpectedly, it was a message from Emperor Shi.
Shi Yu felt that Emperor Shi should want to communicate with everyone about the appearance of the source of transcendence.
Soon, all the famous experts on Blue Planet gathered.
Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, Gem Cat, Owl, Shi Yu…
As for the super divine ancestors of the five divine races on Blue Planet, they were still in seclusion on Blue Planet. They had never cared about the appearance of the source of transcendence. It had been like this in the past, and it was the same now.
As for Emperor Wu and the others, because they had yet to involve super divine battle power, Emperor Shi didn’t inform them.
“Shi Yu, you’re really back. That’s so fast. I thought you would take at least hundreds of years,” the gem cat said regretfully.
“Why are you feeling regretful?” Shi Yu was puzzled. What was this cat doing when he wasn’t around?
It didn’t want him to come back as soon as possible.
“I feel that your aura is very different from before. You broke through again?” After the Prediction Owl arrived at the Dong Huang Realm, it was very surprised to see Shi Yu.
“Yeah,” Shi Yu said with a smile. This was still for convenience’s sake. He now had two appearances, one Shi Yu’s and the other Beast Shi Yu’s. If he became Beast Shi Yu’s, not only would his aura change, but even his face would change.
At that time, he estimated that his acquaintances would be even more awkward.
At this moment, Shi Yu sized up Teacher Owl.
In the end, the source of transcendence of the Green Dragon and Vermillion Bird super divines was distributed to Lin Feng and the Prediction Owl. As Shi Yu had expected.
Speaking of which, he seemed to have a source of transcendence that exploded from the cosmic behemoth… He conveniently brought it back to this space and time.
In any case, he was useless. He would throw it to Blue Planet to exchange for other resources later.
“Good lord, you just returned and such a big thing happened. Wherever you go, something will happen,” Lin Feng said to Shi Yu as he looked at the starry sky.
“Perhaps this is the so-called person favored by fate.” The Space Emperor smiled. He felt that the source of transcendence this time was simply prepared for Shi Yu.
“It’s good that you’re back.” Seeing that everyone was here, Emperor Shi said, “Shi Yu, you should know what’s going on with this situation, right?”
“Although I’ve never experienced the struggle for the source of transcendence, I also know through various ancient books that the birth of a normal source of transcendence won’t have such an impact.”
At this moment, Shi Yu had nothing to hide. He nodded and said, “Yes, I know a little.”
“There’s a high chance that this battle for the source of transcendence will attract experts other than cosmos-level experts in the entire universe to participate. The competition is the cruelest in history.”
“So ruthless?” Lin Feng was stunned.
“Because the quality of the source of transcendence this time is very high.”
“Then do you still want to participate?” the gem cat asked.
“Because of the mission the World King gave me previously, I’ve already been involved. It involves an agreement with the sixth universe level, so I have no choice but to participate.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Senior Emperor Shi, the quality of the source of transcendence this time is extraordinary. Don’t tell me you also want to participate in the competition?” Shi Yu looked at Emperor Shi. If Emperor Shi also wanted to participate in the competition and get a top-notch source of transcendence for his pet, it would be troublesome.
Then wouldn’t he still have to fight Emperor Shi?
Even if they were familiar with each other, it was quite awkward to only determine who was stronger and who was weaker, regardless of life and death.
“Although I’m also very interested in this source of transcendence, this change didn’t happen because of me. I’m not in the chess game. There won’t be a good outcome if I forcefully participate.” Emperor Shi said, “However, although I feel that your strength has improved greatly, are you already prepared to participate in such a chess game so early?”
Shi Yu said, “Let’s take it one step at a time.”
Shi Yu said, “Let’s take it one step at a time.”
“My current strength is a little stronger than during the transcendent duel. I can give it a try,” Shi Yu said.
The Space Emperor and the others were silent. During the transcendent duel, Shi Yu had displayed a level comparable to transcendent high-level.
In less than a year, he actually broke through again. He was simply not human.
“It’s good that you’re not participating, Senior Emperor Shi…”
“I must fight for the source of transcendence. In addition, I have something to ask of everyone,” Shi Yu said.
“Blue Planet’s Will wants me to break through to super divine on Blue Planet, but the origin battle this time is huge. My breakthrough on Blue Planet will definitely be interfered with. I hope everyone can share the responsibility of protecting Blue Planet.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1787: Little Zi, Attacking the Super Divine Level (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1787: Little Zi, Attacking the Super Divine Level (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“You don’t have to worry about this. At that time, I’ll preside over Blue Planet and resist all enemies,” Emperor Shi said.
“This time, when you compete for the source of transcendence, I’ll be your guardian.”
“That’s great.” Shi Yu was very excited, although in theory, his current strength had already exceeded Emperor Shi’s.
However, Shi Yu kept feeling that Emperor Shi shouldn’t be as simple as he looked. After that, Emperor Shi must have experienced something again.
Sometimes, he was relieved to hear Emperor Shi’s words. Emperor Shi didn’t seem to be the kind of person who would make random promises without the capability.
“Although Lin Feng and I can’t help you much, we’ll also protect Blue Planet well,” the Space Emperor said.
“Yes,” Lin Feng said.
“Then next, Teacher Ying, Teacher Tuna, you can be my military advisor competing for the source of transcendence,” Shi Yu said. “I feel that the two of you are the only ones who can help me beside me.”
“Wu.” The gem cat’s head hurt. Ah~ She had only rested for more than half a year.
“F*ck it,” said the gem cat soon after.
The gathering of experts in the entire universe felt like a good opportunity to get rich.
At that time, perhaps dozens of source of transcendence would drop casually. Wouldn’t it be rich!
“Charge.” Although the owl had heard that the battle for the source of transcendence was very cruel, since Shi Yu was confident, it chose to believe him.
“As a thank-you, I’ll tell everyone important information next,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Oh? What important information?” Lin Feng said.
“The conditions to break through to the cosmic level!” Shi Yu said. “Also, how the current five cosmic levels break through to the cosmic level.”
Everyone’s expressions changed slightly.
Next, Shi Yu told everyone the information that Lily had told him about how the World King and the other cosmic emperors had broken through to the cosmic level.
“In other words, to break through to the cosmic level, apart from laying a good foundation and laying an invincible foundation, you also have to be expert in the power of space and time. Most importantly, you have to train the talent ability of your race to the highest level.”
“On humans, it’s equivalent to contracting a cosmic-level Beast Tamer above their level.”
“On my Eleven, the racial talent of the Iron-eating Beast Race can equip its body with the power of metal by eating metal. Then, it might have to devour a large number of cosmic treasure-level metal resources to barely touch the threshold of the cosmic level.”
“What a joke.” At this moment, Lin Feng’s mood was the same as when Shi Yu obtained the breakthrough conditions from the owl. Telling him to contract a level higher than him, which was the cosmic level, was as useless as useless as tits on a bull.
Was this something a human could do?
Demigods could no longer contract divine-levels above their level. Even abnormal people like Shi Yu couldn’t break this rule.
It was even more impossible for a divine-level to contract a super divine above their level. This was even more ridiculous than a demigod above their level.
As for a super divine contracting a cosmic level above his level, it was obvious without thinking that the first two were still difficult. No one had reached the first two, let alone humans.
Was this the reason why no cosmic-level Beast Tamer had been born?
“As expected, it’s this.” The owl was excited. She was very satisfied with this confirmation. This meant that her prediction was right again!
At this moment, even Emperor Shi couldn’t help but smile bitterly. He shook his head and said, “The cosmic level is indeed not that easy.”
“The power of space and time might be able to reach the requirement with a little training. I’m confident, but contracting a cosmic level should be the most difficult to achieve, right?”
“Apart from that, my foundation isn’t firm either. I think I have to polish it again in the future,” Emperor Shi said.
“It’s simply… as difficult as ascending to the heavens.” It was the same for the Space Emperor. His foundation was also poor, because he, Emperor Shi, Lin Feng, and the others had fused second-hand source of transcendence.
In addition, although he was expert in the Dao of Space, the Dao of Time didn’t involve him too much. Lin Feng wasn’t even expert in the Dao of Space and Time.
However, Lin Feng might be the one with the greatest hope of training the ability of his pet race to the extreme, because his talent evolution was more suitable for cultivation than the space-time emperor.
It was the same for the two super divine cats. Their foundations were very poor. On the other hand, the owl was expert in time, and the gem cat was expert in space. This wasn’t bad, but it could be said to be almost impossible to develop the racial talent to the extreme.
“I’ve been thinking during this period of time,” Emperor Shi said.
“After thinking about it, back then, when I accidentally entered the ruins of the era, although it allowed me to transcend the restrictions of Blue Planet early and become an Achievement super divine, causing my strength to increase greatly, it also made me take many detours.”
“When everything is on the right track, I plan to reincarnate and cultivate again. I hope that day can come quickly.” Emperor Shi looked at Shi Yu and said, “Now, among the humans on Blue Planet, your foundation is the strongest. At the same time, you’re expert in the power of space and time, and your pet’s aptitude is the highest. When you completely grow up, I want to reincarnate.”
“Reincarnate?” Upon hearing Emperor Shi’s choice, the gem cat and owl’s expressions turned bitter. They shook their heads. They didn’t want to.
At the super divine level, reincarnation wasn’t as easy as when it was low-level. This was because to disperse the source of transcendence, the process was so painful that one wanted to die. Most importantly, it didn’t mean that reincarnation would definitely succeed. The essence of this was that it was a method to consume existing strength.
One way or another, if Shi Yu could really reach the cosmic level, they wouldn’t pursue the cosmic level. They just had to cozy up to Shi Yu.
“Reincarnation…” Lin Feng and the Space Emperor were also slightly silent. It was clearly very difficult for them to choose. After all, it was also very difficult to cultivate to this level. It was unrealistic for the two of them to pursue the cosmic level without even seeing the peak of the super divine level.
“There’s no need to think so far ahead now…” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Perhaps it won’t be long before Teacher Ying can increase the quality of the source of transcendence… Teacher Ying, how’s your research?”
The gem cat’s face fell. “Stop talking. It’s too difficult. My basic strength is still insufficient. Let’s talk about it when I become a peak super divine…”
“I feel that it might be faster to reincarnate and cultivate again,” Emperor Shi said.
The gem cat: “?”
What did Emperor Shi mean? Did their names and titles have the word Shi? Did they not know how to talk?
Who were they looking down on!
The gem cat swore that sooner or later, it would let these guys beg it.
“Next, let’s return to Blue Planet first…” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I have to discuss it with Blue Planet’s Will.”
He had to prepare some protective measures for Blue Planet.
Otherwise, if Blue Planet, which didn’t even have many divine-level experts, became the main battlefield, those ordinary people would suffer.
“Yes, let’s return to Blue Planet.” Dong Huang and the others nodded.
…
Soon, Shi Yu returned to Blue Planet. At this moment, Blue Planet also began to head to the birthplace of the prototype source of transcendence as a wandering planet.
Apart from Blue Planet, there was also a white planet wrapped in a purple star ring nebula flying with it. It was Little Zi.
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others were on Little Zi to help it break through. As the only member of the team who could break through without the source of transcendence, it carried the most important mission on its shoulders this time.
“Mi!!!” The huge planet was overjoyed as it flew. Little Zi felt that it was time for it to dominate the greatest war in the entire universe.
“Don’t be arrogant, eat quickly.”
On the planet, Shi Yu, Chi Tong, Ling, and the others almost broke open the cosmic crystal and stuffed it into Little Zi’s body, accelerating.
“Wu, wu wu.”
“Wuu!!!” From the moment it was stuffed with food to the moment Little Purple took the initiative to wolf down the cosmic crystal, its gaze was fierce. For this rare opportunity to become Shi Yu’s trump card, Little Zi went all out.
Blue Planet…
The Blue Planet’s Will looked at the purple and white stars in the sky in silence and couldn’t help but drool.
It was too much. It was fine if he ate in front of it, but he actually didn’t give it any. Especially when it sensed that Little Zi was becoming stronger as it ate, Blue Planet, this nanny, felt even more stifled. These resources were much more luxurious than when it broke through to the high-level.
“Mother Blue Planet.” Just as Blue Planet’s Will was speechless, a spatial ripple flashed.
“Why are you here?” Blue Planet looked at the Time Sprite, Qi.
“Mother Blue Planet, Little Zi is only five years old, but it’s already on the same level as you,” Qi said.
Blue Planet: “?”
“What’s the matter?”
“It’s alright, I just can’t be stimulated alone. I came over to share my mood,” Qi said with a chuckle.
She had watched Little Zi hatch. Now that Little Zi was about to become the highest level in the team, she, the lowest level, was also very stifled. She couldn’t just make herself feel stifled!
Blue Planet’s Will: ???
Although the Qi in its impression was very naughty, it wouldn’t say something so heartbreaking! What exactly did Shi Yu do!

chapters.title: Chapter 1788: Transcendent Origin (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1788: Transcendent Origin (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Transcendent from the Divine Realm.
It was a very special star domain in the Cosmic Sea.
It also had a name called “Ultimate Starry Sky Battlefield”.
Every time the source of transcendence was born, it would be born in this area.
Therefore, every time, this place would become a super meat grinder for all the races in the starry sky.
At this moment, the Ultimate Starry Sky Battlefield was extraordinarily lively.
The originally heavy and lifeless dead domain glowed with vitality again as the source of transcendence condensed.
Various vehicles could be seen floating in this starry sky.
There were huge technological mechanical battleships, strange biological battleships, and floating planets.
There were even cosmic monsters comparable to stars. They also had their own civilization on them.
Perhaps some people didn’t come for the transcendent origin naturally condensed by the universe.
Even if it wasn’t for that supreme treasure, if he was lucky on this battlefield, he could still gain a lot next.
In a place destined to fight, as long as one could successfully survive, they could more or less obtain many good things from the dead.
In the Ultimate Starry Sky Battlefield, some super divines were destined to die. The source of transcendence that these super divines might drop was actually also a target for some people to fight over.
And just as the aura of various terrifying experts had already spread across the Divine Realm, two planets flew over.
One of these two planets was blue and very beautiful, while the other was white but surrounded by purple nebula rings, making it look mysterious.
Apart from being convenient for Shi Yu to break through on his body, Blue Planet had also come this time because of the speciality of the source of transcendence. The source of transcendence that had been accelerated by the sixth cosmic life form for hundreds of millions of years triggered endless cosmic power to gather here.
It could be said that the current Starry Sky Battlefield might be the area with the richest power of the universe for a long time. This was undoubtedly very helpful to the growth of planetary life.
“Shi Yu, we’re here.”
As they entered the Divine Realm, the gem cat and the owl flew out of Blue Planet. Teacher Ying was wearing a white dress with golden stars embedded at its waist. It wore a crown and its cat ears kept swaying on both sides of the star crown.
As for Teacher Owl, it was wearing a loose blue witch suit. Its blue dyed white wings flapped under the starlight. After the two of them came over, they checked Little Zi’s situation.
“Little Zi, why haven’t you successfully broken through?” the gem cat asked.
“Wu wu wu.” The floating purple star was very aggrieved.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Little Zi full. It can’t be helped. It has accumulated enough foundation, but it needs to digest it. The environment on the way isn’t very suitable. It’s enough here.”
“The environment here seems to be more suitable for breakthroughs. In any case, there’s no hurry.”
“What’s wrong? What’s the matter, teachers?” Shi Yu asked.
“Just now, the two of us did a divination for you,” the gem cat said. “This battle to transcend the origin is very dangerous. You might ‘have the world as your enemy’.”
“We’ve searched for a way out. Perhaps you can go to the Observer Planet to take a look.”
“If you go there, it might be helpful for you to compete for the source of transcendence.”
“Observer Planet?” Shi Yu recalled. At this moment, Ling appeared and said, “It’s a special planet that transcends the Divine Realm.”
“The environment there is harsh and not suitable for survival. Apart from this special period, generally speaking, only one person lives there.”
“The other party’s name is ‘Observer’. His strength is unknown. It’s said that he’s very strong and is suspected to have transcended the high-level or even the peak of the super divine level. Most importantly, he doesn’t belong to any faction. He’s a loner.”
“His greatest joy is to be an audience member of the transcendent origin in the Divine Realm every 100,000 years. He seems to like to watch shows the most.”
“Although he watches the show, he’ll occasionally help the competitors he thinks highly of.”
“The two of you mean for me to come into contact with him?” Shi Yu asked.
“Meow,” Teacher Ying said. “This is the guidance of the stars. Up to you. I think if you really become an enemy of the world, the defense power of Blue Planet alone might not be enough.”
“If we can obtain the help of that person, our side will be much easier.”
“Unfortunately.” Shi Yu shook his head. He also knew the cruelty of the competition for the source of transcendence this time. This time, he would probably offend many factions by fusing with the source of transcendence. However, as long as he succeeded, everything was worth it.
“The transcendent origin hasn’t condensed yet. In that case, I’ll go relax and stroll around first.” Along the way, Shi Yu worked overtime and consumed a little more energy. Although he had recovered, it wasn’t the best choice to keep his condition tense.
At this moment, the two military advisors had come up with an idea. Shi Yu thought for a moment and decided that it didn’t matter if he went to the Observer Planet.
“Little Zi, accompany Blue Planet.”
“We’re going to play for a while, so I won’t bring you along. You absorb the power of the universe well,” Shi Yu said to Little Zi under his feet.
“Ah.” Little Zi was depressed. Alright then.
However, recently, why did it feel that Mother Blue Planet didn’t like it anymore?
Observer Planet.
Shi Yu and the others weren’t the only ones who took a fancy to this place. Many people knew the name of the “Observer”. There were records in some old factions that this hidden expert had interfered in the battle for the source of transcendence 11 times in 100 million years.
Although the chances weren’t high, many young geniuses chose to descend to the Observer Planet to see if they could come into contact with the legendary Observer and obtain his admiration.

chapters.title: Chapter 1789: Transcendent Origin (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1789: Transcendent Origin (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
If they succeeded, it was equivalent to having half a guardian close to the peak of the super divine level for no reason. Anyone was willing to give this free deal a try.
“Let’s go.”
Soon, three golden meteors could be seen streaking across the starry sky.
