On each of the three meteorites stood a person. Shi Yu, the gem cat girl, the owl girl, and the two cats behind revealed undoubtedly super divine auras. No matter who it was, they could tell at a glance that they were extraordinary.
As for Shi Yu, he kept a low profile and only revealed an aura slightly stronger than a normal peak divine-level. He looked very much like a normal source of transcendence competitor.
Otherwise, if he directly entered this star domain without restraint, even peak super divines would probably be alarmed. Shi Yu didn’t want a pile of trouble to come before the war even started.
The two cats beside him now looked like “protectors” and “guardians”.
Of course, the pets in Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space understood that although the two cat teachers looked powerful, appearance was deceptive. Their functionality was alright at best, and their battle power was really unbearable.
It was another matter how they performed when fighting individually.
However, although the true strength of the two cats wasn’t strong, the title of super divine level was still terrifying.
In the entire starry sky of the universe, including some hidden super divines who didn’t appear in the world, the number of super divines might only be in the four digits. The common active super divines were less than 1,000. In this situation, if a divine-level competing for the source of super divines could have a super divine guardian, it would be enough to satisfy. It could greatly increase the probability of competing for the source of transcendence.
And now, there were two beside Shi Yu.
On the Observer Planet, in an ancient city with broken walls, it was especially lively at this moment, as if it had been lively for a long time.
In the surroundings, there was the Abyss Race, the Yun Race, the cosmic behemoth, the Space Worm, and the Space Race in the Cosmic Sea. These large races from all over the universe were gathered.
The symbol of their unity was that the aura on their bodies was especially powerful. If it wasn’t a human, it might be the strongest divine level in the era, the god of the era. If it was a human, it might be a Beast Tamer who had broken through the limit of the divine level and reached the 11th heavenly layer.
No matter where they were, these were all geniuses whose names shook the starry sky. Now, they were surprisingly obedient in this ancient city.
Perhaps there was still a life-and-death grudge between them and the grudge of their race previously, but now, at least in this place, no one dared to attack randomly. This was all because of an old man sitting on the ground with eyes that seemed to be unable to open.
He looked ordinary. Apart from his red skin indicating that he wasn’t human, he was no different from an ordinary person. There was no aura on his body, but the surrounding people didn’t dare to underestimate him.
This was because this person was a legend who lived outside the divine realm. He usually came and went without a trace. He was a super expert who would only appear when the source of transcendence was born. At this moment, he was like a small vendor setting up a stall on Blue Planet. There were dozens of rocks of various sizes on a rag in front of him.
“Is there anyone else who wants to buy this?”
“As you can see, none of them are empty. Buy them on the spot and open them on the spot. We’re honest.”
At this moment, this old man was half lying on the ground, looking especially enchanting. Of course, if it weren’t for his big yellow teeth and even his shriveled and wrinkled face, he would look even better.
[This merchant is dishonest.]
[Damn, I want to curse, but I don’t dare.]
[My money, my money.]
At this moment, the surrounding divine-level geniuses’ hearts ached. It was difficult to imagine that the legendary observer was such an old man.
A few days ago, this old man had started to set up a stall on Observer Planet to sell things.
The things they sold were also very classic. For example, the super divine stone, the stone that could open various items from the previous era.
No one knew where this observer had found so many super divine stones. There were dozens of them, and perhaps not all of them.
And these geniuses had come because they had an ulterior motive. They wanted to obtain the appreciation of the observer. The old observer selling things also provided these people with some channels.
Then, many people threw money to buy these super divine stones, but after buying them, people realized that they had been tricked.
Until now, the dozen or so super divine stones sold hadn’t even revealed a single good thing. They were all ordinary Level-11 energy crystals. They were the trashiest and cheapest things among the super divine resources.
It could be said that buying and unlocking it immediately depreciated dozens of times.
This made these people suspect that this old man’s super divine stone was all fake. This guy was an immoral businessman. Moreover, they also had evidence.
That was, according to the rumors, the super divine stone needed five super divine levels to open. However, this old man could help the buyer open the super divine stone himself. This clearly didn’t match the rumors.
Of course, many people didn’t care if they could earn by opening the super divine stone. It was fine to lose a little. However, it was as if they were winking at a blind person now. This old man didn’t give any other response at all.
“Is there no one else?” The old observer looked regretful.
“Senior, I wonder what you think of the condensation of the transcendent origin this time,” at this moment, a white-skinned young man covered in red spider patterns said. He had already bought two super divine stones and successfully became a fool. He, who was unwilling to leave just like that, chose to ask some questions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1790: Transcendent Origin (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1790: Transcendent Origin (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
He came from the Worm Mother Nest. His family had signed a contract with a Worm Spider Race for generations. He was once determined to get the transcendent origin, but many people had already discovered the abnormality of the transcendent origin this time.
“Wu.”
“Go, go. Seeing that you bought two of my rocks, I’ll give you a piece of advice. Don’t come into this muddy water this time, or you won’t even know how you died. A little guy like you doesn’t even have the chance to become an old man like me to have fun,” the old man said with a wave of his hand.
“No chance at all?” The spider-striped young man’s expression changed.
“It’s very difficult,” the old man said. “I don’t plan to get involved in this mess this time. It’s too scary. However, business still has to be done. Come, come, come, who else wants to buy it?”
Everyone’s expressions changed slightly. Some super divine guardians hidden in the dark beside the divine-level geniuses also had serious expressions. Even this observer said so?
“Then who do you think has the greatest hope of competing for this source of transcendence this time?” A green giant ape that had shrunk before daring to descend to observe the star asked.
“On account that you also bought a stone, I’ll make an irresponsible guess.” The old man laughed and said, “As everyone knows, the source of transcendence naturally condensed in the universe is fundamentally different from the source of transcendence that fell.”
“The fallen source of transcendence no longer has any spirituality or vitality. It has already been completely refined by others. At this moment, whoever picks it up can use it.”
“However, the source of transcendence naturally condensed by the universe is like a new small cosmic consciousness. It will choose its ‘master’.”
“In the past, you guys might be its candidates. No matter what, it has to decide the strongest before it takes the initiative to find it from the cosmic flower bud. As for some old guys, they’re restricted by face and other pressure. They might not interfere too much in your battle.”
“But this time, don’t even think about it. After you guys finish fighting, everyone will join the battle together. Even if a talented divine-level is the first to obtain the recognition of the transcendent origin, he will definitely be intercepted in the end. After all, the quality of the transcendent origin this time is too good.”
“I reckon that the transcendent origin this time should fall into the hands of a life form that has reached the peak of the super divine level,” he said.
“Huh? No one’s buying anymore?”
“That’s true. You’ve already bought what is needed. Let’s close the stall and talk about it tomorrow.”
“Remember to bring enough money next time.”
Under the silent expressions of the surrounding people, the observer picked up the stall and sighed before walking into the ruined alley.
He took a step without a shadow and quickly crossed an unknown distance. However, as he walked, he suddenly stopped and looked at the sky.
“So many super divine stones.”
A young man in a black archeological suit and a black cloak appeared in the sky under the protection of two beautiful foreign races that emitted a super divine aura.
“But I seem to be a little late. The stall has already closed.” After Shi Yu found the observer, he was the first to not be attracted by the observer. Instead, he was attracted by his dozens of super divine stones. Good lord, was this guy a super divine stone wholesaler? He had saved up for so long, but he had only saved eight pieces. He had to gather two more pieces to get ten pieces to open consecutively. He had yet to do so, but this guy actually had so many pieces?
“Kid, do you want to buy a few pieces?” When the observer saw Shi Yu, a glint subconsciously flashed in his dim eyes.
“As for you, I can make an exception. I’ll sell you a few pieces during non-transaction time.”
“A few pieces… don’t feel good enough.” Shi Yu touched his chin and said, “I really want to buy all of them, but unfortunately, I don’t have that much money.”
“Why don’t we do this? I’ll make an appointment. Help me keep it,” Shi Yu said. “After I finish this battle, I’ll buy your stone when I return. I’ll buy it at 1.1 times your previous price. I’ll take as much as you have.”
“Is this how you do business?” The gem cat couldn’t help but say. Wastrel, shouldn’t the wholesale price be cheaper?
“You’re also here to fight for the transcendent origin, and you look like you’re determined to win. After this, can I still see you alive?” the observer asked.
“I’ll keep it for you. It’s not for nothing.”
Shi Yu said, “Of course. If you’re worried, you can help to ensure that I’m not killed when I fight for the transcendent origin. This way, I can come and buy rocks later.”
At the side, the gem cat and the Prediction Owl were speechless. If they were in the last era, they would probably be able to hear Shi Yu’s plans.
So the old man had to protect Shi Yu from being beaten to death if he wanted to sell him things?
“Hahahaha.” The observer old man laughed and said, “As expected of the strongest divine-level in the universe. To be able to defeat a monster who has transcended the middle stage with the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level, you’re indeed more interesting than those guys. If it were in the past, I would have bet on you. Unfortunately, it’s too dangerous this time.”
“Although you’re very strong, this time, it’s inappropriate.”
“I thought that as the observer, you would be very powerful. As expected, your horizons are still inferior to the cosmic level.” Shi Yu shook his head.
“Huh?” The observer said, “What do you mean?”
“It’s nothing. Even the World King, the cosmic overlord, and even the sixth cosmic life form bet on me. I think I’ll definitely become a super divine this time,” Shi Yu said.
The observer was silent.
The gem cat and the cosmic owl were stunned. Good lord, Shi Yu really dared to say it.
“You’re lying to me, right? Let’s go, let’s go. I won’t play mind games with you young people anymore.” The observer carried his bag and continued walking.

chapters.title: Chapter 1791: Transcendent Origin (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1791: Transcendent Origin (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
This time, Shi Yu didn’t chase after him. Instead, he watched him leave.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, this observer was mysterious and unfathomable to begin with. He didn’t know his identity at all. Shi Yu didn’t have much hope of obtaining help, so he really came to stroll around like a street hooligan, purely treating it as relaxing.
“That’s it?” the gem cat asked.
“What else can we do? We don’t know him either. We don’t know his background. We might even become enemies. He can’t really just enjoy watching shows, right? He definitely has his own goal for paying so much attention to the battle for the source of transcendence.”
“Regardless of whether we act recklessly, there’s no harm in pulling out the big shots’ names, like the World King and the cosmic overlord first. In any case, we’ve really seen the World King and the cosmic overlord.”
“At that time, if things go south, no one will dare to kick me when I’m down. If things go smoothly, someone will definitely come to aid me,” Shi Yu said.
“I thought this guy was so powerful, but he couldn’t even tell your true strength,” the owl said.
“You can tell?” the gem cat asked.
“Ah, this… Didn’t Shi Yu say that he’s a little stronger than when he participated in the transcendent duel? That observer’s information is clearly still from before!!”
“It’s not his fault. With my current strength, apart from the cosmic level that’s expert level in the power of space and time, I’m afraid even if I’m at the peak of the super divine level, it’s difficult to see clearly. I can only vaguely sense that I’ve become stronger, but I don’t know how much stronger I am and my specific battle power,” Shi Yu said. “This old man is still strong. Moreover, I don’t know where he got so many super divine stones. His identity isn’t simple. I feel that we will definitely be involved in the future.”
“I believe in the divination of the two of you.”
“So how strong are you now? Why don’t you show it?” The gem cat curled its lips.
“There’s still a need to show it… Moreover, if I show my strength too much, I’ll easily be targeted by the cosmic will. I’ve broken the limit too many times in a row. Now, I’m still relying on special methods to hide my aura. Look at those geniuses who woke up from their sleep. They don’t dare to attack randomly. Unless it’s a critical moment, it’s better not to erupt with all their might,” Shi Yu said.
“However, after fusing with the source of transcendence, I won’t have to be afraid. At that time, I won’t be an ‘outsider’.”
“Then let’s go back?”
“Go back, go back.”
As Shi Yu and the others arrived, many epoch gods from the five cosmic-level territories arrived at the Cosmic Sea one after another. Even the super divine level in the entire universe had probably gathered more than 50% of the Cosmic Sea.
The attraction of the source of transcendence this time was really too great. Shi Yu could sense the chaotic aura condensed in the transcendence divine realm. Seeing that the transcendent divine realm was becoming more and more lively, everyone guessed what the direction of the transcendent origin battle would be.
In the past, the super divine guardians had always protected the guardian in secret, mainly protecting the lives of their competitors. First, the divine-level geniuses competed among themselves and killed until their eyes turned red. Only when they were anxious would the super divine life be involved in the war. But this time, people suddenly couldn’t say for sure.
Surprisingly, the transcendent divine realm suddenly fell silent, as if it was the calm before the storm. Everyone focused on the transcendent origin that was accelerating condensation and knew that it was already close to maturity.
“Pop~”
Just as the entire universe didn’t dare to breathe loudly, finally, under the crazily beating hearts of countless people, the source of transcendence that was originally like a seed of light became even more dazzling and closer to this space and time. At this moment, although it was still in the nurturing of the universe, it had already established a deeper connection with the outside world!!
In the starry sky, the most talented Beast Tamer in the cosmic overlord army in nearly ten thousand years, Ting Yu, suddenly felt a summoning that transcended the origin.
“Old Master, I feel that the transcendent origin is summoning me.”
“Haha, that’s good. Although we’re not competing, being able to sense the summoning that transcends the origin means that you’re still powerful, girl. You have to know that many Beast Tamers at the 11th heavenly level of the divine level can’t feel the summoning that transcends the origin.” Old Ting Xiang was very happy.
Transcendent origins were equivalent to children of the universe. Although they were destined to be absorbed and refined by others, from the perspective of transcendent origins and the perspective of the cosmic consciousness, they naturally hoped that transcendent origins could be absorbed by better life forms.
Being able to attract the transcendent origin meant that his aptitude and talent had obtained the recognition of the transcendent origin. He had a high chance of finally fighting for the transcendent origin.

chapters.title: Chapter 1792: Focus of the Starry Sky (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1792: Focus of the Starry Sky (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“This opportunity is rare. Even if I die, it’s worth fighting for.”
“If you miss this opportunity, there won’t be a second time in billions of years!”
A gray-robed young man floated in the universe and stared at the transcendent origin in front of him. The phantom of the 13th heavenly layer behind him flickered and also sensed a strong summoning from the transcendent origin.
His appearance stunned many people in the starry sky of the universe.
“It’s him.”
80,000 years ago, the monstrous Beast Tamer of the Cosmic Sea failed to compete for the source of transcendence at the realm of the 12th heavenly layer and was protected by a guardian who transcended high-level battle power. He was originally not an impressive existence among the many losers.
He had already participated in countless battles, but no one expected that after the battle ended, this person would break through to the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level on the spot, shocking the entire Cosmic Sea, immediately making him the strongest competitor in the next transcendent origin battle.
Everyone still remembered that this guy’s name was Lu Mo. His ancestor was a human Beast Tamer who had transcended six times. He came from the strongest Beast Tamer families in the Cosmic Sea. Now, he should have at least three epoch-level pets.
At this moment, the various factions were approaching the transcendent origin. If it weren’t for the fact that the transcendent origin was still in the nurturing stage of the cosmic will and hadn’t left the universe itself, forcefully snatching the lightning tribulation that would attract the cosmic will would probably have already made super divine experts unable to hold back from snatching it.
Many experts knew that now was not the time to snatch the source of transcendence. When the source of transcendence was attracted away by some divine-level genius, that would be the start of the real battle.
And now, in the eyes of many experts hidden behind the scenes, it was just an appetizer. It was the performance of some epoch-level geniuses. Of course, just this performance alone made many people tremble in fear, because too many monsters appeared one after another.
“All of you, get lost. I’m determined to obtain the transcendent origin this time.” Boom, a shocking aura emitted from the universe. An epoch god in the form of a purple antman emitted a monstrous aura and ran towards the transcendent origin, trying to suppress the flames of the others.
Initially, sharp killing intent flashed in the eyes of many geniuses, but soon, their hearts skipped a beat. They were stunned by this guy’s ferocious and violent aura. Although he was only an epoch god, he was different from those epoch gods who only transcended once. This guy’s terrifying bloodline even made super divines who had transcended three times vaguely afraid.
“This guy is Her Majesty’s 101st son, the youngest son. It hasn’t died after disappearing for so long.”
Seeing this purple ant person, many people were extremely shocked, especially the expert from the mother nest who recognized its identity. Some who originally had ill intentions immediately felt their hearts turn cold, because this guy’s identity was too terrifying.
It was the descendant of a cosmic-level life form, the Worm Queen. In theory, it was even more difficult for a cosmic-level life form to reproduce, but this was not a problem for the Worm Queen at all. The advantage of the Worm Race was that they could eat and reproduce, and they could give birth to perfect descendants by combining the genes of the creatures they ate.
The Worm Queen had already given birth to many children, but the outcome of most of these children was not very good. Some children became peak super divine existences of the Worm Mother Nest and even terrifying high-level super divine existences. This was a relatively good outcome, but most of them were regarded by the Worm Queen as failures and directly lost their lives under the Worm Queen’s demonic training.
Since this purple antman had come to the Cosmic Sea from the worm nest, it meant that its aptitude had obtained the recognition of the Worm Queen and was thought to have the aptitude to transcend at least the high level.
“Little worm, why are you so arrogant?” However, not all competitors who had transcended the origin were afraid of this purple ant person. Although its identity was honorable, according to past experience, the Worm Queen didn’t care about the death of its son at all. Of course, it was uncertain if the son recognized by the Worm Queen had other super magical bugs as guardians behind him.
At this moment, what revealed disdain for the purple antman was a huge monster that cracked the starry sky. It was surprisingly a black cosmic behemoth. It was also an epoch god, but three suns spread behind it. It was the symbol of transcendent 3.
This wasn’t the power of this cosmic behemoth, but the power of an extremely small super divine Beast Tamer on its shoulder. This was surprisingly a terrifying cosmic behemoth at the epoch divine level, but it had contracted a “super divine human Beast Tamer” as a “master”.
He wasn’t a super divine yet, but he had successfully gotten a super divine Beast Tamer to assist him in fighting for the transcendent origin. The appearance of this cosmic behemoth also caused a huge commotion.
“The noble bloodline of the cosmic behemoth, the Dark Universe Behemoth. They’re born to eat black holes and are incomparably terrifying. The patriarch is a peak super divine. The most ridiculous thing is that this guy actually found a human super divine who’s willing to assist it with a contract.”
“A monster like this also appeared in the Behemoth Empire?”
As the geniuses of the Worm Mother Nest and the Behemoth Empire arrived, Lu Mo, who was in the Cosmic Sea just now, snorted and didn’t mind.
And this was far from the end. Putting aside those former losers and geniuses who had entered a deep sleep, just the number of new geniuses who had grown up in the past 100,000 years was endless.
There were also monsters from the Contaminated Land that appeared under the serious gaze of the Cosmic Sea’s Environmental Protection Army. Its body emitted a pollution power that was deep to the origin. It had the characteristics of many pollution races such as Meteor, Karma, Abyss, Flame, and Disaster. It was surprisingly a hybrid pollution creature.

chapters.title: Chapter 1793: Focus of the Starry Sky (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1793: Focus of the Starry Sky (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
The Environmental Protection Army had its information. It was said that this guy was one of the proudest research results of the crazy biologists of the Dark King Army in recent years. He was even an experimental subject praised by the Dark King. He was a pollutant creature that combined the characteristics of the eight pollution races.
This guy’s level was also the epoch god, but the terrifying aura emitted from its body was not inferior to the Dark Universe Behemoth and the purple antman.
“Grandpa, I finally know why you didn’t let me compete for the transcendent origin this time…” Ting Yu stood on the battleship. Just sensing the terrifying aura from all directions made her tremble.
“Our cosmic overlord army also has such a monster?”
“Of course… Apart from the Shi Yu you know, there are also many monsters sleeping in the cosmic overlord army in places like the Land of Sleep. For example, I only know one guy whose strength is very close to theirs. Its name is Bu Lu and it’s also a cosmic behemoth… Unfortunately, that guy’s luck is a little bad. It has never come to the Cosmic Sea…”
At that moment, the transcendent divine realm finally became lively from the silence. At this moment, Shi Yu sensed that the transcendent origin had already taken shape. He finally walked out of Little Zi’s body and stood in the starry sky. He looked at the chaotic starry sky and sighed in his heart.
At this moment, although they were still in Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, every pet of Shi Yu felt the crazy summoning from the origin just like those geniuses.
It seemed to also want them to compet.
However, Eleven and the others understood that the transcendent origin this time belonged to Shi Yu. Moreover, according to the World King, the quality of the transcendent origin this time was so high that even if the Beast Tamer absorbed it, it could be fed back to the pet. Then, there was even less need for them to compete alone.
As long as they assisted Shi Yu in obtaining the transcendent origin, everything would be fine.
“Generally speaking, as long as you display absolute strength among competitors recognized by the transcendent origin and become the strongest existence among the competitors, you can attract the transcendent origin out of the cosmic consciousness.”
Ling said, “The source of transcendence can increase the level of life after fusion. It can modify the body and make it more sensitive to the power of space and time. It’s also a recognition of the cosmic will. It’s a ‘high-level life form’ recognized by the cosmic will. With this, we’re not afraid of the lightning tribulation.”
“Interesting. As expected of a transcendent origin. I can also sense its desire. It seems to want me to absorb it very much,” Shi Yu said. “Oh? Something seems to be wrong.”
Shi Yu didn’t want to join the battle too early. He wasn’t interested in the title of “strongest divine-level” at all. This was because no matter which divine-level attracted the transcendent origin, in the end, they still had to experience the cruel competition of the second round. They definitely couldn’t absorb it steadily.
In that case, he would directly wait for the second round of the battle. He would let these divine-levels fight on their own in the first round.
However, things didn’t go according to plan. Shi Yu had yet to attack. Shi Yu’s attraction to transcendent origins seemed to be even greater than transcendent origins for other divine-levels.
At this moment, under everyone’s shocked gazes, the transcendent origin that was still in the nurturing of the cosmic consciousness and wrapped in the cosmic will emitted a dazzling light. The power of space and time circulated on it, and life aura bloomed. Under the entanglement of countless laws, it actually directly left the cosmic will for the first time and came to the outside world.
Seeing this scene, everyone was stunned. This was because the epoch gods who had been recognized by the source had yet to start fighting at all. The strongest expert had yet to be decided. All the casualties were just small fights. Why did this thing come out?
This didn’t make sense.
What exactly happened?
Or rather, the condensation of the source of transcendence this time was already unbelievable. What happened at this moment was even more unbelievable.
Moreover, in an instant, many competitors sensed that the source of transcendence no longer summoned them. The fluctuations that attracted them previously had completely disappeared, as if it had abandoned them and thrown themselves into the arms of others.
As everyone was stunned, they saw that this source of transcendence, the highest quality in history, suddenly crossed space and time and flew towards a white and purple star, as if it had already found its owner.
In the blink of an eye, the source of transcendence floated above the white and purple star, above Shi Yu, who was standing in the starry sky.
At this moment, Shi Yu felt that he was being watched by the entire universe.
There was confusion, shock, anger…
“Oh well, this expression of being deprived of something important…” Shi Yu also scratched his head helplessly, as if something was wrong. At this moment, Ling had also analyzed what was going on.
“Master, firstly, it’s because you’re too strong. We’re too strong. In the eyes of the cosmic will, we’ve already completely crushed all competitors. We’re not in the same dimension at all, so it has no choice at all.”
“Secondly, there are traces of the last era on our bodies. This is a very repulsive thing for the cosmic consciousness. According to Teacher Lily, there’s only one way to not be rejected by the cosmic consciousness, which is to fuse with the source of transcendence naturally born in the universe. This is equivalent to the universe using its own power to turn us into life forms of this era. At that time, we don’t have to withstand the lightning tribulation anymore.”
“The Empress, fusing with the source of transcendence, and cultivating the power system of this era again is also to avoid being rejected by the cosmic will.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1794: Focus of the Starry Sky (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1794: Focus of the Starry Sky (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“That’s not the key. The key is that a battle is coming.” Shi Yu grinned. He had already sensed countless experts attacking him crazily.
Unfortunately, fusing with the source of transcendence, especially such a high-quality source of transcendence, was a very time-consuming thing. Back then, the gem cat had spent a few months fusing. Although Shi Yu was more reliable than the gem cat, it was impossible for him to complete it instantly. Otherwise, Shi Yu would have turned around and run to Blue Planet with the source of transcendence.
Now… if he wanted to successfully fuse quietly, he had to destroy all those who weren’t convinced.
Of course, the most annoying person at this moment wasn’t Shi Yu, but the others.
These people were still stunned. They didn’t understand why the source of transcendence had directly slipped away and even floated above a person.
Looking at Shi Yu, there were actually many people who didn’t know Shi Yu. Some people from the Contaminated Land, the Worm Nest, and the Behemoth Empire, especially the experts who had just arrived, were still a little unfamiliar with Shi Yu.
However, for the native experts of the Cosmic Sea and the cosmic overlord army, they were undoubtedly extremely shocked. They looked at the combination of Shi Yu and the transcendent origin in shock.
“Shi Yu! It’s Shi Yu. He attracted the transcendent origin out!”
“Who’s Shi Yu? Who’s this guy?”
Shi Yu calmly stared at the potential enemies that filled the starry sky. In an instant, no matter who it was, they learned Shi Yu’s identity.
“This guy is a freak. He’s the second Beast Tamer at the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level in the Cosmic Sea. In a transcendent battle, he once easily killed the Four Saints super divine Green Dragon who had transcended to the sixth stage!”
“He even obtained an audience with the World King.”
“He’s even from a terrifying faction that comes from a one-star super divine.”
“Wait a minute, he’s a Beast Tamer from the World King Planet? No, according to what I know, he’s a super genius of the cosmic overlord army. He once challenged the deterrence of the cosmic overlord in the overlord territory and underwent the Glory Challenge. Under the deterrence of the cosmic overlord, he broke through to the 13th heavenly layer of the divine level and successfully challenged the Glory Challenge. He even obtained an audience with the cosmic overlord…”
“It’s a monster that hasn’t appeared in the cosmic overlord army for a long, long time. You can see the main body of the cosmic overlord.”
Shi Yu’s identity was quickly exposed. As everyone learned of Shi Yu’s identity, the experts of the ten thousand races in the starry sky were shocked. They looked at this monster with shocking resume in shock.
Those who were familiar with Shi Yu looked at Shi Yu in shock, such as Ting Yu, the Western General, Bing Ling, and King Lie. These people never expected Shi Yu to appear in the Ultimate Starry Sky Battlefield in this way.
Why… Why could Shi Yu directly summon a transcendent origin without doing anything? However, when he thought of Shi Yu’s terrifying battle results, even the thirteen-level genius of the Cosmic Sea, Lu Mo, had a dark expression. He never expected that such a monster would appear in the Cosmic Sea again after he slept. He had heard of Shi Yu previously. Now that he saw him, he immediately hated this guy…
The expressions of the monstrous geniuses from other cosmic factions darkened when they heard Shi Yu’s terrifying battle results. In fact, some super divine experts were no exception. What a joke. A 13th heavenly layer of the divine level that could reverse-slash someone who had transcended six times?
What kind of monster was this guy? No wonder he could directly attract the transcendent origin…
“From the looks of it, the source of transcendence seems to like me very much this time. Can everyone give me some face and not fight with me, alright?” Shi Yu asked the entire starry sky very politely.

chapters.title: Chapter 1795: 18th Heavenly Layer (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1795: 18th Heavenly Layer (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“As expected of you.”
This was the first time that the transcendent origin didn’t even consider it and directly abandoned other candidates qualified to fuse with it, directly deciding on a certain divine level.
The key was that if this was an ordinary transcendent origin, it would be fine, but the quality of the transcendent origin this time could be said to be the strongest in the era.
How deep was Shi Yu’s divine-level foundation? How many dimensions had he crushed other divine-levels to obtain the favor of the cosmic will?
In the starry sky, on Blue Planet, Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, Gem Cat, Owl, Blue Planet’s Will, and the others stared at the starry sky. This development revealed a reasonableness in the surprise. They knew that with Shi Yu participating, it was impossible to continue normally according to logic.
Shi Yu’s pressure would probably increase exponentially if he had to deal with so many opponents right from the start.
“Ridiculous!” Previously, when the mysterious super divine on the Observer Planet saw Shi Yu directly snatching the transcendent origin, his eyes widened.
After watching the show for so long, this was the first time he had seen such a ridiculous situation.
He instantly recalled what Shi Yu had said to him. Even three cosmic levels had bet on him. He would definitely become the final winner of this transcendent battle.
Thinking of Shi Yu’s confident tone, he was rather silent.
However, what made the observer familiar was still Shi Yu’s shameless style.
‘For your sake, I won’t fight with you anymore?’
What a joke.
If Shi Yu relied on his strength to fight for the transcendent origin, there was a reason why these competitors didn’t fight.
But now, the transcendent origin had inexplicably run to Shi Yu. Even if it was said that Shi Yu was very strong, there would definitely be countless competitors who were indignant and unconvinced.
After waiting for tens of thousands of years, a super high-quality transcendent origin that might not even appear once in an era… How could it not fight just like that?
Even after hearing the rumors about Shi Yu, many people realized Shi Yu’s strength. However, transcendent competition had never been a one-on-one battle.
If one person couldn’t defeat Shi Yu, then couldn’t hundreds or thousands of people with the battle power of the epoch god in this starry sky defeat Shi Yu?
It had always been that the person with the greatest hope of obtaining transcendent origin had to be enemies with all competitors.
Without the ability to become enemies with the entire universe, they weren’t qualified to obtain this source of transcendence.
In short, as long as they worked together to kill Shi Yu, the remaining people would compete.
It wasn’t that the one with the strongest individual battle power could become the final winner, but that the one who lived to the end of the transcendent battle and made all the geniuses in the starry sky convinced that they didn’t dare to fight that person again was the final winner.
“Why?”
“Shi Yu, right? No matter what crooked methods you used to attract the source of transcendence, you don’t deserve to have it without fighting.”
“Human, hand over the source of transcendence. This isn’t something you can obtain.”
“Everyone, attack together. No matter how strong he is, he won’t be a match for all of us. After dealing with him, we can compete normally.”
Noisy voices resounded through the starry sky.
“Although Shi Yu is strong, it’s almost impossible to convince these competitors who are also at the divine level like him.”
“In the face of this kind of opportunity that only happens once in a cosmic era, it’s worth it to fight with your life and not talk about virtue. Attacking with everyone is also worth it.”
“Not to mention, there’s also a group of old guys hidden in the dark.” The observer stood on the observation star and already felt an extremely oppressive atmosphere.
At that time, after Yu said that he would give him face, the competitors directly exploded and surrounded Shi Yu and the others.
However, although Shi Yu was surrounded by countless people, strangely, no one attacked yet.
Ordinary competitors were slightly afraid of Shi Yu because they had heard of Shi Yu’s battle results. The 13th heavenly layer might not be a big deal, but the battle results of defeating a transcendent level six were really too terrifying.
Most competitors’ guardian super divines didn’t have this strength either.
They were waiting for an opportunity to attack in a group.
Many people had already started to speak, bewitching everyone to attack together.
As for the old guys hidden in the dark, they also felt that this matter was a little strange. Shi Yu’s experience of seeing a cosmic overlord and a realm king had indeed played a role.
“Will Lord Cypos be behind this?” Two generals from the north, south, east, and west of the cosmic overlord army came. These two peak super divine experts were extremely serious.
“This guy is Shi Yu? He actually grew to this extent! No wonder he could kill Benos.” The peak super divine of the Yun Race, who was still fighting the Environmental Protection Army at the front line previously, looked at this human genius who had killed one of his generals with his dark gaze.
The Worm Nest, the Behemoth Empire, and some lone peak super divines were still watching.
In any case, Shi Yu couldn’t escape from the origin. The hunter would shoot the bird that sticks out, and now wasn’t the best time to enter.
They wanted to see how Shi Yu would deal with this scene.
“Kill!!!”
This situation was impossible to resolve peacefully. It was unknown who attacked first, or who shouted first, like a stone causing a thousand waves.
In an instant, countless phenomena appeared in the starry sky. There were phantoms of the 11th heavenly layer and the 12th heavenly layer. Countless powerful era auras spread on the ten thousand races in the starry sky. Top-notch laws appeared as if they were free, turning into a sea of laws.
Various divine skills and divine weapons appeared in their hands.
At this point, many people had already lost their rationality under the coercion of the crowd. The transcendent origin was everything. The dazzling divine light seemed to be competing with transcendent origin. In an instant, terrifying killing intent from all directions locked onto Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1796: 18th Heavenly Layer (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1796: 18th Heavenly Layer (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
With so many terrifying attacks, even if it transcended the middle stage, it was definitely impossible to escape.
The epoch geniuses who had accumulated for countless years attacked at the same time and displayed their talent to the extreme. What a huge scene. Some epoch gods who had yet to attack and were still watching were directly shocked by this scene until they couldn’t breathe.
“This…” When Ting Yu saw half of the epoch gods attack, her face was pale to the extreme. Before this, she didn’t expect the battle to be so tragic. One person actually had to face hundreds of epoch geniuses attacking at the same time.
Moreover, the methods of these geniuses were also very unbelievable. The Dark Universe Behemoth from the Behemoth Empire even directly got the super divine guardian to enhance the three transcendent suns on its body, displaying an attack whose power was comparable to the middle stage of transcendent.
The son of the Worm Queen even became a monster that no one had ever seen. The bloodline pressure on its body made some super divine lives and top-notch gods tremble very much. That noble bloodline power seemed to be the limit of the universe.
However, the terrifying thing was that Shi Yu’s expression never changed in the face of this terrifying group attack.
At this moment, the war had already begun. No matter what the situation was, Shi Yu knew that he couldn’t show any signs of retreat.
This was a test from the empress. He could only defeat all his competitors with his strongest strength. Only then could he obtain 100% of the empress’s recognition and support after obtaining the transcendent origin.
At that moment, in this scene that would make anyone’s hair stand on end, endless divine power light suddenly erupted from Shi Yu’s body. The dazzling light rumbled with the power of space, projecting Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space phantom.
At the same time, it was accompanied by a gift from Shi Yu to everyone who wanted to kill him.
An even stronger killing intent wave.
Boom!!!
The extreme killing intent seemed to have frozen space and time, instantly making everyone feel like they had fallen into an ice cave. The light and speed of these divine skills and divine weapons that flew over seemed to have been violently suppressed.
It gave the attacker the feeling that they were attacking an extremely terrifying existence. In the next moment, a scene that the attacker couldn’t understand completely appeared as Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space phantom completely formed.
Even some peak super divines who were secretly paying attention to this place revealed incredulous expressions.
Boom.
Shi Yu naturally activated the Beast Taming Space. First level, second level, third level, fourth level… Until the 13th level, the miraculous level of the era, fell into the eyes of everyone, but it was far from over. Right on the heels of that, 14th level, 15th level, 16th level, 17th level, 18th level!
An entire 18th heavenly layer of the Beast Taming Space phantom appeared behind Shi Yu. As the source of his terrifying killing intent fluctuations, at this moment, the attackers seemed to have seen an extremely ridiculous scene. They were stunned and their gazes exploded.
“What’s this?”
“Is this for real?”
“It’s fake, it must be fake.”
“Are you kidding? How can a divine-level reach this level? Isn’t the 13th heavenly layer the limit?”
The phantom might be fake, but the deterrence fluctuations on Shi Yu’s body weren’t fake. The deterrence that was close to the peak of the super divine level directly made these competitors unable to breathe and faint.
Right on the heels of that, what was even more ridiculous was that the phantom of a black and white bear gradually walked out of the Beast Taming Space and materialized. It descended into the universe and punched into the starry sky out of thin air like Shi Yu’s guard!
The 18th heavenly layer of the divine level corresponded to a super divine Beast Tamer who had transcended eight times. He was already a super expert in a super divine level life form. Shi Yu was actually even stronger than this, because he had cultivated the system of two eras at the same time. At this moment, Eleven used Shi Yu’s power to ascend to the outside world and directly broke its limit, erupting with a terrifying power that was enough to suppress power that had transcended high-level.
It threw a punch. Black and white lightning flashed where the fist landed. Space and time seemed to have collapsed at this moment. The extreme power fluctuations instantly Devoured everything. Under Eleven’s punch, the attack was so helpless and weak. In an instant, be it divine skills or divine weapons, they were all blasted into nothingness.
The punch that shattered the entire star domain had yet to stop. The terrifying aftermath instantly swept over, turning the competitors who were suppressed by the deterrence of the eleventh heaven into blood mist as if they had smashed an ant to death.
“Impossible.” The Dark Universe Behemoth revealed a desperate gaze. It, which was comparable to a battle power that exceeded transcendent 3, felt that the body it was proud of collapsed with a bang. Even its super divine guardian couldn’t escape the fate of turning into dregs.
No matter how noble its background was, the purple ant person known as the son of the cosmic emperor couldn’t resist Eleven’s punch at all. Its gaze was stunned as it was completely devoured by the power fluctuations.
Even in an instant, a mutant insect that had transcended the high-level descended. The guardian was in front of it and blocked this attack for it. This mutant insect that had transcended the high-level still spat out blood crazily, protecting the purple antman as it was sent flying, shattering countless stars.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!
The starry sky trembled, and countless people were shocked.
This was Shi Yu?
Ting Xiang, King Lie, Bing Ling, and the other super divines couldn’t believe it.
Although they knew that Shi Yu was very strong, wasn’t he at the 13th heavenly layer?
What was going on now? Everyone was stunned. Shi Yu was too strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 1797: 18th Heavenly Layer (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1797: 18th Heavenly Layer (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
With a punch, countless competitors and their guardians exploded in the starry sky. In the blink of an eye, only the competitors, spectators, and even some super experts hidden in the dark were left in the silent starry sky.
Under the phantom of the 18th heavenly layer, Shi Yu stood on the purple star. The transcendent origin was still there, and no one could snatch it away. Eleven landed beside Shi Yu and roared at the starry sky!
“Wuu!!!” Even if Eleven looked very cute, at this moment, no matter who it was, they couldn’t look at the black and white little bear directly. Their gazes were filled with shock. Even if they had transcended the upper level, their hearts suddenly skipped a beat at this moment and they were shocked by Eleven’s punch.
“This guy…” At the critical moment, the Yun Race super divine who had saved the perfect experimental subject of the Dark King Army also revealed an incredulous expression.
This was a divine level?
“I already said not to fight with me,” Shi Yu said calmly.
“This transcendent origin will definitely belong to me. If anyone still wants to take things too hard, feel free to come.”
“Whether it’s an era genius, a super divine expert, or a peak super divine expert.”
“But before you attack, please be prepared to be killed.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, countless people broke out in cold sweat. Their gazes were incredulous. They took a deep breath and looked at Shi Yu’s 18th heavenly layer phantom and the countless epoch gods who had turned into ashes, as if they had encountered a terrifying event.
“I still can’t believe it,” muttered many experts in the Cosmic Sea.
“What realm is this? It can actually strengthen a divine-level Iron-eating Beast to the point where it can instantly kill super divines.”
“Is Shi Yu a cosmic reincarnation?”
Eleven’s punch could be said to have shaken the entire transcendent Divine Realm. Countless experts were immersed in the attack just now and were greatly shocked.
Especially Shi Yu’s acquaintances. They were originally worried for Shi Yu, but now, their hearts were filled with endless ridiculousness.
“No wonder he said that we don’t have to interfere.” Lin Feng’s body had already gone limp on Blue Planet.
Was Shi Yu a f*cking human?
“What happened?” Inside Blue Planet, it was protected well by Blue Planet, but this huge commotion still attracted the attention of some experts. The five super divines of Blue Planet suddenly woke up from their cultivation and looked at the starry sky, feeling the terrifying pressure on it.
Eleven’s punch had killed countless competitors at once. There might even be a few super divine levels alone. The three source of transcendence floating in the starry sky blood mist was the best witness.
The other competitors who were still alive were very close to these sources of transcendence, but they seemed to be frightened. Their bodies trembled and they didn’t dare to move at all, their faces pale to the extreme.
As soon as Shi Yu’s level appeared, these people already knew why the transcendent origin would directly choose Shi Yu. They were extremely confused. How did this monster cultivate to this level? Did this level really exist?
Being in the same era as Shi Yu might be their greatest sorrow.
At this moment, the experts in the universe finally experienced what many creatures on Blue Planet had experienced.
“Come.” At this moment, in the silence of the entire starry sky, Shi Yu stretched out his hand. The three floating source of transcendence also flew towards him.
Although he didn’t use these things, he could keep them for Emperor Wu and the others. This way, he could gather five Blue Planet super divines.
At that moment, it could be said that just one attack from Shi Yu had scared all the competitors out of their wits. No matter who it was, they didn’t dare to gossip about competitors of the same level at this moment. If they still thought that Shi Yu wasn’t qualified to obtain the recognition of transcendent origin at this moment, they would be too deluding themselves.
“So, is there anyone else who wants to fight?”
“If not, I’m leaving,” Shi Yu said after obtaining the three source of transcendence.
At this moment, the competitors of the same level fell silent. Lu Mo, the 13th heavenly layer of the Cosmic Sea, was hiding in a corner of the universe trembling. He was glad that he had listened to the advice of the elders of his race and didn’t attack with the big wave immediately.
Otherwise, he would have already been the ashes of the universe.
Which epoch god present wasn’t a genius among geniuses? They were very arrogant, but at this moment, facing Shi Yu’s 18 heavenly layer, it could be said that they couldn’t feel any arrogance. They felt that they were an ant compared to the young man in front of them.
Some geniuses who originally had the faith to risk their lives to fight for the source of transcendence had all forgotten their initial promise and only wanted to leave quickly.
Now, everyone understood that there was completely no one at the same level who was qualified to compete with Shi Yu. Even among super divine levels, there were probably very few who were qualified to compete with Shi Yu.
Some super divines who originally had some ideas were also hiding in the void now, panting. They didn’t dare to act rashly, afraid that they would attract the attention of this fiend.
[Capture him alive.]
[Send him to the Contaminated Land.]
Just as the peak super divines were also immersed in Shi Yu’s ridiculous level and battle power, the peak super divine general of the Dark King Army, one of the most capable generals under the Dark King, the King of the Yun Race, suddenly spoke from the depths of his bloodline.
[Lord Dark King!!] Upon hearing this voice, the King of the Yun Race was shocked. He didn’t expect Lord Dark King to actually pay attention to this transcendent battle and was even extraordinarily interested in Shi Yu.
This King of the Yun Race immediately understood what the Dark King meant. Shi Yu had contracted a cleansing star spirit and couldn’t be left alive at all. The current Shi Yu had already displayed battle power close to the peak of the super divine level before becoming a super divine. If Shi Yu fused with this quality source of transcendence, what would happen?

chapters.title: Chapter 1798: 18th Heavenly Layer (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1798: 18th Heavenly Layer (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
The King of Darkness gave the order, and the King of the Yun Race didn’t dare to disobey.
Just as everyone thought that everyone had been scared out of their wits by Shi Yu and didn’t dare to compete anymore, dozens of terrifying super divine auras suddenly slowly appeared.
These auras appeared, shocking some of the audience. They knew that the main scene was about to completely begin.
Although Shi Yu was very strong, for this shocking opportunity, the super divine experts still couldn’t sit still.
Under Shi Yu’s indifferent expression, many figures of polluted races appeared in the Divine Realm. All of them emitted a terrifying aura, from transcendent low-level to high-level.
There was even one at the peak of super divine.
One was at the peak of the super divine level, four were at the high-level, 12 were at the mid-level, and 20 were at the low-level. More than ten polluted races were involved. This was the first time many people had seen such a shocking scene.
A total of 37 super divines gathered, making the souls of some spectators who thought that the battle just now was the greatest battle in the universe begin to tremble. It was unknown if they were excited or afraid.
“It’s the super divines of the Contaminated Land… I remember now. Shi Yu contracted a cleansing star spirit. The people of the Contaminated Land definitely can’t let Shi Yu inherit the source of transcendence alive.”
“Heavens.” Even the gem cat and the others felt their scalps tingle.
This was simply a scene that even movies didn’t dare to imagine. How many super divines were gathered here?
Here, there were also many members of the Environmental Protection Army stationed. All of them revealed shocked expressions. After all, in the previous huge invasion war, the Dark King Army only had 10 super divines guarding it.
But now, the sudden descent of more than 30 super divines really made them feel like they were going to overturn the sky.
“All members of the Environmental Protection Army, listen up and protect Shi Yu.” At this moment, the expression of the Environmental Protection Association’s God Bing Ling changed when she saw so many Contaminated Land super divines appear. She immediately made a decision to join the battle and use Shi Yu as the core to resist the enemy.
Although she knew that in this situation, not to mention the Environmental Protection Army, even a peak super divine wouldn’t dare to say that they could protect Shi Yu, as a member of the Environmental Protection Army, she couldn’t let this source of transcendence fall into the hands of the Contaminated Land no matter what.
“What a monster.” However, the appearance of the polluted super divines was only the beginning. In the next moment, dozens of super divines appeared, led by a peak super divine.
This peak super divine was a handsome man with an elegant expression and elegant bearing. He had butterfly-like wings and a pair of antennae on his head. His appearance made the expression of the purple ant-man, who was on the verge of death after being saved by a high-level super divine, change.
The ninth son of the Worm Queen was also one of the few heirs who had evolved relatively successfully. He had battle power at the peak of the super divine level and was one of the strongest tiers of the Worm Mother Nest.
“If I capture you and offer you to Mom, she will definitely be very happy.” The butterfly man looked at Shi Yu and said something that made the King of the Yun Race’s expression turn unfriendly.
It knew that the mutant worms that liked to collect outstanding genes wouldn’t let Shi Yu off either. Although Shi Yu’s current value wasn’t as great as the origin, it wasn’t much inferior. If the mutant Worm Queen could eat Shi Yu, who knew how ridiculous the descendants would be.
The King of the Yun Race guessed that the Dark King wanted to capture Shi Yu alive also because it hoped to transform Shi Yu into one of the polluted race and investigate Shi Yu’s secret.
From the moment Shi Yu exposed the 18th heavenly layer, apart from the transcendent origin, many factions had another competitor, which was Shi Yu.
After that, dozens of super divines appeared one after another.
In the blink of an eye, nearly one-tenth of the super divine lives in this universe appeared, causing the oppressive atmosphere that transcended the Divine Realm to reach an extreme.
Many of them had strong killing intent towards Shi Yu. Just now, when Shi Yu destroyed a bunch of geniuses, a large portion of the guardian super divines behind the geniuses didn’t have time to protect him at all. They didn’t even dare to protect him.
Only now, seeing so many super divines appear, as if they wanted to kill Shi Yu together, did a bunch of super divines finally dare to come out.
“You don’t learn.”
However, to everyone’s surprise, the great demon king, Shi Yu, still didn’t react when he saw so many super divines eyeing him covetously. Instead, his tone became colder and colder.
“In that case, leave all of them behind.”
“I wonder how much source of transcendence you can drop?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1799: The Seventh Cosmic Emperor (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1799: The Seventh Cosmic Emperor (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Silence.
Dead silence.
No one expected that in this situation, not only was Shi Yu not afraid, but his words and actions were even more arrogant.
Moreover, he didn’t retreat at all.
Even in the face of such pressure, Shi Yu was relatively calm. Everyone saw that his terrifying Level 18 Beast Taming Space phantom had another change.
Apart from the Iron-eating Beast that had just descended, other pets appeared one after another.
Many Beast Tamers in the Cosmic Sea were very familiar with these pets.
“Roar!!!” A Green Dragon leaped out of the Beast Taming Space. In its eye, a green worm finished painting the finishing touch. It piloted the Green Dragon and emitted a terrifying era divine might.
Everyone recognized that this was the monster that had defeated the Green Dragon super divine. This weird worm had clearly evolved the Green Dragon path to the extreme, but it gave up the Green Dragon path and controlled the Green Dragon.
“Yi.” There was even a ginseng baby in a doctorate hat and research suit. As it straightened its tie, it stepped out into the air. Everyone was also familiar with it. This was Shi Yu’s pet that won first place in the team internal competition, the ginseng emperor.
Right on the heels of that, a small Vermillion Bird landed on the shoulder of the black-robed red Sword Maiden. It walked out with an immortal sword, and a shocking sword intent enveloped the starry sky. Chi Tong also appeared.
After the Sea of Stars Sprite Susu descended, it immediately looked at the polluted races with an unfriendly gaze. The cleansing wave in its eyes was already ready.,
“After analyzing it, we can destroy them all in one go.” The mini battleship Ling analyzed the battle direction for Shi Yu with its shocking computing ability.
“Roar!!!”
“Quack!!!”
There was also the overlord of the earth, Little Ji, and the World Cleansing Demon Duck, Duckie. Their gazes were filled with violence as they looked at these guys who wanted to be enemies with them.
The treasure-hunting white tiger Shorty, the fusion black tortoise Little Quas, and Turtle. In an instant, ten more pets walked out of Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space.
This wasn’t the end. Apart from these familiar faces, there was also a red giant ape that tore through space and descended this time. Seeing its appearance, many experts in the direction of the cosmic overlord army revealed shocked expressions.
It’s the cosmic behemoth, Bu Lu.”
“Shi Yu actually contracted it too?”
“Is Shi Yu crazy?”
“Hahahaha, I, Bu Lu, have finally come here. But this time, I’m not fighting for myself.” Bu Lu stretched out his hand and took out a huge star stick he had refined on the way. He waved it and stood in the starry sky.
Everyone was evil.
It could be said that apart from Qi, every pet of Shi Yu had appeared. All of them emitted the aura of epoch gods. More than ten epoch gods. This ridiculous scene appeared. Everyone finally knew why Shi Yu’s beast level could reach the 18th heavenly layer.
Moreover, the auras of the dozen or so epoch gods beside Shi Yu were much stronger than the so-called strongest competitors with the transcendent origin previously. They were completely comparable to super divine level lives that had transcended three times.
What was even more terrifying was that at this moment, Shi Yu had averaged out his strength to these pets. Their power fluctuations were even more terrifying. Every one of them was actually comparable to high-level battle power.
“How ridiculous is this…” Countless people were already stunned by Shi Yu’s luxurious lineup. With such a lineup, even if it was an enemy with a difference of ten times, it didn’t seem to be a big deal. Unfortunately, there were still two peak super divine existences in his hands. This was a difference that couldn’t be erased no matter what.
Although Shi Yu’s domineering display shocked most super divines again, it was still a little insufficient for the King of the Yun Race and the ninth son of the Worm Queen.
“That’s it? How shameless.” Although their gazes were moved, they still attacked at the same time. The first priority of the target was Shi Yu. In the face of the joint attack of the two peak super divines, the entire transcendent Divine Realm was suppressed. The power of space and time reversed crazily. Even experts who had yet to transcend the Divine Realm could sense the terrifying atmosphere here.
It was like the end of the universe.
“Shi Yu doesn’t have a guardian!”
At this moment, the two peak super divines attacked Shi Yu. Many spectators were anxious. Although the environmental protection army led by Bing Ling wanted to help Shi Yu, there were too many hostile super divines. They couldn’t enter the main battlefield at all.
Logically speaking, a genius like Shi Yu should have a peak super divine guardian, but until now, Shi Yu was actually the only one resisting such a huge pressure.
Some super divines who were originally afraid that Shi Yu had come into contact with the cosmic overlord and the World King also heaved a sigh of relief. It looked like there was nothing between the two parties.
Buzz!!!
A huge battle was about to break out.
It was alright previously, but now, although Shi Yu appeared very calm, no matter how one looked at it, facing so many super divines and super experts in the first tier of the two universes, he was far from being a divine-level expert. He could fight against those pets.
The attainments in the spatial power of the King of the Yun Race and the ninth son of the Worm Queen were also very strong. When they attacked, they were also secretly fighting, wanting to capture Shi Yu and all his pets and obtain the transcendent origin.
It was as if he didn’t take Shi Yu, who was at the 18th heavenly layer of the divine level, seriously at all.
Strangely, Shi Yu didn’t seem to take the two peak super divines seriously.
Moreover, the pets Shi Yu summoned, including the Iron-eating Beast, didn’t seem to have any intention of attacking.
In an instant, everyone couldn’t understand. They thought that Shi Yu was stunned by the two peak super divines.
However, in reality, no one knew that at this moment, Shi Yu’s true trump card wasn’t any pet he had summoned just now, but the star under their feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1800: The Seventh Cosmic Emperor (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1800: The Seventh Cosmic Emperor (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
When the two peak super divines attacked, the white star wrapped in the purple star ring nebula under Shi Yu suddenly opened its purple eyes and emitted endless killing intent.
With a boom, the power of the universe around it was compressed to the extreme. It advanced to a high-level planet in one go, which was the super divine realm. A terrifying aura wave completely erupted, shocking the star domain.
Initially, no one cared about this star at all, but as this star suddenly broke through to super divine, everyone realized that this planet seemed to have an indescribable connection with Shi Yu.
Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng… Their power seemed to be flowing continuously into this star, making it grow purple round hands and feet in the huge starry sky of the universe.
It was very similar to a cartoon image Shi Yu had seen in his previous life, just that the stars were in white and purple.
At this moment, after Little Zi Star advanced and borrowed the power of the entire team through the Star Contract, its battle power instantly reached an unprecedented strongest, even exceeding the mecha that Shi Yu and the others had fused previously.
Under the confused gazes of the entire starry sky, under the focused gaze of the King of the Yun Race and the ninth son of the Worm Queen, it waved its round arm.
“Buzz…”
At this moment, light flickered on Susu’s body. Tens of billions of Star Sea Sprite projections appeared in the star world in Little Zi’s body. They used the Star Sea Contract and the origin wave together. This power swept out, directly making the expression of God Bing Ling in the distance change. She suddenly looked over.
A dazzling Sea of Stars wave swept over. The attack of the King of the Yun Race and the ninth son of the worm was instantly cleansed and annihilated. At the same time, the surging Sea of Stars wave was like a tsunami, instantly devouring everything at a speed that far exceeded the speed of light.
Boom!!!
The expression of the King of the Yun Race changed drastically. It didn’t understand what was going on at all. It felt that its body had suffered a very terrifying injury, and the pressure was even dozens of times greater than when it faced Bing Ling of the Environmental Protection Corps.
“No…”
In an instant, it felt that the traces of its life were being cleansed and worn down.
Apart from it, the polluted creatures that had descended were also quickly devoured by the origin purification wave that had brewed Shi Yu’s entire team’s power attack. Such a terrifying power made them unable to react at all. Without the power of a peak super divine, they could be said to have instantly turned into nothingness after coming into contact.
“Ah!!!!!”
Dozens of miserable cries resounded through the starry sky, shocking everyone and making everyone’s hair stand on end. When the dazzling light of the Sea of Stars descended, how could there be so many shadows of the abyss super divine? Only the source of transcendence that filled the sky was left. All the pollution aura was cleansed.
What was terrifying was that even the figure of the King of the Yun Race, who was at the peak of the super divine level, had disappeared without a trace.
At this moment, in the Contaminated Land, a terrifying figure suddenly opened its eyes. It was just about to move, but in the next moment, a terrifying psychic wave enveloped the entire Contaminated Land, covering a fifth of the universe’s starry sky, making the dark figure’s expression change.
When its vision returned to the Cosmic Sea, the ninth son of the Worm Queen, who wasn’t a polluted creature, escaped a calamity. It was only heavily injured and didn’t die. The other super divines were the same. However, their current state wasn’t much better. The Queen’s ninth son dragged its broken body. As one of the main targets of the attack just now, it was in a sorry state. Under the painful wails of its soul, mind, spirit, and body, it tore and shouted as it looked at Little Zi Star in disbelief.
“Who are you?”
“Impossible.”
Killing dozens of super divines in one hit, including a peak super divine and several high-level super divines. Little Zi’s slap just now already had the demeanor of a cosmic level and could destroy everything in the world. If the super divines who died just now could still have any thoughts, they definitely wouldn’t believe that they were killed in such an instant. There was clearly a peak super divine taking the lead, so why did they still die so miserably?
A slap to cleanse dozens of super divines could no longer describe the horror of this scene with words. Those weren’t the main cleansing targets, but the super divines who were only affected. Just recalling the scene of countless super divines being cleansed into nothingness beside them just now began to produce an extremely strong fear in their hearts. It was like a nightmare, and the scene just now kept appearing in their minds.
No one expected Shi Yu to still be so calm in the face of the siege of so many super divines.
Just as the ninth son of the Worm Queen asked, many people looked at Little Zi in shock and at this strange star. No one expected that the divine-level star that they had ignored at the start would suddenly erupt with such terrifying strength.
“Little Zi Stars, Shi Yu’s tenth pet.”
“Enemy, die.” Little Zi’s voice resounded in the starry sky, making everyone feel that it was unbelievable.
The ninth son of the Worm Queen even revealed a ridiculous expression.
What a joke. A super divine planet was the pet of a divine-level Beast Tamer?
Before it could analyze whether this ridiculous statement was true or false, Little Zi’s star ring suddenly disappeared, and Yin Yang clueless colors appeared inside. Like a spinning Taiji Painting, the Yin Yang Millstone that Devoured everything flew over and enveloped the sky above the ninth son of the Worm Queen.
Inside, it was black and white clueless, one yin and one yang, one light and one dark. It was filled with two-colored lightning that fused, converted, and collided. It was extremely mysterious. Everything around it seemed to have turned into chaos, disintegrating and being obliterated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1801: The Seventh Cosmic Emperor (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1801: The Seventh Cosmic Emperor (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Sensing the threat of death, the pupils of the ninth son of the Worm Queen constricted. It already had the intention to retreat. The ridiculous level of Shi Yu had already exceeded its imagination. It could already confirm that there was definitely a cosmic level behind this Shi Yu. Otherwise, it was impossible for this guy to be so ridiculously strong.
However, when it woke up, it was already too late. The Yin Yang Millstone that Little Zi used the power of the entire team as a prototype even obliterated space and time, preventing the ninth son of the Worm Queen from escaping through the power of space and time. It could only use its strength to try to resist this cosmic millstone.
However, with his strength, how could he resist a Yin Yang Millstone that had fused the power of the entire team? Especially at this moment, the black and white clueless colors circled in Shi Yu’s eyes. He even used the power of the previous era to display the power of Taiji with all his might. The power of the Yin Yang Millstone had already been strengthened to the extreme.
Shi Yu believed that even the black-robed empress back then definitely couldn’t easily block this move.
Moreover, these peak super divines were one level inferior to that Sun God General, let alone the black-robed empress.
“Ahhh!!!” Under the miserable cry of the ninth son of the Worm Queen, its traces of existence were quickly obliterated by the Yin Yang Millstone. At this moment, the surrounding super divines who appeared were just like their previous competitors, scared out of their wits. No one expected Shi Yu to be so terrifying. He could even destroy a peak super divine just like that.
Divine level? They directly regretted their actions deeply.
“Spare me, I’ll leave…”
“I surrender.”
“Don’t kill me.”
Shi Yu’s killing far didn’t stop. After the terrifying Yin Yang Millstone obliterated the worms at the peak of the super divine level, it instantly turned into countless halos and flew towards the various super divines who appeared. Under their shocked expressions, it attacked like a meat grinder.
In the light wheel, figures appeared. Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling…
Little Zi’s power projection possessed them, increasing their battle power again. At this moment, it began the final battle for Shi Yu.
“It’s too late,” Shi Yu said calmly. Under his voice, many super divines were obliterated into a blood mist and exploded in the starry sky. Eleven punched a cosmic behemoth to death. Buggy shattered a super divine worm with a dragon roar. Baby Ginseng’s fruit was like a star exploding and Devouring everything. Chi Tong’s Immortal Slaying Sword Formation trapped and killed countless strong enemies. There was even a battleship that wrapped the terrifying Starry Sky Storm and devoured over.
“Roar!!!” “Quack!!!” Even the pets of the clueless team slaughtered super divines like chickens at this moment. The scene was too beautiful, and blood dyed the starry sky.
Many spectators almost fainted when they saw this scene. Some young competitors even vomited out many filthy things because of the strong fear in their hearts. Their bodies collapsed.
Ting Yu of the cosmic overlord army recalled that she had wanted to challenge Shi Yu like this previously and fainted.
Not much time had passed at all. The hundred super divine experts who had appeared just now had all died in this starry sky. Almost one-tenth of the super divine experts had all died in this area because they wanted to interfere in the transcendent origin competition this time.
And the one who killed them was only a terrifying human young man who hadn’t even reached the super divine level, but had created countless miracles. For example, he was at the 18th heavenly layer of the divine level and contracted a super divine level above his level.
At this moment, the first batch of enemies had been killed. Shi Yu was tired, but his expression was still calm. To be honest, the entire team had already consumed a lot of energy. Fortunately, the power of the Sea of Stars had made up for some of the consumption and polluted many races. Otherwise, it would really be tiring. He didn’t know if another peak super divine would appear and if the second batch of super divines would appear. However, no matter what, they couldn’t retreat at this moment.
“Is there more?” Shi Yu stood in the starry sky. His pets also surrounded him and stared at the entire universe.
In the face of Shi Yu’s words, everyone fell silent. Even the gem cat, the prediction owl, Patriarch Tu Tu, and the others looked at Shi Yu on the Little Zi in silence.
The old observer, who had been watching the battle of transcendent origin as a joke, smiled for the first time in this battle. No, if a bitter smile counted, then he indeed smiled bitterly.
What a joke. With a divine-level talent, Shi Yu created a miracle that had never happened in countless eras. He killed hundreds of super divines in one go and destroyed nearly a tenth of the super divines in the universe. If one didn’t know better, they would think that some cosmic-level expert was bored and had killing intent.
No one dared to have the intention to fight for it.
Those geniuses of the same level would probably live in Shi Yu’s shadow for hundreds of millions of years. Countless super divines would probably tremble in fear of the battle for transcendent in the next hundreds of millions of years. After all, Shi Yu’s battle results were too terrifying.
The Ultimate Starry Sky Battlefield indeed had the right name.
“I was wrong. I wonder if it’s too late to add icing to the cake,” the observer muttered. He knew that this wasn’t the time when Shi Yu needed him the most. Shi Yu probably needed his help when he broke through. When he refined and broke through, he couldn’t be disturbed by the outside world. His battle power couldn’t be completely displayed. If he broke through on his mother planet, there would still be a second and third batch of enemies attacking. He had to have many guardians to ensure that his breakthrough wasn’t disturbed and that nothing went wrong.
In fact, this was also what Shi Yu was most worried about.
Therefore, he had to kill all the races in the Starry Sky Battlefield until they were afraid and afraid, making them not dare to covet him at all.
In fact, it proved that Shi Yu had done it. The entire starry sky was silent. In the beginning, the two peak super divine experts of the cosmic overlord army wanted to interfere. King Lie and the others originally coveted the source of transcendence, but when they saw Shi Yu’s performance, they fell silent. Considering that Shi Yu had come into contact with a cosmic overlord, it was very difficult for them not to associate Shi Yu with a cosmic overlord. They gave up competing.
“In that case, let’s all disperse.”
At this moment, Shi Yu indeed couldn’t feel much strong killing intent.
“My name is Shi Yu.”
“From today onwards, I’m a super divine.” Shi Yu waved his hand. Dozens of transcendence sources floated behind him, reflecting the starry sky. In the entire universe, countless gazes gathered. At this moment, even at the peak of the super divine level, they were convinced by a freak like Shi Yu. They were extremely shocked by Shi Yu’s talent and strength.
Many factions looked at the dozens of sources of transcendence behind Shi Yu, and their eyes were about to pop out. Who would have thought that one day, a divine-level heavenly god could hunt hundreds of super divines? Even the monster from the World King Planet who had hunted several super divines at the epoch divine level and was already at the peak of the super divine level didn’t seem to be much compared to Shi Yu.
“Ha, hahaha.” At this moment, seeing that indeed no one dared to stand out, the observer old man forcefully made himself laugh, and his laughter resounded through the starry sky.
“The sixth, no, the seventh cosmic emperor is about to be born!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1802: Goodbye, Empress (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1802: Goodbye, Empress (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
