What happened to the transcendent origin at the Divine Realm spread throughout the entire universe at an extremely fast speed.
If it were the previous source of transcendence battles, there would definitely not be such a big commotion.
After all, hundreds of super divines had died this time. In the past, at most, a dozen or so had died.
These super divines were the realm lords of the various top-notch domains on the World King Planet. In the Behemoth Empire, they were the lords of a star domain. In the Worm Mother Nest, they were cosmic nobles with noble bloodlines. In the cosmic overlord army, they were the kings of warlords whose names shook the starry sky.
More than a hundred such existences had died. How could it not shake the universe and shake the entire starry sky?
They had a close connection with their factions, and they were learned as soon as they died.
The members of countless factions searched with pale faces, but they couldn’t find any traces of their super divine lives anymore. They had really disappeared from this universe.
Just this point was enough for countless factions to crazily investigate what happened to the transcendent Divine Realm.
On the World King Planet, some demigods and divine-levels didn’t even dare to involve themselves in transcendent divine realms. They didn’t even have the courage to watch the battle and could only wait for first-hand news on the World King Planet.
When a trending topic rushed onto the World King Planet network, everyone couldn’t believe their eyes.
“The birth of a new cosmic emperor, the most tragic battle for the source of transcendence in history!”
The author said that the quality of the source of transcendence born in the universe this time was the strongest in this era. Not only did it attract the birth of hundreds to thousands of geniuses with the battle power of the epoch god, but it also made several super divine experts in the entire universe descend!
Among them, there was no lack of peak super divine life forms with the strongest battle power below the cosmic throne.
For example, the King of the Yun Race, the first Yun Race life form created by the Dark King, the source of all metal-element pollution, the most evil Dark Gold Master in the world.
For example, the ninth son of the cosmic emperor, the Worm Queen, was also one of the heirs with the best talent potential and the noblest bloodline, the Great Universe Holy King Butterfly at the peak of the super divine level.
However, in such a terrifying void background, there was a divine-level action that shook the battlefield, making many peak super divines have no choice but to sigh in admiration. They were called the “future seventh cosmic emperor” by the mysterious old observer who had lived for hundreds of millions of years.
This person’s name was Shi Yu. As a famous super genius in the Cosmic Sea, Shi Yu didn’t experience any battle and directly obtained the recognition of the cosmic will, obtaining the transcendent origin, causing many geniuses and experts to be dissatisfied. In an instant, he became the target of all the competitors.
However, he sent his Iron-eating Beast to kill hundreds of epoch gods with a punch, as well as the super divine guardian behind them, as he broke through the miracle of the era.
According to the people present, 12 epoch gode-level pets had already gathered under Shi Yu. He had even contracted a super divine planet life form above his level and controlled a super divine with a divine-level body.
His strength didn’t stop here at all. He wasn’t even afraid of the risk of offending the cosmic emperor. With ridiculously strong battle power, he killed the King of the Dark King Creatures, the King of the Yun Race, the son of the Worm Queen, the Great Universe Holy King Butterfly, who also wanted to stop him, and blasted the two peak super divine experts to ashes.
Then, his powerful pets even crossed space and time and jointly killed hundreds of super divines who attacked them, making dozens of phantoms of the source of transcendence light up the entire transcendence divine domain.
This battle for the source of transcendence could be said to be the victory of “Shi Yu” alone. It was the stage for him to become a king. Although he had yet to become a super divine, people had already begun to call him “seventh throne in the universe”. This was the recognition of the experts present for Shi Yu’s terrifying strength and their fear of his heaven-defying battle results.
On the World King Planet, from the Sun God General and the other peak super divine experts who had been ordered by the World King not to participate in the battle for the source of transcendence to the Dong Huang Realm, to the Elven Empress of Tingxiang who had ascended from Blue Planet, the Seven Islands Valkyrie, the founder of Shen Feng, Z, and the Tyrannical Sea Legendary, these old experts on Blue Planet also held electronic newspapers and stood silently under the starry sky.
“I knew it, Woo, take off!! Hahahaha.”
The little white dragon locked in the Floating Realm by Lin Feng flew out excitedly. It had said back then that Big Brother Shi Yu could definitely become a cosmic-level expert in the future.
Even some people who weren’t familiar with Shi Yu, such as Zavay and Ming Gu, had ridiculous expressions. It was even more ridiculous than seeing Shi Yu kill the Four Saints super divine.
“He did it.”
On the World King Planet, the World King’s will had been watching the transcendent divine realm the whole time. Shi Yu’s performance was beyond her expectations. As expected of someone chosen by the Super Empress, a transmigrator from the last era.
However, she felt that the title of ‘Seventh Cosmic Emperor’ was a little early for Shi Yu.
As many super divine lives who could be called the heirs of the queen died, many super divine bugs left here knelt under the nest trembling, waiting for the queen’s anger.
But to their surprise, after a long time, the Worm Queen didn’t react at all. In the end, she left the next sentence.
“I see the future. Shi Yu will come to the worm nest. At that time, let us give him the warmest welcome.”
In the overlord territory, the cosmic overlord, Cypos, was on the overlord throne. He knocked on the throne with his finger at an extremely fast speed. Every time it knocked, a galaxy would be destroyed.
“World King, is this what you want to do and her change of mind?”
“Interesting. Then I’ll wait and see. I’ll see if this human who once met her and came from the same mother planet as her can come under my throne.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1803: Goodbye, Empress (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1803: Goodbye, Empress (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
The Dark King, the Worm Queen, the Beastmaster, the World King, and the cosmic overlord, these super experts who stood on the throne of the universe, focused their gazes on Shi Yu for the first time.
Shi Yu was finally noticed by these strongest creatures in the universe. This meant that he had completely walked into the ranks of experts.
Of course, for most people, everything was still too dreamy.
“Impossible, definitely impossible.”
The super divines of the five divine races on Blue Planet who had already flown out of Blue Planet were completely stunned.
Who could tell them what had happened?
Why were there dozens of sources of transcendence around Shi Yu when he woke up from seclusion?
Making a movie?
“The war isn’t over!!!”
However, although Shi Yu had already stepped into the super divine level, many experts in the Divine Realm understood that the war wasn’t over.
As long as Shi Yu didn’t successfully fuse with the source of transcendence, the battle would continue.
Perhaps everyone was afraid of Shi Yu’s strength and didn’t dare to act rashly.
However, when Shi Yu began to refine the transcendent origin and fuse, perhaps no one would be willing to see Shi Yu successfully fuse. They would definitely interfere with Shi Yu from the outside world during the fusion process.
At this moment, Shi Yu was the most helpless.
Shi Yu had instantly killed so many super divines. Was it terrifying? It was very terrifying. However, such an action could be considered a ruthless slap to the Dark King Army and the Worm Mother Nest.
Those two cosmic thrones were enemies with the Cosmic Sea to begin with, especially the Dark King Army. They regarded the cleansing star spirit as a thorn in their side. Even if no one dared to touch Shi Yu now, what next?
Moreover, the current Shi Yu could be said to be the richest person below the cosmic emperor. With so many sources of transcendence, any faction would be envious.
Unless Shi Yu could obtain the protection of the universe or at least two peak super divines, Shi Yu’s super divine path would still be difficult to walk without a strong guardian.
“Sir Shi Yu.”
Just as Shi Yu returned to Blue Planet coolly, a super expert that everyone was familiar with and unfamiliar with appeared in front of Shi Yu and said, “Congratulations, congratulations.”
The old man smiled and said, “It’s a small congratulatory gift. Please accept it.”
He actually gave the pile of super divine stones he had set up previously to Shi Yu as a gift.
When Shi Yu saw the old man, he was amused. “Is this considered a reward for letting you watch the show?”
“What are you talking about?” the observer said. “This transcendent battle is simply an epic that’s enough to be recorded in history. It’s a good story that’s enough to be passed down for several eras. How can it be fun?”
“Next, please let me serve as your guardian and help you break through.”
What?
The entire starry sky was in an uproar when the observer appeared and said that he wanted to be Shi Yu’s guardian and assist him in breaking through. However, that made sense. This old man had always liked to interfere, so they didn’t know what he wanted to do.
“There’s no need.”
Just as the observer was about to protect Shi Yu to break through, a female voice came from the void.
Right on the heels of that, the pressure that surged into the starry sky shocked the starry sky. Her aura was several times stronger than the previous King of the Yun Race, and several times stronger than the previous son of the queen.
In fact, compared to Little Zi, who had absorbed the power of Shi Yu’s entire team and temporarily had enough battle power to suppress peak super divines, its aura looked even more terrifying.
Her descent shocked the observer, Emperor Shi, Blue Planet’s Will, and the others. It even made the expressions of some peak super divine experts like the Western General change.
Just like how there were strong and weak demigods and epoch gods, there was also a difference in strength between peak super divines.
The strength of this mysterious expert who had descended almost made everyone unable to breathe.
In the galaxy, a humanoid figure with a snake tail slowly appeared beside Blue Planet. Everyone could only see a rough outline of her and couldn’t see her face clearly, but they could also sense the terrifying power fluctuations on her body.
“Who is it…”
“Goddess Wa???” Many people in the universe didn’t know Goddess Wa, an extremely mysterious ancient expert from hundreds of millions of years ago, but on Blue Planet, the gem cat, owl, Lin Feng, the Space Emperor, the Time Emperor, and the others were shocked when they saw her.
Didn’t Shi Yu say that Goddess Wa had failed to break through to the cosmic level and had a serious backlash? That it was very difficult for her main body to wake up, and the consequences were very serious?
What was going on? Goddess Wa completely resolved the backlash of the breakthrough?
At this moment, the entire transcendent divine realm was shocked by the powerful fluctuations of the mysterious super divine expert who suddenly appeared.
When the two super divines, the Western General and the Northern General, saw Goddess Wa’s figure, they vaguely thought of something with shocked expressions.
“Could it be that person, the overlord who challenged the cosmic overlord and successfully defeated 1% of his strength? Didn’t she disappear?”
After Goddess Wa descended, she said,
“Next, I’ll be guarding him and helping him break through. Those who obstruct him will be killed without mercy.” Her words made some experts who had originally planned to use some sinister moves behind their backs turn pale to the extreme.
What a joke. As expected, they knew that it was impossible for a freak like Shi Yu not to have a guardian.
This guy’s strength felt even stronger than Shi Yu’s entire team.
Where did this come from?
“Ha… Haha.” At this moment, the corners of the observer’s mouth twitched. He sensed Goddess Wa’s powerful aura and had a depressed expression. With such a strong guardian, Shi Yu shouldn’t have made fun of an old man like him back then.

chapters.title: Chapter 1804: Goodbye, Empress (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1804: Goodbye, Empress (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Goddess Wa, you’re out of seclusion.” At this moment, in the starry sky, Shi Yu was very happy.
Great!
Although he didn’t know what was going on, Goddess Wa had awakened and had the source of transcendence. He was also about to become a super divine. Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, and he were still short of one to gather the key to open the ruins of the Earth Era.
Goddess Wa looked at Shi Yu. Everything was obvious.
She was originally not suitable to come out of seclusion now. There would still be risks, but…
Thinking of the mysterious cosmic level who passed by her Land of Sleep and helped her relieve her injuries, Goddess Wa understood that everything in front of her should be the other party’s masterpiece.
Not only was the birth of this source of transcendence the other party’s masterpiece, but her goal of healing some of her cosmic injuries was also because the other party hoped that she would protect Shi Yu to break through.
As for why the other party didn’t come himself even though he was clearly so strong, Goddess Wa didn’t understand.
“In short, thank you, Goddess Wa,” Shi Yu said.
“Let’s break through first. We’ll talk about the rest after the breakthrough is completed,” Goddess Wa said.
At this moment, the entire starry sky knew that unless a cosmic level attacked, it was impossible for anyone to restrict Shi Yu from breaking through.
Next, with Goddess Wa’s Guardian, Shi Yu returned to Blue Planet’s Will and the others to prepare to refine and break through.
This kind of thing couldn’t be delayed. The longer it dragged on, the easier it was for something to happen. If it went smoothly, it wouldn’t be long.
Therefore, after Shi Yu descended to Blue Planet and explained to everyone, he quickly immersed himself in the breakthrough environment specially created by Blue Planet’s Will for Shi Yu. He took out the transcendent origin and prepared to fuse.
“Wuu!!!”
Shi Yu’s pets looked at this dazzling transcendent origin with anticipation and felt its deep temptation.
This was an opportunity for one person to break through and the entire team to ascend to the sky!
He wondered how far this transcendent origin could raise Shi Yu to and how far it could raise them.
“Then I’ll start.”
However, just as Shi Yu was about to refine and fuse, something unexpected happened.
The space and time of the entire Blue Planet seemed to have stopped. Apart from Shi Yu and his pets, Shi Yu instantly felt that the surrounding grass, trees, rocks, and dust had lost their breath and stopped being washed away by time.
This…
Shi Yu’s expression changed. Not many people could do such a thing. Emperor Shi, Blue Planet’s Will, and Goddess Wa might be able to, but it was impossible for them to mess around at this moment.
“We meet again.”
Then, as a human figure clone appeared, Shi Yu’s entire team fell silent. Qi felt like it was facing a great enemy.
As expected…
“Super Empress, no, are you the Super Empress or Lily?”
Ling looked at the noble woman in front of it in a black empress suit who retained the appearance of the Super Empress, but her hair had turned white like a lily. Her expression was solemn.
Although Ling knew that the empress might have changed some of her thoughts, the priority of the consciousness in the empress’s body was still very important.
At this moment, the Super Empress’s red eyes looked at Shi Yu quietly and said, “This isn’t important. The Empress is me, and Lily is also me. We’re originally one. We’re just fusing again.”
“Then how should I address you now?” Shi Yu said.
“Up to you,” she said.
“Super Lily Empress,” Shi Yu said.
The other party was silent.
“Just call me Empress,” the Super Empress added in silence.
Ling was also sweating crazily at the side. Did fusion mean this?
Its body had fused. It had fused even if it was no longer called Lily! As expected, its Beast Tamer’s naming was still lousy. It really didn’t forget its original intention.
“No matter what, thank you for transcendent origin,” Shi Yu said. “I’ll work hard to become a cosmic Beast Tamer and then become the eternal cosmic holder. I’ll contract the entire universe and help you, no, help us transmigrate back to the last era.”
“I hope so,” the Super Empress said.
“Well… Wait a minute!” At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly realized in shock that his original pet contract had returned as the Super Empress appeared beside him.
Although this contract was extremely dim, and he couldn’t feel any connection to the Super Empress through the contract, it didn’t break or disappear. Previously, it had only disappeared in a special way. Now, it was still in his spiritual sea. At this moment, Shi Yu was shocked. What was going on?
“Why? Our contract is still there,” Shi Yu asked.
The Super Empress looked at Shi Yu and said, “Isn’t this good? Or do you think that apart from me, you still have hope of signing a contract with other cosmic levels and letting them help you break through to the cosmic level?”
Shi Yu said, “You mean that when I reach the peak of the super divine level, you’ll help me break through to the cosmic level?”
The Super Empress said, “Ordinary peak super divines aren’t enough. You have to at least reach ten times the strength of the black-haired Super Empress when she fought you in the past to have any hope of withstanding the true burden of contracting a cosmic level. In fact, without a certain strength foundation, just the feedback power obtained from contracting a cosmic level is enough to burst your body.”
Shi Yu said, “Ten times…”
“I know this is very difficult, but I’ll help you again and bring your other source of transcendence,” the Super Empress said.
Next, the Super Empress snatched away the dozens of transcendence sources Shi Yu had dropped under Shi Yu’s eager gaze, leaving only the transcendent source.

chapters.title: Chapter 1805: Goodbye, Empress (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1805: Goodbye, Empress (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Through the cultivation system of the last era, you can use the fake source of transcendence and the real source of transcendence to strengthen your physical strength, mental strength, and soul power. In the situation after your breakthrough, no one should be able to support the resources needed to strengthen with the fake source of transcendence. In that case, I’ll help you transform these real sources of transcendence into strengthening resources that can be suitable to absorb.”
“Can you do it?” Shi Yu said. The super divine level of this era could only absorb one source of transcendence. He could absorb multiple sources of transcendence through the cultivation system of the last era?
“Yes, but it might be very difficult to do it with my strength alone. I still need to borrow the power of another cosmic level,” she said.
“Of course, it’s not the cosmic level itself. It’s fine as long as it’s the power derived from her.”
“What do you mean?” Shi Yu said.
The Super Empress said, “Lend me the cat girl from before. I need her power of prayer to optimize these transcendence sources, expel their impurities, and change their nature.”
“Teacher Ying?” Shi Yu was extremely surprised.
It actually… actually had to borrow the power of the star to modify the source of transcendence at the cosmic level.
“This is also a good thing for her. During this process, I’ll use some external forces to increase her strength. She only needs to withstand a certain amount of affliction to quickly increase her realm,” the Super Empress said.
“Finally…”
The Super Empress said, “Although I’ve helped you a lot, don’t be happy too early.”
“Even if you become a cosmic level, you’re far from reaching one-tenth of the conditions to contract the ‘universe’.”
“You have something more important to do.”
Shi Yu said, “I more or less know what it is.”
“It should be nurturing them.” Shi Yu looked at Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng beside him.
“With my own strength, even if I reach the cosmic level, whether I can defeat a cosmic emperor alone is another matter, let alone contract the universe.”
“However, if I nurture Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and these pets to the cosmic level…”
“They feedback their powerful strength to me. Then, I can be called the strongest cosmic level. From there, I have the qualifications to contract the will of the universe and can withstand the burden of contracting the universe.”
“Wuu!!!” As Shi Yu finished speaking, Eleven and the others nodded crazily. They could leave everything to them.
“That’s right. Just becoming a cosmic Beast Tamer isn’t enough to reach the threshold of contracting the universe. If it were so easy to be the holder of the universe, the previous eras wouldn’t have been destroyed,” the empress said.
“Apart from that, even if you want to withstand my power and reach the cosmic level, apart from these resources, they have to at least have the power of a peak super divine.”
“Note that it’s not that you have the power of a peak super divine after strengthening yourself, but that you have the power to match a peak super divine with your own strength alone.”
“In other words, after I break through to the super divine level, I have to start searching for their cosmic path for every pet, right?” Shi Yu said.
“You can say that. Although you can also wait until you’re at the cosmic level before finding a cosmic path for them, that should be easier. However, if you’re willing to explore in advance, there’s no harm. After all, if you want to contract the universe, I conservatively estimate that you need to contract at least four cosmic levels.”
“And why is this Time Sprite still weaker than other pets?” At this moment, the Empress noticed Qi and felt that only Qi wasn’t the epoch god.
“What did you say? I’m not weak!” Initially, Qi was already troubled enough without participating in the battle for the source of transcendence. Now that she was stimulated by the Empress, she immediately couldn’t take it anymore.
“It’s useless. Let’s use it to make soup,” the Empress said.
“Ahhh, Shi Yu, look at her… Damn it, she only knows how to bully me. Sooner or later, you’ll transmigrate into space and time and ask for me.” Qi let out a pig-like scream again. She was determined to suddenly sublimate under the stimulation of the empress…
On the other side, the gem cat was still lamenting and thinking about how to sell the source of transcendence for Shi Yu. However, extreme joy turned into sorrow. Suddenly, she was grabbed out of Blue Planet by an invisible psychic hand with a frightened expression.
“Mother Blue Planet, save me!”
“Goddess Wa, save me!!!”
“Ahhh, who, who is it? Do you know who I am? I’m Shi Yu’s teacher! Shi Yu, save me!” The gem cat was attacked by the enemy and also let out a pig-like scream.
“Someone who can help you break through to the peak of the super divine level,” the unknown female voice said.
“Meow???” The gem cat was stunned. What, did she hear wrongly? There was such a good thing?

chapters.title: Chapter 1806: Super Divine Shi Yu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1806: Super Divine Shi Yu (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Blue Planet…
After the Super Lily Empress left, Shi Yu threw away all distracting thoughts again and planned to start refining the transcendent origin.
“How unfortunate.”
Before refining it, Shi Yu felt that it was a pity.
This was because be it Little Zi breaking through to super divine or Qi breaking through to the epoch god, although they brought a certain amount of feedback, they didn’t allow him to break through to the 19th heavenly layer.
After Little Zi broke through, Shi Yu felt that he was even closer to this universe.
It was far from the mutual rejection from before.
After Qi broke through, the feeling it gave Shi Yu was that his understanding of space and time was even more profound.
At this moment, he could even casually adjust the spatial flow in the Beast Taming Space.
Through this method, all pets dreamed for a hundred years.
“1. The power of space and time.”
“2. Perfect foundation.”
“3. Race Talent.”
Shi Yu stretched out his hand and touched the transcendent origin. With these time and spatial pets, his archeological talent, and his identity as a person who had transmigrated into space and time, he believed that the cultivation of the power of space and time wasn’t a problem for him.
A perfect foundation would also be given by the perfect transcendent origin condensed by the Super Lily Empress at this moment. At this moment, Shi Yu could be considered to have walked a path of the universe that rarely had a human Beast Tamer comparable to him.
Buzz!
Under Shi Yu’s touch, the transcendent origin began to emit a light that enveloped everything. Not only did it wrap around Shi Yu, but it also wrapped around Shi Yu’s pets.
The dazzling light seemed to have intertwined into a huge cocoon, transforming into a white universe that wanted to hatch Shi Yu and the others again.
During the refinement process, Shi Yu and his pets felt as if they had crawled back into their mother’s stomach. It was especially warm, the closest to the origin of the universe.
Here, Shi Yu felt that his 18 layers of space began to melt and replace it. A small universe began to nurture in his spiritual sea.
This small universe was like a star field. Many stars floated inside. The attributes of every star perfectly corresponded to the attributes of the pets.
Compared to the previous habitat environment, they seemed to be about to become the masters of the stars and could grow better here.
[This phenomenon.]
Shi Yu muttered in his heart. This was because according to his understanding, this wasn’t the change in the Beast Taming Space after the other super divines broke through.
Although no matter how many days he cultivated, the Beast Taming Space would melt and evolve into a small cosmic star domain, he had never heard of so many stars being born.
Under normal circumstances, ordinary Beast Tamers would only evolve a continent in this cosmic space. This vast starry sky continent would become a new habitat environment for pets. Apart from the Sun of Transcendence, there would be no other stars.
This Sun of Transcendence was also the power that Beast Tamers and pets were going to cultivate next.
However, this situation was broken for the first time by Shi Yu. Every pet of his, apart from Little Zi, had a star of their own. Shi Yu didn’t know if this was related to him, or if it was related to them all refining a Star Arms, or if it was related to Little Zi breaking through to super divine.
However, the experience transmitted by the pets made Shi Yu certain that this wasn’t a bad thing. The comfortable feeling of every pet being nurtured in the stars meant that these places were very beneficial to them.
[A real universe with stars is born in my body. This is something other Beast Tamers don’t have.]
[What’s the difference between my current situation and becoming the will of the universe? There’s the starry sky of the universe in my body, stars, and life on the stars.]
[Perhaps this is also a crucial premise to become the guardian of the universe. Only Beast Tamers with cosmic aptitude will have such a change.]
Shi Yu no longer felt conflicted and continued to refine the source of transcendence. As he refined it, after the changes in the Beast Taming Space, right on the heels of that were the changes in his Beast Taming Talent.
At this moment, Shi Yu actually felt that the coverage of telepathy would immediately envelop a galaxy. If it was between him and his pet, he could sense the other party’s state even from a star field. This was only the beginning. Everything was still slowly increasing.
Time Strengthening, Spatial Strengthening, Body Control, Fusion, Restoration… All these talents transcended qualitative changes at this moment, especially the moment his spatial talent broke through. Shi Yu felt that his entire body had been sublimated. He had a feeling that if he continued to increase, sooner or later, it would be the only feeling in the myriad worlds. Of course, this wasn’t enough to cause Shi Yu’s heart to tremble.
What he cared about was still the foundation of everything, the change in the skill index.
After breaking through to the divine level, his skill index had the ability to plunder the transcendent origin.
Although it didn’t seem very useful now, it at least ensured that no matter how many pets it contracted, they still had the source of transcendence. It was considered a function to assist in breaking through to the super divine level.
And after breaking through to the super divine level, would the skill index have the function to assist in breaking through to the cosmic level?
Or could it be said that after transcendent skills, could new points be activated?
In Shi Yu’s endless anticipation, he paid attention for a long time. However, it seemed that the upgrade of the skill index was much slower than the upgrade of other talents.
Wait for the refinement to be completed…
Shi Yu also knew that he couldn’t rush it. He could only continue to refine it in peace until a Sun of Transcendence floated in the bodies of Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, and every other life form.
At this moment, Shi Yu felt reborn. The star domain space was directly illuminated by the Sun of Transcendence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1807: Super Divine Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1807: Super Divine Shi Yu (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
He had finally reached the traditional realm of “super divine” and “transcended once”.
Of course, for Shi Yu, the increase brought by this realm was almost several times that of others. After all, before he broke through, his main body already had battle power that exceeded the high-level. How could he become weaker the more he broke through?
The advancement was far from stopping.
However, the most obvious one wasn’t Shi Yu, but Eleven and the other pets.
“Wuu!!!” Standing on a metal-element star, Eleven felt its blood boil, as if a sun had exploded in its body. Vaguely, Eleven even felt millions of bloodlines of the same origin waiting to be fed.
Its bloodline directly resonated with these same bloodlines. Eleven was stunned and tried. Just such a subtle change made Blue Planet tremble violently.
To this day, the status of the Iron-eating Beasts on Blue Planet and Dong Huang was already extraordinary. Not only was it Dong Huang’s national treasure, but it was also Blue Planet’s star treasure. After continuous reproduction, their number had also grown from a few thousand in the entire Dong Huang to millions.
Ping Cheng, Bamboo Stone Dojo.
Although the owner of Bamboo Stone Dojo, “Bamboo Stone Legend Lin Hongnian”, had long had many higher positions and was even in charge of many Iron-eating Beast Army, he still didn’t give up on this small dojo and still cultivated the local Beast Tamers and Iron-eating Beasts in Ping Cheng.
Whenever he was free, he would return here to rest and see the changes in his hometown.
On the training ground, Lin Hongnian and an Iron-eating Beast stood at a high place. They looked at a group of young boys and girls and a group of little Iron-eating Beast cubs training arduously and couldn’t help but feel gratified.
However, in the next moment, an unexpected thing happened. On the training ground, the Awakening-level little Iron-eating Beasts were stunned on the spot. Then, they raised their heads and let out long cries, hitting the sky. The boiling of their blood stunned them.
What happened next made even Lin Hongnian, the Iron-eating Beast expert, widen his eyes.
Boom!!
Faint metal law ripples began to appear on the Iron-eating Beasts’ bodies, as if their divine bloodlines had awakened, and their auras increased greatly.
“Wuu!!” It wasn’t just them. Even the Iron-eating Beast beside Lin Hongnian sensed the resonance of their bloodline power, as if some supreme existence had given them favors.
“Why!” In Bamboo Stone Dojo, the apprentices were rather shocked to see the change in their pets.
This situation…
Lin Hongnian was certain that he had encountered it before. It was when Blue Planet advanced to a high-level planet. All the lives on Blue Planet had received blessings and improved their strength.
Then now…
The bloodline power of the Iron-eating Beasts boiled and suddenly increased. They even came into contact with the bloodline of a god. Could it be…
“Is it that kid?” Lin Hongnian suddenly raised his head and wanted to look at the starry sky. “Xiu Zhu, be more careful!!”
At this moment, all of Dong Huang and all the Iron-eating Beasts on Blue Planet received kindness because a super divine was born in their race. Their bloodline power was sublimated.
Such a change was enough to cause the entire country to tremble.
And this was only the beginning. An even more ridiculous scene even appeared on the Green Silkworm, Baby Ginseng, Water Slime, and a bunch of transcendent races.
Although it wasn’t as ridiculous as the Iron-eating Beasts, it was enough to shock Blue Planet, because their race number far exceeded the Iron-eating Beasts.
Be it Ping Cheng, Icefield, Ancient Capital, Divine Capital, Tingxiang, or the Seven Islands, the figures of the Green Silkworms were everywhere. At this moment, these Green Silkworms seemed to have obtained a super large-scale “Butterfly God Blessing”.
This miracle that had once been created by Lin Feng’s Butterfly God in Dong Huang was now happening to the Green Silkworms all over Blue Planet.
However, unlike the small fights like the Butterfly God, even if it was some poor villages that could only eat some ordinary plant leaves, the extremely weak Green Silkworm could still feel the power that was enough to change the level of their race, enough to support them to turn into cocoons and butterflies and become commander creatures.
In the blink of an eye, countless butterflies broke out of their cocoons and were born. Blue Planet entered an unprecedented butterfly mating era. Countless Green Silkworms were born, causing the number of Green Silkworms, which was originally one of the most numerous transcendent races, to increase again.
Of course, the most ridiculous thing still happened to the ginseng baby race.
As a supplement race, the status of the ginseng baby in nature was even lower than the Green Silkworm. The Green Silkworm at least had the ability to change its fate and evolve into an attack method. However, apart from Shi Yu’s ginseng baby, the other ginseng babies had always been supplement lives.
However, at this moment, every ginseng baby’s bloodline actually awakened for the second time under fear. An ordinary battle skill appeared in its mind.
Although this battle skill could be said to be a low-level skill, it was nothing compared to those powerful skills.
But for Baby Ginseng, who didn’t have any battle power, it was undoubtedly a new start.
Even if most ginseng babies still couldn’t escape the hunt of their natural enemies, there would always be some talented, hardworking, and unwilling ginseng babies who would rely on this battle skill inheritance to escape their fate of being food and become the next ginseng emperor.
Water Slimes that had obtained the cleansing skill… Duckbill Beasts that had awakened their knight spirit and could condense water into a cleansing sword… Many races obtained a new evolution path at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1808: Super Divine Shi Yu (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1808: Super Divine Shi Yu (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Perhaps, because of his existence, some transcendent races will become the protagonists of the next era.” Blue Planet’s Will stared at Blue Planet and sensed the evolution of some lives on Blue Planet. It looked forward to these transcendent races related to Shi Yu’s pets creating new legends ten or a hundred years later.
“Two months have passed. Has Shi Yu not completed the refinement?”
The changes on Blue Planet also made the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the others impatient to wait for Shi Yu to come out of seclusion.
At this moment, Shi Yu had no concept of time at all. He only knew that he and his pets were digesting the power of this source of transcendence with all their might.
At this moment, six suns of transcendent had already appeared behind Eleven, marking that it was already close to transcendent high-level. As soon as it broke through, it had already completed the foundation that countless super divines couldn’t accumulate for millions or tens of millions of years.
The situation on the other pets was similar. There were no less than five sources of transcendence on each pet. Thinking of the World King’s words, Shi Yu was silent. This was not just everyone being able to fuse with the source of transcendence. This was simply cheating. As expected of the strongest quality source of transcendence in the era.
Through the feedback of his pet, Shi Yu’s realm had also reached an extremely high level.
In his Beast Taming Star Domain, a total of nine Suns of Transcendence hung, indicating that his realm had already reached transcendent 9. He was only a step away from the peak of the super divine level.
At this moment, the refinement of the transcendent origin seemed to have calmed down. Shi Yu and the others’ realms no longer had an especially huge increase.
“There’s finally a change.”
A trace of joy flashed in Shi Yu’s eyes as he took out the skill index.
What made his balls hurt was that even now, the skill index still didn’t have the effect of increasing transcendent divine skills.
On the contrary, a new page was added, and something that looked like a message appeared.
Also, a new page was added, and something that looked like a star map appeared.
Shi Yu first looked at the message.
“Hello, after reincarnation, when you see this message, I believe your strength is already close to the peak of the universe.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“You might have a lot of questions, but that’s not important. The information I can transmit to you is limited. Next, I’ll explain two questions to you.”
“First, the origin of the index. It’s made by me and some people through cosmic treasures like the Universe Tree in your lost memories. Its existence should have given you a lot of convenience, but this is the end. It will be very difficult for it to give you new help on the path of the universe. You have to work hard yourself.”
“However, the index has another function, which is to help you find the remaining era ruins. Next, you can treat it as a ruins radar to find your own cosmic opportunities.”
“Second, the goal of transmigrating is actually something I don’t want either, but my aptitude is outstanding. I was chosen by some guys to be a savior and hope that I can become the holder of the universe. If you want to know more, you can search for an era ruin that requires five Blue Planet humans to open. There might be more gains over there.”
“That’s all. If you’ve already established more connections and really don’t want to take the risk of becoming the holder of the universe, it’s alright. Your own happiness is the most important. In any case, those people don’t have much hope. So be it if the contract is abandoned. Just treat it as a failure. Moreover, it’s not impossible for me to become the holder of the universe. Those guys still have another backup plan. Well, it’s related to the ruins I mentioned just now. They didn’t tell me what it is. You need to understand it yourself. That’s all. Heh.”
Shi Yu was speechless.
To be honest, when he saw this content, Shi Yu’s mood should have been shocked and complicated.
But at this moment, there was only calmness.
Firstly, he had long suspected the origin of the skill index. If at the start, he could still explain that this was his second accompanying talent, then after knowing that he came from the last era, he had reason to suspect that this skill index was a cheat left to him when he was strong in the last era to allow him to grow quickly.
“Something made by many cosmic treasures such as the Universe Tree of the previous era and the power of some other experts? No wonder it’s so abnormal,” Shi Yu said.
“However, I’m very satisfied that I can leave such a treasure for me, but I can’t continue to cheat and reach the cosmic level. I’m very unhappy… Forget it, at least I still have one last function.”
“In addition, my transmigration indeed has some mission. Is it also to become the holder of the universe? From the looks of it, some experts from the last era chose me. Why do I have to choose the holder of the universe from an era away…”
“Could it be that after becoming the holder of the universe, it can even revive the lives that died in the last era? It can even make the era that has already been destroyed appear again in a parallel universe?”
“This way, these experts can appear in this world again.”
“Those ancient era civilizations that have already walked into the tomb can also be reborn again.”
Shi Yu suddenly had a bold guess, but he felt that it was abnormally reasonable. After all, if it wasn’t to revive, who would spend so much effort to nurture a cosmic holder?
“Who are the experts I mentioned?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1809: Super Divine Shi Yu (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1809: Super Divine Shi Yu (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Damn it, he was halfway through his sentence.
Moreover, the ruins he was talking about should be the ruins of the Earth Era that Goddess Wa also wanted to enter very much.
Goddess Wa felt that there was something in that ruin that attracted her very much, so she had a deep obsession with entering.
And now, in his previous life, he had also mentioned this ruin. It looked like there was really something impressive hidden in this ruin.
“It’s time to go out.”
At this moment, under Shi Yu’s perception, all his pets had already reached the extreme of the mid-stage super divine level, and he was even at the extreme of the high-stage super divine level. Now, Shi Yu felt that even compared to Goddess Wa, his strength might not be bad. With all his pets added together, it might not be strange for him to defeat Goddess Wa.
A single pet could also have the strength of a peak super divine under his strengthening, and it was a very strong peak super divine.
This time, it was completely invincible below the cosmic level.
With such strength, Shi Yu also knew that it was time to solve all his doubts and help his pets complete the final cultivation and find the path to the universe.
“Little ones, let’s go.”
“Wuu!!!” Eleven and the others answered one by one.
On Blue Planet, Shi Yu left the cultivation environment and flew above Blue Planet.
“Eh, not bad.” Just as he came out, Shi Yu sensed the change in Blue Planet and his eyes lit up.
No wonder the Blue Planet’s Will asked him to break through on his mother planet. He felt that Blue Planet’s current level was already close to the peak of the super divine level. It might also have the strength to transcend nine times.
This was also right. He… Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and so many other super divine creatures were all creatures of Blue Planet. If they all broke through on Blue Planet at the moment, the benefits Blue Planet obtained would definitely not be small. The feedback they obtained should be similar to his.
“I’m back!!!” After Shi Yu came out, his telepathy enveloped the entire Blue Planet.
His shout made the Blue Planet’s Will, Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, and the others who were waiting for him sigh.
It could be considered a successful breakthrough.
Although no one had come close to Blue Planet during this period of time to disturb Shi Yu’s breakthrough, they were still a little worried that Shi Yu had yet to successfully break through.
Now that Shi Yu had completed his breakthrough, the huge rock in everyone’s hearts finally fell.
Inatella.
Shi Yu stood in front of the Blue Planet’s Will. Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, and the others appeared one after another.
Apart from that, a special figure appeared here.
Seeing her, even Emperor Shi couldn’t help but bow slightly. On Blue Planet, Emperor Shi only needed to be extremely respectful to two people. One was Blue Planet’s Will. She was the mother planet that nurtured all creatures on Blue Planet. The other was Goddess Wa, the creator of the Blue Planet’s human race.
“Senior Wa, thank you for guarding me.” Shi Yu was also grateful to Goddess Wa for appearing.
“There’s no need to thank me,” Goddess Wa said. “I didn’t expect that your strength would already be close to the peak of the universe in such a short period of time.”
“That’s right, that’s right.” Lin Feng was envious.
“I also obtained a lot of benefits from Shi Yu’s breakthrough this time.” Blue Planet’s Will felt that super divine wasn’t Shi Yu’s end. If Shi Yu could break through to the cosmic level, it might also have a chance to break through to the cosmic level.
After all, even the World King Planet didn’t nurture or give birth to cosmic-level creatures.
“What do you think next?” the Space Emperor asked Shi Yu.
Not long ago, Shi Yu was still a newbie from a rural galaxy who had just entered the Floating Realm. Now, Shi Yu had already become a figure that could shake the universe with a casual shake. His actions and ideas would also trigger the change in the situation in the starry sky of the universe to a certain extent.
Shi Yu said, “Let’s not talk about anything else first. Of course, we have to explore the ruins of Earth that Goddess Wa mentioned as soon as possible.”
“Now, I, Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, and Senior Lin Feng are all super divine. We’re just short of one person to fulfill the conditions to open the ruins.”
Goddess Wa said, “I know. I already have other candidates. Since you’ve already broken through, next, I’ll bring those few people to specially train for a period of time. I hope a new super divine can be born among them as soon as possible.”
Blue Planet’s Will said, “Goddess Wa plans to personally bring Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, Lu Qingyi, Divine Source, and the others to train. Among them, choose the next super divine.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1810: Yue Maiden is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 1810: Yue Maiden is Here
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Goddess Wa was going to be a coach???
Shi Yu said, “Really? That’s great.”
Shi Yu originally thought that this mission would fall on him. Since Goddess Wa had taken the initiative to suggest it, he could slack off and do his own thing before waiting for the results.
“Then as for me, I plan to continue cultivating for a while.”
“Although I’ve already broken through, my realm hasn’t stabilized.”
“It’s time to find the path to the cosmic-level,” Shi Yu said.
“Cosmic-level path…” Goddess Wa was silent. “I wish you success.”
Although the path to the cosmic level was very difficult, it might not be that difficult for Shi Yu to do.
The seventh cosmic emperor… Goddess Wa also acknowledged Shi Yu’s title.
These people gathered quickly and dispersed quickly. As Shi Yu broke through and Goddess Wa revived, the Blue Planet lineage completely became a huge faction that couldn’t be ignored in the universe. If the empress was included, it was definitely the sixth cosmic-level faction in the universe.
At this moment, for the people on Blue Planet, it was to continue strengthening and consolidating this advantage.
On Blue Planet, when Shi Yu saw Goddess Wa take Divine Source and the others away, he recalled the Empress who had taken the gem cat away and was momentarily filled with emotions.
He returned to Ping Cheng and the Icefield Snow Mountain and began the second round of seclusion cultivation.
He wanted to perfect the environment of some Beast Taming Star Domains and adapt to the new level of Beast Taming Talent. At the same time, he also wanted to conceptualize the cosmic path of his pets.
As for the pets, without the help of the skill index, they also had to try their best to see if they could break through the limit of the transcendent divine skill.
Next, the same track was the real test of their team’s throne.
“Ling, let’s analyze where everyone’s cosmic path is.”
On the icy plain, Shi Yu was holding a big hotpot and eating hot boiled beef as he communicated with Ling.
“There’s no need for me to say anything. Eleven’s cosmic-level path should be in the racial ability of ‘eating metal can be converted into metal hardening armor’, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“That’s right,” Ling said. “Therefore, the path of evolution might still be the same as back then. Either it eats cosmic treasure-level metals or a portion of cosmic-level metal elemental creatures.”
“A cosmic treasure-level metal might not be enough. With a cosmic treasure, it can at most give birth to super divine levels. It’s impossible at the cosmic level, and there’s even less of a cosmic-level metal elemental creature in the universe. Therefore, the path is broken.”
“Of course, I’ve thought of a way to create my own path,” Ling said.
“Tell me about it,” Shi Yu said.
“Master, do you still remember Yue Maiden?” Ling said.
“Yes…” Shi Yu nodded and said, “I remember. What’s the matter?”
“The Beast Taming Talent of the Yue Maiden, plunder, also has a very special effect. Do you remember that she can plunder the Beast Taming Talent of others and the abilities of other lives in the form of props?”
“Although none of the current six cosmic life forms are metal-element life forms, at their level, they definitely have the ability of the metal element. As long as we also learn this talent and find some metal-element cosmic treasures to extract their metal-element power and attach it to the metal-element cosmic treasure, we might be able to create powerful metal-element evolution tools.”
“The quality alone isn’t enough to become a cosmic level, but when combined, there must be hope.”
“Cough, cough, cough.” After Ling finished speaking, Shi Yu coughed dryly and said, “It’s a little brutal.”
“If we nurture a cosmic level, we have to fight other cosmic levels. Even if it’s not that we haven’t become the holders of the universe, this universe will be destroyed first. A cosmic level battle will really destroy the cosmic civilization.”
Ling said, “There are also those who aren’t brutal, and that’s to plunder their Beast Taming Talent.”
“Oh??” Shi Yu was stunned. “What do you mean?”
“Master, isn’t your skill index a tool you created yourself?”
“We can plunder our Beast Taming Talent through plundering abilities.”
“Master, think about it. The Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming Talent can strengthen the strength of the pet. Even if the pet hasn’t reached the cosmic level, as long as you reach the cosmic level, your Beast Taming Ability can still strengthen the pet to cosmic battle power.”
“And what if pets can obtain this increase permanently without relying on Beast Tamers?”
“Let me give you an example. If you cultivate another metal-element strengthening talent, after you reach the cosmic level, if your metal-element strengthening talent and Taiji Domain talent can materialize, they will definitely be cosmic treasure-level precious artifacts. If you can fuse the Taiji Domain and the metal-element strengthening talent into a new tool and materialize them for Eleven to eat and let these permanently belong to it, it might be able to naturally rely on this power to break through to the cosmic level.”
“But this way, Master, you might lose these Beast Taming Talents. For example, although there’s still a possibility of cultivating the metal-element strengthening talent again, it’s not necessarily the case for rare talents like the Taiji Domain.”
“Moreover, plundering talent can only be plundered when a person is on the verge of death. Therefore, if you choose this method, you still need to undergo in-depth research and modification. Otherwise, it’s too dangerous for you.”
After Ling finished speaking, Shi Yu touched his chin and thought. Deprive the Taiji Domain from his body and fuse it into a metal-element cosmic treasure to create an exclusive evolution tool, Yin Yang Metal?
It sounded feasible. Shi Yu said, “This sounds much more reliable than messing with other cosmic levels. Initially, my Beast Taming Talent was also cultivated to assist you. If I can materialize it and give it to you permanently, it will save me the trouble of consuming my physical strength to strengthen you in the future.”
“This method can be a backup. If the Taiji Domain is Eleven’s, then the Green Dragon Domain will still be left to Buggy. Unfortunately, apart from these two special Beast Taming Talents, the other Beast Taming Talents are relatively lousy. I feel that it’s not very useful.”
“Perhaps next, I can collect some rare Beast Taming Talents to cultivate,” Shi Yu said.
“However, this method isn’t suitable for all pets,” Shi Yu said. “Only Eleven and Buggy evolve by eating.”
“Eleven eats metal, while Buggy eats some special resources to use worm silk to turn cocoons into butterflies.”
“But people like you can’t use this method.”
“For example, Baby Ginseng, its most basic and original racial talent… What’s it again? Ordinary Baby Ginseng races constantly increase their nourishing effects and evolve from there. Our family’s evolution is crooked. If it wants to break through to the cosmic level, according to normal logic, it definitely won’t attain the Dao with strength, but it still has to work hard on nourishing stats.”
“I have to nurture it into the strongest supplement before it has any hope of reaching the cosmic level?”
“Well, wait a minute, I think I can still increase the nourishing effect of the Enhancement Ginseng Baby by eating. It’s alright, it’s alright.”
[Ginseng Baby: …]
“However, Chi Tong, its most basic and source talent… I didn’t expect that possession counts. However, how do I nurture and develop it? Or do you mean that not every life form has the aptitude to become a cosmic level…”
Chi Tong’s predecessor was a human and a phoenix. Now, it was a heroic spirit. It was fundamentally different from Eleven and the others.
“Susu, on the other hand, is definitely an extreme cleansing power. Perhaps it can cleanse a Dark King… Damn, why did it go to fight a cosmic level again?” Shi Yu had a headache.
“And you, as a mechanical life form, is the most basic racial talent at the intelligence level? Or do you need to load a cosmic-level phantom beast spirit as a soul core to strengthen yourselves, just like how Little Ji fused the Tyrant Dragon, Earth Dragon, and Earth Divine Dragon Phantom to strengthen itself in succession?”
Ling: “I don’t know, but if I choose the wrong path, I might fail to break through like Goddess Wa and suffer a very serious backlash.”
“Even Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng’s guess can’t be guaranteed to be 100% correct now. However, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Susu should be relatively reliable. We can think of a way to help them clear their path first.”
“There’s no hurry for Chi Tong and me.”
“Let me think,” Shi Yu said. “In short, we have to collect more treasures of this level next. If a peak super divine wants to strengthen his strength further, he has to prepare more cosmic treasures as a foundation.”
“Well, when I see the empress again, I’ll ask her about the existing cosmic treasure. Since she knows about the Universe Tree, she definitely knows other things. There’s also the era ruins recorded in the skill index. Perhaps there are still cosmic treasures from other eras. It’s also a way out.”
“Otherwise, I wouldn’t have asked me to find the path to the universe from these era ruins.”
“There’s also the Plunder Talent,” Ling said. “Unfortunately, Senior Lu was taken away by Goddess Wa. Otherwise, with Susu’s current strength, its inheritance water drop should be able to perfectly replicate the Plunder Talent and pass it to you.”
“Wait for Senior Lu and the others to return?” Ling asked.
Shi Yu said, “Alright, forget it. Let’s not wait anymore. I’m a little anxious to study it in detail. Let’s go find the Blue Planet’s Will.”
Ling was stunned. “Wait, don’t tell me you want to…”
“Hehe, that’s right. With Blue Planet’s current level, there shouldn’t be any pressure to revive an ancient from the totem era, right?”
“I originally wanted to find the Yue Maiden inheritance through Qi, but…”
“I know that casually transmigrating into space and time will reduce the lifespan of the universe. We can’t mess around anymore, or we’ll be targeted by the cosmic overlord sooner or later.”
“But it doesn’t matter if we don’t transmigrate. We can just let Blue Planet revive that Yue Maiden into the modern era. It’s the same if we directly take our talent from her.”
Reviving the Yue Maiden of the totem era and inviting her to the modern era! Just like Emperor Wu and the others!
Ling was speechless. The Great Demon King Yue Maiden, who specialized in plundering other people’s abilities in the totem era, definitely didn’t expect that someone would specially revive her in the future just to plunder her talent. It was karma.

chapters.title: Chapter 1811: Teacher Yue (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1811: Teacher Yue (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu made up his mind and didn’t want to go to Inatella.
Instead, he directly called for the Blue Planet’s Will and asked her to descend.
“What is it?”
A few days after everyone left, the Blue Planet’s Will saw Shi Yu looking for it again and felt that nothing good would happen to him.
“Can you help revive someone?” Shi Yu said.
“With your current ability, you should be able to fish someone out of the long river of history, right?”
Blue Planet was silent.
“Who is it?”
Shi Yu grinned. “A Legendary Beast Tamer from the totem era named Yue Maiden. She’s active in the Dong Huang Continent and is very close to the Beast Taming Era. The difficulty of reviving shouldn’t be high, right?”
“If it were when I just advanced, even with the soil of Goddess Wa, it would be difficult for me to revive the ancients of the totem era.”
“But thanks to your breakthrough, with my current realm, there shouldn’t be a problem.”
“Then I’ll leave it to you!” Shi Yu said.
The Blue Planet’s Will nodded. It wasn’t difficult for her to do Shi Yu’s little request. Although she didn’t know what Shi Yu wanted, Shi Yu definitely had his own reasons for asking her to revive this person.
Soon, the Blue Planet’s Will began to consume the power of the world and search for traces of the Yue Maiden whom Shi Yu mentioned in the long river of history.
At this moment, Shi Yu sensitively discovered that with his current attainments in the power of space and time, he could actually invade the ability of the Blue Planet’s Will.
“Can I?” Shi Yu asked.
Blue Planet’s Will: “?”
“Alright, with your memories as a medium, it’s easier to find.”
After obtaining the tacit approval of the Blue Planet’s Will, Shi Yu’s consciousness connected to Blue Planet and began to search for traces of the Yue Maiden in the long river of history with her perspective.
[Change!]
[Change!]
Soon, according to the historical memories provided by Shi Yu as a medium, they successfully found the Yue Maiden.
In Blue Planet and Shi Yu’s perspective, a little girl who might not be more than ten years old with a goatee appeared.
She held the stone mirror and aimed at the rocks and trees by the roadside, shining it randomly.
Under the illumination of the stone mirror, a surprising scene occurred.
Anything reflected in the mirror changed.
The stone evolved into an elemental life form and turned into a small fist stone.
The tree opened its eyes, obtained its feet, and became a treant.
Shi Yu still remembered this scene. The Yue Maiden should have used the “Plundering Talent” to plunder someone’s Awakening Talent and created it into a toy. Then, she played with it happily.
Back then, it was also because of this Awakening Mirror that Shi Yu developed the idea of nurturing mechanical phantom beasts.
“It’s her,” Shi Yu said.
Next, Shi Yu and the Blue Planet’s Will briefly looked at the life of the Yue Maiden.
Although Shi Yu had heard his senior introduce many of the Yue Maiden’s deeds, he felt more emotional now that he had personally understood them.
She was born in that chaotic totem era. She had never seen her parents since she was born. She was an orphan, an abandoned orphan.
In that era, boys were favored over girls. Many girls were abandoned when they were born, and the Yue Maiden was one of them.
She was unlucky and lucky. Although she was abandoned, she was also adopted by a powerful transcendent creature. This transcendent creature was a rare “transcendent creature of a lover”. Perhaps it was just like how in the eyes of humans, kittens were very cute and would give charity to stray cats. In its eyes, humans might also be very cute creatures, so the Yue Maiden was adopted.
Not only did this transcendent creature take in the Yue Maiden, but it also took in many orphans and brought them to survive, hunt, and grow in the mountains.
At this moment, the Yue Maiden had many playmates and had a relatively happy childhood.
Moreover, she was also the most talented among everyone. At the age of seven, she had automatically awakened the Beast Taming Space. Her talent could be said to be at the top in the history of the human race on Blue Planet.
However, something unexpected happened. When the Yue Maiden was in her early teens, they were completely wiped out because they encountered an even stronger transcendent creature. Apart from the Yue Maiden who escaped, everyone died.
Then, the Yue Maiden, who was in her early teens, began to wander in the mountain alone, hunting alone, growing alone, and encountering life-and-death crises countless times…
Because of her talent, she was hated by everyone and encountered a lot. Because she was adopted by transcendent creatures, it was very difficult for her to integrate into normal human society.
After experiencing countless setbacks, she became a powerful Beast Tamer, but she was forced to become stronger. After becoming stronger, although the Yue Maiden was infamous, she didn’t have much ambition. She only inherited the will of that transcendent creature and took in many orphans like her who had been abandoned in the wilderness, nurturing them into adults, and establishing a horde that specialized in adopting abandoned people.
After the horde got on track, the Yue Maiden left most of her pets behind and chose to leave with an arms-type pet.
At this moment, she was still very young. She was only in her forties and had already stood at the peak of the totem era, but because her talent was harmful and she had many hidden injuries, she was already like an old woman.
Shi Yu had also experienced this feeling. F*ck, the first time he added some super skills, it almost made him an old man.
Not long after the Yue Maiden sensed that she had only a few years left to live, she brought the arms-type pet that had accompanied her the longest and entered life and death seclusion to wait for death.
“No wonder.”
After watching the life of the Yue Maiden, Shi Yu recalled the shadow of history he had seen on the Talent Bead.
No wonder there were so many children accompanying the Yue Maiden. No wonder she created so many toys and threw them to those children to play with.

chapters.title: Chapter 1812: Teacher Yue (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1812: Teacher Yue (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
After seeing more history, Shi Yu had a deeper understanding of the Yue Maiden.
“She’s indeed a legendary figure with talent potential not inferior to Emperor Wu, the Empress, the Dragon Emperor, and the others,” the Blue Planet’s Will said. “In this era, she might be able to grow into a super divine. Lu Qingyi’s talent was inherited from her, right?”
“Yes.”
“Next, I’ll imprint the state when her body is at its peak and has the greatest potential to revive her.”
“Please,” Shi Yu said.
Soon, under the power of the Blue Planet’s Will, a black-haired woman in her twenties appeared on the icy plain. She was like a statue, standing alone and calmly on the snow, emitting an indifferent and distant aura.
This person was the Yue Maiden who was also famous in the totem era and wasn’t liked by humans and foreign races.
The Yue Maiden slowly opened her eyes. Then, a cold glint suddenly shot out of her eyes as she looked at Shi Yu in front of her warily.
Until now, she was still a little dizzy and didn’t know what had happened. However, her beast-like vigilance made her feel that something was wrong with her state.
Especially the strange-looking man in front of him. He looked like an ordinary person, but he vaguely gave him a threatening feeling.
Of course, as the strongest Legendary Beast Tamer, the Yue Maiden was confident that she could deal with any enemy.
After Blue Planet completed its mission, its will left the icy plain, leaving the venue to Shi Yu and the Yue Maiden who had just been revived.
“I remember…”
At this moment, as time passed and the baptism of time, the Yue Maiden finally remembered something. She was silent. She remembered that she should have died.
Why…
The power of her Legendary Beast Tamer and her plundering talent were still there. Moreover, this young body with strong vitality made the Yue Maiden feel that it was unreal.
There was also the sword lying in the Beast Taming Space. She remembered that she had also let her leave at the end.
Now, the other party was still beside him.
Moreover, she suddenly discovered the changes in Blue Planet. This place had become very unfamiliar. The snowfield in front of her was even ridiculously large, overlapping countless spaces.
“Hello, Senior Yue Maiden,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Who are you?” The Yue Maiden looked at Shi Yu coldly.
“Well, how should I put it?” Shi Yu said. “You can take it that I’m a Beast Tamer from the later era who has received your favor.”
“A senior of mine inherited your plunder inheritance, and I’ve also obtained an Awakening Mirror that contains an Awakening Talent and a blank Talent Bead. They’ve helped me a lot. This should be your masterpiece, Senior Yue Maiden, right?”
Yue Maiden was stunned. “What year is it now?”
Shi Yu said, “8,000 years after you die.”
“You revived me???” No matter how slow the Yue Maiden was, she realized something. She looked at Shi Yu solemnly and asked.
“That’s right,” Shi Yu said. “After understanding your deeds, Senior Yue Maiden, I feel that a legendary figure like you shouldn’t end in the incomplete era where the laws of that world were suppressed.”
“Now, the laws of Blue Planet have revived, and the path to becoming a god has already opened. Everyone can pursue a higher realm above the legendary level. With your talent, it’s a pity to end your life so early.”
“You’re lying,” the Yue Maiden said.
“How is that possible?” Shi Yu said. He had a super divine level telepathy talent. Even if he was really lying, how could a legendary like him tell? Damn it.
“Instinct.”
“Tell me your goal.”
“Alright, alright~” Shi Yu said, “Then I’ll be direct. I’ve taken a fancy to your talent. Give your talent to me. How about that?”
The Yue Maiden sneered. She didn’t expect that it would finally be her turn after plundering countless talents in her life.
She immediately wanted to summon her pet and fight Shi Yu for 300 rounds. She didn’t plan to let Shi Yu succeed.
However, Shi Yu’s next words made her stop.
“In exchange, I’ll provide you with an identity in this era and let you integrate into this era very well to pursue a higher realm.”
“Don’t worry, my method is much calmer. It’s not plundering, but replicating. It won’t affect you at all. I won’t let you lose your plundering talent, nor will I let you do anything.”
“Unfortunately, my senior hasn’t been around recently. Otherwise, I would have just looked for her directly. I wouldn’t have spent so much effort to awaken you, Senior.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Not interested,” the Yue Maiden said.
“I don’t trust you. I won’t give you my talent.”
“You’re worried that I’ll use my talent to wreak havoc in all directions??” Shi Yu said.
“Yes,” the Yue Maiden said.
“My sister, I still need your talent if I want to wreak havoc everywhere.” Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to explain to her. “Forget it, then I don’t want your talent anymore. In addition, you’re already alive, so I don’t plan to send you back. You don’t want to die that early anyway, right?”
“I’m in seclusion because I’ve gathered too much aggro on myself. In addition, I don’t have much lifespan to begin with.”
“Now, since you have a new life, why don’t you do something meaningful?”
“For example, in the city beside us, an orphanage called Starting Point has recently opened. I can recommend you to be the dean. Don’t you like children very much? Or, you can go to school to be a teacher. I remember that you’ve cultivated many experts, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1813: Teacher Yue (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1813: Teacher Yue (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu planned to directly let Susu record the other party’s talent in the inheritance water drop without anyone noticing.
He could clearly snatch it directly, so why did he have to spend so much effort to explain!
He was too ethical.
In any case, it was impossible for the Yue Maiden to sense it.
“Dean? Teacher?”
“You can understand it as a horde that specializes in adopting and nurturing orphans. No, students aren’t orphans. In short, teachers are the professions that teach a group of young Beast Tamers, similar to masters.”
“Don’t you know my reputation?” the Yue Maiden said.
“I know, but it’s precisely because I know more that I believe you,” Shi Yu said. “This era is no longer your era. Let’s experience it first. If you don’t like it, you can commit suicide. I won’t stop you.”
Yue Maiden was silent. To be honest, she was also very interested in this era. Although she didn’t know what kind of conspiracy Shi Yu had…
After sensing the opportunity to reach the divine level, she also wanted to enter the divine level very much to see the scenery.
“I indeed don’t want to die so early.”
“So, do you want to be a teacher or a dean?”
“If I get a job, I can at least earn a living and earn some resources. In this era, I can’t rely on snatching like you at that time. Every big city has a divine-level presiding over it. Although you’re also very strong, a divine-level is enough to crush non-divines.”
“Teacher,” the Yue Maiden said directly.
“Sure.”
“Then I’ll recommend you to be an archeology teacher at Ancient Capital University. Well, let’s talk about the history of the totem era.” Shi Yu dug his ears. This time, the professions matched.
Next, Shi Yu got Ling to invade the Dong Huang Network and help the Yue Maiden create a modern identity to make it easier to do things.
Then, he spoke to the air in front of the Yue Maiden.
“Principal Feng, are you there?”
His telepathy directly connected from Ping Cheng to the Ancient Capital.
“Pfft.” Principal Feng, who was drinking tea in retirement, spat it out directly. He was shocked. When he heard a familiar voice, he immediately got up from the courtyard.
“Shi Yu??”
“It’s me.”
The current Principal Feng could be said to be a big winner in life. Although he wasn’t strong and his level wasn’t high, with his identity here, even top-notch gods from the World King Planet had to be polite to him.
Now, the status of those related to Shi Yu had risen.
This was because Shi Yu’s deeds of competing for the source of transcendence in the universe had already begun to spread on Blue Planet. They were transmitted to Blue Planet by people from World King Planet.
Now, most people on Blue Planet knew that a ridiculous existence had walked out of Blue Planet. Now, it had already stood at the top of the universe. For the younger generation of Blue Planet, such as Gao Xuan and the others, becoming the champion of the World Tournament and ascending to the World King Planet was as difficult as ascending to the heavens.
As for Shi Yu, not only had he already become first in the God Sealing Battle and the strongest demigod, but he had also become first in the divine level and killed super divines above his level. Now, there was even news that Shi Yu had already killed hundreds of super divines, approached the limit of the Universe Throne, and ranked in the top ten of the battle power universe. It was simply shocking to everyone.
Anyone would be in a daze at this news. In fact, due to their limited horizons, they had no idea how terrifying this heaven-defying battle result was.
In short, although Shi Yu hadn’t left Blue Planet for long, he had already completely become a legendary figure in just a few years. Apart from those who had interacted with Shi Yu, those who had never been related to Shi Yu would feel like they were in a dream when they heard the name Shi Yu.
“You’re free??” Principal Feng was very surprised to see a busy person like Shi Yu looking for him. He didn’t understand what else Shi Yu wanted from him. He couldn’t be here to show respect to him, right?
“Is Ancient Capital University still lacking teachers? I want to introduce someone to be a teacher,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes, battle department, archeology department, and feeding department are fine,” Shi Yu said as he glanced at the Yue Maiden.
As for the Yue Maiden, she was also frowning. She looked at Shi Yu, who was muttering to himself. She observed the surrounding endless snowfield environment. Although she guessed that Shi Yu was using telepathy, this range…
“Is the person you recommended strong?” Principal Feng asked.
Such a small matter naturally didn’t matter. With Shi Yu’s current reputation, it wasn’t a problem for Dong Huang to raise ten thousand idle people for Shi Yu, let alone a position.
However, if he really wanted to participate in the work, he still had to understand the person’s abilities.
“An ordinary legendary Beast Tamer,” Shi Yu said as he looked at the Yue Maiden.
Yue Maiden: “?”
Ordinary legendary Beast Tamer?
“But her battle experience should be very rich and she’s good at fighting.”
“In addition, her talent potential is very strong, not inferior to the Space Emperor and the others. She can grow with her students. Her future is promising.”
Principal Feng said, “Sure, sure, you should have said so earlier. It’s a waste of talent to be an ordinary teacher. Recently, the nine major universities have formed an elite class. There are all geniuses who haven’t reached the legendary level, but they definitely have divine-level potential. They have a chance of getting good results in the World Tournament.”
“The initial decision for this elite class is a team of three. Each team has a legendary teacher leading the team. Do you think you can recommend this person to be qualified?”
“If possible, we can choose three students now and let them come into contact.”
“Sure.” Shi Yu looked at the Yue Maiden’s life and knew that her teaching ability wasn’t bad, although what she taught was how to crush enemies…
But such teaching was really necessary for Dong Huang’s group of sheltered students.
“Alright, can you tell me the specific identity of this teacher?” Principal Feng drank his tea again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1814: Teacher Yue (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1814: Teacher Yue (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“I’ll confirm which geniuses are assigned to him.”
“Yue Maiden, the Yue Maiden who plundered talent.”
“Pfft…”
“Can you tell me the history of these 8,000 years?” At this moment, as Shi Yu ended the call, the Yue Maiden said.
“Next, Ancient Capital University will send you three students. Go and ask them.”
“Then am I a teacher or are they teachers?” the Yue Maiden said.
Shi Yu said, “That’s not important. You have something to teach them. They definitely have something to teach you too. Learning from each other can make you better stronger.”
“Moreover, don’t underestimate your next three students. They’re not very old, none of them more than 25 years old. The younger ones are even in their teens, but their strength is very good. They’re definitely not inferior to you back then.”
“Then you can tell me the identities of these people, right?”
“That’s not a problem. There are three people, two men and a woman. The boy is called An Chang. He’s in his twenties and a Level 8 Beast Tamer. He has some connections with you. Once, this guy had two plundering props from you.”
“The other boy’s name is Yin Zhengfan. Back then, he was still an examinee of the same batch as me and I almost lost to him. At that time, I was already an adult and he was only 12 years old. If I were the same age at that time, I would be inferior to him. Now, he should be an adult too. A Level 7 legendary Beast Tamer.”
“There’s also a little girl called Fang Lan. She’s not very old either. She’s not even 20 years old. She’s a Level 7 legendary Beast Tamer. Her ancestor has a super divine level Beast Tamer called the Space Emperor. She’s at the super divine level and above the divine level… She can be said to have massive potential after becoming a super divine.”
“How is it? Do you feel the pressure?”
“I hope you can teach them well and teach them the laws in the natural world… You know the cruel nature of the world,” Shi Yu said. In his opinion, these three guys would enter the starry sky sooner or later. After arriving at the starry sky, although the Blue Planet bloodline had already risen, it was impossible for them to take care of them in all aspects. For example, if it weren’t for the fact that Shi Yu was strong enough and had the support of a bunch of big shots behind him, it would definitely be a life-and-death danger. The entire starry sky of the universe was essentially a ferocious beast that swallowed people.
At this moment, when she heard Shi Yu’s introduction, the Yue Maiden’s heart was still a little stirred. At this age and level, these three students weren’t weaker than her back then.
Were all the Beast Tamers of the later era so strong?
Moreover, there was actually a Beast Tamer who had already reached above the divine level?
Divine level… super divine level… In an instant, the Yue Maiden was even more curious about this era.
“Then what’s your strength?” The Yue Maiden asked the mysterious Shi Yu.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Hehe, so-so. In the top ten of the universe.”
Yue Maiden: “?”
She was certain that she couldn’t get much truth from this person.
At the same time, Fang Lan, An Chang, and Yin Zhengfan received news from the Nine Schools Alliance.
“Brother An Chang, it’s actually you?”
“Are you Yin Zhengfan?”
Somewhere in the Ancient Capital, the three of them gathered. As the leaders of the younger generation of Dong Huang, the three of them were naturally familiar. Among them, An Chang and Fang Lan were both students of Ancient Capital University and were related to Shi Yu. They were more familiar.
