As for Yin Zhengfan, although he was from the Ancient Capital, he had graduated from Imperial Capital University and didn’t have much to do with the two of them.
“It’s actually the three of us in a group? I feel that it’s the strongest combination.” At this moment, Fang Lan had already grown from a junior high school student to a slender and beautiful girl. Her blue dyed black hair was extremely delicate, and her eyes flickered as she looked at the two reliable young men.
“I didn’t expect such an arrangement either. I just don’t know who our teacher-in-charge is,” An Changxiao said with a smile. He already had the strength of a titled legend, and it was the kind of titled legend with strength. There were really very few people who could be his teacher.
An Chang had once given Shi Yu two important tools. Although he wanted to acknowledge Shi Yu as his master and was rejected by Shi Yu, he, who had been chasing Shi Yu, had also received a lot of additional attention. He had even trained in the military and could long take charge.
“Hello.” Yin Zhengfan wore mechanical glasses. Although he was no longer a little boy, he was still so polite.

chapters.title: Chapter 1815: The Worry of the Ginseng Emperor (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1815: The Worry of the Ginseng Emperor (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Sigh.” When An Chang, Fang Lan, Yin Zhengfan, and the others met according to the agreed time, Shi Yu also brought the Yue Maiden over. At this moment, when they saw Shi Yu appear, An Chang, Fang Lan, and Yin Zhengfan instantly widened their eyes and revealed incredulous expressions.
“Senior Shi Yu??”
“Shi Yu??”
They were shocked.
Fang Lan stuttered, “Wait, wait a minute, Senior Shi Yu. Don’t tell me you’re our lead teacher?”
If Shi Yu was the teacher leading the team, they could do whatever they wanted in the entire universe, let alone Blue Planet.
“What are you guys thinking?” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I don’t have time to play with you.”
“That’s true. You’re already an expert in the top ten of the universe.” Yin Zhengfan’s big friend smiled bitterly and looked up at this competitor of the same batch who had almost bullied him to tears.
“You guys can do it sooner or later,” Shi Yu encouraged with a smile.
Yue Maiden: “?”
Why did they keep mentioning the universe?
As expected, times had changed.
How strong was Shi Yu? Who exactly was he? Why did he not only brag that he was in the top ten of the universe, but others also thought so?
The Yue Maiden was immediately extremely curious about Shi Yu.
“Your teacher-in-charge is the person beside me. I’m just bringing her over to introduce her to you. You can call her Teacher Yue Maiden. Well, she just appeared recently and doesn’t know much about the outside world. Next, you can bring her to the outside world to train, but Teacher Yue Maiden’s battle power is still very strong.”
“Yue Maiden??” Upon hearing this name, An Chang was shocked. However, he suddenly shook his head and treated it as a common name.
“Alright, I’m leaving.”
“Work hard~”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he disappeared with an instant transmission, leaving the Yue Maiden, Fang Lan, and the others. An Chang and the others wanted to keep Shi Yu for a meal, but they didn’t have time to say it.
At this moment, the Yue Maiden looked at An Chang, Fang Lan, Yin Zhengfan, and the others. Although there was no intrinsic difference in their age from Shi Yu, observing these children, the Yue Maiden felt that they were much more normal than Shi Yu. At least she could see the hearts of the three at a glance.
“Teacher Yue.” An Chang and the others immediately greeted politely. Since Teacher Yue came with Shi Yu, she definitely had her own unique points.
He needed to be humble.
“Well…” The Yue Maiden said, “Sorry, I didn’t bring any greeting gifts. When I have the chance and find a suitable hunting target, I’ll make a gift for you.”
The three of them: ???
When the Yue Maiden saw that Shi Yu actually trusted her so much and was willing to teach these three Beast Tamers with extraordinary potential to her, she was silent for a moment. Well, if it was really as Shi Yu said, it was fine to give her talent to Shi Yu when she understood him more.
Moreover, her life was revived by the other party.
“Susu, the recording is successful, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“Ning!! (Copy.)” Susu said.
“As expected of us. We obtained the Yue Maiden’s talent without her noticing,” Shi Yu said. “Alright, it’s time to return to cultivate and plunder her talent…”
“How long do you think I have to sleep to cultivate to Level 11?”
Everyone was silent. They knew that the cultivation Shi Yu mentioned was definitely sleeping.
“The most important thing is not level, but modification. However, if the level is high, its control might be stronger. As long as it can deprive the origin of the talent and not hurt itself,” Ling said.
“I understand, I understand.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Then next, when I sleep, don’t run around anymore. Just adapt in my new Beast Taming Space.”
“Wuu!!” Eleven and the others felt that there was no problem.
After replicating the development method of the plundering talent from the Yue Maiden, Shi Yu couldn’t wait to cultivate. In other words, he would eat the Level 11 super divine resource, the Cultivation Fruit, of the ginseng baby and sleep.
As Shi Yu entered deep cultivation, the others also cultivated hard under their respective opportunities.
Hundred Flowers Star Domain.
A cat girl lying on the ground with a swollen face looked up and meowed.
“Damn it, I don’t want the peak of the super divine level. I want to go home!!!”
“Wu wu wu, Shi Yu, save me…”
Overlord territory.
Goddess Wa had already arrived with a group of people.
Emperor Wu, Dragon Emperor, Empress, Lu Qingyi, Divine Source, and Lin Xiuzhu all had their own unique points. In Goddess Wa’s opinion, they had super divine aptitude.
There was no need to talk about Emperor Wu, the Dragon Emperor, and the Empress. As the revival of the Creation Soil and the power of Blue Planet, her talent potential had already been strengthened to the strongest. After Lu Qingyi received the plundering talent inheritance, her foundation accumulation even exceeded many emperors. Unfortunately, Shi Yu was too excited from killing at that time and didn’t leave some epoch god and super divine near-death people for Senior Lu to plunder. Otherwise, she…
As for Lin Xiuzhu, she accompanied Shi Yu to study the power system of the previous era in detail and walked a path that was different from the Beast Tamer of this era. She also had a lot of potential.
Divine Source… wasn’t bad.
“Senior Wa, where is this?” Seeing that it was getting closer and closer to a black star domain, Senior Panda couldn’t help but ask.
“The place I’m bringing you to next is a training place of the cosmic overlord army. Many epoch gods of the cosmic overlord army have trained here. Here, as long as you fight and kill the enemy, you can increase your strength. Of course, the corrosion to the heart will also be very big.”
“This is the training ground of the cosmic overlord army. Among them, there are even super divine level prisoners of war imprisoned. It’s not impossible to obtain the source of transcendence.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1816: The Worry of the Ginseng Emperor (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1816: The Worry of the Ginseng Emperor (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Hahaha, it’s alright. There hasn’t been any battle that can corrode my heart,” Emperor Wu said confidently.
After rising up, he had been fighting and killing enemies all his life and had even fought the Yun Race for a long time. Such an environment was suitable for him.
“However, can you guys do it?” The Empress looked at Lu Qingyi and Lin Xiuzhu. She wasn’t worried about Lu Qingyi, but she wasn’t very at ease with this little girl in a panda costume.
“I… I should be able to,” Senior Panda said. “I’ve trained in the military camp for a long time after all… Although most of them are administrative…”
“If we can’t hold on, give up as soon as possible. We’re just short of a spot,” Divine Source said.
Sparks shot out among the many Dong Huang legends.
Yes.
There was only one spot left.
Who could be the first to become a super divine?
Lu Qingyi, Senior Panda, and the other juniors were relatively calm, but Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, and Divine Source had already started to compete.
In the blink of an eye, a year passed. This year was the calmest year on Blue Planet. Lin and Kong, who were clueless super divines, methodically developed the factions of Blue Planet and Blue Planet on the World King Planet. Emperor Shi was still so mysterious and his whereabouts were uncertain.
The five super divines of Blue Planet finally became arrogant. They dared to appear publicly on World King Planet and show their divinity in front of everyone, determined to cozy up to Shi Yu.
Shi Yu originally thought that he would continue cultivating calmly like this, but as an uninvited guest came looking for him, he was awakened by the Blue Planet’s Will and was forced to stop cultivating. He looked at an acquaintance who had descended from the starry sky to Blue Planet.
“Hehe.” The observer smiled at Shi Yu and said, “Sir Shi Yu, looks like you’ve already successfully broken through. Congratulations, congratulations.”
“Old man, I didn’t look for you, but you came looking for me yourself,” Shi Yu asked.
“What’s wrong with those super divine stones you gave me? They actually opened trash like Level 11 energy crystals.”
At the mention of this, Shi Yu was angry. Including the breakthrough gift from this old man, he had almost gathered 40 super divine stones. After breaking through, he immediately called his pets to have a good time.
In the end, although more than 30 Level 11 energy crystals were also super divine resources and rare treasures in the eyes of divine-levels, Shi Yu was useless.
On the other hand, the few pieces he collected were barely passable treasures, but for his current identity, their value wasn’t very high.
Shi Yu couldn’t accept the unlucky experience this time. After all, before it opened, his buff was maxed out. He suspected that it was the stone given by this observer that smeared the stone he had collected. Otherwise, it would definitely not be so dark.
“This, this, before we open it, no one knows what’s inside. It’s really purely based on luck,” the observer old man said innocently. “However, it might be related to my batch of rocks being discovered from an era ruin?”
“Perhaps the super divine stones collected here are trash.” He waved his hand.
“What brings you here this time?” Shi Yu said.
The observer chuckled and said, “Of course, there’s something I want to ask you…”
“Of course, I’ll give you a reward. In essence, this can also be considered a good thing!!”
“Tell me about it,” Shi Yu said.
The old observer said, “I wonder, Sir Shi Yu. Have you heard of it? The Universe Tree.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Of course I’ve heard of it. Isn’t that thing said to have already been destroyed?” Shi Yu said.
“That’s right, it was destroyed, but not completely. It still has a seed left in the world.”
Shi Yu asked, “What does the Universe Tree have to do with you?”
The old observer smiled bitterly and said, “My ancestor was once the guardian of the Guardian Universe Tree. However, due to its mistake, the Universe Tree encountered destruction and became what it is now.”
“Although Lord World King didn’t punish it, Lord Ancestor himself made a contract to definitely recover the Universe Tree. However, even Lord World King said that it’s impossible for the Universe Tree to recover…”
“But our ancestor didn’t give up. After its hard research, it thought of a way.”
“With the cosmic Beast Taming Space of a human super divine Beast Tamer as a new universe to nurture the cosmic tree seed, perhaps the Universe Tree can recover.”
“Therefore, he has always chosen suitable Beast Tamers as containers for the cosmic tree seed. Unfortunately, he has never found a successful candidate. Until my generation, I once chose 11 suitable Beast Tamers in the battle for the source of transcendence, wanting them to be containers. Unfortunately, they also failed. They couldn’t withstand the nutrients needed for the cosmic tree seed and finally returned the cosmic tree seed to me.”
Shi Yu looked at the observer in surprise and said, “Could your ancestor be the cosmic tree guardian under the World King, that God of Fertility?”
“You know my ancestor?!” The observer was shocked.
“Well… I guess I do.” Shi Yu kept feeling that the cosmic tree in this space and time was most likely destroyed by the Empress… It was a sin.
After all, the Empress was his contractor now. He had half the blame. However, as long as he didn’t ask clearly, it had nothing to do with him.
“You mean you want to ask me to become a container and nurture the cosmic tree seed?”
The observer said, “That’s right. You’re the strongest human Beast Tamer I’ve ever seen. Perhaps you can really do what others can’t. Moreover, you perfectly meet the conditions.”
“As long as you let your plant-type pet carry the cosmic tree seed and use it as a transceiver to nurture it, it’s fine. Although this might make you in a high consumption state at all times and an enfeeble state, nurturing the cosmic tree seed isn’t without benefits.”
“Firstly, in a perfect state, the cosmic tree is a strange object that can increase other resources to a cosmic treasure. Even now, the cosmic tree seed can subtly strengthen the power of the wearer, equivalent to a low-quality cosmic treasure.”
“During the breeding process, your plant pet can also obtain considerable benefits. It can be strengthened as a resource.”
“Apart from that, I promise that if you successfully restore the cosmic tree seed to Restoration and restore it to the cosmic tree, the cosmic tree will be yours. Lord World King has already given up on the cosmic tree, but as long as this thing doesn’t recover its Restoration, the contract my ancestor made in my bloodline can’t be erased.” The observer was vexed.
“And if you feel that you’re not qualified after trying, it’s alright. You just have to return the cosmic tree seed to me. I’ll make up for your consumption to a certain extent during this period.”
“Why do I feel that this is a good thing?” Shi Yu touched his chin and looked at the observer.
The observer smiled and said, “However, the consumption needed for the cosmic tree seed is really huge. During this period, your realm might not advance but fall instead. Even so, is it a good thing?”
“The 11 containers I’ve come into contact with have their realms fall during this period.”
“It’s just a realm. It doesn’t matter. In any case, I level up quickly, but there aren’t many opportunities to come into contact with such a treasure. Why don’t you take a look?” Shi Yu said.
The corners of the observer’s mouth twitched. Was this human language???
But according to his understanding, it was true that this beast had gone from an ordinary person to close to the cosmic level in less than ten years…
“If possible, I’ll take it,” Shi Yu said.
He was just worried about the cosmic treasure used by his pets to break through to the cosmic level. Good lord, this observer old man was just about to send it up.
It looked like Baby Ginseng was about to take off. If it could obtain the Universe Tree and fuse with the Universe Tree, wouldn’t it be the strongest supplement in the universe?? After all, the Universe Tree could even casually replenish a super divine fruit to the level of a cosmic treasure.
Shi Yu had seen it with his own eyes!
Even if it wasn’t enough for Baby Ginseng to break through, didn’t it still have him? He could cultivate more nourishing talents. After cultivating to the cosmic level, he could extract them and give them to the cosmic tree.
At this moment, in the Beast Taming Space, Baby Ginseng looked panicked.
Oh no!
The first opportunity to break through to the cosmic level appeared on it. It kept feeling that Buggy’s breakthrough to the weakest law was going to be repeated on it. Was this a good thing… or a bad thing?

chapters.title: Chapter 1817: The Fifth Super Divine Human on Blue Planet (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1817: The Fifth Super Divine Human on Blue Planet (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Baby Ginseng.”
After taking on the big job of nurturing seeds, Shi Yu directly summoned Baby Ginseng beside him.
“Yi.”
After Baby Ginseng came out, it stared at the humanoid observer with a burning gaze.
Then, he imagined the image of the God of Fertility.
It didn’t match at all.
How many times had it evolved, mutated, and degenerated before the image of its race changed so much?
But it was definitely his biological son… After all, they were all very strong.
“Yi…” Hundreds of millions of years was long enough. It was normal for descendants to change their appearance.
“I’ve long heard of the ginseng emperor,” the observer said. “Actually, I’ve been paying attention to you since the end of the God Sealing Battle.”
“Any Beast Tamer who contracts a plant life with potential is my target.”
The observer was very satisfied with Baby Ginseng. After all, this guy was first in Shi Yu’s team no matter what. It used to be.
Now, he didn’t know.
“Let’s give it a try,” Baby Ginseng said.
“Senior, where’s the seed?” Shi Yu also asked.
“Over here.” The observer stretched out his hand, and a blue-green seed projection flickered in his palm. Then, it slowly materialized. The seed contained a faint spatial power, very similar to the fluctuations of the Universe Tree that Shi Yu and the others had once sensed.
Baby Ginseng stretched out its hand, and the cosmic tree seed slowly floated in front of it. Soon, the seed was in its hand.
“Yi.” At this moment, Baby Ginseng didn’t feel any side effects. Instead, the power of the cosmic tree seed subtly strengthened its nourishing ability. Baby Ginseng wasn’t unfamiliar with this feeling!
The super divine resource, the Reincarnation Fruit, that it had once created had been improved by the Universe Tree like this. However, this time, the Reincarnation Fruit was changed to it, and the Universe Tree Seed was increasing its quality. Although this speed was extremely slow, more than a hundred million times slower than the increase of the Universe Tree at that time, it was also very extraordinary.
“It’s nothing now, but after you put the ginseng emperor back into the Beast Taming Space, it will automatically absorb power.”
“At that time, be it the ginseng emperor or you, they will be treated as a transit device. It’s alright, but for you, the Beast Taming Space might have to withstand a huge burden. Come and try now. Feel it first.”
When Shi Yu heard that, he directly retracted the ginseng baby.
After Baby Ginseng returned to its planet, it indeed sensed that after the cosmic tree species was in the star area space, it began to ask it for energy. As for it, it was also passively absorbing nutrition from the Beast Taming Space. As for the nutrition of the Beast Taming Space, it was absorbed from the outside world through Shi Yu’s transit device.
In an instant, Shi Yu indeed felt his stamina flowing crazily.
“How is it?” the observer asked. The consumption of nurturing the cosmic tree seed was basically equivalent to ten thousand times the consumption of a super divine Beast Tamer to activate his Beast Taming Strengthening Talent with all his might at all times.
This burden was alright in the short term, but as time passed, it could definitely reduce a super divine Beast Tamer to kidney deficiency. Now, Shi Yu should have experienced this speed. He should be able to predict if he could withstand such consumption.
For example, the Beast Tamers he had chosen previously only lasted for a few minutes before they had to rely on taking medicine to maintain it. After nurturing it for a few months or a few years, they would become neither human nor ghost and finally give up.
“Is that all?” However, a few minutes later, Shi Yu asked.
He still looked energetic and did not look weak at all.
Observer: “?”
“What do you mean?”
“This thing is clearly quite gentle,” Shi Yu said. “I feel that I won’t be affected much if it stays in my body like this.”
“But this guy does eat a lot. I took the initiative to feed it more nutrition just now, but it actually accepted all the food.”
“Huh?” The observer was stunned.
“Don’t have that expression. How can the Beast Tamer you found previously compare to me?” Shi Yu said with a smile.
After all, his skill index was created by the “complete Universe Tree of the last era” combined with “many cosmic treasures”. Its function was to consume its physical strength to strengthen its pet.
It could be said that Shi Yu had spent his entire journey “consuming and adding points”. He was long familiar with this feeling and had trained his physique.
The absorption speed of this thing… Even if he was given a few days, it wouldn’t consume as much energy as fusing a divine skill once.
Moreover, his current physical strength was comparable to a cosmic behemoth that had transcended nine times. Now, the strongest battle power in Shi Yu’s team wasn’t pets like Eleven at all, but Shi Yu himself, who had cultivated the power system of the previous era.
His physical fitness wasn’t something the Beast Tamers of this era could compare to, even if it was a Beast Tamer at the peak of the super divine level.
“In my opinion, Senior, you can’t take back your seed,” Shi Yu said with a chuckle.
“Ah, this.” The observer kept observing Shi Yu. After discovering that Shi Yu was indeed not affected at all, he said in surprise, “Although I already expected that it would definitely be different on you, I didn’t expect your endurance to be so good.”
“It’s just that this guy’s absorption speed is too slow. At this rate, it might not necessarily be able to recover in millions of years,” Shi Yu said. “I plan to find an opportunity to adjust the time flow in the Beast Taming Space and let it recover quickly.”
“If I gain anything, I’ll tell you, Senior.”
Observer: “?”
In the end, the observer left Blue Planet with an expression as if he had seen a ghost. When Shi Yu saw him leave, he sighed slightly. So this observer was also a direct descendant of the World King.

chapters.title: Chapter 1818: The Fifth Super Divine Human on Blue Planet (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1818: The Fifth Super Divine Human on Blue Planet (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
After all, his ancestor was the guardian of the World King’s cosmic treasure. Although his name wasn’t known to the people on World King Planet, he could definitely be considered on the World King’s side.
Then, Shi Yu had another training quest.
That was to nurture the cosmic tree seed.
However, Shi Yu felt that even if he accelerated the time flow in the Beast Taming Space, it wouldn’t be overnight to restore it.
He probably had to wait until he became a cosmic level to completely recover its strength.
No wonder the guys the observer found couldn’t support it. It was another skill.
Next, Shi Yu abandoned his other thoughts and continued cultivating.
After reaching the super divine level, it was indeed different. Under normal circumstances, at the divine level, the concept of time was no longer that important. It was easy to sleep for decades, hundreds, or even tens of thousands of years.
In specific circumstances, it wasn’t impossible for some divine-levels to sleep and seal themselves for hundreds of millions of years.
Shi Yu’s previous cultivation speed was too fast, and the resources were too rich. He had never encountered any bottlenecks, so after he entered the super divine level, he immediately couldn’t see the direction to break through.
He felt that it was impossible for him to reach the peak of the super divine level from the level of transcendent nine and rely on normal meditation cultivation without millions of years.
This was still a situation where his talent was pretty good. Even if he had an endless supply of pseudo source of transcendence as cultivation resources, it would probably be difficult without tens of thousands of years.
Unlike before, when breaking through realms was in a short period of time. With a little hard work, one could break through by looking for some rare resources.
Although just looking at Shi Yu’s estimated breakthrough time, it wasn’t slow compared to the others, Shi Yu himself was definitely not satisfied with this speed.
After all, it had only been less than ten years since he broke through previously. How could he tolerate spending tens of thousands of years to break through to the next realm now?
“There are two ways. First, rely on the feedback of the pets, but the skill index can’t add any old skills now. If I want to increase their strength, I can only add some new skills through ‘evolution’ and ‘teaching new skills’. Or, contracting a new pet and relying on the one-time feedback when new pets join the team can allow me to level up quickly.”
“2. Wait for the Empress and Teacher Ying to transform the hundreds of true source of transcendence into cultivation resources. When these resources are transferred to the account, the strength of my entire team will welcome the next leap.”
Shi Yu considered it for a moment. There was definitely no need to contract a new pet. In his current situation, there were really not many pets that could give him pretty good feedback. They were all old monsters.
Well… If he could contract the Blue Planet’s Will with Goddess Wa, Shi Yu felt that it was pretty good, but it wasn’t suitable… It wasn’t suitable… It was a little unfilial.
Continuing to find new skills and optimizing Eleven and the others’ battle power was also a choice. Although the Empress had told Shi Yu before she left that it was best not to leave the range of the Cosmic Sea, there were definitely targets that could be replicated in the Cosmic Sea.
He also knew that he had destroyed so many super divines in the Contaminated Land and the super divine of the Worm Nest. He must have been targeted by the other party’s universe level. In the Cosmic Sea, the World King and the Empress could still protect him. If he went too far, something would easily happen.
However, he still had to cultivate Beast Taming Talents such as plundering. It wasn’t the best choice to wander around…
After thinking about it, Shi Yu still decided to wait for the Empress’s cultivation resources… Deciding to freeload wasn’t considered freeloading. After all, he had fought his own source of transcendence, and the Empress was his contracted target. This was called self-reliance.
Just like that, as Shi Yu waited with anticipation, another three years passed.
Four years had passed since the end of the battle for the source of transcendence.
For the university student Beast Tamers on Blue Planet, these four years might be the end of their youth, but for some lives who had already stepped into the divine level, it was in the blink of an eye.
For Shi Yu, it was even more of a matter of lying down, getting up, and lying down to sleep again and again.
“It’s been four years, four years! Who knows how I’ve spent these four years!”
Three years later, Shi Yu opened his eyes and suddenly woke up. He was tired. Although he knew that four years was really not long for the current them, who knew how much he looked forward to the Empress and the gem cat quickly bringing over new cultivation resources?
Looking at the situation where he had worked hard for four years, apart from learning and cultivating a few new Beast Taming Talents, his realm hadn’t improved substantially at all, Shi Yu really didn’t dare to imagine that he still had to spend many more years under such circumstances.
He wanted to cheat…
He wanted to instantly reach the peak of the super divine level…
“Teacher Gem Cat must have dragged the empress down. Otherwise, with the Empress’s reliability, she would have long sent resources,” Shi Yu said.
With Teacher Ying’s situation, she shouldn’t be able to accept too strict training. She would probably slack off.
“Calm down,” Ling said. “After all, Teacher Ying needs to reach the peak of the super divine level to have any hope of modifying the source of transcendence. From super divine 3 to the peak of the super divine level, even if there’s a cosmic level as a training teacher, it’s not that easy, right?”
“Compared to this, why don’t we think about why Goddess Wa and the others aren’t done yet?”
“In theory, there’s no need for so long to go from the divine level to the super divine level. With the aptitude of Emperor Wu and the others, I think four years should be enough with the guidance of a peak super divine.”
“Yeah, in four years, I feel that I can already nurture a super divine. Why are Goddess Wa and the others so slow?” Shi Yu muttered. He looked in the direction of the Ancient Capital.

chapters.title: Chapter 1819: The Fifth Super Divine Human on Blue Planet (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1819: The Fifth Super Divine Human on Blue Planet (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
At this moment, a divine-level figure was wearing technological glasses and a black silk uniform, teaching in the huge classroom.
Yue Maiden… adapted to modern life very quickly.
In the past few years, on the surface, the Yue Maiden was a gold-medal teacher of Ancient Capital University. An Chang, Fang Lan, Yin Zhengfan, and the others, who had once taught her, had already ascended to the World King Planet with outstanding results in the World Tournament. In secret, she was the dark side of Dong Huang and was in charge of handling some troublesome matters. Even she was already a high-level god. There was no reason for Emperor Wu and the others, who had arrived at the World King Planet earlier, not to have reached the super divine level, right?
If he hadn’t cultivated in the past few years and personally taught the Yue Maiden, the Yue Maiden would definitely have become a super divine.
After wearing the cosmic tree seed for three years, Baby Ginseng had now become the first pet in Shi Yu’s team to break through to the high-level. The nourishing power on its body was tempting, and it was an excellent cultivation support pet.
“Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey.” Just as Shi Yu was worried, Bu Lu suddenly spoke in surprise.
It pointed at the starry sky, the Eye of the Universe left in the starry sky, and observed the figures of Goddess Wa and the others returning.
Goddess Wa and the others had returned, which meant that…
“Really?!” After being stunned, Shi Yu was also pleasantly surprised. Holy shit, speaking of the devil. He knew that his sudden awakening was due to the guidance of fate, not because he had slept enough.
“Let’s go welcome them.”
Under Shi Yu’s command, all the pets crawled back into Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space. At the same time, they immediately started chattering.
They were all guessing who had become a super divine.
This time, the three emperors of Dong Huang, the Mechanical Divine Source, and the two seniors of Lu and Lin left with Goddess Wa. Among these people, who exactly became a super divine? The pets immediately started to bet.
Whoever lost the bet would be a sandbag for a month in the other party’s training competition.
A small bet was fun. This time, they were going to make a big bet.
“Wuu.” Eleven naturally chose Big Sister Lin Xiuzhu.
“Mi.” Chi Tong didn’t let him choose his sister.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng chose Lu Qingyi…
Shi Yu said, “A month’s worth of sandbags. You guys really dare to bet. If you lose, you really won’t be able to live…”
Soon, the pets finished gambling. Apart from Senior Divine Source, the others were more or less betting.
Soon, Shi Yu arrived at the starry sky and stopped in front of Goddess Wa and the others’ biological battleship. No, he directly barged in.
At this moment, Dong Huang and the others were also on the battleship. They looked at the blue planet in front of them and felt a wave of anticipation. The four years of training had finally come home. Shi Yu had spent the past four years sleeping, but they had spent the past four years fighting and training. Although there was Goddess Wa protecting them behind the scenes, every one of them had a slim chance of survival.
If it weren’t for Goddess Wa being their guardian, they would have long died a hundred times.
However, the returns from such hardships were also very huge.
At that moment, Emperor Wu and the others emitted powerful auras. They were completely different from before they left.
“I wonder how Dong Huang is doing.” Divine Source sighed. He was middle-aged in this group of people. Emperor Wu and the others were older than him, so there was no need to maintain the posture of a senior. He had been much more at ease recently.
“Sigh.” But at this moment, most of them, such as the Dragon Emperor, maintained regret.
Before setting off this time, he swore that he would definitely be the super divine, but… it was over now.
Obviously, the Dragon Emperor wasn’t one of the few who successfully became a super divine. Even now, his body emitted the aura of a peak divine-level. Even if he might not be inferior to the Space Emperor and Lin Feng back then, he still couldn’t successfully become a super divine.
The others were basically at the same level as the Dragon Emperor, at the peak of the tenth level of the divine level. However, they belonged to the peak of the divine level that had a chance of reaching the epoch god level.
“Yo.” Just as everyone was waiting to go home, a voice suddenly made them turn around.
Shi Yu had appeared in the ship at some point in time and appeared behind them, looking at them with a smile.
“Everyone, you’re back.”
“Long time no see.”
Shi Yu’s gaze looked at these people one by one. Senior Panda, peak divine level, Senior Lu, peak divine level, Divine Source Legendary, peak divine level…
Emperor Wu, peak divine level, Dragon Emperor, peak divine level…
Empress Huang Xi… super divine level…!
Shi Yu revealed a surprised expression and said, “So, the one who became super divine in the end is…”
“It can’t be helped. Senior Empress is very powerful.” Lu Qingyi smiled.
“Sister Huang Xi is still powerful. Not only is she the first to break through to the eleventh level of the divine level, but she’s also the first to successfully hunt a super divine.” Emperor Wu shook his head and lost wholeheartedly.
“It’s just because of the advantage of being a hybrid. That place has a stronger training effect on me, a hybrid. Under normal circumstances, I’m inferior to everyone,” Empress Huang Xi said.
In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, the various pets trembled. Chi Tong turned into a human form with a strong smile. She knew that her sister could definitely work hard!!
As for Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others, the corners of their mouths twitched. They secretly hated their two seniors for not being awesome and exciting!
“Then can we head to the ruins of Earth now?” Shi Yu didn’t care who was super divine. In any case, from the looks of it, they all had a chance to be super divine. They were just short of the source of transcendence.
Of course, if Senior Lu and the others were also interested in divine level 11 and 12, that would be a different story.
In fact, if it weren’t to pursue the cosmic level, Shi Yu didn’t recommend that ordinary people pursue breaking the limit. After all, it was too dangerous.

chapters.title: Chapter 1820: The Fifth Super Divine Human on Blue Planet (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1820: The Fifth Super Divine Human on Blue Planet (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
It wasn’t impossible to break through from the tenth level of the divine level to the peak of the super divine level. This level was enough for ordinary people. As long as it was maintained well, it wasn’t a problem to destroy the universe.
“That’s right.” At this moment, Goddess Wa’s figure slowly appeared. This was the first time Goddess Wa revealed her appearance, at least in front of Shi Yu.
Shi Yu looked at this beautiful goddess with silver flowers hanging down and her hair tied into a moon-like bun. “Now that the Scarlet Blue Star Domain has been occupied by the Environmental Protection Army, it’s already the territory of the Cosmic Sea. It’s not a problem to go over directly.”
Ever since Shi Yu destroyed so many super divines of the Dark King Army, the Dark King Army and the Environmental Protection Army had been retreating step by step. The location of the previous battle had long become a part of the Cosmic Sea, and the pollution power had been completely expelled.
“From the looks of it, Shi Yu can’t wait anymore.”
Goddess Wa said, “In that case, let’s return to Blue Planet after we go to the ruins together. Let’s go fetch Wang Kong, Lin Feng, and the others first…”
“Alright.” Everyone was very excited. Although it wasn’t super divine, if they could explore the ruins together, it wouldn’t be a failure.
“Yay.” Shi Yu was as happy as a child weighing 20 billion pounds. After sleeping for four years, he finally had something to do to relieve his boredom.
He hoped that there would be something exciting in this ruin.
Then, everyone directly swept past Blue Planet and approached World King Planet.
Now, Blue Planet had already flown to the center of the Cosmic Sea and wasn’t far from World King Planet. Flying over directly wasn’t much different from using a teleportation array. Its speed was not much different from Shi Yu and the others.
At the same time.
In the center of the Dong Huang Realm and the Floating Realm.
A black-robed figure appeared. Emperor Shi looked at the starry sky and said to both sides,
“Wang Kong, Lin Feng.”
“Senior Emperor Shi, we’re here.”
“Prepare yourself. Goddess Wa and the others have returned.”
Emperor Shi seemed to have a premonition long ago. He began to invite Lin Feng and Emperor Kong to wait for Shi Yu and the others to arrive.
“Holy shit.” In a villa in the Floating Realm, Lin Feng shook his head when he heard that.
“You’re back.” Four years, so fast.
It was really… better to cozy up to someone powerful than to work hard himself.
He had worked hard for hundreds of years, but he didn’t become a super divine. In the end, he still relied on Shi Yu’s dividends.
Now, this batch of people who had been taken away by Goddess Wa was even more ruthless. Although they weren’t as good as Shi Yu, four years of super divine power was already abnormal.
“We can finally go.” At this moment, the Space Emperor was also thinking about the ruins on Earth, wanting to see what information was hidden in the ruins that Goddess Wa and Shi Yu were so concerned about.
Soon, Emperor Shi, Emperor Kong, and Lin Feng boarded the battleship.
After they discovered that the Empress had broken through, they weren’t too surprised. This was because mixed-bloods had a certain advantage over pure-blooded humans.
On the other hand, if it was Divine Source breaking through, they would be surprised.
“By the way, will hybrid humans be different from ordinary humans and not meet the conditions?” As soon as he came up, Lin Feng kept having some novel ideas.
“It’s alright,” the Empress said calmly. “I can strip the phoenix bloodline out of my body at any time. After stripping it out, I’ll be pure-blooded.”
“Then it’s alright.” Lin Feng smiled in embarrassment.
“Everyone is here now.” Shi Yu was excited. “Then let’s go.”
“Yes,” everyone replied one by one.
He began to head to the Scarlet Blue Star Domain.
With the two super divine experts, Goddess Wa and Shi Yu, leading the team, their speed was naturally indescribable. When Shi Yu, Senior Lu, and the others understood their experience during this period of time, everyone quickly arrived at the star where the ruins on Earth were.
There was also an old acquaintance of Shi Yu who had been waiting here for a long time.
“Lord Wa, you’re back!!!”
“Also, there’s Lord Shi Yu.”
On this earth-yellow planet, the Sand Fort Guardian was still protecting it. When it saw Goddess Wa return with a group of people, it was immediately excited and had tears streaming down its face.
It looked like… it could really retire this time.
“You’re still here.” Shi Yu looked at him happily.
“You’ve worked hard,” Goddess Wa said.
After Emperor Wu and the others followed, they also looked at the Sand Fort Guardian curiously.
“Not at all!!” The Sand Fort Guardian sensed the aura of a pile of super divine experts behind Goddess Wa. It swallowed its saliva and said, “Are we going to open the ruins…”
“Naturally.”
Then, just like the first time Shi Yu came here, everyone arrived at the underground world and saw a stone wall door.
On the stone door, there was a pattern. There were five sunken places. Four of them were in four directions, and the other was in the center. The humans who were already super divine nodded at Goddess Wa. They stretched out their hands and teleported their bloodline super divine power to the stone door.
Unlike the first time Shi Yu came to test it himself, this time…
Boom!!!
The stone door swayed, as if it had opened the door to another cosmic space. It finally opened. The moment it opened, Goddess Wa’s expression was solemn as she sensed a familiar power fluctuation.
Among the five of them, Shi Yu was also stunned. He sensed a familiar bloodline fluctuation, as if… it was his relative. As for the other four, the Space-time clueless emperor, Lin Feng, and the Empress didn’t sense anything. Senior Lu and the others were only curious and didn’t sense anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1821: Hope of the Village (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1821: Hope of the Village (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
When the stone door opened, it was a small desolate world.
Be it Goddess Wa or Shi Yu, they weren’t unfamiliar with the environment here.
The era ruin fragment left behind by Goddess Wa looked the same when Shi Yu took out the Creation Soil and other things.
It was suspected to be… a fragment of Earth.
“There’s nothing…” Emperor Wu said.
“It opened just like that?” Lin Feng was surprised.
“No, it’s not like there’s nothing,” Shi Yu said. “There’s a deep space.”
“Yes, that’s right.” Goddess Wa nodded.
“Leave it to me.” Shi Yu took a step forward and activated the two major skills, Time Transformation and Time Operation. As he cracked and stabilized the current ruins, he tried to find something deeper.
A dazzling light shot out of his eyes. In the next moment, the entire ruin rumbled and trembled.
The ground cracked, and an earth-yellow stone pillar rose from the alternate space and connected to the sky.
The stone pillar broke from the center. A little clay figure, a little girl clay figure that looked like a human cub, floated in the center of the stone pillar.
Upon seeing this clay figure, Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
“There are words on the stone pillar,” Emperor Shi said. “However, unfamiliar words.”
“I know this,” Goddess Wa said. “It’s an Elder Gu language from the last era. If that’s the case, it’s easier to decipher.”
“I’m certain now that this ruin should have been left behind by Nüwa.”
“My power was inherited by the cosmic-level expert of the last era, Goddess Wa. As her heir, I can sense that that clay person is her creation.”
“The method used is similar to Blue Planet and me reviving and creating you through the Creation Soil. However, the method is higher,” Goddess Wa said.
“Senior Goddess Wa, quickly decipher the words.” Lin Feng couldn’t wait anymore.
Lu Qingyi, Senior Panda, the Empress, and the others also followed behind, extremely curious about all of this.
Why exactly was this ruin built and what secrets were hidden?
“Yes.” Goddess Wa looked at the words on the stone pillar.
“On this is a self-introduction about Nüwa. She calls herself a cosmic life form on cosmic-level planet Earth.”
“At the same time, it’s also one of the sixteen great cosmic-level life forms in the last era,” Goddess Wa said in disbelief.
“What?” Not only was Goddess Wa shocked, but the Space Emperor and the others were also very shocked.
One of the 16 great cosmic-level life forms in the last era?
In the last era, there were so many cosmic levels??
After all, in this era, there were only six cosmic levels. It was actually only a fraction of the number in the previous era.
“Our universe is in its prime. We still have a very long lifespan. In the end, there might be many cosmic levels,” Emperor Shi said.
Goddess Wa ignored everyone’s communication and said,
“Nüwa is a life born from a cosmic-level planet, Earth. She’s known as the goddess of creation. She imitated the humans of the universe and created the humans of Earth…”
“Because the talent potential of the humans on Earth is peerless in the starry sky, she also obtained a huge return. It can be said that her ability to reach the cosmic level is closely related to ‘making humans’.”
Everyone felt that Goddess Wa on Blue Planet and Goddess Wa on Earth were like a reincarnation. On this side, Goddess Wa also created the human race on Blue Planet, while on the other side, Goddess Wa created the human race on Earth?
“The reason why Nüwa created the humans on Earth is because she hoped to create a human with the best talent and potential to reach the cosmic level. Then, she would contract the universe itself and let it become an eternal guardian to extend the lifespan of the universe.”
“This plan is also a plan developed by a few cosmic levels on Earth with her.”
“As cosmic life forms, they don’t want to end themselves because of the lifespan of the universe.”
“Did it fail?” Lu Qingyi asked after a moment of silence.
At that moment, Shi Yu had already told his relatives and friends on Blue Planet what he knew about the cosmic holder.
Everyone knew that Shi Yu was now working hard to become the holder of the universe.
Although Shi Yu didn’t say anything about the agreement with the empress and only expressed his curiosity about a higher realm, Senior Lu and the others were still very worried about whether this path could be taken.
Contracting a universe sounded like a fantasy. It was even more unreliable than becoming a cosmic level.
“Yes, it failed.” Goddess Wa said, “Although Nüwa and the others cultivated a human and she successfully reached the cosmic level, she died during the process of trying to contract the universe.”
“This outcome also means that the plan of Earth to resist the reboot of the universe in the last era completely failed.”
The Empress and the others looked at Shi Yu.
In the last era, Earth had at least two cosmic levels, and it was even very likely that it was the center planet of the previous universe. It had more than half of the cosmic levels. Even if they gathered the strength of all their members, they couldn’t make the chosen person the holder of the universe.
Shi Yu was certain that he still had to have thoughts about this realm?
To be honest, becoming an ordinary cosmic level and living for billions of years was actually not bad.
Was there really a need to take this risk?
Shi Yu smiled bitterly. It was mainly because he had promised the empress. It wasn’t easy to tell these people about his relationship with the Empress because the Empress didn’t allow Shi Yu to tell the outside world about her relationship with Shi Yu.
Sharing the information about the cosmic level and the cosmic holder he had obtained from the Empress was already the limit.
Shi Yu could also understand these ancient words. He had studied these Mythical words in his previous life. At this moment, he was also deciphering them with Goddess Wa’s progress.

chapters.title: Chapter 1822: Hope of the Village (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1822: Hope of the Village (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“However, although this plan failed, the Earth bloodline still hasn’t completely given up.”
“In the end, they chose a plan called ‘Fire Seed’ to carry it out,” Goddess Wa said.
“The Pyro Plan is about to send a group of Earth lives with potential, including the Earth’s will itself, to the next era at the end of the era.”
“If it goes smoothly, a star similar to Earth will appear in the next era. These flames will also awaken the memories of the previous era on this star, their reincarnation.”
“The Pyro Plan is to let these people have the possibility of becoming the holders of the universe in the next era.”
“During this process, countless flames might be extinguished and die in the vast river of time. It’s also possible that they will escape the lock of reincarnating Earth due to some accident, but there’s a certain possibility that they can successfully reach the next era.”
Shi Yu crossed his arms and looked at the stone pillar with a burning gaze.
Goddess Wa subconsciously looked at Shi Yu.
“However, the success rate of this plan is inferior to the previous attempts. It’s just a final struggle.”
“After all, among this group of fire seeds, the guy with the best talent potential, second only to that cosmic-level human, is very unreliable. Even if he successfully transmigrates, whether he can live to the cosmic level is another matter,” Goddess Wa said. “As for the other Fire Seeds, they’re more or less lacking.”
Shi Yu was speechless.
Who was it?
“This person should be talking about you, right?” Goddess Wa looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was silent. “Probably? In any case, I’m definitely one of these Fire Seeds. I’m sure.”
Shi Yu really didn’t tell too many people about this.
Apart from Goddess Wa, Emperor Shi, and the others who relied on their strength to know that Shi Yu was unusual, Senior Panda, Senior Lu, and the others still didn’t know Shi Yu’s transmigrator identity.
Even the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, Divine Source, and the others didn’t know what was unusual about Shi Yu although they knew that he was unusual.
At this moment, when they heard Goddess Wa’s words and Shi Yu’s answer, everyone was shocked.
“What, what, what, what?” Senior Panda said in shock. “Shi Yu, you’re saying that you’re a transmigrator from the last era, one of the Earth’s Fire Seeds mentioned by Nüwa??”
“Yes,” Shi Yu said. “However, I don’t have any transcendent memories from the last era at all. My memories of the last era only stopped in my early twenties. I died during an archeological expedition.”
“In my era and country, there was no extraordinary power at all. Politicians, vendors, armies, and commoners were all formed by ordinary people. Animals were also mortal beasts. Apart from the historical culture being very similar to Dong Huang, like a reincarnation, there was a huge difference.”
“After I died that time, I woke up again in the pet breeding base of Icefield City and became an ordinary pet breeder. A few months later, I took Eleven from you, Senior Lin, and opened the path of Beast Taming in this life.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Damn,” Lin Feng and the others muttered. No wonder Shi Yu was so abnormal. They finally knew the reason.
However, there was nothing new about this.
Reincarnation and rebirth weren’t rare on Blue Planet. Just on Blue Planet in this era, countless experts had reincarnated. President Ming Hua, who was next to Dong Huang, was also a reincarnator. Susu was equivalent to experiencing countless reincarnations. However, this was the first time everyone had seen Shi Yu take such a long leap.
It came from the last era!
As a genius recognized by a bunch of cosmic-level big shots, everyone understood why Shi Yu could advance so quickly.
“So, what exactly is this ruin…” The Empress looked at the little clay figurine and the remaining unglowing words.
Goddess Wa said, “This ruin can actually be considered a backup plan of the Pyro Plan.”
She looked at the little clay figure floating in the stone pillar and said, “This soil creation is a creature, an unactivated creature.”
“She came from the last era. She’s a new creature created by Nüwa with the power of a genius’s bloodline.”
“Nüwa said that this is her most perfect creation. Her talent and aptitude even exceed the cosmic level they cultivated. However, because it was too difficult to send her to this era, Nüwa only sealed a half-finished product in this ruin.”
“And the way to revive her is for the five super divine humans with the marks of Earth, which is the traces of Blue Planet, to awaken her with the power of the super divine bloodline. This way, not only can she awaken the aptitude from her previous life, but she can also obtain some of their talent aptitude from the five super divine humans. From there, she will become the human with the strongest talent in the two eras. She will almost definitely become a cosmic level.”
“Even if the Pyro Plan fails, even if no one chooses to come to this era, as long as she successfully arrives, as long as five super divine humans of Blue Planet in this era are born, find this place, awaken her, and nurture her, there’s still hope of a cosmic holder being born in this era.”
“Apart from that, the inheritor of Goddess Wa, the reincarnation of Earth, also has a high chance of achieving the great cosmic level by nurturing her to the cosmic level.”
After Goddess Wa finished speaking, everyone was stunned. They looked at the little clay figure in disbelief.
This little girl’s appearance was actually so powerful? She would definitely become a cosmic level?

chapters.title: Chapter 1823: Hope of the Village (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1823: Hope of the Village (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Among the crowd, only Shi Yu didn’t smile.
Instead, the corners of his mouth twitched fiercely.
“Then let’s awaken her through our power and let her inherit our talent potential. Am I considered her godfather? Haha,” Lin Feng said.
His child was useless, but if he took in a goddaughter who could become a future cosmic level, it would be very good too.
“No.” At this moment, Shi Yu said bluntly, “I refuse.”
Everyone: “?”
“A new creature created with the power of a genius’s bloodline…” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth were still twitching. “This Goddess Wa uses my bloodline!”
“F*ck, moreover, it was definitely without my knowledge.”
Shi Yu was angry. In the index, he had once said that it didn’t matter if he didn’t become the holder of the universe because some experts still had other backup plans. The backup plans were in this ruin.
Even he didn’t know what this backup plan was.
Now, Shi Yu understood why he didn’t know. It was because Goddess Wa and the others had definitely secretly used the power of his bloodline to create this child.
At the start, he definitely rejected it.
What was this surprise? Shi Yu was directly shocked. He knew it. When he entered, he felt that something was wrong and sensed an affinity bloodline power. Now, he understood.
He suddenly had a daughter for no reason, and she was a biological daughter of the same bloodline as him. Who could tolerate this?
In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, Chi Tong was also stunned. She bit her finger and fell into deep thought.
Eleven and the others couldn’t think straight either, but they felt that it wasn’t a big problem.
At this moment, some people were shocked when they learned that this little clay figurine was created with Shi Yu’s bloodline power. Of course, Goddess Wa and the others seemed to have expected it long ago. They only fell silent.
“She, she…” Senior Lu pointed at the little clay figurine and looked at Shi Yu. “So this, from the perspective of bloodline, is your daughter, right?”
Shi Yu said, “If she’s revived, you can say that. However, I don’t have any intention of having a real biological daughter…”
Although he called Chi Tong his biological daughter, this wasn’t the same thing at all. Shi Yu only hoped that Goddess Wa purely used his bloodline and didn’t add any other nonsense.
Otherwise, even if Goddess Wa was the goddess of creation, he would transmigrate back and talk to her nicely and ask for some compensation for mental damage.
It was too much.
If she revived, would he care? Regardless, it was definitely not suitable, but if he cared, contracting a pet was alright, but Shi Yu really didn’t have the EXP to nurture a “person”.
Moreover, if he had a daughter before he got married, how could he find a partner in the future?
At this moment, as Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone fell silent.
Looking at this little clay figure, they didn’t know how to deal with it.
“So, is it over?” Emperor Wu said. “Why are the experts of the last era so obsessed with nurturing the cosmic holder, the holder of the universe?”
“They should be dead already.”
“It’s over,” Goddess Wa said.
“This question might only be answered by Shi Yu.”
When Shi Yu heard that, he shrugged and said, “My guess is that after the birth of the holder of the universe, the era that ended previously might still appear again in the form of a ‘parallel universe’ and coexist with this cosmic era. One main universe and multiple parallel universes, thereby giving these experts a second chance to be reborn.”
“Otherwise, there’s no need to spend so much effort.”
“Therefore, if I really become the holder of the universe one day, everyone will have a chance to travel to the parallel universes of other eras…”
And if he failed…
It could be said that the little clay person in front of him was the hope of the entire Earth Village…
“Since Shi Yu is unwilling, don’t awaken her,” Goddess Wa said as she looked at the clay figure.
“It’s not that I’m unwilling, but I’m not ready yet,” Shi Yu said. “Sigh, how should I put it? In any case, there’s no hurry.”
“I understand,” Lin Feng said. “I was nervous about being a father for the first time too, but I was used to it. It’s actually no different from raising a pet.”
“You’re so disgusting. Can you talk normally?” Divine Source said.
“Then, who will you hand her to for safekeeping?” Goddess Wa asked.
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu said, “Well… I’m not sure who to give her to. It’s better for me to keep her myself.”
“In short, even if I want to awaken her, I won’t let her pursue any cosmic holder. Such a dangerous thing can’t be arranged for an unborn child.”
The outcome of this exploration of the ruins exceeded everyone’s expectations.
However, there were no huge gains.
Of course, it wasn’t that there were no gains at all. At least Goddess Wa was satisfied.
In the ruins, Goddess Wa had some insights and learned impressive information from Nüwa.
Was her cosmic path on creating humans?
All along, although she had received the inheritance of Nüwa, Goddess Wa had always treated the other party’s inheritance as a power obtained postnatally. It was the same when she mainly developed her original power and advanced to the cosmic level.
However, she failed.
And now, Nüwa actually left a message saying that her inheritor and Blue Planet’s cosmic path might be on that little girl. This made Goddess Wa think about whether she should imitate Nüwa’s path and try to break through to the cosmic level.
It relied on creating humans to become a cosmic emperor.
Logically speaking, it was very difficult to become a cosmic level by imitating, but now, Goddess Wa didn’t know what to do. She could only choose to believe Nüwa’s judgment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1824: Hope of the Village (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1824: Hope of the Village (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
As for the Empress and the others, they were feeling pity.
Especially the Empress. When she saw an opportunity to become the godmother of Shi Yu’s daughter slip away, she knew that she had missed an opportunity to increase her seniority. Chi Tong was Shi Yu’s biological daughter, and Chi Tong called her sister. She was one generation lower than Shi Yu for no reason.
However, if it could contribute its bloodline power and revive that child to let the other party inherit a portion of its talent, this seniority could probably be reversed. Chi Tong still had to call her Mom.
When Shi Yu and the others were in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain, the other guy Shi Yu was thinking about finally returned to Blue Planet after four years.
“Damn Shi Yu, damn Shi Yu. That woman took me away because of you.”
After the gem cat returned to Blue Planet, it was still very traumatized by its experience in the past four years.
Although it was four years, she felt like 400 years had passed!
Although its realm had received an unprecedented increase, approaching the peak of the universe and reaching the peak of the super divine level, the gem cat felt that she might need millions of years to heal from this experience.
That woman in black and white hair really didn’t treat her as a cat. How could she bully such a cute little cat like her?
“I’m finally back, but…”
At this moment, the gem cat returned to Blue Planet and realized that apart from being able to sense Blue Planet’s Will, the experts on Blue Planet weren’t here.
She was slightly puzzled, but she didn’t think too much about it. She would treat it as if those people were on World King Planet.
After thinking about it, the gem cat flew away from Blue Planet and directly made a wish to teleport to World King Planet. However, after arriving, she realized that there were still no traces of Shi Yu and the others.
“So he went there!” The gem cat used the Star Contract to sense Little Zi’s location before confirming Shi Yu’s current location.
“Damn it, you’re not bringing me along again.” She was indignant.
But forget it. Compared to this, she had more important things to do.
In the Astrologer Family in the Dong Huang Realm.
After getting close to Dong Huang, forget about the owl, even the Exposing King was already super divine.
The Astrologer Family had joined the Blue Planet bloodline and could be said to be doing well.
At this moment, the Exposing King Tu Tu felt that even if he announced his identity as the Exposing King, no one would dare to do anything to it.
After all, his sister was one of the two cat-headed military advisors beside Shi Yu!
“Who…”
However, soon, the peaceful atmosphere was broken. A powerful super divine pressure suddenly descended, shocking the Exposing King Tu Tu and the Prediction Owl in the Astrologer Race.
The siblings quickly flew out of the family and into the sky. Then, they saw the gem cat girl standing calmly in the sky.
“Long time no see.” Seeing the shocked expressions of the Prediction Owl and the Exposing King, the gem cat felt secretly pleased. “Speaking of which, do you know where Shi Yu and the others are?”
Although she already knew, she still asked to be more natural.
“You, you, you, you…” At this moment, the Prediction Owl exploded. It sensed the terrifying aura on the gem cat’s body, the aura that was comparable to a peak super divine. Her breathing was rapid, and her voice was dry and hoarse. She couldn’t believe it.
“What’s wrong with me?” The gem cat had an innocent expression.
“Why are you…”
“Oh, you mean the realm? I easily became a super divine without much effort previously. In the past few years, I’ve come to a realization and casually worked hard. However, I feel that with Shi Yu’s breakthrough speed, he’s still lacking. He’s indeed an animal,” said the gem cat.
Prediction Owl and Exposing King: ???
“Looks like you don’t know where Shi Yu is either. Forget it, it doesn’t matter.” The gem cat girl looked at the Exposing King and said, “Help me with something.”
“I want to know what races participated in the destruction of the Star Prayer Race back then.”
“It’s time to settle everything.” She looked up at the starry sky. Since she had accepted the inheritance of the Star Prayer Race, as the only Star Prayer Race today, she also had to vent the painful experience of the past four years and let others feel the pain.
She had a premonition that after helping the Star Prayer Race end their karma, she could still be stronger.
Well, it was actually the final training handed to her by the Empress. The gem cat was also very helpless.
“What are you doing?” The Prediction Owl swallowed its saliva and said, “That group of guys is even larger than the Four Holy Family.”
“You’re afraid?”
“What’s there to be afraid of? Steal them,” the Prediction Owl said excitedly. “Although I don’t know what’s wrong with you, with Shi Yu protecting you, what’s there to be afraid of?”
“There’s no need for Shi Yu. Now, I’m also invincible in the Cosmic Sea. Ordinary super divines are no match for me,” the gem cat said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1825: The Cat Returns (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1825: The Cat Returns (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Are these those guys?”
In the Astrologer Family, the Prediction Owl gave the gem cat a list.
Looking at this list, the gem cat fell into deep thought. Most of the factions on this list were indeed more terrifying than the Four Holy Family.
The strongest expert of the Four Holy Family was only at the middle stage of the super divine level.
Although their family had developed to hundreds of realms, the main activity location was still World King Planet.
However, most factions could already “establish themselves” on the list given by the Prediction Owl.
The main foundation was no longer on the World King Planet. They were all in the Cosmic Sea. With their own territory, this meant that they no longer needed the protection of the World King Planet and had already stood among the powerful factions in the universe.
For example, the Beast Taming Genius of the thirteen heavens of the Cosmic Sea. His family was such a family. They controlled their own star domain and had several permanent teleportation arrays. They could be said to be powerful in the starry sky, and there was a high-level super divine presiding in the family.
Of course, the current Blue Planet was almost in the same situation. Even without the protection of the World King Planet, as long as it wasn’t targeted by the universe, it could dominate the starry sky and not be afraid of any disasters.
“What are you going to do? They’re all over the various star areas of the Cosmic Sea. It’s a huge project for you to take revenge,” the Prediction Owl said.
“It doesn’t matter. I don’t have to attack,” the gem cat said.
“With this list, it’s enough.”
Her eyes changed slightly, and her blue eyes turned into the nine-colored Nine Gem Eye. It was like dazzling stars spinning, and immediately, billions of stars in the Cosmic Sea appeared in front of her.
“Star Prayer Curse.”
Boom!
In an instant, the Sea of Stars trembled, but it was as if nothing had happened on the gem cat’s side.
“Hey, hey, hey, what did you do?” the Exposing King said.
The gem cat: “It’s nothing. It’s just a wish for all the factions that participated in the destruction of the Star Prayer Race to encounter more cosmic disasters.”
“The effect is worse on direct participants than on indirect participants. Even if it’s an innocent descendant, as long as it’s related to them at all, it will have bad luck for decades.”
“Yes, it should be about the same. It’s about to happen. I’ll go take a look.”
With that said, the gem cat flew out of the World King Planet.
Because a small number of factions also settled on World King Planet, a cosmic disaster suddenly appeared near World King Planet.
First, a time hole appeared in the starry sky. This was a special phenomenon that only appeared with very small chances in the starry sky of the universe. It could teleport things from very, very far away.
Back then, the Space Emperor was teleported near the World King Planet by this thing.
At this moment, the time hole appeared abnormally. What teleported over was a huge meteorite that contained a strong attraction. From the size, it was no longer inferior to Blue Planet before the Mythical Revival.
At this moment, the power of this meteorite wasn’t enough to attract the World King Planet. Instead, it was attracted by the World King Planet and directly fell to a certain place…
“Good lord.” The gem cat’s eyes lit up.
“Damn, it won’t be an accidental injury, right? The wish won’t hurt the innocent. I hope he’s alright…” As she prayed again, another Starry Sky Storm appeared in the starry sky and blew towards a certain place.
Right on the heels of that, the Cold Silence wave was born out of thin air in a certain place, turning into a cold stream that surged towards the World King Planet.
Disasters appeared so frequently that the Space Disaster Research Institute was caught off guard.
Although to a certain extent, they could predict cosmic disasters in advance and prevent them, this time, cosmic disasters appeared too suddenly.
After all, as a cosmic-level star, the cosmic will had to give it face. The chances of encountering a cosmic disaster around the World King Planet were extremely small, but this time, it was extremely abnormal.
This situation not only appeared near the World King Planet, but also in the various star domains of the Cosmic Sea. Even countless light years away from the World King Planet, cosmic disasters of various sizes occurred.
For example, when the starry sky trembled, a spatial vibration was now invading a star field, instantly causing the family business accumulated by a super faction for countless years to collapse with a bang.
“This isn’t an accident.” A high-level super divine who resisted the spatial vibration and coughed up blood looked in a direction fiercely.
“Someone cursed our family. This is a premeditated attack. Who is it, who exactly is it?”
Soon, the Cosmic Sea was in chaos.
Many super factions encountered a cosmic disaster out of thin air, forcing some families to wake up and go out to resist to prevent their foundation from being completely destroyed.
At the same time, the gem cat didn’t hide its curse power. It didn’t take long for many experts to sense that the curse power came from near World King Planet.
As famous experts in the Cosmic Sea, how could they withstand such humiliation? They all descended on the World King Planet with extremely fast methods.
“You have a death wish. How dare you plot against me!”
Soon, the native experts of the World King Planet and some experts who rode a permanent teleportation array to solve the “origin” ascended to the starry sky outside the World King Planet and discovered the gem cat girl in the Star Prayer Robe who was surrounded by starlight like a holy maiden. She pressed her palms together and prayed in the universe.
After these people discovered the power fluctuations on the gem cat’s body, their expressions changed and they revealed shocked expressions, as if they had seen something ridiculous.
“The power of the Star Prayer, the Star Prayer Race…”
“Why…”
After discovering that it was the Star Prayer Race who attacked, the entire starry sky trembled.
Wasn’t the Star Prayer Race exterminated?

chapters.title: Chapter 1826: The Cat Returns (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1826: The Cat Returns (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
After such a big thing happened, even factions unrelated to this incident had already learned of the World King Planet and paid attention to the starry sky.
On the World King Planet network, the scene of the gem cat girl being surrounded by many super divines crazily spread.
“It’s her?!” In the Dong Huang Realm, the Tyrannical Sea Legendary looked at the cat girl in the scene in confusion and shock.
Wasn’t this Teacher Ying?
“Ying…” The Dragon God also looked at the live broadcast that shocked the entire World King Planet in surprise. It couldn’t believe that its good friend was so fierce today.
The little white dragon… the ice dragon… They were all stunned.
Teacher Cat… stood up and actually faced more than ten super divines alone!
“A karmic connection.”
In the starry sky, the gem cat girl slowly opened her eyes and answered simply, looking at these “enemies” that had been attracted by her.
There was once Shi Yu who fought a hundred super divines alone. Today, she, the cat, would sweep through all the strong enemies!
Karma…
Upon hearing the gem cat girl’s words, these people immediately realized something, and their expressions changed drastically.
Boom!
However, it was too late. The gem cat’s expression suddenly turned cold. The terrifying Psychic wave directly turned into a cosmic tide and swept over, making the expressions of these super divines change again. As a low-level plant super divine was closest, it was almost instantly crushed into dregs by psychic power and turned into nothingness.
“No matter who you are, do you want to start a ‘war’?”
These super divines were also forced to come here because the gem cat’s curse had already been formed. They would be attacked no matter where they were. It was better to come to the source. However, they didn’t expect that not only them, but so many experts were actually cursed. Moreover, now that so many people had gathered, this cat girl was still so domineering.
Each of them was a powerful super divine of the Cosmic Sea. They had made illustrious contributions in the Starry Sky Battlefield. Wasn’t this cat girl afraid of causing the Cosmic Sea to tremble?
“Boom!”
In the next second, another mid-stage super divine was crushed by psychic power, and a source of transcendence erupted, making the eyes of the Prediction Owl, who was observing in the dark, light up.
“Damn, it’s so cool. Why is this cat so strong? I’m so envious.” The owl cried to death. It was fine if it was Shi Yu, but if the gem cat, who was also a hooligan, was like this… The owl wasn’t convinced.
“Buzz!”
In the next moment, another high-level super divine became the gem cat’s main target. However, this time, the gem cat’s psychic wave only repelled the other party and didn’t successfully insta-kill it.
After this high-level super divine resisted with difficulty, he sweated and heaved a sigh of relief. Then, he subconsciously smiled.
“I thought you were so arrogant and strong, but it turns out you’re only at the high-level super divine level.”
In the dark, the owl covered its mouth. Although the gem cat didn’t erupt with all its might now and didn’t have a stronger aura than when it postured with them, no matter what, this was also an attack at the peak of the super divine level. It was actually regarded by others as a high-level super divine… the weakest peak super divine mace!
As expected of you. You’re already at the peak of the super divine level, but you still sit firmly on the weakest throne.
The gem cat: ???
In the face of its opponent’s provocation, the gem cat gritted its teeth fiercely. “I’m not angry either.” It erupted with stronger psychic power.
Boom!!
“Everyone, work together and kill this cat,” the high-level super divine said.
When the dozen or so super divines heard that, their expressions immediately turned cold. They nodded heavily. There weren’t many simple factions that dared to attack the rare race of the World King Planet, the Star Prayer Race, and adopt the Star Prayer Race as slaves. Their strength was naturally needless to say.
Under the joint efforts of more than ten super divines, their strength was mastered, and they easily pushed away the psychic sweep this time.
“Hu…” In the next moment, these super divines sighed and looked at the unhappy gem cat girl opposite them.
Although they said that it wasn’t strong, this Star Prayer Race indeed gave them a huge pressure.
“Sir, do you know what you’re doing?”
“From today onwards, there will be no place for you in the entire Cosmic Sea.”
“Even if you can escape, your family and friends can forget about surviving in this world from now on.” A super divine who had transcended level seven looked at the gem cat with a murderous aura.
Gem Cat: “?”
“Are you crazy?” The gem cat mocked softly. “Forget it, I won’t play with you anymore. In that case, I’ll show you my true strength.”
She took a deep breath. Ten colorful suns suddenly appeared behind her, enveloping the entire World King Planet under the phenomenon of the ten-colored sun.
As soon as the phenomenon appeared, the hearts of the super divines who still wanted to resist just now trembled, and they revealed incredulous expressions again.
“Peak super divine??”
They originally thought that this Star Prayer Race could only transcend nine times at most, but now, the number of transcendence sources of the gem cat immediately stunned them. They couldn’t understand why a peak super divine had suddenly been born.
“Who said I was weak just now…” The gem cat’s gaze swept across, and a ten-colored Psychic wave instantly penetrated. In the next moment, a high-level super divine body was crushed, and it died with grievances. There were still its shocked mental fluctuations in the starry sky.
“Well, you seem to have eaten the Star Prayer Race before. You deserve to die.” The gem cat looked at a dragon-shaped super divine again and swept its gaze over. This dragon-shaped super divine’s body also suddenly exploded.
In the World King Planet, countless people watched this terrifying live broadcast and were extremely shocked. Seeing these big shots whose names shook the starry sky being crushed like chickens in the hands of this cat girl, they were all afraid.
Boom!! Boom! Boom!!
Just now, the super divines thought that they could resist, but now, even high-level super divines were extremely panicked when facing the gem cat.

chapters.title: Chapter 1827: The Cat Returns (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1827: The Cat Returns (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
In any case, the gem cat didn’t think that it was the weakest peak super divine. She was a disciple of a cosmic level… She had learned the spiritual development system of the previous era.
For example, she was also confident of defeating the two peak super divine experts Shi Yu had defeated previously, although it wasn’t as easy as Shi Yu…
Then, just as the gem cat was about to kill all these enemies of Star Prayer, suddenly, a super divine middle-stage Time Fox asked for help.
“Sir God Lu, save me.”
As soon as it finished speaking, another peak super divine aura came from the void… No, it was even stronger than ordinary peak super divine auras, even stronger than the Sun God General. This strong aura blocked the gem cat’s attack.
“Who is it?” the gem cat said unhappily again.
“It should be one of the peak super divine experts under the World King, the human Beast Tamer Lu Ming. He has a pet that seems to be the Time Fox. There’s probably a connection.” Just as the gem cat was blocked, another figure walked out of the starry sky.
Shi Yu, who was wearing a panda casual suit, walked out of the starry sky.
When the gem cat saw Shi Yu, it said in surprise, “You’re back.”
“I sensed the commotion here in the Scarlet Blue Star Domain. How can I not return as soon as possible?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
“You’re really something.”
“It’s all for you,” the gem cat said.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Alright, I understand.”
With that said, he looked at the void and said, “Lu Ming, right? Can you give me some leeway and ignore this matter?”
“This matter isn’t something a peak super divine like you can interfere in.”
No one expected Shi Yu to appear because very few people knew about the relationship between the gem cat and Shi Yu.
At this moment, the figure in the void was clearly extremely silent about Shi Yu’s appearance.
The gazes of the super divines chased by the gem cat exploded.
Shi Yu’s appearance made the starry sky tremble even more than the sudden appearance of the gem cat, a peak super divine. Such a vibration even shocked the other peak super divines on the World King Planet, such as the Sun God General.
On World King Planet, those watching the live broadcast felt their hearts about to explode.
Although the younger generation didn’t know about Shi Yu and the one he named, the older generation knew very well that it was the ruthless person who scared the five super divines of Blue Planet into not daring to come out of seclusion for millions of years and killed several super divines.
