And now, Shi Yu actually said to the other party that this matter wasn’t something a peak super divine like him could interfere in. This was simply…
What made the experts observing in the dark the most unbelievable was a slow voice coming from the void.
“Alright, then I’ll give you some leeway this time.”
With that said, this peak super divine aura wave disappeared directly. Although the middle-stage super divine Time Fox didn’t know what relationship it had with Lu Ming, it had undoubtedly been given up at this moment.
The super divine peaks who were regarded by the gem cat as enemies had pale expressions and revealed looks of despair.
If it was just the gem cat, even if they couldn’t defeat it, they might still have a chance to escape. However, the moment a ruthless person like Shi Yu appeared, they knew that this Star Prayer Race was related to a ferocious person like Shi Yu. These people understood that even the peak super divine under the World King couldn’t save them.
This ferocious guy could even destroy a peak super divine just like that.
It was known as the seventh cosmic emperor.
This day was destined to be another extremely turbulent day for the World King Planet and the Cosmic Sea. More than ten super divines died, and more than ten super factions were affected until they almost died. It was really shocking to the starry sky.
Soon, everyone understood what was going on.
These super factions involved the sale, transaction, and enslavement of rare races. This was originally a very common thing in the starry sky. Even on Blue Planet, ordinary people raised many domestic animals and pets that could be killed at any time.
However, the essence of this starry sky was that whoever had the bigger fist made sense. Now that an expert who could suppress the Sea of Stars had appeared in the Star Prayer Race that had been exterminated and divided, even Shi Yu was standing behind this race. Those factions that had targeted the Star Prayer Race couldn’t escape punishment no matter what.
“Scary, too scary.”
“That mysterious expert with a human body and a snake tail, Shi Yu himself, and that Star Prayer Goddess just now, three experts at the peak of the super divine level!!”
“Moreover, two of them are definitely not something ordinary peak super divines can compare to. When exactly did another such faction condense in the Cosmic Sea?”
Not only was it the peak battle power, but everyone also thought of the backbone forces like Emperor Shi, the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the new super divines. Their scalps went numb, and they felt that the Blue Planet bloodline was too terrifying.
It was also on this day that the various factions on the World King Planet and even the Cosmic Sea knew that another peak super divine expert had been born. Her name was Ying, and she was from the Gem Cat Race. She was an existence that definitely couldn’t be provoked.
At this moment, this existence that definitely couldn’t be provoked was eating and drinking crazily with a gem fruit and a cup of gem fruit juice.
“Delicious, so delicious.” Teacher Ying cried as she ate.
“Slow down, slow down,” Shi Yu said. “Teacher Cat, did the Empress starve you?”
“It’s mainly because she doesn’t care about food at all. When I said I was hungry, she let me inhale energy crystals. Although that thing can maintain its state, it’s not delicious,” the gem cat said.
“The food I made a wish for myself… How can I be in the state to make a wish for delicious food? Every time I finish training, I’m exhausted. I’m almost never in perfect condition.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1828: The Cat Returns (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1828: The Cat Returns (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Uh,” Shi Yu said. “But no matter what, four years at the peak of the super divine level is very worth the suffering…”
“In short, it’s finally over,” the gem cat said. “Moreover, after sanctioning those factions, I’m also feeling refreshed now. I feel that the fusion between those Wish Stars and me is completely compatible. No wonder the Empress wanted me to deal with them.”
Shi Yu said, “By the way, has the modification of the source of transcendence been completed?”
The gem cat said, “The Empress modified a portion of it. I’m just short of completing the last process. I tried to perfect one and spent two months. The Empress felt that it was too slow, so she kicked me out and let me resolve the resentment of the Wish Star.”
“Now, I don’t feel like I can perfect one in a month.”
Shi Yu said, “Then give me the one that’s perfected first. There are still 71 left, right? I’ll give you 60 months to perfect it as soon as possible. As you perfect it, I’ll use it…”
The gem cat: “?”
She looked at Shi Yu with tears in her eyes and said, “I just returned. Do you want to rush me to death? Can you let me rest for a month before starting work? Just a month!!!”
Shi Yu smiled. “Alright, alright, alright. One month, I’ll give you two months. Moreover, eat well. Baby Ginseng, who has transcended seven times, carefully makes the full set meal of gem fruits every day.”
“That’s more like it.” Teacher Ying was satisfied and instantly felt comfortable.
“Unfortunately, this is technical work. My clones can’t do it. Otherwise, I would directly get my clones to settle it for you in a day.”
“Speaking of which, how’s your exploration of the ruins?” the gem cat asked.
“This” Shi Yu scratched his head, not knowing how to explain.
A moment later.
A shocked voice came from the room.
“You said that your bloodline daughter is sealed in the ruins???”
“What a joke.”
“Yes, why not!! If you don’t raise it, you can raise it for others. Goddess Wa and the Blue Planet’s Will will definitely be willing to raise it. After all, it concerns their cosmic level.”
“If it really doesn’t work, I can barely help you take care of the baby.”
“We’ll start work tomorrow, thank you,” Shi Yu said. “Where’s the Demon Divine Stone I gave you previously?? Have you raised that little demon to death?”
“No, I didn’t. I just let it grow!”
After the exploration of the ruins was completed, the cat returned, and the Blue Planet people also returned. For Blue Planet, it could be said that the universe was completely peaceful.
Apart from the Empress who had successfully advanced to the super divine level, the others also began to challenge their super divine path.
Although the gem cat had dropped another pile of source of transcendence and she now had the initial ability to increase the quality of the source of transcendence, everyone still planned to pursue the next 11 levels and break the limit.
As for Shi Yu, he also used the only perfect ball of source of transcendence as a cultivation resource.
With just one try, Shi Yu fell in love with this feeling and was extremely excited.
It only took ten days to refine a source of transcendence, but the strengthening it brought him was equivalent to about 100,000 years of bitter cultivation.
Moreover, it wasn’t that kind of bitter cultivation that purely meditated, but the strengthening of the soul, body, and spirit in all aspects.
Shi Yu made a simple calculation. If he refined all the source of transcendence, he might be able to increase his cultivation by more than 7 million years.
This was simply… definitely enough to send him and all his pets to the peak of the super divine level.
Ten days later, Shi Yu, who had enjoyed cheating, couldn’t help but get up and find the gem cat that was lazing around. “I’m done absorbing that. When are you starting?”
“Didn’t you say two months??” The gem cat, who was holding the tablet and watching the movie, said angrily.
“I regret it. Please start work now. You don’t want the empress to know that you don’t work after returning and only know how to slack off, right?”
The gem cat: “?”
“Hey, Teacher Ying, please. In return, I’ll let Baby Ginseng take care of your food for the rest of your life, alright?”
Baby Ginseng: “?”
“Stop showing off. Someone seems to be looking for you outside.” The gem cat was angry.
Shi Yu scratched his cheek with a helpless expression. He shrugged and teleported outside.
In the outside world.
Shi Yu’s familiar figure, the super god in his eyes in the past, the president of the Environmental Protection Association, Bing Ling, was looking at Shi Yu seriously.
“Sorry to disturb you, Shi Yu. There’s something I need to discuss with you.”
“Senior Bing Ling? What’s wrong?” Shi Yu said. The Environmental Protection Association had helped him in the battle for the source of transcendence. Although it wasn’t very useful, Shi Yu still remembered it.
“Do you know that the World King was weak and fell into a deep sleep again?” Bing Ling said. “I obtained information from the Sun God General that for some reason, the World King consumed a lot of strength and had no choice but to fall into a deep sleep.”
Shi Yu was stunned. Could it be… because of the time when he teleported them back to ancient times??
The World King indeed seemed to have said that she would have to pay a considerable price to do this.
“What’s wrong? Doesn’t Lord World King often sleep?”
Bing Ling said, “Indeed, but Lord World King’s weak state this time is unprecedented. In addition, it’s said that the Dark King woke up in the Contaminated Land instead. Moreover, although you killed many super divines of the Contaminated Land and they retreated step by step, not only did their aura not decrease, but they also showed signs of counterattacking. I have a premonition that the Cosmic Sea will have a violent collision with the Contaminated Land next.”
“If possible, I hope to obtain your and Susu’s help to guard the Cosmic Sea.”
Shi Yu said, “It’s a small problem. As long as the Dark King doesn’t come, I’ll kill no matter how many other polluted races come!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1829: Sick (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1829: Sick (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“It’s a small problem. As long as the Dark King doesn’t come, I’ll kill no matter how many other polluted races come!”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, Bing Ling nodded slightly.
“I believe you, but I’m afraid that the Dark King will come too.”
“Ah, this…” Shi Yu said, “I don’t think so.”
“Lord World King’s condition isn’t good. No one can say for sure.” Bing Ling shook her head.
“Of course, I don’t mean for you to deal with the Dark King. I’m not that heartless.” She smiled.
“It’s just that if the Dark King personally goes to battle, even if it doesn’t attack, the strength and morale of the Dark King Army will become unprecedentedly powerful.”
“It’s roughly equivalent to saying that the Dark King Army is a pet army with a cosmic-level Beast Tamer strengthening them behind their backs. Do you understand?”
“Is that so?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “As a behind-the-scenes strengthener, the Dark King still let his subordinates go out to battle and doesn’t do it himself. This way, it won’t cause a cosmic dispute. However, Lord World King’s condition isn’t good. I’m afraid he can’t strengthen the army of the Cosmic Sea as a behind-the-scenes chess player.”
“This way, during the period when the World King is sleeping, the Cosmic Sea might even be swallowed some territory. The Dark King will also become stronger because of this.”
“Well, that’s what I mean,” Bing Ling said. “If things really turn into this, although the Sun God General, Lu Ming, and the World Divine Dragon will attack later, it’s actually still not enough to face an army with cosmic strengthening.”
The Sun God General, Lu Ming, and the World Divine Dragon were the three peak super divine experts under the World King.
The Sun God was the strongest stellar life form in the universe. Lu Ming was a human and had several powerful pets under him. The World Deity Dragon Race was a super strong race ranked at the top of the myriad races in the starry sky. It was also born on the World King Planet. It could be said that during the early stages of the World King Planet’s birth, it had always accompanied the growth of the World King Planet, similar to the five divine races on Blue Planet.
Of course, apart from these three parties, there was also a hidden peak super divine like the observer, who was also under the World King.
However, it was definitely not enough for these people to interfere in a cosmic-level dispute.
Therefore, in order to deal with the possible war, Bing Ling first came to ask for Shi Yu’s opinion on this throne known as the “seventh universe level”.
As long as the cosmic level didn’t take action personally, even if the super divine level was strengthened by the cosmic level, if Shi Yu could preside over the Cosmic Sea, the chances of winning would greatly increase.
After all, Shi Yu could kill a peak super divine at the divine level. No one knew how strong Shi Yu, who had absorbed the strongest transcendent source in the era, was.
Moreover, the Blue Planet bloodline Shi Yu represented was also a power that couldn’t be ignored. Just Goddess Wa… was a super expert not inferior to or even stronger than the Sun God General.
If this batch of experts could all gather together, even if Lord World King couldn’t wake up, he should be able to withstand the attack of the Contaminated Land.
After confirming with Shi Yu, Bing Ling left. Shi Yu also shook his head and entered the room.
“If the Dark King Army really wants to attack while the World King is weak, wouldn’t that be just nice to farm EXP for Susu?”
“However, President Bing Ling is right. It’s more or less a little dangerous to involve a cosmic-level war… The strength of a super divine level is still a little lacking. If only I could reach the cosmic level faster.”
Shi Yu looked into the room. The gem cat had already disappeared. The corners of his mouth twitched. His psychic power directly enveloped the Dong Huang Realm. Then, in a luxurious house with a pool, sunlight, and plants, he discovered the gem cat lying leisurely on the beach in a swimsuit.
“Cough,” Shi Yu said. “Teacher Ying, it’s useless even if you run. Did you hear President Bing Ling just now?”
“The Dark King Army might want to attack the Cosmic Sea. Susu and I can’t sit back and do nothing. We urgently need strength. You don’t want us to die in the Void Battlefield, right?”
In the distance, when it heard Shi Yu’s telepathy, the gem cat’s face fell. “If you can die, I’ll fall down and find you.”
Stop lying to her. The gem cat already knew that Shi Yu had the protection of a cosmic-level empress and the throne of the sixth universe. With that woman’s strength, the Dark King might not necessarily be able to defeat her. It would be difficult for Shi Yu to die even if he wanted to.
“Alright, alright, alright. Then help me with something else. When you’ve rested enough, you can modify the source of transcendence.”
“What help?” The gem cat girl took off her sunglasses.
“I know the location of a pile of era ruins, but there are too many era ruins, more than I imagined. It’s impossible to explore them all in a short period of time. In order to avoid wasting time, I want to choose the key points to explore.”
“I need the power of you and Teacher Owl to help me divine which ruins are the most suitable for me first.”
“Wu.” When the gem cat heard that, although it was also a technical job, as long as it used the ruins to send Shi Yu away, he shouldn’t rush her to work like he was urging her to die. That was alright.
“Sure, go find the owl!”
“Alright.” Shi Yu shrugged.
Even if the gem cat didn’t rest to modify the source of transcendence all day, with her turtle speed, Shi Yu would have a lot of free time for a long time. During this period of time, it was better to use it to explore the era ruins of the Cosmic Sea and see if he could find some treasures from the era ruins to increase his strength.
A moment later.
In the Astrologer Race, the Prediction Owl was also called over by Shi Yu.
She immediately ran over to Shi Yu with her family’s treasure.
Although the owl had just become a super divine not long ago, her family had the “cosmic treasure” “divination crystal ball”. With the support of this exclusive tool of the astrologer race, the divination ability of other races couldn’t surpass their race.

chapters.title: Chapter 1830: Sick (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1830: Sick (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Soon, the two cats gathered beside Shi Yu.
“You should be able to predict which ruins are the most suitable for you, right?”
The Prediction Owl touched the crystal ball and muttered, “Old Ying, quickly buff me.”
“Climb.” The gem cat exploded in anger. It was fine if it was Shi Yu, but how could a small early-stage super divine like him dare to?
“How disrespectful. Be careful, I’ll curse you to encounter cosmic disasters every day.”
“I’m just kidding…” The Prediction Owl smiled in embarrassment and said, “Ying God, come and give me a buff.”
“Ling, you come too.” A green and white Rubik’s Cube appeared beside Shi Yu’s shoulder. He distributed the power of his luck to the Prediction Owl, hoping that it would be lucky enough to predict the location of valuable ruins.
Soon, luck and the power of the Star Prayer worked on the Prediction Owl. It held the crystal ball with a serious expression and predicted according to the star map provided by Shi Yu.
In the next moment.
As expected, with the support of a pile of super experts and supreme divine weapons, the owl’s premonition was very successful. Soon, the crystal ball mapped the future content and a coordinate appeared.
However, at the same time, a chaotic spatial power also made the Prediction Owl’s brain rumble. Many complicated information appeared like needles, making her suddenly cover her head and scream.
“Hello.”
The owl’s change shocked Shi Yu and the others. Fortunately, it was only for an instant. She recovered with sweat all over her face. Although she was still holding her head and panting, her expression looked calm.
“Teacher Owl, are you alright? What’s going on?” Shi Yu asked.
“It’s alright,” the owl said. “It’s just that this ruin is a little special. His master might still…”
“Still be alive in this universe!”
“Oh?” Shi Yu said.
The owl said, “It’s this era ruin that was created by someone in the last era. However, this creator, like you, successfully came to this era as a transmigrator.”
“It’s precisely because of this that the interference I suffered this time is a little strong.”
Shi Yu frowned and said, “Huh?”
Empress?
Shi Yu immediately thought of the empress. Was it a ruin created by this guy in his previous life?
“This location is the Vegetable Star Domain.” Shi Yu looked at the crystal ball and said, “The border star domain of the Cosmic Sea close to the worm nest…”
“Right.”
“Are you sure that this ruin is the most suitable era ruin for me to explore now?” Shi Yu touched his chin and said, “I thought that you would divine a ruin related to the ‘evolution-type cosmic treasure’.”
“In the end, it’s a ruin with information about transmigrators. Why do I feel that there’s a pit again?”
“Do you want to explore?” the gem cat asked. “Go, go. It definitely sounds like there’s important information.”
Shi Yu said, “You just want to chase me away. Forget it, since your premonition results are out, let’s make a trip.”
Vegetable Star Domain was a very special star domain. It was located at the border of the Cosmic Sea and was one of the few star domains closest to the worm nest. It was very similar to the geographical location of the Blue Star Domain.
Shi Yu’s curiosity was still aroused by the owl and the others’ divination. He arrived at a planet in the Vegetable Star Region.
In a huge mountain, Shi Yu walked in the wild forest in the mountains and sensed the situation of the era ruins.
“Interesting.” Shi Yu strolled here for a long time and kept using his Passage of Time skill, but he couldn’t crack and open this ruin. This ruin was built relatively high-level.
Beside Shi Yu, Eleven and Ling were also following beside him and giving advice. In fact, Ling was the only one giving advice. It was unknown if Eleven was still a child or clueless, but it had already climbed onto the big tree beside it. It broke the branch with a palm and directly made the red worm lying on it fall.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven made a declaration of victory.
In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, the corners of Buggy’s mouth twitched when it saw its “super distant relative” end up in the same situation as its young self.
“There are many bug-type creatures here. Although we haven’t reached the worm nest, it’s already comparable to the insect paradise,” Ling said.
“Yeah, but this isn’t the key. The key is why can’t we open this ruin!” Shi Yu gritted his teeth.
This was the first time he had suffered a loss in cracking ruins after obtaining the power system of the last era.
After all, he had easily broken through even the mechanical ruins of the previous era, and it was at a low level. Now that he was close to the cosmic level, this lousy ruin couldn’t be broken?
Of course, it was actually not a problem to forcefully tear it down, but that would damage the information and resources inside the ruins. Shi Yu still wanted to use the normal process to make it more sensible.
“You can’t do this.”
Just as Shi Yu was in deep thought, a voice suddenly came from behind them.
Upon hearing this voice, be it Shi Yu, Eleven, or Ling, they shuddered.
Shi Yu suddenly turned around and saw the Super Empress descending from behind.
“Why are you here?”
“Could it be that the owner of this ruin is really you?”
The Super Empress turned to look at Shi Yu and said, “I have nothing to do with this ruin.”
“Then you… Huh? Could it be that you’re protecting me all the way?” Shi Yu said.
The Super Empress said, “Don’t flatter yourself. My goal is also this ruin.”
“You’re not the only one who can know the specialness of this ruin.”
“Alright…” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Then, Your Majesty, what do you think? Do you know what’s going on with this ruin?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1831 - 1831 Sick (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1831 Sick (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“This is an exclusive ruin. Only specific people, specific bloodlines, and specific soul traces can open it. Something extremely important to the other party should be stored inside.”
“Moreover, ever since this ruin survived from the last era until now, there have been traces of it being opened once.”
Shi Yu said, “Therefore, the owner of this ruin is indeed still alive. It’s somewhere.”
“Yes.” The Empress nodded.
“Did the identity of the owner of the ruins as a transmigrator attract you?” Shi Yu asked.
The Empress shook her head and said, “A little, but not all. Didn’t you feel it?”
“What do you feel?”
“The universe is sick.”
“The universe is sick???” Shi Yu was stunned.
The Super Empress said, “Yes, the universe is sick for unknown reasons. Although the illness is relatively light now, the loss of the lifespan of the universe has already begun to slowly accelerate.”
“The one with a clearer perception of this should be a planetary life form. You can let your star pet sense its communication with the power of the universe. Isn’t it much more difficult?”
“Mi…” Little Zi was at a loss as the Beast Taming Space left.
It sensed it carefully and was slightly shocked. Although it wasn’t very obvious, it did feel very different from before.
This subtle feeling was difficult to observe at all. In most cases, they would think that it was because of their state. Even if they sensed it, they wouldn’t think that the universe was sick.
“After I sensed this, I was worried that the state of the universe might affect you contracting the universe, so I started to search for the reason,” the empress said. “In the end, I found this place. It seems that there’s a final explanation for this ruin.”
“Looks like although you didn’t discover any abnormalities, you also came here through other methods. This means that the illness of the universe is destined to have a certain impact on you.”
After hearing the Empress’s words, Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “I see. Then, if we want to crack this ruin, it looks like we have to find its original owner.”
“In other words, apart from the two of us, the third ‘transmigrator’ whose identity can be confirmed.”
“Yes.” The Empress nodded.
“You should have come here before me, right? Did you discover anything?” Shi Yu asked.
The Empress was a cosmic-level old demon who had lived for an unknown period of time. Her methods should be much richer than young people like him.
“The other party has already died and reincarnated again,” the Empress said.
“If I’m not wrong, the other party should have reincarnated into the worm nest.”
“The Worm Nest?” Shi Yu said. “Where are we going to find it…”
“Isn’t the territory of the Worm Queen a little dangerous… Back then, in the transcendent Divine Realm, I killed many of his people and had several heirs and descendants…”
“I’ll leave this to Your Majesty. I’ll wait for your good news,” Shi Yu immediately said. He didn’t want to go to the worm nest.
“Unfortunately,” the Super Empress said. “That guy and I also have aggro. We were once permanently forbidden by her from stepping into the worm nest. Although it doesn’t matter if we forcefully enter, it’s easy to cause a greater conflict.”
“This matter still has to be handed to you to investigate. I’ll leave a protective layer on you to ensure your safety and hide your identity. As long as you don’t take the initiative to cause trouble, you should be able to successfully complete the mission and return.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“What? Why have you even provoked the Worm Queen? In addition to the World King and the cosmic overlord… Why do I feel that you’re more troublesome than me?” Shi Yu said.
The Empress said, “We’re about the same, but you’re weaker. It’s not easy to attract the other party’s attention.”
“Moreover, the Worm Mother Nest is the universe of the Worm Race. Over there, there are many worm-type resources. Your worm-type pet might be able to obtain cosmic opportunities over there.”
Shi Yu took a deep breath and said, “Alright, I’ll go, but if there’s danger…”
“I know. I’ll save you and bring you back.”
“Deal.”
Shi Yu knew that the exploration of the ruins of the era definitely wouldn’t be that smooth. Now, he was extremely dizzy and didn’t know what was going on.
According to the Empress, he would definitely be noticed if he directly entered the worm nest from the Cosmic Sea. Therefore, the Empress directly used special methods to teleport Shi Yu over.
At that time, where he would appear, how to differentiate his location, and how to find the third transmigrator would depend on Shi Yu’s own abilities.
However, the Empress said that she would try her best to teleport Shi Yu near the third transmigrator. Through the traces of the era ruins, she had already locked onto the approximate location of the third transmigrator.
“If the other party is a reincarnated transmigrator, with the power of Baby Ginseng and Qi, I should be able to recognize the other party’s identity.”
Just like how Goddess Wa and the World King could tell his identity back then, if the other party’s strength after reincarnation wasn’t very strong, Shi Yu felt that he should be able to tell. After all, his spatial attainments weren’t low now.
However, what Shi Yu wanted to know the most now was where the Empress had teleported him to. Why was it so dark here? Shi Yu clearly felt that he had already landed steadily.
“Holy sh*t.”
However, at that time, when Yu’s state was stable and he released his mental strength to confirm where he was, he was directly stunned.
The surrounding lifeless environment…
In addition, when Shi Yu saw a girl kneeling not far away and praying for something, his expression darkened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1832 - 1832 Sick (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1832 Sick (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Ancestor, bless Father not to be eaten.” The girl’s voice made Shi Yu fall into deep thought.
Why did the Empress teleport him to the ruins of someone else’s tomb?
If things went wrong, they might even be treated as tomb raiders!
After his spiritual power observed the surrounding human and insect corpses, Shi Yu felt a chill.
“Damn it.” Shi Yu cursed in a low voice. He was now certain that he had been teleported to the ground by the Empress and was being buried.
“And a seal. Ridiculous.”
Shi Yu directly broke free of the seal.
Boom.
At the same time, the ground cracked, and the entire tomb ruin trembled violently.
In the next moment, the eyes of the girl who was praying in front of the tomb suddenly widened. She looked at the cracked ruins in disbelief and the young man who crawled out of the ground.
This young man was about 15 to 16 years old. He had long hair, a handsome face, and was wearing a cotton shirt. It was Shi Yu. To be precise, it was the appearance of Beast Shi Yu when he was 15 to 16 years old.
After arriving at a dangerous place, Shi Yu naturally used his physical control talent to change his form and become what he looked like in his previous life.
“You, you, you, you…” At this moment, the girl who had just worshiped her ancestors saw someone coming out of the tomb with a panicked expression.
Shi Yu was calm. He looked at her and said, “You should be a disciple of the Butterfly Holy Land, right?”
When the girl, who looked about the same age as Beast Shi Yu, heard Shi Yu’s question, she gulped and nodded.
“I’m…”
“Could it be, could it be?” she said. “Ancestor, you really heard my prayer and came back to life?”
Shi Yu’s expression darkened again. “What are you talking about? I’m not dead to begin with.”
Although this was a tomb, it was a ruin after all. As long as it was in the ruin, nothing could hide from Shi Yu.
He had already known where this was through listening to the Voice of History.
This was the tomb ruins of a super Beast Taming faction called the Butterfly Holy Land. The ancestor of the Butterfly Holy Land and their pets that could be traced back to hundreds of thousands of years ago were buried inside.
The reason why there was a layer of seal was because the people buried inside were very strong. The weakest was at least at the divine level, and it was easy to breed evil spirits.
Shi Yu waved his hand and applied another layer of seal on the tomb. Then, he looked at the young but noble girl and said, “You can treat me as your ancestor. I was reborn after death. I’ve been in seclusion here and slept for a long time. I don’t know what the situation is outside.”
“Come and introduce me.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the girl cried.
“Ancestor, save my father. He, he’s going to be eaten.”
“If you cry again, I’ll eat you first.” Shi Yu frowned.
The other party’s expression immediately tensed up, not daring to cry anymore.
“What’s going on?” Although Shi Yu looked young, in this transcendent universe, it wasn’t strange for him to have a young face and live for millions of years. When this girl saw Shi Yu climb out of the bottom of the tomb, she already thought that Shi Yu was the ancestor of the Butterfly Holy Land.
“Ancestor, you’ve been in seclusion for too long. You might not know.”
“120,000 years ago, our world was invaded by a race called ‘Red Ants’. After they invaded our world, they requested that one divine-level human and ten Level 9 humans be sacrificed as food every 100 years. Only then can our world continue to be stable.”
“One of the sacrifices chosen in this hundred years is my father.”
“Red Ant.” When Shi Yu heard this familiar name, he immediately understood everything. On World King Planet, he had fought a Red Ant that had joined the cosmic overlord army, the 177th Army.
The Red Ant was one of the 13 noble insect races of the Worm Mother Nest. It ate humans. So, the Empress had teleported herself to the Red Ant’s territory? Although the humans on this Beast Taming Continent were quite strong, it seemed to be just a food warehouse for the Red Ant.

chapters.title: Chapter 1833 - 1833 The Third Transmigrator (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1833 - 1833 The Third Transmigrator (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“He can’t be saved.”
“I’m helpless.”
After Shi Yu heard the girl’s words, he stood there and shook his head.
He was really helpless.
It would be fine if it was another race, but it just had to be the Red Ant.
As one of the thirteen nobles under the Queen of the Worms, to put it bluntly, they were directly related to the Queen.
If he wanted to challenge their rules, he undoubtedly had to fight the Red Ant Race head-on.
Even if Shi Yu could defeat a Red Ant Race, the people in this world were still too weak.
Without the Red Ant enslaving them, there were still other insect races enslaving them.
In this Worm Nest, the Worm Race was the largest. Shi Yu was helpless to change this situation because he couldn’t defeat the Worm Queen.
There were too many weak people. It was impossible to save them. Everything still had to follow the law of the forest, just like how there were only poor people on Earth and weak people in the transcendent world.
If he wanted to do anything, he still had to rely on himself to become stronger. Relying on others wouldn’t work.
He looked at the girl in front of him and tapped gently. The other party immediately fell asleep in a daze and stopped crying.
“Master, you’re so heartless,” Ling said.
“I want to be affectionate too, but I’m too weak and not familiar with her. It’s more important to carry out the mission,” Shi Yu said. “If the Dong Huang humans are enslaved, I’ll definitely save them even if I have to die!”
Ling said, “As expected of Master, but actually, there’s a relatively simple way to change the situation of this world.”
“You seem to be very familiar with this place,” Shi Yu said.
Ling said, “Of course, I’m learning at all times.”
“Master, observe if this world is sealed by the Red Ant Race now.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu could clearly sense that he couldn’t sense any star power on the continent he was in.
It was as if he was locked in a box and couldn’t come into contact with the starry sky of the universe at all.
“Generally speaking, no one can leave a world ruled by the Red Ants,” Ling said.
“Even if we want to get out, we have to pass the seal first, just like the tomb seal just now.”
Shi Yu pondered. He didn’t know if he could break through the seal and not be detected by the other party.
Logically speaking, it should be possible. The Empress had sent him in without anyone noticing. Even if he was inferior to the Empress, it shouldn’t be a problem to deceive a seal.
“And apart from breaking the seal and leaving, there’s actually another way,” Ling said.
“Can you finish speaking in one go?” Shi Yu curled his lips.
“Good, good, good~”
“Generally speaking, a special passage will be opened in the world enslaved by the thirteen great worm nobles.”
“The special passage leads to a small universe called ‘Buggy King Ruins’.”
“You can reach other places through the ‘Buggy King Ruins’.”
What Ling said touched Shi Yu’s knowledge blind spot again.
“The Ruins of the Worm King is maintained by a cosmic treasure. It’s a mystic realm established by the Worm Queen and managed by the thirteen great worm nobles. This place is meant to nurture more experts for the Worm Race and choose new nobles.”
“As long as a powerful insect is born in any small world, there’s a chance to obtain the gift of the insect noble and become a second-rate noble. At the same time, this world where a second-rate noble is born can also be exempted from food offerings and obtain freedom.”
“After all, the Worm Race invaded other worlds only for resources. If an expert who gives them a headache appears in this world, they need to be enemies with this expert to obtain resources. It’s a little not worth it. Instead of both parties suffering, it’s better to give the other party special privileges and turn enemies into friends.”
“Therefore, if there are no too important resources in a world and there are powerful experts, the Red Ant will give up invading. After all, the Red Ant’s army is also a very precious resource. Of course, there are rare resources in this world. For example, Blue Planet at that time couldn’t escape the fate of being invaded no matter what, even if it had to mobilize a super divine.”
“Also, the ‘expert’ I mentioned above also has a restriction, which is that the race has to be bug-type.”
“In the Worm Nest, there’s a rule. Although the worms can devour any other life form, they don’t advocate devouring the worms. Even low-level worms like the Green Silkworm are superior to others in the eyes of the worms in the Worm Nest, even more honorable than humans.”
[Buggy: Ling!]
“Therefore, only the world occupied by the experts of the insect race can obtain the respect of the worms. Therefore, in the world we’re in, many factions are like this Butterfly Transformation Holy Land, nurturing the worm element. It can’t be helped. The worm element is superior in the Worm Nest.”
Shi Yu said, “I see.”
“Therefore, if we disguise ourselves as the ancient experts of this world and enter the Ruins of the Worm King, this world will also receive the attention of the Red Ant Race and be liberated.”
“Of course, it’s still treating the symptoms but not the root cause. If you want to obtain the right to speak permanently, it still depends on the development of this world.”
“However, the most important thing now is to find the third transmigrator quickly. If there are no traces of the other party in this small world, let’s go to the Worm King Ruins to take a look. Just the area under the jurisdiction of the Red Ants in that small universe should have gathered the powerful lives of the various star areas. If the other party is a transmigrator, he shouldn’t be an incompetent person. He must be active towards a higher platform.”
“Apart from that, there are also various resources targeting the insect race in the Worm King Ruins. Perhaps I can go here to see if there are any evolution materials Buggy needs.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1834 - 1834 The Third Transmigrator (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1834 - 1834 The Third Transmigrator (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
He teleported out of the tomb and into the sky. Psychic waves began to envelop this world.
Soon, he could see the situation in this world clearly. There were about ten divine-level experts in this world, and the highest was at the sixth level of the divine level. They were mainly humans, but they were still too weak. It was impossible for them to resist the Red Ant.
Of course, Shi Yu was mainly looking for traces of the third transmigrator. After about ten minutes of perception, Shi Yu frowned and said, “As expected, it’s not that simple. There are no traces of transmigrators.”
“Although a few humans are indeed reincarnated, the spatial fluctuations on their bodies don’t match. They’re just natives of this world.”
“Then let’s see where the entrance to the Worm King Ruins is,” Ling said. “We’ll look there.”
“But I remember that the Ruins of the Worm King… seems to be a place that only life forms with bug-type bloodlines can enter.”
“Huh?” Shi Yu was stunned. “Then in that case, I can’t enter?…”
“That’s not it. Human Beast Tamers with hybrids of humans and bugs should also have insect-type bloodlines, so Master, as long as you fuse with Buggy, you should be able to enter.”
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded.
Shi Yu sighed and directly fused with the Buggy bloodline in the Beast Taming Space. There were no changes to his body, mainly because with his physical control attainments, he could already suppress these changes at will.
It didn’t matter if he fused with Eleven, Chi Tong, and the others, but Shi Yu had to be careful when fusing with Buggy.
He didn’t want to dye the thing on his head green.
He could accept red hair, white hair, blue hair, and purple hair, but not green hair.
“Ji!” Buggy was disappointed. Shi Yu was even unwilling to become its color.
“The next time you evolve, evolve into other colors, such as the flash blue of the Butterfly of Imagination, I can accept it,” Shi Yu said.
“Wuu” Buggy replied.
After turning himself into a Beast Tamer who looked like a hybrid of a wormman, Shi Yu immediately found the so-called entrance to the Worm King’s Ruins. This place was close to the seal of the starry sky. It was a huge vortex under the starry sky. It should be able to teleport the person who entered to other places.
The closer they were to this place, the stronger the pressure. If they didn’t have strength close to the peak of the divine level, they couldn’t even approach the entrance of the Worm King Ruins.
After confirming many times that there was no information about the third transmigrator in this small world, Shi Yu chose to enter and take a look. In the next moment, he entered the Worm King Ruins. Right on the heels of that, he arrived at a huge mountain range filled with a sea of clouds and thunder. This place seemed to be a door formed by a natural natural natural chasm environment. It was majestic and spectacular.
On a main peak in the mountain range, the only life fluctuation here was spread. It was actually a rare human old man. Shi Yu was rather surprised. He didn’t expect that the one guarding the entrance of the Worm King Ruins wasn’t the insect race, but the human race.
Of course, it was still a hybrid human. The other party’s tentacles were clearly not what ordinary humans could have, but in other aspects, it wasn’t much different from humans.
As Shi Yu arrived, the old man on the main peak also appeared leisurely and looked at Shi Yu, who had descended.
“How many years has it been since an expert like you was born in this small world?”
“A middle-level world with more than 1 billion cultivation population actually can’t even give birth to a late-stage divine level expert after so many years. It deserves to be enslaved by the Red Ant for so many years…” The old man expected better from someone.
When Shi Yu heard the other party’s complaint, he felt that it was nothing. There was no need to be so angry.
He knew that in a country with more than a billion people, there weren’t even many who could play football.
“Who are you?” Shi Yu asked.
“It’s nothing. You can be considered a ‘worker’ under the Red Ant Race. You were assigned to this place to be the guard of the Worm King Ruins. The fact that you can come here means that your strength isn’t bad. Then, I’ll explain it to you simply.”
“As long as your strength obtains my recognition, you can enter the true Worm King Ruins. At the same time, you can also advance to a ‘second-level noble’ and liberate your world.”
“So simple?” Shi Yu said. “Then how exactly do I obtain your recognition? Battle?”
“Simple? Heh heh, this kid’s tone is not small. Although I’m also a human, restricted by the contract, I won’t go easy.”
“The first method is to defeat me. The second is for you to have a Beast Taming level at the peak of the divine level, or for your pet to have the realm of a perfect divine.”
“If you satisfy one of the three, then…”
Before the old man could finish speaking, the phantom of the tenth heaven spread behind Shi Yu. In the phantom, a beautiful butterfly that was shining blue like an illusion flew out.
A perfect divine aura was undoubtedly displayed.
“Wu.” The form of the Green Silkworm was too sensitive. Buggy still recovered and became the form of the Butterfly of Imagination. At the same time, both Shi Yu and Buggy hid their strength to the peak of the divine level.
However, just this level made the expression of the original guard of the Worm King’s Ruins turn cold. He said in confusion, “Who exactly are you?”
“I’ve understood the situation in this small world. It’s impossible for an expert like you to exist.”
“In terms of battle, there should be no need, right?” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “In addition, I might be older than you.”
“When I was sleeping, the Red Ant Race had yet to invade this world. When I woke up this time, everything changed. After an old antique like me woke up, I naturally had to interfere.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the guard of the Worm King’s Ruins fell silent. A former expert who existed before the Red Ant invaded this world?

chapters.title: Chapter 1835 - 1835 The Third Transmigrator (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1835 The Third Transmigrator (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
He quickly grinned and said, “In that case, it makes sense. Looks like this world is pretty lucky. With an expert like you, it’ll probably be unsealed soon.”
“I’ll report it. Then how should I address you? Do you stay in this small world to wait for the seal to be unsealed, or do you enter the Worm King Ruins first?”
“I’ll leave the other things to you to deal with. I want to enter the Worm King Ruins first. As for how you address me… Lu Bai.”
“Lu Bai.” The old man chuckled and said, “Peak divine-level strength, perfect divine-level pet. Impressive. When you reach the Worm King Ruins, you’ll probably become famous soon. Perhaps you still have a chance to break through to the supreme super divine realm.”
“This is the first time I’m here. Can you tell me in detail about the situation in the Worm King Ruins?” Shi Yu suddenly asked.
The information recorded by Ling was only a relatively shallow portion. He still had to learn more detailed information about the Worm King Ruins from the people here.
“After you enter the Worm King Ruins, you will be in a city under the jurisdiction of the Red Ant Race. There are basically all the necessary facilities in the Worm King Ruins. Among them, the most important facility is called the ‘Bug King Tower’.”
“The Worm King Tower has a total of 20 levels.”
“The first 10 levels correspond to the divine level, and the last 10 levels correspond to the super divine level.”
“On every level, there are ferocious beast projections of the corresponding level as guardians. It’s said that if anyone can reach the top of the Worm King Tower, its race will be conferred as a cosmic noble by that supreme Worm Queen. The reason why the thirteen worm nobles, including the Red Ant Race, exist is because their ancestors have once ascended to the top of the tower.”
“Apart from that, the first time you ascend to the top of the tower, apart from your noble identity personally conferred by the Queen, you will definitely obtain a cosmic treasure as a reward.”
“Of course, these have nothing to do with ordinary people, but even if you achieve it for the first time on other levels, you can still have corresponding treasures and noble status rewards of different levels.”
“This place isn’t only a paradise for the current 13 top-notch insect nobles, but also a paradise for other insect branches and races that aren’t Space Worms or Insects to climb and evolve…”
After obtaining enough information from the old guard, Shi Yu did a second teleportation in this space not long after and entered the true Worm King Ruins.
With a flash of light, Shi Yu arrived at a place that looked like a collective teleportation array. As he was used to teleportation on World King Planet, Shi Yu was very familiar with this model.
There was no one to welcome Shi Yu’s arrival, and there was no one guarding the surroundings. He arrived at an ancient city with a dense insect stream. Insects were everywhere.
Various strange worms with insect stats wandered and crawled in the ancient city, mixed-blood humans with insect bloodlines, and other mutated beasts. It was a proper insect paradise.
“Yi! (This place might be able to solve Buggy’s marriage problem.)” In the Beast Taming Space, Baby Ginseng said.
“Wu. (There should be many worms with devour skills who want to eat ginseng babies in this place.)” Buggy replied.
Baby Ginseng was angry. Wasn’t he happy to solve its marriage problem?
Buggy flapped its wings. Women would only slow down its speed of becoming stronger!
In a very free place, Shi Yu quickly confirmed it. That made sense. In this insect territory with a strict bloodline level, although it looked free on the surface, all the rules were written in the bloodline level. In short, it was just what he wanted. After Shi Yu arrived, he first searched for the existence of the third transmigrator.
Logically speaking, if the Empress teleported him nearby, the third transmigrator should be here.
With Shi Yu’s current strength, even the strongest expert of the Red Ant Race wasn’t Shi Yu’s match. Shi Yu naturally had freedom of movement here. He quickly searched for the fluctuations of the third transmigrator just like in the small world just now.
Then… hard work paid off! The Empress was indeed stable!
After coming from that small world to the Ruins of the Worm King of the corresponding star domain, Shi Yu’s eyelids twitched. He had really found a guy with very special spatial fluctuations. He was 99% certain that the other party was the third transmigrator.
“This is the place!!”
The excited Shi Yu directly chose to teleport near the other party. Then, he teleported in front of an insectoid with about a demigod-level wave and a spider body and human head.
“Who is it!” Shi Yu’s arrival stunned the strange creature with the lower body of a spider and the upper body of a human woman. It was pitch-black like a Black Widow Spider and looked at Shi Yu with hostility.
In Shi Yu’s aesthetic sense, the other party’s human upper body was very cool, but surprisingly… it was a bald head.
“Good heavens, who are you?” Shi Yu frowned. So, the third transmigrator had reincarnated into this thing??
“I’m the 100th daughter of the Queen, Princess Judy Lintian. Who are you? Why aren’t you greeting me when you see me?” When this demigod-level bald Spider King’s daughter saw Shi Yu, whose strength was unknown, she only panicked for a moment before being full of energy. This was because she was the 100th daughter of the cosmic-level Worm Queen. She believed that no one dared to harm her.
At this moment, Shi Yu, who had heard the identity of the third transmigrator’s reincarnation, was slightly stunned. His heart skipped a beat and he was a little stunned.
You, a transmigrator from the last era, reincarnated into a descendant of a cosmic level??
Can you have some integrity? As an expert from the last era, how could you casually acknowledge someone as your mother?

chapters.title: Chapter 1836 - 1836 The Third Transmigrator (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1836 The Third Transmigrator (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
No…
The other party shouldn’t have casually acknowledged her as his mother, but it was very likely that she had been killed and eaten by the Worm Queen in her previous life.
“Queen’s 100th daughter, Judy Lintian?” Shi Yu said. “Don’t you know who I am? Look carefully.”
Judy looked at Shi Yu with a serious gaze. She indeed didn’t know a guy like Shi Yu.
“Looks like you’ve completely forgotten your memories of your previous life. There’s only your memories of this life left.”
“What do you mean?” Judy looked at this strange person who had suddenly appeared in her boudoir and said with a strong tone, “Who exactly are you and what’s your goal?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “As the 100th daughter of a queen, you should know how a queen gives birth to heirs, right? She has always eaten other rare species and given birth to heirs with potential.”
“In other words, you were also born after the other party ate a certain expert.”
“But coincidentally, you were very powerful in your previous life, so even after the queen ate you, you still retained some traces of your previous life. I was friends with you in my previous life, so after discovering you, I came to search.”
The eyes of the bald Spider King Lady, who was ranked 100, flickered with a strange expression. She didn’t expect the person in front of her to be so bold as to talk about the Worm Queen.
Everyone knew that the children of the Worm Queen were born through devour, but who dared to say anything?
Even the children of the Queen, even if the Queen didn’t treat these children as her own flesh and blood, these children didn’t dare to say anything. The Worm Queen was really too terrifying, and she could control their life and death at all times.
“I don’t understand what you’re saying. If you leave now, I can pretend that nothing happened,” the Spider Princess said in a low voice.
She didn’t care about her previous life…
“If I remember correctly, the Worm Queen doesn’t care about the life and death of you descendants at all. She will give every descendant a training environment where they barely survive. If they can survive and become experts, the Queen will allow their existence.”
“If you die in the training, you will be regarded as a failed product. The Queen doesn’t care about the other party’s life and death.”
“As the 100th princess of the Queen, you’re only at the demigod level now. You’re even weaker than the 101st son. You should still be training. In fact, from your level, your growth isn’t smooth…”
“If you continue like this, are you sure you won’t be regarded by the Queen as a failure and executed? Although you’re a princess, your situation is actually worse than the descendants of the thirteen great worm nobles.”
“Why don’t you leave the Worm Nest and follow me?” Shi Yu didn’t expect that he would one day use his mouth to abduct a cosmic-level daughter.
However, Shi Yu felt that the analysis Ling had just transmitted to him made sense. The family of the Worm King represented by the Worm Queen was simply born in hell.
If it were him, he would rebel!
Shi Yu estimated that less than ten of the 100 children of the Queen were still alive. There was a one in ten chance of survival!!
“Heh, aren’t you afraid that if Mother kills you, your actions will no longer be worth pitying?” The bald Spider King Princess looked at Shi Yu coldly.
Although she also knew that she most likely couldn’t last long, in her opinion, Shi Yu’s behavior was no different from tempting fate.
“If I were afraid, I wouldn’t be telling you this.” Shi Yu also chuckled. He didn’t even know how many children the Queen’s 101st son had, but he was undoubtedly one of the most talented. He had already killed the peak super divine butterfly man, so why would he care about abducting another queen’s child?
However, Shi Yu really didn’t expect the third transmigrator to reincarnate into a queen’s child on this mission. He kept feeling that something would happen on this mission…
If this caused trouble, Lily Empress couldn’t blame him. It was purely because this guy’s identity was too sensitive. He could only take it one step at a time.
“If you’re worried, I can actually forcefully kidnap you. This way, you’ll be passive. How about that?” Shi Yu smiled. “I’ll take you to a place. That place is related to your previous life. You won’t regret it.”
The bald Spider Queen looked at Shi Yu as if she was looking at a fool and said, “Unfortunately, my bloodline contract has a certain restriction. Before I complete the training, as long as I leave the Worm King Ruins, I’ll immediately die.”
“Therefore, be it you forcefully taking me away or me taking the initiative to go with you, it’s impossible.”
“?? Even if a tiger is poisonous, it still won’t eat its cubs. Is there a need for this Worm Queen?” Shi Yu’s balls hurt. How could he give his daughter such a bloodline contract?
“Sure, sure, sure.”
Shi Yu thought for a moment. It was unrealistic to break this guy’s contract. After all, it was set by the cosmic level, but what if it helped her complete the training quests?
“What’s your training quest?”
“Pass the 11th level of the Worm King Tower.”
“So simple?” Shi Yu was stunned. “The 11th level is equivalent to the strength requirement of super divine 1. Isn’t it enough to have the strength of an epoch god?”
Judy said, “My physique’s cultivation is very slow. From birth, I’m destined to be a failure. I have a brother who’s said to be already an epoch god, and I’m still a demigod. I haven’t been able to become a god until now and can’t even pass the first level.”
Shi Yu grinned. “If I help you become stronger and let you pass the 11th level in a short period of time to break the bloodline contract on your body, are you willing to come with me?”
“Of course, I know you have concerns. I’m not asking you to betray the Worm Nest. I’m just taking a trip with me. At most, if you want to come back after we’re done, I’ll send you back.”
“Can you really let me pass the 11th level?” The bald Spider King Daughter looked at Shi Yu. After all, she didn’t make any progress even though the Red Ant Race supported her with all their might and invested in her.
Where did this person get his confidence?
“Of course, who do you think I am?” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “In that case, the contract is completed. I’ll help you remove the restrictions. Come with me when the time comes.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1837 - 1837 Sword Slash Cosmic Level (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1837 - 1837 Sword Slash Cosmic Level (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
After hesitating, the 100th princess of the Worm Mother Nest gritted her teeth and chose to believe Shi Yu.
She had no hope of training through the Queen in the first place. She was destined to be dealt with as a failed product. Instead of waiting for death, it was better to bet again.
“How do you plan to make me stronger?”
“After I came to the Worm King Ruins, I used various methods. Be it cultivation resources, EXP inheritance, or evolution mystic realms, I tried them. My cultivation speed is extremely slow.”
“It means that the resources you come into contact with aren’t good.”
“I’ll give it a try,” Shi Yu said. With that said, he took out an inheritance crystal, a Cultivation Fruit, and a World Tree Fruit. “Use this crystal first. If it doesn’t work, then use that green fruit. Finally, use this ‘ordinary’ fruit.”
“Super divine resources?” Seeing Shi Yu reach out and take out three super divine resources, Judy gradually believed in Shi Yu’s strength.
She followed Shi Yu’s request and took the inheritance crystal. In this inheritance crystal, Buggy had the cultivation EXP for the combination of worm silk and spatial control. It could allow the user to cultivate the spatial worm silk divine skill (Perfect+47), the Space Breaking Thread, according to talent potential.
It could be said that with the resources made by Buggy and Susu together, even pigs could take off, let alone the Spider Princess, who was the daughter of the universe and a transmigrator.
However, Shi Yu still underestimated the other party. After this Spider Princess used such a top-notch resource, Shi Yu could clearly sense that the other party’s absorption efficiency of this super divine resource was indeed inferior to a pig.
“Are you a spider or a pig?” After half an hour, the other party didn’t even absorb one-hundred millionth of the EXP. Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
Princess Judy suddenly opened her purple eyes and said, “I’m a worm. I already said that my physique is special.”
“Eat the fruit.” Shi Yu let her eat the World Tree Fruit that increased her learning ability.
As it was a super divine resource, the other party was also obedient in the face of Shi Yu’s request. However, the scam was that even after eating the World Tree Fruit carefully made by Baby Ginseng, this guy’s cultivation speed still flew up slowly.
This made Baby Ginseng in Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space fall into deep thought. Good lord, its ginseng emperor’s fruit actually couldn’t even nurture a divine-level??
In the end, Judy had no choice but to eat the Cultivation Fruit too…
Then, she knew why Shi Yu let her eat this in the end. After eating the Cultivation Fruit, this guy with a white spider lower body and a white human upper body had a pale face that was red and black. Then, it turned green, blue, and purple. Her expression instantly changed.
“Ugh…” She vomited crazily, wanting to ask Shi Yu what he had given her to eat. After all, she had the four major elements of time, space, worm, and poison. She had a physique that was immune to hundreds of millions of poisons, but this thing had almost killed her just as it entered her mouth.
Bang.
She fainted and fell to the ground.
“Damn.” Shi Yu looked at the unconscious Spider King Maiden and said, “The speed increased a little this time, but it’s still not enough.”
“Use the Reincarnation Fruit,” Baby Ginseng suggested. “If she was very strong in her previous life, using the Reincarnation Fruit can definitely awaken her strength and memories the fastest.”
Shi Yu said, “I think so too, but I’m a little worried.”
Ling said, “Well, this guy’s previous life was most likely the ‘enemy’ of the Worm Queen. However, because her identity as a transmigrator is too special, it caused her to have traces of a transmigrator. If we awaken the power of her traces, there’s a certain chance of attracting the Queen’s attention.”
“If we don’t use the Reincarnation Fruit, we can only use this move.” Shi Yu stretched out his hand and looked at the unconscious Spider Princess. “In any case, she’s also in an unconscious state now. She doesn’t know anything.”
In the skill index, increase points!
Recently, Shi Yu had also thought it through. There was no need to hide the skill index anymore. This was because the skill index wasn’t a rare treasure for the cosmic level. It was created by a group of people through a cosmic treasure. In addition, its upper limit of increase was only at the super divine level. It couldn’t create the cosmic level at all, so it was naturally not attractive to the cosmic level.
It was also easy for a cosmic-level to nurture and destroy a peak super divine himself. It was even faster than the skill index. He could reference the Super Empress and the gem cat.
And not at the cosmic level. Even if they coveted the secret of the skill index, they couldn’t defeat the current Shi Yu at all.
In terms of rarity, the current skill index might not be as rare as that one that exceeded the origin.
Therefore, if he was free, Shi Yu could use this thing to help familiar faces like the cat, Senior Lu, and Senior Panda increase their strength. Even if everyone knew his talent and had the protection of the Empress, no one could do anything to him.
Now that he was the future seventh throne of the universe, he was no longer the newbie who had to be careful in everything. The skill index… was only one of his many abilities. At the appropriate time, he could use it as he pleased.
Soon, the princess woke up. After she woke up, she felt pain all over her body as if it had cracked. She covered her exploded brain and said in disbelief, “My level…”
After waking up, the Princess quickly discovered that her level had actually reached the perfect divine level. She was even a step away from the epoch god.

chapters.title: Chapter 1838 - 1838 Sword Slash Cosmic Level (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1838 - 1838 Sword Slash Cosmic Level (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
She vaguely remembered that she seemed to be cultivating automatically in her sleep, but the effect of this automatic cultivation was too terrifying.
“How long did I sleep? No, what did you do to me?” She looked at Shi Yu, who was still nearby, eating supplements with a weak expression.
“What can I do to a bald spider like you? How is it? The taste of the Cultivation Fruit is pretty good, right?” Shi Yu’s kidney hurt. Of course, the reason why the other party became stronger wasn’t all because of the Cultivation Fruit, but also because he had secretly added points. It was just that the other party was sleeping and didn’t know anything.
To be honest, adding points these times was nothing to Shi Yu’s current level. However, he was still nurturing the “cosmic tree seed”, so he had consumed a little too much energy and was a little weak.
“It stinks.” The Spider Princess’s face was still green. She strangled her neck and wanted to retch.
“Good medicine stinks,” Shi Yu said. “In short, with your current strength, passing the tenth level is not a problem. As for the eleventh level, it depends on your own determination. Whether you can break through to the epoch god level in the face of the super divine phantom… I can’t help you with this.”
“You can give it a try.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the Spider Queen’s gaze was clearly a little excited. She also sensed her current strength and felt that it was very unbelievable. After all, even the super divine experts of the Red Ant Race were helpless against her situation.
“If I can pass the 11th level, I’ll fulfill the agreement and go with you.” The Spider Princess looked at Shi Yu with a gentle gaze because Shi Yu had given her another life.
After saying that, she couldn’t wait to challenge the Worm King Tower.
In the thirteen major areas of the Worm King Ruins, there was a Worm King Tower in every area. This place was the same as the honor challenge of the cosmic overlord army. It was a symbol of the glory of the Worm Race.
The monster projections on every level of the tower were all races that had once been conquered by the Worm Race.
It was said that among the higher-ups, there would even be projections of extinct creatures like “cosmic overlords” who were born with “cosmic races”. Whether they could defeat them also meant that they could have the aptitude of a noble.
It could be said that every time a new noble, new expert, or old noble hoped to rely on the Worm King Tower to increase their bloodline level in the Worm Race, it would attract a large number of busybodies.
Of course, if it was already like this for ordinary nobles who came to challenge the Worm King Tower, let alone a royal like Princess Judy.
As a royal, although she was only the youngest daughter of the queen, Princess Judy was already a little famous in the Worm King Ruins under the jurisdiction of the Red Ant Race.
Firstly, it was because of her noble identity, and secondly, it was because she came from a noble family, but her strength was inferior to the descendants of ordinary nobles. Therefore, in the eyes of most nobles, she was destined to be a failed product abandoned by the queen.
For so many years, some worm nobles were already used to the Queen’s hobby. The Queen liked to combine various strange racial characteristics to see if she could create miracles of life and create powerful descendants. Even if the Worm Queen was at the cosmic level, she might not necessarily be 100% successful. Sometimes, many flawed descendants would appear.
The Spider King Maiden was one of them. Although the worm nobles active in the Worm King Ruins didn’t know which races’ bloodlines she had, her growth trajectory was undoubtedly too ordinary.
“His Highness Judy entered the Worm King Tower?”
Not long after the Spider King Maiden entered the Worm King Tower, a super divine life form of the Red Ant Race descended here. She frowned, as if she was very dissatisfied with Jutilint for not discussing with them before challenging the Worm King Tower.
Judy was thrown here to train. The first meaning of the Queen was to let the Red Ant Race assist the other party’s growth. Any performance of Judy was closely related to the Red Ant Race. With such a princess, the Red Ant Race felt that their race was extremely unlucky.
“Yes, but this time, Her Highness Judy’s aura seems to be very different. She should have broken through to the divine level.”
“She’s at the divine level??” In the face of the report of the guardian of the Worm King Tower, the explosive female Red Ant revealed a strange expression.
Soon, the news of the princess breaking through to the divine level spread in all directions. Many experts and geniuses of the Red Ant Race gathered at the scene, and many other insect races and ordinary insect-element nobles from various starfields gathered here to see the princess’s performance.
“Yo, Brother Lu Bai, I finally found you.”
Shi Yu was also in front of a stall, drinking honey tea leisurely. This was the flower honey tea squeezed out by the bee race of this honey tea shop. It was fresh and delicious. Shi Yu and the Butterfly of Imagination Buggy, who had landed in his hand, experienced the local customs of the worm nest while waiting for the Spider Princess to remove the bloodline restrictions.
At this moment, a familiar voice sounded. Shi Yu looked and saw that it was the old man guarding the entrance of a small world.
“Why are you here?” Shi Yu said in surprise.
“It’s nothing. Let me tell you good news. The world you walked out of has already been unsealed. As long as you don’t die, you shouldn’t have to worship others in the future,” the old doorman said with a smile.
“It’s pretty efficient,” Shi Yu said. “But this shouldn’t be the only thing you’re looking for me for, right?”
“Yes,” the old doorman said. “Generally speaking, even if divine-level experts born in small worlds like us become second-rate nobles, we usually have to rely on a top-notch noble. This way, we can survive more in this starry sky.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1839 - 1839 Sword Slash Cosmic Level (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1839 - 1839 Sword Slash Cosmic Level (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“After hearing your information, the heir of a Red Ant branch I serve wants to see you. What do you think, Brother Lu Bai?”
“I shouldn’t be able to refuse, right…” Shi Yu said, “The person seems to be already here.”
As Shi Yu spoke, the surrounding space was torn open. A Red Ant person with two mantis worm guards walked out of the void and looked at the old doorman and Shi Yu, who was sitting and drinking tea.
“Old Gray, this is the Lu Bai you mentioned, right? Peak divine-level, contracted a perfect divine-level butterfly beast.”
After this face appeared, it had distinct edges and corners. In the eyes of humans, it was even a little handsome. It smiled and looked at the old doorman and Shi Yu sitting opposite.
“Young Master, this is the expert from that small world, Lu Bai.”
Shi Yu also looked at the genius of the Red Ant Race. To be honest, Shi Yu had destroyed at least ten sacks of worm geniuses stronger than it when he transcended the Divine Realm… Was this guy trying to recruit him?
Eh, so troublesome.
“Sir, how about serving me? Follow me. After I become the head of the family, I can let you become a first-level noble…” This young master of the Red Ant noble family was quite direct.
Shi Yu said, “I’ll definitely do it next time.”
“Huh??” The Red Ant noble was at a loss.
“There, after I came here, I happened to encounter Princess Judy. She seems to have taken a fancy to me, so she probably can’t serve you anymore, Young Master,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Ah, this…” The young master of the Red Ant noble family said, “What’s going on? You just arrived at the Worm King Ruins and you’re already relying on Her Highness Judy??”
“How is this possible?” The old doorman beside him also said with an incredulous expression, “You’re referring to Princess Judy??”
Shi Yu shrugged and said, “Yes, perhaps she thinks I’m more handsome.”
“Are you lying?” The young master of the Red Ant noble family frowned. He was considered a little famous among the Red Ant Race. That royal daughter didn’t even look at her directly. What right did Shi Yu have? Although the royal daughter seemed to be a failed product, she was still the daughter of a queen after all. Her status was extremely noble.
“Brother Lu Bai, you can’t say that casually.” The old doorman also touched his wrinkled face and thought to himself that could it be that the princess really liked a pretty boy like Shi Yu??
“Wu…” At the side, Buggy was already used to its Beast Tamer’s shamelessness. They were clearly the ones who wanted to kidnap the other party, but they could say that the other party liked them…
“He passed?? He actually passed?!”
At this moment, a commotion suddenly came from various places. They saw that the information on the tower of the Worm King, which displayed the challenge of the crown princess, had been updated. Moreover, it had been updated to the fourth level in one go.
The representative, the Spider Princess, had already ascended to the fifth level. Although this battle result was nothing, it was the first time for Judy. Seeing that the Spider Princess was already so ferocious after just breaking through to the divine level and producing results comparable to a middle-level god, the bugs watching were surprised.
“Fourth level? Could it be that Princess Judy has finally activated her bloodline power?” On Shi Yu and the others’ side, the red ant young master was also attracted by the situation in the Worm King Tower and revealed a look of surprise.
“As expected of the son of that lord. Even if it fell silent at the start, there’s still a chance to soar into the sky. As long as it can grow to have super divine battle power within a hundred years, it won’t be abandoned by the Queen,” the old doorman said.
Next, the situation in the Worm King Tower was like it had been injected with steroids. Before anyone could react, it quickly updated to the tenth level, making everyone’s eyes widen.
“What a joke. I remember seeing the king’s daughter at the banquet last year. She’s still a quasi divine.”
“How did he have perfect divine battle power in such a short period of time? No, ordinary perfect divines can’t pass so quickly,” Young Master Red Ant said in confusion.
“Brother Lu Bai, haven’t you come into contact with the princess? What’s wrong with her?” The old doorman was also stunned.
“Who knows?” Shi Yu’s expression became serious. He didn’t know if the other party could pass the 11th level. This was the key. He hoped that nothing unexpected would happen.
In the end, there was still a little risk in wanting to abduct this guy. Even if he didn’t eat the Reincarnation Fruit, it was still unknown if it would attract the attention of the Worm Queen when the bloodline restrictions were lifted.
At the same time.
After obtaining Shi Yu’s help, the Spider King Maiden quickly arrived at the 11th level. Killing the illusions on the first 10 levels was as simple as drinking water. There was no pressure at all. After all, her “Broken World Thread” skill, which was the combination skill of “Space Control+Buggy” taught her, had already been raised to (Perfect+47).
Unfortunately, relying on this temporary increase to reach this point seemed to be the limit. On the 11th level, the Spider King Maiden faced the super divine turtle that carried a continent on its back in front of her and retreated step by step.
It was impossible for her, who wasn’t yet an epoch god, to be a match.
“As expected…” After confirming that it was very difficult for her to defeat this huge turtle, the Spider Princess revealed an indignant expression.
She didn’t expect that even if she obtained such a huge opportunity, she was still so weak and couldn’t do anything well. She wanted to break through at the last minute, but she couldn’t find an opportunity.
Super Divine Will wasn’t that easy to be born.
[Judy.] Just as the Spider Princess was already bleeding and still unable to break through the huge turtle’s defense, a high and mighty voice suddenly sounded in the Spider Princess’s heart, making her expression change and her face turn pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 1840 - 1840 Sword Slash Cosmic Level (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1840 - 1840 Sword Slash Cosmic Level (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
[Judy, you’re indeed a failed product.]
At this moment, the surroundings of the Spider Princess seemed to have darkened. In the endless darkness, the Spider Princess floated in midair. The light opposite outlined a terrifying figure, making her bloodline throb infinitely.
Judy quickly determined that this consciousness was derived from her bloodline.
It came from the restrictions of the bloodline contract.
“Mother…” she said with a pale face.
[You seem to have obtained a very special fortuitous encounter, but from the looks of it, you’re still useless.] Staring at the Spider King Princess in front of him, the phantom of the Worm Queen seemed to have crossed space and time and seen the meeting of the Spider King Princess and Shi Yu.
[I was once curious about how he would come to the worm nest. I didn’t expect all the reasons to be on you. Looks like you have a characteristic that attracts him very much.]
[What a surprise. If it weren’t for the fact that your strength increases at an abnormal speed, I wouldn’t have discovered that he had already arrived here. Who is it that can send him to the Worm Nest with such methods?]
The Spider Princess instantly understood who the Worm Queen was talking about.
It was the young man who helped her increase her strength.
The Queen knew the other party!
Moreover, she easily knew that the other party wanted to take her away and knew everything after they met.
Judy was extremely nervous. She knew that it was impossible for her to hide her little deal with Shi Yu from the supreme Queen Mother no matter what.
It was over… This was the only thought left in her heart. She understood that she would definitely be directly executed.
“Her Highness Judy is out!!!”
In the outside world, as Judy appeared, the surroundings rumbled. Although Judy couldn’t break through the 11th level, breaking through 10 levels in one go was also a very impressive battle result.
This made people understand that the fate of this royal daughter might have to be rewritten from here on. She might be able to become a true royal daughter acknowledged by the queen.
In the sky, the super divine of the Red Ant Race also had a happy expression. They didn’t expect Princess Judy to give them such a big surprise this time.
However, as Judy appeared in the sky outside, the expressions of all the worms changed.
The endless fear and trembling in the depths of their bloodlines made them look at the expressionless Princess Judy in the sky in shock.
At this moment, the princess’s expression was pale, her eyes were listless, and her entire body emitted purple mist.
“This, this is…” On Shi Yu and the others’ stall, when the bloodlines of Young Master Red Ant and the old man at the door trembled infinitely, their expressions were filled with horror, as if they sensed a terrifying existence even more terrifying than seeing the super divine in the race.
“Wu!!!” Buggy’s bloodline instantly trembled. Even someone with a noble bloodline like Buggy felt a huge pressure. Even if its source of power had the power of the Four Holy Green Dragon, it couldn’t stop the suppression of this bloodline.
Shi Yu’s expression changed drastically, and he felt extremely helpless. Why couldn’t he make things smoother every time he carried out a mission?
Damn, how good would it be if it were an ordinary human as a third transmigrator? He would directly take it away. Why did it have to be the daughter of the Queen? It was simply too troublesome. This time, he was already extremely careful. The Super Empress couldn’t blame him for causing trouble. It was purely because of his identity as a third transmigrator. It was already a hellish difficulty opening. As expected, it was still too difficult to hide from the Worm Queen and the cosmic level.
If he had known that he would fail sooner or later, he might as well have visited directly from the start and laid his cards on the table.
Boom!!!
At this moment, outside the Worm King Tower, a huge bloodline shadow bloomed from the Spider King Daughter’s body and formed a new phantom in the sky above her. This phantom form was abnormally strange. It was made of dark purple matter that looked like an exoskeleton or armor. Its appearance was similar to a worm bone, and it had the characteristics of ants, dragonflies, locusts, and many other insects. The dark light formed skin, and there was no trace of a human appearance, like a worm god that had awakened from ancient times.
