“Queen…” Seeing this phantom, countless nobles were extremely shocked and trembled. They didn’t understand why a noble existence like the Worm Queen would appear here. At this moment, even the super magical bugs in the other 12 areas were shocked and looked over.
After all, even if it was the leader of the thirteen great worm nobles, it was as difficult as ascending to the heavens to see the Queen.
Was it because of Her Highness Judy?
However, what was even more unbelievable was that just as the Queen’s phantom appeared, it raised the Queen’s sharp claws in front of everyone, as if it wanted to penetrate the Spider Princess’s body.
Such an action made everyone’s hearts explode, especially the Red Ant Race, who was just pleasantly surprised by the princess’s performance. At this moment, they were shocked to the extreme, not understanding what the Queen meant.
The king’s daughter had displayed pretty good talent potential, so why did the Queen have to execute her…
At this moment, no one dared to breathe. Their entire bodies froze on the spot. Shi Yu’s pupils constricted as he understood the intention of the Worm Queen’s actions. Was this guy trying to force him to take the initiative to appear?
Did he want to see how much he needed her as an heir?
“Buggy.”
Bang.
Before anyone could move, Shi Yu couldn’t help but crush the teacup. Under the shocked expressions of the old man guarding the door, Young Master Red Ant, and the sexy bee girl who came to fill the tea, the blue butterfly that landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder turned into a blue beam of light that penetrated space and time!!
A terrifying spatial power and spiritual power wrapped around Buggy’s body, wrapping it into a ball of light. This blue light ball streaked a lightning-like light across the Worm King Ruins with a bang, shaking the entire thirteen areas of the Worm King Ruins!!
Boom!!!
When everyone reacted, they saw a blue butterfly wrapped in a psychic ball directly collide with the Queen’s sharp claws. The power of both parties was in a stalemate. Be it the psychic ball or the Queen’s sharp claws, they were trembling crazily.
“Who is it?”
This scene shocked the surrounding people even more than the Queen appearing and wanting to kill the Spider Princess.
“There’s no need to use your offspring as bait.”
A voice sounded like a thunderclap in the clear sky. After the blue butterfly just now, a red sword light seemed to have broken through the darkness and instantly severed the Queen’s sharp claws. Light spots filled the sky. At this moment, the Queen’s phantom seemed to have also suffered a huge injury and lost control of the Spider Queen.
The red-haired young man holding the sword grabbed the Spider King Daughter with one hand. Blue butterflies flew around him as he looked at the queen with a broken arm and said, “Alright, as you wish, I’m out. I really can’t let you kill this guy like this.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1841 - 1841 Acknowledging a Thief as a Mother
chapters.content:
Chapter 1841 - 1841 Acknowledging a Thief as a Mother
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
First, the strengthened Buggy blocked the Queen’s phantom attack in one hit. Then, the mysterious person severed the Queen’s arm with a sword.
Such a scene was undoubtedly very ridiculous for the nobles of the Worm Mother Nest.
The super divines from the thirteen areas of the Worm Races were stunned when they saw the phantom of the Queen, whose arm had been severed.
For the worm super divine, although it could sense that this phantom was only derived from the bloodline of the king’s daughter, and its strength might not even be 1% of its main body, it was completely not something ordinary peak super divines could deal with.
What exactly was going on now?
Countless people looked at Shi Yu, who was facing the Queen’s phantom, with explosive gazes, not understanding who he was.
“Shi Yu…”
At this moment, the Queen’s phantom finally spoke.
“You killed many of my heirs and countless clansmen, and you still dare to come to the Worm Nest. You’re quite bold. Aren’t you afraid of death?”
“Your Majesty, in the universe, there are always some helpless actions. I have no choice. Please forgive me.” Shi Yu smiled.
The conversation between the two parties shocked the nobles on the Worm King Ruins.
Even countless nobles’ eyes began to turn red as they stared at Shi Yu intently.
This name…
Many people were very familiar with it!
The legendary future seventh cosmic emperor, Shi Yu!
It was him who killed dozens of mutant Insect super divines in the battle to transcend the origin.
He also killed countless mutant insect geniuses.
It could be said that among the thirteen great worm nobles, experts had died in Shi Yu’s hands.
At that moment, no one expected that Shi Yu would actually dare to come to the Worm Nest. He even faced the Queen at this moment.
Was he really not afraid of death?
He was definitely afraid of death. At this moment, Shi Yu was already crazily calling the Empress to save him.
He could still deal with this bloodline phantom, but after the Queen’s true body descended, crushing him was probably as simple as crushing an ant.
However, what Shi Yu was most worried about now was whether she would directly die if he forcefully left the Worm King Ruins without breaking the bloodline contract. In that case, that special era ruin couldn’t be opened.
He wondered if the Empress had a way to break the restrictions of the other party’s contract.
Boom!!!
As countless people were shocked, the two parties started to collide again. The Queen’s sharp claws and broken limbs regrew and instantly regenerated. At the same time, a layer of purple-gold substance spread and swept towards Shi Yu and the others again.
“What’s this? It’s not the power of the natural order, but a pure bloodline skill…”
Shi Yu and Buggy rarely saw such a move. As Shi Yu and Chi Tong entered the possession state, he divided his strength to strengthen Buggy and could only resist.
Several figures intertwined, and the entire Worm King Ruins began to rumble and tremble, like an apocalypse.
At the same time.
In the deepest part of the Worm Nest, the Worm Queen opened her eyes. However, before she could do anything else, an incomparably terrifying spiritual power enveloped the entire Worm Nest. A spiritual true body condensed in front of the Worm Queen.
The Worm Queen stared at the woman in front of her and said, “I think I said that you’re not welcome in my territory.”
“So, you’re indeed related to this human. You were the one who specially condensed it for him?”
“Like Cypos, you have an idea?”
The Super Empress also stared at the Worm Queen and said, “Although I don’t know why, I can sense that you don’t have any killing intent towards him. In that case, why don’t we let this matter end and let him leave?”
The Super Empress had also been offended by Shi Yu. At that time, when the Super Empress faced the Dark King, she could sense the Dark King’s strong desire to kill Shi Yu. However, this Worm Queen gave the Super Empress a different feeling.
This worm… had a goal.
“Your thinking is too naive,” the Worm Queen said, “But now, I don’t want to fight you. In that case, let’s negotiate.”
“What’s the real reason why you want to take Judy away?”
“Don’t tell me it’s just her identity as a transmigrator.”
“You should be able to sense the abnormality in the universe. According to my investigation, she has the key information to solve this problem,” the Empress said.
“The abnormality of the universe, isn’t that the Dark King’s doing? If it wants to invade the Cosmic Sea, it should first turn the universe into this state and weaken the power of the World King again.”
“I know,” the Super Empress said. “But the key is how to crack the abnormal methods the Dark King makes the universe produce.”
“This, I indeed don’t know,” the Worm Queen said. “So you want to stop the Dark King.”
The Super Empress didn’t care about the Cosmic Sea. However, if the Dark King did this and disturbed her plan, she definitely wouldn’t sit back and do nothing. Just like back then, her actions disturbed the plan of the cosmic overlord. The other party wouldn’t sit back and do nothing either.
“According to what I know, the Dark King has already made contact with the Beastmaster. It’s extremely difficult for the Cosmic Sea to survive this crisis unless Cypos takes action.”
“However, in Cypos’s current state, it might no longer care about this. The Dark King and the Beastmaster also took a fancy to this. They’re afraid that if they wait any longer, when that Shi Yu really becomes the seventh cosmic level, they won’t have the fate to enter the treasure land of the Cosmic Sea.”
“What about your attitude? It’s impossible for the Dark King not to have looked for you,” the Super Empress said. “You rejected it?”
“Of course,” the Worm Queen said. “I’m no longer interested in the species of the Cosmic Sea, and I don’t want to see the entire universe filled with those disgusting pollution races. If its invasion fails, I’ll be very happy.”
“Now, the only guys I’m interested in are the human you cultivated and his little worm that perfectly controls the power of the Green Dragon.”
The Super Empress sneered and said, “So you’re indeed still eyeing their bloodlines.”
“No, on account of you and the World King, I won’t eat them. I just want to make another attempt with them.”
“Speak.”
“My previous heirs were all born by me devouring various rare races and combining their bloodline power to integrate part of my own bloodline power.”
“I’ve already done enough of such experiments. Even if I give my descendants the power of a cosmic race, it’s very difficult to give birth to a cosmic heir.”
“Next, I plan to find an insect with potential and let it directly fuse with my bloodline to complete its evolution. I want to see where this final limit is. In other words, I want that green insect to acknowledge me as its mother and make it my 102nd son.”
“I see the future in it.”
“Since it can perfectly control the power of the Green Dragon, in theory, it can also perfectly control the power of my bloodline.”
“As long as I nurture a cosmic-level heir, I should be able to have strength comparable to Sepos.” The Worm Queen was also honest. Nurturing a heir was also one of its racial talents. If the strength of the heir reached the standard, her strength would also improve. Although she couldn’t break through a major realm, a small realm was still alright. The previous heir really couldn’t satisfy the Worm Queen. Now, it had its eye fixed on Buggy.
The combination of Buggy and Shi Yu was known as the seventh throne. She also took a fancy to this potential.
“Heh heh, do you think an expert like them who has the chance to ascend to the throne of the cosmic emperor will abandon their dignity and be your son?” After the Super Empress finished speaking, she suddenly fell silent and was a little unconfident.
Initially, the scene that the Super Empress imagined was Shi Yu and Buggy saying to the Worm Queen in disdain, “Are you worthy?”
However, for some reason, she suddenly imagined Shi Yu and Buggy saying excitedly, “There’s such a good thing?”
“Why don’t we leave it to them to choose?” the Worm Queen said.
“Sure,” the Super Empress also said.
Worm King Ruins.
The laws had been obliterated, and space and time had collapsed. Countless worm nobles looked at Shi Yu, who was fighting the queen’s phantom, trembling. They didn’t even have the power to get close.
Just as these people were waiting for the Queen’s true body to descend and kill Shi Yu, something unexpected happened. A crack appeared in the collapsed space and time, directly sucking Shi Yu, whose expression had changed, and devouring the Queen’s phantom.
In the center of the Worm Nest.
Shi Yu, who kept praying for the Empress to arrive quickly, arrived at a new environment. He looked around in confusion, as if he was facing a great enemy, thinking that it was the Worm Queen’s method.
However, when he realized that the main body of the Worm Queen and even the Super Empress were in front of him, he fell silent.
“Wu!!” Buggy, whose body was in tatters, also looked at the huge monster, the Queen of Worms, in shock. It felt a completely different pressure from the phantom just now.
“Shi Yu.” After the Super Empress pulled Shi Yu over, she said calmly, “Don’t worry, I’m here.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu sighed and looked at the Worm Queen, not understanding what was going on.
“We finally meet.” The Worm Queen looked at Shi Yu and Buggy and said, “Little brat, how about making a deal?”
“If the transaction is smooth, not only can you leave the Worm Nest freely, but you can also take Judy away. At the same time, your grudge with the Worm Nest will be written off.”
“What?” Shi Yu and Buggy looked at the Worm Queen warily.
“If I’m not wrong, the path of the universe you’re searching for for it should be ‘cocoon evolution’, right?”
“So what if it is?” Shi Yu said.
“It’s impossible for it to break through the shackles of the cosmic level just by relying on the normal evolution of the cocoon. I have a way to ensure that it advances to the cosmic level 100%. That is, I’ll give it a portion of my bloodline power and let it learn the strongest devour skill, Ultimate Devour. This way, be it before or after the cocoon transformation, it can absorb the nutrition used for evolution in its strongest state. Apart from that, the Worm Nest will also bear all the materials needed for its evolution. As for the price, it only needs to acknowledge me as its mother. How about that?”
When the Queen finished speaking, Shi Yu was stunned. He was momentarily stunned. “There’s such a good thing?”
“Wu wu wu.” Buggy was also a little stunned. There was such a good thing?
The Worm Queen looked at the Super Empress, who was clenching her fists. Even she didn’t expect it to go so smoothly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1842 - 1842 Acknowledging Mother and Validating the Dao (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1842 - 1842 Acknowledging Mother and Validating the Dao (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Say that again?”
The Super Empress looked at Shi Yu and Buggy and was furious. She had indeed not chosen the wrong person.
His contracted partner really didn’t have the heart of an expert at all. Could such a guy really contract the universe?
“Uh…” When Shi Yu and Buggy saw that the Empress seemed to be very unhappy, they immediately said in embarrassment, “I’m just kidding, just kidding. We’ll listen to you.”
Buzz.
A soundproof barrier was formed between Shi Yu, Buggy, and the Empress.
The Worm Queen smiled. She knew that they wanted to communicate alone, so she didn’t stop them or eavesdrop.
To be honest, from the emotional fluctuations of Shi Yu and the others just now, the Worm Queen could confirm that the other party was surprised from the bottom of her heart and not pretending.
This was the first time the Worm Queen had seen such an easygoing quasi-cosmic-level expert. She couldn’t help but sigh.
In the soundproof barrier, the Empress stared at Shi Yu intently, wanting to see how Shi Yu would explain.
Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, “It was a slip of the tongue, really a slip of the tongue. I was thinking that if I could solve it without battle, I would do it without battle.”
“It’s mainly because I don’t want you to work too hard, Your Majesty. It doesn’t matter if we sacrifice a little.”
“In this way, you can call me mom at will?” the Empress said. “Why do I feel that you’re secretly happy?”
“Oh, this…” Shi Yu scratched his cheek. “Perhaps in our opinion, this choice is also very common?”
“This kind of thing is just a title…” Shi Yu said, “We won’t be affected in any way because of this title.”
“As long as there are huge benefits to be found and there’s no conflict of ideals, acknowledging a godmother is like becoming sworn siblings. There’s no difference.”
“This is very useful. Let me think. How many mothers have we acknowledged along the way? One, two, three… I forgot. In short, they’ve all been very helpful to us.”
The Empress: “?”
“I…” The Empress had thought that Shi Yu had no integrity, but she had never thought that he had so little integrity.
He even recognized a few?
She acknowledged Shi Yu’s starting point. Indeed, the Cosmic Sea was now targeted by the Dark King and the Beastmaster at the same time. Among them, the Dark King was definitely going to kill Shi Yu because Shi Yu had contracted the “cleansing star spirit”.
If they provoked the Worm Queen at this juncture and the three cosmic levels joined forces, no one would be able to withstand it.
However, she didn’t understand why Shi Yu was so casual.
“Then if the Worm Queen is disadvantageous to you in the future, as its son, where will you go?” The Empress asked Buggy again.
“Wu. (Shi Yu, Chi Tong, and the Empress once had a combination called Mother Hunter.)” Buggy quoted the classics and didn’t feel any pressure. It was completely led astray by Shi Yu.
If there was milk, it was a mother. If there was poison, it was prey.
The Empress: “?”
“Cough, cough. Buggy means that as long as it’s our enemy, it can even kill its own mother, let alone this…” Shi Yu said, “Blood relations can’t restrain us. Moreover, the Worm Queen herself doesn’t take this relationship very seriously.”
“Although I don’t know its goal yet, it’s roughly to use each other. That depends on who’s better in the end. We can get along peacefully. If we have other ambitions, it’ll be a matter of life and death.”
“So you and I have this relationship too?” the Super Empress asked Shi Yu.
“How is that possible?” Shi Yu said. “If it weren’t for you, I wouldn’t be interested in such a high-risk thing like becoming the holder of the universe. I would definitely directly give up transmigrating to the last era and retire in this era.”
The Super Empress nodded. Because she had a contract with Shi Yu, she could tell if Shi Yu was lying.
Although Shi Yu had no integrity, no morals, and a relatively low upper limit, only contracts wouldn’t deceive him. At least, the Empress saw the way Shi Yu interacted with each of his pets and saw Shi Yu give his all for the contracted partner.
He didn’t lie to the Super Empress at all.
“This might indeed be its cosmic path, but you have to bear the consequences yourselves. It wants to use your breakthrough to reach the realm of a cosmic overlord. At that time, if it has other ambitions, it will be even harder to restrict.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded. “Buggy, if the Queen of the Worms in the future…”
All the blame originated from Shi Yu.
Now that it was about to reach the cosmic level, it still had to acknowledge its mother. Buggy suspected that its race’s talent was really evolved from a cocoon.
However, Buggy was confident. Just like how it borrowed the power of the Green Dragon and then controlled the power of the Green Dragon, with the power of the worm now, it could also control the power of the worm in the future and have the strongest achievement.
The soundproof barrier shattered, and the body of the Worm Queen was like a mountain range. Its purple eyes stared at Shi Yu, Buggy, and the Super Empress and said, “So, have you thought it through?”
“I’ve thought it through.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Instead of having another enemy, it’s better to have another relative.”
“Buggy, change your words.”
“Wu!! (Mom!!)” Buggy didn’t have any integrity anymore. It only wanted to know how much red packet money the other party could give.
The Worm Queen had a strange expression. After all, its biological heirs were afraid of its pressure and didn’t even call it mom as smoothly as Buggy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1843 - 1843 Acknowledging Mother and Validating the Dao (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1843 Acknowledging Mother and Validating the Dao (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“What should we do next?” Shi Yu asked.
“Let me say this in advance. This is also equivalent to a contract, a mutually beneficial contract. If you harm them, you will have to bear my anger,” the Super Empress also said.
The Worm Queen said, “I naturally know this. Its basic origin race is the lowest level of the insect race, so its racial talent is cocoon evolution.”
“However, because its basic race is too weak, even if its bloodline has been optimized countless times now, there’s still a certain difference from a ‘cosmic-level race’.”
“With its physique, it’s impossible for it to perfectly absorb the ‘nutrition contained in the evolution materials’ that are enough to support it to break through to the cosmic level.”
“In terms of the evolution of the bug-type bloodline, I’m the absolute authority. You don’t have to doubt me.”
“What it lacks now is a skill perfectly compatible with its racial talent that can assist its racial talent and a large number of cosmic-level evolution resources.”
“For the mutated worms, mastering the two devouring skills, ‘Infinite Devour’ and ‘Ultimate Devour’, can perfectly absorb nutrition. Among them, the highest the Infinite Devour can absorb is the nutrition of super divine resources. If they want to perfectly absorb and transform the nutrition of the ‘cosmic treasure-level resource’, they can only rely on the ‘Ultimate Devour’.”
“Its racial evolution talent can only allow it to break through to the cosmic level with the support of the ‘Ultimate Devour’.”
“And I’m the only existence in this universe who has mastered the ‘Ultimate Devour’.”
“Apart from that, the cosmic treasure-level resources most suitable for the evolution of the Insect Race in the entire universe are all in the Worm Mother Nest. Without my help, it’s very difficult for you to find all the materials to let it evolve perfectly.”
“Therefore, you won’t regret your choice.”
After the Worm Queen finished speaking, Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. To be honest, he had long had the thought of letting Buggy learn Infinite Devour from Susu.
This way, Buggy could absorb and digest more nutrition to transform into a cocoon and evolve.
However, just as the Queen had said, even if Susu’s Infinite Devour had already upgraded from Infinite Devour to transcendent, the upper limit of perfect digestion seemed to only be “the highest quality super divine resource” and couldn’t perfectly digest the universe’s treasure-level resources.
The Ultimate Devour the other party was talking about should be the upper level of Infinite Devour, the upper level skill of the Infinite Devour.
If only the Queen knew this, then even if she replicated it, she might not be able to replicate it. Shi Yu could confirm that even if the power of the skill index could hide from the peak of the super divine level, it definitely couldn’t directly plunder the power of the universe.
“Why don’t you teach the Ultimate Devour to the other heirs?” Shi Yu asked.
“Not everyone can learn the Ultimate Devour. This is a skill I created myself. You have to withstand the power of my bloodline to learn it, but none of those guys have such aptitude.”
“But it’s different. Since it can perfectly control the bloodline power of an ancient Elder Gu like the Green Dragon, theoretically speaking, it can also control my power like controlling the power of the Green Dragon. Moreover, as an insect, the compatibility will be higher.”
“You can even walk so far on the wrong path of the Green Dragon’s evolution, let alone the current correct path of the Insect Race’s evolution.”
“Moreover, with the support of a special Beast Tamer like you, its success rate will also be higher.”
As it spoke, a purple-red blood drop-shaped crystal floated in front of the Worm Queen. The power fluctuations contained in this crystal weren’t inferior to the source of transcendence that was born once every 100,000 years.
Cosmic-level resources could also be divided into levels in terms of quality.
The low-level was undoubtedly the source of transcendence that erupted from others. The medium-level was the source of transcendence that naturally condensed for 100,000 years. The high-level and top-notch… It was difficult for Shi Yu to classify.
However, he estimated that the transcendent origin condensed by the Universe Tree and the empress, as well as the skill index, should be included.
And this bloodline crystal was about the second level, although in essence, it wasn’t a cosmic treasure.
“After fusing this, it can inherit my bloodline. If it can withstand it, it can learn the Ultimate Devour. After that, with the help of the worm silk and the Ultimate Devour, you can complete the most perfect evolution.”
“As for the other evolution materials you need, come and get them after it learns the final evolution.” After the Worm Queen finished speaking, she gave the order to leave.
“Dark King, Beastmaster, bloodline fusion. There are many difficulties you have to face next. I hope I can still successfully see you in the future.”
“What do you mean?” Shi Yu was stunned.
The Super Empress said, “The Dark King is behind the fall of the universe. It has already joined forces with the Beastmaster to try to invade the Cosmic Sea. Of course, apart from wanting to occupy the super resource, the ‘World King Planet’, there’s another thing. When the Dark King fought for the source of transcendence, it already wanted to harm you.”
“If I hadn’t stopped you at that time, you would have already been captured by the Dark King.”
“At that time, not only was the Dark King afraid of me, but it was also afraid of the World King and the cosmic overlord, so it didn’t dare to attack. But now, it used some unknown method to make the universe abnormal. The battle power of the cosmic life forms largely relied on the environment of the universe. The World King was already weak, and now, it’s even weaker.”
“If nothing goes wrong, after the Dark King and the Beastmaster confirm that the cosmic overlord won’t interfere in this war, the Cosmic Sea will suffer a strong impact.”
“Damn.” Shi Yu was stunned. “Two cosmic levels?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1844 - 1844 Acknowledging Mother and Validating the Dao (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1844 Acknowledging Mother and Validating the Dao (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“And it might be targeting me?”
“As its mother, you can’t just watch from the sidelines on this matter, right? You have to deal with a cosmic level no matter what, right?” Shi Yu asked Buggy’s new mother.
The Worm Queen: “?”
“Unfortunately, the Worm Mother Nest won’t participate in the battle. Whether you can survive depends on yourselves.”
“All I can do is provide it with resources to become stronger and give you Judy.”
The Worm Queen clearly didn’t want to interfere in the cosmic war.
If the World King, the Dark King, the Beastmaster, and the Super Empress could all lose, that would be what it wanted to see.
“Ji!!” Buggy knew that this new mother was unreliable. If it were Mother Dragon… Alright, Mother Dragon wasn’t reliable either.
“Princess Judy… What was her identity in her previous life?” Shi Yu suddenly recalled this important question.
“Queen, you should have swallowed her, right?”
The Queen looked at Shi Yu and said, “I only know that her physique is special. When I devoured her, she was already a corpse drifting over from the void. There’s only a body from the last era left, and she has a special curse.”
“But from the looks of it, the body of the last era combined with my bloodline can’t create any heir worth nurturing. After being pregnant for so long, in the end, her talent is so poor. She’s already useless. If you want it, take it.”
Upon hearing that Princess Judy wasn’t killed and devoured by the Worm Queen, but that she had died when she was picked up, Shi Yu’s expression froze. Could it be that this guy was the same as Beast Shi Yu, but her body had come to this era and her soul hadn’t arrived?
No.
If she didn’t have her own consciousness, who opened that era ruin?
Or could it be that a third transmigrator successfully arrived here but was killed?
The person who killed her wasn’t the queen, but someone else.
Shi Yu thought for a long time in an instant, but it was useless to think about it alone. When he brought the Spider Princess to open the ruins, he might know more.
“Let’s go. She’s too timid to interfere in the war,” the Empress finally said to Shi Yu.
“Back then, when I came to the Worm Mother Nest to plunder resources, she didn’t dare to counterattack.”
Shi Yu was stunned.
In the next moment, as the anger of the Worm Queen suddenly rose, the Super Empress left with Shi Yu immediately.
On the trip to the Worm Mother Nest, Shi Yu could be said to be trembling in fear, but the outcome was good.
In the Worm Mother Nest, the Queen gave a new order, saying that Beast Tamer Shi Yu would be an honored guest of the Worm Mother Nest, shocking the various worm nobles for a moment.
No one knew the outcome of the battle between Shi Yu and the Worm Queen, but the Queen’s order contained countless information.
Although Shi Yu had killed countless worms, the Queen had already given the order. Even if there were unconvinced worms, they could only put down their aggro or bury their aggro in their hearts.
Even if not all the worms were very convinced by the Worm Queen, on the surface, no worm dared to resist the cosmic emperor in the Worm Mother Nest.
With the bloodline crystal given by the queen, Shi Yu and the others left the Worm Mother Nest. Although they had obtained this thing, they had to check it carefully before fusing.
Shi Yu had to let the gem cat, the Empress, and the others eliminate the drawbacks of fusing bloodline crystals.
However, before that, Shi Yu still brought the princess to the Vegetable Star Domain and arrived in front of the special ruin guided by fate.
“Wu…” The princess felt dizzy and woke up from her sleep in a daze. After recovering her consciousness a little, she suddenly woke up and looked around in horror.
However, it wasn’t the hell she imagined in front of her, but a forest. There was no longer the Worm Queen in front of her, only that familiar young man.
“You…” Seeing Shi Yu, the Spider Princess was shocked. “You weren’t killed by the queen?”
“Wait a minute…”
She tried her best to remember. In the end, it seemed that the Queen wanted to kill her, but at the critical moment, a blue light and a red light followed and saved her. After that, she completely lost consciousness.
“You saved me from the queen?? How did you escape? How did the bloodline contract on my body be broken?” She checked her situation in confusion and became more and more shocked.
“You have too many questions. In short, it’s not as complicated as you think. It’s purely because I have a flexible position.” Shi Yu leaned against the tree and looked at her. “Let’s not talk about this first. Let’s get down to business first. You’re finally awake.”
“Although I couldn’t let you pass the 11th level and something unexpected happened, fortunately, your bloodline contract was broken. Next, according to the agreement, you should do me a favor, right?”
Shi Yu smiled and looked ahead. “This is the place I want to bring you to. In this area, there’s an era ruin that can only be opened by specific people.”
“Actually, you’re its key. I want to use your power to open this ruin.”
“There might also be more information about your original identity in this ruin. If you’re ready, I’ll lend you my strength and you can open it.”
The Spider Princess was slightly stunned when she heard that. Then, she said, “Will the Queen still chase after us?”
“Probably not,” Shi Yu said. “Of course, if you want to take revenge on it, it’s best to wait until you’re stronger…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1845 - 1845 Acknowledging Mother and Validating the Dao (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1845 - 1845 Acknowledging Mother and Validating the Dao (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“I’ll help you open the ruins.” After the other party finished speaking, Shi Yu snapped his fingers and said, “I was waiting for you to say this.”
“Passage of Time, open.” His eyes filled with mental fluctuations. At the same time, a special power appeared on the Spider Princess beside him. Shi Yu’s current behavior was equivalent to treating the other party as a key and inserting it into the ruins, wanting to twist and open the ruins!
Although the process of searching for the key was a little more complicated, fortunately, the opening process was abnormally smooth.
Boom.
Under the continuous vibration, the ruins finally opened. This Spider King Daughter was indeed a third transmigrator. After her body resonated with the ruins, golden light appeared around her, and a new world seemed to have been born.
Buzz!!!
However, to Shi Yu’s surprise, the Empress, who was observing in secret, didn’t expect that there were no special items in this ruin. It didn’t look like there was anything at all.
However, only the Spider Princess’s body suddenly changed after opening the ruins.
First, its aura rose steadily, and soon, it rose from the perfect divine level to the super divine wave. However, this super divine wave wasn’t the cultivation system power of this era, but the cultivation system power of the previous era.
It was similar to the physical source power of Beast Shi Yu.
After a golden light enveloped her, in the end, an aura comparable to a peak super divine appeared in her body. This power shocked Shi Yu and the duck in Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space.
A familiar power wave… Its nature… was very similar to the Vajra Demon Subduing Staff!
So, the meaning of the existence of this ruin was to seal the power of the third transmigrator, or even some of her memories?
At this moment, as the aura of the third transmigrator changed drastically, from the poisonous worm element, her entire body was filled with a holy aura. She slowly opened her eyes again and looked at Shi Yu.
“Amitabha…”
“Thank you for bringing me out of the Worm Mother Nest.”
As soon as the Spider Queen finished speaking, Shi Yu was undoubtedly silent by this guy. He looked at the bald Spider Queen and said,
“Kid, you’re actually a little nun?”
“So, you have the memories of the last era??”
The Spider Princess said regretfully, “Unfortunately, I don’t have the memories of the last era. After awakening, I only remember the cultivation method and some rules of the last era.”
“So what exactly is going on? Why did you seal your power and memories here? Why were you eaten by the queen?” Shi Yu lowered his arms that were wrapped around him. The other party’s awakening undoubtedly made Shi Yu 200% more alert.
The spider nun was silent for a moment before saying, “I should have awakened earlier than you, benefactor. When I came to this era, this era had just been born.”
“I, who didn’t have any memories, wandered in this universe in a daze and did some things that needed to be done until a ruin from the last era appeared.”
“In the ruins of this cosmic era, there’s a cosmic treasure from the last era left behind by a cosmic creature.”
“Before the restart of the last era, many cosmic life forms wanted to resist. Among them, a cosmic life form’s actions were the most extreme. Since the universe isn’t willing to give all living beings a way out, he’s also unwilling to let the universe successfully restart. It wants to completely destroy the universe and make the universe completely disappear.”
“It developed a cosmic virus that can accelerate the consumption of the lifespan of the universe. Unfortunately, it was a step too late in the end. In the end, he could only try to pass this ‘cosmic virus’ to the next era.”
“This virus is extremely dangerous. The conditions to use it are harmful to the heavens. After obtaining this information in the ruins, I originally wanted to recover this virus and seal it again, but others beat me to it, so an irreconcilable conflict arose between us.”
“And this life form is the current Dark King!”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
“In the end, I lost to the Dark King and was cursed by the cosmic virus. I died ten times over. Although I barely escaped, it was very difficult to see any hope of survival.”
“After sealing myself for countless billions of years, I still couldn’t find a way to break the curse. Until the last moment, I made a gamble. I separated my strength, memories, and body from each other and sent my body to another cosmic emperor, the Worm Queen, who was searching for a rare species. I wanted to rely on its devouring skills to digest and give it the power of new life to see if I could successfully reincarnate before searching for strength and memories.”
“In the situation at that time, only the Worm Queen, who could even devour and transform the source of pollution, had the chance to cleanse the curse on my body.”
“From the looks of it, I succeeded in the bet.” She smiled and said, “It’s just that… the current race and stats are really too different from what I expected.”
Facing this little nun, Shi Yu and the Empress fell silent. No one expected things to turn out like this.
The Spider Princess said, “Obviously, the reason why you’re looking for me is because the Dark King used that cosmic virus again to infect the universe, right?”
“After so many years, my strength is still so weak. I shouldn’t be a match for the current Dark King who dominates the universe. It shouldn’t remember me, its former enemy.”
“However, as its old opponent, apart from it, I’m indeed the person who knows that cosmic virus the most. I’ve also developed a way to counter it over countless years.”
“If you need it, I can share it. At the same time, I can also cooperate with you to fight the Dark King.”
“I see.” At this moment, the Empress slowly appeared and said, “The method to make the universe abnormal came from the cosmic experts of the last era? No wonder it’s difficult to find the source.”
“Little spider, since you’ve studied the cosmic virus, teach me all the methods you know to counter the cosmic virus,” the Empress said.
“Little spider…” The Spider Queen’s eyelids twitched. She was also very helpless about her transformation into a spider. She said, “Benefactor, you should call me little nun.”
“I want to learn too, I want to learn too.” Shi Yu was also excited at this moment. “Is it the cultivation system of the Buddhist sects? To be honest, my Duckie also cultivates.”
“Let it learn from you too. It happens to be an Abyss Race. It can absorb the negative energy of the universe and use it as an experiment.”

Little Ji: Alert.jpg

chapters.title: Chapter 1846 - 1846 Revealing the True Intent of Filial Piety (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1846 - 1846 Revealing the True Intent of Filial Piety (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Blue Planet…
Somewhere on a holiday beach.
After returning from the Super Empress, the gem cat enjoyed it in various ways. It was definitely going to make up for the hardships it had suffered these days.
She was lying comfortably on a beach chair in the form of a little cat. On the beach, a tall and handsome Demon Horned Beetle was holding a fan in one hand and seasonings in the other, making barbecue seafood.
Shi Yu was wrong to say that the gem cat had raised the young demon to death, but it was definitely not raised well. A demon of a Mythical Race had actually been reduced to a barbecue chef and did work that even its clones didn’t do.
“Are you done roasting?” the gem cat urged. “I’m starving… Seriously.”
“Hu…” The Demon Horned Beetle felt aggrieved.
It still remembered that it had just been born. The cat in front of it promised to make it the strongest and most handsome demon. In the end, in a few days, this cat sent it to a big fat pig called the Boar God to learn culinary skills…
“Hu!” The Demon Horned Beetle suddenly discovered the abnormality and looked at the light that appeared behind the gem cat.
Seeing who it was, it was secretly pleased. It felt that someone could teach Teacher Cat a lesson.
“Teacher Ying.” While the gem cat was waiting for dinner, Shi Yu appeared, scaring the gem cat into trembling and standing up.
“Why are you back so quickly?”
When the gem cat saw that Shi Yu, who had gone out to explore the ruins, had returned so quickly, it felt its teeth hurt. She even specially returned to Blue Planet from World King Planet, afraid that Shi Yu would go back and see her urging him to work again, but he still didn’t escape…
“I’m not the only one…”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, two more figures appeared around him. One was the Super Empress in a black empress suit, and the other was the Princess Judy, who was wearing a gray-blue monk suit and hat. She forcefully changed her bloodline race and turned herself back into a human.
Of course, she had already abandoned the name of the worm and called back the name of her previous life, Floating Light.
Any characteristics on this Floating Light were different from the few Buddhist big shots on Earth in Shi Yu’s impression. This guy was probably not a famous figure in the last era. He was most likely just one of the many fire seeds with talent and potential that Goddess Wa and the others had searched for. He was a rising star.
However, although no one knew each other, Shi Yu was still very happy to encounter someone of the same race who was suspected to be a transmigrator from the same place. He decided to bring her to Blue Planet and let her join the Blue Planet bloodline.
Knowing that Shi Yu was also a transmigrator and was enemies with the Dark King, Floating Light naturally didn’t refuse. In short, it was a happy thing to meet a fellow countryman in a new era.
“Shi Yu, you can’t afford to play!”
At this moment, the cat didn’t care about the little nun. When she saw Shi Yu call the Super Empress over, she immediately cried. Didn’t they agree to a holiday? He really called the Empress over to threaten her?
It would remember this. In the future, it would definitely make Baby Ginseng repay double, mainly because it could only provoke Baby Ginseng.
“Things have changed. You might have to work overtime.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Originally, it wasn’t a big problem to touch it for a long time, but this time, we confirmed something.”
“What is it?” the gem cat said.
“The second throne of the universe, the Dark King of the polluted land, and the throne of the Behemoth Empire, the cosmic Behemoth Emperor. Soon, we might have to attack the Cosmic Sea and World King Planet together.”
“Now, the World King is sleeping and weak. The battle power of the World King bloodline has decreased greatly. Apart from the World King, I might be the second target of the Dark King.”
“If you want to be safe and sound, there’s only one way. That’s for you to work overtime and let me reach the cosmic level as soon as possible.”
The gem cat opened its mouth slightly. What a joke. Two cosmic levels???
“You’re not lying to me, right?”
She looked at the Empress and saw the Empress also nod slightly. “You should have rested enough after resting for so long, right?”
“The Star Prayer Race born on the World King Planet is also a rare delicacy for cosmic behemoths, let alone the Star Prayer Race at the peak of the super divine level.”
“If it’s made into soup, it will definitely be delicious.” The Empress used what she had said to scare Qi previously to scare the gem cat.
“I’ll do it, I’ll work overtime, alright!!!” The gem cat’s expression changed as it cursed, “Damn it, why are they all fighting and killing? Isn’t the peace of the universe good? These guys are too detestable.”
“By the way, this is…” The gem cat noticed the little nun again and sensed power that wasn’t inferior to its own from her.
“You can call her Master Floating Light, Floating Light Bodhisattva, and Floating Light Buddha,” Shi Yu said. “They’re helpers we found to deal with the Dark King.”
“Master Floating Light, pleased to meet you!” When the gem cat heard that it was a fighter, it immediately greeted. The more fighters there were, the better. This way, she would be safe.
On the other side, the little nun immediately replied to the gem cat. At the same time, she was confused. Shi Yu was already so strong, and he had even gotten to know a cosmic level. Why did he have to ask this seemingly weak cat demon for the opportunity to break through to the cosmic level?
Initially, Shi Yu wasn’t in a hurry. Even the Super Empress wasn’t in a hurry. If she wanted Shi Yu to cultivate to the peak of the super divine level normally and reach the cosmic level first, the gem cat could rest for two months if it wanted. This little time wasn’t a big deal.
However, the state of the universe was abnormal. After revealing the ambition of the Dark King, Shi Yu and the others had no choice but to be anxious. Even the Super Empress had to deal with it solemnly.
Firstly, she was worried that the Dark King wanted to harm Shi Yu. Secondly, she was worried that the interference of the cosmic virus would affect Shi Yu contracting the universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1847 - 1847 Revealing the Truth of Filial Piety (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1847 - 1847 Revealing the Truth of Filial Piety (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Therefore, no matter what, the Dark King, who had the ability to change the state of the universe, had to be resolved.
“The strength of the cosmic virus used by the Dark King depends on the user’s strength. Not only can it affect the universe, but it can also affect other lives. It’s also very simple to neutralize. Actually, Shi Yu has already guessed the method.”
“Oh??” Shi Yu was stunned. “How did I guess?”
The little nun looked up and said, “Didn’t you say previously that one of your pets has the ability to absorb the negative energy of the universe?”
“Yes…” Shi Yu nodded.
The little nun said, “Under normal circumstances, even a cosmic cleansing race expert in cleansing is helpless against a virus that has already integrated into the universe. In order to prevent the cosmic will from having the chance to cleanse this virus, the creator of the virus has already perfected the virus to an extremely powerful level.”
“Yes, I’ve also mastered some cleansing methods, but they’re useless against the abnormality of the universe,” the Empress said.
“Although the creator of the virus has perfected it very well, it’s inevitable that there’s a weakness that can’t be considered a weakness,” Floating Light said.
“That is, become a part of the universe and share this virus with the universe. When this virus is transferred from the universe to the shareholder, its nature will change and it can be cleansed.”
“You mean, contract the universe?”
“Not all universes are contracted. A portion is enough,” the little nun said. “For example, the Star Spirit Race.”
“The Star Spirit Race all has the ability to sign a contract with a portion of the environment of the universe. The skill I developed is to let all lives have abilities similar to the cleansing star spirit. Of course, they can only purely withstand the damage of the universe through the contract. They can’t borrow the power of the universe like the cleansing star spirit.”
After Floating Light finished speaking, Shi Yu and the others came to a realization. So that was the case.
The nature of the virus was that when it was in the universe, it couldn’t be cleansed.
However, as long as he contracted with the universe and became a part of the universe to help the universe bear the virus, when the virus transferred, its nature would change to a certain extent and it could be cleansed.
In essence, skills like the Star Sea Contract were equivalent to contracting the universe.
However, it was a little different from the contract to become the holder of the universe.
Although Susu’s Star Sea Contract was powerful enough to borrow the power of the universe, it needed to fulfill a certain responsibility. If it didn’t fulfill it, the universe had the right to take the initiative to break the contract.
The universe was the master, and the contractor was the secondary.
However, if one wanted to become the holder of the universe, they had to have the contractor as the master, and the universe as the secondary. They needed the contractor to have the ability to control the power of the universe 100%. However, this way, the difficulty would definitely multiply exponentially.
In other words, Susu worked for the universe, a cosmic cleaner, and the guardian of the universe was the master of the universe, the master of the universe.
“Ning.”
At this moment, Susu came out of Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space with a serious expression.
After knowing that the abnormality of the universe was that the Dark King was using a special cosmic virus, Susu couldn’t take it anymore.
“Ning, Ning. (I’ll bear the cosmic virus. I can cleanse it myself.)” Susu said.
Using the power of the Sea of Stars to cleanse the cosmic virus!
“Just you alone is definitely not enough.” Shi Yu pressed her down and said, “You probably have to be at the cosmic level to withstand this cosmic virus. It’s not a big deal, right?”
“If you don’t reach the cosmic level, the number and cleansing speed will definitely be very slow. You will have to contract many, many lives with the universe and bear it together.”
The little nun nodded and said, “Yes.”
“What I can do is share the method of sharing the cosmic virus and the special effect cleansing with the two of you.”
“However, before completely dealing with the Dark King, I don’t recommend using this method. It only treats the symptoms but not the root cause. It can’t solve the problem from the source. No matter how many cosmic viruses we bear and absorb, the Dark King can still create them again.”
The Empress said, “It’s not easy to deal with the Dark King. Although there are strong and weak among every cosmic level, at the cosmic level, there’s no cosmic level that can completely destroy another cosmic level.”
“Even a cosmic overlord can’t destroy the other four cosmic emperors.”
“Back then, even if the cosmic overlord and the World King joined forces, they couldn’t kill me. They could only seal me.”
“Similarly, against the Dark King and the Beastmaster, even if we can defeat them, it’s impossible to destroy them,” the Super Empress said.
“Is it that difficult?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Then seal it and recover the cosmic virus,” the little nun said.
“In theory, this is the only way. Sealing is the best choice. If you want to kill the Beastmaster, you have to destroy all the stars in the universe first to prevent the Beastmaster from reincarnating. For example, if you want to kill the Dark King, you have to cleanse all the pollution concepts in the universe. At the cosmic level, the origin is already close to the concept. Unless there are specific countermeasures, it will be very difficult to determine life and death.”
“However, that’s not necessarily the case.” The Super Empress looked at Shi Yu and said, “Human Beast Tamers might be a variable. When the power of two cosmic levels superimposes, no one knows what kind of power can be displayed and if it can surpass the cosmic overlord. This, no one knows.”
“I understand, I understand.” Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, “In that case, let’s work hard together. Me and the cat will try our best to modify the cultivation resources as soon as possible. We’ll reach the peak of the super divine first and let every pet reach it. Your Majesty, study the virus mechanism and the method she mentioned with Floating Light first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1848 - 1848 Revealing the True Intent of Filial Piety (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1848 - 1848 Revealing the True Intent of Filial Piety (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Yes.” Both parties nodded.
“Ning Ning!!” Susu expressed that it wanted to go too.
However, Shi Yu grabbed it and said, “Help me become stronger. Throw Duckie here first.”
Now, the best state was that before the two cosmic levels attacked the Cosmic Sea, Shi Yu had also reached the cosmic level.
This way, regardless of whether the World King could fight or not, he and the Empress definitely wouldn’t be afraid of the two cosmic levels.
“Oh, I’m busy.”
After communicating with the Empress and the others and leaving Duckie behind to learn, Shi Yu found the gem cat. At this moment, under the Empress’s might, she had no choice but to work hard again.
“What, what?”
“Don’t disturb me if there’s nothing important.”
“Of course.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Isn’t my heart aching for you? I brought you some toys. When you’re tired, you can divert your attention and change your mood.”
“What, what?” The gem cat’s eyes lit up. It knew that Shi Yu still had some conscience.
Next, Shi Yu took out the Worm Queen’s bloodline crystal. The cosmic pressure in the bloodline crystal instantly made the cat’s expression change. The malice aura on this resource was even stronger than the Empress’ pressure.
“What is it?” She took a step back.
“It smells like a worm. I don’t eat worms.”
“The bloodline crystal of the Worm Queen is one of the evolution resources after Buggy. If you’re tired of modifying the source of transcendence, you can change your mood and find the Empress to modify this together. The bloodline traces on it are still too strong. It might not be good for Buggy to directly fuse.”
Although it didn’t have much of an impact, it was very easy for Buggy to be afraid when it encountered the Worm Queen in the future and be suppressed by its bloodline, unable to display its full battle power. At that time, if the Worm Queen had ill intentions, it would be difficult for Buggy to join Mother Hunters.
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the gem cat was stunned.
“You’re a dog, right!! I thought you were here to care about me, but in the end, you came with a new job that’s even more difficult for cats??”
“So the Empress also has to work for you? You’re lazing around yourself, right!!”
“Nonsense!!” Shi Yu said righteously.
“Cough, cough, actually, there’s an easier way for you.”
“What? I hope you can speak human language this time.”
“Let’s contract it too. You’re now at the peak of the super divine level. Perhaps after the contract, you can directly feedback me to the peak of the super divine level. At the same time, I can also give you a lot of power. At that time… you’ll be more powerful when you work…”
Boom!!
“Think about it!!!” As expected, Shi Yu was sent flying.
Shi Yu had an innocent expression. He didn’t fancy the previous cat and felt that Teacher Cat’s battle power was too low. Now that Teacher Cat was at the peak of super divine, its functionality was still strong, and the contract wasn’t a loss. Unfortunately, it didn’t seem to work… The other party was unwilling.
“If Teacher Cat doesn’t work, Goddess Wa and Blue Planet will probably be in even more trouble…”
“Sigh, looks like nurturing my pet is more reliable.”
“Time is tight, and I can’t run around anymore. Next, I want to optimize Eleven and the others’ accompanying moves before becoming a cosmic level…”
The randomness of exploring ruins was too great. In order to increase battle power, it was indeed more suitable for the current Shi Yu to optimize the accompanying moves and wait for the modification of the source of transcendence to be completed on the spot.
Among the 14 pets now, apart from Baby Ginseng that had transcended seven times, the other pets had transcended six times. However, Shi Yu felt that they were also about to break through.
The reason why he had the thought of optimizing the accompanying moves was that although the quality of their skills wasn’t bad, it was far from the highest.
For example, Susu’s Infinite Devour was already one of the top super skills in the team. It could devour various things and let itself evolve, transforming into racial skills. It could also eat various attacks. It was simply invincible. There weren’t many skills in the team that were stronger than this move.
However, even such a skill still had a high-level skill like the “Ultimate Devour”. Of course, a terrifying skill like the Ultimate Devour that could even perfectly digest a cosmic treasure and transform it into its own strength could already be said to be the signature skill of the cosmic emperor, the “Queen of Worms”. It was the only one in the entire universe who had mastered it.
If Buggy could also learn it, a second life form would have mastered it, but Buggy’s proficiency in this move definitely couldn’t exceed the Worm Queen. After all, this was an exclusive skill developed by Buggy according to its race.
In the words of the Empress, a skill like “Ultimate Devour” could no longer be described as a “divine skill”. It could already be called a “super divine skill” and “cosmic profundity”.
In fact, even the Empress didn’t have a skill of this quality. The reason why the Empress was powerful was because of the power system of her dual cultivation for two eras. In terms of the power system of this era alone, her strength might not necessarily be stronger than cosmic emperors like the Worm Queen.
Therefore, in order to make Eleven and the others stronger, Shi Yu had two directions.
One was to let Eleven and the others also master a “super divine skill” and “cosmic profundities” that belonged to them.
Or, he could let them cultivate the power system of two eras at the same time.
In fact, if the pet’s talent was enough, it would want all of them. It would want super divine skills and dual cultivation.
As for the latter, it wasn’t impossible. Shi Yu’s pet’s physique had all been modified. Using a special method, it obtained the physique of the previous era. Just like Bu Lu, it could learn the cultivation system of the previous era. Even Teacher Gem Cat had optimized its physique and learned the power system of the previous era with the help of the Empress. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have been able to reach the peak of the super divine level so quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1849 - 1849  Revealing the True Intent of Filial Piety (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1849 - 1849  Revealing the True Intent of Filial Piety (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Therefore, Shi Yu’s pets all had this aptitude. For example, Duckie had already run to learn the cleansing power of the Buddhist Sect from the last era from the little nun Floating Light. Apart from that, other pets had also learned the skills of the last era. For example, Eleven had learned Weapon Control. This was an ancient skill that Lin Xiuzhu had excavated from the Chi You Ruins.
As for super divine skills, this was very difficult, but Shi Yu had the skill index.
Although the additional points function of the skill index could only reach the transcendent divine skill at most and couldn’t allow the divine skill to undergo a qualitative change again, the additional points function was only one of the many functions of the skill index.
It also had the functions of “Skill Deduction” and “Technique Fusion”. Shi Yu felt that perhaps he could use these two functions to charge at the “super divine skill”.
If he couldn’t add a super divine skill, couldn’t he be a gambler and fuse one??
Shi Yu decided to start with Eleven according to the order of entry.
Having a “super divine skill” was almost equivalent to a “cosmic race”. This was the highest level of race and belonged to the pet of the universe.
Name  Eleven
[Stats]: Metal, Thunder, Dark, Light
[Race]: Iron-eating Beast  Nine Li Battle Beast  Demon God Iron-eating Beast  Chaos Panda
[Race Level]: Top-notch god race
[Level of Growth]: Super divine level (Transcendent 6 times)
[Will Level]: Super divine
[Star Arms]: Star Bamboo
[Skill]:
“Divine-level”: Yin Yang Millstone (transcendent), Battle God Body (transcendent), Eight Trigrams Clone (transcendent), One Thought of God and Demon (transcendent), Metal Control (transcendent), Star Refining (transcendent), Weapon Control (transcendent), Chaos Wex Body (transcendent), Light and Darkness Control (transcendent)
Compared to before, the current Eleven had a new skill of Light and Darkness Control. It was fused before the competition for the source of transcendence.
Shi Yu originally thought that light and darkness could fuse into skills related to the Yin Yang Great Dao, but he was overthinking. He only fused into one Light and Darkness Control. Although this skill was also very powerful, it could allow the user to absorb all the dark power in the land of darkness and turn it into the only light source. It could also allow the user to absorb all the light in the land of light and turn it into a pure source of darkness. It could have the strongest control of darkness, transforming light and darkness into each other and fusing with each other, but it was still a little far from a super divine skill.
Perhaps if it were changed to Yin Yang Control, it would be a super divine skill, but unfortunately, it couldn’t be exchanged and couldn’t be bet.
“Wu wu wu…”
Shi Yu hugged Eleven and looked at it. “The current situation is that the Star Bamboo Arms are relatively lousy, causing the Weapon Control to not be able to display a perfect effect. Now that Star Refinement has reached transcendent, it can already refine two weapons and two stars. These two skills can be optimized and even fused.”
“Apart from that, the compatibility between Light and Darkness Control and Yin Yang Millstone is enough. It can be fused into a new skill.”
“The compatibility between the Battle God Body and the Chaos Thunder Body is also relatively good. It can also be fused into a new skill.”
“Wuuu.” Eleven was grabbed by Shi Yu and danced around. Its gaze was bright, and it didn’t care about strengthening before strengthening. In short, it was happy to be able to add points.
“Alright, you can eat the Star Bamboo directly. We’ll find a high-level star to refine later,” Shi Yu said.
The Star Refinement skill could only refine dead stars, even if it reached transcendent. However, at transcendent, its refining range was much wider. It could even refine some special celestial bodies.
Shi Yu got Eleven to eat the Star Bamboo and prepare to change weapons. He already had a target.
He planned to search for these two special stars in the Cosmic Sea with Eleven and refine them into weapons to use with the control of weapons.
These two special celestial bodies weren’t difficult to find in the universe.
However, it might be a little difficult to control them of a relative nature. Shi Yu placed his hopes on the fusion skill first. If he could fuse with the Yin Yang Control that he was thinking about, it might be easier to refine the black and white hole.
Firstly, what he tried to fuse was the Chaos Thunder Body and the Battle God Body. The success rate of the fusion of these two skills was extremely low. When they both reached transcendent, the success rate was still 0. It was only when Shi Yu and Eleven stepped into the super divine level that the success rate was displayed.
The success rate this time was “extremely low”. This was the first time such a hint appeared in the skill index, so Shi Yu had never tried it casually.
But now, Shi Yu felt that it was extremely low and very tempting. Perhaps it could really fuse into a “super-divine skill” and let Eleven leap into a cosmic race. This way, it might be easier for it to break through to the cosmic level in the future.
The reason why Shi Yu didn’t let Susu go was because he hoped to leave it behind to assist in his fusion…
Apart from that, he also had to do some psychological construction for his pets.
“Cough, cough, I haven’t fused skills in a long time. I’m a little nervous,” Shi Yu said.
“Let’s do some mental preparation before fusing,” he said as he stared at the eager Eleven.
“If the skill fusion is successful, what do you want to do after you become stronger?” Shi Yu knew that his consumption completely depended on the pet’s will and whether the pet could persist.
Therefore, in advance, Shi Yu tricked Eleven as usual to make it firmly believe in him.
This way, it would be easier for him.
“Wu wu wu?” Eleven lowered its head and bit its palm before letting out a howl.
Fighting the Dark King?
“Don’t think so far ahead. As long as you work hard this time and try to complete the skill fusion in half a minute, I’ll help you fight the Sun God General. How about that? The Star Race is currently ranked first among the ten thousand races in the starry sky. Although the Iron-eating Beast Race overall can’t defeat the starry sky life form, if you defeat the strongest individual of the Star Race, the Iron-eating Beast will definitely be famous in the starry sky. Although it’s not number one among the ten thousand races in the starry sky, it’s better than number one among the ten thousand races in the starry sky!!”
“Can you do it in half a minute?” In order to strengthen Eleven’s will, Shi Yu used all kinds of scams.
“Wuu?!?” Eleven was shocked.
For Eleven, who hadn’t fought in the ranking battle of all races for a long time, the title of number one among the ten thousand races in the starry sky was infinitely attractive to it.
Eleven could still vividly remember the impressiveness of the Sun God General. It mobilized the power of billions of stars across countless star areas to kill the Four Saints and the super divine. Although the entire team should have no problem fighting the Sun God General together, Eleven definitely couldn’t defeat it alone now. The birth of a star life form was a super divine. It was fully deserving of being the number one race in the Cosmic Sea. If it could defeat the strongest individual among them…
No one knew his pets better than Shi Yu. As expected, its tempting challenge immediately made Eleven howl in excitement.
It could PK the Sun God General!!!
Eleven wanted to frown at this fusion skill. Even if it lost!
At the same time.
As one of the few peak super divine experts under the World King, the Sun God General had a bad feeling. Its mood was extremely solemn. “As expected, from the looks of it, it’s right. The ambition of the Dark King is about to surface… Even I’ve been targeted?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1850 - 1850 Challenging the Number One of All Races (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1850 - 1850 Challenging the Number One of All Races (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
After mentally preparing the panda, Shi Yu decisively summoned the entire team’s pets to assist it.
Buggy, Creation Domain, Baby Ginseng, Healing, Chi Tong, Possession Scapegoat, Susu, Purification, Ling, Luck Blessing!
Little Zi, World Force Blessing, Qi, Time Reversal, Turtle and Little Quas, Life Sharing of the Holy Black Tortoise Body, Shorty, White Tiger Divine Armor, and even Bu Lu could more or less assist in healing skills derived from skills such as Wood Control, Light Control, and Water Control.
Only Little Ji was thrown by Shi Yu to be a cheerleader. This guy wasn’t very useful. He didn’t even need it to fuse with him.
“Roar!!!” Little Ji looked at everyone eagerly. Although it was a good thing to be able to slack off, why did it feel isolated?
Its good brother, Duckie, had also gone to cultivate with other big shots. Little Ji immediately felt that there was no love. It poked its claws and was extremely pitiful.
Now, Little Ji was undoubtedly the most anxious in the team…
“There.” As Little Ji was anxious, Shi Yu’s big hand pressed on its head and said, “Don’t worry, I’ll definitely make you the earth overlord of the universe.”
“Roar!!!” Little Ji smiled.
After arriving at the starry sky of the universe, Little Ji had long had a new dream. On Blue Planet, its dream was to turn the sea of Blue Planet into the ground. From the looks of it, this dream had undoubtedly been shattered.
But now, it had a higher-level dream, which was to build a super continent in the starry sky, letting the universe not only have planets as footholds, but also other pure lands as holy lands for earth pets.
It wanted to be the earth overlord in the starry sky of the universe.
This dream wasn’t difficult. The rare thing was how to let others acknowledge the territory it had created. This required strength, at least at the peak of the super divine level.
However, Little Ji believed that as long as it followed Shi Yu and Ling, everything wasn’t a problem.
“Wu wu wu.” After comforting Little Ji, Shi Yu raised the expectant Eleven. Various buffs were added to Shi Yu and the others. Shi Yu took a deep breath.
Skill: Chaotic Thunder Body, Battle God Body
[Fusion success rate]: Extremely low
[Fusion Risk]: Extremely high
“Why don’t you increase your points step by step?” Shi Yu complained about why he had designed it like this in his previous life and directly charged forward.
“Wu!” “Yi!” “Mi!” “Ning!” As the other pets assisted, they were also observing the changes in Shi Yu and Eleven.
After all, they also had to undergo this level of skill fusion next.
Under the cheers of the entire team, the skill furnace directly activated!!
Countless skill EXP shattered and fused. The huge will impact made Eleven roar at the sky!!
At this moment, they were in Little Zi’s Star World and Buggy’s Creation Domain. Eleven’s painful roar made Little Zi’s entire body tremble.
“Roar!!!!!!”
Under a painful roar, a shocking black and white lightning erupted from Eleven’s body!!
In an instant, Shi Yu felt his body being drained. The life force of the turtles and the others who shared Shi Yu’s life was also instantly drained. Chi Tong, who had possessed Shi Yu, had suffered countless injuries for Shi Yu.
Crack. As cracks appeared on the White Tiger Divine Armor, Baby Ginseng widened its eyes and nourished even harder…
The entire team twisted into a rope and used all their strength.
However, an extremely low success rate was indeed the first. Even if so many pets worked hard together, even if Shi Yu’s physique could already be called number one below the cosmic level, he was still instantly on the verge of death.
The various functions gradually stopped operating. Some pets like Chi Tong were shocked and wanted to bear more for Shi Yu, but they were stopped by Shi Yu’s will.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng took a step forward and expressed that it would leave it to it. The hexagram in its green eyes circulated and had already fused the two Time Marks into Shi Yu’s body.
This way, Shi Yu would have two lives to add points to.
The Time Mark that had been trained to transcendent no longer needed to be completely dead to take effect. As long as it was on the verge of death, it could take the initiative to activate it and save its state to the peak.
From Eleven’s perspective, Eleven was also enduring the impact of the incomparably painful will. Although it had promised Shi Yu well, its mind went blank the moment it fused. It couldn’t think about anything, and only endless lightning wreaked havoc in its body.
At this moment, Eleven felt that its physique was being tempered by the lightning tribulation and underwent a magical transformation. If nothing went wrong, if it succeeded, it would still be a physique skill.
“Roar!!!”
In the outside world, Buggy and the others could already see Eleven’s body completely exploded by the lightning tribulation. They couldn’t help but be shocked. After all, Eleven’s physique was the strongest in the team. Its will had also been torn apart by the lightning and was undergoing an unbelievable rebirth.
Although they had agreed for half a minute, a full three minutes had passed.
Be it Shi Yu, the main force, or the pets that added points as support, they were already tragic.
Among them, Shi Yu was even forced to use the Time Mark once.
“It’s so f*cking difficult.” Shi Yu’s body was similar to Eleven’s. It had endured endless destruction. He felt that it was even more difficult than fighting for the source of transcendence, even more difficult than resisting the deterrence of a cosmic overlord.
However, although Shi Yu complained verbally, he was very surprised in his heart.
Although Eleven wasn’t awesome or exciting and didn’t listen to the agreement with him, the skill fusion was stable and good. During the process of tempering Eleven’s body, the lightning tribulation was also comparable to the process of perfectly fusing with its physique.

chapters.title: Chapter 1851: Challenging the Number One of All Races (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1851: Challenging the Number One of All Races (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
During this process, the lightning tribulation exploded its flesh and blood. The lightning and flesh seemed to have sublimated, turning into a dense chaotic aura. A gray chaotic aura began to linger around Eleven’s body, reviving its flesh and blood. Ripples that contained mysterious laws appeared, giving birth to a new physique.
Boom.
Its level also instantly arrived at the level of transcendent seven times. After the gray chaotic sea of energy, seven Suns of Transcendence appeared.
“Roar!!!”
Eleven felt its body itch and was forced to shout again. Its will was clear at the same time. However, after its will was clear, it suddenly sensed the flow of time and knew that a few minutes had passed. It couldn’t help but be shocked.
When it opened its eyes, it saw that its teammates had already fallen to the ground weakly. Even Baby Ginseng sat on the ground panting. As for the Beast Tamer in front of it, he was as thin as a bag of bones, no longer human.
“Wu wu wu. Wu wu.”
Eleven’s chubby and round body immediately crawled up from the ground. Its black eyes were filled with apology as it apologized to Shi Yu for not being able to withstand the impact of its will.
“Jiejiejiejie, hehehehe.” However, Shi Yu, who was opposite him, didn’t care about this.
On his skin and bones face, his eyes revealed a green light. He was extremely happy. As expected, as expected.
“It’s good that it succeeded. The rest doesn’t matter. This time, it’s impressive, and even incomplete skills are so strong??”
Eleven also knew that Shi Yu wouldn’t care about this, but Eleven still felt a little apologetic for not being able to persist and make Shi Yu and the others suffer a little more.
However, when it heard Shi Yu mention skills, its eyes lit up.
[Fusion successful]
[Chaos Thunder Body and Battle Divine Body] had already fused into [Chaos Divine Body (Incomplete)].
Skill: Chaos Divine Body (Incomplete)
< Introduction > It can be immune to all law attacks and absorb the other party to strengthen its physique.
This skill, this skill… Although the introduction looked ordinary, Shi Yu and Eleven could confirm immediately that this skill was simply invincible.
If the previous Chaos Thunder Body could only allow Eleven to absorb ten thousand lightning bolts, even if it was cosmic tribulation lightning, then the current Chaos Divine Body was no longer afraid of any cosmic law.
Even if the cosmic will sent down a heavenly tribulation of the fire, gust, and frost nature, Eleven could ignore it like lightning.
Not only was it the calamity of the universe’s laws descended by the cosmic will, but even the attacks of other enemies… For example, the Fire Law, the Space Law, the Time Law, the Creation Law, the World Destruction Law, the Return to Zero Law… Eleven was immune to all the law divine skills and absorbed them.
As long as it was a law skill born in this universe, Eleven could ignore it, absorb it, and transform it into its physique!!
This was simply an extremely shameless terrifying physique. It countered all divine-level life forms in this era. After all, the mainstream cultivation system of this era was to cultivate the power of laws in the universe.
It could be said that with this skill, there was only one way to hurt Eleven.
Shi Yu only thought of a few experts who could do this with skills that didn’t contain the power of laws in the universe, such as pure physical strength, pure spiritual power, and pure soul power.
For example, the cosmic overlord and the Beastmaster had heard that their pure physiques could destroy a star domain with a punch without the help of the laws of the universe.
For example, the Super Empress had combined the cultivation system of the previous era and mainly cultivated her mental strength. She also didn’t have a deep understanding of the universe laws of this era.
There was also the Empress of the Worms. Before and after reaching the cosmic level, she mainly cultivated the power of her bloodline.
Perhaps only these methods could pose a threat to Eleven. As for ordinary law divine skills, unless the attacker’s level far exceeded Eleven.
Otherwise, it was definitely impossible to cause any damage.
It could be said that if the previous Eleven was at the super divine level, there were still many old antiques who could casually beat Eleven up, but now, Eleven definitely had the ability to fight them evenly.
If they wanted to hurt Eleven, they had to sacrifice many powerful methods and find other ways.
“This physique… is so strong.” At this moment, the weak Ling couldn’t help but mutter.
“Roar!!! (It’s all thanks to Big Sister’s luck blessing.)” Little Ji drooled.
“Wu!!” “Yi!!” At this moment, the entire team was drooling. It could be said that with this skill, Eleven was directly invincible in the entire team. After all, Shi Yu’s pets had yet to reach the realm where they could have very strong battle power after leaving the laws of the universe.
Baby Ginseng even started to conceptualize the anti-chaotic body energy fruit on the spot.
“Wuu!!” Sensing Shi Yu’s joy and the envy of his teammates, Eleven couldn’t help but clench its fists, its eyes shining.
“It’s already so strong just because it’s incomplete. How powerful is the complete version?” Shi Yu said. “This shouldn’t be a real ‘super divine skill’, but it feels about right. If it becomes a complete Chaos Divine Body, it will definitely be a super divine skill. It won’t be inferior to the Ultimate Devour.”
“Do you want to continue fusing other skills…” Shi Yu took a look and suddenly realized that all the other skills suddenly had compatibility with the Chaos Divine Body (incomplete).
In other words, the skill of the Chaos Divine Body could fuse with any skill and contain ten thousand skills. Chaos gave birth to extremes, and extremes gave birth to Taiji. Taiji gave birth to two elements… What he said was indeed right.
“Holy shit.” Shi Yu couldn’t help but think to himself. It was too domineering.

chapters.title: Chapter 1852: Challenging the Number One of All Races (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1852: Challenging the Number One of All Races (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Alright, you’re a real Chaos Panda now…” Shi Yu said, “When we rest, we’ll continue fusing other skills.”
“Now, everyone is recuperating. Eleven, study the Chaotic Body yourself.”
“Wuu!!” Eleven bowed to everyone crazily, indicating that it would definitely end the battle in half a minute next time.
Baby Ginseng, on the other hand, started to suck Blue Planet’s blood with everyone in envy.
After Shi Yu recovered a little, he went out to the starry sky alone.
Although Eleven couldn’t persist, Shi Yu’s heart itched when he saw the power of Eleven’s Chaos Divine Body. He wanted to see it fight.
A suitable opponent… Blue Planet, Goddess Wa, and the little nun. To be honest, there weren’t many, but it was meaningless to fight these targets.
Instead, the Sun God General was the best choice.
There was no other reason than that the Sun God would be the strongest in the life of a star.
As for stellar life forms, they were ranked first among the ten thousand races in the starry sky.
The ranking of the ten thousand races in the starry sky was a competition of the overall strength of the race. The consciousness born by the star race was that of a super divine, which was to be born into a super divine. In addition, the ranking battle of the ten thousand races in the starry sky was the ranking competition of the Cosmic Sea. Therefore, the first throne belonged to the star race.
Just as they arrived at the World King Planet, Eleven was very interested in the ranking battle of all races.
