On Blue Planet, there were very few Iron-eating Beasts at the start, and their reputation wasn’t obvious. The reputation of the Iron-eating Beasts was all fought out step by step by Shi Yu and Eleven through various competitions such as the Class Tournament, the National Tournament, and the World Tournament. It could be said that Eleven was the representative of the Iron-eating Beast race, the symbol of the Iron-eating Beast race, the king of the Iron-eating Beasts. Eleven also liked this feeling very much, so it had always been very concerned about the strength of its race.
Now, giving Eleven a chance to let the Iron-eating Beast race reach the top could be considered to have satisfied its initial wish. Perfecting its mind could undoubtedly increase Eleven’s chances of advancing to the cosmic level.
On World King Planet, in front of the nine super divine level stars, Shi Yu arrived in front of the one with the strongest aura. Soon, a flaming figure slowly walked out and looked at Shi Yu.
“Shi Yu.” The Sun God General wasn’t very surprised by Shi Yu’s arrival.
“I believe you’ve also discovered the abnormality of the universe. Bing Ling has already looked for you, right? Then you should have come this time to learn more about the Contaminated Land from me…”
“Huh?” Shi Yu said, “No.”
“Sun God General, can I invite you to fight a ranking battle with my Iron-eating Beast?”
“I’ve checked the information. When you were ‘young’, you were also a fanatic about the ranking battle of all races, right?”
Sun God General: ???
The Sun God General was clearly a little stunned and stunned. It suspected that it had heard wrongly.
The ranking battle of all races?
Shi Yu specially came to find it for this??
“What are you doing?” The Sun God General was confused.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “What can I do? I just want to satisfy the wish of a pet. As the representative of a race and the leader of a race, its dream is to let the Iron-eating Beast Race reach the top of the strongest race in the universe. As the strongest individual of the Star Race ranked first among the ten thousand races in the starry sky, you have always been its challenge target.”
“Sorry, I’m not interested…” The Sun God General couldn’t help but say. Now that a cosmic war could erupt at any time, how could it care about such a child-like competition?
Although it was indeed passionate about this competition a long, long time ago and it was the one who led the Star Race to first place, that was billions of years ago. In its opinion, such a competition was already an empty title. It was no different from a child playing house.
However, what it didn’t know was that Eleven was still a child and was at the stage where it needed honor and recognition.
Shi Yu had no choice. Who didn’t have two children? For the sake of their child, he had to fight this Sun God.
“I know a friend at the peak of the super divine level. She’s not Goddess Wa, not the Star Prayer Cat, not the Blue Planet’s Will, but another one. She’s expert in the power of cleansing. If the Sun God General can satisfy my little wish… I can work hard and invite her over to protect the Cosmic Sea and the World King Planet. If there’s a cosmic-level dispute in the future…”
The Sun God General fell silent again.
He had never seen such a shameless person like Shi Yu.
However, where did Shi Yu get to know a new peak super divine?
“Alright, when?” In the end, the Sun God General still gave in. If it could pull in an ally at the peak of the super divine level just by competing, it could still.
In addition, the Sun God General didn’t find this competition difficult.
If it was just fighting Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast…
If Shi Yu’s entire team joined forces, it would indeed be powerful. Perhaps it wouldn’t be his match either.
However, it was only one of more than ten pets, and there was no Beast Tamer to strengthen it. It was just a one-on-one battle… The Sun God General felt that with its strength, it might be able to end the battle in a second.
The strength of a Beast Tamer was that they could fight with all their pets as a whole. The Sun God General didn’t deny that Shi Yu was very strong, but the Sun God General didn’t believe that a pet alone could threaten it.
After all, among the super divine levels in the entire universe, its strength was also the strongest. It was far from what the peak super divine subordinates created by the Dark King and the peak super divine heirs born by the Worm Queen could compare to.
“In a month,” Shi Yu said. “Friendship first, competition second. Thank you, Lord Sun God. I’ll go to the ranking battle of all races to make an appointment.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1853: Challenging the Number One of All Races (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1853: Challenging the Number One of All Races (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Sun God General:
As he watched Shi Yu leave, the Sun God General fell into deep thought.
When Shi Yu left, he could clearly sense that the Sun God General was indifferent to this competition.
He couldn’t help but smile. If the Sun God General dared to underestimate Eleven, he would be wrong.
Eleven wouldn’t lose this battle.
After all, if it lost, how could it challenge the Tauren sitting on the throne of a cosmic overlord in the future, the strongest in the era, Cypos?
That was Eleven’s final challenge target.
After bidding farewell to the Sun God General, Shi Yu descended on the World King Planet on the way and arrived at the Dong Huang Realm. Ever since Shi Yu became a super divine, the Dong Huang Realm naturally automatically upgraded to a first-level realm.
Facilities like the Myriad Race Ranking Battle could register for the competition in their own world.
Shi Yu came this time to tell the person in charge of the ranking battle of the ten thousand races in his realm that he wanted to fight the Sun God…
Ten Thousand Races Ranking Committee, Dong Huang Branch.
A woman in a panda casual suit was approving the documents. When she saw that the Iron-eating Beast Race’s ranking had already risen to 20220, she couldn’t help but smile.
“Ah, President Lin, I’m busy.” In the quiet office, a figure suddenly appeared. Lin Xiuzhu suddenly looked at Shi Yu and said, “Hey, hey, hey, even if you’re a realm lord, you can’t barge into other people’s offices, right?”
“Didn’t I accidentally teleport over after locking onto the aura?” Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment.
The current president of the Myriad Races Committee in the Dong Huang Realm was Lin Xiuzhu.
It could be said that Shi Yu didn’t let the other party plant people in the official organization that settled in the Dong Huang Realm. Instead, he distributed them to his friends on Blue Planet. It was mainly because the salary wasn’t low and their social status was high. As for being busy… he could completely slack off and throw them to his assistant or pet!
For example, Senior Lu had already thrown the position of prison director to her Wind Demon Lion.
However, for Senior Panda, she liked the job of ranking battles of all races very much. It was mainly because she could see at a glance the native races of Blue Planet rising their rankings step by step in the starry sky of the universe, especially the Iron-eating Beasts. It was very fulfilling.
Now, the Iron-eating Beast race from Blue Planet grew the fastest among the ten thousand races in the starry sky. They had already reached more than 20,000.
Of course, this was also thanks to Shi Yu. Because of Shi Yu and Eleven’s performance, the geniuses of the floating, Heavenly Demon, and Dong Xuan major realms ran to Dong Huang to contract the Iron-eating Beast to nurture. Apart from that, even Lin Feng, the Space Emperor, the Tyrannical Sea, Divine Source, and President Lin’s new pets had also subdued the Iron-eating Beast to nurture. It was mainly because Eleven’s battle power was too tempting.
However, it was worth affirming that it was impossible for them to nurture a monster like Eleven.
But even so, the Iron-eating Beasts were loved and respected by so many big shots, causing their status to rise. Under Lin Xiuzhu’s Poof, these Iron-eating Beasts cultivated by the big shots could casually participate in the ranking battle of all races and quickly increase the ranking of the Iron-eating Beast race.
It could be said that although Eleven hadn’t fought in the ranking battle of all races for a long time, Lin Xiuzhu, who was bewitched by Eleven, didn’t stop the Iron-eating Beast from fighting in the ranking battle of all races.
“Busy person, what’s the matter? Didn’t Teacher Ying say that you went to explore the ruins?” asked the panda senior.
“Yes, I want Eleven to participate in a ranking battle of all races.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I’ve already made an appointment with my opponent.”
“Really?” The panda senior was stunned and had a pleasantly surprised expression.
She knew Eleven’s strength. It was already at the super divine level. Now, the reason why the Iron-eating Beast race’s ranking increased slowly was because no super divine level participant participated.
Although many big shots had taken a fancy to the Iron-eating Beast, apart from Eleven, the strongest Iron-eating Beast, which was her and Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast, was only a perfect divine.
If Eleven represented the Iron-eating Beast Race to win a few battles and defeat a few super divines, the overall ranking of the Iron-eating Beast Race would quickly enter the top ten thousand, even the top thousand, or even the top hundred.
“Who’s the opponent?” Lin Xiuzhu asked quickly.
“Star Race, Sun God General.”
“Pfft.” Senior Panda couldn’t help but be a little stunned. She widened her beautiful eyes and looked at Shi Yu. “Let Eleven… fight that Sun God General??”
“Is it the Sun God General at the peak of the super divine level I know?”
“Yeah.” Shi Yu casually sat opposite Senior Panda and said, “I’ve already made an appointment with my opponent. It’s indeed a little difficult in a month, but it doesn’t matter. I’ll leave it to you to operate. No problem, right?”
“No problem! I believe in Eleven! Even Teacher Ying can reach the peak of the super divine level so quickly. Eleven must have already reached the peak of the super divine level, right? Although the speed is a little unscientific, it’s very likely if it’s you.”
Senior Panda’s eyes lit up. Great. She said, “Let me think about how to make it more newsworthy.”
Shi Yu smiled. This guy’s business genius attributes were still the same, but was it really alright for him to say that about Teacher Ying?
“Yes, the ‘newbies’ of the Space Race, which is also the race that entered the top 10,000 of the Space Race for the first time, have an opportunity to specify a certain large race in the top 100 to challenge. The races on both sides will each produce an individual battle. This challenge is called the ‘Young Lion Battle’.”
“The challenger of the ‘Young Lion Battle’ won’t fall in ranking if he loses the competition, but if he wins, his ranking will increase greatly. It’s a small mechanism of the ranking battle of all races. We can start with the Young Lion Battle. The attention will be higher.”
“A month, give me a month. I’ll get Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast and the others to rank the Iron-eating Beast Race in the top 10,000 as soon as possible. Then, your Iron-eating Beast will challenge the cub, and the target will be the Sun God General. This way, the attention will be the highest.”
“At the same time, it can also greatly increase the Iron-eating Beast ranking in one go! It’s a big surprise for the Cosmic Sea.”
“They definitely didn’t expect that not only are you strong yourself, but the entire team is also strong. Now that you’ve pulled out a pet alone, it’s already standing at the top of the universe!” Seeing Shi Yu and Eleven become stronger step by step, Senior Panda was even happier than Shi Yu himself.
“Alright.” Shi Yu looked at the excited panda senior and smiled. “I’ll leave it to you. Then I’ll get Eleven to wait for the battle.”
…
After instructing Senior Panda, Shi Yu returned to Blue Planet to see how his pets were recovering. Shi Yu went out alone and left his pets to recover with the help of Baby Ginseng’s power of the Blue Planet’s world…
Although they had only gone out for a short period of time, under Baby Ginseng’s hard work, the pets basically recovered their vitality.
“What are you doing?” After observing the situation of the pets, Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng. At this moment, it was wearing the cosmic tree seed and doing some miserable research on a group of awakening-level ginseng baby clones.
It looked like it recovered the fastest and had even invested in new work.
“Research the Anti-Chaotic Body Energy Fruit?”
“Yi, Yiya.” After Baby Ginseng finished speaking, Shi Yu was amused. It had to be said that Baby Ginseng was indeed the most thoughtful existence in the team…
It wasn’t researching the Anti-Chaotic Body Energy Fruit. After thinking about it, Baby Ginseng had already started. It no longer pursued first place in the team and wanted to do something more meaningful.
After Shi Yu’s pets broke through to the super divine level, they gave a certain amount of feedback to their races. For example, Baby Ginseng allowed the Baby Ginseng race on Blue Planet to master some battle skills.
However, Baby Ginseng wasn’t satisfied with this.
It wanted to develop a “cultivation method” that was suitable for all the weak supplement races to cultivate. It was similar to meditation, a cultivation method with an extremely low threshold. Then, it would preach to the billions of planets in the starry sky of the universe, giving all the supplement races a chance to resist their fate. At this moment, for countless supplement races, the ginseng emperor was undoubtedly doing a great thing.
It had actually wanted to do it for a long time, but only now did it have the ability.
Baby Ginseng didn’t think that the guys who treated supplement races as prey were wrong, but it felt that some supplement races naturally didn’t have the slightest power to resist fate. This was the fault of the universe. It wanted to correct this mistake.
“Yi! (As long as I become the idol of all the supplement races, it will be easier for you to add points, Shi Yu. With my command, countless supplement races will contribute faith nourishing power from the starry sky of the universe… Great supplement!)”
“Good heavens, I support you,” Shi Yu said. “But countless years later, those who want to eat supplements might curse.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1854: Heavenly Emperor Scripture and Chaos Panda (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1854: Heavenly Emperor Scripture and Chaos Panda (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu had always supported what pets liked to do.
It gave them enough autonomy and even the right to privacy.
For example, Shi Yu had never looked at Baby Ginseng’s research on the Anti-Teammate Energy Fruit, nor would he reveal it to other pets. It was very fair.
As for why it was three hands, he was afraid that they would be proud if he left one behind.
Now, if Baby Ginseng wanted the supplement races in the starry sky universe to have some self-defense methods like Baby Ginseng on Blue Planet, Shi Yu felt that it wasn’t impossible.
This wasn’t meaningless, because there was indeed a faith system in the world. What Baby Ginseng did was a great merit for the supplement race. In the future, when it took shape, Baby Ginseng could also benefit.
Of course, for some races who used supplements as food, it was a little scammy.
At that time, they would hate Baby Ginseng, probably the same as Susu hated the Dark King…
However, what Baby Ginseng could actually do wasn’t too much. After all, the target it faced was a trillion supplement races. There were so many of them. Even if Baby Ginseng was at the cosmic level, it was impossible for it to make these supplement races stand up all at once.
Even if it was its race on Blue Planet, Baby Ginseng could only let their bloodlines awaken a low-level battle skill.
Baby Ginseng was a race that wasn’t good at battle to begin with. After awakening this low-level battle skill, it was impossible for it to defeat a predator.
But this way, at least it wouldn’t be like before where they could only wait for death and escape. As long as some ginseng babies were willing to work hard, it might not be impossible to train this low-level skill to become proficient and increase the chances of survival.
Baby Ginseng felt that it was enough to do this. At least, it could let some supplement races see hope for the future.
It didn’t want to protect the supplement race, but it wanted many supplement races like it, who were born without battle power, to have hope of resisting fate.
“Yi.”
At this moment, after Shi Yu finished encouraging him and was just about to leave, Baby Ginseng stopped Shi Yu.
“Why, do you need my help?” Shi Yu stopped and asked.
“Yes, yes.” Baby Ginseng nodded crazily. In fact, the cultivation technique it wanted to create already had a prototype. It wasn’t a problem for it to create any divine skill for a life form that had transcended the high-level.
Moreover, Baby Ginseng had comprehension to begin with. After researching so many anti-teammate energy fruits, it could be said to be the most creative in Shi Yu’s team. Creating a cultivation method now wasn’t a problem for it.
“Yi!! (Help me name it.)” Baby Ginseng said. It wanted Shi Yu to help it name the cultivation technique it created.
“What, you want me to name it???” Shi Yu was stunned. Was he sure Baby Ginseng didn’t have a fever?
Don’t you know your Beast Tamer level? You’ve already transcended the high-level, and you’re still using the name “Baby Ginseng”. Why don’t you know your own limits?
“Yiyi.” Baby Ginseng shook its head. It knew Shi Yu’s dilettantish, middling skills.
However, Shi Yu had to name this cultivation technique.
It planned to let Shi Yu participate in the creation of the cultivation method. This way, if possible, some supplement races would also believe in Shi Yu.
At that time, even if it died one day, there would be countless supplement races to act as supplements for Shi Yu, ensuring that Shi Yu didn’t die.
Of course, Baby Ginseng didn’t say anything. It just pulled Shi Yu along and let Shi Yu give it a name, like a child acting cute.
“Let me think.”
“You have to let me see the process of the cultivation method first, right?”
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng expressed that there was no problem and immediately called over an awakening-level ginseng baby clone.
The level-three awakened ginseng baby clone it created was no different from the lowest level ginseng baby and supplement race in nature. Apart from a little life force that was very nutritious for mortals and new Beast Tamers, there was nothing special about it.
In fact, even a stronger brat could toy with this ginseng baby clone like pulling out a radish and nibble on a few teeth marks.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng began to let this clone cultivate the cultivation technique it had created from the beginning.
Under Shi Yu’s gaze, the clone suddenly closed its eyes. Shi Yu used the contract connection with Baby Ginseng to observe the changes in the clone’s body.
In the depths of the spirit of this ginseng baby clone, no, its brain began to imagine a scene.
That scene was an ordinary sky, a sky with a breeze as far as the eye could see.
As the ginseng baby clone visualized, this visualization diagram of the wind in the sky slowly fused into this ginseng baby clone and began to subtly change its body.
Slowly, this ginseng baby clone began to evolve slightly. Its body became incomparably light, as if it had turned into wind. Its movement speed was extremely fast. With its eyes closed, it began to use its messy escape footwork.
In the end, a pair of Wind Flower Wings that could fly actually evolved.
Although it was only equivalent to a levelless skill and low-level skill and didn’t have much battle power, it was already a rare gain for a ginseng baby.
At least… it increased its ability to escape.
This wasn’t the end. It was still continuing to evolve. Evolution of the Wind Flower Wings was only the beginning. When it proficiently used the Wind Flower Wings, a green Dao Seed was born in the depths of this ginseng baby’s soul.
Through constantly nurturing the Dao Seed, the seed kept growing, further subtly changing the physique of the cultivator until the seed strengthened and bloomed with three flowers that contained strong life force. The physique of the cultivator could already be called a super life body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1855: Heavenly Emperor Scripture and Chaos Panda (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1855: Heavenly Emperor Scripture and Chaos Panda (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
The last step was for the Dao Seed to completely mature and become a Dao Fruit. The form of the Dao Fruit was like a small ginseng baby, but the color was slightly different from other individuals, containing the power of the sky.
When the cultivator completely fused with the Dao Fruit and the two parties fused into one, the Wind Law and the Life Law also began to be born, modifying this originally ordinary awakening-level ginseng baby clone into a divine-level race’s divine-level wind-element and wood-element Undying Medicine supplement that had mastered the Wind Law and the Life Law.
“Yiya.” After a cultivation process, Baby Ginseng’s clone beside him had already become an Undying Divine Medicine. Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu and patted its chest to ask how it was.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “Did you reference Buggy’s power of imagination and the meditation technique of the spiritual element? By letting the supplement race visualize other things, this thing can be the sky, lightning, sun, or sword… to let the supplement race obtain the nature of these things.”
“This stage can already be called an ‘evolution skill’.”
“Although from the looks of it, the evolution range isn’t big. It can only allow cultivators to evolve a levelless or even low-level skill, it’s already enough to change their fate.”
“A further step is the true beginning of cultivation, the true entry level. From this stage, it’s to let the supplement race evolve towards a divine-level race. It can further visualize and let the corresponding Dao Seed be born in the depths of its soul. Then, it can nurture a Dao Seed. This process allows the mind, soul, and body to become one, giving birth to three Flowers of Life and modifying the body…”
“The body is enough to withstand the Dao Fruit, and the Dao Fruit can take shape. The current Dao Fruit already contains weak laws. When it fuses with the Dao Fruit, it completely masters the power of laws corresponding to the visualization target.”
“The weaker the item visualized, the easier it is to cultivate. The stronger the thing visualized, the harder it is to cultivate. The upper limit is about a divine-level race.”
“Yiyi!!” Baby Ginseng nodded. Although its clone cultivated relatively quickly, that was because it was controlling it. If it were an ordinary ginseng baby, it would probably be difficult. The first step could crush countless ginseng babies, but there was no other way.
It had already worked very hard to lower the threshold. It could become stronger and evolve just by constantly visualizing and strengthening its faith. There was no simpler skill than this. Although the cultivation difficulty wasn’t low, the cultivation threshold was definitely low.
Of course, it was only for supplement races. The cultivation method it created could only be cultivated by supplement races without attack skills.
“This skill cultivation method should have been modified by you through the fusion of the World Tree Fruit, Cultivation Fruit, Soul Fruit, Wood Control, Life Divine Body, and other skills, right?”
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng nodded and even borrowed the power of the cosmic tree seed.
Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng. This guy was really a genius. This was indeed a cultivation technique that combined evolution, growth, and skills.
“Let me think. If I give it a name.” Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Visualization? Visualization skill? It was too low-level. How could it be worthy of Baby Ginseng’s hard work? Dao Fruit skill? It was too direct.
“Forget it, I’ll clueless with you.”
“This cultivation technique will be called the ‘Heavenly Emperor Scripture’.” Shi Yu scratched his cheek and said, “The first guiding realm is called the Visualization Realm. The second transformation realm is called the Evolution Realm. The third is called the Dao Seed Realm. The fourth is called the Three Flowers Convergence Realm. The fifth is called the Dao Fruit Realm. The sixth is called the Dao Integration Realm. After reaching the sixth realm, it will evolve into the Undying God Race and become an Undying Divine Medicine. Then, it will graduate!”
“Yi!!!” After Shi Yu finished speaking, Baby Ginseng’s eyes lit up, and the aura on its body rose steadily. As its cultivation method was perfected, Baby Ginseng’s realm directly went from transcendent seven times to transcendent eight times. Then, right on the heels of that, it transcended nine times!! Only then did it stop, scaring Shi Yu.
“Holy shit.” Shi Yu was stunned as he realized the difference in Baby Ginseng.
Sensing Baby Ginseng, at this moment, there was another skill.
< Name > Heart of the Heavenly Emperor
< Introduction > The more supplement races that cultivate the Heavenly Emperor Scripture to perfection, the stronger the founder.
This was a f*cking different faith skill?
“Sure.” Shi Yu realized that Baby Ginseng had gained an epiphany again and successfully created a skill on its own. He nodded excitedly. As expected of the number one in the team.
There was probably only one pet in Shi Yu’s team that frequently developed new skills without using skill fusion.
Of course, Shi Yu looked at the cosmic tree seed worn by Baby Ginseng and felt that apart from creating a skill cultivation method that matched its heart, Baby Ginseng’s breakthrough this time was also related to this incomplete cosmic treasure. Baby Ginseng, who was nourished by this, had always improved the fastest in Shi Yu’s team.
He didn’t know who among the pets in the team could be the first to step into the cosmic level.
“Yi, Yi!!” After breaking through, Baby Ginseng was also overjoyed. Under the shocked gazes of the other pets, it stuck out its chest and asked Shi Yu for leave.
“Where are you going?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yi.” It was about to start preaching. It would first spread the “Heavenly Emperor Scripture” to the entire Blue Planet, the entire World King Planet…
“Let’s do something serious. The entire team is crying for food and waiting for you to heal them. Can’t we just let our clones do the preaching?” Shi Yu said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1856: Heavenly Emperor Scripture and Chaos Panda (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1856: Heavenly Emperor Scripture and Chaos Panda (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Yi?” Baby Ginseng was stunned. Yes, just leave it to the clone…
Even if it was a clone, it could still have super divine battle power. A clone that had mastered super divine battle power was completely qualified to negotiate with the will of the various planets with the “World Grace” skill. Then, it could introduce its Great Dao to the various planets…
Then, as long as they completed the original accumulation of capital, they could let the first batch of Undying Divine Medicine that had successfully cultivated become the second batch of preachers again. They could transmit their cultivation methods to an even more remote corner. A spark could start a prairie fire!
Hundreds of millions of years later, the supplement races in the entire universe would be its disciples as the ginseng emperor.
“Wu…” Baby Ginseng’s improvement made the entire team feel very anxious. Eleven was alright. After all, it was currently enjoying the benefits of the skill fusion version. Buggy and the others were even more anxious.
Buggy looked in the direction of the gem cat. For the first time, it felt that Teacher Ying was so slow. When could it fuse with the bloodline crystal gifted by its godmother?
Susu sighed and couldn’t even wait to fight the Dark King Army. It felt that if it wanted to take another step forward, it still had to fight the Dark King Army.
Ling’s pursuit of strength wasn’t as strong as the other pets. On the other hand, Chi Tong frowned and thought about where its cosmic path was.
“Hurry up and rest. Be more energetic.” Shi Yu called his pets and everyone piled together to suck Blue Planet’s blood.
Little Zi and Bu Lu were the ones who sucked the most.
World King Planet.
After Shi Yu and Senior Panda finished explaining, Senior Panda also started the Myriad Race Ranking Battle. Although Shi Yu and the Sun God had already completed the battle, it was clearly against the rules to fight directly like this.
The ranking battle of all races couldn’t be directly encountered by the two of them through a private battle.
Although with the identities of these two people, they could meet through a conspiracy, it wasn’t proper enough and would easily cause it to discuss. After all, it was too obvious that there was an inside story when the Iron-eating Beast Race ranked more than 10,000 encountered the strongest individual of the Star Race. Therefore, Senior Panda still planned to let Eleven challenge the Sun God General with the formal special competition system of “Young Lion Challenge”.
And if he wanted to complete all of this, he needed the Iron-eating Beast Race to reach the top 10,000 of all races first.
“Senior Emperor Wu, I have something to ask of you…”
“Senior Space Emperor, I have something to ask of you…”
Lin Xiuzhu called these seniors who had cultivated the iron-eating beasts one by one and asked them to invest resources in the iron-eating beasts at all costs in the next month, letting them wholeheartedly work hard on the ranking of all races.
After learning that it was related to Shi Yu, these people naturally agreed readily, but it was hard on these Iron-eating Beasts.
“You go too.” Senior Panda also summoned her Iron-eating Beast and let it work hard on the ranking.
It had to be said that when the battle power of Blue Planet’s group was fully released, and all the resources of Blue Planet were invested in the Iron-eating Beasts, the advancement speed of the Iron-eating Beasts’ ranking was simply fast.
In just a week, the Iron-eating Beast race worked hard to reach 9,978th place and stepped into the top 10,000. It was all thanks to Lin Xiuzhu and Emperor Wu’s two perfect divine-level Iron-eating Beasts.
This change immediately caused a heated discussion on the entire World King Planet.
In the Green Dragon Race, which was ranked 9000+, the Star Refining Race, which was ranked 200+, and even the Cosmic Crow Race, which was ranked 30… There was also the Ice Kirin Race, which was ranked below a million…
Countless large clans with deep connections to the Iron-eating Beasts were rather emotional about the changes in the Iron-eating Beast race when it entered the top 10,000.
In the Cosmic Crow Race, Zavay looked at the news of the Iron-eating Beast ranking entering the top 10,000 and thought to himself, “And this is even before that guy attacked.”
“I wonder how strong it has become now. It must have already become super divine.”
In the battle for the source of transcendence, Eleven blew up countless epoch gods with a punch and shocked the starry sky. With Eleven’s Iron-eating Beast Race, entering the top 10,000 was originally not a big deal, but in reality, this battle result that entered 10,000 was completely not worth Eleven’s contribution.
They were all fought by the Iron-eating Beast Race that surged out from other places. Therefore, this was the source of many large races’ emotions. If that Eleven participated in the ranking battle of all races again, who knew how high the Iron-eating Beast Race could be pulled to? The top 1,000? The top 500?
It had to be said that whatever people were looking forward to arrived instantly. Just as the Iron-eating Beast Race squeezed into the top 10,000, a video announcement shocked World King Planet and even the Cosmic Sea.
In the video, it was a woman with long hair, a voluptuous figure, and a panda suit. She was very beautiful, and people weren’t unfamiliar with her. It was Lin Xiuzhu, who was known by many people on the World King Planet as the “Iron-eating Beast Goddess”. Be it in the God Sealing Battle or the ranking battle of all races, Senior Panda Lin Xiuzhu’s Iron-eating Beast had displayed outstanding results.
Now, the powerful Beast Tamer Lin Xiuzhu, who came from the Blue Planet and had already stepped into the peak of the divine level, was quite popular on World King Planet.
“Hello, everyone. I’m the president of the Myriad Races Committee of the Dong Huang Realm, Lin Xiuzhu.”
“Next, I’ll announce a piece of news for everyone. A day ago, the Iron-eating Beast race has successfully entered the top 10,000 of the cosmic races and is ranked 9978.” Senior Panda smiled and said,
“After entering the first 10,000, the Iron-eating Beast Race applied for the ‘Young Lion Battle’ and will challenge a certain large race. Now, the battle list has been confirmed. Both parties will have a direct duel in 18 days.”
“And the two parties have already been confirmed. They are the Iron-eating Beast Race, Eleven, and the Star Race, Sun God General Fasol!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1857: Heavenly Emperor Scripture and Chaos Panda (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1857: Heavenly Emperor Scripture and Chaos Panda (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“The strongest super divine Shi Yu’s initial pet, the King of the Iron-eating Beast Race, will fight the strongest individual of the strongest race, the King of the Sun!”
After Lin Xiuzhu finished speaking, the entire World King Planet was undoubtedly stunned and couldn’t even react.
“What, what?” Even the headquarters of the Myriad Race Committee was in turmoil. Lin Xiuzhu had never heard of this matter. She directly passed the Myriad Race Committee and announced. After all, even the Myriad Race Committee was qualified to decide the matter of the Star Race, let alone the battle of the Sun God General.
“Eleven and the Sun God General??”
Eleven of the Iron-eating Beast Race finally appeared again. Everyone was very surprised. It wasn’t strange for it to represent the Iron-eating Beast Race in the cub battle. However, the challenge target was the Sun God General who could also rank in the top five of the super divine peak. It really stunned everyone.
After all, in the ranking battle of all races, one couldn’t borrow the power of a Beast Tamer. Eleven already thought that, or perhaps Shi Yu already thought that it had the ability to challenge the Sun God General?
After everyone was stunned, they went completely crazy. This shocking news instantly swept through the Cosmic Sea.
Shi Yu’s initial pet, known as the strongest super divine, fought the strongest individual Sun God General of the strongest race, the Star Race, alone without the strengthening of the Beast Tamer. It was difficult not to be paid attention to such a explosive battle.
“I bet the Sun God General will win!! Although Shi Yu is a monster that only appears once in a billion years, it refers to their entire group. It’s still impossible for one pet to resist the Sun God General who has lived for billions of years, right?”
“Is there a need to bet? The Sun God will definitely win. It can mobilize the power of the stars in the entire Cosmic Sea…”
“Not necessarily. Has Shi Yu and the others not created enough miracles? However, it’s still a little ridiculous. As long as Shi Yu and Eleven challenge the Sun God General together, I’ve already suppressed them. However, I still feel that it’s a little lacking to challenge the strongest star with just a new race’s Iron-eating Beast. It’s probably really just a challenge.”
“A king of a new race challenging the strongest individual of the strongest race overall. Look at the difference. Even if he loses, no one will feel anything. After all, one is less than ten years old, and the other has already lived for billions of years.”
The entire World King Planet was in a heated discussion. Senior Panda looked at the rising popularity and was very satisfied.
This competition would definitely be paid attention to by the entire Cosmic Sea. Even the experts from the other cosmic territories would pay attention. If Eleven won, the Iron-eating Beast race would really be famous in the universe.
Lin Xiuzhu really didn’t expect that her and Shi Yu’s combination of advertising for the Iron-eating Beast could reach the universe.
“Shi Yu, how’s your preparation?” Lin Xiuzhu looked in Blue Planet’s direction.
At the same time.
Blue Planet…
Shi Yu and the others had just completed the fusion of new skills.
[Fusion successful]
[Yin Yang Millstone, Light and Darkness Control, One Thought of God and Demon] had already fused into [Yin Yang Control].
Skill: Yin Yang Control
< Introduction > Everything has Yin and Yang. It can’t be ruptured and is interdependent. Everything contains the characteristics of Yin and Yang. Yin and Yang Control can split Yin and Yang, reverse Yin and Yang, and obliterate everything. It can also adjust Yin and Yang and nurture and create everything…
At this moment, the black and white color on Eleven’s body was originally purely black and white, but now, every color contained endless profundities. The strange law was the power of Yin Yang.
Another divine skill that wasn’t inferior to the Chaos Divine Body was born. As Eleven learned Yin Yang Control, its Chaos Divine Body, Yin Yang Control, and even the Eight Trigrams Clone seemed to have undergone a strange change. Both parties resonated and evolved.
As the saying went, chaos gave birth to endless, endless gave birth to Taiji, Taiji gave birth to two elements, two elements gave birth to four symbols, and the four symbols gave birth to eight trigrams…
Chaos was the Chaos Divine Body, Yin and Yang Control, and Eight Trigrams was the Eight Trigrams Clone…
These three concepts kept circulating in Eleven’s body, shocking Shi Yu. Eleven, who had just broken through not long ago, broke through again and reached the eighth level.
“Damn it, although Yin Yang Control has reached the top of the divine skill and is even close to the combination of the Star Sea Contract and the origin fluctuations, it’s actually still a little inferior to a super divine skill.”
“However, this increase is already very terrifying. Most importantly, it actually established a connection with skills like the Chaos Divine Body and the Eight Trigrams Clone…”
“Wuu!!!” At this moment, Eleven had yet to realize the key to the problem. While it was still immersed in the joy of breaking through, Shi Yu’s gaze was already constantly circling around him, Buggy, Chi Tong, Shorty, Turtle, and the Little Quas!
“I might be able to do this.”
Shi Yu thought to himself that the current Eleven had mastered the power of chaos, Yin Yang, and eight trigrams.
As for the other pets, Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others had mastered the power of the four symbols.
As for himself, he had mastered the Taiji Domain.
Perhaps he could think of a way to help Eleven integrate these powers. At that time, he might be able to nurture a true chaotic body.
As long as he mastered this ultimate physique, he might be able to challenge even the cosmic overlord, Cypos, and the Sun God General was nothing.
After all, the ultimate concept of chaos came from before the “universe” was born. If Eleven could master the complete chaotic body, it would definitely be one of the best clueless in the universe.
“I originally wanted to create the Green Dragon Domain into materials for Buggy to eat. From the looks of it, I have to reference the Green Dragon Domain and the power of Chi Tong and the others to self-study the Vermillion Bird Domain, the Black Tortoise Domain, and the White Tiger Domain. Then, with the Taiji Domain, I’ll create five special metals for Eleven to eat and create the evolution process of chaos. In this way, can Eleven enter the cosmic level?”
“It feels like I’m serving Eleven by nurturing the Four Saints myself.”
The more Shi Yu thought about it, the more excited he became. He felt that this cultivation idea was alright. This was a complete Chaos Panda. He drooled, making the surrounding pets shiver.
“Sob.” Eleven also took a step back and looked at Shi Yu. It knew that it was very strong now. Shi Yu felt a sense of accomplishment, but they were already old partners. It couldn’t be so reserved, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 1858: The Prediction Dream of a Cosmic Overlord (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1858: The Prediction Dream of a Cosmic Overlord (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Chaos Divine Body, Yin Yang Control…
It was far from Eleven’s limit. Putting aside the Chaos Path Shi Yu had conceptualized, just the two skills, Star Refinement and Weapon Control, could strengthen Eleven again.
“Hu…”
After completing the fusion of Yin Yang Control, the entire team went limp. Shi Yu lay on the ground and said, “There’s still time. Ling, it should be enough to bring Eleven to find a black hole and a white hole to refine, right?”
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven was eager to try.
Ling said as it charged, “If it were before, it might have been a little difficult, but now that Eleven has learned the Chaos Divine Body and Yin Yang Control, refining the Black and White Cave and cooperating with the Star Refinement should be a piece of cake for it.”
“That’s good.” Shi Yu grinned.
If Eleven could refine the black hole and white hole, it would be completely stable.
Black holes and white holes were the two strongest cosmic disasters.
The Star Race was powerful, right? But even these forms had to avoid black holes when they saw them.
Perhaps only a peak star like the Sun God General could ignore black holes, but only some weaker black holes.
In the universe, only the Cosmic Behemoth Race had no need to be afraid of black holes.
Among them, the Dark Universe Behemoth Race could also use weaker black holes as food. They were also the only race that could naturally master the power of black holes.
It couldn’t be helped. Although the Star Race was the strongest race in the Cosmic Sea, it was still a little inferior to the cosmic behemoth, the Space Worm, and the polluted race.
The Cosmic Sea formed by the World King Planet+all races in the starry sky (including the Star Race) = Behemoth Empire = Contaminated Land = Worm Mother Nest. And the Behemoth Empire was a paradise for cosmic beasts. It was natural for cosmic beasts to be strong.
In the entire universe, the Star Race was definitely not the strongest race.
However, even the Cosmic Behemoth Race couldn’t master the two cosmic disasters of opposite properties at the same time.
Perhaps cosmic-levels could, but at their level, there was no need to use this as a sure-kill skill.
And now, what Shi Yu wanted Eleven to do was to refine the black hole and the white hole at the same time.
Even the ancestor of the Star Refining Race didn’t dare to imagine this. They could at most refine stars, but Eleven was different. Apart from Star Refining, it had other skills.
Just as Ling had said, Eleven now had the Chaos Divine Body and was naturally immune to the power of the black hole and the white hole. At the same time, it had the control of Yin and Yang and could adjust Yin and Yang and their Balance, so it was easier to control.
Shi Yu didn’t want Eleven to control them because he liked their destructive power. It was purely because black holes and white holes contained the nature of space and time.
Now, most races had moves to simulate black holes, but they were mainly dark-element. If they were stronger, they would only have multiple spatial-element stats. However, in fact, the main stats of the black hole were space and time, including the white hole. As long as he mastered these two celestial arms, Eleven’s control over the power of space and time would be stronger.
This was also confirmed by Qi. It had always felt that the combination of the black hole and the white hole was a little similar to the spatial travel it mastered, but it wasn’t as stable as its skill.
If he mastered it, Eleven could also be more helpful when it broke through to the cosmic level.
At this moment, he would let Eleven test the water first. If the difficulty wasn’t high, the Effect was alright. He could also let other pets try to refine it. If the difficulty was too high for other pets, he could only let them refine other high-level stars.
Buggy and the others didn’t know, but Qi and Bu Lu could probably succeed. It was purely a racial advantage.
The Dark King and the Beastmaster were indeed eyeing the Cosmic Sea covetously.
The Dark King coveted the territory of the Cosmic Sea and wanted to pollute it into its own territory to complete its evolution. As for the Beastmaster, it coveted the complete World King and wanted to completely devour the World King to complete its evolution.
As long as they successfully obtained what they wanted, they could reach the second level of the cosmic level and have strength comparable to the cosmic overlord, Cypos.
Now was the best time. Firstly, the World King consumed a lot of strength to help Shi Yu transmigrate. Then, the Super Empress accelerated the condensation of the source of transcendence in the universe, causing the vitality of the universe to be poor. It directly gave the Dark King an opportunity to further weaken the universe and the World King.
For the next battle, the Dark King and the Beastmaster were paying attention to the situation in the Cosmic Sea at the same time.
However, what these two cosmic emperors didn’t expect was that they didn’t believe that the Cosmic Sea couldn’t sense the abnormality, but in this situation, as the number one general of the Cosmic Sea, the Sun God General actually had the time to fight Shi Yu’s pet in the ranking battle of all races?
Was there… a conspiracy?
No matter how the think tank of the Contaminated Land and the Behemoth Empire analyzed this action, they couldn’t analyze the principle.
“Shi Yu…”
On the Dark Throne in the polluted land, the Dark King rejected the existence of Shi Yu and the Empress.
It hated these two guys who had transmigrated from the last era and interfered with the progress of this era.
If it remembered correctly, there was once a bald transmigrator who made enemies with it many times.
Now, after billions of years, another transmigrator who had contracted a cleansing star spirit appeared. He was destined to be its enemy in the future. The Dark King really couldn’t be happy.
After all, if the other party wanted to enter the cosmic level, it would definitely fight it.
Most importantly, the only cosmic-level transmigrator was also on the other party’s side. This made the Dark King feel that he couldn’t let this group of transmigrators grow anymore.
At this moment, joining forces with the Beastmaster to attack the Cosmic Sea was the best choice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1859: The Prediction Dream of a Cosmic Overlord (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1859: The Prediction Dream of a Cosmic Overlord (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
The Dark King was even prepared to face the Super Empress and the World King at the same time. However, the only person they were afraid of and had yet to attack was another figure.
A cosmic overlord.
Although the cosmic overlords also didn’t get along with the Super Empress and had once sealed the Super Empress, and it was impossible for them to be on the same side as the Super Empress, after so long, the Super Empress didn’t say anything when she appeared as a cosmic overlord this time. This ambiguous attitude made the Dark King hesitate.
“Your Majesty Dark King.”
“You want us to observe the overlord territory… The cosmic overlord has finally made a move.”
“The other party’s destination should be confirmed to be… the Cosmic Sea, World King Planet!”
Boom.
As a black-robed figure appeared and reported the information, a huge aura erupted from the Dark King’s body. “I understand.”
“That guy finally made a move.”
“Then, whether the next war can be carried out depends on this guy’s attitude.”
Half a month later.
In the Cosmic Sea.
“We came back at the right time!”
On a battleship from the overlord territory, a top-notch Divine Realm black bull looked at the cosmic newspaper and said excitedly,
“The seventh cosmic throne candidate, Eleven, the number one general under Shi Yu, vs the number one general under the World King, the Sun God General.”
“Really?” Zi Jian, the captain of the special forces, was slightly shocked when he saw Zi Jian snatch the newspaper and take a look.
This guy really didn’t stop.
Ever since they separated in the overlord territory, it had actually only been a few years. The Zi Jian’s special forces had always stopped at the overlord territory to replenish their supplies.
However, too many things had happened during this period of time. They were even famous in the overlord territory.
First, Shi Yu challenged Glory Challenge to kill the Four Saints super divine. Then, Shi Yu killed hundreds of epoch gods, hundreds of super divines, and became a candidate for the seventh universe throne. This news bombardment directly stunned them.
They originally thought that Shi Yu’s battle results of passing the Glory Challenge in the 13th Heaven in the overlord territory were already heaven-defying, but they didn’t expect Shi Yu to be even more brutal after returning to the Cosmic Sea. It made them a little regretful that they didn’t come with him to watch the commotion.
However, it wasn’t too late now. Now that Examiner Jermon of the Demolishing Divine Bull was no longer afraid to go home. He was someone who had given Shi Yu an exam. Even Shi Yu had joined the overlord army. It didn’t believe that its ancestor would restrict it.
“As expected, coming back was the right choice.” After confirming that Eleven really wanted to fight the Sun God, Zi Jian swallowed his saliva and said, “Accelerate, accelerate, accelerate.”
“However, can it work? Fighting that Sun God General with just one pet…”
“It’s probably difficult, but as long as we resist, it’s enough to prove Shi Yu’s horror,” Jermon said.
They clearly didn’t think highly of Shi Yu challenging the Sun God alone.
“Captain!! Captain!!”
However, just as they finished speaking, with a boom, the entire battleship trembled. At the same time, the voice of the navigator came.
“Not good, we accidentally entered the domain of a black hole. Moreover, it’s an especially large-quality super black hole.”
The frightened voice of his subordinate sounded, stunning Captain Zi Jian, who was holding the newspaper, and the Demolishing Divine Bull beside him.
Then, Captain Zi Jian, who had tiger teeth and long purple hair, directly opened his mouth and cursed, “You f*cking trash, what are you doing? You couldn’t detect the border of an especially large black hole and directly barged in??”
At this moment, Zi Jian was numb.
Regarding the black hole disaster that existed in the starry sky, they had a domain. If they were outside the domain, they couldn’t observe the situation in the domain. Therefore, ordinary battleships couldn’t see the black hole, and when they saw the black hole, it also meant that they had entered the domain of the black hole. They could completely wait to die.
Compared to ordinary fleets, the black hole was more threatening, but for the battleships of the cosmic overlord army, they had corresponding detection methods. The navigator could also accurately predict the location of the domain and avoid such a disaster. There was no reason to directly barge into such a terrifying place.
Meeting this thing was simply much more fatal than encountering disasters like the Starry Sky Storm and Cold Silence.
The battleship of the Zijian Special Forces immediately became a mess. Countless people lay on the protective wall and looked at the dark red world outside. They felt that the battleship was being crazily attracted by the power of the black hole and gradually lost control of the battleship.
“F*ck…” The Demolishing Divine Bull was also numb. It said in a daze, “Old Master, you’re right. I shouldn’t have joined this bullsh*t overlord army. Isn’t it good to stay on World King Planet?”
Zi Jian: “?”
In the face of life and death, the bull decisively abandoned its dream.
“It’s over.” After sensing the horror of this black hole, even a celestial-level life form would be swallowed. Captain Zi Jian’s face was pale.
At this moment, the mental fortitude of the seafarer from the Zijian Special Forces was pretty good. She was still working hard to control the battleship to break free from the attraction of the black hole, but how could she do such a thing? However, as she kept shaking, a miracle… appeared.
Under her incredulous expression, the huge black hole in the black hole domain in front of her seemed to have shrunk and kept shrinking. After carefully observing through the battleship detector, she revealed an incredulous expression.
In the most dangerous center of the black hole, a black and white bear race flew, completely ignoring the super gravity of the black hole. It stretched out its arm, and in its palm was a white light ball. Soon, another black dot appeared beside the white light ball. This dot seemed to be the key to the shrinking of the black hole…

chapters.title: Chapter 1860: The Prediction Dream of a Cosmic Overlord (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1860: The Prediction Dream of a Cosmic Overlord (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Well… No…” Seeing the familiar appearance, the seafarer of the Zijian Special Forces felt that he was dreaming.
At this moment, the others also sensed that the attraction of the black hole was shrinking. Before they could react, the battleship swayed with a boom. The surroundings seemed to have changed, and the black hole domain completely disappeared. The surroundings returned to the appearance of the starry sky of the universe, an empty chaos. In its place was a black and white panda floating in the starry sky, looking at the two black and white light balls in its hand curiously.
Zi Jian and the others also discovered this panda at this moment. She looked at the black light ball in the Iron-eating Beast’s hand and opened her mouth wide. Although this light ball was only the size of a bottle cap, she instantly sensed the quality comparable to tens of billions of ordinary stars on it. She felt that this small light ball was enough to destroy everything and instantly kill hundreds of super divines.
“That’s… the black hole just now??”
“But, how is that possible?” Captain Zi Jian looked at Eleven in confusion after surviving a calamity.
“Isn’t that guy… Shi Yu’s pet, Eleven?” Examiner Jermon was lying on the protective wall and exclaimed, “That guy is holding the black hole just now??”
Just as it was exclaiming, a familiar figure suddenly appeared in the battleship and said, “What a coincidence! Why are you guys here? I was wondering which unlucky person barged in…”
Captain Zi Jian and Jermon suddenly turned around. A group of ship members looked at Shi Yu, who had appeared, and their mouths opened slightly. It was indeed this pair…
“What exactly is going on!!” Zi Jian immediately went limp.
Shi Yu looked at Zi Jian and also sensed the Cosmic Sea navigator who had already fainted. He coughed slightly and said, “It’s my fault, it’s my fault. I was helping Eleven refine the black hole, so the spatial border here is a little chaotic. It might have made your detector malfunction…”
Refine… refine the black hole?
It wasn’t that they couldn’t accept it. As long as Shi Yu said that his cosmic Behemoth was refining the black hole, everyone could accept it. However, the Iron-eating Beast was completely unrelated to the black hole no matter how they looked at it. It could also be refined? Was this scientific?
“Refining the black hole… What do you want…” The corners of Jermon’s mouth twitched. “Don’t tell me you’re preparing for battle in advance to fight the Sun God General…”
“Eh, you know too?” At this moment, in the outside world, Eleven had already eaten the refined black hole and white hole like it was eating candy. It eagerly tore open space and time and came to Shi Yu’s side.
“Wu wu wu.” After climbing onto Shi Yu’s shoulder, Eleven greeted Jermon and the others.
“Now… I suddenly wonder if the Sun God General can win,” Jermon said.
“Me too…” Zi Jian said.
Shi Yu looked at their stunned expressions and chuckled. However, at this moment, a voice sounded in Shi Yu’s heart.
It was the Super Empress.
[Shi Yu, that cosmic overlord has also come to World King Planet.]
Shi Yu: “?”
Shi Yu looked at Captain Zi Jian and the others in shock and said, “You guys aren’t the only ones this time. Even the cosmic overlord is here??”
“What?” In the face of Shi Yu’s shock, Zi Jian and the others were also very stunned. They didn’t know what he meant.
World King Planet.
In order to pay attention to this special battle, many factions in the Cosmic Sea gathered.
However, as a special super battleship appeared outside the World King Planet, all the experts who saw this battleship fell silent.
Countless super divine experts looked at this black battleship with the symbol of the demon ox’s head in shock and gulped.
Some juniors were still puzzled, not understanding why everyone’s reaction to the battleship of this cosmic overlord army was so violent, but soon, an elder covered their mouths and slapped them.
“Look carefully, that symbol, the color of that battleship, the appearance of that battleship. This is… This is the exclusive battleship of a cosmic overlord. Impossible, impossible. Why would a cosmic overlord personally descend on the World King Planet?”
Seeing this battleship, not to mention the natives of the World King Star, even the members of the cosmic overlord army stationed in the Cosmic Sea, such as the super divine of the 177th Army, were shocked and afraid. They didn’t know why the cosmic overlord would personally come to the Cosmic Sea.
At this moment, the Sun God General, the World Divine Dragon, the Observer, Lu Ming, Goddess Wa, Blue Planet, Emperor Shi, and the other experts looked in the direction of the battleship solemnly.
Generally speaking… cosmic-levels wouldn’t casually enter other cosmic-level territories…
At this moment, as one of the guardians of the World King Planet, the figure of the Sun God General was the first to appear outside this battleship and stare at it.
A moment later, a human Beast Tamer with gray pupils, long gray hair that reached his waist, a red tattoo on his face, and a half-faced antelope skull came out of the battleship.
Her appearance shocked the Cosmic Sea, because any expert with some strength could sense that this guy’s strength was definitely at the peak of the super divine level.
Apart from the four generals, there were actually other peak super divine beings in the cosmic overlord army, and they seemed to be a human!
After all, King Lie and the others wanted to nurture Shi Yu because the cosmic overlord army had not had a human super divine for a long time. The human race was gradually declining. If King Lie and the others knew that there was actually a human peak super divine Beast Tamer with unknown origins beside the cosmic overlord, they would definitely be very shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1861: The Prediction Dream of a Cosmic Overlord (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1861: The Prediction Dream of a Cosmic Overlord (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Welcome, Lord cosmic overlord.” Although he had never seen a cosmic overlord and didn’t know why he was here, at this moment, even if the Sun God General was the strongest of the star race, he couldn’t help but bend down and greet him respectfully.
“I’m the secretary of the cosmic overlord. The cosmic overlord has come to the Cosmic Sea to watch the battle between the human Beast Tamer Shi Yu and the Sun God General of the Star Race. There’s no need for special reception. Unrelated people can leave,” the secretary of the cosmic overlord said. The Sea of Stars trembled, and even the Sun God General revealed a stunned expression.
“What…” Its heart broke. It couldn’t understand why the cosmic overlord would pay attention to it. No, it was definitely not worth the attention of the cosmic overlord. In that case, in other words, the cosmic overlord was paying attention to its opponent, Eleven of the Iron-eating Beast Race?
It didn’t understand. Even the cosmic overlords didn’t care about such a grand matter like the previous source of transcendence battle. Cosmic-levels didn’t care either. However, why did they come personally for a small Race Ranking Battle now?
After all, even it didn’t pay attention to this battle. It was completely focused on the movements of the Contaminated Land.
The words of the cosmic overlord’s secretary shocked everyone.
However, the Sun God General didn’t dare to ask further. After confirming the other party’s goal in coming, he left on his own with thousands of thoughts.
As for the secretary of the cosmic overlord, she also returned to the battleship. However, apart from her, another figure descended into the battleship.
When the secretary of the cosmic overlord returned, Goddess Wa was already standing under the throne of the cosmic overlord, looking straight at the supreme existence above.
“Lord Cypos, are you here because of Shi Yu? Or because…”
“Oh, it’s you. Long time no see…” A lazy voice came from the throne.
“It’s you.” The secretary of the cosmic overlord entered. After discovering Goddess Wa, he clearly knew her.
“I didn’t expect you to still be alive, Katney.” Goddess Wa was the most surprised by her existence. She knew this person. She was also one of the human experts cultivated by a cosmic overlord hundreds of millions of years ago. Unfortunately, not to mention a cosmic maintainer, she couldn’t even successfully reach the cosmic level.
Goddess Wa originally thought that the other party was already dead, but she didn’t expect him to still be alive.
“You’re not dead, so I naturally won’t die,” the cosmic overlord’s secretary, Katney, said.
At this moment, she also looked at Sepos. In fact, she was also very confused that Cypos was going to the Cosmic Sea personally.
“I’m indeed here for Shi Yu.” The cosmic overlord looked at Goddess Wa.
“It’s to revive that plan?” Goddess Wa said. If that was the case, Shi Yu undoubtedly had the greatest backer in the entire universe. However, she kept feeling that the arrival of a cosmic overlord might not be a good thing.
“No.” As expected, the cosmic overlord said, “I’ve long given up on that plan. Moreover, in essence, this Shi Yu isn’t a human Beast Tamer I cultivated. I’m not interested in competing with others for the so-called ‘genius’.”
“Besides, it’s with that guy.”
The cosmic overlord said, “Even if he carries that special transcendent origin and has two eras of cultivation system, I don’t think highly of him becoming the guardian of the universe.”
“But interestingly…”
“Not long ago, I had a premonition dream that I couldn’t control.”
The secretary of the cosmic overlord and Goddess Wa looked at Cypos solemnly. At the level of a cosmic overlord, what would the premonition dream he had be?
On the throne, Cypos laughed and said, “I actually dreamed that Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast and I started a protracted battle. Do you believe it??”
“What??” The secretary of the cosmic overlord said in disbelief, “With the other party’s… pet??”
“That’s right.”
“Although the dream memories are already chaotic, I didn’t remember wrongly what I should remember. I indeed started a huge battle with that Iron-eating Beast. Moreover, it fought against me without any help from the Beast Tamer.”
“Interesting. Do you think this dream will come true in the future?”
“Impossible, definitely impossible.” The secretary of the cosmic overlord seemed to have endless worship for Cypos. “Lord Cypos, how can there be a life form fighting you… Moreover, it’s fighting alone…”
If that was the case, didn’t that mean that Shi Yu’s pet alone might have the battle power of a cosmic overlord? How was this possible?
“In my opinion, the highest that Iron-eating Beast can reach in the future is to reach the Sun God General or…” She looked at Goddess Wa. Reaching this height of the peak of super divine was the limit.
“Perhaps,” the cosmic overlord said. It recalled Eleven’s eyes that were filled with Warpath when it challenged the Glory Challenge and resisted its deterrence. “However, if the Super Empress also wants to nurture a cosmic holder, then Shi Yu and I will eventually fight.”
After becoming the guardian of the universe, it would become the master of the universe. As a creature in the universe, how could the cosmic overlord allow its survival environment to have another master? It would be fine if this person was cultivated by it, but the key was that Shi Yu wasn’t its direct descendant.
However, it didn’t reject Shi Yu and the others working hard for this. It had failed to nurture the cosmic maintainer. It wanted to see if that Super Empress could successfully nurture it.
Regardless of whether the cultivation was successful or not, before Shi Yu contracted the universe, Shi Yu had to pass its level first. If he couldn’t even defeat it, let alone contract the universe, at that time, it would directly kill Shi Yu first. The bored Cypos had long changed its interest from nurturing humans to slowly cultivating and waiting for the universe to restart before finally fighting the cosmic will.
However, before this, it really hoped that Shi Yu and the others would quickly grow up and stand in front of it to satisfy itself first. However, the premise was… that Shi Yu had to pass the stage of the Dark King and the Beastmaster first. This time, after descending, it would also make its stand clear and not interfere in any cosmic disputes. It planned to be an audience and see the experts of the last era compete with the experts of this era.
“So, Lord Cypos, you want to become an ‘examiner’ for Shi Yu and the others to become the holder of the universe?” Goddess Wa asked.
“‘Examiner’? You can say that,” the cosmic overlord said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1862: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1862: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
After hearing that the cosmic overlord had descended, Shi Yu first got Ling to add a layer of luck buff to Zi Jian’s special forces to prevent them from accidentally entering the cosmic disaster again. Then, he got Buggy to bring him back to the World King Planet through the magnetic path first.
On the World King Planet, in the Dong Huang Realm, Shi Yu used Senior Panda as a coordinate teleportation again, successfully scaring Senior Panda again.
Pa.
Lin Xiuzhu patted the table, her chest trembling in anger. “You’re using me as the teleportation coordinates again, right! Don’t you know it’s very scary?”
“This isn’t more convenient, and it was originally a range teleportation. Who knew that it would randomly teleport to your side every time… Cough, cough… I can ask you about the arrangements for the ranking battle of the myriad races… Moreover, I heard that the cosmic overlord is here?” Shi Yu looked at the ceiling and looked at the starry sky through the ceiling, changing the topic.
“Well…” At the mention of the cosmic overlord, Senior Panda was stunned. She nodded and said, “The super divine lives have almost noticed. That cosmic overlord seems to have come because of your battle with the Sun God General and wants to be a spectator.”
“Is that so…” At this moment, Shi Yu, who still didn’t know Cypo’s true goal, was also a little afraid. After all, he still didn’t know this cosmic overlord’s attitude towards him and the Empress joining forces to become the holder of the universe.
Just the relationship with Goddess Wa might not necessarily be strong. After all, Goddess Wa could only be equivalent to a worker.
Although it was said to be a spectator this time, what was there to see in a battle at the peak of the super divine level for a universe supreme master? He most likely had other goals.
As Shi Yu and Senior Panda were talking, a figure descended right on the heels of the heels into the office of the Myriad Races Committee. In the hazy phantom, Goddess Wa walked out.
“Are you back?” Goddess Wa said to Shi Yu, “I’ve already gone to ask about the cosmic overlord.”
“There’s no need to worry. It shouldn’t have any ill intentions this time. Don’t worry and prepare for your own competition… Although I don’t know why you want to carry out this competition.”
“Is that so??” Shi Yu scratched his head with a smile and said, “That’s good. In that case, I won’t visit the cosmic overlord.”
“The Sun God General isn’t weak. Even if it’s inferior to me, it’s still one of the strongest among the super divine levels. If you go with victory in your heart, tell your Iron-eating Beast to be careful.”
“I know, there’s no need to worry,” Shi Yu said.
After Goddess Wa left, Senior Panda walked over and patted Shi Yu’s pocket. “Huh?? Where’s Eleven? Is he around?”
“Ji.” In the pocket, Buggy popped its head out and curled its lips. Tsk, it only knew Eleven. Why didn’t it greet Buggy?
“Eleven just finished training. I retracted the Beast Taming Space and let it sleep and rest,” Shi Yu said.
Although it wasn’t difficult for Eleven to continuously refine the white hole and black hole, because Shi Yu and the others had chosen the more powerful white hole black hole, Eleven had consumed a lot of energy. There was only a little time left. He had to let Baby Ginseng support it with all its might to accelerate and rest.
“It’s good that you’re sufficiently prepared. All the best. The price of Blue Planet’s Iron-eating Beasts has even reached one Level 11 energy crystal each… Countless super divine factions can’t get it.”
“What?” Shi Yu was stunned. A super divine resource and an Iron-eating Beast?
So expensive?
However, for some super divine clans, a super divine resource was indeed nothing. In comparison, Iron-eating Beasts were relatively rare, exclusive to Blue Planet.
“If you win this time, it’ll probably increase!” The panda senior rubbed her palms and said, “Of course, I didn’t sell any of them. It’s mainly because you’re the only powerful Iron-eating Beast. I’m afraid that others won’t be able to nurture them well after buying them and torture them in the end.”
“The buyer show is different from the seller show. It’s easy to get bad reviews.”
Shi Yu said, “Well… It’s a problem. It’s better to let them grow on their own. Unless it’s someone like the Astrologer Race and the Environmental Protection Association who’s closer to Blue Planet… Otherwise, it’s best if the Iron-eating Beasts are exclusive to Blue Planet.”
The Demon God Iron-eating Beast ate the Yun Race to become stronger and evolve, so the Environmental Protection Association also took a fancy to the Iron-eating Beast. When they came to the World King Planet, the Iron-eating Beast’s employment range was wide.
Shi Yu chatted with Senior Panda right on the heels of that before returning to his residence to rest and wait for the ranking battle to begin.
This time, the ranking battle of all races was still carried out in the alternate space of the second world. For this battle, Eleven and the Sun God stopped all the competitions in the second world for half a month.
At the same time, he prepared hundreds of super divine level cosmic crystals as backup energy. Just in case, it was to accumulate energy for this battle and prevent the two of them from destroying the second world and the surrounding star areas.
The arrival of the cosmic overlord made people realize that this battle wasn’t simple. They looked forward to the process of Eleven vs the Sun God even more.
In the past two days, Shi Yu had indeed been recuperating and didn’t do much. Although he was fighting Eleven and was just a spectator, if he consumed too much energy in the past two days, Eleven in the Beast Taming Space wouldn’t be able to rest well.
It was equivalent to someone sleeping and his house being renovated…
Just like that… calm time passed. In the blink of an eye, it was the day of the battle.
Be it super divine, divine, or even demigods, as long as they knew about this battle, they were paying attention. Those with money used special devices to watch the battle, while those without money squeezed to the venue of the Myriad Race Ranking Battle to watch the low-level live broadcast. There was nothing… They could only wait for the results at home silently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1863: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1863: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Bet, bet!!”
At this moment, Dong Huang and the others had also gathered and came to Lin Xiuzhu’s Myriad Race Committee. They actually started a bet in private. Lin Feng said, “I’ll bet that in one to two hours, the winner will be decided. Eleven wins and bet two super divine resources!”
“Two to three hours, Eleven wins, two super divine resources,” the Space Emperor followed.
Emperor Wu, the Empress, the Dragon Emperor, Lu Qingyi, the gem cat, the owl, and the others were all here. If outsiders learned of the situation here, their faces would definitely be speechless.
This was because this batch of people were all betting on Shi Yu to win. The specific content of the bet was actually how long Eleven could win. Whoever guessed the closest would take all the bets of others.
“It’s rare for me to rest for a day… And it’s playing so big. I’ll bet 30 minutes.” The gem cat looked at the Prediction Owl and kept wishing that Eleven would end the battle at this time.
In the end, only the Prediction Owl didn’t bet. The witch chuckled and said, “Eleven wins in ten minutes. You guys bet with my Astrologer Race. Don’t care about your life.”
Everyone: “?”
“In ten minutes?” The panda senior said, “Teacher Tuna, are you serious? Did you divine this??”
“The secrets of heaven can’t be leaked,” the Prediction Owl snorted.
“Tsk.” The gem cat didn’t believe that its power at the peak of the super divine level couldn’t compare to a quack owl that had just entered the super divine level.
Soon, Emperor Wu’s voice sounded. He said with a serious expression, “It’s about to begin…”
Apart from him, his Iron-eating Beast also watched the battle with him, wanting to see how its battle power would perform without the enhancement of a Beast Tamer.
Time quickly arrived at the competition time. In order to not take up too much space, the lowest threshold to watch the battle was restricted to demigods. In an instant, from peak super divine experts like Lu Ming, the World Divine Dragon, and the Observer, to the core of the World King lineage like Bing Ling, to Zavay, Ming Gu, and Fanba of the Star Smelting Race, the Green Dragon, the son of the Demon Emperor, and the younger generation who had been involved with Eleven and Shi Yu, they surged into the battle room and looked at the venue from an omniscient perspective.
The venue… was the starry sky venue.
In the starry sky, a huge sun hung there.
A moment later, a humanoid figure walked out of the sun. It was a pure Elemental figure covered in white and red flames. It had the appearance of a human, but it was all made of fire. It was the core incarnation of the Sun God General. The most obvious thing about this core incarnation was the five Sun Eye in its eyes, which was mighty.
Buzz.
In the next moment, another figure spread out on a meteorite floating in the starry sky.
After the Panda King, Eleven, with black and white hair, appeared on the meteorite, the audience was instantly shocked. This was because the moment it descended, Eleven’s Warpath erupted. There were actually nine spinning Radiant Suns hanging behind it. Although there were only nine, the dazzling level wasn’t inferior to the ten Radiant Suns that appeared behind the Sun God General!!
“How is this possible? How long has it been? It actually reached Transcendent 9!”
Seeing Eleven’s level, the strongest human Beast Tamer in the Cosmic Sea, Lu Ming, who had given Shi Yu face not long ago and didn’t argue with the gem cat, was slightly stunned.
After all, it had only been less than five years since Shi Yu obtained the transcendent origin. If Shi Yu himself could reach this level, he would accept it considering the power of the transcendent origin, but if it was his pet…
“Is that transcendent origin so powerful?” Lu Ming was silent. After all, even if he was at super divine level 10, his strongest pet was only at super divine level 9. This was even the result of millions of years of hard work and no sleep time. This Shi Yu actually caught up in such a short period of time. He just didn’t know how Shi Yu’s other pets were compared to this Eleven’s specific battle power.
Logically speaking… the battle power of a level that was forcefully raised in such a short period of time definitely couldn’t match the level. Just like the previous Star Prayer Gem Cat, it had a realm, but its battle power could only be said to be the disgrace of a peak super divine.
“Transcendent 9? So fast? It should have mainly distributed that power that transcends the origin to itself and this Iron-eating Beast.” At the same time, in the cosmic overlord’s battleship, the cosmic overlord didn’t use the official spectator device of the World King Planet. It used some unknown method to make a dimensional screen directly appear in midair. Looking at this screen, his secretary, Katney, seemed to be immersed in it as if she was watching the battle on the spot and analyzing at the same time.
Katney’s strength was definitely not inferior to Lu Ming, but at this moment, these two peak super divine Beast Tamers couldn’t tell that Eleven was extraordinary. Only the cosmic overlord narrowed its eyes slightly and revealed a surprised expression.
“Interesting. He actually reached this realm?” he suddenly said, making Katney confused.
Because she knew that what could surprise the cosmic overlord was definitely not a ‘realm’ that exceeded transcendent 9, but something else.
What exactly was it… She looked at the Iron-eating Beast carefully again, wanting to see what was so special about Shi Yu’s pet and why the cosmic overlord cared so much.
“Transcendent 9…” At this moment, Eleven’s level undoubtedly made many people numb. After all, a few years ago, this guy was only an epoch god. Two years later, he was only at the quasi-divine level…
In less than ten years, it had gone from quasi divine to super divine Level 9. This growth speed was simply ridiculous. Its master was a monster, and the pet was also a monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 1864: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1864: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
No wonder Shi Yu dared to let Eleven challenge the Sun God General. Although the difference between super divine 9 and the peak of super divine was said to be very big, in terms of numbers, the difference was already very small. Apart from those who had really reached the super divine level, many divine-levels suddenly felt that they could completely fight with such a small difference.
“It’s not that simple. Every time a super divine transcends, the difference is huge. The difference between the low-level, mid-level, and high-level super divines is even greater.
