To talk about which realm the difference is the greatest, it’s still between transcendent 9 and 10!” But soon, an old expert expressed his opinion.
Of course, soon, a young man retorted, “These guys are still at the epoch god level and killed a peak super divine. There have been eleven heavenly miracles since ancient times. Can you not use ‘common knowledge’ and ‘old EXP’ to analyze it?”
“Unreasonable!! That’s under the circumstances where quantitative changes cause qualitative changes and there’s the enhancement of a Beast Tamer. It’s a one-on-one battle now!!” Although Shi Yu’s battle results were extremely glorious, there were still some old antiques who had a deeper understanding of the power of the Sun God General. They couldn’t believe that a rising star could hunt a majestic sun lion as a cub.
“The divine general will definitely win.” More than ten super divine stellar life forms also paid attention to this battle.
As many spectators were discussing, the Sun God General and Eleven were still colliding with the super divine aura. At this moment, the one who was the most shocked by Eleven’s state was none other than the Sun God General’s main body.
“He actually…”
This star shadow’s aura was fully released. The scorching deterrence had already melted many meteorites, leaving only a sun in the entire starry sky arena.
The light of the sun seemed to illuminate the entire universe. The huge aura made many divine-level and demigods feel a terrifying heat just by watching the battle through machines. It was difficult to continue watching the battle. Those with weak willpower even retreated directly with sweat all over their faces.
However, in this situation, only the meteorite under Eleven’s feet was still intact. Its body seemed to be wrapped in a layer of extremely heat resistant metal, or its overall nature had been changed. Eleven stood on it calmly and similarly erupted with an aura. The lightning-like aura collided with the fiery aura. The two parties were actually evenly matched.
“Roar!!!” Eleven roared in the galaxy. It wasn’t afraid of the Sun God General at all. Instead, its gaze passed the Sun God General and saw another pair of eyes outside this fake sky.
A cosmic overlord… was watching the battle?
“Huh? No matter what, since I’ve agreed to this battle, I’ll do my best.”
“Do your best too.”
Although Eleven had displayed extremely strong strength and wasn’t at a disadvantage in terms of aura, making the Sun God General look at it in a different light, it still didn’t think that it would lose.
“Wuu.” Eleven shook its head.
“Sob. (Senior, it’s better if you attack first. Otherwise, I’m afraid you won’t have a chance to attack.)”
Eleven said politely.
But he didn’t have much manners.
Everyone: “?”
As Eleven finished speaking, ridiculous national essences from various places sounded.
“Huh?” The light on many stellar life forms flickered violently a few times, as if they were saying, “Is this little bear crazy?”
“Holy shit.” Even Lin Feng couldn’t help but say, “As expected, pets like Beast Tamers. They’re too arrogant, too arrogant.”
However, everyone also knew that without this faith, Shi Yu and the others might not necessarily challenge randomly.
“Hahahahahaha.” At this moment, in everyone’s hearts, the calm Sun God General couldn’t help but laugh. It felt that it was ridiculous. After living for hundreds of millions of years, this was the first time it had encountered such a situation.
“In that case, let me see how strong you are if you want to obtain the title of the number one race in the universe.”
The expression of the Sun God General froze. It raised one hand high. In the next moment, the ten sources of transcendence hanging behind it divided into a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand, and 100,000 suns that were filled with a terrifying destructive aura.
This move was terrifying because every sun contained many laws such as Indestructibility, Fire, Destruction, and Destruction. There were several top-notch laws, and all of them perfectly fused into a sun fireball.
It could be said that each of these 100,000 small suns could easily destroy several galaxies. In the God Sealing Battle, those demigods could become absolute dark horses if they took out a prototype of a top-notch law. And now, the Sun God had perfectly fused several top-notch laws into a destructive killer move. Even many super divine beings didn’t even dare to imagine it. How many years of bitter cultivation would it take to accumulate this power?
“Damn.” The gem cat looked at the battle and felt that its super peak was several levels inferior to the other party. Fortunately, her functionality was strong!!
“Eleven, beat it up!”
Eleven’s provocation undoubtedly succeeded. They didn’t know if this move was the killer move of the Sun God General, but it definitely shocked countless people. Millions of small suns descended, like the end of the universe. Many people felt that the havoc of the universe was nothing more than this…
Even Goddess Wa, Karnet, and the others took this move seriously and felt that it had to take some effort to defend. However, in the next moment, what made Lu Ming, the Observer, and the others suddenly silent was that in the face of a million stars falling, Eleven was actually still standing on the meteorite and looking at the other party’s attack calmly… No… No action!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1865: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1865: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“What a joke.” At this moment, the Space Emperor and the others were stunned. However, when the attacks completely descended continuously and completely swallowed Eleven, they were stunned.
Under the light and heat that filled the entire starry sky arena, under the endless terrifying violent explosion, when the afterglow of the setting sun dissipated, the attack of the Sun God General was like a scratch. Eleven actually stood on the meteorite unscathed, instantly making all the spectators shut up.
Chaotic ripples lingered around its body, making it look like a god of the universe. It wasn’t afraid of any attack.
If it weren’t for the fact that they could almost feel the horror of the attack immersed in the battle, many super divine lives would have suspected that the Sun God was fighting a fake competition.
“This is…” At that moment, the one who felt the most ridiculous was still the Sun God General. Seeing that its attack actually didn’t even burn a single bear hair of the other party, it couldn’t help but be shocked. After living for so long, even when Shi Yu killed a peak super divine above his level, it wasn’t this shocked.
“Sob. (Senior, use your unique skill. Stop testing.)” Eleven sensed the strengthening of its physique and continued.
Chaos Divine Body!
It was immune to all law attacks and converted its absorption into its own physique!
Eleven finally knew how to use tactics. It planned to let the other party consume itself first. At the same time, it would strengthen itself before attacking.
If they fought directly, it might not necessarily be able to quickly finish the Sun God General.
At this moment, seeing that this ridiculous Iron-eating Beast actually ignored the attack of the Sun God General, many experts, such as the Bing Ling God, began to be stunned, wondering if they were dreaming…
“The Sun God must have shown mercy…” Some old antiques couldn’t believe it and planned to see the second attack of the Sun God General. At this moment, the Sun God General was solemn to the extreme, not daring to underestimate this panda at all.
The Chaos Divine Body was mysterious and unfathomable. Apart from the cosmic level, opponents of the same level couldn’t see the mystery of this move at all.
Such poor information was enough to overload the Sun God’s brain, but even if it knew Eleven’s physique, it was most likely helpless. This was because planetary life forms were the race that relied on the laws of the universe the most. It could be said that Eleven was even better at resisting stars than the cosmic behemoth now.
“I admit that you’re powerful.”
“But…”
The Sun God General still planned to continue attacking, but this time, it no longer used the scattered and casually condensed attack just now. Instead, it took a deep breath. At this moment, all the power of the primitive star in the star arena seemed to have been extinguished and absorbed into its body.
Not only that, but near the World King Planet, countless stars that didn’t nurture life consciousness also suddenly lit up at this moment, revealing a vast light. It completely illuminated every area of the World King Planet, making people reveal shocked expressions. They knew that the Sun God was starting to fight for real.
At this moment, the Sun God directly evolved towards its main body and directly turned into a sun, turning into a gradually expanding super huge fireball that devoured Eleven!!
The sun had always been a symbol of warmth, but when it came into contact with them at a close distance and was really devoured by the star, they would become the most terrifying existence. At this moment, the Sun God devouring its main body also meant that it completely regarded Eleven as a troublesome target.
Wrapping Eleven in its body was also its strongest attack method.
However, to everyone’s surprise, even if the Sun God displayed absolute attack faith this time, Eleven still didn’t move and let this terrifying guy devour it.
Just like that… a second… a second passed…
The Sun God General had already completely swallowed Eleven and was swallowed by the strongest star. How could the fire cosmic behemoth feel any joy? The death law fluctuations and the nirvanic law fluctuations couldn’t be resisted by the devouring fire alone.
However… at this point in the battle, the most incomprehensible scene still appeared. Even so, although the meteorite under Eleven’s feet finally turned to ashes, Eleven, this tiny Iron-eating Beast, seemed to be swimming in the Sun Sea. There were no traces of its defense breaking through at all.
It was unscathed after being swallowed by such a terrifying sun!
Eleven didn’t break through its defense at all, but the Sun God General did.
“Impossible.” After wrapping Eleven in its body and sensing that Eleven didn’t react at all to its violent law attack, its mentality, which had been tempered for billions of years, almost collapsed. Even if it attacked the World King Planet, it was impossible for the World King Planet to be unscathed.
What exactly was going on?
In the cosmic overlord battleship, the secretary of the cosmic overlord was also extremely incredulous. Only the cosmic overlord was rarely interested. “I’ve heard that in the ancient era, in order to escape the restraints of the universe and trace the origin of the universe, an expert opened up the Great Dao of Chaos and wanted to transcend all the laws of the universe. I didn’t expect that someone could really cultivate it successfully. No, although it’s not perfect, it has already taken shape.”
“Chaos? How can such a skill exist…” Katney said.
“Of course it can’t exist. It’s impossible for any life form to cultivate chaos and transcend the laws of the universe, so they’re only prototypes, but they’re only prototypes. It’s enough to defeat that Sun God General.”
“Shi Yu inherited all the essence of the top-notch cultivation system of the last era. It should be the strongest fire seed chosen in the last era.” The cosmic overlord looked forward to the battle with Eleven after it grew up more and more.

chapters.title: Chapter 1866: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1866: Pets Are Even More Ridiculous Than Master (5)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
At this moment, Eleven ignored the Sun God General’s attack and shocked the Sea of Stars. No one expected that this would be the situation after the battle.
“I don’t believe it!!” At this moment, no one suspected that the Sun God was fighting a fake competition, because at this moment, most of the stars in the entire Universe Sea flickered. Just like how it crossed countless star areas to kill the Four Saints super divines, it triggered the miracle of the Sea of Stars, making some lives on ordinary planets look up at the sky, not understanding what had happened.
However, no matter how hard the Sun God tried, it couldn’t cross the difference in class. Eleven, who had evolved the power of laws in the universe, had already risen steadily. Of course, due to the existence of the Chaotic Body, outsiders couldn’t see its state clearly at all. Its current physique had long exceeded the peak of the super divine level and could already be described as quasi-cosmic.
Perhaps its hard strength had already exceeded the level of Goddess Wa and temporarily reached the level of the Super Empress before fusing with Lily.
However, one cultivated spirit, and the other cultivated physique.
It was still a little difficult to defeat the Sun God General in front of him with just his physique… But Eleven didn’t just have the Chaotic Body.
After being strengthened by the enemy, Eleven took a deep breath in the Sun Sea and slowly stretched out its arms.
Yin Yang Reversal!!!
Its physical body was Yang, and the nomological energy was illusory. Eleven directly converted its powerful physique into the power of laws in the universe!!
“Sob. (It’s my turn to counterattack.)”
Although he was very sorry to use the Sun God as a stepping stone, for the glory of the Iron-eating Beast race, in a fair competition… Eleven still charged!!
Boom!!
Under everyone’s stunned expressions, a real small black hole appeared in one of Eleven’s palms in the strongest star. A real small white hole appeared in the other palm. The terrifying fluctuations of both parties directly made the heart of the Sun God General tremble, and also made the hearts of all the spectators tremble.
Because after the transformation of Yin and Yang, the Star Refining Arms, the weapon that controlled multiple strengthening black holes and white hole Arms, could already be said to be a cosmic treasure-level astral divine weapon. The kind that was enough to reach 1% of the power of the cosmic level. It was extremely terrifying.
“What a joke…” At this moment, the Sun God was completely stunned. He suddenly understood what the worry that vaguely appeared in his heart a month ago was. That wasn’t the attack of the Contaminated Land, but this ranking battle of all races!!
The Sun God General never expected that he was actually not heavily injured on the battlefield, but… in a baffling “child competition” that he had agreed to…
Bang!
Eleven patted the black and white holes in its palms. The process of them approaching each other was like the creation of the universe and the destruction of the universe. Space and time seemed to have undergone a restart, and everything seemed to have returned to nothingness and chaos.
Under the dazzling light, the second world directly collapsed. Outside the World King Planet, a broken sun figure floated in the endless starry sky like a flame flickering in the Gust…
“Aba, Aba, Aba, Aba, Aba…” At this moment, everyone was stunned.
A group of sneaky people, who were watching this battle with the help of their cosmic emperors in the Contaminated Land and the Behemoth Empire, were also stunned.
Damn, what was going on? Was this that extremely domineering Sun God General??
And that black and white bear… was it really just a human pet that had never been enhanced by a Beast Tamer??
Shi Yu’s ferocious reputation was already terrifying, but that was established when he enhanced his pet and everyone fought together.
At this moment, looking at Shi Yu’s single pet that had shattered the Sun God General, who was considered a big boss at the top of the super divine level alone, many foreign super divines’ bodies trembled a little.
Why did it feel that this pet was even more ridiculous than its master? It was already so strong alone. If there was still the enhancement of a Beast Tamer, how heaven-defying would it be?
“This is… the strength of a reserve throne in the seventh universe?”
At that moment, the Dark King and the Beastmaster were as shocked by Eleven’s strength as the cosmic overlord. The Dark King hadn’t seen this kid improve so quickly in a few years and felt that it was ridiculous. According to what it knew, even the growth speed of the cosmic overlord back then wasn’t as fast as this Shi Yu. No, it wasn’t even half as fast as its pet.
Sensing the shaken hearts of his subordinates, the Dark King was silent. It was supposed to be a plot where both parties were injured and the enemy was investigated to increase morale. Why didn’t it follow the script now!
“F*ck.” At the same time, she knew that Eleven was very fierce, but she didn’t know that such a fierce gem cat like Eleven would silently walk to the rooftop after losing two super divine resources… It was better for her to continue working. She would bet that the dog would die a horrible death.

chapters.title: Chapter 1867: Tragic (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1867: Tragic (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
After the battle ended, many people started to doubt life.
After all, not long ago, the Sun God General was still high and mighty. He was the judge of the transcendent duel between Shi Yu and the four super divines and casually controlled the life and death of both parties.
But now, it was actually shattered by one of Shi Yu’s pets in a few minutes?
“I didn’t see wrongly… That’s… a black hole, a white hole.”
Many big shots from the disaster research institute spoke and recalled what Eleven’s killer move was just now.
Their expressions were incredulous. Could an Iron-eating Beast master black holes and white holes at the same time?
Even the cosmic behemoth couldn’t do it!
How many secrets did the Iron-eating Beast have? At this moment, they really wanted to personally nurture an Iron-eating Beast to see, no matter how difficult it was to obtain it… But for the sake of academics, everything was worth it.
However, thinking ahead, even if it was a black hole or a white hole, it was impossible to ignore the attack of the Sun God General.
“This Iron-eating Beast’s attack has already touched the threshold of the cosmic level.”
In the eyes of the observer and the others, Eleven’s counterattack after using the Chaos Divine Body to strengthen the power of the Sun God could already be called a quasi-cosmic level.
It was precisely because of this that they couldn’t understand and weren’t willing to believe why creatures could improve so quickly.
Many experts locked onto the broken body floating in the void. Their voices were dry and hoarse. They could sense that the Sun God had really fainted from the beating. It was extremely miserable. This situation was too rare.
At the level of the Sun God General, it could revive even if it was killed. However, Eleven’s attack could make the other party unable to even die. It could directly faint with its will and lose its resistance. It was obvious what unbelievable level Eleven’s power control had reached.
“So brutal. I’m willing to believe now that Shi Yu is the future seventh throne of the universe.”
“Apart from the cosmic level, he’s definitely the strongest among super divines. Even if he’s not considered a Beast Tamer, this Iron-eating Beast alone can be considered the strongest, right?”
Someone else said, “…Although it’s very inappropriate, I want to say that that Iron-eating Beast didn’t
even enter the final battle in Shi Yu’s so-called ‘team internal competition’ back then…”
Everyone:
“Impossible, the situation is definitely different now. Now, God Eleven must be Shi Yu’s trump card!” A bunch of Iron-eating Beast fanatical fans, most of them from the bear race. Countless female bears argued for Eleven. What trash ginseng baby? It couldn’t be stronger than the Iron-eating Beast.
As Eleven was too outstanding, even some zebra horses and penguins were tempted by Eleven, mainly because the skin color was similar.
Just as everyone was immersed in this strange and unbelievable short moment, the entire World King Planet emitted a hazy white light that spread into the starry sky. Like a gentle touch, it quickly restored the broken Sun God General.
The Sun God General’s body quickly recovered, and its consciousness gradually became clear.
“Lord World King…” it muttered.
Seeing this scene, Lu Ming, the World Divine Dragon, the Observer, and the other experts were slightly stunned. They suddenly fell silent.
The World King woke up!!
It was no longer a secret for the experts of the Cosmic Sea that the World King was sleeping.
But at this moment, his godson was beaten up by a bear, and the second world he created was blown up by a bear. The World King seemed to have finally woken up.
“So this is the method to awaken it?”
“Wuu.” In the sky of the Dong Huang Realm, Eleven, who had cracked open from the second world, also floated in midair and sensed that someone was watching him.
“World King? Are you awake?” Shi Yu was stunned. He walked out of the void and stood beside Eleven.
At this moment, the World King indeed woke up for a short period of time. However, if the World King had a physical body, it would definitely have a headache at this moment.
What were they doing?
The World King originally thought that when it woke up, it would see the peak of the World King Planet preparing for battle, cautiously wary of the Contaminated Land and the Behemoth Empire.
Who would have thought that as soon as he woke up, he would see his general being beaten up in his territory and the entire starry sky paying attention?
Did this group of people have any sense of urgency?
Not far from the World King Planet, on Blue Planet, the planet’s will looked at the World King Planet.
“Looks like even cosmic-level stars can’t escape the scourge of these guys.”
The World Tree clone nodded.
Although Shi Yu couldn’t affect the World King Planet much when he was weak, as Shi Yu became stronger, the World King should have realized how troublesome this guy was.
“Lord World King??” At this moment, the commotion of the World King waking up was very big. Not to mention super divine levels, even some powerful divine levels could sense some abnormality.
They couldn’t help but tremble in excitement. They didn’t know if they could see Lord World King with their own eyes.
Was Lord World King attracted by this battle?
Not to mention impossible, even a cosmic overlord had come personally. What was impossible?
Unfortunately, no one saw any World King.
At this moment, after the World King woke up immediately, it didn’t have the time to care too much about Shi Yu and the Sun God General. Instead, it directly focused its thoughts on the overlord battleship outside the starry sky.
“You didn’t come here just to watch the battle, right?”
The screen created by the cosmic overlord, Cypos, to watch the second world suddenly disappeared, and a pair of blue and white starry eyes appeared.
Seeing these eyes, Katney’s expression turned cold, while Cypos smiled.
“That’s right. Next, I’m leaving the Cosmic Sea. Have you thought of how to deal with those two guys?
I won’t help you this time. You shouldn’t be able to take out the reward for hiring me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1868: Tragic (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1868: Tragic (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
The World King was silent. Indeed, the cosmic overlord, Cypos, had never had any position to speak of.
As the orphan of a “cosmic race”, it had been a cosmic mercenary since it was young. Although it had the strongest Achievement in battle, it basically worked for money. As long as its salary was right, the cosmic emperor would also be crippled.
A long time ago, the Super Empress set her base camp in the Cosmic Sea. Therefore, the plan of the Super Empress to transmigrate space and time was the greatest threat to the Cosmic Sea. Regardless of whether she succeeded or not, the first to bear the brunt would definitely be the Cosmic Sea. Therefore, the World King was the one who wanted to stop the Super Empress the most among the many cosmic levels.
However, it was too difficult to stop the Empress with its own strength. Therefore, it could only spend a lot of money to hire a cosmic overlord. Fortunately, the cosmic overlord was also unhappy with the Super Empress and gave the World King a discount. Only then could the World King take out enough fees.
And now… the World King, who had already given its most precious cosmic treasure to the cosmic overlord, could no longer take out any resources to hire the cosmic overlord.
The World King naturally could sense the covetous gazes of the Dark King and the Beastmaster, so the next battle might be borne by the Cosmic Sea itself.
“Although I won’t take action, you can hire the others in the cosmic overlord army as you wish. Similarly, you can also hire the Contaminated Land and the Behemoth Empire,” the cosmic overlord said, still neutral.
“You spent most of your effort to send that kid back. You should have been conscious of this day.”
The World King said, “Of course, but I also predicted that the Cosmic Sea wouldn’t lose this battle. The one who would suffer a huge blow would be the other party.”
“In that case, I’ll wait to watch a good show.” The cosmic overlord laughed crazily.
As the mother of the Astrologer Race and the Star Prayer Race, the astrological ability of the World King could be said to be stronger than the Star Prayer Race and the Astrologer Race combined.
Before deciding to send Shi Yu back to the past and solve the current most troublesome problem, the Empress, the World King had already predicted what the Cosmic Sea would face after its vitality was greatly injured.
It had already considered its state.
Of course, the World King also admitted that it didn’t expect that the Dark King controlling the cosmic virus would make its originally weak state even weaker.
This kind of cosmic-level item from the previous era wasn’t within the range of astrology.
However, even so, the World King was still a little confident, because at this moment, the Super Empress’s cosmic battle power should be able to be seen as an “ally” for the time being.
“Let’s go.” The cosmic overlord waved its hand and dispersed the screen. Beside it, its exclusive secretary nodded with mixed feelings.
She didn’t care about cosmic-level disputes. As the secretary of a cosmic overlord, this kind of thing couldn’t interfere with her. However, she couldn’t ignore the cosmic overlord’s premonition dream and Eleven’s battle results just now. That Iron-eating Beast… She actually didn’t have the confidence to defeat it alone.
At this moment, many experts discovered the battleship of the cosmic overlord and slowly left the Cosmic Sea.
“Is the cosmic overlord really only here to watch the competition?” After learning that the cosmic overlord had really come to the World King Planet and was here to watch the battle, Zi Jian, the Demolishing Divine Bull, and the others were shocked for a long time. However, now that the cosmic overlord had left, they had a bad feeling.
“Star Army, Contract Army, Myriad Race Army, Environmental Protection Army.”
At this moment, the voice of the World King appeared in the ears of the Sun God General, Lu Ming, the World Divine Dragon, the Human Bing Ling, and the Elemental Bing Ling, making their hearts skip a beat.
“From today onwards, the World King Planet will enter a special battle state. The Cosmic Sea will seal and condense a protective barrier to prepare for the war with the Contaminated Land and the Behemoth Empire.”
The Sun God General had just woken up in a daze when its eyes suddenly widened.
Special battle state!
Sealing the Cosmic Sea!
A special battle state had only appeared a few times in all these years on World King Planet. The last time was still a battle with the Super Empress. This meant that a cosmic-level battle was about to happen.
As for sealing the Cosmic Sea, this command also explained a lot.
When this order was given, the World King would even take action personally and cooperate with the barrier-type cosmic treasure to isolate the Cosmic Sea from the Contaminated Land, the Behemoth Empire, the Worm Mother Nest, and the overlord territory.
At that time, the creatures of the Cosmic Sea wouldn’t be able to go out, and the lives elsewhere wouldn’t be able to enter.
If he wanted to break it, he had to break the barrier personally created by the World King. He had to do it personally at the universe level!
Generally speaking, launching the blockade command was because the World King felt that with its current strength, it wasn’t enough to fight the enemy. It needed a certain amount of time to prepare for battle.
At this time, even the teleportation between the various star areas, major planets, and World King Planet would be strictly controlled.
He had to check the identities of every teleportation user and settle the spies currently hidden in the Cosmic Sea.
“I’ll carry it out.” The awakened Sun God General disappeared directly after hearing the command. He didn’t want to face the World King and his acquaintances, mainly because he was worried that they would ask what was going on with the battle with Eleven.
The outcome of this battle was too miserable. The Sun God could imagine that he would be in the shadow of this battle for a long time.
At this moment, as the battle ended, the ranking of the Iron-eating Beast Race directly rose to 11th place among the various races in the starry sky, making Eleven, Senior Panda, and the others so excited that they exploded.
This ranking had even exceeded the 19th place of the Cosmic Crow Race!
It was completely averaged by Eleven!
This might be the fastest increase in ranking battle in history.

chapters.title: Chapter 1869: Tragic (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1869: Tragic (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
If the Iron-eating Beast Race gave birth to another super divine, it would definitely not be a problem for the Iron-eating Beast Race to enter the top 10 of the cosmic races.
However, before the people on World King Planet could be silent for too long, an official announcement from World King Planet immediately detonated the Cosmic Sea.
Special battle state!
Sealing the Cosmic Sea!
“What’s going on? Holy shit, holy shit, holy shit.” Ever since the World King occupied the Cosmic Sea and became the guardian of countless planets in the Cosmic Sea, it had been many years since it had entered a battle state.
Some young people looked at the announcement and were directly stunned.
After all, the last time the Environmental Protection Army and the Contaminated Land fought a battle of nearly 20 super divine levels, the Cosmic Sea didn’t enter a battle state either. It didn’t even enter a level-three battle state.
But now, it directly jumped from level three to special level. Who could withstand this?
Not to mention some epoch gods and perfect gods, even some super divine-level old antiques had never experienced it.
“I knew it wasn’t that simple for a cosmic overlord to personally come to the Cosmic Sea. Something big is definitely going to happen,” some people said with pale faces.
Once a battle in a special battle state happened, it was no longer something one could dodge just because they wanted to.
A casual confrontation between experts might cause the destruction of a star field, causing countless lives to die.
In this situation, no one immediately discussed the ranking battle of the myriad races that was still being discussed just now. Everyone on World King Planet was in a panic, and life forms above the quasi-divine level basically quickly knew about this.
As for the weaker existences, apart from those with special identities and backgrounds, the announcement was hidden locally to avoid causing chaos.
Fortunately, the Blue Planet was already prepared for this day. They weren’t too shocked.
Be it battle resources or food, the Blue Planet had long completed their reserves a while ago.
Apart from the super divines of the five divine races on Blue Planet who were shocked, the others were still cultivating normally.
“World King created a barrier. Looks like we have more time again.”
The Super Empress appeared in front of Shi Yu and said, “No matter how weak the World King is at this moment, no matter how weak she is, it will take years for the Dark King and the Beastmaster to break the sealing barrier she created with all their might.”
“This time might be said to be an emergency battle preparation, but in fact, after the World King paid attention to the battle between it and the Sun God General, it decided to buy you time at the last minute.”
“It’s impossible to have a chance of winning against the Beastmaster and the Dark King at the same time with the current power of the Cosmic Sea, but the variable is you. World King, you’re betting on whether I can nurture you to the cosmic level during this period of time.”
“Ling has already analyzed it. Empress, did you specially come over to say this?” Shi Yu and Eleven on his shoulder looked at the Super Empress and said.
The Super Empress: “?”
The Super Empress looked at Eleven and said, “It’s not bad. I underestimated you. You obtained more inheritances from the last era than I imagined. As expected of the strongest fire seed. But this way, the Dark King’s determination to kill you will be even greater.”
“I’m the father of the strongest fire seed. The strongest fire seed is my daughter,” Shi Yu said.
The Super Empress: “?”
“Sob, sob.” Eleven realized that Shi Yu didn’t seem to be very good at talking today. He was especially good at making people choke.
However, it seemed to be the truth?
“To be honest, isn’t this just casually correcting it because I treat the Empress as one of us?” Shi Yu felt aggrieved.
Shi Yu naturally didn’t hide the matter of the Goddess Wa’s Ruins from the Super Empress. This also made the Empress feel that choosing Shi Yu was indeed the best choice.
There were many transmigrators. For example, that nun was also a transmigrator, but in terms of talent potential, she was naturally inferior to Shi Yu.
This was because the Taiji Domain, the Green Dragon Domain, the skill index, and Beast Shi Yu were all part of Shi Yu’s talent potential.
But now, the Empress felt that perhaps the Shi Yu bloodline left behind in the Goddess Wa Ruins was the best choice. It could even be nurtured from a young age. Shi Yu was too infuriating and had developed too many bad habits.
“In that case, I won’t say anything else.”
The Super Empress was angered by Shi Yu and left. Before leaving, she told Shi Yu, “The bloodline crystal of the Worm Empress has been cleansed by me and that cat.”
“After you feel that the conditions are right, you can let that butterfly fuse.”
“Alright, alright. Thank you, Empress.” Shi Yu was excited. Good news.
As the two parties communicated, Buggy also let out a happy cry in the Beast Taming Space.
“Wu wu wu wu!!!” It was finally its turn.
First, Baby Ginseng created its own cultivation method, preached to the starry sky, broke through to transcendent 9, and became the Emperor.
Then, Eleven’s skill fusion was a huge success. It refined the cosmic disaster and broke through to transcendent 9, crushing the Sun God General above its level.
It, Buggy, felt even worse than being beaten up when it saw Eleven and Baby Ginseng posture.
Now, it was finally time for it to verify the conclusion of “strength after strengthening”.
After the Super Empress left, Shi Yu sensed Buggy’s excited heart and said, “Don’t worry, I’ve already experienced so many evolutions. What’s the hurry?”
“That’s a queen bloodline crystal. Next, make more preparations before fusing.”
“Wu!!” Buggy nodded.
“Wu wu.” Eleven stretched out its finger and shook it with a regretful expression. No, with its current strength, no matter how Buggy evolved, it couldn’t defeat it.
“Wu!!” Buggy snorted. Wasn’t it just the immunity law? At most, it wouldn’t cultivate the power of laws in the future. It would cultivate the power of the bloodline like the Worm Queen and the physical strength like the Beastmaster…

chapters.title: Chapter 1870: Tragic (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1870: Tragic (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
As the two pets fought head-on, Shi Yu also began to prepare. He could even imagine that if the team continued to roll like this, the threshold of the team internal competition might have to transcend the restrictions of the universe to start.
If strengthening Eleven required skill fusion, then strengthening Buggy now, apart from that resource, needed skill deduction.
Skill: Bloodline Control
< Introduction > It can control 100% of the fused cosmic bloodline into its own power.
Skill: Bloodline Limit
< Introduction > It can fuse at most two cosmic bloodlines of different natures in the body, allowing it to evolve and give birth to a more perfect bloodline. Note: One time, a life form can only use it once.
Shi Yu planned to let Buggy learn two new skills before fusing with the queen bloodline.
This skill was all the effects he had imagined, but the abnormality of the skill index was that it could deduce the learning method of this skill according to the skill effect of his imagination.
Therefore, although the skill index couldn’t increase points, as long as one dared to imagine it, there were still many ways to strengthen pets.
In the beginning, Shi Yu’s thoughts were even more ridiculous. For example, he imagined that he could fuse the many cosmic bloodlines in his body and evolve perfectly, but it completely exceeded the upper limit of the skill index. The deduction success rate was 0. Only when it fell to two and there were many restrictions at once did there be an extremely low chance of success.
However, two types were enough.
Under normal circumstances, even if Buggy successfully fused with the queen bloodline, Buggy might still not be able to control this kind of external high-level bloodline well. However, as long as it learned bloodline control and maxed it out, there shouldn’t be a problem.
Moreover, even if it controlled it perfectly, the Queen Worm bloodline was still its path. Even if Buggy didn’t want to take this path again and only used it as a tool for evolution, this evolution tool wasn’t its in the end.
However, as long as the bloodline restriction skill fused the foreign bloodline of the Worm Queen and the foreign bloodline of the Green Dragon, producing a new bloodline, this new perfect bloodline that had evolved would definitely be Buggy’s own. It would be more proficient in using it.
At that time, with the new bloodline fused by the Worm Queen and the Green Dragon as an evolution support tool, it would assist its insect bloodline in completing the evolution. It would become the strongest cosmic level!
The bloodline of the Worm Queen was in charge of Devouring the power of the outside world. The Green Dragon bloodline was in charge of opening up the main body as a new universe to consolidate the inner body in case it couldn’t withstand the nutritional impact of the outside world and died.
Of course, what Shi Yu was most worried about was whether he could find materials to learn these two skills in the Cosmic Sea…
Including recuperation, it took about half a month. Shi Yu successfully deduced the skills of Bloodline Control and Bloodline Limit. At the same time, he began to search for materials one after another.
With his current identity and strength, it was very easy for him to find anything unless it was a cosmic treasure.
Fortunately, he only needed to learn these skills and didn’t need cosmic treasure-level resources. In just three days, Shi Yu had found most of the skill materials, leaving only the last material to learn the bloodline limit.
It wasn’t that this material was very difficult to find. It could even be said that this material was the easiest to obtain among all the learning materials deduced.
However…
“Alright, there’s only this Star Prayer Race’s bloodline gem left. Let’s go draw two tubes of blood from Teacher Cat…”
“Sigh, learning a bloodline fusion skill actually requires the blood of the Star Prayer Race. How strange. Is this to let the blood make a wish on its own during the fusion process? It has to successfully fuse?”
If it were in the past, anyone who wanted to learn the bloodline restriction would probably have to scratch their heads because the Star Prayer Race had nowhere to find. Fortunately, Shi Yu happened to have the Star Prayer Race.
However, Shi Yu didn’t go to Teacher Cat to draw blood for a long time…
It was mainly because he had seen Teacher Cat work so hard. She wanted to modify the source of transcendence and optimize the crystal of the queen’s bloodline… Now, Buggy actually wanted her pure bloodline to learn a skill. Even capitalists weren’t so cruel.
“You’re here.”
In the working room, Teacher Cat wiped her sweat and said, “The bloodline crystal is over there. In addition, another source of transcendence has been modified. Take it yourself.”
“Ah, this battle state makes me quite nervous. If we really start a war, I haven’t finished modifying these sources of transcendence. If I let you break through, wouldn’t you become the sin cat of the Cosmic Sea?” The gem cat was vexed.
So difficult. Was this the so-called saying that the greater the ability, the greater the responsibility?
When could he be a carefree free cat?
The gem cat thought about it carefully. It was actually the one who lived the most leisurely when it was a warehouse manager at Ancient Capital University.
Damn it, ambition and desire had harmed him!
Shi Yu coughed dryly and said, “There’s no need to feel so guilty, but if you really feel that guilty, can you let me draw two tubes of your blood before you condense it into a bloodline gem?”
The gem cat: “?”
“Damn, why do you want my blood?”
Shi Yu said, “Buggy’s skill materials… aren’t for free. At most, I’ll let Buggy acknowledge you as its godmother. How good would it be to have another cosmic son in the future?”
The gem cat said in disdain, “No, you’re more like my son. Forget it, it’s just two tubes of blood… But the two tubes are too abstract. How much is it exactly?”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Not much. A ton each.”
“You f*cking want me to die???”

chapters.title: Chapter 1871: Buggy Evolution, Worm of the Devouring Universe (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1871: Buggy Evolution, Worm of the Devouring Universe (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Don’t panic. As long as you expand to the size of a cosmic behemoth, isn’t drawing two tons of blood a matter of minutes?”
Shi Yu chuckled.
“Bullshit, your family’s tube is the cannon barrel of a cosmic cannon.”
The gem cat was just short of slapping Shi Yu away.
“How long has it been since you were injured? With your current strength, it’s easy for a drop of blood to crush a starfield…” Shi Yu looked at her suspiciously. It was just a joke. This guy really cared about weight?
As long as the quality of the bloodline was right and it could be condensed into a bloodline gem, everything else was secondary.
“You’re so long-winded… So annoying. I understand.”
In the end, the gem cat still submitted to Shi Yu. As for Shi Yu, he took away the bloodline gem, the queen bloodline crystal, and the new source of transcendence that the cat had trained recently.
He also considerately left a few super divine dates made by Baby Ginseng for her.
“The skill index shows that it just needs an ordinary super divine-quality bloodline gem. Teacher Cat condensed a top-notch super divine-quality in an instant. This cat is good!”
“It’s all because Master said that the higher the quality, the better… That it would persecute Teacher Cat…” Ling’s voice echoed in Shi Yu’s heart as they left dejectedly.
After taking the things, Shi Yu and the others’ mission was very clear.
About a week later, with the help of Baby Ginseng’s cultivation fruit and the World Tree Fruit, Buggy learned bloodline control and bloodline restriction.
< Name > Buggy
[Level of Growth]: Super divine level (Transcendent 7 times)
[Star Arms]: Dragon Ball
[Skill]:
“Divine-level”: Worm Bloodline (transcendent), Faith skill, Creation God Domain (transcendent), Space Control (transcendent), Dragon of Imagination (transcendent), Faith skill, Dragon Star Group (transcendent), Faith skill, Green Dragon Indestructible Body (transcendent), Star Refinement (transcendent), Spirit Control (transcendent), Magnetic Travel (transcendent), Faith Plunder (transcendent), Arms Control (transcendent), Bloodline Control (transcendent), Bloodline Limit (transcendent), Infinite Devour Devour (transcendent).
At this moment, Buggy could be said to be a remnant of the old era. Although it had returned to being a worm, it was the only worm-type skill that had been tempered to the divine level. It was very pitiful.
More powerful skills still came from the Green Dragon’s evolution path, but this was also related to the fact that it didn’t walk on a new path. Now, Buggy was finally going to take the first step.
First, it learned the Infinite Devour, Bloodline Control, and Bloodline Limit, allowing it to go from transcendent 6 to transcendent 7. Then, Shi Yu took out the Queen’s bloodline crystal and threw it to Buggy.
These three moves were actually to lay the foundation for learning the Ultimate Devour.
“Yi. (I didn’t expect that you would evolve from the Green Silkworm again one day.)” Baby Ginseng leaned against the tree and looked at Buggy.
“Wu wu. (Yes, yes.)” Eleven took out its cell phone. There was also a video it treasured inside. It was Buggy’s first evolution.
It recorded it at Ancient Capital University. In a daze, such a long time had passed since then.
“What, what, let me take a look.” Not everyone had seen the pets that joined the team later. For example, Bu Lu immediately came over and said.
Fusion of the Queen’s bloodline crystal was a very dangerous thing. Many of the Queen’s biological heirs’ genes collapsed because they couldn’t withstand the powerful inheritance of the Ultimate Devour.
Buggy had a godson, so the success rate was hard to say.
However, the other pets didn’t seem to think that Buggy would fail. Only Shi Yu, the Beast Tamer, had the heart to bless Buggy.
“Don’t die!!” Shi Yu said.
“Ji!!” After receiving Shi Yu’s encouragement, Buggy’s expression drooped, and then it was determined!
No!
In fact, even if it failed, its life shouldn’t be in danger. Shi Yu and the others were very prepared. For example, Baby Ginseng used the Time Mark to record Buggy, and Buggy could also use the Green Dragon faith to revive itself.
However, it was uncertain if the bloodline crystal could recover to its original state. At that time, it would undoubtedly miss the path of the universe.
The Worm Queen probably wouldn’t be kind enough to give him a second one.
“Wuu.” As it spoke, Buggy directly used the worm silk to sweep over the bloodline crystal the size of a soldier’s ping pong ball. It opened its mouth wide and let out Eleven’s voice before eating the queen bloodline crystal in one bite!
After Devour, Buggy’s expression first changed. Then, it immediately activated Infinite Devour…
This bloodline crystal undoubtedly exceeded this category. Fortunately, Buggy had the bloodline control skill, and its foundation was strong enough. Perhaps it could break through…
“Wu!!!”
In the next moment, Buggy’s expression became pained. Shi Yu and the others were beside it, but they didn’t dare to talk.
“It’s coming.” Shi Yu’s heart froze. Soon, such a terrifying bloodline fusion immediately triggered Buggy’s racial talent, “Cocoon Evolution”.
Buggy relied on this talent to evolve into the Butterfly of Imagination and the evolution skill of the Butterfly of Imagination to become the Green Dragon. Now, in the end, it still started a new reincarnation and used its initial racial talent to evolve from its initial posture again.
“Ji!!”
At this moment, Buggy didn’t move at all. Its body directly spread with light and didn’t spit out silk to form a cocoon. That was because its control over the worm silk had already reached the point where it could directly transform the nature of its body into worm silk!
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others saw the terrifying purple-red phantom of the Worm Queen lingering outside Buggy’s body, as if it wanted to devour it and emit an aura that made one’s bloodline tremble.

chapters.title: Chapter 1872: Buggy Evolution, Worm of the Devouring Universe (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1872: Buggy Evolution, Worm of the Devouring Universe (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
In just a short instant, Buggy’s lifeblood seemed to have been devoured by the other party. However, at this moment, another Green Dragon phantom returned to the ground, making Buggy energetic and ready to attack, interweaving with the worm phantom.
The two terrifying cosmic bloodline phantoms collided, bringing with them dazzling light, also causing Little Zi to be heavily injured again. It widened its watery eyes. As the pet in the team that specified the evolution location and breakthrough location, its body could definitely be said to be of good quality now.
In the outside world, on Blue Planet, even through a star barrier, Blue Planet’s Will, Emperor Shi, and the other experts left on Blue Planet could sense that the fluctuations from that icy plain seemed to be from a cosmic battle.
“What’s this kid doing again?” Emperor Shi stood at the top of the Ancient Capital and looked at the icy plain. He was very satisfied with Shi Yu’s progress. From the looks of it, it wouldn’t be long before Shi Yu could reach the cosmic level and completely let Dong Huang become a cosmic faction. He could also reincarnate in peace.
Although the cat had become a peak super divine and already had the initial ability to increase its source of transcendence, after thinking about it again and again, Emperor Shi still decided to walk the path of Beast Taming again. It wasn’t that he didn’t trust the gem cat, but purely because this way, he could see the problem more clearly.
The former was equivalent to knowing that the question was wrong and looking at the answer to change it. The latter was equivalent to doing the correct process and answer from the beginning again. The effect brought by it was completely different.
As for Lin Feng, the Space Emperor, and the others, they didn’t plan to go through so much trouble. They began to prepare many resources, planning to ask Teacher Cat to help make up for the flaw in their realm when she was free in the future.
In Little Zi’s body, the world of stars.
The light disappeared.
Buggy’s figure had already disappeared.
What was left was a strange cocoon.
The cocoon’s entire body was covered in a green-purple hard shell. There were four sharp horns on both sides, and three small horns on its forehead. Its green-purple body was also covered in white and green patterns. Be it the Green Silkworm, the Worm Queen, or the Green Dragon, there were characteristics. However, without eyes or mouth, Shi Yu and the others directly lost their connection with Buggy.
Shi Yu knew that the current Buggy had entered a sleeping state of pseudo evolution. In the depths of its bloodline consciousness, it was resisting the bloodline power of the Worm Queen.
As a Beast Tamer, he could see that in the Cosmic Sea, the Green Dragon with the Green Silkworm in one eye was fighting a purple-red worm monster.
The pain brought by the attack of the worm wasn’t inferior to the pain brought by the extremely low probability of skill fusion. Shi Yu took a deep breath. He knew that no one could help Buggy at this step.
He had already helped everything he could before fusing.
“Next, I wonder how long Buggy will sleep for,” Shi Yu said.
“After all, it’s a treasure-level thing in the Devouring Universe. It’s possible to last for a long time if we have to fuse it with the Green Dragon bloodline.”
“Everyone, go do your own things first. When there are any changes on Buggy’s side, I’ll immediately inform you.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the pets nodded.
Shi Yu looked at the newly formed cocoon of Buggy and took a deep breath. He decided to cultivate beside Buggy the whole time during this process and protect it.
Due to Buggy’s state, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t wander around casually. He started a new round of calm cultivation.
In order to prevent any accidents from happening, Shi Yu didn’t do anything as wasteful as fusing skills, adding points, and deducing skills for other pets. He directly started his own cultivation.
The gem cat kept modifying the source of transcendence, and Shi Yu kept receiving it.
During this process, Shi Yu quickly reached the peak of the super divine level and finally reached the peak.
However, according to the Super Empress, the peak of the super divine level was only the beginning. If he wanted to contract a cosmic level, just the peak of the super divine level was not enough. Shi Yu wanted to continue breaking through the limit and find another way to transcend 11, 12, 13… Just like when he was at the divine level.
Transcended 11 times. Even the few humans cultivated by cosmic overlords couldn’t do this. Shi Yu wanted to be the number one person now.
Of course, restricted by the efficiency of Teacher Cat’s modification of resources, Shi Yu would also start to turn around and cultivate new content whenever he was free.
Creating a new Beast Taming Talent.
At his level, it wasn’t difficult to create a new Beast Taming Talent. What was rare was to create a powerful Beast Taming Talent.
As for the Beast Taming Talent Shi Yu wanted to open up, it was undoubtedly comparable to the Vermillion Bird, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise Domains of the Green Dragon Domain.
If it was created out of thin air, even if Shi Yu had Baby Ginseng’s cultivation fruit and the World Tree Fruit, it would definitely be very difficult. Fortunately, he had the Green Dragon Domain as a reference. He also had Chi Tong’s Vermillion Bird clone, Shorty, and the Fusion Black Tortoise, the three pets closest to the real Four Saints.
This way, no matter how stupid Shi Yu was, he would definitely be able to open up the other four holy domains. It was just a matter of time.
During this process, Shi Yu had been observing Buggy’s state. The Green Dragon and the worm were still fighting.
There was no winner.
“As expected, super divine skills aren’t that easy to obtain.” Shi Yu was helpless against this.
After all, this concerned whether Buggy could obtain super divine skills.
The Ultimate Devour was a super divine skill, the peak crystallization of a bloodline skill. It was the final profundity cultivated by the Worm Queen with her life. In terms of level, it was even above the incomplete Chaos Divine Body and even Yin Yang Control.

chapters.title: Chapter 1873: Buggy Evolution, Worm of the Devour Universe (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1873: Buggy Evolution, Worm of the Devour Universe (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
If Buggy wanted to obtain this, it would definitely have to suffer countless times more pain than before.
As for time, Shi Yu could wait, but he didn’t know how long the World King’s barrier could last. If the Dark King and the Beastmaster charged into the Cosmic Sea at this time, he couldn’t fight in his state.
In the blink of an eye, a year had passed since World King Planet entered a special battle state.
In a year, an unprecedented recruitment began in the entire Cosmic Sea. Almost all the divine-level Beast Tamers who cleansed their races and contracted them were searched by the Environmental Protection Army, asking if they wanted to join the Environmental Protection Army.
The other Star Army, Contract Army, and Myriad Race Army were also vast and mighty. As they recruited soldiers, they set up arrays to protect the Cosmic Sea in all directions.
As the number one super divine in the Cosmic Sea and the future seventh throne, Shi Yu acted as if this battle didn’t concern him. He didn’t prepare for battle frequently like other peak super divines.
It was mainly because it was impossible for other super divines to have much breakthroughs in the short term. However, Shi Yu was different. With rich resources, he could improve greatly every minute and second.
In a year, the speed at which the gem cat modified the source of transcendence was also increasing. Recently, it had finally modified all the source of transcendence.
If nearly a hundred sources of transcendence were all cultivated into super divines, the number would be terrifying. However, at this moment, they were all absorbed and refined by Shi Yu himself.
However, what gave Shi Yu a headache was that even after absorbing so many resources, although he could sense that even if he could crush the Sun God General alone without the power of any pet, enough to have battle power close to the Black-robed Empress at that time, he still couldn’t transcend 11 time.s
At this moment, Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and every other pet’s strength had also subtly increased during the process of Shi Yu becoming stronger, reaching the peak of the super divine level. However, Shi Yu’s level was still the same.
After a year of bitter cultivation, excluding the sleeping Buggy, all of them were at the peak of the super divine level. It was undoubtedly very terrifying and rich strength. It was probably not impossible to say that the current Shi Yu and the others had 5% or 10% of the strength of the cosmic emperor together.
However, Shi Yu knew that this wasn’t enough.
Facing a real cosmic level, it would still be insta-killed.
Even if it had 50% of the strength of a cosmic level, it couldn’t escape the fate of being insta-killed. If it wanted to resist a cosmic level, the difference had to be narrowed to less than 20%.
Moreover, according to the Empress, at least at the super divine level, the entire team had to have 20% strength comparable to the cosmic emperor. Only then would there be a slight chance of successfully contracting without any resistance and active cooperation from the cosmic level.
“Where exactly is the key to transcendent 11?” At this moment, Shi Yu had even cultivated the other three holy domains to a point close to the Green Dragon Domain.
The other talents were also cultivated to perfection, including the spatial talent.
However, he still couldn’t find a way to reach transcendent 11.
Shi Yu knew that whether he could perfectly contract the Empress depended on this level.
One day, Shi Yu finally felt the bottleneck loosen.
“Transcendent 11 is the same as the 11th heavenly layer of the divine level. The key is in the pet. As long as one pet becomes a peak super divine of a cosmic race, the feedback can allow the Beast Tamer to break through.”
The reason why Shi Yu made this judgment was because he had spent a year in the outside world. After an unknown period of time in the bloodline dream, Buggy finally defeated the Worm Queen!
He had successfully learned the super divine skill “Ultimate Devour” through bloodline control!
This was the main reason why Shi Yu felt his level finally changing. However, at this moment, Buggy couldn’t be said to be a cosmic race, because even if the Ultimate Devour was perfectly controlled by it, it was still given by someone else.
Now, if it wanted to take a deeper step to control the queen bloodline, the first thing it had to do was to fuse it with the Green Dragon bloodline after controlling the queen bloodline and give birth to a new bloodline that belonged to it.
“Roar!!!”
In Buggy’s bloodline space, after the broken Green Dragon Buggy defeated the Worm Queen, it bared its fangs and brandished its claws, jumping down from the starry sky, as if it wanted to Devour the Worm Queen’s bloodline body in one bite.
This process wasn’t as difficult as before. Buggy activated its bloodline restriction and controlled the Green Dragon bloodline and the Queen bloodline to fuse.
At the same time.
Worm Mother Nest.
Even if the Cosmic Sea was completely sealed, the Worm Queen still sensed the change in the bloodline she gave.
Her expression was incredulous.
“It actually fused so quickly, and it’s already perfectly controlled. As expected, I didn’t choose the wrong person.”
“Moreover, you actually dare to…”
Sensing that its bloodline was being forcefully refined and fused with other cosmic bloodlines, the Worm Queen was first stunned. Then, it let out a laugh that made the hair of the entire Worm Mother Nest stand on end.
“He can actually do this. Shi Yu is indeed a lunatic. No wonder he was chosen by that crazy woman. Interesting. The Dark King and the Beastmaster might not know what kind of monster they are facing. Shi Yu will definitely give them a huge surprise.”
“If he succeeds, his talent potential might be comparable to Cypo!!”
With the bloodline of the Worm Queen and the bloodline of the Green Dragon, no one knew what kind of legend would be created.
However, at this moment, as Buggy fused, it completely stepped into the threshold of the cosmic race.

chapters.title: Chapter 1874: Buggy Evolution, Worm of the Devour Universe (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1874: Buggy Evolution, Worm of the Devour Universe (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
In Little Zi’s body, the galaxy trembled.
Even if Shi Yu didn’t inform the other pets, these guys also sensed shocking changes.
During this process, it didn’t even use Shi Yu’s skill to fuse. The dragon bloodline and worm bloodline in Buggy’s body actually fused on their own. Some of its dragon-element skills began to contain the worm-element.
A terrifying new bloodline was slowly born in its body.
Shi Yu kept receiving information in the outside world.
It could be said that apart from the super divine skill Ultimate Devour, which was the greatest gain, Buggy had also given birth to another quasi super divine skill at this moment. It was incomparably terrifying.
[Skill]: Universe Devourer (Incomplete)
[Introduction]: It can directly devour the power of the universe to grow.
After this skill appeared in his mind, Shi Yu was shocked on the spot.
He sensed the abnormality of this skill. Wasn’t this… the talent of a planet race?
Planet races could grow all the way to the cosmic level by directly absorbing the power of the universe without doing anything.
It was a competition of talent potential and time.
Now, Buggy actually had such an ability? However, other planets’ races had racial talent, while Buggy turned this racial talent into an active bloodline skill.
The essence of the worm bloodline was devour, the essence of the Green Dragon bloodline… Logically speaking, it should be life and creation, but it seemed that the bloodline fusion this time combined the characteristics of the Four Holy Constellation God and the cosmic god, allowing Buggy to learn a skill related to “stars” and “cosmic”.
For a moment, Shi Yu couldn’t think of a good way to use this skill, but Ling was pleasantly surprised.
“Master, I made a killing.”
“The strongest thing about this skill isn’t relying on absorbing the power of the universe to grow at all.”
“Why don’t we change our train of thought? The will of the universe is also a part of the universe and an invisible power of the universe.”
“If this Universe Devourer is raised to perfection, perhaps it can even devour the cosmic will and finally replace the cosmic will to become a new cosmic will, the Cosmic Heavenly Dao.”
“At that time, Buggy will be the universe, and Master, you and Buggy have a contract. You don’t have to do anything. You can directly contract the universe and become the holder of the universe…”
“Of course, it might be as difficult as ascending to the heavens for Buggy to do this, but even if it can’t reach that step, with this skill, it can also consume the cosmic will as much as possible and increase the success rate of the enhancement contract when you contract the universe.”
After Ling finished speaking, Shi Yu was stunned. Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others were also stunned. That worked?
However, they also knew that Ling was speculating. As long as they dared to imagine it, an ordinary frontal fist could still explode the universe. There was ultimately a difference between imagination and actual instant. Whether they could do it was the key. However, this was undeniable. The Ultimate Devour and the Universe Devourer skill directly gave Buggy the potential to replace the cosmic will, making Baby Ginseng drool.
Damn it.
“Buggy is really the strongest after evolution?” Bu Lu was also stunned.
The other pets looked like they were used to it. It was an old tradition.
“Wu wu.” Eleven crossed its arms. Fortunately, it still felt that its Chaotic Body was stronger. After all, it was a skill that could transcend and leave the universe.
At this moment, Buggy seemed to have finally finished.
“Wuu!” “Yi!!!”
The pets looked at Buggy’s situation. The cocoon that had slept for more than a year finally changed… But… there weren’t many changes.
Just like the first evolution, a pair of blue-purple eyes appeared on the cocoon…
“Wu!! (I’m back.)” Buggy, who had broken through to the peak of the super divine level and had evolved its race, returned excitedly. However, when it sensed that everyone was already at the peak of the super divine level, it was immediately stunned. It kept feeling that even after working hard for a year, it didn’t widen the gap with everyone?
“Welcome back.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “In your current state, you should be able to evolve again. At that time, with evolution, your growth level can also reach the cosmic level.”
Next, it was time to find enough evolution materials for Buggy.
Now, it could also devour the cosmic treasure for its own use and be invincible!
Eh.
At this moment, Shi Yu was stunned. Since Buggy could even devour the universe now, why not directly use the power of the universe to evolve?
To put it bluntly, cosmic treasures were only born from the universe. What power was stronger than the most primitive power of the universe?
“Directly devour the universe.” Just as Shi Yu was excited, the 11th round of Transcendent Sun appeared behind him. He officially stepped into the realm of transcendent 11. However, at the same time, the long-awaited cosmic heavenly tribulation appeared again…
It might be a little personal.

chapters.title: Chapter 1875: New Healer, Super Empress (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1875: New Healer, Super Empress (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
On Blue Planet.
The Super Empress, Susu, and Duckie had already learned the method to contract the universe from the little nun.
When Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng found their way, the other pets weren’t idle either. They were all searching for their way blindly.
Shi Yu arranged for the pixel duck to prepare for the Dark King Army.
Using the cosmic contract method, Susu modified the Star Sea Contract, making the range of the Star Sea Contract larger. It could cover the entire cosmic sea with the World King Planet as the center.
It was basically equivalent to her reaching the level of the Sun God General.
As for Duckie, it had even learned the cleansing divine skill of the Buddhist Sect, Buddhist Light.
The two pets, one positive and one negative. It could be imagined that in the future, when the cosmic virus was completely cleansed, they would definitely be the main battle power.
After obtaining the method to cleanse the cosmic virus, the Super Empress was much more at ease. She entered seclusion outside Blue Planet to cultivate.
At the moment, there wasn’t much that could alarm the Super Empress. The shattering of the Cosmic Sea barrier was one, and Shi Yu’s breakthrough might also be another.
“Boom… Boom… Boom…”
The starry sky changed, and endless tribulation seas formed. In her mystic realm, the Super Empress opened her eyes and said, “I finally broke through.”
“From ancient times until now, at least in this era, he’s the first to transcendent 11. Looks like if he breaks the limit at the super divine level, he will still encounter the heavenly tribulation of the universe. It has nothing to do with his identity. Even the concealment method I taught them has lost its effect.”
“What happened?”
At this moment, in the Starry Sky Tribulation Sea, meteorites, storms, lightning, flames, frost, black holes, white holes, and various other law phenomena were born. It was far more complicated than the tribulation lightning that descended after breaking through the limit of the divine level.
Sensing the vibration of the starry sky, the World Tree and the other creatures were shocked, thinking that the Dark King and the Beastmaster were attacking.
“Every power isn’t inferior to my full-strength attack.” Goddess Wa looked at this terrifying heavenly tribulation and fell silent. She understood that Shi Yu’s realm had already exceeded hers and reached a level that the universe couldn’t tolerate.
“It’s coming for me.” At this moment, Shi Yu came out of Blue Planet and walked out of the planet. He stood in the starry sky. Eleven blazing suns shone behind him. Blue Planet’s Will and the others noticed Shi Yu’s situation and were slightly shocked.
Transcendent 11. This situation had never happened.
Since ancient times, even if Beast Tamers enhanced their pets’ strength, they had never had it.
However, there was a legend. If a human Beast Tamer reached the peak of the super divine level, his pet would also reach the peak of the super divine level. If the Beast Tamer enhanced his strength on his pet, that pet could reach a realm that exceeded transcendent 11.
On the other hand, as long as one Beast Tamer or pet didn’t reach the peak of the super divine level, the accumulation of 10+9 on both sides wouldn’t be 19, but 10.
Only 10+10 would be 11.
But now, Shi Yu had actually reached the realm of transcendent 11 alone, and not him who had enhanced his pet to transcendent 11.
Apart from the experts of Blue Planet, although this area was quickly sealed off by the Super Empress and isolated Blue Planet from the starry sky, there was another life form that sensed the changes here.
The will of the World King Planet also sensed the descent of the Universe Tribulation Sea and couldn’t help but watch.
“They succeeded in reaching transcendent 11?”
At this moment, the World King’s will was undoubtedly very happy.
Although the birth of a transcendent 11 Beast Tamer still wasn’t considered a cosmic Beast Tamer, it was equivalent to a miracle of the same level.
Only by reaching transcendent 11 could he break through to the cosmic level!
Even the cosmic overlord, Cypos, didn’t nurture a Beast Tamer who exceeded transcendent 11. At most, he would let the Beast Tamer’s pet reach transcendent 11 with the support of its master.
Of course, according to archeological discoveries, the cosmic overlord could confirm that be it humans who exceeded transcendent 11 or cosmic-level humans, they really existed. In other eras, it was just that the birth conditions were too difficult.
Thinking about it carefully, Shi Yu’s cultivation level was almost equivalent to two lifetimes plus the feedback of more than ten peak super divine pets. Among them, there was also the feedback of a freak like Buggy that had fused two cosmic bloodlines to succeed.
If it were anyone else, it would be too difficult to replicate.
“Roar!!!”
“Wu!!!”
At this moment, the lightning tribulation descended. Shi Yu ascended to the starry sky. Beside him was a black and white panda and a strange worm cocoon.
Shi Yu only kept these two pets because the fluctuations of this heavenly tribulation were too terrifying… and too delicious.
Letting Baby Ginseng and the others block it was a pure waste. Not only would they be injured, but they would also waste the power of the heavenly tribulation.
On the other hand, be it Eleven or Buggy, the former could refine the power of the heavenly tribulation through the Chaos Divine Body, while the latter could devour the power of the universe through the Universe Devour skill…
Although his good mood just now was completely disturbed by the heavenly tribulation, Shi Yu endured it on account of the heavenly tribulation giving him a big meal.
“Eat it,” Shi Yu ordered.
“Boom… Boom… Boom…” Just as Shi Yu got his two pets to charge up, the starry sky was first completed by the tribulation lightning and directly descended.
Just a golden lightning tribulation produced a temperature that was higher than the full-strength eruption of the Sun God General, let alone the terrifying law power contained inside. If it was struck, even a peak super divine like Teacher Cat would be instantly killed.
“Wuu!!” However, Eleven didn’t even blink. A chaotic aura lingered on its body as it directly faced the lightning tribulation, just like how it used the Thunder Palm to cut the lightning in the Class assessment back then. Now, it was replicating it again, but the identities and strength of both parties were already worlds apart.
Boom.
During the Heavenly Thunder Purification, the lightning light was glorious. Every wisp of electric arc tore through space and time. Eleven’s body was like a piece of divine iron and a Lightning Rod, enduring the impact of the heavenly tribulation on every inch of his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1876: New Healer, Super Empress (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1876: New Healer, Super Empress (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Electric arcs wrapped around its flesh and quickly turned into runes that fused into it, tempering Eleven’s body even stronger. “Sun God General, your loss wasn’t in vain. ”
“It can actually ignore law lightning of this level. ”
When the World King saw this, it was secretly shocked. Before reaching the cosmic level, no, even now, it couldn’t imagine that there was actually a super divine level who could be so valiant.
The reason why the World King could reach the cosmic level was partly because of its racial talent and partly because of the push of the Beastmaster. It could be said to be not that difficult. Now, seeing the valiance of the Chaotic Body Eleven, the World King judged that it definitely couldn’t defeat this panda before the cosmic level.
What was even more terrifying was that Eleven’s Chaotic Body was actually still being perfected under the baptism of the tribulation lightning.
Shi Yu could also sense that if Eleven ‘s incomplete Chaotic Body was 10% perfect previously, it had become 11% now.
Not only could fusing other new skills increase the perfection, but the Universe Devour’s law tribulation could also perfect the Chaotic Body!
Realizing this, Shi Yu and Eleven’s eyes lit up even more.
Before the big shots observing the lightning tribulation could be shocked, another phenomenon descended from the Tribulation Sea born in the starry sky. It was endless fallen leaves. The withered fallen leaves emitted an endless murderous aura and contained death fluctuations, as if they could snatch away all life.
They were like blades that rained down like autumn rain.
“Wuu!! ” However, at this moment, Eleven was enjoying the lightning and had no time to care about this. Seeing this, Buggy quickly leaped up. Eleven had snatched the lightning just now, so Eleven couldn’t snatch it, right?
Boom!!
Although it was in the form of a cocoon, when it ascended, its body immediately turned into a terrifying bloodline vortex that exceeded the black hole. Those fallen leaves were like weeds facing a lawn mower, attracted to devour without any resistance.
The terrifying bloodline power swallowed the laws of the universe and turned into its growth nutrients. In Buggy’s cocoon space, in the dark space and time, a trace of withered fallen leaves was permanently branded. It directly refined this heavenly tribulation and kept it as a backup evolution material. At this moment, the World King, who was observing in the dark, was shocked again.
“Ultimate Devour. ”
“No, it’s not as simple as the Ultimate Devour. ”
“Cosmic-level race… So the source of his breakthrough is here. ”
World King was shocked. He didn’t expect that the first person in Shi Yu’s team to enter a cosmic race wasn ‘t Eleven, but the little guy who had evolved into a Green Dragon and degenerated into a worm.
From the looks of it, this little worm had achieved its ambition and completed its terrifying evolution again in the form of a worm. Not only would it surpass the Green Dragon, but it would also surpass the Worm Queen.
At this moment, with Buggy’s Ultimate Devour and the Universe Devourer skill, even in the era before the extinction of that cosmic race, it could be considered above average. Its talent was close to the cosmic overlord Cypos, who was born with two super divine skills.
Now, after discovering that Buggy could also ignore the calamity of the universe’s laws like Eleven, although the World King had never seen lightning tribulation that exceeded transcendent 11, it felt that Shi Yu seemed to be stable.
The others were the same. When they sensed such a terrifying lightning tribulation, Eleven and Buggy heaved a sigh of relief.
In fact, that was the case. Next, no matter what law phenomenon descended, even if two or three descended together, Eleven and Buggy directly helped Shi Yu block. Even if they were injured, they, who had special talent, wouldn’t be too heavily injured.
Soon, Eleven’s Chaos Divine Body reached small success. Its perfection was at least 30%.
At this point, Eleven could no longer increase its physique by resisting the nomological tribulation. It seemed to have reached a bottleneck.
In its place, Buggy carried the banner and didn’t refuse anyone.
In Buggy’s evolution space, there were imprints of lightning tribulation, wind tribulation, Exort Tribulation, Quas Tribulation, and various other law tribulations. It had imprints on all the law tribulations that the universe could send down since it was born.
If Buggy refined all of this in the future, it could be converted for its own use. Just as Ling had said, it was equivalent to a weakened version of the cosmic will.
Of course, for Buggy itself, it didn’t fancy these because these law tribulations couldn’t defeat Eleven!!
At this moment, the nomological phenomena gathered in the Tribulation Sea were about to end. Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief.
“It’s over. That’s it?” He looked at the Tribulation Sea and felt that the will of the universe was only so so. He felt that the probability of contracting the universe was even greater…
However, just as everyone thought that the lightning tribulation that exceeded
transcendent 11 was about to end, something unexpected happened.
Eleven and Buggy’s expressions also changed. Like Shi Yu, they felt that it was a little ridiculous.
After the law phenomenon, a figure was actually born in the Tribulation Sea.
He had a weak face and was covered in blood. On his weathered face, his gaze seemed to have crossed ancient times. Although there was no transcendent Yang phenomenon behind him, Shi Yu could clearly sense that the other party’s level realm was the same as his.
In other words, it should also have exceeded the realm of transcendent 11 and broken the limit of the super divine level.
“Who’s this guy?” Shi Yu didn’t understand, nor did the others watching. Even the Super Empress and the World King revealed puzzled expressions.
But soon, as the Tribulation Taker, Shi Yu seemed to resonate with the universe and knew what was going on.
The era they were in nowwas the 11th era.
In other words, before this, the universe had restarted a total of ten times.
Although in the 11th era, no one had reached the realm of transcendent 11 like Shi Yu, it wasn’t like there weren’t talented humans who had reached this realm in the first ten eras.
