chapters.title: Chapter 1877: New Healer, Super Empress (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1877: New Healer, Super Empress (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Perhaps they had succeeded in transcending the tribulation or failed, but their traces were all branded in the Tribulation Sea. At this moment, these power phantoms had also become a kind of heavenly tribulation that was about to fall.
“Alright, come on.” Shi Yu took a deep breath. He knew that the sixth brother of the cosmic will wasn’t that simple. Fortunately, he didn’t attack just now and preserved his physical strength. Now, it was completely no problem to fuse with Eleven and Buggy to fight the experts of the other eras.
At this moment, not only was Shi Yu unafraid, but he was also very excited.
In the other eras, he definitely cultivated other power systems. He also wanted to broaden his horizons and see what he would encounter.
Even if it was someone of the same level, Shi Yu didn’t believe that anyone could defeat him, who mainly cultivated the Beast Taming System.
Under the Beast Taming System, he wasn’t alone. To be precise, the power all over his body came from various pets. He must be stronger than individuals.
Unity was power!
However, just as Shi Yu was about to fight, the Tribulation Sea that had just condensed the power phantoms of other era experts suddenly trembled. A black and purple wave invaded the Tribulation Sea, causing it to quickly disperse and retreat like a tide.
Before Shi Yu could wait for the calamity, the Universe Tribulation Sea disappeared without a trace, leaving behind a dark starry sky.
Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, and the others were stunned on the spot.
What was going on?
It was gone just like that?
“It’s the cosmic virus.” Realizing the abnormality of the Tribulation Sea, the World King said, “I didn’t expect the cosmic virus’s corrosion of the universe to have reached such a deep level.”
“The virus that should have been used to weaken us has helped a lot.” The Super Empress’s voice sounded. “Looks like the heavenly tribulation has already ended.”
The voices of the World King and the Super Empress sounded in Shi Yu’s heart at the same time, stunning him.
He said, “No, what scammy virus? It’s over just like that. I’m not satisfied yet. I haven’t fought experts from other eras. Give me back my lightning tribulation!!”
Shi Yu was about to go crazy. He didn’t want to transmigrate, but when he wanted to get addicted to transmigrating, the Tribulation Sea directly left. What the hell?
“Roar, roar, roar.” Eleven and the others also looked dissatisfied. Yes, yes, they hadn’t had enough fun.
Could that power phantom be eaten?
They felt that it couldn’t be eaten, but after being beaten up for so long, it was fine to beat it up.
The World King and the Empress could understand when they sensed Shi Yu and the others’ childish hearts.
“The Tribulation Transcenders of other eras?” For warlike people, having a chance to fight experts of other eras was undoubtedly very precious. Although Shi Yu and the others weren’t easy to fight, it was indeed a little regretful to miss such an opportunity.
“No one knows the strength of the next lightning tribulation. It’s always a good thing to be able to cheat and clear the level without being affected,” the Super Empress said. “If you want to fight experts from other eras, become the holder of the universe. At that time, there are plenty of opportunities to clear other parallel eras.”
Shi Yu said, “I’ve already become the holder of the universe. I’m definitely invincible in the entire universe. When the time comes, what’s the point of bullying experts from other eras… Well, it does seem more interesting than fighting a phantom.”
“Wu wu wu.” “Wu wu wu!!” Eleven and Buggy were stunned and nodded. That made sense.
The culture in Shi Yu’s team had never been to enjoy battle. Instead, when they encountered strong enemies, they would cultivate quietly and increase their points to become stronger before crushing the other party.
Who said that experts had to grow while in combat?
It was better to save enough strength and bully the weak.
At this moment, without the interference of the Tribulation Sea, Shi Yu completely stabilized his realm that exceeded transcendent 11 and was no longer suppressed by the cosmic will. Apart from that, Eleven and Buggy, who had swallowed the nomological tribulation, had much stronger auras.
Sensing the current situation, Shi Yu was very happy and excited.
“World King.” At this moment, sensing Shi Yu’s state, the Super Empress said to the World King’s will, “I’ve already strengthened your barrier for you.”
“Next, please protect Shi Yu and me.”
“What do you mean?” World King said.
“His level has already reached the standard. I want to sign a contract with him to help him cultivate and enter the cosmic level.”
World King: “?”
“What?” Even as a cosmic level, the World King was a little stunned.
The Super Empress… wanted to sign a contract with Shi Yu?
Shi Yu and the Empress quickly appeared in her vision.
When did they hook up to this extent!
She completely didn’t expect that the Super Empress would want to contract Shi Yu.
Even if a cosmic overlord cultivated humans, they definitely wouldn’t have the intention of contracting humans.
This was because if human Beast Tamers wanted to obtain feedback, there were only two types of contracts. The first was a master-servant contract, with humans as the master and pets as servants. The second was an equal contract.
The contract of a human servant pet master couldn’t give much feedback to human Beast Tamers.
It was naturally impossible for a cosmic life form to sign a master-servant contract with a super divine level human.
Therefore, the contract the Super Empress wanted to make with Shi Yu must be an equal contract.
However, the risk of the equal contract failing was borne by human Beast Tamers and pets together.
How could a cosmic life form be willing to take a huge risk to sign an equal contract with a lower-level human to help the other party become stronger?
It wasn’t strange for the World King to be surprised that the Super Empress wanted to use any other method to nurture Shi Yu to the cosmic level, but she didn’t understand why the Super Empress would be so determined to contract him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1878: New Healer, Super Empress (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1878: New Healer, Super Empress (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Did the other party trust Shi Yu so much?
How exactly did Shi Yu do it?
He had only asked him to do a quest, but in the end, not only did Shi Yu solve the Cosmic Sea crisis, but he also made the Super Empress do this for him?
“According to other methods, it’s too slow,” the Super Empress said.
Moreover, when she was two consciousnesses, one of them had long taken the initiative to sign a contract with Shi Yu.
Now, it was just connecting this broken contract again.
As for his baffling trust in Shi Yu, it might be related to the previous era. Perhaps both parties were really old friends.
“Now?” Shi Yu heard the Empress’s words and said, “Then I’ll leave it to you, Lord World King.”
Since the Empress judged that a contract could be signed now, Shi Yu naturally accepted it.
As long as he successfully contracted it, he could cross the cosmic level and become the real seventh throne.
At that time, he would really not be afraid of anyone in this universe.
“Alright… Since you’ve already made your decision.”
“I’ll try my best not to let external factors interfere with your contract,” World King said after a moment of thought.
Only the three of them knew about the conversation between the World King, Shi Yu, and the Super Empress. Even Goddess Wa and the Blue Planet’s Will were blocked.
The World King didn’t expect Shi Yu and the Super Empress to make this decision. By doing this, Shi Yu could indeed reach the cosmic level as soon as possible.
However, according to her thoughts, she originally thought that Shi Yu would choose to nurture a cosmic-level path himself.
For example, that worm, that panda.
Although it might take longer and take ten thousand years or even hundreds of millions of years, it was undoubtedly stable. After all, both parties already had a contract. Letting pets try to break through above their level was also a different kind of contracted cosmic level.
“If they can successfully contract it, then a cosmic-level Beast Tamer, a cosmic-level Super Empress, the Dark King, and the Beastmaster undoubtedly made the worst choice.”
“And if their contract fails…”
The World King prepared for the worst. She had fought for time for Shi Yu to become stronger. In fact, she was already very satisfied that Shi Yu had become stronger to this point, but now, it looked like Shi Yu also wanted to take another step forward.
He wanted to play a pivotal role in the battle with the Dark King.
As for the current transcendent 11 Shi Yu… The World King estimated that under their full strength, they already had 30% of the battle power of the cosmic throne. It was already extraordinary for them to reach such an achievement with the Super God Realm.
In the eyes of Blue Planet and the others, Shi Yu had disappeared after transcending the lightning tribulation. They didn’t know where Shi Yu had gone.
However, Shi Yu had always been such a sloppy and impatient person. Everyone was already used to it. Seeing that Shi Yu had transcended the lightning tribulation normally, they were relieved.
At this moment, in fact, Shi Yu had already entered the contract space created by the Empress with his pets.
The appearance of this contract space was similar to the pavilion in the sky of the Hundred Flower Star Region back then. The Super Empress said, “Are you ready?”
“I’m a little nervous,” Shi Yu said.
“There’s no need to be nervous. I’ve already signed a contract with you in parallel space. The contract method of the two eras is shared. In my deduction, the success rate is already 99%.”
Shi Yu looked at the Super Empress and felt that her tone was a little close to Lily.
“Isn’t there still 1%?”
“There’s no absolute success rate in everything,” the Empress said. “I don’t know what will happen either.”
“Why don’t we wait another half a month? In any case, this little time isn’t a problem. I’ll train other pets,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright…” the Super Empress said. She could be happy at any time.
He didn’t lack this bit of time.
Shi Yu scratched his head and looked at the Super Empress. “In any case, we’re about to contract it. Why don’t you help me train my pet, Empress? It’s too tiring for me to train it myself.”
“What do you mean?” The Super Empress had a premonition that she wanted to work.
At this moment, Shi Yu summoned all his pets and said, “Empress, you know healing… No, you know healing skills, right? Leave the cultivation of pets to me. You just have to increase my state. When my pets reach their peak and I’m also returned to a stronger state by them, we’ll start the contract!!”
Shi Yu wanted to let the Super Empress be a healer to assist in the fusion of his skills.
It had to be said that after Shi Yu finished speaking, every pet of Shi Yu looked at the Super Empress with shining eyes. A cosmic-level healer. This was something they didn’t even dare to imagine in the past.
“Help…” Qi was about to drool. With the Empress’s help, her few time skills would definitely be able to fuse into time control very quickly!
Otherwise, if she had to rely on Baby Ginseng to heal her, she would have to wait until the god knows when, it’ll be a cold day in hell.
“At your current level, even if they all reach the cosmic Race, it’s impossible for them to make much progress,” the Super Empress said. “Forget it, then as you wish. After helping you nurture your pets, we’ll contract.”
“Wuuu!!” Eleven was overjoyed. It wished Shi Yu and the Empress success in contracting! However, in the blink of an eye, it frowned. It seemed… that its skills had almost been fused? It had nothing to do with the subsequent cultivation?? Ah!
In short, at this moment, when they heard that the cosmic-level Empress wanted to be a healer and assist them in adding points, everyone was excited. They felt that their strength could welcome another epic increase.
“Let it create enough nourishing medicine. I’ll help you refine it into a medicinal pill,” the Empress said.
Shi Yu was stunned. “Empress, you know how to refine pills?”
The Super Empress said, “It should be my primitive racial talent. I was able to awaken it after plundering a portion of the power of the Universe Tree. However, it consumes a lot of strength and isn’t convenient to use. It’s a very contradictory feeling. It might be related to some experiences in my previous life.”
Shi Yu said with a strange expression, “Don’t tell me you were a jade rabbit in your previous life? You specialized in creating medicine!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1879: Charging Towards the Cosmic Level (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1879: Charging Towards the Cosmic Level (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Jade Rabbit…”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the Super Empress was clearly stunned.
This was the first time she had heard of this race.
Her main body was indeed a rabbit.
“What else do you know?” the Super Empress asked.
It looked like Shi Yu, who carried a portion of his memories, indeed knew more than her, someone with no memories.
“It’s just a myth.”
“Jade Rabbit, also known as Moon Rabbit, lives on the moon and is in charge of pounding medicine in the Moon Palace. It’s a creature from ancient Chinese myths and legends.”
Shi Yu pondered for a moment and said,
“There are too many stories about her. I don’t know which is true, or maybe none of them are true.”
“Speak,” the Super Empress said, meaning that she wanted to hear everything.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded. Eleven and the others also raised their heads. They also knew this!!
When Shi Yu was bored, he would tell them various mythical stories.
It was very much like an adult coaxing a child with a story.
“It’s said that the Moon Rabbit is the embodiment of Chang’e, a woman who drank the elixir of immortality and ascended to the moon…”
Next, Shi Yu told the other party all kinds of myths and legends about the Jade Rabbit.
However, this kind of thing was clearly unreliable. Among the six myths and legends Shi Yu mentioned, some said that the Jade Rabbit was the embodiment of Chang’e, some said that the Jade Rabbit was Hou Yi, Chang’e’s husband, and some said that the Jade Rabbit was Chang’e’s “pet”. It was a rabbit that had become a spirit and was male.
“In short, the ability of the Moon Rabbit is to hold the jade pestle and kneel on the ground to smash the medicine. It can refine pills that allow longevity and immortality. It’s very powerful.”
Shi Yu estimated that he would probably have to recover his “complete memories” to know about this.
“If my memories were complete, I might know more,” Shi Yu said.
“I once learned in the ruins of an ancient god that ‘I’ had contact with the ‘Heavenly Court’ and definitely knew a lot of inside information. When I become the holder of the universe, we can figure it out when we return to the last era.”
“Yes.” The Super Empress nodded. The legendary stuff Shi Yu mentioned was indeed the same as listening to it for nothing. She indeed didn’t analyze anything.
However, the key word Jade Rabbit could be memorized deeply.
“Alright, let’s begin.” The new healer, the Super Empress, looked at Shi Yu’s entire team.
“This is too awesome.”
Before long, Shi Yu was shocked by the Empress’s ability.
The supplements created by Baby Ginseng were already powerful.
Under the refinement of the Super Empress, Shi Yu ate one of the pills. The extremely low success rate was like a joke.
It succeeded without any side effects. Compared to the previous torment, it was simply extremely happy.
As Shi Yu’s biological daughter, Chi Tong was the target of additional points.
At this moment, she was also overjoyed. She flew non-stop in the form of a sword.
The cleansing pill refined with Baby Ginseng’s supplements and Susu’s cleansing water greatly offset the pain of adding points.
She and Shi Yu barely felt any pressure before the skill fusion was successful.
The Immortal Slaying Sword Formation, Interlocking Sword, and Myriad Sword Convergence directly fused into the sword origin.
This was a very strange move.
Generally speaking, most laws in the universe were derived from “natural environments”.
However, there were also a few special cosmic laws derived from the “thought of life”.
For example, when many lives’ “warpath” reached the extreme and reached a saturated level, the universe would be born with the corresponding “Warpath Law” because of these life thoughts.
It could be said that natural laws, such as water laws and thunder laws, were all natural laws.
As for the Warpath Law and the Sword Law, they were all acquired laws.
In this universe, when the number of lives using weapons like sword or sword-type lives reached a certain number, the universe gave birth to the first wisp of the Sword Origin, which was the prototype of all Sword Laws.
Now, what Chi Tong had mastered was the source of all the Sword Laws that traced back to the origin.
The origin of the sword wasn’t a law skill, but it could give birth to laws and form new sword laws by fusing various laws, such as the previous Immortal Slaying Sword Formation, Myriad Sword Convergence, and the Interlocking Sword.
It could also directly attack with its source. For example, if the source of the sword was attached to ordinary swords that didn’t contain laws, it could also display shocking divine might.
Of course, it was definitely weaker than the nomological sword skill. After all, the origin was also born from the universe. However, at least, without the power of laws to attack now, it was much stronger than before. Therefore, Chi Tong was very happy after obtaining this skill.
It wasn’t afraid of the Chaos Divine Body anymore.
Chi Tong looked at Eleven.
“Wu wu wu.”
“Continue, continue.” Originally, it would have taken a lot of effort to fuse such a skill, but now, with the Empress’s support, Shi Yu knew what it meant to take off!
Just like that, a week later.
Every skill of Shi Yu’s pet had been fused.
The originally top-notch divine skills were all even more divine.
For example, skills like Time Acceleration and Time Stop fused into Time Control.
Unfortunately, even if everyone was strengthened, just as the Super Empress had said, Shi Yu couldn’t break through to super divine 12.
This was because even if the entire team could fuse all the skills, they didn’t give birth to a second super divine skill like Buggy.
It was mainly because Buggy had the bloodline given by the Empress, so it was easier.
And with the power of the skill index, raising Shi Yu’s pet to this extent was already the limit. The skill index couldn’t create a cosmic level out of thin air, nor could it create a cosmic-level race.

chapters.title: Chapter 1880: Charging Towards the Cosmic Level (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1880: Charging Towards the Cosmic Level (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
The reason why Buggy could become a cosmic race was mainly because of the external power of the Queen’s bloodline.
Even the fake Green Dragon bloodline was secondary.
“Are you satisfied?” After a week, the Empress’s state had become much weaker. Even as a cosmic level, it wasn’t easy for her to constantly pester Shi Yu with medicine.
Just as she said, it consumed a lot of strength.
Obviously, strengthening Shi Yu and the other strange pets one by one wasn’t easy even for the cosmic level.
Just like the skill index, a cosmic level could nurture a peak super divine, but it couldn’t nurture an existence at the same cosmic level.
“Thank you,” Shi Yu said. “According to the law of Pokémon subjugation, the weaker the state, the easier it is to contract.”
“What nonsense are you talking about again?” the Super Empress said.
What nonsense was this?
However, although she didn’t understand at the start, the Empress understood at the end.
If a Beast Tamer wanted to contract a pet, the worse the pet’s condition, the higher the success rate of the contract.
Although she felt that the contract between Shi Yu and her wouldn’t reduce the difficulty much, it was better than nothing.
“If you’re ready, let’s contract it as soon as possible.”
She looked outside the mystic realm and said, “I still don’t know how long the contract will take. The Dark King and the Beastmaster are constantly corroding the barrier…”
“We have to complete the contract before they break the barrier, be it success or failure.”
“Well, in an hour, I’ll adjust my state…”
Soon, an hour passed.
At this moment, Shi Yu meditated calmly and adjusted his condition to its optimal state.
In the Beast Taming Space, Eleven and the others also became active. They knew that Shi Yu was about to contract the Empress and break through to the cosmic level.
After Shi Yu reached the cosmic level, the entire team felt good.
At that time, Shi Yu would carry out his cosmic cultivation plan and separate all his Beast Taming Talents to permanently give them to his pets.
At that time, every pet would have hope at the cosmic level.
Unlike now, it was extremely difficult to nurture a cosmic race.
“Shi Yu…”
However, just as the entire team was cheering for Shi Yu, Qi suddenly spoke eagerly.
“I have a bad feeling. Can we not contract it?”
“Oh?” Shi Yu said, “What’s wrong? What did you discover?”
Shi Yu recovered from his meditation and asked Qi.
“No… I just have a bad feeling. I don’t know what’s going on,” Qi said.
“This…” Shi Yu was stunned. A bad feeling?
He naturally didn’t suspect that Qi was talking nonsense, but at this juncture.
“Do you feel anything?” Shi Yu asked the other pets.
“Wu wu wu?” Eleven and the others revealed puzzled expressions and shook their heads.
“No, but Qi’s feeling is worth looking into,” Ling said. “Qi, can you work hard to sense what’s wrong?”
“I just feel that there might be risks in this contract, but I don’t know what’s going on,” Qi said.
“Ahhh, I can’t say for sure. Perhaps I’m overthinking.”
“In short, Shi Yu, you have to be careful when you contract it.”
“The risk can’t come from the Empress. It’s not a problem for her. In other words, if there’s really a risk, it will definitely come from contracting above her level. But logically speaking, in the current situation, even if the contract is difficult, it shouldn’t exceed the extremely low probability of adding too many points.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought, but he still couldn’t think of anything.
But no matter what, a contract had to be followed through. After all, he had already promised the Empress. Moreover, if he didn’t break through to the cosmic level, the Dark King and the Beastmaster would come. The pressure on the Cosmic Sea was too great.
Firstly, the Empress was willing to fight the Dark King for her own sake.
And if she couldn’t become the holder of the universe, there was no need for the Empress to protect the Cosmic Sea. She might even ignore him.
At that time, if the Dark King came looking for him, what was the point of fighting?
Even if he could run, it was impossible for him to bring his family and the entire Blue Planet to hide.
Therefore, the only solution was to break through to the cosmic level and crush the Dark King.
“Don’t worry, don’t worry, I’ll succeed.”
“After all, with Ling around. Come, Lady Luck, give me a luck buff!”
“Oh.” Ling sighed. No matter how it thought about it, her luck buff couldn’t reach the cosmic level.
However, Ling still sent the Wind Blessing to Shi Yu’s side. Apart from that, it was more of its sincere wish that Shi Yu could reach the cosmic level.
After all, she was born “to make Shi Yu stronger and better”.
“Wu!!” “Mi!!” Then, under the cheers of the entire team, Shi Yu took a deep breath and walked out to find the Empress.
At that moment, the Empress was still standing at the edge of the pavilion in the sky, looking at the sky. It was unknown what she was thinking.
When Shi Yu came looking for her, the Empress’s human form had already disappeared. There was only a big white rabbit standing there.
“Let’s begin.” She didn’t say anything and looked at Shi Yu.
“Come.” Shi Yu took a second deep breath. Although this wasn’t the first time he had contracted a pet, why was he so nervous this time?
Contracting a cosmic level above his level…
The opportunity to break through to the cosmic level…
“Then I’ll start.” Shi Yu didn’t say anything else. He closed his eyes and muttered in meditation.
So be it. Let’s get started!
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the Beast Taming Space in his brain.
It was a star domain with more than ten stars and eleven suns.
On every star, there was the figure of a pet staring at Shi Yu. It was Eleven and the others.
If everything went smoothly, they would have one more neighbor.
Hu hu hu
As Shi Yu communicated with the Beast Taming Space, a breeze blew outside, and the grass swayed.
Countless light spots flickered Blink in front of Shi Yu. Two contract arrays that looked like star maps with eleven suns hanging at the edge appeared above the Empress and under her feet.
In the next second, countless weak light spots flowed out of the formation. The light spots that were like suns wrapped around the Empress’s main body, as if they wanted to envelop and cover her!
At this moment, time seemed to have stopped.
Shi Yu had once contracted every pet and succeeded instantly, putting them into the Beast Taming Space.
However, this contract above his level had indeed taught Shi Yu a lesson.
In an instant, he felt a huge pressure.
The previous contract was as simple as taming a little white rabbit. It was easy to control.
But now, what he clearly wanted to contract was a real little white rabbit. The feeling it gave Shi Yu was like facing a ferocious beast king, even if the Empress didn’t have any intention of resisting.
Large beads of sweat flowed down Shi Yu’s forehead.
“It has to succeed.”
“At this point, how can we stop before the cosmic level!”
Shi Yu’s consciousness became more and more blurry. He even felt that he had heard the voices of the Empress and his pets, but he could no longer hear the specific content.
Pain, fatigue, dizziness, weakness…
Various complicated perceptions appeared on Shi Yu’s body. Shi Yu had no idea what was going on.
However, as time passed, Shi Yu finally felt better.
A wisp of light appeared in his vision. He slowly opened his eyes and felt the relief in his body. He was overjoyed. Success?
However, as a voice sounded, Shi Yu was clearly stunned.
“The surgery looks very successful. Look, the patient is already awake.”
As Shi Yu opened his eyes, they were filled with disbelief.
Because at this moment, he was lying in a modern ward. Beside him, a doctor and an old man were looking at him and talking.
“Little Yu, you’re finally awake.” The old man was very excited to see Shi Yu.
“You brat, I told you to be disobedient and run around the mountain yourself. Fortunately, the rescue team came in time and saved you from the stone pile. Otherwise, you would have lost your life!”
“Cough, cough.” The doctor beside him coughed dryly. The old man reacted and said, “Let’s not talk about it anymore. How do you feel? If you feel unwell, tell the doctor.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Teacher??” Shi Yu was stunned. Wasn’t this the old man who taught him non-mainstream archeology in his previous life on Earth?
“It hurts, it hurts.” A heart-wrenching pain woke Shi Yu up. He was stunned.
Mountain, stone pile, teacher, hospital…
Damn, what was going on?
Was he dreaming, or had he transmigrated back???

chapters.title: Chapter 1881: Let Me Back (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1881: Let Me Back (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
The memories were like a horse looking at flowers as it relived them.
He, Shi Yu, was an orphan.
He had grown up in an orphanage and didn’t know who his parents were.
However, the genes of both parties should be alright. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be so handsome.
Under the nurturing of the country, primary school, junior high school, high school, university…
Although he didn’t have any dazzling results, he still entered an unknown hundred-year-old ancient school.
And because of his personal preferences, he applied for the archeological profession.
When it came to studies and work, as long as he wasn’t a noob and liked to play, as long as he had some talent, he would do well.
Shi Yu, who was a little smart and witty, quickly stood out.
However, what awaited him wasn’t to get the scholarship so easily or to graduate perfectly to find a job in the light. Instead, it was another beautiful path of no return. He was led away by an old professor in the university. Shi Yu followed him to various places to do archeology.
In fact, Shi Yu was originally a proper archeological student. He learned proper knowledge.
However, it was precisely because he had come into contact with this old professor that the other party got Shi Yu to study a special mythical system with him. That was why Shi Yu took the detour and changed his profession to a Mythical Scholar.
It would be fine if it was a proper Mythical Scholar.
However, what this old professor studied was either wild history myths that had never been heard of on the market or legends that were regarded as rumors by others at a glance. In short, it didn’t look like it could earn money at a glance.
However, the content was interesting, so Shi Yu still fell into it.
Moreover, it wasn’t really not profitable. Although he didn’t know how to sell it, some mythical archeological information could really be sold for a high price. Shi Yu received a lot of money from his teacher.
The other party said that a group of old-timers and rich people liked this kind of thing.
Therefore, Shi Yu had bought a house and car at a young age. Although he had bought it with a loan, he could be said to be young and promising.
Of course, the house was only a small house in a remote suburb, not in the cities. He couldn’t afford to buy an expensive house in the cities. In a few more years, he wouldn’t even be able to afford a toilet.
In short, after that, Shi Yu started. It looked like archeology, but it was actually a path of no return to investigate various mythical ruins.
From being an assistant with the old professor at the start to flying solo and exploring on his own… After all, old people had weak legs and couldn’t run around 365 days a year.
In Shi Yu’s previous life, he was far from as weak as now.
Among them, be it the Taiji Ruins or the Green Dragon Ruins, in Shi Yu’s impression, they were all explored at this stage.
In the end, it was the critical moment. When Shi Yu explored a certain ruin, he encountered a mountain collapse and was suspected to have died.
He hadn’t even seen a single hair in that ruin.
Fortunately, because he walked in dangerous places all year round, in order to prevent himself from being killed, Shi Yu had always carried a locator and a rescue device with him.
However, what was going on now?
Shi Yu looked at the doctor and teacher and felt that it was ridiculous.
“It must be a dream now.”
“Do you remember your name?” At this moment, seeing that Shi Yu was stunned for a long time, the doctor asked worriedly.
“He still remembers that I’m his teacher. His mental state should be fine,” the old man said.
Yes!!
There was something wrong with him.
Shi Yu was numb.
Because he sensed that the level realm, pet contract, skill index, and so on were all gone.
But now, compared to the real feeling, it didn’t feel like a dream at all.
On the contrary, the experience of transmigrating was like a dream.
At this moment, Shi Yu even felt that his memories of transmigrating were fading.
It was as if it was a dream…
Just as he woke up from the dream, the things in the dream were gradually forgotten.
Unknowingly, two drops of tears flowed down the corners of Shi Yu’s eyes for no reason. Although he could still remember some key things, for some reason, as his memories blurred, he suddenly couldn’t control his emotions.
“Kid, don’t cry now. It’s harmful to your body. Let me tell you, you’ll definitely have good fortune after surviving this disaster. When others encounter such a disaster, they’re basically finished. You actually only have superficial injuries all over your body. Your bones and tendons aren’t injured at all. You can be discharged in two days. It’s simply a miracle.”
At this moment, seeing Shi Yu aggrieved like a child, Shang Qiu, Shi Yu’s teacher, spoke.
“I…” Shi Yu said, “No, no.”
Then, under the shocked gazes of the doctors and teachers, Shi Yu lifted the blanket and forcefully dragged his injured body up.
To be honest, even if it was a superficial wound, how could a normal person recover from such a superficial wound without a change in expression?
The doctor saw that Shi Yu didn’t cry out in pain this time and got up directly. When he saw that Shi Yu wanted to walk out, he was stunned.
“That’s not a dream,” Shi Yu confirmed as he walked.
Everything else could be gone, and even memories could be blurred.
However, his overlord will might have even been upgraded to the Super Divine Will. After adding points to his pet, the will to withstand the affliction that had been tempered thousands of times was still there.
Although he cried out in pain, it was only subconsciously. As long as Shi Yu wanted to, he could completely resist it without changing his expression.
Just as the other party said, this superficial injury was nothing.
Shi Yu ignored the shouts and pursuit of the doctors and teachers behind him and jogged outside in his hospital clothes. When he was outside, Shi Yu looked at the clear sky and said,
“Something’s wrong. There’s no smog at all. This doesn’t make sense. It’s indeed a dream.”
“The quality of the air in Earth’s hometown is compared to Blue Planet’s Dong Huang.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1882: Let Me Back (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1882: Let Me Back (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu didn’t expect that he would actually grit his belief that this was a dream from these two strange angles.
He could confirm that he was…
“Wait, why did I accidentally enter here?” Suddenly, Shi Yu’s brain hurt. The pain this time made Shi Yu, a person with strong willpower, unable to withstand it.
“Damn it.” He hit his head with his little fist and tried to fight fire with fire, using violence to counter violence. The double pain added up, but it still didn’t make Shi Yu remember how he accidentally entered here.
Was he tired from adding points and was sleeping and resting?
He was still exploring ruins and had accidentally entered a terrifying place.
Or was it an enemy attack?
Why was he here?
What was he doing previously…
Shi Yu’s memories began to blur again. He had directly forgotten what he had been doing previously.
“I can’t continue like this. I have to escape this world quickly. Be it illusions or dreams, it’s too dangerous.”
At this moment, the doctor who was called something and the old professor, Shang Qiu, also followed. Their legs were definitely not as agile as Shi Yu’s.
Seeing Shi Yu looking at the sky in a daze outside, the two of them were speechless.
“How can I break free?”
“I don’t have any power now.”
“Suicide?” Shi Yu looked at the huge stone pillar beside him.
No, there were many terrifying abilities that controlled and killed people in dreams.
If he died in his dream, he would also die in reality. He couldn’t die.
“Shi Yu, lease calm down. You still need to recuperate now. Come, follow me back to the ward now.”
The doctor realized that Shi Yu didn’t seem to be fine.
His brain might have been more or less affected.
It was possible that modern medical methods couldn’t detect any problems in this mysterious domain.
“What are you doing?” Shang Qiu looked at Shi Yu, panting. He was still jumping around.
“I…” Shi Yu was just about to say something when his brain hurt again.
At this moment, under the panicked expressions of the teachers and doctors, he swayed and fainted.
“Shi Yu!!”
Pain, fatigue, dizziness, weakness…
“A familiar feeling.” Shi Yu opened his eyes with difficulty and looked at the familiar empty ward.
As he woke up, there was a commotion outside. Soon, the door was pushed open and the two familiar people entered again.
Upon seeing the two of them, Shi Yu cried.
Although this teacher had treated him well, Shi Yu really didn’t want to see him anymore.
At this moment, Shang Qiu looked at Shi Yu with a complicated expression.
Now, according to the inspection, there was nothing wrong with Shi Yu’s body.
However, there might be an unclear problem in his mind.
There would most likely be side effects.
Three days had passed since Shi Yu fainted the last time.
Sleeping for three days wasn’t a good sign.
This young man… didn’t even have a family or a girlfriend. What if something happened?
“Do you feel alright?” the doctor asked.
“Not good,” Shi Yu said. “No, I feel very good. I want to be discharged.”
Although Shi Yu didn’t feel good and only wanted to go back now, he didn’t have time to argue with the other party in this hospital.
He had to leave the hospital quickly and think of a way.
“I suggest we observe for another week. If there’s no problem, we can be discharged,” the doctor said.
Since the inspection couldn’t find any problems, they could only let him go.
“I’m fine. I want to be discharged now,” Shi Yu said.
The doctor looked at Shang Qiu. Shang Qiu was silent for a moment before saying, “Sure, you can be discharged.”
That day, the discharge procedures were completed.
When Shi Yu left the hospital, his teacher pulled him and said, “Follow me. Although I don’t know what’s wrong with you, come with me first.”
“Huh?”
Shi Yu originally wanted to go home and then go to the ruins where something happened. He even wanted to take a look at the Taiji Ruins and the Green Dragon Ruins to find extraordinary power and crack the dream. However, the serious expression of the old man in front of him stunned Shi Yu.
“What’s wrong, Teacher?”
Shi Yu followed the other party to the other party’s car.
Shang Qiu said, “I’ll take you to see an old friend of mine. She might be able to see the problem with your head.”
Shi Yu looked depressed.
However, even if it was a dream, he couldn’t completely ignore an old man who cared about him.
“Teacher, I’m fine. Moreover, the hospital can’t find anything… I’m just too tired and got a fright. There’s no need to go, but since we’re here, you can just send me home.”
“That friend of mine is very extraordinary.”
“You, she, this world is going to be extraordinary next.”
“I originally thought your situation was an accident, but some recent information made me sense that something was wrong.”
“Perhaps something strange happened to you.”
Shi Yu looked at the mumbling teacher. Although he had been like this in the past, Shi Yu kept feeling that there was a hidden meaning in the other party’s words.
Shi Yu said, “What do you mean?”
“There’s no need to hide it from you.”
“It won’t be long before the entire world knows. I just found out a while in advance.”
In the car, Shang Qiu said, “Have you heard of the ‘Revival of Spirit Qi’?”
Shi Yu:
“Huh?”
“Have you ever thought that the myths and legends I brought you to study aren’t the fictional mental sustenance of the ancients? They really exist.”
“My family has studied this knowledge for generations. There was once a message left behind in an ancestral ancient book that one day, the world with exhausted spiritual energy will be filled with vitality again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1883: Let Me Back (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1883: Let Me Back (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“At that time, various cultivators, such as immortals, cultivators, demons, and gods, will also appear in the world again.”
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
Wait a minute.
At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly thought of a possibility.
In this world, regardless of whether it was true or false, did it have memories that he had forgotten?!
According to his deduction, after he transmigrated, because the weight of a portion of his memories was too heavy, it couldn’t transmigrate with him.
Therefore, he could only intercept the memories of the mortal stage.
For example, there were no transcendent memories.
According to his deduction, after the mountain collapsed, he indeed didn’t directly transmigrate, but had a forgotten memory.
Was what he was experiencing now that forgotten memory?
Perhaps the memories weren’t deleted, but just sealed? Was it just in the memory world now?
At the thought of this, Shi Yu’s heart suddenly skipped a beat. He believed his teacher’s words. Earth definitely had extraordinary power.
At this moment, Shi Yu wanted to continue exploring, but the constantly blurry memories after transmigrating made Shi Yu a little afraid.
“I believe you,” Shi Yu said to his teacher.
Shang Qiu didn’t expect Shi Yu to accept it so quickly. He laughed out loud and said, “As expected of you, kid. I wasn’t wrong about you.”
“However, I still have a lot to say. Listen slowly.”
“According to the records of my family’s ancient books, it’s said that this universe has lifespan.”
“And the time period we’re in now is the end of our lifespan.”
“At this stage, the universe will decline, and various mythical and legendary powers will be suppressed. Cultivators have no choice but to sleep. Therefore, there are no longer extraordinary powers on Earth.”
“However, close to death, the universe will still have one final moment before death.”
“During this final stage, spiritual energy will revive on a large scale. It will be the last celebration for cultivators. After all, for the universe, a short final moments might be in the blink of an eye, but for ordinary people like us, even legendary cultivators, there might still be a million or ten million years. It’s enough.”
“We’re currently in the context of such a large world.”
Shi Yu took a deep breath and looked at the old man. Who exactly was Shang Qiu? He actually knew so much.
Why didn’t he see that Shang Qiu was so impressive in the first place?
Shang Qiu’s family was probably ancient. He felt that it should be related to that Heavenly Court.
“After the recovery of spiritual energy, apart from some cultivators who will wake up, it’s said that some people with special physiques will also awaken some special abilities.”
“I suspect that you’re in a waiting state, which is why your body is abnormal.”
“It encountered such a dangerous thing, but it’s ‘unscathed’. Moreover, there’s an abnormality in its brain that can’t be verified by modern medicine. It’s probably a good thing,” Shang Qiu said.
“The old friend I mentioned previously is also from a cultivator family. Although it’s desolate now, it was once glorious. The other party was the one who told me about the recovery of spiritual energy. I’ll take you to her to take a look at the situation. The problem with your body might be able to be resolved. At least, it won’t be like now, where you’re blind. After all, the other party has already become a legendary cultivator.”
Shi Yu: !!!
However, this wasn’t the key now.
If there were no side effects to his body at this moment and if he knew the exact way to leave this place, Shi Yu would happily slowly experience this lost memory with the other party.
But now…
“Or should I say that recovering all my lost memories is the method to awaken? However, from my deduction, every time I recover a little of my lost memories, the memories after transmigrating will be a little blurry and forgotten.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
If he had to choose, he would rather not have the memories before he transmigrated than to lose the memories of interacting with Eleven and the others.
However, this wasn’t a matter of whether he could choose. The problem was that he had no choice now.
Soon, Shi Yu decided not to choose.
He planned to take it one step at a time.
“Even if I really forget my memories after transmigrating, as long as I can escape this dream, there’s no problem.”
“Susu can replicate my forgotten memories after transmigrating through the memory water drop and awaken my forgotten memories.”
“I still have a group of pets. Even if I can’t find a way to escape the dream, they will definitely work hard to wake me up when they discover my abnormality.”
“I’m just a weak Beast Tamer. It’s better to leave such a headache to my pet to solve.”
Shi Yu actually let it go.
He directly chose to believe in his pets and believe in his connection with them.
He had already forgotten many things and couldn’t remember many things.
For example, he couldn’t remember the name of the first Beast Tamer he and Eleven defeated.
For example, in the National League, he couldn’t remember the name of his opponent’s pet.
For example, he couldn’t remember how many times he had squeezed Teacher Gem Cat dry.
This feeling of gradually forgetting his memories made Shi Yu feel very stifled. Fortunately, at the moment, they were all unimportant memories. He still remembered the key memories of his pets clearly.
“I’ll go with you. However, can I go home to take a look first? I keep feeling that I forgot something and have to go back,” Shi Yu said as he scratched his head.
“Alright, sure.” Upon hearing that, Shang Qiu nodded.
The car drove quickly.
After an unknown period of time, they finally arrived at Shi Yu’s house.

chapters.title: Chapter 1884: Let Me Back (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1884: Let Me Back (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Under Shi Yu’s invitation, Shang Qiu and Shi Yu entered the house together.
Just as he entered, Shi Yu cursed.
“Moon in the Earth?!” Singing voices came from the living room television. Shi Yu was stunned. He didn’t turn off the television when he went out?
He lived alone.
However, when he went deeper, he discovered an extremely ridiculous scene.
A snow-white rabbit was actually lying on the sofa and watching cartoons on television.
Shi Yu:
Shi Yu felt a sharp pain in his brain again, as if he had recalled something, but he didn’t completely remember it.
“Holy shit.” Seeing this scene, Teacher Shang Qiu, who followed in, also spoke.
At this moment, the rabbit didn’t react when it saw someone enter and continued watching the television.
“Wh-what’s going on?” Shi Yu said.
He tried to remember.
At this moment, Shang Qiu said, “Is this the rabbit you picked up?”
“Has it become a spirit?”
Picked up… That rabbit?
Under the pain in Shi Yu’s brain, memories appeared.
during the last archeological activity…
He passed by the thorny forest and was just about to sit down and rest for a while when he discovered a fat and white rabbit in the swaying grass.
From the looks of it, its leg was injured and it couldn’t run.
Initially, Shi Yu wanted to have an additional meal, but something strange happened. He had already boiled hot water and set up the fire. He was just about to heat it up and roast it, but who knew that this rabbit could also act cute?
After seeing the rabbit act cute aggrievedly, Shi Yu was moved and made do with a fish.
He helped this rabbit bandage its wound and found something for it to eat. Then, he originally wanted to let it go, but who knew that this rabbit would still rely on him?
Just like that, Shi Yu, who was already bored, simply brought it along.
Shi Yu didn’t expect to be able to raise it either, but now, looking at the rabbit that had become fat and even took the initiative to watch television, Shi Yu was stunned.
He looked at the messy house and knew that it must have searched through everything in the house.
Otherwise, with the food reserves he had prepared for the rabbit after he was hospitalized for so many days, the rabbit would most likely starve to death.
“Unbelievable.”
“Could this be the so-called animal awakening after the ‘revival of spiritual energy’?”
Shang Qiu said, “Kid, what kind of luck is this? You casually picked up a rabbit, and it’s actually an animal with talent and potential to transform into a ‘demon’.”
“Oh no, it won’t suddenly attack us, right? The two of us, an old man and a patient who has just been discharged from the hospital, definitely can’t defeat a ‘demon’. Don’t tell me it’ll eat us.” Shang Qiu was shocked.
Shi Yu was also shocked.
He was also shocked. After all, he had wanted to roast the rabbit previously. He was just one step away from eating the rabbit.
If this rabbit remembered anything and bore grudges more deeply, it was really hard to say what it would do next.
However, fortunately, this rabbit was currently obsessed with cartoons.
As it watched the animation, it actually used its psychic power to control a few cabbage leaves from the kitchen and ate them as snacks.
“Is it an ability that has awakened its mental strength?” Shang Qiu said when he saw this. “Looking at the swaying cabbage leaves, it’s not very proficient in controlling them. Well, its battle power shouldn’t be that scary.”
Shi Yu said, “I think I roughly know why I want to return. I actually forgot about this guy and completely forgot that I even adopted a rabbit.”
He had completely forgotten this adoption experience. Even his memories after transmigrating didn’t have it. It was very vague.
“I’m relieved to see that it’s fine. However, there shouldn’t be any rules in the country not to adopt a creature that has awakened its superpower, right?”
Shang Qiu fell into deep thought and said, “There are indeed not many relevant rules now, but it’s good as long as you don’t cause any trouble. Next, such transcendent creatures shouldn’t be rare, and we don’t have that much personal strength to control them all.”
“But no matter what, if you want to raise it, it’s better to bring it along to watch over and educate it.”
“Well, bring it to my old friend too.”
“Can you still order it around now?”
“I’ll give it a try.” Shi Yu took a deep breath and slowly took a few steps forward. “Rabbit, rabbit?”
The white rabbit shook its head and looked at Shi Yu with its red eyes. What was it? Don’t disturb it from watching the finale!

chapters.title: Chapter 1885: Fate (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1885: Fate (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Stop watching the show. Follow me. I’ll play it for you on my cell phone.”
Shi Yu glanced at the television and saw that after the title “The Final Battle”, it was time to review the situation. In a “Beast Taming Duel”, a certain silly thing’s fire-element drake was smashed, causing the competition to lose.
After knowing what the rabbit was watching, Shi Yu directly went forward and pulled it up.
The rabbit spirit was very angry. After being pulled up, it wanted to resist.
However, after approaching it, Shi Yu knew that this rabbit wasn’t very strong.
In terms of strength, it might be equivalent to an “awakening-level” creature.
Even if he had the physique of an ordinary person now, he could easily subdue the other party with his rich battle experience and psychic EXP.
Seeing Shi Yu easily subdue a rabbit who had become a spirit, Teacher Shang Qiu was shocked.
Damn, why didn’t he realize that Shi Yu was so bold previously? Alright, he was probably also just as bold previously.
“There’s no reversal, but this isn’t the final outcome. Don’t worry, I’ll find more shows for you to watch later,” Shi Yu said.
The rabbit spirit was stunned.
“You can communicate with it??” Teacher Shang Qiu asked in surprise.
Could this rabbit understand what Shi Yu was saying?
“Erm.” Shi Yu was also subconsciously stunned. “I’m used to it.”
With telepathy, he was used to communicating with pets directly and forgot that he didn’t have any extraordinary power in the current situation.
However, when Shi Yu looked down at the rabbit spirit, he realized that it seemed to understand.
It was unknown if Shi Yu’s language ability was maxed out or the other party’s intelligence was maxed out.
“Coo, coo!!” The rabbit spirit expressed that it wanted to see the real outcome.
At this moment, Shi Yu instantly knew what the other party meant.
He agreed, but he muttered in his heart, ‘By the time you watch the finale of this anime, you might have already learn to speak.’
Some animes seemed to have ended, but as long as the author wanted to write, the anime could still continue for 1,000 episodes.
“That’s it?”
At that moment, when he saw the rabbit spirit obediently being tamed by Shi Yu and becoming obedient, Teacher Shang Qiu clicked his tongue in wonder again.
He didn’t expect Shi Yu to have the talent of “Beast Taming”.
In myths and legends, there was also a considerable number of big shots who were expert in this field and had one or more powerful demon pets as helpers.
“Teacher, let’s go,” Shi Yu said. He could meet the familiar face the other party mentioned.
He wanted to see how the other party successfully cultivated.
In the car just now, Shi Yu tried to meditate to recover his strength. Even if he cultivated again, he failed.
It was as if there was also a reason why the spiritual energy of heaven and earth was insufficient after being suppressed by the laws of the world.
Soon, in the car.
“What are you doing?” The teacher driving asked when he saw Shi Yu frowning.
“No, no.”
Shi Yu had failed in his cultivation again. He was very speechless.
“By the way, Teacher, what’s the situation over at the ruins I’m exploring?”
“The mountain over there is very dangerous, but when the rescue team went to save you, they discovered some special places. That place might be related to the ‘Jade Rabbit’, but don’t think about it. The most important thing now is to understand your situation.”
“Oh, oh.” Shi Yu nodded. He kept feeling that he had forgotten some key information.
He looked at the white rabbit beside him… The Jade Rabbit… Did he explore the ruins because of it?
Next, Teacher Shang Qiu brought Shi Yu to the residence of his old friend.
During this process, Shi Yu couldn’t help but marvel at how real this world was. Everything he saw along the way was built extremely realistic.
This even gave Shi Yu the illusion that this was really reality and that he had really transmigrated back.
However, there was no reason.
His existence in the next era was the result of the joint efforts of a bunch of cosmic-level big shots, who considered him as the torchbearer.
However, what was the principle behind his transmigration back to this era?
“We’re here.” As Shi Yu was conflicted along the way, he finally arrived at the house of Teacher Shang Qiu’s old friend, who was also a rich woman.
Living in a rather large independent villa, when Shi Yu and Shang Qiu came to visit, a maid was in charge of opening the door.
Then, Shi Yu and the others saw an old granny in luxurious clothes.
The old granny was noble and extremely energetic. She held a walking stick, but her legs weren’t weak at all.
“You’re here,” she said.
“Sister Shu, this is my student.”
“Yes, there’s also an awakened rabbit?” The old woman was slightly surprised to see Shi Yu and the rabbit beside his feet.
“Hello, Senior,” Shi Yu said.
“There’s no need to be reserved,” the old granny said. “I’ve already heard about you. Perhaps you’ll be lucky to survive a disaster. Little Shang, you came at the right time. You guys should check together.”
“Me too?” Shang Qiu was stunned.
“Yes,” Granny Shu said. “Aren’t you curious how I successfully cultivated?”
“Of course I’m curious, but if you don’t say, I won’t ask,” Shang Qiu said.
“We’re all from the ancient family. At this moment, I won’t hide anymore,” Granny Shu said. “My family has an immortal stone passed down from my ancestors.”
“This immortal stone is called ‘Immortal Guidance’.”
“Its effect is also very magical. It can detect the talent aptitude of the people it comes into contact with, test if they have the potential to cultivate, and guide them in the right direction.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1886: Fate (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1886: Fate (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“Before the recovery of spiritual energy, our immortal stone was actually an ordinary rare stone. There was nothing special about it, but some time ago, something unexpected happened.”
“I only entered the sect because of this stone. Unfortunately, apart from an old woman like me, the aptitude of the others in our family isn’t very good.” She shook her head.
“As I expected, soon, other talented humans will also awaken their cultivation talent one after another and have abilities like superpowers. On this point, because humans’ bodies are too complicated, there are many slower animals and plants. Therefore, it’s nothing to let you come into contact with the immortal stone and see if you can cultivate in advance. After all, it’s inevitable.”
“It’s always good to be a step faster than others. In the next unknown world, everyone can help each other.”
“There’s actually such a stone.” Shang Qiu sighed. “Why can’t I get such a good thing…”
“This wasn’t dug up. It was passed down from our ancestors.”
Shi Yu listened to both parties and gradually fell into deep thought.
So the other party relied on props to cultivate. He wondered…
After Shi Yu thanked Granny Shu, both him and Shang Qiu carried out the test.
Unfortunately, Teacher Shang Qiu didn’t detect any cultivation aptitude. Regarding this, Granny Shu was extremely regretful. Being unable to cultivate meant that Shang Qiu’s lifespan had a limit. At that time, she might have to send away old friends one after another.
Although he couldn’t cultivate himself, Shang Qiu was still optimistic. He smiled indifferently and said, “It’s just that I can’t accomplish it at the start. It’s nothing. Even in the current novels, aren’t there ways to ‘change fate’ the day after tomorrow?”
“Perhaps there’s still a chance in the future. Little Yu, quickly give it a try. If you can cultivate, don’t forget me and get me some natural treasures.”
Shi Yu was speechless.
Shi Yu estimated that his shameless personality must have been more or less affected by his teacher’s teaching.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded. He looked at the white immortal stone in front of him and walked forward to come into contact.
At that time, when Shi Yu touched the white immortal stone with both hands, the next moment, the immortal stone began to crazily absorb the already thin spiritual energy of heaven and earth from its surroundings. Soon, through the immortal stone, Shi Yu felt a force surge into his body.
He, who hadn’t cultivated successfully previously, instantly felt endless motivation in his body.
Boom!
The messy airflow circled around Shi Yu, stunning Shang Qiu and Granny Shu.
“Yes.”
“He really has cultivation aptitude!”
After discovering this scene, Granny Shu was shocked and said, “And this posture…”
As Shi Yu came into contact with the immortal stone, the changes around him became greater and greater. Not only was there wind howling, but even space was a little distorted.
Boom!
Soon, Shi Yu was rather incredulous. His palm separated from the immortal stone, and a colorless and transparent prismatic mark appeared out of thin air in front of him.
Upon seeing this mark, Shi Yu was even more surprised.
However, Granny Shu was even more surprised than him. At this moment, she had a shocked expression.
“How is this possible?” Seeing this scene, she exclaimed.
“What’s wrong, what’s going on?” Shang Qiu asked.
Grandma Shu said, “The first time he came into contact with an immortal stone, he should have only vaguely caught a cultivation method. Why did he immediately have results?”
“This mark is… a contract mark!”
“He has the talent to contract demon beasts, and his talent is probably very powerful. He actually entered the sect without cultivating much and cultivated a contract mark.”
“I wasn’t wrong. This divine power was recorded in detail in Jin Cen’s ‘Mutated Beast Record’. Have you forgotten?”
“Mutated Beast Record?” Upon hearing the other party’s words, Teacher Shang Qiu carefully observed Shi Yu’s current situation and seemed to have recalled something. He was slightly surprised.
Wait a minute, he had even said previously that Shi Yu had talent in “Beast Taming”. In the end, it was really in this aspect??
“Coo, coo.” At this moment, the rabbit spirit looked at the prismatic mark condensed by Shi Yu with a wary expression.
“Good lord.” Of course, for Shi Yu, this feeling was a little strange. He was actually not unfamiliar with this prismatic mark. Wasn’t it the contract method of this era?
He had come into contact with it while researching the Chi You Ruins with Senior Panda.
However, Shi Yu was suddenly stunned. His head hurt again. He felt that he should have forgotten something again. Apart from the Chi You Ruins, he should have come into contact with and used this contract method elsewhere, but why couldn’t he remember anything?
Shi Yu grabbed the contract mark and destroyed it. He took a deep breath and said, “The consumption is a little high.”
“Good observation.” At this moment, Granny Shu said in surprise, “Little Shang, your student is really not bad.”
“No wonder you brought a Demon Rabbit. Looks like you’ve long expected it.”
“However, the power of the Beast Taming Technique depends on the beast. Compared to other cultivators, this rabbit’s main body is weak. Would contracting a Demon Rabbit be…”
In other words, if he knew the cultivation system, it would be a loss to contract a Demon Rabbit.
Even if he couldn’t control a Demon Tiger, the king of beasts, getting a Demon Dog contract was better than a Demon Rabbit, right?
This kind of rabbit spirit’s battle power was no different from an ordinary flower pet cat. No, cats could at least catch rats, but rabbits…
The rabbit spirit frowned. It felt like someone was looking down on it.
It couldn’t help but let out a dissatisfied “coo coo”.
“No, my rabbit is very strong.” Shi Yu smiled. As a powerful Beast Tamer, even without the skill index, his mind was filled with countless Beast Taming knowledge.

chapters.title: Chapter 1887: Fate (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1887: Fate (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Even if he really cultivated it from scratch, he was confident that he could nurture a harmless rabbit into a super monster.
But now… he didn’t have the mood. How to go back and escape this dream was the most important thing.
Now that he had found the cultivation method, he might be able to explore some ruins that also had extraordinary power and see if he could trigger some mechanisms.
Moreover, Shi Yu looked at the rabbit.
He also had a baffling feeling that his transmigration this time might be related to this rabbit.
Shi Yu believed that his memory wasn’t bad. He remembered some things clearly even when he was young, but he had actually forgotten everything about adopting a rabbit that happened not long before the mountain collapsed. He needed to see it and be reminded by his teacher to remember. It was too abnormal.
Perhaps it was also a key clue?
At that moment, Shi Yu, who had already forgotten a lot of his memories and had completely forgotten what he was doing before entering, thought hard and analyzed.
However, Shi Yu, who had awakened the contract method, felt very strange.
If his previous life had also awakened his Beast Taming Ability under the guidance of his teacher, wouldn’t that mean that he mainly cultivated the Beast Taming Contract system in his previous life and current life?
This could also be considered fate… He was destined to be a Beast Tamer.
That day, Shi Yu returned alone with the rabbit.
Regardless of whether it was allowed to become a spirit after the founding of the country, Shi Yu carried this rabbit spirit with him.
After confirming that Shi Yu was awakened, Teacher Shang Qiu was relieved. There was an explanation for what had happened to Shi Yu recently.
The reason why he wasn’t crushed to death by the mountain collapse was definitely because he had awakened some potential in an unexpected situation and resisted the danger. The pain in his brain was most likely because the contract method was a spiritual divine power.
Be it Shang Qiu or Granny Shu, they let Shi Yu rest well when he returned. They weren’t in a hurry to casually get him to make a contract.
However, Shi Yu didn’t care so much. If he was obedient, he wouldn’t be Shi Yu. After he returned, he directly pulled the rabbit up and said, “Do you want to sign a contract with me?”
“After the contract is over, I’ll take you to explore the ruins. It’s exciting.”
Rabbit:
“Coo, coo!!” The rabbit struggled, indicating that it wanted to watch animes. Its two ears kept shaking.
“If you don’t contract or explore the ruins with me, I won’t show you animes.”
Rabbit:
“Coo! Coo!”
In the end, the rabbit submitted to Shi Yu’s might. Shi Yu chuckled and condensed a prismatic mark that fused into the rabbit spirit’s body.
“It’s beneficial to both parties. Don’t resist and don’t be nervous.”
Under the rabbit spirit’s aggrieved gaze, Shi Yu directly contracted it. In the next moment, the contract mark fused, and the contract between the two parties was completed!
At this moment, Shi Yu immediately sensed that his physical fitness had received feedback, especially his mental strength.
However, as his mental strength increased, what stunned Shi Yu even more was that his brain began to hurt again.
The intense pain this time had another explanation. After he contracted this rabbit, as Shi Yu had guessed, this rabbit was indeed the key to him accidentally entering this unknown world.
A forgotten memory gradually appeared.
White-robed Lily, Black-robed Empress, Super Empress, a rabbit, Cosmic Sea crisis, a contract, charging to the cosmic level…
Shi Yu suddenly recalled a pile of forgotten memories. He was drenched in sweat and had a splitting headache.
“Ah…” With a low roar, Shi Yu panted and froze on the spot.
He looked at the shocked rabbit spirit… No, he was the one who was shocked.
“I remember.”
“I remember everything.”
“Not long ago, I should have established a contract with the Empress to try to break through to the cosmic level.”
“So, did it succeed or fail? Why did I come to such a place?”
“Moreover…”
At this moment, Shi Yu’s balls hurt as he looked at the little white rabbit.
“Don’t tell me you…”
“Coo, coo?”
Looking at the confused little white rabbit, Shi Yu was a little nervous. Very nervous, in fact.
Damn, is this white rabbit the Super Empress?
Did I also contract the Super Empress in my previous life?
The Super Empress was my pet to begin with?
Most importantly, on our first meeting, I actually tried to eat the Super Empress?
After recalling everything, Shi Yu connected some of the memories that appeared when he first contracted the Super Empress to all his current memories and deduced a fact that made his balls hurt.
Regardless of whether he had contracted the Empress like he was now in his previous life, it was worth affirming that the Empress definitely knew him in the lost memories.
“I contracted the rabbit and successfully recovered my memories with the Empress. This means that this rabbit is most likely the Empress. However, I’ve recovered my memories and even completed the contract. Why can’t I go back?” Shi Yu was confused.
“Coo, coo? (Animes?)” The rabbit suspected to be the Super Empress asked.
Shi Yu felt depressed.
Ancestor, stop talking.
It’s annoying.
If I knew more about your dark childhood history, even if the contract was completed and I returned, you would have to kill me.
In short, if the Super Empress was really a contracted beast from his previous life, Shi Yu felt that he had definitely angered and embarrassed her.
What a sin.
“Let’s see on the way. I want to go somewhere now,” Shi Yu said with a deep breath.
Rabbit:
“I have to go.” Because just now, he remembered everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1888: Fate (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1888: Fate (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Apart from the memories of the Super Empress, there were also some memories of his previous life that he had forgotten after transmigrating.
Of course, it didn’t mean the memories after the mountain collapsed.
Instead, it was the memories after adopting the white rabbit.
After adopting the white rabbit, Shi Yu was suddenly very interested in the rabbit.
Therefore, after he checked the ancient books, he discovered a ruin that might be related to the legendary Jade Rabbit, so he wanted to explore it.
In the end, the mountain collapsed and directly crushed him.
In addition, he recalled what Teacher Shang Qiu had said just now. The ruins he had explored were indeed related to the Jade Rabbit. This made Shi Yu even more certain.
This ruin might be the next key point.
There was no other reason than that the ability of the Super Empress was too similar to the Jade Rabbit. He even teased the Empress by guessing that she might be the Jade Rabbit.
But from the looks of it, the Super Empress was clearly a not very smart little white rabbit.
But why was the ability of the Super Empress so similar to the Jade Rabbit and even had the talent to smash medicine?
Perhaps Shi Yu could find some clues in this ruin. Since he had undergone some changes after contracting the little white rabbit, perhaps he could push the progress again if he found the mystery of the Empress’s power next.
“Interesting.” Shi Yu was suddenly full of energy.
However, the face of the young Empress beside him fell, and it couldn’t say anything.
It wanted to see animes!
Two days later.
Shi Yu appeared near the ruins of the collapsed mountain in his previous life.
Because of the previous disaster, this place had already been sealed.
Although they had confirmed that there were ancient ruins here, before eliminating the danger, the other archeological teams didn’t dare to enter rashly.
Shi Yu brought the little white rabbit and secretly crossed the blockade all the way into the main area.
“Be careful.” Shi Yu didn’t want to be buried again, so he warned the rabbit. “I’ve played animes for you in the car for so long. When I encounter danger later, you have to save me.”
Rabbit:
What?
After they signed the contract, the rabbit could sense Shi Yu’s thoughts even more. As it had established an equality contract, the big white rabbit’s impression of Shi Yu improved a little. In fact, none of this mattered. Shi Yu only hoped that it didn’t remember any grudge of almost being eaten.
“Coo, coo?”
Along the way, apart from watching cartoons, Shi Yu also taught the little white rabbit how to use psychic power.
It was unknown if the other party was talented or if Shi Yu had taught it well. Its learning speed was simply the best batch of pets Shi Yu had ever seen. It was so outstanding compared to Buggy at that time.
In just a day or two, witohut even using any nutritional resources, the rabbit relied on nibbling on carrots to practice to the point where it could sense with psychic power.
At this moment, after sensing the nearby situation, the young Empress suddenly reminded Shi Yu.
Underground!
The ground not far away was empty. There was another ruin underground!
Shi Yu:
“Oh.” Shi Yu was stunned. “As expected, I didn’t teach you for nothing. You’ve made a huge contribution.”
“However, I didn’t bring any tools. How do I dig down?”
“Why don’t you know Instant Transmission?”
Rabbit: “?”
“I’m just kidding. Sense if there are any mechanisms to enter.”
“Coo, coo.” The Empress’s young face turned bitter. Why don’t Shi Yu teach her Instant Transmission?
“You’re the boss, so rest first.” Shi Yu didn’t dare to squeeze too much out of the rabbit, afraid that the Empress would also recover her memories and bear a grudge.
After a while, the rabbit successfully found a secret passage that led to the underground ruins through its psychic perception.
Shi Yu and the others carefully opened it and entered. They arrived at a place that looked like an ancient tomb or a cave.
However, after going deeper, Shi Yu was stunned.
Because this was really a f*cking tomb.
Moreover, what was extremely ridiculous was the words on the tombstone. What the hell?
Tomb of the Time Sprite, Also the Jade Rabbit Empress, Revered Above All

chapters.title: Chapter 1889: The Boundaries of Past and Present Life (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1889: The Boundaries of Past and Present Life (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“What’s this?”
Time Sprite, also known as the Jade Rabbit Emperor?
Could these words be put together?
the Jade Rabbit was a Time Sprite???
“Coo.” The young Empress, who couldn’t read, had a puzzled expression as it asked Shi Yu what this was.
At this moment, Shi Yu ignored it and fell into deep thought.
He looked around, not knowing where to start.
Should he “strategically” dig up the tomb first?
However, before Shi Yu could attack…
There was a crack.
The tombstone cracked on its own.
A crack suddenly spread, scaring Shi Yu.
At the same time, Shi Yu felt as if ants were crawling in his heart, and his ears were ringing.
“Listen to the Voice of History.”
“Even now, I can still use this ability.”
Shi Yu had originally lost all his strength, including the ability to communicate telepathically, so he naturally lost some special archeological skills.
However, he didn’t expect that at this moment, in the face of “archeological ruins”, his special skill could still be activated.
He saw the shadow of history, or rather, the shadow of history that the tomb owner wanted him to see, which was the tomb owner’s message.
Firstly, Shi Yu saw a strange little elf fleeing in the universe in panic.
Then, they saw a panicked Moon Rabbit fleeing through the universe.
In the end, this Moon Rabbit came to Earth and built a tomb for itself.
At this moment, in the midst of the absent-minded archeology, Shi Yu seemed to have been able to cross space and time to talk to the other party’s traces with the sound of listening.
“Who are you?” Shi Yu asked.
“Hello, fated person.” Shi Yu seemed to have really heard the other party’s message.
“Firstly, let me introduce myself.”
“My initial race is the Time Sprite.”
“It’s a race that can travel through space and time and transmigrate time.”
“As my racial abilities are too rare, my battle power is extremely weak, causing me to become the prey of many experts.”
“In order to avoid the enemy, I can only escape everywhere.”
“In the end, I even chose to give up the power of the Time Sprite through reincarnation.”
“However, I didn’t expect that I would actually reincarnate into a rabbit and be captured to refine medicine.”
“Moreover, with my peerless talent, I actually refined a medicinal pill that can allow anyone to become a true immortal.”
“But this also caused me to become the target of covetous eyes again.”
“Many experts covet my ability and even want to lock me up permanently and let me refine medicine. Fortunately, during the refinement process, I refined a medicinal pill that awakened the ability of my previous life, recovered the power of space and time, and escaped again.”
“This experience…” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. Was the identity of this tomb owner so complicated?
Its initial race was a Time Sprite. Similar to Qi, it was also captured and then reincarnated, but it actually reincarnated into a rabbit with the talent to refine medicine. It was also captured and controlled, becoming a Jade Rabbit…
Only when it recovered the power of the Time Sprite could it escape again.
However, the other party should be stronger than Qi. After Qi reincarnated, it didn’t know anything. This Time Sprite had at least activated its alchemy talent.
The incident was far from over.
“These two experiences have made me angry. However, my physique is still not suitable for battle.”
“When I developed a medicinal pill to let the Time Sprite master its battle ability, the spiritual aura began to dry up. The worst thing happened. The universe was about to restart.”
“At this moment, even my spatial travel ability is sealed.”
“However, I won’t wait for death. In the last opportunity, I developed the Space-time Pill. It can allow my space-time attainments to temporarily reach the ‘cosmic level’, break through the seal, and transmigrate.”
“At this moment, I’ve decided to head to the next era to avoid the restart of the universe. This seems to be the direction many people are working hard in.”
“When you see this, I’ve already set off. Perhaps I succeeded, or perhaps I failed. Just in case, I built a tomb for myself first. Moreover, no matter what, I want to leave something for this space and time.”
“In this tomb, there’s my alchemy inheritance and the method to open the Space-time Dragon Vein and transmigrate space and time.”
“The fact that you can come here means that we’re fated. As long as you’re willing, you can inherit these. You just need to beat up the factions and names on the grudge book under my tombstone.”
“Well, of course, some of them are already dead, but it’s not a big problem. You can transmigrate into space and time, but let me remind you that the lifespan of the universe is not much now. If you want to transmigrate into space and time, the universe will accelerate death. When the main universe restarts, the parallel universe will also collapse. Therefore, when the time comes, you will definitely be wanted by the various large factions. You have to be careful.”
Shi Yu:
Shi Yu’s conversation with the historical message across space and time completely ended.
At that time, when Yu returned to his senses, he didn’t know how much time had passed.
At this moment, Shi Yu stood on the spot in a daze. He felt that he seemed to know something again.
“I didn’t expect that the ruins I wanted to explore in my previous life were actually the ruins of the Time Sprite.”
“This makes sense.”
“Why did the Empress master the talent to refine medicine? Why did I transmigrate to the Chi You era?”
“In my previous life on Earth, I definitely came to this ruin and obtained the inheritance. I gave the alchemy inheritance to the Empress, and I learned the method to control the Space-time Dragon Vein and transmigrated into space and time.”
“After transmigrating into space and time, ‘I’ entered the eyes of various experts. As the ‘inheritor’ of a peerless Time Sprite, I’m naturally one of the best candidates to be sent to the next era to carry out the Pyro Plan.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1890: The Boundaries of Past and Present Life (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1890: The Boundaries of Past and Present Life (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
After investigating the information of this ruin, many things could suddenly be roughly sorted out. Shi Yu took a deep breath. He didn’t expect that the turning point in his previous life was actually this ruin.
In addition, this “Jade Rabbit Emperor” actually refined a medicinal pill that allowed his spatial attainments to temporarily reach the cosmic level and advance to the next era?
This Time Jade Rabbit was so exaggerated.
He didn’t know if it succeeded.
Shi Yu felt that it should have failed. At least in 11 years, he had never heard of any Time Sprite that could refine medicine.
“Senior, have a safe trip. Although you didn’t transmigrate successfully, at least your inheritor, we transmigrated successfully.”
Shi Yu looked into the tomb, wanting to dig the tomb again in this world to find the other party’s inheritance.
“Bunny, there’s something good.” Shi Yu looked at the rabbit beside him. Although he knew that it was illusory, he still planned to share the alchemy inheritance with her.
At the same time.
In the real world, in the Cosmic Sea, in the Empress Mystic Realm.
A month had passed since Shi Yu signed a contract with the Super Empress to work towards breaking through to the cosmic level.
On the first day of the contract, Shi Yu fainted during the contract process.
“Master hasn’t woken up yet?”
