Almost every day, Ling brought Eleven and the other pets to visit the unconscious and sleeping Shi Yu.
“Not yet, but the contract… is still in progress.”
“I didn’t expect this situation either.” At this moment, the Super Empress was fine, but Shi Yu’s situation wasn’t ideal.
Whether it was successful or not, it shouldn’t be this sign.
However, Shi Yu fainted for no reason. No one could awaken Shi Yu, nor did they know what had happened to him.
Strangely, while Shi Yu was unconscious, the contract was still in progress and not over.
Everyone had no choice but to wait.
“We can’t continue like this.” Although Ling was very afraid of the Empress, it still said seriously, “The backlash on our bodies… is getting more and more serious.”
“What exactly happened to him?”
If it was just a month of coma, the pets could still wait.
But during this process, there was a very terrifying backlash on them.
As time passed, they were forgetting their memories of Shi Yu.
If not for Susu’s memory water drop, they might have completely forgotten about Shi Yu.
Even if he was as calm as Ling, he began to panic after a month.
The current situation was too strange.
This phenomenon made Eleven and the other beasts very afraid that they had completely forgotten about Shi Yu.
He could still recall it with Susu now, but as time passed, he had no idea what would happen.
Now, the pets were a little regretful that Shi Yu had signed a contract with the Empress. If they had known earlier, they would have listened to Qi and not let Shi Yu touch the risky contract this time.
But now, it was too late to say anything. Even the Super Empress, who had cosmic spiritual attainments, didn’t understand what had happened to Shi Yu and what was going on.
“I will…” At this moment, the Empress was just about to say something when she suddenly felt the touch of the contract. Then, she was stunned. This was because at this moment, even she, a cosmic level, couldn’t withstand the backlash of the contract. Suddenly, she felt dizzy.
Right on the heels of that, under the shocked gazes of Ling and the others, the Super Empress actually fell unconscious like Shi Yu when she contracted him previously.
“Wu!!!”
“Ning!!!” At this moment, all the pets were anxious, especially Susu. At this time, their forgotten memories were very difficult to recover with ordinary memory water droplets. Just as they recalled it, they would immediately forget, as if they had involved some higher power.
During this period, it had always been with the Empress’s help to strengthen the water droplets that they could successfully recover every time.
But now, even the Empress had gotten into trouble. Susu and the others immediately didn’t know what to do.
In the memory world of his previous life.
Shi Yu and the Empress cub had already received their inheritances.
Countless knowledge about space and time surged into Shi Yu’s brain, allowing Shi Yu’s understanding of the power of space and time to deepen.
“I was originally worried that my spatial attainments weren’t enough to break through to the cosmic level, but now that I’ve recovered the memories of this inheritance, it should be enough.” Shi Yu took a deep breath.
“Buggy, how are you?”
At this moment, Shi Yu also looked at the Jade Rabbit that had finished accepting the alchemy inheritance.
However, to Shi Yu’s surprise, the big white rabbit was looking at him in shock.
“Shi Yu, where is this?”
Shi Yu:
A familiar voice sounded, stunning Shi Yu.
“Holy shit, you came in too???” Shi Yu’s words made the Empress frown.
Soon, a memory that should have belonged to her appeared in her mind.
“Is this the memory of my previous life?”
At this moment, the Super Empress was extremely surprised.
However, when he saw her reaction, Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
F*ck, it was over.
From the perspective of the Empress, she had experienced her birth, injuries, and almost becoming someone’s food. She was forced to survive by acting cute.
The Super Empress: What’s this???
At that moment, the Empress was extremely shocked.
He never expected that at the start of his previous life, it was actually just an ordinary rabbit. Moreover, it almost became a meal for a familiar face.
“I want an explanation.” Before the Empress could finish speaking, Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. At this moment, many memories appeared with the Empress.

chapters.title: Chapter 1891: The Boundaries of Past and Present Life (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1891: The Boundaries of Past and Present Life (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
The memories that appeared on both sides weren’t what they had experienced just now.
Instead, it really seemed to have happened.
The little white rabbit was adopted by Shi Yu. Both parties encountered the recovery of spiritual energy. Shi Yu changed his profession to a Beast Tamer and formed a partner with the little white rabbit. The two parties began to wander and explore ruins in the new transcendent world.
Until they arrived at this Time Sprite Ruins, where both parties accepted the inheritance and soared into the sky.
Shi Yu was in charge of earning money to buy medicinal herbs, and the Jade Rabbit was in charge of refining medicine. It helped Shi Yu train his body and help him become stronger. The combination of the two parties rose quickly. Even some revived ancient experts were extremely shocked.
However, the tallest tree would be destroyed by the wind. Soon, the Empress’s ability was exposed. In addition, when both parties explored the ancient ruins and obtained many treasures, they offended many factions. They encountered the most dangerous encirclement, and there were people much stronger than them participating.
This time, it could be said that they were really at the end of the road. It was the closest to death for both parties, but there was always a way out. At the critical moment when the strong enemy descended, Shi Yu and the others escaped to a Space-time Dragon Vein…
Shi Yu directly used his ability to activate the Space-time Dragon Vein and transmigrate space and time to dodge the enemy.
The memories ended here.
Shi Yu and the Empress seemed to have experienced a long dream. They had just woken up and were still in a daze.
“Is this my previous life?” The Super Empress had mixed feelings.
As the Black Empress, she suddenly understood why Lily was so concerned about Shi Yu.
Because in their previous life, they were Shi Yu’s contracted beasts.
Although she still didn’t know what they had experienced after touching the Space-time Dragon Vein, the initial growth experience was undoubtedly spent with Shi Yu on that planet called Earth.
“I see. It’s not much different from what I experienced previously.”
At this moment, Shi Yu recovered. After being in a daze, he also scratched his head with a smile. He looked at the Empress and said, “We’re not family, so we don’t enter the same house. Be it in our previous lives or this life, it looks like we’re the best partners.”
“Long time no see, Buggy.”
The Super Empress: “?”
The Super Empress said, “Compared to catching up, you should think of a way to leave this damn place.”
The Empress had a thousand things to say at this moment.
However, when it reached his mouth, he still didn’t say it out loud. Instead, he reminded Shi Yu of his current crisis.
The contract had yet to be completed, and the crisis had yet to disappear. Even she had fallen into danger.
“Huh??”
“In the outside world, a month has passed. Ever since the start of the contract, you’ve been unconscious. Are you trapped here?”
“No matter how I awaken you, you can’t awaken. Even I can’t awaken you.”
“Of course, if that’s all, it’s nothing. But during this process, your pet is continuously forgetting memories related to you.”
“It’s as if you shouldn’t belong to that universe.”
“What?” Upon hearing the Empress’s words, Shi Yu was stunned. “Eleven and the others are also forgetting me?”
After Shi Yu hurriedly entered, he completely forgot all his memories of the Empress. Then, he gradually began to forget other memories and told the Empress.
After hearing that, the Empress fell into deep thought and said, “So, you’re here, and between you and your contracted partner, you’re forgetting each other?”
“However, why exactly did a transmigrator have to experience such a thing when breaking through to the cosmic level? Why didn’t I encounter it?”
At this moment, Shi Yu’s stomach hurt. “It might be related to the fact that I’m a human?”
“But no matter what, don’t you have a way to break this world?” At this moment, Shi Yu no longer wanted to stay in this world.
“Unfortunately,” the Empress said. “After arriving here, my strength is only this little in front of you. I’m helpless.”
The Empress had a serious expression. This seemed to be the most troublesome desperate situation she had encountered since transmigrating…
However…
She looked at Shi Yu, who was in deep thought. The emergence of memories just now made her heart tremble greatly. Although she didn’t show it to Shi Yu, this feeling of recovering her true self made the Empress’s heart ache.
If they really had to be trapped here continuously, it seemed like a good choice for her and Shi Yu to recover the remaining memories.
This way, Shi Yu didn’t have to take any risk of becoming the holder of the universe.
“Why don’t…”
“No.” As if he knew what the Empress was talking about, Shi Yu said, “After hearing you out, I’m worried about Eleven and the others. I can’t stay here anymore.”
It was very difficult for the Super Empress to imagine that Shi Yu would say words of worry about a group of “peak super divines”.
However, in fact, Eleven and the others were actually just children in Shi Yu’s eyes.
Although the Empress said it calmly, Shi Yu could imagine how Eleven and the others were also gradually forgetting their feelings.
Perhaps it was a little narcissistic, but Shi Yu knew that in the hearts of some guys, he was the only one. If he wasn’t around…
“But what other way is there?” The Empress was also trying very hard to awaken herself through various methods. However, after arriving here, she, a cosmic level, felt helpless for the first time.
This strange world bound everything to them.
“Yes.” Shi Yu took a deep breath and sat down on the spot. He closed his eyes slightly and searched for the contract connection that should have existed in his originally nonexistent sea of consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1892: The Boundaries of Past and Present Life (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1892: The Boundaries of Past and Present Life (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“As long as the hearts of both parties resonate, they can break through all shackles and find each other.”
“I believe in my connection with Eleven and the others.”
“Wuu.”
“Wu!!”
The Empress was also unconscious, and after Shi Yu didn’t wake up, Eleven and the others immediately fell into a leaderless state. It was chaotic.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and every other pet surrounded Shi Yu and the others.
“Roar!! (Big Sister, quickly think of a way.)” Even the brainless Little Ji couldn’t help but urge.
As for Eleven and the others, they looked even more panicked, afraid that they would completely forget Shi Yu in the next second.
They really couldn’t understand what had happened to Shi Yu.
“Sorry.” However, at this moment, even Ling really couldn’t think of a good solution. After all, even the power of the Empress couldn’t awaken Shi Yu previously. Even Susu’s memory water drop gradually couldn’t reverse the forgetfulness of its memories.
This kind of thing that involved the unknown spatial laws was definitely related to Shi Yu’s transmigrator identity.
With its current ability, it couldn’t understand.
“I can’t think of a way, but we have to awaken Master and not forget him. This is what we have to do.” As Ling finished speaking, many pets were stunned and nodded.
“I’ve already gotten my clone to seek Lord World King’s help. Before that, what we have to do is repeatedly deepen our memories and constantly awaken Master…”
At this moment, Ling had become everyone’s backbone. Eleven and the others nodded and started to recall.
Ling recalled that when it was born, it had been given the mission to help Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Shi Yu become stronger. It could be said that the meaning of its birth was to help Shi Yu become the strongest Beast Tamer.
If not for Shi Yu, it would have no meaning in existence.
In fact, if it forgot Shi Yu, it would even forget where it was born.
This mechanical spirit that had already become the strongest mechanical life form in the 11th era but was still young had no idea where it would go when the time came. It was very confused.
“Ning.” Susu kept calling. Even if she no longer protected the Guardian Sea of Stars, she didn’t want to lose Shi Yu and forget Shi Yu.
If not for Shi Yu, she might have long ended the countless reincarnations of the Blue Sea Sprite in the form of a slime and ended the final reincarnation. She would have completely returned to death. She would have been born in the sea and died in the sea.
There would be no happy experience at all. Although the team was very complicated and she had yet to be first in the team after being tricked into joining the team, letting Shi Yu see that she had become the strongest in the team, she liked this place very much. Even the ducks of the Abyss Race liked it very much and liked every teammate.
“Mi.” Chi Tong even landed on Shi Yu in the form of a sword spirit and kept calling out. As Shi Yu’s guardian spirit, a soul that had been personally born by Shi Yu, she was also afraid of losing the meaning of existence like Ling. If not for Shi Yu, she might still be sealed in the dark ruins until now.
Perhaps she wasn’t everything to Shi Yu, but Shi Yu was everything to her.
“Yi.” During the period when Shi Yu was unconscious, Baby Ginseng had been replenishing Shi Yu’s body with nutrition. Baby Ginseng didn’t like others to treat it as a supplement. It had brushed past death countless times and had always hoped to obtain a chance to escape the fate of its race.
This opportunity was given by Shi Yu. If not for Shi Yu, it might still be using it as a supplement and doing things it didn’t like.
However, Baby Ginseng had different feelings for Shi Yu. It was willing to be Shi Yu’s supplement for the rest of its life and help its often weak Beast Tamer recover to his optimal state. Every time this happened, although it was complaining, Baby Ginseng could experience a happier mood than becoming stronger.
It turned out that it didn’t hate becoming a supplement, but it hated becoming a supplement for people it didn’t like.
“Ji.” Shi Yu fainted. Buggy, who originally thought that it could enter Shi Yu’s dream, had also experienced failure many times. Its current mood was also extremely complicated. If it weren’t for Shi Yu, it would have already died of old age on that persimmon tree. It wouldn’t have had the life of a legend at all. Buggy, who had dreams in its heart, was given by Shi Yu. It really didn’t dare to imagine what would happen after it completely forgot Shi Yu.
Even if it became the strongest race in the universe after evolution, without the Beast Tamer who created all of this sharing the joy of evolution beside it, Buggy felt that it wouldn’t be happy either.
“Sob.” Eleven might be the most anxious at this moment. As Shi Yu’s initial pet, it had witnessed the bond between Shi Yu and every new pet. It knew very well that no one could forget Shi Yu or lose Shi Yu. Otherwise, it would lose the most important part of its life process.
It still wanted to stay in Shi Yu’s pocket, still want to hang on Shi Yu’s shoulder, still want to let Shi Yu sleep with it as a pillow, still want to fight side by side with Shi Yu and become stronger together, but it was unwilling. At that time, no matter what, it couldn’t remember who Shi Yu was.
If that was the case, it would rather not become stronger. That future wasn’t the future it wanted. It just wanted to stay with Shi Yu forever.
Little Ji, Duckie, Qi… Every pet kept recalling and working hard to remember so that they wouldn’t forget. At the same time, they kept waking Shi Yu up through telepathy.
After losing the Empress, Shi Yu fell into an unknown state again. At this moment, their wishes and will had reached a peak. No matter what, they wanted to awaken Shi Yu and stop forgetting about Shi Yu.
If not for Shi Yu, they would have lost the meaning of their lives, so nothing could happen to Shi Yu.
So what if it was at the cosmos level? At most, they wouldn’t break through. They just needed Shi Yu.
Countless strong thoughts were added to Shi Yu. In the memory world, Shi Yu, who had his eyes closed, suddenly sensed something.
Shi Yu, who was also constantly calling his pets, suddenly saw a beam of light that broke through the spatial memory world.
Shi Yu and the Super Empress raised their heads slightly. When they saw the beam, the latter revealed a stunned expression, while the former smiled.
“Found you.”
“Don’t worry, I’m fine,” Shi Yu said slowly. He directly stretched out his hand and tore open the memory world of his previous life along the beam, tearing open the passage back to reality.
Seeing this scene, the Super Empress’s mood was shocked and complicated. She never expected that Shi Yu, who couldn’t even awaken a cosmic level like her, a mysterious place that could even trap a cosmic level like her, would actually be easily torn open just like that.
“This power…” the Empress muttered.
“As long as the pets are still around, there’s no place to trap me.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Let’s go. No matter what, let’s go back first.”
At this moment, seeing Shi Yu break free from the restraints of the memory world of her previous life and successfully return to reality, the Empress was stunned. She also stepped in. Although her memories hadn’t been completely recovered, perhaps she knew what she was looking for.
At the same time, in the outside world.
As Shi Yu and the Empress slowly opened their eyes, every pet of Shi Yu revealed a pleasantly surprised expression. Seeing that Shi Yu had finally woken up, they cried out in joy.
However, as Shi Yu and the Empress woke up this time, Shi Yu immediately completed the most gorgeous change in history.
Strands of cosmic origin power circled around him. After he opened his starry eyes, his strength finally broke through the shackles of the super divine level and stepped into the threshold of the cosmic level in one go.
At this moment, the starry sky power of the entire universe seemed to be cheering for the birth of a new cosmic emperor.
“Sorry to have made you worry.” After Shi Yu woke up, he didn’t care about his level. Instead, he smiled at Eleven and the others. Apart from the Empress, it was all thanks to the help of these little guys that he could break through to the cosmic level this time.
It was all thanks to everyone’s hard work that they could advanced to the cosmic level.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven and the others were overjoyed. Great!!
Shi Yu was finally back!
Moreover, they could also sense that the contract connection between them and Shi Yu was even stronger. This time, they definitely wouldn’t forget Shi Yu.
Although they were frightened previously, joy quickly rushed into their hearts now.
Let’s celebrate! From today onwards, their Beast Tamer, Shi Yu, was the seventh cosmic emperor!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1893: Finally Reaching the Cosmic Level (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1893: Finally Reaching the Cosmic Level (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
World King Planet.
Ever since the World King woke up, although its state was weak, it had been silently protecting the Cosmic Sea and maintaining the barrier corroded by the Dark King and the Beastmaster.
This was also to buy enough time for the Super Empress and Shi Yu.
Although the Super Empress and Shi Yu didn’t have much reason to protect the Cosmic Sea, the Dark King was destined to be mortal enemies with the cleansing star spirit. The enemy of an enemy was a friend.
With Shi Yu and the others around, they could definitely share the pressure on the World King Planet.
However, breaking through to the cosmic level was easier said than done. Even if Shi Yu displayed the aptitude of the seventh cosmic emperor, and his talent was peerless since ancient times and over two eras, the World King still felt that it was a little too impatient.
It wasn’t that it didn’t believe that Shi Yu could break through to the cosmic level, but that breaking through at the last minute in such a situation was too sharp.
If it were given the choice, even if it could break through, it would choose to settle down for hundreds of millions of years and accumulate enough confidence before trying.
As Ling’s clone arrived anxiously, the World King’s will knew that something had happened!
“Lord World King!!”
After Ling’s clone arrived at the World King Planet, it immediately summoned the World King’s will. With its peak super divine ability, it could already do it.
But whether it wanted to care or not was up to the will of the World King.
Ling’s clone was just about to tell the World King about Shi Yu and beg the World King to take a look at the situation, but suddenly, Ling’s clone was stunned.
He sensed the reversal of the situation from his main body!
Master woke up, and the Empress woke up at the cosmic level!
“Lord World King, Master has already broken through to the cosmic level. This day is worth celebrating with the entire universe. I specially came to tell Lord World King that I’m very grateful for your support. There’s no need for the congratulatory gift.”
World King:
Congratulatory gift?
Wait…
Breaking through… to the cosmic level?
The World King sent a wisp of its mind to sense the state of the Cosmic Sea. Then, it was shocked. This was because the weak state and all its energy was used to maintain the Cosmic Sea barrier, causing its perception to decrease greatly.
With this perception, it immediately discovered that the cosmic power of the entire Cosmic Sea was trembling. It could be explained as a trembling of joy and celebration, or it could be understood as fear and helpless trembling.
For the universe, it might not matter how many super divine levels there were, but a cosmic level being had already reached the point where it could give the universe a headache.
In other words, fighting at the super divine level in the universe was equivalent to giving the universe a scratch. No matter how intense the battle was, the universe wasn’t affected.
In fact, if they fought for a longer time, the damage speed wouldn’t be able to keep up with the self-healing speed of the universe.
However, the cosmic level was different. It really had the initial ability to destroy the universe. Some powerful cosmic levels were completely capable of affecting the state of the universe.
For example, the cosmic-level big boss from the last era who created the cosmic virus was aiming for the destruction of the universe.
The current Dark King was also using its relics to affect the state of the universe.
If it was said that the super divine level of most races might not be able to live for 10 billion years and could not be equal to the lifespan of the universe, the lifespan of the universe level definitely exceeded 10 billion years, reaching the point of longevity, immortality, immortal body, immortal soul, and eternal thought.
Perhaps only the self-destruction of the universe could destroy the cosmic level. Otherwise, even if it was the calamity of the universe’s laws, the cosmic emperor could easily ignore it and destroy it with a thought.
It was also because of this that when the universe wanted to restart, cosmic levels beings would use various evasive methods to survive, resist, or escape.
The World King didn’t expect Shi Yu to really succeed. He successfully contracted the Empress in such a short period of time. This was simply unbelievable.
“In the lifetime of a mortal, he has been shining for a hundred years. His cultivation time in this lifetime won’t exceed 20 years. Such a young cosmic level is an extremely ridiculous existence even in the ten eras in front of us. Perhaps the fate of this era will be different from other eras?”
The World King knew that it had to prepare a huge congratulatory gift according to this Mechanical Spirit.
The birth of a new cosmic emperor was worth celebrating with a cosmic treasure!
At the moment, with the Cosmic Sea sealed, the other cosmic levels probably didn’t know that another terrifying emperor with unlimited potential had been born here.
Empress Mystic Realm.
Although Shi Yu’s life level had reached the cosmic level after contracting the Empress, he had yet to completely reach the cosmic level. The transformation of his body and strength required time.
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at his pets with a smile. The pets also looked at him in anticipation.
Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space had the greatest change in its life level. The original small universe Beast Taming Space that was similar to a universe was only the size of a galaxy with dozens of planets. It was a small starry sky.
This scale was neither big nor small. The scale was even inferior to a first-level realm on World King Planet.
But now, Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space had expanded to an endless extent. Not to mention a first-level realm, it even had hundreds of first-level realms.
Shi Yu estimated that in an instant, the scale of his Beast Taming Space might expand to a level comparable to and close to the inner space of World King Planet.
Such a large Beast Taming Space also meant that the growth nutrients Shi Yu could provide to his pets now were completely not inferior to a terrifying Star Emperor like the World King Planet.
Even if he didn’t rely on other abilities, it probably wouldn’t take much effort for Shi Yu to nurture a pet at the peak of the super divine level from scratch with just this Beast Taming Space.
As he broke through, various powers appeared on Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1894: Finally Reaching the Cosmic Level (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1894: Finally Reaching the Cosmic Level (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
At this moment, Shi Yu’s telepathy power had reached a qualitative leap.
A voice in hundreds of millions sounded in Shi Yu’s mind.
“Shi Yu? Number one in the God Sealing Battle and turned the God Sealing Battle into an internal team competition? Really?”
“What, killed hundreds of super divines in one hit? The seventh cosmic emperor?”
“I really want to marry Shi Yu.”
“I really want to be Shi Yu’s pet.”
“Demon Mirror, who’s more handsome, me or Blue Planet’s Shi Yu?”
Countless thoughts resounded in Shi Yu’s heart, making Shi Yu understand that at least for the time being, as long as anyone called his real name in the huge Cosmic Sea, as long as anyone thought of him, he could spy on everything about them.
Upon hearing these thoughts, Shi Yu had a strange expression. He felt that some places had just been connected to the Internet and that some people were too bold.
“Bastard Shi Yu.”
In fact, Shi Yu even heard someone scolding him. He couldn’t tolerate it at all.
He was just about to cross countless star areas and send down the punishment of the cosmic emperor to let the other party understand that the cosmic emperor couldn’t be humiliated…
But after locking onto it, he realized that the one who scolded him was actually the gem cat.
In that case, it was fine.
However, he still had to punish it.
“Ugh.” Shi Yu used a great divine power to temporarily change the gem fruit he had just placed in its mouth to the Cultivation Fruit.
In the next moment, the gem cat, who didn’t have any protective measures or mental preparation, turned pale and purple. It immediately hugged the trash can and retched.
However, Shi Yu really couldn’t take this ability for a long time. He immediately turned off this widespread telepathy. There were too many creatures in the Cosmic Sea. If he kept activating this ability, he would sooner or later be annoyed enough to explode and want to destroy the Cosmic Sea.
Of course, telepathy was only one of the many abilities that upgraded and transformed with Shi Yu.
Apart from that, there was also physical control. At this moment, Shi Yu felt that his life form no longer had any obstacles to him. After reaching the cosmic level, he could still be called a human for the time being, but as long as he wanted to, he couldn’t be a human at any time.
Countless races could be changed as long as he understood them completely. However, there was no need. This was because although he wasn’t perfect in the path of humans, he was at least familiar with them. Changing races casually would instead affect his strength.
Of course, these were all secondary.
After breaking through to the cosmic level, the strongest thing was still the use of the power of space and time. Shi Yu descended to Blue Planet with a thought and no one sensed him.
Wherever his gaze landed, time flowed backward.
He casually spied on the historical scene of Blue Planet. Listening to the Voice of History was extremely weak in front of the use of this spatial power.
His gaze landed on the capital and saw a little boy about 12 years old. With the thought that he had to defeat Shi Yu, he came from the Ancient Capital to the distant capital to further his studies.
This was Yin Zhengfan, who had lost to Shi Yu in a class competition.
He also saw that at the Feeding Conference, he, who had once shocked the world and shocked the Feeding World, and Buggy became the most dazzling star in the Feeding World.
He also saw an old acquaintance who was also playing with time and trying to predict his future.
Shi Yu smiled and stretched out his hand to help to encourage it. He used his attainments in the power of space and time to strengthen the premonition results of a certain owl.
At this moment, at a certain time, the Prediction Owl felt that the results of its premonition this time were a little ridiculous. It even felt that the consumption of its premonition this time was super small. It was very strange…
Very strange indeed…
“I’m already at the realm where I can play with space and time at will. Of course, I’m not as violent as Qi.”
“At most, the power projection will affect the past and the future, and it will consume a lot of energy. It can’t descend with its true body like the Time Sprite.”
In an instant, Shi Yu sensed many changes in his body.
Of course, every pet Shi Yu contracted could also sense the feedback from the cosmic Beast Tamer.
They were already very powerful, but when they sensed their strength rising steadily, it was even more unbelievable.
It felt that Shi Yu hadn’t even done anything. Their battle power had increased by at least 20%. This 20% wasn’t to be underestimated. If they were all below the divine level, it was nothing to increase their battle power by two times.
However, at the peak of the super divine level, above that was the cosmic level. It was extremely difficult to advance further. In this situation, 20% of the battle power was worth ordinary peak super divines spending 200 million years cultivating, and they might not necessarily be able to do it.
And now, Shi Yu had broken through alone. The entire team’s pets received feedback, making their already strong strength even more brutal.
The only one who didn’t receive much feedback might be the Super Empress. As a cosmic level, unless Shi Yu supported her with all his might, her improvement was limited.
This time, the Empress used her own strength to allow Shi Yu to break through to the cosmic level.
“There’s no need to pursue the cosmic holder anymore.” At this moment, looking at Shi Yu looking at the many pets, the Super Empress made a decision.
Although she hadn’t recovered her complete memories and had only recovered a small portion, she no longer planned to search.
Forcefully contracting with him above his level made Shi Yu experience such a complicated thing. If he contracted with the cosmic will, who knew what would happen?
Since Shi Yu was the only person she was familiar with now, she naturally didn’t want anything to happen to Shi Yu.
The risk of contracting with the universe was still too high. If Shi Yu failed… She could already understand the feelings of Shi Yu’s pets.
“No.” However, the Empress didn’t want to look anymore. Shi Yu didn’t want to. At this moment, he touched Eleven and the others’ heads and said, “I’m definitely going to be the master of the universe.”
“Whether the lifespan of the universe is immortal or limited, I’m very vulgar. I like longevity and immortality. I like myself to be eternal. I also want my pets and friends to transcend with me.”
“Therefore, controlling the universe is something that has to be done.”
“When the time comes, I can still search for the remaining memories.” Shi Yu turned around and smiled. “However, the next time I contract the universe, I have to be more prepared.”
“Since you’re not in a hurry and we have enough time, why don’t we wait a little longer? At least for now, the lifespan of the universe is still very sufficient.”
“At least, wait until a pet can fight a cosmic overlord alone before undergoing the cosmic contract, right?”
“It’s up to you, but before that, let’s deal with the guy who covets this place first,” the Super Empress said.
“Yeah.” Shi Yu nodded. Interesting. Next, let him see if the cleansing star spirit/Sea of Stars sprite that had been enhanced by him, a cosmic Beast Tamer, could cleanse this supreme master of pollution.
“Susu.”
“Ning!” At that moment, Susu’s gaze was firm. It was already completely prepared.
“As a cosmic-level being, like others of the same levels, it’s not too much to have your own territory, right?”
“Next, we want the former Contaminated Land. After purification, change its name to the Milky Way and it’ll become our new territory!” Shi Yu’s ambition had just appeared. Since he wanted to nurture his pets to the cosmic level as much as possible, resources were indispensable. It was time to fight for his resource territory.

chapters.title: Chapter 1895: Difficult Cosmic Level (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1895: Difficult Cosmic Level (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Just as Shi Yu made up his mind to try using the Dark King to fight the Contaminated Land, Ling, who was beside him, suddenly spoke.
“Master, the World King has brought a congratulatory gift.”
Her tone more or less had the intention of taking credit. It was very playful, as if she was in a good mood today.
“World King? A congratulatory gift?”
Upon hearing the congratulatory gift, Shi Yu and the others looked up. They were all money-grubbers.
He was curious. What was the congratulatory gift and who could use it?
Shi Yu looked at the Super Empress. In the next moment, the Empress Mystic Realm opened.
A supreme spiritual consciousness descended in the Empress Mystic Realm.
The Realm King’s main body was the World King Planet, so it was naturally impossible for her to descend with her true body. She still descended with her own habit and only her consciousness.
“You guys actually really succeeded…”
Space-time ripples spread, and a mental voice came from the eyes formed by the white and blue arcs of light.
“Yo, World King.” Shi Yu smiled.
Before he broke through, he had always felt that the Super Empress, the World King, and the cosmic overlord were all unfathomable.
But now, in his opinion, the other party almost didn’t have any big secrets. They were all creatures of the same level.
The greatest difference between the cosmic level and other levels was the use of the power of space and time.
He felt that the World King’s spatial attainments weren’t low. It should have studied it for a long time. It had probably completed the convergence of parallel spaces and could communicate with him in all parallel spaces.
The last time he transmigrated, he was probably under the gaze of a realm king from another parallel space the whole time.
“Congratulations.”
“You’ve become the seventh cosmic life form in this universe. From today onwards, you’ll be ranked at the highest.”
“This is a small gift from me.”
World Kings could be said to be the most aggrieved among the previous five cosmic levels.
The Dark King, the Beastmaster, the Worm Queen, and the cosmic overlord were all not easy to deal with.
The Dark King and the Mutated Insect Race had always coveted the prosperous Cosmic Sea and the myriad races in the starry sky. The Beastmaster had also always coveted the World King himself.
Only the Super Empress knew what the sixth cosmic emperor, the Super Empress, had done in the Cosmic Sea.
Fortunately, although the current seventh cosmic level wasn’t considered a direct descendant of the World King bloodline, it was more or less deeply related to the World King bloodline.
It wasn’t easy for a cosmic emperor who wasn’t from the enemy camp to be born. The World King naturally had to express it well.
In the spatial ripples, an invisible sword slowly appeared.
Its appearance instantly triggered terrifying sword intent fluctuations and outlined the supreme sword law, as if it was the most primitive sword origin.
The World King’s congratulatory gift was a Shadowless Sword. It didn’t have a body. However, when they saw this weapon, Chi Tong, Little Ji, and the others who played with swords immediately widened their eyes in excitement.
It was the same for Shi Yu. He sensed that this treasure was extraordinary.
Without a doubt, this was a cosmic treasure-level treasure. Although it might not be comparable to the Universe Tree or the skill index, it was also commendable. Its value wasn’t inferior to dozens of source of transcendence, and it wasn’t a kind of low-level cosmic treasure.
As expected of a World King, he had a rich collection of treasures.
“There’s nothing.” Bu Lu looked around and scratched its head.
“Idiots can’t see it,” Little Zi said.
Apart from Bu Lu, many pets pretended that they could see the sword.
“It’s a Space-time Shadowless Sword,” the World King said. “This cosmic treasure was born from the most primitive sword origin combined with the power of space and time after the birth of the sword origin law in this universe. It doesn’t have a body. Only creatures who are expert in the sword law can sense and use it.”
“I remember that you’re expert in swords. It can be a suitable weapon for you.”
After the World King finished speaking, it sent the Space-time Shadowless Sword to Shi Yu. This was indeed a treasure. Shi Yu could confirm that even if it was a transcendent 1 sword spirit, as long as it could proficiently bind this thing, it wasn’t a problem for its battle power to be at the peak of the super divine level.
“Thank you, Lord World King.” Shi Yu smiled. He liked this gift very much. Most importantly, this sword contained very strong spatial power. With Chi Tong holding this, Qi probably couldn’t escape through spatial travel even if she wanted to. It could kill one Time Sprite with one slash.
It was very suitable for Chi Tong, who had also mastered the sword origin, to fuse and train the Space-time Sword Dao.
Cosmic treasures… were all good things. Shi Yu suddenly wanted to give every pet a cosmic treasure.
He wanted to enhance their skills further.
He wondered how many treasures he could plunder from the Dark King after defeating it…
The plundering aura on Shi Yu’s body rose steadily, attracting the attention of the World King and the Super Empress, making their eyelids twitch.
“The Dark King and the Beastmaster are still corroding the barrier, right?” Shi Yu asked the World King.
“Lord World King, are you interested in launching a counterattack together?”
The World King said, “Are we going to a complete war… I’m long prepared.”
“However, because of the barrier, apart from me, the other cosmic emperors shouldn’t know that you’ve already reached the cosmic level.”
“Since the other party hasn’t completely broken through the barrier, I suggest that you adapt to the cosmic level first and consolidate your new realm before carrying out the final battle.”
The World King still felt that Shi Yu was too impatient. He had just broken through…
“That’s true. Then let’s prepare for a while more.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I’ll go inform my acquaintances to prevent them from panicking if a cosmic battle happens next.”
“At that time, if possible, Lord World King, please delay the Beastmaster and ensure that the two cosmic levels can’t invade the Cosmic Sea. The Empress will assist you. As for me, I’ll directly fight the Dark King.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1896: Difficult Cosmic Level (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1896: Difficult Cosmic Level (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
It was impossible for a World King and Empress to not be able to defeat a Beastmaster, right?
This way, it should be able to distract the World King and protect the Cosmic Sea.
This prevented places like Blue Planet from being affected.
In short, he had to control the battlefield to be outside the Cosmic Sea, and within the Contaminated Land and the Behemoth Empire.
As for himself… Shi Yu felt that with his current strength, there was nothing wrong with cooperating with so many pets to fight the Dark King directly.
Although now, Shi Yu only looked like a cosmic-level rookie, in theory, he should be at a disadvantage when facing an old cosmic-level like the Dark King.
However, it shouldn’t be forgotten that Shi Yu could strengthen every pet from the peak of the super divine level to the cosmic level at any time.
As long as he wanted, this second could allow Susu to be at the cosmic level. In the next second, it could allow Eleven to be at the cosmic level, or it could also let Qi be at the cosmic level.
This way, there were many choices in terms of skills, making the opponent unable to guard against them.
Although Shi Yu felt that the chances of strengthening two cosmic levels at the same time with his current strength weren’t high, it was enough.
After all, even if he couldn’t strengthen two cosmic-level battle power at the same time, don’t forget that his main body also had battle power, and it was even stronger now.
After strengthening a cosmic-level Susu, he would let the remaining pets, such as Chi Tong, possess him with the Shadowless Sword. Wasn’t this appropriate? It was also cosmic-level battle power.
Or, he could open another mecha.
Although dividing power to strengthen pets might cause greater consumption, it wasn’t a problem at all. After all, Susu only needed him to strengthen it at the start. Then, it could directly freeload the power of the Sea of Stars for battle. It was very easy.
Presumably, the universe was also very happy to lend its strength to Susu to punish the Dark King.
Therefore, no matter how he thought about it, Shi Yu felt that he wouldn’t lose.
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s arrangements, the World King had no objections. Although she didn’t know how powerful a cosmic Beast Tamer was, one thing was certain. At least Shi Yu wouldn’t lose.
It was impossible for a cosmic-level being to kill another cosmic-level being.
Therefore, even if Shi Yu had just entered the cosmic level, his foundation at the cosmic level was inferior to the Dark King.
But as long as she and the Empress quickly forced the Beastmaster back, the situation of the war could be determined.
Although she felt that it might be a better choice to let Shi Yu assist in strengthening the Empress, since the Empress didn’t say anything, she naturally didn’t have any other thoughts.
“Sure,” World King replied and disappeared.
At the same time, Shi Yu smiled and looked at the Super Empress. “I remember your previous life’s name…”
“Shut up.” Just as Shi Yu finished speaking, the Super Empress looked at Shi Yu with a gaze that was enough to kill.
This scene shocked Eleven and the others. What was wrong?
“Alright, alright.” Shi Yu had originally said if he should call back his previous life’s name, but from the looks of it, the Empress didn’t like it.
He remembered that the name he gave the Empress in his previous life was Buggy. It was similar to Buggy’s name. As expected of him…
Unfortunately, now that the Empress had become stronger and more aloof, she wasn’t willing to take that name anymore. It was better to call her Empress.
Sigh, Buggy was still the best. Even now, it didn’t despise its name…
“However, we can finally fight side by side again,” Shi Yu said with a distant gaze. Although his experience on Earth was only three to four years, far inferior to the time in this lifetime, he had indeed fought side by side with the Super Empress countless times. Moreover, in the early stages of the recovery of spiritual energy and the lack of resources, it was far more difficult than in this lifetime.
When Shi Yu left the mystic realm and returned to Blue Planet, the gem cat, whose expression wasn’t very good, sensed the commotion and walked out.
“As expected, it’s you. Damn Shi Yu, did you switch the gem fruit just now!!”
It gritted its teeth in hatred. This bastard…
When it ate the Cultivation Fruit in Ping Cheng, it would give itself a bunch of buffs and be mentally prepared. Only then would it dare to eat a bunch of delicious food that neutralized the stench.
Did Shi Yu know how much psychological trauma he had caused it?
The current cultivation fruit was no longer like before. It was made by a ginseng baby at the peak of the super divine level. It was even more smelly.
“You should be glad.” The first thing Shi Yu did when he returned to Blue Planet was to take a look at the gem cat’s state. He couldn’t help but be very satisfied and smile.
“F*ck…” the gem cat cursed.
“After all, the first thing I did after breaking through to the cosmic level was to supervise your cultivation. Isn’t it worth being happy about?” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Moreover, you keep cursing me in your heart.”
The gem cat: “?”
The gem cat was stunned. It carefully recalled Shi Yu’s words and sensed that something was wrong. “You, you, you, you broke through to the cosmic level??”
“How can it be so fast!!!” The gem cat was extremely incredulous. Shi Yu was already at the cosmic level?? Why did it feel like a dream?
“Yes,” Shi Yu said. “The war is imminent, so we have to break through quickly. Teacher Ying, even if you want to contract me now, I don’t want you anymore.”
The gem cat: “?”
“I don’t care!” The gem cat curled its lips. So be it. What was the big deal?
However, the gem cat suddenly thought of something. “Wait, how did you break through to the cosmic level?”
“I contracted a cosmic-level feedback breakthrough above my level,” Shi Yu said.
“Oh no, doesn’t that mean that owl predicted it again!”
Shi Yu had once asked the owl in the past about the specific method to advance to the cosmic level. The answer the owl
gave was to contract a cosmic level above its level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1897: Difficult Cosmic Level (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1897: Difficult Cosmic Level (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Although the targeting of that premonition wasn’t very strong and it only predicted a rough range, it still hit.
Shi Yu really advanced by contracting a cosmic level above his level. Even if the owl obtained a trace of EXP bar, it concerned the birth of a cosmic emperor. It was also a huge amount of upgrade EXP.
“Well,” Shi Yu said, “she’s barely related to premonition. However, my situation is a little special. Without my nod, others can’t obtain any benefits from my breakthrough for the time being.”
“What do you mean?”
“It means that Teacher Owl hasn’t received any feedback for the time being. Not only her, but Blue Planet and Goddess Wa too.”
“I actually came this time because of this. I want to see how many benefits my upgrade can give them,” Shi Yu said.
Blue Planet and Goddess Wa were existences that had nurtured Blue Planet’s human race. If Shi Yu, a Blue Planet’s human, broke through, it was natural for them to obtain benefits.
The reason why the Worm Queen wanted to give Buggy the bloodline and let Buggy reach the cosmic level was also because she hoped to obtain the bloodline feedback after Buggy broke through to the cosmic level.
However, unlike the Worm Queen, the Worm Queen was at the cosmic level herself. After Buggy broke through to the cosmic level, it was very simple for the Worm Queen to receive feedback.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu had broken through. As Blue Planet, Goddess Wa, and the owl were still super divine and not at the cosmic level, without Shi Yu’s permission, no one else could get any feedback from him.
In addition, Shi Yu’s situation was special to begin with. He was a transmigrator, so it was even harder to directly obtain feedback from him.
“You mean…” the gem cat said.
“Well, I plan to let Blue Planet’s Will and Senior Goddess Wa prepare first. This way, with the feedback, they might be able to charge into the cosmic level,” Shi Yu said.
“Oh, I see.” The gem cat was envious. Blue Planet and Goddess Wa were winning without doing anything.
Eh? It seemed that from overlord to peak super divine, it was the one who won the most?
Forget it, the gem cat was paralyzed. Now that Shi Yu was at the cosmic level, it felt that it was also invincible in the universe. Now, it could slack off to the destruction of the universe, right?
“By the way, Teacher Owl doesn’t have much potential anyway. I’ll give her the feedback first,” Shi Yu said.
With that said, he relaxed his spatial shield, allowing the owl to sense that he had broken through to the cosmic level.
At the same time.
World King Planet.
An owl girl was extremely shocked.
“Oh my god, what did it hit again?”
“Moreover, it was a big one.”
The owl sat at home and rose to the middle stage of transcendent out of thin air, stunning the Prediction Owl. When it returned to its senses, it understood what had happened and couldn’t help but head to Blue Planet in shock.
“Holy shit, what a joke. Could it be that guy… is at the cosmic level??”
Apart from that, Shi Yu also released his cosmic-level aura. A trace of cosmic-level might spread, immediately making the expressions of Goddess Wa, Blue Planet’s Will, Emperor Shi, the little nun Floating Light, and the others change.
However, when they deeply sensed the source of this aura, every Blue Planet expert was extremely shocked.
This aura, could it be…
“Shi Yu?” The little nun said, “He’s actually at the cosmic level so quickly??”
Ever since Shi Yu broke through to super divine 11 and experienced the heavenly tribulation under everyone’s nose before suddenly leaving, it had only been a month. No one expected Shi Yu to return in a short month at the cosmic level.
“Looks like I can reincarnate in peace soon,” Emperor Shi said. He felt that he might have to reincarnate and cultivate again to catch up to this heaven-defying junior.
Soon, as Shi Yu’s aura was released, the Blue Planet’s Will, Goddess Wa, Emperor Shi, and Floating Light quickly descended where Shi Yu was.
“Shi Yu, you broke through to the cosmic level??” Goddess Wa and the others immediately asked just as they descended.
“Isn’t this very normal?” Shi Yu said.
The four of them were stunned. The gem cat was also here and sighed. Sigh, Shi Yu had managed to act cool again.
“Let’s not talk about this. My breakthrough should be able to bring a certain amount of feedback to the two of you, right? Next, I plan to feedback my strength to the two of you. I wonder if you’re confident of charging into the cosmic level.” Shi Yu looked at the Blue Planet’s Will and Goddess Wa and went straight to the point.
“Is a war about to begin?” Blue Planet’s Will said.
“Yes, let’s make preparations. Everyone, increase your strength. I’m prepared to meet the Dark King. The barrier of the Cosmic Sea can’t last long,” Shi Yu said.
“Prepare yourselves, and I’ll let go of the restrictions.”
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, Goddess Wa and Blue Planet had complicated feelings. They didn’t expect that Shi Yu would help them cross the cosmic level one day.
“We can give it a try.” Both parties were looking forward to it.
“Alright, Master Floating Light, Senior Emperor Shi, come and watch too. It might be beneficial for you to try to break through to the cosmic level in the future,” Shi Yu said.
“Thank you.” Floating Light, who was also at the peak of the super divine level, thanked Shi Yu.
“Yes.” Emperor Shi also nodded silently. There was no doubt that he could gain a lot from sensing the breakthrough process of his mother planet.
Soon, Shi Yu directly released the restrictions. In the next moment, the power of Blue Planet and Goddess Wa clearly increased very much.
The figure of the Blue Planet’s Will disappeared and fused into the planet. Strands of star origin lingered. The creatures living on it didn’t notice that their mother planet was trying the most difficult breakthrough.
After Goddess Wa received Shi Yu’s feedback, her strength became even more perfect. In the ruins of Earth, she confirmed that the opportunity to assist her in breaking through to the cosmic level was to “create humans”. Although Shi Yu wasn’t the initial human she created, half of his bloodline came from that group of humans…
It could more or less be very helpful to Goddess Wa’s breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 1898: Difficult Cosmic Level (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1898: Difficult Cosmic Level (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Time passed little by little. In the blink of an eye, three days later.
Such a short period of time wasn’t enough to complete a complete breakthrough. However, it was enough to confirm that the breakthrough was impossible.
They only made a little attempt. Soon, Blue Planet and Goddess Wa stopped giving up. They realized the difficulty and that both parties couldn’t break through to the cosmic level.
The gem cat and the others also returned to reality from their comprehension.
Regarding this outcome, Shi Yu, Blue Planet, and Goddess Wa were naturally disappointed. However, it was only natural.
“What a pity.” Blue Planet shook its head. It knew its situation the best. Even if Shi Yu, as a life form on Blue Planet, could give it very strong power, its other attainments were far from reaching the standard.
For example, the use of the power of space and time.
If it wanted to break through to the cosmic level, all kinds of abilities were indispensable.
As for Goddess Wa, although it had improved a little, because Shi Yu wasn’t the first-generation human it had created and Shi Yu wasn’t a “complete Blue Planet life form”, the feedback Shi Yu brought wasn’t that huge to support its perfect breakthrough.
“It still won’t do.” Goddess Wa shook its head.
“Is that so?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but feel regretful.
“It’s alright,” Blue Planet’s Will said. “If nothing goes wrong, the future eighth, ninth, and even tenth cosmic emperors will be creatures of Blue Planet.”
“There’s still enough time to train your strength.”
“However, Shi Yu, you have spatial attainments that are enough to break through to the cosmic level in such a short period of time. It’s really unbelievable.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Actually, it’s partly luck.”
In his previous life, he had received the inheritance of a Time Sprite with the ability to temporarily reach the cosmic level. With his own strength, he could transmigrate through the Space-time Dragon Vein. The combination of the experience of both lifetimes allowed Shi Yu to successfully break through.
That memory world had more or less given him some help.
“I remember now. Perhaps you can also try to recover the power of your previous life.” Shi Yu suddenly recalled something and said, “In the previous era, Earth was a cosmic star. If Blue Planet is Earth’s next reincarnation, it means that the power of Earth was also sent to this era as a kind of fire seed.”
“Now, I can temporarily strengthen Baby Ginseng to the cosmic level. The Reincarnation Fruit created by the cosmic level might be able to let you recover some power and memories related to Earth!” Shi Yu said.
“Indeed,” Goddess Wa also said. Blue Planet was a reincarnation of Earth, and she was the first to raise this point.
“That makes sense,” Blue Planet’s Will said. It would recover the power and memories of Earth and wait for the feedback from Shi Yu’s other pets breaking through to the cosmic level…
This way, it could reach the cosmic level faster than directly absorbing the power of the universe. Perhaps this was indeed the fastest way for it to reach the cosmic level.
“As for Senior Goddess Wa…” Shi Yu said, “I failed this time. You work hard yourself next. I’m helpless.”
Goddess Wa: “?”
“Actually…” Goddess Wa was just about to say something when Shi Yu said in all seriousness, “No, don’t even think about it.”
Goddess Wa originally wanted to say that if Shi Yu was willing, it could help Shi Yu nurture the 10th era’s Hope Fire Seed that he had brought out of the ruins of Earth, which was the baby girl with Shi Yu’s bloodline.
However, Shi Yu seemed to know what Goddess Wa was thinking and directly rejected her.
The baby girl created by the cosmic creature of the last era, Goddess Wa, through Shi Yu’s bloodline could definitely be said to have cosmic potential. Perhaps her talent and aptitude weren’t inferior to the cosmic overlord, Cypos. If this baby girl was handed to Goddess Wa to nurture and revive, her cosmic level should be stable.
However, Shi Yu clearly didn’t have this thought. He said directly, “I think Emperor Shi has the intention to reincarnate. Goddess Wa, you can go take a look and help him mold a reincarnation. I think Emperor Shi also has cosmic aptitude!”
“And after this battle, we can also let Master Floating Light reincarnate on Blue Planet…”
Emperor Shi and Floating Light: ???
Emperor Shi was speechless. From the looks of it, the cosmic-level Shi Yu was no longer the sensible junior who respected his seniors and the late Emperor of Dong Huang.
His wings had indeed hardened.
He didn’t know what Shi Yu could do after becoming the holder of the universe.
From the moment Shi Yu returned to Earth, the news of him breaking through to the cosmic level had already spread in a small range, from the Blue Planet’s Will to the World Tree, to the Space Emperor, to Lin Feng, to Senior Lu, to Senior Panda…
Soon, Shi Yu’s acquaintances knew that Shi Yu had already broken through to the cosmic level and become the cosmic emperor. They couldn’t help but be shocked.
At the same time, they also knew that Shi Yu was about to join the Cosmic Sea War and fight the cosmic emperor. They couldn’t help but sweat for Shi Yu. Humans were always worried about unknown domains and incomprehensible battles.
However, after making all the preparations, Shi Yu still headed to the edge of the Cosmic Sea alone, the Void Battlefield presided over by the Environmental Protection Army, and the star domain close to the Contaminated Land.
After arriving, one could clearly see an invisible barrier that wrapped the Cosmic Sea like an egg white wrapped in egg yolk. In the invisible buffer area, filth constantly penetrated and corroded. The Dark King Army didn’t stop invading the Cosmic Sea for a moment. If it weren’t for the barrier, they would probably have already attacked.
In the Environmental Protection Army, the two Bing Lings, the Human Bing Ling and the Cleansing Star Spirit Bing Ling, were presiding. This was already the 21st meeting of the Environmental Protection Army since the Cosmic Sea entered a battle state to discuss the possible battle.
Recently, the barrier had suddenly become weak. According to speculation, it couldn’t last long.
“This battle is inevitable.” In the battle conference room, a higher-up of the Environmental Protection Association from the World King Planet sighed and said, “President Bing Ling, haven’t you received any instructions from the World King?”
“Not at the moment,” the blue-haired President Bing Ling said. “Just follow the initial command and guard the border to the death.”
“Apart from the Dark King Army, Lord World King might value the invasion of the Behemoth Empire more. There’s nothing we can do.”
The goal of the invasion of the two cosmic emperors was only to expand their territory and pollute the myriad races in the starry sky. However, the goal of the Beastmaster Army was to devour the planet and even the World King. Clearly, the Beastmaster Army was a greater threat.
Therefore, most of the troops in the Cosmic Sea were on the other side. It wasn’t that the Environmental Protection Army couldn’t understand this, but the pressure here was indeed a little too great…
It was precisely because of this pressure that soon, the battle conference room started arguing again. Indeed, no one could deny the determination of these Environmental Protection Army to protect the Guardian Cosmic Sea, but in the face of a terrifying existence like the Dark King, it was understandable for their hearts to waver.
At this moment, if they could obtain the strong support of the World King, perhaps they could stabilize the morale of the army.
However, what they waited for wasn’t the World King. As a figure suddenly tore through space and time with a powerful pressure and walked out of the pitch-black crack, the entire battle conference room suddenly felt as if it was facing a great enemy. However, when they saw the appearance of the person who came and the Starry Sky Slime on his shoulder, everyone was clearly stunned.
Under the happy expression of President Bing Ling, Shi Yu calmly looked at the many higher-ups of the Environmental Protection Army and said, “I’ve been invited by President Bing Ling. Next, I’ll preside over the Environmental Protection Army.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1899: Declaring War on the Cosmic Emperor (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1899: Declaring War on the Cosmic Emperor (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Initially, everyone thought that someone was so bold and unusual as to barge into the battle conference room.
This kind of behavior didn’t seem like something a normal person could do. It was most likely an enemy.
However, when they saw the identity of the person, many higher-ups of the Environmental Protection Army fell silent.
The seventh cosmic emperor, Shi Yu! That was fine!
Many experts present had heard of Shi Yu’s unscrupulousness. This kind of thing was nothing.
At that moment, when they heard Shi Yu’s words, many higher-ups of the Environmental Protection Army revealed stunned expressions.
What did Shi Yu say?
He would preside over the next Environmental Protection Army?
Everyone suddenly looked at President Bing Ling. Apart from Bing Ling herself, no one below her level knew that Bing Ling had gone to invite Shi Yu.
It was mainly because although Shi Yu had agreed, Bing Ling herself couldn’t be sure if Shi Yu would come.
Now, seeing that Shi Yu had really arrived, President Bing Ling immediately heaved a sigh of relief. She felt that the pressure on the Environmental Protection Army was instantly much smaller.
The Star Army was maintaining an all-round barrier. The Contract Army and the Myriad Race Army were guarding the border of the Behemoth Empire. On the Environmental Protection Army’s side, there wasn’t even a super divine peak on the surface.
Fortunately, Shi Yu came.
“Welcome.” President Bing Ling stood up and welcomed Shi Yu.
The others immediately got up. If it were anyone else who dared to say so pretentiously, with him guarding the Environmental Protection Army, these super divine purifiers present would definitely disdain it.
However, if this person was Shi Yu, it was a different story. Everyone in the Cosmic Sea knew that back then, in the battle for transcendence, Shi Yu had destroyed dozens of super divines in the Contaminated Land.
The battle results of the Environmental Protection Army for hundreds of millions of years added together weren’t as valiant as Shi Yu alone.
In terms of military merits, Shi Yu was now enough to take charge of the Environmental Protection Army.
“How’s the situation?” There were many people here, and Shi Yu only knew President Bing Ling. After arriving, he asked, “The barrier should be much weaker, right?”
After he broke through to the cosmic level and confirmed that he would participate in the battle, the World King shouldn’t place all its strength on maintaining the barrier.
“Yes, the situation is very dangerous now.”
“On the other side of the barrier, the ancestor of the Abyss Race and the ancestor of the Pollution Race are presiding. There are a total of two peak super divines, and the number of high and middle super divines is even more uncertain. A conservative estimate is that there are more than a hundred super divine levels polluting lives alone.”
“This time, the entire army of the Contaminated Land mobilized. They’re definitely going to take down the Cosmic Sea.”
“The commotion isn’t small.” Shi Yu took a few steps forward and casually sat in a seat without treating himself as an outsider.
“However, no matter how many super divines there are, they’re still useless.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, many people smiled bitterly. Perhaps only Shi Yu dared to say this.
After all, this great demon king could beat up the Sun God General alone.
In terms of battle power, the battle power of the three peak super divines in the Contaminated Land, the Yun Race ancestor, the Calamity Race ancestor, and the Abyss Race ancestor, was inferior to the Sun God General.
Among them, the Yun Race’s ancestor had already been killed by Shi Yu in the Transcendent Divine Realm. There were only two left. Now that Shi Yu was here, he probably couldn’t cause any waves, but…
“It’s very difficult to believe that the actions of the Contaminated Land this time weren’t instructed by the Dark King.” At the mention of the Dark King, the deputy of President Bing Ling, an old general, had an extremely serious expression.
“If it really interferes in the war, that will be the most troublesome moment.”
Just as the general finished speaking, the expressions of many soldiers present suddenly changed drastically. There were also messengers who rushed towards the battle conference room in a hurry with pale faces. There were even countless voice transmissions that ignored the rules and transmitted to the battle room.
“Not good.”
“The Dark King Army… is about to invade on a large scale.”
“According to the information at the front line, the barrier is trembling. The power of pollution has penetrated the barrier and already flowed to the battlefield. Countless pollution tribes are offering a ceremony, as if they’re welcoming the supreme existence.”
When the news came, the entire battle conference room immediately turned extremely cold. Some people had shocked expressions. Whatever they were worried about came.
Could it be… that it was really the Dark King? Although countless people already had a premonition that a cosmic-level battle warning issued by the Cosmic Sea was very likely to happen, when this day really arrived and was really confirmed, many experts were still unwilling to believe it.
Although these purifiers had never fought the Dark King, just from the legends, they could tell how terrifying the Dark King was.
At the moment, the three peak super divine experts of the Contaminated Land, the Yun Race Ancestor, the Abyss Race Ancestor, and the Calamity Race Ancestor, were only creations of the Dark King.
The Contaminated Land also existed because of the existence of the Dark King. The polluted races in the entire universe could be said to have been born because of the Dark King.
Every cosmic level was incomparably terrifying, including the Cosmic Sea. Among the ten thousand races in the starry sky, even the powerful World Deity Dragon Race was only one of the races born by the World King.
Cosmic level and super divine level were no longer in the same dimension.
Just the Dark King’s pollution creation alone made the Cosmic Sea and the Environmental Protection Army barely hold on for so many years. If all the pollution origins personally descended and the World King didn’t appear, the Environmental Protection Army couldn’t think of any way to resist.
“Shi Yu.” President Bing Ling looked at Shi Yu urgently, wanting to ask him if he had brought any information about the World King.
“Don’t think about it. Although the World King has woken up, he’s probably dealing with the invasion of the Beastmaster Army at this moment.” At this moment, Shi Yu was still very calm. “I don’t have time to care about the Dark King.”
“I know you’re very anxious, but this isn’t the time to panic.”
“Looks like you came at the right time. World King’s calculations are really accurate.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1900: Declaring War on the Cosmic Emperor (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1900: Declaring War on the Cosmic Emperor (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Hey, if I say that I’ll deal with the Dark King, you guys are only in charge of protecting yourselves and cleaning up the battlefield later, is that alright?”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone present was confused and stunned.
What did Shi Yu mean?
“Who said that the only cosmic level in the Cosmic Sea is the World King?” Shi Yu looked outside, shocking everyone present.
In the Contaminated Land, as the World King relaxed the maintenance of the barrier, a wisp of dark light shot out of the Contaminated Land. At this moment, it was the most exciting moment for the thousands of Pollution Races in the Contaminated Land.
Although some pollution super divines sensed it, they didn’t expect that that person would really appear. As expected, this huge war was definitely personally planned by that person.
“You’re kidding.” In the Contaminated Land, on many mercenary planets, the mercenaries from the overlord territories dared to interfere in any war, but at this moment, some elite mercenaries smelled a bad feeling.
Many people sensed the vibration of the Sea of Stars. In the lonely starry sky, a Void Throne was slowly appearing. The dark black throne seemed to be a cosmic treasure, a supreme authority that could control the power of all pollution in the Contaminated Land.
Around it, countless illusions slowly appeared. An ugly and filthy world was forming. There were collapsed and rotten buildings everywhere. The corpses of nameless beasts that had been corroded by the plague swayed. They gradually rotted as the flying corpse worms ate them. The mottled black blood that filled the starry sky might be the last traces left behind by those corpses in this universe.
In the wail, in the terrifying and miserable starry sky, its blood-red eyes slowly opened, outlining a huge body. The Dark King sat on the throne like a huge dragon. It was all covered in dark scales. Every scale had mysterious vortex-shaped patterns. The Wings of Darkness that didn’t belong to a dragon covered the starry sky and enveloped the pollution domain formed by the throne, bringing with it the aura of absolute death.
Boom!!!
The true body of the Dark King descended. Even through a barrier, countless soldiers in the Cosmic Sea Void Battlefield felt the trembling in the depths of their souls and their scalps went numb.
Over the years, the barrier had protected the Cosmic Sea very well. Outside the barrier, the mission of a group of Environmental Protection Army soldiers was at most to investigate and guard. Although they knew that a huge battle was destined to happen one day, they didn’t expect this day to happen so quickly, and it was personally broken by the Dark Throne.
At this moment, countless polluted races that were densely packed and spread across more than ten Star Domains gathered in the starry sky. They seemed to have obtained a miracle and their strength increased greatly. Their gazes seemed to be able to cross several starry sky and their consciousness connected, staring at the Cosmic Sea barrier in front of them.
“Lord Dark King!!!”
“Lord of Pollution!!”
When the Dark King descended, the hearts of countless Pollution Races trembled. This was the first time they had seen the Dark King’s true body. When they saw the Dark King, they felt that they had fallen into a deep vortex and couldn’t extricate themselves. However, in the depths of their minds, they were extremely excited and fanatical, as if they had seen the supreme master of creation and hoped to pray for its attention.
It had been hundreds of millions of years. The first time the Dark King appeared was something that countless Pollution Races didn’t even dare to imagine. At the moment, even the Abyss Ancestor and the Pollution Race Ancestor could only accompany the Dark King like two servants.
“From today onwards, the Cosmic Sea has changed owners and belongs to the Dark King!”
The ancestor of the Pollution Race had a long and narrow body and a long face. It was a terrifying creature that emitted purple-brown plague fluctuations. Its voice resounded through the starry sky, capturing one’s soul.
On the throne, the Dark King looked ahead. Recently, it had vaguely felt uneasy and wanted to start a war as soon as possible, but unfortunately, the barrier was difficult to break through. At the moment, no matter what reason the barrier became weaker, the Contaminated Land had to launch an all-out attack as soon as possible, or else there would be more variables.
“Kill!!!” As the Origin God of the Pollution Race spoke, the army was excited. This day had finally come.
For their race, invasion was the best growth nutrition. The environment and resources of the Cosmic Sea could be polluted into something beneficial to their growth. The lives of the Cosmic Sea could also be polluted into their own race and slaves. War was the most effective way to strengthen the Pollution Race.
Although the Contaminated Land was also very large, it had been occupied by the Pollution Race for so many years. There weren’t many places suitable for pollution. The Cosmic Sea with the richest resources had long been a place that the race had coveted for a long time.
Now, as the Dark King descended and personally presided over it, the already irrational polluted creatures became even more crazy and chaotic. Their eyes were filled with turbidity, and only desire was left.
Boom!!
However, if they wanted to invade the Cosmic Sea, although the barrier was weak now, they still had to break it first. On the throne, the Dark King, who had the body of a dragon, didn’t move at all. Instead, the wild boar-like Origin God of the Pollution Race took a step forward.
Its entire body suddenly emitted an incomparably terrifying plague wave that swept through the starry sky.
“Ahhh…” At this moment, the members of the cosmic overlord army who were originally hired by the Dark King Army as mercenaries were shocked to discover that the plague fluctuations had already spread all over the starry sky. Some creatures with weak strength and weak willpower quickly had purple bubbles spreading on their bodies. Their bodies rotted, like inhuman monsters transforming.
This was only the aftermath of the power emitted by the Origin God of the Pollution Race. Black ground appeared under the feet of this peak super divine creature. It walked forward step by step, and its strength rose steadily. Originally, at the peak of the super divine level, its strength should have belonged to the end, but at this moment, the power fluctuations became incomparably terrifying. The power of the earth in the entire Contaminated Land was triggered by it, and its body was enhanced by a purer and darker pollution source. Its strength had probably already exceeded the peak of the super divine level like the Sun God General and even Goddess Wa by several times.

chapters.title: Chapter 1901: Declaring War on the Cosmic Emperor (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1901: Declaring War on the Cosmic Emperor (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Monster¦” A super divine of the cosmic overlord army that was originally stationed in the pollution land saw the appearance of the Pollution Race’s Origin God and knew that this guy had been enhanced by the power of the Dark King. He had probably been bestowed a powerful pollution source by the Dark King.
The current Origin God of the Pollution Race was like a pet strengthened by a Beast Tamer. Its strength had increased greatly. It seemed to want to replace the Dark King to break the gradually weakening barrier.
On the other side of the barrier, all the Environmental Protection Army soldiers stationed there felt uneasy. They didn’t even dare to breathe loudly. Sensing the commotion on the other side, although they immediately made preparations for battle, the oppressive aura made it difficult for the Environmental Protection Army without an expert to take out their warpath.
“No, I can’t cleanse it!!!”
The pollution that gradually seeped into the barrier had already made some sweating purifiers reveal helpless expressions. The level of the pollution source was too high, and with their abilities, it was impossible to cleanse it!
“Roar!!!”
In this situation, the ancestor of the Pollution Racewas still in the starry sky of the polluted land, turning into a dark light like a dark star. It wanted to penetrate the barrier and directly make the Environmental Protection Army stationed there feel like they had fallen into an ice cave. Their hearts seemed to have stopped.
It was over.
Many people felt despair, but they also had hope. They only hoped that the higher-ups of the Environmental Protection Army could appear at this moment to resist the enemy’s attack.
“President Bing Ling!!!” At this moment, in the Environmental Protection Army, only President Bing Ling had the ability to deal with a peak super divine. She was the vice president of the Environmental Protection Army. One was a human, and the other was the cleansing star spirit. However, the two parties were like one. One alone couldn’t have the battle power of a peak super divine, but with the combination of the two, it wasn’t a problem to use the advantage of stats to fight a polluted race at the peak of the super divine level.
However, even if it was President Bing Ling, many people weren’t very confident that she could withstand the pollution army presided over by the Dark King.
“This time, no one can stop it.” The pollution army that had been attacking the barrier for a long time had greater confidence this time. The terrifying might of the Disaster God had long torn apart space and time, making the barrier tremble violently. In the next moment, tearing the barrier was already an indisputable fact.
Who could resist?
Not even Bing Ling.
As the Origin God of the Pollution Race got closer and closer to the barrier, suddenly, space and time trembled. A larger hole cracked, and strong cleansing fluctuations shot out of the spatial crack, illuminating the Sea of Stars.
“Someone can’t sit still anymore.” Seeing this scene, countless pollution super divines smiled. This was the first time the Environmental Protection Army had taken the initiative to cross the barrier to resist the attack under pressure, right?
However, in the next moment, the polluted races couldn’t smile anymore. The cleansing light became more and more dazzling. The incomparably dazzling starlight suddenly pressed countless Pollution Race citizens down on their knees. It was as if a star was shining on their bodies, burning them until smoke came out.
“Roar!!~” What was even more unexpected was that even the Pollution Race’s Origin God suddenly changed shape under this cleansing light. Its body distorted and it let out a miserable cry.
It was filled with fear and disbelief. There was actually a creature that could make it suffer so much under the enhancement of His Majesty, the Dark King.
