“What happened!!” Such a change was really unexpected. As the light became stronger and stronger, both parties on the battlefield suddenly realized that the Origin God of the Pollution Race seemed to have reached a limit. The entire trace of life was about to be cleansed.
This cleansing light was too terrifying, as if it came from the beginning of the universe, a divine light that expelled all darkness. Seeing that the Origin God of the Pollution Race was about to be cleansed into nothingness, on the throne, the Dark King finally couldn’t help but choose to attack.
Space and time reversed, as if an invisible huge hand wanted to cross space and time and capture the Origin God of the Pollution Race.
The cleansing light didn’t make things difficult for the Pollution Race’s Origin God or the Dark King. After being saved by the Dark King, the Origin God returned to the back, but it was already half dead. It had lingering fears and was shocked.
“Pointless resistance.” At this moment, the Dark King looked at the Origin God coldly. It didn’t understand who it was that could actually easily crush the ancestor of the Pollution Race, despite being enhanced with its power.
That power wave just now… If the Dark King wasn’t wrong…
[Cleansing Origin]!
The origin could evolve laws. It was the upper system of the power of the natural order. It was an ability that could only be comprehended by cultivating many skills to the extreme and fusing them.
When did the Cosmic Sea give birth to a creature that had mastered the cleansing origin?
Moreover, behind this creature was definitely a cosmic-level existence. Otherwise, it had already succeeded in spying on the other party’s traces just now.
World King and Super Empress?
Before the Dark King could make a judgment, a figure slowly walked out of the spatial crack. When it saw this figure, even the Dark King revealed an incredulous expression.
The rich origin of the universe lingered beside Shi Yu like a chaotic aura. He was wearing an ordinary panda casual suit. With one hand in his pocket, he stepped in the starry sky. A Starry Sky Slime that emitted a halo floated beside his shoulder. Both parties seemed to be the “culprit” who had resisted the Pollution Race’s Origin God just now.
“Trash, what do you want to do to my territory?” Shi Yu said after appearing.
“Shi Yu?!!!”
Be it the Contaminated Land or the basic level of the Environmental Protection Army, they didn’t expect that the one who appeared to resist the attack of the Pollution Race’s Origin God was actually Shi Yu.
Upon seeing Shi Yu, the Dark King was furious. Then, it was shocked and in disbelief. This was because it felt that the current Shi Yu had probably stepped into the cosmic level, but how was this possible?
How could he break through to the cosmic level in such a short period of time?
It was shocked and angry in its heart and couldn’t understand. It suddenly understood what the uneasiness in its heart was. How could there be a human as monstrous as this?

chapters.title: Chapter 1902: Declaring War on the Cosmic Emperor (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1902: Declaring War on the Cosmic Emperor (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“It’s him.” After discovering Shi Yu’s figure, there were actually many familiar faces on the Environmental Protection Army’s side.
For example, the president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association, Xing Nan, Master Adolf, who had once tested Duckie, his disciple Xia Zhichun, and even the genius of the Environmental Protection Association, Feng Jing, who had once fought Duckie in the God Sealing Battle. These people had no choice but to go to the battlefield now that the battle was imminent.
There was also Yue Ling, who had once been saved by Shi Yu from the Contaminated Land and joined the Environmental Protection Army. When these people realized that it was Shi Yu who attacked, they were shocked and their pupils lit up.
However, what did Shi Yu just say?
What did he want to do to his territory?
Wasn’t it the Cosmic Sea barrier that the Disaster Race’s Origin God wanted to attack just now?
Everyone had strange expressions. They felt that Shi Yu was saying that the Cosmic Sea was his territory.
“I accidentally said my heartfelt words. I can’t let the World King hear me,” Shi Yu suddenly reacted.
“You’ve reached the cosmic level.”
The words were shocking. First, it came from Shi Yu’s mouth, then from the Dark King’s mouth, a sentence that shook the starry sky.
This was the first time the Dark King had spoken. What it said directly caused a huge earthquake in the starry sky, directly making billions of gazes stop on Shi Yu and be stunned.
The many pollution super divines who were already extremely afraid of Shi Yu were even more shocked.
Cosmic level?
What did the Dark King say?
Shi Yu had stepped into the cosmic level?
The seventh cosmic emperor, Shi Yu? Didn’t he just become a super divine a few years ago?
Everyone naturally believed the Dark King’s words, but it was precisely because of this that countless people were extremely shocked. After all, since the establishment of the universe, no human had reached the cosmic level.
And now, Shi Yu had actually achieved it. How could they not be shocked?
The other races were alright, but the humans located in the two battlefields were all shocked. Their gazes were stunned. So humans could really reach the cosmic level?
Although they had previously said that Shi Yu was the seventh cosmic emperor, it wasn’t true after all. Now, Shi Yu seemed to have completely confirmed this title and really reached the cosmic level.
“As expected!”
As they obtained the certification from the Dark King, Bing Ling and the others gasped and their brains rumbled.
No wonder Shi Yu was so confident, but this growth speed was too creepy. He directly leaped from that newbie to break through to a cosmic emperor??
“I originally wanted to find you, but I didn’t expect you to walk into a trap.” At this moment, Shi Yu reaching the cosmic level was indeed beyond the Dark King’s expectations. However, at this point, the Dark King didn’t want to regret anything.
Things had already developed to this point. The Dark King wanted to fight first.
A new cosmic level also wanted to defy the heavens?
As a cosmic emperor who had stayed at the cosmic level for billions of years, although the Dark King was extremely shocked that Shi Yu had stepped into the cosmic level, it was impossible to be afraid of a cosmic newbie.
Of course, Shi Yu wasn’t afraid of it either. “You’re very arrogant, but unfortunately, there aren’t many days left for you to be arrogant.”
“After this battle, the Contaminated Land changes hands and changes its name to the Milky Way. I’m the overlord of the Milky Way, the seventh supreme cosmic emperor in the universe!” Shi Yu said, his declaration shocking the stars.
“You have a death wish!” When had the Dark King ever suffered such a provocation? However, it seemed that every word Shi Yu said could provoke its nerves. Who was the arrogant one?
“If you want me to attack, you have to defeat my pet first.”
“Let me see if the legendary cosmic emperor has an undeserved reputation.” Shi Yu crossed his arms. Susu naturally chose to fight. Its gaze revealed a determined expression as it looked at the source of the pollution in this universe.
“Ning.” However, after staring at the Dark King, Susu said something that surprised Shi Yu.
It was actually the cleansing star spirit. At this moment, Susu saw through the Dark King’s race.

chapters.title: Chapter 1903: Balance (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1903: Balance (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
The cleansing star spirit was a race born in the universe because of the yearning of countless lives for a beautiful environment.
At the start, Susu’s kind, a Blue Sea Sprite, could be said to be a low-level race that cleansed the star spirit. However, even if it was a low-level race, Susu still had the obsession of hundreds of millions of years to cleanse the polluted sea.
The obsession to cleanse the star spirit was probably above this. Therefore, it was very difficult for Susu to believe that the source of the pollution that had always been regarded as its final enemy was actually to cleanse the Star Spirit Race.
The Dark King didn’t care about Susu’s surprise at all.
Others probably wouldn’t mind. It might be the greatest joke in the universe that the Dark King was a cleansing star spirit.
“Domain.” The Dark King looked at it coldly. A cosmic-level attack was enough to overturn the starry sky. The Dark King was still sitting on the throne, but the turbid dark domain had already covered the starry sky and devoured everything.
Wherever the domain passed, countless stars turned into pollution stars, the ground turned into earth, and the water turned into an abyss. A domain that was far more terrifying and strange than a cosmic disaster swept past. At this moment, space and time seemed to have stopped. Be it the Pollution Army or the Cleansing Army, they didn’t dare to breathe loudly and trembled under the pressure of the two cosmic thrones.
“Looks like cosmic levels have some secrets of their own.”
Although Shi Yu was also surprised by the Dark King’s race, it wasn’t important at the moment. As long as he killed the Dark King, he would know everything he needed to know.
At this moment, most of his power had already been used on Susu. Psychic Resonance, Time Strengthening, Space Strengthening, Purification Amplification, Water Strengthening, and Ice Strengthening. A series of enhancement effects made Susu’s body suffuse with starry sky divine light. Apart from that, as a cosmic-level Beast Tamer, Shi Yu had mastered a special ability after breaking through, which was the origin of the universe.
Not only could the origin of the universe condensed in his Beast Taming Space evolve into various power of laws to shape the cosmic Beast Taming Space, but it could also temporarily strengthen a pet to cosmic battle power.
Although Susu didn’t have the ability to defeat the Dark King alone, with Shi Yu’s help, Susu would also ascend to the throne.
In the blink of an eye, a terrifying dark domain superimposed from dozens of alternate spaces and overlapped from the shattered spatial cracks.
Seeing this, many super divines panicked. They felt that the space and time where Shi Yu was had completely turned into a place that even the cosmic will despised. There was no way to escape.
Boom!!!
After the unknown effect of the domain was activated, the Dark King attacked again. This time, it raised its arm claws on the throne high and suddenly waved in the direction of Shi Yu and the others. Space and time immediately decayed, and the laws were tainted.
In the starry sky, a little starlight flickered. Susu flashed into the attack range of the Dark King just like that. Starlight erupted from its body, and a terrifying power that was not inferior to the Dark King completely erupted from its body. The starlight was like a sharp blade that tore through space and time.
In an instant, the origin purification wave representing the Sea of Stars collided with the Dark King’s Origin pollution power. The two parties didn’t feel anything, but the cleansing light that shot out only sprinkled a little on countless Polluted Races and instantly obliterated any traces of their existence!!
“Roar!!!” A huge roar came from the starry sky. It turned out to be one of the envoys of the Dark King. The Ancestor of the Pollution Race accidentally touched the origin fluctuations and directly erased the traces of its body under the frightened gazes of countless polluted races, as if it had never appeared in this starry sky. A peak super divine actually died because it was too close to the cosmic battlefield.
Not only that, but countless Polluted Races were also affected by the aftershock of the origin wave. Just seeing that light figure, their bodies involuntarily purified. They let out painful wails and slowly disappeared into ashes.
The terrifying power collided and also affected the barrier created by the World King. As space and time vibrated, cracks suddenly appeared in the barrier. A terrifying pollution power kept seeping in, instantly turning some of the cleansing army into monsters that were neither human nor ghost. As they struggled, their bodies kept collapsing.
This scene made the armies of both parties tremble to the extreme. Be it the Pollution Army or the leader of the Cleansing Army, they quickly and shockingly gave orders.
Without a doubt, ants like them couldn’t interfere in a cosmic-level battle, but at this moment, they clearly couldn’t escape either. They could only do what they had to do.
On the Environmental Protection Army’s side, Bing Ling quickly cooperated with the Star Army to maintain the barrier and cleanse the pollution power that had seeped in. As for the Dark King Army, they knew that they couldn’t help the Dark King, so they charged towards the barrier of the Cosmic Sea.
“Kill!!!” In an instant, as Shi Yu and the Dark King came into contact, the confrontation between the Dark King Army and the Environmental Protection Army completely erupted. At this moment, apart from the Cosmic Sea, the entire universe sensed the commotion from the Contaminated Land.
However, when the Dark King and Susu collided, the huge earthquake in the entire starry sky attracted the attention of countless experts.
“He’s actually at the cosmic level.” The Worm Queen, who was far away in the Worm Mother Nest, woke up from its sleep and cast its gaze at the Contaminated Land. Then, it was shocked when it sensed the power displayed on Susu and Shi Yu.
The Worm Queen didn’t expect Shi Yu to break through to the cosmic level so quickly. Moreover, the Cosmic Sea had completely waged a war with the Dark King.
In the overlord territory, the cosmic overlord also woke up from its rest and looked at the Contaminated Land with an interested expression.
It said to the secretary beside it with an incredulous expression, “Shi Yu has broken through to the cosmic level. I didn’t expect him to be so fast. In terms of nurturing humans, I lost to that guy too much.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1904: Balance (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1904: Balance (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Next, let’s see how his battle power is after breaking through.”
In the Behemoth Empire, the cosmic emperor Beastmaster that threatened the Cosmic Sea also suddenly woke up from another direction. Sensing that the Dark King was in a battle with an unknown cosmic-level existence, the Beast King was just about to go and support, but a familiar pressure descended on the Behemoth Empire.
“World King… and…”
As Shi Yu moved, for a moment, many cosmic levels collided. The turbulence of the universe made many stars and experts tremble. At this moment, probably only mortals who were so weak that they couldn’t sense anything could continue doing their things in peace and leisure.
“Roar!!!” At the border of the Contaminated Land, the Dark King’s sharp claws collided with Susu’s body that was filled with light seas. The aftermath was still trembling. The cleansing light killed countless Pollution Races, and the pollution wave corrupted the lives of countless non-Pollution Races. Under the collision of the cosmic level, even super divines were unable to resist their fate.
In the collision, the Dark King was shocked. It had underestimated Shi Yu and the others’ strength. It actually felt that the power of this cleansing star spirit wasn’t inferior to it at all.
If it could mobilize the pollution power of the entire Contaminated Land, then the cleansing star spirit in front of it was enough to mobilize the power of the Sea of Stars in the entire Cosmic Sea and turn it into an origin wave.
“If this is all you have, we’ll kill you in the next round.”
“I heard that when I once transcended the Divine Realm, you wanted to attack me, right? Are you already planning to bear the consequences now?” As Shi Yu finished speaking, the Dark King revealed a violent expression. This arrogant brat…
“Who do you think you’re facing!!!” Under the Dark King’s roar, it also sensed the battle fluctuations on the Behemoth Empire’s side and knew that the Beastmaster had already been restrained.
It understood that it had to quickly deal with Shi Yu on its side. Be it sealing, pollution, suppression, or repelling, in short, it had to support the Beastmaster as soon as possible. Otherwise, the situation would be disadvantageous to them.
The pressure the Beastmaster was under at this moment was definitely greater than it. At this moment, facing a cosmic-level newbie, even if it couldn’t kill the other party, the Dark King wouldn’t allow it. It didn’t even have the strength to quickly repel the other party.
The Dark King unsealed its battle power further. A purple dark light appeared on its huge dragon body. At this moment, the universe was wailing. In the Cosmic Sea, the countless stars maintaining the barrier suddenly felt the weakening of the power of the universe, and their state gradually weakened.
Drop after drop of the cosmic tear phenomenon landed in the starry sky, and countless pollution traces corroded the origin of the universe. It was the Dark King who activated the ability of the cosmic virus passed down from the previous era. Not only did the Dark King use it, but it also further activated its invasion of the universe.
The barrier shattered further, and the morale of the Dark King Army rose.
“Dark King is invincible!!!”
“Capture the Cosmic Sea!”
Countless Pollution Races didn’t care about their lives and sacrificed their lives crazily, hitting the barrier. The rain of pollution and the tears of blood in the universe intertwined, dyeing the starry sky in a color that had never been seen before.
“Roar!!!” The Dark King’s terrifying pressure enveloped over. The purple virus curse mark on its body seemed to have activated its power to an even more terrifying level. The Dark King slowly flew up and left the throne. The throne turned into an undercurrent, condensing into dark armor that armed the Dark King’s entire body.
It directly turned into a beam of light in the void and tore towards Shi Yu and the others.
“I said I’ll destroy you, so I’ll keep my promise,” Shi Yu said confidently. Making an enemy of the cosmic will was like having a death wish.
Although Shi Yu also had ill intentions towards the universe, he was a person who judged the situation and had a flexible position. He knew to borrow strength. Under normal circumstances, even if Susu reached the cosmice level, it could only mobilize one-fifth of the power of the cosmic Sea of Stars to strengthen the origin fluctuations.
However, it had to be said that in some extreme situations, Susu could borrow more cosmic power. For example, as the Dark King activated the cosmic virus and made the universe cry, Susu’s Star Sea Contract and the cosmic contract it had learned from Master Floating Light directly broke through the original contract restrictions.
The universe might not reject the Pollution Race, but it definitely rejected the cosmic virus that affected it.
Buzz!!
In an instant, countless cosmic viruses invaded Susu’s body. Although part of its state was affected, it, who had replaced it and endured the cosmic virus for the universe, obtained a greater authority in the power of the universe. It could mobilize almost half of the power of the universe to strengthen its cleansing power.
This strengthening with the help of external forces instantly made Susu’s cleansing power close to the level of a cosmic overlord, making the expression of the attacking Dark King change. He didn’t expect Shi Yu and the others to still have a trump card.
Boom!!
In a flash, the Dark King’s body was directly penetrated by countless cleansing lights, and several holes appeared in its palm. Although it had been strengthened, Susu’s temporary strengthening was even stronger.
The Dark King was shocked and furious, but he understood that he had indeed underestimated his opponent. At the same time, the Pollution Army that was still borrowing the power of the Dark King to increase their morale instantly stopped on the spot in shock and looked at the Dark King, whose body had been shattered, in disbelief.
“I’ve said it before. You can’t defeat my pet.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the Dark King Army was extremely shocked. The cleansing army was also stunned. They didn’t expect the Dark King, who had just erupted, to instantly explode. They didn’t know what was going on.
Only Susu was extremely excited. It even wanted to acknowledge the cosmic will as its mother. This strength was strong. Although it might only be used against the Dark King this time, it was too strong. If it could continue like this, there was no need to worry about not being first in the team.

chapters.title: Chapter 1905: Balance (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1905: Balance (3)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“You’re playing with fire.” The Dark King’s low roar came from the cosmic void. “All power has a price for it to deal with. Don’t tell me you think you can borrow the power of the universe so casually?”
“We took someone’s money and helped them eliminate disasters,” Shi Yu said. “We’re only trading fairly with the cosmic will. If it flips the table, I’ll even destroy the universe! You should think about how to resist this power first.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the Dark King was clearly stunned. Then, it laughed out loud in the dark domain. At this moment, the cleansing light on Susu’s body continued to spread, wanting to expel the dark domain.
However, the use of the dark domain seemed to have been completed. The shadow outlined in the starry sky, and just this shadow had a full cosmic power fluctuation, emitting extremely terrifying evil thoughts.
“This is…” Seeing this move, many the Pollution Army and Cleansing Army weren’t unfamiliar. The Pollution Race involved various stats, and there were naturally spirit and soul stats. In the Dark King’s domain, it seemed that it could directly strip out the “dark side” of a life form and turn it into its dependent.
As long as it was a creature, its heart couldn’t be pure and flawless. It would more or less produce a dark side due to various experiences. However, restricted by law and ethics, many people could suppress their dark side. As for the Dark King’s move, it directly pulled out the dark side of life and magnified it infinitely. Even at the cosmic level, Shi Yu couldn’t resist it immediately.
In an instant, Shi Yu and Susu felt that a dark monster with cosmic battle power was forming. At this moment, Susu looked at Shi Yu in dissatisfaction, as if it wanted to ask why the dark side in Shi Yu’s heart was so huge. His battle power seemed to be very strong.
“Little trick.”
Shi Yu curled his lips. He looked at the dark giant that was gradually forming in the starry sky and saw that in the next moment, the dark giant punched Shi Yu out of thin air.
Space and time shattered, and the laws were chaotic. The battle power of the black giant was incomparably powerful. Just a punch made the starry sky tremble, and the Cleansing Race’s hair stood on end. They felt that the Dark King’s use of this ability was much stronger than its creation races. Even the cosmic level wasn’t spared and was stripped out of the dark side.
This dark giant filled with evil thoughts had a body similar to Shi Yu’s. The aura it emitted made even peak super divines extremely afraid. They felt that if it was released, it would definitely be a terrifying monster that could wreak havoc in the universe.
However, in the face of the powerful dark side attack, Shi Yu still crossed his arms and didn’t mind. Susu beside him didn’t seem to mind either. When this punch approached Shi Yu, the dark giant stopped with a bang. Its fist stopped in midair. Between the fist and the figure, it was as if a universe had been punched out, and space and time kept collapsing.
“Come back here.” Shi Yu took a deep breath and successfully used his body control to control his dark side, snatching the body control of the dark side from the Dark King. In the next moment, under everyone’s stunned expressions, Shi Yu opened his mouth and distorted the dark side into black mist under the miserable cry. He swallowed it into his body like he was smoking.
At this moment, be it the Pollution Army or the Cleansing Army, they were all in disbelief. President Bing Ling originally thought that Shi Yu would let the cleansing star spirit cleanse its dark side, but who knew that Shi Yu would actually swallow it back into his body with an unbelievable method? He didn’t reject it at all, as if he didn’t care that he had such a terrifying dark side.
However, at that moment, everyone was more concerned about where the Dark King had gone. After its body was dispersed by Susu’s cleansing light, it directly disappeared.
Only Shi Yu instantly sensed that the other party had directly entered his body along the dark side and into his Beast Taming Space, as if he wanted to pollute Shi Yu from the inside.
The reason why Shi Yu didn’t send his other pets out was to guard against this situation. In the Beast Taming Space, just as the Dark King appeared and saw a mecha that was like a demon god that perfectly fused with the cosmic Beast Taming Space, as well as a psychic brand left behind by the cosmic super divine Empress, the Dark King’s expression immediately changed, and it wanted to retreat.
“Damn it!!! He actually!!” The Dark King didn’t expect Shi Yu to actually sign a contract with the Super Empress.
After all, in a one-on-one battle, it might not necessarily be a match for the Super Empress. Now, it was actually told that cosmic-level Beast Tamer Shi Yu had signed a contract with the Super Empress?
In addition, this cleansing star spirit that borrowed the power of the universe was extremely troublesome. The Dark King instantly cursed and felt the pressure.
“Since you’re here, why are you leaving?” The Dark King had walked into a trap. Shi Yu didn’t stand on ceremony. He directly bound the Dark King through the Beast Taming Space. The powerful spatial power directly locked onto the Dark King, as if it had created a barrier for it. It wasn’t that easy for its consciousness to escape.
“You think you can trap me with this?” The Dark King said, “Interesting. No wonder that guy protected you so much and even did this now. What’s your relationship?”
At this moment, Susu appeared in the Beast Taming Space again.
“At this point, you’re still confident?” Shi Yu didn’t know how the Dark King would win. Just Susu, who had obtained the enhancement of his and the cosmic will, felt that it could farm the Dark King alone. Moreover, it had a bunch of pets as a backup plan.
“I…” The Dark King was just about to say something, but suddenly, its heart trembled.
Shi Yu suddenly had a strange expression. This was because the World King and the Super Empress had just fought the Beastmaster for a few minutes when the Beastmaster seemed to have directly voted. It turned and ran. This speed was something Shi Yu completely didn’t expect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1906: Balance (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1906: Balance (4)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Holy sh*t.
What was wrong with this Beastmaster?
At this moment, the Dark King’s expression was also unfriendly. He didn’t expect that monkey to be so unreliable. Wasn’t this a scam?
“How about letting it go?” the Dark King said. Clearly, he didn’t want to fight anymore.
“Tell me first why you’re a cleansing star spirit,” Shi Yu said.
The Dark King sneered and said, “What’s so strange about that? The universe is in ‘balance’. Not any race pursues a ‘pure’ living environment.”
“When the universe is white without any filth, it will also fall into a sick state. Isn’t ‘pollution’ also a kind of cleansing? For some races, isn’t a ‘pure’ environment also a kind of ‘pollution’?”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. It was like saying that when water was clear, there were no fish. He didn’t expect to obtain such an explanation from the Dark King.
Susu was also clearly stunned, but then its expression turned serious. The Dark King was just making excuses. The Dark King’s expansion of territory and continuous invasion had clearly exceeded this limit.
“Any race has its own meaning. For example, I’ve already conceptualized the origin and integrated it into this universe. If I don’t exist, the pollution concept of this universe will completely disappear. The subsequent illness of the universe won’t be any lighter than what ‘it’ brings.”
On the Dark King, a cosmic virus appeared. Shi Yu looked at it indifferently and said, “Why do I feel that you think that the situation is over and want to find an excuse to end the war?”
“Susu, crush it.” When Shi Yu finished speaking, the Dark King’s expression was furious. It didn’t expect Shi Yu to be so ungrateful. At this moment, just as the Dark King was about to resist, a terrifying spiritual power appeared from the spiritual mark in the Beast Taming Space.
The Super Empress had returned!!
Being controlled by powerful psychic control and bound by the spatial power of the Beast Taming Space, the Dark King’s consciousness couldn’t move directly and it let out a roar that shook the universe.
“Empress!” Shi Yu was extremely surprised to discover that the Empress had returned unscathed. However, he wanted to personally kill the Dark King with Susu and the others.
“I understand. You have to be careful. It’s about to self-destruct.” As the Empress finished speaking, Shi Yu was shocked. He saw that the Dark King’s consciousness, which was bound by the Beast Taming Space and the Empress’ psychic power, had a strong pollution source condensing inside. It was still as difficult as ascending to the heavens to control a cosmic-level being. It actually chose to self-destruct directly.
If the Dark King’s consciousness successfully self-destructed in the Beast Taming Space, if nothing went wrong, something would definitely happen to Shi Yu.
“Wuu!!!” Fortunately, at this moment, Susu was very capable. It directly enlarged into a slime and devoured the Dark King in one bite. The self-destruction of the Dark King was mainly the eruption of the pollution power. With Susu’s current strength, it could completely suppress the Dark King.
At this moment, the Empress reminded again, “As long as there’s pollution in the world, no matter what form it takes, the Dark King won’t die. This self-destruction is only a method to escape the restraints of the Beast Taming Space. Unless you let no civilization have pollution behavior in the next billions of years, the Dark King will be eternal…”
“I know. I’ve already sensed that it’s reviving.” Shi Yu’s gaze crossed space and time and looked at the Contaminated Land. In the outside world, Shi Yu moved, and Susu beside him also moved.
The Dark King was indeed not easy to kill. What the Dark King said should be right. There was a balance in everything. Although most races pursued purity, there was a reason for pollution. If the Dark King was completely killed, it might break this balance.
However, this didn’t mean that Shi Yu had no choice. At most, he would create another Dark King before completely killing it! It wasn’t that there couldn’t be filth in the world. As long as this filth was in his hands, there was no problem.
“Duckie, do you want to replace the ‘Dark King’ and become the source of the pollution, the new master of pollution?” Shi Yu asked Duckie in the Beast Taming Space.

chapters.title: Chapter 1907: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1907: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (1)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
“Duckie, do you want to replace the Dark King and become the new master of pollution?”
Shi Yu’s words were decisive. He had expected various situations before deciding to fight the Dark King.
At this moment, Shi Yu felt that be it the World King, the Beastmaster, the Worm Queen, or the cosmic overlord, they were all watching this battle.
Whether he, a cosmic-level newbie, could sit steadily on the cosmic-level throne depended on this battle.
This battle also concerned whether he could let the few cosmic levels acknowledge his qualifications to be the holder of the universe.
Just like how the cosmic overlords weren’t willing to have a holder born in the universe who was above them, the other cosmic-level beings definitely weren’t willing.
As for how to make them willing, it was naturally to showcase the ability to change laws.
As for what law it was, it was the law of “cosmic levels can’t be killed”.
Even if it was a cosmic overlord, although it had the ability to defeat other cosmic emperors, it didn’t have the ability to kill cosmic overlords.
Therefore, what Shi Yu wanted to do was make the cosmic-level being afraid! Afraid of death!
“Quack?” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s question, Duckie was stunned before its eyes burned.
It wasn’t very interested in becoming the master of pollution, but if it wanted to become stronger, this was a good path.
“Quack!”
Shi Yu and Susu nodded. At the same time, this cosmic battle officially began.
Although the two parties had exchanged a few rounds just now, in a sense, neither party had touched the other’s foundation.
In the Contaminated Land, in a reverse dark matter world that was completely different from the real universe, endless pollution power flowed in. The Dark King’s body was born again.
During this process, the pollution power of a star domain in the Contaminated Land slowly dissipated, becoming the source of the Dark King’s revival.
The reborn Dark King roared and broke through the reversal world. The pollution power of more than ten star domains in the Contaminated Land instantly erupted like a volcano.
“That’s…”
Not all members of the Dark King Army had come to the Cosmic Sea. After all, the huge Contaminated Land still needed to be managed and provided support to the army in front.
A super divine Yun Race was originally presiding behind the Contaminated Land. When it saw the phantom of the legendary Dark King appear in this star domain under its jurisdiction, it immediately didn’t understand and was shocked.
However, what shocked it even more was that soon, space and time were broken open, and a figure tore through the air.
“Are we really going to fight to the death?” The Dark King actually hated hot-headed people like Shi Yu. In its opinion, there was no point in fighting Shi Yu anymore. It wasn’t like the original five cosmic levels had never fought each other. In the end, there was a winner, but it was impossible to kill the other party.
Back then, when the Super Empress faced the sealing of the World King and the cosmic overlord at the same time, it was already the worst outcome.
Did Shi Yu really think that he could change the rules? However, from the looks of it, Shi Yu didn’t seem to plan to stop.
“I said before, I want the Contaminated Land.” Shi Yu and Susu tore through the air. As soon as they came out, Susu turned into a weapon and stabbed at the Dark King like a cleansing spear that penetrated the starry sky.
The cleansing spear seemed to contain half the power of the universe. Its power was terrifying, making the pupils of the Dark King shrink. At this moment, extreme anger appeared in the Dark King’s heart.
As the first cleansing star spirit in the universe, it was originally the most capable general of the cosmic will. It spent its life to cleanse the universe pure and flawless, becoming the first cleansing star spirit at the peak of the super divine level.
However, the universe seemed to care more about balance and wasn’t satisfied with the pure and flawless universe. Therefore, it no longer nurtured the cleansing star spirit and broke the contract with the cleansing star spirit race.
The Dark King, who had sealed countless negative energy himself, had countless pollution erupt in its body. The originally clean universe once again gave birth to many Pollution Races.
The Dark King understood. The cosmic will didn’t want to cleanse the pollution at all. It just wanted to maintain balance. But in this way, what was the meaning of the existence of the cleansing star spirit?
Since the pollution couldn’t be completely cleansed, what was the meaning of the Dark King’s existence?
The Dark King, who didn’t want to be a tool that the universe could call over, decided to break the balance of the universe. It became the king of those Pollution Races and helped them “cleanse” more paradise until it obtained the cosmic virus of the previous era and turned its ambition into the pattern of rewriting the universe.
It was the laws of the universe that deprived the power of the cleansing star spirit. As it reached the cosmic level, the laws of the universe started to nurture the cleansing star spirit again. Now, the cleansing star spirit inherited the power of the universe and appeared in front of the Dark King, trying to cleanse it and make the universe balance again…
The Dark King was very angry. Why could the laws of the universe play with all races in its palm?
“No, I refuse to be defeated…” The Dark King roared and erupted with all its might. The pollution origin flowed on its body, turning into a mysterious curse seal that erupted with terrifying power. However, Susu, who had been enhanced by half the power of the universe and Shi Yu’s strengthening, was undoubtedly the enemy of the Dark King.
Boom!!!
The cleansing spear directly penetrated all the pollution curse seals and directly penetrated the dragon’s chest. A strong cleansing light kept spreading until it destroyed the Dark King’s body again.
Bang!!
The Dark King’s body exploded, but there were no pollution fluctuations at all. The moment it exploded, it was turned into nothingness by the cleansing light. Instead, the terrifying cleansing starlight shone on the Sea of Stars, shocking the countless Pollution Races who looked up at the starry sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 1908: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1908: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (2)
Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
Although the Dark King could revive infinitely, the one Shi Yu and the others blew up was undoubtedly the Dark King’s true body. No matter what, the Dark King’s main body also had cosmic battle power. Its strength was more than a hundred times that of a peak super divine.
However, such a cosmic level couldn’t even withstand a round and was instantly blown up… In the pollution star field enveloped by the cleansing light, before many Pollution Races lost consciousness, they were extremely shocked. Was that Lord Dark King? What enemy did it encounter??
One of the few World Kings, Beastmasters, Worm Queen, and cosmic overlords who could clearly watch the battle were also shocked.
“The Dark King can’t fight back at all. I underestimated them. A cosmic cleansing star spirit’s battle power is enough to match a cosmic overlord when facing the Dark King.”
“Not only do Shi Yu and the cleansing star spirit want to kill the Dark King, but the cosmic will also wants to kill the Dark King, so their current battle power is completely not something the Dark King can resist.”
“However, even if the cosmic will wants to kill the Dark King, it’s not that easy…” The World King couldn’t help but relax when it saw that the battle on Shi Yu’s side was also very smooth.
The Dark King still had to revive. In the Contaminated Land, the power of pollution was everywhere. It could completely revive infinitely. During this process, Shi Yu played with the Dark King.
The process of the other party’s revival was also the process of Shi Yu and Susu cleansing the entire Contaminated Land. In a certain star domain, just as the Dark King revived, the cleansing blade Susu turned into instantly beheaded it.
“Seal.” Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space separated a portion and turned into an eternal seal. He wanted to suppress and seal the Dark King again, but it seemed to be extremely difficult to seal a cosmic level. The Dark King, whose body had been divided into two, easily shook and broke through space and time. Only a useless head was sealed by Shi Yu.
This head could also be said to be the source of cosmic pollution. It was enough to pollute dozens of star domains, but it was insignificant at the moment. It was directly thrown into the Void by Shi Yu and fell into the Void Battlefield.
At the edge of the Cosmic Sea, the huge head of the Dark King fell. The pupils of the pollution army that was still here constricted with looks of disbelief. As for the Environmental Protection Army, the group of people led by Bing Ling had hoarse voices. They had no idea what was going on in the battle between Shi Yu and the Dark King.
However, from the looks of it, Shi Yu seemed to have the upper hand and the situation was one-sided? Otherwise, why would the Dark King’s head be thrown here like trash?
“Let’s see how long you can last.” Even if the Dark King was blown up time and time again, it was still extremely calm. The universe was already weakened by the cosmic virus, so the power Shi Yu and the others could borrow was limited.
Now wasn’t the time for it to counterattack.
Next, Shi Yu and the Dark King started a pursuit that lasted for several days. During this period, Shi Yu and the others became more and more proficient.
In the past few days, the commotion of the cosmic battle had swept through the entire universe. The news of Shi Yu breaking through to the cosmic level and becoming the seventh cosmic emperor had already spread throughout the starry sky.
The cleansing light coming from the Contaminated Land was the strongest proof. In the Worm Mother Nest, the overlord territory, the Behemoth Empire, and the Cosmic Sea, many experts stared at the Contaminated Land with the method of stargazing.
“I heard that the war has started. What exactly happened over there?”
Even the World King Planet was trembling. There were thousands of strange scenes in the starry sky. At this moment, the Exposing King, Tu Tu, appeared again, causing even the peak of the super divine level to look over.
The Exposing King, Tu Tu, had obtained the right to broadcast from god knows where. The video directly connected to Shi Yu’s perspective and shocked the starry sky.
“This is the seventh cosmic emperor!!! The Dark King and the Beastmaster joined forces to invade the Cosmic Sea. The World King was originally no match for them and could only rely on the barrier to resist. Who knew that Shi Yu would break through to the cosmic level and directly kill his way into the Contaminated Land, crushing the Dark King?” Originally, Brother Owl wasn’t qualified to broadcast the cosmic-level battle at all, but it was Shi Yu’s fault for being familiar with him.
At this moment, Tu Tu was extremely excited. It revealed, “Shi Yu won this battle!”
Everyone was shocked. They didn’t understand why the Exposing King could broadcast a cosmic battle, but even the officials of the World King didn’t come out to refute the rumors. For a moment, everyone was shocked.
“What a joke.” Zavay, Ming Gu, and the others, who had long become gods, were stunned as they watched the video.
The first round of the battle between Shi Yu and the Dark King was a battle of attrition. As Shi Yu consumed the Dark King’s foundation in the Contaminated Land, the Dark King consumed the power that the universe could lend Shi Yu and the others.
After the Flower of Purification bloomed in the Contaminated Land, 95% of the huge Contaminated Land had already been completely changed. At this moment, the living beings still alive in the Contaminated Land looked up at the night sky. The Milky Way was like a faint thin cloth that crossed the entire night sky, like a divine dragon that transmigrated the galaxy, emitting a halo that reflected a light belt.
The starry sky didn’t look like the environment of the Contaminated Land at all.
The Contaminated Land was really going to change hands.
Shi Yu and the others had only fought for a few days before completely rewriting one-fifth of the “terrain environment” in the universe.
After the Dark King was “killed” countless times, be it the polluted lives in the Contaminated Land, the Cosmic Sea, the Behemoth Empire, the Worm Mother Nest, or the overlord territory, they could feel their weakness.
“Kill!!!”
On the Void Battlefield, the Environmental Protection Army was unstoppable. Apart from them, a mysterious expert appeared and guarded the border. The appearance of the little nun, Floating Light, confused President Bing Ling and the others. However, seeing that she was standing on the Environmental Protection Army’s side, they no longer had any worries.

chapters.title: Chapter 1909: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1909: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“Lord Dark King…” The depths of the polluted life form that was gradually killed dimmed and was very frightened. It wasn’t afraid that it would die, but that Lord Dark King had actually fallen into a disadvantage and its origin was weakening.
The polluted lives weren’t afraid of death because the Dark King had promised to revive people who had contributed. However, now that even the Dark King’s origin had weakened, these polluted lives were immediately extremely afraid. They didn’t understand who Shi Yu was to be able to rise so quickly.
Although the Pollution Army knew that Shi Yu was definitely one of the great enemies when Eleven defeated the Sun God General, they never expected that Shi Yu would break through to the cosmic level in a short moment and display a battle result that crushed the veteran cosmic level. This situation was unprecedented. Many people knew that they had completely witnessed the birth of a cosmic legend.
Now, the Pollution Races everywhere only hoped that Lord Dark King could obtain the final victory of this battle.
Boom!!!
The last piece of “earth” in the Contaminated Land had been cleansed. In theory, the Dark King no longer had the foundation to revive, but just as the Empress had said, cosmic-level creatures were impossible to kill.
As long as the concept of pollution didn’t die, the Dark King wouldn’t die.
After completely transforming the Contaminated Land into the Milky Way, Shi Yu’s aura suddenly increased, but the Dark King didn’t mind. It was just a territory. After it was killed again, it disappeared without a trace.
In the Contaminated Land, on an ordinary human planet that had never been invaded by the pollution army, as an experimental factory poured the pollution wastewater into the ocean, the vague concept law gave birth to a wisp of consciousness. Runes flashed, and relying on the pollution of the human environment, the Dark King was reborn again.
When Shi Yu found this place, the Dark King had already swallowed the entire planet into its body. Although the aura on its body was a little weaker than before, it still displayed a cosmic-level aura.
“You can’t kill me.”
“Even if you can cleanse the entire Contaminated Land, you don’t have the ability to cleanse the hearts and behavior of every life form.”
“Even if you can cleanse the will of all life in the Contaminated Land, the concept of pollution outside the Contaminated Land, and even the negative emotions produced by every creature, can still allow me to be reborn.”
This was the confidence of the Dark King’s immortality. Unless someone could destroy all life in the universe, it was immortal.
“Noisy,” Shi Yu said. The Dark King was just about to persuade Shi Yu to give up on this meaningless behavior, but in the next moment, its expression changed drastically. It sensed that a creature was actually corroding the pollution source.
It focused its gaze. In the reversed world of dark matter, a Demon Duck’s eyes were shining with a dark light. It Devoured and replaced its authority. The Dark King recalled carefully and suddenly realized that every time it died, a portion of its strength would be unknowingly deprived.
From the looks of it, the culprit seemed to be here.
“Hahahahahaha.” The Dark King laughed crazily. Perhaps the cosmic will would like a guy like Shi Yu very much. Purification and pollution, balance and restraint… The Dark King’s expression gradually became cruel. Just as it was about to reach out to the dark matter world, the cleansing arrow penetrated its heart again.
Blue Planet!
Dong Huang.
Even if an ancient country with the Environmental Protection Department was established, it still couldn’t avoid pollution. This was the bad habit of humans. Even in super strong countries, there would still be people who had darkness in their hearts. Under the light, there was also a shadow. Under the gathering of various negative powers, a terrifying aura began to brew on Blue Planet.
The Dark King left the Contaminated Land directly and chose to be reborn on Blue Planet on Shi Yu’s mother planet. It wanted to teach Shi Yu a lesson, but before it could completely be reborn, a powerful spiritual power crushed over, making the Dark King’s expression change.
“Get lost.” The Super Empress stood on the icy plain and looked up at the sky, directly crushing the unformed Dark King. Shi Yu didn’t let the Super Empress participate in the battle, but let it protect Blue Planet. From the looks of it, he had done the right thing.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t be so easy for Shi Yu, who didn’t know the Dark King’s next rebirth destination, to follow the other party immediately. If Blue Planet didn’t have an expert presiding over it, the Super Empress probably wouldn’t be able to last 0.1 seconds in the hands of the Dark King.
The Dark King, who had failed to reincarnate on Blue Planet, cursed in its heart. It understood that there was a World King and the Super Empress presiding over the Cosmic Sea, so it couldn’t think of messing around over there. The Dark King had no choice but to choose to reincarnate in the Behemoth Empire again to attract the trouble.
“The Dark King is here!!”
“Shi Yu is here too!” In the Behemoth Empire, countless super divine experts were shocked in their hearts. They roared and fled, not wanting to be involved in a cosmic war at all. This battle had lasted for a long time. Even the map of the polluted land had been rewritten, and it had already made countless super divine experts’ hearts tremble. They didn’t know how long it would take for the war to end.
Shi Yu followed closely and descended with Susu. However, when they wanted to attack this time, an accident happened.
The universe was in turmoil. Even if the Super Empress and the others had already taken the place of the universe to withstand the cosmic virus, the universe was still a little weak after being tortured. It couldn’t provide power to Susu anymore.
Perhaps it wasn’t that the universe had completely lost its power, but that after entering a standard, it fell into a self-protection mechanism, unwilling to consume any more energy. Susu’s cosmic Star Sea Contract immediately lost its effect, and its strength was directly halved.
Sensing the power on Susu’s body decrease, the Dark King trembled in the starry sky and laughed. “Looks like the universe has also abandoned you. Now, without the power of the universe, what should you do?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1910: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1910: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (4)
Editor: Atlas Studios
At this moment, it was the key turning point. The World King, the Beastmaster, the Worm Queen, and the others watched even more seriously.
At this moment, it was the key turning point. The World King, the Beastmaster, the Worm Queen, and the others watched even more seriously.
Shi Yu had never placed his hopes of victory on the Star Sea Contract.
Boom!!
In the next moment, Ling, who had long been prepared and used itself as a container, was directly summoned and began to change. It shapeshifted into a super mecha that was very huge even if it stood in the starry sky.
The blue-purple mecha was no different from the fusion mecha controlled by Shi Yu and the others previously.
It had a humanoid body and a head with the characteristics of the sheep race. Under the contrast of the white Kirin Horn, the entire face of the mecha was like a white demon.
A very huge light wheel appeared behind the cosmic mecha. Every part of the light wheel was equivalent to a small cockpit. Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Little Ji… Every pet of Shi Yu was in the light wheel and distributed evenly.
This mecha had three most important cores. They were the pilot Shi Yu at its chest, as well as Susu and Duckie, who had turned into weapons.
The main stats of the entire mecha had become cleansing and pollution. Under the harmonization of the Taiji Domain, both parties suddenly erupted with extremely terrifying power, shocking the Dark King.
The light of purification and pollution lingered on the light wheel and the entire mecha body.
The super Demon God of the light wheel appeared. Eleven and the others, who had been watching the battle, recuperating, and waiting to receive the baton, revealed ferocious expressions.
“Roar!!!!” The super Demon God of the light wheel let out a roar that was like an ancient ferocious beast, moving the other cosmic thrones. On Blue Planet, the Super Empress looked at the even more perfect mecha with a long gaze.
It turned out that cosmic-level Beast Tamers could still display absolute advantages even when facing the veteran cosmic throne.
Shi Yu’s mecha held the Sword of Purification and Pollution. He activated the dual-blade style. Under the Dark King’s incredulous expression, his body was once again divided into two by the chaotic power. At the same time, he felt the dissipation of the pollution source.
“Damn it!!!” The Dark King was furious and let out a beast-like roar. When it heard the Dark King’s angry roar, the Beastmaster, who had already hidden in the stars in the depths of the Behemoth Empire, also gritted its teeth.
If he had known earlier, he wouldn’t have listened to this guy and attacked the Cosmic Sea together. Shi Yu was so strong, not including the Super Empress and the World King. He couldn’t win this battle no matter how he looked at it.
From the looks of it, the immortal Dark King would probably suffer a huge blow after this battle and sleep for hundreds of millions or even billions of years before reviving.
Until now, the Beastmaster still didn’t feel that the Dark King had killed it. Only at the cosmic level could one know the power of the cosmic level. At this moment, although the Dark King was furious, it also saw the situation clearly.
It couldn’t revive infinitely anymore.
In fact, he couldn’t even come into contact with the current Shi Yu anymore. He couldn’t leave any traces of himself in this space and time. Otherwise, it would be giving Shi Yu a chance to seal himself for no reason.
“I’ll remember you. Shi Yu!!!” The Dark King said. At this moment, it had already bet everything and admitted that it was careless this time. However, the matter was far from over. It would make a comeback sooner or later and kill Shi Yu…
Boom!!!
It was destroyed again. This time, the Dark King chose to detonate even its pollution source. There were no traces of the Dark King in this universe space and time. This scene made the Beastmaster, the World King, and the Worm Queen extremely silent, and also shocked some peak super divine experts.
At this moment…
In a certain parallel space in the 11th era.
Everything was fine. There were no cosmic disputes in the past parallel space.
The Dark King, who had self-destructed, directly teleported a trace of its consciousness to another space and time with the power of space and time and possessed another cosmic-level body. It recuperated and waited for revival and return.
Boom!!!
The aura of the Dark King erupted, shocking the entire universe. Countless experts stared at the Contaminated Land, not understanding what the awakening of the cosmic emperor meant.
Even the many Pollution Races in the Contaminated Land looked in a direction piously.
The Dark King woke up!
They knelt down piously again, including the peak super divine level, waiting for the Dark King’s supreme instructions.
But in the next moment, space and time shattered, and the interweaving chaotic aura spread. Another extremely terrifying cosmic-level aura descended with a bang. It was a cosmic-level aura that all the experts in this parallel space were extremely unfamiliar with.
Some experts closer could clearly see an incomparably terrifying human-type mecha holding the Blade of Purification and Pollution. It crossed space and time and arrived at this universe.
“Do you think you can escape after transmigrating for a billion years and coming to the past?” A deep and terrifying voice came from the mecha, making the universe tremble and the few universe levels in this parallel space fall silent.
It even made the hearts of the lives under the universe tremble.
“Impossible, how can you descend with your true body!!” The Dark King, who was originally prepared to recuperate, was immediately shocked to an incomparable level when it saw Shi Yu transmigrate a billion years with his true body and come to the past. It was even more frightened than being killed by Shi Yu ten thousand times in this space and time.
Under the terrifying might of the cosmic emperor, the galaxy trembled. In the Contaminated Land, the brains of countless Pollution Races trembled, not understanding what had happened.
However, there were also some super divine levels who had touched the power of space and time. Their expressions gradually became shocked as they deduced an unbelievable conclusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1911: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1911: Change of Master in the Contaminated Land (5)
Editor: Atlas Studios
A billion years later, the Dark King was chased by an unknown cosmic level. With the power of space and time, a trace of consciousness escaped to space and time a billion years ago to avoid powerful enemies, but…
Boom!!!
“Who do you think I am?” This time, it wasn’t Shi Yu who spoke, but Qi in a certain light wheel. It looked at the Dark King, who had raised its arms high and caught the World Cleansing Destruction Sword, with pity.
In the gradually blurry spatial traces, the wisp of consciousness of the Dark King escaped again.
It looked like the Dark King had also achieved the level of resonance with many parallel spaces. In an instant, Shi Yu sensed the Dark King resonating with the nine parallel spaces.
“Is your tempering of the power of space and time only at this level?”
This time, Shi Yu didn’t chase after the Dark King because after chasing once, he could roughly understand the “time and space laws” mastered by the Dark King.
He directly looked at the Dark King, who was roaring in this space and time. He exerted strength again. The cleansing sword Susu turned into directly shattered the head of the dark dragon.
At the same time, the universe trembled. In many parallel spaces, the brain of one of the cosmic emperors standing on the throne exploded with a bang, as if it had been killed by a supreme expert who crossed countless spaces and instantly alarmed the entire universe.
Through the attack that contained the supreme spatial profundity, Shi Yu directly nailed the other party to the reversed space and time. After a blurry space and time accelerated, they returned to the original space and time. The moment the space and time were in chaos just now, it deeply stunned many experts. Even the Beastmaster, the World King, and the Worm Queen revealed incredulous expressions.
He didn’t expect that even at this point, the Dark King was still chased by Shi Yu.
“Cosmic-level Time Sprite.”
In an instant, the Beastmaster, the Worm Queen, and the others realized what was going on and looked at a little creature in the light wheel in shock.
They could tell that this guy was only at the peak of the super divine level, but under Shi Yu’s enhancement just now, he actually reached the cosmic level. It was enough to easily transmigrate space and time and hunt countless cosmic bodies in parallel space and time?
The gazes of the cosmic emperors who were originally watching the show, such as the Beastmaster and the Worm King, trembled at this moment. They were deeply afraid of Shi Yu.
At this moment, the Dark King completely didn’t expect Shi Yu’s cultivation of the power of space and time to transcend to this extent.
Even if its body was nailed to multiple spaces, it still looked at Shi Yu fiercely.
At this moment, it suddenly had a feeling that it would be the first cosmic level to be completely killed. The person in front of it was a freak.
“Are you convinced this time?” Shi Yu asked.
“You’ll regret it. As a transmigrator, you’ll die without a burial place under the backlash of the universe sooner or later.” The Dark King looked at Shi Yu with a cold smile.
At this moment, it seemed to have seen the future and Shi Yu’s ambition. It wanted to contract the universe and become the holder of the universe.
That was a goal even more terrifying than its ambition to overturn the balance of the universe and destroy the universe.
However, what awaited the Dark King was Shi Yu’s final sword. With a boom, the Dark King’s body exploded again in many parallel spaces. Strands of origin traces were retracted and sealed in a black stone ball by Shi Yu.
He still couldn’t kill the Dark King. He could only wait for Duckie to completely snatch the other party’s authority bit by bit. However, the current outcome could already mean that he had completely won. The Dark King had already been sealed. Next was the double corrosion of Susu and Duckie.
“That’s too scary.”
“You’re the first one I’ve encountered who’s about to die. You refuse to back down,” Shi Yu said as he grabbed the stone ball.
The battle with the Dark King ended with Shi Yu’s complete victory. Although he was offline for a moment, Wang Tu Tu clearly broadcasted the scene of Shi Yu finally nailing the Dark King in countless space and time and sealing it.
Although he had expected it, at this moment, even King Tu Tu trembled a little. His mouth trembled. He was a little shocked by the outcome of Shi Yu, a new cosmic level, really crushing an old cosmic level.
Shi Yu was really a freak!!!
“Do you see that? From today onwards, the Contaminated Land has changed hands!!! The seventh cosmic throne, Shi Yu, will personally ascend the throne of the ‘galaxy’ and rule the universe!! What trashy Dark King? I didn’t expect the World King to be even afraid of it, but in front of Shi Yu’s throne, it’s simply unable to withstand a single blow!!”
At this moment, King Tu Tu, who was hugging Shi Yu’s thigh tightly, was becoming more and more arrogant. However, at this moment, the audience no longer had the mood to pay attention to its disrespectful words. Their lips also trembled slightly, wondering if what they had seen the whole time was true. Was there really such a person?

chapters.title: Chapter 1912: Milky Way Overlord
chapters.content:
Chapter 1912: Milky Way Overlord
Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu successfully sealed the Dark King, but the price he paid was huge.
This price was actually indirect.
In order to successfully seal the Dark King, Shi Yu and the others had no choice but to use Qi’s power to travel through space and time in this era.
After transmigrating, Shi Yu sensed that the universe was even weaker. This was because the Time Sprite casually transmigrated through space and time, causing the lifespan of the universe to decrease!
Therefore, the greatest price Shi Yu and the others paid was to reduce the lifespan of the universe by hundreds of millions of years for no reason.
As a cosmic level that lived almost as long as the universe, it was indirectly equivalent to losing hundreds of millions of years of lifespan.
It wasn’t just Shi Yu and the others. The World King, the Beastmaster, the Worm Queen, and the others might have also been scammed for no reason. They might have to face the restart of the universe earlier.
Of course, if someone could become the guardian of the universe, the consumption of the universe this time could naturally be ignored.
Shi Yu, who had no intention of letting the universe restart naturally, was determined to become the holder of the universe. Therefore, he didn’t care much about the lifespan of the universe.
“Susu, how do you feel?”
Shi Yu stood in the starry sky. At this moment, the mecha form slowly disappeared, leaving only Susu beside him.
Susu was also floating in the starry sky. In this battle, its Star Sea Contract completely lost its effect. The entire Contaminated Land had been cleansed, and even the Dark King had been sealed. It was estimated that no cleansing Star Spirit Race would be born in the future.
Just as the Dark King had said, external forces were unreliable. Shi Yu and the others had only done this for one goal from the beginning to the end.
Cosmic level.
As long as Susu could break through to the cosmic level, everything was worth it.
At the cosmic level, unless the universe chose to restart this huge killing weapon, the cosmic level could almost be said to be on par with the cosmic will.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, after cleansing the entire Contaminated Land, Susu shouldn’t be far from the cosmic level.
“Ning.” Susu shook its head.
“Just a little more? From the looks of it, I’m afraid I have to completely cleanse the Dark King before I have a chance to reach the cosmic level,” Shi Yu said. “I’ll use the remaining source of extreme pollution on its body to temper my cleansing origin to the extreme!”
This way, it should be possible.
“Let’s go over there and take a look first.” Shi Yu thought for a moment and opened a spatial passage. He directly arrived at the Contaminated Land from the Behemoth Empire.
No…
“From today onwards, the Contaminated Land will change its name to the Milky Way. I’ll be the overlord of the Milky Way.” After arriving in the Milky Way, Shi Yu’s voice sounded in the ears of every expert who knew about this battle, making them take a deep breath, their expressions changing drastically.
It looked like the war had really ended. The battle between the Dark King and Shi Yu had completely ended with Shi Yu’s complete victory.
No one dared to be unconvinced that Shi Yu called himself the overlord of the Milky Way.
In the Milky Way.
In some civilizations that had been bitterly resisting the Dark King Army and had been enslaved by the Dark King Army and had yet to fall, countless experts knelt piously.
“All glory! Master of the Milky Way!” They submitted almost immediately and offered their faith.
In the Cosmic Sea.
Bing Ling, the Sun God General, the Observer, and the others also clearly knew that from this moment onwards, Shi Yu wouldn’t be a figure from the same dimension as them.
Of course, there was also a group of people who were paying attention to this battle at all times. They didn’t feel that Shi Yu was no different from before since he was already at the cosmos level.
In the cosmic battle, Shi Yu’s acquaintances were all sent to Blue Planet to be protected by the Super Empress, such as Lu Qingyi and Senior Panda…
In their opinion, Shi Yu had always been so unscientific. This scene had more or less appeared in their dreams. Now that it had really happened, it was very calm.
Overlord territory.
“Interesting. Katney, choose a gift and send it to the ‘galaxy’ on behalf of the cosmic overlord army,” Cypos, who was still a cosmic supreme master, said to his secretary.
At this moment, Katney was still in deep shock. When she heard Cypo’s words, she was slightly stunned. Then, she looked incredulous.
The stingy cosmic overlord was actually willing to give someone a gift??
Legend had it that it had always been the cosmic overlord who plundered “gifts” from others.
The Cosmic Sea, the overlord territory, the Worm Mother Nest, and the Behemoth Empire could be said to have acknowledged the orthodox nature of the Milky Way almost immediately, acknowledging that Shi Yu was the true seventh cosmic emperor in the universe.
Contracting a cosmic level and stepping on the “corpse” of the previous cosmic emperor to climb up… No new cosmic level was more valuable than Shi Yu.
At this moment, just by temporarily activating telepathy, Shi Yu could hear hundreds of millions of creatures. They muttered his name in shock, as if they were praying to a god.
“Next, we can move Blue Planet to the Milky Way and not fight for territory with the World King.” Shi Yu stood in the Milky Way, but before that…
He looked at the Void. As the Dark King was sealed, he saw the increase in dark matter in the Milky Way. They radiated from the cosmic magnetic field and affected the creatures in the Milky Way at all times.
Although there wouldn’t be too much pollution, it would subtly pollute the mind and heart, making the lives in the Milky Way more angry and passive. It was easy to nurture more dark sides.
As time passed, many Pollution Races might still be born.
Realizing this, Shi Yu said, “This guy is really difficult to deal with.”
“Or it can be said that the universe is also pursuing ‘balance’. It’s impossible for complete purity to exist.”
From the looks of it, Susu couldn’t cleanse the Contaminated Land at all. The remaining power of the Dark King had long been hidden in the universe and fused with the universe. It was impossible to guard against.
This power was probably also the key for the Dark King to break through the seal and revive. It had studied the universe and understood it.
Although the impact wasn’t very big, if they wanted the Milky Way to become a place where all races in the starry sky could move like the Cosmic Sea, Susu and Duckie might still have a huge project to do.
Shi Yu wouldn’t complain about the cosmic environment like the Dark King.
After all, the universe didn’t have true consciousness. All its behavior, be it restarting or maintaining the balance of the universe, was equivalent to a life body. In order to survive better, it was a process of self-regulation.
They were all fixed laws of the universe’s own operation.
This was also a huge difficulty for Shi Yu to contract the universe. If the universe really had consciousness, it would have the capital to negotiate with the universe. Unfortunately, the universe didn’t.
If he wanted to contract the universe, he had to contract it forcefully. Although if the contract was successful, the universe could escape the fate of continuous reincarnation, the life and death reincarnation of the universe was completely in the hands of others. Therefore, the universe couldn’t accept it easily. It would reject contractors very much.
At the thought of the bumps in the future, Shi Yu understood that the most important thing now was to nurture more pets to the cosmic level. Only then could he really be evenly matched with the cosmic will.
“Quack,” Shi Yu said. The blindfolded duck immediately appeared. It removed its eye mask and walked towards a spatial crack like an ascetic monk.
“Quack! (If I don’t enter hell, who will?)” Duckie said.
“Quack! (With my body, I’ll transform into the origin. When I return, Little Ji is nothing.)”
It recited a poem and directly entered the depths of the cold and silent dark universe. Looking at Duckie’s departing figure alone, Shi Yu and the others also sighed deeply. They hoped that Duckie could withstand it…
In the Beast Taming Space, Little Ji gritted its teeth.
This was both strengthening and bitter cultivation.
Although the Dark King had been sealed, the continuous pollution power born in the universe would still flow into its origin to help it recover and break through.
In order to prevent this situation, Duckie had to transform into a new pollution source here and absorb the pollution power of the entire universe.
It mastered the Eye of the Evil God and could see all the dark matter drifting in the starry sky of the universe. It could fight for nutrients with the Dark King.
Without these nutrients, the Dark King would become weaker and weaker in the sealed artifact. In addition to Susu’s continuous cleansing, it would be completely destroyed sooner or later.
During this process, the most dangerous one was Duckie. It wasn’t at the cosmic level yet, so it might lose its mind if it wasn’t careful. It wasn’t that easy to be the master of pollution.
Fortunately, it had a Beast Tamer and a Sea of Stars Sprite as its boss. It wasn’t a life-and-death trip. As long as it had enough willpower and patience to persist in this bitter cultivation, it would definitely obtain a considerable return.
Shi Yu’s idea was to let Susu further modify the Milky Way and make this place the cleanest place in the entire universe to satisfy Susu’s cleanliness.
He wanted to create ten, a hundred, a thousand, or ten thousand holy lands that could cleanse the mind and negative emotions here to decorate the universe.
However, Shi Yu also wanted to establish a special administrative area of the Pollution Race in the center of the Milky Way and let some Pollution Races like Duckie that could control their own strength have a paradise where they could stay and not be exterminated.
Regardless of whether Duckie could break through to the cosmic level, it would become the remaining king of polluted lives after the cleanup.
After the battle ended, Duckie entered the darkest spatial crack in the Milky Way and sealed itself here, absorbing the power of pollution.
Susu also swallowed the Dark King’s sealed artifact into its body in one go. It turned into countless starlight and fused into the Milky Way, turning into the Sea of Stars. It continued to cleanse the Dark King and the Milky Way with its body and protect Duckie.
Seeing that the two pets had found their path, Shi Yu, who had stopped in the starry sky, did what he should do after a battle.
He stared at the huge Milky Way. There were no secrets that could be hidden from him. “Let me see, apart from the cosmic virus and the pollution throne, what other treasures did the Dark King collect?”
It began to collect the spoils of war!
He hoped for a useful cosmic treasure.
As for cosmic treasures, Shi Yu was still in urgent need.
The most ordinary cosmic treasure was the source of transcendence. However, for super divines, unless they cultivated subordinates, this thing was no longer very useful.
Apart from the source of transcendence, cosmic treasures were rare.
Even peak super divines might not necessarily be able to come into contact with other cosmic treasures. This kind of thing was basically controlled by a few cosmic levels. Even if peak super divines held cosmic treasures, they were most likely bestowed by the cosmic level and could be taken back at any time.
Now, the evolution of Eleven, Buggy, and a bunch of other pets might use cosmic treasures as support materials. How could Shi Yu miss them?
Although the Dark King had hidden very deeply, Shi Yu was still relatively relaxed. He found the remaining four cosmic treasures of the Dark King in the other party’s spatial treasure vault.
“Is this guy poor or rich?”
For a moment, Shi Yu fell into deep thought. This was because he didn’t know that normally speaking, a cosmic level existence with a few cosmic treasures was considered qualified.
The World King had given him the Space-time Shadowless Sword. The former cosmic treasure, the Universe Tree, had also fallen into his hands through the hands of the observer. These two definitely wouldn’t be all the assets of the World King…
As for the Dark King, apart from those who had already been crippled in combat, there were only the four in front of him.
Shi Yu took out four treasures from the spatial treasure vault and watched as they floated in front of him.
“I still feel that it’s a little shabby. Perhaps it’s for my subordinates.”
In the Beast Taming Space, a group of little money-grubbers also watched.
“Wu…”
Among them, Ling was the first pet to react to one of the four cosmic treasures. She stared at one of the rhombus bones that looked like a “fossil” and said,
“Master, this, this…”
“Let me study this.”
“This bone might be from the previous era, or even the previous era. In short, a cosmic-level expert from a certain era failed to forcefully smuggle it in, but it successfully integrated into the universe and was born again in the form of a ‘cosmic treasure’ by the universe.”
“Oh? You want to still rely on the ‘machinery phantom beast system’ to attack the cosmic level?” Shi Yu asked. He didn’t know what race this bone would be and whether it matched Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 1913: Space Bandit (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1913: Space Bandit (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“Roar!!”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Little Ji rushed forward.
What did it mean by it didn’t match Ling? It could give the bone to it. Little Ji didn’t care about fossils.
As long as the race of the fossils wasn’t a duck, it wouldn’t refuse anyone.
Little Ji had suffered without cultivation resources for a long time.
“You sure have the awareness to be a lab rat,” Shi Yu said.
If it didn’t match Ling, Ling might really be unwilling to fuse and experiment with Little Ji.
In short, if Ling had a request, Shi Yu was naturally satisfied. He directly threw the fossil to Ling.
After obtaining the fossil, Ling observed it more carefully and came to the conclusion that it was probably not easy to understand the secret of this fossil.
The phantom beast system was to enter a dream fossil, materialize illusions, and fuse illusions.
He didn’t know if Shi Yu could enter the dream of this fossil after strengthening Buggy to the cosmic level.
If it didn’t work, it would definitely have to wait for Buggy to evolve before reaching the cosmic level.
“The things collected and left behind by the Dark King seem to be useful to it.” Ling looked at the other three treasures.
“Yeah.” Apart from this prismatic fossil, Shi Yu realized that the other three treasures weren’t simple either.
He first looked at a white gem-like ball.
“Gem? Unfortunately, it’s useful, so I won’t give it to Teacher Gem Cat. Otherwise, it would be a waste.”
“This should be a cosmic treasure that contains the dream origin.” Shi Yu obtained it and only sensed it slightly before understanding the function. “If the user is expert in the dream path, he can easily use it to create a ‘real dream universe’. His body is equivalent to the cosmic will of a parallel universe.”
“But the use of the Dark King seems to be very crude.”
Shi Yu seemed to have crossed time and seen how the Dark King used it.
“This thing can also be seen as a ‘cosmic treasure’ cultivation fruit,” Shi Yu said. “If you hold it and fall into a deep sleep, you can be in a cultivation state at all times. Moreover, it’s a cultivation state with terrifying cultivation efficiency.”
“Of course, this is only the most basic usage method. The Dark King probably couldn’t be bothered to study the Dream Dao, so he brought it along as a cultivation pendant.”
“This can be given to Buggy as evolution materials.” Shi Yu looked at Buggy.
“Ji!!” Buggy was already very happy when it heard the dream source. Great, from the looks of it, it had also gained something.
“And this.” Shi Yu looked at something that looked like a flower. There were still eleven petals on it, each containing strong time power. Shi Yu was slightly stunned and said, “Good stuff.”
“Time Flower.”
“It’s a renewable cosmic treasure.”
