“Every petal of it is edible. The life it eats will awaken powerful time-element aptitude, comparable to the time-element aptitude of a top-notch time-element god,” Shi Yu said.
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, most pets’ eyes lit up. As expected of a cosmic treasure.
There were even cosmic treasures that mass-produced time-element pets.
“Unfortunately, condensing a petal requires 100 million years. However, 11 petals is enough. When the time comes, whoever’s spatial attainments aren’t good will eat a petal first.” Shi Yu’s heart rippled.
It felt that even when it sealed the Dark King, it didn’t plunder its treasure vault. It was even more exciting.
Cosmic-level fossils, Dream Gem, Time Flower, and the last one that Shi Yu was also very satisfied with.
It was a cosmic treasure the color of a starry sky that was like a heart. Shi Yu would call it the Heart of Purification for the time being.
After reaching the cosmic level, there was nothing that could be hidden from Shi Yu.
He only took a look and knew the origin of this thing. Probably after the Dark King broke through to the cosmic level, in order to maintain balance, the universe naturally condensed a cosmic treasure that could strengthen the power of cleansing.
It was the cleansing heart in front of him.
It could be said that even if it was a gem cat that only knew entry-level cleansing skills, as long as it carried this, the cleansing power could completely exceed a pile of cleansing star spirits.
Unfortunately, after this cleansing heart was naturally born in the universe, it was still useless. It tossed and turned and was finally obtained by the Dark King.
“The Dark King actually didn’t destroy this thing but kept it.” Shi Yu shook his head.
As for this, he would directly throw it to Susu. Without the Star Sea Contract for the time being, this thing could increase its cleansing efficiency.
“Wuu.” Almost all four treasures had targets to distribute. The pets who didn’t obtain the treasures were slightly regretful.
Apart from these things, the Dark King actually had many super divine resources in his collection, but Shi Yu didn’t fancy those.
After that, he would let Blue Planet take over and use it to rebuild the Milky Way. After all, developing a territory also required resources.
However, as a Beast Tamer who doted on his pets, Shi Yu still said in the end, “If there’s anything you like, you can take it directly, but don’t take all of it…”
“In any case, we still have to go to the Behemoth Empire to ‘extort’ the Beastmaster later. In short, there won’t be a lack of resources. There are also the cosmic resources promised by the Worm Queen. It’s time to transfer them.”
The Beastmaster invaded just like that and escaped just like that. It didn’t even leave anything behind. How could there be such a good thing?
The Cosmic Sea had heard Shi Yu’s plan. After breaking through to the cosmic level, he was determined to be a bandit for once and make the other cosmic levels pay a price.
“Roar!!”
Upon hearing that their Beast Tamer was so realistic, the pets were extremely touched. This had to be the case. Otherwise, how could they be raised well?

chapters.title: Chapter 1914: Space Bandit (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1914: Space Bandit (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
After the war ended, the World King sent a voice transmission to Shi Yu, indicating that it was really going to sleep for a while. It hoped that when it woke up, it could see Shi Yu turning the Contaminated Land into a new environment.
After Shi Yu and the World King asked about the Beastmaster, they made the World King sleep in peace, indicating that they would continue to maintain the peace of the universe…
In order to prevent the universe from being destroyed and to protect the peace of the world, the first stop was the Behemoth Empire!
As Shi Yu arrived, his cosmic power instantly swept through the entire starry sky.
Bang!
The group of behemoth nobles instantly felt as if they were facing a great enemy. They felt that the scythe of the Death God was quietly arriving. Even the super divine level cosmic behemoth was panting crazily at this moment. It was pressed to the ground by Shi Yu’s aura with a shocked expression and couldn’t get up.
Shi Yu held the stick formed by Bu Lu like a primeval ferocious beast, as if a stick could shatter the universe. His aura was extremely terrifying.
Just like that, he maintained the aura that suppressed the entire Behemoth Empire and displayed endless determination before arriving at a certain star domain.
With a swing of his arm, Shi Yu pointed at the stars.
“Beastmaster, I’ll give you three seconds to come out. Otherwise, I’ll blow up your country.”
After arriving at a starry sky, Shi Yu spoke, as if he was talking to someone or muttering to himself.
A moment later, a low voice came from the starry sky.
“Milky Way Overlord, what do you want?”
“I’ve already broken the alliance with the Dark King and admitted my defeat. Could it be that you want to exterminate us?”
“Do you think I’ll be like the Dark King?”
Originally, among the five cosmic levels, the cosmic overlord was undoubtedly the strongest. The other four had their own divine powers, but in terms of battle power alone, the cosmic behemoth with the strongest body was undoubtedly the most valiant.
In comparison, the Dark King’s pollution was far less destructive to contestants of the same level.
Of course, even if the Beastmaster wasn’t weak, it could only admit defeat against two World Kings and the Super Empress.
At this moment, the Beastmaster calling Shi Yu the Milky Way Overlord basically meant that it had already acknowledged Shi Yu’s status and strength. It was very submissive, but it also vaguely threatened not to let Shi Yu go overboard.
“You can admit defeat. Four cosmic treasures,” Shi Yu said.
“Impossible,” the Beastmaster said angrily.
Was Shi Yu a bandit?
Even countless years ago, it had a conflict with the cosmic overlord, Cypos. The two parties fought, and the other party only snatched two cosmic treasures. Shi Yu, on the other hand, opened his mouth and said four… He was simply worse than Persia.
“Three,” Shi Yu said.
It was mainly because he didn’t want to fight the Beastmaster for the time being. If he fought the Dark King, he would have the advantage of time, place, and people. He had yet to completely kill the other party. If he fought the Beastmaster now, with the other party’s star reincarnation ability, unless Shi Yu crushed all the planets in this universe, it would be very difficult to kill the other party.
In the end, he still hadn’t mastered the method of “100% annihilation of the cosmic level”.
“A cosmic treasure and some special high-level stars. You occupy the Contaminated Land. There aren’t many suitable life planets over there at all. I can provide them to you.”
“Just treat it as a celebration for the birth of a new cosmic emperor.”
The Beastmaster hit the nail on the head. The planet in the Contaminated Land had basically been destroyed by the Pollution Race. Even if it was cleansed, it was also a huge project to restore prosperity.
The cosmic behemoths of the Behemoth Empire ate planets as food and were the largest planet buyers of the cosmic overlord army. It could be said that the rare planets here, be it those that nurtured consciousness or those that didn’t, weren’t inferior to the Cosmic Sea in terms of quantity and quality.
When Shi Yu heard the Beastmaster’s words, he agreed with the other party and said, “A cosmic treasure and 500 high-level lifeless planets that involve rare sats such as space and time.”
“Sure.” As long as it wasn’t a cosmic treasure, although special high-level planets were also rare, the Beastmaster didn’t think much of it. At most, it would let its subordinates tighten their belts with their tails and suffer for a while.
“I like honest people.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Alright, give me the cosmic treasure too. I hope you won’t use a low-level cosmic treasure to deceive me…”
“I’m a very picky person.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, a planet turned into an eye and opened. Space and time shattered, and a huge golden-haired giant ape appeared.
It looked at Shi Yu and also at the cloth in Shi Yu’s hand.
Bu Lu, who had turned into a stick, also looked straight at the Beastmaster. It could now confirm that the best choice it had made in its life was to follow Shi Yu.
As an unlucky person, he didn’t even dare to imagine that he could one day threaten the supreme throne of the Cosmic Behemoth Race.
“Take it.” In the face of Shi Yu’s words, the Beastmaster couldn’t be bothered with him and directly took out a ball of light.
“Sure, at least you’re smart.” Shi Yu smiled and stretched out his hand. The spiritual light flew towards him.
This cosmic treasure should be equipment that could be integrated into mental consciousness and strengthen mental consciousness to a very terrifying level.
Before Shi Yu came, he had asked the World King about it. Most of the collections of Beastmasters were weapons. For example, weapon-type cosmic treasures born from the universe. Apart from that, there were also cosmic treasures like the Spirit Light that strengthened the mind.
Compared to the physical body, mental strength should be the weakness of Beastmasters. Now that he had taken out the mental light, it looked like he had cultivated a mental trump card and no longer needed this.
As for this thing, it wasn’t useless… In fact, among the cosmic treasures in Shi Yu’s team, only Buggy could really perfectly display their effect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1915: Space Bandit (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1915: Space Bandit (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Buggy’s Ultimate Devour could transform 100% of its devour into its own foundation. The other pets were a little lacking compared to it. Shi Yu thought for a moment. If nothing went wrong, this thing should also be eaten by Buggy as one of the evolution materials.
“I’ll teleport the planet to your Milky Way. If you’re satisfied, I won’t send you off,” the Beastmaster said.
“Goodbye,” Shi Yu said.
Goodbye my ass… The Beastmaster watched Shi Yu leave and knew that another “cosmic overlord” had appeared. In its opinion, Shi Yu’s strength was far from the limit when fighting the Dark King.
A cosmic-level Beast Tamer was too terrifying. Against the Dark King, it could strengthen a cosmic-level cleansing pet. Against the Dark King, it could use the power of space and time to escape and strengthen a cosmic-level Time Sprite. Against it, it could probably also strengthen a targeted pet. It could be said that Shi Yu would become the first cosmic-level without shortcomings in this era.
Moreover, Shi Yu was still quickly growing. It wasn’t impossible for him to catch up to a cosmic overlord in the future…
After leaving the Behemoth Empire, Shi Yu, the cosmic bandit, arrived at the next stop almost immediately. In the incomparably dark space, Shi Yu barged in without knocking.
This time, there was a cocoon on Shi Yu’s shoulder. Shi Yu and the cocoon looked at the monster in front of them and smiled. “Queen, it has successfully fused with your bloodline.”
“Previously, because the Cosmic Sea was sealed, I didn’t have time to ask for the next step of evolution resources. Now, I finally have time…”
Shi Yu rubbed his hands, not looking like the cosmic emperor at all. It was mainly because the Worm Queen didn’t invade the Cosmic Sea and didn’t kick him when he was down. It was worth praising.
Everyone benefited from each other. If he wanted his evolution resources, the Queen would wait for Buggy’s feedback. No one would lose out.
“Hmph…” The Queen’s low voice sounded.” The fusion was indeed successful. Moreover, she arrogantly modified your bloodline. With your current achievements, I won’t say anything else. ”
“I hope you can abide by the contract. I’ll provide the evolution resources you want.”
Then, the Worm Queen also showed its sincerity. These cosmic treasures were actually prepared for Buggy long ago.
There were a total of three.
At this point, Shi Yu’s eyes lit up. Only then did he know what it meant to be generous.
Even Buggy’s breathing was a little rapid, although it didn’t have any breathing organs.
At their cosmic level, the World King had only given them one treasure. Even if the Dark King was beaten to death, he only obtained four. He had only extorted one from the Beastmaster…
As a bystander to all the wars, the Worm Queen directly gave three.
Including pseudo cosmic treasures like the Queen Bloodline, there were four.
As expected, Shi Yu still had to get some kinship to be generous.
Of course, this was also related to the fact that the Worm Queen wanted repayment. After all, whether Buggy could break through to the cosmic level was closely related to whether it could reach the level of a cosmic overlord.
“Dragon Essence.”
“Space-time Jade Butterfly.”
“Heavenly Swamp Stone.”
“Among them, the Dragon Essence is a dragon race treasure born in the universe. It was once fought over by the dragons of two supreme cosmic races, but in the end, both of them were swallowed into my mouth. This Dragon Essence is one of the many delicacies I treasure. It’s expert dragon-element and can be easier to control than me.”
“The Space-time Jade Butterfly. Those who enter can enter the alternate space and time to accelerate their comprehension of the Space-time Law. Initially, I was worried that its spatial attainments weren’t enough to charge into the cosmic level, but when I saw the battle between you and the Dark King, I knew that I was overthinking. However, this should still be able to help it accelerate its evolution.”
“As for the Heavenly Swamp Stone… There are heavenly tribulations and heavenly lakes in the universe, but the triggering conditions are even more harsh. Using the Heavenly Swamp Stone can make the universe send down the Blessing of Grace. Perhaps it has a chance of increasing the success rate of its evolution breakthrough.”
“These resources can now be devoured by it, who has mastered the Ultimate Devour. However, it will probably take a long time to digest them. I hope you can succeed in the end.”
The Worm Queen took out three of her treasures. Shi Yu suddenly felt that apart from the cosmic overlord, it was the richest.
After all, it was said that the Worm Queen was the culprit behind the destruction of all the “cosmic races”. The foundation of so many supreme races in the universe had all been accumulated on the Worm Queen. Even if some of them had already been extorted by the cosmic overlords, there should still be a lot left.
“Thank you. If Buggy really reaches the cosmic level in the future, you will definitely be rewarded,” Shi Yu said. After thanking the other party for his generosity, he left the Worm Mother Nest with Buggy.
At this point, he had already obtained benefits from the four cosmic levels.
As for the cosmic overlord… After Shi Yu broke through to the cosmic level, he still felt that this guy was unfathomable.
Perhaps, if he increased the battle power of the Super Empress and used the full battle power of the two eras system, he could fight a cosmic overlord evenly, but it was hard to say.
Therefore, it had nothing to do with him in the first place, so Shi Yu didn’t ask for the congratulatory gift to avoid hitting a wall.
However, just as Shi Yu returned to the Milky Way, he was slightly stunned. He discovered that a battleship of the cosmic overlord army had entered the Milky Way range.
Moreover, the person on this battleship seemed to be the secretary of that cosmic overlord or something. Shi Yu had learned about him from Goddess Wa.
Could it be that the other party came…
“What’s the matter?” Shi Yu crossed countless light years and his voice landed in the battleship.
In the battleship, Katney was stunned. “Lord Shi Yu… On behalf of the cosmic overlord, I’m here to send a congratulatory gift for you to become the Milky Way Overlord.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1916: Space Bandit (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1916: Space Bandit (4)
Editor: Atlas Studios
As expected!
“You’re welcome. As long as your intentions are there.” In the next moment, Shi Yu’s true body descended into the battleship with a smile.
Hahahahaha, it looked like the cosmic overlord was also convinced by his powerful strength. This time, the five cosmic levels of this era had all given him gifts.
Not bad, not bad.
“This is a gift. Please accept it, Lord Shi Yu.” Then, Katney took out a crystal in a box. This was… a cosmic treasure-level wood-element crystal.
Shi Yu’s smile stopped. “Thank the cosmic overlord for me. I’ve already received his kindness.”
Didn’t they agree on the richest life in the universe?
If cosmic treasures were also divided into levels, the source of transcendence was the trashiest cosmic treasure. A little higher was pure energy crystals.
The one given by the cosmic overlord was expensive, but it revealed its stinginess. However, the fact that the other party could come and give a gift was already giving him, the Milky Way Overlord, a lot of face. Shi Yu couldn’t be picky.
When the cosmic overlord had a happy event, he would have to give him an even more expensive gift. To think that he was an employee of the other party’s army. It was unfair.
But no matter what, Shi Yu felt that it was impressive to be able to send a congratulatory gift!
It was just that what was the use of the other party collecting so many cosmic treasures? He was probably going to be scared. In the future, when they sparred, he might be able to use some cosmic treasures as a bet to win and lose.
“Alright, also, the cosmic overlord said that it’s waiting for your challenge,” Katney said.
Whatever he thought would come.
“Oh.” Shi Yu put away the gift and said, “That day won’t be far.”
After harvesting a round, Shi Yu could be said to be quite rich. Shi Yu was so concerned about how much he had obtained because he was counting on these things to be resources for the team’s pets to charge into the cosmic level.
Although charging into the cosmic level couldn’t be succeeded with resources, without resources, one couldn’t do anything without resources.
Now, Ling had an unknown fossil. Susu had the Heart of Purification and the Dark King. Chi Tong had the Space-time Shadowless Sword, Baby Ginseng had the seed of the Universe Tree, Buggy had the Dream Gem, the Light of Spirit, Dragon Essence, the Space-time Jade Butterfly, the Heavenly Swamp Stone, and wood-element crystals. In Shi Yu’s opinion, Buggy was the most stable. The other pets had purely just started.
Of course, Eleven didn’t seem to have any resources, but Shi Yu’s cultivation of the plundering talent was all for Eleven. His Taiji Domain, Green Dragon, Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger domains were all prepared to be stripped from him and permanently given to Eleven, so its resources were actually the most luxurious.
As for the second team… The first team wasn’t done yet. Shi Yu could only say that he would take his time.
In any case, he wasn’t in a hurry to become a cosmic holder. In the next billions of years, Shi Yu didn’t believe that he couldn’t nurture a bunch of cosmic levels.
In the last era, there were a total of 16 cosmic levels. In this era, Shi Yu felt that there should only be more, not less.
“Looks like you’ve gained a lot.” Just as Shi Yu was imagining the future, the figure of the Super Empress slowly appeared. Shi Yu smiled at her and said, “Yes.”
“Next, I can enter seclusion to cultivate fiercely for a period of time.”
“Don’t worry and enter seclusion. I’ll train your pets,” the Super Empress said.
Shi Yu was stunned. “Hahaha, is this the reliability of a senior?”
The Empress: “?”
“No need, no need. They can take good care of themselves. I think you should go and train the gem cat and squeeze it dry. If she can also become a cosmic level before I contract the universe, won’t the success rate of the contract be even higher? A cosmic level wish is still worth looking forward to.”
“It’s easier said than done. Do you know how much effort I spent to make her at the peak of the super divine level?” The Super Empress sneered, suspecting that Shi Yu was making things difficult for her!

chapters.title: Chapter 1917: The Arrival of Shi Yu’s Daughter (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1917: The Arrival of Shi Yu’s Daughter (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
As the Dark King was sealed, the Contaminated Land changed owners and changed its name to the Milky Way. Blue Planet began to wander again.
Shi Yu had been waiting for this day and satisfied his bad taste.
Originally, Earth was in the Milky Way, but now, Blue Planet was finally in the Milky Way.
However, this Milky Way was countless times larger than that Milky Way.
Before Blue Planet stationed in the Milky Way, Little Zi was filial and beat them to it, occupying the best place in the Milky Way.
As the exclusive star of Shi Yu and the others, the place they stayed naturally couldn’t be bad. Otherwise, Little Zi was afraid that Shi Yu and the others wouldn’t sleep comfortably.
If nothing went wrong, Little Zi would also become a cosmic-level star in the future. After all, compared to other races, it was too easy for a planet to become a cosmic-level star. It just had to endure time.
Perhaps Little Zi would be the last to become a cosmic level in the team, but it definitely had the highest chance.
Therefore, apart from Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, Eleven and the others also had traces in Little Zi’s inner world. Eleven and the others had also built their residences. Although they didn’t plan to stay at the moment, they had to occupy a toilet first.
In other words, he would first get a piece of land and wait for Little Zi to break through before waiting for its value to increase.
As for the planets promised by the Beastmaster, they had also been transferred to the account. However, before using them to decorate the Milky Way, Shi Yu first chose a batch and refined them into weapons for his pets.
With money, he naturally had to arm himself first. As for the ordinary lives waiting for resources in the Milky Way, it was fine to suffer a little more. In any case, it had suffered for so long.
The creatures of the original Contaminated Land shouldn’t be so naive as to think that a new good person had come here… That was impossible. All development had to serve their side first.
“Next, you guys cultivate yourselves.”
“I’m going to pinch Eleven and Buggy’s evolution materials first.”
Before Shi Yu went into seclusion, he dispersed his pets. However, in order to avoid them lazing around, Shi Yu said, “It’s been a long time since I’ve organized the team internal competition. Ling, arrange for them to compete one last time before the cosmic level.”
“As for the reward, 10 cosmic experience vouchers will do,” Shi Yu said with a chuckle.
“Wu wu wu!!! (Team internal competition?!)”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the pets were stunned. Damn, was he finally waiting for the next team internal competition?
Eleven, Buggy, and the others looked at each other.
As for the reward… 10-year cosmic experience voucher…
The pets roughly understood what it meant. Shi Yu had the ability to strengthen them to the cosmic level, but during this process of maintaining strengthening, Shi Yu would definitely consume energy. Therefore, without special circumstances, Shi Yu wouldn’t keep activating strengthening. He would become weak.
However, if anyone could get first place in the team, they could continue to be strengthened for 10 years and experience 10 years of the cosmic level. This experience was definitely very helpful in charging into the cosmic level.
After all, they had already experienced the true meaning of the universe level in advance, and it had been so long. As long as it wasn’t someone like the gem cat who didn’t improve, it would definitely be at the cosmic level in the future.
It could be said that the first place in the team this time would most likely be the first in the team to enter the cosmic level. The Super Empress didn’t count…
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the group of pets secretly worked hard. When the last team internal competition was still at the demigod level, everyone originally thought that the next one would be held at the divine level. In the end, they didn’t expect to wait until the peak of the super divine level…
“Wu!!” Buggy was depressed. Damn it, its current cocoon form… wasn’t complete.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng was also depressed. It didn’t study the Anti-Teammate Fruit in this version.
The pets and planets were different, but no matter what, they wanted to make their ranking look better. Shi Yu had controlled them. None of the pets he tamed wanted to be destroyed or lie flat. It was pretty good.
“It’s good to know the pets in the team.”
Under Shi Yu’s gaze, the group of pets muttered and left. As for him, he began to enter seclusion with mixed emotions.
This time, Shi Yu didn’t know how long he would have to cultivate. Although his Beast Taming Talent, such as telepathy, had already reached the cosmic level, his Plundering Talent, his metal-element Strengthening Talent, his worm-element Strengthening Talent, and so on were still only below the cosmic level. They weren’t upgraded because of the breakthrough in realm.
Therefore, Shi Yu couldn’t deprive talents like Taiji and directly give them to Eleven.
Even if he could deprive the Taiji talent, it was still not enough.
Just having the Taiji talent definitely couldn’t perfectly strengthen Eleven of the Iron-eating Beast Race. Therefore, he had to fuse the Taiji Domain talent and the metal-element strengthening talent and materialize these abilities in the state of a piece of metal and give them to Eleven.
In other words, he wanted to forge Taiji Yin Yang Metal!
Then, he would let Eleven eat this metal as an evolution material.
Apart from that, there was also the Green Dragon Metal, Vermillion Bird Metal, Black Tortoise Metal, White Tiger Metal… Taiji, Four Symbols, and Eight Trigrams. This way, Eleven could undergo Chaos Origin Evolution.
And if he wanted to achieve this, Shi Yu had to cultivate metal-element strengthening, deprivation of talent, and so on to the cosmic level. Even with Baby Ginseng’s cultivation fruit, Shi Yu felt that this was also a huge project.
After all, Baby Ginseng’s cultivation fruit couldn’t care less about the universe level for the time being.
Apart from that, there was also Buggy that could devour things to evolve. Therefore, before it evolved, Shi Yu was also prepared to strip something out for it. For this, Shi Yu specially cultivated talents suitable for Buggy such as Worm Strengthening.

chapters.title: Chapter 1918: The Arrival of Shi Yu’s Daughter (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1918: The Arrival of Shi Yu’s Daughter (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
After this series of processes, it was no different from creating a top-notch super divine skill. Fortunately, the current Shi Yu wasn’t a threat externally. He didn’t have anything else, but he had ridiculously much time.
Of course, in order to avoid completely losing contact with the outside world, Shi Yu still had a clone to watch the changes in the Milky Way when his main body cultivated.
This clone didn’t have any other quests. It was just playing and communicating with the outside world in place of Shi Yu’s main body.
He had obtained Teacher Cat’s reverse teachings.
This was because Shi Yu was cultivating with his main body at this moment. His clone was playing, while Teacher Cat’s main body was lazing around. With his clone working, it was obvious that he wasn’t a good cat.
Three years passed in the blink of an eye.
Three years was simply an instant for the universe.
Even for Shi Yu and the others, it was in the blink of an eye.
In fact, even the news of Shi Yu becoming the Milky Way Overlord had yet to completely spread to all corners of the universe. This process probably took a long, long time. After all, there were still many backward planets like “Past Blue Planet”.
In three years, Blue Planet had already established itself in the Milky Way.
However, three years didn’t allow Shi Yu to cultivate any talent he learned after birth to the cosmic level.
It was too difficult.
This was even under the situation where Shi Yu cheated and let the rabbit assist in his cultivation.
The Super Empress was expert in spiritual power. Next was time. After all, she had “eaten” so many time sprites.
Although it was a pity that he didn’t learn spatial travel, his time attainments should be the strongest tier in the entire universe.
With her time control, three years wasn’t just three years, but it was still not enough.
However, Shi Yu wasn’t discouraged. After all, if the cosmic level was that easy, it would have long been common. He was already prepared to cultivate for 30,000 years.
As for pets, they had just finished the team meeting a few days ago. The pets were different.
Apart from the Empress, all Shi Yu’s pets participated in this team internal competition.
The ranking was updated!!!
Among them, because Turtle and Little Quas didn’t participate in the competition in the form of a fusion this time, they were undoubtedly at the bottom. Little Quas won slightly.
However, the entire team suspected that Turtle was going easy on Little Quas. It was afraid that Little Quas would lose face at the bottom, so it sacrificed itself for love.
Next was Shorty, who followed closely behind and was third from the bottom. As the pet of the second team, it still had to have the awareness of the second team’s pet. However, it was the pain in their hearts that they didn’t defeat Bu Lu.
Bu Lu had too many skills and was too sick. After being maxed out and fused, he couldn’t play with it at all.
However, although Bu Lu’s skill interface was very abnormal, he only defeated the little three of the second team. He really couldn’t defeat Little Ji and Duckie in front.
During this period of time, Little Ji and Duckie’s epic enhancement had increased.
Duckie was always accepting the Dark King’s inheritance.
Little Ji, on the other hand, accepted the Dark King’s inheritance.
Although the Dark King was a cleansing star spirit, it was a cleansing star spirit in the form of a “dragon”. It could also be considered a dragon from soup to nuts.
The Dark King was sealed, but the components on its body could be used uselessly.
Ling and Susu asked for the Dark King’s dragon bone to update Little Ji’s anti-poison system. The two of them were indeed lifelong enemies. One snatched the source of the Dark King’s power, and the other used the source of the Dark King’s power to train his immune system…
In the end, it was a draw no matter how they fought.
He didn’t know how long this situation would last.
Unfortunately, Ling had yet to figure out what the cosmic fossil Little Ji was looking forward to was. With the abilities of Shi Yu and the others, they still couldn’t figure it out.
He probably really had to wait for Buggy to enter the cosmic level itself.
After that, it was Little Zi. As a planetary life form, because it had learned the Star Contract from Blue Planet, it could summon the power projection of a team of big shots to help it fight. It was a summoner.
The team of big shots summoned by the extreme consumption of the power of the star, such as Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Little Ji, and the others, really couldn’t defeat them.
Then, it was Qi. As a Time Sprite with battle power, Qi’s battle method was more torturous. Most pets couldn’t hit it at all.
Even in the first team, not every pet could steadily punish Qi. Qi lost purely because she couldn’t do anything to the other party. After the anxious battle, the first team of pets was still better. Everyone more or less learned the essence of the ginseng baby.
In the old team, the version changed drastically. What was more strange was that Buggy was at the bottom this time and became the sixth.
As the rules didn’t allow equipment, the most generous Buggy was weakened when the cosmic treasure couldn’t be used.
As the rules didn’t allow equipment, the most generous Buggy was weakened when the cosmic treasure couldn’t be used.
Defeating the second team was already the limit.
If Buggy wanted to rise again, it probably had to evolve.
As for number five, it became Chi Tong. As a spirit body, this girl’s strongest point was still to cooperate with Shi Yu, but unfortunately, this was a one-on-one battle.
Ling became number four. It looked like it was indifferent to the team internal competition, but it had actually studied Chi Tong’s skills thoroughly and defeated it a little.
As for number three, it was Baby Ginseng. It wasn’t researching the Energy Fruit of the Anti-Teammate. Instead, it was shaping the Heart of the Heavenly Emperor. Its performance this time could only be said to be average, and it couldn’t find a perfect way to crack Eleven’s Chaos Divine Body.
However, Eleven, who had the strongest Chaos Divine Body and could casually crush the Sun God General, didn’t get first place this time either. Instead, it was taken by Susu, who had broken its contract with the Sea of Stars.

chapters.title: Chapter 1919: The Arrival of Shi Yu’s Daughter (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1919: The Arrival of Shi Yu’s Daughter (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
No one expected this before the team internal competition. After all, Susu had lost the Star Sea Contract. In theory, it should be the one whose battle power was the most weakened, even more serious than Buggy.
However, no one expected Susu to have a breakthrough in its cleansing attainments during the process of cleansing the Dark King. Although it didn’t have the Star Sea Contract, its origin fluctuations became the second “super divine skill” in the team.
Susu became the second cosmic race after Buggy.
Apart from the Dark King’s EXP package, it was also related to Shi Yu’s enhancement of her for a long time, allowing Susu to accumulate incomparably rich EXP.
Now that she was first in the team, it meant that she had already walked further than every pet on the path of the universe.
Although the Chaotic Body was also very strong, it was incomplete after all. Eleven still lost to Susu. However, every pet felt that Susu deserved it.
The last team internal competition was still the God Sealing Battle. If it was before the super divine level, the divine level would also hold an internal team competition. As the first epoch god, Susu was still far ahead. Everyone had yet to forget that Susu was the first to break through to the epoch god.
At that time, Susu was in the lead at the divine level, and now it was in the lead at the super divine level. Everyone had to be convinced of her first place. Of course, although they were convinced, Eleven and the other pets were also waiting for him to enter the complete body and the cosmic level. At that time, they would fight the complete Susu seriously.
Fighting a cosmic level was only for fun. In terms of strength, it still depended on the team internal competition.
At this moment, Susu finally obtained first place in the team.
Its only wish was to cleanse the Dark King as soon as possible and break through to the cosmic level.
After this team internal competition, the entire team was still cultivating calmly.
Shi Yu’s clone continued to pay attention to the situation in the outside world. Among them, after Emperor Shi confirmed that Shi Yu was almost invincible in the universe, he directly chose to reincarnate.
Originally, Goddess Wa, Blue Planet, and the others wanted to protect Emperor Shi. The Space Emperor and the others had even imagined a novel by Long Aotian: “The reincarnated me is actually a senior of the cosmic throne.”
This plot was too invincible no matter how one thought about it.
Unfortunately, Emperor Shi still had a personality. He pulled all his pets to reincarnate together and only established a karma connection with his pets. Then, he erased all traces of himself and didn’t let big shots like the Blue Planet’s Will help him.
Emperor Shi said, “If there’s someone protecting you, reincarnation won’t have the tempering effect.”
“Don’t worry, I’ve already made enough backup plans. Perhaps after reincarnation, I’ll die from various accidents when I’m weak, but after I die, I’ll still undergo the next reincarnation until I surpass the past.”
“I’m already prepared to reincarnate a hundred, a thousand, or ten thousand times. Perhaps if we meet again, it’ll be a hundred million years later, but it doesn’t matter.”
“I won’t stop until I see the cosmic level.”
Emperor Shi had abandoned his memories and everything during this reincarnation. However, it was certain that he had still reincarnated on Blue Planet.
Emperor Shi didn’t let everyone protect his reincarnation, so everyone chose to respect him.
Although even if Emperor Shi erased his traces, Shi Yu could still find him as long as he wanted, since Senior Emperor Shi was unwilling, Shi Yu wouldn’t ruin his cultivation.
However, as a super divine reincarnation, his future was destined to be dazzling. It was difficult not to be noticed by the Blue Planet’s Will… Emperor Shi probably meant for the Blue Planet’s Will and the others to not interfere when they saw that his reincarnation was on the verge of death…
Seeing the reincarnation of Emperor Shi, Shi Yu looked forward to it. It looked like Senior Emperor Shi was determined to charge at the cosmic throne. He didn’t even hesitate to reincarnate to train and cultivate again. In fact, with his ruthlessness, it was possible for him to say that he wasn’t satisfied with an ordinary throne and wanted to charge at the cosmic overlord realm.
The other emperors didn’t have the boldness of Emperor Shi, but they were already super divine, including geniuses like Senior Lu and Senior Panda who had been taken away by Goddess Wa to nurture. They had already become famous. Now, with the four peak super divine powers, Goddess Wa, Floating Light, Blue Planet, and Gem Cat, presiding over the Milky Way, they could be said to be not inferior to any cosmic-level faction.
Among them, Goddess Wa and Blue Planet decided to nurture the Blue Planet’s humans and races and let themselves charge at the cosmic level.
The revived emperors were all their cultivation targets.
Floating Light established a star in the Milky Way and called itself Buddha. It planned to promote Buddhism in the Milky Way. Although Shi Yu didn’t like Buddhism, considering that the other party had helped a lot, he allowed it. It was a world with freedom of religion.
As for the gem cat, it was the least ambitious among the few peak super divines. Fortunately, Shi Yu had tricked her. Although the Empress felt that helping the gem cat break through to the cosmic level was unrealistic, considering that contracting the universe was also unrealistic and difficult, she decided to test it with the gem cat first.
She wanted to see if they could transform the gem cat to the cosmic level.
If this was already done, what else was impossible?
As time passed, this time, a little too much time passed. In the blink of an eye, 10 years passed.
Although it was still like an instant compared to the universe, and even for ordinary demigods, it wasn’t long, Shi Yu and the others had only grown for a few decades.
This leap gradually made Shi Yu and the others feel that they were no longer the happy time where they could quickly gain something by casually adding points.
In the past 10 years, Shi Yu had still been accumulating. After reaching the cosmic level, it was indeed not that easy to think of some progress.
His metal-element strengthening, bug-element strengthening, and other talents had been cultivated to the cosmic level, but the plundering ability that could strip away his talent was still a little lacking.

chapters.title: Chapter 1920: The Arrival of Shi Yu’s Daughter (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1920: The Arrival of Shi Yu’s Daughter (4)
Editor: Atlas Studios
However, Shi Yu wasn’t in a hurry. He had already cultivated bitterly for 10 years. At most, he would cultivate bitterly for another ten years. In any case, cultivation was just sleep for him. It had been a dream for 10,000 years, and in reality, 10 years. Shi Yu had actually slept for god knows how long with the Empress’s help.
In the past 10 years, basically nothing big had happened in the outside world, and there was nothing that could attract Shi Yu’s attention. The pets were still accumulating their foundation for the universe level, and the Dark King had still not been cleansed.
Shi Yu originally thought that he would calmly experience another ten, twenty, hundred, or thousand years. He would gradually become like the old antiques he had encountered previously and become an “older generation figure”.
However, an unexpected thing brought slight changes to Shi Yu’s calm cultivation life.
More than ten years ago, a group of super divines from Blue Planet explored the ruins of Earth and obtained a baby.
That baby was a hope seed with cosmic aptitude created by the cosmic-level big boss of the previous era, Goddess Wa. With Shi Yu’s bloodline and a group of rare materials, it was known as the human with the strongest talent.
It was said that this baby needed to combine the bloodline power of a few human experts with potential on Blue Planet to revive, but this day…
She directly lived on her own.
“Are you my father?” The baby girl, who was less than half a meter tall, widened her eyes and stared at Shi Yu, who was a little annoyed.
“Holy shit, what’s going on?” Shi Yu cursed in his heart for a long time. He no longer had the calmness of a cosmic level.
In fact, he didn’t even have time to carefully sense the situation on her body.
Only the Empress, who had temporarily stayed here in the Beast Taming Space to assist Shi Yu in his cultivation, could tell what was going on at a glance.
“She should be from a certain parallel space, a certain parallel space. She has reached the cosmic level. She should have been possessed by consciousness now, just like how the Dark King went to other parallel spaces at that time.”
“Huh?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Are you… really my father?” the baby girl repeated.
In fact, she had already sensed the bloodlines of both parties.
However, when Shi Yu’s cosmic-level consciousness possessed the baby Shi Yu, the person she saw made her doubt life.
Shi Yu looked at the young man in front of him in slippers, a panda casual short-sleeved shirt, and shorts. He looked weak and Enfeeble, and he was holding a medicine bottle. Her stomach hurt.
As the most beautiful and powerful female Beast Tamer in the era, the source of her bloodline was actually this appearance?
“What’s wrong with you?”
Shi Yu’s face darkened. He looked at the baby girl with a trembling hand and said, “Little guy, you casually transmigrated from other parallel spaces. You shouldn’t be here to scare me, right?”
“I can’t afford this shock.”
“I want… to ask for your help,” Shi Yu said.
The baby girl said, “Let me introduce myself first. My name is Shiyu. You should know my identity. I’m from a future parallel space. That space-time is a little special. It doesn’t have a close connection to other space-times, as if it’s blocked. The specific reason is very complicated to explain. It’s very difficult for other parallel spaces to sense its existence. In the future parallel space-time, the universe is encountering an unprecedented disaster…”
“Which five beasts revived you? Is that allowed?” Shi Yu didn’t seem to have caught the main point of the problem.
Shi Yu was also very helpless when he saw Shiyu, who hadn’t caught the main point of the problem.
“That space and time are a little special. You didn’t exist. Or rather, in that space and time, you failed to transmigrate and didn’t successfully awaken the memories of your previous life. In the 177th year of the alliance calendar, you already died in the breeding base of Icefield City because of your heart paralysis…”
“Because a certain historical node changed, giving birth to a completely different parallel universe, but it’s inextricably linked to other universes…”
“They died before leaving the breeding base???” Shi Yu paused. What the hell? Not only Shi Yu, but Eleven and the others were also stunned. What about them?? Did the situation of not encountering Shi Yu really happen?

chapters.title: Chapter 1921: Special Parallel Space (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1921: Special Parallel Space (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Shiyu began to tell Shi Yu about the situation in the future parallel space he was in.
In that space and time, Shi Yu had long died from mental pressure and heart paralysis in the staff dormitory of a pet breeding base in Icefield City.
On Blue Planet in that space and time, there was no transmigrator Shi Yu at all. There was no genius archeologist Shi Yu from Bureau 11. A monster that was enough to change the structure of the universe died in such a small dormitory.
However, although there was no Shi Yu, the torrent of history still had to advance.
As a parallel universe, many things were similar, but many things were also different.
Similarly, for example, the five cosmic levels didn’t change, nor did the Mythical War.
A creature named Goddess Wa still obtained the inheritance of Goddess Wa and rose in the universe to manage the cosmic overlord army.
However, at a certain historical node, this space and time changed again. After Goddess Wa left the cosmic overlord army, although she also failed to break through to the cosmic level, the backlash she suffered was much lighter.
This allowed her to recover earlier. After recovering, Goddess Wa returned to Blue Planet and helped Blue Planet recover its Restoration and Mythical Revival in advance. She did what Lin Feng, the Space Emperor, and the others originally wanted to do.
Moreover, in order to explore the ruins of Earth, Goddess Wa also began to cooperate with the Blue Planet’s Will to revive geniuses and nurture humans. Under Goddess Wa’s return, it didn’t take long for many super divine humans to be born on Blue Planet in this space and time.
The ruins of Earth were naturally opened. She, Shiyu, was discovered at this time.
In this space and time, although Shi Yu couldn’t transmigrate, the daughter of Shi Yu, who was regarded as a spark of hope in the previous era, transmigrated.
Moreover, it was successfully revived by the Blue Planet bloodline in this space and time.
Under the protection of Goddess Wa, Blue Planet’s rise was unstoppable. As Shi Yu’s daughter appeared, Blue Planet’s momentum became even fiercer.
It only took 18 years. When Shiyu was 18 years old, she reached the peak of the super divine level and was ranked at the quasi cosmic level.
It could be said that she was undoubtedly the strongest genius in the starry sky of the universe.
Until here, everything was still very normal. Although there was no Shi Yu, the most dazzling new star in the universe had become his daughter, Shiyu. It wasn’t bad.
However, as Shiyu grew, she came into contact with more and more secrets.
As Shi Yu listened, his expression changed from calm to surprise.
This was a relatively special future parallel space.
It was special because of two unexpected guests.
Because these two unexpected guests made this space-time isolated from other space-times, as if it was blocked.
The first unexpected guest was the culprit behind this spatial confusion.
According to the investigations of the various cosmic levels in this space and time, this unexpected guest was a Time Sprite from the tenth era!
The way the Time Sprite transmigrated through space and time was extremely crude, directly causing the space and time it descended into to collapse.
The most detestable thing was that it even failed to transmigrate. After it arrived at the 11th era, there were no longer any traces of life, making it impossible for the few cosmic emperors to punish it.
According to Shiyu, this Time Sprite was a guy with the appearance of a rabbit. It was suspected to be a cosmic-level Time Sprite!
[F*ck.] Upon hearing this, Shi Yu, the Empress, and the others looked calm on the surface, but their hearts exploded.
Even the Super Empress wasn’t calm at this moment.
[Could this Time Sprite from the 10th era be the one that gave us the inheritance?]
[Mm…] The Empress felt that it was very likely.
[No wonder I didn’t see it in this space and time. So it ran to another time. However, in a sense, it still failed.]
[In addition, didn’t it rely on taking medicine to temporarily reach the cosmic level? Is this a breakthrough during the process of transmigrating space and time?] If it was only a cosmic level that took medicine, it was impossible for the cosmic level of this era not to discover that it was only at the peak of the super divine level. It had probably broken through during this process.
Shi Yu and the Empress communicated in their hearts. They never expected that the culprit who made the future parallel space special and independent as if it had been blocked was “Senior Jade Rabbit”.
They continued to listen to Shiyu’s introduction.
If only the Jade Rabbit of Time was an unexpected guest, this space and time could still withstand it, but…
The other unexpected guest was the source of the disaster that would cause a crisis in the future space and time!
It was still a transmigrator.
“It calls itself the ‘cosmic god of destruction’.”
“It should be from the first era. It’s the first batch of cosmic life forms to resist the reboot of the universe.”
“We don’t know how it crossed the other eras and directly came to the 11th era. However, it might be the first life form in history to transmigrate to the universe after reboot in a complete state.”
“It’s very powerful and retained its strength. The most terrifying thing is that just like its name, as an expert who resisted the reboot of the universe, its goal is also to destroy the universe.”
“Why are there so many dangerous elements?” Shi Yu had a headache. “So, the crisis of the future space and time is a cosmic level that crossed ten eras from the first era?”
“That’s not right. It’s just a cosmic level existence. Can’t you guys solve it yourselves?”
The baby girl, Shiyu, said, “It’s very strong, and its strength is even above that of a cosmic overlord. It broke the precedent of not being able to kill at the cosmic level. The Worm King, the Beastmaster, the Dark King, and the World King died in its hands one after another.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1922: Special Parallel Space (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1922: Special Parallel Space (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu:
“In fact, even Cypos couldn’t defeat it.”
“Of course, at the same time, making an enemy of the entire universe, the God of Destruction also paid a considerable price. Now that both parties are injured with the cosmic overlord, be it the God of Destruction or the cosmic overlord, they’re currently in the recuperation stage.”
“It can be said that the territory of a cosmic overlord is the last pure land in the universe.
The other places have already been turned upside down by it. Blue Planet received protection because of the relationship between Goddess Wa and the cosmic overlord.”
“If it weren’t for the protection of the cosmic overlord, it would probably have become a speck of dust in the universe.”
“I understand.” Shi Yu originally didn’t mind, but when he heard his future daughter’s words, he immediately understood the seriousness of the matter.
Killing four cosmic-level existences… It was killing them, not sealing them!
After all, he had only sealed the Dark King previously.
Just as Shiyu had said, the strength of this Cosmic God of Destruction was probably above that of a cosmic overlord.
Why were these powerful people all crazy? They wanted to destroy the universe at every turn…
However, Shi Yu thought about it from his position. If the universe wanted to restart and kill him and obliterate everything he was familiar with, he would probably hate the universe itself.
It was to avoid this situation that he wanted to become the holder of the universe.
“Then, how did you think of looking for me?” Shi Yu looked at her. “When did you cultivate to the cosmic level? Not bad.”
“You, your cosmic pet, and the cosmic overlord can’t defeat that guy together?”
Shiyu said, “The injuries of the cosmic overlord are far more serious than those of the God of Destruction. He might not be able to attack in the short term.”
“In addition, I don’t have a cosmic pet…”
Shi Yu:
“How did you break through to the cosmic level without a cosmic pet?”
“It’s the World King.” Shiyu took a deep breath and said, “Before Senior World King died, he used his last bit of strength to contract me and help me break through to the cosmic level.”
“After completing it, she died.”
“Before she died, she also predicted how to save this universe through the power of stars and astrology.”
“The answer she gave is the origin of my bloodline. She divined that in a certain space and time, your existence thinks that you can save this universe.”
“Therefore, I thought of a way to break through the limit and come here through my bloodline connection,” Shiyu said. “The cosmic overlord was heavily injured. I think I’m not a match for the God of Destruction. I can’t even find any traces of it now. When the God of Destruction recovers one step in advance, that space and time will probably be completely finished.”
“Hu…”
Upon hearing that, Shi Yu roughly understood the situation in the future space and time. He took a deep breath and felt a headache.
It was so troublesome…
He originally thought that he could easily slack off after reaching the cosmic level, but in the end, where did this transmigrator who was stronger than a cosmic overlord come from?
As expected, the greatest enemy of transmigrators was still transmigrators.
“If your space-time destruction happens, the other space-times will probably be greatly implicated,” Shi Yu said. Many parallel spaces still belonged to the large area of the 11th era. If one encountered destruction, the others would also have a chain reaction and encounter destruction.
This was what made Shi Yu feel troubled.
Shiyu said, “Well, the universe I’m in has long been unstable for many years. This is because these two special invading transmigrators should have had billions of years of lifespan left. Now, there’s not much lifespan left. At most, there are hundreds of millions of years. In addition, with the God of Destruction wreaking havoc, there are only two outcomes waiting for our universe.”
“One is the destruction of the God of Destruction. This way, the other parallel universes will also be implicated. The second is the universe restarting itself. This will also cause the other parallel universes to be implicated. Therefore, this is no longer a disaster of a single parallel universe, but a disaster of the 11th era.”
“You probably haven’t gotten a boyfriend yet, right?” Shi Yu suddenly looked at Shiyu and said.
Shiyu:
“No, why are you asking this?” Shiyu was angry. What the hell was this question?
Why did they go astray again?
Shiyu felt that her bloodline source was indeed so unreliable.
“It’s good that you don’t. Let me tell you, there are too many bad people in this universe. You can’t fall in love casually, especially a girl like you. You’re easy to deceive.” Shi Yu suddenly muttered. Although Shiyu wasn’t Shi Yu’s daughter, his blood was flowing in her body. It could be regarded as a bloodline daughter, so it was impossible for him not to care.
“Hey, hey, hey.” In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, Chi Tong and the other pets immediately had a headache when they saw Shi Yu’s focus gradually deviate. Therefore, was this the reason why Shi Yu didn’t find a girlfriend? However, what was with this strong fatherly feeling?
Shouldn’t the focus now be that God of Destruction?
“I’m already the cosmic emperor!” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s lecture, Shiyu wanted to pull the other party onto the right track.
“Are you even listening to me?”
“I heard it, I heard it.” Shi Yu suddenly stopped and closed the lid of the medicine in his hand. Then, he took a deep breath and said,
“There’s really no other way. Since my daughter has crossed space and time to ask for help, as her father, I naturally have no reason not to help.”
“God of Destruction? It doesn’t matter. I’ll attack. Let me see how strong the guy who broke my quiet life is.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1923: Special Parallel Space (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1923: Special Parallel Space (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu, who had the medicine on, seemed to have broken some seal. His aura changed drastically, making Shiyu slightly stunned. She felt that as a Beast Tamer, her father’s strength was definitely above hers.
No wonder the World King’s divination results said that Shi Yu was the best external help.
“So, can you get me into your space and time?” Shi Yu’s aura suddenly weakened again as he asked.
“This…” Shiyu said, “I can’t do it…”
“Forget it, leave behind a coordinate. I’ll think of a way myself. As long as it’s still this era… I should be able to pass,” Shi Yu said.
“Well…” Shiyu looked at Shi Yu. Although this was the first time they had met, she indeed felt a strong sense of security from Shi Yu. She said softly, “Thank you…”
“You’re welcome.” Shi Yu smiled. He sensed that Shiyu was very strong, though she might not be older than Eleven and the others.
When they saw Eleven and Buggy, they had to call them uncles.
Although Eleven was still very young from the perspective of a super divine level, compared to ordinary people, they were also “young people”.
In short, Shiyu should have a growth experience that was even smoother than his. He had probably accumulated a lot of pressure after encountering such a big thing in the universe he was in.
“It’s about time for me…” Shiyu said.
At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly felt that the other party’s aura had become much weaker.
“Don’t worry and go. I’ll be there soon,” Shi Yu said.
Then, under Shi Yu’s gaze, Shiyu’s aura disappeared bit by bit, leaving only a spatial mark on his body. It was the coordinates for Shi Yu.
After he left, Shi Yu first scratched his head and said, “Little ones, what do you think?”
“Wuuu!!! Wuuu!!” Eleven was the first to express its interest. Ah, it was about to die of boredom. It had stayed in this godforsaken galaxy for more than ten years.
“Wu!!” Buggy expressed its pity. It wasn’t at the cosmic level yet. Otherwise, it could solve whatever cosmic God of Destruction it was. Probably!
“If only the other party had come a little later,” Shi Yu said.
Now, although the pets in the team were much stronger than before, his cultivation had yet to be completed, and he didn’t let them start charging for the cosmic level…
This also caused the overall strength of the team to be far from the peak.
If there was a tough battle at this time…
Shi Yu looked at the Super Empress.
Everyone could be said to be very surprised by the sudden arrival of this guy who called himself Shi Yu’s daughter.
Especially the Super Empress.
“A variable?” Originally, it was already very peaceful to deal with the Dark King in this parallel space. However, he didn’t expect another guy who was enough to threaten the safety of the universe to appear in other parallel spaces.
Moreover, from the looks of it, not only did Shi Yu not exist in that space and time, but she also didn’t exist.
From Shiyu, it could be said that she didn’t mention the existence of the Super Empress at all.
“It’s indeed a variable.” Although Shi Yu was laughing and joking, the current Shi Yu also had a thoughtful expression. “Even a cosmic overlord isn’t his match. Empress, what do you think?”
“Can the two of us defeat each other together?”
“I might not be a match for a cosmic overlord in a one-on-one battle, but with your strengthening, I shouldn’t be weaker than it, or even stronger. In addition to the support of your other pets, the outcome is self-evident. If you can have other pets break through to the cosmic level again, the situation will be one-sided,” the Empress said directly.
“I’m relieved to hear that,” Shi Yu said. “The cosmic overlord of that space and time, Shi Yu, also has two cosmic battle power. This way, that God of Destruction shouldn’t be a threat. In that case, I’ll make a trip…”
“Qi and I should be able to lock onto the location of that space-time, but if our strength isn’t enough to break through space and time, we’ll need your help.”
“Alright.” The Empress nodded.
At this moment, everyone in the meeting came to a conclusion. After preparing, they would immediately head to the future space and time to deal with the cosmic God of Destruction, who might cause multiple parallel universe chain disasters.
After everything was ready, Shi Yu set off. Of course, before setting off, he left behind his consciousness clone to guard the Milky Way.
He used his actions to show his future daughter that his father was still his father.
When the other party came to this space and time, it could only possess its unborn body with a wisp of consciousness. However, Shi Yu and the others didn’t spend much effort to invade this blocked parallel space.
After confirming the coordinates, they might have only brewed for a few minutes before transmigrating.
There was no other reason than that Shi Yu’s team was too expert in the power of space and time. Firstly, Shi Yu himself had obtained the inheritance of the Time Jade Rabbit in his previous life and become a transmigrator who crossed an era. Secondly, Qi was a Time Sprite herself. Moreover, the Super Empress had harmed countless Time Sprites…
This also caused the spatial travel in the same era to be a piece of cake for Shi Yu and the others. This was also why the Dark King was so shocked when he saw Shi Yu easily descend into the space and time with his true body.
“Let’s go.”
Shi Yu really followed closely behind. Not long after Shiyu left, he set off for the future space and time.
In the future parallel space.
On the overlord territory, Blue Planet.
In the sky above the Ancient Capital of Dong Huang, a time hole appeared. Shi Yu naturally crossed from it to here.
“I’m at… the Ancient Capital??”

chapters.title: Chapter 1924: Special Parallel Space (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1924: Special Parallel Space (4)
Editor: Atlas Studios
After Shi Yu appeared, he was slightly stunned. Although he realized that the environment was very different from the Ancient Capital in his memories, this place should be the Ancient Capital.
In addition, this Blue Planet looked very peaceful. It should be as Shiyu had said, protected very well by Goddess Wa and not involved in the disaster created by the cosmic God of Destruction.
Moreover, Blue Planet in this space and time had also reached the peak of the super divine level. Its development wasn’t bad. There were many super divine auras on the planet, and it was also a large faction with more than one-star super divine auras…
“Who is it!”
At this moment, as Shi Yu arrived, two terrifying auras suddenly rose in the Ancient Capital.
Shi Yu didn’t hide his arrival, nor did he deliberately release his aura. Therefore, an expert immediately discovered him in the Ancient Capital.
In Ancient Capital University, a female Beast Tamer in a black trench coat with beautiful tea-colored long hair was catching up with a cat-shaped creature with beautiful eyes like gems.
She looked to be in her thirties and emitted a mature charm. The cat didn’t look simple either. Although it looked like a pet, ordinary pets definitely didn’t have such a noble aura.
At this moment, the female Beast Tamer in the black trench coat suddenly sensed something and suddenly looked in a certain direction.
“Qingyi, what’s wrong?” the gem cat asked.
“A mysterious expert descended in the Ancient Capital,” Lu Qingyi said. “The aura is very mysterious. I can’t determine the other party’s strength. Who could he be?”
“Let’s go take a look.” With that said, the two of them flew into the sky.
On Lu Qingyi’s body, the aura of a super divine level emitted slightly, and on the gem cat…
“Eh.”
Shi Yu looked at the two “acquaintances” who had suddenly come in front of him. It could be said to be too f*cking surprising.
As the two parties were too familiar, Shi Yu even saw them and directly spoke.
“I’m dying of laughter. Why are you only at the divine level? No, you’re actually at the divine level.” Shi Yu wanted to laugh when he saw Teacher Gem Cat.
First, the gem cat that mocked this space and time was inferior to the cat in his space and time. In his space and time, the gem cat teacher was at the peak of the super divine level after all, yet in this space and time, the gem cat teacher was actually only at the divine level.
Then, Shi Yu felt that the divine level was already very impressive. After all, he didn’t exist in this space and time. Teacher Cat had mixed into the divine level… Well, it was already not bad.
“Who are you!!” The gem cat was furious when it saw this unknown young man in a panda suit.
It almost angered her to death.
Although the gem cat didn’t know this guy, it kept feeling that this guy was very annoying.
Was the other party… mocking her for being weak just now?
Ridiculous!!
As the inheritor of the Star Prayer Race, no one had mocked Blue Planet’s “star treasure” like this.
“Who are you?” At this moment, the future senior was looking at Shi Yu solemnly. She felt that Shi Yu seemed to know them.
“It’s more troublesome to explain who I am…” Shi Yu looked at his future senior. He was also very surprised that her future senior could actually be super divine.
She sensed an unusual aura from her future senior. The other party must have experienced hundreds of battles. Moreover… Shi Yu also sensed a very familiar wave. He had been cultivating this recently.
The senior in this space and time should have also obtained the Yue Maiden inheritance. If she had the talent to plunder and archeological talent, she would definitely be heavily nurtured by Goddess Wa. It seemed normal for her to be at the super divine level. Although she looked to be in her thirties, Shi Yu knew that the senior in this space and time was old enough to be a grandmother.
“Do you know Shiyu?” Shi Yu asked.
“Shiyu??” When Shi Yu mentioned this name, Lu Qingyi and the gem cat’s expressions changed. “Why are you looking for her?”
Of course they were familiar with Shiyu!
Shiyu was the most dazzling genius on Blue Planet! Most importantly, Lu Qingyi, was still one of the super divines who had revived Shiyu back then. 20 years ago, she, who had just reached the super divine level, was chosen by Goddess Wa to become one of Shiyu’s “godmothers”. It could be said that Shiyu’s growth experience was watched over by their generation.
“I know her. That’s easy,” Shi Yu said. “Why didn’t I sense where she was? She hid pretty well.”
“Let me introduce myself. I’m Shiyu’s father. Do you know that she invited me over… Well… Looks like I don’t know.”
Lu Qingyi and the gem cat: ???
The two of them felt that the person in front of them was definitely crazy!

chapters.title: Chapter 1925: Father and Daughter Bureau (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1925: Father and Daughter Bureau (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
It actually dared to take advantage of a cosmic-level existemce!
“Kid, are you provoking a cosmic throne?” the gem cat said.
“As expected, you don’t believe me.” Shi Yu knew it.
“No one knows this nonsense…” The gem cat was just about to say something when suddenly, she and Lu Qingyi were slightly stunned and heard a familiar voice.
“Ying, Lu Qingyi, don’t be nervous. He’s indeed Shiyu’s father.”
“To be precise, Goddess Wa of the previous era used his bloodline to create Shiyu. This person is one of the most dazzling experts in the previous era.”
“He also transmigrated to the 11th era, but he didn’t come to this space and time.”
“It was Shiyu who worked hard to break through the spatial limit and invited him from other parallel universes to deal with that cosmic overlord.”
How could Lu Qingyi and the gem cat not be familiar with this voice? Wasn’t this the Blue Planet’s Will!!
As expected, when Shi Yu arrived, the Blue Planet’s Will also noticed Shi Yu.
“Is it the Blue Planet’s Will?” Shi Yu looked up slightly.
At this moment, as Shi Yu spoke, Lu Qingyi and the gem cat opposite him had already opened their mouths wide in disbelief.
Was this person really Shiyu’s father???
What a joke.
“Hehe.” Shi Yu smiled at them and said, “In my space and time, we’re familiar with each other, so you don’t have to be reserved. Senior Lu, Teacher Ying.”
Senior… Teacher…
“I’m also a student of Ancient Capital University, the archeology department.”
Before Lu Qingyi and the gem cat could be too shocked, the voice of the Blue Planet’s Will sounded again.
“Sir, because she transmigrated to space and time to contact you, she consumed too much energy and fell into a deep sleep. I wonder how long you can stay in this space and time.”
Shi Yu was stunned. Why was this child so weak?
Its consciousness could become weak after transmigrating through space and time? It was even inferior to the Dark King!
Not to mention his daughter.
Unless Teacher Gem Cat could really break through to the cosmic level, this title of the weakest cosmic level might have to be given to Shiyu.
“There are no restrictions on me,” Shi Yu said.
“Is that so?” The Blue Planet’s Will was secretly shocked. Shiyu’s bloodline father was indeed very strong. There were no restrictions on even transmigrating space and time.
“If there’s no problem, please hand her to me.”
“I’ll think of a way to wake her up quickly,” Shi Yu said.
It was still difficult if Shiyu was still weak. Shi Yu had nothing else here, but he had a lot of medicine.
“Sure.” In the face of Shi Yu’s request, Blue Planet didn’t refuse. “She has been moving in a spatial universe treasure and is also recuperating there. I’ll tell you the spatial coordinates.”
Soon, Shi Yu obtained the spatial coordinates of Shiyu’s location.
However, just as he was about to go, he recalled that there were two familiar faces here.
He looked at his senior and the gem cat teacher and smiled. “Then, I’ll leave first.”
“Wait, I want to talk to you. How can I find you later?” Lu Qingyi said.
“If I’m still free, I’ll come back and take a look,” Shi Yu said.
He wanted to see how Eleven, Buggy, and the others in this parallel space were doing…
It was a pity that they didn’t encounter him. For example, Buggy might have died long ago… If possible, he would take action to guide their fate.
“Goodbye.”
With that said, Shi Yu left.
The gem cat watched Shi Yu leave in silence and said, “This guy is actually real…”
“By the way, what do you want to talk to him about?”
“It’s nothing. I’m just more curious about the parallel universe and the 10th era,” Lu Qingyi said. “Aren’t you curious about your own situation in the parallel universe?”
“From what he said, Teacher Ying, your current situation is very different from in the parallel universe.”
“Ah, this.” The gem cat fell into deep thought. Forget it, who cared about her? No matter how powerful it was in the parallel universe, could it still go to the sky? It didn’t want to compete with it.
At the same time.
Shi Yu entered a special space. After arriving, Shi Yu clicked his tongue in wonder. “No wonder I couldn’t discover it. So there’s such equipment.”
He walked into this space. At first, there was nothing. As he walked further and further away, he quickly seemed to have entered a girl’s boudoir.
At this moment, the figure of a pet slowly appeared beside Shi Yu. Baby Ginseng looked at the center of the pink room filled with dolls and let out a cry.
At this moment, Shiyu was lying on the big bed. So this was how she recuperated.
“Baby Ginseng.” Shi Yu didn’t move on the spot, but the power of the universe had already augmented Baby Ginseng. In the next moment, the cosmic-level ginseng emperor healed Shiyu from afar.
After an unknown period of time, the sleeping beauty on the bed coughed dryly.
The other party was carved from the same mold as Shi Yu. If Shi Yu was extremely handsome, then the other party was extremely beautiful. She was a standard black-haired, black-eyed, and beautiful girl.
At this moment, Shi Yu opened his eyes and suddenly realized that Shi Yu was sitting on a chair not far away. He had his legs crossed and a ginseng baby on his lap. Both parties were looking at him.
“How long has it been?”
The moment she saw Shi Yu, the other party knew that Shi Yu had successfully transmigrated into space and time and arrived in her world.
“I said I would come, so I naturally will,” Shi Yu said. “But the problem now is that I didn’t sense the traces of the guy you mentioned.”
These guys were pretty good at hiding.
“The other party might have used the power unique to its era. It might have relied on the power unique to the first era to kill a cosmic-level existence,” Shiyu said with a shake of her head.
“You…”
“There’s no restriction on my words.” Shi Yu guessed that the other party wanted to ask how long he could stay in this space and time. Shi Yu replied to Blue Planet word for word.
“Forget it, it’s alright,” Shi Yu said. “There’s no need to be in such a hurry to find the other party. I just have to ensure that the next time the other party appears, I’ll block it.”
Shi Yu was naturally willing to take advantage of the other party’s weak state to find and kill him.
However, it didn’t matter if he couldn’t do it. He could also take advantage of this period of time to continue cultivating. If there were any results and Eleven, Buggy, and the others entered the cosmic level, the chances of victory could also increase.
“I’ll stay in this space and time until the other party appears. Or I can leave enough consciousness in this space and time to ensure that I can arrive immediately.”
“Are you really confident of defeating the other party?” Shiyu hadn’t suspected Shi Yu previously. At this moment, as Shi Yu’s true body arrived, Shiyu couldn’t help but ask again.
After all, even a cosmic overlord wasn’t his match…
“Regardless, I have to fight.” Shi Yu was amused. “Why, do you want to test my strength? I’m free, so I don’t mind having a father-daughter battle with you.”
“Wuuu!!!”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Eleven and the other pets in the Beast Taming Space were excited.
Fighting a cosmic Beast Tamer, they requested to fight and beat up Shiyu’s pet!!
Shiyu broke through to the cosmic level by contracting a World King above her level. However, the World King quickly died. Now, her normal pet should only be at the peak of the super divine level.
“Is this alright?” Shiyu’s face darkened.
“Didn’t you also rest?” Shi Yu smiled and said, “But compared to that, I have other things to ask.”
“Actually, I’ve always been interested in what you said previously about the transmigrator of the 10th era, the Time Sprite in the form of a rabbit,” Shi Yu said. “You said that she failed to transmigrate. May I ask if she left any traces in this space and time?”
“You’re interested in her?” Shiyu was stunned. “That’s true. After all, we’re all from the 10th era.”
“Do you know her other identities? In this era, we only know her race, appearance, and nothing else about her other experiences.”
“Although she failed to transmigrate, her true body also descended into this era. However, she has already been completely washed into a complete fossil by the traces of time.”
“Fossil??” Shi Yu was shocked, as if he had triggered some keyword.
“Yes, a fossil that no longer has any traces of life.”
“Do you know where this fossil is?” Shi Yu asked. “Is this fossil still preserved?”
Shiyu was stunned. “Probably. In the beginning, this fossil was obtained by Lord World King. Later on, it flowed into the hands of a cosmic overlord.”
“Now, it might be one of the collections of the cosmic overlord army…”
“Now that the cosmic overlord is recuperating, Senior Goddess Wa is in charge of the cosmic overlord army. If you want to see it, ask Senior Goddess Wa. You should be able to find it.”
Shi Yu said, “Interesting. Good daughter, I came to help you fight. There has to be some reward, right? What do you think of this fossil?”
Shiyu: “?”
Why, it wasn’t the first time she felt that Shi Yu was a little out of place! Now, he was actually starting to think about the collection of the cosmic overlord again?
However, Shiyu was even more curious about why Shi Yu wanted this fossil.
“This is very important to you?”
“You can say that.” Shi Yu nodded. Since it was a fossil, it might become a material for a mechanical phantom beast.
Wasn’t Ling looking for suitable mechanical phantom beast materials?
Wasn’t the fossil of this Time Jade Rabbit just right?
He didn’t know the type of the one he obtained from the Dark King, so he didn’t have to care about it for the time being, but the Time Jade Rabbit was simply too suitable.
If it was successfully fused, it might be able to let Ling also have the ability to travel through space and time and become a space and time machine.
During the fusion process, if there were any difficulties, he wasn’t afraid. After all, the Empress and he had studied the Time Sprite very deeply.
It could be said that compared to that unknown fossil, the Time Jade Rabbit fossil in this space and time was more suitable for Ling to strengthen itself at the current stage.
“Alright, then I’ll think of a way to ask Senior Goddess Wa,” Shiyu said with a deep breath.
“There’s no need to be in such a hurry. You can completely give it to me after I defeat the God of Destruction.” Shi Yu got up and stretched. “You can slowly recover. In that case, I’ll stay in this space and time for a while.”
“If you need anything, look for me again. I should be on Blue Planet the whole time. Of course, if you’re interested in testing my strength, I’ll accompany you at any time, haha.”
Shiyu pondered for a moment.
“So be it. However, sparring is the priority. Don’t waste your strength too much.” Shi Yu looked at her bloodline father extremely seriously. In fact, she was more curious about Shi Yu’s strength than anyone. She had just broken through to the cosmic level. She had only fought people lower than her level and had never fought a cosmic level. If it was just sparring, it shouldn’t be a problem, right?
“Are you sure?” Shi Yu had originally planned to leave, but when he heard Shiyu’s words, he was also interested.
“Well, you shouldn’t mind having an audience, right? I want to invite Senior Goddess Wa and the Blue Planet’s Will. Although I still trust you, Senior Goddess Wa and the others are different. However, as long as you show enough strength to resist the God of Destruction, I don’t think Senior Goddess Wa will mind completely opening the resource bank of the cosmic overlord army to you.”
“At that time, the chances of winning against the God of Destruction might also be higher.”
“I heard that there are several cosmic treasures in the resource warehouse of the cosmic overlord army… Everything is for the peace of the universe.” Speaking of cosmic treasures, Shiyu swallowed her saliva, as if she had also cared about a few for a long time.
“You…” Shi Yu was speechless.
Good lord, this was baiting him to take advantage of the situation and take all the cosmic treasures of the cosmic overlords first, right? It was immoral! But like him!

chapters.title: Chapter 1926: Space and Time Without Shi Yu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1926: Space and Time Without Shi Yu (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Now, Goddess Wa, who was in charge of the cosmic overlord army, and the cosmic overlord who had fought the God of Destruction until both parties were injured, would never have thought that Shi Yu and his daughter would directly start to covet the treasure vault of the cosmic overlord army.
It could only be said that the bloodline of the Shi family was too powerful. Even Goddess Wa couldn’t cleanse it.
“Sigh…”
