At this moment, Shi Yu was already walking on the street of Dong Huang on Blue Planet. In this familiar and unfamiliar city, Shi Yu didn’t dare to look at Eleven and the others in this space and time.
However, it wouldn’t take long. With the mentality of changing a fate, Shi Yu still said, “Before Shiyu is ready, let’s walk around.”
In Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, pets sat on their planets and looked outside. They nodded.
Shi Yu stretched out his hand, and the traces of the pet’s power leaped onto his fingertips. “Bu Lu, the traces of your life have completely disappeared in this space and time. My condolences.”
Shi Yu searched them one by one. In the Beast Taming Space, when the little monkey Bu Lu heard Shi Yu’s words, it was like a bolt from the blue.
“Oh, this, but I’ve long expected it. I’m so unlucky. If a disaster happens in this universe, I’ll definitely be the first to bear the brunt.”
“Ji.” Buggy shot out a worm silk hand from the cocoon and patted Bu Lu’s shoulder. Don’t be sad, it must have died long ago!
Without Shi Yu, with the Green Silkworm’s average lifespan of about a year… it would be difficult for it to defy the heavens.
Even if it had reincarnated, it would probably have died countless times. Moreover, it was a little green worm, so it was impossible for it to reincarnate.
“Haha, I’m kidding. You still seem to be sleeping somewhere in the overlord territory and aren’t dead. Your life is pretty strong.”
Bu Lu: “?”
Buggy: “?”
“As for Shorty, I can sense the fluctuations. Moreover, it’s in Ancient Capital City. It’s probably living like Teacher Ying in Ancient Capital University. In comparison, it’s not bad.”
“Meow!! (Unfortunately, there’s no Shi Yu’s special battle team in this space and time. My life must have lost its light.)” Shorty felt pity.
What was the point of a life where it couldn’t chase celebrities? It felt that with its high standards, it shouldn’t worship others.
“Little Quas and Turtle are also living normally in Dragon Palace City. You guys have no problem,” Shi Yu said. The few he contracted later had some status.
Unlike Buggy and the others, who were directly grassroots.
Therefore, it wasn’t bad for Shorty, Turtle, and Little Quas to still be able to live comfortably.
“Hu.” “Wu.” Turtle and Little Quas sighed slightly. They didn’t know what developments they would have in Tiny Dragon Palace City.
However, on second thought, there definitely wouldn’t be much achievement. After all, they would be without Shi Yu.
This was the greatest sorrow of this parallel universe.
Otherwise, if Shi Yu was around, there was no need for him to run to other parallel universes to find external help. Shi Yu could definitely directly solve it.
“As for Little Zi, you’re living pretty well.”
“Mi.” Upon hearing Shi Yu mention him, Little Zi chuckled.
As they were relatively close, Shi Yu looked at the starry sky and could clearly see a purple divine-level star hanging in the starry sky.
That should be Little Zi…
Shi Yu looked back and could confirm that because no one had passed the Void Mantis’s test in this space and time, the Void Mantis directly left with Little Zi’s egg.
When the Void Mantis passed by Inatella on its trip, the World Tree sensed Little Zi’s specialness. Therefore, with the agreement of the Void Mantis, it kept Little Zi’s egg and personally hatched it, taking it in as a goddaughter and nurturing it near Blue Planet.
Therefore, Little Zi in this space and time was actually Blue Planet’s goddaughter.
At this moment, compared to Shorty and the others, Little Zi was even more comfortable. It was born with a golden spoon in its mouth.
Seeing that they were all good, Shi Yu was relieved.
“What about me?” Qi said in anticipation.
“Uh.” From Qi, Shi Yu was a little silent.
“You should have died directly in the Mythical War in this space and time. Due to the speciality of space and time, the space and time barrier of this space and time is especially difficult to transmigrate. The ability of the Time Sprite has plummeted.”
“Ah.” Qi was shocked and a little aggrieved. “Why is that?”
“Don’t be sad. Duckie is as miserable as you. It was… After the Mythical Revival and awakened the abyssal abilities of its previous life, it was directly crushed by the powerful creatures on land…”
Shi Yu couldn’t help but say. This guy didn’t learn in his previous life, but it still didn’t learn in this life.
He had just awakened the memories and power of the Abyss Demon Duck in his previous life in the form of a Duckbill Beast and directly thought that he was that ocean overlord. As expected, he was shattered by the powerful creatures on land.
“Quack!!” In the Beast Taming Space, Duckie was also shocked. Were it and Qi so miserable?
“Roar, roar, roar.” Little Ji comforted Duckie. It couldn’t be helped. It was normal for it to not be able to defeat ground creatures.
“Quack!!” Duckie felt that Little Ji wasn’t comforting it, but gloating!!
“Quack. (You probably weren’t even born, right?)” Duckie said.
At this point, Little Ji was stuck and stood on the spot in a daze. Damn, it was still waiting. Shi Yu was narrating its growth experience in this space and time. In the end, it turned out that its self in this space and time hadn’t been created at all?
Yes, if not for Shi Yu, there wouldn’t be a mechanical phantom beast, nor would there be it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1927: Space and Time Without Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1927: Space and Time Without Shi Yu (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“You…” Ling looked at Little Ji with a headache. Could it be that after upgrading the Abyss Anti-Poison System, it still affected its intelligence? Little Ji’s intelligence had long been upgraded, but from the looks of it, it still didn’t look high.
“Wearing is indeed a very terrifying thing.” Ling shook its head. Little Ji’s battle method was to sacrifice its intelligence in exchange for powerful strength. No matter how intelligent it was, it couldn’t withstand its violent battle skills gradually wearing down.
The stronger one was, the faster their intelligence would decrease.
It estimated that if it didn’t have daily maintenance and breakthroughs, although Little Ji was at the peak of the super divine level, it was very likely that in its later years, something bad would happen. Just like some relatively low-level mechanical lives, it would become demented.
“My words don’t exist either.” Compared to Little Ji, Ling was much calmer.
“It’s also a good thing. At least in this space and time, you don’t have to tire yourself out every day,” Shi Yu joked.
However, soon, everyone fell silent.
“Ning. (As for me, I should be dead too.)” Susu looked at the sea of stars and said calmly.
“I think so,” Shi Yu said. “At the slime stage, it was the last few reincarnations. After failing to awaken the power of the Blue Sea Sprite the last few times, it completely disappeared…”
“Ning. (It’s also very good. This is the best fate.)” Susu quickly understood. It had already helped Blue Planet’s life resist the abyss time and time again during Blue Planet’s sleeping stage. Now that Goddess Wa had returned, Blue Planet had awakened, and the abyss had been completely eliminated. After being tired for so long, completely returning to the sea might also be a fate.
After all, even the number one enemy of the Blue Sea Sprite and the cleansing star spirit in the starry sky of the universe, the Dark King, had been killed by the God of Destruction. Even if it lived, there was nothing to pursue.
“Sigh.” Shi Yu continued to search for Chi Tong’s traces, but soon, he was stunned.
“Mi.” Chi Tong saw that Shi Yu was stunned and immediately asked itself what was wrong.
Was it still unacknowledged in the heroic spirit ruins, or…
Even in a parallel universe, Chi Tong would rather still sleep in the heroic spirit ruins than be hatched by others.
“In this space and time, Chi Tong… you’ve already contracted with others,” Shi Yu said with a deep breath.
Chi Tong: “?”
“Mi! (No, go crush the other party!!)” Chi Tong was angry and couldn’t accept it.
“Don’t worry, don’t worry. The person who contracted you specially came to find you. It’s the Empress.” Shi Yu said with a strange expression, “After Empress Huang Xi was revived by the Blue Planet’s Will and Goddess Wa, she became your contractor.”
“Mi?” Chi Tong was stunned. It had contracted with its sister. That was still acceptable. If it were anyone else, it would have to shatter the other party and set itself free to be with Shi Yu…
“The Empress of this space and time seems to have also become a super divine.” Shi Yu sensed the aura of the super divine Empress in a mystic realm on Blue Planet. She was suspected to be in seclusion to cultivate.
Well… In his space and time, the Empress was the first in the new generation to step into the super divine level. In this space and time, the other party’s strength wasn’t bad either. Shi Yu had a strange expression. Wait a minute, could it be that the Empress of this space and time was also one of the mothers of Shiyu’s bloodline?
Damn, his seniority was in chaos, but forget it. As long as he didn’t think too much about it, his brain wouldn’t overload.
“In this space and time, the combination of the two of you is also very strong,” Shi Yu said. “If the sisters join forces, they will have cosmic aptitude in the future.”
“Uh.” Chi Tong curled its lips. Shi Yu was really boring. It didn’t even know how to enter the cosmic level now. Without Shi Yu, it was definitely impossible for Chi Tong to enter the cosmic level in parallel space.
“Alright.” Shi Yu sighed and said, “Baby Ginseng, I don’t know if you’re lucky or unlucky.”
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng’s eyelids twitched and it also sighed. It was already prepared to welcome its fate in parallel space.
“No matter which space and time it is, you still love to learn so much.” Shi Yu smiled.
This time, Shi Yu began to walk. He arrived at Ancient Capital University and outside a research room. Through the research room, Shi Yu and the others could clearly see that there was a ginseng baby in a research suit studying something carefully.
A ginseng baby’s life painting gradually appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
It also became a mutated ginseng baby.
He was also caught by Senior Sun of Bureau 11.
However, without Shi Yu, Baby Ginseng’s fate had changed greatly.
First, it was heartlessly used by Granny Sun as an experimental material. Although the honest ginseng baby didn’t want such a life, it could only be forced to accept it helplessly. After all, there was no choice.
Fortunately, Baby Ginseng’s EQ and intelligence were relatively high. In this space and time, during the experiments time and time again, Baby Ginseng made Grandma Sun happy, and the two parties established a pretty good friendship.
At the appropriate time, Baby Ginseng made a wish to Granny Sun.
It wanted to change its fate, and it wanted to learn. Grandma Sun wasn’t surprised by this, because from a long time ago, Baby Ginseng had loved to hold a branch as a Sword Dao gesture.
In the end, Grandma Sun gave it to Ancient Capital University. Baby Ginseng signed a 50-year contract with Ancient Capital University. During this period, it provided supplements as tuition fees. It would hold a position under Teacher Gem Cat and learn some knowledge.
It could be said that in this space and time, Baby Ginseng didn’t escape the fate of working for the gem cat teacher to create food.
After arriving at university, Baby Ginseng also studied hard, trying its best to have battle power. However, after decades, Baby Ginseng was more and more nourishing in the field of supplements. However, in terms of battle power, it was still extremely pitiful… It could be said that it had almost no battle power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1928: Space and Time Without Shi Yu (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1928: Space and Time Without Shi Yu (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
However, decades passed like a day. Baby Ginseng had even become a teacher under the recommendation of the gem cat, but it still didn’t give up its initial dream.
“Yi. (It couldn’t even evolve.)” Baby Ginseng looked at itself in the parallel universe and sighed slightly.
It wondered how it would feel if it still couldn’t change the fate of the supplement race after working hard for decades.
Fortunately, it had tried hard and had been working hard for its dream. Unfortunately, it didn’t succeed and couldn’t see any hope.
Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu.
“Sure.” Shi Yu nodded. He knew what Baby Ginseng wanted to do.
At the same time.
In the laboratory, Professor Ginseng of Ancient Capital University was still concocting the Skill Potion, but he failed again.
Just as Professor Ginseng sighed countless times, it was suddenly slightly stunned and looked at the table.
At the table, an experimental material that he had never seen before suddenly appeared.
“What’s this?” Professor Ginseng frowned in confusion and looked at the green seed.
It subconsciously touched it, and the moment it touched it…
A cultivation method information called the “Heavenly Emperor Scripture” that was exclusive to supplement races appeared in its brain, causing it to completely shut down.
It stood on the spot in a daze for a long time until it reacted and ran out of the laboratory crazily to observe its surroundings, but there was no one around.
“Yi. (Who is it? Why?)” Tears slid down the corners of Baby Ginseng’s eyes. It was very certain that this Heavenly Emperor Scripture was what it had imagined day and night. Why did it appear beside it in this form? Who was helping it?
Baby Ginseng’s fate made everyone sigh.
“Is that enough?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng nodded. It understood itself. After working hard for so many years, it definitely didn’t want to reach the top in one step. Instead, it would continue to rely on its hard work and research to walk a new path.
That “Heavenly Emperor Scripture” was the most suitable thing for it. Baby Ginseng was confident that after it, who was in a parallel universe, took over the “Heavenly Emperor Scripture” it had created, it would definitely be able to cultivate it even more perfectly than it. In the end, it would also create the Heart of the Heavenly Emperor and shock the universe.
“Wu.” Buggy looked at Baby Ginseng in envy. How nice.
Although its fate was still bumpy, it had rich experience. In comparison, Buggy could already imagine itself. In its life, there was only one sentence that could be summarized.
“There’s really no other way in Buggy’s situation.”
“I won’t say anymore,” Shi Yu said.
“Wu.” Buggy in the form of a cocoon expressed that it didn’t mind. Even if it quickly withered in all parallel spaces, it didn’t matter.
At least, it would become a cosmic level and the strongest.
Buggy’s gaze revealed a determined expression as it kept urging, “Wu!! (Leader, how’s Leader?)”
The lifespan of iron-eating beasts was much longer than that of pandas on Earth. If nothing unexpected happened, Eleven in this space and time definitely wouldn’t die so easily.
“Eleven.” Shi Yu took a deep breath and looked in the direction of Ping Cheng in Icefield City.
He felt a little uncomfortable and couldn’t say anything for a long time.
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven expressed that it could accept it.
Shi Yu arrived at Ping Cheng in one step. The Iron Bamboo Breeding Base was still alive.
Of course, this wasn’t what shocked Shi Yu the most. What shocked Shi Yu the most was that Senior Panda’s experience in this space and time was actually like a proud daughter of heaven. What he did in the original space and time was almost repeated by Senior Panda in this space and time.
“Lin Xiuzhu, genius Iron-eating Beast Feeder. She joined forces with Senior Lu Qingyi of Ancient Capital University to crack the Iron-eating Beast Ruins and discovered the evolution method of the Iron-eating Beast. Her name spread throughout the Dong Huang Feeding World.”
“Many years later, he joined forces with Lu Qingyi of Ancient Capital University to explore an era ruin called the ‘Chi You Ruins’ and obtained the Iron-eating Beast cultivation method of the last era. From then on, he soared into the sky and was heavily nurtured by Blue Planet. He was one of the most dazzling geniuses of Blue Planet’s generation.”
“Now, I’ve also reached the super divine level.” Shi Yu had a strange expression. He felt that with him around, his acquaintances were doing pretty well.
Apart from the gem cat, it looked like this guy was really lazing around.
“Wu wu wu.” Upon hearing that the big sister was actually doing so well, Eleven’s eyes lit up. Not bad.
“Eleven, don’t be sad about what I’m going to say next,” Shi Yu said. “Sigh, I said a long time ago that you were too hardworking.”
Eleven: QAQ
“Originally, there was nothing wrong with you. Your awakening and hardening were slower, and your congenital body was weaker. It was just that the royal bloodline was too strong…”
“If you do nothing, perhaps when Lin Xiuzhu rises and when the spiritual energy recovers, you can also change your fate with her.”
“But why are you so disobedient?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say, even a little angry.
“In this space and time, you weren’t chosen by any Beast Tamer until the end. Because of this, you trained even harder. When the Feeder was accidentally negligent and didn’t watch over you, you…” Shi Yu shook his head. “Because of the overload of training, your injuries were more serious. It didn’t take long for you to lose your vital signs.”
“Even if it was resuscitated later, it couldn’t be saved…”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the entire team was stunned. No one expected that the leader of this space and time would actually die young.
They looked at Eleven in unison. If Buggy, Susu, and the others had long expected their fate and knew that their fate was irresistible, but Eleven actually died from overload because it was born weak and trained too hard. No teammate could accept this and felt that Eleven shouldn’t have such an outcome.

chapters.title: Chapter 1929: Space and Time Without Shi Yu (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1929: Space and Time Without Shi Yu (4)
Editor: Atlas Studios
In their opinion, Eleven shouldn’t have died like this. At least, it had to become a relatively stronger Iron-eating Beast.
“Sob…” Eleven was stunned for a moment before lowering its head slightly. Then, it walked out of the Beast Taming Space and looked at the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base. After watching for a while, it finally sighed and climbed onto Shi Yu’s shoulder.
Perhaps this was fate. Fortunately, it encountered Shi Yu and Shi Yu took it away.
“I want to see Senior Panda,” Shi Yu said.
Just now, he had crossed countless times with a glance and seen the situation that happened at that time. He saw the situation of Eleven dying from excessive training. Of course, he also saw other scenes.
He saw a girl lying in front of the hospital bed and crying loudly. In this space and time, someone was very sad and blamed himself for not looking after Eleven. This person was naturally the breeder of the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base, Lin Xiuzhu.
Shi Yu didn’t know if Senior Panda, who had already become a super divine expert, still remembered that weak number eleven Iron-eating Beast. However, Shi Yu felt that perhaps he should let her know that in another parallel universe, this number eleven Iron-eating Beast was actually living very well.
Ping Cheng, Bamboo Stone Dojo.
Now, the Bamboo Stone Dojo that had already opened branches all over Blue Planet was undoubtedly a very powerful super divine faction in the entire starry sky.
Lin Xiuzhu, who had inherited the cultivation system of the previous era, wasn’t easy to deal with. He had always been dedicated to letting the Iron-eating Beast Race strengthen and become the strongest race.
At this moment, the headquarters of this Bamboo Stone Dojo no longer recruited apprentices. It had purely become Lin Xiuzhu’s own training and residence.
“Who are you?”
In the dojo, Lin Xiuzhu, who was wearing a battle suit and completely didn’t ignore his battle skills, was training with his Iron-eating Beast.
She realized that the door of the training hall was opened and looked over slightly.
A young man with a Tiny Iron-eating Beast on his shoulder walked in. The clothes this young man was wearing were also Iron-eating Beasts…
An apprentice from Bamboo Stone Dojo?
Lin Xiuzhu was surprised that the other party could enter this place. After all, not everyone could pass through the barrier in the outside world. Anyone could pass through without her reacting.
“Wuu!!” Senior Panda’s Iron-eating Beast, Flower, also looked at Shi Yu and Eleven fiercely.
“Eleven.” Shi Yu gave the order. Eleven leaped out of Shi Yu’s shoulder and punched Lin Xiuzhu and the others.
“Kid, do you know what you’re doing?” Seeing the other party directly attack, Lin Xiuzhu narrowed her eyes. Her Iron-eating Beast also took a step forward and resisted Eleven’s attack.
The fists of both parties collided, and the two Iron-eating Beasts stopped in midair at the same time. In the next moment, with a bang, Lin Xiuzhu’s Iron-eating Beast’s strength was “slightly” weaker and it was directly sent flying!!
Hu!!
Flower cried out in pain.
“Hey, no way.” At this moment, Lin Xiuzhu was stunned and couldn’t believe it. After all, her Iron-eating Beast was a perfect god. In her understanding, anyone who could defeat her Iron-eating Beast, even Emperor Wu Dong’s Iron-eating Beast, couldn’t!
“Wuu…” Lin Xiuzhu’s Iron-eating Beast was sent flying. It stood on the spot in pain and looked at its opponent fearfully.
He also told the Beast Tamer that the other party was very dangerous.
“Who exactly are you?” Lin Xiuzhu became serious.
But in the next moment, Lin Xiuzhu suddenly realized something and said, “No, what did you call your Iron-eating Beast just now? Eleven?”
She looked at Eleven carefully. Lin Xiuzhu had a deep impression of the number Eleven. That was the first mistake she made not long after she became a family breeder. It had always been a pain in Lin Xiuzhu’s heart to make a hardworking little Iron-eating Beast lose its life.
This Iron-eating Beast was actually also called Eleven…
“Sob. (Big Sister.)” As Eleven spoke, a familiar voice sounded. Lin Xiuzhu was completely stunned on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 1930: The Second Cosmic Level (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1930: The Second Cosmic Level (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“You…” Lin Xiuzhu looked at Eleven in disbelief.
“Are you very surprised? There’s no need to be surprised.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Hello, Lin Xiuzhu.”
“Let me introduce myself. I’m from another parallel universe. As for it, you weren’t wrong. It’s one of the Iron-eating Beast cubs from the year 177 of the alliance calendar, the Iron-eating Beast with the number Eleven.”
“Although it’s already dead in this space and time, I took the contract away from it in another parallel universe. In that case, can you understand?”
Lin Xiuzhu was stunned, still in disbelief. Parallel universe?
Under the nurturing of Goddess Wa, when she reached the super divine level, she naturally had some understanding of these concepts, but this was still a little unbelievable!
“You said that you guys came from a parallel universe. How should I believe you?” Senior Lin was still so beautiful, but her perfect figure had shrunk a lot. She should have specially learned physical control in order to train her body. Shi Yu felt that it was a pity. Senior Panda, who had a good figure, was still better looking.
“Shiyu,” Shi Yu said. “You know Shiyu, right? She can prove our identities. I can’t possibly use the name of a cosmic emperor to deceive others, right?”
Lin Xiuzhu was surprised. “You know my goddaughter?”
However, she had never told anyone about Eleven. In her opinion, even if Shi Yu was from a parallel universe, the reason why he could come here was most likely because of her goddaughter, Shiyu. Why would Shiyu do this…
“F*ck.” However, Lin Xiuzhu, who was still waiting for Shi Yu’s answer, didn’t expect Shi Yu and Eleven opposite to directly collapse.
Shi Yu looked at Senior Panda in shock. Eleven also had an innocent expression.
“You were also present when Shiyu revived? You also used your bloodline?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but ask.
Lin Xiuzhu looked at Shi Yu indifferently and said, “You know a lot. Looks like you really know her…”
In order to revive Shiyu, Goddess Wa finally decided to choose five female humans with excellent talent on Blue Planet. She gave up on the male super divine and gave up on Emperor Shi and the others. This was because according to her research, half of the bloodline in Shiyu’s body belonged to Yang. The other half of the bloodline was still the most perfect combination of Yin and Yang.
As a genius who had inherited the power system of the last era, Lin Xiuzhu was naturally chosen by Goddess Wa.
“In that case…” Senior Panda’s expression softened. She looked at Eleven and said, “You’re really Eleven…”
“Wu wu wu. (How can this be fake?)” Eleven smiled in embarrassment.
“Sorry.” Although it was Eleven from the parallel universe, Senior Panda still felt a little guilty.
“Wuu! (It’s alright, I didn’t know my limits!)” Eleven was no longer the insensible little panda from before. It also knew that its training method was purely courting death. If Shi Yu hadn’t taught it high-speed healing, it would have been very miserable no matter what Beast Tamer it encountered.
“Cough, cough. Don’t catch up first,” Shi Yu said. “Senior Lin, can you talk about Shiyu in detail? Who were the few people who revived her back then?”
“Senior?” Lin Xiuzhu was stunned. She was very surprised by Shi Yu’s address, but soon, she came to a realization. Since Shi Yu had taken Eleven away from her, he was most likely her junior in a parallel universe.
“Congratulations, Eleven. I didn’t take good care of you in this world, but in another universe, it looks like you encountered a very good Beast Tamer.” When Senior Panda saw Eleven’s strength, she knew that Shi Yu and Eleven weren’t simple now.
Thinking that Eleven was living very well in another space and time, she couldn’t help but smile.
“Although I’m very happy that you’re here, forgive me for not being able to answer your question. If you want to know, you can ask Shiyu yourself.”
“Up to you.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. This was because he had shamelessly read his mind just now and already knew which five people had revived Shiyu.
Damn, what was going on? Why were there Senior Panda, Senior Lu, and the Empress? There were even two western Beast Tamers he didn’t know, and there was actually no Emperor Shi and the others. What was going on with the development of this space and time? Why was it so strange? What exactly was Goddess Wa doing?
“Huh?” Just as Shi Yu was about to discuss it in depth with Senior Panda, the change in the Beast Taming Space suddenly shocked Shi Yu slightly.
“Susu?”
There were suddenly some abnormalities on Susu’s side.
“Ning!” Although she had followed Shi Yu to the parallel universe to travel, Susu had never stopped cleansing the Dark King.
It was cleansing the Dark King at all times, and its strength was also improving day by day.
If Shi Yu wasn’t wrong just now, Susu seemed to have touched the threshold of the universe a few seconds ago.
“Ning. (I’m going to try to break through.)” Susu said. The opportunity was rare. She was very excited now. She had finally waited for this day.
“Alright!” At this moment, Shi Yu couldn’t help but cheer. The heavens were helping him.
After looking forward to the stars and the moon, one of the pets finally broke through. Compared to other pets, Susu, who had always used the Dark King as an EXP package, was just like the Beastmaster who used the World King as an EXP package at that time. It was undoubtedly the closest to the cosmic level.
Now, after more than ten years of purification, there was finally a result, making Shi Yu tear up.
“What’s wrong?” Senior Panda was dizzy from Shi Yu’s shock.
“Haha, it’s nothing. See you another day. There’s suddenly an emergency,” Shi Yu said. “Eleven, you can stay.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1931: The Second Cosmic Level (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1931: The Second Cosmic Level (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“Wuu. (No, I want to see Susu break through.)” Although Eleven also wanted to talk to the big sister of this space and time, it wanted to see Susu break through to the cosmic level more.
“Then let’s go.” Shi Yu made a bow to Senior Panda. In the next moment, he teleported away from Blue Planet and into the starry sky.
Susu directly came out of the Beast Taming Space and was in the Sea of Stars.
“Try it. I’ll support you with all my might now.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, his cosmic aura completely erupted, not caring about anything.
Boom!!!
The power of the cosmic throne instantly swept through the entire overlord territory, Blue Planet, Origin Planet, and Overlord Planet. Countless experts were shocked.
The cosmic origin power on Shi Yu’s body acted on Susu. In the next moment, Susu’s aura also increased like the uprising of the Sea of Stars. The same cosmic-level might spread throughout the entire universe.
“What’s going on?” In Blue Planet, countless experts woke up. Blue Planet’s Will, the Five Emperors of Dong Huang, the super divines of the five divine races, various experts from ancient times and modern times, as well as new era super divines like Lu Qingyi and Lin Xiuzhu, suddenly looked at the starry sky.
An unfamiliar cosmic-level aura. Could it be… the God of Destruction??
The interior of Blue Planet immediately became chaotic. Only Blue Planet’s Will immediately discovered that it was Shi Yu and the others and immediately comforted them. “It’s not an enemy attack. There’s no need to be nervous.”
She was very puzzled why Shi Yu wanted to expose his strength in the starry sky with great fanfare.
But soon, the Blue Planet’s Will sensed something and was very surprised.
“Could it be…” She stared at the Starry Sky Slime floating in the starry sky and sensed the abnormality of the other party’s state.
“Break through to the cosmic level?”
At this moment, the overlord territory was also in an uproar. Even the cosmic overlord who was recuperating and sleeping was shocked and suddenly woke up.
“Two unfamiliar cosmic-level auras, could it be another transmigrator from somewhere?” It could be said that it basically didn’t have any battle ability now. At this moment, with the threat of the God of Destruction in front of it and the appearance of two new cosmic-levels, Cypos only felt his stomach hurt.
“Hm?”
At the same time, Goddess Wa, who had already arrived at the Overlord Planet and had just found the cosmic overlord army, also sensed one of the two auras, and her expression changed slightly.
“Shiyu!” Goddess Wa walked out of Overlord Planet at this moment. When she saw Shiyu, she asked, “What’s going on? That direction is… Blue Planet?”
“Goddess Wa, don’t be nervous first. It’s not an enemy, it’s…” Shiyu said, “Do you remember the divination before Lord World King died…”
“What, you mean…” Goddess Wa was stunned. She had always been on Overlord Planet and not Blue Planet. Did Shiyu mean that she had really found the father of the bloodline in parallel spaces?
This aura was them?
“That’s right, what’s he doing…” Shiyu felt a headache.
It wasn’t just them. At this moment, even the greatest invader of this parallel universe, the God of Destruction, suddenly opened its eyes and woke up from its sleep and recovered in the spatial crack.
“There’s actually more.”
Sensing that a new cosmic level had appeared in this universe, its veins popped out, but it quickly accelerated its restoration indifferently.
It was just an ordinary cosmic level. There was no need to care. No matter how many there were, as long as the God of Destruction felt its path blocked, it would personally destroy whoever it was.
“Looks like he can hold it in.” Shi Yu and the others’ breakthrough with great fanfare was actually to see if they could make the God of Destruction lose its cool and reveal some flaws.
But from the looks of it, the other party didn’t have any thoughts about them and didn’t want to stop Susu from breaking through.
If the other party came out to stop him, he would have been tricked. He would summon the Empress with a flip of his hand and beat up the God of Destruction with the Empress.
However, it wasn’t a good move for the other party not to come out and stop him, because when Susu broke through, his battle power would take a qualitative leap again.
Boom!!!
With Susu and Shi Yu in the Sea of Stars as the center, a terrifying cleansing wave was spreading in all directions like a continuous tide.
Wherever the ripples spread, all filth was cleansed. In this space and time, it had just experienced battle and Exort. The Dark King only died and wasn’t cleansed. Not only did its death not cleanse the Contaminated Land, but it also polluted more areas because of its death.
Because of the death of the Dark King, it could be said that the entire starry sky was filled with plague.
At this moment, Susu’s breakthrough in this space and time was undoubtedly a miracle of salvation for this space and time.
“What a strong cleansing power.” At this moment, the experts of Blue Planet gathered in the starry sky one by one. They didn’t dare to get too close to the starry sky. They sensed this powerful cleansing power in shock and found it unbelievable.
This was the first time he had seen a cosmic cleansing power…
“Wait, isn’t that person…” Lu Qingyi, Senior Panda, and the gem cat were slightly shocked when they saw Shi Yu.
This guy was actually at the cosmic level…
“Hahahaha.” At this moment, the entire starry sky could hear Shi Yu’s laughter. This was because Susu’s breakthrough was very smooth. It was a breakthrough that came naturally, far smoother than his breakthrough at that time.
During this breakthrough process, the Dark King Sealed Artifact that had yet to be cleansed was being accelerated. In the Sealed Artifact, the dying Dark King’s gaze fell.
“I didn’t expect that I couldn’t withstand it in the end. In just such a short period of time, I completely cleansed you.”
“Looks like I’m going to be the first cosmic level to fall.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1932: The Second Universe Level (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1932: The Second Universe Level (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
At this moment, even until death, the Dark King didn’t show anything. It only wanted to fiercely look at the guy who continued to release cleansing fluctuations through the sealed artifact.
Seeing that Susu had reached the cosmic level because it cleansed the filth, the Dark King sighed with emotion and stopped struggling. Under the gaze, its body slowly turned into nothingness.
“Dark King, have a safe trip.” Shi Yu’s voice sounded.
“Smash it. I hope you don’t die in the hands of the cosmic will.” Before dying, the Dark King left a final message, hoping that Shi Yu and the others could become the masters of the universe. This way, it wouldn’t have died for nothing.
“Your hatred for the universe is really strong. Yes,” Shi Yu said.
At that moment, as the Dark King was completely cleansed and Susu was about to break through, the power of space and time fused with the power of cleansing and was nurturing a new universe origin on her body!!
Extreme race abilities and powerful spatial power. Now, Susu had them all.
There was naturally no need to talk about the cleansing ability. As for the power of space and time, Susu had learned the time-element Heavenly Frost Cold Energy in its early years. Now, it had long been modified by Shi Yu into the time and ice-element cosmic disaster skill Cold Silence.
The spatial element also had the Infinite Devour at the start and the current Boundless Devour.
Of course, just these two skills weren’t enough for Susu’s spatial attainments to support the universe. However, Shi Yu even got Susu to turn high-level time-element and spatial-element stars into armed tools, fuse them into one, and devour them.
In addition, Shi Yu used the dual cosmic spatial talent as the foundation for Susu to constantly build… After it broke through, its spatial attainments might not be the strongest at the cosmic level, but it would definitely have a solid foundation. At the moment, it was enough to try to break through to the cosmic level.
Boom!!!
As the entire universe watched in disbelief as countless cleansing power flowed to every part and completely cleansed the plague left behind by the Dark King, Susu’s own aura finally reached the cosmic level without relying on Shi Yu.
If Shi Yu was included, her current strength was enough to approach the strongest state with the enhancement of half the power of the cosmic Sea of Stars back then.
“Ning!” Countless halos retracted. Susu’s breakthrough shocked the experts on Blue Planet deeply. The smiling young man beside them shocked them even more. Who exactly was this person and where did he come from?
Just as they were puzzled, the surrounding space changed. Shi Yu and Goddess Wa’s figures appeared not far away. Their appearance also attracted Shi Yu’s attention.
“Yo, my good daughter is back.” Shi Yu looked at Shi Yu, the sixth cosmic throne in this space and time, and smiled.
“Father, this is…” Shiyu was stunned. A pet had broken through to the cosmic level and even succeeded? This guy… was really “at ease” and really “reliable”.
“Father…”
At this moment, apart from Blue Planet’s Will and a few others who knew, the experts of Blue Planet looked at Shi Yu in shock when they heard Blue Planet’s Throne Shi Yu’s words.
“Looks like I didn’t lure that guy out.” Shi Yu hugged the soft Susu and said, “Are you ready to spar? Don’t worry, I won’t bully you. I won’t send a cosmic pet.”
“I…” Shiyu looked at the group of people around her and couldn’t say anything. Although she wanted an audience, she only wanted Goddess Wa to be a witness. There was no need to make such a big commotion, right? If she lost too badly, how could she survive in this space and time?

chapters.title: Chapter 1933: Monster Father (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1933: Monster Father (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
At this moment, the conversation in the starry sky stunned the experts who came out of Blue Planet.
In fact, there were very few people who knew Shiyu’s true identity even among the Blue Planet experts.
Many people only knew that Shiyu, the most dazzling genius in the universe, was cultivated by Goddess Wa single-handedly. They knew that she had a few godmothers who took turns to take care of her.
However, even Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, and the others, who were also in the crowd, had no impression of Shiyu’s father’s identity.
However, even Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, and the others, who were also in the crowd, had no impression of Shiyu’s father’s identity.
Most importantly, Shiyu’s father looked very strong.
Just now, he cultivated a cosmic pet?
“Hiss…”
The powerful thing about cosmic-level Beast Tamers was that they could strengthen one of their super divine pets to the cosmic level.
And if the pet of a cosmic-level Beast Tamer was originally at the cosmic level, how strong would the combination of the two parties be?
Everyone looked at Shiyu and Goddess Wa.
“Yes.” Shiyu nodded and said,
“He’s indeed my father. The cosmic overlord is heavily injured. I don’t know when the God of Destruction will come to the overlord territory again. I was worried about the safety of Blue Planet, so I called him over. He’s very strong. He can definitely deal with the God of Destruction.”
Shi Yu was naturally familiar with the experts on Blue Planet. After all, be it the Five Emperors of Dong Huang or the super divines of the five divine races on Blue Planet, they had all been sparring partners for her.
They had all been beaten up by her.
“Really?” As Shiyu explained, Lin Feng and the others looked at each other in disbelief.
Lin Feng said in shock, “I only know that Shiyu has a few powerful godmothers, so is this person a godfather or a biological father??”
“Shiyu is indeed impressive to acknowledge her mother. This is the first time she’s acknowledged her father, right?”
“Cut it out,” Divine Source said. Wasn’t he afraid of being beaten up by a cosmic level?
“A cosmic Beast Tamer and a cosmic pet… are indeed very reliable,” the black-robed Emperor Shi said calmly. He acknowledged Shiyu’s strength very much. To be invited by Shiyu as external help, how strong was Shiyu’s father?
They weren’t the only ones. Goddess Wa was also observing Shi Yu.
“Goddess Wa has been invited. In that case…”
“Hey, girl, let your strongest pet out for me to see.” Shi Yu looked at Shiyu and said, “I’m here to see your strength.”
“My strongest pet…” Shiyu stared at him and said, “Alright, since the atmosphere has reached this point.”
“Senior Goddess Wa, if his strength is qualified, you should be able to make the decision, right?”
Goddess Wa said, “The commotion just now has probably awakened the cosmic overlord. If he’s strong enough to resist the God of Destruction, the cosmic overlord shouldn’t mind giving him a cosmic treasure and hiring him to protect the overlord territory for a period of time.”
“Alright.” As long as he could take the resources of the cosmic overlord army’s treasure vault, Shiyu was very satisfied.
“Then, come out, Rain Dragon.” As Shiyu spoke, space and time blurred behind her. With a dragon roar, a black dot appeared.
In the spatial hole, the black dot quickly enlarged. It was a blue divine dragon. It flew out of the Beast Taming Space and spread its wings, looking like it was covering the stars.
A nebula that was like rain mist lingered, as if it was produced from its body. A thick rain mist spread in the starry sky, setting off its descent from a different space and time.
“Roar!!!” The blue divine dragon stared at Shi Yu. The aura of a peak super divine was undoubtedly revealed. It was very powerful, and the power fluctuations on its body were even deeper and boundless, like the Sea of Stars, making Shi Yu feel various powers such as time, space, water, and wind.
“Dragon?” Seeing Shi Yu’s pet, Shi Yu stood in the starry sky and muttered to himself.
“And this stats…”
“World Divine Dragon,” Shi Yu said.
“That’s right. Rain Dragon is the little princess of the World Divine Dragon Race,” Shi Yu said. A World Divine Dragon with both time and space attributes was definitely one of the strongest races in the starry sky.
This pet was specially requested by Goddess Wa from the Boss of the World Divine Dragon Race at the peak of the super divine level.
“Come, let me see how strong you are.” Shi Yu crossed his arms in front of his chest. Susu slowly disappeared from the outside world and returned to the Beast Taming Space.
“Heh, then watch carefully.” Shiyu still hoped to make her father suffer a little. This was because she kept feeling that her father treated her like a child. She was the cosmic emperor after all.
Even if Shi Yu was really stronger than her, he should at least give her the corresponding respect as the cosmic emperor!
Boom!!
Shiyu also stood in the starry sky. The fluctuations of the universe origin bloomed on her body and acted on the World Divine Dragon at the peak of the super divine level. The aura of this World Divine Dragon was instantly even more terrifying!!
“Roar!!! (Sorry to offend you.)”
The World Divine Dragon was the strongest dragon born on the World King Planet, and Shiyu had broken through to the cosmic level with the help of the World King. The combination of the power of this lineage made the World Divine Dragon easily enter the cosmic level and erupt with a power that was enough to stir space and time!!
After completing the strengthening, it directly danced in the space and bared its fangs and brandished its claws at Shi Yu. This claw looked ordinary, but in fact, every time it moved, countless subspaces exploded, turning into a push, making the destructive power of this claw even more terrifying.
This claw even used the law of time to overlap the power of countless time periods, accumulating and concentrating, only erupting with the most dazzling point. Anyone who had already started to cultivate the power of space and time could feel a strong pressure from this attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 1934: Monster Father (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1934: Monster Father (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“Hiss… No way.” The super divines of the five divine races on Blue Planet completely didn’t expect the two of them to attack just like that. They were immediately shocked.
“Do you have to work so hard? This attack can easily destroy a star field, tens of billions of stars. Didn’t Shiyu just break through to the cosmic level? Why is she so reckless?” Lin Feng also shouted.
He didn’t doubt Shiyu’s battle power. After all, Shiyu could blow them up when she was at the super divine level. However, he was worried that Shiyu, who had just broken through to the cosmic level, couldn’t control the power of the cosmic level well and blow up countless stars.
This place was so close to Blue Planet. If they suddenly fought, even Goddess Wa and Blue Planet’s Will couldn’t control Shiyu and the World Divine Dragon now.
“Her control is alright.” In comparison, peak super divines like Goddess Wa and Blue Planet acknowledged Shiyu’s ability to control her powers and understood that she knew how to control herself.
As long as Shi Yu also knew the limits of control, there would be no problem.
In the midst of everyone’s thoughts, this attack had already reached Shi Yu’s side. Shi Yu didn’t even wait for Shi Yu to summon a new pet before attacking. Of course, she also felt that this was nothing. Although Susu had been retracted by Shi Yu just now, as a Beast Tamer, it should be basic to guard against various situations.
However, the next scene stunned everyone.
“How could this be?” Lu Qingyi, Lin Xiuzhu, and the other godmothers of Shiyu revealed incredulous expressions.
Everyone saw that after the huge dragon claw arrived in front of Shi Yu, it didn’t even cause any explosions. Shi Yu didn’t even summon his pet. He only stood in the starry sky with a smile. He stretched out his hand and held the dragon claw that was much larger than his body.
Buzz. Buzz.
The dragon claw trembled in the starry sky, but it couldn’t move forward anymore. All the strength seemed to have been sealed and didn’t leak out at all. It felt like it was a World Divine Dragon controlled by a monster with extraordinary strength. Its pupils swayed like an earthquake, and its entire body exerted strength, but it couldn’t move forward anymore.
Shi Yu sensed the state of the World Divine Dragon and suddenly trembled. She looked at Shi Yu, who had received the World Divine Dragon’s attack empty-handed, in confusion.
What a joke.
She could clearly sense that Shi Yu hadn’t summoned any pets at all. He was only using his own strength… to directly receive the World Divine Dragon’s skill with his own strength??
“Boom!!!” At this moment, Shi Yu, who felt that his hand was also a little numb, began to move his wrist. In the next moment, the entire body of the World Divine Dragon was reversed. Shi Yu leaped gently and his figure had already arrived on the head of the World Divine Dragon. His spatial travel method was even incomprehensible to the World Divine Dragon.
Shi Yu used the World Divine Dragon as a force point and gently tapped it with his feet. The World Divine Dragon’s brain suddenly rumbled as it felt a terrifying impact. In the next moment, under the eruption of strength, Shi Yu’s body had already exceeded time and arrived in front of Shi Yu at an extreme speed.
“You…” Shi Yu was suddenly shocked. His expression changed drastically, but it was already too late. In the next moment, Shi Yu’s palm was already pressed against Shi Yu’s abdomen.
Boom!
Shi Yu exerted a little strength, and Shiyu immediately spat out a mouthful of blood. Her body smashed towards Blue Planet like a meteor!!
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically, unable to believe this scene at all. Lu Qingyi, Lin Xiuzhu, and the others immediately had sullen expressions. This guy really didn’t show mercy.
As for Emperor Shi and the others, they were relatively more rational. They just couldn’t believe what Shi Yu had done just now.
Although Shiyu had never fought after breaking through to the cosmic level, before the cosmic level, apart from the two peak super divine experts, Goddess Wa and Blue Planet’s Will, she had already fought all the invincible experts on Blue Planet. Everyone knew her strength.
Now, she, who had broken through to the cosmic level, was undoubtedly the strongest on Blue Planet. Apart from the cosmic overlord and the God of Destruction, she was the strongest in the universe.
However, Shiyu, facing her father with the World Divine Dragon, was actually heavily injured in an instant!!
The most terrifying thing was that Shi Yu didn’t even send out his pet!!
It only used its own strength!
“Cough.” In the end, Shiyu wasn’t smashed onto Blue Planet. She successfully stopped outside, but she also felt her body fall apart in intense pain.
She wiped the blood from the corners of her mouth and looked at Shi Yu. As for Shi Yu, he also looked at her and said, “Your physique is too weak. No wonder you’re so weak.”
“However, at your age, it’s already rare and precious to meditate and raise the Beast Taming Space to the cosmic level. It’s a little unreasonable to ask for physique again. However, you can’t ignore it in the future. You have to strengthen it.”
“At least, you have to be able to resist the cosmic level without relying on pets, relying on your physical strength, mental strength, and soul power!” Shi Yu instructed the other party.
“What a joke…” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, Shi Yu gritted her teeth and didn’t say anything. On the other hand, the others understood what Shi Yu meant. Did Shi Yu’s father mean that even if he didn’t rely on pets and fought alone, he could still fight against the cosmic levels of other races?
“Yes.” In the crowd, Lu Qingyi suddenly recalled that since Shi Yu was also a transmigrator from the last era, Shi Yu probably had mastered the cultivation system of the last era like Lin Xiuzhu…
In the last era, the battle power of humans didn’t lie in pets.
Of course, everyone knew that Shi Yu also had a pet. In other words, not only was he a cosmic-level Beast Tamer who could strengthen his pet to the cosmic level, but he could also fight a cosmic-level monster Beast Tamer alone? This was too ridiculous.

chapters.title: Chapter 1935: Monster Father (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1935: Monster Father (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Since Beast Tamers were already so strong, why would they still need pets? Wasn’t this bullying?
“Cultivate the two eras system at the same time,” Goddess Wa said.
“Of course I know.” Shiyu gritted her teeth and finally spoke. She was very dissatisfied. Of course, she knew that the Beast Tamer’s physique was also very important. She also cultivated and even had a pretty good level. It was not a problem for her to fight a super divine-level cosmic life form alone. She could even defeat a super divine level cosmic behemoth.
However, wasn’t Shi Yu’s physique that could fight a cosmic level alone a little too much? Could the difference be so big?
“Rain Dragon.” Shiyu gave the order, and the World Divine Dragon directly turned into rain mist and disappeared. In the next moment, a blue spear appeared in Shiyu’s hand.
Surprisingly, he chose to let the World Divine Dragon transform into a weapon and fuse with her to strengthen his physique. This way, he might be able to resist Shi Yu.
“You’re not the only one who cultivates the power system of two eras at the same time.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, he flashed and stabbed at Shi Yu with a spear in hand. The spear shot out like a dragon, and a little blue light illuminated the starry sky.
This move was taught to her by her godmother, Lin Xiuzhu. It was the ability of pet weaponization.
Although it wasn’t the complete cultivation system of the previous era, it could more or less increase his strength.
“Come on.” Shi Yu still smiled and even placed his hands behind his back. Even if Shi Yu’s spear spike locked space and time, it still didn’t lock Shi Yu’s movements.
He only retreated lightly, turned sideways, and dodged Shiyu’s spear hundreds of times in just a few seconds.
In terms of cultivation of the power of space and time, Shiyu and the others were clearly not home yet.
“At this level, waiting for you to deal with a God of Destruction that even a cosmic overlord can’t deal with is indeed not enough,” Shi Yu said with a smile as he dodged.
“Damn, does this guy not know how to speak human language? Is he really Shiyu’s father?” In the crowd, the gem cat couldn’t stand it anymore. Shiyu, the cosmic throne, was half her student after all. Now that she saw that Shiyu was already at the cosmic level and was still so aggrieved when hitting people, she was even more anxious than Shiyu.
Beat it up, Shiyu!!
At this moment, everyone was numb from watching. The Blue Planet expert who had once been beaten up by Shiyu felt his heart flip when he saw Shiyu being played by her father like a child.
How was this possible? Even if Shi Yu’s father was also at the cosmic level, how could the difference be so big?
[This guy…] At this moment, in the overlord territory, just as Goddess Wa had expected, the cosmic overlord was indeed observing in the dark. It also couldn’t understand Shi Yu’s powerful body, heart, will, and terrifying spatial attainments.
Although it was still a little lacking, Shi Yu was only a human Beast Tamer. Beast Tamers should obediently fight with their pets. How could a person be so strong himself?
[If this guy fights with his pet, his strength won’t be inferior to mine.] The cosmic overlord made a judgment.
In comparison, as a cosmic-level Beast Tamer, the foundation Shi Yu had accumulated was clearly inferior. This was also normal. After all, according to Shi Yu’s understanding, it had only been two to three years since she broke through to the cosmic level.
As for Shi Yu himself, after breaking through to the cosmic level, he had already cultivated bitterly in this realm for more than ten years.
However, Shi Yu could confirm that even when he had just broken through to the cosmic level, he should be a little stronger than the other party. It should be that the other party’s pet configuration wasn’t as high as his, so the feedback he received was a little lesser.
As expected, he still took advantage of his pet.
“Damn it.” At this moment, Shi Yu kept flickering. He used the power of space and time to dodge the other party’s attack, leaving Shi Yu helpless.
“Don’t dodge if you have the ability,” Shiyu couldn’t help but say. What awaited her was an “Alright”.
When Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone saw a small red sparrow fly out of thin air. It flew around Shi Yu and suddenly entered the space between his eyebrows.
The appearance of this little sparrow stunned Empress Huang Xi and the woman who looked similar to her in the crowd.
“Chi Tong, possess me.”
“Let’s have a civil war between daughters.” Shi Yu smiled. His body began to turn blurry and hot, and red fire flames quickly erupted and lingered around him.
In the next moment, Shi Yu’s gaze seemed to contain fire as it changed in the direction of Chi Tong’s burning eyes.
In an instant, Shi Yu completed his shapeshift. A fierce spiritual aura that was like the flames of the sun turned into flames that wrapped around his entire body!
Bright red hair, fair skin, a thin but powerful body, and the fire spiritual sword that spread and condensed in his hand marked Shi Yu’s entry into the long-lost Chi Tong possession state.
This time, Shi Yu didn’t dodge. The moment the other party’s attack arrived, he held Chi Tong and waved it gently. In the next moment, it was as if the entire parallel universe was burning. The terrifying power of the spatial flames erupted in front of Shiyu like the Big Bang, making her reveal an incredulous expression.
A voice seemed to come from the Sword Chant, indicating that it was still a little lacking.
Boom!!!
The spear collided with the sword aura, and Shi Yu was blasted out again. She ran towards the endless galaxy. Shi Yu strengthened Chi Tong, and Chi Tong possessed Shi Yu. It turned into a weapon and fused with the power of the two eras. Without a doubt, Shi Yu had completely launched a cosmic overlord-level attack.
This attack wasn’t something Shiyu could block at all. Unsurprisingly, she was sent flying.
At this moment, sensing the terrifying aura of the red-haired Shi Yu, the experts on Blue Planet held their breaths and were even more afraid of Shi Yu’s strength.
Shiyu was actually completely not her father’s match.

chapters.title: Chapter 1936: Monster Father (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1936: Monster Father (4)
Editor: Atlas Studios
[A monster.] Even the recuperating cosmic overlord muttered to himself. [Looks like someone can check and balance that guy. Interesting, two more experts have appeared. The next time won’t be boring.]
It closed its eyes again and continued to recuperate. In its opinion, there was no suspense in this battle at all. It was an old man playing the fool. The difference between the two parties was even greater than the difference between it and cosmic emperors like the Dark King. Shiyu still had to train for a long time before it could be considered a true cosmic level. It was still too young.
In comparison, the red-haired man was much more experienced.
“I’m not fighting anymore.” After a while, Shi Yu saw a blue light dot flying back quickly in the distant starry sky with an aura. He said to the unconvinced Shi Yu, “Apart from being more resistant to beatings like every cosmic level, you still have to cultivate well next.”
“I’ll find you a coach.”
“Continue fighting,” Shiyu said indignantly.
“I still have business to do. The difference just now should be obvious.” Shi Yu exited the red-haired Sword God form and an Iron-eating Beast with black and white hair appeared beside him.
Shi Yu patted its head gently. The Iron-eating Beast, which originally had a peak super divine aura, was immediately strengthened to the cosmic level.
“Wuu!!” Eleven immediately gave a military order when it heard that Shi Yu wanted to hand his daughter to it to train.
OK, give it eleven years and it’ll definitely train Shiyu to the normal cosmic level.
At this moment, no one expected Shi Yu to summon another Iron-eating Beast.
Everyone felt that Shi Yu’s three pets were very interesting.
Putting aside the cosmic cleansing pet, everyone had a ridiculous deduction about the little bird that had possessed Shi Yu just now. Why did they feel that the aura of the little bird was so similar to the Empress and her contracted sword spirit?
“That’s me. It should be me in a parallel space,” Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit in this space and time said with a blank expression. She shared her deduction with the Empress, making the other party take a deep breath and find it unbelievable.
There was also this Iron-eating Beast. The Iron-eating Beast was also one of the mainstream races on Blue Planet. Everyone was very surprised that Shi Yu actually had a contract.
In fact, it wasn’t surprising. This was because there was a panda on the casual clothes Shi Yu was wearing. However, just now, no one paid attention to him at all.
“So annoying,” Shiyu shouted and attacked again. Eleven took the initiative to face it, even more brutal than Shi Yu. It directly stretched out its bear paw and grabbed the spear tip with a bang.
“Wuu. (Didn’t you eat?)” Eleven howled and was extremely serious.
“Ahhh.” Shiyu wanted to pull out her spear, but she realized that Eleven’s palm was like a black hole, directly attracting all their strength and making them unable to resist.
No…
The most terrifying thing was that the palm that was like a black hole suddenly turned white, and a shocking Illuminate suddenly erupted. Shiyu and the others… were sent flying extremely far again without any doubt.
Everyone was stunned.
“Sigh.” Shi Yu yawned and said, “This should be enough. You guys fight slowly. I’m going to do another important thing. I’ll leave first.”
At this moment, everyone swallowed their saliva.
And now, it was actually very obvious that Shi Yu regarded it as important.
It wasn’t a resource from the overlord army’s treasure vault.
Instead…
After Susu broke through to the cosmic level, Shi Yu himself also received feedback. This feedback successfully made Shi Yu’s mind clear and his thoughts awaken. He felt that his plundering talent had loosened. This was very valuable.
He had been cultivating for more than ten years for this day. He didn’t know how much effort he had spent. He felt that it was even harder than cultivating a peak super divine pet, but now, fortunately, he finally saw hope.
As long as his plundering talent broke through to the cosmic level, he could try to strip away his talent. This meant that…
Buggy and Eleven had finally reached the stage where they could charge into the cosmic level!

chapters.title: Chapter 1937: Why Another One (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1937: Why Another One (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
A year later.
In the blink of an eye, Shi Yu had already stayed in this future parallel space for a year.
This year, many experts on Blue Planet had already accepted the fact that Shiyu had a powerful father.
In a year, Shiyu didn’t stay idle the whole time. She fought Eleven 24 hours a day for 365 days a year and didn’t stop resting for a whole year.
Just outside Blue Planet.
The experts on Blue Planet were numb.
Only Eleven and Shiyu weren’t tired of it.
As for Shi Yu, he had landed on Blue Planet early and chose to enter seclusion to cultivate. He no longer wasted time fighting Shiyu personally.
In a year, Shi Yu finally made progress.
“Hehehehe.” Shi Yu, who had taken out his heart, revealed a villainous smile in a certain mystic realm. It was a very presumptuous smile.
He looked at the Worm Heart in his hand and his face filled with joy.
This cocoon-like Worm Heart was the Worm Strengthening Talent that Shi Yu had cultivated to the cosmic level. Through the modified plundering talent, Shi Yu stripped away his Beast Taming Talent!!
Shi Yu felt that the value of this thing wasn’t inferior to a cosmic treasure at all. It wasn’t inferior to the queen bloodline given by the Worm Queen.
As long as he gave this to Buggy as one of the evolution materials, in addition to the evolution materials he had originally prepared, Buggy would be at a stable cosmic level.
“It’s really damaging to the body.” Shi Yu felt that although he wouldn’t die if he stripped his talent, it would hurt his source. He felt that he couldn’t strip more. At most, he could strip a few more. That would be his limit. Any more would really overload him.
“Take your time. There’s no hurry.” Shi Yu wasn’t in a hurry to call Buggy to evolve. Instead, he took out a memory crystal. Inside was the EXP memory of the use of the Worm Strengthening Talent before he stripped it.
Now that his bug-type talent had been stripped away by him, he couldn’t use this talent anymore. Now, Shi Yu wanted to see if the stripped talent could be returned to him in a buggy way like the memory water drop.
Shi Yu crushed the activation memory crystal. In the next moment, a memory torrent rushed into Shi Yu’s mind.
The level EXP regarding the Worm Strengthening Talent instantly returned. However, Shi Yu’s expression didn’t become happy. Instead, it was a little serious.
“I’ve returned all my EXP and knowledge, but my bug-element strengthening talent hasn’t returned. I started cultivating again and can’t even reach Level 1.”
His brain contained the usage method and EXP, but his body couldn’t use it.
“Can’t I?” At this moment, Ling slowly appeared beside Shi Yu and said, “From the looks of it, although the EXP knowledge can still be returned, the body permanently lacks some ‘functions’ to use the corresponding talent.”
“Looks like it. I indeed feel a considerable backlash.” Shi Yu looked at the Worm Heart in his hand and said, “This way, I feel that the price is a little high. A trash talent like the Worm Strengthening Talent is alright, but if I strip away talents like the Taiji Domain and can’t return forever, it’s a loss. I can’t use it a second time.”
“Forget it, it doesn’t matter. In any case, there are many Beast Taming Talents that can be cultivated, and there should be many similar talents. If I help my pet break through to the cosmic level at a zero cost, that would be even more ridiculous. Before researching this method, I was already prepared for the worst.”
“I can sense that it’s something that far exceeds the origin of the bloodline and might be close to the backlash of the cosmic laws,” Shi Yu said. “It’s really fierce after all… To think that I still have a cosmic-level body control talent.”
“Perhaps it can only recover after it becomes the holder of the universe,” Ling said.
“I hope so. Forget it,” Shi Yu said. “If I can’t recover, so be it. In any case, apart from a few special talents related to archeology, I also have the functional talent of a combination pet like fusion. The other talents are useless to me.”
“Where’s Buggy?”
Under Shi Yu’s call, Buggy, who was sleeping soundly and recuperating in the Beast Taming Space, immediately woke up.
“Wu!!” Buggy was summoned by Shi Yu from the Beast Taming Space. In the next moment, it saw a pile of evolution materials placed in front of it.
As a dream-element cosmic treasure, the Dream Gem, the Spirit Light of the Spirit-element cosmic treasure, the Dragon Element cosmic treasure, the Time-element cosmic treasure, the Space-time Jade Butterfly, the cosmic treasure, the Heavenly Lake Stone, which could mobilize the kindness of the universe, and an ordinary wood-element cosmic-level crystal were all evolution materials prepared by Shi Yu for Buggy. He had taken them from other cosmic emperors.
At the moment, there was still a new batch of bug-type strengthening talent that Shi Yu had joined. Shi Yu felt that it was enough.
There were a total of seven cosmic treasures that involved various stats domains. For any cosmic emperor, they weren’t bad collections. And at the moment, Shi Yu wanted Buggy to eat all of them!!
Devour and digest into evolution nutrients to help him evolve!
Previously, in the entire universe, only the Worm Queen could transform the power of the cosmic treasure for her own use. Buggy, who had inherited the Worm Queen’s Ultimate Devour, was the second!
“Eat, eat.” Shi Yu looked at the excited Buggy and smiled. “Eat your fill, then slowly digest and modify yourself to see if you can break through to the cosmic level in the end.”
“Wu! Yes!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1938 Why Another One (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1938  Why Another One (2)
Then, under Shi Yu's gaze, countless worm silk lingered around Buggy's body, wrapping the pile of cosmic treasures in front of it and pulling it to its side. Under the cover of the worm silk, its body directly enlarged, and its eyes grew out of the newly wrapped cocoon.
"Burp." Just as it swallowed, Buggy felt a little stuffed and sleepy.
"With your digestion speed, digesting a cosmic treasure shouldn't take too long. The difficulty isn't digestion, but whether you can perfectly modify yourself and achieve evolution with the nutrition you digest."
"This depends on your own hard work. I'll send you to the time acceleration area of the Beast Taming Space to assist in your evolution," Shi Yu said. "Sleep in peace."
"I hope you can come into being and become the strongest bug type in the universe that can replace the Queen of the Worms."
"Ji!! (For the strongest!)" Buggy nodded heavily. Then, it slowly closed its eyes. Right on the heels of that, Shi Yu teleported it back to the Beast Taming Space to prepare for evolution.
At this time, Shi Yu naturally wouldn't stay idle. He chose to continue stripping his talent.
This time, what he planned to strip away was the Taiji Domain, Green Dragon Domain, Vermillion Bird Domain, Black Tortoise Domain, White Tiger Domain, and Metal Strengthening. Shi Yu didn't know if he could withstand stripping away six cosmic talents in a row.
Moreover, during the stripping process, he still had to think of a way to split the metal-element talent into five and fuse with the other five talents to fulfill the new metal. It was a huge project. He had to think about how to do it carefully.
In order to let Eleven complete the invincible Chaos Origin Evolution, all his efforts were worth it. When he thought of how Eleven could cultivate Chaos, Taiji, Four Symbols, and Eight Trigrams into one, Shi Yu looked forward to its complete body after evolution.
Another half a year later…
In the past half a year, Shi Yu had been studying the profundity of the Beast Taming Talent day and night. Baby Ginseng nursed Shi Yu while also studying the profundity of the cosmic tree seed.
Ling was naturally the one who had a research mission like the two of them. In the end, after knowing that Shi Yu was eyeing the Jade Rabbit fossil, Goddess Wa took out the Jade Rabbit fossil from the treasure vault of the cosmic overlord army and let Shi Yu study it.
In Shi Yu's hands, it was naturally in Ling's hands. Apart from Ling, Qi and the Empress were also very interested in this thing. The three parties studied it together.
"So that's how it's done?"
Shi Yu had already experienced countless simulations. A metal pendant in the form of a vermillion bird gradually appeared in his palm, like a small accessory bought with five coins at a roadside stall.
The red metal piece was strange and ugly. It was probably because Shi Yu's skills weren't good enough. He had no skills and it was all emotions. It was just an evolution material that Shi Yu had poured a lot of effort into!
"Hu…" This thing was actually quite useful to Chi Tong. It wasn't much inferior to the Space-time Shadowless Sword, but it was only at this level. It could only be considered an external object at most.
Unlike Eleven and Buggy, who had racial abilities that could devour them into evolution nutrients and really transform them into their own things, this was still the most cost-effective for Eleven.
"Alright." The more Shi Yu looked at this ugly Vermillion Bird metal, the more pleasing to the eye it was. Then, he threw it aside and began to study other metals.
About half a year later.
In the starry sky of the universe, Eleven and Shiyu continued fighting for two years, but it still didn't end.
In the past two years, Shiyu's aura had gradually become stronger. From being suppressed by Eleven at the start, it gradually became evenly matched, and now, it was even suppressing Eleven.
As expected of a Beast Tamer with the strongest human talent. In two years, Eleven could clearly feel the other party's improvement. At least this will was worth affirming. If it were Shi Yu, Shi Yu definitely wouldn't be willing to be beaten up for two years.
"Uncle Eleven, continue," Shiyu said indignantly. "I feel that in a while, we can defeat you."
Shiyu could also clearly sense that after fighting for two consecutive years, her understanding of space and time had deepened, and she was more proficient in using various Beast Taming Talents.
"Wuu!" Eleven was just about to respond, but it suddenly heard Shi Yu's call.
[Eleven, it's time to come back. The five evolution metals are ready. It's time to f*cking evolve!! Taiji Metal, Green Dragon Metal… They're all top-notch!!]
Eleven: !!!
With a whoosh, countless saliva brewed in Eleven's mouth. It had waited for this day for a long time.
"Wuu. (Forget it, I'm already tired. I admit defeat~)" Eleven looked at Shiyu and admitted defeat.
As if.
During this period of time, Eleven had gradually been suppressed. It was mainly because Shi Yu hadn't provided it with much strengthening power from the start. As they fought, Eleven's realm gradually fell from the cosmic level. This gave Shi Yu and the others the illusion that they were getting stronger and stronger.
In fact, it was Eleven who constantly strengthened its basic strength by fighting cosmic-level Beast Tamers during the battle. It was still uncertain who would gain more from both parties.
As for now, Eleven only wanted to eat the evolution metal quickly and didn't want to fight Shiyu anymore.
After admitting defeat and encouraging Shiyu, Eleven slipped away with a whoosh, leaving behind a confused Shiyu and the World Divine Dragon.
"It… admits defeat," Shiyu said.
Blue Planet…
Eleven bounced back and was even happier than Buggy when it saw the pile of metal Shi Yu had prepared for it.
What was love?
Both Buggy and Eleven received Shi Yu's unlimited love.
On Eleven's side, Shi Yu personally researched and stripped five evolution materials for it.
As for Buggy, although there was only one, Shi Yu had given 80% of the team's cosmic treasures to Buggy as evolution materials.
It could be said that Shi Yu had placed endless expectations on these two initial pets, hoping that they could become the strongest cosmic level, the kind where each of them could fight a cosmic overlord alone.
Click, click, click…
In the next moment, Eleven had already sat on the ground. It held the Green Dragon Metal in one hand and the White Tiger Metal in the other and started eating.
One, one, and another. Soon, the five metals were drained into Eleven's stomach.
Eleven could be said to be satisfied with the food. Just like Buggy at that time, it burped. Then, it was a little full and sleepy…
"With so many things, it's impossible to complete evolution immediately. Let's go to the Beast Taming Space to digest it first. Whether you can condense the power of Taiji, Four Symbols, Eight Trigrams, and Chaos together depends on your own comprehension."
"Wuu!!!" Eleven immediately obeyed and ran back to the Beast Taming Space to rest.
However, just as Eleven returned to the Beast Taming Space, it was stunned.
He gradually felt that a terrifying aura was being nurtured and born on the next star.
Not only Eleven, but the group of pets in the Beast Taming Space also looked at a certain insect star.
The Empress looked over and said in surprise, "Is that little worm also going to break through to the cosmic level?"
"That's true. With so many rare nutrients and the Ultimate Devour, it's time."
On the Worm Star, at this moment, a cocoon was emitting a dazzling light, constantly brewing stronger fluctuations. Sensing this aura, Shi Yu couldn't help but be stunned before being delighted.
"Yo, apart from the Empress and Susu, the third cosmic level is coming too? After that, there's still Eleven… He's invincible now."
"Buggy, don't worry. I'll put you in the outside world now. Try to mobilize the kindness of the universe to complete the final impact."
Shi Yu was extremely excited. He came to the starry sky again and released Buggy.
In the next moment, after two years, it was Susu the last time. This time, it was Buggy. Shi Yu arrived outside Blue Planet again and let his pet break through to the cosmic level.
Boom!!!
The terrifying power fluctuations of Shi Yu and Buggy instantly swept through the entire universe, shocking everyone on Blue Planet, the overlord territories, and the experts in the entire universe, especially a certain God of Destruction who was recuperating in the crack of space and time and had yet to appear.
The God of Destruction was awakened by the aura of the outside world again and revealed a ridiculous expression.
"Why is there another one!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1939 Birth of the Strongest (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1939  Birth of the Strongest (1)
Overlord territory, the starry sky outside Blue Planet!
A cocoon covered in a green-purple hard shell and covered in white and green patterns was shining.
Although it was only an ordinary cocoon, at the moment, with it as the center, it erupted with an aura that was enough to shake the world. For bug-type life forms, they could sense the unbelievability of this aura the most directly.
In the thousands of universes, countless insect life forms subconsciously raised their heads and looked into the sky for an instant. Although the Worm Mother Nest had already died in battle, her heirs weren't all dead. At this moment, sensing Buggy's power fluctuations, countless insect bloodlines trembled with incredulous expressions.
The death of the Queen made them lose their home and pillars. They were no longer the insect race that dominated the universe. And now, these worms felt that a new king was being born.
Shi Yu observed Buggy in the starry sky like that, and his mood also fluctuated. This evolution was extraordinary for Buggy. It even gave up its powerful Green Dragon body to become the strongest Worm Race…
Could it be done? It depended on now.
"What happened again?"
There had actually been movement in the starry sky outside Blue Planet. The battle between Shiyu and Eleven had lasted for so long, and the experts on Blue Planet were already used to the commotion here.
However, when Shiyu fought Eleven, she would create a battle domain and try her best not to let the fluctuations affect Blue Planet.
But this time, this wave that triggered the starry sky was incomparably vast. No barrier could stop it. Just like the last time Susu evolved, it instantly attracted the gazes of the stars.
Susu needed to cleanse the Contaminated Land of this universe to farm one last EXP to break through to the cosmic level. And now, Buggy needed to rely on the "Universe Devourer" skill to devour the power of the universe to complete the final impact.
They all wanted to cause the universe to resonate. This way, they would naturally cause a huge range phenomenon. When the experts of Blue Planet ascended to the starry sky in unison, their teeth and stomachs immediately hurt.
Even the Blue Planet's Will was a little silent at this moment. Everyone understood what was happening in front of them.
That cosmic-level cocoon was being strengthened by Shi Yu. This scene was too similar, too similar to how Shi Yu had helped Susu break through previously. And now, apart from breaking through, this cocoon seemed to have another mission, evolution.
"Again? Wholesale cosmic level." Lin Feng couldn't help but say, "What kind of insect cocoon is that…"
"This person is really…" Shi Yu was also in the crowd. Not long after she ended her battle with Eleven, she had just returned to Blue Planet to digest her battle experience. She didn't expect to be shocked by Shi Yu and the others in the blink of an eye.
Shi Yu never expected that when she was fighting Eleven, Shi Yu would actually nurture another cosmic pet at the stage where he was holding it in on Blue Planet!
What a joke. When did the cosmic level become so cheap? She and the World Divine Dragon had fought that monster panda for two years, but the World Divine Dragon had never touched the threshold of the cosmic level.
"I understand now why Goddess Wa of the last era used this young man's bloodline as Shiyu's origin bloodline." In the crowd, Lu Qingyi took a deep breath and said, "Monsters are indeed of the same bloodline."
"I feel that Shiyu might not have to take the risk of becoming the holder of the universe. Her father will definitely be one step ahead of her. This is good too. Let this guy bear that risk," Lin Xiuzhu said.
"Meow, meow, meow." As one of the few connections who ascended to the starry sky with divine-level strength, the gem cat said, "Although I feel that it's not on good terms with his race, I don't deny it. This guy is really abnormal. If it succeeds, it'll be three universe levels! I feel that even if the God of Destruction recovers, he doesn't have the ability to destroy the universe."
"Lin Feng, can you tell what's going on with that cocoon?"
