Everyone asked Lin Feng, who had an evolution talent. At this moment, Lin Feng's gaze was filled with light as he observed Buggy's information. However, he shook his head and said, "It's evolution, but I can't understand it at all. It has already exceeded the upper limit of my talent."
"Look, there aren't many opportunities to witness the evolution of cosmic races," Lin Feng exclaimed.
Buzz!!
Just as everyone was watching, it was as if the universe was playing music. An incomparably deep sound of laws appeared. Everything under the starry sky seemed to have been blessed. The nebula condensed into a benevolent sea that continued for several star domains. It was really like the sea of stars. A flower that no one had ever seen bloomed in the sea, spreading waves of fragrance.
"What's this?"
Smelling the fragrance of the flowers in the Sea of Stars, some Space Races had the urge to not control their bodies. They felt incomparably tempted. They looked at the phenomenon in the Sea of Stars with drool and yearning.
"It seems to be condensed naturally by the universe." Blue Planet's Will was very surprised.
"That's the kindness of the universe." At some point in time, Goddess Wa had also arrived. She was also shocked. After all, it was already not bad for all races in the universe to be able to break through normally. In most cases, heavenly tribulations would also be sent down, such as humans breaking through the limit.
And too many cosmic levels had been born, which was a scene that the universe was unwilling to see. Why was there still kindness now?
Moreover, judging from the strength of this favor, it was very ridiculous. Even the cosmic overlord and the God of Destruction, who were secretly observing again, sensed that the strength of this cosmic favor was extraordinary.

chapters.title: Chapter 1940 Birth of the Strongest (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1940  Birth of the Strongest (2)
"If I eat all of them, I should be able to recover immediately."
The cosmic overlord made a judgment.
"Forget it, if it can recover naturally, it's better not to cause unnecessary trouble in this state. The other party isn't weak. In its weak state, it might not necessarily win." The cosmic God of Destruction originally coveted it very much, but in the end, it gave up. It had injured its origin, so it wasn't suitable to be happy in this state.
The cosmic overlord and the cosmic destruction god were purely overthinking. Buggy didn't plan to give outsiders a chance to fight for the favor of the universe at all.
This phenomenon naturally attracted countless Star Domain experts. Many experts wanted to fight for the favor of the universe excitedly, but in the next moment, they were mercilessly killed into nothingness by Buggy's killing intent that crossed space and time.
"Wu!!!" Its body seemed to have turned into a devouring hole. Even the Sea of Grace and the avatar of grace were quickly devoured by it.
In fact, this wasn't the kindness of the universe that took the initiative to descend. Although Buggy had swallowed the stone, it couldn't trigger a kindness of this scale with the stone. This was a magnificent feat completed by Buggy with the combination skill of the "Universe Devourer" and the "power of the stone".
It could be said that this cosmic favor wasn't voluntarily given by the cosmic will, but snatched by Buggy.
The incomparably vast kindness of the universe wasn't allowed to be touched by anyone at all. After all, it had snatched it himself, so why should it be given to others? If Shi Yu wanted his teammates, Buggy naturally didn't mind, but in this situation, the entire team was looking forward to Buggy breaking through, so naturally, no one fought with it.
After the power of the universe's favor in the continuous Sea of Stars was devoured by Buggy, another phenomenon appeared in the starry sky.
Buggy's entire body emitted an evolution light that shot into the galaxy like its aura. At this moment, everyone's eyes suddenly widened as they discovered an unbelievable scene. Under Buggy's aura, everyone felt that they were instantly pulled into another universe.
Not only the experts of Blue Planet, but at this moment, all the experts in the universe had the illusion of entering a dream for an instant.
This rope-in range even included the cosmic overlord recuperating in the depths of the Overlord Planet, including the God of Destruction who hid in the crack of space and time with other epoch methods.
The two of them widened their eyes in disbelief, unable to understand why this little worm's power could affect them.
The cosmic overlord was still alright, but the cosmic God of Destruction was immediately shocked. It immediately broke free from the restraints of this "dream universe" and kept jumping through space and time to prevent the other party from finding it.
In fact, Buggy had no intention of looking for the God of Destruction at all. It was purely because its current power involved the origin power of creation in the universe, directly affecting the entire universe in the form of a dream.
In the incomparably pitch-black cosmic dream realm, it seemed to be nurturing a terrifying creation creature. It was born in endless light, making the egg-like universe turn from dark to light, and dense white spatial cracks began to appear.
What was unbelievable was that waves of dragon might gradually emitted from these spatial cracks. Green divine dragons leaped from them one after another, forming the scene of ten thousand dragons dancing together in the world of light.
Each of these Green Dragons carried a cosmic pressure, making the experts who could maintain their consciousness and watch reveal incomparably shocked expressions. This was because most experts weren't unfamiliar with the power contained in these Green Dragons.
"One of the cosmic throne in the 10th Era, Green Dragon!"
Lu Qingyi was the first to speak. No one expected that the evolution phenomenon of this worm would actually have the shadow of a Green Dragon. Moreover, these Green Dragons actually seemed to be celebrating the birth of something, and signs of dancing appeared.
This scene was really surprising, because most people didn't understand why the insect race could be related to the Green Dragon, let alone why the hierarchy of both parties seemed to be higher than that insect egg.
"Roar!!!"
At this moment, under the dragon dance of the Creation God Dragons of the last era, the light ball became larger and larger. They kept circling in the starry sky. In the end, they focused and all the divine dragons entered the most dazzling light ball.
Boom!
The light ball finally broke open. A creature that seemed to be enough to support the birth of the cosmic world, like the most primitive god of creation in the universe, gradually displayed its full appearance.
Its figure was like a dream. It had a shining green luster and a white luster. It was incomparably holy and emitted endless vitality. The entire surface of its wings was like a green Sea of Stars blooming with countless white flowers. It was extremely gorgeous and displayed the highest image.
Shi Yu and the others held their breaths. They could see that Buggy's current posture was very similar to the Butterfly of Imagination, but the Butterfly of Imagination was blue. And now, Buggy had retained the green color from the Green Silkworm era. In addition to the white color of the worm silk, it had completed a new transformation and suppressed all external bloodlines, purely raising its worm bloodline to the extreme.
Boom!!!
At this moment, Buggy had undoubtedly completed the breakthrough and evolution of the universe level. In an instant, Shi Yu sensed a completely different change when Buggy broke through from Susu.
When Susu broke through, although its strength had increased in all aspects and the power of the origin wave was stronger, the essence of the skill didn't have any new transformation.
However, Buggy was different. After it completed its evolution breakthrough, one of its skills completed a gorgeous transformation and directly upgraded to a super divine skill. Buggy directly became the first pet in Shi Yu's team to have two super divine skills!!
"Wu…" Buggy's voice was like a huge earthquake in the starry sky, shaking the entire universe. At this moment, the cosmic overlord and the God of Destruction, who had hidden in the cracks of other spaces, were a little shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1941 Birth of the Strongest (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1941  Birth of the Strongest (3)
Skill: Dream Genesis
[Level]: Super Divine Skill
< Introduction > It can build a dream world with its mind. Even if it completely dies, even if the universe is destroyed, even if the universe restarts, the dream world won't be destroyed. The user can achieve eternal spirituality in the dream world, true immortality.
Shi Yu felt that the skill Buggy had awakened was ridiculous. This was the first skill he had seen that could ignore the restart of the universe.
At this moment, Buggy was also very happy. It sensed the power of the Dream Genesis, but soon, it was extremely regretful. It felt that although this move was powerful, it wasn't powerful enough.
The things in the dream… were ultimately illusory… It was the only one who could achieve eternity, not everyone.
If only this move could create a real universe and ignore the restart of the existing universe. This way, it, Shi Yu, and the others could at most change universes to Survival. They didn't have to take the risk of becoming the holder of the universe.
At this moment, as Buggy completed its breakthrough, the experts on Blue Planet sensed the incomparable aura on its body, especially since Buggy was still strengthened by Shi Yu. It made Goddess Wa take a deep breath and have an unbelievable deduction.
"At the stage where Shi Yu strengthened this pet, the strength of this butterfly has probably already exceeded that of a cosmic overlord."
The powerful thing about a cosmic overlord was that other cosmic emperors only had one super divine skill, but there were two cosmic overlords. Now, Goddess Wa felt that this butterfly most likely also had two super divine skills. Otherwise, it would be impossible for it to have such a terrifying aura.
As a peak super divine who had fought a cosmic overlord, Goddess Wa had this judgment.
"I'll call your new race the Creation Dream Butterfly." Shi Yu gathered everything and casually gave Buggy a name. When Buggy, whose body was as huge as a star, heard this, it smiled and didn't care if the name was nice.
"Wu, wu!!" Its huge body gradually shrank and turned back into a small green butterfly. It flew towards Shi Yu and landed on the back of Shi Yu's hand.
It showed its strength!
What Susu, what Empress? They were all inferior to it!
It was fine if it was Susu. It was used to the arrogance of every teammate when they first evolved and broke through. It had also had this arrogance.
However, in the Beast Taming Space, the Empress couldn't help but frown…
"Interesting." Was she too gentle after joining the team? Did these little guys not know their limits?
"Hahahaha." Shi Yu didn't mind. "When you're all at the cosmic level, I'll let you fight."
"Now isn't the time."
Just as Shi Yu finished speaking, Buggy was suddenly stunned, as if it had recalled something.
"Wu wu wu…" It said quickly. It seemed to have captured the traces of the God of Destruction for an instant just now.
However, he immediately let the other party run away again.
Buggy could confirm that its Dream Genesis used the universe as a blueprint. When it created the Dream Universe, it also had the function of sensing the entire universe. It should be able to lock onto the God of Destruction!
"Really?" Shi Yu was stunned. He had sensed it himself and let the Empress sense it. He had also strengthened every pet and made every pet search for traces of the God of Destruction.
However, they couldn't find any traces of the other party.
Did Buggy discover it just now???
"Wu!! (Want to crush the other party!! I want to farm the other party alone!!)" Buggy was excited. It didn't expect that the cosmic God of Destruction still had to be dealt with by the Creation God of the Dream Universe.
"There's no hurry," Shi Yu said. "Eleven should be able to break through in a few days. Adapt to your new realm in the next few days. I also need to recover my state. When we reach the most perfect state, we'll carry out the overall attack."
Shi Yu had just created a pile of talent metals and was still relatively weak. Although he had three cosmic pets beside him, Shi Yu wanted to solve the disaster of this parallel universe at the smallest cost.
Eleven was about to evolve and break through. Why didn't it wait until it gathered the four cosmic pets before attacking the cosmic God of Destruction? In any case, it had already been confirmed that Buggy could lock onto the other party's location.
"Wu." After Shi Yu finished speaking, Buggy nodded heavily.
At the same time.
In the Beast Taming Space, Eleven took a deep breath, hugged the bamboo pole, closed its eyes, and quickly digested the evolution resources. It swore to evolve stronger than Buggy.
"Why are they all here again?" At this moment, Shi Yu turned to look in the direction of Blue Planet and scratched his cheek.
"Disperse, disperse," he said to Shiyu and the others.
Shi Yu expressed that he didn't want to communicate much with these guys. After all, he was preparing to leave after fighting the God of Destruction and didn't plan to come to this parallel universe again. If they communicated too much, it would be troublesome.
At the moment, nurturing pets was more important. Now that Buggy had finally broken through to the cosmic level, Shi Yu had something big to do.
With that said, he stepped into the Void and left, leaving Shiyu and the others looking at each other.
"Too strong…" Old man Divine Source and the others could only leave this sentence in the end.
"He's indeed quite strong, but I'll surpass him sooner or later," Shiyu said. She was confident that she could reach the cosmic level in her twenties.
Wasn't it just two cosmic pets? If she was given some time, she could also nurture them.
…
At this moment, Shi Yu had returned to the icy plain. No matter which space and time it was, he still liked this cold little place.
"Buggy is at the cosmic level. We should be able to figure out the true appearance of this fossil, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1942: Birth of the Strongest (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1942: Birth of the Strongest (4)
Editor: Atlas Studios
After Shi Yu landed, he took out a cosmic fossil he had obtained from the Dark King.
“Wu. (Leave it to me.)” Buggy said.
“What could it be?” Ling also came out of the Beast Taming Space and was extremely curious.
Previously, even if Shi Yu strengthened Buggy and temporarily strengthened Buggy to the universe level, they couldn’t enter a dream.
But now, as Buggy broke through to the cosmic level, Shi Yu felt that if he strengthened it now, he should be able to see the true secret of this fossil.
“Dream.” Shi Yu activated his archeological ability.
Although he had stripped away the talents in the insect-element strengthening, Taiji, and other domains, Shi Yu still kept the spatial talent, a universal strengthening talent that involved archeology.
After all, not every pet had hope of reaching the cosmic level. They couldn’t not leave any talent on them.
If he didn’t even have a Beast Taming Talent, it wouldn’t be appropriate to say that he was a Beast Tamer no matter how many pets he contracted.
“Come on.” After Shi Yu strengthened Buggy through the power of space and time, both parties entered the dream fossil together. In the next moment, their vision suddenly turned pitch-black. In the dark dream world, a light source slowly appeared!
Then, it was the scene of a continent.
Success!
As expected, it couldn’t succeed previously because Buggy’s level wasn’t high enough.
This Dream Genesis that involved the Origin of Creation and the Origin of Dreams was still strong. As expected of a move that could even “resist” the restart of the universe to a certain extent.
At this moment, under Shi Yu and Buggy’s dream, they quickly successfully entered the dream world of this fossil. However, when they carefully observed this dream world, they immediately fell silent.
Because there was nothing inside the fossil…
The main body of this fossil shouldn’t be a life race in the traditional sense.
“An elemental-type life form?”
“It can’t be considered an elemental type. It’s more suitable to describe it as a planet-type race.”
Shi Yu and the others were standing on a continent. The sky, the ground, was a lifeless continent. Shi Yu and the others wanted to leave this continent and head to the starry sky to take a look, but they directly failed and were intercepted.
“I see.”
After failing in his attempt, Shi Yu strolled on this continent right on the heels of the heels. Through his Passage of Time and Luck Turns Aroundm, he circulated his archeological skills to explore the secret of this dream world.
After spending an unknown amount of time, Shi Yu finally understood.
“Wu.” Buggy looked at Shi Yu, not understanding.
Shi Yu closed his eyes slightly and opened them again. “This fossil should be from the 8th era, so it’s so difficult to enter a dream.”
“Although it’s very difficult to trace the traces of time back to the source, I still did it.”
“This guy’s experience is very valuable as a reference.” Shi Yu felt that many pets in the Beast Taming Space didn’t understand. He explained, “This guy should be a cosmic-level expert who wanted to become the holder of the universe but failed.”
“It wanted to replace the cosmic will or fuse with the cosmic will to become the maintainer of the universe, but it didn’t succeed. Or rather, it succeeded in a portion. It only let a portion of itself integrate into the cosmic will until this era. It was treated as trash by the cosmic will and excreted into a cosmic treasure.”
Little Ji: “?”
“Yi! (If you’re not human, you can also contract the universe?)”
“I don’t know. This is a continent-type life form. It turned into an earth-element life form on the continent. During its prosperous period, it should be like the World King Planet. Many races and experts survive on it until the universe is destroyed…”
“Although it might not be able to contract like a human, there’s probably a skill like Buggy’s Universe Devourer. It might be a cosmic fusion skill…” Shi Yu said, “Regardless of whether it’s a human or not, I understand that it can come to this era, but I really don’t understand how that God of Destruction from the first era came to this era.”
“So, it’s pretty lucky, right?” Ling said. “Although it’s not a human, its experience contracting the universe should be able to help you, Master, right?”
“Well, I’ll study it carefully. It should be able to help. Even if it can increase the success rate by 1%, it’s very rare.”
“Roar!! Roar!!” At this moment, in the Beast Taming Space, Little Ji also cried out excitedly. That’s right, that’s right. Big Sister Ling was the Lady Luck.
Not only was this helpful to Shi Yu, but when Shi Yu didn’t need it anymore, he could also give it Little Ji!
When it heard that the source of the fossil was the embodiment of the will of a continent, Little Ji climaxed.
In the universe, creating a continent had always been Little Ji’s dream. Although the main body of this fossil was a continental life form, it was at least familiar with it. It should be able to load it, right??
Apart from the fact that Shi Yu regarded it as cosmic excrement, Little Ji was very unhappy. Everything else was pretty good.
“You really hit the jackpot.” Shi Yu was speechless. Little Ji was a fool.
After he finished researching, he could really throw it to Ling and Little Ji to try and see if Little Ji could obtain some pretty good skills from this cosmic continent life form.

chapters.title: Chapter 1943: Endless Breakthrough (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1943: Endless Breakthrough (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
As the consumption of the era fossil that crossed three eras in the dream wasn’t small, Shi Yu and the others quickly exited the dream. They had already reached the cosmic level, but Shi Yu still hadn’t escaped the situation of being weak every day.
As expected, physical strength was too important to a Beast Tamer. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have the time to pamper them one by one even if they had the opportunity.
“Hu,” Shi Yu said. “Buggy, familiarize yourself with the realm first. If you think you’re familiar with it, you can also help Ling and the others study that Jade Rabbit fossil.”
“Perhaps Ling’s cosmic path is on this Jade Rabbit fossil.”
“Yes, yes.” Buggy expressed that there was no problem.
“It shouldn’t be a big problem for Eleven to successfully break through to the cosmic level. I hope Ling can also succeed. Only Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong aren’t too confident.”
At this moment, Shi Yu sensed Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong’s anxious mood and fell into deep thought.
The pets of the clueless team didn’t have much desire for the cosmic level. After all, they understood that the first team hadn’t reached the full cosmic level, so their chances were definitely not high.
However, Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong, who were in the first team, had at least gotten first place in the team. Now, they weren’t at the cosmic level yet, so they were naturally very anxious.
“Compared to the races of Eleven, Buggy, and Susu, your races indeed don’t have any shortcuts… Especially Baby Ginseng, which can only slowly strengthen the nourishing power…”
“Hasn’t the cosmic tree grown better and better recently? Perhaps when the cosmic tree completely recovers, you can reach the cosmic level,” Shi Yu said.
As he broke through to the cosmic level, the Universe Tree nurtured with him gradually recovered its original appearance. The ginseng baby that carried it also obtained many benefits, but it was still not enough.
“Chi Tong, don’t worry. I wonder what the situation is with this cosmic God of Destruction. No matter who defeats the cosmic God of Destruction in this battle, I’ll leave the cosmic God of Destruction to you to completely kill.”
Shi Yu said, “Perhaps the earliest Spirit Release skill is your path to cosmic advancement? If you kill a cosmic-level soul and turn it into growth nutrients, you might be able to break through to the cosmic level.”
“The original universe didn’t have a suitable hunting target for you, but this God of Destruction came at the right time.”
“Mi!!” Chi Tong was very happy, but it felt that the Spirit Release was most likely not the key to her advancement to the cosmic level. It could feel it itself, but regardless, it had to slowly try and find it.
Next, Shi Yu began to recuperate and adjust his state.
The cultivation of stripping talent had come to an end here. For the time being, other pets didn’t need to rely on this method to advance to the cosmic level.
During this period of time, Eleven tried its best to digest a few talent metals. As for Ling and the others, with the support of the Creation Dream Butterfly, Buggy, their research on the Jade Rabbit fossil deepened.
However, fusing a cosmic-level fossil wasn’t a simple matter. It was impossible to fuse it just like before. The current Ling had yet to master this technology.
Be it the more detailed experiments or the final attempt, she estimated that she needed Shi Yu’s help. She needed Shi Yu to temporarily strengthen it to the cosmic level. This way, mechanical phantom beasts like them would have the qualifications to be on par with or above the cosmic level fossil.
“Sir Shi Yu.”
A few days later, although Shi Yu hid very well, someone else came looking for him. Shi Yu didn’t miss the person who came this time, mainly because the other party had sent the Jade Rabbit fossil the last time. Perhaps they had sent something good this time.
“It’s Goddess Wa.” Shi Yu, who was meditating on the snow mountain, immediately smiled when he saw the humanoid snake-tailed goddess appear in the sky. “What brings you here?”
“Actually, the cosmic overlord has awakened. It wants to see you.”
“Then let it see me,” Shi Yu said.
Ahem, Shi Yu felt that he had indeed become arrogant.
Goddess Wa smiled bitterly and said, “In order to recuperate, the cosmic overlord sealed itself in the core of Overlord Planet. There’s a backup plan left behind by it to heal its injuries, so it can’t move now. Even its clone can’t do it.”
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu said, “That injury is pretty serious.”
According to Buggy, at least the God of Destruction could still move.
This was the only time a cosmic battle had reached such a tragic level. No wonder the other four cosmic thrones had died.
This was the only time a cosmic battle had reached such a tragic level. No wonder the other four cosmic thrones had died.
“Alright, then I’ll go with you,” Shi Yu said. “But Goddess Wa, Shiyu has already broken through to the cosmic level. Why are you still at the peak of the super divine level?”
Goddess Wa was speechless. “After all, I didn’t personally create Shiyu.”
“All the best,” Shi Yu encouraged. He realized that Goddess Wa from both spaces was quite pitiful.
Sometimes, the rain in this space and time didn’t include him. In his space and time, even if he didn’t have Shiyu, he was just a little lacking. He was clueless and lacked one.
…
Under the invitation of the cosmic overlord, Shi Yu arrived at Overlord Planet and arrived at an environmental space that was like the lava area of an underground volcano.
This was the first time Shi Yu had seen the full appearance of a cosmic overlord with his own eyes. He didn’t know what race the other party was. It had purple skin, explosive muscles, and curved two horns. It was very similar to the symbol on the battleship of the cosmic overlord army. In short, with Shi Yu’s current gaze, it was very ordinary.
Perhaps he was strong enough and no longer had that unreachable filter, or perhaps the current state of the cosmic overlord was very poor, and it no longer had the domineering aura of dominating the universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1944: Endless Breakthrough (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1944: Endless Breakthrough (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“Hu…” At this moment, the cosmic overlord was in a cylindrical technological healing cabin. This healing cabin was in magma. Shi Yu didn’t feel any destructive power from this magma. Instead, it looked like nutritional fluid.
The other party should be… absorbing the nutrition of the overlord star. This quasi-cosmic-level star gave Shi Yu a feeling that just from its recovery ability, it was already close to the World King Planet. It should have some cosmic treasure that wasn’t inferior to the Universe Tree.
“We finally meet, another transmigrator from a parallel space.” As Shi Yu arrived, the cosmic overlord in the nutritional cabin opened its eyes in the green healing liquid and stared at Shi Yu. Shi Yu could hear what he said outside.
“Cosmic overlord, Cypos,” Shi Yu said. “What’s the matter?”
Cypos said, “I want to ask you a favor.”
“What help?” He had already obtained the Jade Rabbit fossil from the other party. If it was a small favor, such as destroying the God of Destruction, Shi Yu would definitely help. It was convenient.
“I want to ask you not to kill that cat.”
Shi Yu narrowed his eyes. He knew who the cat the other party was talking about was. It should be referring to the God of Destruction.
However, according to his understanding, that cosmic God of Destruction, to be precise, should be a leopard.
It was a black-skinned and gray-spotted leopard-shaped orc. However, it was also a feline.
Sigh, as a feline, when could Teacher Cat be so fierce?
“You’re too reckless,” Shi Yu said. “You don’t want me to kill it. You want to end it personally after you recover?”
“Are you sure you can control this battle? This parallel universe might be destroyed because of you.”
“Hmph.” The cosmic overlord, Cypos, snorted and said, “This guy’s abilities are just strange. If we didn’t know its abilities at the start, we wouldn’t have been forced to do this.”
“I already know its situation. If we fight again, it will definitely lose.”
“That’s only losing, not killing,” Shi Yu said. “Sorry, I can’t agree to this request. I’ll kill that guy.”
It was mainly because Chi Tong was still waiting to use the God of Destruction as nutrients, so it naturally couldn’t not kill it.
Boom!
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the pressure of a cosmic overlord emitted from the nutritional cabin. Shi Yu felt a strong threat, but he wasn’t to be outdone. He had an indifferent expression.
Who were they scaring? They thought he was a cosmic newcomer.
“Alright.” Seeing that Shi Yu didn’t agree to its request, the cosmic overlord didn’t force it anymore. It said, “In that case, let’s talk about other things.”
“You probably want to become the holder of the universe, right?”
“Yes.” There was nothing to hide about this.
“Hmph,” Cypos said. “I originally thought that it would be that girl who finally tried to become the holder of the universe. I didn’t expect her to actually have a father, and his strength is so terrifying.”
“The other ‘me’ in the space and time you came from should also know your ambition, right?” Cypos asked.
“That’s right,” Shi Yu said with a nod.
“There will definitely be a battle between the two of you.” Cypos knew itself very well. It was impossible for it in another space and time to be indifferent to Shi Yu wanting to become the holder of the universe.
However, it was a pity that due to special reasons, the cosmic level of this space-time couldn’t resonate with itself in other parallel spaces. It couldn’t understand the situation of that space-time at all.
“Since you insist on killing the God of Destruction, in the end, can you replace the God of Destruction and fight me?” The cosmic overlord, Cypos, revealed killing intent and said, “Not with me in a parallel space, but with me!”
“You mean that I want to fight you twice.” Shi Yu looked helpless and said, “It’s so troublesome. Forget it, I’ll agree to it. It’s easier than the previous request.”
“Interesting, this universe is finally not so boring.” The cosmic overlord sighed and said, “The cosmic level is divided into two major realms. I, who was in the second realm, had no opponents a long time ago.”
“The appearance of the cosmic God of Destruction is considered a small pleasure.”
“Your appearance makes me even more excited.” In the eyes of the cosmic overlord, Shi Yu was considered part of Universe One. In the eyes of the cosmic overlord, Shi Yu’s cleansing star spirit and the Creation Dream Butterfly were also Universe One. Among them, the Creation Dream Butterfly might be considered relatively strong in Universe One.
However, if Shi Yu strengthened them, be it the cleansing star spirit or the Creation Dream Butterfly, they should be considered the second clueless in the universe. These were all opponents worth fighting. Cypos looked forward to it very much.
“Old Bull, look, I’ve already agreed to your request. Is there any equipment in your overlord treasure vault that can increase the strength of the enhancement? Give me two. It’ll be bad if I can’t defeat the cosmic God of Destruction. Although it’s as you wish, and it doesn’t have to die, it won’t be good if it comes here to cause trouble while you haven’t recovered.”
“It’s still up to me. Not only do I abide by the agreement, but I’m also determined to maintain the peace of the universe. My character is also high.” Shi Yu stretched out his hand.
Cypos gritted his teeth and said, “Kid, you’re also a greedy person. You have the demeanor of me when I was young.”
…
In the end, Shi Yu called Shiyu over. He had a father and a daughter. They plundered the overlord’s treasure vault. Shi Yu advised earnestly, “Good daughter, this is all I can do for you. In the future, don’t look for me for no reason. It’s not good to suddenly have another daughter. I haven’t found a partner.”
“Take these cosmic treasures and cultivate well. In the future, if you encounter danger, try your best to solve it yourself…”
“Shut up!”
Shiyu was furious. He despised her for being a burden so quickly. As a cosmic throne, shouldn’t he reflect on himself first if he couldn’t find a girlfriend?
Moreover, having a cosmic-level daughter for no reason was a bonus for finding a partner.
“Do you need me to set up a blind date?”
“This is a good thing. I’ll take it.” Shi Yu ignored her. After choosing for a long time, he finally chose a good thing. This thing was an era treasure of the 9th era.
Shi Yu directly threw it into the Beast Taming Space and threw it to Ling. “For you to play with.”
“Yay~” Ling was very happy. It was good stuff, this mechanical era treasure. With this, her scientific research ability could still increase. As expected of the treasure vault of a cosmic overlord. There were many good things. No wonder the technological level of the cosmic overlord army was number one in the universe.
Of course, it, Ling, was first!
In the end, Shi Yu, who had only taken two or three items, returned to Blue Planet, leaving the sulking Shiyu behind.
This time, Shi Yu didn’t stay long either. Something happened to Eleven.
“Coming, coming. As expected of Eleven, it digested it faster than Buggy.” Sensing Eleven’s movements in the Beast Taming Space, Shi Yu’s eyes lit up.
“Roar!!!”
In the Beast Taming Space, on Eleven’s star, Eleven roared like a behemoth. Its body was steaming, as if it had finally refined all the metal.
He sensed that it should be Eleven’s wonton divine body that assisted Eleven in quickly transforming and digesting the Taiji metal and the Four Holy Metals.
If the previous wonton divine body was only incomplete and only at initial success…
Then now, it could be said to have reached great success, or even perfection.
“Release to your heart’s content.”
Shi Yu flew out of Blue Planet again. He was even a little further from Blue Planet this time to avoid disturbing ordinary people.
He directly let Eleven out of the Beast Taming Space. At this moment, Buggy and the others felt that it was too fast. As expected of the Leader. As the only existence who had accepted Shi Yu’s six Beast Taming Talents, Buggy and the others also wanted to see how far the leader could reach.
The Eight Trigrams, Four Symbols, and Taiji all returned to chaos.
A huge chaotic aura swept through the starry sky, making Blue Planet tremble from top to bottom and the overlord territory tremble. It also woke up the sleeping cosmic overlord again. Of course, there was also the God of Destruction who only wanted to recover quickly.
This time, the cosmic God of Destruction, who was still recuperating, completely exploded.
“Who? Are you done? Why is there another one!!!” It had spent so much effort to eliminate the cosmic throne of this era. How long had it been before it broke through and returned?

chapters.title: Chapter 1945: Chaos Divine Demon (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1945: Chaos Divine Demon (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
When there was turmoil in the universe, Blue Planet and the cosmic overlord knew that it was most likely Shi Yu’s doing again.
Apart from him, a cosmic-level Beast Tamer, no one else could nurture cosmic-level pets so frequently.
First, it was the cleansing star spirit, then the powerful butterfly. This time…
The breakthrough fluctuations this time were even greater than the original two, making the cosmic overlord unable to help but be shocked. He admired Shi Yu’s ability to cause trouble.
“Roar!!!”
Shi Yu and the others leaped to the Cosmic Sea.
Eleven floated in the starry sky, surrounded by stars, its body constantly strengthening.
The power of plants in the universe crazily reversed and surged over from all directions in the universe, integrating into Eleven’s hair.
The lake and sea of the martial world also surged crazily, turning into the concept source that flowed over and fused into Eleven’s blood.
The mountains of the various planets also contributed their strength and fused into Eleven’s body to strengthen its physique.
At this moment, the entire universe turned into light.
Even the power of the stars from the Worm Mother Nest, the Contaminated Land, the overlord territory, and the Behemoth Empire gathered in Eleven’s limbs, making it even larger during this process.
Eleven’s body was enlarging crazily. This concept of “large” was simply extraordinary. Slowly, there seemed to be no creature larger than it in the world.
Even on the World King Planet, Beastmasters were like bugs compared to its current body.
It was as if Eleven’s hair was enough to crush a star.
Even Shi Yu and the others were a little shocked by this scene. Although they knew that the commotion of Eleven’s breakthrough would be very big, they didn’t expect it to be so big.
Its current size was about to destroy countless star areas with a finger.
“Wu…” In the Beast Taming Space, Buggy came out. When it saw Eleven’s situation, it knew that something was wrong. It didn’t expect those talent metals to be so compatible with Eleven.
However, the corners of Buggy’s mouth curled up. This was more interesting. Only when Eleven was stronger than it would it have a greater sense of accomplishment after conquering the leader.
“No way, it can even affect this side.”
On Blue Planet’s side, everyone could roughly determine that Shi Yu was currently very far from Blue Planet.
However, at this moment, even Blue Planet’s Will couldn’t control it. In Blue Planet, the power of lightning and wind and clouds flowed crazily towards the Cosmic Sea.
Seeing the natural changes in Blue Planet that were like the end of the world, the experts on Blue Planet were stunned and spoke in disbelief.
This situation wasn’t limited to Blue Planet, Overlord Planet, Origin Planet… On various planets, the power of natural laws flowed towards the Cosmic Sea and crossed countless spaces at an extremely fast speed.
Apart from that, there was also the power of the sun and moon that turned into divine light and fused into Eleven’s left and right eyes, making it look like a super demon god had been born.
“Roar!!!” In the center of the universe, Eleven, who had caused all of this, roared. Lightning fused into the voice, and wind and clouds fused into the aura. Its life level was still rising, and it had already broken through the shackles of the universe.
The aura of a cosmic throne on its body was undoubtedly revealed, but what shocked the cosmic overlord and the cosmic destructive god who were secretly observing was that this was only the beginning.
“The chaos is divided into Pangu first, then the Taiji elements and the Four Symbols.” At the same side, Shi Yu, who was observing, suddenly thought of this sentence. In the myths and legends, Pangu was the first living being and emerged from a cosmic egg that contained a chaotic mixture of yin and yang. As he grew, he separated yin and yang, creating the earth and the sky. Pangu brought order to the universe and created the Taiji two elements, and the two elements gave birth to the Four Symbols. The Four Symbols changed and were complicated. Everything in the universe was formed by Pangu.
It was born from chaos and was the most primitive God of Creation.
Although Shi Yu didn’t know if it really existed at the start of the last era, at this moment, Eleven seemed to be completing this process in reverse.
The power of all things fused into its body, then right on the heels of that…
At this moment, the shadows of history that crossed space and time could be sensed out of thin air in all directions of the universe.
The shadows of the four incomparably terrifying cosmic holy beasts were born after absorbing the power of faith of all the four saints in this universe. They also displayed shocking divine might, as if they made the thousands of creatures in the universe feel the revival of the cosmic emperor of the last era.
“Roar…”
These four shadows of the Four Saints were even more terrifying than the aura of the ten thousand Green Dragons dancing together in Buggy’s dream back then. Green Wood, Fire, Sharp Metal, Water, and endless power also formed a miracle like the power of the universe, turning into divine light and integrating into Eleven’s body.
At this moment, Eleven’s aura had already reached the peak of the “Universe One” mentioned by the cosmic overlord.
Moreover, it was in a state that hadn’t been strengthened by Shi Yu.
“Impossible.” If this was the only end, the cosmic overlords and the others could still accept and understand. However, in the next moment, they realized that the breakthrough was still continuing.
From the deepest part of the universe’s space and time, countless clear and turbid auras that contained the power of time and space slowly gathered towards Eleven in the most primitive and original form.
Be it the cosmic overlord or the cosmic destructive god, they felt that once the spatial and cosmic Yin Yang Qi fused into Eleven’s body, it would definitely break through the shackles of the Universe One in one go and reach the second cluelessness of the universe.
Sepos only felt that it was ridiculous. Even it was only a quasi-cosmic clueless when it broke through from a super divine to the cosmic level. It only broke through to become a cosmic overlord after cultivating for countless years.
But now, there seemed to be a life form that wanted to cross Universe One and attack Universe Two from the peak of the super divine level in one go.
At this moment, even the gaze of the cosmic God of Destruction turned cold. It felt a deep threat from this creature that had just broken through.

chapters.title: Chapter 1946: Chaos Divine Demon (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1946: Chaos Divine Demon (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“Damn it, are you done? Die.”
It stopped recuperating, and endless black light shot out of its eyes. It crossed space and time and turned into a flying saber that slashed at Eleven’s origin, trying to stop it from breaking through.
However, just as the black light flying saber traversed the Cosmic Sea, it was blocked by a red-haired and red-eyed figure.
Boom!!!
“I can’t stay anymore?”
Shi Yu stood in the starry sky with a longsword in hand. He stared in a certain direction with a cold gaze. Under his obstruction, the flying saber was directly divided into two!!
The terrifying aftermath instantly affected countless stars. Shi Yu looked in a direction and said, “Don’t worry, I’ll look for you personally soon.”
Originally, Shi Yu had to destroy the God of Destruction. Now that the God of Destruction had interfered with Eleven’s breakthrough, he had another reason to kill the God of Destruction.
When he left the Overlord Planet, Shi Yu asked Cypos for its battle memories with the God of Destruction. At this moment, in Shi Yu’s opinion, the God of Destruction’s sneak attack wasn’t technical. He easily resisted it.
Just as Cypos had said, if it fought another battle with the God of Destruction, it would definitely not be so miserable.
“Damn it.”
In the spatial crack, seeing that the sneak attack was ineffective, the God of Destruction’s expression was cold as he realized that big trouble was about to be born.
“Have you confirmed the location?” Shi Yu said. With a cry, a green light escaped through space and time and successfully arrived in the space and time crack.
Boom!!
Buggy looked at the black leopard person in front of it, and the black leopard person also looked at it coldly.
“As expected, you can already lock onto my location.”
Ever since the last time, it vaguely felt that this butterfly had obtained the ability to lock onto its location. Now, it could be completely confirmed.
“Your opponent is me.” At this moment, Buggy had also obtained some strengthening from Shi Yu. It stared at the God of Destruction intently, and the two parties were immediately in a confrontation stage.
“Hmph.” The black-robed God of Destruction wasn’t in the mood to fight Buggy. It only wanted to stop that panda from breaking through now.
In its opinion, only that bear race was qualified to threaten it after breaking through and being strengthened by the Beast Tamer, so it had to be eliminated.
However, Buggy didn’t give it this chance at all, or rather, it wanted to stall it and create time for Eleven to break through.
Buzz!!!
Buggy directly modified its surroundings into a dream universe and activated its domain.
The God of Destruction was very familiar with this dream universe. Previously, when Buggy broke through, it was captured by this dream universe and easily broke free.
But this time, the God of Destruction tried to break free from the dream and didn’t succeed. It looked at the scene of the surrounding desolate continent and its expression turned cold. It realized that the destructive divine power in its hand actually couldn’t destroy this universe.
“If you want to destroy the 8th era’s dream universe strengthened by the cosmic treasure, you need to have deeper attainments in the power of space and time.” Buggy’s expression was calm.
Compared to the previous dream universe, this dream universe wasn’t that easy to destroy.
“Little trick.” The black-robed God of Destruction was calm and composed. It closed his hands and pulled them apart, forming an even more terrifying purple-black ball.
In the next moment.
Boom!!!
A terrifying destructive divine power erupted, and a crack was instantly torn in this dream universe. Buggy didn’t expect that the other party could still use a move of this level despite saying that it was heavily injured.
However, Buggy wasn’t anxious either. It followed the God of Destruction who left through the crack.
“Huh?” The God of Destruction had just broken free from the 8th era universe, but looking at the universe filled with mechanical stars in front of him, its scalp immediately felt troubled.
“Welcome to the 9th era universe.” Mechas and battleships floated in the starry sky behind Buggy, locking onto the God of Destruction.
Who told him that the dream universe only had one level?
Buggy had built a total of it. It involved the dream universe of the 8th, 9th, 10th, and 11th eras, layer by layer. Unless it broke through all of them at the same time, it could escape the restraints of the dream.
“Die!!” This time, the God of Destruction didn’t destroy the universe itself. Instead, it teleported behind Buggy and completely swallowed Buggy’s body with a destructive bomb.
Even Buggy’s body and this universe turned into nothingness.
However, what awaited the God of Destruction wasn’t to return to the real universe, but to a blue planet.
“It’s useless. In the dream universe, I’m immortal.” Buggy still appeared.
“Then I’ll destroy all the dreams before destroying you,” the God of Destruction said coldly.
“Feel free to try.”
Then, in the Dream Universe, Buggy and the God of Destruction started a huge battle. The two parties only fought for an instant before the birth and destruction of a universe.
Shi Yu and the others had learned from the cosmic overlord that the ability of the cosmic god of destruction was mainly that unbelievable destructive divine power.
That wasn’t destroying laws or the source, but something above it. This kind of destructive divine power had the characteristic of being “indefensible” and “destructing everything”. Nothing could be immune to it, nothing could stop it.
It could even directly destroy the concept and the origin. For example, when it destroyed the Dark King, it directly destroyed the connection between the Dark King and the pollution concept. When it destroyed the Beastmaster, it directly destroyed the connection between the Beastmaster and the planet and used the destructive divine power to destroy the other party’s universe origin, making it impossible for it to revive.
Even the cosmic overlords didn’t know the origin of this ridiculous power. They could only treat it as a unique power of the first era.
The cosmic overlord even had a vague feeling that this destructive divine power was related to the universe itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1947: Chaos Divine Demon (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1947: Chaos Divine Demon (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Although the other skills about the God of Destruction were also very unbelievable, they were still within the range of everyone’s understanding.
Boom!!
It was the birth and destruction of another dream universe. Buggy kept retreating. It didn’t expect the God of Destruction to be so fierce. Even the Empress and Susu believed that they couldn’t instantly destroy the first dream universe it created, but the God of Destruction could destroy it with a stretch of its hand. It was really disgusting.
“What other abilities do you have? Next time, I’ll destroy them all.” After constantly destroying the dream universe created by Buggy, the God of Destruction came behind Buggy again and aimed its palm at it.
“I’m not playing with you anymore. I’ll let you out.” However, this time, Buggy spoke, as if it planned to give up the battle.
In the next moment.
The dream universe shattered, but the God of Destruction, who had finally come out, didn’t feel any joy. Instead, its expression turned cold.
Buggy naturally wouldn’t let the other party out out of goodwill. Letting the other party out meant that there was no need for it to stall for time.
At this moment, all the yin and yang energies contributed by the universe had already fused into Eleven’s body, making Eleven, who was as huge as countless star areas, seem to be shrinking in a chaotic egg like a chicken.
The terrifying aura coming from inside made the God of Destruction’s expression turn cold.
“Chaos Divine Demon, I understand. In the countless parallel spaces of the 11th era, you should be the strongest in this era, right?”
In the next moment.
Boom!!
The chaos was opened, and the huge Eleven had already disappeared. Only a normal panda more than a meter tall was left. Its entire body erupted with fluctuations made of black and white flames. Its expression was calm. Although it stood there quietly, the terrifying aura completely restrained on its body made the cosmic god and cosmic overlord’s hearts tremble.
“Universe Two.”
“It has reached Universe Two. It just broke through and reached this realm. And the most terrifying thing is…” The cosmic overlord stared at the owner of this panda, Shi Yu.
The moment Eleven broke through, there was also a chaotic divine aura lingering around Shi Yu. It wasn’t that Eleven broke through alone, but that Shi Yu and Eleven complemented each other. It was hard to say if Shi Yu’s breakthrough into Universe Two led Eleven to break through to Universe Two, or if Eleven’s breakthrough Universe Two led Shi Yu to break through to Universe Two.
No matter what, an extremely unscientific scene had appeared. Two overlord-level figures of the universe were born in this universe at the same time, and their battle power belonged to the violent combination that could be multiplied.
“F*ck…” The God of Destruction cracked again, feeling that it was even worse.
“Hu.” In the universe, Shi Yu clenched his fists and felt endless power surging out of his body. He felt that the price of stripping his talent was nothing. After all, the breakthrough of his pet could also give him stronger stats.
“Eleven!!” Eleven also kept roaring in the world. As Shi Yu gave the order, it looked in a certain direction with warpath in its eyes and locked onto the cosmic God of Destruction that Buggy had just released.
“Damn it.”
Seeing Eleven’s situation, the God of Destruction was shocked. It felt that the aura on Eleven’s body was extremely dangerous. Shi Yu had added all the power of Universe Two’s realm to Eleven, causing Eleven’s battle power to reach an extreme.
“Eleven, cripple it!”
Boom.
Just as Shi Yu gave the order, Eleven crossed space and time and descended beside the God of Destruction like an ancient god. Its breakthrough evolution, be it its appearance or skills, didn’t change much.
If one had to say, the Chaos Divine Body was perfect, making Eleven’s physique reach a terrifying level. This physique seemed to really be like the Creation God Pangu, with extreme power. Eleven only punched the God of Destruction close to him, and the other party’s expression changed drastically.
Boom!!
The fist that swept up destructive divine power and Eleven’s fist that swept up chaotic divine power collided. In an instant, the God of Destruction felt its arm fall apart. The terrifying impact instantly devoured it. The powerful fist wind directly turned into a disaster countless times more terrifying than the Starry Sky Storm and blasted deeper into the universe with the God of Destruction.
“Hiss.” Buggy, who had just appeared, was shocked by Eleven’s power when it saw this scene. However, when it recalled that Eleven and Shi Yu had superimposed, it was relieved. But even so, it was still very terrifying. It felt that the power displayed by Eleven now wasn’t much inferior to the other party’s destructive divine power.
“Who are you?”
At this moment, the violent universe boom let the experts know that a certain freak had collided with the God of Destruction. At that moment, Shi Yu chased after the God of Destruction and came to the place where its body stopped. He looked at the broken God of Destruction and said, “Tell me your identity.”
“You…” The God of Destruction was still lively after being sent flying countless star domains. It stared at Shi Yu intently. This sentence was clearly what it wanted to say.
It only wanted to know where this human in front of it came from. Not only did he have so many terrifying pets, but he also seemed to have the intention to kill it from the start.
“Do you think victory is in your grasp just like that?” Although it had seen Eleven and Shi Yu’s powerful strength, the God of Destruction was still very calm.
“What else?” Shi Yu didn’t spoil this guy either.
Apart from Eleven and Buggy, who had just arrived beside him, Shi Yu stretched out his arm in the next moment. The Infinite Summoning Array behind him activated, and the cosmic Sea of Stars Sprite Susu appeared with a bang.
Then, accompanied by a terrifying mental wave that was close to Universe Two, the figure of the Super Empress appeared indifferently in the universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1948: Chaos Divine Demon (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1948: Chaos Divine Demon (4)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“What?”
At this moment, the God of Destruction’s expression turned cold. It didn’t expect Shi Yu to summon another cosmic level.
Moreover, on the Super Empress, it also felt that the other party wasn’t as simple as the peak of ordinary Universe Onw. It seemed that just the cultivation system of an era had reached the peak of Universe One. Coupled with the power system of another era, its battle power was close to Universe Two.
This wasn’t the end. Baby Ginseng, Ling, Little Ji, Duckie, Little Zi, Shorty, Qi… Shi Yu summoned his pets one after another.
“Yi!!” “Roar!!” All of them looked evil as they stared at the God of Destruction.
Then, the most ridiculous scene appeared. Shi Yu’s gaze turned cold as he used his strength on every pet. In the next moment, the aura of this group of pets attacked Universe 1.
“How about this?” Shi Yu shouted.
After reaching Universe Two, Shi Yu obtained a new ability, which was to strengthen multiple pets to the cosmic level at the same time. The price was naturally the accelerated consumption of physical strength. If it was said that previously, he had only strengthened one pet to the cosmic level, and it wasn’t a problem for him to fight for 100,000 years, then now, there might only be a few hours of battle time.
But even so, it was enough. More than ten cosmic-level auras covered the universe together. Without a doubt, it alarmed all races and shocked all experts.
“Human Beast Tamers are really the favorites of the world. They can actually do this.” The cosmic overlord was stunned. It knew that cosmic Beast Tamers were very strong and could strengthen any pet to the cosmic level.
However, he didn’t expect that a Beast Tamer with the second clueless in the universe could actually strengthen multiple pets to the cosmic level at the same time.
“Abnormal.” On Blue Planet, a cat sensed the dozen or so terrifying pressure in the starry sky and said, “Is this something a human can do? More than ten cosmic levels? In the last era, there were only 16 cosmic levels in total. Now, he did it alone. Is this scientific?”
“Damn, I really want to be a pet of a cosmic Beast Tamer. I also want to experience the cosmic level,” the gem cat said enviously.
“Teacher Ying, forget it. I feel that when you reach the peak of the super divine level, even a cosmic level might not necessarily be able to strengthen you to the cosmic level. For the sake of the heroic reputation of a cosmic-level Beast Tamer, you should be more free,” Shiyu said.
The gem cat: “?”
At that moment, the entire universe stared at the Cosmic Sea where more than ten cosmic auras erupted. Their hearts trembled and their hearts raced.
They kept feeling that the universe was about to be destroyed in the next moment.
“I almost forgot. This realm can already do this kind of thing.” The cosmic Destruction God regretted it in its heart, very much.
Looking at Shi Yu’s smug and annoying face, it wanted to punch its previous self. Why did it have to recuperate in peace?
This human was simply not following the routine. Cosmic-level pets came one after another, and he even gave himself feedback to break through. Could he be more shameless?
It understood that a fierce battle was inevitable. Moreover, it was very likely that it would die in this guy’s hands.
“Damn it, if I were at my peak now… If I have the ability, I’ll do it one by one!” The God of Destruction said angrily. He regretted asking.
“You wish,” Shi Yu said. “However, I’ll satisfy you.”
Shi Yu was just trying out his new ability. Just as he finished speaking, Eleven rushed forward alone and hit the God of Destruction’s abdomen with the Chaos Divine Fist.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
There were a total of three voices. The first voice was that a huge hole was penetrated in the God of Destruction’s abdomen. The second voice was that it spat out countless divine blood. The third voice was that its pupils directly turned white and lost their luster.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven roared and pulled the other party’s body forward, looking like a monster.
Seeing this scene, Shorty and the others swallowed their saliva. They felt that the leader was a little too fierce now. If it weren’t for the fact that he had let them break through time and time again, the God of Destruction wouldn’t be in such a miserable state. At this moment, they begged for the trauma of the God of Destruction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1949: Space Conference (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1949: Space Conference (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Boom!!
Boom!!
Boom!!
In the dream world, Eleven was still pulling the head of the God of Destruction, using its body to smash star after star and constantly pressing it to the planet to rub.
If the God of Destruction didn’t want to be beaten up, Shi Yu would satisfy it. Even if it was Eleven, it was more than enough to heavily injure the God of Destruction who had yet to recover.
“Ugh.” In the dream universe, no matter how strong the black panther’s God of Destruction was, it couldn’t withstand Eleven, who was using the reverse Pangu evolution method.
However, the closer it was to a desperate situation, the crazier this guy became. He counterattacked even more crazily, even if it was only one-sided.
“I… I’m the God of Destruction!!!”
It roared angrily. To Shi Yu and the others’ surprise, blood tears even flowed out of the corners of the God of Destruction’s eyes.
It seemed to be venting its dissatisfaction and anger.
“No matter what your reasons are.”
Shi Yu and the others looked at the black panther’s God of Destruction with burning gazes. That made sense. No matter who it was, how could they have an anti-cosmic personality?
The God of Destruction probably had its own reasons.
But no matter what the reason was, since it threatened the safety of him and his companions, they could only completely eliminate the other party.
“Roar!!!” The God of Destruction attacked again. Shi Yu held the spiritual sword in his hand, and the dream universe began the second round of violent turmoil!
…
The starlight dimmed, and a drop of liquid condensed in the nebula. The universe seemed to be whimpering. Ever since Shi Yu and the God of Destruction started the battle, the scene of the universe seemed to have become much more desolate.
…
After an unknown period of time.
The dream universe shattered. Shi Yu and the others were in the real universe again. When they saw Shi Yu come out, Shiyu, who had been lingering here, immediately teleported over in surprise.
She saw that Shi Yu and the pets beside him were basically not injured. Moreover, there was no sign of the God of Destruction. Shiyu said happily, “Dad, where’s the God of Destruction? Could it be…”
“He’s dead.” Shi Yu looked at the longsword in his hand and said, “I killed him.”
“Great, you’re too strong!!!” Shiyu looked over in surprise. She simply worshiped her father from this parallel universe too much. Although her wish was to surpass Shi Yu, Shi Yu had helped this universe solve such a huge disaster. She still hugged Shi Yu happily.
“Hey, hey, hey.” Shi Yu pushed his cosmic-level daughter away and smiled bitterly. “Don’t be happy too early. Although the other party is dead, the trouble hasn’t been resolved.”
“Huh?? Don’t tell me it can still be revived,” Shiyu said in confusion.
“No…” Shi Yu’s heart was extremely heavy. He was indeed prepared for it to revive infinitely, but…
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and recalled his final confrontation with the God of Destruction.
Swoosh!!!
The body of the God of Destruction was divided into two by the spiritual sword in Shi Yu’s hand. At this moment, even its soul was quickly shattered by Chi Tong and obliterated into soul nutrients.
Boom!
The body of the God of Destruction exploded, but before it died, its face was filled with mockery.
“I’ll die, but this universe will also be destroyed.”
After that, Chi Tong began to Spirit Release the other party’s soul and extract the other party’s memories…
Shi Yu looked at his daughter and said, “Do you know the true identity of the God of Destruction?”
“What?? Isn’t he a cosmic-level expert from the first era?”
“Not only that.” Shi Yu smiled bitterly. He didn’t expect this God of Destruction to be so troublesome.
“Actually, the universe isn’t as simple as the 11th era,” Shi Yu said.
“It’s the pet of the previous holder of the universe.”
According to the soul memory scene transmitted by Chi Tong, Shi Yu saw a small black panther snuggling beside a majestic body.
Shiyu: “?”
“In a certain era, a human successfully contracted the universe and became the holder of the universe, the will of the universe.”
“However, just because you become the holder of the universe doesn’t mean that you can really be eternal. As the true cosmic will that has been suppressed, you won’t be willing to be contracted by others forever. Even if the contract succeeds, the holder of the universe still has to constantly guard against the backlash of the universe.”
“The previous holder of the universe broke free of the contract and died by the universe countless years after becoming the holder of the universe. That’s already a story from before the first era.”
“And the powerful power on the God of Destruction was also given to it by its master. Now you know why the power on its body is so special, right? It can cross so many eras probably because of the maintenance master.”
“What??”
Shiyu was shocked. No wonder the God of Destruction hated the will of the universe so much and hoped to destroy the universe.
So it was to avenge its master.
“Then what do you mean the matter isn’t over?”
Shi Yu sighed slightly and said, “Although the other party died, its ‘resentment’ turned into a curse and fused into the universe.”
“It used its own death as the price to curse something and let its life flow away with it.”
“I’m fine.” Seeing Shiyu’s worried expression, Shi Yu said, “Its cursed target is this universe.”
“Oh!” Shiyu had been shocked for a long time. When she heard Shi Yu’s words, she cried again and sensed the state of the universe.
“If nothing goes wrong, your parallel universe won’t be able to live for long. Moreover, even if the universe wants to restart, it probably won’t go smoothly. We need to guard against the resentment of the dead God of Destruction. I didn’t expect it to do this this this time.” Shi Yu was silent. From the start, the cosmic God of Destruction didn’t want to live. It wanted to perish with the universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1950: Space Conference (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1950: Space Conference (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Now, his interference was only bringing this process forward.
“No, it’s alright.” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, Shiyu took a deep breath and said, “Dad, don’t worry. Leave the rest to me. The universe should have a little lifespan left now, right? I’ll try to become the holder of the universe in a while. As long as I succeed, the universe won’t die, right?”
“Don’t worry, I won’t let your universe be affected too.”
“You? You?” Shi Yu shrugged and said, “Girl, it’s not that I look down on you, but with your strength, it’ll take another ten billion years to contract the universe.”
“Don’t worry, although it’s not my fault in essence, I’ll clean up someone’s mess for this parallel universe.”
“In any case, I’m prepared to contract the universe sooner or later and become the holder of the universe. This God of Destruction only brought my plan forward a little.”
“Actually, I’m quite grateful to it. At least it let me know that I can’t always be comfortable after contracting the universe… Its master should be someone stronger than me. No wonder it’s so unconvinced.”
“Mi!!” Chi Tong didn’t like to hear that. Who said that Shi Yu was the most powerful?
“In short, I didn’t expect the identity of the God of Destruction to be so special.” Shi Yu took a deep breath.
Shi Yu prepared to return and spend some time getting ready before attempting to form a contract with the universe. According to the memories of the God of Destruction, its master successfully contracted with the universe when they reached the Universe 2 realm.
Since the other party’s master could succeed, there was no reason why Shi Yu couldn’t succeed.
“But…”
“There’s no but.” Shi Yu held his forehead and said, “It’s so annoying. I originally thought I could play for billions of years before contracting the universe.”
“Sob.” Eleven and the others also looked at Shi Yu eagerly.
Regarding this unknown risk, they naturally felt that the later the better.
“Ling, are you done checking?”
“Well, this parallel universe still has about 63 million years of lifespan, and it’s still accelerating.”
“At this speed, we might be close to the edge of restart in less than 500,000 years and touch the restart mechanism. There’s not much time left for us.”
“Alright, the crisis in your universe has almost been resolved on the surface. After resting, I’m preparing to leave.” Shi Yu stretched out his hand and touched Shi Yu’s head. “I won’t bid farewell to the others. It’s good that you know these things.”
“Hey…” Shiyu still wanted to say something, but in her daze, she realized that Shi Yu and the others had directly disappeared in front of her. Looking at the empty starry sky, Shiyu felt an empty feeling in her heart. Seriously, why were they in such a hurry to go back?
…
Shi Yu and the others were indeed anxious. After all, hundreds of thousands of years was neither short nor long. Moreover, there might be accidents midway, so they had to take it even more seriously. In order to prevent other parallel universes from being affected, he indeed had to prepare to become the holder of the universe as soon as possible. He originally thought that it would be very easy to destroy the God of Destruction, but he didn’t expect that the other party would still trick him before it died.
“It’s not easy to become the holder of the universe.”
Shi Yu felt that the God of Destruction and the previous holder of the universe were quite innocent. This was because the universe with the holder of the universe could be almost eternal. Therefore, more and more races and lives would be born in the universe, causing the resources of the universe to be insufficient.
The God of Destruction was given broken divine power by the holder of the universe in this situation. Through destroying planets and lives, it maintained the balance of the universe. However, it was because of this action that the holder of the universe became the enemy of all races. After all, no one wanted anyone to casually eliminate them.
Apart from the resistance of the cosmic will itself, a large part of the reason why the last holder of the universe was overthrown was because the various cosmic levels resisted together. This was also why the God of Destruction not only hated the universe, but also the life forms of the universe.
When he returned to the original space and time, Shi Yu sighed slightly and said to his pet beside him, “Say, if we became the holder of the universe, would we have ended up like this?”
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven said what Shi Yu was saying. It would be the first to not forgive whoever dared to attack Shi Yu.
“Wu!!” Buggy expressed that the cosmic will was still too dangerous. It could actually resist after being contracted. As expected, it should completely devour the cosmic will and replace the other party, right? If it were it, it definitely wouldn’t resist Shi Yu!
“Mi! (I’ll destroy the universe!)”
“Hey, hey, hey, calm down.” Shi Yu said to Chi Tong, “Shouldn’t you be conflicted now? Why haven’t you broken through to the cosmic level after killing the soul of the God of Destruction?”
Chi Tong: QAQ!!
Chi Tong expressed that it was also very helpless. The other party’s soul was clearly very nourishing, but it still felt a little lacking.
“Is this fate?” At this moment, Shi Yu and the others had already arrived at the original space and time. In the Milky Way, the Empress stood in the starry sky and pondered slightly. “In the end, you still have to become the holder of the universe as soon as possible. Although your current conditions are already very suitable, but…”
“Don’t worry, don’t worry,” Shi Yu said. “It’s only a matter of time. The earlier it’s done, the easier it will be. Otherwise, more accidents like the God of Destruction will happen.”
Shi Yu said, “In addition, if I want to become the holder of the universe, I have to discuss it with the four cosmic levels of this universe first. Without their agreement, I can’t ‘dare’ to contract the universe randomly, in case they cause trouble and end up following in the footsteps of the last holder of the universe.”
“I remember that the cosmic overlord, Cypos, still wants to be your examiner, right? To become the examiner of the cosmic holder,” the Empress said.
“I think so.” Shi Yu nodded. If he wanted to become the holder of the universe, he had to pass Cypos first.
He looked at Eleven with a strange expression.
“Huh?” Eleven was eager.
He felt that Eleven could already farm a cosmic overlord alone now. Although the cosmic overlord was strong and was the only one from Universe Two, Eleven, who combined the power of the last era and this era, cultivated the Chaos Divine Body inversely and became a Pangu God, hence becoming incredibly strong.
“Cough, in short, let’s not waste time. Let’s discuss it with them first.” Although Shi Yu felt that there was nothing to discuss, after all, after a trip to a parallel universe… there were already more than ten cosmic levels on his side… A cosmic level vote would also crush the other veteran cosmic emperors.
At the same time.
World King, Beastmaster, Worm Queen, cosmic overlord… The four cosmic levels were stunned when they heard a telepathy at the same time.
[Everyone, I’m Shi Yu. I want to hold a “cosmic meeting” to discuss the future direction of the universe. I wonder if you could attend the meeting.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1951: Persecuting the Cow Again (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1951: Persecuting the Cow Again (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s voice, the few cosmic levels were quite puzzled.
Why wasn’t this kid cultivating obediently in his galaxy? Why was he doing a cosmic meeting?
However, they still had to give face to the new cosmic level expert.
“Interesting, let’s see what you’ve done again,” Cypos muttered to itself.
“There’s definitely nothing good.” The Beastmaster was helpless, but it knew that Shi Yu wasn’t to be trifled with and didn’t dare to not keep the appointment.
“I can take a look at its recent situation.” The Worm Queen thought about Buggy.
“The future direction of the universe, could it be…” The originally sleeping World King had also recovered a little essence energy with Shi Yu’s help for more than ten years.
In an instant, the will projections of the four cosmic-levels descended into the Milky Way.
For cosmic-levels, they could go anywhere in the universe. Their use of space and time could already easily cross half the universe.
In order to not cause a commotion, when the will projection descended into the Milky Way, the World King, the Worm Queen, and the Beastmaster were very polite and didn’t reveal their aura.
However, for the unscrupulous and unrestrained Cypos, it didn’t care about anything at all. It didn’t deliberately hide its aura. This was its personality, so the moment it descended, the Milky Way immediately trembled.
“This is… the aura of the cosmic overlord, Cypos!!!” On Blue Planet’s Will, Goddess Wa, Master Floating Light, and the others were immediately stunned. They didn’t understand why Cypos had descended into the Milky Way at this time.
Soon, the four cosmic will projections arrived in front of Shi Yu.
However, when they saw Shi Yu, they were slightly stunned. They felt that Shi Yu should have improved again.
At least in terms of hiding aura, it was already impeccable. Even they couldn’t tell Shi Yu’s depth at this moment. They felt that Shi Yu was like an ordinary person.
“Tell me, what do you mean by discussing the future direction of the universe?” Cypos said.
Its thick arms were wrapped around its chest, and it had the posture of a big boss. Its face was like that of an ox-headed demon, and it was fierce. It had a much stronger aura than the heavily injured Cypos in the parallel universe.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “This is what happened.”
“I’ve already decided to become the holder of the universe, and I might contract the universe soon.”
Buzz!
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the expressions of the Beastmaster, the Worm Queen, and the others turned cold.
Although they expected that with Shi Yu’s terrifying talent potential, he would sooner or later set his eyes on the holder of the universe.
However, Shi Yu was too fast. His current age was simply pitifully small in the eyes of them, who had lived for billions of years.
“Huh?” Even the cosmic overlord didn’t expect Shi Yu to be in such a hurry.
“This is what happened.” At this moment, a stone chair appeared behind Shi Yu. He slowly sat down and crossed his legs. “I didn’t want to be in such a hurry either.”
“After all, even if I have this ambition, isn’t it better to prepare more?”
“But the situation has already exceeded expectations.”
“During this period of time, I was guided to a parallel universe completely isolated from our space and time.”
“A monster appeared in that universe. It killed the World King, the Dark King, the Beastmaster, and the Worm Queen. Even the cosmic overlord… is half dead.”
“It can be said that he fought the 11th era’s cosmic-level beings alone.”
“Impossible!!!” When Shi Yu finished speaking, the Beastmaster was the first to retort.
The other cosmic levels, including the cosmic overlord, also had doubtful expressions. It was really too unbelievable.
“Because that parallel universe is blocked from our space and time. You can’t sense it here, so it’s normal that you don’t believe me. However, that monster indeed has the strength.”
“It came from before the 1st era. It was the pet of the previous holder of the universe.”
“With the destructive divine power bestowed by a universe master, even a cosmic life form can easily destroy it,” Shi Yu said. “The other party revived in that parallel universe. Its goal is to destroy this universe.”
“As for why it wants to destroy the universe, the reason is very complicated. I can’t be bothered to talk about it.”
“The current situation is that fortunately, I’m invincible and successfully killed it. However, it has already riddled that parallel universe with holes. I’m afraid it won’t be long before that universe dies and restarts. Moreover, this process will be accompanied by unknown risks.”
“At that time, that parallel universe will be finished. The other parallel universes will also have a chain reaction. Either they will be heavily or lightly affected, and there’s a high chance that they will also be finished.”
“If we want to avoid this situation, we can only find a person to become the holder of the universe and extend the life of the universe and eliminate the unknown hidden dangers in the universe.”
The few cosmic-level beings present felt that Shi Yu’s words were getting more and more ridiculous.
Even the pet of the previous holder of the universe came out?
Was he telling a story?
“Little brat, are you confused by the Dark King’s virus entering your body?” Cypos was almost speechless.
How could Shi Yu, this brat, destroy a guy who not only fought five cosmic-levels alone, but even destroyed four and heavily injured one?
Cypos admitted that Shi Yu wasn’t weak, but his strength wasn’t enough to achieve such a feat.
“I know this is very difficult to accept, but that’s the situation in that parallel universe.” Shi Yu shrugged and said, “I could destroy the other party because I had a new breakthrough.”
With that said, Shi Yu released his aura. The power of Universe Two was undoubtedly displayed. He was like a primeval ferocious beast, a humanoid version of a cosmic overlord!!
The pupils of the few cosmic-level beings who originally had doubts about Shi Yu immediately constricted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1952: Persecuting the Cow Again (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1952: Persecuting the Cow Again (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“This… is impossible…” At this moment, the Beastmaster felt that it was dreaming. Didn’t Shi Yu just break through to the cosmic level a few years ago? Why did he reach Universe 2 so quickly?
“Really?” The Worm Queen and the others also felt that it was extremely exaggerated.
It was true…
Indeed, it was the power of Universe 2. They could all feel a clear pressure.
“What a joke…” At the same time, the cosmic overlord, Cypos, had been calm for so many years. It finally revealed a shocked expression again and felt that it was extremely ridiculous.
What was Shi Yu doing?
Even if he ate a cosmic treasure as a meal, he couldn’t break through so quickly, right?
“Do you believe me now?” Shi Yu said, “You’ve never seen a Universe 2 Beast Tamer, right!”
At this moment, Shi Yu’s aura wasn’t fake at all. The World King and the other cosmic emperors were directly numb from watching. Others treated them like strangers after three days, but Shi Yu completely didn’t treat them like humans after three days. Was this a job that a normal person could do?
This was the new breakthrough Shi Yu mentioned?
The Worm Queen was about to cry from envy. It had given birth to so many children for Universe 2, but it didn’t succeed in the end. What was wrong with Shi Yu?
