“Interesting… Interesting… No wonder you’re confident of contracting the universe.”
Bang, bang, bang.
At this moment, the cosmic overlord, Cypos, stared at Shi Yu intently. It never expected Shi Yu to improve so quickly.
It said, “I still underestimated your growth speed. Your goal in holding the cosmic meeting is to make it clear in advance that other cosmic levels shouldn’t disturb you from contracting the universe and not attack the Milky Way when you contract the universe, right?”
“You can say that,” Shi Yu said.
“Little brat, regardless of whether what you say is true or false, if you want to contract the universe, you have to pass my level first. As long as you defeat me, I’ll acknowledge that you have the aptitude to become the holder of the universe. When you contract the universe, I’ll protect the Milky Way for you. Whoever becomes your enemy is my enemy.”
“As long as you can defeat me, I don’t want this title of cosmic overlord anymore. I’ll let you have it.”
Although Cypos was very shocked, Shi Yu’s growth was so fast. It was exactly what Cypos wanted.
It looked at Shi Yu with burning eyes.
“Sure!” Shi Yu also knew that it was impossible to convince all the cosmic levels just by posturing. He still had to fight. And with the personality of a cosmic overlord, it definitely wanted to test his strength the most.
He had known this long ago.
It could be said that the other party was an examiner for whether he could become the holder of the universe.
At this moment, when they heard that the Milky Way Overlord, Shi Yu, and the cosmic overlord, Cypos, were going to fight, the other cosmic levels immediately fell silent.
“Then the rules are up to you to decide,” Shi Yu said to Cypos.
The cosmic overlord said, “I once had a premonition dream.”
It pointed at Shi Yu and said, “In the future, I’ll fight a certain pet of yours. No one will interfere. However, I don’t want to fight a battle where the opponent holds back.”
“You, use whatever abilities you have. All of you, attack together.”
“I want to fight to my heart’s content!”
“Call out all your pets, including that rabbit. I want to fight them together!”
“Huh?” After the cosmic overlord finished speaking, Shi Yu was stunned.
Was this alright? This wasn’t good.
“Is there a problem?” Cypos said. “Or do you think I’m not your match?”
Shi Yu was silent. He didn’t understand why this bull race was so arrogant.
Should he tell the cosmic overlord about the enhancement effect of the Universe 2 pets he had now?
“Forget it, let’s do it directly. We have to win this battle”, Shi Yu thought to his pets. Shi Yu didn’t mind choosing the rule with a high chance of winning. In any case, the rule was requested by the other party.
“Sure.” In the end, Shi Yu nodded.
“There’s no time to lose!!” Upon hearing that there was a battle to fight and the opponent was a very strong guy, the cosmic overlord’s blood boiled and he was finally interested.
Its will clone disappeared. At the same time, in the overlord territory, the true body of the cosmic overlord, Cypos, rose from the overlord throne.
Boom!
The battle intent of the cosmic overlord penetrated the overlord territory, making the four generals, the overlord secretary, and the other peak super divine experts extremely shocked, not understanding what had happened.
“Lord Overlord!” The secretary of the cosmic overlord was slightly stunned when it saw the cosmic overlord leave the Overlord Planet directly. It hesitated for a moment and chose to follow.
However, its speed was too slow. At this moment, Cypos’s true body had long descended outside the Little Zi Star.
Little Zi Star approached Blue Planet. As the overlord’s might condensed even more, the experts inside Blue Planet finally couldn’t help but come out of the star to watch.
With a look, be it Goddess Wa or anyone else, they fell into deep thought.
This was because in the starry sky, Shi Yu and the cosmic overlord were in a confrontation. Moreover, beside them, the will projections of the World King, the Beastmaster, and the Worm Queen seemed to be watching.
This unbelievable scene was enough to shock the starry sky.
What was going on…
“Actually, I still suggest not attacking together,” Shi Yu said. “I have a little too many cosmic pets.”
In the end, for the sake of the heroic reputation of the cosmic overlord, Shi Yu still couldn’t help but persuade Cypos. Of course, the premise of persuading was that he knew that the cosmic overlord would definitely refuse. It was commonly known as politeness.
“Cut the crap.” Since it had already said it, Cypos naturally couldn’t take it back. It wanted to see what power a clueless Beast Tamer could display with a cosmic pet.
It had been invincible for too long. Compared to an evenly matched battle, Cypos wanted to see a higher peak more, hoping that Shi Yu could satisfy it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1953: Persecuting the Cow Again (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1953: Persecuting the Cow Again (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“Then let’s do it.” Shi Yu licked his lips. He originally wanted to say that they should change places to avoid the aftermath.
However, looking at Cypos’s arrogant appearance, Shi Yu felt that there was no need.
In another parallel universe, Cypos had given him the battle memories of himself and the God of Destruction. Apart from letting Shi Yu know the strength of the God of Destruction, he also knew Cypos’ strength.
Even if it was a little different, it shouldn’t be much different. Shi Yu felt that he didn’t even know how to lose with his eyes closed. Everyone was very arrogant.
“In that case, come on!!!” Shi Yu also let go.
Cypos looked at Shi Yu calmly as he summoned his pet.
The summoning array was activated!
“Empress, Susu, Buggy, Eleven.” Shi Yu summoned consecutively.
Before summoning, the cosmic overlord was still very calm. However, in the blink of an eye, it frowned.
In the next moment, a scene that made the few cosmic-levels feel extremely ridiculous appeared.
Accompanied by the four star maps, four figures appeared. The luxurious Super Empress stared at the few cosmic-level acquaintances indifferently, her cosmic-level might undoubtedly displayed.
The terrifying cleansing origin wave of the Sea of Stars Sprite, Susu, was no longer as simple as just cleansing filth. It was completely opposite to the Dark King, but it was higher than the other party. Its aura far exceeded the former Dark Throne.
The green Creation Dream Butterfly appeared, and the aura of the cosmic emperor directly made the pupils of the Worm Queen shrink, revealing an incredulous expression. Facing Buggy, it actually felt that its bloodline level was only 50-50 with the other party after absorbing countless outstanding race bloodlines. The enhancement effect of Shi Yu’s bug-type Strengthening Crystal far exceeded various rare bloodlines.
The most terrifying was Eleven, who was surrounded by a chaotic aura. It floated out of the summoning array and wasn’t inferior to the shocking divine power of the cosmic overlord, Cypos, making the few cosmic levels extremely shocked.
“There’s more.”
Baby Ginseng, Ling, Chi Tong… Shi Yu summoned his pets one after another.
Then, the most ridiculous scene appeared. Shi Yu’s gaze turned cold as he used his strength on every pet. In the next moment, the aura of this group of pets rose towards the cosmic level.
Shi Yu had a total of 14 pets. Including Shi Yu, a total of 15 cosmic-level beasts directly appeared.
The terrifying cosmic aura made the entire universe tremble, making countless experts a little panicked, not knowing what had happened.
At this moment, the few cosmic-level spectators, as well as Blue Planet’s Will, Goddess Wa, and the others, were all stunned.
“This is impossible…” At this moment, the Beastmaster felt that it was dreaming. 15 cosmic level? When did cosmic levels become so cheap? The most ridiculous thing was that these 15 cosmic levels belonged to one body and were contracted?
Of course, the cosmic overlord, Cypos, was even more stunned.
The cosmic overlord: “?”
When I’m puzzled, it’s not that I have a problem, but that you have a problem!
Unlike the Black Panther God of Destruction, the cosmic overlord had never seen a Beast Tamer of Universe 2, so it naturally didn’t know that a Beast Tamer of Universe 2 could strengthen so many cosmic pets.
Moreover, even if he couldn’t strengthen so much, the four Shi Yu summoned at the start were still very problematic.
What the f*ck is wrong with that black and white panda of Universe 2? Why is it also Universe 2??
The cosmic overlord was stunned.
At this moment, it seemed to understand why it had fought this panda alone in the premonition dream.
It was very reasonable for a cosmic overlord to fight a Universe 2 one-on-one.
However, Cypos actually made Shi Yu release all his pets and fight simultaneously.
“…” Cypos was numb. Were human Beast Tamers so abnormal?
However, it still didn’t believe it. “Not bad…”
“Come, then!!”
“Let me see your strength!!”
So what if there were many? It was a cosmic overlord!!
The strongest in the universe, the cosmic overlord, Cypos!!
Boom!!
A huge battle was about to begin.
Cypos’s fist was filled with black and purple fluctuations. That was the Void Origin. It smashed at Eleven, wanting to test the strength of its old enemy in its dream.
At the same time, Shi Yu and the others actually still felt that a group battle wasn’t very honorable.
Therefore, for the sake of fairness, Shi Yu only let every pet pass their strength to Eleven. He still let Eleven “fight one-on-one”.
“Beast Taming Enhancement!”
Buzz!!
The substantialized mental wave shone. With Shi Yu’s mental resonance as the connection, first, Shi Yu used his Beast Taming Ability to strengthen Eleven. Then, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, the Empress, and the other pets transmitted their strength to Eleven.
In the next moment, the 14 cosmic-level powers were more or less distributed to Eleven. A terrifying black and white flames spread from Eleven’s body, and its demonic eyes looked at the attacking Cypos.
In the blink of an eye, Cypos, who had already smashed its fist on Eleven’s head, narrowed its eyes.
It felt like it was a little cow who had bumped into an iron fool.
In the next moment.
Eleven only turned its head back. Then, its right arm swung around and blasted out!
A serious punch!
Boom!
Eleven punched Cypos’s abdomen.
At this moment, space and time seemed to have stopped.
The cosmic emperors watching the battle and the experts from Blue Planet were stunned.
With a retch, a huge pit was penetrated in Cypos’s abdomen. It encountered the same outcome as another God of Destruction in another space, and its eyes were filled with disbelief.
The intense pain made it feel that its willpower was gradually disappearing.
This, this was impossible!!!
What kind of power was this…
How could a life form reach this realm?
The cosmic overlord couldn’t believe it and couldn’t accept it.
The peak battle it was pursuing actually had such an outcome??
Was it too arrogant?
It suddenly recalled what its mother had taught it when it was young.
If it worked hard, it would improve, but if it was arrogant, it would be beaten up.
Cypos felt that it should have listened to Shi Yu’s persuasion, mainly because it really didn’t know that the other party could take out more than ten cosmic levels.
“Mommy…”
The cosmic overlord first spat out purple blood crazily. Then, its eyes gradually dimmed and lost their color.
Eleven’s strength control was very good. With a terrifying punch, Cypos wasn’t sent flying. As Eleven retracted its fist, the heavily injured Cypos was already floating in the starry sky in a daze and lost the ability to fight.
Or rather, the battle will was completely obliterated by the destructive power derived from the Chaos Divine Fist.
“Sob.” Eleven sighed and bowed in embarrassment. You chose the rules this time. Let’s fight a serious one-on-one next time!
If there was a third step at the cosmic level, Eleven, who had been enhanced by the entire team, would definitely temporarily have that battle power.
As strong as a cosmic overlord, it could kill in one hit.
At this moment, the few cosmic emperors looked at the floating Cypos, their eyes only blank and stunned, their gazes exploding.
That cosmic overlord… was… was…
Goddess Wa and the others had originally wanted to see what was going on. How could they want to see such a shocking scene?
Shi Yu summoned more than ten cosmic pets at once. Eleven defeated the cosmic overlord Cypos with a punch. This scene could shock Goddess Wa and the Blue Planet’s Will for 100 million years.
“I’ll go.”
“It’s persecuting the cow again…” At this moment, the gem cat also came out. When it saw Eleven defeat a cosmic overlord with a punch, it felt that this scene was familiar.
Yes, the gem cat remembered that other long-horned creatures had been beaten up so miserably before.
However, that was a cosmic overlord!!! Even if it also had bull horns, Shi Yu, Eleven, and the others couldn’t beat it up like Master Qu Jie’s cow and Ancient God Golden Bull!! Did they have a grudge with cows?

chapters.title: Chapter 1954: New Cosmic Overlord (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1954: New Cosmic Overlord (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
The invincible cosmic overlord fell.
The other few cosmic levels had never experienced such an unscientific thing in their lives.
In fact, they gradually forgot Shi Yu’s goal in holding the meeting.
The holder of the universe…
The Beastmaster was actually unwilling for Shi Yu to become the holder of the universe. At that time, wouldn’t the life and death of any life form in the universe be decided by Shi Yu alone? Even it had to listen to Shi Yu.
But now… the Beastmaster felt that it didn’t seem to matter much if Shi Yu became the holder of the universe or not.
The bull cosmic overlord was a very good example. No matter how strong the Beastmaster was, could it be stronger than a cosmic overlord?
Although it might not be that easy for Shi Yu to completely kill the cosmic overlord, it would definitely be easy to heavily injure and seal Cypos.
The World King and the Worm Queen were even more speechless.
Regarding Shi Yu becoming the holder of the universe, the World King had an indifferent attitude. If the universe was really in danger and Shi Yu was willing to take this risk to save the world, it would have to thank Shi Yu.
As for the Worm Queen, it also cast away its other thoughts at this moment. It only hoped that Shi Yu and the others wouldn’t break the contract, and hoped that Buggy could still acknowledge it as its godmother…
…
“Lord, lord, overlord!!!”
It had to be said that the secretary of the cosmic overlord came pretty quickly. After all, she was the only person qualified to activate the cosmic overlord’s battleship that used cosmic treasures as energy.
After following the cosmic overlord to the Milky Way, Katney immediately sensed many cosmic auras. Then, when she arrived at the specific location, she saw her boss floating in the starry sky like a crippled cow.
She was immediately stunned, her gaze stunned.
“You even brought your secretary.” Shi Yu saw the secretary of the cosmic overlord arrive and said, “But leave the treatment to me.”
“Eleven.”
“Wuu.” Shi Yu gave the order. Eleven immediately nodded and directly turned the chaotic power hand into a wonton. Such supreme power could naturally give birth to a healing ability. Eleven’s palm aimed at the floating cosmic overlord and the wonton wave instantly blasted over.
In the next moment, the cosmic overlord coughed out another mouthful of blood. Its gaze gradually recovered its divine color. However, the cosmic overlord, who was gradually waking up, felt that it was still heavily injured.
It was a mental injury.
“I lost??” Cypos had yet to recover and react. It dragged its broken body and looked at World King and the others in confusion.
The World King and the others also looked at Cypos and thought to themselves that it had been beaten silly…
“Admit defeat.” Right beside Cypos, Shi Yu smiled and said, “How is it? My current strength is alright, right?”
The cosmic overlord glanced at its broken body, then at Shi Yu and Eleven in front of it. It opened its mouth wide.
“Impossible, definitely impossible.”
It was invincible, but it was actually insta-killed.
The cosmic overlord expressed that it couldn’t accept it.
“Ahhh!!!” It beat its body crazily, scaring Shi Yu, the World King, and the others. Then, the cosmic overlord’s eyes turned red and it panted. “It’s true, but how is this possible?”
It looked at Shi Yu and the others with red eyes. It had thought that it would lose one day in the future, but its loss was so without any suspense. For a moment, the cosmic overlord didn’t even know how to catch up to Shi Yu.
Thinking back, it had once wanted to nurture a powerful human, preferably stronger than it to satisfy its battle desire. However, now that this person had appeared out of nowhere, Cypos couldn’t see any hope of victory.
Cypos felt that it was impossible for it to defeat Shi Yu in a one-on-one battle.
“Wu wu wu! (One-on-one next time!)” But at this moment, Eleven waved at the cosmic overlord and said.
The cosmic overlord, Cypos, was silent for a long time. It finally understood why it was the one happily fighting this panda in the premonition dream.
With the addition of others, there was no suspense in the outcome. As expected, a battle between evenly matched opponents was more interesting and satisfying!
“I admit defeat. I’ll do everything I promised you,” the cosmic overlord Cypos said as it glanced at Shi Yu.
It was tired. It looked at its battleship and returned in loneliness, like a child who had lost its dream.
In the battleship.
When Katney saw her boss return, she wanted to ask something, but she didn’t dare to, afraid that she would anger the cosmic overlord whose current state was wrong.
“Katney.”
“My Lord, I’m here.”
“I’m going to sleep and calm down. It might be ten years, a hundred years, or ten thousand years.”
“If there’s anything, just wake me up.”
“In addition, in the name of the cosmic overlord army, help me announce to the entire universe that I lost to Shi Yu. From today onwards, I don’t want the title of cosmic overlord… Until I can snatch it back.”
Katney opened her mouth wide in shock.
…
After the cosmic overlord left, the cosmic meeting was almost over. The World King and the others expressed that they would listen to Shi Yu and bid farewell for the time being, not discussing anything other than the meeting.
“Things went very smoothly,” Shi Yu said in surprise as he stood in the starry sky.
The corners of the pets beside him twitched. How could it not go smoothly with more than ten cosmic-level pets crushing their faces? Why not try changing them to Teacher Cat?
At this moment, as the few cosmic levels left, Teacher Cat and the others came over.
“Meow, meow, meow…” Teacher Ying spat out three gem cat national essences and flew over, her voice revealing shock.
“Shi Yu, what’s going on? Was that Buggy’s projection just now? You’re making a movie to scare people, right?”
Buggy indeed had this ability. Indeed, compared to what had just happened, it was more credible if it was Buggy’s prank.

chapters.title: Chapter 1955: New Cosmic Overlord (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1955: New Cosmic Overlord (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
“Sorry, you have to believe your eyes,” Shi Yu said with a smile. As expected, Teacher Cat from this parallel universe was more intimate.
It was mainly because the cat girl looked more pleasing to the eye. The other one was already at the divine level but didn’t know Shapeshift. Boo!
“Shi Yu… This is…” Blue Planet’s Will, Goddess Wa, and the others also came over with shocked expressions, especially Goddess Wa. She, who had dealt with cosmic overlords many times, was the most stunned.
This was the premonition dream Cypos mentioned??
Was Cypos dreaming of getting beaten up?
No, the key was why Shi Yu had become so strong!!!
“Yes…” Shi Yu looked at them and said, “Because of something, I called all the cosmic levels over. I think it’s necessary to tell you these things.”
…
Blue Planet…
Inatella.
After finding a place to stay, Shi Yu also told these peak super divine masters on Blue Planet what he had said in the cosmic meeting.
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s description, Blue Planet’s Will and the others became extremely serious.
But at the same time, their shock was simply a drop in the bucket compared to the shock of the entire universe.
Because of their relationship with Shi Yu, Zi Jian’s special forces were like fish in water in the cosmic overlord army. After all, from a certain perspective, the Milky Way Overlord, Shi Yu, was also a member of the cosmic overlord army and had once joined Zi Jian’s special forces.
With a cosmic-level team, he could ask the other armies if they were afraid.
Captain Zi Jian was now incomparably comfortable. The Demolishing Divine Bull examiner in the team also preferred to talk about how he had tested Shi Yu…
But today, Zi Jian’s special forces exploded.
Because…
The cosmic overlord army announced the highest information.
The original cosmic overlord, Cypos, lost the battle of laws with the Milky Way Overlord, Shi Yu!
From then on, the cosmic overlord changed hands.
The cosmic overlord army changed its name to the Cypos Army. In the army, no one was allowed to use the name of the cosmic overlord randomly.
“F*ck!!!” Captain Zi Jian’s canine teeth almost collapsed as she looked at this notice in disbelief.
“Moo!!!” Beside her, the shocked voice of the Demolishing Divine Bull, Examiner Jermon, also came. Shi Yu had defeated a cosmic overlord??
Why was this guy leveling up like a cheat? Just sealing and assassinating wasn’t enough, and now, even the status of the cosmic overlord had been shaken?!
This situation happened everywhere in the universe. First, there was a huge commotion in the cosmic overlord army. Then, some organizations with top-notch intelligence abilities also knew about the changes in the cosmic overlord army.
On World King Planet, there were more people who were familiar with Shi Yu here. When this internal announcement of the Cypos Army reached World King Planet, shocked voices immediately came from this place. It wasn’t inferior to the sound wave-type natural disaster that happened on World King Planet.
Many super divines of the older generation had experienced countless years and seen many geniuses rise like comets, but they quickly disappeared. However, this was the first time they had seen someone like Shi Yu.
The strongest demigod, the strongest divine level, the strongest super divine… It even took less than 20 years to defeat a supreme master.
Being the son of the universe was no longer enough to describe Shi Yu’s legendary nature.
“It’s simply the biological father of the cosmic will!!” Many experts of the older generation stuttered. They didn’t expect that they could still live to see the major changes in the history of the universe.
…
Strangers were already shocked, but Shi Yu’s acquaintances, such as the emperors of Dong Huang, Divine Source, President Lin Xiao, and the Dragon God, were even more dizzy when they learned the news.
Of course, for the Blue Planet, the most important thing at this moment was actually still the maintenance.
Shi Yu didn’t want to tell too many people about his attempt to contract the universe, but he couldn’t surpass some people.
“I don’t know how long later, but there’s no need to be so worried. Contracting the universe is just a final plan. If we can solve the hidden dangers of the universe through other methods in advance during this period, there’s no need to contract the universe in such a hurry.”
After Shi Yu explained them one by one, they lay on Eleven to rest in a sage mode.
“Next, it’s time to study that continent fossil. Then, I’ll study the memories of the God of Destruction in detail. Of course, I have to observe and pay attention to the situation in the parallel universe at all times.”
“Leave it to me!”
Only Shi Yu’s exclusive secretary, Ling, could react so decisively and agree to Shi Yu’s mission.
Shi Yu smiled.
It could be said that creating Ling was the most correct thing for a lazy person like him to do.
In order to let Ling have a better cosmic monitoring ability, Shi Yu felt that it was time for the entire team to work hard to help Ling break through.
Shi Yu’s defeat of Cypos shocked the world. No one expected that the God Sealing King would become the strongest in the universe in a short period of time. However, even if it really happened, this indeed had nothing to do with most people.
Most ordinary people and even transcendent people were still active in their small circle. Not everyone had the ability to come into contact with the vastness of the universe. Compared to the change in the position of cosmic overlord, they might be more concerned about their own small matters. This was the truth.
However, Shi Yu had indeed left a deep mark in the 11th era. When people who didn’t know him heard Shi Yu’s legend, they felt that it was like a mythical legend, but some people who had come into contact with Shi Yu kept feeling extremely emotional.
Of course, Shi Yu becoming a cosmic overlord also brought about an obvious change. The universe was much more peaceful, and the Cypos Army had temporarily restrained themselves a lot. The mercenary business was no longer on the surface, so there was naturally no war between the Cosmic Sea and various parties.
Many experts knew that this change was definitely related to Shi Yu. Or perhaps Shi Yu didn’t explicitly ask for this, but the universe becoming like this was definitely affected by Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1956: New Cosmic Overlord (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1956: New Cosmic Overlord (3)
Editor: Atlas Studios
As for being the strongest in the 11th era, Shi Yu didn’t have much pursuit. His only pursuit might only be to let the universe last forever, allowing him and his pets to last forever. In addition, it was to create some fun, such as knowing the history of the other 10 eras, or knowing the history of the era where the previous holder of the universe was, to archeological something more interesting.
These things were things that even he, the cosmic overlord, didn’t know. Just like Cypos, if he couldn’t pursue some difficult things, Shi Yu would feel bored if he lived for too long.
Shi Yu focused on observing the changes in the universe and researching how to become the holder of the universe a few years later.
A terrifying spatial wave came from the Milky Way.
“A new cosmic level is born!”
Many experts of the 11th era sensed powerful spatial fluctuations. Even Cypos, who planned to sleep well, didn’t expect to be awakened so quickly.
However, when the various cosmic levels sensed the direction of the fluctuations, the corners of their mouths twitched and they ignored it.
“It’s just his pet.”
Shi Yu was already very invincible to begin with. Now that there was another natural cosmic level, no one took it seriously.
Ling had broken through to the cosmic level.
It might only be Shi Yu who could create a new cosmic level without causing too much of a stir.
In order to let Ling break through to the cosmic level, Shi Yu and the others assisted Ling in fusing with the Time Sprite fossil from the previous era.
However, in the end, Ling still couldn’t become the favorite of space and time and couldn’t learn space and time travel. Apart from learning time control, it didn’t have Shi Yu’s expectations.
Similar to Ling, Chi Tong and Baby Ginseng were also there.
During this period, the Universe Tree completely recovered. Baby Ginseng’s nourishing ability could be said to be close to the cosmic level. In terms of spatial attainments, it should have reached the standard. Unfortunately, it couldn’t achieve the position of the universe, and it wasn’t as smooth as Eleven, Buggy, and Susu.
As for Chi Tong, even if it released the soul of the God of Destruction, it was still stuck at the quasi cosmic level.
Ling was the same at the start. This made Shi Yu feel that it was troublesome. It also made Shi Yu understand that the luck on Susu, Eleven, and Buggy wasn’t that easy to replicate.
However, as expected of Ling. It had helped him find the “path to the universe”.
No, or rather, the cosmic level that helped his teammate find the path to the universe and allowed him to break through!
In recent years, Shi Yu and the others had really not found any other way to solve the hidden dangers of the universe. Therefore, contracting the universe seemed to be the only solution.
As for the contracted universe, it didn’t seem to be able to drag it out anymore. They observed that the lifespan of the parallel universe next door was accelerating.
Although there was still a long time left, don’t forget, contracting the universe would probably take a long time.
Just like how Shi Yu had spent several times more time contracting other pets when he contracted the Empress back then, this was even without the Empress resisting.
Therefore, if the time Shi Yu contracted the universe exceeded the remaining lifespan of the parallel universe next door, it would be troublesome.
Therefore, the earlier Shi Yu contracted the universe, the better.
At this moment, Shi Yu was at the second realm of the universe. With four cosmic pets on him, logically speaking, he had already reached the threshold of contracting the universe.
According to the black panther’s memories, the situation of the previous holder contracting the universe was even worse than his. This was already a success!
However, Ling was still worried about Shi Yu.
As Ling helped Shi Yu organize the method to contract the universe, it was thinking about how to let Chi Tong and Baby Ginseng reach the cosmic level as soon as possible. This way, Shi Yu could also be stronger.
In the end, Ling chose the divine skill “Future Prediction” to use the power of Shi Yu, the Empress, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and many others to try to predict the cosmic path of Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong.
Ling predicted countless results and discovered the possibility of Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong breaking through to the cosmic level in many ways. Ling knew that there was definitely a interference element.
However, Ling’s premonition still more or less provided Chi Tong and Baby Ginseng with a direction.
After careful consideration, Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong each chose their favorite breakthrough method.
Baby Ginseng continued to cultivate the “Heart of the Heavenly Emperor” and decided on “Dao Attainment”. It would change the fate of the supplement races in the world and attain the cosmic level.
Chi Tong chose “Protect the Dao” and decided that when Shi Yu contracted the universe, he would also stay beside Shi Yu and stay in the Beast Taming Space to accompany Shi Yu and share the affliction with Shi Yu.
To be honest, the two paths Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong chose weren’t the most compatible with their racial abilities. However, even Shi Yu didn’t expect that when Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong made a decision…
Ling sensed an opportunity to break through.
The entire team was very stunned, and so was Ling.
However, after Ling was stunned, it gradually became clear.
“I see. It’s not the mechanical phantom beast system or the mechanical intelligence level. So, my breakthrough opportunity is that.”
“In addition to the Dark King’s breakthrough experience, from the looks of it, breaking through to the cosmic level isn’t as fixed as Sister Empress concluded. There are still too few reference targets in this era.”
“Perhaps we can open up a new universe breakthrough path.”
When Shi Yu created Ling, he wrote a program.
Or rather, he wrote Ling’s dream.
Let Ling become the most powerful all-round machine and assist Beast Tamer Shi Yu and his companions in becoming stronger.
The current Ling hadn’t only witnessed with its own eyes that Beast Tamer Shi Yu and its companions were invincible in the universe, but it had also concluded a way to lead its teammates to the “strongest”. Its dream was already almost perfect and could be said to be a dream breakthrough.
“As expected, I have the life of a secretary. I actually relied on completing work to break through to the cosmic level.” Ling was a little helpless.
“However, this also means that Baby Ginseng’s “Dao Attainment” with its heart and Chi Tong’s “Protect the Dao” are really feasible?”
“Baby Ginseng is still alright…” Shi Yu said, “Chi Tong, are you serious?”
When he contracted the universe, Shi Yu didn’t plan to place his pets in the Beast Taming Space. At most, he would let them help him in the outside world. This way, even if he made any mistakes, his pets still had a chance of survival. What if the parallel universe next door was destroyed and this universe wasn’t affected much?
But if they were all in one body, once they failed, they would be completely wiped out. It would be difficult to find a way from the outside world.
The owner of the God of Destruction didn’t leave any pets when he contracted the universe.
Shi Yu thought for a moment and decided to be safer this way. He wouldn’t put all the eggs in one basket.
This was Shi Yu’s strong request. The pets couldn’t refute it, but the current Chi Tong seemed to be very stubborn.
“I’ve already decided,” Chi Tong said. “I want to stay in the Beast Taming Space. Ling has already predicted that my breakthrough opportunity is here. It wasn’t easy to find a breakthrough method!”
“Cut it out.” Shi Yu knew that Chi Tong didn’t want to break through, but purely wanted to stay by his side. After all, when he said that there were no pets in the Beast Taming Space, Chi Tong was the most dissatisfied.
Now, Ling’s premonition direction gave Chi Tong another excuse.
Protect the Dao… Was this for real…
“Sigh, let me think.” Shi Yu sighed and said, “I’ve been in seclusion for so long. I’ll go out and relax.”
“It’s been a long time since I bullied Teacher Cat. I’ll find some fun first before thinking about these troubles.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1957: Contracting the Universe (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1957: Contracting the Universe (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Shi Yu didn’t really want to be a suck up to the cat.
Instead, the closer he got to contracting the universe, the more uneasy Shi Yu felt.
Although he kept saying that he wanted the universe to be eternal and that he wanted to be eternal with his pets…
Shi Yu firmly believed that doing this kind of thing that could be said to be the most difficult thing in the universe would make him uneasy even if he prepared for another billion years.
Shi Yu knew that he was sometimes very arrogant. However, he was only arrogant when he had the confidence to win, or when even if he lost the bet, he wouldn’t lose much benefits. At most, he would damage his reputation… In any case, he was shameless, so it didn’t matter.
Moreover, the risk of contracting the universe clearly exceeded shamelessness.
It was true that he wanted to take a walk. Not only did he want to find Teacher Cat, but Shi Yu also wanted to look around for traces of walking before contracting the universe.
“Wuu.”
Shi Yu wanted to go and relax, so Eleven naturally accompanied him. Shi Yu touched Eleven’s head. Both parties had arrived at Ping Cheng, and the current Ping Cheng had long changed.
Its current economic level could already be said to be a first-level city. Of course, what surprised Shi Yu the most was the candidate for the president of the Beast Tamer Association in Ping Cheng.
Shi Yu and the others walked to the foot of the Beast Tamer Association building and looked up, transmigrating into space and time.
A gentle and elegant bespectacled young man was working hard. Beside his leg, a Quas-Armored Beast God was napping on the ground.
The most special thing in the room was a large photo frame hanging on the wall. In the photo frame was a photo of the battlefield. On both sides of the arena, two young people were in high spirits and sent out their pets.
Mid-level transcendent, Quas-Armored Beast!
Mid-level transcendent, Iron-eating Beast!
A photo seemed to have been cut from the surveillance video and was fixed at the moment the judge announced the start of the competition.
“His name should be Chen Kai,” Shi Yu said. “Our first opponent actually became the president of Ping Cheng, and his pet has become so powerful… He should have had some fortuitous encounter.”
“Sob, sob!” Eleven was also very surprised.
Well, they didn’t know what position the old President Feng, who had brought them to fleece the Evolution Holy Spring, had already risen to.
At this moment, even the owner of Bamboo Stone Dojo had changed.
As Shi Yu walked around, he realized that Senior Panda and her father should have gone to World King Planet to play ranking.
He smiled and shook his head. Although it was already at the cosmic level, this still couldn’t resist the footsteps of the panda army.
After all, the ranking battle of all races could be contested with small races. With Lin Xiuzhu’s personality, if she didn’t study the iron-eating beast’s evolution form and squeeze out all its potential, how could she let the matter rest?
Shi Yu had always felt that this father and daughter liked giant pandas more than him, a transmigrator who had transmigrated from Earth.
After walking around Ping Cheng, Shi Yu arrived at the Ancient Capital.
He realized that most of the people he knew had gone to the World King Planet. There weren’t many people left. It wasn’t that Blue Planet was much worse than the World King Planet now.
Instead, it was because the World King Planet was new!
Everyone had lived on Blue Planet for decades. Who didn’t want to go out and broaden their horizons?
Of course, Teacher Ying had been staying at Ancient Capital University recently. Perhaps she had gone out to play with Shi Yu enough and missed the place where she grew up.
Who would have thought that not only did this tiny university “cultivate” a few super divines, but it also had a cosmic overlord?
The current structure of Ancient Capital University was also familiar and unfamiliar to Shi Yu. For example, the president of the association had been changed to the Dragon Tamer, Yu Shu.
For example, the principal of Ancient Capital University had also been changed now. It was changed to Dean Hao of the Mechanical College that assisted Eleven in evolution and assisted Shi Yu in researching mechanical lives. He successfully took office. As for Principal Feng, he had retired a long time ago.
“Wu.” Buggy actually didn’t understand how Yu Shu became the president of the Ancient Capital Association.
Shi Yu was amused. “Because Yin Zhengfan and the others are doing better. They’ve all gone to World King Planet to play.”
Perhaps these competitors from the same batch as Shi Yu still had a certain amount of hope in the early stages, hoping to surpass Shi Yu.
But as time passed…
As Shi Yu became a cosmic supreme master, even those Blue Planet geniuses who had ascended to the World King Planet could only smile bitterly when they heard Shi Yu’s name again. Some people would brag about their relationship with Shi Yu, and some people would be embarrassed to say that they were once Shi Yu’s strong opponent.
“Principal Feng, you’re back from a trip to World King Planet?”
In the end, Shi Yu came to Principal Feng’s place to see him. The other party had taken good care of him and was Senior Lu’s elder. Shi Yu came with supplements.
“Shi, Shi Yu??” Principal Feng, who was sitting on the old man’s chair and listening to songs, suddenly swayed and said, “Holy shit, what brings you here?”
Shi Yu’s face darkened. “Why did you become more lively?”
“I’m free anyway, so I came back to take a look.”
“… Aren’t you going to contract the universe?” Principal Feng suddenly said.
“You even know this??” Shi Yu was stunned. He had never told Principal Feng.
“Qingyi mentioned it to me a little. She said that the risk is very high.” Principal Feng was silent and said, “From your eyes, I can tell that you seem to be going to do something important. Is the mental pressure greater?”
Shi Yu was speechless. “The older the wiser. Although I didn’t deliberately hide it, you can see through the thoughts of a cosmic supreme master at a glance. You can brag for 100 million years.”
“Idiot! I don’t understand very much. You didn’t continue cultivating after the recovery of spiritual energy. Is it really very dangerous?” Principal Feng said.
“It’s not that dangerous,” Shi Yu said. “Don’t worry. Wait, your gaze is a little strange.”
“Cough, cough, I was thinking that if it’s really quite dangerous, you’re not young anymore. You have to leave a descendant before passing.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Was Principal Feng cursing him?
“As expected, it’s you.” When Shi Yu arrived, although he had controlled his aura very well, he still couldn’t hide it from the gem cat that was very familiar with Shi Yu’s ordinary form.
The gem cat from Ancient Capital University teleported to Principal Feng’s side and looked at Shi Yu. “Not messing with your things anymore? You actually have time to run around.”
“Yeah, but I must say, this distance is just a thought for you.”
“You came at the right time.” Shi Yu scratched his head and said, “Teacher Ying, I plan to contract the universe in a while. I wonder how long it will take to succeed.”
“I came to ask you for a favor.”
“So anxious? What’s the matter?” The gem cat’s expression turned cold. Shi Yu was too anxious.
However, before doing such an important thing, Shi Yu had something to ask of it.
The gem cat wondered if Shi Yu was entrusting someone to it.
“Can you be more hardworking? I made a bet with the Empress. I said that before I successfully contracted the universe, you would definitely be able to reach the cosmic level. The Empress said that with that cat, there’s no chance. Can you let me win, although I know that the chances are minimal.”
The gem cat: “?”
“Level up!!”
“…”
The gem cat exploded in anger.
At the side, Principal Feng also sighed. How disrespectful. Teacher Ying was his teacher after all!!!
…
Shi Yu began to stroll in Ping Cheng, the Ancient Capital, Dong Huang, and even the entire Blue Planet.
Shi Yu only glanced at most of the familiar faces from afar. For some familiar faces, Shi Yu would carry gifts and run to have a drink with them.
The Blue Planet’s Will clearly discovered Shi Yu’s abnormal actions. When Shi Yu was free, it appeared and said,
“Are you already prepared to do it?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “Although if I wait a little longer, I might be able to nurture a few cosmic pets and become stronger, if I delay too much time, the situation might be even more uncontrollable.”
“The success rate now is already not small. Let’s give it a try.”
“I wish you luck,” Blue Planet’s Will said.
Under the final blessing of Blue Planet’s Will, Shi Yu smiled and left Blue Planet. He headed to World King Planet to see someone he knew. Of course, there were also some people who stayed in the Milky Way to develop the Milky Way. It wouldn’t take too much time for Shi Yu to visit them together.
Senior Lu, Senior Panda, and even the beast-eared girl who was catching up…
Dong Huang’s generations of “Legends”, Tyrannical Sea “Legends”, Hua “Legends”, and other modern experts of Dong Huang…
Some people still only took a look at Shi Yu. Some people went to chat personally, but as long as they chatted personally, they could guess what Shi Yu was going to do.
…
A month later.
Although he was in a hurry to contract it, Shi Yu thought about it carefully. In fact, he still had many things to do. He dawdled and finished what he had yet to do, giving himself more time to bid farewell to his acquaintances and eat a few more meals together.
After all, according to the memories of the God of Destruction, its master had spent a total of 330,000 years contracting the universe.
Was it a long time? Not really.
But for Shi Yu, was it long? Yes, it was.
Although Shi Yu hoped to complete the contract faster, this kind of thing was hard to say.
Perhaps for him, the contract time of tens of thousands of years was only an instant, but for his acquaintances and pets, it was a long wait.
In fact, it was alright if it was someone he knew. What Shi Yu was most worried about was these pets during the time he contracted the universe.
When he contracted the Empress, it had only been a few days, but these guys already felt aggrieved.
“This time, it’s also a training for you.”
“When necessary, I need your help, but most of the time, you need to survive independently in the universe.”
“I won’t give you any quests. In short, what’s most important is that you’re happy.”
“No,” Ling said. “There are missions. Even during the contract period, if a new pet breaks through to the cosmic level, you can still receive feedback.”
“So your next mission is to work hard to break through to the cosmic level, do you hear me?” Ling said to the pets.
“Roar!!!” Little Ji, Duckie, and the others expressed that there was no problem.
“Wu.” Shi Yu shrugged and looked at Eleven and the others. “According to the original plan, I’ll go and connect with the universe alone.”
“What?!” In the crowd, Chi Tong suddenly raised its voice.
“Alright, I’ll bring you, Chi Tong,” Shi Yu said. “Don’t worry now.”
“That’s more like it.” Chi Tong turned into a sword spirit form, clearly looking forward to it for a long time.
The pets were definitely worried about Shi Yu. Although every pet wanted to follow Shi Yu, they also knew that it basically wouldn’t work. Perhaps now, only Chi Tong had this treatment.
However, it was the same if they could also assist Shi Yu by providing him feedback.
“Empress, take good care of them,” Shi Yu said to the Super Empress. Clearly, he had already planned to set off to contract the universe.
“I understand.” The Empress was still relatively calm.
“Then, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Susu, Ling…”
“Little Ji, Duckie, Little Zi, Qi, Shorty, Little Quas, Turtle, Bu Lu.”
“Next, I’ll leave the Milky Way to you to protect.”
Shi Yu bid farewell to his pets one by one.
“Wuu!!” Eleven and the others also bid farewell to Shi Yu. They each had different feelings. For example, although Eleven couldn’t bear to leave, it was still strengthening its heart, indicating that it was no longer a child. It just had to wait patiently for Shi Yu to return.
The first step of contracting the universe…
Transfer the complete body and heart to the Beast Taming Space.
Make the Beast Taming Space resonate with the space and time of the universe.
This step required extremely high talent and strength.
Right on the heels of that, after succeeding, work hard to fuse the Beast Taming Space with the universe space and time and try to fuse the contract!
Once successful, the Beast Taming Space and the universe space and time would fuse, and the main body of the will would become a new universe master.
If it failed, the Beast Taming Space would be destroyed, along with the Beast Tamer and the Beast Taming Space.
This process didn’t have to be tough. It was easy to trigger the stress reaction of the universe. Gentle fusion was also a choice. Therefore, what Eleven and the others had to do was the contract process of Shi Yu. Through the contract connection with Shi Yu, they could constantly provide nourishing power to Shi Yu, allowing him to last for so long.
Compared to having everyone stay in the Beast Taming Space, it was obviously more beneficial and sustainable for most of them to remain in the outside world, collecting resources and providing feedback to Shi Yu over the long term.

chapters.title: Chapter 1958: Changing History
chapters.content:
Chapter 1958: Changing History
Editor: Atlas Studios
Milky Way!
Outside the Little Zi Star!
On the day Shi Yu decided to contract the universe, no one bid farewell, apart from his pets.
However, under the gaze of the pets, he took a deep breath and closed his eyes.
“Body, heart, will…”
Apart from Chi Tong, who had already entered the Beast Taming Space, the other pets were watching outside.
At this moment, spatial ripples spread on Shi Yu’s body and his figure slowly disappeared. The pets knew that Shi Yu was the first step to transform everything into the will of the Beast Taming Space.
After becoming the final cosmic will, it would first become the cosmic will of the small universe of its Beast Taming Space.
Only in this way could he have the qualifications to contract with the great universe.
Rather than saying it was a contract, it was more like it was the counter to the superior!
Occupy it and replace it!
“Wuu!!” As Shi Yu disappeared, the pets could still feel Shi Yu’s voice, Shi Yu’s existence, and even communicate with Shi Yu.
However, slowly…
As time passed, as Shi Yu tried to let the Beast Taming Space resonate and fuse with the universe’s space and time, he entered the most difficult moment. At this moment, he didn’t have any extra energy to split his mind to chat with the pets in the outside world.
It was even a little difficult for him to think about some things.
Because he also had to welcome the universe. He didn’t know if the cosmic will was considered a strong resistance…
…
No one knew how many times the universe had restarted before these 11 eras or how many universe holders there once were.
Those who maintained it might be born to pursue supreme power, or they might not want themselves, their relatives, and friends to be forced to become universe masters after the universe restarted and died.
No one knew about their will and obsession when they contracted the universe, but Shi Yu might be the first to try to break through the defense of the cosmic will with verbal attacks.
Although his consciousness was blurry, Shi Yu’s sweet little mouth was still chattering.
“Little Universe, stop resisting. Contract with me.”
“I promise you, just 10 billion years. You don’t have to resist during this process. When the time comes, I’ll leave myself.”
“Just treat me as a friend. See if the previous generation’s guardian pet wants to kill you or if I saved you!”
“It’s meaningless to keep restarting…”
As if it were instinctual, words flowed from Shi Yu’s mouth without repeating themselves, rambling on to the universe, which may or may not have had any awareness.
In fact, after knowing that after becoming the holder of the universe, the cosmic will still wouldn’t destroy and would still resist, Shi Yu had a new goal.
Now, this universe belonged to someone else after all. He just had to become a universe master for a period of time in exchange for time to develop.
After seeing Buggy’s Dream Genesis, Shi Yu felt that perhaps they could still pursue a higher realm.
For example, creating a real universe himself.
At that time, it didn’t matter if he was still the maintainer of this universe. It was fine to return the power to the original universe.
“Mi…” Chi Tong’s consciousness was blurred along with Shi Yu. The Beast Taming Space and the universe space and time overlapped and fused. Chi Tong, who was inside, felt far more pressure than Eleven and the others in the outside world.
In the outside world.
As Shi Yu began to contract the universe, the pets also looked at each other and nodded before leaving.
Without the restraints of a Beast Tamer, the size of the universe was their stage.
However, these pets only had one goal.
To help Shi Yu.
The ones that had yet to reach the cosmic level could think of ways to train, cultivate, and break through to the cosmic level themselves.
As for the ones that had reached the cosmic level, they would think of ways to earn money and resources to feedback to Shi Yu.
“Wuu…” Eleven rubbed its fists and left. It planned to replicate Cypos’s old path and let itself become the strongest in the universe without relying on Beast Tamers to become the new cosmic overlord. It would create the richest Milky Way Army in the universe and create an invincible battle race, the Iron-eating Beast Race, to fight in the universe for it and earn resources!
“Yi. (It’s time.)” Baby Ginseng also left. It planned to continue spreading the Great Dao and gather the power of the supplement races in the entire universe to feedback to itself, nourishing Shi Yu and also breaking through to the cosmic level.
Every pet had its own goal.
Before long, the experts in the Milky Way discovered Shi Yu’s various pets. They suddenly began to be active everywhere in the universe alone.
This made Blue Planet’s Will and the others understand that Shi Yu had probably already started to contract the universe.
…
Shi Yu began to contract the universe. At first, only Shi Yu’s pets knew. Then, seeing the state of Shi Yu’s pets, Shi Yu’s acquaintances guessed this one after another.
However, what made some people realize that something was wrong was still the first round of resistance from the cosmic will.
Inside Overlord Planet, the sleeping cosmic overlord suddenly opened its eyes and snorted.
“Has it started?”
“Get lost, don’t try to interfere with me.”
It muttered to itself, not knowing what it was saying.
In the Worm Mother Nest.
After obtaining the power of Buggy’s bloodline feedback, the Worm Queen, who was in seclusion to break through to a higher realm, suddenly opened her eyes.
“Is this the first resistance mechanism of the universe?”
The cosmic emperors immediately sensed that the cosmic will was wiping away the traces of Shi Yu’s existence.
The first thing that was reflected was memories.
In the universe, the memories of all life forms regarding Shi Yu slowly disappeared.
Unlike when Shi Yu contracted the Empress, where his pets gradually forgot and outsiders were unaffected, this time, the contracted pets remained unaffected, but outsiders without any contract connection to Shi Yu were severely disturbed by the will of the universe.
However, this level of interference could naturally be easily resisted by the cosmic emperors. If the cosmic will wanted to erase their memories, it wasn’t enough.
However, it was very terrifying for those below the cosmic emperor.
From every young Beast Tamer on Blue Planet who regarded Shi Yu as their idol to a super divine peak like the gem cat, they were vaguely stunned. They kept feeling that they had forgotten something.
Space and time were being corrected. Even some of the history Shi Yu had once created and some documents and movies that recorded Shi Yu had been modified and erased.
Facing Shi Yu, who wanted to control it, the cosmic will wanted to completely eliminate Shi Yu from the origin level.
It didn’t take long for the entire universe to forget the name Shi Yu. They also forgot Shi Yu’s pets and experiences.
Just like that, the greatest historical break in the 11th era, the most strange lost historical phenomenon, appeared.
Shi Yu had actually anticipated this because both the owner of the God of Destruction and other beings on the continent faced similar resistance from the universe when they attempted to dominate it.
Firstly, he would be completely forgotten by the universe.
However, could he really be forgotten?
The cosmic will still couldn’t change the memories of the cosmic level, which gave Shi Yu a chance to cheat.
Shi Yu didn’t care about the memories of people he didn’t know. If it were 20 years ago, he might have pursued his reputation very vainly, but now, after becoming a universe supreme master for so many years, it no longer mattered.
As long as those familiar faces with good relationships didn’t forget him.
And it wasn’t difficult to do this.
At the headquarters of the Milky Way Archeological Association, the president, Lu Qingyi, stood in the pavilion and looked at the starry sky with a confused gaze. She kept feeling that she had forgotten something important, but no matter what, she couldn’t remember what it was.
“Ning.”
But at this moment, a slime the color of a starry sky opened the spatial door and appeared in front of her.
“You are…” Lu Qingyi looked at Susu and had even forgotten her memories of Susu. All her memories of this universe had been corrected to the fact that Shi Yu didn’t exist.
“Ning.” Susu took out a pendant that looked like a memory water drop and handed it to the other party.
Lu Qingyi was momentarily stunned as she took the memory droplet. In the next instant, all of Shi Yu’s memories—from the cracked statue in Pingcheng, Donghuang, to Blue Planet, and the prodigy who could hear the sound of history—returned completely, with Susu’s help, from the very beginning of everything.
During this process, Lu Qingyi broke out in cold sweat and panted heavily.
“Susu~”
“It’s me!” Susu said happily.
“Is this one of the side effects of contracting the universe?”
“Yes.”
“It’s all thanks to you…” Lu Qingyi said with lingering fear, “My memories have actually been rewritten. I didn’t notice at all.”
“It’s alright. With me around, don’t worry. This is a mission Shi Yu gave me,” Susu said. “If you’re alright, I’ll help the others.”
“Wait, how’s his situation?”
“I don’t know,” Susu shook its head and said.
“Is that so…”
Shi Yu didn’t allow Susu to restore the entire universe’s memories of him, as that would provoke a stronger resistance from the universe. Instead, he only restored a small and selective portion of the memories that were worth recovering.
No one expected this process to be extremely long. It was the first intense confrontation between Shi Yu and the cosmic will.
…
“The universe is forgetting me, and my strength is weakening.” After an unknown period of time, Shi Yu’s blurry consciousness sobered up a little. He didn’t know how the situation in the outside world was, nor did he know how long had passed.
He felt that his stamina was falling rapidly, but there was an endless stream of stamina replenishing from the outside world.
It should be Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others…

chapters.title: Chapter 1959: Sustainer
chapters.content:
Chapter 1959: Sustainer
Editor: Atlas Studios
Everything about Shi Yu was erased in the universe.
Apart from a specific group of people, everyone had forgotten about the God Sealing King who had risen like a comet and achieved the strongest terrifying existence in the universe at an unbelievable speed.
However, the vast universe had never lacked experts.
If Shi Yu disappeared, a new supreme creature would naturally sit in the position of cosmic overlord again.
Naturally, there would be new creatures who would attain the cosmic level and rank at the highest, their names shaking the world.
Countless years after Shi Yu began to contract the universe, the structure of the universe had already undergone a huge change.
This area of the Milky Way had already become a paradise for supplement races.
It became a holy land that countless supplement races dreamed of.
The reason was simple: a peerless powerhouse, who had risen from humble beginnings and attained the cosmic-level by relying on the ginseng baby race, was about to break through to the cosmic level here.
Baby Ginseng seized the opportunity and changed the fate of the supplement races in the universe with its own strength, giving some races without any battle power a chance to cultivate and become stronger, allowing them to protect themselves.
Countless supplement races called it the ginseng emperor and thought that it was the greatest existence.
Of course, there were also countless races who couldn’t wait to tear off Baby Ginseng’s skin. After all, although it wasn’t easy for supplement races to cultivate the “Heavenly Emperor Scripture”, it had more or less changed the relationship of some races, making many races hungry.
“Yi…”
However, Baby Ginseng, who was standing on the Little Zi Star, looked at the sun and moon and didn’t care about this.
Not many people knew that this ginseng emperor was actually the pet of a forgotten person. Everything it did was to help that person contract the universe as soon as possible.
“It’s been 200 years…”
Baby Ginseng pressed down its doctorate hat and felt that it was too stupid. Although it had successfully attained the cosmic level through the “Heart of the Heavenly Emperor”, it had spent a full 200 years doing so.
200 years might be a little too long for it and Shi Yu.
Fortunately, it still successfully broke through in the end. It didn’t disappoint everyone’s expectations. It had already gathered the power of the Undying Divine Medicine in the entire universe and constantly transmitted the nourishing power to Shi Yu.
…
Day after day, year after year.
Shi Yu only knew that his pets were working hard. He could clearly feel the power transmitted to him by every pet.
Especially Baby Ginseng… It should have broken through to the cosmic level.
Shi Yu became more and more awake. In the chaos, he felt that he had had a very long dream. It was as if he had gone through the memories of his previous life in the form of a dream.
Shi Yu felt that this should also be the resistance of the cosmic will. The other party wanted him to sink into the memories of his previous life and forget this life.
However, it didn’t know that Shi Yu had already trained pretty good resistance when he contracted the Empress. Moreover, Buggy’s power also made Shi Yu extremely sensitive to dreams.
The cosmic will failed again.
“What other methods do you have? Use them all,” Shi Yu said. However, what awaited him was eternal darkness. It was as if there was no need for any new methods.
As long as Shi Yu was trapped in this eternal darkness and Shi Yu couldn’t fuse perfectly, that was enough.
Shi Yu was stunned on the spot. Then, he fell into deep thought for a long time and said, “It’s my use of the power of space and time that hasn’t passed. My understanding isn’t good enough.”
“The key to contracting and fusing the universe is space and time.”
“I forgot some important steps. The cosmic will is interfering with my memories again.”
Shi Yu indeed felt that he was still a step away from contracting the universe.
He indeed remembered that he had forgotten something important, but at this moment, no matter what, he couldn’t remember.
It was as if his thoughts were imprisoned, preventing Shi Yu from thinking in that direction.
“Chi Tong, do you remember?”
“Mew…”
“You don’t remember either?”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought, but unfortunately, his connection with the outside world had been severed. Apart from being able to sense the nourishing power of his pets, he could no longer accept any information from the outside world.
No!
Nourishing power!
Shi Yu was stunned. He suddenly patiently sensed the endless nourishing power and tried to obtain some information from it.
Nourishing power of different scales transmitted consecutively, as if forming strings of codes and constructing messages!
This was the “secret password” that Ling had forced Shi Yu to learn back then.
This kind of secret signal wouldn’t be detected and targeted by the cosmic will, but it could form important news.
“Parallel space…”
Under the pain in his brain, Shi Yu was suddenly stunned. He understood something.
“Oh, cosmic will. It’s already taken a lot of effort for you to block my and Chi Tong’s memories, right? You can’t block the memories of every cosmic pet of mine, let alone completely interfere with all our memories!”
“There’s always a loophole in your obstruction.”
“I remember now. You indeed made me forget the most important step of contracting the universe.”
“Not only do I have to forcefully fuse the consciousness of the Beast Taming Space with this universe, but I also have to constantly expand and fuse with all the parallel universes of the 11th era! Only in this way can I perfectly fuse with the universe space and time and become a universe master!”
Shi Yu laughed. It was easy to realize this. If he wanted to further expand and fuse all parallel universes, the most important thing was his spatial attainments…
Shi Yu was still very confident in his spatial attainments. After all, he could even transmigrate to the special universe where Shiyu was…
Boom!!
Shi Yu expanded his thoughts, but at the same time, he encountered the most intense resistance from the universe yet. Unlike the previous instances of mental interference, this time it manifested as a complete space-time tremor!
The cosmic will was like a struggling prey, resisting Shi Yu’s hunt.
The embodiment it brought was a strong spatial vibration. The substantial spatial vibrations, each comparable to a cosmic-level attack, bombarded Shi Yu.
Bang, bang, bang!!
During the fusion process, Shi Yu spat out a mouthful of blood. He felt that the universe’s crudest and most direct resistance this time had a greater impact on him.
If the universe could continue like this, it would definitely interfere with his contract. However, just one time made Shi Yu feel that the damage and impact of the universe oscillation were much lighter.
In its place, cracks gradually appeared on a floating spiritual sword in the Beast Taming Space.
Chi Tong activated a divine skill similar to a scapegoat.
“I’ll resist it. Contract it as soon as possible,” Chi Tong said firmly. Shi Yu also knew that letting Chi Tong share the pressure with him was the best method at this moment. Chi Tong, who had been strengthened to the cosmic level by him, could still resist a spatial vibration of this level for a long time.
As long as he could contract the universe as soon as possible…
“I’ll leave it to you.” Shi Yu nodded and focused on contracting the universe.
Time… slowly passed.
Shi Yu was trying his best to accelerate the expansion of his consciousness. At this moment, his consciousness had already spread back to the parallel space where Shiyu was.
As Shi Yu’s consciousness spread, Shi Yu could also sense that the resistance of the universe was becoming more and more intense.
If it were in the past, Shi Yu would definitely not contract a “life” that resisted so intensely.
However, this time, Shi Yu really had no choice.
Perhaps when a Beast Tamer walked to the extreme, it was to experience contracts in all different situations.
“Soon, soon.”
Shi Yu became more and more excited because he felt that his consciousness was gradually about to fuse with all the universe space and time.
“Chi Tong, do you feel it!”
Shi Yu happily shared the situation with Chi Tong, but soon, Shi Yu was extremely stunned.
He realized that the small sword in the Beast Taming Space had long completely shattered at some point in time and lost all signs of life. Only the last wisp of spiritual power lingered around Shi Yu, blocking the attack for him…
Chi Tong completely disappeared…
“Wait for me!”
In the next moment, an extremely firm grit appeared in Shi Yu’s eyes. “I can become the holder of the universe soon. At that time, I’ll revive you.”
Time passed. The resistance of the universe continued, and Shi Yu’s contract continued.
Chi Tong had bought the most precious period of time for Shi Yu. Shi Yu didn’t know how long this period of time had been, but he vaguely sensed that Chi Tong should have already completed a cosmic breakthrough during this period of time.
Unfortunately, as a Beast Tamer, he was interfered with by the cosmic will and couldn’t notice Chi Tong’s state the whole time.
Chi Tong wasn’t dead!
In Shi Yu’s opinion, as long as he became a universe master, there was no “death” in his eyes.
He could also revive Chi Tong.
“If you struggle again, when I complete the contract, I’ll completely erase your consciousness. No matter the price, you know that I can do it,” Shi Yu threatened.
Boom.
A terrifying might erupted from Shi Yu’s body. At this moment, although the universe was still trembling, there seemed to be a trace of fear in the resistance.
The vast Beast Taming Space and Time and the infinitely vast cosmic space and time suddenly matched the last stroke under the entanglement of the power of space and time.
A new holder of the universe was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 1960: Beast Taming Final Chapter (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1960: Beast Taming Final Chapter (1)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Did the universe have consciousness?
Did the cosmic will exist?
Was it instinct, or was someone plotting against the common people behind the scenes?
This was an eternal topic that countless experts of eras wanted to understand.
But from today onwards, there was a conclusion to this problem for the time being.
“Wake up, wake up.”
In addition, the cosmic will would also sleep.
In the dark, Shi Yu felt someone slapping his face. Shi Yu opened his eyes slightly and realized that he was lying on the leg of a red-haired and red-eyed sword spirit. He sensed a familiar wave and said, “Chi Tong…”
“Looks like I succeeded.” Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief and gradually woke up.
So the cosmic will could also be tired and sleep. Now, he was a new cosmic will.
“Is this the deepest part of the consciousness space?” Shi Yu got up with difficulty. He felt his endless power, as if he could also decide the life and death of the universe with a thought.
This feeling made Shi Yu very excited. However, what excited him the most was that he had indeed pulled Chi Tong back.
“Chi Tong, how do you feel? Are you alright?”
“Come, let me see.”
“Stop daydreaming.” Chi Tong urged Shi Yu, “The most important thing hasn’t been completed. Don’t forget to repair the universe.”
Chi Tong was exhausted. As expected, it was the right decision to follow Shi Yu. Otherwise, this guy would be constantly forgetful and scatterbrained.
“Yes, repair the universe.” Shi Yu was suddenly stunned. He suddenly recalled that the God of Destruction had even cursed the parallel universe next door.
After becoming the will of the universe, Shi Yu realized that the universe really didn’t have consciousness.
Those resistance could only be said to be a law instinct.
Only a universe with such instinctive responses could use the most primitive methods, like a reset, to counteract some damages in a short time. Over a longer timeline, specific races might emerge to save themselves, but that would take too long.
But now, after he became a universe master, he could use some gentler and more subtle methods to change some situations.
“Let’s do it together.” Shi Yu invited Chi Tong and said, “After we’re done, we’ll quietly go back and give Eleven and the others a surprise.”
“It should have been a long time…” “Alright~”
…
In the Milky Way.
It had been a long time since a young man in a panda outfit with a small sword pendant hanging from his neck appeared. He had just appeared in the starry sky with a strange expression.
He vaguely felt a familiar voice calling him.
“Shi Yu, save me…”
The voice came from very, very far away, crossing countless spaces. However, Shi Yu immediately recognized the owner of the voice.
He coughed dryly and crossed over, arriving outside a certain era ruin. He crossed space and time and looked inside.
He saw a big cat covered in dust trapped in the ruins and couldn’t leave no matter what.
Inside the ruins.
The gem cat was filled with hatred. Why was it so bored as to explore the ruins alone? At this moment, its cries were useless. It could probably only wait for Baby Ginseng and the others to discover that it had disappeared and come to save it.
The gem cat could be said to have made a wish for all the names that it could think of to save itself.
“Anyone is good. Come on, one of you. It’s been 100 years!!” The gem cat was about to cry. No one had noticed it for 100 years. Damn it.
“Teacher Ying, what are you thinking? You came to such a place alone.” In the outside world, Shi Yu first smiled before casually destroying the ruins and letting the gem cat come into contact with the outside world.
At the same time.
Sensing that the ruins were collapsing and it was gradually sensing the outside world, the gem cat was stunned, its eyes filled with surprise.
“This voice, Shi Yu??”
The gem cat was extremely excited and in disbelief. “Is it Shi Yu?”
“It’s me.” Shi Yu slowly descended in front of the gem cat and said, “Why didn’t you call Eleven and the others to explore the ruins?”
“Wait, you actually… In other words, you’ve become the holder of the universe?!” The gem cat was shocked and happy with various emotions. It didn’t expect that after making a wish for a long time, the person who was least likely to appear actually appeared.
“Chirp!” Seeing the gem cat teacher, Chi Tong also turned into a bird and landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder, looking at her happily.
“Chi Tong!!!…” The gem cat girl cried, as if it had seen its family.
“Wow, you guys were gone for a long time…”
Shi Yu sighed slightly. It had been a long time. If he wasn’t wrong, he and Chi Tong had spent a total of 100,000 years. In other words, he and Teacher Gem Cat hadn’t seen each other for 100,000 years.
Fortunately, the gem cat teacher was strong enough. Although it was still at the peak of the super divine level and couldn’t reach the cosmic level, 100,000 years was nothing to it.
It was a matter of a nap.
“We just succeeded and returned,” Shi Yu said. “Yes, we sensed your wish immediately.”
“Wu wu wu wu wu,” the gem cat said. “I missed you guys so much.”
“In other words, you haven’t seen Eleven and the others?”
“Yeah,” Shi Yu said. “I wanted to give them a surprise one by one. I secretly came out and didn’t call them. What’s wrong with you?”
“I didn’t expect that even though I’m already so strong, there are still ruins that can trap me.” The gem cat’s eyes were filled with tears. “I just want to break through to the cosmic level. Is it that difficult…”
In 100,000 years, some of the gem cat’s thoughts gradually changed. Bored, she finally wanted to break through to the cosmic level. Her goal was naturally a gem-type cosmic treasure to break through through through evolution.

chapters.title: Chapter 1961: Beast Taming Final Chapter (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1961: Beast Taming Final Chapter (2)
Editor: Atlas Studios
Therefore, exploring the ruins of the era became the gem cat’s main direction.
The exploration of some ruins previously was indeed relatively smooth. This was purely unlucky.
“Speaking of which, do you know that the structure of the universe has changed especially drastically now?” The gem cat changed the topic, not wanting Shi Yu to investigate the matter of it being trapped.
“I did, but I haven’t understood it in detail. It should have come from the universe erasing memories of me, Eleven, and the others in the world,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes, yes,” the gem cat said. “Apart from us, no one remembers you anymore after 100,000 years.”
“It doesn’t matter.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Chat?” Shi Yu originally wanted to use his cosmic will power to check the history of the universe and see the experiences of his pets and acquaintances.
However, now that he had encountered Teacher Gem Cat, he felt that perhaps understanding the changes through conversation might feel more personal and engaging.
It was better to use the cosmic will’s power sparingly. For some reason, Shi Yu has this feeling, hoping that it wouldn’t turn out to be a case of “be careful what you wish for.”
…
A change of 100,000 years could not be said to be small.
Unfortunately, in the past 100,000 years, apart from Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong, Shi Yu’s team had no other pets that had advanced to the cosmic level.
On the other hand, Buggy and the Empress broke through to Universe 2.
At this moment, apart from some old antiques, most people had forgotten what the former Contaminated Land was like. They only remembered the new area of the Milky Way.
Of course, after 100,000 years, there were also many new myths and legends in the Milky Way now. In the words of the gem cat, they were all created by Shi Yu’s pet.
…
100,000 years ago, Eleven challenged the cosmic overlord Cypos alone and won. People forgot about Shi Yu, but they remembered the new [cosmic overlord]. Its name was Eleven. It defeated the once invincible Cypos and became the strongest in the universe.
Now, under Eleven’s lead, the Iron-eating Beast Race had already become a famous battle race. They fought in the universe and unearthed resources. Then, they were sent back to the Milky Way and replaced the original Cypos Army, becoming a new invincible army that roamed the universe.
Under his command, the Beastmaster Bu Lu, Lin Xiuzhu, and other super experts gathered.
…
Buggy built a super dream universe network that connected the Milky Way, the Cosmic Sea, the overlord territory, the Worm Mother Nest, and the Behemoth Empire, connecting the entire universe.
Life forms who logged into the Dream Universe network could freely communicate, entertain, and experience novel things with the Dream Universe network, and the price was only to have a certain amount of physical strength extracted.
Now, the cosmic dream net had long become the most popular special mystic realm in the universe, and the Creation Dream Butterfly was also respectfully called [Lord of Dreams].
…
Baby Ginseng was presiding over the Little Zi Star alone. The current Little Zi Star was the second largest star in the Milky Way. There were still no new lives born here, but it welcomed those external supplement races to settle in.
This was a holy land for countless supplement races to “worship the emperor”. 100,000 years after Baby Ginseng changed the fate of the supplement races, many epoch god supplement races that were enough to attack super divine had already been born in the universe, becoming the overlords of the starry sky.
And the [ginseng emperor] had always been a light to guide them forward.
…
In comparison, Susu had worked hard for 100,000 years. It temporarily gave up its job of cleansing and only kept awakening the memories of some people.
For the past 100,000 years, the erasure of Shi Yu by the universe had never stopped. Even if someone’s memories recovered, it was still possible for them to be erased a second time.
Susu was like a recorder of history, helping some people and making them remember Shi Yu.
However, although most people had still forgotten Shi Yu, even if the history had been changed, no one forgot that the Dark King was killed by a cleansing star spirit and Sea of Stars sprite called Susu. Many people vaguely remembered that such a supreme cleansing life form existed in the universe.
…
What Ling did was the most difficult. It had been assisting other pets, either helping a team of pets better complete its goal or helping the second team’s pets break through to the cosmic level.
Of course, perhaps Shi Yu didn’t sense it clearly, but it was indeed Ling. It led every pet behind the scenes and nourished Shi Yu for 100,000 years. At the same time, it was transmitting some information through the changes in the nourishing power at all times.
In the end, Shi Yu could successfully contract the universe because of Ling’s silent guidance.
At the same time, as the only cosmic-level mechanical juggernaut in the universe to maintain the “cosmic dream net” with Buggy, Ling also monopolized almost all the technological products surrounding the cosmic dream net. At the same time, as the largest battleship supplier of the Iron-eating Beast Fleet, the entire universe knew that a certain mechanical juggernaut was also extremely rich. It was an indispensable partner of [cosmic overlord Eleven] and [Lord of Dreams].
…
Very few people knew that these powerful, terrifying, and indescribable supreme creatures were actually one person’s pets.
…
Of course, in terms of infamy, Little Ji and Duckie were still the best. These two guys had never stopped fighting for 100,000 years.
One side was expanding the continent in the Milky Way, while the other was leading some obedient Abyss Races to expand the Sea of Stars in the Milky Way.
Even those powerful beings not residing in the galaxy know that there were two super fierce beasts here. They often engaged in conflicts at the slightest provocation, causing disruptions in the star domains, with combat prowess comparable to that of a quasi-universal throne.
